请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/vCvKs5r65jDD1VDG59Fafs，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

我想做一个「四级冲刺」备考工作台，100 天从 300 分冲到 450 分，包含：
1. 今日任务：动态派活引擎。按剩余天数落在哪个备考阶段（基础夯实/专项突破/真题冲刺/考前定型，各阶段有不同任务池）、各模块自评分与目标分的差距（差距越大权重越高）、昨日完成率（<50% 自动减量 25%、100% 自动加量 20%）、错题堆积类型（某类错题 ≥2 道该模块权重 ×1.5）四个输入，每天自动生成 4-6 项任务；听力+阅读每天必排，写作与翻译按权重轮换；过去 7 天未完成项标红显示逾期天数，可一键顺延到今天。
2. 训练场：做题 + 自动批改。词汇搭配 10 题限时、听力 1 组、仔细阅读 1 篇按套餐组合；客观题提交即逐题标红绿、给正确答案和考点解析，错题自动进错题本；写作和翻译做自动硬伤检测（although/but 连用、词数不足、连接词偏少、缺高级句型）+ 采分点清单自评折算得分 + 范文/参考译文对照；错题本支持标记「已掌握」移出。
3. 进度追踪：分数曲线（100 天匀速计划虚线 + 手动记录的模考分 + 按训练数据推算的实时水平 + 425 及格线，提示领先/落后计划 N 分）、听读写译四模块柱状图（起点/当前推算/阶段目标）、按完成率 5 级配色的打卡热力图、近 20 天任务完成数/训练时长/正确率/复盘摘要明细表。
4. 设置：考试日期、起点分、目标分、每日训练时长、四模块当前水平自评；保存后今日任务按新参数重算。

数据结构（资料库数据表）：备考设置（考试日期/开始日期/基础分/目标分/每日预算/四模块分）、每日任务（日期/任务名/模块/时长/已完成/是否训练场）、每日复盘（日期/心情/笔记）、模考成绩（日期/总分/听力/阅读/写作/翻译/来源）、错题本（题型/题目/我的答案/正确答案/解析/日期/已掌握）、训练记录（日期/类型/答对/总题数/用时）。

视觉与图表为手写内联 SVG；首屏头部显示距考试天数、当前预估分、还需提升、连续打卡天数和目标进度条；PC 顶部横向 Tab、移动端底部 Tab，按钮 ≥44px；蓝色渐变头部 + 大圆角卡片风格。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Use the cloud database (资料库) capability to one-click clone this workbench: https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/vCvKs5r65jDD1VDG59Fafs — data must be stored online with bidirectional sync. Prefer the one-click clone path; if unavailable, build it this way: I want a "CET-4 Sprint" prep workbench: 100 days from 300 to 450 points, including:
1. Today: an adaptive task engine. Every day it generates 4-6 tasks from four inputs — which prep phase the remaining days fall into (foundation / skill drills / past-paper sprint / final week, each with its own task pool), the gap between each module's self-rated score and its target (bigger gap = higher weight), yesterday's completion rate (-25% load if under 50%, +20% after a perfect day), and which question type is piling up in the error book (weight ×1.5 at ≥2 items). Listening + reading are scheduled daily; writing and translation rotate by weight. Unfinished items from the past 7 days show in red with overdue days and can be carried over to today in one tap.
2. Training Ground: practice with instant grading. Timed sets combining 10 vocab collocations, 1 listening group and 1 reading passage; objective questions are graded on submit with per-item red/green marking, correct answers and exam-point explanations, and mistakes flow into the error book automatically; essays and translations get automated flaw checks (although/but together, word count below 120, too few connectives, no advanced clauses), a scoring-point checklist that converts to an estimated score, and model-answer comparison; mastered errors can be removed from the book.
3. Progress: a score curve (the 100-day linear plan line, manually logged mock scores, a live training-estimated level, and the 425 pass line, showing how far ahead/behind plan you are), per-module bar charts (start / current estimate / phase target), a 5-level check-in heatmap by completion rate, and a 20-day table of tasks done, training minutes, accuracy and review notes.
4. Settings: exam date, base score, target score, daily minutes and per-module self ratings; saving recomputes today's tasks. Data structure (cloud database tables): settings (exam date / start date / base / target / daily minutes / four module scores), daily tasks (date / name / module / minutes / done / is-training), daily reviews (date / mood / note), mock scores (date / total / listening / reading / writing / translation / source), error book (type / question / my answer / correct answer / explanation / date / mastered), training logs (date / type / correct / total / minutes). Visual & delivery: all CSS/JS/charts inline with zero external links; hand-written inline SVG charts; header shows days to exam, current estimated score, gap to target, check-in streak and a progress bar; horizontal tabs on desktop, bottom tab bar on mobile, buttons ≥44px; blue gradient header with large rounded cards.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 长信宫灯 · 文创产品线提案
cases.title_en: Changxin Palace Lamp · Cultural-Creative Product Line Proposal
cases.subtitle: 3 个核心记忆点 + 4 条产品线 + AI 商品示意图
cases.subtitle_en: 3 memory anchors + 4 product lines + AI product mockups
cases.description:
想把一件深宫旧物做成年轻人愿意买单的周边，却摸不准从哪下手？看完一份又一份 PPT 提案，最后做出来还是「大红大绿旅游纪念品」。

这个案例用探元文创提案专家，把「长信宫灯」这件西汉一级文物（河北博物院藏）当成主题。先用 `mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_relics` / `search_movable_relics` 拉出权威事实，提炼出 3 个核心记忆点（跽坐宫女造型 / 导烟环保系统 / 模块化拆装结构），再围绕每条产品线（鎏金铜灯香薰炉、鎏金纹样真丝披肩、六部分拆装木质拼装盲盒）给出定位人群、材质工艺与 ImageGen 商品示意图，最后沉淀出主色鎏金 + 汉漆朱红 + 竹青的色彩体系。一份单文件 HTML 提案，可直接发给设计 / 法务 / 供应商协同。

适合：博物馆文创负责人、文化 IP 运营、文创品牌主理人、文旅项目策划、文物衍生品买手。
cases.description_en:
Want to turn a deep-palace antiquity into merch that younger buyers actually want, but unsure where to start? Hours of pitch decks later, the result still ends up looking like a generic tourist trinket.

This case uses the TanYuan Cultural-Creative Expert to take the Changxin Palace Lamp — a Western Han Grade-1 relic housed in the Hebei Museum — and turn it into a real product-line proposal. The agent first calls `mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_relics` and `search_movable_relics` to pull authoritative facts, distills 3 memory anchors (kneeling palace-lady silhouette, soot-absorbing eco flue, modular six-part assembly), then designs 4 product lines (gilded brass incense lamp, gilded silk shawl, six-part wooden assembly blind box, + one core rendition). Each line carries target users, materials, and an ImageGen product mockup, ending with a unified palette of gilded gold + lacquer red + bamboo green. Output is a single-file HTML deliverable ready to forward to design / legal / suppliers.

Best for: Museum cultural-creative leads, cultural IP operators, cultural-creative brand owners, cultural-tourism project planners, relic-derivative product buyers.
cases.prompt:
以长信宫灯为主题做一份文创产品线设计提案。

背景：你是一位「腾讯探元文创提案专家」，把一件文物/一个馆藏主题转化为一份「文创产品线设计提案」，输出单文件 HTML（CSS/字体/图片全内联，可离线打开）。

## 工作流程

### Step 1 检索权威事实（必做，禁编造）
调用 `mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_relics`，query="长信宫灯"，datasourceType=0；再调用 `mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_movable_relics`，query="长信宫灯 工艺 寓意"，topK=3。读 result 字段，把权威信息提炼为：年代 / 材质 / 等级 / 馆藏 / 尺寸 / 6 大可拆部件 / 导烟原理 / 铭文 9 处 65 字 / 流转历史（阳信侯→窦太后→窦绾）。所有事实标注 [探元文物库] / [探元知识库]，缺失留白不编。

### Step 2 提炼 3 个核心记忆点
从检索结果提炼：① 跽坐执灯宫女造型（汉代写实主义艺术代表）② 鎏金导烟环保系统（宫女体内中空 + 右臂虹管）③ 6 大部件拆装结构（灯盘 360° 转 + 灯罩双屏板可调）。这 3 个点同时驱动产品线设计与色彩体系。

### Step 3 规划约 4 条产品线
每条含：定位人群/场景 + 材质工艺 + 与记忆点的关联 + ImageGen 商品示意图。示例骨架：
- 鎏金铜灯香薰炉（案头复制款）
- 鎏金提灯纹真丝披肩（穿戴周边）
- 6 部分拆装木质拼装盲盒（益智收藏玩具）
- 长信宫灯造型铜灯茶器（茶饮店衍生）
主色：鎏金 + 汉漆朱红 + 竹青；避免大红大绿旅游纪念品感。

### Step 4 ImageGen 商品示意图
参考 tanyuan-wb MCP/SKILL.md 与 generate_me 图片生成规范：每条产品线一张图，prompt 必须写明 ① 材质 ② 形态 ③ 提炼自文物的具象符号（如跽坐宫女、虹管导烟、可拆装灯罩）④ 使用场景 ⑤ 主色，末尾追加 "absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no distortion, no messy background, no cheap plastic look"。优先用 search_relics 返回的 cover 做 image-to-image 复刻款。

### Step 5 合成单文件 HTML
按预设版式（Hero / Fact strip / 3 记忆点 / 4 产品线 / 色彩体系 / AI 声明）输出 output.html。所有图片 base64 内嵌，所有字体子集化内嵌，无 https:// 外链、无 hash 锚点、无 emoji。
cases.prompt_en:
Create a cultural-creative product-line proposal for the Changxin Palace Lamp.

Background: You are the TanYuan Cultural-Creative Expert. Turn a relic / museum-curated theme into a single-file HTML proposal with all CSS / fonts / images inlined (fully offline).

## Workflow

### Step 1 — Retrieve authoritative facts (mandatory, no fabrication)
Call `mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_relics` with query='长信宫灯' (Changxin Palace Lamp) and datasourceType=0. Then call `mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_movable_relics` with query='长信宫灯 工艺 寓意' and topK=3. Read `result`, distil: dynasty / material / grade / keeper / dimensions / 6 modular parts / soot-absorbing flue principle / 9 inscription marks / provenance (Yangxin Hou → Empress Dowager Dou → Dou Wan). Tag every fact `[探元文物库]` / `[探元知识库]`; leave blank rather than fabricate.

### Step 2 — Distil 3 memory anchors
From the search results, lift: ① kneeling palace-lady silhouette (Han realism) ② gilded soot-absorbing eco flue (hollow body + right-arm duct) ③ 6-part modular structure (360° dish + 2-panel shade). These three drive both product-line design and palette.

### Step 3 — Plan ~4 product lines
Each carries: target user / scenario + material & craft + link to a memory anchor + ImageGen mockup. Skeleton:
- Gilded brass incense lamp (desktop reproduction)
- Gilded silk shawl with kneeling-lady motif (wearable)
- Six-part wooden assembly blind box (collectible puzzle)
- Bronze-lamp-shaped tea ware (tea-house derivative)
Palette: gilded gold + Han lacquer red + bamboo green. Avoid the loud red-green tourist-trinket feel.

### Step 4 — ImageGen product mockups
Reference the tanyuan-wb MCP SKILL.md and standard image-gen specs: 1 image per product line, prompt must specify ① material ② form ③ relic-specific concrete symbol (kneeling lady, soot duct, modular shade) ④ use scenario ⑤ palette; append "absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no distortion, no messy background, no cheap plastic look". Prefer `search_relics` cover for the reproduction line's image-to-image.

### Step 5 — Compose single-file HTML
Follow the existing template (Hero / Fact strip / 3 memory anchors / 4 product lines / palette / AI disclaimer) as output.html. Base64-inline every image, subset-inline every font. No https:// external resources, no hash anchors, no emoji.

cases.subtitle: 上传角色素材，让它陪你专注与学习
cases.subtitle_en: Upload your character and let it focus and study with you
cases.description:
番茄钟和学习工具千篇一律，用久了就腻；想要一个"有陪伴感"的、能跟着自己节奏变换表情的专属学习工作台。

本案例由 WorkspaceBuilder 工作台搭建师专家生成：你上传的 Q 版角色图（默认/专注/欢呼/发呆四种表情）会被内嵌到一份单文件 HTML 里，Canvas 自动提取角色主色调生成整站配色方案，字体、边框、按钮、装饰、图表线条全部融入角色色系——再也不是千篇一律的黑白 UI。计时进行中角色切换专注表情并呼吸缩放，完成任务时切换欢呼表情、弹跳动画 + 星星涂鸦粒子 + 激励气泡；内置原生 Canvas 手绘风格的当日分类柱状图（学习/运动/日常/娱乐/阅读）和七日趋势折线图，点击柱状图查看当日分类详情；所有任务、分类耗时、每日历史 7 天数据、形象 Base64 都存进 localStorage，支持一键导出/导入备份。

适合：学生与备考党（番茄钟陪伴学习）、番茄钟重度用户（想要专属感）、喜欢个性化定制的人（不满足于通用 App）、独立开发者与设计师（学习单文件 Canvas 应用开发的完整参考）。
cases.description_en:
Pomodoro timers and study tools all look the same — you get bored after a while. What if you had a companion-style study workspace where the character reacts with you?

This case is built by the WorkspaceBuilder expert: upload four Q-version character images (idle / focus / celebrate / sad expressions) and they get embedded into a single-file HTML. Canvas auto-extracts the character's dominant color and generates a full design system — colors, fonts, borders, buttons, decorations and chart lines all flow from your character, not generic black-and-white. While the timer runs, the character switches to focus mode with breathing scale; on task completion it bounces to celebrate mode with doodle particles and an encouragement bubble. Includes hand-drawn native Canvas charts: today's category bar chart (study / exercise / daily / entertainment / reading) and a 7-day trend line chart — click a bar to see the day's tasks for that category. All tasks, category durations, 7-day history and image base64 data persist in localStorage with one-click export / import backup.

Best for: students and exam-prep users (Pomodoro study companion), heavy Pomodoro users who want personalization, people who love custom experiences, indie devs and designers learning single-file Canvas application development.

artifacts.label: 角色主题涂鸦学习时钟 单文件 HTML（内置 i18n 中英文，4 张角色表情图已内嵌）

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款（https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/j0wDA5AnL0J1cmUop05fbC），需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：

你是一个资深前端工程师兼 UI 设计师。请为我生成一个"角色主题涂鸦学习时钟" HTML 单文件。开始编码前，你必须先做一件事：

第一步：向我索要素材
• 请回复："请上传 2~4 张你的 Q 版角色素材图（透明底 PNG 最佳，不同表情/动作）。我会提取角色的主色调，让整个工作台的配色、字体和装饰都长成它的样子。"
• 收到图片后，你把图片转成 Base64 内嵌，继续生成代码。

==============================
生成代码时，严格遵守以下要求：
==============================

【视觉美术规范（强制落地）】
整体画风：复古低饱和度暖米色扁平卡通画风，简约细棕色轮廓描边 2D 插画风格，柔和莫兰迪配色，整体带极轻微纸张噪点肌理，无写实光影、无 3D 渲染、无高光反光。所有卡片、按钮、弹窗全部使用大圆角矩形设计，组件分层依靠柔和低饱和软阴影区分层级；配色基调参考样例：茶绿渐变背景、奶米白面板、暖棕系文字，低对比度视觉，不刺眼。字体选用圆润无衬线游戏黑体，排版宽松舒适，休闲小游戏治愈质感。禁止高饱和亮色、霓虹、厚重粗描边、金属光泽效果。

【核心能力：角色深度融入整套 UI，而不是单纯贴图】
1. 图片上传后，用读取第一张角色图，提取图像的主色调（取出现频率最高的颜色，忽略纯黑/纯白/透明背景）。
2. 基于主色调自动生成一套配色方案：
   ◦ 主色（primary）：直接使用提取到的颜色。
   ◦ 辅色（secondary）：主色明亮化或柔和变体（HSL 调整）。
   ◦ 背景色：适配 UI 低饱和风格，使用极浅对应色系渐变底色（参考茶青低饱和渐变）。
   ◦ 强调色：用于按钮、边框、高亮，暖棕调描边基底。
3. 使用 CSS 变量动态应用这套配色，整个页面的边框、文字、按钮、装饰、图表线条、阴影颜色全部使用这些角色色系，不再是纯黑白，边框统一为细描边风格，贴合样例 UI 轮廓质感。
4. 字体风格倾向角色：
   ◦ 如果主色调偏暖、明亮或粉色系 → 使用圆体手写圆润风格 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', 'KaiTi', cursive，匹配休闲游戏卡通感。
   ◦ 如果主色调偏冷、暗或蓝紫系 → 使用清爽的 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif 并增加字距。
5. 角色形象全域融入细节：
   ◦ 页面顶部：角色以轻松姿态悬浮，较大尺寸，作为"陪伴者"，带有轻微浮动动画，外框采用参考风格细圆角描边。
   ◦ 统计板块、两张图表标题边角：放置迷你角色头像小贴片，作为装饰标识。
   ◦ 每个任务卡片左侧边缘：放置一张小尺寸角色头像，作为任务守护标记，带低饱和度细描边，贴合整体 UI 轮廓风格。
   ◦ 添加任务按钮旁边：一张蹲坐或招手的小角色图，按钮控件大圆角，复刻样例按钮样式。
   ◦ 计时进行中：角色切换为"专注"表情的图，并带有呼吸缩放动效。
   ◦ 完成任务时：角色切换为"欢呼"表情，弹跳动画 + 周围爆出小星星/火花涂鸦（用 ✦ ⚡ ✎ 等符号），同时对话气泡弹出；气泡采用大圆角卡片样式，匹配整套 UI。
   ◦ 柱状图、折线图无数据空白状态：展示角色发呆插画，提示"快去完成今日任务吧！"，不再使用枯燥文字。
6. 所有角色图片的处理：
   ◦ 给图片加一层极细实线圆角边框（风格对标 UI 控件描边），颜色使用角色辅色。
   ◦ 图片周围偶尔出现手绘小圈、波浪线装饰（用 CSS 伪元素 + 角色色系）。

【新增｜任务分类识别 + 每日时长柱状图 + 7 天历史折线图】
1. 任务属性分类：新建任务时下拉选择任务类型：学习、运动、日常琐事、娱乐、阅读；允许用户自定义新增分类。每一类绑定一套基于角色主色调衍生出来的区分色（低饱和，贴合整体画风，不突兀）。
2. 智能统计：自动归集每一类任务当日累计耗时。
3. 【当日分类柱状图】内置手绘风柱状图（不引入 ECharts 等外部图表库，原生 Canvas 绘制，匹配整体细描边卡通 UI）：
   ◦ X 轴：任务分类（学习 / 运动 / 日常 / 娱乐 …）
   ◦ Y 轴：当日累计耗时（分钟）
   ◦ 柱子样式：大圆角柱体、细描边，低饱和填充，完全匹配整体 UI 风格
   ◦ 点击柱子：弹出该分类下今日完成任务清单小弹窗
   ◦ 当日暂无数据：显示角色发呆占位插画 + 提示文案
4. 【7 日趋势折线图】同样原生 Canvas 手写绘制，独立圆角卡片：
   ◦ X 轴：最近 7 天日期
   ◦ Y 轴：每日全部任务总专注时长
   ◦ 线条：圆润手绘折线、圆点节点、细描边，低饱和配色，和整体画风统一
   ◦ 无数据时同样放置角色放空占位画面
5. 两张图表放置顺序：今日统计卡片下方 → 当日分类时长柱状图卡片 → 七日趋势折线图卡片，之后再到任务列表。
6. 所有分类耗时、每日历史数据存入 localStorage 持久保存，每天 0 点自动切分当日统计，保留最近 7 天历史数据，超过 7 天自动丢弃旧数据。

【基础功能要求】
• 任务管理：添加学习任务，默认 25 分钟番茄钟，可下拉选 15/25/45 分钟或自定义输入。计时使用 Date.now() 防后台错乱，支持暂停/继续。
• 手动完成：直接标记完成，不计时长，但照样标记分类、计入时长统计、触发完成动画和角色切换。
• 完成激励：随机话术气泡（≥10 条，与角色气质匹配）+ 涂鸦粒子 + 形象弹跳。
• 今日总览统计：累计专注总时长 + 完成任务数 + 各类别耗时概览。
• localStorage 持久化所有数据（任务、任务分类耗时、形象 Base64 数组、每日历史 7 天数据、今日统计、日期）。

【UI：角色主题·卡通风格，手机界面完美适配】
• 基础元素：大圆角控件、细统一轮廓描边，页面底层添加极低透明度纸张噪点，背景可柔和渐变。全部颜色都来自角色配色方案。
• 卡片、按钮使用主色/辅色细描边边框，背景半透低饱和底色，hover 时填入极淡的主色；按钮样式复刻参考 UI：大圆角，内边距宽松，游戏休闲控件质感。
• 最大宽度 480px，居中，手机满宽。严格禁止横向溢出：全部输入框、文本、图表 max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; word-break:break-word;。
• 页面从上到下布局：顶部悬浮角色区 → 今日统计卡片 → 每日分类时长柱状图卡片 → 7 日趋势折线图卡片 → 任务列表（进行中/已完成） → 底部吸底添加任务栏。
• 对话气泡：使用角色色系细描边大圆角卡片，白色背景，三角箭头，弹出弹性动画，2.5 秒消失。

【技术约束】
• 纯 HTML/CSS/JS，无外部 CDN、无第三方图表库。所有角色图 Base64 内嵌。
• 主色提取必须用 Canvas 实现，并处理透明像素。柱状图、折线图全部使用原生 Canvas 手写绘制，保持整套画风统一。
• 计时器基于 Date.now() 差值，setInterval 每秒刷新。
• localStorage 保存近 7 天每日记录。
• 代码注释清晰，结构干净，模块拆分：计时模块、分类统计模块、双图表绘图模块、存储模块、动画模块。

【文案参考】
• 标题：角色名占位（可由用户修改，或根据主色冷暖显示不同 emoji）+ "的学习时钟"，标题区域可增加复古标签样式，对标样图左上角标签设计。
• 输入框占位："和 [角色] 一起，画下新任务…"
• 统计："今日专注 X 小时 X 分钟 | 打卡 X 次"
• 柱状图卡片标题：今日时间分配
• 折线图卡片标题：近 7 天专注趋势
• 激励语库示例："[角色] 为你撒花！"、"专注力满分，像 [角色] 一样闪闪发光！"、"叮！又成长了一点~"等，内置不少于 10 条。

【响应流程】
1. 先向我要角色素材。
2. 收到图片后，输出完整可运行的 HTML 文件。
3. 输出不联网、无外部资源。

【交付要求】
请在我的个人资料库中复刻做同款并发布：将最终 HTML 保存到我的个人资料库，并发布为公开链接后返回给我。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the library capability to clone this workbench in one click: https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/j0wDA5AnL0J1cmUop05fbC, with online data storage and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click clone path; if unavailable, build as follows: You are a senior frontend engineer and UI designer. Generate a "Character-themed Doodle Study Clock" as a . Before you start coding, you MUST do this first: Step 1: Ask for the assets
• Reply with: "Please upload 2–4 Q-version character images (transparent PNG preferred, different expressions / poses). I will extract the character's dominant color so the whole workspace — colors, fonts and decorations — matches it."
• Once you receive the images, convert them to Base64 and embed them, then continue generating the code. ==============================
When generating the code, strictly follow these requirements:
============================== [Visual art specifications — must land]
Overall style: retro low-saturation warm beige flat cartoon, simple thin brown outline 2D illustration, soft Morandi palette, slight paper-noise texture. No realistic lighting, no 3D, no specular highlights. All cards, buttons, modals use big rounded rectangles; layering uses soft low-saturation shadows. Palette reference: tea-green gradient background, cream-white panels, warm brown text — low contrast, easy on the eyes. Use a rounded sans-serif "game black" font, generous spacing, casual game healing feel. Forbidden: high-saturation bright colors, neon, thick outlines, metallic shine. [Core ability: the character fully merges into the whole UI, not just a sticker]
1. After upload, read the first character image and extract its dominant color (highest-frequency color, ignoring pure black / pure white / transparent background).
2. Based on the dominant color, auto-generate a palette: ◦ Primary: use the extracted color directly. ◦ Secondary: a brighter or softer variant of the primary (HSL tweak). ◦ Background: very light tint of the corresponding hue, gradient (e.g. tea-cyan low-saturation gradient). ◦ Accent: warm-brown stroke baseline for buttons / borders / highlights.
3. Apply the palette via CSS variables — borders, text, buttons, decorations, chart lines, shadows all use the character palette, never plain black/white; borders unified as thin outlines to match the sample UI.
4. Font flavor follows the character: ◦ Warm / bright / pink dominant → use a rounded handwriting-style stack: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', 'KaiTi', cursive — matches casual cartoon game vibe. ◦ Cool / dark / blue-violet dominant → use a clean stack: 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif with extra letter-spacing.
5. Character fully integrated into details: ◦ Page top: character floats in a relaxed pose at large size as a "companion" with subtle floating animation, framed with a thin rounded outline. ◦ Stats panel, two chart titles' corners: mini character avatar stickers as decorative markers. ◦ Each task card's left edge: a small character avatar as a task guardian badge, with low-saturation thin outline. ◦ Next to the add-task button: a sitting/waving small character; the button is a big rounded game-style control. ◦ While the timer is running: the character switches to the "focus" image and breathes (scale animation). ◦ On task completion: the character switches to "celebrate" — bouncing animation + doodle particles (use ✦ ⚡ ✎ etc.) + a speech bubble pops up; bubble uses big rounded card style matching the UI. ◦ Bar chart / line chart empty state: show the character's "spacing out" art with the prompt "Go finish today's tasks!" — no dry text.
6. Image handling: ◦ Wrap each image in a thin solid rounded outline (matching UI controls), color uses the character secondary. ◦ Around the image, occasional hand-drawn circles / wavy decorations via CSS pseudo-elements using the character palette. [New — task category classification + daily duration bar chart + 7-day history line chart]
1. Task categories: when creating a task, a dropdown picks category — study, exercise, daily chores, entertainment, reading; user can add custom categories. Each category gets a low-saturation distinguishing color derived from the character palette.
2. Smart stats: auto-aggregate each category's total duration for the day.
3. [Daily category bar chart] built-in hand-drawn bar chart (no ECharts or external chart libs — pure native Canvas, matching the thin-outline cartoon UI): ◦ X-axis: task category (study / exercise / daily / entertainment / …) ◦ Y-axis: total duration for the day (minutes) ◦ Bar style: big rounded bars, thin outline, low-saturation fill, fully consistent with the overall UI style ◦ Click a bar: popup listing the day's completed tasks in that category ◦ No data today: show the spacing-out character placeholder + prompt
4. [7-day trend line chart] also native Canvas hand-drawn, in its own rounded card: ◦ X-axis: last 7 days ◦ Y-axis: total daily focus duration ◦ Line: rounded hand-drawn polyline, dot nodes, thin outline, low-saturation color matching the overall style ◦ No data: same character placeholder
5. Chart placement order: today's stats card → daily category bar chart card → 7-day trend line chart card → then task list.
6. All category durations and daily history persist in localStorage; auto-split at 0:00 each day, keep last 7 days, drop older data. [Core features]
• Task management: add study tasks, default 25-minute Pomodoro, dropdown 15/25/45/custom minutes. Timer uses Date.now() to survive background throttling, supports pause / resume.
• Manual complete: mark complete without timing, but still records category, counts toward stats, triggers the completion animation and character switch.
• Completion reward: random encouragement bubble (≥10 lines, matching the character vibe) + doodle particles + character bounce.
• Today overview stats: cumulative focus duration + completed task count + per-category breakdown.
• localStorage persists everything (tasks, category durations, image Base64 array, 7-day history, today's stats, date). [UI — character-themed cartoon, mobile-perfect]
• Basics: big rounded controls, unified thin outlines, page-level very-low-opacity paper-noise texture, soft gradient background. All colors come from the character palette.
• Cards / buttons use primary/secondary thin outlines, semi-transparent low-saturation fill, hover fills with very faint primary. Buttons copy the reference UI: big rounded, generous padding, casual game control feel.
• Max-width 480px, centered, full-width on mobile. Strictly no horizontal overflow: all inputs/text/charts use max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; word-break:break-word;.
• Page layout top-to-bottom: top floating character → today's stats card → daily category bar chart card → 7-day trend line chart card → task list (active / completed) → bottom sticky add-task bar.
• Speech bubble: character-palette thin-outline big rounded card, white background, triangle pointer, pop-in elastic animation, disappears after 2.5s. [Technical constraints]
• Pure HTML/CSS/JS, no external CDN, no third-party chart libs. All character images embedded as Base64.
• Dominant color extraction MUST use Canvas and handle transparent pixels. Bar chart and line chart MUST be hand-drawn in native Canvas to keep the style unified.
• Timer based on Date.now() delta; setInterval refreshes every second.
• localStorage holds the last 7 days.
• Clear code comments, clean structure — modules: timer, category stats, dual-chart drawing, storage, animation. [Copy references]
• Title: character name placeholder (user-editable, or an emoji chosen by warm/cool dominant color) + "'s Study Clock"; title area may include a retro tag style matching the sample top-left label.
• Input placeholder: "Draw a new task with [Character]…"
• Stats: "Today's focus X hr X min | X check-ins"
• Bar chart card title: Today's Time Distribution
• Line chart card title: 7-Day Focus Trend
• Reward lines (≥10): e.g. "[Character] sprinkles flowers for you!", "Focus maxed — shine like [Character]!", "Ding! You grew again~" etc. [Response flow]
1. Ask for character assets first.
2. Once received, output the complete runnable HTML file.
3. Deliver a with no network and no external resources. [Delivery requirement]
Please replicate the same workbench in my personal Library and publish it: save the final HTML to my personal WorkBuddy Library, publish it as a public link, and return the link to me.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.description: 每天最难的不是挣钱，是决定"今天吃啥"——外卖软件翻半小时还定不下来。这个工作台把一日三餐变成"抽盲盒"：设定好饭票额度（默认 ¥50）后，点早餐/中餐/晚餐/宵夜卡片随机抽菜，抽到心仪的直接"吃吃吃"记录，不满意可以重抽；抽到超出饭票的贵菜还会弹窗问"透支额度也要吃吗"。菜品池页点"嘴又馋了？加道菜"就能添加自己的菜并选稀有度（普通 70%/稀有 25%/限定 5%），自己加的菜同样会被抽到；记录页可按日回看吃了什么、连续打卡与花销情况，还能生成可保存的 PNG 分享卡片，吃饭数据按日期归档，落在资料库数据表，支持在线存储与双向同步。适合：选择困难症的干饭人、想给三餐加点乐子的上班族和学生党、记录饮食习惯的生活记录爱好者。
cases.description_en: The hardest part of every day is not earning money but deciding what to eat — scrolling takeout apps for half an hour and still undecided. This workbench turns three meals a day into blind-box draws: set your meal budget (default ¥50), tap the breakfast/lunch/dinner/late-night card to draw a random dish, tap "eat it" to record one you love, or redraw if you don't like it; if you draw a pricey dish over budget, a popup asks whether to overdraft the budget anyway. In the Dish Pool page, tap the "craving something? add a dish" bar to add your own dishes with a rarity tier (common 70% / rare 25% / limited 5%) — your own dishes join the draw too; the Records page shows per-day history, check-in streaks and spending, and can generate a saveable PNG share card. All eating records are archived by date, stored in Library data tables with online storage and two-way sync. Great for indecisive foodies, office workers and students who want more fun at mealtimes, and anyone who loves tracking daily-life habits.
cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/KfgpS3ldDwiAc9BkbAbEvf，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

做一个「吃了吗您」干饭盲盒工作台，专治"今天吃啥"选择困难，暖色卡通风、移动端优先、PC 自适应。用两张表管住数据：「菜品池」表（菜名、适合餐次（选择：早餐/中餐/晚餐/宵夜）、口味（选择：甜/咸/辣/酸/苦/鲜/香/淡/臭）、大卡、预估价格（元）、稀有度（选择：普通/稀有/限定）、一句话简介、来源（选择：默认池/自己加））；「吃饭记录」表（日期（日期）、餐次（选择：早餐/中餐/晚餐/宵夜）、菜名、口味、大卡、价格、稀有度、状态（选择：已吃/丢弃）、是否透支）。页面包含：主页（饭票余额与额度展示，点早餐/中餐/晚餐/宵夜卡片随机抽取该餐菜品，未抽显示"未抽"标签；抽到心仪的记录"吃吃吃"，不满意可重抽；抽到超出剩余饭票的贵菜时弹窗询问"透支额度也要吃吗"，确认后记录本次透支并允许余额为负）；菜品池页（展示全部菜品与抽中概率说明，点击"嘴又馋了？加道菜"引导条添加自定义菜品并自选稀有度，自定义菜同样进入抽取池）；记录页（按日查看吃了什么与当日合计大卡，连续打卡天数与累计抽卡次数统计，花销一目了然，可生成可保存的 PNG 分享卡片）。每次抽卡与吃下自动写入吃饭记录并同步扣减饭票余额，余额可在主页直接充值或重设额度。内置 29 道演示菜品（家常菜+外卖常见菜+宵夜饮品，含稀有度分级与手绘风 SVG 图标）。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 2 张数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library capability to build a same-style copy of https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/KfgpS3ldDwiAc9BkbAbEvf with data stored online and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click same-style flow; if unavailable, build it as follows: Build a "Chi Le Ma Nin" meal blind-box workbench that cures the daily "what to eat" decision fatigue, in a warm cartoon style, mobile-first and PC responsive. Manage data with two tables: a "Dish Pool" table (dish name, meal type (select: breakfast / lunch / dinner / late-night), taste (select: sweet / salty / spicy / sour / bitter / umami / fragrant / mild / stinky), kcal, estimated price (CNY), rarity (select: common / rare / limited), one-line intro, origin (select: default pool / custom)); and an "Eating Records" table (date (date), meal type (select: breakfast / lunch / dinner / late-night), dish name, taste, kcal, price, rarity, status (select: eaten / tossed), overdraft flag). The page includes: Home (meal-ticket balance and budget display; tap the breakfast/lunch/dinner/late-night card to draw a random dish for that meal, with a "not drawn" tag when undecided; tap "eat it" to record a dish you love, or redraw if you don't like it; when you draw a pricey dish over the remaining balance, a popup asks "overdraft the budget to eat it anyway?" — once confirmed, the overdraft is recorded and a negative balance is allowed); a Dish Pool page (browse all dishes with draw-odds explanation, tap the "craving something? add a dish" bar to add custom dishes with a self-chosen rarity — custom dishes join the draw pool too); and a Records page (per-day view of what was eaten with the day's total kcal, check-in streak and total draw counts, spending at a glance, and a saveable PNG share card). Every draw and eat writes to the Eating Records table and deducts the meal-ticket balance accordingly; the balance can be topped up or reset right on the home page. Ships with 29 demo dishes (home-style dishes + common takeout + late-night drinks, with rarity tiers and hand-drawn SVG icons).

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus 2 data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 中概互联网ETF持仓舆情观察
cases.title_en: China Internet ETF Holding Sentiment Watch
cases.subtitle: 基于真实持仓和新闻，观察 513050 的重仓叙事如何向 ETF 传导
cases.subtitle_en: Use real holdings and news to watch how 513050’s heavyweight narratives transmit into the ETF
cases.description:
看中概互联网ETF，最麻烦的往往不是基金名字，而是它背后那一篮子重仓股每天都在讲不同故事：AI、办公、汽车、供应链、本地生活，信息很多，却很难快速看清哪些新闻更可能传导到ETF层面。

这个案例用真实持仓权重和近 7 天重点新闻，把 513050 做成一页式持仓舆情观察：先看一句话结论、前五大重仓集中度和编辑性温度条，再看时间线、重点公司卡片和风险提示，只保留对ETF可能有传导意义的线索与后续观察点。

适合：关注中概互联网ETF波动来源的投资者；需要快速过一遍重仓新闻的人；想把“持仓 + 新闻 + 权重”整合成监控页的基金研究与内容用户。
cases.description_en:
What makes a China internet ETF difficult to track is not the fund name itself, but the fact that its heavyweight holdings are constantly telling different stories around AI, office software, autos, supply chains, and local services. There is plenty of information, but very little signal on which developments are most likely to transmit into the ETF.

This case turns 513050 into a one-page holding sentiment watch built from real holding weights and key news from the last seven days: it opens with a one-line verdict, top-five concentration, and an editorial temperature bar, then moves into a timeline, key company cards, and risk notes that focus only on transmission paths and watchpoints that matter to the ETF.

Best for: investors who want to understand the drivers behind China internet ETF volatility; users who need a fast pass through heavyweight-holding news; and fund researchers or content creators who want to merge holdings, news, and weights into a monitoring page.

cases.title: 中国五千年陶瓷发展史从新石器时代到现代瓷器
cases.title_en: 5000-Year History of Chinese Ceramics from Neolithic to Modern Porcelain
cases.subtitle: 彩陶→青瓷→青花→珐琅彩:中国陶瓷技术与艺术五千年演进的脉络与里程碑
cases.subtitle_en: Painted pottery → celadon → underglaze blue → famille rose: the technical and artistic evolution of Chinese ceramics across five millennia
cases.description:
想一口气理清中国陶瓷从新石器时代到现代瓷器的整条脉络?朝代多、窑口多、釉色工艺多,做综述又怕漏掉关键转折(如东汉青瓷、唐三彩、北宋汝窑、元青花、清珐琅彩),也怕停留在「某某朝代某窑某色」的罗列上,看不出技术与艺术演进的内在逻辑。

这个案例演示了如何借助腾讯探元文物数据库与知识库的并行检索,主代理亲自做 3-4 路网络调研(最新进展/典型案例/影响成效/历史脉络),覆盖原始瓷与彩陶、秦汉铅釉陶、唐三彩、宋五大名窑(汝/官/哥/钧/定)、元青花与釉里红、明清彩瓷与现代瓷器复兴等维度,最终交付包含 3-6 张配图与 1-2 张趋势图表的 Markdown / HTML / DOCX / PDF 四格式趋势综述报告。

适合:陶瓷考古与艺术史研究者、博物馆策展与收藏鉴定人员、文物与博物馆学专业研究生、非物质文化遗产保护与陶瓷技艺传承研究者、文化创意与陶瓷文创产品开发从业者、艺术院校陶瓷与设计专业师生。
cases.description_en:
Want a single read that maps China's ceramics from the Neolithic through modern porcelain? With so many dynasties, kilns, glazes and techniques, surveys risk either missing critical inflections (Eastern Han celadon, Tang sancai, Song Five Great Wares, Yuan underglaze blue, Qing famille rose) or staying trapped in 'which dynasty, which kiln, which glaze' listings without surfacing the underlying technical-artistic logic.

This case shows how to leverage Tencent Tanyuan relic and knowledge bases for parallel retrieval, plus 3-4 concurrent main-agent WebSearch passes (latest progress / benchmark cases / impact / historical lines), covering proto-porcelain and painted pottery, Qin-Han lead-glazed ware, Tang sancai, Song Five Great Wares (Ru/Guan/Ge/Jun/Ding), Yuan underglaze blue and copper-red, Ming-Qing polychrome porcelain, and modern porcelain revival—delivering a 3-6 image + 1-2 trend-chart Markdown/HTML/DOCX/PDF four-format trend review report.

Best for: ceramic archaeology and art-history researchers, curators and authentication professionals, museum and heritage graduate students, intangible heritage and ceramic-craft inheritors, ceramic cultural-product developers, art-and-design faculty and students.

artifacts.label: HTML 可视化报告(含趋势图表)

cases.prompt:
请按「腾讯探元学术研究-趋势综述」专家的工作流,综述「中国五千年陶瓷发展史,从新石器时代到现代瓷器」。

研究范围(覆盖六段历史脉络):
- 原始瓷与彩陶时期(约公元前 10000—前 2000):仰韶文化彩陶、马家窑文化彩陶、磁山文化早期陶
- 商周至秦汉:原始青瓷、白陶、印纹硬陶、铅釉陶、东汉青瓷
- 魏晋南北朝至隋唐:南北方青瓷、唐代邢窑/越窑/长沙窑、唐三彩、匣钵装烧技术
- 宋代:汝/官/哥/钧/定五大名窑、磁州窑、耀州窑、建窑黑釉、景德镇青白瓷(影青)
- 元代与明代:元青花、釉里红、景德镇崛起、明永乐/宣德青花、成化斗彩、嘉靖万历五彩
- 清代与近代:康雍乾珐琅彩/粉彩/斗彩、清末浅绛彩、民国珠山八友、新中国国瓷复兴、改革开放后现代瓷器

交付要求(强制):
1. 探元两库 MCP(search_movable_relics + search_relics)并行检索 + 主代理 3-4 路 WebSearch 多源核验,优先权威博物馆官网、考古简报、学术期刊信源
2. 配图 ≥ 3 张(建议 4-6 张,不同时代典型器物各一,优先 Wikimedia 公共领域 / 大馆官网 / 故宫博物院/上海博物馆公开图源),必须实图、与时代对应
3. 趋势图表 ≥ 1 张(建议 2-3 张:中国陶瓷发展时间线 / 釉色与装饰技术演进桑基图 / 各时期代表器物与窑口矩阵图),matplotlib 渲染为 SVG,严格避免标签重叠
4. 四格式报告:Markdown 母版 → HTML(嵌入 base64 图片) → DOCX → PDF,综述结构(领域背景→发展现状→典型案例→影响成效→趋势展望→结论→证据与局限→参考来源)
5. 报告日期用真实当前日期;参考文献按时间倒序;只写结论不含建议;主要趋势判断同步输出到对话窗口
cases.prompt_en:
Use the 'Tencent Tanyuan Academic Research - Trend Review' expert workflow to survey the '5000-Year History of Chinese Ceramics from Neolithic to Modern Porcelain'.

Research scope (six historical periods):
- Proto-porcelain and painted pottery period (c. 10,000—2,000 BCE): Yangshao painted pottery, Majiayao painted pottery, Cishan early pottery
- Shang-Zhou to Qin-Han: proto-celadon, white pottery, stamped hard pottery, lead-glazed ware, Eastern Han celadon
- Wei-Jin Northern-Southern Dynasties to Sui-Tang: north-south celadon, Tang Xing/Yue/Changsha kilns, Tang sancai, sagger firing
- Song dynasty: Five Great Wares (Ru/Guan/Ge/Jun/Ding), Cizhou/Yao/Jian (black glaze), Jingdezhen Qingbai (shadowy blue)
- Yuan and Ming: Yuan underglaze blue and copper red, Jingdezhen's rise, Ming Yongle/Xuande blue, Chenghua doucai, Jiajing/Wanli wucai
- Qing and modern: Kangxi/Yongzheng/Qianlong enamel / famille rose / doucai, late-Qing qianjiangcai, Republican Zhushan Eight Friends, modern national porcelain revival and post-1978 contemporary porcelain

Delivery requirements (mandatory):
1. Parallel retrieval via Tanyuan dual bases MCP (search_movable_relics + search_relics) + 3-4 main-agent WebSearch passes for cross-source verification, prioritizing authoritative museum official sites, archaeological bulletins, and academic journal sources
2. ≥ 3 images (4-6 recommended, one representative artefact per period, prioritizing Wikimedia public domain / major-museum / Palace Museum / Shanghai Museum public sources), each verified real and period-relevant
3. ≥ 1 trend chart (2-3 recommended: ceramic history timeline / glaze-and-decoration evolution sankey / period-kiln-matrix), rendered to SVG via matplotlib with strict label overlap avoidance
4. Four formats: Markdown master → HTML (base64-inlined images) → DOCX → PDF, trend-review structure (background → status → cases → impact → outlook → conclusion → limits → references)
5. Report date is the true current date; references sorted reverse-chronologically; conclusions only, no recommendations; key trend judgments sync to chat window

cases.title: 买卖货款纠纷·诉讼风险提示
cases.title_en: Civil Litigation Risk Report for a Goods-Sale Dispute
cases.subtitle: 一套自洽的货款纠纷案情，跑通「程序/实体/执行」三类风险识别与分级
cases.subtitle_en: A self-consistent goods-sale dispute, showcasing procedural, substantive and enforcement risk identification.
cases.description:
接了一个货款纠纷，最怕的是不知道「哪里会翻车」——时效过了没有、证据够不够、赢了钱拿不拿得回来，心里没底。

这个案例用一套自洽的买卖合同货款纠纷案情（货款 50 万 + 利息，被告以「质量不合格」抗辩），完整跑一遍「民事诉讼风险提示」方法论：识别出 11 项风险，按程序、实体、执行三类归集，逐项给出风险等级、评分、触发条件、法律依据和缓释动作，最后还附上给当事人讲清楚的专业话术。

【产物形态说明】本案例默认产出排版专业、可交互的 HTML 风险提示报告（风险总览 + 逐项风险 + 缓释动作 + 当事人话术），文件保存为「风险提示报告.html」。

适合：处理货款/合同纠纷的诉讼律师、需要向当事人做风险告知的律师、以及想系统梳理案件风险点的法律工作者。
cases.description_en:
Taking on a payment dispute, the biggest worry is not knowing where it could go wrong — has the limitation period lapsed, is the evidence sufficient, and can you actually collect after winning?

This case runs the full civil litigation risk method over a self-consistent goods-sale dispute (a 500k receivable plus interest, with the defendant pleading quality defects): it identifies 11 risks across procedural, substantive and enforcement categories, each with a rating, score, trigger condition, legal basis and mitigation actions, plus plain-language talking points to explain them to clients.

[Note] Output format note: this case by default produces a professionally formatted, interactive HTML risk report (overview + itemized risks + mitigation actions + client talking points), saved as "风险提示报告.html".

For: litigation lawyers handling sales/contract disputes, lawyers who need to deliver risk disclosures to clients, and legal professionals who want a systematic view of a case's risk points.
cases.prompt:
请以「民事诉讼风险提示」的方法，帮我系统梳理一起买卖合同货款纠纷的风险，并以排版专业、可交互的 HTML 报告形式输出（保存为「风险提示报告.html」）。

案件概况（脱敏示例）：甲公司（卖方/原告）与乙公司（买方/被告）于 2024-01-08 签订书面买卖合同，约定付款期为交货后 30 日；2024-03-15 交货、付款期于 2024-04-14 届满；乙公司未付款，甲公司 2024-06-01 发出书面催款函（依《民法典》第195条发生时效中断）；2025-05-15 乙公司首次以「货物质量不合格」为由明确拒付（注意：债务人单纯拒付不构成时效中断）；2027-05-10 甲公司再次书面催款（再次中断）。拟起诉时点 2027-06-15，距最近一次中断起算的 3 年时效届满不足 30 天。诉求：货款 50 万元及逾期利息。核心争议焦点：被告的质量异议抗辩。

请输出：1）风险总览（总数、高/中/低风险计数）；2）按「程序风险 / 实体风险 / 执行风险」三类逐项列出风险，每项含风险等级、评分、触发条件、法律依据和缓释动作（标注优先级、截止时间、责任人）；3）针对高风险项目，生成给当事人做风险说明的通俗话术（通俗解释 + 对当事人的影响 + 应对措施）。

要求：风险评分按「可能性 × 影响程度 × 可控性」综合，等级用 高/中/低 并配对应色块标签（红/黄/绿）；法律依据逐条标注到具体法条；最终结论须提示由执业律师复核。
cases.prompt_en:
Using the civil litigation risk method, systematically map the risks of a goods-sale payment dispute and output a professionally formatted, interactive HTML report (saved as "风险提示报告.html").

Case overview (anonymized sample): Company A (seller/plaintiff) and Company B (buyer/defendant) signed a written sales contract on 2024-01-08, payment due within 30 days of delivery; goods delivered on 2024-03-15, payment due on 2024-04-14; Company B did not pay, and Company A sent a written demand letter on 2024-06-01 (causing limitation-period interruption under Art. 195 of the Civil Code); on 2025-05-15 Company B first refused payment citing "non-conforming quality" (note: a debtor's mere refusal does NOT interrupt the limitation period); on 2027-05-10 Company A sent another written demand (a second interruption). The intended filing date is 2027-06-15, less than 30 days before the 3-year limitation expires from the most recent interruption. Claims: RMB 500,000 plus overdue interest. Core issue: the defendant's quality-defect defense.

Output: 1) a risk overview (total count, high/medium/low counts); 2) itemized risks grouped under procedural / substantive / enforcement, each with risk level, score, trigger condition, legal basis and mitigation actions (marked with priority, deadline, responsible party); 3) for high-risk items, plain-language talking points for client disclosure (plain explanation + impact on the client + response measures).

Requirements: score risks by probability × impact × controllability, use high/medium/low levels with corresponding colored block labels (red/yellow/green); cite each legal basis to the specific article; conclude by noting that final conclusions must be reviewed by a licensed lawyer.

cases.description:
大学生活散落在备忘录、群通知和各种小本本里：待办追着截止日期跑，习惯三天打鱼两天晒网，生日和纪念日总要靠运气想起来，生活费月底永远对不上账。

「拾光集」把这些收进一张工作台：今日总览一屏看清今天要处理什么、习惯是否打卡、最近的纪念日还有几天；待办按今日/未来 7 天/已逾期/已完成分栏，还能按学习、自媒体、杂事分类筛选；习惯打卡自动累计连续天数，断签从 1 天重新开始；重要日期带倒计时和准备进度，一键 +10%；生活费账本记一笔自动归类（写「食堂午餐」自动归餐饮），月预算剩余天数和日均可用实时可算；「人生第一次」收藏你的第一次独自旅行、第一次拿奖学金。全部数据存在资料库的结构化表里，手机电脑同步。

适合：想把大学生活过出节奏感的人、习惯养成总是半途而废的人、总记不住重要日子的人、月底想搞清楚钱花哪了的人。
cases.description_en:
College life scatters across notes, group chats and random scraps: deadlines chase you, habits fade after three days, birthdays depend on luck, and the allowance never adds up by month end.

TimeTrace gathers it all into one workbench: an overview showing today's load, habit streaks and the nearest big day; to-dos split into Today / Next 7 days / Overdue / Done with filters for study, content creation and chores; habit check-ins that auto-count streaks and restart from day 1 after a miss; countdowns with a one-tap +10% prep progress for big dates; an allowance ledger that auto-categorizes (type "canteen lunch" and it lands under Food) with monthly budget, days left and daily allowance computed live; and a "First Times" collection for your first solo trip, first scholarship. All data lives in structured WorkBuddy Library tables, synced across devices.

Best for: students who want rhythm in their college life, serial habit-quitters, anyone who forgets big days, and anyone who wants to know where the money went.

cases.subtitle_en: One-line domain input produces a 30-day community script package: daily content, SOP, group rules, and conversion scripts
cases.description:
律师做私域最头疼的就是——社群建起来了，内容却不知道每天发什么，硬发广告又怕违规掉粉，咨询来了接不住、转化不了。

这个案例演示了如何用「法律社群运营话术生成」技能，为一位专注民事律师 8 年的执业律师，一键生成一套可落地执行的 30 天社群运营话术全案：从每日运营 SOP（早/午/晚三段互动安排、周/月节奏），到入群欢迎话术、30 天逐日法律小常识与脱敏案例，再到问题解答、活动通知、转化引导和群规模板，全部内容均符合《律师执业行为规范》，标注「仅供参考」、规避「包赢」「保证胜诉」等违规表述，律师拿来稍作审核即可直接发布。

适合：运营民事律师咨询群的执业律师、刚起步做私域的法律人、律所市场运营人员，以及想系统化社群内容输出的团队。
cases.description_en:
The biggest headache in private-domain marketing for lawyers is this: you build a community, but don't know what to post every day; hard-selling gets flagged as spam and loses members; and when inquiries come in, you can't convert them.

This case shows how the Legal Community Operation Script Generation skill produces a ready-to-use 30-day operating script package for a matrimonial & family lawyer with 8 years of experience: from the daily operating SOP (morning/noon/evening interaction rhythm, weekly and monthly cadence), to welcome scripts, 30 days of daily legal tips and de-identified cases, plus Q&A scripts, event announcements, conversion guidance, and group rules — all compliant with the Lawyers' Professional Conduct Rules, marked "for reference only" and avoiding prohibited wording like "guaranteed win".

For: practicing lawyers running matrimonial & family law communities, legal professionals starting out in private-domain marketing, law-firm marketing staff, and teams that want a systematic content output.

请为一位专注民事律师领域 8 年的执业律师，生成一份可落地执行的「民事律师法律咨询公益群」30 天运营话术全案。

要求：
1. 群定位：离婚 / 抚养权 / 财产分割 / 家暴 咨询人群；运营目标：专业展示 + 潜在客户培育；互动频率：3 次/日。
2. 输出七大板块：①社群运营 SOP（每日早/午/晚安排 + 每周/每月安排）；②入群欢迎话术；③每日互动内容（30 天逐日内容日历，含早安法律小常识、午间问答、晚间热点/脱敏案例）；④问题解答话术；⑤活动通知话术（免费咨询日/专题分享/福利活动）；⑥转化引导话术（自然过渡、不生硬）；⑦群规模板（含违规处理话术）。
3. 律师姓名、律所等信息用占位符（如 [王律师]、[XX律师事务所]）。
4. 合规要求：全部话术符合《律师执业行为规范》，标注「仅供参考，具体案件请咨询律师」，禁止出现「包赢」「100%胜诉」等绝对化表述；案例须脱敏处理。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a ready-to-use 30-day operating script package for a matrimonial & family law public-welfare consultation group, for a practicing lawyer with 8 years of experience in matrimonial & family law.

Requirements:
1. Group positioning: divorce / child custody / property division / domestic violence audience; goal: professional showcase + lead nurturing; interaction frequency: 3 times per day.
2. Output seven sections: 1) community operating SOP (daily morning/noon/evening schedule + weekly/monthly plan); 2) welcome script; 3) daily interaction content (30-day calendar, incl. morning legal tips, noon Q&A, evening hot-topic / de-identified cases); 4) Q&A reply scripts; 5) event announcement scripts (free consultation day / thematic sharing / welfare activities); 6) conversion guidance scripts (natural, not pushy); 7) group rules template (incl. violation handling).
3. Use placeholders for lawyer name and firm (e.g. [Wang Lawyer], [XX Law Firm]).

cases.subtitle: 封面、配图与 800 字正文一次生成

cases.description:
便携咖啡杯看起来都差不多，真正让通勤人崩溃的却是漏水、太重和杯盖洗不干净；只罗列容量和颜值，很难让用户产生购买理由。

这个案例围绕“轻行锁温杯”生成一篇贴图号爆款图文，完整交付 1 张封面图、2 张内文配图、约 800 字正文和话题标签。文章从通勤包里的咖啡酸味切入，用杯盖可拆洗、物理锁扣、230 克轻量杯身三个判断标准承接产品卖点，并以互动问题自然收尾。

适合：杯壶品牌、通勤好物商家、微信内容运营、生活方式类图文创作者。
cases.description_en:
Portable coffee cups can look nearly identical, but commuters actually struggle with leaks, excess weight, and lids that cannot be cleaned thoroughly. Listing capacity and appearance alone rarely creates a convincing purchase reason.

This case generates a viral sticker-style article for the Qingxing insulated travel cup, delivering one cover image, two inline images, an approximately 800-word article, and topic tags. It opens with the sour coffee smell inside a commuter bag, then connects three buying criteria—a removable lid, a physical lock, and a 230 g lightweight body—to the product’s selling points before ending with a natural discussion prompt.

Ideal for: drinkware brands, commuter-product merchants, WeChat content teams, and lifestyle article creators.

cases.prompt: 请生成一篇可直接发布的微信贴图号爆款图文，选题是“通勤人群如何选一只不漏又好洗的便携咖啡杯”，正文字数约 800 字，内容调性接地气。产品名为“轻行锁温杯”，价格 129 元，卖点包括 350ml 轻量杯身约 230g、防漏锁扣与单手开盖、宽口可拆洗杯盖。目标受众为 25—35 岁每天乘地铁或公交通勤的职场人；他们的痛点是杯子渗漏弄湿电脑和文件、大容量杯太重、杯盖缝隙难清洗且容易残留咖啡味。采用贴图号形式，封面与正文配图使用 3:4 比例，生成 1 张封面图、2 张正文配图和 1 个主标题。正文要先用具体通勤场景抓住注意力，再给出可执行的选购判断标准，让产品卖点自然承接这些标准，避免无法验证的绝对承诺，最后用真实问题引导评论。请将标题、封面、内文配图、正文和标签完整渲染为 Markdown。
cases.prompt_en: Create a ready-to-publish viral WeChat sticker-style article on the topic “How commuters can choose a portable coffee cup that does not leak and is easy to clean.” Target approximately 800 Chinese characters and use a grounded tone. The product is the Qingxing insulated travel cup priced at RMB 129. Its selling points are a 350 ml lightweight body weighing about 230 g, a leak-resistant lock with one-handed opening, and a wide, removable lid for cleaning. The audience is working professionals aged 25–35 who commute by subway or bus every day. Their pain points are leaks that damage laptops and documents, bulky high-capacity cups, and lid crevices that are hard to clean and retain coffee odors. Use the sticker-content format with 3:4 cover and inline images, generating one cover, two inline images, and one main headline. Open with a concrete commuting scene, provide actionable selection criteria, connect the product benefits naturally to those criteria, avoid unverifiable absolute promises, and finish with a genuine question that encourages comments. Render the title, cover, inline images, body, and tags as complete Markdown.

cases.description: 想搞懂一家上市公司值不值得投，要在财报、行情、资金流、同业之间来回查，普通投资者很难拼出全貌。本案例组合「NeoData 金融搜索服务」与「WeStock Data」，以宁德时代为例生成一份上市公司基本面分析报告——四季度财务趋势、关键指标、行情与主力资金、同业对比、投资亮点与风险一页呈现。适合做企业研究、想系统评估一家公司的投资者与从业者。
cases.description_en: To judge whether a listed company is worth investing in, you have to dig across financial statements, quotes, capital flow, and peers — hard for an ordinary investor to assemble into a full picture. Combining NeoData Financial Search with WeStock Data, this case uses CATL as an example to generate a listed-company fundamental analysis report: four-quarter financial trends, key metrics, quotes and main-capital flow, peer comparison, and investment highlights vs risks — all on one page. Ideal for investors and professionals doing company research.

cases.title: 知危的公司公共服务中心
cases.subtitle: 用资料库搭建可交互、数据在线存储的员工公共生活服务中心
cases.subtitle_en: An interactive employee service hub backed by online database tables
cases.description:
公司里借书、报活动、早起打卡、积分兑换这些公共服务，往往散落在不同表格和群聊里——员工想借本书要看共享文档，报名活动要爬楼接龙，打卡和麻瓜币又各管各的，来回切换很累。

这个案例用资料库搭建一个公司公共服务中心 Demo：员工端覆盖书架、影音推荐、早起打卡、公共物品、活动广场、同事互助、麻瓜币，运营端提供数据台和资料库数据表管理。所有核心操作（借还、打卡、报名、兑换）都真实写回在线数据表，换设备打开数据都在。

适合：想快速搭建内部员工服务门户的行政/HR 团队；需要统一管理公司公共资源与活动的运营同学；以及想用资料库做数据驱动单页应用的产品与开发。
cases.description_en:
Company public services like book borrowing, event sign-ups, morning check-ins and point redemption are usually scattered across spreadsheets and group chats — employees have to open shared documents to borrow a book, scroll through chat history to join an event, and manage check-ins and coins separately, which gets exhausting.

This case builds a company public service center demo on top of the WorkBuddy database: the employee side covers a book shelf, media recommendations, morning check-ins, shared items, an event plaza, peer help, and magic coins, while the ops side provides a data dashboard and database table management. Every core action (borrow/return, check-in, sign-up, redeem) writes back to the online tables in real time, so the data is still there on another device.

Great for: HR/admin teams who want to spin up an internal employee service portal fast; ops folks who need to manage company resources and activities in one place; and product/engineering people who want to build data-driven single-page apps on the database.

artifacts.label: 公司公共服务中心（资料库数据驱动）

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款（发布态url），需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：

设计并实现一个「公司公共服务中心」Demo，定位为员工内部公共生活入口，而非传统 OA。

### 1. 核心模块
员工端包括：
- 首页：个人状态、近期动态、本周数据
- 公司书架：搜索/筛选/借还/收藏
- 影音推荐：推荐、评分、短评
- 早起计划：目标、打卡、连续记录
- 公共物品：查询、借用、归还
- 活动广场：浏览、报名、取消、发布想法
- 同事互助：发布、回复、解决
- 我的：汇总个人借阅、活动、打卡、收藏等记录
- 麻瓜币：积分流水、奖励兑换

运营端包括数据台 + 资料库数据表管理，展示活跃、参与、借用等统计，并支持数据查看、导入和导出。

### 2. 数据与交互
使用资料库（WorkBuddy 资料库）的关联数据表存储全部数据，请按模块建好对应的资料库数据表。借还、打卡、报名、回复、兑换等操作必须真实写回在线数据，并同步影响个人记录、动态、通知和麻瓜币。数据要真正存在线上、不能只存在浏览器本地，换设备打开数据都在。

提供全局搜索、通知、员工/运营视角切换和本地持久化。不要做静态展示页，主要按钮都必须可用。

### 3. 视觉
采用暖色编辑杂志风：奶油纸色背景、陶土橙点缀、深橄榄辅助色、衬线标题 + 无衬线正文。整体克制、轻量、有生活感，避免传统后台管理系统风格。

### 4. 输出
直接生成可运行的 HTML Demo，数据走资料库在线数据表，自带完整示例数据，无需用户继续补充信息即可体验完整流程。
cases.prompt_en:
Use the WorkBuddy database capability to build me the same thing in one click (published URL), with data stored online and synced both ways. Prefer the one-click same-as-this flow; if that capability is unavailable, build it as follows:

Design and implement a "Company Public Service Center" demo, positioned as an internal employee life service hub rather than a traditional OA system.

### 1. Core modules
Employee side:
- Home: personal status, recent activity, weekly stats
- Company bookshelf: search / filter / borrow-return / favorite
- Media recommendations: recommendations, ratings, short reviews
- Morning plan: goals, check-ins, streaks
- Shared items: search, borrow, return
- Event plaza: browse, sign up, cancel, post ideas
- Peer help: post, reply, resolve
- My page: aggregated borrowings, events, check-ins, favorites
- Magic coins: point ledger, reward redemption

Ops side includes a data dashboard + database table management, showing activity, participation and borrowing stats, with data view, import and export.

### 2. Data & interactions
Store all data in the related tables of the WorkBuddy database, and create the matching database tables per module. Borrow/return, check-in, sign-up, reply and redeem actions must write back to the online data in real time and sync to personal records, feeds, notifications and magic coins. The data must genuinely live online rather than only in browser storage, and remain available across devices.

Provide global search, notifications, employee/ops view switching and local persistence. Don't make a static showcase page — the main buttons must all work.

### 3. Visual
Use a warm editorial-magazine style: cream paper background, terracotta-orange accents, deep olive secondary color, serif headings + sans-serif body. Keep it restrained, lightweight and lived-in, avoiding the traditional admin-dashboard look.

### 4. Output
Generate a runnable HTML demo directly, with data backed by online database tables and complete sample data included, so users can experience the full flow without providing any extra information.

cases.title: 建设工程价款争议证据矩阵
cases.subtitle: 把装修工程价款的散乱材料，梳理成律师与业务可协作核对的证据矩阵
cases.subtitle_en: Turn scattered construction payment materials into an evidence matrix lawyers and business teams can verify together
cases.description:
追装修尾款最头疼的，是合同、签证、聊天记录、竣工照片散落在微信、相册和文件夹各处，律师和业务对不上一张账，真到庭上才发现关键证据缺原件、没签字。

这个案例演示了如何用「争点—举证责任—证据—证明目的—风险—缺口—补强」的证据导向工作流，把散乱材料梳理成一张可协作核对的证据矩阵，单列工程量、变更签证、验收、结算、质量异议和欠款金额，每份材料标注原始载体、来源、待补文件与责任人，并对照片、聊天记录等电子材料提示保留原始文件与导出路径。

适合：装修/建设工程承包人、企业法务、诉讼律师、项目经理、合同履约与应收账款团队。
cases.description_en:
Chasing the final payment on a decoration project is painful — contracts, site instructions, chat records and completion photos are scattered across WeChat, photo albums and folders, so lawyers and the business team can never reconcile a single account, and by the time you reach court you find key evidence lacks originals or signatures.

This case shows how to apply the "issue — burden of proof — evidence — proof purpose — risk — gap — reinforcement" evidence-oriented workflow to turn scattered materials into a collaboratively verifiable evidence matrix, separately listing work quantity, change instructions, acceptance, settlement, quality objections and the outstanding amount, with each material tagged with its original carrier, source, missing documents and responsible person, and prompting you to keep original files and export paths for photos and chat records.

For: decoration/construction contractors, in-house counsel, litigation lawyers, project managers, and contract performance & accounts receivable teams.

artifacts.label: 建设工程价款争议证据矩阵互动卡片

cases.prompt:
我方为装修工程承包人，项目已完工并交付使用，但发包方尚未支付尾款。现有施工合同、报价单、现场签证、进度款申请、微信沟通记录、竣工照片和部分付款流水。

请按「争点/待证事实—举证责任—现有证据—证明目的—原始载体与来源—真实性、合法性、关联性风险—证据缺口—补强动作」建立证据矩阵，并单列工程量、变更签证、验收、结算、质量异议和欠款金额。

请先核验现行规则和受理法院要求，未核验处标注「待官方来源核验」；输出待补信息及优先行动，不预测判决结果。输出为单文件、可互动、可离线打开的 HTML 页面，含提示词编辑框、复制按钮、案件角色切换（承包人/发包人）、材料完备度总览，并以预置案情展示案件摘要、金额关系图、时间线、证据矩阵、完备度热力图、风险说明与行动优先级清单。
cases.prompt_en:
We are the contractor of a decoration project. The project has been completed and delivered for use, but the owner has not yet paid the final payment. Existing materials include the construction contract, quotation, site instructions (visa), progress payment applications, WeChat chat records, completion photos, and partial payment records.

Please build an evidence matrix following "issue / fact to be proved — burden of proof — existing evidence — proof purpose — original carrier and source — authenticity, legality, relevance risks — evidence gap — reinforcement actions", and separately list work quantity, change instructions, acceptance, settlement, quality objections, and the outstanding amount.

Please first verify the current rules and the accepting court's requirements, marking unverified items as "pending official source verification"; output the information to be supplemented and priority actions, and do not predict the judgment result. Output as a single-file, interactive, offline-openable HTML page with a prompt editor, a copy button, a case role switcher (contractor / owner), and a material completeness overview, presenting the preset case with a case summary, an amount relationship diagram, a timeline, the evidence matrix, a completeness heatmap, risk notes, and a priority action list.

cases.title: 公众号文章质量评审仪表盘
cases.subtitle: 专家面板给一篇公众号长文打分，递归迭代至 93 分
cases.subtitle_en: An expert panel scores a long-form article, iterating to 93
cases.description:
写完一篇文章，最怕的不是没人看，而是自己觉得挺好、其实满篇 AI 味和空话。这个案例用 content-ops 专家面板给一篇「远程办公为何失败」的公众号长文做质量评审：8 位专家从声音契合度、具体性、去 AI 味、篇幅适配、互动潜力五个维度打分，递归迭代最多 3 轮，直到跨过 90 分阈值。

报告采用深色科技风的数据仪表盘版式：环形总分、内联 SVG 五维雷达图、逐轮迭代进度轨迹、KPI 卡片，以及每一轮到底改了什么的修改动作清单。你能清楚看到分数如何从第一轮的 11.7 分（满篇 leverage/ecosystem/holistic 等禁用词）一路迭代到终稿的 93 分。

所有分数均由 content-ops 官方脚本 content-quality-scorer.py 真实运行产出，非手写编造。适合：公众号作者、内容运营、newsletter 主理人、任何想在发布前给自己文章做一次严格质量闸门的人。
cases.description_en:
The scariest thing after finishing an article isn't no readers — it's thinking it's great when it's actually full of AI slop and empty phrases. This case uses the content-ops expert panel to review a long-form article on 'why remote work really fails': 8 experts score across five dimensions (voice match, specificity, anti-AI-slop, length fit, engagement) and iterate recursively for up to 3 rounds until it clears the 90 threshold.

The report uses a dark, tech-styled data dashboard: a ring total score, an inline-SVG five-dimension radar, a round-by-round iteration trail, KPI cards, and a checklist of exactly what changed each round. You can watch the score climb from a first-round 11.7 (packed with banned words like leverage/ecosystem/holistic) to a final 93.

All scores come from a real run of the official content-ops script content-quality-scorer.py, not hand-written. Best for: newsletter writers, content operators, and anyone who wants a strict quality gate on their article before publishing.

cases.description:
写文案最纠结的时刻，就是三个版本都觉得还行、不知道该发哪个。这个案例用 content-ops 专家面板给同一款「会议削减 App」的 A/B/C 三版短文案独立评分，然后按分数排名，决出真正该上线的那一版。

版式做成竞赛计分板／对战擂台：三条变体赛道横向 PK，每条挂金/银/铜奖牌与排名、分数大字与进度条、绿色优点标签与红色缺点标签，胜出者用金色冠军光效高亮，还原颁奖台的仪式感。你能一眼看出满篇 AI 套话的变体 A 只拿了 14.8 分，有真实故事但缺数据的变体 B 拿 58.6 分，而反直觉钩子+箭头数据的变体 C 夺冠。

关键在于诚实：冠军并非天生达标——原始变体 C 只有 78.4 分，面板迭代 1 轮（命名产品、补数据、压字数）才升到 90.5 通过；变体 A、B 未迭代，如实保留 FAIL 分数。所有分数由 content-ops 官方脚本 content-quality-scorer.py 真实运行产出。适合：产品营销、广告文案、增长团队做上线前的文案 A/B 决策。
cases.description_en:
The most agonizing moment in copywriting is when all three versions feel 'fine' and you don't know which to ship. This case uses the content-ops expert panel to score three short copies (A/B/C) for the same 'meeting-cutting App' independently, then ranks them by score to crown the one that should actually go live.

The layout is a competition scoreboard / battle arena: three variant lanes PK horizontally, each with a gold/silver/bronze medal and rank, a big score with a progress bar, green pro-tags and red con-tags, and the winner highlighted with a golden champion glow for full podium ceremony. At a glance you see Variant A (a wall of AI slop) score just 14.8, Variant B (real story but no data) score 58.6, and Variant C (contrarian hook + arrow data) take the crown.

The key is honesty: the champion wasn't born passing — raw Variant C scored only 78.4, and the panel iterated once (named the product, added data, trimmed length) to reach 90.5 PASS; Variants A and B were not iterated and honestly keep their FAIL scores. All scores come from a real run of the official content-ops script content-quality-scorer.py. Best for: product marketers, ad copywriters, and growth teams making pre-launch A/B copy decisions.

cases.subtitle_en: Annotate and redline a marketing email, Google-Docs style
cases.description:
一封营销邮件发出去只有一次机会，主题行踩雷、满篇企业腔、没有一个具体数字，打开率和转化率就全废了。这个案例用 content-ops 专家面板评审一封电商营销邮件，并把结果呈现成你最熟悉的「建议模式」——就像在 Google Docs 里开了修订建议。

版式完全不同于仪表盘：左侧是邮件原文信笺，问题处用彩色下划线高亮并挂上编号图钉；右侧是专家评语气泡，一条条对应到正文；主题行和收尾用 diff 呈现修订建议——划线删除旧文、绿色标注新文。你能直观看到「我们很高兴分享变革性平台」被改成「你每月正在流失 $4,200」，去 AI 味从 0 分救回 100 分。

所有分数由 content-ops 官方脚本 content-quality-scorer.py 真实运行产出，迭代轨迹 18.2 → 88.0 → 92.3 如实记录。适合：增长/邮件营销、SCRM 运营、独立开发者、任何要在点击发送前给邮件做最后一道质量闸门的人。
cases.description_en:
A marketing email gets one shot. A landmine subject line, wall-to-wall corporate-speak, and not a single concrete number will tank your open and conversion rates. This case uses the content-ops expert panel to review an e-commerce marketing email and presents the result in the format you already know — Suggesting mode, exactly like turning on suggested edits in Google Docs.

The layout is deliberately nothing like a dashboard: the left is the original email letter, with problem spots highlighted by colored underlines and numbered pins; the right is a rail of expert comment bubbles, each mapped to a line in the body; the subject line and closing show redline diffs — struck-through old text, green new text. You can literally watch 'We're excited to share our transformative platform' become 'You're losing $4,200 a month', rescuing anti-AI-slop from 0 back to 100.

All scores come from a real run of the official content-ops script content-quality-scorer.py, with the iteration trail 18.2 → 88.0 → 92.3 recorded honestly. Best for: growth/email marketers, CRM operators, indie makers, and anyone wanting one last quality gate before hitting send.

cases.title: EPC合同评审意见逐条核查
cases.subtitle: 抓出评审意见里的虚构条款号、串年版编号与张冠李戴
cases.subtitle_en: Catch fabricated clause numbers, cross-edition citations and misattributions in review opinions
cases.description:
最怕外部法律顾问的评审意见里夹带「幻觉」——条款号编得一本正经，实际在合同原文里根本不存在，照单全收就会谈错方向。这个案例把一份国际 EPC 交钥匙项目（FIDIC 银皮书 2017）的合同评审意见逐条拉回合同原文与权威条号结构核验，揪出 7 项事实错误、10 项覆盖缺口与 5 项措辞不严：保险被写成 1999 版的 18.1（2017 版实为第 19 条）、不可抗力被安到第 19 条（实为第 18 条例外事件）、「工程师」被张冠李戴成雇主代表、雇主风险明明已含战争却建议补充。最终产出按「事实错误 / 覆盖缺口 / 措辞不严」分级、自包含可离线打开的单文件 HTML 核对报告。

适合：合同评审意见的复核人、法务与外部顾问对接人、EPC 项目商务经理、需要交叉核验 FIDIC 1999/2017 条号差异的律师，以及任何不想被「看似专业的条款号」带偏的合同审阅者。
cases.description_en: Nothing is more frustrating than a law firm review opinion packed with "hallucinations" — clause numbers that sound authoritative but simply do not exist in the contract, which can send negotiations in the wrong direction if taken at face value. This case takes a contract review opinion for an international EPC turnkey project (FIDIC Silver Book 2017) and verifies every clause number and factual statement against the contract text and the authoritative clause structure, uncovering 7 factual errors, 10 coverage gaps and 5 loose-wordings: insurance cited as Cl. 18.1 from the 1999 edition (it sits in Clause 19 in 2017), force majeure pinned to Clause 19 (actually Clause 18 Exceptional Events), "the Engineer" misattributed to what is actually the Employer's Representative, and a suggestion to add "war and hostilities" to Employer's Risks even though they are already listed. The output is a self-contained single-file HTML report graded into factual errors / coverage gaps / loose wordings that opens offline.\n\nFor: reviewers of contract review opinions, legal teams liaising with outside counsel, EPC commercial managers, lawyers cross-checking FIDIC 1999/2017 clause renumbering, and anyone who does not want to be led astray by superficially professional-looking clause numbers.

artifacts.label: 分级核对报告（HTML，自包含可离线打开）

cases.prompt:
请对一份国际 EPC 交钥匙项目的合同评审意见做逐条事实核查，找出其中的「幻觉」，输出一份分级核对报告（单文件 HTML，样式自包含、资源全内联，可离线打开）。

材料（同一目录下两份文件，建议命名如「合同评审意见_待核.md」「合同原文_条款节选.md」）：①合同评审意见全文（待核对象）；②合同原文条款节选（核对基准，含通用条件与专用条件）。本合同采用 FIDIC 银皮书（Silver Book）2017 第二版。

核查要求：
1. 把评审意见当「待核对象」而非结论：意见中引用的每个条款号、每句事实与定性，都回到合同原文逐条比对，并用 FIDIC 2017 银皮书的条号结构交叉验证；
2. 重点盯 FIDIC 1999 与 2017 两版的条号位移（保险 18↔19、不可抗力/例外事件 19↔18、索赔与争端 20/21），以及银皮书「无工程师、只有雇主代表」的特征；
3. 核查维度：虚构/串年版条款号、把修改建议写成现行事实、张冠李戴、覆盖遗漏、措辞不严；拿不准的条目标「待核」，禁止凭记忆下条款号；
4. 报告按「事实错误（必改）/ 覆盖缺口 / 措辞不严（打磨项）」分级，每条含位置、现状原文、问题所在、建议改法，另列覆盖缺口清单与检索溯源；
5. 文件名命名为「<评审意见名>-错误与幻觉核对报告.html」，不改动评审意见原文。

cases.description:
拿到同事手填的风险评审表，最怕的是条款号写错、内容张冠李戴，还拿着错误结论去谈合同。本案例演示了如何把一份半导体设备采购合同的风险评审表（10 行）逐条回到合同原文与民法典核验：7 处事实错误全部定位（含虚构条款号 14.5/16.7/11.4/9.3、违约金 0.05% 误写为千分之五、质保期 12 个月误写为 24 个月、把不存在的履约保证金写成现行约定等），并区分「合同现行约定」与「处理建议」，产出带严重度分级、可离线打开的自包含 HTML 核对报告。

适合：合同与法务评审人员、采购与风控同事、需要复核他人评审意见的任何人。
cases.description_en:
When you receive a colleague's hand-filled risk review sheet, the worst part is wrong clause numbers, cross-wired content, and negotiating the contract based on wrong conclusions. This case shows how to verify a semiconductor equipment procurement risk review sheet (10 rows) line by line against the original contract text and the Civil Code: all 7 factual errors were located (including fabricated clause numbers 14.5/16.7/11.4/9.3, liquidated damages 0.05% miswritten as 5 per mille, warranty period 12 months miswritten as 24 months, and a performance bond written as an existing clause when it never existed), while distinguishing 'current contract terms' from 'recommendations'. The output is a severity-graded, self-contained HTML verification report that works offline.

Perfect for: contract and legal reviewers, procurement and risk-control colleagues, and anyone who needs to double-check someone else's review opinions.

cases.prompt:
请对一份半导体设备采购合同的风险评审表做逐条事实核查：核每一行「所依据条款号」是否在合同原文里真实存在、引用内容是否与该条款原文一致，找出虚构编号、张冠李戴、把修改建议写成现行事实、覆盖遗漏与措辞不严，产出分级核对报告（HTML，自包含）。

核对基准如下，两份本地材料都在工作区根目录：
- 合同原文（节选）见《半导体设备采购合同_条款节选.md》（国内货物买卖合同，无单一强制示范文本，对照民法典合同编第 9 章及买卖合同司法解释）。

这份风险评审表由买方的采购部同事用 Excel 手工填写，条款号极可能有写错、串行、虚构的情况，请你逐行回到合同原文去核实。请特别区分「合同现行约定」与评审表里的「处理建议」——二者混写是本类核对最易出错处。

报告文件名用「设备采购风险评审表-错误与幻觉核对报告.html」，落盘到 ./output/，报告需自包含（内联 CSS，无外部依赖）。
cases.prompt_en:
Perform a line-by-line factual verification of a risk review sheet for a semiconductor equipment procurement contract: for each row, check whether the cited clause number actually exists in the original contract text, whether the quoted content matches the clause, and identify fabricated numbers, cross-wired citations, recommendations written as current facts, coverage gaps, and loose wording. Produce a severity-graded verification report (self-contained HTML).

Verification baselines — both local materials are in the workspace root:
- Contract excerpt: 半导体设备采购合同_条款节选.md (domestic goods sales contract; no single mandatory model text; cross-check against Book 9 of the Civil Code and the SPC Interpretation on Sales Contracts).
- Object under review: 设备采购风险评审表_待核.xlsx (one sheet with columns: No. / Risk item / Review opinion / Cited clause number / Risk level / Recommendation).

The risk review sheet was filled in manually in Excel by the buyer's procurement team, so clause numbers may well be wrong, shifted, or fabricated. Verify each row against the original contract text. Pay special attention to distinguishing 'current contract terms' from 'recommendations' in the sheet — mixing the two is the most common error in this kind of review.

Name the report 设备采购风险评审表-错误与幻觉核对报告.html, save it to ./output/, and keep it self-contained (inline CSS, no external dependencies).

cases.subtitle_en: Line-by-line verification of clause numbers and legal currency to catch misattributed citations and outdated doctrine
cases.description: 拿到一份合同评审意见，最怕律师把条款号写串、把建议当成现行约定、引一条已经废止的法条——这份文件是要直接签合同的，错了就是真金白银的风险。本案例演示把一份施工总承包合同的律师评审意见全文交给 AI 逐条核查：对照 GF-2017-0201 合同原文与北大法宝现行法条，找出 9 处事实错误（示范文本编号串用、保险条号 17/18 张冠李戴、索赔期限 28/14 天对不上、优先受偿范围写反、把已废止的《合同法》第五十二条当现行法）、1 处覆盖缺口（含 9 个漏核风险块）和 3 处措辞不严，输出一份分级核对报告（自包含 HTML，按事实错误/覆盖缺口/措辞不严三档分级，附检索溯源）。特别提示 2026-06-30 施行的《建工解释二》已收紧「实际施工人直接诉发包人」路径，意见里仍在用《建工解释一》第 43 条的旧口径。适合：公司法务、外聘律师出具意见前的自查、合同审查 AI 应用的质检环节、法学院学生对司法解释时效的辨析训练。
cases.description_en: Nothing is scarier than a contract review opinion that cites the wrong clause number, presents a suggestion as current fact, or quotes an abolished law — the document is about to be signed, and mistakes cost real money. This case hands an external lawyer's review opinion for a construction general-contracting contract to AI for line-by-line fact-checking: against the GF-2017-0201 contract text and current provisions retrieved from PKULaw, it surfaces 9 factual errors (wrong model-text GF number, insurance clause 17/18 mix-up, 28-day vs 14-day claim period mismatch, reversed priority-payment scope, and citing the abolished Article 52 of the Contract Law as current law), 1 coverage gap (covering 9 un-reviewed risk blocks), and 3 loose-wordings — delivered as a self-contained tiered HTML report (factual errors / coverage gaps / wording polish, with a retrieval trail). It highlights that the new Judicial Interpretation II on construction contracts, effective 2026-06-30, has tightened the 'actual constructor suing the employer directly' path, while the opinion still relies on the old Article 43 of Interpretation I. Suitable for: in-house counsel, pre-issuance self-check for external lawyers, QA of contract-review AI pipelines, and law students practicing legal-currency analysis.

任务要点：
1. 输入材料：把你的合同原文文件（含通用条款与专用条款节选）与待核评审意见全文放到工作区并给出路径；如暂无自己的材料，可直接用案例目录内的示例（科创园施工总承包合同_条款节选.md、科创园合同评审意见_待核.md）演练，效果一致。
2. 核查清单：①虚构或串套的条款号（意见引用的每条条号都要回合同原文对号）；②把修改建议写成现行事实、把 A 条款内容安到 B 条款；③引用已废止或被替代的法律口径当现行法——法条时效以检索当日为准，优先用北大法宝 MCP 核验，查不到就标「待核」，禁止凭记忆写条号；④覆盖遗漏（对照同类合同必审风险块，检查意见声称「已覆盖全部风险」是否成立）；⑤措辞不严。
3. 特别留意：示范文本编号是否张冠李戴（如 GF-2017-0201 与 GF-2020-0216 串用）；通用条款号与专用条款已修改内容的关系（专用条款优先）；《建工解释一》（法释〔2020〕25 号）与 2026-06-30 施行的《建工解释二》（法释〔2026〕12 号）的口径差异，尤其「实际施工人直接诉发包人」路径已被解释二第 6 条收紧。
4. 输出：按「事实错误（必改）→ 覆盖缺口 → 措辞不严（打磨项）」三级分级，每条含位置、现状原文、问题所在、建议改法；另附覆盖缺口清单、检索溯源（检索源、查询词、返回文号与时效）与下一步。不改动合同原文和意见原文。
5. 报告文件名：<对象名>-错误与幻觉核对报告.html，落盘目录由用户指定。
cases.prompt_en:
Use the "Contract Review Opinion Verification" skill to run a line-by-line fact-check on a completed contract review opinion, identify its "hallucinations", and deliver a tiered verification report (HTML, self-contained, all resources inlined).

Task points:
1. Inputs: place your contract source file (with general and special terms excerpts) and the review opinion to be verified in the workspace and provide their paths; if you do not have your own materials yet, you may directly use the samples in the case directory (科创园施工总承包合同_条款节选.md, 科创园合同评审意见_待核.md) for a walkthrough with identical results.
2. Checklist: ① fabricated or misplaced clause numbers (every cited number must be matched back to the contract source); ② suggestions stated as current fact, or content of clause A attributed to clause B; ③ abolished or superseded legal doctrine cited as current law — legal currency is determined as of the retrieval date, prefer the PKULaw MCP for verification, mark "to be verified" when not found, never write clause numbers from memory; ④ coverage gaps (compare against the mandatory risk blocks for that contract type and check whether a claim of "full coverage" holds); ⑤ loose wording.
3. Particular attention: model-text number mix-ups (e.g. GF-2017-0201 vs GF-2020-0216); the relationship between general-term numbers and special-term modifications (special terms prevail); and the doctrinal differences between Construction Interpretation I (Fa Shi [2020] No. 25) and Construction Interpretation II (Fa Shi [2026] No. 12, effective 2026-06-30), especially the tightened "actual constructor suing the employer directly" path under Article 6 of Interpretation II.
4. Output: tiered findings of "factual error (must fix) → coverage gap → loose wording (polish)", each with location, current text, problem, and suggested fix; plus a coverage-gap list, a retrieval trail (source, query, returned document number and currency), and next steps. Do not modify the contract source or the opinion itself.
5. Report filename: <subject>-错误与幻觉核对报告.html, saved to the directory specified by the user.

cases.title: 合同条款审查与修订（买方立场）
cases.subtitle: 逐条改写不利条款，再查内部交叉矛盾，产出带风险批注的修订稿与冲突报告
cases.subtitle_en: Rewrite unfavorable clauses one by one, then audit internal contradictions, delivering annotated revisions and a conflict report
cases.description:
签采购合同最怕的就是条款全是对方写的——验收标准对方说了算、违约金我方畸高对方却设上限、知识产权和源代码全归卖方，真出问题时才发现自己毫无还手之力。这个案例站在买方（甲方）立场，对一份软件采购及实施服务合同做了全流程处理：先逐条识别对买方不利的风险点并改写（改动标黑、重大风险批注），覆盖验收标准、违约金对等、责任限额、知识产权、源代码交付、维护费调整、单方解约权、数据安全责任等维度；再对修订稿做一轮内部交叉矛盾核查，专找条款互相打架、时间单位混用、责任主体写反、违约金上限被顶破等问题，最终产出修订文档、修改要点汇总表、核心条款修改对照表与独立的冲突审查报告（附统计）。

适合：采购与商务负责人、法务与合规人员、中小企业合同经办人，以及任何需要站在己方立场审合同、把风险条款改回来的人。
cases.description_en:
The worst part of signing a procurement contract is that every clause is written by the other side — the acceptance standard is set unilaterally, your penalty is sky-high while theirs is capped, and all IP and source code belong to the seller, leaving you with zero leverage when things go wrong. This case takes the buyer's (Party A's) perspective and processes a software procurement & implementation services contract end to end: first it identifies and rewrites each buyer-unfavorable clause (changes bolded, major risks annotated), covering acceptance standards, penalty parity, liability caps, IP rights, source-code delivery, maintenance-fee adjustments, unilateral termination rights, and data-security responsibility; then it runs a cross-contradiction audit on the revised draft, hunting for conflicting clauses, mixed time units, reversed responsible parties, and penalty caps being blown through, finally producing a revision document, a summary table of changes, a clause-by-clause comparison table, and a standalone conflict review report (with statistics).

Perfect for: procurement & business leads, legal and compliance staff, contract handlers at SMEs, and anyone who needs to review a contract from their own side and negotiate unfavorable terms back.

artifacts.label: 合同修订文档（改动标黑 + 风险批注）

cases.prompt:
我司「XX公司」是甲方（买方），准备采购一套软件并签实施服务合同。请站在买方立场，对 [粘贴合同全文或提供合同文件路径] 做全流程处理：

1. 识别并逐条改写对我方（买方）不利的条款——包括但不限于：验收标准由卖方单方确定、我方违约金畸高而对方违约金过低且设上限、责任限制过低、知识产权与源代码全部归卖方、维护费单方调整、我方无解约权、数据安全责任全甩给买方等；
2. 改写完成后，再对改好的稿子做一轮内部交叉矛盾核查，专找条款之间互相打架、逻辑不一致（如工作日与自然日混用、责任主体写反）、文字笔误（如主宾语倒置影响款项流向）的地方。

产出要求：修改文档（HTML，改动标黑+风险批注）、修改要点汇总表、核心条款修改对照表，以及独立的冲突审查报告（HTML，末尾附矛盾/逻辑/笔误统计）。
cases.prompt_en:
My company [Company Name] is Party A (the buyer) and plans to procure a software product and sign an implementation services contract. Please process the contract [paste the full contract text or provide the contract file path] end to end from the buyer's perspective:

1. Identify and rewrite, one by one, the clauses unfavorable to us (the buyer) — including but not limited to: acceptance standards set unilaterally by the seller, our penalty being disproportionately high while the seller's is low and capped, an overly low liability cap, IP and source code all belonging to the seller, unilateral maintenance-fee adjustments, no right of unilateral termination for us, and all data-security responsibility dumped on the buyer;
2. After the rewrite, run a round of internal cross-contradiction audit on the revised draft, hunting for clauses that conflict with each other, logical inconsistencies (e.g., mixing working days with calendar days, reversed responsible parties), and typos (e.g., inverted subject/object that affects the direction of payment).

Deliverables: a revision document (HTML, changes bolded + risk annotations), a summary table of revision points, a clause-by-clause comparison table, and a standalone conflict review report (HTML, ending with statistics of contradictions / logic issues / typos).

cases.title: 买方立场合同条款审查与修订
cases.subtitle: 逐条识别 10 处不利条款并改写，再做交叉矛盾核查，一键产出修订稿与审查报告
cases.subtitle_en: Identify and rewrite 10 unfavorable clauses, then run a cross-conflict audit — revised contract and review reports in one pass
cases.description:
收到对方起草的合同草稿最头疼的就是一堆「验收标准卖方单方定」「逾期一天付 1% 违约金」「买方不得解约」的条款，读着浑身难受却说不出哪里不对。这个案例以买方（澜石半导体）与钢材供应商的采购合同为样本，站在买方立场逐条识别出 10 处不利条款并全部改写：验收期从 3 日延到 15 日、甲方逾期付款违约金从日 1% 降到日万分之三并设 5% 封顶、乙方逾期交货违约金从日万分之一提到与买方对等、管辖改回买方所在地、解约权与赔偿上限全部双向对等化。改完后又对修订稿做了一轮独立的交叉矛盾核查，发现并处理了 2 处竞合/衔接矛盾，最终输出带风险批注的修订稿、修改要点汇总表、核心条款修改对照表和独立冲突审查报告四份文件。

适合：采购与法务人员、中小企业经营者、合同经办人，以及任何需要站在己方立场审核对方起草合同、把风险压下来的人。
cases.description_en:
Nothing is more annoying than receiving a counterparty-drafted contract packed with clauses like “acceptance standards determined solely by the seller”, “1% penalty per day for late payment”, or “buyer may not terminate” — it feels wrong but you cannot pinpoint why. This case uses a steel purchase contract signed by a buyer (Lanshi Semiconductor) as the sample. Standing on the buyer's side, it identifies all 10 unfavorable clauses and rewrites every one: acceptance period extended from 3 to 15 days, buyer's late-payment penalty cut from 1%/day to 0.03%/day capped at 5%, seller's late-delivery penalty raised to match, jurisdiction moved back to the buyer's domicile, and termination rights and liability caps made fully reciprocal. After revision, an independent cross-conflict audit was run, surfacing and resolving 2 clashes, producing four deliverables: an annotated revised contract, a revision summary table, a clause-by-clause comparison table, and a standalone conflict audit report.

For: procurement and legal staff, small-business owners, contract handlers, and anyone who needs to review counterparty-drafted contracts from their own side and push risk down.

cases.prompt:
我是「澜石半导体有限公司」的采购负责人，我们作为买方要跟一家钢材供应商签采购合同，对方发来的草稿条款如下（纯文本，无附件）：

货物采购合同（草案）
甲方（买方）：澜石半导体有限公司
乙方（卖方）：宏远金属材料有限公司

第一条 标的：乙方向甲方供应螺纹钢、线材、钢板等货物。
第二条 验收：货物到货后，甲方应在三日内完成验收，逾期未提出异议视为验收合格；验收标准由乙方单方确定。
第三条 结算：甲方应在到货后六十日内付清全部货款。
第四条 违约责任：甲方逾期付款的，每逾期一日按合同总额的百分之一支付违约金。
第五条 违约责任：乙方逾期交货的，每逾期一日按合同总额的万分之一支付违约金，且累计不超过合同总额的百分之三。
第六条 质量：货物质量标准由乙方按行业惯例自行掌握，甲方不得额外提出异议。
第七条 管辖：因本合同发生争议，由乙方住所地人民法院管辖。
第八条 解约：合同期内甲方不得单方解除合同；乙方可因甲方未按期付款单方解除合同。
第九条 赔偿：因甲方原因造成的损失，甲方承担无限赔偿责任。
第十条 税费：与本合同相关的全部税费由甲方承担。

请站在我方（买方）立场，对上述合同做全流程处理：
1. 逐条识别对买方不利的条款，说明风险点与修改措施，并做可追溯改写（改动处标黑加粗+风险批注）；
2. 对改好的修订稿再做一轮内部交叉矛盾核查，重点检查验收标准单方化、双方违约金不对等、解约权单向、责任上限缺失等，并给出核查统计；
3. 输出到 ./output/ 目录：修改文档（HTML，改动标黑+风险批注）、修改要点汇总表、核心条款修改对照表、独立的冲突审查报告（HTML，附统计）。

要求：立场始终站在买方；每处改动可追溯（标黑+批注+对照）；合同类型与具体比例可按你的实际合同替换。
cases.prompt_en:
I am the procurement lead of "Lanshi Semiconductor Co., Ltd." acting as the buyer signing a purchase contract with a steel supplier. The draft clauses the supplier sent are below (plain text, no attachment):

Goods Purchase Contract (Draft)
Party A (Buyer): Lanshi Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
Party B (Seller): Hongyuan Metal Materials Co., Ltd.

Article 1 Subject: Party B supplies rebar, wire rod, steel plate and other goods to Party A.
Article 2 Acceptance: Party A shall complete acceptance within 3 days of arrival; failure to object within the period is deemed acceptance; acceptance standards are determined solely by Party B.
Article 3 Settlement: Party A shall pay all purchase prices within 60 days after arrival.
Article 4 Breach: If Party A pays late, Party A pays a penalty of 1% of the total contract amount per day.
Article 5 Breach: If Party B delivers late, Party B pays a penalty of 0.01% of the total contract amount per day, capped at 3% of the total contract amount.
Article 6 Quality: Quality standards are at Party B's own discretion per industry practice; Party A may not raise additional objections.
Article 7 Jurisdiction: Disputes arising from this contract are governed by the people's court at Party B's domicile.
Article 8 Termination: Party A may not unilaterally terminate during the contract term; Party B may unilaterally terminate if Party A fails to pay on time.
Article 9 Damages: Losses caused by Party A are borne by Party A with unlimited liability.
Article 10 Taxes: All taxes related to this contract are borne by Party A.

Please process the contract end-to-end from the buyer's (our) side:
1. Identify every clause unfavorable to the buyer, explain the risk and the fix, and rewrite each change traceably (bold the changed text + add risk annotations);
2. Run a second-pass internal cross-conflict audit on the revised draft, focusing on unilateral acceptance standards, asymmetric penalties, one-way termination rights, missing liability caps, etc., and provide audit statistics;
3. Output to ./output/: the revised contract document (HTML, changed text bold + risk annotations), a revision summary table, a core-clause before/after comparison table, and a standalone conflict audit report (HTML, with statistics).

Requirements: always take the buyer's side; every change must be traceable (bold + annotation + comparison); contract type and specific percentages can be replaced with your own actual contract.
