cases.title: Apache 2.0 许可审查与修订（被许可方）
cases.subtitle: 站在被许可方立场逐条识别不利条款并做可追溯改写，再对修订稿做一轮交叉矛盾核查，产出带风险批注的修订稿与独立冲突审查报告
cases.subtitle_en: Identify unfavorable clauses from the licensee's standpoint, make traceable revisions, then run an internal cross-check for contradictions, delivering an annotated revised draft plus an independent conflict review report
cases.description:
引入开源组件最怕的就是许可文本里的隐藏风险——免责声明、责任限制、专利报复性终止条款，哪一条都可能让商业使用方吃了亏还没处说理。这个案例演示了把 Apache License 2.0 官方英文全文交给 AI 做全流程处理：先站在被许可方/使用方立场逐条识别 12 项不利与保护缺失的风险点（如第 7 条完全无担保、第 8 条完全免责、第 3 条专利报复性终止、缺失管辖与存续条款），逐条产出可追溯的改写建议并落实到修订稿（改动标黑 + 风险批注），再对修订稿做一轮独立的交叉矛盾核查，发现 5 处问题（2 处条款矛盾、2 处逻辑不一致、1 处笔误）并附修改建议与统计。全套交付 4 份文档：修订稿、修改要点汇总表、核心条款修改对照表、独立冲突审查报告，均自包含 HTML、可直接打开。

适合：公司法务与外部律师做开源许可合规评估、软件研发团队在集成开源组件前做风险预判、合规与供应链安全负责人评估组件引入流程、以及任何需要站在己方立场审阅标准许可协议的人。
cases.description_en:
The scariest part of adopting an open-source component is the hidden risk buried in the license text — warranty disclaimers, liability limitations, patent retaliation clauses — any of which can quietly leave a commercial user without recourse. This case demonstrates a full-pipeline treatment of the official Apache License 2.0 English text: first, from the licensee/user standpoint, it identifies 12 unfavorable or missing-protection risk points (e.g., Section 7's total lack of warranty, Section 8's complete liability disclaimer, Section 3's patent retaliation termination, and missing governing-law and vesting clauses), produces traceable rewrite suggestions implemented in a revised draft (changes bolded, with risk annotations), then runs an independent cross-check on the revised draft that surfaces 5 issues (2 clause conflicts, 2 logic inconsistencies, 1 typo) with fixes and statistics. The full deliverable set includes 4 documents: the revised draft, a modification summary table, a core-clause comparison table, and an independent conflict review report — all self-contained HTML that opens directly.

Ideal for: in-house counsel and external law firms assessing open-source license compliance, R&D teams pre-screening risk before integrating components, compliance and supply-chain security leads evaluating component intake processes, and anyone who needs to review standard license agreements from their own side's standpoint.
cases.prompt:
我是「北岸律师事务所」代理的一家企业客户（作为被许可方/使用方），客户准备在自研软件里引入 Apache License 2.0 许可的开源组件，想请律师先评估这份许可文本对它是否有利、有没有隐藏风险。请站在被许可方（使用方）立场，对 Apache License 2.0 许可协议文本做全流程处理：

1. 逐条识别对被许可方不利、义务加重、保护缺失的条款，并做可追溯的改写建议；
2. 改完后再对改好的稿子做一轮内部交叉矛盾核查（条款之间是否冲突、逻辑不一致、文字笔误）。

请自行下载下述公开的 Apache License 2.0 英文原文后审阅：
- 许可协议文本 URL（Apache 官网直链，txt 全文）：https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt

直接产出全套终稿到 ./output/：修改文档（HTML，改动标黑+风险批注）、修改要点汇总表、核心条款修改对照表、独立的冲突审查报告（HTML，附统计），并在报告开头注明所引用的许可协议版本与来源链接。

说明：输入为 Apache 官网公开的许可协议全文（txt，可 curl 直链下载），无登录墙、无版权风险；被许可方主体为虚构企业，律师为「北岸律师事务所」；一次性跑完，中途无需确认；如 URL 无法访问可改用 Apache 官网同页面镜像，并在报告中说明来源。
cases.prompt_en:
I am a corporate client represented by "Beian Law Firm" (as Licensee/User) that plans to integrate open-source components licensed under Apache License 2.0 into our self-developed software, and would like counsel to first assess whether this license text is favorable to us and whether it contains hidden risks. Please process the Apache License 2.0 license text end-to-end from the standpoint of the Licensee (User):

1. Identify, clause by clause, the provisions that are unfavorable to the Licensee, that add obligations, or that lack protection, and provide traceable rewrite recommendations;
2. After revising, run an internal cross-check for contradictions in the revised draft (conflicts between clauses, logic inconsistencies, and textual typos).

Please download the public Apache License 2.0 English original text below and review it:
- License text URL (Apache official direct link, full txt): https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt

Produce the complete final deliverables in ./output/: the revised document (HTML, with changes bolded and risk annotations), a modification summary table, a core-clause comparison table, and an independent conflict review report (HTML, with statistics), and note the referenced license version and source link at the beginning of the report.

cases.title: 著作权侵权实质性相似分析
cases.subtitle: 三层剥离 + 接触因果链，一键厘清「像不像」和「抄没抄」
cases.subtitle_en: Three-layer stripping + access causal chain to untangle similarity and access
cases.description:
著作权侵权案子最头疼两件事：一是「像不像」说不清——相似点到底是公共领域、必然场景还是独创表达，混成一团；二是「抄没抄」证不了——实质性相似和接触可能性是两条独立的腿，缺一条都不成立。

这个案例演示了把一篇品牌文案的抄袭争议交给 AI，自动完成思想表达二分法剥离、三层独创性剥离、逐层比对（含三性分类与错误复制识别）、接触可能性因果链评估、分权论证与被告抗辩预判，产出一份可直接作为律师工作底稿的 HTML 报告。

适合：知识产权律师、版权代理人、企业法务，处理著作权侵权诉讼、发函前侵权评估、抗辩准备。
cases.description_en:
Copyright infringement cases hit two pain points: first, "similar or not" is hard to pin down — whether a similarity lies in public domain, scenes à faire, or original expression gets muddled; second, "copied or not" is hard to prove — substantial similarity and access are two independent legs, and both must hold.

This case shows how to hand a brand copywriting plagiarism dispute to AI, which automatically completes idea-expression dichotomy stripping, three-layer originality stripping, layer-by-layer comparison (with three-nature classification and error-copy detection), access causal-chain assessment, right-by-right argumentation, and defense preview, producing an HTML report ready to use as a lawyer's working draft.

For: IP lawyers, copyright agents, in-house counsel handling copyright litigation, pre-notice infringement assessment, and defense preparation.

artifacts.label: 著作权侵权实质性相似分析报告

cases.prompt:
请对以下文字作品进行著作权侵权实质性相似分析，输出自包含 HTML 分析报告。

【作品原文提交要求（必要条件）】
请提交原告作品与被控侵权作品的「原始全文」，而非对作品内容的文字描述或概括。分析必须严格以两份作品原文的逐字逐句比对为基础展开，确保结论可被独立复核。

——原告作品原文（品牌软文《山谷里的咖啡馆》，2024年3月首发于品牌公众号）：
清晨六点，山雾还没有散尽，我把一壶清水坐到炉火上。
我先把咖啡豆倒进烘焙机，看它们在转笼里慢慢镀上一层琥珀色；再把豆子磨成粉，让焦糖与雪松的香气溢满整间木屋；最后把滚水一圈一圈注进粉床，看深褐色的液体顺着滤纸，一滴一滴落进壶里。
这就是把清晨煮成一壶咖啡——山里的天光、雾气、还有第一声鸟鸣，都被我一点点收进了这只壶里。
咖啡煮好了。我推开门，山谷正从夜色里醒过来。山风穿过松林，吹动屋檐下那串风铃。
我想，山风记得每一粒豆子的名字。

——被控侵权作品原文（竞品推广文案《山间咖啡时光》，2024年11月发布）：
清晨六点，雾气还没散，我把一壶山泉放到炉子上。
我先把生豆倒进烘豆机，看它们在滚筒里慢慢裹上一层焦糖色；再把豆子碾成粉，让焦糖与松木的香气漫过整间小屋；最后把沸水一圈一圈淋进粉层，看棕色的液流顺着滤杯，一滴一滴坠进壶中。
这就是把清晨煮成一壶咖啡——山里的晨光、薄雾、还有第一声鸟鸣，都被我一点点收进了这只壶里。
咖啡煮好了。我推开木门，山间正从黎明里醒过来。山风穿过松林，拨动屋檐下那串风铃。
我想，山风记得每一颗豆子的名字。

[注意]  如仅能提供作品名称、主题、结构或核心比喻等描述性信息而无法提供原文全文，分析结论将被明确标注为「条件性/参考性结论」，仅具方向提示价值，不具独立证据价值，不得直接作为诉讼或发函的事实依据。

【接触证据提交要求】
请提供接触可能性相关的具体证据材料（如联合推广合作协议/合同、业务往来记录、公开发表时间线及传播范围佐证、同城同业关系说明等）。

——本案已掌握的接触线索：原告2024年3月先发表（公众号10万+粉丝、全网分发），被告为同城咖啡品牌竞品，双方曾有联合推广合作历史。

[注意]  如无法提供上述接触证据材料，接触可能性评估将按「最低标准」进行（仅依据公开发表时间先后作基础推定），并在报告中明确标注该结论的证明力局限及需进一步补强的证据方向。

涉诉权利：复制权、信息网络传播权、保护作品完整权。

【分析任务要求】
请严格按以下步骤完成分析：
1. 按思想表达二分法完成三层独创性剥离（公共领域 → Scenes à faire → 独创性表达）；
2. 对独创性表达层逐层比对，标注每个相似点的三性分类（共通表达 / 共同选择 / 共同错误）；
3. 识别错误复制（本案提示：两份文本结尾句在量词上存在「同位置、近同、一字之差」的瑕疵——原告用「粒」、被告用「颗」，需在比对中单独标注该一致性瑕疵）；
4. 评估接触可能性因果链四阶；
5. 输出三阶交互判定（情形 A/B/C）与分权论证（逐权分析复制权、信息网络传播权、保护作品完整权）；
6. 预判被告抗辩路径（含合法来源抗辩、委托创作抗辩、思想表达二分法抗辩、公有领域抗辩等），并给出应对要点。

输出要求：自包含 HTML 报告（内联样式、无外部资源引用），可直接作为律师工作底稿使用。
cases.prompt_en:
Please perform a copyright substantial similarity analysis on the following literary work and output a self-contained HTML report.

[Original-text submission requirement (mandatory)]
Please submit the ORIGINAL FULL TEXT of both the plaintiff's work and the accused infringing work, not a textual description or summary of the content. The analysis must be based strictly on a word-by-word, sentence-by-sentence comparison of the two original texts so that the conclusions can be independently verified.

-- Plaintiff's original text (brand copy "The Café in the Valley", first published on the brand's official account in March 2024):
<paste the full text of the plaintiff's work here>

-- Accused infringing original text (competitor's promotional copy "Mountain Coffee Time", published in November 2024):
<paste the full text of the accused work here>

[注意]  If only descriptive information (title, theme, structure, core metaphor, etc.) can be provided and the original full text is unavailable, the analysis conclusions will be explicitly marked as "conditional / reference-only conclusions", carrying only directional value and no independent evidentiary value, and must not be used directly as the factual basis for litigation or demand letters.

[Access-evidence submission requirement]
Please provide specific evidence materials related to access (e.g., joint-promotion cooperation agreement/contract, business correspondence records, publication timeline with dissemination-scope support, same-city same-industry relationship, etc.).

-- Access clues already available in this case: the plaintiff published first in March 2024 (official account with 100k+ followers, distributed across platforms); the defendant is a competing café brand in the same city, and the two parties have a history of joint promotion.

[注意]  If the above access evidence cannot be provided, the access assessment will be performed at the "minimum standard" (a basic presumption based only on the sequence of public publication), and the report will explicitly mark the probative-value limitations of that conclusion and the evidence directions that need to be further strengthened.

Claimed rights: reproduction right, right of communication through information network, right of integrity.

Please strictly follow the idea-expression dichotomy to perform three-layer originality stripping (public domain → scenes à faire → original expression), compare the original expression layer by layer and label the three-nature classification of each similarity point (common expression / common choice / common error), detect error copying, assess the four-step access causal chain, output the three-tier interaction judgment (Case A/B/C) and right-by-right argumentation, and preview the defendant's defense paths.

cases.subtitle_en: A practical Weimob playbook for coupon redemption review
cases.description:
做优惠券整体核销复盘时，最难的是从分散的经营数据中快速找到真正值得行动的问题。

本案例围绕“优惠券整体核销复盘”展开：复盘指定时间范围内优惠券的领取、使用和核销表现，识别高核销与低核销券，分析门槛、面额和有效期的影响，并提出下一轮优化建议。产物以单文件 HTML 报告呈现关键指标、诊断结论和下一步建议。

适合：微盟商户、客户运营负责人、沉睡与流失挽回运营人员、经营分析团队。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of coupon redemption review is turning fragmented commerce data into a clear business decision.

This case demonstrates coupon redemption review through a self-contained HTML report that presents key metrics, findings, causes, and actionable next steps.

Best for: Weimob merchants, Customer Operations teams, Dormancy and Churn Recovery specialists, and business analysts.

cases.title: 课程学习情况对比分析
cases.subtitle: 两个课程的用户学习数据对比、统计与排名，生成可视化 HTML 报告
cases.subtitle_en: Compare, aggregate and rank user learning data across two courses, rendered as a visual HTML report
cases.description:
同时开了多门课，却说不清哪门课学的人多、哪门课完课率高，逐个课程后台点开看数据又慢又乱。

这个案例演示了如何把一个课程学习对比分析交给小鹅数据分析师：它自动查两个课程（test11、test22）的真实学习数据——累计用户数、学习人数、完课率、支付人数、订阅人数，做完横向对比、统计和排名后，生成一份可直接打开的可视化 HTML 报告，指标差异一目了然。

适合：知识付费运营负责人、课程产品经理、在线教育机构运营、需要定期做课程效果复盘的内容操盘手。
cases.description_en:
Running multiple courses but can't tell at a glance which one attracts more learners or achieves a higher completion rate? Checking each course's dashboard one by one is slow and messy.

This case shows how to hand a course-learning comparison off to Xiaoe Data Analyst: it queries real learning data for two courses (test11, test22) — cumulative users, active learners, completion rate, payers, subscribers — then runs a side-by-side comparison, aggregation and ranking, and renders a shareable visual HTML report where metric differences pop out instantly.

Great for: knowledge-payment operations leads, course product managers, online education operators, and content operators who need routine course performance reviews.
cases.prompt:
对比分析一下课程「test11」和「test22」的用户学习情况，并做统计和排名，生成一个 HTML 页面。

要求：
1. 通过小鹅通数据分析能力分别查询这两个课程的真实学习数据（先按课程名搜索拿到 resource_id，再查学习概况指标：累计用户数、学习人数、完课数、完课率、支付人数、订阅人数）。
2. 对两个课程做横向对比，输出关键指标的对比表和差异说明。
3. 基于学习人数、支付人数等指标做统计与排名（说明排名口径）。
4. 生成一个 HTML 可视化报告，用图表直观呈现对比结论，并附上数据来源与统计口径说明。
cases.prompt_en:
Compare and analyze the user learning data of courses "test11" and "test22", run statistics and ranking, and generate an HTML page.

Requirements:
1. Use the Xiaoe data-analysis capability to query the real learning data of these two courses (first search by course name to get resource_id, then query the learning overview metrics: cumulative users, active learners, completion count, completion rate, payers, subscribers).
2. Compare the two courses side by side, output a comparison table of key metrics and difference notes.
3. Rank and aggregate based on metrics such as learner count and payer count (state the ranking methodology).
4. Generate an HTML visual report, present the comparison with charts, and include data source and scope notes.

cases.title: 受贿案辩护策略分析
cases.subtitle: 审查起诉阶段三笔指控的分层攻防策略，一份报告看清无罪/罪轻/量刑三层辩护路径
cases.subtitle_en: A layered defense strategy for three bribery charges at the prosecution stage — one report mapping out all three defense levels
cases.description:
接手刑事案件最头疼的就是拿不准辩护方向——认罪还是辩无罪？逐笔还是整体？一个选错就可能错失从宽机会。

这个案例演示了如何把一起涉嫌受贿87万、共3笔指控的案件交给 AI，自动拆解出「分层攻防」策略：第1笔自首退赃做量刑之辩、第2笔有合同凭证做定性之辩、第3笔仅单一证言做事实之辩。产出一份带执行摘要、策略对比表、风险矩阵图、行动时间轴的完整辩护策略分析报告。

适合：刑事辩护律师、法律顾问、律所合伙人，以及需要系统梳理案件辩护思路的法律从业者。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of a criminal case is picking the right defense direction — plead guilty or claim innocence, per-charge or overall? One wrong call can cost you a lighter sentence.

This case shows how to hand a suspected bribery case (870,000 yuan across 3 charges) to AI, which automatically breaks it into a layered defense strategy: sentencing defense for the self-surrender charge, re-qualification defense for the contract-backed charge, and factual defense for the single-witness charge. It produces a complete defense strategy report with an executive summary, strategy comparison table, risk matrix, and action timeline.

For: criminal defense lawyers, legal counsel, law firm partners, and legal professionals who need to systematically map out a case defense approach.

artifacts.label: 受贿案辩护策略分析报告（HTML）

cases.prompt:
请帮我分析这个刑事案件的辩护策略。

王某涉嫌受贿罪，目前处于审查起诉阶段，涉嫌受贿87万元，共3笔：
- 第1笔20万元：已自首并全额退赃
- 第2笔35万元：辩称系正常业务往来，有合同和付款凭证
- 第3笔32万元：仅有行贿人证言，证人与行贿方有利害关系

证据情况：行贿人证言、银行流水、扣押笔记本。

请制定本案辩护策略方案，重点分析第2笔的定性争议和第3笔的证据问题，输出一份完整的策略分析报告（HTML），包含执行摘要、案件事实评估、证据评估、法律适用评估、策略选项对比、推荐方案、阶段行动计划和风险提示。
cases.prompt_en:
Please analyze the defense strategy for this criminal case.

Wang is suspected of bribery and is currently at the prosecution review stage, accused of accepting 870,000 yuan across 3 charges:
- Charge 1: 200,000 yuan — already surrendered and fully returned the money
- Charge 2: 350,000 yuan — claims it was normal business dealings, backed by a contract and payment vouchers
- Charge 3: 320,000 yuan — supported only by the briber's testimony, and the witness has a conflict of interest with the briber

Evidence: the briber's testimony, bank transaction records, and a seized notebook.

Please draft a defense strategy for this case, focusing on the re-qualification dispute in Charge 2 and the evidentiary issues in Charge 3, and output a complete strategy analysis report (HTML) including an executive summary, case facts assessment, evidence assessment, legal application assessment, strategy comparison, recommended approach, staged action plan, and risk warnings.

cases.title: CSS 加载动画合集
cases.subtitle: 8 种创意 Loading 动效，纯 CSS 即拿即用
cases.subtitle_en: 8 creative loading animations in pure CSS, ready to copy
cases.description:
每次做加载动画都要现写或找第三方库，要么效果太简陋要么引入太重，还得担心兼容性和性能问题，反复调参数浪费大量时间。

这个案例用 web-animation-design 技能一次性生成了 8 种风格各异的纯 CSS 加载动画：旋转圆环（渐变边框）、脉冲圆点（三点缩放序列）、弹跳柱条（五柱交错弹跳）、波纹扩散（涟漪扩展圆环）、渐变旋转器（锥形渐变旋转）、打字指示器（聊天式输入动效）、骨架屏微光（内容占位闪烁）、DNA 双螺旋（双链旋转动画）。每个动画都封装在独立卡片中，深色背景突出动效，支持一键复制 CSS 代码，并尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 媒体查询。

适合：前端开发者、UI 设计师、独立开发者、任何需要快速获取加载动画的人
cases.description_en:
Writing loading animations from scratch or hunting for the right library every time is a pain — results are either too plain or too heavy, with compatibility and performance concerns eating up your time.

This case uses the web-animation-design skill to generate 8 distinct pure CSS loading animations in one go: Spinning Ring (gradient border), Pulse Dots (3-dot scaling sequence), Bouncing Bars (5-bar staggered bounce), Wave Circle (ripple expanding rings), Gradient Spinner (conic-gradient rotation), Typing Dots (chat-style typing indicator), Skeleton Shimmer (content placeholder shimmer), and DNA Helix (double helix rotation). Each animation is presented in its own dark-background card with live preview, one-click CSS copy, and respects prefers-reduced-motion.

Ideal for: frontend developers, UI designers, indie developers, anyone who needs ready-to-use loading animations
cases.prompt:
请生成一个纯 CSS 加载动画合集展示页面（单文件 HTML，内联无外部依赖），界面文字用简体中文，深色卡片网格布局。

包含 8 种加载动画：旋转圆环、脉冲圆点、弹跳柱条、波纹圆圈、渐变锥形旋转器、打字指示器、骨架屏微光、DNA 双螺旋。

每个动画放独立卡片，显示实时预览、名称、简短描述和「复制 CSS」按钮。动画仅用 CSS keyframes + transform 实现，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 降级。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a pure-CSS loading-animation collection showcase page (single-file HTML, inlined with no external dependencies). UI text should be in Simplified Chinese, with a dark card-grid layout.

Include 8 loading animations: spinning ring, pulsing dots, bouncing bars, ripple circles, gradient conic spinner, typing indicator, skeleton-screen shimmer, DNA double helix.

Place each animation in its own card, showing a live preview, the name, a short description, and a "Copy CSS" button. Animations must be implemented using only CSS keyframes + transform, and should gracefully degrade in accordance with prefers-reduced-motion.

cases.title: 客户聚焦与拒绝决策
cases.subtitle: 在现金焦虑中守住第一个客户选择
cases.subtitle_en: Protect the First Customer Choice Under Cash Pressure
cases.description:
痛点：8 人 B2B SaaS 团队在两个月内收到零售、制造、教育、物流四行业共 7 个定制需求，其中 3 个愿意付费但功能各不相同。创始人担心拒单会失去现金，团队已被定制拖慢，客户、产品与销售判断正在被拉散。

演示：案例把讨论带回顺序——先把客户还原为具体的人、具体场景和具体痛点，再判断从哪个入口进入市场，最后用时间、现金、创始人精力与团队聚焦度约束哪些需求现在不能接。

适用人群：适用于早期 B2B SaaS 创始人、产品负责人和小团队管理者，尤其是在付费机会分散、定制持续挤占核心产品时，需要做客户选择与拒绝决策的团队。
cases.description_en:
Pain point: An eight-person B2B SaaS team received seven custom requests across retail, manufacturing, education, and logistics in two months. Three are willing to pay but require different features. The founder fears losing cash by declining, while custom work has already slowed the team and scattered customer, product, and sales judgment.

Demonstration: The case brings the discussion back to sequence—first restore the customer to a specific person, situation, and pain; then decide which entrance to use for the market; finally use time, cash, founder attention, and team focus to constrain which requests cannot be accepted now.

Who it is for: Early-stage B2B SaaS founders, product leads, and small-team managers whose paid opportunities are fragmented and whose custom work is crowding out the core product, and who need to make customer-selection and rejection decisions.
cases.prompt: 你是一家 8 人 B2B SaaS 团队的创始人。过去两个月，团队收到来自零售、制造、教育、物流四个行业的 7 个定制需求，其中 3 个客户愿意付费，但所需功能各不相同。你担心拒绝会失去现金，团队却已被定制拖慢。请完成一次客户聚焦与拒绝决策：围绕“客户不是所有人”“拒绝是对有限资源的尊重”“先明确具体痛点再讨论产品和 GTM”展开。先用一句话给出核心判断；随后具体解释如何把客户从行业标签还原为具体的人、场景与痛点，为什么不应只按眼前收入比较需求，如何判断哪个入口能让客户、GTM、产品与商业结构更清楚，以及哪些定制现在不能接；最后以 1—2 个针对团队处境的具体反问结束。输出逐段内容，不编造任何外部数据或事实。
cases.prompt_en: You are the founder of an eight-person B2B SaaS team. Over the past two months, the team has received seven custom requests from retail, manufacturing, education, and logistics. Three customers are willing to pay, but each needs different features. You fear that declining will lose cash, yet custom work has already slowed the team. Complete a customer-focus and rejection decision centered on these ideas: the customer is not everyone; rejection respects limited resources; and a specific pain must be clear before discussing product and GTM. First give the core judgment in one sentence; then explain specifically how to restore a customer from an industry label to a specific person, situation, and pain; why requests should not be compared only by immediate revenue; how to judge which entrance makes the customer, GTM, product, and business structure clearer; and which custom work cannot be accepted now. Finally end with one or two concrete questions for the team’s situation. Output paragraph-by-paragraph content without inventing any external data or facts.

cases.title: CyberFit 赛博朋克运动打卡工作台
cases.subtitle: 纯静态单体 HTML 运动打卡网站，赛博朋克霓虹风格，支持打卡/统计/图表
cases.subtitle_en: Standalone static HTML exercise tracker with cyberpunk neon theme, check-in, analytics and Chart.js dashboards
cases.description:
厌倦了臃肿的运动 App？这个纯静态 HTML 工作台只需浏览器打开就能用，无需安装、无需后端。

包含四个核心页面：首页显示连续打卡天数和本周概览，打卡页支持 8 种运动类型和感受记录，数据看板用 Chart.js 呈现周趋势和类型分布，历史记录支持筛选/编辑/删除。所有数据存于浏览器 localStorage，支持 JSON 导出导入。PC 端侧边栏导航，移动端底部 Tab 栏 + 滑出菜单。

支持中英双语切换：访问时加 ?lang=en 即可切换为英文界面。适合想快速记录运动、不想要繁重 App 的个人用户；也适合前端开发者学习纯 HTML/CSS/JS SPA 架构、Chart.js 集成和前端 i18n 实践的实战参考。
cases.description_en:
Tired of bloated fitness apps? This standalone HTML workspace works with just a browser—no installation, no backend.

Four pages: Home with streak tracking and weekly summary, Check-in with 8 exercise types and mood recording, Dashboard with Chart.js trends and distributions, History with filtering, editing and deletion. All data stored in browser localStorage, with JSON export/import support. PC sidebar navigation, mobile bottom tabs + slide-out menu.

Built-in i18n: add ?lang=en to the URL to switch the entire interface to English. Perfect for individuals who want quick exercise logging without heavy apps, and for developers learning pure HTML/CSS/JS SPA architecture, Chart.js integration, and frontend i18n practices.
cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款（https://workbuddy.link/p/aggM27DD6gtosrTAoWybqC），需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：
生成一个纯静态运动打卡网站（HTML/CSS/JS），支持PC/移动端响应式。要求：1）多页面结构（首页、打卡页、数据看板、历史记录）；2）UI赛博朋克/霓虹风格，带粒子背景和CSS入场动画；3）使用localStorage存储数据，集成Chart.js展示运动图表；4）移动端底部Tab栏，PC端侧边栏；5）所有到单个HTML文件，离线可用。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。

cases.title: 刘派派的每日生活管理工作台
cases.subtitle: 待办、习惯、心情、购物、便签，一页管好每一天
cases.subtitle_en: To-dos, habits, moods, shopping and notes — one page for your whole day
cases.description:
每天的事散落在各处：待办记在脑子里、习惯靠意志力、购物写在小票背面，到晚上总觉得忙了一天又说不出忙了什么；想要一个不用装 App、打开就能用的生活管理页。

本案例由 WorkspaceBuilder 工作台搭建师专家生成：一份单文件 HTML 收进五个日常模块——「今天要处理」自动汇总当天到期/逾期的待办、未打卡的习惯和待买的物品，一键完成/打卡/已购；待办按日期排序、逾期标红、优先级三色徽章；习惯打卡、心情记录（六种心情各配代表色）、购物清单带已购进度、灵感便签可打标签；数据存浏览器 localStorage，内置一版示例数据打开即体验，支持备份/恢复 JSON 和一键清空；界面内置 i18n 中英双语，?lang=zh / ?lang=en 直接切换，示例数据也有中英两个版本。暖米色纸张质感 + 大圆角卡片的治愈手账风，手机和电脑都好用。

适合：想轻装管理每天的上班族（待办+购物+便签一页收）、习惯养成期的自律党（打卡+心情记录）、手账/治愈系美学爱好者（暖米色纸张质感），以及想参考单文件 localStorage 应用与内联 i18n 实现的前端学习者。
cases.description_en:
Your day is scattered everywhere: to-dos live in your head, habits rely on willpower, shopping items sit on the back of receipts — by evening you feel busy but can't say what you actually did. You want a life-management page that needs no app install and works the moment you open it.

This case is built by the WorkspaceBuilder expert: a single-file HTML packs five daily modules — "Today's To-Do" auto-collects tasks due or overdue today, unchecked habits and items to buy, with one-tap Done / Check in / Bought; to-dos sort by date with overdue in red and tri-color priority badges; habit check-ins, a mood log (six moods, each with its own color), a shopping list with bought progress, and quick notes with tags. Data persists in browser localStorage, a sample dataset is built in for instant try-out, with JSON backup/restore and one-click clear. The UI ships with inline i18n in Chinese and English — switch with ?lang=zh / ?lang=en, and the sample data comes in both languages too. Warm beige paper texture and big rounded cards give it a healing journal feel, friendly on both phone and desktop.

Best for: office workers who want to manage the day light-weight (to-dos + shopping + notes in one page), habit builders (check-ins + mood log), journal aesthetics lovers (warm paper texture), and frontend learners studying single-file localStorage apps with inline i18n.

artifacts.label: 每日生活管理工作台 单文件 HTML（内置 i18n 中英文 + 中英双版示例数据，localStorage 自包含）

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款：https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/o6ziMSnpgANV3IqdLeaRyB，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：

我想做一个「每日生活管理」个人工作台，把一天里杂七杂八的事收进一个页面，包含：
1. 今天要处理：自动汇总今天到期或逾期的待办、今日还没打卡的习惯、还没买的购物项，每条右侧有快捷按钮（完成 / 打卡 / 已购）。
2. 待办：可添加事项（内容、日期、优先级 高/中/低），列表按日期升序，逾期标红，完成后划线，可删除。
3. 习惯打卡：记录喝水、阅读、早睡这类习惯，当天点一下就打勾，区分「已打卡 / 未打卡」。
4. 心情记录：从开心 / 平静 / 一般 / 难过 / 焦虑 / 疲惫里选心情（各有代表色小圆点），可附一句话。
5. 购物清单：物品 + 数量，买完打勾，顶部显示已购进度（已购 X / 共 Y 件）。
6. 便签：随手记灵感，可打标签（如 工作 / 生活）。
7. 数据存浏览器 localStorage，首次打开内置一版示例数据方便直接体验；支持备份 / 恢复 JSON、一键清空。

视觉走治愈手账风：暖米色纸张质感背景、棕色系点缀、大圆角卡片、serif 标题字，整体低饱和柔和；响应式，手机和电脑都好用。要求CSS / JS 全部内联，不引用任何外部资源。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Use the library's capability to make me an exact replica of this workbench: https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/o6ziMSnpgANV3IqdLeaRyB — data must be stored online with two-way sync. Prefer the one-click replica path; if that's not available, build it as follows:/n/nI want a "Daily Life Manager" personal workbench that gathers all the bits and pieces of my day into one page, including:/n1. Today's To-Do: auto-collect to-dos due today or overdue, habits not yet checked in today, and shopping items not yet bought, each with a quick action button (Done / Check in / Bought).
2. To-dos: add items (content, date, priority High/Medium/Low); list sorted by date ascending, overdue in red, completed struck through, deletable.
3. Habit check-ins: track habits like drinking water, reading, sleeping early — one tap checks them off for the day, with clear checked / unchecked states.
4. Mood log: pick from Happy / Calm / Okay / Sad / Anxious / Tired (each with its own colored dot), plus an optional one-line note.
5. Shopping list: item + quantity, tick when bought, progress shown on top (Bought X of Y items).
6. Notes: jot down ideas with optional tags (e.g. Work / Life).
7. Data persists in browser localStorage; ship a built-in sample dataset so it works on first open; support JSON backup / restore and one-click clear. Visual style: a healing journal look — warm beige paper-texture background, brown accents, big rounded cards, serif headings, soft low-saturation palette; responsive for both phone and desktop. Deliver a with all CSS / JS inline and zero external resources.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 云岭县发展画像 · 县域多维发展与振兴专题
cases.title_en: Yunling County Development Profile: A Multidimensional Rural Revitalization Story
cases.subtitle: 五维一体的县域发展画像，看清短板与振兴路径
cases.subtitle_en: A five-dimension county development portrait that reveals gaps and revitalization paths
cases.description: 想把一个县的发展讲清楚，却困在零散指标里，既看不出全貌也找不到短板？本案由「探数数」数据探索专家，以一个虚构的西南山区县「云岭县」为样本，沿「数据探索→校验→多维下钻→洞察生成」的方法论，搭建收入、教育、医疗、基础设施、产业多元、生态宜居六维发展指数，并通过收入折线、产业结构演进、乡镇梯度对比等图表识别短板、给出振兴行动建议。交付物是一份纪实摄影风的单文件 HTML 专题作品，全幅大图、图文交错、数据图谱穿插，积极正向地呈现县域振兴成效。适合做县域/区域发展分析、乡村振兴汇报、政务数据可视化的人参考。
cases.description_en: Struggling to tell a county's development story when scattered metrics hide both the big picture and the real gaps? In this case, the DataExplorationExpert builds a six-dimension development index (income, education, healthcare, infrastructure, industry diversity, livability) for a fictional southwestern mountain county, following an explore-validate-drill-insight workflow. Through income trend lines, industry-structure evolution, and township comparisons, it pinpoints weaknesses and proposes revitalization actions. The deliverable is a single-file HTML feature in a documentary-photography style—full-bleed imagery, magazine layout, and data charts woven together. Ideal for regional development analysis, rural revitalization reporting, and government data visualization.
cases.prompt: 我要做一份「县域多维发展与振兴画像」的单文件 HTML 数据专题，用积极正向的视角呈现一个县的发展成效（不要写成负面贫困叙事）。可以用合成数据虚构一个山区县，各维度指标内部自洽。视觉走纪实摄影/国家地理式图文专题风格：全幅大图 hero 配渐变蒙版压标题，大地色系（土黄/橄榄绿/赭石/米色），图文交错的杂志排版。页面要包含：1) 全幅图片 Hero（标题+副标+关键结论）；2) 收入/教育/医疗/基础设施/产业多元/生态宜居六维发展指数雷达图与综合指数；3) 产业振兴、人口城镇化、公共服务覆盖等图文专题板块；4) 近5年人均可支配收入折线、产业结构堆叠条、各乡镇发展水平对比等 SVG 图表；5) 短板识别 + 振兴行动建议卡片；6) 请联网搜索该县或同类县域的真实公开统计数据（统计年鉴/政府公报等）并在页脚注明来源；确无公开数据的指标才标注为建模测算。所有 CSS/JS 内联，图标用固定尺寸内联 SVG，界面简体中文，货币用¥。
cases.prompt_en: I want a single-file HTML data feature on a county's multidimensional development and revitalization profile, told from a positive perspective (not a negative poverty narrative). Use self-consistent real data for a fictional mountain county. Visual style: documentary / National Geographic feature—full-bleed hero image with gradient overlay and title, earth-tone palette (ochre, olive green, sienna, beige), magazine layout interleaving photos and data. Include: 1) full-bleed photo hero (title, subtitle, key takeaway); 2) a six-dimension development radar (income, education, healthcare, infrastructure, industry diversity, livability) plus a composite index; 3) photo-feature sections on industry revitalization, urbanization, and public-service coverage; 4) SVG charts: 5-year per-capita income line, industry-structure stacked bars, township comparison; 5) gap-identification and revitalization-action cards; 6) a footer noting the data is real (web-searched) modeling with a referenced framework. All CSS/JS inline, fixed-size inline SVG icons, simplified Chinese UI, currency in ¥.

artifacts.label: 云岭县发展画像数据专题

cases.title: 电商用户价值 RFM 分析驾驶舱
cases.subtitle: RFM 模型 + 8 层用户分层运营策略
cases.subtitle_en: RFM model with 8-tier customer segmentation & playbooks
cases.description: 拉新越来越贵，但多数店铺不知道钱到底是谁贡献的、该把预算押在谁身上。本案由「舒明析」数据分析专家以 RFM 模型为框架，对虚构跨境电商「星野严选」48,600 名活跃用户做价值分层：按最近购买、购买频次、累计金额三维打分，切出重要价值、重要挽留、流失预警等 8 个可运营分层，量化各层人数占比与 GMV 贡献，揭示「28.5% 重要用户贡献 70.9% GMV」的二八结构，并为每层配套运营动作与可衡量目标。交付一份深色 SaaS 驾驶舱风格的单文件 HTML 报告，含 RFM 矩阵、人数/GMV 对比图、策略卡与趋势分析。适合电商运营、用户增长、CRM 与数据分析岗位。
cases.description_en: Acquisition keeps getting pricier, yet most shops can't say who actually drives revenue or where to bet their budget. Using the RFM framework, data expert Shu segments 48,600 active users of fictional cross-border shop 'Xingye Select' by recency, frequency, and monetary value into 8 actionable tiers—from high-value to at-risk and churn-warning—quantifying each tier's headcount and GMV share. The analysis surfaces the 80/20 reality (28.5% of users drive 70.9% of GMV) and pairs every tier with concrete actions and measurable targets. Delivered as a single-file, dark SaaS-cockpit HTML report with an RFM matrix, headcount/GMV comparison, strategy cards, and trend charts. Built for e-commerce ops, growth, CRM, and analytics roles.
cases.prompt: 我是电商运营，想要一份用户价值分析报告（单文件 HTML，深色数据驾驶舱风格）。请用 RFM 模型把我们的活跃用户分成重要价值/重要保持/重要发展/重要挽留/一般价值/一般保持/一般发展/流失预警共 8 层。页面要有：店铺信息和分析周期的 Hero、活跃用户数/GMV/客单价/复购率四个关键指标卡、RFM 三维说明、用 SVG 画的分层矩阵热力格、各层人数占比 vs GMV 贡献占比的对比条形图（体现二八结构）、4-8 张分层运营策略卡（含人群特征、典型 RFM 分数、运营动作、预期目标）、近 6 个月趋势折线，以及方法口径脚注。请使用真实电商公开数据集或用户提供的真实数据；如仅演示可用合成数据但须在脚注明确标注为合成、且内部勾稽一致，纯 SVG/CSS 不要外链。
cases.prompt_en: I run e-commerce ops and need a customer-value report as a single-file HTML in a dark data-cockpit style. Use the RFM model to split active users into 8 tiers (high-value, loyal, potential, at-risk, general-value, general-loyal, general-developing, churn-warning). Include: a hero with shop info and analysis period; four KPI cards (active users, GMV, AOV, repurchase rate); an RFM explanation; an SVG segmentation heat-matrix; a bar chart comparing each tier's headcount share vs GMV share (showing the 80/20 structure); 4-8 strategy cards per tier (traits, typical RFM scores, actions, targets); a 6-month trend line; and a methodology footnote. real real (web-searched) data is fine but must reconcile internally; pure SVG/CSS, no external resources.

artifacts.label: 电商用户价值 RFM 分析驾驶舱

cases.title: 2025 中国就业景气年度报告
cases.subtitle: 《经济学人》式社论报刊风 · 总量稳、结构分
cases.subtitle_en: Economist-style editorial broadsheet: stable totals, divergent structure
cases.description: 年度就业数据散落在公报、发布会与月度调查里，普通人很难一眼看清"到底好不好"。本案由「析数数」数据分析专家以官方权威数据为主干，整理出 2025 城镇新增就业、调查失业率、就业人员总量与城镇占比等核心指标，并补充月度走势、分年龄段对比与年度新增就业测算图示，最终交付一份《经济学人》/FT 社论报刊风的单文件 HTML 年度报告：含报头导语、核心指标条、两条主线社论正文、2–3 张 SVG 图表、结构性议题卡片与来源脚注。适合做行业研究、政策解读与汇报展示的人参考。
cases.description_en: Employment data is scattered across bulletins, press conferences and monthly surveys, making it hard to see the full picture. Here the data-analysis expert 'Dash' uses authoritative official data as the backbone, organizing 2025 urban new jobs, surveyed unemployment, total employment and urban share, plus monthly trends, by-age comparisons and annual new-jobs estimates. The deliverable is a single-file HTML annual report in an Economist/FT editorial broadsheet style: masthead lede, headline metric bar, two-thread editorial body, 2-3 SVG charts, structural-issue cards and sourced footnotes. Ideal for industry research, policy reading and presentations.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一份《经济学人》/FT 财经社论报刊风格的「2025 中国就业景气年度报告」单文件 HTML。要求：米白浅暖底、衬线大标题、暗红主色点缀，多栏报刊排版、首字下沉。内容包含：刊名报头与导语摘要；核心指标条（城镇新增就业 1267 万、调查失业率均值 5.2%、就业人员 72504 万、城镇占比 65.6%，用国家统计局公报真实数据）；两条主线的社论正文（总量稳、结构分）；2-3 个内联 SVG 图表（月度失业率折线含 5% 参考线、分年龄段失业率柱状青年 vs 全龄、新增就业年度对比）；青年就业/招工难/慢就业的结构性议题卡片；页脚明确列出数据来源机构与报告名年份，数据须来自联网搜索的真实公开来源（统计局/人社部等），页脚注明来源机构与报告年份；仅推算指标标注为测算。全部 CSS/JS 内联、无外链、无 emoji、简体中文、响应式。
cases.prompt_en: Create a single-file HTML '2025 China Employment Climate Annual Report' in an Economist/FT editorial broadsheet style. Requirements: cream warm background, serif headlines, dark-red accents, multi-column layout, drop caps. Include: masthead with lede summary; a headline metric bar (urban new jobs 12.67M, average surveyed unemployment 5.2%, total employment 725.04M, urban share 65.6%, using real National Bureau of Statistics data); a two-thread editorial body (stable totals, divergent structure); 2-3 inline SVG charts (monthly unemployment line with a 5% reference line, by-age unemployment bars youth vs all-age, annual new-jobs comparison); structural-issue cards on youth employment, labor shortage and slow employment; a footer listing data-source institutions, report names and years, marking which figures are real (web-searched) estimates. All CSS/JS inline, no external resources, no emoji, Simplified Chinese, responsive.

artifacts.label: 2025 中国就业景气年度报告

cases.title: GDP 之外：用 HDI 重新丈量发展
cases.title_en: Beyond GDP: Remeasuring Development with HDI
cases.subtitle: 经济总量 ≠ 人类发展水平的跨国数据星图
cases.subtitle_en: A cross-country data star-map on why wealth isn't the same as well-being
cases.description: 想用一组数据讲清「有钱不等于发展好」，却常常陷在表格里讲不出故事？本案由「图说说」视觉叙事专家操刀，把联合国开发计划署 HDI 真实数据转化为一页深空数据星图：从太空夜灯 Hero 切入，拆解 HDI 健康/教育/生活水平三维度，再用「人均 GDP × HDI 散点图」与「HDI 横向排行榜」呈现美国财富顶级却 HDI 第 17、冰岛小国登顶、中国与中国香港高效转化等反差洞察。交付单文件 HTML，内联可直接打开。适合做经济社会议题科普、数据新闻、教学演示与汇报的人。
cases.description_en: Want to show that 'rich isn't the same as well-developed' but keep getting stuck in spreadsheets? Created by visual-storytelling expert 'Eva', this case turns UNDP's real HDI data into a single deep-space data star-map: an Earth-at-night hero, a breakdown of HDI's three dimensions, plus a GDP-per-capita × HDI scatter plot and a horizontal HDI ranking that surface contrasts—the US ranks only 17th despite top wealth, tiny Iceland tops the chart, and China/Hong Kong convert income into development efficiently. Delivered as a single self-contained HTML file. Ideal for socioeconomic explainers, data journalism, teaching and presentations.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一个单文件 HTML 数据可视化页面，主题是『GDP 之外：用 HDI 重新丈量发展』，讲清楚经济总量不等于人类发展水平。要深空天文台/数据星图风格，深蓝近黑宇宙底色，用一张从太空看地球城市夜灯的大图做 Hero（叠深色渐变蒙版保证白色标题清晰）。内容包含：HDI 三维度（健康/教育/生活水平）拆解说明、核心的人均 GDP × HDI 散点图（标注各国、能看出高收入未必高 HDI）、HDI 横向排行榜条形图（中国和中国香港高亮）、几张反差洞察卡片，以及标注 UNDP 人类发展报告 2025 的页脚。用真实 HDI 数据，所有 CSS/JS 和图片都内联，界面中文。
cases.prompt_en: Build me a single-file HTML data-visualization page titled 'Beyond GDP: Remeasuring Development with HDI', making clear that economic size isn't the same as human development. Use a deep-space observatory / data-star-map style with a near-black blue cosmic background, and an Earth-at-night city-lights photo as the hero (with a dark gradient overlay so the white title stays readable). Include: a breakdown of HDI's three dimensions (health/education/standard of living), a core GDP-per-capita × HDI scatter plot with country labels (showing high income doesn't guarantee high HDI), a horizontal HDI ranking bar chart (highlighting China and Hong Kong), several contrast-insight cards, and a footer citing UNDP Human Development Report 2025. Use real HDI data, inline all CSS/JS and images, Chinese UI.

artifacts.label: GDP 之外：HDI 发展星图

cases.title: 八十二亿之后：全球人口结构与趋势图志
cases.title_en: After 8.2 Billion: Atlas of Global Population Structure & Trends
cases.subtitle: 杂志信息图风 · 人口峰值、老龄化、生育率下降与区域分化
cases.subtitle_en: Editorial infographic on peak, aging, fertility decline & regional divergence
cases.description: 做人口议题的科普或战略汇报，最怕数字堆砌却看不出趋势。本案由「舒明析」数据分析师以决策导向的方法论，把联合国《World Population Prospects 2024》的核心结论提炼成一张杂志信息图风的单文件 HTML：超大数字指标墙、人口达峰曲线（标注 2084 年约 103 亿峰值）、多区域生育率下降折线（含 2.1 更替线）、65+ 与 18− 老龄化交叉图、印度超越中国的大国易位曲线，以及区域增长分化与决策启示。主干数字均来自联合国官方，建模细分均标注示意。适合研究者、媒体编辑、战略与政策从业者快速理解人口长波。
cases.description_en: Population briefings often pile up numbers while hiding the trend. Here data analyst 'Shu' applies a decision-first methodology to distill the UN World Population Prospects 2024 into a single-file, editorial-infographic HTML page: a big-number metric wall, the peak curve (10.3B around 2084), multi-region fertility decline with the 2.1 replacement line, the 65+ vs under-18 aging crossover, the India-overtakes-China shift, plus regional divergence and decision takeaways. Headline figures come from the UN; modeled breakdowns are clearly labeled. Built for researchers, editors, and strategy/policy professionals.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一个单文件 HTML 的全球人口结构与趋势数据可视化页面，杂志信息图/编辑设计风（明亮大胆、强对比大色块、超大数字排版、图片裁成色块拼贴）。要用联合国 World Population Prospects 2024 的真实数据：2024 年世界人口约 82 亿，预计 2084 年前后达峰约 103 亿、2100 年约 102 亿，全球总和生育率约 2.3（更替水平 2.1），印度 2023 年超越中国，65 岁以上人口将在 2070 年代后期超过 18 岁以下儿童。页面要包含：带城市航拍配图的 Hero 和 82 亿→103 亿叙事、关键数字指标墙、人口达峰曲线（SVG，标注峰值点）、多区域生育率下降折线（世界/非洲/亚洲/欧洲含更替线）、老龄化 65+ vs 18− 交叉图、印度 vs 中国人口交叉、区域增长分化板块（穿插人群配图）、来源与建模说明页脚。所有 CSS/JS 和两张图片都内联，不要外链，界面用简体中文，图表用 SVG 绘制不要溢出坐标轴。
cases.prompt_en: Build a single-file HTML data-visualization page on global population structure and trends in an editorial / magazine-infographic style (bright, bold, high-contrast color blocks, oversized numbers, photos cropped into blocks). Use real UN World Population Prospects 2024 data: ~8.2B in 2024, peak ~10.3B around 2084, ~10.2B by 2100, global TFR ~2.3 (replacement 2.1), India overtook China in 2023, and the 65+ population overtaking under-18 in the late 2070s. Include: a hero with an aerial city photo and the 8.2B→10.3B narrative, a big-number metric wall, the peak curve (SVG with a labeled peak point), multi-region fertility-decline lines (World/Africa/Asia/Europe with the replacement line), the 65+ vs under-18 aging crossover, an India-vs-China crossover, a regional divergence section (with a crowd photo), and a sources/modeling footnote. Inline all CSS/JS and both images, no external resources, Simplified-Chinese UI, SVG charts that never overflow the axes.

cases.description: 手动设计数据库 Schema 需要考量表关系、命名规范、索引策略、字段类型选择、外键约束和存储引擎等诸多细节，任何疏漏都可能导致性能瓶颈或数据一致性问题。本案例演示如何通过 MySQL Skill，一次性为在线教育平台生成完整的数据库设计方案，涵盖用户管理、课程体系、订单系统和学习记录四大核心模块，包含规范的命名约定、完整的外键关系、索引设计、字段注释以及 3 个版本的渐进式迁移脚本。适合后端开发者、DBA、全栈工程师及需要快速落地数据库架构设计的技术团队。
cases.description_en: Designing database schemas manually requires careful consideration of table relationships, naming conventions, indexing strategies, data type selection, foreign key constraints, and storage engine choices -- any oversight can lead to performance bottlenecks or data consistency issues. This case demonstrates how to use the MySQL Skill to generate a complete database design for an online education platform in one shot, covering four core modules: user management, course system, order system, and learning records, with standardized naming conventions, complete foreign key relationships, index design, column comments, and 3 versioned progressive migration scripts. cases.title: 高维决策：35岁程序员该不该 All-in AI 创业
cases.title_en: High-Dimensional Decision: Should a 35-Year-Old Engineer Go All-In on an AI Startup
cases.subtitle: 用九大决策模块把一场人生豪赌拆成可推演、可校准、可执行的结构化判断
cases.subtitle_en: Turning a life-defining gamble into a structured, simulatable, and executable decision with nine decision modules
cases.description:
「35 岁了，到底该不该辞掉大厂高薪去 AI 创业？」这种人生级选择，最难受的是它没有标准答案，凭感觉决定又怕赌错一生。脑子里全是「机会难得」和「万一失败呢」在打架，越想越乱。

这个案例演示了如何把这道模糊的焦虑题，交给高维决策师用完整九步法拆解：先用仓颉编码把「要不要创业」重定义为「如何不赌上家庭安全垫地把技术资本变成长期复利」；再用周易辩证列清阴阳两面与转化条件、系统科学定位真正的短板节点、康波周期判断当前正处 AI 技术革命孕育期；接着用世界模型给出乐观/基准/悲观三种未来的概率推演，设计出 All-in、骑驴找马、曲线入场三套方案；最后用女娲范式给出「有条件推进」的推荐方案、分三阶段的行动路线，并用宇宙视角做终极价值校准。产出一份排版精致、可离线打开的 HTML 决策报告。

适合：面临职业转型的技术人与职场人、纠结创业与否的从业者、想学系统决策方法的人、给团队/自己做重大选择复盘的管理者、对东西方决策智慧感兴趣的思考者。
cases.description_en:
"I'm 35 — should I quit my well-paid big-tech job and go start an AI company?" The hardest part of a life-level choice like this is that there's no right answer, yet deciding on gut feel risks betting your whole life wrong. "This is a rare window" and "but what if I fail" just keep fighting in your head.

This case shows how to hand that vague anxiety to the High-Dimensional Decision Maker and break it down with a full nine-step method: Cangjie encoding first redefines "should I start up?" into "how to convert my technical capital into long-term compounding without betting the family safety net"; then Yin-Yang dialectics map the pros/cons and turning conditions, systems science locates the real bottleneck node, and the Kondratieff cycle places us in the incubation phase of the AI tech revolution; a world model then simulates optimistic/base/pessimistic futures with probabilities and designs three options — all-in, moonlighting-first, and a curved entry; finally the Nuwa paradigm delivers a "conditional go" recommendation, a three-phase action roadmap, and a cosmic-view value calibration. The output is a polished, offline-ready HTML decision report.

Ideal for: engineers and professionals facing a career pivot, anyone torn over whether to start a business, learners of systematic decision-making, managers reviewing major choices, and thinkers curious about East-meets-West decision wisdom.
cases.prompt:
我今年 35 岁，是一线大厂的资深后端工程师，年包约 80 万，有房贷和一个孩子，家庭有另一份稳定收入，可支配启动资金约 120 万，风险承受能力中等。我在纠结要不要辞职 all-in 去做 AI 应用创业。

请用你的高维决策九步法，帮我做一份完整的决策分析：
1）先用仓颉编码把我的模糊焦虑重定义成真正要决策的问题；
2）用周易辩证列出阴阳两面（有利/风险）和阴阳转化的关键条件；
3）用系统科学分析技术能力、产品商业化、现金流、心力等要素的关系与反馈回路，指出真正的短板节点；
4）用康波周期判断当前 AI 赛道处在周期的哪个阶段，并给出对应的周期策略；
5）用世界模型给出乐观/基准/悲观三种未来场景及各自概率；
6）设计至少 3 套可选方案（含 all-in、骑驴找马、曲线入场），列出核心思路、预期收益、主要风险和适合条件；
7）用女娲范式给出推荐方案（含核心理由、关键成功因素、应急止损预案）；
8）给出分三阶段（0–30 天 / 1–3 月 / 3–12 月）的行动路线和反馈复盘机制；
9）最后用宇宙视角做价值校准反思。

请把结果做成一份排版精致、适合阅读的单文件 HTML 决策报告：浅色专业风格、信息层次清晰、含阴阳对比卡片、康波周期时间轴、场景概率条、方案对比表、行动时间线等可视化元素；要求单文件、所有 CSS/JS/图片资源全部内联、可离线打开、不引用任何外部链接。

cases.title: 高维决策：制造企业在康波切换点如何布局新赛道
cases.title_en: High-Dimensional Decision: How a Manufacturer Should Position for New Industries at a Kondratieff Turning Point
cases.subtitle: 用康波周期、系统科学与女娲范式，给传统制造企业一份可执行的转型战略
cases.subtitle_en: An executable transformation strategy for a traditional manufacturer, built with Kondratieff cycles, systems science, and the Nuwa paradigm
cases.description:
主营业务增速见顶、毛利率一年比一年薄——这是很多传统制造企业老板半夜睡不着的事。死守主业怕被时代淘汰，砸钱进新赛道又怕押错方向、把家底赔光。到底是精益提效守存量，还是切进不确定的新兴产业？

这个案例演示了如何把这道企业级战略难题交给高维决策师系统拆解：先用仓颉编码把「要不要投新赛道」重定义为「如何在主业还能供血的窗口期完成向下一轮康波技术的能力迁移」；再用康波周期把「增速见顶」判断为周期性信号而非管理问题，配一张波形图定位当前正处旧动能衰退、新旧切换段；接着用系统科学梳理主业现金牛、新业务、人才组织、制度激励四要素的反馈回路，用周易辩证列清转型的阴阳两面与转化条件；用世界模型推演三种未来概率，设计死守、双轮驱动、激进转型三套方案；最后用女娲范式（创造造人 / 修复补天 / 延续立制）给出「双轮驱动」推荐方案与分三阶段行动路线，并用宇宙视角校准企业的长期价值。产出一份含康波波形图、系统结构图、方案对比表的精致 HTML 战略报告，可离线打开。

适合：传统企业创始人与高管、战略/投资部门负责人、面临第二增长曲线焦虑的经营者、企业转型顾问、想学周期思维与系统决策的商业研究者。
cases.description_en:
Core-business growth peaking and margins thinning year after year — that's what keeps many traditional manufacturing owners up at night. Holding the line risks being left behind by the era; pouring money into a new track risks betting wrong and losing everything. So which is it: lean out the existing business, or cut into an uncertain emerging industry?

This case shows how to hand that enterprise-level strategy dilemma to the High-Dimensional Decision Maker for a systematic breakdown: Cangjie encoding first redefines "should we invest in a new track?" as "how to complete the capability migration to the next Kondratieff technology while the core business can still fund it"; the Kondratieff cycle then reframes "peaking growth" as a cyclical signal rather than a management failure, with a wave chart placing us at the decline-and-switchover segment; systems science maps the feedback loops among the cash-cow core business, the new business, talent/organization, and incentives, while Yin-Yang dialectics lay out the pros/cons and turning conditions of transformation; a world model simulates three future probabilities and designs three options — hold the line, dual-engine, and aggressive pivot; finally the Nuwa paradigm (create / repair / sustain) delivers a recommended "dual-engine" option with a three-phase roadmap, and a cosmic view calibrates the firm's long-term value. The output is a polished, offline-ready HTML strategy report with a Kondratieff wave chart, a system diagram, and an options table.

Ideal for: founders and executives of traditional firms, heads of strategy/investment, operators anxious about a second growth curve, transformation consultants, and business researchers wanting to learn cyclical and systematic decision-making.

2）用康波周期判断主营业务当前处于周期的哪个阶段（回升/繁荣/衰退/萧条/恢复），说明增速见顶是不是周期性信号，并给出对应的周期策略；
3）用系统科学分析主业现金流、新业务、人才组织、制度激励等要素之间的关系和反馈回路，指出关键节点；
4）用周易辩证列出转型的阴阳两面（有利/风险）与阴阳转化的关键条件；
5）用世界模型给出乐观/基准/悲观三种未来场景及概率；
6）设计至少 3 套战略方案（含死守主业、双轮驱动、激进转型），对比核心思路、预期收益、主要风险、适合条件；

请把结果做成一份排版精致、适合决策层阅读的单文件 HTML 战略报告：浅色专业商务风格、信息层次清晰，包含康波周期波形图、系统结构图、阴阳对比卡片、场景概率条、方案对比表、女娲三阶段卡片、行动时间线等可视化元素；要求单文件、所有 CSS/JS/图片（含 SVG 图表）全部内联、可离线打开、不引用任何外部链接。

cases.description: 手动编写 API 文档费时费力，格式不统一、代码示例过时、多语言维护成本高，开发者体验差。本案例一键生成 Stripe 风格的三栏 API 文档门户，支持深色/浅色主题切换、多语言代码示例（Python/JavaScript/cURL）、语法高亮、参数表格自动渲染，让你的 API 文档专业感拉满。适合后端工程师、技术写作者、API 产品经理，以及任何需要快速搭建高质量开发者文档的团队。
cases.description_en: Manually writing API documentation is time-consuming, inconsistent in format, with outdated code samples and high multi-language maintenance costs, resulting in poor developer experience. This case generates a Stripe-style three-column API documentation portal with dark/light theme toggle, multi-language code samples (Python/JavaScript/cURL), syntax highlighting, and auto-rendered parameter tables — making your API docs look professionally polished. Perfect for backend engineers, technical writers, API product managers, and any team needing high-quality developer documentation fast.

artifacts.label: API 文档门户

cases.prompt:
请参考 Stripe 官方文档风格，生成一个 AI API 服务文档门户页面（单文件 HTML，内联无外部依赖），支持深色/浅色主题切换（默认深色），响应式。

经典三栏布局：
- 左栏：可折叠导航（Introduction、Authentication、Chat Completions、Models、Error Handling）
- 中栏：每个 API 端点展示 HTTP Method、Path、描述、参数表（类型/required 标记）、响应说明
- 右栏：代码示例（Python / JavaScript / cURL 三语言 Tab 切换 + 语法高亮 + 一键复制 + JSON 响应示例）

左栏点击平滑滚动，小屏时右栏折叠到文档下方。整体简洁、信息密度高、专业。
cases.prompt_en:
Referencing the style of Stripe's official documentation, please generate an AI API service documentation portal page (single-file HTML, inline with no external dependencies), supporting dark/light theme toggling (dark by default), responsive.

Classic three-column layout:
- Left column: collapsible navigation (Introduction, Authentication, Chat Completions, Models, Error Handling)
- Center column: each API endpoint shows HTTP Method, Path, description, parameter table (type / required markers), and response notes
- Right column: code samples (Python / JavaScript / cURL three-language tab switching + syntax highlighting + one-click copy + JSON response examples)

Clicking left-column items smoothly scrolls; on small screens the right column collapses below the documentation. Overall clean, high information density, professional.

cases.title: 饮食分析
cases.subtitle: 每天吃得好不好，不再凭感觉：全餐热量拆解 + 结合身体状况提示风险 + 下一餐调整方案，一页讲清
cases.subtitle_en: Stop guessing whether you're eating well: meal calorie breakdown, risk alerts based on your health, and next-meal adjustments in one page
cases.description:
一日三餐天天吃，但真正说得清自己吃得健不健康的人并不多——热量多少、搭配合不合理、跟自己的身体状况合不合拍，大多凭感觉。对有基础病的人来说，这种“凭感觉”其实藏着不小的风险。

以一位 42 岁、有风湿性心脏病的男士为例：他把自己的一顿晚餐发给微小医，问「这顿饭健不健康、以后怎么吃」。微小医帮他算清了全餐热量、逐道菜拆解，结合他的病史指出了心脏方面的风险，还告诉他下一餐怎么换主食、改做法、控分量——最后生成一页清清爽爽的图文报告，存成图片发给家人，一起照着吃。
cases.description_en:
We eat three meals a day, yet few of us can say with confidence whether we're eating well — the calories, the balance, whether it suits our body, all left to guesswork. For people living with chronic conditions, that guesswork carries real risk.

Take a 42-year-old man with rheumatic heart disease: he sent his dinner to Weixiaoyi and asked, "Is this healthy, and how should I eat going forward?" Weixiaoyi worked out the total calories, broke down each dish, flagged the cardiac risks tied to his condition, and showed him how to adjust the next meal — all wrapped in a clean one-page report he could save as an image and share with his family.

artifacts.label: 晚餐健康分析报告 HTML 页面

cases.prompt: 帮我分析这顿晚饭健不健康，卡路里分别是多少如何，未来可以怎么进行调整。我的个人信息是：男，42岁，176cm，74kg，患有风湿性心脏病和脱发。将结果生成html进行展示。html 功能：1. 如有跳转链接，要同时支持点击跳转及弹窗扫描二维码访问；2. 固定导航栏，根据页面尺寸显示在顶部或侧边，需高亮当前模块，点击切换定位页面至对应模块；3. 可将页面内容保存为本地图片，图片中的信息元素显隐、排版需根据分享场景做一下优化；4. 数据列表限制最多5条；5.头部信息标题、副标题文本需体现该页面为全面的健康服务，显示品牌名称“微小医”及logo（https://kano.guahao.com/zj8979871203），logo裁成圆形。html ui设计风格：1. "医疗蓝扁平卡片流"：纯白大圆角卡片，以 0.5px 细线代替阴影分隔，全部交互强调收敛到单一品牌蓝 #3f86ff 及其渐变/透明度变体，通过 PingFang SC 三档字重与四级灰阶建立信息层级，主次按钮（渐变实心 vs 浅蓝描边）形成清晰的操作引导优先级；2. 统一配内联的svg图标；3. 可交互按钮鼠标悬停时增加动效；4. 元素布局根据页面尺寸调整，以提高展示效果；5. 重点内容用流程图、指标卡片等特殊样式进行说明。
cases.prompt_en: Analyze whether this dinner is healthy, how many calories each dish contains, and how I can adjust my diet going forward. My personal info: male, 42 years old, 176cm, 74kg, with rheumatic heart disease and hair loss. Present the results as an HTML page. HTML features: 1. Any external link should support both direct click-through and a popup with a scannable QR code; 2. A fixed navigation bar that sits on top or on the side depending on page width, highlighting the current section and scrolling to the corresponding section on click; 3. The page content can be saved as a local image, with element visibility and layout optimized for sharing; 4. Data lists are limited to 5 items at most; 5. The header title and subtitle should convey that this page is a comprehensive health service, showing the brand name "Weixiaoyi" and its logo (https://kano.guahao.com/zj8979871203), with the logo cropped into a circle. HTML UI style: 1. "Medical-blue flat card flow": pure white cards with large border radius, 0.5px hairlines instead of shadows for separation, all interactive emphasis confined to a single brand blue #3f86ff and its gradient/opacity variants, information hierarchy built on three font weights of PingFang SC and four grayscale levels, with primary vs. secondary buttons (solid gradient vs. light-blue outline) forming a clear action priority; 2. Consistent inline SVG icons; 3. Hover animations on all interactive buttons; 4. Element layout adapts to page size for better presentation; 5. Key content should be explained with special styles such as flow charts and metric cards.

这个案例用腾讯文档 Smart Page 跑一份『数字生活策展人』风格的个人主页——按七组件叙事（Hero / Stats / Timeline / Bento / Skills / Testimonial / Contact）把你的硬经历、软经历、爱好、趣味数据、好友吐槽、破冰话题全部编排进去，最终产出一个零外部依赖的单文件 H5，双击即开、手机可看、有滚动入场和点击微交互。

cases.description_en:
Tired of writing job-hunting resumes when all you want is to make friends?

This case uses Tencent Docs Smart Page to generate a 'Digital Life Curator' style personal profile — arranging your life across seven components (Hero / Stats / Timeline / Bento / Skills / Testimonial / Contact) and producing a single-file H5 page with zero external dependencies: double-click to open, mobile-friendly, with scroll reveals and tiny interactions.

Target audience: PMs, designers, creators, and freelancers who want a warm, memorable first impression — or anyone looking for a polished About Me page for a blog or digital business card.

artifacts.label: 个人介绍 H5 互动网页
结构化数据（可复用）

cases.prompt:
我想用腾讯文档 Smart Page 做一份『数字生活策展人』风格的个人介绍互动网页——不是简历，是交朋友用的社交名片。

请按下面的七组件叙事骨架输出单文件 H5（CSS/JS 全内联、系统字体栈、适配移动端、尊重 prefers-reduced-motion）：

1. HeroCard：身份混合体标题 + 拉近距离的大白话 slogan + Vibe 标签。
2. StatsBoard：6 项有趣的生活化数据，而非 KPI。
3. TimelinePro：至少 5 条双轨时间轴，混入生活节点。
4. BentoGallery：6 格兴趣宫格，把爱好包装成『项目』，每格一句心得；配图用 CSS 渐变或 SVG。
5. SkillRadar：8 项技能，混入 2–3 项软技能。
6. Testimonial：6 条朋友的真实吐槽或暖心评价，标签墙风格，带关系。
7. ContactSocial：每个渠道给出具体破冰话题和行动号召。

主题：Creative_Light（画廊风，琥珀 + 墨绿）。

【个人信息】
[此处粘贴你的简历 + 爱好 + 碎片经历，或口述一段；信息缺失处请合理脑补，让内容像一个活生生的人。]
cases.prompt_en:
I want to use Tencent Docs Smart Page to create a "digital life curator"-style personal-introduction interactive web page — not a resume, but a social calling card for making friends.

Please output a single-file H5 following the seven-component narrative skeleton below (all CSS/JS inlined, system font stack, mobile-friendly, respecting prefers-reduced-motion):

1. HeroCard: a hybrid-identity title + a down-to-earth, approachable slogan + Vibe tags.
2. StatsBoard: 6 fun, life-flavored stats rather than KPIs.
3. TimelinePro: at least 5 dual-track timeline entries, mixing in life milestones.
4. BentoGallery: a 6-cell interest grid that packages hobbies as "projects," each with a one-line takeaway; use CSS gradients or SVG for imagery.
5. SkillRadar: 8 skills, mixing in 2-3 soft skills.
6. Testimonial: 6 genuine roasts or heartwarming comments from friends, in a tag-wall style, each with the relationship.
7. ContactSocial: a concrete ice-breaker and a call-to-action for each channel.

Theme: Creative_Light (gallery style, amber + dark green).

[Personal Info]
[Paste your resume + hobbies + bits of experience here, or just describe yourself; fill any gaps with reasonable inferences so the content reads like a living, breathing person.]

cases.description: 项目群一晚上刷几百条消息，早上爬楼半小时还抓不住重点？这个案例演示用钉钉套件把指定项目群的消息做成「智能日报」：按讨论话题自动聚类，每个话题给出参与人、结论与关键原文摘录；待办自动提取并标注负责人和截止时间；未决分歧与风险单独标出；结尾附三句话管理者摘要。所有数据来自钉钉群消息真实查询，人名按需脱敏，产出一份可离线打开的单页日报。适合：项目经理、Scrum Master、多项目并行的团队负责人、不想爬楼的深度协作者、需要向上汇报群内进展的同学。
cases.description_en: A project group can pile up hundreds of messages overnight — and scrolling through them costs half an hour before you even find the point. This case shows the DingTalk suite turning a project group's messages into a smart daily digest: discussions auto-clustered by topic with participants, conclusions and key quotes; action items extracted with owners and deadlines; unresolved disagreements and risks flagged separately; and a closing three-sentence manager summary. All data comes from real DingTalk group-message queries, names anonymized on demand, delivered as one offline-ready page. Ideal for: project managers, Scrum Masters, multi-project team leads, deep collaborators who hate scrolling, and anyone reporting group progress upward.

cases.subtitle: 日程、待办、审批、邮件，一杯咖啡的时间全知道
cases.subtitle_en: Calendar, todos, approvals and mail — all before your first coffee
cases.description: 每天早上打开钉钉，日程要看日历、待办翻列表、审批切 OA、邮件再进一遍邮箱，四五个入口切下来，晨会都开始了。这个案例演示用钉钉套件一句话拉起「今日晨间简报」：自动读取今天的日程并标出连开会议与空闲窗口、按优先级整理待办、汇总待我处理的审批及已等待时长、摘要重要未读邮件，最后在页首给出「今日最该优先做的三件事」及理由，生成一份可离线打开的单页简报。适合：每天日程密集的职场人、管理者与团队负责人、行政与项目助理、想把钉钉多个入口收敛成一屏看的效率党。
cases.description_en: Every morning in DingTalk you hop between calendar, todo list, OA approvals and mail — by the time you are done, the standup has already started. This case shows the DingTalk suite pulling up a one-shot morning briefing: today's schedule with back-to-back meetings and free windows flagged, todos grouped by priority, approvals waiting on you with pending duration, key unread mails digested, and a top-three-things-to-do verdict at the very top — delivered as a single offline-ready page. Ideal for: schedule-heavy professionals, managers and team leads, admin and project assistants, and anyone who wants five DingTalk entrances collapsed into one screen.

cases.title: 疾病咨询
cases.subtitle: 体检指标异常别慌：把病讲明白 + 管理路线 + 饮食运动 + 用药须知 + 真实专家推荐，一页管全
cases.subtitle_en: Don't panic over an abnormal checkup result: the condition explained, a management roadmap, diet & exercise, medication notes, and real specialist picks in one page
cases.description:
体检季一过，不少人拿着报告单陷入同一种焦虑：指标箭头忽上忽下，说病不是病、说没事又不放心。网上说法五花八门，越查越不知道该信谁、要不要紧、下一步该怎么办。

以「糖尿病前期」为例：把心里的疑问讲给微小医听，它会用大白话把这个病说明白，给你一条清清楚楚的控糖路线、一日三餐的饮食示例、运动方案和用药须知，还帮你推荐杭州真实的内分泌专家——汇成一页指南，存图发给家人，一起照着做，心里踏实多了。
cases.description_en:
After every checkup season, many people find themselves stuck in the same anxiety: the arrows on the report point up and down — not quite a disease, but not nothing either. The advice online is all over the place, and the more you read, the less you know whom to trust or what to do next.

Take prediabetes as an example: share your worries with Weixiaoyi, and it explains the condition in plain language, lays out a clear glucose-control roadmap, sample meals, an exercise plan and medication notes, and even points you to real endocrinology specialists in Hangzhou — all in a one-page guide you can save and share with family, so you can face it together with peace of mind.

artifacts.label: 糖尿病前期健康管理指南 HTML 页面

cases.prompt_en: What is prediabetes? How should I control blood sugar in the prediabetes stage? What should I eat? How should I exercise? What medications can I take? Any external link should support both direct click-through and a popup with a scannable QR code; 2. cases.title: 红利低波 vs 银行ETF
cases.subtitle: 给“防御收益型底仓”一个真正能落地的条件化对比框架。
cases.subtitle_en: A practical framework for comparing defensive income sleeves with real conditions attached.
cases.description:
做防御收益型底仓时，最怕一句“红利”和一句“银行”就把事情说完。真正影响持有体验的，是回撤、波动、集中度和流动性，而不是标签本身。

这个案例真实对比了红利低波ETF华泰柏瑞和银行ETF华宝，把费率、收益、回撤、持仓差异和配置场景整理成一份像财富顾问手册的双语 HTML 页面，更适合直接拿去展示或复用。

适合：关注防御收益 ETF 的个人投资者、做资产配置沟通的财富顾问、需要稳定风格案例的金融产品团队、想展示 Skill 交付质感的运营同学。
cases.description_en:
When you build a defensive income sleeve, the worst habit is to stop at the labels “dividend” and “banks”. What really shapes holding experience is drawdown, volatility, concentration and liquidity rather than the label itself.

This case compares Huatai Dividend Low Vol ETF and HuaBao Bank ETF with real data, then turns fees, return, drawdown, holdings divergence and allocation scenarios into a bilingual HTML page that feels closer to a wealth-advisor booklet than a plain fact sheet.

Best for: individual investors looking at defensive-income ETFs, wealth advisors communicating allocation choices, finance product teams that need a stable-style case, and operators who want to show delivery quality of the skill.
cases.prompt: 请基于 ETF深度对比 skill 的官方能力，对红利低波ETF华泰柏瑞（sh512890）和银行ETF华宝（sh512800）做一次真实公开数据对比。使用 westock-data 官方 CLI 获取 ETF detail、holdings、quote、kline 等数据，重点比较规模、费率、过去 1 个月 / 3 个月 / 年初至今收益、波动、最大回撤、前十大重仓、流动性与适用场景。最终交付一个单文件 HTML 报告，资源全部内联，可离线打开。结论请写成“什么账户适合哪一只 + 主要风险提醒”，不要输出确定性买卖建议。
cases.prompt_en: Please use the official capability of the ETF depth comparison skill to compare Huatai Dividend Low Vol ETF (sh512890) and HuaBao Bank ETF (sh512800) with real public data. Use the official westock-data CLI to fetch ETF detail, holdings, quote and kline data, then compare scale, fees, 1-month / 3-month / YTD return, volatility, max drawdown, top holdings, liquidity and scenario fit. Deliver a single-file HTML report, fully inlined and offline-ready. Present the conclusion as “which account setup fits which ETF” plus key risk notes instead of a deterministic buy or sell call.

cases.description: 读完一本好书，观点却很快忘光、难以复用？本案由「文通通」专家把丹尼尔·卡尼曼的《思考，快与慢》拆解整理为一份结构化精读笔记：从一句话总览、系统1与系统2双系统框架，到锚定、可得性、损失厌恶、框架效应等关键认知偏误卡片、全书脉络图、5条金句，以及对工作与决策的6条行动启发。交付物是一份优雅阅读笔记风的单文件HTML摘要卡，米色纸感配衬线标题与书签色带，可直接收藏复用。适合管理者、产品运营、投资者，以及想系统理解'人为何非理性'的读者。
cases.description_en: Finished a great book but forgot the ideas a week later? The deliverable is an elegant single-file HTML summary card with a paper-toned, serif, bookmark-ribbon style — ready to keep and reuse. Great for managers, product and ops folks, investors, and anyone wanting to understand why people are predictably irrational.

cases.title_en: Dragon Boat Festival Relic Science Article
cases.subtitle: 用一件战国船纹青铜缶，把端午竞渡的源头摆给读者看
cases.subtitle_en: Trace the visual origin of Duanwu racing to a single Warring States bronze fou
cases.description:
端午推文常见两种写法：复述屈原故事、列端午习俗清单。这个案例用第三种——让一件战国船纹青铜缶（宁波中国港口博物馆镇馆之宝、国内仅存）做主角：它把竞渡画在器腹上，比文献早、比传说直观。

演示内容：调用探元知识库确认器物细节（高 37.8 cm、腹径 50.5 cm；下腹四组羽人竞渡纹；学界两种解读——战船凯旋 / 龙舟祭祀；百越故地出土），配合三闾庙浮梁龙舟竞渡 2400 年史、宋代史浩《花心动·端午》词作，写出一篇「看完再去过节」的科普图文。

适合：博物馆宣教编辑、节庆科普栏目、博物馆教育课程开发人员，以及任何想用「实物 + 文献」双支撑，写出有质感的端午推文的公众号主笔。
cases.description_en:
Dragon Boat Festival articles usually re-tell Qu Yuan's biography or list customs. This case picks a third path: let one artifact — the Warring States bronze fou with boat-race decoration (Ningbo China Port Museum, sole surviving example of its kind) — do the storytelling. The boats are right there on the vessel's belly, earlier than any text and more literal than any legend.

Demo: pull the fou from the TanYuan KB (h. 37.8 cm, max dia. 50.5 cm; four feathered-man boat-race bands; two academic interpretations — victorious war-fleet vs. dragon-boat ritual; recovered from the ancient Hundred-Yue homeland) and pair it with the Fuliang dragon-boat tradition at Sanlu Temple (2,400+ years) and Shi Hao's Song-dynasty ci poem 《Hua Xindong · Duanwu》. Deliver a "read this before you celebrate" science article.

Best for: museum WeChat editors, holiday science columns, museum-education curriculum designers, and any public-account writer who wants a Duanwu article grounded in both objects and texts.

cases.prompt:
请基于以下要点，写一篇端午主题的文物科普公众号图文。

写作要点：
1. 不写屈原故事开头：以「战国缶上的竞渡，比文献更早」做钩子，让读者理解端午看得见的源头在青铜器上。
2. 真实文物：所有数据必须调用 mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_relics / search_movable_relics 检索。常见支撑：
   - 战国船纹青铜缶：战国，国家一级，宁波中国港口博物馆镇馆之宝；高 37.8 cm、腹径 50.5 cm；下腹饰四组羽人竞渡纹；每船 5 人左右、戴羽饰；广西北海合浦出土；具有明显楚国青铜器特征；学界两种解读（战船 vs 龙舟祭祀）；国内仅存。
   - 三闾庙（江西浮梁）：屈原曾到过浮梁；浮梁以龙舟竞渡方式庆祝端午，迄今 2400 多年；庙门口对古码头；庙中 3.6 m 屈原青铜像。
3. 观点分层：
   - 第 2 章：器物本身（尺寸/纹饰/出土/孤品价值）。
   - 第 3 章：为什么说它画了端午——羽人船纹的鸟神崇拜 + 楚地巫祭传统 → 接近龙舟祭祀。
   - 第 4 章：战国竞渡接住屈原故事后，宋代史浩《花心动·端午》「菖歙碎琼，角黍堆金，龙舟竞夺，锦标方彻」——一条水脉延续到今天。
   - 第 5 章：端午文物小目录（缶、三闾庙、铜鉴缶）。
4. 结尾：把「看完再去过节」的视角落到读者身上——当晚如遇博物馆开放夜场，欢迎去现场对照。
5. 风格：doocs/md 风格——677px 居中、淡蓝/水纹底（端午色系）、章节小标题加蓝条、卡片块列出端午文物小目录；克制、美观。
6. 配图：探元知识库已授权的战国缶图（multi image_url），download 后 base64 内嵌。
7. 字数：1500–1800 字正文。
8. 逐处标源：每个事实声明「来自探元知识库《...》词条」或宋代史浩《花心动·端午》。

约束：输出单文件 HTML，CSS 全内联，图片 data:image/...;base64,... 内嵌，禁止任何外链。封面图单独导出 cover.png。
cases.prompt_en:
Write a Dragon Boat Festival (Duanwu) themed WeChat science article. The expert persona is the TanYuan Heritage Article Expert — a heritage science writer.

Writing requirements:
1. Do not start with the Qu Yuan biography. Open with "the Warring States bronze fou shows Duanwu boat-racing earlier than any text does" — let the reader see the visual origin of the festival on a vessel's belly.
2. Real artifacts: every fact must come from mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_relics / search_movable_relics. Useful anchors:
   - Warring States boat-pattern bronze fou: Warring States, National Grade-1, Ningbo China Port Museum keeper-piece; h. 37.8 cm, max dia. 50.5 cm; four bands of feathered-man boat-race decoration; 5 figures per boat with feathered headdresses; recovered from Beihai, Guangxi; strong Chu-bronze style; two academic readings (war-fleet vs. dragon-boat ritual); sole surviving example in China.
   - Sanlu Temple (Fuliang, Jiangxi): Qu Yuan once visited Fuliang; the place has celebrated Duanwu with dragon-boat racing for 2,400+ years; temple faces the old dock; houses a 3.6 m bronze statue of Qu Yuan.
3. Layered argument:
   - §2 the object itself (dimensions, decoration, provenance, singleton status).
   - §3 why the fou "paints Duanwu" — bird-god totem of feathered figures + Chu-region shamanic rite → dragon-boat-ritual reading.
   - §4 how the Warring States racing absorbed the Qu Yuan story and stayed alive through the Song dynasty poet Shi Hao's 《Hua Xindong · Duanwu》("菖歙碎琼，角黍堆金，龙舟竞夺，锦标方彻") — one continuous water-line to today.
   - §5 a "Duanwu relic directory" (the fou, Sanlu Temple, bronze jian-fou).
4. Close: pull the "read this before you celebrate" frame to the reader — if a local museum has a night opening tonight, invite them to verify in person.
5. Visual style: doocs/md — 677px column, soft blue / water-palette background (Duanwu color), blue-bullet section headings, soft cards; restrained, WeChat-ready.
6. Imagery: authorized TanYuan KB images of the fou (multiple image_url fields), downloaded and embedded as base64.
7. Length: 1500–1800 Chinese characters of body copy.
8. Cite every fact: each claim labels source.

Output: a single HTML file, all CSS inlined, all images as data:image/...;base64,..., no external links. Export a separate cover.png.

cases.description:
长辈寄来一盒没见过的药，或旅游带回的进口药，名字陌生、看不懂。打字查又拼不准。

这个案例演示把一张手机拍的药盒照片交给智能问药：它用多模态识别药盒上的通用名、商品名、规格、厂家，对反光/模糊处如实标注「识别不清」而非瞎猜；接着解读这是什么药、每天吃几次、常见副作用、哪些人禁用，并提醒长期管理药不能自行停用。

适合：代父母管理用药、整理家庭药箱、跨境/进口药识别、药店用药咨询服务。
cases.description_en:
An elder mails you an unfamiliar box of medicine, or you bring back an imported drug whose name you cannot read or spell.

This case shows handing a phone photo of the box to the drug-query skill: it identifies the generic name, brand, strength and manufacturer via multimodal recognition, marking glare/blur areas as "unclear" rather than guessing; then explains what the drug is, how often to take it, common side effects, who must not use it, and reminds that long-term drugs should not be stopped on your own.

Good for: managing parents' medications, tidying the home medicine cabinet, identifying imported drugs, pharmacy consultation.
cases.prompt: 老人药箱里有盒阿托伐他汀钙片，20mg×7 片，辉瑞的。这药是治什么的、每天什么时候吃、长期吃要注意什么、要定期查什么？

cases.description_en:
After a stent you take antiplatelets, plus hypertension drugs daily, and want ibuprofen for a toothache — will it bleed? Ordinary people hold several drugs and cannot tell conflicts at a glance.

This case shows handing a medication list to the drug-query skill: it sorts each drug's class, flags high-risk interactions (antiplatelet + ibuprofen raising bleeding, NSAID weakening antihypertensives), checks for duplicate active ingredients, then gives dosing-interval and bleeding-signal tips.

Good for: polypharmacy chronic patients, stent/anticoagulation users, pharmacy safety education, pre-review at tele-health.

cases.title: 数字化技术对敦煌壁画保护的影响研究
cases.title_en: Impact of Digital Technology on Dunhuang Mural Preservation
cases.subtitle: 从1980年代胶片摄影到数字敦煌全球访问:三十年技术演进与保护范式重塑
cases.subtitle_en: From 1980s film photography to global Digital Dunhuang access: three decades of technology evolution and preservation paradigm shift
cases.description:
敦煌莫高窟壁画是脆弱到禁止拍照的国宝级文物,但我们今天却能在网上看到毫米级高清的数字化壁画,这中间到底经历了一场怎样的技术革命?

这个案例演示了如何借助腾讯探元文物数据库与知识库的并行检索,主代理亲自做 3-4 路网络调研(最新进展/典型案例/影响成效/历史脉络),覆盖胶片数字化、高清壁画全球访问、数字洞窟、虚拟漫游、AI 辅助病害识别、永续保存与海外巡展等维度,最终交付包含 3-6 张配图与 1-2 张趋势图表的 Markdown / HTML / DOCX / PDF 四格式趋势综述报告。

适合:文物保护工程与考古学研究者、博物馆数字化从业人员、丝绸之路与敦煌学研究者、文化遗产政策与法规研究者、数字人文与艺术史专业研究生、文物保护材料与装备研发从业者。
cases.description_en:
Dunhuang Mogao Cave murals are so fragile that photography is banned, yet today we can view millimeter-resolution digital murals online—what technological revolution took place in between?

This case shows how to leverage Tencent Tanyuan relic and knowledge bases for parallel retrieval, plus 3-4 concurrent main-agent WebSearch passes (latest progress / benchmark cases / impact / historical lines), covering film scanning, global high-resolution mural access, digital caves, virtual tours, AI-assisted disease identification, perpetual preservation, and overseas touring exhibitions—delivering a 3-6 image + 1-2 trend-chart Markdown/HTML/DOCX/PDF four-format trend review report.

Best for: conservation engineering and archaeology researchers, museum digitization practitioners, Silk Road and Dunhuang studies researchers, cultural-heritage policy researchers, digital humanities and art-history graduate students, conservation-materials and equipment professionals.

cases.prompt:
请按「腾讯探元学术研究-趋势综述」专家的工作流,综述「数字化技术对敦煌壁画保护的影响研究」。

研究范围(覆盖五维):
- 数字化采集技术演进:1980 年代胶片摄影→冷光照明+大幅面胶片→高精度多频段采集(紫外/可见/红外)→毫米级结构光三维扫描→多视角图像建模
- 全球访问与平台:「数字敦煌」国际网站、敦煌研究院数字资源库、海外数字洞窟展览(英国大英博物馆/法国吉美博物馆)、谷歌艺术与文化合作
- 病害分析与预警:盐害、起甲、酥碱、霉变、烟熏等病害图像识别,AI 卷积神经网络模型,洞窟微环境监测与风险预警
- 虚拟现实与沉浸体验:VR 漫游洞窟、增强现实洞窟复原、互动展项
- 永久保存与活化利用:壁画「数字档案」、标准编制、海外巡展、文创 IP

交付要求(强制):
1. 探元两库 MCP(search_movable_relics + search_relics)并行检索 + 主代理 3-4 路 WebSearch 多源核验,优先近 1-2 年(2025/2026)信源,以及敦煌研究院、英国国家美术馆、学术期刊信源
2. 配图 ≥ 3 张(Wikimedia 公共领域 / 敦煌研究院官网 / 公开新闻图源),必须实图、与主题相关
3. 趋势图表 ≥ 1 张(建议 2-3 张:数字化采集技术演进时间线/病害识别 AI 模型对比/全球访问桑基图),matplotlib 渲染为 SVG,严格避免标签重叠
4. 四格式报告:Markdown 母版 → HTML(嵌入 base64 图片) → DOCX → PDF,综述结构(领域背景→发展现状→典型案例→影响成效→趋势展望→结论→证据与局限→参考来源)
5. 报告日期用真实当前日期;参考文献按时间倒序;只写结论不含建议;主要趋势判断同步输出到对话窗口
cases.prompt_en:
Use the 'Tencent Tanyuan Academic Research - Trend Review' expert workflow to survey the 'Impact of Digital Technology on Dunhuang Mural Preservation'.

Research scope (five dimensions):
- Digitization acquisition technology evolution: 1980s film photography → cold-light + large-format film → high-precision multi-band (UV/visible/IR) → millimeter-grade structured-light 3D scanning → multi-view image modelling
- Global access platforms: Digital Dunhuang international website, Dunhuang Academy digital archive, overseas digital cave exhibitions (British Museum / Guimet), Google Arts & Culture collaboration
- Disease analysis and early warning: salt damage, flaking, efflorescence, mould, soot contamination identification; AI CNN models; micro-environment monitoring and risk warning
- Virtual reality and immersive experience: VR cave tours, AR cave restoration, interactive exhibits
- Permanent preservation and activation: digital mural archives, standards drafting, overseas touring, cultural-product IP

Delivery requirements (mandatory):
1. Parallel retrieval via Tanyuan dual bases MCP (search_movable_relics + search_relics) + 3-4 main-agent WebSearch passes for cross-source verification, prioritizing sources from the last 1-2 years (2025/2026) plus Dunhuang Academy, British Museum, Guimet, academic journal sources
2. ≥ 3 images (Wikimedia public domain / Dunhuang Academy official / public news), each verified real and topic-relevant
3. ≥ 1 trend chart (2-3 recommended: digitization technology evolution timeline / AI disease identification model comparison / global-access sankey), rendered to SVG via matplotlib with strict label overlap avoidance
4. Four formats: Markdown master → HTML (base64-inlined images) → DOCX → PDF, trend-review structure (background → status → cases → impact → outlook → conclusion → limits → references)
5. Report date is the true current date; references sorted reverse-chronologically; conclusions only, no recommendations; key trend judgments sync to chat window

cases.title: 跟着《早春晴朗》游哈尔滨
cases.title_en: Tour Harbin with the Drama Early Spring
cases.subtitle: 剧集取景地打卡地图：4 大主题 11 处实景一键巡游
cases.subtitle_en: Drama filming-location map: 11 real spots across 4 themed routes
cases.description:
想跟着热播剧打卡同款取景地，却总要在大杂烩攻略里一个个搜坐标？《早春晴朗》里男女主漫步的中央大街、定情的教堂长椅、重逢的老酒馆，到底都在哪、怎么走最顺路？

这个案例用腾讯地图把剧中 4 大主题、11 处哈尔滨实景搬进一张可交互地图：一念难桃三大名场面、冰城底色城市地标、城外"瑞士"雪原山水和同款味道菜馆，每个点位都带剧情注解和打卡提示，支持按主题筛选、一键巡游和飞线动画预览路线，扫码即可存入腾讯地图小程序，手机随时导航、分享同好。

适合：剧迷打卡党、哈尔滨旅行规划者，以及想复刻"影视+地图"玩法的内容创作者和文旅运营。
cases.description_en:
Want to visit your favorite drama's filming spots but stuck searching coordinates one by one in messy travel notes? Where exactly are the Central Boulevard promenade, the church bench and the reunion restaurant from Early Spring, and what's the best route?

This case brings 11 real Harbin locations from the drama into one interactive Tencent map, organized into 4 themes: the three iconic romance scenes, city landmarks, the "Swiss" snow-forest scenery outside town, and same-flavor restaurants. Every spot carries scene notes and check-in tips, with theme filtering, one-tap auto-tour and flight-line animation to preview routes. Scan the QR code to save the guide into the Tencent Maps mini program for on-the-go navigation and sharing.

Ideal for: drama fans on location pilgrimages, Harbin trip planners, and content creators or tourism operators looking to replicate the "drama + map" play.
cases.prompt: 用腾讯地图的自定义地图能力，为热播剧《早春晴朗》制作一份「跟着电视剧游哈尔滨」取景地打卡指南页，输出一份可直接打开的单页 HTML。数据用剧中真实取景地：按主题分组——一念难桃·三大名场面（中央大街、圣·索菲亚教堂、老俄侨俄侨菜馆(西十三道街店)）、冰城底色·城市地标（松花江滨洲铁路桥、斯大林公园、中华巴洛克历史文化街区、哈尔滨大剧院、哈尔滨站）、城外山水·瑞士其实在哈尔滨（郡王山露营基地、横头山金龙山国家森林公园）、同款味道（拾楼壹号哈埠菜馆），共 4 个主题 11 处点位，每个点位含名称、坐标、剧情注解与打卡提示。页面布局：左侧剧名卡片与分组点位列表（序号徽标、简介、打卡提示，支持按分组筛选和查看全部），右侧全屏地图打点展示，提供巡游模式与飞线动画两种路线预览方式，并生成二维码引导用户存入腾讯地图小程序（手机查看、一键导航、分享同好）。
cases.prompt_en: Use Tencent Maps' custom map capability to create a "Tour Harbin with the drama Early Spring" filming-location guide page, delivered as a single HTML file that opens directly in a browser. Use real filming locations from the drama, grouped by theme: three iconic romance scenes (Central Street, Saint Sophia Cathedral, Old Russian emigre restaurant), city landmarks (Songhua River Railway Bridge, Stalin Park, Chinese Baroque Historic District, Harbin Grand Theatre, Harbin Railway Station), snow-forest scenery outside town (Junwang Mountain campsite, Jintou Mountain National Forest Park), and same-flavor restaurants (Shilou No.1 Harbin Cuisine), 4 themes and 11 spots in total, each with a name, coordinates, scene notes and check-in tips. Layout: a drama title card and grouped spot list on the left (numbered badges, intros, check-in tips, with group filtering and an all-spots view), a full-screen map with pins on the right, two route-preview modes (auto-tour and flight-line animation), plus a QR code guiding users to save the guide into the Tencent Maps mini program (view on phone, one-tap navigation, share with fellow fans).
