cases.title: 地球Online（大学版）
cases.subtitle: 把大学生活过成一场角色扮演游戏
cases.subtitle_en: Turn college life into a role-playing game
cases.description:
大学生活过得像一团浆糊，上过的课、做过的事转头就忘，更别说看清自己到底会什么、想学什么。

这个案例展示了一个游戏化的「大学成长人物面板」：像玩游戏一样给自己建玩家档案、挑形象，随手记录真实经历自动整理成结构化复盘、提取技能，想学的技能拆成每天能打勾的小任务，经验值、等级、技能树、日历、每日一句全部联动，还能随时生成一张游戏风人物存档卡。演示数据是一位建筑系大二学生的真实感日常。所有数据落在资料库数据表，手机电脑双向同步。

适合：想把大学生活过明白一点的人、需要一点游戏化动力去学习和记录的人、想给自己攒一份成长存档的人。
cases.description_en:
College life blurs by—classes attended and things done are quickly forgotten, let alone a clear picture of what you can do and what you want to learn.

This case shows a gamified "college growth character panel": create a player profile and pick a look like in a game, jot down real experiences that get auto-structured into reflections and skill suggestions, break skills you want to learn into daily checkable tasks, with EXP, levels, a skill tree, a calendar and a daily quote all interconnected—plus a game-style character archive card you can generate anytime. Demo data follows a believable day-to-day of a sophomore architecture student. All data lives in Library tables with two-way sync across devices.

Best for: students who want to live college life a bit more deliberately, anyone needing gamified motivation to learn and record, and anyone who'd love to keep a growing archive of themselves.

artifacts.label: 地球Online（大学版）工作台（单体 HTML）

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/dGEWUioQbbmcx82MUAP2Uz，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

帮我做一个「地球Online（大学版）」游戏化大学成长工作台，做成单个完整 HTML 文件。

功能模块：
1. 启动流程：启动页（品牌视觉 + 点击进入）→ 建立玩家档案表单（昵称必填，学校、专业、年级选择、一句话描述、兴趣关键词、职业关键词）→ 选择角色形象（5 张预设背景 + 14 个预设角色，点选实时合成预览）→ 进入首页。
2. 首页人物面板：人物卡（形象图、昵称、学校/专业/年级、一句话气泡、兴趣标签）；等级经验条（LV.1~30，加经验弹 +EXP 提示、升级弹庆祝）；两个主操作（记录一段经历 / 帮我学习一个技能）；我的技能等级（从经历和学习任务自动识别 22 个分类并累计等级）；本月日历（有经历或完成任务的日子打点、周末与今天高亮）；今日清单（自建待办回车添加、勾选 +8 EXP，每个学习中的技能显示今天第一个未完成任务、勾选 +5 EXP，今天记过的经历也在列）；最近经历 5 条；正在学习 Top3（进度条 + 下一步任务）；每日答案之书（按日期稳定抽一句，可换一句）。底部导航：人物 / 经历 / 技能 / 存档。
3. 经历库：记录经历（日期、标题、发生了什么），本地规则自动整理成「发生了什么 / 我做了什么 / 结果 / 我的感受」四段结构，并按关键词给出技能建议（只有我勾选确认才加入面板，可自己补充）；经历列表可展开原始输入、可删除；记录经历 +30 起 EXP、每确认一个技能 +20 EXP。
4. 技能树：左边「我已经拥有的技能」（来自经历确认），右边「我想学习的新技能」；可新建成长方向并勾选技能归入、按方向 Tab 筛选。想学新技能时用一句话描述目标，内置领域知识库（雅思 / 视频剪辑 / 设计 / 做饭 / 健身 / 写作等）自动拆成 2-3 个能力单元和按天或按周的具体学习任务（每个任务含做什么、时长、达标标准），最后一个是验证任务；勾选任务推进进度与单元状态，全部完成且验证任务通过后技能正式点亮。
5. 存档：把当前昵称 / 学校 / 年级 / 等级 / 技能 / 经历汇总成游戏风人物存档卡，可命名保存多版历史存档并点击回看，可生成存档长图保存或分享。

数据落在资料库数据表，支持在线存储与双向同步：eo_玩家档案（昵称/学校/专业/年级/一句话描述/兴趣关键词/职业关键词/总经验）、eo_经历库（日期/标题/描述/结果/感受/确认技能）、eo_技能（技能名/状态[已点亮/学习中/想学]/目标/进度说明/确认日期）、eo_任务（类型[学习任务/今日待办]/所属技能/日期/标题/内容/时长/达标标准/是否完成）。页面加载时从数据表拉取渲染，页面内的新增与修改异步回写数据表。

视觉方向：像素游戏风 + 清新手账感，奶油色卡片、像素描边、游戏化图标，mobile-first 单栏布局。无外部 CDN 依赖。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library capability to clone this workbench in one click: https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/dGEWUioQbbmcx82MUAP2Uz — with online data storage and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click clone path; if unavailable, build as follows: Build me a "Earth Online (College Edition)" gamified college-growth workbench as a single complete HTML file. Feature modules:
1. Onboarding flow: splash page (brand visual + tap to enter) → player profile form (nickname required; school, major, grade selector, one-line bio, interest keywords, career keywords) → character look picker (5 preset backgrounds + 14 preset characters with live composited preview) → home.
2. Home character panel: character card (avatar, nickname, school/major/grade, one-line bubble, interest tags); level & EXP bar (LV.1–30, +EXP toast on gains, celebration toast on level-up); two main actions (Log an Experience / Help Me Learn a Skill); "My Skill Levels" (auto-detects 22 categories from experiences and learning tasks, accumulating levels); monthly calendar (dots on days with experiences or completed tasks, weekends and today highlighted); Today's list (add custom todos with Enter, +8 EXP per check; each learning skill shows today's first unfinished task, +5 EXP per check; today's logged experiences also listed); 5 recent experiences; top-3 learning goals (progress bar + next task); Daily Book of Answers (a stable quote per date, refreshable). Bottom nav: Character / Log / Skills / Archive.
3. Experience log: log an experience (date, title, what happened); local rules structure it into "what happened / what I did / result / how I felt", and suggest skills by keywords (only my confirmed ticks join the panel; custom additions allowed); the list supports expanding raw input and deletion; logging an experience grants +30 EXP and up, each confirmed skill +20 EXP.
4. Skill tree: left "Skills I already have" (confirmed from experiences), right "New skills I want to learn"; create growth tracks, assign skills to tracks, filter by track tabs. Describe a learning goal in one sentence; a built-in domain knowledge base (IELTS / video editing / design / cooking / fitness / writing, etc.) breaks it into 2–3 ability units and concrete daily or weekly tasks (each with action, duration, and pass standard), ending with a verification task; checking tasks advances progress and unit states, and once everything plus verification is done, the skill is officially lit.
5. Archive: compile current nickname / school / grade / level / skills / experiences into a game-style character archive card; save multiple named historical archives and revisit them; generate a tall archive image to save or share. Data lives in Library tables with online storage and two-way sync: eo_玩家档案 (nickname/school/major/grade/bio/interests/career keywords/total EXP), eo_经历库 (date/title/description/result/feeling/confirmed skills), eo_技能 (skill name/status[已点亮/学习中/想学]/goal/progress note/confirmation date), eo_任务 (type[学习任务/今日待办]/skill/date/title/content/duration/standard/done). The page pulls from the tables on load; additions and edits in the page are asynchronously written back. Visual direction: pixel-game style meets fresh journal aesthetic—cream cards, pixel borders, game icons, mobile-first single-column layout. no external CDN dependencies.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 定时 AI 资讯聚合 Agent 应用
cases.subtitle: 多 Agent 流水线每天自动产出 AI 资讯日报，部署到 EdgeOne Makers
cases.subtitle_en: A multi-agent pipeline that auto-generates a daily AI news digest, deployed on EdgeOne Makers
cases.description:
每天想快速掌握 AI 圈动态，却要在 Hacker News、Dev.to 之间反复刷、人工筛选摘要，既费时又容易漏。

这个案例由「Makers 开发专家团」协作完成：主理人齐上线做技术选型与编排，前端裴知页搭 React+Vite 工作台，后端范云申用 LangGraph 写「采集 → 过滤分类 → 摘要 → 打分 → 生成报告」五阶段流水线，全程通过 SSE 实时把进度推到前端。支持 cron 每天 09:00 自动触发，也能点按钮手动跑；产出一份带分类、重要性评分和中文摘要的 Markdown 日报并落库，可随时回看历史。案例同时附带完整可部署的项目工程包。

适合：① 想在 EdgeOne Makers 上做定时 Agent 应用的全栈开发者；② 需要搭建资讯/趋势聚合看板的产品团队；③ 想学习 LangGraph 多节点流水线 + SSE 流式推送 + 定时触发完整范式的工程师。
cases.description_en:
Want to stay on top of the AI world every day, but tired of jumping between Hacker News and Dev.to, manually filtering and summarizing — slow and easy to miss things?

This case is delivered by the "Makers Dev Team": the lead orchestrates the tech stack, the frontend engineer builds a React+Vite workbench, and the backend engineer implements a five-stage LangGraph pipeline (collect → filter/classify → summarize → score → report), streaming progress to the frontend over SSE in real time. It supports a cron trigger at 09:00 daily as well as a manual run button; it outputs a categorized, importance-scored Chinese Markdown digest that is persisted for history browsing. The case also ships the full deployable project source.

For: (1) full-stack developers building scheduled Agent apps on EdgeOne Makers; (2) product teams that need a news/trend aggregation dashboard; (3) engineers learning the complete pattern of LangGraph multi-node pipelines + SSE streaming + scheduled triggers.

我想在 EdgeOne Makers 上做一个定时运行的 AI 资讯/趋势聚合 Agent 应用，请按团队协作流程完成开发与部署。

2. 数据源：Hacker News、Dev.to 两个公开 API
3. 定时频率：每天一次
4. 单次条目数上限：30 条

cases.prompt_en:
I want to build a scheduled AI news/trend aggregation Agent app on EdgeOne Makers. Please complete development and deployment following the team collaboration workflow.

App shape:

Defaults:

2. Data sources: Hacker News and Dev.to public APIs
3. Schedule: once a day

5. Model: @makers/minimax-m2.7

Delivery: get the main flow working so it reliably completes "scheduled trigger → Agent pipeline → report → frontend shows report + articles"; finally do a local preview + deploy and give me the full access URL.

cases.title: 如何了解新上市的ETF：创业板算力ETF易方达
cases.title_en: Getting to Know a Newly Listed ETF: E Fund ChiNext Computing Power ETF
cases.subtitle: 158050！创系列上新，这次轮到算力
cases.subtitle_en: 158050 is live — this time, computing power
cases.description:
新ETF上市，最麻烦的不是买不到，是看不懂——它跟踪的指数是什么、最近的行情走到了哪一步，信息散在公告、指数公司和七八篇公众号文章里。

这份报告替你把这些收进一页：创业板算力指数近一年涨了多少、波动多大、最新点位和当日表现，一张表看完；再挑出 5 篇最相关的公众号原文，点标题直接跳原文，不用自己搜。

你看完会知道：这只 ETF 到底装的是什么资产。
cases.description_en:
The hard part of a newly listed ETF is never access — it is understanding what is inside. What index does it track? Where does the market stand right now? The answers are scattered across filings, the index provider's site and half a dozen WeChat articles.

This report gathers them onto one page: how much the ChiNext computing-power index has returned over the past year, how volatile it has been, its latest level and daily move — all in a single table. Plus five of the most relevant E Fund WeChat articles, each a click away from the original.

By the end you will know what this ETF actually holds.

artifacts.label: 创业板算力ETF易方达 · 跟踪指数与相关资讯（单页 HTML 报告）

cases.prompt:
围绕「易方达创业板算力ETF（158050）2026-09-18 在深交所上市」，用「指数查询」+ efunds 连接器出一份单页 HTML 简报，只讲两块：

1）跟踪指数：创业板算力基础设施指数（970083）的编制属性、申万一级行业分布、前十大成分股权重、近一年收益与年化波动率、PE/PB 当前倍数、最新行情（点位、涨跌幅、昨收、时间）。
2）相关资讯：挑 4–5 篇易方达系公众号相关文章，给出标题、公众号、发布时间与原文逐字摘录（不得改写为归纳），标题可点开原文。

数据须真实查询并注明来源与日期，取不到就留空，不要编造或估算。单文件 HTML、样式内联、可离线打开；红涨绿跌；末尾附数据来源与风险提示。
cases.prompt_en:

cases.title: 企业投资可研第1-3章编写实操：新能源储能电站
cases.title_en: Enterprise FSR Chapters 1-3: New Energy Storage Station
cases.subtitle: 基于2023版大纲，逐章演示企业投资可研与政府项目的关键差异
cases.subtitle_en: A chapter-by-chapter demo of enterprise feasibility study with differences from government projects
cases.description:
企业可研报告和政府项目可研大纲相似但写法迥异——最头疼的是不知道哪些地方该写「赚钱逻辑」、哪些地方该写「公共服务」。

本案例以某制造企业 50MW/100MWh 储能电站为样本，按2023版10章框架逐章编写第1-3章（项目概况、市场与商业模式、选址与要素保障），每章标注与政府项目写法的关键差异，让读者一眼看清企业项目可研的正确姿势。

适合：企业可研编制人员、银行审贷经理、投资经理、咨询顾问、储能项目开发者。
cases.description_en:
Enterprise feasibility reports and government project reports share similar outlines but require fundamentally different approaches — the hardest part is knowing where to write 'profit logic' and where to write 'public service'.

This case uses a manufacturing enterprise's 50MW/100MWh energy storage station as a sample, demonstrating Chapters 1-3 (Project Overview, Market & Business Model, Site Selection & Factor Assurance) following the 2023 edition 10-chapter framework, with key differences from government project approaches clearly annotated for each chapter.

For: feasibility report writers, bank credit reviewers, investment managers, consultants, energy storage project developers.

artifacts.label: 第1-3章编写稿（含企业vs政府差异对比）

cases.prompt:
请根据《项目任务书_新能源储能电站企业投资.md》中的项目参数（50MW/100MWh储能电站，总投资约2.1亿元，商业模式为峰谷套利+需求响应+备用容量），按《企业投资项目可行性研究报告编写参考大纲》（2023年版）10章框架，编写第1-3章（项目概况、市场与商业模式、选址与要素保障）的编写稿。

要求：
1. 严格按照企业投资可研的编写指引，每章包含指引要求的全部子节
2. 每章末尾以「与政府项目的差异」框单独标注企业项目与政府项目写法的关键区别
3. 项目概况需包含项目基本画像（含技术经济指标表）、企业综合画像（含能力匹配论证）、编制依据、结论与建议综述
4. 市场与商业模式需包含规划政策符合性、企业战略必要性、市场维度分析（行业全景/目标市场/容量预测/竞争格局/价格分析）、建设内容与产出方案、商业模式设计（收入结构/成本结构/盈利评估/外部支持条件）
5. 选址与要素保障需包含多方案比选、建设条件分析、要素保障评估
6. 数据使用真实查询或基于行业公开数据的合理推算，标注数据来源和推算依据
7. 输出为单文件HTML，资源全内联、可离线打开

Market & Business Model must include policy compliance, enterprise strategic necessity, market dimension analysis (industry landscape/target market/capacity forecast/competitive landscape/price analysis), construction content & output plan, and business model design (revenue structure/cost structure/profitability assessment/external support conditions)

cases.description:
向领导提交跨部门战略提案最怕越权踩雷——写了供应链部门的行动计划、替财务定了预算、给法务排了认证节点，VP一眼就看出你不懂组织边界。

这个案例完整演示了大型组织内部提案的四阶段工作法：先做多源调研与数据交叉验证，再写出覆盖市场分析、竞争格局、成本收益框算、风险边界的完整版（42页），然后经过三重自审过滤——越权审查、冗余审查、越级审查——删掉替其他部门做决策的内容、压缩内部众所周知的信息、把"建议正式启动"改写为"建议纳入规划讨论"，最终打磨为18页可上会版。

适合：需要向VP/经营会提交跨部门协同提案的业务负责人、战略/商分团队、大型组织内的中高层管理者。
cases.description_en:
The biggest pitfall in internal strategic proposals is overstepping organizational boundaries—writing action plans for supply chain, setting budgets for finance, or scheduling certification milestones for legal. This case demonstrates the complete four-stage methodology, from multi-source research to triple self-review filtering, producing a VP-ready proposal that respects departmental autonomy.

Ideal for: business heads submitting cross-department proposals to VPs, strategy/business analysis teams, and mid-to-senior managers in large organizations.
cases.prompt:
请按大型组织内部提案方法，基于以下背景信息，帮我产出一份可提交 VP 审核的跨部门战略提案初稿：

【提案背景】
- 提案人：国际业务部 | 审核层级：需 VP 审核后提交经营会
- 方向：在东南亚核心市场试点「本地仓 + 三日达」履约能力，服务公司 3C 配件跨境生意。
- 已知信息：2025 年该区域 GMV 约 1.2 亿人民币，物流时效投诉占比 18%；竞品已有本地仓，签收时效中位数快我们 1.5 天；预算粗估年增运营成本 900 万。

【输出要求】
提案需覆盖以下全部内容：
(a) 调研提纲——列出需要验证的关键数据和信息缺口
(b) 核心论点——用数据支撑的核心主张，每条结论须标注数据来源和可信度
(c) 成本/收益框算——分情景（保守/基准/乐观）的投入产出分析
(d) 组织协同与风险边界——列出需要供应链、财务、法务三方参与的关键议题，标注本方可提供的输入
(e) 自审删减说明——按越权审查、冗余审查、越级审查三重过滤，标注所有删改内容及原因

严格遵循大型组织内部提案的五项行为准则：署名即担责、不为上级写话术、协同邀约而非任务分配、数据要硬建议要软、内部文档保留边界声明。
cases.prompt_en:
Using the enterprise internal proposal methodology and the following background, produce a cross-department strategic proposal draft ready for VP review:

[Background]
- Proposer: International Business Department | Review level: VP review before management committee submission
- Direction: Pilot "local warehouse + 3-day delivery" fulfillment capability in core Southeast Asian markets for the company's 3C accessories cross-border business.
- Known facts: 2025 regional GMV ~120M RMB, logistics complaint rate 18%; competitors already have local warehouses with median delivery 1.5 days faster; estimated annual incremental operating cost ~9M RMB.

[Output requirements]
The proposal must cover: (a) research outline, (b) core arguments with data sources and confidence levels, (c) cost/benefit estimation across scenarios, (d) organizational synergy and risk boundaries, and (e) self-review deletion notes using the triple-filter method.

Strictly follow the five organizational conduct principles: signatory accountability, no writing communication scripts for superiors, synergy invitations not task assignments, hard data soft recommendations, and boundary disclaimers in all cross-department sections.

Output a tiered report.

cases.title: AI 助手出海欧盟合规披露研究
cases.title_en: EU AI Act Disclosure Compliance for AI Assistants
cases.subtitle: 一键摸清 EU AI Act 对 AI 语音助手的终端用户披露义务
cases.subtitle_en: One-click research on EU AI Act end-user disclosure obligations for AI voice assistants
cases.description:
做 AI 出海最头疼的不是技术，而是不知道欧盟到底要你披露什么。这个案例演示了如何把AI 语音助手向欧盟用户提供服务这一具体场景交给全球法律研究 Skill，自动检索 EU AI Act、GDPR 等欧盟官方法源，定位 Article 52 等关键条款原文，输出带风险评级和整改清单的合规研究报告。

案例会真实调用 LegalDataHunter 检索欧盟数据源，逐条核验披露义务的触发条件、披露方式、豁免情形和违规后果，并给出可直接落地的产品改动建议。产物为单文件 HTML，无外部资源引用，可离线打开。

适合：计划出海欧盟的 AI 产品法务/合规、AI 产品经理、跨境法律顾问、正在研究 EU AI Act 落地路径的技术团队。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of AI global expansion isn't the tech — it's figuring out exactly what the EU requires you to disclose. This case shows how to hand a concrete scenario (an AI voice assistant serving EU users) to the Global Legal Research Skill, which automatically retrieves official EU sources such as the EU AI Act and GDPR, anchors key provisions like Article 52, and produces a compliance report with risk ratings and an actionable remediation checklist.

The case genuinely invokes LegalDataHunter to search EU data sources, verifies trigger conditions, disclosure methods, exemptions, and consequences one by one, and gives product-level remediation advice. The deliverable is a single-file HTML with no external references, viewable offline.

Great for: AI product legal/compliance teams planning EU expansion, AI product managers, cross-border legal counsel, and technical teams studying EU AI Act implementation.

artifacts.label: 欧盟 AI 助手披露义务合规研究报告

cases.prompt:
我方是一家中国科技公司，计划向欧盟用户提供一款 AI 语音助手产品，用户通过网页和 App 与 AI 进行自然语言对话。请使用全球法律研究技能，针对以下问题完成研究并输出单文件 HTML 报告：

1. 欧盟 AI Act 是否要求我们在用户首次与 AI 交互时披露"这是 AI"？具体法律依据是什么？
2. 披露义务的触发条件是什么？哪些 AI 系统可以豁免？
3. 披露方式有哪些要求？需要在用户界面如何呈现？
4. 该义务与 GDPR 透明度要求如何衔接？
5. 违规可能面临什么后果？民事、行政、刑事三类责任分别是什么？
6. 给出可直接落地的合规整改建议，按高/中/低优先级排列，包含具体动作、责任人和完成时限。

要求：
- 每个法域结论必须带可回链的法规原文或官方来源；
- 引用至少包含 EU AI Act Article 52 等关键条款；
- 输出为单文件 HTML，所有资源内联，无外部 CDN 或远程 URL，无 hash 锚点导航；
- 报告首页显示 AI 辅助生成免责声明。
cases.prompt_en:
Our company is a Chinese technology firm planning to offer an AI voice assistant to EU users via web and mobile apps. Please use the Global Legal Research Skill to research the following and output a single-file HTML report:

1. Does the EU AI Act require us to disclose to users that they are interacting with AI on first interaction? What is the specific legal basis?
2. What are the trigger conditions for the disclosure obligation? Which AI systems are exempt?
3. What are the disclosure-method requirements? How should it be presented in the UI?
4. How does this obligation interact with GDPR transparency requirements?
5. What are the potential consequences of non-compliance, broken down by civil, administrative, and criminal liability?
6. Provide actionable remediation recommendations prioritized as high/medium/low, including specific actions, owners, and deadlines.

Requirements:
- Every conclusion must cite traceable official legislation or sources;
- Include key provisions such as EU AI Act Article 52;
- Output a single-file HTML with all resources inlined, no external CDNs or remote URLs, and no hash-anchor navigation;
- Display an AI-assisted disclaimer at the top of the report.

cases.prompt:
请调用同舟股市投研专家，围绕「{事件与公司，例如：动力电池需求改善对宁德时代的影响}」生成一页单文件 HTML 事件因子解读。

先完成同舟 MCP Gateway 认证；如果没有 API Key 或认证失败，只提示用户去控制台申请/绑定，不要继续编造内容。取证范围包括公开新闻、公告/PDF、行情与财务数据、行业图谱、同舟观点、公开因子框架和历史相似事件统计。估值因子必须用 fin-data 补数：个股事件先解析股票代码，再用行情日频指标取 PE(TTM)、PE、PB、市值；行业事件先解析稳定申万行业名，再用行业估值工具取 PE/PB 和历史分位。页面必须完全按产品原型的事件解读长报告形式：浅灰背景、白色圆角卡片、纯文字页面标题、顶部操作区、胶囊式 Tab 导航和 scrollIntoView，不使用 href="#section-id"；顶部“返回总览 / 导出 PDF / 生成工作底稿”必须是真实按钮：返回总览滚动到首屏，导出 PDF 调用 window.print()，生成工作底稿下载一份 Markdown 底稿，不要做成不可点击装饰。PC 宽度源 HTML 是主版式，首屏采用左侧结论叙事、右侧报告日期/结论等级卡、底部四列摘要指标条的结构。首屏先展示示例公司、行业、事件类型、报告日期和数据截止，再给普通用户能听懂的一句话结论；720px 封面只是响应式预览，不要用封面宽度反推主页面。正文固定顺序为：事件影响因子与客观数据、因子归因如何推导结论、公司产业链地位与核心业务权重、历史相似事件、相似事件后的股价平均走势、源头复核区、证据链/反方证据/后续验证。影响因子卡片必须按源 HTML 使用“标题+方向徽标、两行客观指标、底部历史分位/进度条”的行式结构，不要做三格 KPI 小盒子。因子归因区在 PC 宽度必须是左侧表格 + 右侧归因合成结果卡的两栏布局，右侧包含总分、贡献摘要和围绕零点的正负贡献条，不要让表格铺满后把分数卡放到下面。公司产业链地位与核心业务权重在 PC 宽度必须是左侧四节点 chain-map（公司位置节点高亮）+ 右侧 business-panel 业务权重条，不要把链路和权重拆成上下两段。历史相似事件必须先展示四个匹配条件卡，再用 event-list 横向行列表展示样本日期、标题、证据说明和统计状态徽标，不要做四张样本卡片网格。相似度按“需求/政策匹配 25%、产业链匹配 25%、有效回测窗口 25%、源头可复核 15%、负向/混合证据最多扣 10%”计算和说明，展示为“相似度 84%”这类用户可读标签；不要提后端字段是否返回。凡工具返回原文、公告、小程序或研报链接，都做“阅读原文/查看公告/复核数据”跳转；行情、财务和图谱这类没有文章级链接的数据，只标注同舟行情库、同舟财务指标库、同舟行业图谱等来源类型，不做假链接。若相似事件统计数据或统计工具返回有效样本，必须展示真实样本数、均值、胜率和缺失窗口；若同时有公司事件回测和行业/指数回测，必须按“公司事件样本 vs 行业基准样本”对比展示，并给出公司相对行业超额；若某个窗口样本不足，只标注该窗口样本不足，不编造收益、胜率、样本数或回测结果。若已取到因子框架、指标名和源头链接但缺少当前实时数值，可以生成透明的“规则评分/规则贡献/暴露等级”，规则必须写在页面上：因子框架、指标面板、历史样本、源头复核、产业链暴露加分，反向证据扣分；不要反复显示接口缺口类文案。

输出只要一个 HTML 文件，样式和必要交互内联；允许源头复核外链，但不要加载外部脚本、CSS、图片或字体；不展示 raw JSON、内部 ID、API Key、手机号、验证码、个人持仓或交易历史，不给买卖建议。
cases.prompt_en:
Use Tongzhou Equity Research Expert to create a single-file HTML event factor interpretation page for "{event and company, e.g. improving power-battery demand and CATL}".

First complete the Tongzhou MCP Gateway credential check. If the API key is missing or invalid, only ask the user to apply or bind a key in the console and do not invent content. Retrieve public news, announcements/PDFs, market and financial data, industry graph evidence, Tongzhou viewpoints, public factor frameworks, and historical similar-event statistics. Valuation factors must be sourced from fin-data: for named-stock events, resolve the ticker and use daily market metrics for PE(TTM), PE, PB, and market cap; for industry events, resolve a stable Shenwan industry name before using sector valuation for PE/PB and historical percentiles. Match the product prototype exactly: pale gray background, white rounded cards, text-only page title, top workbench actions, capsule tabs, and button-based scrollIntoView navigation rather than href="#section-id". The top actions must be real buttons: return-to-overview scrolls to the first viewport, export PDF calls window.print(), and generate working draft downloads a Markdown draft; do not render them as inactive decoration. Treat the PC-width source HTML as canonical: the first viewport uses a left conclusion narrative, a right report-date/conclusion-grade card, and a four-column summary strip below. Show metadata chips, report date/data cutoff, and a plain-language conclusion; the 720px cover is only a responsive preview and must not drive the primary page layout. Render sections in this order: impact factors with objective data, factor attribution table, company value-chain position and business exposure, historical similar events, post-event price path statistics, source review, and evidence/risk/verification. Factor cards must use the source HTML row-style structure: title plus direction badge, two objective metric rows, and a bottom percentile/progress line; do not use three boxed KPI tiles. At PC width, the attribution section must be a two-column layout with the table on the left and a composite attribution score panel on the right, including total score, contribution summary, and signed bars centered around zero. At PC width, company chain and business exposure must use a left four-node chain-map with the current company node highlighted plus a right business-panel with exposure progress bars; do not split these into stacked blocks. Historical similar events must render four matching-condition cards followed by a horizontal event-list of sample rows with date, title, evidence note, and statistics-status badge; do not use a sample-card grid. Compute and explain similarity from demand/policy match 25%, value-chain match 25%, valid backtest windows 25%, source-review availability 15%, and negative/mixed-evidence adjustment up to -10%. Show user-facing badges such as “Similarity 84%”; do not mention MCP, ES, backend fields, or whether a native field was returned. When the tools return original article, announcement, mini-program, or report links, render read-original/view-announcement/verify-data links. Market, financial, and graph data without article-level links should be attributed to Tongzhou market data, Tongzhou financial metrics, or Tongzhou industry graph, not turned into fake links. If comparable-event statistics are returned, show the real sample count, average return, win rate, and missing windows. When both company-event backtest and industry/index backtest are available, compare them as company-event samples vs industry benchmark samples and show excess return. If a window has insufficient samples, label only that window as insufficient; do not invent returns, win rates, sample sizes, or backtest results. If factor frameworks, metric names, and source links are available but complete current values are not, produce transparent rule-based factor scores, contribution scores, and exposure bands; state the rule on the page and avoid repeated backend-gap wording.

Output one HTML file only, with styling and necessary interactions inline. Source-review external links are allowed, but do not load external scripts, CSS, images, or fonts. Do not expose raw JSON, internal IDs, API keys, phone numbers, verification codes, personal holdings, or trade history. Do not give buy/sell advice.

cases.title: 微服务系统架构图
cases.subtitle: 手绘风格的交互式微服务架构可视化
cases.subtitle_en: Interactive microservice architecture visualization with hand-drawn style
cases.description: 需要一张清晰直观的系统架构图？本案例展示如何生成 Excalidraw 手绘风格的微服务架构图，包含 API 网关、认证服务、订单服务、消息队列等 8+ 组件，支持鼠标悬停高亮连接关系，按层级着色，配有图例说明。适合架构师、技术负责人和开发团队内部分享。
cases.description_en: Need a clear and intuitive system architecture diagram? This case demonstrates how to generate Excalidraw-style hand-drawn microservice architecture diagrams with 8+ components, hover-to-highlight connections, layer-based coloring, and interactive legend.

artifacts.label: 微服务架构图页面

cases.prompt:
请创建一个 Excalidraw 手绘风格的微服务系统架构图页面（单文件 HTML，内联无外部依赖），白底淡灰网格、手绘质感（用 SVG 绘制，粗糙边框/不规则线条）。

包含 8+ 服务组件：API Gateway、Auth Service、User Service、Order Service、Payment Service、Notification Service、Message Queue (Kafka)、Database (PostgreSQL)，按层级着色（网关/业务/基础设施），服务间用箭头标注连接关系。
交互：悬停某服务高亮其所有连接。含颜色图例。
cases.prompt_en:
Please create an Excalidraw hand-drawn-style microservices system architecture diagram page (single-file HTML, inlined with no external dependencies), with a white background and light-gray grid, and a hand-drawn texture (drawn with SVG, rough borders / irregular lines).

Include 8+ service components: API Gateway, Auth Service, User Service, Order Service, Payment Service, Notification Service, Message Queue (Kafka), Database (PostgreSQL), colored by tier (gateway / business / infrastructure), with arrows labeling the connections between services.
Interaction: hovering over a service highlights all of its connections. Include a color legend.

cases.title: 销售数据分析仪表盘
cases.subtitle: 12 月趋势 × 区域排名 × 毛利分析 × KPI 达成率
cases.subtitle_en: 12-Month Trend × Regional Ranking × Margin Analysis × KPI Achievement
cases.description:
在快速变化的商业环境中，销售团队每天面对海量订单数据，却难以快速定位业绩短板、毛利异常和区域差异——手动汇总耗时且容易出错，管理层无法及时获取决策所需的关键指标。

本仪表盘通过六大核心模块一站式解决销售数据管理难题：销售明细表记录全年12个月按产品线、区域、销售员维度的逐笔数据，月度趋势表自动计算环比增长率揭示业务波动，区域排名表量化各区域人效与总产出，产品线毛利分析精准定位高利润与低利润业务线，Top 10 客户贡献表识别核心大客户，KPI 仪表盘汇总收入达成率、同比增长、客均单价等关键经营指标。

交付物为一份包含 6 个工作表的 Excel 文件（output.xlsx），涵盖：销售明细数据表、月度趋势汇总表、区域业绩排名表、产品线毛利分析表、Top 10 客户贡献表、KPI 达成率仪表盘。所有百分比与增长率均使用 Excel 公式自动计算，支持数据更新后即时刷新。
cases.description_en:
In a fast-changing business environment, sales teams face massive order data daily yet struggle to quickly pinpoint performance gaps, margin anomalies, and regional disparities—manual consolidation is time-consuming, error-prone, and delays critical decisions for management.

This dashboard solves sales data management challenges through six core modules: a Sales Detail sheet recording 12 months of transaction-level data by product line, region, and salesperson; a Monthly Trend sheet with automatic MoM growth formulas revealing business fluctuations; a Regional Ranking sheet quantifying per-capita output and total production by area; a Product Line Margin Analysis pinpointing high- and low-profit business lines; a Top 10 Customer Contribution table identifying key accounts; and a KPI Dashboard summarizing revenue achievement, YoY growth, average deal size, and other critical business metrics.

The deliverable is a single Excel file (output.xlsx) containing 6 worksheets: Sales Detail, Monthly Trend, Regional Ranking, Product Line Margin Analysis, Top 10 Customers, and KPI Dashboard. All percentages and growth rates use Excel formulas for automatic recalculation when data is updated.

artifacts.label: 销售数据分析仪表盘

cases.prompt: 帮我生成一份销售数据分析 Excel 仪表盘。包含：12 个月的销售数据（按产品线/区域/销售员）、月度趋势图数据、区域业绩排名、产品线毛利分析、Top 10 客户贡献、环比/同比增长率计算公式、KPI 达成率仪表盘数据。
cases.prompt_en: Help me generate a sales data analysis Excel dashboard. Include: 12 months of sales data (by product line / region / salesperson), monthly trend chart data, regional performance ranking, product line margin analysis, Top 10 customer contribution, MoM/YoY growth rate calculation formulas, and KPI achievement rate dashboard data.

cases.title: 行政综合管理工作台
cases.subtitle: 行政人的一站式工作台：12 大模块覆盖从数据看板到知识库的全部日常
cases.subtitle_en: One-stop workbench for admins: 12 modules from data dashboards to knowledge base
cases.description:
行政工作琐碎又分散：数据要汇总、公文要起草、预算要盯、会议要统筹、合同要跟进、物资要记台账，工具散落在各处，来回切换效率低。

这个案例把行政综合管理整合进一个单页工作台，12 大模块各管一摊：数据分析看板汇总收支与预算执行；制度公文撰写内置模板库与公文导出；财务分析辅助拆解预算与费用结构；商务接待管理从审批到接待标准全流程记录；物资出入库台账含出入库流水与库存警戒；人力资源 SOP 覆盖招聘、入转调离；智能会议纪要支持录音与要点沉淀；会议活动统筹排期与物料清单；合同合规提示带临期预警与台账；任务督办看板按责任单元跟踪进度；专属知识库沉淀制度、话术与经验，支持全文检索。另支持文档导入导出、打印存档、修改个人头像等细节。

适合：企业行政、综合管理岗，以及想把行政日常工作全部装进一个页面的团队负责人参考。
cases.description_en:
Admin work is fragmented: data to consolidate, documents to draft, budgets to track, meetings to coordinate, contracts to follow up, supplies to log — with tools scattered everywhere.

This case pulls it all into a single-page workbench with 12 modules: a data dashboard consolidating income, spend, and budget execution; document writing with a template library and Word export; financial analysis breaking down budgets and expenses; business reception management from approval to hosting standards; a supplies in/out ledger with stock alerts; HR SOPs covering hiring and transfers; smart meeting minutes with voice notes; meeting and event scheduling with checklists; a contract ledger with expiry warnings; a task supervision board tracking progress by owner; and a searchable knowledge base for policies and know-how. Documents can be exported, printed, and the avatar customized.

Best for: corporate admin and general-affairs roles, and team leads who want every routine admin task in one page.

artifacts.label: 行政综合管理工作台（中英双语单文件 HTML）

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/9410HNQy1yehAvJaNXG7Ov，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

做一个「行政综合管理工作台」单页工作台，面向企业行政与综合管理岗，左侧 12 个模块导航：① 数据分析看板（收支汇总、预算执行率、趋势图表）；② 制度公文撰写（模板库、编辑器、导出）；③ 财务分析辅助（预算项、费用结构、月度对比）；④ 商务接待管理（接待记录、审批与标准提示）；⑤ 职场技能提升（学习记录与打卡）；⑥ 物资出入库台账（物品清单、出入库流水、库存警戒）；⑦ 人力资源 SOP（招聘、入转调离流程节点）；⑧ 智能会议纪要（纪要列表、录音、要点）；⑨ 会议活动统筹（活动排期、物料清单）；⑩ 合同合规提示（合同台账、临期预警、合规提示卡）；⑪ 任务督办看板（按责任单元跟踪、进度百分比）；⑫ 专属知识库（制度、话术、经验条目，全文检索）。顶栏支持修改头像；各模块支持新增、编辑、删除与 Excel 导出。视觉：左侧深色导航 + 右侧浅色内容区，卡片化布局，PC 优先、移动端可折叠导航。数据存储：在资料库中创建数据表存放各模块业务数据（督办任务、年度预算、支出流水、物资台账、出入库流水、会议纪要、活动统筹、合同台账、商务接待、周边餐饮、公文文档、知识库、技能打卡等），种子 CSV 已挂在本页面节点附件里（种子-*.csv 共 15 份，可直接导入同名表），页面通过页面数据能力在线读写表，改动实时保存到表、跨设备可见；表字段与页面字段一一对应。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 12 张数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library capability to build a same-style copy of https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/9410HNQy1yehAvJaNXG7Ov with data stored online and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click same-style flow; if unavailable, build it as follows: Build an "Executive Admin Workbench" single-page workbench for corporate admin and general-affairs roles, with 12 modules in a left nav: ① Data dashboard (income/spend summary, budget execution, trend charts); ② Document writing (template library, editor, export); ③ Financial analysis (budget items, expense structure, monthly comparison); ④ Business reception management (reception log, approvals and standards); ⑤ Skills development (learning log and check-ins); ⑥ Supplies in/out ledger (item list, in/out flows, stock alerts); ⑦ HR SOPs (hiring, onboarding/transfer process nodes); ⑧ Smart meeting minutes (minutes list, voice notes, key points); ⑨ Meeting and event coordination (schedules, material checklists); ⑩ Contract compliance alerts (contract ledger, expiry warnings, compliance tips); ⑪ Task supervision board (progress tracking by owner, percent complete); ⑫ Knowledge base (policies, scripts, know-how, full-text search). Top bar supports avatar customization; every module supports create, edit, delete, and Excel export. Visual: dark left nav with light content area, card-based layout, PC-first with collapsible nav on mobile. Data storage: create Library databases to hold each module's business data (task board, annual budget, expense ledger, supplies ledger, in/out flows, meeting minutes, event coordination, contracts, receptions, nearby restaurants, documents, knowledge base, skills log, etc.); seed CSV files are attached to this page node (15 files named "种子-*.csv", importable into the matching tables), and the page read and write the tables online through the page-data capability, so every change is saved to the tables and visible across devices; table fields map one-to-one to page fields.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus 12 data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 生效裁判后执行材料与财产线索整理
cases.title_en: Post-Judgment Execution Materials and Property Clue Preparation
cases.subtitle: 为申请执行人梳理执行材料清单、金额结构与财产线索三层分级
cases.subtitle_en: Prepare execution materials, amount structure and three-tier property clues for judgment creditors
cases.description:
判决赢了，钱却迟迟拿不回来——最头疼的不是打不赢官司，而是不知道申请执行要备齐哪些材料、迟延履行利息怎么算、手头零散的账户和应收线索该怎么分级提交。

这个案例演示腾讯电子签资深合同法务专家如何先核验申请执行条件、执行管辖与迟延履行计算，再输出申请执行材料清单、执行请求金额结构、财产线索「已掌握 / 待依法核查 / 不宜据此推断」三层分级表与优先行动清单，并明确不承诺查控、冻结、拍卖或回款结果。

适合：持有生效判决或裁定的申请执行人、企业法务、财务催收人员，以及代理执行案件的律师与实习律师。
cases.description_en:
You won the judgment but still can't get paid. The headache isn't winning the case, it's figuring out which execution materials to prepare, how to calculate late-performance interest, and how to tier the scattered bank-account and receivable clues you already hold.

This case shows how Tencent eSign's senior contract legal expert verifies execution conditions, jurisdiction and late-performance calculation first, then produces an execution-material checklist, an execution-amount structure, a three-tier property-clue table (known / to-be-verified / not-inferable) and a priority action list — while explicitly promising no seizure, freezing, auction or recovery results.

Best for: judgment creditors holding an effective judgment or ruling, in-house legal counsel, finance and collections staff, and lawyers or trainee lawyers handling enforcement cases.

artifacts.label: 互动执行准备灵感卡片

cases.title: 高管竞业限制协议专项审查
cases.subtitle: 签了竞业，跳槽却被 20% 补偿金卡住——拆解一份藏在细节里的无效陷阱协议
cases.subtitle_en: A non-compete paying only 20% compensation hides invalidation traps in the fine print
cases.description:
技术总监离职前收到一份竞业限制协议，补偿金却只给到月工资的 20%，签不签都心里打鼓——这种藏在细节里的"无效陷阱"最让人头疼。

这个案例演示了如何把一份真实的《保密与竞业限制协议》交给 AI 做专项审查：从甲方、乙方两个视角逐条拆解，精准命中"补偿金 20% 低于法定 30%""地域全国但实际只在华南经营""保密范围未排除公知信息"三大风险点，输出合规性检查清单和分级修改建议。

适合：劳动法律师、企业 HR／法务、准备跳槽的高管与技术骨干、需要审查竞业协议的个人。
cases.description_en:
A tech director gets a non-compete agreement before quitting, but the compensation is only 20% of monthly salary — sign it or not, either way feels like a trap. These hidden "invalidation traps" in the fine print are the most annoying part.

This case shows how to hand a real Non-Disclosure & Non-Compete Agreement to AI for a targeted review: it dissects clauses from both the employer and employee perspectives, pinpoints the three key risks (20% compensation below the statutory 30%, nationwide scope vs. South-China-only operations, and confidentiality scope that fails to exclude public information), then produces a compliance checklist and tiered revision suggestions.

For: labor lawyers, corporate HR/legal teams, executives and tech leads about to change jobs, and anyone reviewing a non-compete agreement.

artifacts.label: 保密与竞业限制条款专项审查报告

cases.prompt:
请以「双方视角」专项审查下面这份劳动合同中的保密条款和竞业限制条款，输出详细审查报告。

【合同信息】
- 合同类型：劳动合同
- 甲方角色：用人单位（互联网公司，实际经营以华南为主）
- 乙方角色：劳动者（高级技术总监，属法定"高级技术人员"）
- 乙方月工资：80000 元
- 行业：互联网/软件
- 地区：深圳市

【保密条款】
乙方在职期间及离职后，对甲方的商业秘密负有保密义务。商业秘密包括但不限于技术信息、经营信息、客户信息、财务信息等。保密期限为在职期间及离职后5年。
但不包括：（1）已进入公有领域的公知信息；（2）乙方离职后通过合法公开渠道独立获得的信息；（3）乙方在本协议签署前已合法拥有或独立开发、且不属于甲方职务成果的技术与知识；（4）乙方个人的一般性知识、技能与经验。

【竞业限制条款】
乙方离职后两年内，不得在甲方实际开展经营并构成实质竞争关系的区域（以本协议附件所列地域/城市清单为准）内，与甲方生产或经营同类产品、从事同类业务的企业任职，不得自营或与他人合作经营与甲方同类的业务。
甲方应在乙方离职时，以书面形式向乙方提供与甲方存在竞争关系的企业清单；乙方仅对该清单所列企业及与其经营范围实质相同企业负有竞业限制义务。
竞业限制补偿金按乙方离职前十二个月平均工资的30%按月支付（现约定月工资80,000元对应为24,000元/月），且不得低于当地最低工资标准；支付期限与竞业限制期限一致。
甲方未按约定按月足额支付竞业限制补偿金累计满三个月的，乙方有权书面通知甲方解除竞业限制义务。
本保密条款约定的保密义务期限（离职后5年）与竞业限制期限（离职后2年）相互独立，竞业限制期限届满后，乙方仍应继续履行保密义务。

请分别从甲方视角和乙方视角识别风险点，重点审查：竞业限制补偿金是否达到法定30%标准且不低于当地最低工资标准、竞业限制对象与地域范围是否合理、竞业限制期限是否超过2年法定上限、保密范围是否排除公知信息与原有知识，并给出合规性检查清单、可执行性评级和分级修改建议（必须修改/建议修改）。

【产物格式（交付版）】
请将审查报告生成为可交付的正式文件，而非 Markdown 草稿。默认输出为单文件 HTML（内联 CSS，中文专业排版，含风险等级色块、合规性检查表格、双视角卡片、可打印/导出 PDF 按钮，无需外部资源引用，内容默认可见）。如委托人另有要求，可改为输出 DOCX（Word 文档，便于二次编辑归档）或 PDF（固定版式，防篡改，适合直接送达当事人）。无论何种格式，均须在文末附免责声明。
cases.prompt_en:
Please perform a targeted review of the confidentiality and non-competition clauses in the employment contract below from both perspectives, and output a detailed review report.

[Contract info]
- Contract type: employment contract
- Party A role: employer (an internet company operating mainly in South China)
- Party B role: employee (senior technical director, a statutory "senior technical personnel")
- Party B monthly salary: CNY 80,000
- Industry: internet/software
- Region: Shenzhen

[Confidentiality clause]
Party B shall keep Party A's trade secrets confidential during employment and after departure. Trade secrets include but are not limited to technical information, business information, customer information and financial information. The confidentiality period is during employment and 5 years after departure.
However, the above shall not include: (1) public information already in the public domain; (2) information independently obtained by Party B through lawful public channels after departure; (3) technology and knowledge lawfully owned or independently developed by Party B before signing this agreement and not constituting Party A's work product; and (4) Party B's general knowledge, skills and experience.

[Non-competition clause]
Within 2 years after departure, Party B shall not work for, nor run or co-run a business similar to Party A's, any enterprise that produces or operates the same kind of products or engages in the same kind of business as Party A, within the regions where Party A actually operates and competes substantially (as listed in the region/city list attached to this agreement).
Party A shall, upon Party B's departure, provide Party B in writing with a list of enterprises competitive with Party A; Party B shall bear non-competition obligations only toward the enterprises on such list and those with substantively identical business scope.
Non-competition compensation is paid monthly at 30% of Party B's average monthly salary over the 12 months before departure (i.e., CNY 24,000/month given the current monthly salary of CNY 80,000), and shall not be lower than the local minimum wage; the payment period shall align with the non-competition period.
If Party A fails to pay the non-competition compensation in full on a monthly basis for a cumulative total of three months, Party B may notify Party A in writing to terminate the non-competition obligations.
The confidentiality obligation period under this clause (5 years after departure) and the non-competition period (2 years after departure) are independent of each other; after the non-competition period expires, Party B shall continue to perform the confidentiality obligations.

Please identify risks from both Party A's and Party B's perspectives, focusing on: whether the non-competition compensation meets the statutory 30% threshold and is not lower than the local minimum wage, whether the non-competition scope of personnel and territory is reasonable, whether the non-competition period exceeds the 2-year statutory cap, and whether the confidentiality scope excludes public information and prior knowledge. Provide a compliance checklist, an enforceability rating, and tiered revision suggestions (must-fix / suggested).

[Output format (deliverable version)]
Generate the review report as a formal deliverable file rather than a Markdown draft. By default, output a single-file HTML (inline CSS, professional Chinese typesetting, with risk-level color blocks, a compliance checklist table, dual-perspective cards, and a print/export-to-PDF button; no external resource references; content visible by default). If the client requests otherwise, you may instead output DOCX (Word document, convenient for further editing and archiving) or PDF (fixed layout, tamper-resistant, suitable for direct delivery to the client). Regardless of format, append a disclaimer at the end.

Best for: product owners handling facial or biometric data, data-compliance owners, legal, security and privacy engineering teams.

cases.prompt: 假设产品是一个普通的工具产品，不具备关键信息基础设施特殊主体身份/资质/属性。当前产品存储人脸信息已经达到10万人，请分析产品面临的数据合规风险，并给出后续产品需要履行的合规义务、应采取的数据合规措施以及对应可落地的方案。请以法规检索为基础，重点说明人脸识别技术应用备案时限、个人信息保护影响评估、单独同意与告知、非人脸替代验证、存储与互联网传输边界、第三方委托和事件响应，并以风险分级、责任人、交付物和30/90天路线图呈现。
cases.prompt_en: Assume the product is an ordinary tool product and does not have the special status, qualification or attributes of a critical information infrastructure operator. It currently stores facial information for 100,000 people. Analyze the data-compliance risks it faces, the compliance obligations it must perform, the data-compliance measures it should take and implementable solutions. Base the answer on legal retrieval, with particular focus on the facial-recognition application filing timeline, personal information protection impact assessment, separate consent and notice, non-facial alternative verification, storage and internet-transmission boundaries, third-party entrustment and incident response. Present the result with risk ratings, owners, deliverables and a 30/90-day roadmap.

cases.description: 拟 IPO 的公司要对内对外快速讲清楚上市准备到什么程度、值多少钱。本案例由「银拓远」投资银行专家做一张投行 pitchbook 风格的上市准备度与估值速览页——5 维就绪度评分、近三年三表摘要、可比公司法与 DCF 的足球场估值区间、募资用途与上市时间表。区别于完整 CIM 或单一估值模型，是一页路演速览。适合拟上市企业、投行与投资人。
cases.description_en: A pre-IPO company needs to quickly convey, internally and externally, how ready it is to list and what it's worth. Built by the Investment Banking Expert, this case is a banker pitchbook-style IPO readiness & valuation one-pager — a 5-dimension readiness score, a three-year three-statement summary, a football-field valuation range from comparables and DCF, use of proceeds, and a listing timeline. Unlike a full CIM or a single valuation model, it's a one-page roadshow overview. Ideal for pre-IPO companies, bankers and investors.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一张拟 IPO 科技公司的上市准备度与估值速览页（单文件 HTML，投行 pitchbook 风）。要直观看到：公司/板块/募资规模/估值区间/投资亮点、5 维上市准备度评分（雷达或条形）、近三年三表精简摘要、可比公司法与 DCF 的足球场估值区间图、募资用途拆解、上市时间表里程碑、关键风险。深海军蓝+金质投行风，界面中文，金额 ¥/亿元，请基于真实拟 IPO 或近期上市科技公司，联网搜索其招股书/财报的真实财务与估值数据（注明公司与来源）。
cases.prompt_en: Help me build an IPO readiness & valuation one-pager for a pre-IPO tech company (single-file HTML, banker pitchbook style). Show the company/board/raise size/valuation range/investment highlights, a 5-dimension readiness score (radar or bars), a three-year three-statement summary, a football-field valuation range from comparables and DCF, use-of-proceeds breakdown, a listing-timeline milestone, and key risks. Deep navy + gold banker style; UI in Simplified Chinese; amounts in ¥/100M; data marked real (web-searched).

cases.subtitle: LBO 回报桥 + IRR/MOIC + 敏感性，一页看懂杠杆收购
cases.subtitle_en: LBO value bridge + IRR/MOIC + sensitivity on one page
cases.description: 杠杆收购的回报到底从哪来、能赚多少倍，散户和初级投行人常常算不清。本案例由「建模模」金融建模专家做一张 LBO 模型分析页——资金来源与用途、去杠杆路径、价值创造桥（EBITDA 增长/倍数变化/去杠杆三部分贡献）、IRR/MOIC 三情景与敏感性表。区别于 DCF/可比公司估值，专讲杠杆收购回报。适合 PE、投行与想搞懂 LBO 的人。
cases.description_en: Where do LBO returns come from and how many times your money do you make — questions retail investors and junior bankers often can't pin down. Built by the Financial Modeling Expert, this case is an LBO model analysis page — sources & uses, the deleveraging path, a value-creation bridge (EBITDA growth / multiple change / deleveraging contributions), IRR/MOIC across three scenarios, and a sensitivity table. Unlike DCF/comparables valuation, it's about leveraged-buyout returns. Ideal for PE, bankers, and anyone learning LBO.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一张私募股权 LBO 杠杆收购模型分析页（单文件 HTML）。要直观看到：交易概览（EV/收购倍数/杠杆率/持有期/投资逻辑）、资金来源与用途对照、持有期去杠杆路径（债务下降+EBITDA 增长）、价值创造桥（EBITDA 增长/倍数变化/去杠杆三部分对股权价值的贡献）、IRR 与 MOIC 三情景、入场×退出倍数对 IRR 的敏感性表、关键假设与风险。石墨灰+钢蓝建模风，界面中文，金额 ¥/百万，标的公司基础财务请联网搜索真实数据（注明公司与来源），LBO 情景假设与测算部分可注明为模型假设。
cases.prompt_en: Help me build a private-equity LBO model analysis page (single-file HTML). Show the deal overview (EV/purchase multiple/leverage/hold period/investment thesis), a sources & uses comparison, the deleveraging path over the hold period (debt paydown + EBITDA growth), a value-creation bridge (EBITDA growth / multiple change / deleveraging contributions to equity value), IRR and MOIC across three scenarios, an entry×exit multiple sensitivity table for IRR, and key assumptions and risks. A graphite + steel-blue modeling style; UI in Simplified Chinese; amounts in ¥/million; data marked an real base financials via web search (model assumptions may be noted as assumed) model.

cases.subtitle: 养老金缺口测算 + 资产积累 + 退休现金流
cases.subtitle_en: Pension-gap calc + asset build-up + retirement cash flow
cases.description: 很多人到中年才发现没认真算过养老账，不知道退休后钱够不够花。本案例由「理财财」财富管理专家做一份养老退休规划方案——养老金缺口测算、40 到 60 岁的资产积累路径、三支柱构成、退休后逐年现金流，并给出可执行的补充建议。区别于追求提前退休的 FIRE，本案聚焦常规退休的养老金与现金流规划。适合做养老准备的家庭。
cases.description_en: Many people reach midlife before realizing they've never seriously run the retirement math, unsure if their money will last. Built by the Wealth Management Expert, this case is a retirement planning plan — a pension-gap calculation, an asset accumulation path from age 40 to 60, the three-pillar mix, year-by-year retirement cash flow, and actionable top-up suggestions. Unlike FIRE (which chases early retirement), this focuses on conventional-retirement pension and cash-flow planning. Ideal for families preparing for retirement.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一份家庭养老退休规划方案页（单文件 HTML）。一对 40 岁夫妻计划 60 岁退休。要直观看到：家庭信息/目标退休年龄/退休后年支出/缺口结论、养老金缺口测算（需求 vs 三支柱覆盖）、40→60 岁资产积累曲线、三支柱构成、退休后 60→85 岁逐年现金流、3-4 条行动建议、关键假设与风险。温暖信赖的浅色财富顾问风，界面中文，货币 ¥，数据为测算示意。
cases.prompt_en: Help me build a family retirement planning plan page (single-file HTML). A couple aged 40 plan to retire at 60. Show family info/target retirement age/post-retirement annual spend/gap conclusion, a pension-gap calculation (need vs three-pillar coverage), an asset accumulation curve from 40 to 60, the three-pillar mix, year-by-year retirement cash flow from 60 to 85, 3-4 action suggestions, and key assumptions and risks. A warm, trustworthy light wealth-advisor style; UI in Simplified Chinese; currency ¥; figures illustrative.

cases.description_en: Retail investors watching single stocks often miss the forest for the trees and can't see how money rotates across sectors. Built by the Equity Research Expert, this case is a sector rotation & capital flow monitor — a sector gain/loss heatmap grid, a main-capital net-inflow ranking, style-rotation strength, northbound flows, plus objective sector-allocation views. Unlike single-stock analysis, it focuses at the sector level. Ideal for investors tracking rotation and where the money flows.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一个 A 股行业轮动与资金流向监控仪表盘（单文件 HTML）。要直观看到：大盘概览与今日资金主线、16 个一级行业涨跌热力网格（涨红跌绿，深浅表强度）、主力资金行业净流入排行（双向条形）、风格轮动强弱（大盘价值↔小盘成长等）、北向资金动向与趋势、3 条行业配置研判。深色金融终端风，A股惯例涨红跌绿，界面中文，请联网搜索获取 A 股各行业当日真实行情、资金流向与北向数据（注明数据日期与来源）。

cases.title: 13F 聪明钱工作台
cases.subtitle: 一页追踪 20 家华尔街机构的季度持仓、共识买入与个股反查
cases.subtitle_en: Track quarterly holdings, consensus buys, and stock-level ownership across 20 Wall Street institutions
cases.description:
SEC 13F 披露量大、申报格式分散，直接翻 EDGAR 很难快速回答：头部机构本季在加仓什么、哪些股票形成共识、某只股票到底被谁持有。

这个案例把 SEC EDGAR 13F-HR 公开申报整理成一张可离线浏览的交互工作台，覆盖 20 家机构、4 个季度、25,386 条持仓记录。它提供本季速览、机构名单、共识买入排行、股票/CUSIP 反查、机构详情、简明/专业视图以及按市值或季度变动排序，并明确标注数据抓取时间、申报期和 45 天披露滞后。

适合：研究美股机构持仓的个人投资者、需要跟踪聪明钱动向的投研人员、制作 13F 季度复盘的内容创作者，以及想把公开金融数据做成交互工作台的分析师。
cases.description_en:
SEC 13F filings are large and fragmented, making it difficult to quickly answer three practical questions in EDGAR: what leading institutions added this quarter, which stocks attracted broad consensus, and who owns a specific stock.

This case turns public SEC EDGAR 13F-HR filings into a self-contained interactive workbench covering 20 institutions, four quarters, and 25,386 holding records. It includes a quarterly overview, institution directory, consensus-buy rankings, stock/CUSIP lookup, institution drill-down, simplified and professional views, and sorting by market value or quarterly change. The page clearly states the retrieval time, reporting periods, and the roughly 45-day filing lag.

Best for: individual investors researching U.S. institutional holdings, investment researchers tracking smart-money moves, creators producing quarterly 13F reviews, and analysts turning public financial data into an interactive workspace.

artifacts.label: 13F 聪明钱交互工作台

cases.prompt:
请搭建一个名为「13F 聪明钱工作台」的单文件交互式 HTML。真实查询美国证监会 SEC EDGAR 的 13F-HR 公开申报，注明数据来源、抓取时间、报告期、申报日期和约 45 天披露滞后；不要使用示意或模拟持仓。覆盖不少于 20 家有代表性的机构和最近 4 个可得季度，按 CUSIP 对比环比变化，并在可可靠映射时展示股票代码。

工作台包含四个核心入口：本季速览、机构名单、共识买入、股票/CUSIP 反查。本季速览展示总持仓市值、覆盖股票数、机构集中加仓与减仓结论；机构卡片展示代表人物、风格、持仓规模、前十大持仓与新进/增持/减持/清仓；共识页按共同持有机构数和本季变化排序；反查支持输入股票代码、公司名或 CUSIP，查看哪些机构持有及其季度变化。机构详情支持简明/专业视图，并可按市值或本季变动排序。

使用浅色、克制、专业的金融研究风格，涨用红色、跌用绿色，桌面和手机均可用。所有 CSS、JavaScript、图标、字体和数据必须内联，不依赖外部资源；页面默认可见，离线打开仍能完整浏览和交互。页面底部加入数据口径、来源与“不构成投资建议”声明。
cases.prompt_en:
Build a self-contained interactive HTML named “13F Smart Money Workbench.” Query real public 13F-HR filings from the U.S. SEC EDGAR system and state the data source, retrieval time, reporting periods, filing dates, and the roughly 45-day disclosure lag. Do not use illustrative or simulated holdings. Cover at least 20 representative institutions and the latest four available quarters, compare quarter-over-quarter changes by CUSIP, and show ticker symbols where they can be mapped reliably.

Provide four core entry points: Quarterly Overview, Institution Directory, Consensus Buys, and Stock/CUSIP Lookup. The overview should summarize aggregate market value, covered securities, and concentrated additions or reductions. Institution cards should show the representative investor, strategy style, portfolio size, top ten holdings, and new/increased/reduced/exited positions. The consensus view should rank securities by the number of institutions holding them and by quarterly change. Lookup should accept a ticker, company name, or CUSIP and show which institutions hold it and how positions changed. Institution detail should offer simplified and professional views with sorting by market value or quarterly change.

Use a restrained, professional light financial-research aesthetic, with red for gains and green for declines, and support both desktop and mobile. Inline all CSS, JavaScript, icons, fonts, and data with no external resources; keep content visible by default and fully functional offline. Add data definitions, sources, and a not-investment-advice disclaimer in the footer.

cases.title: 2026 A股半年报分析台
cases.subtitle: 总榜 · 产业链赚钱榜 · 双增公司 · 预告观察，中报季一页掌握
cases.subtitle_en: Master ranking, industry-chain profit board, double-growth list and preannouncement watch — mid-report season on one page
cases.description: 中报季几千家公司陆续披露，想比出谁真的好，要在公告、行情、行业数据之间反复横跳。本案例组合「NeoData 金融搜索服务」与「WeStock Data」，生成一个 2026 A股半年报分析台：正式半年报总榜按所选维度排行，产业链环节赚钱榜看哪段最赚钱，双增公司一眼锁定营收净利双升的标的，还有业绩预告/待披露观察区和宏观行业对照。适合中报季做行业比较和选股初筛的投资者。
cases.description_en: During interim-report season, thousands of companies disclose in waves — comparing them means bouncing between announcements, quotes and industry data. Combining NeoData Financial Search with WeStock Data, this case builds a 2026 A-share mid-year report analyzer: a formal-report master ranking sorted by your chosen metrics, an industry-chain profit board showing which segment earns most, a double-growth list flagging companies with rising revenue and profit, plus a preannouncement/pending-disclosure watchlist and macro-industry comparison. Built for investors doing sector comparison and first-pass stock screening in interim season.
cases.prompt:
帮我做一个「2026 A股半年报分析台」网页并发布返回。

用 NeoData 金融搜索服务查财务与宏观数据，用 WeStock Data 查行情、财报、资金流和技术指标，所有数据真实查询并注明来源。先把查询结果整理成 CSV 数据表存入资料库，再生成单页 HTML，利用资料库能力关联这些 CSV 数据表展示（页面通过资料库 SDK 按需查询数据，并提供导出 CSV 备份与离线静态快照兜底），最后把网页发布后返回。页面分六大板块：① 全市场正式半年报总榜（按营收/净利/ROE 等维度排行）；② 产业链环节赚钱榜（选产业链自动联动环节）；③ 双增公司榜（营收与归母净利同比双升）；④ 产业链内公司对比；⑤ 业绩预告/待披露观察区（未披露公司自动观察、披露后转正入榜）；⑥ 宏观行业对照区。支持产业链→环节→板块/类型/排序/关键词联动筛选，数据全部内嵌、单文件 HTML、资源全内联，涨跌按 A 股习惯（涨红跌绿），附免责声明（非投资建议）。
cases.prompt_en:
Build a '2026 A-Share Mid-Year Report Analyzer' web page and publish it back.

Use NeoData Financial Search for financials and macro data, and WeStock Data for quotes, statements, capital flow and technicals — query real data and cite sources. First organize the queried data into CSV tables and store them in the knowledge base, then build a single-page HTML that leverages the knowledge-base capability to render those CSV tables (the page queries data on demand via the knowledge-base SDK, with CSV-export backup and an offline static snapshot fallback), then publish the page and return it. Six panels: ① market-wide formal interim-report master ranking (sortable by revenue / net profit / ROE etc.); ② industry-chain segment profit board (pick a chain, segments auto-filter); ③ double-growth list (revenue and net profit both rising YoY); ④ within-chain company comparison; ⑤ preannouncement / pending-disclosure watchlist (undisclosed companies stay observed and join the ranking once disclosed); ⑥ macro-industry comparison. Support chained filtering (chain → segment → board / type / sort / keyword). All data embedded, single-file HTML with fully inlined assets, China-market colors (up=red, down=green), plus a disclaimer (not investment advice).

cases.title: 50ETF期权牛市价差策略
cases.subtitle: 趋势市怎么用牛市价差，Gamma/希腊字母怎么看
cases.subtitle_en: Using a bull call spread in a trending market, and how to read Gamma and the Greeks
cases.description: 期权策略门槛高，趋势市里到底该不该用牛市价差、Gamma 等希腊字母怎么影响盈亏，新手很容易凭感觉下单。本案例以 50ETF 期权为例，讲清楚牛市价差的构造、盈亏结构、盈亏平衡点，并用希腊字母（Delta/Gamma/Theta）拆解风险敞口，配期权定价可视化。适合想系统学习期权策略、做结构化交易的进阶投资者。
cases.description_en: Options strategies have a high bar; in a trending market, whether to use a bull call spread and how Greeks like Gamma affect P&L can lead beginners to trade on gut feel. Using 50ETF options as an example, this case explains the construction, payoff structure and break-even of a bull call spread, decomposes risk exposure via the Greeks (Delta/Gamma/Theta), and adds option-pricing visualizations. Ideal for advanced investors who want to learn options strategies systematically and trade structurally.
cases.prompt:
帮我生成一份「50ETF 期权牛市价差策略」分析单页 HTML。

查 50ETF 行情与波动率数据。讲清楚：当前趋势市下牛市价差是否合适、怎么构造（买低行权价 call + 卖高行权价 call）、盈亏结构和盈亏平衡点，并用希腊字母（重点 Gamma，兼顾 Delta/Theta）拆解风险敞口怎么随价格变化。用图表画出到期盈亏曲线和希腊字母变化，最后给适用场景和风险提示（非投资建议）。界面文字用简体中文。
cases.prompt_en:
Generate a single-page HTML analysis of a '50ETF options bull call spread strategy'.

Pull 50ETF quotes and volatility data. Explain: whether a bull call spread suits the current trending market, how to construct it (buy lower-strike call + sell higher-strike call), its payoff structure and break-even, and use the Greeks (focus on Gamma, plus Delta/Theta) to decompose how risk exposure changes with price. cases.description_en: After the close, investors want to know what mainline the market is trading, whether sentiment is hot or cold, and whether it's still chaseable tomorrow — but signals like limit-up counts, seal rates and consecutive-board promotion rates are scattered, making the full picture hard to assemble. This case produces an A-share mainline & sentiment recap, quantifying sentiment temperature (limit-ups, seal rate, board height, promotion rate), identifying the true mainline and capital direction, and flagging sustainability. Ideal for intraday/overnight reviews and active investors tracking market sentiment.

Produce a single-page HTML A-share mainline & sentiment recap: what mainline the market traded today and how hot sentiment is.

Use charts for sector strength, the limit-up ladder and sentiment indicators, ending with an overnight judgment (not investment advice). UI text in Simplified Chinese; up=red, down=green.

cases.subtitle: 100万股债怎么配，两种经典框架哪个更适合现在
cases.subtitle_en: How to allocate 1M between stocks and bonds — which classic framework fits now
cases.description: 手里有一笔钱想做股债配置，最大夏普组合和全天候策略是两种经典思路，但各自的逻辑、风险暴露和适用环境差别很大，普通投资者很难选。本案例以 100 万资金为例，对比两种配置框架的构造方法、预期收益风险、回撤特征和当前市场适配度，给出具体配置比例。适合做资产配置、想在两种主流框架间做选择的投资者。
cases.description_en: With a sum to allocate between stocks and bonds, the max-Sharpe portfolio and the all-weather strategy are two classic approaches, but their logic, risk exposure and suitable environments differ greatly, making the choice hard for ordinary investors. Using 1M as an example, this case compares the two frameworks' construction, expected return/risk, drawdown characteristics and fit with the current market, and gives concrete allocation weights. Ideal for asset allocation and investors choosing between the two mainstream frameworks.
cases.prompt:

cases.prompt_en:
Generate a single-page HTML comparing 'max-Sharpe vs all-weather' asset allocation, using a 1M stock-bond allocation as the example.

Pull major-asset quotes and historical performance. Compare the two frameworks: how the max-Sharpe portfolio and the all-weather strategy are each constructed, their logic, expected return and risk, drawdown characteristics, and which fits better under the current rate and market environment. Provide concrete allocation weights for each, use charts for asset weights and risk-return comparison, ending with a selection suggestion (not investment advice). UI text in Simplified Chinese.

cases.subtitle_en: How BYD actually makes money compared with peers, and where its moat lies
cases.description: 都说比亚迪是龙头，但它和同行的赚钱方式到底差在哪、垂直整合究竟带来多少利润优势，光看股价说不清楚。本案例把比亚迪的商业模式拆开，对比同行的打法，量化垂直整合的收益（如代工/电池外供的协同贡献），讲清楚护城河和成长驱动。适合想从商业模式而非短期行情维度理解一家公司的投资者与产业研究者。
cases.description_en: BYD is called the leader, but how its money-making model differs from peers, and how much profit advantage vertical integration really brings, can't be explained by share price alone. This case dissects BYD's business model, compares peer approaches, quantifies the gains from vertical integration (e.g. synergy from contract manufacturing / external battery supply), and clarifies the moat and growth drivers. Ideal for investors and researchers who want to understand a company from a business-model angle rather than short-term price.
cases.prompt:
帮我生成一份「比亚迪商业模式拆解」单页 HTML。

查比亚迪（002594）及同行的财务、行情数据。重点说清楚：比亚迪和同行相比，赚钱方式有什么不一样，垂直整合（自产电池、半导体、代工等）带来多少利润优势，护城河和长期成长驱动在哪。用图表对比比亚迪与同行的盈利结构和关键指标，最后给一段综合判断（非投资建议）。界面文字用简体中文，涨跌涨红跌绿。

Use charts to compare profit structure and key metrics vs peers, ending with an overall assessment (not investment advice). UI text in Simplified Chinese; up=red, down=green.

cases.subtitle: 是不是抱团股，拥挤度高不高，还能不能追
cases.subtitle_en: Is it a crowded consensus trade, how crowded, and can it still be chased
cases.description: 明星股最怕「抱团瓦解」，但拥挤度到底高不高、是不是已经到了危险区，普通投资者只能凭感觉。本案例对宁德时代做拥挤度诊断，从机构持仓集中度、基金重仓比例、成交占比、北向持股等维度量化「抱团」程度，判断当前拥挤度处在什么水位、风险大不大，并给出交易层面的应对计划。适合关注热门股、想规避抱团瓦解风险的投资者。
cases.description_en: Star stocks most fear a 'consensus unwind', but whether crowding is high and already in the danger zone is something ordinary investors can only guess. This case diagnoses CATL's crowding, quantifying the degree of 'huddling' across institutional holding concentration, fund overweight ratio, turnover share and northbound holdings, judges what level crowding sits at and how risky it is, and gives a trading-level action plan. Ideal for investors following popular stocks who want to avoid consensus-unwind risk.
cases.prompt:
帮我对宁德时代做一份拥挤度诊断单页 HTML：它算不算抱团股，拥挤度高不高，还能不能追。

cases.prompt_en:
Produce a single-page HTML crowding diagnosis for CATL: is it a crowded consensus trade, how crowded, and can it still be chased.

Pull its institutional holdings, fund overweights, turnover and northbound-holding data. Quantify the degree of 'huddling' across institutional concentration, fund overweight ratio, turnover share and northbound holdings, judge where crowding sits versus history and how big the consensus-unwind risk is, and give a trading-level action plan (key levels, trim signals, etc.). Use charts for the crowding dimensions and their history, ending with an overall judgment (not investment advice). UI text in Simplified Chinese; up=red, down=green.

cases.title_en: Why GOOGL Fell Despite a Beat

cases.subtitle_en: Beat expectations yet dropped — what the earnings call actually said
cases.description: 财报超预期股价反而下跌，是美股常见却最让人困惑的现象。本案例以谷歌（GOOGL）某季财报为例，拆解「超预期却下跌」背后的真实原因——是指引不及预期、资本开支超预期，还是市场早已price in，并梳理业绩会管理层的关键表态。帮你看懂财报数字之外的市场逻辑。适合关注美股财报、想理解预期差交易的投资者。
cases.description_en: A stock falling after an earnings beat is a common yet baffling US-market phenomenon. Using a Google (GOOGL) quarterly report, this case unpacks the real reason behind 'beat yet dropped' — soft guidance, capex above expectations, or already priced in — and distills management's key remarks on the call. It helps you see the market logic beyond the headline numbers. Ideal for investors following US earnings who want to understand expectation-gap trading.
cases.prompt:
帮我做一份谷歌（GOOGL）财报点评单页 HTML：业绩超预期为什么还跌，业绩会说了啥。

查谷歌的财报数据、行情和历史表现。拆解：这次财报哪些超预期、哪些不及预期，股价超预期却下跌的真实原因（指引、资本开支、是否已被 price in 等），并梳理业绩会上管理层的关键表态。用图表展示分业务营收、利润和关键指标的同比环比变化，最后给综合解读（非投资建议）。涉及非一手来源的信息要标注。界面文字用简体中文。

Unpack: what beat and what missed this quarter, the real reason the stock fell despite the beat (guidance, capex, whether already priced in, etc.), and distill management's key remarks on the call. Use charts for segment revenue, profit and key-metric YoY/QoQ changes, ending with an overall reading (not investment advice). Mark any non-first-hand sourced information. cases.title: 香港宽频业绩与增长预测
cases.subtitle: 财年改制下的利息吞噬陷阱，增长率怎么还原
cases.subtitle_en: The interest-erosion trap under a fiscal-year change, and how to normalize growth
cases.description: 香港宽频（01310.HK）的财报藏着两个坑：财年改制让同比口径错位、高杠杆下利息费用大幅吞噬利润，直接看增长率容易被误导。本案例对其做业绩与增长率预测，还原可比口径，拆解利息对净利的侵蚀，识别财报里的「会计陷阱」，给出更接近真实经营的增长判断。适合做港股财报分析、关注高杠杆公司盈利质量的投资者。
cases.description_en: HKBN's (01310.HK) financials hide two traps: a fiscal-year change misaligns year-on-year comparisons, and heavy leverage means interest expense erodes profit substantially, so reading growth at face value is misleading. This case forecasts earnings and growth, normalizes the comparable basis, decomposes interest's erosion of net profit, flags the 'accounting traps' in the statements, and gives a growth judgment closer to true operations. Ideal for HK-stock earnings analysis and investors focused on the profit quality of highly leveraged firms.
cases.prompt:
帮我对香港宽频（01310.HK）做一份业绩与增长率预测单页 HTML。

查它的财报、行情和历史财务数据。重点处理两个难点：财年改制导致的同比口径错位怎么还原成可比口径；高杠杆下利息费用对净利润的吞噬有多大。在此基础上预测营收和净利润增长率，识别财报里容易误导人的「会计陷阱」，给出更贴近真实经营的增长判断。用图表展示历史与预测的营收利润趋势、利息侵蚀和增长率，最后给综合结论（非投资建议）。界面文字用简体中文。
cases.prompt_en:
Produce a single-page HTML earnings & growth forecast for HKBN (01310.HK).

Pull its statements, quotes and historical financials. Tackle two key difficulties: how to normalize the year-on-year basis distorted by the fiscal-year change; and how much interest expense under heavy leverage erodes net profit. On that basis, forecast revenue and net-profit growth, flag misleading 'accounting traps' in the statements, and give a growth judgment closer to true operations. Use charts for historical and forecast revenue/profit trends, interest erosion and growth rates, ending with an overall conclusion (not investment advice). UI text in Simplified Chinese.

cases.title: 低空经济产业链全景拆解
cases.subtitle: 上中下游怎么分，哪一段最受益，伪受益怎么识别
cases.subtitle_en: Upstream-to-downstream breakdown, who benefits most, and how to spot fake beneficiaries
cases.description: 提到低空经济，市场一拥而上炒概念，但产业链上中下游的价值分布天差地别，普通投资者很难分清谁是真受益、谁只是蹭热点。本案例以「空管 > 整机 > 运营」的价值链视角，把低空经济产业链分层拆开，标出每一段的代表公司、受益逻辑和确定性，并专门识别「伪受益」标的。适合做主题投资研究、想看懂产业链结构而非追概念的投资者。
cases.description_en: When the low-altitude economy is hot, the market piles into the theme, but value is distributed very unevenly across the chain, and ordinary investors struggle to tell real beneficiaries from hype-chasers. Using an 'air-traffic-control > airframe > operations' value-chain lens, this case breaks the chain into layers, marks representative companies, benefit logic and certainty for each, and specifically flags 'fake beneficiaries'. Ideal for thematic research and investors who want to understand chain structure rather than chase concepts.

cases.description: 都说药明康德是 CXO 龙头有护城河，但壁垒究竟来自哪、面对生物安全法案等外部冲击还稳不稳，光靠印象说不清。本案例用「护城河证据矩阵」框架，从规模、一体化能力、客户黏性、转换成本等维度逐条找证据，评估壁垒的深度和可持续性，并把地缘政策风险纳入考量。适合做长期价值研究、想验证「护城河」是否真实的投资者。

Ideal for long-term value research and investors who want to verify whether a 'moat' is real.

cases.subtitle: 用复利和里程碑，把财务自由拆成可执行的 15 年计划
cases.subtitle_en: Turn financial independence into an actionable 15-year plan with compounding and milestones
cases.description: 「财务自由」听起来遥远，难点在于它是一个抽象的长期目标，普通人很难知道自己现在在哪、还差多远、每年该存多少。本案例由「理财财」财富管理专家生成一份个人 FIRE 规划路线图——用 4% 法则算出目标资产，画出 15 年复利增长曲线，把大目标拆成可达成的里程碑，并对比保守/基准/积极三种情景。适合想认真规划长期财务、追求提前退休的个人。
cases.description_en: 'Financial freedom' sounds distant — the hard part is that it's an abstract long-term goal, and most people can't tell where they stand, how far they have to go, or how much to save each year. Generated by the Wealth Management Expert, this personal FIRE roadmap uses the 4% rule to compute the target nest egg, plots a 15-year compounding growth curve, breaks the big goal into achievable milestones, and compares conservative/base/aggressive scenarios. Ideal for individuals serious about long-term planning and early retirement.
cases.prompt:
生成一份个人财务自由（FIRE）规划路线图。

cases.prompt_en:

Key parameters: current net worth ¥600,000, annual savings ¥180,000 (savings rate 43%), expected annual return 7%; by the 4% rule, the FIRE target = annual expenses × 25 = ¥6,000,000, current progress 10%. Include target-assets / progress / projected age of achievement / savings-rate KPIs, a 15-year compounding asset-growth curve, key milestones, and a conservative/base/aggressive scenario comparison.

cases.description:
散户和研究员读财报，最容易卡在两点：数据散落各处，结论和论证对不上号。

这个案例展示了一个「财报八步分析法工作台」：输入公司名即可生成标准分析指令，报告统一按「一句话结论置顶 → 核心指标卡片 → 八步框架逐层展开 → 深度长文 → 数据源交叉验证表」组织；内置贵州茅台、兆易创新、英伟达、五粮液、中国石化、寒武纪、国泰海通、中际旭创、新易盛等龙头公司的完整财报分析（NeoData 主源 + 东财第二源双源交叉验证），报告库可增删查看，数据表支持挂载 CSV 财务数据。

适合：想系统化拆解财报的投资者、需要把研报线索收在一处的研究员、关注 A 股基本面的个人。
cases.description_en:
When retail investors and analysts read financial reports, they most often get stuck on two things: data scattered everywhere, and conclusions that don't line up with the evidence.

This case shows an Eight-Step Financial Report Analysis Workbench: enter a company name to generate a standard analysis prompt, and every report is organized as 'one-sentence conclusion on top → core metric cards → eight-step framework → in-depth article → data-source cross-validation table'. It ships with complete analyses of leading companies — Kweichow Moutai, GigaDevice, NVIDIA, Wuliangye, Sinopec, Cambricon, Guotai Haitong, Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink and more — cross-validated across NeoData (primary) and EastMoney (secondary). The report library supports add / view / delete, and the data-table tab supports mounting CSV financial data.

Best for: investors who want to dissect financial reports systematically, analysts who want to keep research threads in one place, and anyone who follows A-share fundamentals.

cases.title_en: Resource Capacity & FinOps Cost Health Inspection
cases.subtitle: 一键生成云资源水位+成本健康综合巡检报告
cases.subtitle_en: One-click comprehensive cloud resource capacity and cost health report
cases.description:
每月手动盘点云资源利用率和费用明细，是运维团队最头疼的重复劳动，既容易遗漏闲置资源，又缺乏系统性优化建议。

本案例演示了如何通过腾讯云 DevOps 专家（CloudQ）自动完成一次「资源容量水位 + FinOps 成本健康」综合巡检：自动盘点 CVM/Lighthouse/SCF 等计算资源的实例数、地域分布和利用率水位，识别停机闲置和低利用率实例，分析成本科目分布和环比变化，并给出 5 条具体的优化建议（含动作、预期节省金额和风险点），最终输出一份带可视化图表的专业 HTML 巡检报告。

适合：云运维工程师、SRE、FinOps 负责人、技术管理者、需要定期做成本优化的团队
cases.description_en:
Manually reviewing cloud resource utilization and cost breakdowns every month is the most tedious recurring task for ops teams — it's easy to miss idle resources and hard to generate actionable optimization advice.

This case demonstrates how to use the Tencent Cloud DevOps Expert (CloudQ) to automatically perform a comprehensive 'Resource Capacity + FinOps Cost Health' inspection: inventorying CVM/Lighthouse/SCF compute resources by instance count, region, and utilization levels; identifying shutdown/idle and over-provisioned instances; analyzing cost category distribution with month-over-month trends; and delivering 5 concrete optimization recommendations (with actions, expected savings, and risk points) — all in a professional HTML report with visualizations.

Ideal for: Cloud ops engineers, SREs, FinOps leads, tech managers, teams needing periodic cost optimization

artifacts.label: 综合巡检报告

cases.prompt:
请基于当前账号的真实数据，帮我做一次「资源容量水位 + FinOps 成本健康」综合巡检报告。要求：

一、资源容量水位
1) 列出当前账号下主要计算资源（CVM、TKE、Lighthouse 等）的水位情况，给出实例数、地域分布、CPU/内存/磁盘的近期水位区间
2) 标注高水位（>80%）与低水位（<20%）实例，分别给出资源 ID/名称/规格

二、FinOps 成本分析
1) 闲置或低利用率资源清单（停机/低 CPU/未挂载磁盘等），按潜在节省金额降序
2) 主要成本科目分布（计算/存储/网络/数据库等）及环比变化提示
3) 给出 3-5 条最具性价比的优化建议（每条要写明：动作、预期节省、风险点）

输出格式要求：生成一份带可视化图表和专业排版的 HTML 报告，包含执行摘要、资源明细表格、成本占比图、优化建议卡片和行动项 Checklist。
cases.prompt_en:
Based on the real data of the current account, please help me run a comprehensive "Resource Capacity + FinOps Cost Health" inspection report. Requirements:

I. Resource Capacity
1) List the capacity status of the main compute resources under the current account (CVM, TKE, Lighthouse, etc.), giving instance counts, regional distribution, and recent utilization ranges for CPU/memory/disk
2) Flag high-utilization (>80%) and low-utilization (<20%) instances, providing the resource ID/name/specification for each

II. FinOps Cost Analysis
1) A list of idle or low-utilization resources (shut down / low CPU / unattached disks, etc.), sorted in descending order by potential savings
2) Distribution of major cost categories (compute / storage / network / database, etc.) and month-over-month change notes
3) Provide 3-5 of the most cost-effective optimization recommendations (each must specify: action, expected savings, risk points)

Output format requirements: Generate an HTML report with visualizations and professional layout, including an executive summary, a resource detail table, a cost breakdown chart, optimization recommendation cards, and an action-item checklist.

cases.title: 品种晨会简报
cases.subtitle: 开盘前一次看全单品种观点、评级与关键信号
cases.description: 研究员定期观点、周度评级、当日快评分散在不同材料里，挨个翻费时费力还怕漏掉关键信号。本案例把繁微Fiona的多源研究材料串成一条流水线，聚焦任一期货品种，产出一份信息密度高、全部真实可溯源的单页HTML晨会简报：从年度/季度定期观点到近11周周度评级色块，再到最新研报与当日快评的四维提炼（核心结论→关键数据→研究逻辑→风险），加上6-12项重点指标看板和共识/分歧/张力三列交叉比较，开盘前一次看完。适合每日开盘前的例行信息准备。
cases.prompt:
生成单文件HTML《{品种}晨会简报》，数据基准日期为{日期}。所有数据通过繁微Fiona MCP工具（finoview-reports skill）真实查询并注明来源与日期，禁止编造；若该品种的研报/周度评级/快评/定期观点四个维度全部为空即视为未覆盖，直接告知用户并给出替代建议，不生成报告。按以下步骤执行：
第一步、研究员观点时间线：查询{品种}的年度/半年/季度定期观点（对应材料缺失时注明"暂未覆盖"；如存在产业链或相关品种材料，可单独列为"相关参考"，不得替代该品种观点）；拉取近11周周度评级并以色块呈现（空周留灰块）；附一句时间线解读。
第二步、今日材料四维提炼：检索最新研报、本周周度评级、当日快评三类材料（多品种周报只取{品种}段落；周度评级查不到时尝试"沪{品种简称}"作为关键词；快评优先品种日度数据跟踪与点评），按核心结论→关键数据→研究逻辑→风险四个维度提炼。
第三步、重点关注指标看板：展示6-12项实际查询到且与{品种}相关的指标，按"指标/最新状态/方向信号/出处"四列呈现。
第四步、交叉比较：输出共识、分歧与张力三列表（比较维度/结论/依据；结论列只写短判断，依据列单独写明出处）。
输出格式要求：单文件HTML，全部样式内联、无外部依赖；配色遵循看涨红、看跌绿、震荡黄；所有来源注明"繁微Fiona/东证衍生品研究院"及具体日期。

cases.subtitle_en: One page to see all variety views, ratings and key signals before market open
cases.description_en: Researcher periodic views, weekly ratings, and intraday flash comments are scattered across different materials—reading them one by one is time-consuming and risks missing key signals. This case turns Finoview Fiona's multi-source research materials into a pipeline, focusing on any single futures variety, and produces an information-dense, fully-traceable single-page HTML morning briefing: from annual/quarterly periodic views to 11-week weekly rating color blocks, to four-dimensional extraction of the latest research reports and intraday flash comments (core conclusion → key data → research logic → risk), plus a 6-12 item key indicator dashboard and consensus/divergence/tension three-column cross-comparison, all readable before market open.
cases.prompt_en:
Generate a single-file HTML '{Variety} Morning Briefing' with data reference date {Date}. All data is queried via Finoview Fiona MCP tools (finoview-reports skill) with sources and dates noted; fabrication is prohibited. If all four dimensions (research report / weekly rating / flash comment / periodic view) for the variety are empty, treat as uncovered, inform the user and suggest alternatives without generating a report. Execute the following steps:
Step 1, Researcher View Timeline: Query {Variety}'s annual/semi-annual/quarterly periodic views (mark 'not covered' when materials are missing; if supply chain or related variety materials exist, list separately as 'related reference', not as a substitute for the variety's own views); pull the latest 11 weeks of weekly ratings and display as color blocks (gray blocks for empty weeks); add a one-sentence timeline interpretation.
Step 2, Today's Material Four-Dimensional Extraction: Search for the latest research reports, this week's weekly ratings, and intraday flash comments (for multi-variety weekly reports, only extract the {Variety} section; if weekly ratings are not found, try 'Shanghai {Variety abbreviation}' as keyword; flash comments prioritize daily variety data tracking and commentary), extract by core conclusion → key data → research logic → risk.
Step 3, Key Indicator Dashboard: Display 6-12 indicators actually queried and related to {Variety}, presented in four columns: 'Indicator / Latest Status / Direction Signal / Source'.
Step 4, Cross-Comparison: Output consensus, divergence, and tension three-column tables (comparison dimension / conclusion / basis; conclusion column only has short judgments, basis column separately notes sources).
Output format requirements: Single-file HTML, all styles inline, no external dependencies; color scheme follows bullish red, bearish green, neutral yellow; all sources noted as 'Finoview Fiona / Oriental Securities Derivatives Research Institute' with specific dates. UI text in Simplified Chinese.

cases.title: 评级异动捕手
cases.subtitle: 升级、降级、僵持与背离，板块评级边际信号一屏锁定
cases.description: 想捕捉板块评级的边际变化，上周和本周谁升级、谁降级、谁僵持不动，靠人工查阅既慢又容易看漏。本案例把繁微的跨周评级对比能力串成一条流水线，聚焦任一板块，产出一份全部真实可溯源的单页HTML异动扫描：升级/降级/新纳入/退出四类变动清单，每个变动品种近8周评级色带配研报快评原文摘句，连续6周以上僵持品种锁定，以及评级与快评背离品种的双边依据罗列，边际信号一屏锁定。
cases.prompt:
生成单文件HTML《{板块}评级异动扫描》，对比{上周日期}与{本周日期}两期评级。所有数据通过繁微Fiona MCP工具（finoview-reports skill）真实查询并注明来源与日期，禁止编造。板块口径：周度观点无宏观/能源/金工独立项，宏观→股指或国债、能源→化工、金工只用研报与快评。按以下步骤执行：
第一步、本周评级变动清单：对比上周与本周的品种评级，分升级（震荡→看涨等）、降级（看涨→震荡等）、新纳入、退出四类列出，注明变动前后评级；无变动则如实写"本周无评级变动"。
第二步、变动品种归因：每个变动品种给出近8周评级色带，并附支撑本次变动的研报或快评原文摘句+出处；找不到对应材料的如实写"暂未见对应材料"，不要推测原因。
第三步、僵持品种：列出连续6周及以上评级未变的品种，标注锁定周数与当前评级。
第四步、评级与快评背离：列出评级维持震荡、但本周快评方向性偏多或偏空的品种，罗列两边依据。
第五步、品种池错位：只在快评有跟踪、未进入周度评级矩阵的品种，单独注明。
输出格式要求：单文件HTML，全部样式内联、无外部依赖；配色遵循看涨红、看跌绿、震荡黄；所有来源注明"繁微Fiona/东证衍生品研究院"及具体日期。

cases.subtitle_en: Upgrades, downgrades, stalemates and divergences—sector rating marginal signals locked on one screen
cases.description_en: To capture marginal changes in sector ratings—who upgraded, who downgraded, who remained stalemate—manual review is slow and prone to missing signals. This case turns Finoview's cross-week rating comparison capability into a pipeline, focusing on any sector, and produces a fully-traceable single-page HTML change scan: upgrade/downgrade/new inclusion/exit four-category change list, each changed variety's 8-week rating color band with research report flash comment original text quotes, 6+ consecutive weeks stalemate varieties locked, and rating vs flash comment divergence varieties with bilateral evidence listed, marginal signals locked on one screen.
cases.prompt_en:
Generate a single-file HTML '{Sector} Rating Change Scan', comparing {Last Week Date} and {This Week Date} two periods of ratings. All data is queried via Finoview Fiona MCP tools (finoview-reports skill) with sources and dates noted; fabrication is prohibited. Sector scope: weekly views have no independent macro/energy/quant items; macro → stock index or treasury bonds, energy → chemicals, quant uses only reports and flash comments. Execute the following steps:
Step 1, This Week's Rating Change List: Compare last week and this week's variety ratings, categorize into upgrades (neutral → bullish, etc.), downgrades (bullish → neutral, etc.), new inclusions, and exits, noting pre and post change ratings; if no changes, honestly write 'no rating changes this week'.
Step 2, Changed Variety Attribution: For each changed variety, provide an 8-week rating color band, and attach the research report or flash comment original text quotes + sources supporting this change; if no corresponding materials found, honestly write 'no corresponding materials found yet', do not speculate on reasons.
Step 3, Stalemate Varieties: List varieties with unchanged ratings for 6 or more consecutive weeks, marking locked weeks and current rating.
Step 4, Rating vs Flash Comment Divergence: List varieties where rating remains neutral but this week's flash comment direction is bullish or bearish, listing both sides' evidence.
Step 5, Variety Pool Mismatch: Varieties only tracked in flash comments but not in the weekly rating matrix, noted separately.
Output format requirements: Single-file HTML, all styles inline, no external dependencies; color scheme follows bullish red, bearish green, neutral yellow; all sources noted as 'Finoview Fiona / Oriental Securities Derivatives Research Institute' with specific dates. UI text in Simplified Chinese.

cases.title: 研报深度剖析
cases.subtitle: 一篇深度报告读透：结论、逻辑链、风险与历史观点对照
cases.description: 想吃透一篇深度研报的完整逻辑，200字摘要远远不够：核心观点、关键数据、推演链、风险因素以及研究员过去的观点脉络都得拉出来对照，手动翻全文既耗时又容易只看到结论、忽略逻辑。本案例把繁微的研报全文检索与观点交叉引用能力串成一条流水线，聚焦任一品种的深度报告，产出一份全部真实可溯源的单页HTML深度剖析：报告概览、3-5条核心结论附原文摘句、关键数据"数据→判断→依据"三列逻辑链、逐条风险因素，最后串联该品种主要研究员历史观点对比（标注延续与转向）与近4周数据周报逻辑递进脉络，一篇报告读透读深。
cases.prompt:
生成单文件HTML《{品种}研报深读_{日期}》。所有内容通过繁微Fiona MCP工具（finoview-reports skill）真实查询，禁止编造。按以下步骤执行：
第零步、选报告：先按{品种}搜索研报，筛选深度类报告（深度报告/月度报告/专题报告/季度观点/半年报/年报/策略报告等），优先选取最近一期作为剖析对象；若全部为数据周报、无深度类报告，则如实告知"暂无深度类报告"并停止，不生成HTML。此步骤不生成单独章节。
第一步、研报概览：报告标题、作者、发布日期、报告类型、关联品种、评级与预测标签。
第二步、核心观点提炼：从全文中提炼3-5条核心结论，每条附原文摘句（带引号）与所在章节。
第三步、关键数据与逻辑链：列出报告中的关键数据点（价格区间、库存、加工费、供需平衡等）及其推演逻辑，按"数据→判断→依据"三列呈现。
第四步、风险提示：先逐条列出研报原文明确提出的风险因素并附原文摘句；如基于报告逻辑补充潜在风险，应单列"补充观察"并明确标注为AI归纳，不与原文风险提示混淆。
第五步、与研究员历史观点对比：拉取该品种主要研究员的全部定期观点，按时间排列，对比本篇研报核心判断与过去定期观点是否一致——标注延续点与转向点；如评级发生变化，注明转向前后的评级与依据。
第六步、近期周报追踪：取该品种最近4周数据周报，每周提炼核心变化一句话，观察从周报到深度报告的逻辑递进脉络。
输出格式要求：单文件HTML，全部样式内联、无外部依赖；配色遵循看涨红、看跌绿、震荡黄；所有来源注明"繁微Fiona/东证衍生品研究院"及具体日期。
