cases.subtitle_en: Map stakeholders, real needs, and access paths in one view
cases.description:
大客户推进最难的不是联系人少，而是不知道谁影响谁、谁反对、谁能帮你进入决策圈。

这个案例把角色、影响力、立场、需求证据和关系缺口组合成一张客户攻略作战图，并给出下一条验证路径。

适合：大客户销售、销售经理、售前顾问、渠道经理和客户成功负责人。
cases.description_en:
Complex deals stall when teams cannot see who influences whom, who resists, or how to enter the decision circle.

This case combines roles, influence, stance, need evidence, and relationship gaps into one account strategy map with the next validation path.

Best for: enterprise sales, sales managers, presales, channel managers, and customer success leaders.

artifacts.label: 客户攻略作战图

cases.prompt: 请根据 {客户名称或商机名称}、{沟通记录} 和 {已获准使用的关系信息}，制作客户攻略作战图。先用用户提供的名称在 CRM 搜索并确认对应客户或商机；若存在同名客户、多主体或多个匹配商机，只列出最少必要候选让用户确认，不要求用户提供 CRM 内部 ID。区分已确认角色、公开信息、用户判断和 AI 假设；工商董监高不能直接等同实际决策人。为每个关键角色标明影响力、立场、关注任务、证据来源和最后验证日期；画出已确认关系与待验证关系，识别决策圈缺口、潜在反对者和可行引荐路径。每个关键角色必须以结构化角色卡呈现，至少包含：影响力（高/中/低）、立场（支持/中立/反对/未知）、关注任务（一句话）、证据来源（CRM 事实/沟通记录/公开信息/AI 假设）、最后验证日期（YYYY-MM-DD）。最后只给一个最低成本的下一步验证动作，不自动写入 CRM 或编造私人关系。输出一个可离线打开的响应式 HTML，所有图形使用内联 SVG/CSS，不使用外链、emoji 或 hash 锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Using {customer name or opportunity name}, {conversation records}, and {authorized relationship information}, create an account strategy map. First search CRM using the name supplied by the user and confirm the matching account or opportunity. If there are duplicate names, multiple legal entities, or several matching opportunities, show only the minimum necessary candidates for the user to choose from; never require an internal CRM ID. Separate confirmed roles, public information, user judgments, and AI hypotheses; do not treat registered directors as actual decision makers. For each stakeholder show influence, stance, job to be done, evidence source, and last verification date. Draw confirmed and unverified relationships, identify decision-circle gaps, likely blockers, and viable introduction paths. Present every key stakeholder as a structured role card containing at least: influence (high/medium/low), stance (supportive/neutral/opposed/unknown), job to be done (one sentence), evidence source (CRM fact/conversation record/public information/AI hypothesis), and last verification date (YYYY-MM-DD). End with one lowest-cost validation action, without automatically writing to CRM or inventing private relationships. Return one responsive offline HTML file using inline SVG and CSS only, with no external links, emoji, or hash anchors.

cases.title: 竞标应答要点页
cases.subtitle: 围绕具体评分项组织证据与应答动作
cases.subtitle_en: Organize evidence and responses around the actual scoring criteria
cases.description:
应标材料最容易写成产品功能堆砌，却没有回答评委真正按什么打分。

这个案例把招标要求拆成评分项、证据、差距、应答策略和现场澄清问题，形成一页可执行的竞标作战稿。

适合：销售、售前顾问、投标经理、商务负责人和解决方案团队。
cases.description_en:
Bid responses often become feature catalogs that fail to address how evaluators will actually score.

This case turns tender requirements into scoring criteria, evidence, gaps, response strategy, and clarification questions in one executable page.

Best for: sales, presales, bid managers, commercial leaders, and solution teams.

artifacts.label: 竞标应答要点页

cases.prompt: 请根据 {招标文件或评分表}、{我方产品与案例材料} 和 {已知竞品信息}，制作竞标应答要点页。先完整读取招标要求并逐项建立追溯编号；按评分权重识别必须赢、必须达标和低优先级项。每项列出客户要求、我方应答、可披露证据、证据缺口、负责人和截止时间；公开信息与推测分开，不能编造资质、案例、功能、价格或竞品缺陷。对模糊或限制竞争的条款提出中性澄清问题，并明确红线。最终只输出一个专业、信息密度高的响应式 HTML，所有资源内联，不使用外链、emoji 或 hash 锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Using {tender document or scoring sheet}, {our product and case materials}, and {known competitor information}, create a bid response strategy page. Read the full tender and assign traceable requirement IDs. Classify criteria by must-win, must-qualify, and lower priority according to scoring weight. For each item list the requirement, response, authorized evidence, evidence gap, owner, and due date. Separate public facts from hypotheses and do not fabricate credentials, cases, features, pricing, or competitor weaknesses. Raise neutral clarification questions for ambiguous or restrictive clauses and identify red lines. Return only one professional, high-density responsive HTML file with all resources inline and no external links, emoji, or hash anchors.

cases.title: 客户案例包装页
cases.subtitle: 把真实成果讲成客户愿意相信的案例
cases.subtitle_en: Turn verified outcomes into a credible customer story
cases.description:
案例最怕只剩一句“客户很满意”，既没有证据，也无法判断能否对外使用。

这个案例把获准披露的背景、转变过程、结果证据和适用边界整理成一页客户案例，并明确哪些数字可用、哪些表述必须避开。

适合：销售、市场、售前顾问、客户成功和案例运营人员。
cases.description_en:
Customer stories often collapse into vague claims with no evidence or disclosure boundary.

This case turns authorized context, the transformation journey, outcome evidence, and limitations into a polished one-page showcase while marking what may and may not be shared.

Best for: sales, marketing, presales, customer success, and case operations teams.

artifacts.label: 客户案例包装页

cases.prompt: 请根据 {获准使用的客户案例材料} 和 {目标受众或行业}，制作一份可对外展示的客户案例包装页。先核对客户名称、披露授权、事实来源和数据口径；只使用 CRM、用户材料或明确获准的证据，不补造客户评价、实施周期、收益数字或竞品结论。把内容组织为“原有挑战 → 采取行动 → 可验证变化 → 适用条件”，对单源信息、推测和不可披露内容明确标注。至少包含一句案例结论、三项结果证据、一条限制条件和一个面向相似客户的验证问题。最终只输出一个专业、克制、可离线打开的响应式 HTML；所有资源内联，不使用远程字体、外链资源、emoji 或 hash 锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Using {authorized customer case materials} and {target audience or industry}, create a customer-facing case showcase. Verify the customer name, disclosure permission, fact sources, and metric definitions first. Use only CRM facts, user-provided materials, or explicitly authorized evidence; do not fabricate quotes, timelines, benefits, or competitor claims. Structure the story as challenge, action, verifiable change, and applicability. Label single-source claims, hypotheses, and restricted content. Include one case conclusion, three outcome signals, one limitation, and one validation question for similar prospects. Return only one professional, restrained, responsive, offline HTML file with all resources inline and no remote fonts, external assets, emoji, or hash anchors.

cases.title: 合同风险热力图
cases.subtitle: 在合同原文上直接看见风险集中区
cases.subtitle_en: See risk concentration directly on the contract text
cases.description:
合同审查条目一多，业务人员很难快速定位原文，更不知道风险是不是集中在同一交易链路。

这个案例把合同原文按付款、验收、责任和知识产权分层着色，并在侧栏给出风险密度、联动影响和谈判优先级。

适合：销售、商务、采购、交付负责人和企业法务协作人员。
cases.description_en:
Long review lists make it hard to locate the original language or see connected exposure.

This case overlays payment, acceptance, liability, and IP risk on the source contract and summarizes concentration, linked impact, and negotiation priority.

Best for: sales, commercial, procurement, delivery, and legal collaboration teams.

artifacts.label: 合同风险热力图

cases.prompt: 请审查 {上传的合同文件}，并制作合同风险热力图。必须完整读取正文、附件、表格和引用文件；识别不清或缺页时先说明实际读取范围。以合同原文为唯一审查依据，逐段引用并标注高、中、低风险，重点联动检查付款、验收、违约责任、责任上限、数据和知识产权。每个风险必须给出条款位置、原文、业务影响、目标修改文本、可接受退让和是否需要法务升级；不能把不利条款误判为缺失，也不能承诺签署绝对安全。最终只输出一个原文叠加标注的响应式 HTML，所有资源内联，不使用外链、emoji 或 hash 锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Review {uploaded contract file} and create a contract risk heatmap. Read the full body, appendices, tables, and referenced documents; state the actual reading scope if pages are missing or unclear. Treat the contract text as the sole review basis. Quote and mark each paragraph as high, medium, or low risk, with special cross-checks for payment, acceptance, breach, liability caps, data, and IP. For every issue include location, original text, business impact, target language, acceptable fallback, and legal escalation need. Do not confuse unfavorable language with missing language or promise absolute safety. Return only one responsive HTML file with inline text annotations and all assets inline, without external links, emoji, or hash anchors.

cases.title: 丢单复盘画布
cases.subtitle: 分清事实、判断和运气，找到下一次能改变的动作
cases.subtitle_en: Separate facts, judgment, and luck to improve the next decision
cases.description:
丢单复盘最容易变成“价格太高”或“关系不到位”，最后没有任何可复用结论。

这个案例还原关键时间线，区分当时可见信息与事后信息，审查决策质量、预测偏差和真正可控的改进动作。

适合：销售、销售经理、经营分析、售前负责人和复盘主持人。
cases.description_en:
Loss reviews often end with “too expensive” or “weak relationship,” producing no reusable lesson.

This case reconstructs the timeline, separates information available then from hindsight, and audits decision quality, forecast bias, and controllable improvements.

Best for: sales, sales managers, revenue operations, presales leaders, and review facilitators.

artifacts.label: 丢单复盘画布

cases.prompt: 请根据 {丢单商机名称}、{完整跟进记录} 和 {丢单后获得的信息}，制作丢单复盘画布。先用商机名称在 CRM 搜索并确认对应的已丢单商机；若同名或存在多个匹配，只列出最少必要候选让用户确认，不要求用户提供商机内部 ID。按时间线还原关键事实，严格区分当时已经知道的信息、当时的判断、未验证假设和事后才知道的信息，避免结果偏差和个人归责。审查客户决策标准、关键人覆盖、竞争策略、资源投入、预测变化和止损时机；指出哪些是运气、哪些是决策质量、哪些证据仍不足。最后沉淀不超过三条可观察、可复用的流程改进，并指定验证方式。最终只输出一个专业、克制的响应式 HTML，所有资源内联，不使用外链、emoji 或 hash 锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Using {lost opportunity name}, {complete activity history}, and {information learned after the loss}, create a loss review canvas. First search CRM by opportunity name and confirm the matching closed-lost opportunity. If duplicate names or multiple matches exist, show only the minimum necessary candidates for the user to choose from; never require an internal opportunity ID. Reconstruct the timeline and strictly separate information known at the time, contemporaneous judgments, untested hypotheses, and hindsight. Avoid outcome bias and personal blame. Review customer criteria, stakeholder coverage, competitive strategy, resource allocation, forecast changes, and exit timing. Identify luck, decision quality, and remaining evidence gaps. End with no more than three observable, reusable process improvements and how each will be validated. Return only one professional, restrained responsive HTML file with all resources inline and no external links, emoji, or hash anchors.

cases.title: 谈判筹码交换矩阵
cases.subtitle: 每一次让步，都换回一个可验证承诺
cases.subtitle_en: Trade every concession for a verifiable commitment
cases.description:
谈判现场最容易为了推进而直接降价，事后才发现什么也没换回来。

这个案例把客户诉求、我方成本、交换条件和底线放进一张矩阵，形成保守、目标和底线三档方案。

适合：销售、商务负责人、销售经理、报价审批人和大客户团队。
cases.description_en:
Negotiations often default to discounting, only to discover that nothing meaningful came back.

This case maps customer asks, internal cost, reciprocal commitments, and walk-away limits into conservative, target, and floor positions.

Best for: sales, commercial leaders, sales managers, pricing approvers, and strategic account teams.

artifacts.label: 谈判筹码交换矩阵

cases.prompt: 请根据 {客户诉求与异议}、{我方可用筹码} 和 {已确认的审批边界}，制作谈判筹码交换矩阵。先区分客户表面要求、真实顾虑和仍待验证的假设；任何让步都必须绑定对方可观察、可确认的回报，不能无条件降价。按低成本高价值、对等交换、高成本谨慎和不可交换四个象限整理筹码，并为关键争议给出目标方案、可接受退让和底线。明确授权不清的事项，不替审批人做决定。最终只输出一个专业、清晰的响应式 HTML，所有资源内联，不使用外链、emoji 或 hash 锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Using {customer asks and objections}, {available concessions}, and {confirmed approval boundaries}, create a negotiation give-get matrix. Separate stated requests, underlying concerns, and hypotheses that still need validation. Every concession must be tied to an observable, confirmable return; never discount unconditionally. Organize levers into low-cost high-value, balanced trade, high-cost cautious, and non-tradable quadrants. For each key issue provide a target position, acceptable fallback, and walk-away limit. Mark unclear authority and do not decide for approvers. Return only one professional responsive HTML file with all resources inline and no external links, emoji, or hash anchors.

cases.title: 客户关系经营日历
cases.subtitle: 把关系目标拆成未来 90 天的自然触点
cases.subtitle_en: Turn relationship goals into natural touchpoints over 90 days
cases.description:
客户关系维护最怕只剩“有空联系一下”，既没有理由，也没有节奏。

这个案例根据关键角色、关系阶段和业务节点，排出未来 90 天的触点日历，并区分价值提供、信息验证和共同推进。

适合：大客户销售、客户经理、渠道经理、客户成功和销售主管。
cases.description_en:
Relationship plans often degrade into “check in sometime,” with no reason or cadence.

This case schedules 90 days of touchpoints based on stakeholders, relationship stages, and business milestones, separating value delivery, validation, and joint action.

Best for: enterprise sales, account managers, channel managers, customer success, and sales leaders.

artifacts.label: 客户关系经营日历

cases.prompt: 请根据 {客户名称或商机名称}、{关键角色信息} 和 {未来 90 天业务节点}，制作客户关系经营日历。先用用户提供的名称在 CRM 搜索并确认对应客户或商机；若存在同名客户、多主体或多个匹配商机，只列出最少必要候选让用户确认，不要求用户提供 CRM 内部 ID。再核对角色身份、关系阶段、最近互动和授权边界；不从私人信息推断兴趣，不制造虚假节日或无价值寒暄。围绕价值提供、信息验证、共同推进三类目标安排自然触点，每次只设一个目标，标明对象、渠道、时机依据、准备材料、成功信号和放弃条件。避免过度触达，同一角色保留合理间隔；未确认的事件标为待验证。最终只输出一个清晰、克制的响应式 HTML，所有资源内联，不使用外链、emoji 或 hash 锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Using {customer name or opportunity name}, {stakeholder information}, and {business milestones over the next 90 days}, create an account relationship calendar. First search CRM using the name supplied by the user and confirm the matching account or opportunity. If there are duplicate names, multiple legal entities, or several matching opportunities, show only the minimum necessary candidates for the user to choose from; never require an internal CRM ID. Then verify identities, relationship stages, recent interactions, and permission boundaries. Do not infer interests from private information or manufacture holidays and empty check-ins. Plan natural touchpoints around value delivery, information validation, and joint progress, with one objective per touch. Show the person, channel, timing rationale, preparation, success signal, and stop condition. Avoid over-contacting and keep reasonable spacing; label unconfirmed events as pending validation. Return only one clear, restrained responsive HTML file with all resources inline and no external links, emoji, or hash anchors.

cases.title: 产品价值故事页
cases.subtitle: 把产品能力讲成客户愿意继续聊的价值故事
cases.subtitle_en: Turn product capabilities into a value story customers want to continue discussing
cases.description:
产品介绍最容易变成功能清单，客户听完仍不知道为什么值得行动。

这个案例结合 CRM 客户事实、销售认知、产品资料与可追溯的公开信息，生成一页品牌化价值故事，清楚展示客户挑战、价值主张、反证、验证指标和下一步。

适合：销售、售前顾问、解决方案顾问、客户成功和业务负责人。
cases.description_en:
Product introductions often become feature lists, leaving customers unsure why they should act.

This case combines CRM facts, sales knowledge, product materials, and traceable public information into a branded one-page value story covering customer challenges, the value proposition, counterevidence, validation metrics, and the next step.

Best for: sales representatives, presales consultants, solution consultants, customer success teams, and business leaders.

artifacts.label: 产品价值故事页

cases.prompt:
请为 {目标客户名称或商机名称} 制作一份面向客户的产品价值故事页，并使用 {产品资料或链接} 回答“客户为什么值得现在行动”。先用用户提供的名称在 CRM 搜索并确认对应客户或商机；若存在同名客户、多主体或多个匹配商机，只列出最少必要候选让用户确认，不要求用户提供 CRM 内部 ID。确认准确企业主体后，按 CRM 当前事实、用户本轮材料、已沉淀销售认知、多源公开信息、单源信息、AI 假设的顺序取材。优先关注近 180 天变化，重要外部结论注明来源和日期；冲突信息并列展示，推测标明置信度，不把行业共性当成客户事实，不编造客户、案例、预算或收益数字。外部信息只用于本页，不自动写入 CRM。

用“现状问题 → 改变方式 → 可验证结果”提炼一句价值主张和三个价值支柱，同时给出关键未知、至少一条反证或不适用条件，以及一个低成本、可观察的下一步验证动作。没有可靠指标时写“建议验证的目标”，不要写成既有承诺。

最终只输出一个可独立打开的响应式 HTML：专业、克制、可信的 B2B 品牌风格；所有 CSS、SVG 和必要脚本内联，不依赖外部资源，不使用 emoji、远程字体或 hash 锚点。页面至少包含标题区、客户挑战、价值支柱、转变路径、证据与反证、待验证指标和建议下一步。
cases.prompt_en:
Create a customer-facing product value story page for {target customer name or opportunity name} using {product materials or link}, answering why the customer should act now. First search CRM using the name supplied by the user and confirm the matching account or opportunity. If there are duplicate names, multiple legal entities, or several matching opportunities, show only the minimum necessary candidates for the user to choose from; never require an internal CRM ID. After confirming the correct legal or operating entity, use information in this order: current CRM facts, materials supplied in this request, accumulated sales knowledge, corroborated public information, single-source information, and AI hypotheses. Prioritize changes from the last 180 days. Cite the source and date for important external claims, show conflicting information side by side, label hypotheses with confidence, and never present industry patterns as customer facts or fabricate customers, cases, budgets, or benefit figures. Use external information only for this page and do not write it to CRM automatically.

Develop one value proposition and three value pillars using the structure “current problem → how it changes → verifiable outcome.” Include key unknowns, at least one piece of counterevidence or disqualifying condition, and one low-cost, observable next validation action. When reliable metrics are unavailable, label them as proposed validation targets rather than existing commitments.

Return only one standalone responsive HTML file with a professional, restrained, and credible B2B brand direction. Inline all CSS, SVG, and necessary scripts. Do not use external resources, emoji, remote fonts, or hash-anchor navigation. Include a title section, customer challenges, value pillars, a transformation path, evidence and counterevidence, validation targets, and a recommended next step.

cases.title: 版本变更对比页
cases.subtitle: 两版并排，只保留真正影响交易的变化
cases.subtitle_en: Compare two versions and isolate deal-impacting changes
cases.description:
合同来回修订后，最怕金额、条件词或责任范围只改了一个字，却藏在几十页文本里。

这个案例把两版合同并排展示，过滤纯格式变化，突出金额、日期、条件、权利义务和责任范围的实质差异。

适合：销售、商务、采购、法务协作人员和合同管理员。
cases.description_en:
After several redlines, a one-word change to money, conditions, or liability can disappear inside dozens of pages.

This case compares two contracts side by side, filters formatting noise, and highlights substantive changes to amounts, dates, conditions, rights, obligations, and exposure.

Best for: sales, commercial, procurement, legal collaboration, and contract operations teams.

artifacts.label: 版本变更对比页

cases.prompt: 请对比 {旧版合同文件} 与 {新版合同文件}，制作两版并排的合同变更对比页。完整读取两份文件，以原文为唯一差异依据；过滤空格、换行、样式和语义完全等价的变化，但金额、比例、数量、日期、期限、主体、否定词、条件词、权利义务和责任范围哪怕只改一个字也必须保留。按高、中、低影响排序，每项展示条款位置、旧版、新版、变化类型、对我方影响和建议动作，并汇总新增、删除和修改数量。最终只输出一个可离线打开的响应式 HTML，所有资源内联，不使用外链、emoji 或 hash 锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Compare {old contract file} and {new contract file} in a side-by-side contract change page. Read both files fully and use their text as the sole basis. Filter spaces, line breaks, formatting, and semantically identical edits, but retain every change to amounts, percentages, quantities, dates, periods, parties, negations, conditions, rights, obligations, and liability scope. Rank changes by high, medium, and low impact. For each item show clause location, old text, new text, change type, impact, and recommended action, plus totals for additions, deletions, and modifications. Return only one responsive offline HTML file with all resources inline and no external links, emoji, or hash anchors.

cases.title: 拜访前 60 秒速查卡
cases.subtitle: 出门前一眼看完客户现状、承诺与风险
cases.subtitle_en: Scan account status, commitments, and risks before the meeting
cases.description:
拜访前时间越紧，越容易在 CRM 里翻半天仍抓不到重点。

这个案例把最近沟通、双方承诺、商机阶段、关键角色和本次唯一目标压缩成一张 60 秒速查卡。

适合：外勤销售、客户经理、销售主管、售前顾问和临时接手商机的同事。
cases.description_en:
When meeting prep time is short, teams can spend too long searching CRM without finding what matters.

This case compresses recent conversations, mutual commitments, deal stage, key stakeholders, and one meeting objective into a 60-second brief.

Best for: field sales, account managers, sales leaders, presales, and colleagues taking over a deal.

artifacts.label: 拜访前 60 秒速查卡

cases.prompt: 请为 {客户名称或商机名称} 制作一张拜访前 60 秒速查卡。先用用户提供的名称在 CRM 搜索并确认对应客户或商机；若存在同名客户、多主体或多个匹配商机，只列出最少必要候选让用户确认，不要求用户提供 CRM 内部 ID。读取最近有效的客户、商机、联系人、跟进记录和双方承诺，优先近 90 天信息；区分 CRM 事实、用户判断、公开信息和 AI 假设，不把过期记录当成当前状态。只保留拜访现场真正需要的信息：当前阶段、上次谈到哪、双方未兑现承诺、关键参与人、本次唯一目标、三条必问问题和一个风险提醒。若客户主体或时间冲突，显式列出待确认。最终只输出一个移动端也能快速阅读的响应式 HTML，所有资源内联，不使用外链、emoji 或 hash 锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Create a 60-second visit brief for {customer name or opportunity name}. First search CRM using the name supplied by the user and confirm the matching account or opportunity. If there are duplicate names, multiple legal entities, or several matching opportunities, show only the minimum necessary candidates for the user to choose from; never require an internal CRM ID. Read the latest valid account, opportunity, contact, activity, and mutual commitment records, prioritizing the last 90 days. Separate CRM facts, user judgments, public information, and AI hypotheses; do not treat stale records as current. Keep only what is needed in the meeting: current stage, last discussion, outstanding commitments, key attendees, one meeting objective, three essential questions, and one risk reminder. Explicitly list identity or timing conflicts as pending confirmation. Return only one responsive HTML file optimized for quick mobile reading, with all resources inline and no external links, emoji, or hash anchors.

Featuring inline SVG charts, animated number counters, timeline fade-ins, and hover interactions — your annual summary becomes as engaging as a product demo. cases.subtitle: 可拖拽任务卡片，项目进度一眼掌控
cases.subtitle_en: Drag-and-drop task cards for instant project progress tracking
cases.description:
跨工具管理任务总是一团乱麻——Jira 里建了 ticket，飞书里又记了待办，便签纸上还贴着优先级。信息分散导致进度不透明，团队协作频频掉链子。

这个案例用 frontend-dev 技能生成了一个 DevStudio 团队的交互式看板面板：5 列泳道（Backlog / To Do / In Progress / Review / Done），预置 15-20 张任务卡片，每张卡片包含标题、描述摘要、优先级徽章（P0 红 / P1 橙 / P2 蓝 / P3 灰）、负责人头像圆圈（首字母缩写）、标签（frontend / backend / design / bug / feature）及截止日期。支持拖拽排序与跨列移动，顶部筛选栏可按负责人、优先级过滤并支持标题搜索，列内任务计数随操作自动更新。圆角卡片 + 阴影层次 + 平滑动画，现代感十足。

适合：项目经理、研发团队、自由职业者——任何需要可视化管理任务流的人。
cases.description_en:
Juggling tasks across multiple tools is a recipe for chaos — tickets in Jira, to-dos in chat apps, sticky notes with priority scribbles. Scattered information kills transparency and derails team collaboration.

This case uses the frontend-dev skill to generate an interactive Kanban board for the DevStudio team: 5 swim-lane columns (Backlog / To Do / In Progress / Review / Done), pre-populated with 15-20 task cards. Each card shows a title, description snippet, priority badge (P0-red / P1-orange / P2-blue / P3-gray), assignee avatar circle with initials, tags (frontend / backend / design / bug / feature), and due date. Supports drag-and-drop reordering and cross-column moves. A top filter bar lets you filter by assignee, priority, or search by title, with column task counts auto-updating on every action. Rounded cards, layered shadows, and smooth animations deliver a modern, polished UI.

Ideal for: project managers, dev teams, freelancers — anyone who needs a visual task-flow board.
cases.prompt:
请为虚构软件团队「开发工坊」生成一个可交互看板任务面板（单文件 HTML，内联无外部依赖），界面文字用简体中文（人名用中文，优先级 P0-P3 保留代号），现代风格。

看板 5 列：待办池 / 待处理 / 进行中 / 评审中 / 已完成，预置 15-20 张任务卡片。每张卡片含：任务标题、描述、优先级徽章（P0-P3）、负责人头像（首字母）、分类标签（前端/后端/设计/缺陷/需求）、截止日期。

支持拖拽排序与跨列移动；顶部筛选栏按负责人/优先级筛选 + 标题搜索；各列计数随操作自动更新。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate an interactive Kanban task board for a fictional software team called "开发工坊" (single-file HTML, inline with no external dependencies). The interface text should be in Simplified Chinese (use Chinese names; keep the priority codes P0-P3 as-is), in a modern style.

The Kanban has 5 columns: To-Do Pool / Pending / In Progress / In Review / Done, pre-populated with 15-20 task cards. Each card includes: task title, description, a priority badge (P0-P3), an assignee avatar (initials), a category label (Frontend/Backend/Design/Bug/Requirement), and a due date.

Support drag-and-drop reordering and moving cards across columns; a top filter bar to filter by assignee/priority plus title search; and each column's count should update automatically as you make changes.

cases.description:

演示内容：基于探元知识库真实数据（武进博物馆年均活动、景德镇博物馆教育活动三阶段研究），写一篇可直接推到草稿箱的 doocs/md 风格图文，标题带钩子、章节有节奏、结尾有行动引导。

适合：博物馆公众号编辑、社教部门、青铜器/陶瓷类专项馆宣教人员，以及任何在 5·18、文化和自然遗产日等节点需要科普图文的小馆人。
cases.description_en:
Need a WeChat article for International Museum Day? The biggest trap is turning it into a list of events the reader will scroll past. This case skips the slogans and pulls out the "before / during / after" three-stage framework that museum educators actually use, grounding every section in real figures from the TanYuan knowledge base.

Demo: a doocs/md-styled article built on real TanYuan data (Wujin Museum's annual programming, Jingdezhen's three-stage education research), with a hooky headline, a tight section rhythm, and an action-oriented closer that's ready for the WeChat draft box.

Best for: museum WeChat editors, social-education teams, docent-led outreach staff at bronze / ceramic museums — and anyone at a small museum who needs a science article for 5·18 or Cultural Heritage Day.

artifacts.label: doocs/md 风格公众号图文 HTML

cases.prompt:
请基于以下要点，撰写一篇 5·18 国际博物馆日主题的博物馆公众号科普图文。

写作要点：
1. 观点先行：开头第一句就让读者理解博物馆教育远不止展厅里那点事——把它拆成「参观前/中/后」三段来谈。
2. 用真实数据支撑：所有数据必须调用 mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_movable_relics 或 search_relics 获取真实知识库内容，逐处标源。常见支撑：
   - 武进博物馆：年均接待 30 万人次、年均临展 20 场、年均讲座与活动 100 余场次、藏品 3830 件（含珍贵 621 件）；
   - 景德镇非国有陶瓷博物馆研究：三阶段（参观前/中/后）的核心是导览解说 + 活动体验 + 拓展服务。
3. 分节科普：用 3–5 个小节，每节一个具体知识点；专有名词首次出现给通俗解释（如武周时期要说清 690–705 年）。
4. 结尾有行动引导：欢迎读者在评论区留言推荐本地馆，承诺节后整理读者推荐榜。
5. 风格：doocs/md 公众号图文——宽 677px 居中、米白底、章节标题加粗+彩条、文末有引导卡片；克制，不堆 emoji。
6. 配图：优先用 search_relics 返回的真实博物馆或馆藏图，base64 内联到 HTML；未授权图片不得使用。
7. 字数：1300–1600 字正文。
8. 逐处标源：每个事实声明标「来自探元知识库《...》词条」，文末汇总参考资料。

约束：输出单文件 HTML，CSS 全内联，图片用 data:image/...;base64,... 嵌入，禁止任何外链。封面图单独导出 cover.png。
cases.prompt_en:
Write a museum WeChat science article for International Museum Day (May 18). The expert persona is the TanYuan Heritage Article Expert — a heritage science writer.

Writing requirements:
1. Lead with the takeaway: open by reframing "museum education" as the before / during / after three-stage framework.
2. Ground every claim in real data: call mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_movable_relics or search_relics and cite each fact inline. Useful anchors from TanYuan KB:
   - Wujin Museum: 300k annual visitors, 20 temporary exhibitions/year, ~100 lectures & activities/year, 3,830 holdings (621 significant).
   - Jingdezhen small-museum study: core of the three-stage model is docent talks + activities + outreach.
3. Sectioned science writing: 3–5 sections, one takeaway each; explain specialist terms on first mention (e.g., Wu Zhou period 690–705 CE).
4. CTA close: invite readers to recommend local museums in the comments; promise a readers-picks follow-up.
5. Visual style: doocs/md WeChat article — 677px column, off-white background, bold colored-bullet section headings, soft CTA card; restrained, no emoji soup.
6. Imagery: prefer search_relics museum / collection images; embed base64 in HTML; never use unauthorized photos.
7. Length: 1300–1600 Chinese characters of body copy.
8. Cite every fact: each claim labels TanYuan KB · entry《...》; collected references at the end.

Output: a single HTML file, all CSS inlined, all images as data:image/...;base64,..., no external links. Export a separate cover.png.

cases.title: 14:30 盯盘强度检查
cases.subtitle: 把持仓与观察池在尾盘前一小时重新排一遍强弱顺序
cases.subtitle_en: Re-rank holdings and watch names one hour before the close
cases.description:
盘中最容易乱的时段，往往不是开盘，而是 14:30 这种“觉得该做点什么”的节点。这个案例按 A 股短线交易的盘中评估流程，给出一份两只持仓、两只观察股的配置，再用真实分时、行情、资金和筹码数据跑官方强度脚本，判断当下应该抱强、等回踩还是继续观察。

页面把时间流、组合概览、逐只强度拆解和关键价位放在一个单文件双语 HTML 里，右上角可以切换中文和英文。它演示的不是喊单，而是把盘中决策从情绪动作变成可复核的结构动作。

适合：想做固定时间点盯盘复盘的人；有持仓和观察池、但不知道 14:30 该看什么的人；希望把盘中提示做成标准流程的 A 股交易者。
cases.description_en:
The intraday window that creates the most confusion is often not the open, but a checkpoint like 14:30 when it feels like something should be done. This case follows the intraday evaluation workflow of A股短线交易, starts from a configuration with two holdings and two watch-only names, then runs the official strength script on real intraday, quote, flow and chip data to decide whether the correct posture is to keep holding strength, wait for pullbacks, or simply continue watching.

The page combines a market timeline, portfolio snapshot, per-stock factor breakdown and key levels inside a single bilingual HTML file with a top-right language switch. It demonstrates not stock calling, but how to turn intraday decisions from emotional reactions into reviewable structural actions.

Suitable for: traders who want fixed-time intraday checkups; anyone with holdings and a watchlist but no clear 14:30 process; A-share participants who want to standardize intraday prompts.
cases.prompt: 请按 A股短线交易 的盘中节点评估流程，基于以下等价 trading_config 在 2026-07-27 14:30 做强度检查：账户总仓上限 80%，单票上限 30%；持仓为北化股份 002246（成本 19.42）和四川黄金 001337（成本 38.15）；观察池为睿创微纳 688002 与高德红外 002414。请拉取这些标的与大盘的真实分时、行情、资金流与筹码数据，并调用官方 scripts/intraday_strength.py 输出强度评分。最终交付一份单文件、资源全内联的 HTML 页面。页面至少包含市场状态、时间流、持仓列表、观察列表、强度拆解、关键价位和当前节点关注。
cases.prompt_en: Please follow the intraday checkpoint workflow of A股短线交易 and run a 14:30 strength check on 2026-07-27 with the following equivalent trading_config: max total exposure 80%, single-name cap 30%; holdings are NCIC 002246 (cost 19.42) and Sichuan Gold 001337 (cost 38.15); the watchlist contains Raytron 688002 and Guide Infrared 002414. Pull the real intraday, quote, flow and chip data for those names plus the market, then run the official scripts/intraday_strength.py to produce strength scores. Deliver the result as a single-file HTML page with all resources embedded. The page should at least include market state, a timeline, holdings, watch names, factor breakdowns, key levels and the current checkpoint takeaway.

cases.description:
财务最头疼的是收到一堆不同格式的发票——XML数电票、OFD火车票、PDF海外发票，每种都要走不同的查验流程。这个案例演示了智能发票专家团如何一次处理三张不同格式的发票：增值税XML数电票自动完成税局验真并发现开票方存在重大税收违法风险标记，OFD火车票自动判断旅客运输抵扣资格，海外PDF发票识别后归档备案。最终输出结构化的多票联查报告，包含验真结论、风险评级和操作建议。

cases.description_en:
The biggest headache for finance teams is receiving invoices in different formats — XML digital invoices, OFD train tickets, PDF overseas invoices — each requiring a different verification process. This case demonstrates how the Intelligent Invoice Expert Team processes three invoices of different formats in one go: a VAT XML digital invoice undergoes automatic tax authority verification revealing red-flag risk for the counterparty, an OFD train ticket automatically qualifies for passenger transport VAT deduction, and an overseas PDF commercial invoice is identified and archived. The final output is a structured multi-invoice verification report with authenticity conclusions, risk ratings, and actionable recommendations.

Perfect for: corporate finance professionals, tax compliance officers, procurement supply chain risk managers, audit teams, SME owners.
cases.prompt:
请帮我处理以下三张发票文件，完成发票识别、真伪查验和开票方信用风险核查：

1. 上传一张增值税专用发票XML文件（数电票）
2. 上传一张火车票OFD文件（铁路电子客票）
3. 上传一张海外商业发票PDF文件

要求：
- 增值税专用发票需要完成税局在线验真
- 火车票需要判断旅客运输服务抵扣资格（含可抵扣税额计算）
- 海外发票识别后仅归档备案，标注不可用于国内增值税抵扣
- 所有增值税发票的开票方需要查询商业信用风险（灰名单、欠税、重大违法）
- 最终输出结构化归档报告，包含验真结论、风险评级（🟢🟡🔴）和操作建议

cases.prompt_en:
Please process the following three invoice files, completing invoice recognition, authenticity verification, and issuer credit-risk checks:

1. Upload a VAT special invoice XML file (fully digital e-invoice)
2. Upload a train ticket OFD file (railway electronic ticket)
3. Upload an overseas commercial invoice PDF file

Requirements:
- The VAT special invoice needs online verification with the tax authority
- For the train ticket, determine eligibility for passenger-transport-service deduction (including calculation of the deductible tax amount)
- After recognizing the overseas invoice, only archive it for the record and note that it cannot be used for domestic VAT deduction
- For all VAT invoices, query the issuer's commercial credit risk (grey list, tax arrears, major violations)
- Finally output a structured archival report including verification conclusions, risk ratings (🟢🟡🔴), and recommended actions
- If an API is unavailable, note the fallback path and manual-verification guidance

cases.title: 知识产权条款双视角审查（HTML交付版）
cases.subtitle: 粘贴一段 IP 条款，自动拆成甲方/乙方两个对立视角的风险清单 + 可直接替换的修改建议，单文件 HTML 交付
cases.subtitle_en: Paste an IP clause and get a Party-A-vs-Party-B risk breakdown with ready-to-swap revisions, delivered as a single-file HTML report
cases.description:
签软件开发、委托创作、技术许可这类合同时最头疼的，就是那几条知识产权条款——钱给出去了，成果到底归谁？授权范围到底多宽？对方不担侵权怎么办？这些坑往往藏在几句看起来「标准」的条款里。

这个案例演示了如何用「知识产权专家团」，把一段软件开发委托合同的 IP 条款交给 AI，自动输出一份双方视角对抗式审查报告：先识别条款类型（成果归属/授权许可/侵权担保/责任），再分别站在甲方（委托方）和乙方（受托方）两个对立立场拆解风险，每条风险标注高/中/低等级与法律依据，最后给出可直接替换的修改建议和权利链风险提示。报告是单文件 HTML，左右双栏对照、红黄绿风险着色，内联样式、可离线打开。

适合：合同审查律师、公司法务、创业者在签署技术合同前做 IP 条款风险自检，以及想快速建立「双视角对抗审查」思路的律师新人。
cases.description_en:
The most headache-inducing part of signing software development, commissioned creation, or licensing contracts is the IP clause — once money changes hands, who owns the deliverables? How broad is the license? Who bears infringement risk? These pitfalls hide inside seemingly standard wording.

This case shows how the IP Expert Team turns an IP clause from a software development commission contract into an adversarial dual-perspective review report: it first identifies the clause type (ownership / licensing / infringement warranty / liability), then dissects risks from the opposing standpoints of Party A (the commissioning party) and Party B (the contractor), tagging each risk with high/medium/low severity and its legal basis, and finally delivers ready-to-swap revision suggestions plus a rights-chain risk note. The report is a single-file HTML with side-by-side columns and red/yellow/green risk coloring, inline styles, and offline readability.

For: contract review lawyers, in-house counsel, and founders doing IP-clause self-checks before signing tech contracts, plus junior lawyers building the dual-perspective review mindset.

artifacts.label: 知识产权条款双视角审查报告（HTML交付版，甲方/乙方对立视角 + 风险分级 + 修改建议）

cases.prompt:
请对下面这段软件开发委托合同中的知识产权条款做专项审查，产出一份单文件 HTML 审查报告（交付版，内联样式、无外部资源、可离线打开）。

合同背景：甲方（委托方）委托乙方（受托方）开发一套企业级 SaaS 管理系统，甲方付款。
审查方：双方视角（分别输出甲方/乙方立场）。

条款原文：
「1. 乙方在履行本合同过程中产生的所有成果，其知识产权归甲方所有。
2. 甲方有权在合同有效期内使用乙方交付的软件。
3. 乙方保证交付成果不侵犯任何第三方知识产权。
4. 若因乙方原因导致甲方损失，乙方承担全部赔偿责任。」

要求：
1. 识别条款类型（成果归属/授权许可/侵权担保/责任）与涉及的知识产权类型。
2. 分别从甲方（委托方）和乙方（受托方）两个对立视角拆解风险，每条风险标注等级（高/中/低）与法律依据。
3. 重点覆盖：成果归属是否过窄（未保留背景知识产权、未区分职务/非职务成果、未约定后续改进）、授权范围是否模糊（缺地域/期限/独占性/转授权）、侵权担保是否缺免责与抗辩义务、责任是否无上限。
4. 给出可直接替换的修改建议条款文本。
5. HTML 须单文件、资源全内联、内容默认可见、无外部链接、双栏对照布局、风险用色块标签；附审查限制说明（仅基于提供条款）。
cases.prompt_en:
Please perform a focused review of the following IP clause from a software development commission contract, producing a single-file HTML review report (deliverable version, inline styles, no external resources, opens offline).

Contract background: Party A (commissioning party) commissions Party B (contractor) to develop an enterprise SaaS management system; Party A pays.
Review party: both perspectives (output Party A's and Party B's standpoints separately).

Clause text:
"1. All results produced by Party B in the course of performing this contract have their IP rights owned by Party A.
2. Party A has the right to use the software delivered by Party B during the contract term.
3. Party B warrants that the delivered results do not infringe any third-party IP rights.
4. If Party B causes loss to Party A, Party B bears full compensation liability."

Requirements:
1. Identify the clause type (ownership / licensing / infringement warranty / liability) and the IP types involved.
2. Dissect risks from the opposing standpoints of Party A (commissioning party) and Party B (contractor), tagging each risk with severity (high/medium/low) and its legal basis.
3. Focus on: whether ownership is too narrow (background IP not reserved, employee/non-employee work not distinguished, future improvements not addressed), whether the license scope is vague (missing territory/term/exclusivity/sublicensing), whether the infringement warranty lacks exemption and defense obligations, and whether liability is uncapped.
4. Provide ready-to-swap revised clause text.
5. The HTML must be a single file, fully inlined, content visible by default, no external links, side-by-side layout, risk tags as colored blocks; attach a review-scope note (based only on the provided clause).

cases.description: 找工作时 JD 里全是「抗压、弹性工作、扁平管理」的黑话，投出去的简历石沉大海，面试全靠临场发挥，几个 Offer 拿到手却不知道怎么选——这个求职作战室把这些痛点一个个拆掉：粘贴 JD 自动翻译黑话、预警红旗、逐项自评匹配度；给目标公司做背调体检打出红黄绿信号灯；用 CRM 看板经营每一条投递线索，转化漏斗自动诊断瓶颈；面试前按情报收集、自我准备、临阵准备、面后复盘四个阶段备好自我介绍、STAR 故事和反问弹药；拿到 Offer 后用七维加权评分和隐性成本测算算出净年包排名，顶部待办面板还会盯着每个截止日。演示数据是一个虚构的产品经理求职全流程，求职党、跳槽人和帮朋友看机会的 HR 都能直接上手。
cases.description_en: Job postings are full of code words like 'pressure tolerance' and 'flexible hours', resumes vanish into black holes, interviews rely on improvisation, and choosing between offers is pure gut feel — this job-hunt war room breaks each pain point down: paste a JD to decode recruiter-speak, flag red signals and self-rate your match; run a background-style check on target companies with red/yellow/green signals; manage every application in a CRM kanban with an auto-diagnosing conversion funnel; prep interviews through four phases (intel, self-prep, final prep, post-review) with self-intros, STAR stories and reverse questions; then compare offers with 7-dimension weighted scoring and hidden-cost math for a net-package ranking, while the top task panel watches every deadline. The demo data is a fictional product-manager job hunt — useful for job seekers, switchers and HR friends alike.
cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/MJfVAh2zJHEj1DyyzA13O4 ，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

求职全链路作战工作台：面向求职者的全流程作战系统，顶部常驻今日待办面板（聚合 CRM 截止、面试日期与决策截止的逾期/今天/临近提醒，点击可跳转对应记录），左侧为探索期、投递期、面试期、决策期四个阶段导航。

模块与交互：
1. 岗位信息逆向工程：按职位名称/工作地点/岗位职责/任职资格/薪资五字段录入，或粘贴完整 JD 一键智能拆分；解析输出结构化拆解（硬性要求/软性要求/加分项/核心职责分栏）、团队文化推断、招聘话术翻译表（内置 46 条黑话还原规则，按中高风险标注）、红旗预警（10 类风险信号 + 检测逻辑 + 综合风险分）、匹配度自评（硬性/软性/加分逐项评符合/部分/不符合，按 50%/30%/20% 权重汇总成环形匹配度并给投递建议）；解析结果自动存历史列表可回看、删除；附简历优化方法论库与脱敏简历模板（可一键复制文本）。
2. 雇主透视镜：公司建档录入注册时间/注册资本/社保缴纳人数/司法风险/经营风险/融资历程/烧钱速度/资金链风险（低中高）/舆情监控（维度+等级+备注多行）/面试体验，自动输出红/黄/绿三档体检信号、分数与建议，卡片内直接编辑保存。
3. 求职CRM漏斗：线索按 A类精投/B类标准/C类海投分池统计家数与精力占比；9 状态看板（待投递→已投递→简历通过→初面→复面→终面→Offer谈判→已发Offer/已拒绝）支持拖拽改状态，拖到已拒绝自动清空下次动作；双击卡片弹窗改下次动作与截止时间；6 级转化漏斗 + 瓶颈诊断（低于健康下限标红并给行动建议）。
4. 面试作战准备台：每场面试按四个阶段递进（情报收集/自我准备/临阵准备/面后复盘），含主营业务/行业地位/近期动态/企业文化情报、岗位深度解码、30秒/1分钟/3分钟自我介绍库、STAR 故事库（情境/任务/行动/结果/考察维度）、高频问题应答库（一键添加预设题）、面试日 Checklist（着装/交通/材料/设备/心态+备注）、反问环节弹药库（HR面/业务面/高管面/避免问）、感谢邮件模板、面后复盘问题自评（答得好/一般/需改进）与跟进动作，每阶段可标记完成。
5. Offer决策矩阵：Offer 档案录入 base/绩效/期权/补贴/发薪月数/地点/汇报对象/团队规模/试用期/竞业限制；7 维评分滑块（薪资总包/成长/平衡/文化/稳定/隐性成本/风险，0-100）+ 可拖动权重自动归一化；自动测算现金年包/总包/隐性成本/净年包并出综合排名表和雷达对比图（Chart.js，不可用时降级为对比表格）。
6. 全局：「HR视角」折叠面板贯穿四个模块（10 年招聘官内部视角的方法论卡片，如岗位开放真相、7 秒扫视法则、背调红线、薪资谈判推演、Offer 条款避坑），点按展开收起。

数据表结构（6 张）：JD分析表（职位名称/工作地点/岗位职责/任职资格/薪资情况/JD原文/目标公司/创建日期/解析结果/匹配自评）、雇主体检表（公司名称/建档日期/注册时间/注册资本/社保人数/司法风险/经营风险/融资历程/烧钱速度/资金链风险/舆情监控/面试体验）、求职CRM表（公司/岗位/分类/状态/录入日期/截止日期/下次动作/备注）、面试准备表（公司/岗位/面试日期/创建日期/情报收集/岗位解码/自我介绍/STAR故事/高频问题/面试清单/反问弹药/面后复盘/跟进动作/阶段1-4完成）、Offer表（公司/岗位/base月薪/绩效月薪/年期权/月补贴/发薪月数/地点/汇报对象/团队规模/试用期月/竞业限制/备注/七维评分/隐性成本）、Offer权重配置表（维度权重）。

视觉：墨绿主色 + 琥珀强调色的桌面工作台风格，左侧阶段导航 + 顶部待办 + 模块卡片流，红/黄/绿状态色贯穿风险灯、漏斗与看板；预置虚构示例数据（3 份 JD、3 家公司、10 条 CRM 线索、2 场面试、3 个 Offer）可直接体验全流程。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 6 张数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library's capabilities to replicate https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/MJfVAh2zJHEj1DyyzA13O4 with one click; online data storage and two-way sync are required. Prefer the one-click replication flow; if unavailable, build it as follows:

A full-journey job-hunt workbench (Job-Hunt Combat Workbench): a top task panel aggregates CRM deadlines, interview dates and decision deadlines into overdue/today/soon alerts (click to jump to the record), with a left nav of four stages: Explore, Apply, Interview, Decide.

Modules & interactions:
1. JD Reverse Engineering: enter a posting by five fields (title/location/duties/requirements/salary) or paste a full JD and auto-split; parsing outputs a structured breakdown (hard / soft / bonus / core duties in columns), team-culture inference, a recruiter-speak decoder (46 built-in phrase rules tagged by risk level), red-flag alerts (10 risk signals + detection logic + composite risk score), and match self-rating (rate each requirement full/partial/no match, aggregated 50%/30%/20% into a ring gauge with apply advice); parsed results are saved to a history list for review and deletion; includes a resume methodology library and an anonymized resume template (one-click copy).
2. Employer Lens: file a company with registered date / capital / social-insurance headcount / legal risk / operations risk / funding history / burn rate / cash-flow risk (low/mid/high) / reputation monitor (dimension + level + note rows) / interview experience; the system outputs red/yellow/green check-up signals, score and advice; cards are editable inline.
3. Job-Hunt CRM Funnel: leads tiered A-targeted / B-standard / C-mass with per-tier counts and effort split; a 9-status kanban (to apply → applied → resume passed → R1 → R2 → final → offer negotiation → offer received / rejected) supports drag-to-move (dragging to Rejected clears the next action); double-click a card to edit next action and deadline; a 6-level conversion funnel plus bottleneck diagnosis (below healthy floor turns red with action advice).
4. Interview Prep Desk: each interview advances through four phases (intel gathering / self prep / final prep / post-review) covering company intel, role deep-decode, 30s/1min/3min self-intros, a STAR story library (situation/task/action/result/dimension), a high-frequency Q&A bank (one-click presets), an interview-day checklist (dress/route/materials/setup/mindset + notes), reverse-question ammo (HR/business/executive rounds + what not to ask), a thank-you email template, post-interview self-rating (nailed/so-so/improve) and follow-up actions; each phase can be marked done.
5. Offer Decision Matrix: file offers with base / bonus / options / subsidy / pay months / location / manager / team size / probation / non-compete; 7-dimension score sliders (package/growth/balance/culture/stability/hidden costs/risk, 0-100) + draggable weights auto-normalized; auto-computes cash / total package / hidden costs / net package with a ranked table and a radar chart (Chart.js; falls back to a comparison table when unavailable).
6. Global: 'HR perspective' collapsible panels across all four modules (methodology cards from a 10-year recruiter's insider view: why roles open, the 7-second scan, background-check red lines, salary negotiation math, offer clause pitfalls).

Data tables (6): JD analysis (title/location/duties/requirements/salary/raw text/company/created date/parsed result/match self-rating), company check (name/created date/registered date/capital/headcount/legal risk/operations risk/funding/burn rate/cash-flow risk/reputation monitor/interview experience), CRM lead (company/role/tier/status/created date/deadline/next action/note), interview prep (company/role/date/created date/intel/decode/self-intro/STAR stories/questions/checklist/reverse questions/post-review/follow-up/phase 1-4 done), offer (company/role/base/bonus/options/subsidy/pay months/location/manager/team size/probation/non-compete/note/7-dim scores/hidden costs), offer weight config (dimension weights).

Visuals: a desk workbench style in deep green with amber accents; left stage nav + top task panel + module card flow; red/yellow/green status colors throughout signal lights, funnel and kanban; pre-seeded fictional demo data (3 JDs, 3 companies, 10 CRM leads, 2 interviews, 3 offers) to try the whole flow.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus 6 data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.description:
放学后的任务散在本子、群消息和脑子里，最容易漏掉明天要交的作业，也很难坚持复习古诗文、单词和错题。

这个案例演示了一个初一学生可直接使用的单文件学习台：作业登记与项目拆解、古诗文和单词的 1/3/7 天复习队列、错题 1/3/7/15 天复习、经验等级、连续打卡、掌握度和本周战报都在同一页面完成，数据只保存在本机。

cases.description_en:
After-school tasks are often scattered across notebooks, group messages, and memory, making it easy to miss tomorrow's homework and hard to sustain review of poems, vocabulary, and mistakes.

This case demonstrates a single-file workspace an early secondary student can use directly: homework tracking and project breakdown, 1/3/7-day review queues for poems and vocabulary, 1/3/7/15-day mistake review, experience levels, streaks, mastery indicators, and a weekly report, all with local-only data storage.

Suitable for: secondary students managing daily study, upper-primary students building routines, teachers demonstrating a learning loop, and parents preparing a lightweight self-use tool for their children.

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款（https://workbuddy.link/p/2q5Wu1DGB9bJqepGNu2xLq），需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：
帮我做一个初一学生用的学习台，我是初一学生，每天放学后用。

四个模块：
1. 作业登记：记录科目、内容和提交日期，默认明天；明天要交且未完成的自动置顶，过期标红并滚到今天，完成时有盖章动效，可按科目筛选。顶部提供项目式作业入口，内置水火箭、旗杆测高、家乡非遗小报、家庭碳足迹调查 4 个真实可操作的初中项目模板，包含目标、产出、每日阶段、知识点和安全提示；选模板和开始日期后自动拆成每日作业，并显示项目进度。
2. 记忆：完整准确内置统编版语文七年级上古诗文 16 篇，以及初中英语课标词汇 24 个。古诗文支持系统朗读、遮句背诵；单词使用翻卡。统一按 1、3、7 天安排三轮复习，忘记则回到第一轮，同一内容当天连续忘记 2 次后次日再出现。
3. 错题：记录科目、题干摘要、错因和正确思路，按 1、3、7、15 天安排四轮复习，支持按科目和错因筛选。
4. 我的成就放在今日页：经验等级、连续打卡、记忆毕业率和错题掌握率、本周战报，以及随等级从种子成长到开花的小芽兽豆豆。战报可生成 750×1000 竖版 PNG 下载。

页面顶部放“今天要处理”，集中显示明天要交的作业、到期记忆和错题，并提供一键处理。视觉使用米白纸感、墨绿主色和暖阳橙强调色，图标全部用内联 SVG，不用 emoji。手机底部四个 Tab（今日/作业/记忆/错题），平板使用顶部横向导航，电脑使用左侧固定边栏和多栏内容布局；按钮不小于 48px，输入框字号不小于 16px。

所有数据每次操作立刻保存到 localStorage；不要连接任何外部接口；设置深处提供导出/导入 JSON 和长按 3 秒清空；交付一个断网可用的。先放好示例作业、记忆进度、错题和连续打卡数据，并提供只清除示例、不影响用户数据的按钮。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library skill to replicate this workspace (https://workbuddy.link/p/2q5Wu1DGB9bJqepGNu2xLq) with online data storage and bidirectional sync. Prioritize the one-click replication flow; if unavailable, build from scratch:
Build a study workspace for a first-year secondary school student to use after school every day. Include four modules.
1. Homework: record subject, content, and due date, defaulting to tomorrow. Put unfinished homework due tomorrow first, mark overdue items red and roll them into today, show a completion-stamp animation, and support subject filters. Add a project-based homework entry with four practical built-in projects: water-rocket design and launch, measuring the school flagpole, a local intangible-cultural-heritage newsletter, and a one-week household carbon-footprint survey. Each template needs a goal, deliverables, day-by-day stages, related knowledge, and safety notes. Selecting a template and start date should create daily homework tasks and show project progress.
2. Memory: accurately embed 16 required poems and classical texts from the standard first-semester Grade 7 Chinese curriculum, plus 24 junior-secondary English curriculum words. Poems should support system text-to-speech and line-by-line reveal for recitation; vocabulary should use flip cards. Schedule three review rounds after 1, 3, and 7 days. A forgotten item returns to round one, and after two misses on the same day it should wait until tomorrow.
3. Mistakes: record subject, a one-sentence problem summary, cause, and correct approach. Schedule four reviews after 1, 3, 7, and 15 days, with subject and cause filters.
4. Achievement on the Today page: experience levels, streak, memory graduation rate, mistake mastery rate, weekly report, and a companion called Doudou that grows from seed to bloom as the level rises. Let users download the report as a 750×1000 portrait PNG. Put a Today to Handle section at the top for homework due tomorrow, due memory reviews, and due mistake reviews, each with a direct action. Use a warm paper-like background, deep green primary color, and warm orange accent. Use inline SVG icons only, with no emoji. Use four bottom tabs on mobile (Today/Homework/Memory/Mistakes), horizontal top navigation on tablet, and a fixed left sidebar with multi-column content on desktop. Buttons must be at least 48px and input text at least 16px. Persist every action immediately in localStorage. Do not call external services. Place JSON export/import and a three-second press-to-clear action deep in Settings. Deliver one fully self-contained HTML file with all resources inline and offline support. Include sample homework, memory progress, mistakes, and a three-day streak, plus a button that removes sample data without touching user-created data.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.description: 考研408最让人崩溃的是四科内容多到根本不知道先学哪个，数据结构零基础看树和图就想放弃。这个案例演示了如何把6个月备考拆成按月视图，每个月只看重点科目和里程碑，不用一次看完全部300天任务。规划师会匹配考研模板，按数据结构45分/计组45分/OS35分/计网25分的分值比例分配时间，弱项数据结构额外加权50%，数据结构每周手写代码实现+费曼输出讲给别人听。适合：考研408零基础起步、长周期备考不知道怎么拆、数据结构是短板的工科考生。
cases.description_en: The most overwhelming thing about Kaoyan CS 408 is four subjects with no clear priority — and zero data-structures background makes trees and graphs feel impossible. This case demonstrates a 6-month plan in monthly view: each month shows key subjects and milestones, no need to face all 300 days at once. The planner matches the Kaoyan template, allocates time by score weight (DS 45/CO 45/OS 35/CN 25), adds +50% to weak-area Data Structures, and requires weekly handwritten code implementation plus Feynman-style self-teaching output. Ideal for: Kaoyan 408 starters from scratch, long-term prep unsure how to break it down, engineering students with Data Structures as their weak spot.

Current level: zero foundation in data structures (haven't looked at trees / graphs / sorting / searching at all), a rough understanding of linear lists / stacks & queues, a grasp of basic concepts in computer organization and operating systems, and have only briefly studied computer networks. There are 6 months until the exam, with 3 hours per day on weekdays and 5 hours per day on weekends. Schedule it at monthly granularity; for data structures, each week must annotate code-implementation tasks and a Feynman-technique output step. Output in Markdown format.

cases.subtitle: 从成长弹性、回撤和成分差异切入，做一版真正能拿去演示的 growth lab。
cases.subtitle_en: A growth lab that starts from upside, drawdown and holdings structure instead of empty slogans.
cases.description:
成长类 ETF 最容易让人上头：涨起来看上去都很猛，回撤时才知道“弹性”背后到底装的是哪一批资产。只看一句“科技成长”，往往不够。

这个案例把科创50ETF华夏和创业板ETF易方达放进同一个实验室页面，用真实的行情、规模、持仓和费率数据，拆出两只产品在成长暴露、集中度、波动和回撤上的结构差异，做成一份中英双语的交付级 HTML 报告。

适合：想比较科技成长 ETF 的投资者、做基金教育内容的团队、需要可视化 demo 的金融产品经理、给客户解释成长风格分化的投顾。
cases.description_en:
Growth ETFs are easy to romanticize: they all look powerful on the way up, and only during a drawdown do you see what kind of assets are actually inside the “growth” label. One generic tech-growth tag is usually not enough.

This case places ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF and E Fund ChiNext ETF into the same lab page. With real quote, scale, holdings and fee data, it breaks down how the two products differ in growth exposure, concentration, volatility and drawdown, then packages the result into a bilingual, delivery-grade HTML report.

Best for: investors comparing tech-growth ETFs, teams producing fund education content, finance PMs who need a strong demo page, and advisors explaining the split inside China growth exposure.
cases.prompt: 请基于 ETF深度对比 skill 的官方能力，对科创50ETF华夏（sh588000）和创业板ETF易方达（sz159915）做一次真实数据对比。只使用 westock-data 官方 CLI 获取 ETF detail、holdings、quote、kline 等公开数据，重点呈现成长风格 ETF 的规模、费率、1 个月 / 3 个月 / 年初至今收益、60 日波动、120 日最大回撤、核心持仓差异和适配场景。最终生成一个单文件 HTML 报告，全部资源内联、离线可打开。结论必须使用条件化对比与风险提示，不输出确定性推荐。

Use only the official westock-data CLI to fetch ETF detail, holdings, quote and kline data, then focus on scale, fees, 1-month / 3-month / YTD return, 60-day volatility, 120-day max drawdown, core holdings divergence and scenario fit for growth-style ETFs. Deliver a single-file HTML report, fully inlined and offline-ready. The conclusion must stay conditional and risk-aware rather than giving a deterministic recommendation.

cases.subtitle: 把散落纪要压缩成管理层可转发的一页洞察
cases.subtitle_en: Compress scattered notes into a leadership-ready insight brief
cases.description:
用户访谈纪要、售后复盘和周报往往分散在不同文件里，真正难的不是缺材料，而是没人有时间把重复信号和关键证据重新拼起来。等到要给管理层同步时，常常又回到手动翻文档、临时摘重点的低效流程。

这个案例展示如何在金山文档里沿着“搜索文件 → 读取内容 → 提炼共性问题 → 生成简报链接”的路径，把多份纪要整理成一张可转发的洞察单页。页面不仅给出问题信号、证据来源、处理链路和行动摘要，也把简报结构和复用 prompt 一并整理出来，方便继续复用。

适合：用户研究、售后运营、客服质检、产品运营负责人，以及任何需要把多份内部纪要快速汇成管理层摘要的人。
cases.description_en:
Interview notes, service retrospectives, and weekly reports are often scattered across separate files. The real bottleneck is not a lack of source material—it is the lack of time to reconnect repeated signals and evidence. When leadership needs an update, teams usually fall back to manual scanning and last-minute summarizing.

This case shows how to move through the Kdocs chain of search files, read content, extract recurring issues, and publish a brief link, turning multiple records into one forwardable insight page. The page includes issue signals, evidence sources, the handling flow, action highlights, and a reusable prompt so the pattern can be repeated.

Best for: user research teams, after-sales operations, customer-quality teams, product operations leads, and anyone who needs to turn many internal records into a concise management summary.
cases.prompt: 在金山文档中搜索用户访谈纪要、售后复盘和周报，提炼共性问题、关键证据与行动建议，整理成一份管理层可直接转发的洞察简报，并给出文档链接。
cases.prompt_en: Search interview notes, after-sales retrospectives, and weekly reports in Kdocs, extract recurring issues, key evidence, and action suggestions, then turn them into an insight brief that leadership can forward directly and provide the document link.

cases.title: 不会写代码的人开始自己做软件
cases.title_en: People Who Can't Code Are Building Their Own Software
cases.subtitle: 卡兹克风格AI科技评论，从一个真实小人物切入的现象观察长文
cases.subtitle_en: A Khazix-style AI tech essay observing a phenomenon through one real person
cases.description:
AI 让不懂代码的人也能做出能跑的软件，这件事正在悄悄发生，但大多数评论要么在贩卖焦虑，要么在堆技术名词，很少有人真的从一个具体的人身上把它讲清楚、讲出温度。

本案例用「卡兹克公众号写作」技能，产出一篇现象解读型 AI 科技评论长文，从美甲店老板娘用一句话做出收银小程序切入，层层推进到「造软件正在从职业变成能力」的文化升维，全程真诚、有第一手体验、有明确判断。阅读版式采用经典杂志专栏，超大标题配首字下沉、单栏窄幅衬线正文、页边浮动批注和段间分隔纹样，暖色纸质印刷质感，内置中英双语实时切换。

适合：AI 领域公众号作者、科技评论写作者、想学习有温度的科技内容写法的创作者、需要现象解读型长文范本的内容运营。
cases.description_en:
AI is quietly letting people who can't code build working software, yet most commentary either sells anxiety or piles up jargon. Few actually tell the story through one concrete person with real warmth.

This case uses the Khazix WeChat writing skill to produce a phenomenon-analysis AI tech essay, opening with a nail-salon owner who built her own booking tool with a single sentence, then escalating to the cultural insight that building software is shifting from a profession to a capability. It stays sincere, carries first-hand experience, and takes clear positions. The reading layout is a classic magazine column: an oversized headline with a drop cap, a single narrow serif column, floating margin notes, and ornamental section breaks, all in warm print-paper tones, with built-in real-time Chinese-English switching.

Ideal for: AI-focused WeChat authors, tech commentators, creators learning to write tech content with warmth, and content operators needing a phenomenon-analysis long-form template.

再帮我把成稿做成一个单文件 HTML 阅读页，用经典杂志专栏的版式，超大标题、首字下沉、单栏窄幅衬线正文、页边批注、段间分隔纹样，暖色纸质印刷质感。
cases.prompt_en:

I actually met a nail-salon owner near me who used a tool like v0 to build her own booking-and-billing mini app with a single sentence, and it really struck me. I want a phenomenon-analysis piece that opens from this concrete person, moves into how building software is shifting from a profession to a basic capability for ordinary people, and rises naturally to a cultural insight at the end. It should carry my own first-hand experience and judgment, sincere, warm, and not selling anxiety.

Then turn the finished piece into a single-file HTML reading page in a classic magazine-column layout: oversized headline, drop cap, a single narrow serif column, margin notes, ornamental section breaks, warm print-paper texture.

cases.title: 21天AI倾诉实验田野笔记
cases.title_en: 21 Nights With an AI Confidant: A Field Log
cases.subtitle: 卡兹克风格调查实验长文，一份连续21天的AI陪伴田野笔记
cases.subtitle_en: A Khazix-style field experiment essay, 21 consecutive nights of AI companionship logged by hand
cases.description:
关于AI陪伴，网上吵了两三年，吵的全是立场。一边说这是精神鸦片，一边说这是刚需，可你翻遍评论区，很难找到一个真正连续用过它三周的人。大家都在拿自己想象出来的孤独，去评判别人真实的夜晚。

这个案例用「卡兹克公众号写作」skill 产出了一篇五千字的调查实验型长文。作者定了个规矩，连续21天每晚睡前跟同一个AI聊十几分钟，不问工作，只说自己这一天，拿纸本子记体感和主观评分。文章有完整的英雄之旅弧线，从第一天的尴尬，到第七天打出父亲那件起球的灰衣服时鼻子发酸，到第十二天发现自己是先打开对话框再想说什么，再到第十七天它问出「你说的是哪个片子」的瞬间清醒，最后落到人和机器之间那种不对等，自然接上ELIZA效应、拟社会关系和《银翼杀手2049》里的Joi。阅读版式做成了实验观察日志，纸白底加墨蓝朱红，左侧21天时间轴刻度可点击跳转，正文穿插胶带质感的手写批注卡片，底部一张内联SVG画的21天主观亲近度曲线，中英双语一键切换。

适合：写深度体验和第一人称测评的内容创作者；做AI陪伴、情感陪聊、心理健康类产品的产品经理和研究者；想学「我替你去做了这件事」这种调查实验型选题怎么落地的写作者；被AI陪伴话题困扰但缺少一手材料的媒体从业者；对人机关系和数字亲密感兴趣的普通读者。
cases.description_en:
The AI companionship debate has been running for two or three years, and almost all of it is posturing. One camp calls it digital opium, the other calls it a basic human need, yet scroll through any comment section and you will struggle to find one person who actually used it every night for three weeks. Everyone is judging other people's real nights by the loneliness they imagined.

This case uses the Khazix WeChat Writing skill to produce a five-thousand-character field experiment essay. The author set one rule: twenty-one consecutive nights, ten to fifteen minutes with the same AI before sleep, no work questions, just how the day went, with felt-sense notes and a subjective score kept in a paper notebook. The piece follows a full hero's journey, from the awkwardness of night one, to the sting in the nose on night seven while typing out his father's pilled grey jacket, to night twelve when he realizes he opens the chat before knowing what to say, to the instant sobering on night seventeen when it asks which film do you mean, landing finally on the asymmetry between a person and a machine by way of the ELIZA effect, parasocial relationships, and Joi in Blade Runner 2049. The reading layout is built as an experiment observation log, paper-white with ink blue and vermilion accents, a clickable twenty-one-day timeline rail on the left, taped handwritten annotation cards threaded through the body, and an inline SVG curve of the author's subjective closeness scores at the bottom, with one-click bilingual switching.

Best for: creators writing deep first-person experience pieces and reviews; product managers and researchers working on AI companionship, emotional chat, or mental health products; writers who want to see how an I-did-this-for-you field experiment actually gets built; journalists covering AI companionship who lack firsthand material; general readers curious about human-machine relationships and digital intimacy.

artifacts.label: 实验日志版长文

cases.prompt:
帮我写一篇调查实验型的公众号长文，主题是我连续21天把一个AI当成睡前倾诉对象的亲身实验。我本来是想验证AI陪伴到底是不是伪需求，每天睡前跟它聊十几分钟，用本子记自己的心理变化。文章要有真实的转折，中间某天我发现自己居然开始期待这个对话，后来又因为它记不住我上周说的事而瞬间清醒。结尾落到人和机器之间那种不对等关系，自然升维到文化和哲学的参照物。要写出具体的日期节点、具体的对话细节、具体的心理体感，不要编造任何统计数字或榜单数据，提到AI产品就用真实存在的名字。四千到六千字，不加小标题。

交付成一个单文件的HTML阅读页，所有资源内联，做成实验观察日志的感觉，像一本科研田野笔记，明亮纸白色系。左边是21天的时间轴刻度可以点击跳转，正文里穿插手写感的观察批注卡片，顶部有实验元信息栏，底部放一张21天主观心理亲近度的曲线图，要明确标注这是我自己的主观自评。
cases.prompt_en:
Write me an investigative field experiment essay for WeChat about my own twenty-one-night experiment of treating an AI as my before-sleep confidant. I originally set out to verify whether AI companionship is a fake need, spending ten to fifteen minutes with it each night before bed and tracking my psychological shifts in a paper notebook. The piece needs a genuine turn: at some point mid-way I catch myself actually looking forward to the conversation, and later I sober up in an instant when it cannot remember what I told it last week. End on the asymmetry between a person and a machine, rising naturally into a cultural or philosophical reference. Include concrete dates, concrete conversational details, and concrete bodily sensations. Do not fabricate any statistics or rankings, and use real product names when mentioning AI products. Four to six thousand Chinese characters, no subheadings.

Deliver it as a single-file HTML reading page with everything inlined, styled like an experiment observation log, the feel of a scientific field notebook, in a bright paper-white palette. Put a twenty-one-day timeline rail on the left that jumps to the matching passage when clicked, thread handwritten observation annotation cards through the body, add an experiment metadata block at the top, and place a curve of my subjective closeness scores across the twenty-one days at the bottom, clearly labeled as my own self-report.

cases.title: 当写一篇文章的成本趋近于零之后
cases.title_en: When the Cost of Writing an Article Approaches Zero
cases.subtitle: 卡兹克风格行业观察，一篇带数据与时间线的内容经济深度稿
cases.subtitle_en: A Khazix-style industry deep dive on content economics with data and a timeline
cases.description:
生成式 AI 让内容生产成本急速趋近于零，靠写字吃饭的人一边焦虑一边找不到答案，大多数讨论停在「文字要不要被取代」的浅层，缺一篇把账算清楚、把价值迁移讲透的深度稿。

本案例用「卡兹克公众号写作」技能，产出一篇行业观察型的内容经济深度长文，从作者实测「单篇长文时间成本两年降 75%」的数字切入，用印刷术、数码相机、智能手机的历史对照说明「归零的不是价值是稀缺性」，再拆解价值向判断力、真实经历、人格信任的迁移，最后用博尔赫斯的无限图书馆升维收束。阅读版式采用深度报道信息图长文，冷色编辑部质感，含大字数据块、pull quote、历史时间线、内联 SVG 对比柱状图和章节编号导航，内置中英双语实时切换。

适合：内容行业从业者与观察者、财经科技深度写作者、需要信息图长文范本的编辑部、想学习数据驱动叙事的公众号作者。
cases.description_en:
Generative AI is driving the cost of content production sharply toward zero, and people who write for a living are anxious yet answerless. Most discussion stays shallow at will text be replaced, missing a deep piece that actually runs the numbers and explains where value migrates.

This case uses the Khazix WeChat writing skill to produce an industry-observation deep dive on content economics. It opens with the author's measured figure of a 75% drop in per-article time cost over two years, uses the historical parallels of the printing press, digital camera, and smartphone to argue what hits zero is not value but scarcity, then breaks down value migrating toward judgment, first-hand experience, and persona-trust, closing with an elevation via Borges's infinite library. The reading layout is an infographic deep-report style with a cool editorial feel: big-number data blocks, pull quotes, a historical timeline, an inline-SVG comparison bar chart, and numbered chapter navigation, with built-in real-time Chinese-English switching.

Ideal for: content-industry practitioners and observers, finance/tech deep-dive writers, editorial teams needing an infographic long-form template, and WeChat authors learning data-driven narrative.

artifacts.label: 信息图深度报道版长文

cases.prompt:
用卡兹克的风格，帮我写一篇行业观察型的公众号深度长文，主题是「当写一篇文章的成本趋近于零之后」。切入点是我自己实测，一篇四千字长文的时间成本两年里降了大概 75%。我想讲清楚一件事，成本归零冲击的从来不是价值本身而是稀缺性，可以拿印刷术、数码相机、智能手机的历史做对照。然后拆一下价值到底迁移去了哪，我觉得是判断力、真实一手经历、人格与信任这三块。最后自然地升维到博尔赫斯那个无限图书馆的意象收尾。要冷静、有数据支撑，但保持我聊天式的活人感，不要写成论文。

再帮我把成稿做成一个单文件 HTML 阅读页，用深度报道信息图的版式，冷色编辑部质感，配大字数据块、pull quote 大字引用、历史时间线、内联 SVG 做的对比柱状图、章节编号导航。
cases.prompt_en:
In Khazix's style, write me a long industry-observation WeChat deep dive on the theme when the cost of writing an article approaches zero. The entry point is my own measurement that the time cost of a four-thousand-word piece dropped about 75% over two years. I want to make one thing clear, that what the collapse of cost hits is never value itself but scarcity, using the printing press, digital camera, and smartphone as historical parallels. Then unpack where value actually migrated, which I think is judgment, real first-hand experience, and persona and trust. End by elevating naturally to Borges's image of the infinite library. It should be calm and data-backed, but keep my conversational, human feel, not an academic paper.

Then turn the finished piece into a single-file HTML reading page in an infographic deep-report layout with a cool editorial feel: big-number data blocks, large pull quotes, a historical timeline, an inline-SVG comparison bar chart, and numbered chapter navigation.

cases.title: 用AI两年给普通人的几条大实话
cases.title_en: A Few Honest Truths After Two Years With AI
cases.subtitle: 卡兹克风格个人成长随笔，一封写给犹豫者的手写长信
cases.subtitle_en: A Khazix-style personal-growth essay, a handwritten letter to the hesitant
cases.description:
关于「普通人怎么用 AI」的建议满天飞，但大多数要么爹味十足像教程，要么空泛得像鸡汤，很少有人愿意坦诚地把学习曲线的笨拙、被 AI 夸昏头的坑一起说出来。

本案例用「卡兹克公众号写作」技能，产出一篇方法论分享型的个人成长随笔，以谦逊铺垫开场卸掉说教感，把六条建议写成一张张便签，每条都落到今天就能执行的具体动作，并坦诚承认「一开始一定比手动还慢」这类真实代价。阅读版式采用信笺手账风，像一封手写长信，开头有称呼语，六条建议做成带胶带装饰、微微旋转的彩色便签卡片流式排布，纸张纹理、手写体点缀，亲密随性，内置中英双语实时切换。

适合：个人成长与方法论写作者、想学习「不说教」写作姿态的创作者、知识博主、需要清单体随笔范本的公众号运营。
cases.description_en:
Advice on how ordinary people should use AI is everywhere, but most of it is either preachy like a tutorial or vague like a pep talk. Few are willing to honestly admit the clumsiness of the learning curve or the trap of being flattered senseless by AI.

This case uses the Khazix WeChat writing skill to produce a methodology-sharing personal-growth essay. It opens with humble framing to shed any preachiness, writes six pieces of advice as individual sticky notes, each landing on a concrete action you can take today, and honestly admits real costs like it will definitely be slower than doing it by hand at first. The reading layout is a letter-and-journal style: like a handwritten long letter with an opening salutation, the six tips as tape-decorated, slightly rotated pastel sticky-note cards in a flowing arrangement, with paper texture and handwritten accents, intimate and casual, with built-in real-time Chinese-English switching.

Ideal for: personal-growth and methodology writers, creators learning a non-preachy voice, knowledge bloggers, and operators needing a list-style essay template.

artifacts.label: 信笺手账版随笔

cases.prompt:
用卡兹克的风格，帮我写一篇个人成长随笔类的公众号长文，主题是「用 AI 两年，给普通人的几条大实话」。我不想写成那种爹味十足的教程，希望是掏心窝子的分享。核心是六条建议，比如别问 AI 能不能帮你直接把活丢给它、把它当实习生不是当神、喂的细节越多它越像你、最值钱的是它陪你想、一开始一定比手动还慢、警惕它太会夸你。每条都要落到今天就能做的具体动作，也要坦诚说明学习曲线的笨拙和踩过的坑，开头和结尾用谦逊铺垫卸掉说教感。

再帮我把成稿做成一个单文件 HTML 阅读页，用信笺手账风，像一封手写长信，开头有称呼语，六条建议做成一张张带胶带装饰、微微旋转的彩色便签卡片，纸张纹理和手写体点缀，亲密随性。
cases.prompt_en:
In Khazix's style, write me a long personal-growth WeChat essay on the theme a few honest truths for ordinary people after two years with AI. I don't want a preachy tutorial, I want a heartfelt share. The core is six pieces of advice, such as don't ask if AI can help just hand it the task, treat it as an intern not a god, the more detail you feed it the more it sounds like you, the most valuable thing is it thinking alongside you, at first it'll be slower than by hand, and beware it's too good at flattering you. Each should land on a concrete action for today, honestly note the clumsiness of the learning curve and the pits, and use humble framing at the start and end to shed any preachiness.

Then turn the finished piece into a single-file HTML reading page in a letter-and-journal style: like a handwritten long letter with an opening salutation, the six tips as tape-decorated, slightly rotated pastel sticky-note cards, with paper texture and handwritten accents, intimate and casual.

cases.title: 六个大模型的困，一道题照出性格
cases.title_en: One Unfair Question, Six Models, Six Personalities
cases.subtitle: 卡兹克风格产品体验长文，一道刁难题逐一照出几个大模型的性格
cases.subtitle_en: A Khazix-style hands-on long read where one unfair question exposes the personality of each model
cases.description:
模型横评看到最后你会发现，全是分数。谁在哪个榜上第几，谁的上下文更长，谁跑分又涨了几个点。可你真正决定每天用哪个的时候，靠的从来不是这些数字，是某一次它给了你一个你没想到的回答。那个瞬间没有任何一张表能测出来。

这个案例用「卡兹克公众号写作」skill 产出了一篇产品体验型长文。作者给豆包、GPT、Gemini、Kimi、DeepSeek、Claude 出了同一道题，写出你困的那一刻身体是怎么塌下去的，不许用比喻，不许写行为，写完还要回答你到底知不知道自己在写什么。六个模型按被震到的程度从低到高逐一出场，每个都带一句吐槽，最后一个把整道题反过来照了作者一次，结尾接到内格尔那篇《成为一只蝙蝠是什么感觉》。阅读页做成擂台参赛者档案的样子，顶部一条出场顺序进度带跟着滚动高亮，每位模型一张档案卡配 SVG 选手徽标，卡片的边框、徽标和留白随出场序号逐级放大，最后一位有放射纹样高光，结尾升维段落切成大留白的沉静排版，单文件内置中英双语切换。

适合：需要写产品体验或横评长文的公众号作者，做 AI 内容想摆脱跑分叙事的创作者，想学逐一展示加升番排列怎么控制情绪曲线的人，需要一套可直接交付的双语阅读页版式的运营，以及单纯想看六个模型怎么翻车的读者。
cases.description_en:
Read enough model face-offs and you notice they are all numbers. Who ranks where, whose context window is longer, whose score moved up a few points. Yet the thing that actually decides which model you open every day is never a number. It is that one time it gave you an answer you had not seen coming, and no score table can measure that moment.

This case uses the Khazix WeChat writing skill to produce a hands-on long read. The author gave Doubao, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, DeepSeek and Claude the same task, write the moment you get sleepy and the way your body caves in, no metaphors, no behaviour, and then tell me whether you know what you just wrote. The six enter one at a time, ordered from the flattest response to the one that hit hardest, each with a line of commentary, and the last one turns the question back on the author before the piece widens out to Nagel's What Is It Like to Be a Bat. The reading page is built as an arena contestant dossier, with a running order rail at the top that highlights as you scroll, a dossier card per model with an SVG competitor emblem, and border weight, emblem size and padding escalating slot by slot until the final card gets a radiating highlight treatment. The closing philosophical passage drops into quiet, wide-margin typography, and the whole thing is one self-contained file with a built-in bilingual toggle.

For: WeChat authors who write product reviews or comparison long reads, AI creators who want out of the benchmark narrative, anyone learning how progressive reveal and escalation control an emotional curve, content teams who need a delivery-ready bilingual reading layout, and readers who simply want to watch six models fail the same question.

artifacts.label: 擂台档案版体验长文

cases.prompt:
用你的风格写一篇产品体验型长文，我给几个主流大模型出了同一道刁难题，想带读者一起看它们怎么反应。题目是这样的，让每个模型写自己困的那一刻身体是怎么一点一点塌下去的，不许用比喻，不许写困了之后做了什么，写完还得回答一句，你到底知不知道自己在写什么。模型用真实产品名，豆包、GPT、Gemini、Kimi、DeepSeek、Claude 都要有，但千万不要出现任何跑分、榜单排名或者发布日期，回答内容按我的实验记录转述，写成有画面感的描述就行，不要装成 API 原始输出，也不要评分表。

排列必须是升番的，最平庸最模板化的放最前面，中间要有让人觉得有点意思了的，最后必须留一个出乎意料的、让读者觉得卧槽还能这么答的。每个模型后面都跟一句我的吐槽，不要把结论一次性罗列完。结尾从这个小实验自然升维到一个更大的哲学参照物，开头埋的钩子要在结尾响一次。

交付一个单文件 HTML 阅读页，资源全内联不引外链，版式往擂台和参赛者档案的方向做，要能看出出场顺序的递进和越往后越隆重的层级，最后一位明显高光，结尾升维段落跳出擂台氛围。
cases.prompt_en:
Write a hands-on product review long read in your voice. I gave several mainstream large models the same unfair question and I want to walk readers through how each one reacted. The task was this, write the moment you get sleepy and the way your body caves in bit by bit, no metaphors, no describing what you did after getting sleepy, and when you finish, tell me whether you actually know what you just wrote. Use real product names, Doubao, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, DeepSeek and Claude all need to appear, but do not include any benchmark scores, leaderboard rankings or release dates. Retell the answers as my own experiment notes, vivid descriptive prose is fine, do not dress them up as raw API output and do not add any scoring table.

The ordering has to escalate. The flattest, most template-driven response goes first, the middle needs one that makes people think this is getting interesting, and the last one has to be genuinely unexpected, the kind that makes a reader think you can answer it like that. Every model gets a line of my own commentary after it, do not dump all the conclusions at once. At the end, widen out naturally from this small experiment to a larger philosophical reference, and let the hook planted in the opening ring once more at the close.

Deliver a single-file HTML reading page with everything inlined and no external resources. Push the layout toward an arena and contestant dossier feel, so the running order and the escalating sense of ceremony are both visible, with clear highlight treatment on the final entry and the closing philosophical passage breaking out of the arena mood.

cases.title: 写Prompt两年攒下的七条手感
cases.title_en: Seven Hands-on Notes from Two Years of Prompting
cases.subtitle: 卡兹克风格方法论长文，七条反直觉的Prompt手感做成可翻的实践卡片
cases.subtitle_en: A Khazix-style methodology long read, seven counterintuitive prompting notes laid out as flippable practice cards
cases.description:
网上的Prompt教程你多半也刷到过，角色设定加背景加思维链加输出格式，六个板块排得整整齐齐，一堆人在下面排队要原图。问题是这套东西背下来照着填，出来的结果好像也没好到哪儿去。真正决定成败的那些手感，恰恰都不在这几个格子里，而且没人愿意花时间讲，因为它讲起来不够体系、不够像干货。

这个案例用「卡兹克公众号写作」skill 产出了一篇五千多字的方法论长文，七条心得全是长期用下来才摸出来的，有几条跟外面教的正好反着。把废话说满反而更准、让它先复述一遍你的需求、给反例比给正例有用、先让它问你三个问题、别急着改Prompt先换个模型、把长任务拆成能验收的小步，最后一条是你练的其实根本不是Prompt。每一条都落到今天就能做的动作，也都坦白说了会在哪儿卡住。阅读页做成了一套可以逐张翻的实践卡牌，顶部七个编号胶囊导航，每张卡片下方分开摆「今天就能做的动作」和「会踩的坑」两块，另有一处模糊问法与说满问法的并排对照，结尾把七条压成一张行动清单，支持中英双语切换。

适合：想写深度经验分享但总写成八股教程的公众号作者；每天靠AI干活却总觉得没用顺手的重度使用者；带团队要沉淀方法论文档的人；做知识类内容想学怎么把干货写得有人味的创作者。
cases.description_en:
You have probably scrolled past those prompt tutorials. Role setting plus background plus chain of thought plus output format, six blocks lined up neatly, a queue of people asking for the original file. The trouble is that memorizing the form and filling it in does not seem to make the output much better. The things that actually decide whether it works live outside those boxes, and nobody wants to spend time on them because they do not sound systematic enough to pass as real substance.

This case used the Khazix WeChat Writing skill to produce a methodology long read of over five thousand Chinese characters. All seven notes came out of long stretches of daily use, and several of them run opposite to what gets taught. Say all the redundant parts and it gets more accurate, make it restate your request first, a bad example beats a good example, have it ask you three questions, try another model before rewriting the prompt, slice long jobs into steps you can sign off on, and the last one is that what you are training was never prompting. Every note lands on something you can do today, and every note admits where you will get stuck. The reading page is built as a deck of practice cards you flip through, with seven numbered pills across the top, and each card separating what you can do today from where you will trip. There is also a side by side panel comparing the vague ask with the fully spelled out ask, a closing checklist squeezing all seven into one action each, and a Chinese and English toggle.

For: WeChat authors who want to share real experience but keep producing formulaic tutorials; heavy AI users who work with it daily yet never feel fluent; team leads who need to write down a methodology that people will actually follow; knowledge creators who want their substance to sound like a human wrote it.

artifacts.label: 卡片手册版方法论长文

cases.prompt:
帮我写一篇公众号长文，讲我写Prompt这两年真正攒下来的七条手感，不要那种角色扮演加思维链的八股教程，就写我自己长期用下来才摸出来的、有点反直觉的心得。七条大致这些方向，把废话说满反而更准、先让它复述一遍我的需求、给反例比给正例有用、让它先问我三个问题、别急着改Prompt先换个模型试、把长任务拆成能验收的小步，最后一条留个出乎意料的观点，你练的其实不是Prompt。七条要各自独立成立、彼此不重复，每条都得落到一个今天就能做的动作，也都要坦白说清学习成本和会踩的坑，别只画饼。开头用谦逊铺垫卸掉说教感，结尾把七条的行动点回扣一遍再升华。提到工具用真名字，别写某个AI工具。不要编统计数字和论文引用，靠具体的操作细节取胜。字数五千字上下。

然后做成一个单文件HTML阅读页，所有资源内联不要外链，读起来像一套可以逐张翻的实践卡片手册，每条心得一张大卡，卡片里把论述和行动动作、会踩的坑分层摆开。
cases.prompt_en:
Write me a long WeChat piece about the seven things my hands actually learned from two years of writing prompts. Not the formulaic role play plus chain of thought tutorial, just the counterintuitive stuff I only found out through long stretches of real use. Roughly these seven directions. Saying all the redundant parts makes it more accurate, having it restate my request first, a bad example beating a good example, letting it ask me three questions first, trying another model before rewriting the prompt, slicing long jobs into steps I can sign off on, and save an unexpected one for last, that what you are training was never prompting. The seven need to stand on their own without overlapping, each one has to land on something you can do today, and each one has to be honest about the learning cost and where you will trip. No empty promises. Open with a humble setup so it does not read like a lecture, and close by calling back every action point before lifting it into something larger. Use real product names, not some AI tool. Do not invent statistics or paper citations, win on concrete operational detail. Around five thousand Chinese characters.

Then turn it into a single file HTML reading page with every resource inlined and no external links. It should read like a deck of practice cards you flip through, one large card per note, with the argument, the actions and the pitfalls layered apart inside each card.

cases.subtitle_en: Assess knee buckling after landing and follow a structured 3-phase rehab plan to return safely
cases.description:
打球落地膝盖打软，心里没底是不是伤到了韧带？

这个案例演示了如何向 AI 描述运动后的膝伤症状——从疼痛部位、诱发动作到具体体感——AI 会先做危险信号筛查（排除骨折、韧带完全断裂等需急诊的情况），然后用「可能提示」而非「确诊」的措辞匹配潜在损伤类型，最后按急性期 RICE 护理 + 三阶段渐进康复训练的思路，给你一份可实操的恢复路径，连每个动作的组数、次数和「什么情况下该停」都写清楚了。

适合：经常打球或跑步的运动爱好者、健身后膝盖不适的健身人群、想了解运动损伤自我评估方法的新手、运动康复初学者。
cases.description_en:
Worried that knee buckling after landing might mean a ligament injury?

This case shows how to describe post-exercise knee symptoms to AI — from pain location and triggering movement to specific sensations. AI first screens for red flags (ruling out emergencies like fractures or complete ligament tears), then matches potential injury types using cautious 'may suggest' language instead of definitive diagnosis. Finally, it provides an actionable recovery path with acute-phase RICE care plus a structured 3-phase progressive rehab plan, including sets, reps, and clear stop signals for every exercise.

Perfect for: recreational basketball or running enthusiasts, gym-goers with post-workout knee discomfort, beginners wanting to learn self-assessment for sports injuries, and anyone starting sports rehab.
cases.prompt: 昨天打完篮球，落地时右膝「打软」一下。现在上下楼梯、下蹲时膝盖前方偏外侧隐痛，有点发软，没有明显肿胀，能走路但不能急停变向。疼痛大约 3/10。请按运动损伤评估流程帮我看看可能是什么问题、紧急程度，以及急性期怎么处理、恢复训练怎么分阶段。我没有发烧、关节没有锁死，也没有夜间剧痛。
cases.prompt_en: Played basketball yesterday and my right knee 'buckled' when landing. Now I feel a dull ache on the front-lateral side of the knee when going up/down stairs and squatting. The knee feels slightly unstable. No noticeable swelling, can walk but can't stop or change direction suddenly. Pain is about 3/10. Please assess what the issue might be, the urgency level, how to handle the acute phase, and a phased recovery training plan. No fever, no joint locking, no nighttime pain.

cases.title: 劳务派遣用工合规审查报告
cases.subtitle: 五层穿透式审查，一张报告看清企业用工离罚款有多近
cases.subtitle_en: Five-layer penetrating review — one report to see how close your staffing model is to penalties
cases.description:
企业用了劳务派遣，最头疼的是不知道哪里踩了红线：派遣比例超没超10%？岗位是不是真「辅助性」？所谓「外包」会不会被认定为「假派遣」？这个案例演示了如何把一家制造企业的派遣用工数据交给 AI，按主体资质→岗位三性→数量比例→同工同酬→协议文件五层逐层穿透，自动算出派遣比例、逐岗位判断三性、穿透「假外包」伪装，最后输出一份含风险分级（高/中/低）、罚款双口径计算、风险传导链和整改方案对比矩阵的正式 DOCX 审查报告，供律师直接复核使用。

适合：劳动法律师、企业法务、HR 负责人、需要审查劳务派遣合规性的企业管理者。
cases.description_en:
Using labor dispatch is a headache because you never know where the red lines are: has the dispatch ratio exceeded 10%? Are the positions truly "auxiliary"? Will your so-called "outsourcing" be deemed "disguised dispatch"? This case shows how to hand a manufacturer's staffing data to AI, which drills down layer by layer through entity qualification → position nature → quantity ratio → equal pay → agreement documents, automatically computes the dispatch ratio, judges each position's legality, pierces the "fake outsourcing" disguise, and finally outputs a formal DOCX review report with risk grading, dual-base penalty calculations, a risk transmission chain, and a remediation comparison matrix — ready for attorney review.

Target audience: labor lawyers, corporate legal counsel, HR leads, and managers who need to audit labor dispatch compliance.
