cases.prompt:
请以用工单位视角，对以下企业的劳务派遣用工进行五层穿透式合规审查，并生成正式 DOCX 审查报告。

【用工单位】宁波启航精密制造有限公司（主营业务：精密机械零部件制造）
【派遣单位】宁波诚达劳务派遣有限公司（持有有效《劳务派遣经营许可证》，有效期至2027年8月）
【派遣岗位】流水线操作工32人、质检员8人、仓库管理员3人、行政前台2人
【正式员工】260人；【外包用工】60人（名义外包，实际由启航公司直接考勤排班、按人头每月6800元计费、使用启航公司场地设备、从事主营业务流水线作业）
【审查基准日】2026年6月30日
【历史履约】派遣单位近2年社保断缴3个月、工资延迟支付2次、近3年3件劳动争议（含2件同工同酬争议、1件败诉）
【同工同酬】流水线岗位派遣工绩效系数0.5 vs 正式工1.0（同一薪酬体系）

要求：
1. 按「主体资质→岗位三性→数量比例→同工同酬→协议文件」五层逐层审查，逐岗位判断三性，不得批量结论；
2. 计算派遣比例（列公式），超10%红线标注高风险，并同时展示第92条罚款的两种计算口径；
3. 对60名外包工做「假外包」四要素穿透（指挥管理权/计费方式/自主经营/业务关联性）；
4. 输出含风险分级、风险传导链、整改方案对比矩阵的九部分报告，报告标题为「关于[公司名称]劳务派遣用工合规审查之法律审查报告」；
5. 报告首部声明不构成正式法律意见，末尾附保密声明。
cases.prompt_en:
From the perspective of the receiving employer, conduct a five-layer penetrating compliance review of the following company's labor dispatch usage and generate a formal DOCX review report.

[Employer] Ningbo Qihang Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (main business: precision mechanical parts manufacturing)
[Dispatch Agency] Ningbo Chengda Labor Dispatch Co., Ltd. (holds a valid Labor Dispatch Business License, valid until August 2027)
[Dispatched Positions] 32 assembly-line operators, 8 quality inspectors, 3 warehouse keepers, 2 receptionists
[Regular Employees] 260; [Outsourced Workers] 60 (nominally outsourced, but actually scheduled/clocked by Qihang directly, billed 6,800 yuan per head per month, using Qihang's premises and equipment, performing core assembly-line work)
[Review Base Date] June 30, 2026
[Historical Performance] The dispatch agency had 3 months of social insurance arrears and 2 delayed wage payments in the past 2 years, plus 3 labor disputes in 3 years (including 2 equal-pay disputes and 1 lost case)
[Equal Pay] Assembly-line dispatched workers have a performance coefficient of 0.5 vs. 1.0 for regular workers (same compensation system)

Requirements:
1. Review layer by layer in the order of entity qualification → position nature → quantity ratio → equal pay → agreement documents, judging each position's legality individually without batch conclusions;
2. Calculate the dispatch ratio (show the formula), flag high risk if it exceeds the 10% red line, and present both calculation bases for the Article 92 penalty;
3. Conduct a four-element "fake outsourcing" piercing analysis of the 60 outsourced workers (command/management authority, billing method, operational autonomy, business relevance);
4. Output a nine-part report with risk grading, a risk transmission chain, and a remediation comparison matrix, titled "Legal Review Report on Labor Dispatch Compliance of [Company Name]";
5. State at the top that it does not constitute formal legal advice, and append a confidentiality statement.

cases.title: 竞业限制违约金仲裁庭演练
cases.subtitle: 实习仲裁员居中裁判全流程实录：四个易漏法定环节的完整示范
cases.subtitle_en: Full rehearsal from the adjudicator's seat, covering four mandatory procedural steps
cases.description: 开庭前最怕的就是流程走错、法定环节漏掉、争议焦点没归全——尤其竞业限制这类「主体适格性」决定生死的案件，一个环节失误就可能导致裁决被撤销。本案例用一桩竞业限制违约金争议（用人单位为申请人、设备维护员李某抗辩非适格主体），由 AI 补齐申请人、被申请人双方及其代理人角色，以【程序提示】单独标注告知权利义务、询问回避、征询最后意见、先行调解四个易漏的法定必经环节，完整走完仲裁轨的开庭身份核对、调查、举证质证、辩论、最后陈述、先行调解与收尾研判，最后输出复盘总结，逐项评估程序完整性、争议焦点归纳、举证责任分配与当庭认证释明边界，并附庭前准备清单。适合：实习仲裁员与仲裁员、劳动争议方向法学生、想演练单位一方抗辩的 HR 与公司法务、备考法律职业资格的人员。
cases.description_en: The worst part before a hearing is worrying about procedural slip-ups, missed mandatory steps, or incomplete issue framing — especially in non-compete cases where the eligibility of the subject decides everything, one mistake can get the award revoked. This case walks through a non-compete penalty dispute (the employer is the applicant; equipment maintainer Li argues he is not a proper subject), with AI filling in both parties and their agents. Four easily-missed mandatory steps — informing rights and obligations, asking about recusal, soliciting final statements, and mandatory pre-award mediation — are flagged separately as [Procedural Tips]. The full arbitration track is rehearsed end to end: identity check, investigation, evidence examination, debate, closing statements, mediation, and closing analysis, followed by a review summary evaluating procedural completeness, issue framing, burden-of-proof allocation, and the boundary of on-the-spot authentication and interpretation, plus a pre-hearing checklist. Suitable for: intern arbitrators and arbitrators, law students focusing on labor disputes, HR and in-house counsel wanting to rehearse the employer side, and candidates preparing for legal professional exams.
cases.prompt:
我是一名实习仲裁员，下周要主持一起劳动人事争议仲裁案件，想演练居中裁判（仲裁员）这一侧。请补齐申请人（劳动者）和被申请人（用人单位）双方及其代理人的全部角色，我演仲裁员。

案情如下（脱敏虚构，直接沿用）：
- 劳动者李某 2019 年 3 月入职澜石半导体有限公司（统一社会信用代码 91440101MA3C00003Z，注册地：广州市黄埔区）任设备维护员，月工资 3500 元，订立 2 年期劳动合同。
- 合同内附竞业限制条款：离职后 1 年内不得到有竞争关系的单位就职，公司按月支付当地最低工资标准 30% 作为补偿，违约金 20 万元。
- 2021 年 3 月合同到期终止，李某入职另一家同类设备公司任维护员。
- 用人单位（澜石半导体）为申请人，请求裁决李某支付竞业限制违约金 20 万元；李某抗辩自己设备维护岗不掌握商业秘密，非竞业限制适格主体。

请按仲裁轨走完开庭身份核对、调查、举证质证、辩论、最后陈述、调解征询、收尾研判的完整流程。我演仲裁员，所以不要替主持人推进程序；当我可能遗漏法定必经环节（告知权利义务、询问回避、征询最后意见、先行调解）时，请以【程序提示】单独提醒我，并在我说「按你的判断继续」时才代为推进。

演练结束后请输出【复盘总结】，重点评估：程序完整性（法定必经环节有无遗漏）、争议焦点归纳是否准确穷尽、举证责任分配是否规范、当庭认证与释明是否越界。
cases.prompt_en:
I am an intern arbitrator who will preside over a labor dispute arbitration next week and want to rehearse the role of the neutral adjudicator. Please fill in all roles for both parties — the applicant (worker) and the respondent (employer) — and their agents; I will play the arbitrator.

Facts (anonymized and fictional; use as given):
- Worker Li joined Lanshi Semiconductor Co., Ltd. (unified social credit code 91440101MA3C00003Z, registered in Huangpu District, Guangzhou) in March 2019 as an equipment maintainer, monthly wage 3,500 CNY, under a 2-year labor contract.
- The contract contains a non-compete clause: for 1 year after leaving, he may not work for a competing company; the company pays 30% of the local minimum wage monthly as compensation, with a penalty of 200,000 CNY.
- The contract expired in March 2021; Li then joined another similar equipment company as a maintainer.
- The employer (Lanshi Semiconductor), as applicant, requests an award that Li pay a non-compete penalty of 200,000 CNY; Li argues that his equipment-maintenance post does not expose him to trade secrets and that he is not a proper subject of a non-compete covenant.

Proceed through the full arbitration track: identity check at opening, investigation, presentation and examination of evidence, debate, closing statements, mediation inquiry, and closing analysis. Since I play the arbitrator, do not advance the procedure on my behalf; when I may miss a mandatory procedural step (informing rights and obligations, asking about recusal, soliciting final statements, pre-award mediation), remind me separately as [Procedural Tip], and only advance on my behalf when I say "proceed at your discretion".

After the rehearsal, output a [Review Summary] focusing on: procedural completeness (any missing mandatory steps), accuracy and exhaustiveness of the dispute-focus framing, the propriety of burden-of-proof allocation, and whether on-the-spot authentication and interpretation overstepped.

cases.title_en: Court Trial Rehearsal: Salary Cut After Pregnancy
cases.subtitle: 法院一审旁观全演，9 组证据逐轮质证攻防
cases.subtitle_en: Full court-trial rehearsal with line-by-line evidence cross-examination
cases.description:
开庭最怕的就是对方代理人质证时步步紧逼。这个案例演示了如何用劳动争议庭审演练 Skill 旁观一场完整的法院一审——怀孕后变相调岗降薪的工资差额纠纷，从宣布开庭、法庭调查、举证质证到辩论、宣判全流程走通，重点把 9 组证据的出示、三性质证与回应逐轮演细，并给出复盘总结和一套可直接照读的劳动者代理人质证话术。

适合：即将开庭的劳动者与代理律师、HR 与公司法务演练单位侧抗辩、法学院学生与法学爱好者学习庭审流程。
cases.description_en:
The scariest moment in court is when the opposing counsel attacks your evidence line by line. This case shows how to use the labor dispute hearing rehearsal Skill to watch a complete first-instance court trial — a wage-difference dispute over disguised demotion after pregnancy — covering everything from court opening and investigation to evidence cross-examination, debate and judgment, with 9 pieces of evidence examined in full, followed by a review summary and a ready-to-read cross-examination playbook for the worker's counsel.

Suitable for: workers and lawyers about to appear in court, HR and in-house counsel rehearsing the employer's defense, and law students learning trial procedure.
cases.prompt:
我想旁观一场劳动争议法院一审，重点看「怀孕后变相调岗降薪」的举证质证。请按《劳动合同法》（2008 年施行）及女职工劳动保护相关规定的现行口径演练。

案情（脱敏，可直接沿用）：赵某 2022 年 1 月入职知远教育科技有限公司，任课程研发工程师；合同约定项目期间月工资为基本工资 3000 元＋项目岗位津贴 14000 元，等待项目期间仅领基本工资。2023 年 2 月赵某告知怀孕，公司未协商即宣布其退出项目组，此后按 3000 元/月发放孕期工资。赵某起诉请求按 17000 元/月补齐孕期工资差额。

要求：
1. 我旁观全演（三方都由你扮演），举证质证做细，其余环节带过但要完整（宣布开庭、身份核对、法庭调查、举证质证、法庭辩论、最后陈述、调解征询、宣判并告知上诉权）；
2. 归纳无争议事实与争议焦点，引用法条须给准条号（《劳动合同法》第三十五条、《女职工劳动保护特别规定》第五条第六条、《妇女权益保障法》第四十八条、《劳动争议调解仲裁法》第六条、《劳动争议司法解释（一）》第四十四条）；
3. 走完写【复盘总结】，并给「如果我是劳动者代理人，质证怎么应对」——逐份证据的应对话术与庭审节奏控制技巧；
4. 输出标注【演示作答】，并声明本模拟仅为庭审演练参考、不构成正式法律意见。

cases.subtitle_en: Unlawful dismissal compensation dispute - full adversarial rehearsal on the arbitration track (statement & evidence cross-examination)
cases.description:
下周三要上劳动仲裁庭，最怕的就是一开口就慌、证据被对方一顿质证就崩。这个案例用「林某诉星澜科技违法解除赔偿金案」完整走了一遍仲裁轨全程：身份核对、调查陈述答辩、举证质证、辩论、最后陈述、先行调解、闭庭，仲裁员在调查环节主动发问把三次通宵值守任务的细节、员工手册民主程序、工会通知、工资构成全部问透；单位代理人按真实庭审口径打「严重违纪+手册有效」抗辩，六组证据逐项三性攻防，微信记录还做了当庭核验原始载体。演练结束输出五维复盘：流程表现、四段可直接照读的话术改写版、10 项庭前准备清单、证据薄弱点与补强建议、对方抗辩核心与和解底线反推（含 70%-80% 胜诉概率研判）。

适合：即将参加劳动仲裁或劳动争议诉讼开庭的劳动者；想练举证质证和调查答辩的当事人；HR、公司法务想从单位视角预判风险；法学生和法律从业者做庭审演练教学。
cases.description_en:
Going to a labor arbitration hearing next week? The worst part is freezing up when you speak and watching your evidence fall apart under cross-examination. This case walks through the full arbitration-track hearing using the "Lin v. Xinglan Tech unlawful dismissal" dispute: identity verification, statement and defense, evidence presentation and cross-examination, debate, closing statements, mediation, and adjournment. The arbitrator actively questions details of the three overnight duty tasks, the employee handbook's democratic procedure, union notification, and salary composition; the employer's counsel mounts a real "gross misconduct + valid handbook" defense, and all six evidence exhibits face three-aspect challenges, with the WeChat records verified against the original device in court. After the rehearsal, a five-dimension review follows: process performance, four ready-to-read rewritten scripts, a 10-item pre-hearing checklist, evidence weaknesses and reinforcement advice, and a reverse-engineering of the employer's true defense core and settlement floor (including a 70%-80% win-probability assessment).

Ideal for: workers about to attend labor arbitration or litigation hearings; parties wanting to practice evidence and statement skills; HR and in-house counsel stress-testing risk from the employer side; law students and legal professionals teaching hearing rehearsal.

cases.prompt:
我下周要参加劳动仲裁开庭，想完整演练一遍。我演申请人本人（劳动者林某），请你补齐仲裁员和单位代理人两个角色，按仲裁轨（申请人/被申请人）的称谓和顺序，把开庭身份核对、调查陈述答辩、举证质证、辩论、最后陈述、调解征询、收尾研判全程走完。

案卷材料如下（脱敏模拟）：申请人林某，2020 年 6 月 1 日入职星澜科技有限公司任后端开发工程师，月薪基本工资 12000 元+绩效津贴 8000 元共 20000 元；2022 年 8 月 31 日公司以《员工手册》第 18 条「连续三次拒绝服从上级工作安排，属于严重违纪」为由单方解除；林某主张三次被拒任务系直属上级深夜安排的「通宵值守、次日照常到岗」且与本职开发无关的变相强迫加班要求，公司亦未事先将解除理由通知工会。仲裁请求：违法解除劳动合同赔偿金 100000 元（20000 元×2.5 年×2）。证据清单：劳动合同（原件）、解除通知书（原件）、员工手册节选（PDF 打印件）、上级工作安排微信聊天记录（可当庭演示）、工资银行流水（打印件）、钉钉考勤记录（可登录演示）。

请按常规难度，重点练调查阶段的陈述与答辩、举证质证两个环节，主持人在调查环节主动发问澄清细节（三次任务内容、手册民主程序与公示、工会通知、工资构成）。我方主张：任务属变相强迫加班的不合理安排、拒绝不构成违纪；手册条款「无需支付经济补偿」违反强制性规定无效；未通知工会程序违法。单位抗辩：手册经民主程序制定并公示、签收有效；三次拒绝属实构成严重违纪；绩效津贴属浮动不计入基数。演练结束后输出【复盘总结】：流程表现、话术打磨（给出可直接照读的改写版）、庭前准备清单、证据薄弱点与补强建议、对方策略研判（反推单位真正的抗辩核心与和解底线）。全程用【仲裁员】【申请人】【被申请人代理人】标注发言角色。
cases.prompt_en:
I will attend a labor arbitration hearing next week and want a full rehearsal. I will play the applicant himself (worker Lin). Please fill in the arbitrator and the employer's agent, and run the whole arbitration-track process in order (applicant/respondent): opening and identity verification, statement and defense, evidence presentation and cross-examination, debate, closing statements, mediation inquiry, and closing analysis.

Case materials (desensitized simulation): Applicant Lin joined Xinglan Technology Co., Ltd. on June 1, 2020 as a backend developer, monthly salary 12,000 RMB base + 8,000 RMB performance allowance = 20,000 RMB total; on August 31, 2022 the company unilaterally terminated under Article 18 of the Employee Handbook ("three consecutive refusals to obey work arrangements constitute gross misconduct"); Lin claims the three refused tasks were late-night "overnight duty with normal attendance the next day" assignments unrelated to his development work, i.e., disguised forced overtime, and that the company did not notify the union of the dismissal reason in advance. Arbitration claim: 100,000 RMB compensation for unlawful dismissal (20,000 x 2.5 years x 2). Evidence list: labor contract (original), dismissal notice (original), employee handbook excerpt (PDF printout), WeChat chat records of work assignments (can be demonstrated in court), bank salary statements (printout), DingTalk attendance records (can be logged in for demonstration).

Use regular difficulty and focus on two phases: statement/defense during investigation and evidence cross-examination; the arbitrator should proactively question details (content of the three tasks, handbook democratic procedure and publicity, union notification, salary composition). Our position: the tasks were unreasonable disguised forced overtime and refusal does not constitute misconduct; the handbook clause "no economic compensation" is void for violating mandatory provisions; failure to notify the union is a procedural violation. Employer defense: the handbook was adopted through democratic procedure, publicized and signed for; the three refusals constitute gross misconduct; performance allowance is variable and excluded from the base. After the rehearsal, output a [Review Summary]: process performance, script polishing (provide ready-to-read rewritten versions), pre-hearing preparation checklist, evidence weaknesses and reinforcement advice, and opponent strategy analysis (reverse-engineer the employer's true defense core and settlement floor). Mark speakers throughout as [Arbitrator], [Applicant], [Respondent's Agent].

cases.title: 劳动争议仲裁前证据材料梳理清单
cases.title_en: Pre-Arbitration Evidence & Material Checklist for Labor Disputes
cases.subtitle: 以同一套事实—证据框架，梳理工资、加班、解除争议的对应关系与应核验规则
cases.subtitle_en: One fact-evidence framework to map wage, overtime and termination disputes to the rules and deadlines to verify
cases.description:
劳动仲裁最让人头疼的不是不会写申请书，而是拿到一堆聊天截图、考勤碎片却理不清「哪些事实有证据、哪些还是缺口」。这个案例把这些散乱材料收敛成一张可核对的时间线与举证矩阵。

案例演示腾讯电子签资深合同法务专家如何用同一套「事实—证据」框架，为劳动者和用人单位中立梳理入职、岗位与薪酬、考勤与加班、绩效、工资支付、解除与离职交接七维时间线，并先核验仲裁时效、前置程序、举证责任与仲裁委材料规则，未核验处标注「待核验」。

适合：准备申请劳动仲裁的劳动者、被员工提起仲裁的用人单位 HR 与法务、需要诉前证据材料梳理的劳动争议当事人。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of labor arbitration is not writing the application, but making sense of scattered chat screenshots and attendance fragments — knowing which facts have evidence and which are still gaps. This case turns that mess into a checkable timeline and a burden-of-proof matrix.

It demonstrates how Tencent eSign's senior contract legal expert uses one neutral fact-evidence framework for both employees and employers, building a seven-dimension timeline (onboarding, position & pay, attendance & overtime, performance, wage payment, termination, and exit handover), and first verifies the arbitration time limit, precondition procedure, burden of proof and arbitration committee filing rules — marking anything unverified as “to be verified against official sources”.

Best for: employees preparing to file labor arbitration, employers and HR/legal responding to employee claims, and anyone who needs a pre-litigation evidence & material checklist.

cases.prompt: 我是劳动者，入职两年后被公司通知解除劳动关系，尚有绩效工资和加班费争议。我已保留劳动合同、工资流水、考勤截图、解除通知、部分工作聊天和邮件。请按入职、岗位与薪酬约定、考勤与加班、绩效、解除过程、工资支付、仲裁请求与证据七个维度建立事实时间线和材料核对表；对仲裁时效、前置程序、举证责任及当地仲裁提交要求先核验，未核验处标注“待核验”。请区分已知事实、待确认事实和证据缺口，给出中立的下一步行动，不评价案件胜负。
cases.prompt_en: I am an employee who was notified of termination of the employment relationship after two years of service, and there are still disputes over performance pay and overtime pay. I have retained the labor contract, bank salary records, attendance screenshots, the termination notice, and some work chats and emails. Please build a fact timeline and material checklist across seven dimensions — onboarding, position and compensation terms, attendance and overtime, performance, the termination process, wage payment, and arbitration claims and evidence; first verify the arbitration time limit, the precondition procedure, the burden of proof and the local arbitration submission requirements, marking any unverified items as “to be verified against official sources”. Please distinguish known facts, facts to be confirmed, and evidence gaps, and give neutral next steps without assessing the outcome of the case.

cases.title: togo罗仪涵的劳动法律师工作台
cases.subtitle: 仲裁时效、开庭、上诉期，一个页面全盯牢
cases.subtitle_en: Limitations, hearings, appeal deadlines — all tracked on one page
cases.description:
劳动法律师最怕的不是忙，而是仲裁时效、上诉期这类「错过一天就全盘皆输」的日子埋在日程里。

这个案例展示了一个专为劳动法律师打造的个人工作台：早上把日程整段粘进去，自动识别时间排好序，到点未完成立刻标红；仲裁时效、开庭、上诉期等关键日期单独登记，7 天内临期提醒、逾期高亮；下班前一键把今天的完成事项和案件进展归档成工作日志，按日期回看、导出 Markdown。数据落在资料库在线表格里，手机电脑同步。

适合：日常办理劳动争议案件的律师、需要同时盯多个案件关键节点的法律从业者、想把日程和案件管理收进一个干净页面的法律团队。
cases.description_en:
For labor lawyers, the real risk isn't being busy — it's the limitation periods and appeal deadlines buried in the calendar, the kind where missing a single day can lose the whole case.

This case shows a personal workbench built for labor lawyers: paste your morning schedule in one block and it auto-parses the times into a sorted checklist, with overdue items flagged in red; key dates like limitation periods, hearings and appeal deadlines are tracked separately with 7-day advance alerts and overdue highlighting; at the end of the day, one click archives completed items and case progress into a work log you can review by date and export as Markdown. All data lives in WorkBuddy Library tables, synced across phone and desktop.

Best for: lawyers handling labor dispute cases day to day, legal practitioners tracking critical deadlines across multiple matters, and legal teams who want schedule and case management in one clean page.

artifacts.label: 劳动法律师工作台（单体 HTML，中英双语）

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/d8xxW2NZAvSpIyQnppYmDK，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：

做一个「劳动法律师工作台」，整体样式和布局参考上述公开链接。

三个模块：
1. 今日日程：顶部多行文本框粘贴当天日程，一键解析每行中的时间（支持 09:00、下午2点、14点30分 等写法）并按时间升序展示为可勾选清单；已完成项自动划线，到点未完成项自动标红。
2. 时效与关键日期：表单录入事项名称、类型（仲裁时效/开庭日期/上诉期/举证期限/履行期限/其他）、关键日期、备注；列表按未处理优先、日期升序排列，7 天内临期橙色提醒、逾期标红，支持勾选已处理。
3. 工作日志：一键把今日已完成事项和临近关键日期归档为当天工作日志（今日完成事项/各事项进展/涉及文件清单三段式），按日期回看、点击展开全文、可下载 Markdown。

要求：单个完整 HTML 文件；高级简约风格，米白底 + 墨黑正文 + 古铜金点缀，大圆角卡片；CSS/JS 全部内联、无外部 CDN 依赖。制作完成后：① 将 HTML 存入我的资料库，并创建 3 张资料库数据表（今日日程/时效与关键日期/工作日志）与页面绑定，数据跨设备同步；② 将页面发布为公开链接并返回给我；在线表

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Use the WorkBuddy Library to clone this workbench for me in one click: https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/d8xxW2NZAvSpIyQnppYmDK — the data must be stored online and synced two-way. Prefer the one-click clone path; if that capability is unavailable, build it as follows: Build a "Labor Lawyer Workbench", using the public link above as the visual and layout reference. Three modules:
1. Today's Schedule: a multi-line text box at the top for pasting the day's plan; one click parses the time in each line (formats like 09:00, 2pm, 2:30 pm) and shows a sortable checklist — completed items are struck through, items past their time are flagged red.
2. Limitations & Key Dates: a form to enter matter name, type (limitation / hearing / appeal / evidence / performance / other), key date and notes; the list prioritizes unhandled items in ascending date order, with 7-day advance alerts in orange and overdue items in red, plus a handled checkbox.
3. Work Log: one click archives today's completed items and upcoming key dates into a daily work log (three sections: completed today / progress by matter / files involved), browsable by date, expandable to full text, downloadable as Markdown. Requirements: a single complete HTML file; a refined minimal style with an off-white background, ink-black text and bronze-gold accents, large rounded cards; all CSS/JS inlined with no external CDN dependencies. When done: ① save the HTML to my WorkBuddy Library and create 3 bound Library tables (today's schedule / limitations & key dates / work log) so data syncs across devices; ② publish the page to a public link and return it to me. Fall back to localStorage when the online-table SDK is unavailable.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 试用期用工合规风险分析报告
cases.title_en: Probationary Employment Compliance Risk Analysis Report
cases.subtitle: 一份可离线查看与复用的试用期用工合规分析报告
cases.subtitle_en: An offline, reusable compliance analysis report for probationary employment
cases.description:
痛点：试用期约定、工资标准、社会保险与解除程序相互关联，任何一个环节处理不当，都可能引发用工合规和劳动争议风险。

演示：本案例以可离线使用的交互式报告，清晰呈现试用期规则、工资和社保要求、解除六步审查、离职规则以及制度与证据清单；用户可直接修改和复制提示词，获得结合具体事实的进一步分析。

适用人群：适合用人单位管理者、人力资源与法务人员，以及需要核对试用期工资、社保和离职权益的劳动者。
cases.description_en:
Pain point: Probation terms, pay, social insurance and termination procedures are interrelated. An error in any one of them can create employment-compliance and labor-dispute risk.

Demonstration: This offline interactive report clearly presents probation rules, pay and social-insurance requirements, a six-step termination review, resignation rules, and policy and evidence checklists. Users can edit and copy the prompt for a further analysis based on their specific facts.

Who it is for: It is suitable for employer managers, HR and legal teams, and employees reviewing probation pay, social insurance and resignation rights.
cases.prompt: 公司准备与新员工签订劳动合同，并约定试用期；员工也希望确认自己的工资、社保和转正权益。请结合现行有效劳动法律法规，分析试用期应如何根据劳动合同期限合法约定、是否可以重复约定、试用期工资和社保应如何处理，以及公司在试用期内解除劳动合同、员工主动离职时分别需要满足哪些条件。请同时从公司和劳动者双方视角给出风险提示、操作步骤、材料清单和制度完善建议，并形成法律分析报告。
cases.prompt_en: The company plans to sign an employment contract with a new employee and agree on a probation period. The employee also wishes to confirm pay, social-insurance and confirmation-of-employment rights. Based on currently effective labor laws and regulations, analyze how probation should be lawfully agreed according to the contract term, whether it may be agreed repeatedly, how probation pay and social insurance should be handled, and what conditions respectively apply when the company terminates during probation or the employee resigns. Please provide risk prompts, operational steps, material checklists and policy-improvement recommendations from both employer and employee perspectives, and prepare a legal analysis report.

cases.title: 跨部门周会协作中枢
cases.subtitle: 用文档、日历、任务把周会变成可追踪闭环
cases.subtitle_en: Turn weekly syncs into a trackable loop with docs, calendar, and tasks
cases.description:
跨部门项目周会最头疼的不是把人拉到一个会议里，而是会前资料散、时间难约、会后动作总掉线。只要文档、日历、任务三套动作没有串起来，周会就会变成每周重复一次的口头同步。

这个案例把飞书套件里的 docs / calendar / task 三域连成一条周会闭环：会前用文档收敛议题与背景材料，用日历推荐时间块、查会议室并创建正式周会；会中继续在同一份文档里追加决议、风险和待确认项；会后再结合 task.tasks.create 的官方 schema，把行动项拆成负责人、截止时间、依赖关系和结构化字段，最终交付一份双语、单文件、可直接复用的 HTML 作战手册。

适合：负责跨部门项目推进的 PM / TPM、周会主持人、PMO / 运营同学、需要把会议纪要稳定转成任务跟进的团队负责人。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of a cross-team weekly sync is rarely getting people into one meeting. The real pain is scattered prep materials, hard scheduling, and follow-up items that disappear after the call. If docs, calendar, and tasks are not connected, the sync becomes the same verbal update every week.

This case links the docs / calendar / task domains inside the Lark Suite into one operating loop: before the meeting, docs gather agenda and context while calendar suggests time blocks, finds rooms, and creates the formal event; during the meeting, decisions, risks, and unresolved items are appended in the same document; after the meeting, the official task.tasks.create schema is used to turn outcomes into owners, due dates, dependencies, and structured fields, resulting in a bilingual, single-file HTML handbook that teams can reuse directly.

Fits: PMs and TPMs driving cross-functional initiatives, weekly sync facilitators, PMO and operations roles, and team leads who need meeting notes to become reliable follow-up work.

artifacts.label: 双语周会协作中枢作战手册页

cases.prompt: 请使用飞书套件（lark-unified）为“跨部门周会协作中枢”产出一个写入 output.html 的单文件 HTML。请围绕“产品发布前 6 周的跨部门周会”来组织内容：参会角色包括 PM、研发负责人、设计、运营和 PMO；页面要让人一眼看懂 docs / calendar / task 如何把会前预读、时间协调、会中决议、风险追踪、会后行动项串成一套周节奏。取材以官方来源为准：`lark-cli docs --help`、`lark-cli calendar --help`、`lark-cli task --help`、`lark-cli skills read lark-doc`、`lark-cli skills read lark-calendar`、`lark-cli skills read lark-task`、`lark-cli schema task.tasks.create`。请重点生成场景背景、周会运行节奏、角色分工、文档/日历/任务各自承接什么、关键字段设计、从会前到会后的闭环流程图、可复制命令示例、常见失效点、推荐落地顺序，以及适合哪些团队直接照搬。格式要求保持克制，只需保证是可交付的 HTML 页面即可。
cases.prompt_en: Use the Lark Suite skill (lark-unified) to create a new HTML page for "Cross-Team Weekly Sync Hub" and write it to output.html as a single-file deliverable. Organize the page around a cross-functional weekly sync during the six weeks before a product launch, with PM, engineering, design, operations, and PMO joining the cadence. Make the page show clearly how docs / calendar / task connect pre-read prep, time coordination, live decisions, risk tracking, and post-meeting action ownership into one operating loop. Ground the content in official sources: `lark-cli docs --help`, `lark-cli calendar --help`, `lark-cli task --help`, `lark-cli skills read lark-doc`, `lark-cli skills read lark-calendar`, `lark-cli skills read lark-task`, and `lark-cli schema task.tasks.create`. Focus on scenario setup, weekly operating rhythm, role split, what docs/calendar/task each own, key field design, an end-to-end flow from pre-meeting to follow-up, copyable command examples, common failure points, rollout order, and the kinds of teams that can reuse the pattern directly. Keep format requirements minimal and just make it a strong delivery page.

cases.title: 新人入职知识库启动包
cases.subtitle: 用 Wiki、Docs、IM 串起入职空间、文档沉淀与 FAQ 触达
cases.subtitle_en: Use Wiki, Docs, and IM to connect onboarding spaces, document capture, and FAQ reach-outs
cases.description:
新人入职最头疼的就是资料散、口径乱、消息靠人追。没有统一知识空间时，欢迎资料、设备开通、制度说明和高频 FAQ 很快就分散在群聊、个人文档和临时表里，新同学找不到入口，HRBP 和支持同学也会反复回答同样的问题。

这个案例基于 `lark-cli wiki/docs/im` 官方帮助、内置 domain skill 说明与 `wiki.spaces.create` schema，演示怎样规划一套“知识库建空间—文档沉淀—消息触达—FAQ 引导”的入职启动包，并交付为单文件中英双语 HTML，包含空间结构建议、节点层级示意、官方命令能力清单、关键命令示例与身份限制说明。

适合：HRBP 与企业文化团队、行政/IT 入职支持团队、部门知识库 owner、需要把 onboarding 资料标准化沉淀到飞书的业务团队。
cases.description_en:
New hire onboarding gets messy fast when materials live in too many places and every answer depends on a human chase. Without a single knowledge entry point, welcome notes, device setup steps, policy docs, and repeated FAQs scatter across chats, personal docs, and temporary sheets, leaving new joiners lost and support teams answering the same questions again and again.

This case is built from the official `lark-cli wiki/docs/im` help output, embedded domain skills, and the `wiki.spaces.create` schema to show how to design an onboarding starter kit that closes the loop from space creation to document capture, message reach-out, and FAQ guidance, delivered as a bilingual single-file HTML page with structure recommendations, hierarchy diagrams, official command coverage, copyable command examples, and identity constraints.

Suitable for: HRBP and culture teams, admin/IT onboarding support teams, department knowledge base owners, and business teams that want to standardize onboarding content in Lark.

cases.subtitle_en: Connect lead capture, status push, alerts, and follow-up with Sheets, IM, and Task
cases.description:
销售线索跟进最常见的问题，不是没有表，而是线索入口散、字段不统一、阶段推进靠口头同步、提醒全靠人工催。线索一旦从群聊、表单、活动名单流入团队，就很容易出现谁在跟、是否首触、多久未更新、哪些商机即将超时都说不清，最后台账有记录，动作却没有闭环。

这个案例围绕官方 `lark-cli sheets --help`、`lark-cli im --help`、`lark-cli task --help`、`lark-cli skills read lark-sheets`、`lark-cli skills read lark-im`、`lark-cli skills read lark-task` 与 `lark-cli schema task.tasks.create` 取材，演示如何把电子表格 typed table 写入与回读、下拉字段、公式校验、群聊检索与消息发送、任务清单创建、任务建立/更新/提醒串成一套“线索入表—进度推进—消息提醒—任务跟进”的运营台账模板，并交付为单文件中英双语 HTML 作战页。

适合：销售运营、SDR/BDR 团队负责人、渠道线索分发团队、商机培育流程 owner、正在用飞书做轻量 CRM/线索台账试点的业务团队。
cases.description_en:
The biggest problem in sales lead follow-up is rarely the absence of a spreadsheet. The real issue is fragmented lead entry points, inconsistent fields, stage updates handled verbally, and reminders driven by manual chasing. Once leads flow in from chats, forms, and event lists, teams quickly lose clarity on who owns a lead, whether the first touch happened, how long a row has been stale, and which opportunities are about to time out. The ledger exists, but the operating loop does not.

This case is grounded in the official `lark-cli sheets --help`, `lark-cli im --help`, `lark-cli task --help`, `lark-cli skills read lark-sheets`, `lark-cli skills read lark-im`, `lark-cli skills read lark-task`, and `lark-cli schema task.tasks.create` outputs. It demonstrates how to combine typed table writes and read-backs, dropdown fields, formula verification, chat discovery and messaging, tasklist creation, and task create/update/reminder operations into an operating template that closes the loop from lead entry to progress push, message alerting, and task follow-up, delivered as a bilingual single-file HTML control-room page.

Suitable for: sales operations teams, SDR/BDR managers, channel lead-routing teams, opportunity pipeline owners, and business teams using Lark as a lightweight CRM or lead ledger pilot.

cases.title: 离婚财产分割全攻略普法直播方案
cases.title_en: Divorce Property Division Legal Livestream Plan
cases.subtitle: 预热+脚本+转化+复盘，一份可直接开播的公益普法直播全流程方案
cases.subtitle_en: Promotion + script + conversion + review — a ready-to-broadcast full workflow plan
cases.description:
律师想做普法直播获客，最头疼的是不知道从哪下手：预热怎么铺、两小时说什么、互动怎么带、观众怎么转成咨询，全凭感觉凑，往往播到一半冷场。

这个案例演示了把「离婚财产分割」这个高频家事话题交给 AI，自动产出预热海报文案、15秒短视频脚本、社群话术、120分钟直播时间轴（暖场→核心讲解→互动答疑→服务介绍→收尾）、转化引导话术和复盘模板，并内置合规提醒（不承诺结果、不泄露隐私、案例脱敏），产出一份可直接开播的完整方案。

适合：婚姻家事律师、想通过直播打造个人 IP 的律师、律所市场运营人员，用于公益普法直播、专项答疑直播、获客转化直播的策划。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of running a legal-education livestream is knowing where to start: how to warm up the audience, what to say in two hours, how to drive interaction, and how to turn viewers into consultations — it's all improvised and often stalls midway.

This case shows how to hand the high-frequency topic "dividing marital property in divorce" to AI, which automatically produces poster copy, a 15-second short-video script, community warm-up messages, a 120-minute timeline (opening → core content → live Q&A → service intro → wrap-up), conversion scripts, and a review template — plus built-in compliance reminders (no outcome promises, no privacy leaks, anonymized cases) — yielding a plan ready to broadcast.

For: family-law lawyers, lawyers building a personal IP through livestream, and law-firm marketing staff planning public-education, Q&A, or lead-conversion livestreams.

artifacts.label: 离婚财产分割全攻略普法直播全流程方案

cases.prompt:
请帮我策划一场「离婚财产分割全攻略」公益普法直播，输出一份可直接开播的完整流程方案。

直播基本信息：
- 主题：离婚财产分割全攻略
- 目的：公益普法（专业展示 + 弱转化）
- 平台：抖音
- 时长：120 分钟
- 主讲：李律师（执业领域：婚姻家事）

请严格按照以下五大模块输出：
1. 预热宣传方案：预热海报文案、15秒短视频脚本、社群预热话术，以及直播前7天/3天/1天/2小时的分段预热时间线；
2. 开播准备清单：设备清单、材料准备、直播间设置；
3. 直播流程脚本：120分钟时间轴（开场暖场5分钟 → 核心内容讲解45分钟 → 互动答疑40分钟 → 服务介绍20分钟 → 收尾总结10分钟），核心内容覆盖四个知识点：夫妻共同财产认定、离婚财产分割原则、对方隐匿财产应对、离婚协议书写法；
4. 转化引导路径：私信引导、加群引导、福利引导的话术，以及合规注意事项（不承诺案件结果、不泄露客户隐私、案例脱敏、不生硬营销）；
5. 复盘总结模板：数据统计表、效果评估、问题分析、优化建议。

要求：法律内容专业准确，符合律师执业规范和平台直播规则；输出为一份自包含 HTML 文件（资源全内联、可离线打开），内置中英文双语切换。
cases.prompt_en:
Please plan a "Complete Guide to Dividing Marital Property in Divorce" public-education livestream and output a complete workflow plan ready to broadcast.

Basic info:
- Topic: Complete Guide to Dividing Marital Property
- Goal: public legal education (professional showcase + soft conversion)
- Platform: Douyin
- Duration: 120 minutes
- Host: Lawyer Li (practice area: family law)

Please output in the following five modules:
1. Pre-event promotion: poster copy, 15-second short-video script, community warm-up messages, plus a phased timeline at 7/3/1 days and 2 hours before;
2. Pre-live checklist: equipment, materials, room setup;
3. Livestream script: a 120-minute timeline (opening 5 min → core content 45 min → live Q&A 40 min → service intro 20 min → wrap-up 10 min), covering four knowledge points: identifying community property, property-division principles, dealing with hidden assets, and drafting a divorce agreement;
4. Conversion path: scripts for DM, group invite, and giveaway, plus compliance notes (no outcome promises, no privacy leaks, anonymized cases, no hard sell);
5. Review template: data statistics table, effect evaluation, problem analysis, optimization suggestions.

Requirements: legally accurate and professional, compliant with lawyer ethics and platform rules; output as a self-contained HTML file (all resources inlined, offline-openable) with built-in Chinese-English switching.

cases.title: 法律热点搜集与研判
cases.subtitle: 输入一个法律热点命题，自动召回权威来源、结构化研判，产出可直接排期的运营选题包
cases.subtitle_en: Feed it a legal topic and it auto-recalls authoritative sources, produces structured analysis, and outputs a publish-ready editorial package
cases.description:
律师做内容营销最头疼的两件事：一是没时间盯立法、司法、监管的最新动态，二是抓到一个热点却不知道怎么把它变成能涨粉、能获客的选题。

这个案例把「新公司法注册资本五年实缴」这个正在发酵的立法热点交给 AI，让它按「召回 → 研判 → 分发」三步走：先从中国政府网、国务院公报等 Tier 1 权威来源 + 市场监管总局等 Tier 2 专业源交叉验证核心事实，再输出带 legal_effect 分级、urgency 紧急度、争点地图的结构化热点底座，最后渲染成运营团队能直接排期的选题包——候选标题、钩子模板、格式建议、FAQ 引导一应俱全。虽然新规已于 2024 年落地，但因「存量公司过渡期截止日 2027-06-30」正在逼近，这个立法热点重新进入决策窗口期，被自动识别为 P0 优先级、可反复发酵。

适合：执业律师（内容营销/客户服务）、律师团队内容运营、企业法务合规预警。
cases.description_en:
For lawyers doing content marketing, two things are a constant headache: no time to track the latest legislative, judicial, and regulatory changes, and no idea how to turn a trending topic into client-winning content.

This case hands the brewing legislative topic of "five-year paid-in capital under the new Company Law" to AI, which runs a recall → analysis → distribution pipeline: it first cross-validates core facts from Tier-1 authoritative sources (gov.cn, SAMR), then produces a structured hotspot base with legal_effect grading, urgency flags, and an issue map, and finally renders a publish-ready editorial package — candidate titles, hook templates, format recommendations, and FAQ prompts included. Even the time-sensitive deadline (2027-06-30 transition cutoff) is automatically flagged as P0 priority.

For: practicing lawyers (content marketing / client service), law-firm content teams, and in-house counsel for compliance monitoring.

artifacts.label: 法律热点研判报告（运营选题包）

cases.prompt:
请调用「法律热点搜集与研判」技能，对近期公司/金融合规领域的法律热点进行搜集与结构化研判，输出运营选题包（视图 C）。

【检索参数】
• goals：operation（运营选题包）
• domain_scope：["公司", "金融合规"]
• time_window_days：7
• tone：严谨

【热点命题】
新《公司法》注册资本五年实缴新规及国务院配套规定（国务院令第 784 号）对存量公司的影响——重点聚焦 2027 年 6 月 30 日过渡期截止这一时效节点。

【输出要求】
1. 第一步：从 Tier 1 权威来源（中国政府网、市场监管总局、全国人大网等）与 Tier 2 专业源交叉检索，召回热点事实，不得编造来源
2. 第二步：输出结构化热点底座，含 hotspot_type、legal_effect 分级（confirmed/tendency/inferred/pending）、urgency、evergreen_potential、issue_map（争点）、applicability/exclusions（适用与排除条件）
3. 第三步：渲染视图 C 运营选题包，含 production_priority、候选标题、钩子模板、格式建议、FAQ 引导
4. 每条结论带 citations 锚点（来源名称/文号/链接），法条引用标注「以现行有效文本为准」
5. 输出 HTML 报告，供律师审核后使用，不替代专业法律意见
cases.prompt_en:
Invoke the Legal Hotspot Collection & Analysis skill to collect and structurally analyze recent legal hotspots in the corporate / financial-compliance domain, and output an editorial package (View C).

[Search parameters]
• goals: operation (editorial package)
• domain_scope: ["corporate", "financial compliance"]

The five-year paid-in capital rule under the new Company Law and its supporting State Council regulation (State Council Decree No. 784) and their impact on existing companies — with focus on the time-sensitive June 30, 2027 transition deadline.

2. Step 2: output a structured hotspot base including hotspot_type, legal_effect grading (confirmed/tendency/inferred/pending), urgency, evergreen_potential, issue_map, and applicability/exclusions
3. Step 3: render a View C editorial package with production_priority, candidate titles, hook templates, format recommendations, and FAQ prompts

cases.title: 知识库一问，跨页综述即成
cases.title_en: Ask Once, Get a Cross-Page Synthesis
cases.subtitle: 在企业知识库里检索一个专题词，AI 跨页聚合出一份带来源引用的知识综述
cases.subtitle_en: Search one topic in your knowledge base, and AI aggregates a cited synthesis across pages
cases.description:
知识散落在十几篇文档里，搜出来一堆结果还得自己一篇篇点开读、一段段摘录再手动拼成一篇，费时又容易漏。

输入一个专题词，腾讯云知在知识库里做跨页语义检索，把多个页面的命中内容聚合，AI 自动写成一份带来源引用的知识综述——每个论点都标注来源页面链接，像企业版 Perplexity，可点击溯源。

适合：知识运营、AI 产品经理、客服负责人、研究员等需要快速从内部知识库沉淀出结论的人。
cases.description_en:
Knowledge is scattered across a dozen docs; a search returns piles of hits and you still have to open each page, copy fragments, and stitch them together by hand — slow and error-prone.

Enter one topic keyword, and Tencent Yunzhi runs a cross-page semantic search over your knowledge base, aggregates the hits, and AI writes a cited synthesis — every point links back to its source page, like an enterprise Perplexity you can click to trace.

Best for: knowledge ops, AI product managers, support leads, and researchers who need to distill conclusions from an internal knowledge base fast.

artifacts.label: 知识综述报告

cases.prompt:
用腾讯云知（乐享）在我的知识库里检索「企业知识问答系统」相关内容，做一份带来源引用的知识综述。

步骤：
1. 围绕这个专题拆成 3 个方向的关键词（如 RAG 检索增强、Prompt 工程、Agent 智能体），分别调用云知的 search_kb_search 在知识库内做语义检索，记录每条 query 的命中数(total)与耗时(took_ms)。
2. 从各页面命中的正文高亮片段(snippet)中提取要点，跨多个页面聚合。
3. 把聚合内容组织成一篇连贯综述，分几节撰写；每处论点后用上标角标 [1][2][3] 标注来源，并在文末列出对应的来源页面标题与可点击链接(url)。

重要约束：所有内容、数字、页面标题和链接都必须来自云知知识库的真实检索返回，禁止编造任何数据；每个论点都要能溯源到具体来源页面链接。

最终输出为一份暗色科技感、信息密度高的单文件 HTML 报告：顶部标题区标明数据来源知识库；中部可视化展示检索过程（query / 命中数 / 耗时 →聚合流程）；正文综述带角标引用；下方列出来源引用列表（标题+链接+关键词标签）；底部给出结论与数据来源说明。所有资源内联，不引用任何外部字体、脚本或图片。
cases.prompt_en:
Use Tencent Yunzhi (Lexiang) to search my knowledge base for content about "enterprise knowledge Q&A systems" and produce a cited knowledge synthesis.

Steps:
1. Break the topic into 3 keyword angles (e.g. RAG retrieval augmentation, Prompt engineering, AI Agents) and call Yunzhi's search_kb_search for each to run semantic search inside the knowledge base; record each query's hit count (total) and latency (took_ms).
2. Extract key points from the highlighted body snippets returned for each page, aggregating across multiple pages.
3. Organize the aggregated content into a coherent multi-section synthesis; mark every point with superscript citations [1][2][3] and list the corresponding source page titles and clickable links (url) at the end.

Strict rule: every piece of content, number, page title, and link must come from the real search results of the Yunzhi knowledge base — fabricating any data is forbidden; every point must be traceable to a specific source page link.

Output a single-file HTML report with a dark, tech aesthetic and high information density: a header stating the source knowledge base; a mid-section visualizing the retrieval process (query / hits / latency → aggregation flow); the synthesis body with citation superscripts; a source reference list (title + link + keyword tags); and a footer with the conclusion and data-source note. Inline all resources — no external fonts, scripts, or images.

cases.subtitle_en: Turn a financial literacy PPT into a 3-minute hand-drawn animation
cases.description: 想把枯燥的理财知识变成生动好懂的手绘动画？这个案例展示了如何用手绘动画能力，把一份《资产与负债》理财PPT转化为一段3分钟的温暖扁平画风动画视频。视频从「100万选择测试」切入，区分资产与负债，剖析房子、车子背后的现金流真相，再到财富思维与消费顺序，适合理财博主、财经教育、自媒体知识可视化。
cases.description_en: Want to turn dry financial knowledge into a lively, easy-to-understand hand-drawn animation? This case demonstrates how to use the handdraw skill to transform a financial literacy PPT on Assets vs Liabilities into a 3-minute warm flat-illustration animation video. Starting from the 'What would you do with 1 million' test, the video distinguishes assets from liabilities, reveals the cash-flow truth behind houses and cars, and explains wealth thinking and consumption order. Suitable for finance bloggers, financial education, and knowledge visualization on social media.
cases.prompt: 读取《理财：资产与负债》PPT内容，提炼核心观点，用手绘动画的方式生成一个3分钟的温暖扁平画风动画视频。视频结构：从100万选择测试切入，对比富人/中产/穷人三种金钱去向；定义资产与负债，并以房子、车子为例揭示现金流真相；分析社会如何把负债包装成资产；讲解财富思维（沙子 vs 种子）、富人的消费顺序、负债的危险阶段；最后给出4个转身小行动。选用暖心扁平画风，画面只画看得见的具体事物，每页配一句简短口语化旁白。
cases.prompt_en: Read the PPT 'Finance: Assets and Liabilities', extract the core ideas, and generate a 3-minute warm flat-illustration hand-drawn animation video. Structure: start with the 'what to do with 1 million' choice test, compare how the rich, middle class, and poor spend money; define assets vs liabilities, using houses and cars to reveal cash-flow truths; analyze how society packages liabilities as assets; explain wealth thinking (sand vs seeds), the rich consumption order, and the dangerous stage of debt; end with four small turning-point actions. Use a warm flat illustration style. Draw only concrete, visible things. Each page has a short, colloquial narration.

Visual style: soft pink-purple gradients, rounded cards, generous whitespace, responsive on PC and mobile. Deliver a

This case turns information rights, resolution validity, related-party transactions, and derivative actions into an interactive legal risk report: copy-ready prompts, shareholder/company perspective filters, a procedural checklist, and a locally downloadable action list.

cases.prompt_en: A limited liability company has multiple shareholders. cases.subtitle_en: Pull your Kugou favorites and listening data into a magazine-style personal music almanac
cases.description:
听了这么多歌，却从没真正看清自己是怎么听歌的——收藏了上千首，反复循环的却总是那几首。这个案例调取酷狗音乐的收藏、最近播放和听歌统计，生成一份深色沉浸式的单文件 HTML 听歌报告：一句话画像、核心听歌数字、常听歌曲与歌手、曲风与语言偏好，还会挖出「收藏 × 实际播放」的反差、「熟悉 × 探索」的比例和「广度 × 深度」的性格，让你恍然「原来我是这样听歌的」。

适合：把音乐当空气的重度用户、想给年度歌单做个仪式感总结的人、爱在朋友圈晒高质感数据卡片的分享控。
cases.description_en:
You've listened to so much music, yet never really seen how you listen — thousands of songs saved, but only a handful on repeat. This case pulls your Kugou favorites, recent plays, and listening stats into a dark, immersive single-file HTML report: a one-line portrait, core listening numbers, top tracks and artists, genre and language preferences, plus the contrast between "saved vs. actually played," the ratio of "familiar vs. exploring," and the personality of "breadth vs. depth" — until you realize "so this is how I listen to music."

Ideal for: heavy listeners who treat music like air, anyone wanting a ceremonial wrap-up of their year in songs, and sharers who love posting high-quality data cards.

artifacts.label: 个人听歌画像报告页面

cases.prompt: 帮我做一个单文件 HTML 数据可视化页面，主题是「你的听歌画像」，调用 kugou skill 获取我的收藏、最近播放和听歌统计，并按实际可用时间范围生成个人听歌报告。采用高质感音乐杂志/数据展览风格，深色沉浸背景，用唱片、舞台灯光或耳机特写大图做 Hero（叠深色渐变蒙版保证标题清晰）。内容包含：一句话听歌画像、核心听歌数字、常听歌曲与歌手、曲风偏好、收藏 × 实际播放对比、我的听歌方式、音乐坐标、陪伴最久与最近靠近的声音、偏好变化和阶段总结。除常规排行外，重点发现收藏与回听、熟悉与探索、偏好广度与播放深度之间的关系，呈现有反差、有长期陪伴感或容易被忽略的个人听歌特点，让我感受到原来我是这样听歌的。采用分章节报告排版，结合大标题、大数字、轻量图表与错落分栏，避免大段榜单；数据不足的内容直接隐藏，兼容手机打开展示。内容必须静态预渲染进 HTML，绝不能依赖 JS 注入，所有 CSS/JS 和图片均内联，响应式布局。
cases.prompt_en:
Help me build a single-file HTML data visualization page themed "Your Listening Portrait." Call the kugou skill to fetch my favorites, recent plays, and listening stats, and generate a personal listening report based on the actually available time range.

Use a high-quality music-magazine / data-exhibition style with a dark, immersive background. Use a large image of a vinyl record, stage lighting, or a headphone close-up as the Hero (overlay a dark gradient mask to keep the title legible).

Content includes: a one-line listening portrait, core listening numbers, top tracks and artists, genre preferences, a "saved vs. actually played" comparison, how I listen, my music coordinates, the sounds that have stayed longest and the ones I've reached for recently, shifts in preference, and a phase summary. Beyond the usual rankings, focus on surfacing the relationships between saving vs. re-listening, familiar vs. exploring, and breadth of preference vs. depth of play — reveal the contrasts, the long-term companionship, and the easily overlooked personal listening traits, so I feel "so this is how I listen to music."

Use a sectioned report layout combining big headlines, big numbers, lightweight charts, and staggered columns; avoid long list rankings. Hide any content that lacks sufficient data, and make it work well on mobile. Inline all CSS/JS and images, use a responsive layout.

cases.description:
炒股最麻烦的不是看行情，而是持仓散在各个 App 里：想看总资产要自己手算汇率，想知道今天谁拖后腿得翻五六个页面，看过的研报转天就忘。

这个工作台把 28 只覆盖 A股/港美股/ETF/黄金/债券的示例持仓搬进资料库在线表：总览页实时算总资产、当日盈亏、资产分类和盈亏贡献榜；持仓页直接增删改、每日盈亏日历还原组合波动；诊断页自动扫集中度和深度套牢；资讯页多源聚合并标记持仓相关；还有一键生成的每日复盘（数据与推断分离）和个股研究（K线/基本面/财报/综合打分），有价值的消息随手收进研究心得。行情实时来自公开财经接口，心得与持仓多端同步。

适合：多市场持仓想一个面板看清全局的个人投资者、想把「看盘-研究-复盘-记笔记」串成一条流水的认真玩家，以及想做同款数据驱动工作台的人。
cases.description_en:
The annoying part of investing isn't checking quotes — it's holdings scattered across apps: total assets need manual FX math, finding today's drag means flipping six pages, and research you read yesterday is gone today.

This workbench moves 28 demo holdings across A-shares / HK / US stocks / ETFs / gold / bonds into library online tables: the overview computes total assets, day P&L, allocation and contributor boards in real time; the holdings page does CRUD with a daily P&L calendar; diagnostics scans concentration and deep losses; news aggregates multi-source feeds with holding relevance; plus a one-tap daily review (data vs. inference separated) and per-stock research (K-line / fundamentals / filings / overall score). Valuable items clip into research notes. Quotes stream from public finance APIs; notes and holdings sync across devices.

For: multi-market investors who want one pane of glass, serious players chaining watch → research → review → notes into one flow, and anyone building a data-driven workbench of their own.

artifacts.label: 路口理财工作台（双语自包含演示）

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/DjCSvayYNp5wZAROJjYoE4，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：
做一个「路口理财工作台」 理财驾驶舱，持仓与研究心得存资料库在线数据表（页面运行时读写，在表里加减记录后页面刷新即同步）。功能：①工作台总览——总资产/当日盈亏/总盈亏/总收益率/仓位 KPI（港美股按设置汇率折人民币），资产分类按市场与板块双图、组合走势曲线（近 60/120/250 日可切）、每日盈亏趋势、持仓结构热力图、当日与累计盈亏贡献榜、A股/港股/美股主要市场指数区；②我的持仓——表单新增/修改/删除持仓，按市值/当日盈亏/总盈亏/涨跌幅/权重排序，资产类型筛选，每日盈亏日历（基于日K还原组合每日盈亏、A股红涨绿跌）；③持仓诊断——健康度分布环形图、集中度体检（前三大权重/板块集中度/现金占比）、风险与机会自动扫描（单票偏高、深度套牢、接近成本线、涨停关注兑现）、持仓相关资讯热点；④财经资讯——多源聚合快讯与公告，去重、来源切换、关键词过滤、只看持仓相关、一键收藏到研究心得；⑤每日复盘——按当前行情快照一键生成，客观数据与规则推断分离标注，可复制/下载 Markdown；⑥标的研究——输入代码或全市场搜索名称，基本面画像（行业/市值/PE/PB/ROE）、技术面（日K蜡烛+均线+技术指标速览）、持仓关联、相关资讯与公告、财报列表、综合诊断打分；⑦研究心得——心得与收藏双类型笔记，标签筛选、全文搜索，存资料库数据表。行情与资讯实时取自公开财经接口（腾讯财经/东方财富等），可用现金与汇率在设置中调整。视觉为专业行情终端风：深色侧栏 + Bloomberg 式滚动行情条、红涨绿跌、ECharts 图表、顶部 LIVE 徽标，PC 优先并适配窄屏。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 7 张数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the library capability to clone this workbench in one click: https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/DjCSvayYNp5wZAROJjYoE4, with online data storage and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click clone path; if unavailable, build as follows:
Build a 'Crossroads Finance Desk' as a finance cockpit. Holdings and research notes are stored in library online data tables (read/written at runtime; records added or removed in the table appear after refresh). Features: 1) Overview — KPIs for total assets / day P&L / total P&L / total return / position (HK & US stocks converted to CNY at your FX rates), allocation by market and by sector, portfolio curve (switchable 60/120/250 days), daily P&L trend, holdings treemap, day and cumulative P&L contributor boards, and A-share / HK / US index panels. 2) Holdings — add/edit/delete via forms, sort by value / day P&L / total P&L / change / weight, asset-type filter, and a daily P&L calendar reconstructed from daily bars (red = up, A-share convention). 3) Diagnostics — health-mix donut, concentration check (top-3 weights / sector concentration / cash ratio), automatic risk & opportunity scan (single-stock heavy, deeply underwater, near breakeven, limit-up watch), and news on your holdings. 4) News — aggregated flashes and exchange filings with dedup, source switching, keyword filter, holdings-only filter, and one-click clip into notes. 5) Daily review — one-tap generation from the current snapshot with data vs. inference clearly tagged; copy or download as Markdown. 6) Research — enter a code or search by name across markets; fundamentals profile (industry / market cap / PE / PB / ROE), technicals (daily candlestick + MAs + indicator snapshot), position link, related news & filings, financial reports, and an overall score. 7) Notes — note/clip types with tag filter and full-text search, stored in a library table. Quotes and news come live from public finance APIs (Tencent / EastMoney); cash and FX rates are editable in Settings. Visual: pro trading-terminal style — dark sidebar + Bloomberg-style scrolling ticker, red-up/green-down, ECharts, LIVE badge; PC-first with narrow-screen support.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus 7 data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 投资并购股权尽职调查
cases.subtitle: 系统跑通十部分核查，挖出代持、隐藏担保、专利瑕疵、关联交易四大红旗
cases.subtitle_en: A full 10-part review surfacing nominee holdings, hidden guarantees, IP defects and related-party deals
cases.description:
收购一家公司最怕的就是踩坑——表面上光鲜，背后却藏着代持、隐藏担保、专利归属不清这些看不见的债务。

这个案例演示了把一家 Pre-B 轮医疗器械公司的尽调资料交给 AI，按律所十大部分框架逐项核查，结合 16 维风险矩阵量化，最终挖出股权代持、2000 万未披露连带担保、离职 CTO 核心专利归属瑕疵、实控人关联采购四大红旗，并给出解决方案与交易定价建议。

适合：投行 / PE / VC 尽调分析师、公司法务、并购律师、创业者在收购或投资前的快速自查。
cases.description_en:
The scariest part of acquiring a company is the hidden risk — nominee holdings, undisclosed guarantees, and unclear patent ownership lurking beneath a clean surface.

This case hands a Pre-B medical-device company's diligence materials to AI, which runs a law-firm-grade 10-part review plus a 16-dimension risk matrix, surfacing four red flags: nominee holdings, an undisclosed RMB 20M joint guarantee, a departed CTO's core-patent ownership defect, and related-party procurement — each with a fix and a deal-pricing suggestion.

For: investment-banking / PE / VC due-diligence analysts, in-house counsel, M&A lawyers, and founders doing a pre-deal self-check.

artifacts.label: 尽调报告（HTML）

cases.prompt:
请调用「公司股权尽职调查」技能，对目标公司「杭州智行医疗科技有限公司」执行投资并购（M&A）场景的全面深度尽职调查，出具律所实务结构报告。

【目标公司内部资料】
• 全称：杭州智行医疗科技有限公司；统一社会信用代码：91330108MA2HXXXXXX；成立日期：2020-03-12；注册资本1000万元、实缴850万元；注册地：杭州市滨江区；经营范围：二类医疗器械研发、生产、销售
• 股权结构（Pre-B轮）：创始人张某某28%（其中8%系为已离职CTO王某某代持、无书面协议）、联合创始人李某某20%、天使投资人王某12%、A轮机构启明创投20%、B轮机构远山资本18%、员工持股平台智行合伙2%
• 历史沿革：2020年设立（张60%/李40%）→ 2021年天使轮 → 2023年A轮（含一笔张某某向王某某的0元转让）→ 2025年B轮
• 主要财产：1款二类器械注册证（电子血压计，2027年到期）；核心在研专利「便携式血糖检测方法」发明人为已离职CTO王某某，无职务发明归属协议
• 债权债务：为实控人张某某控制的「杭州智联贸易有限公司」提供2000万元连带责任保证，未在财报披露
• 关联交易：2025年向智联贸易采购原材料占营业成本35%，未履行关联交易决策程序
• 财务：2025年营收约1.2亿元、净利润约800万元、经营性现金流为负
• 劳动人事：员工约150人（研发占40%），约30%员工社保按最低基数缴纳
• 诉讼：1起未决供应商货款纠纷（标的约300万元）

【尽调要求】
1. 场景=投资并购，深度=全面（十部分全覆盖）
2. 按十部分核查框架逐项核查，每部分标注风险评级（正常/需关注/[红旗]）+ 信息来源
3. 结合16维风险矩阵，标注每维度风险类型与红旗量化（金额/比例/整改成本）
4. 发现[红旗]→深度分析，汇总至报告第一部分
5. 结论须转化为投资协议附件建议（陈述与保证/交割条件/赔偿条款）
6. 附免责声明；引用法条需联网核实或标注【待核实】
7. 输出格式：单文件 HTML（全内联样式、无外部依赖，可直接浏览器打开/打印/导出 PDF）；16 维风险矩阵以 HTML 表格内嵌呈现，不单独输出 Excel/Word
cases.prompt_en:
Invoke the Company Equity Due Diligence skill to run a full-depth M&A due diligence on the target company Hangzhou Zhixing Medical Technology Co., Ltd., and produce a law-firm-style structured report.

[Target company internal data]
• Full name: Hangzhou Zhixing Medical Technology Co., Ltd.; USCC: 91330108MA2HXXXXXX; founded: 2020-03-12; registered capital RMB 10M, paid-in RMB 8.5M; registered in Binjiang District, Hangzhou; scope: R&D, manufacture and sales of Class II medical devices
• Shareholding (Pre-B): founder Zhang XX 28% (of which 8% is nominee-held for the departed CTO Wang XX, no written agreement), co-founder Li XX 20%, angel investor Wang X 12%, Series A firm Qiming Ventures 20%, Series B firm Yuanshan Capital 18%, ESOP platform Zhixing Partnership 2%
• History: 2020 incorporation (Zhang 60% / Li 40%) -> 2021 angel round -> 2023 Series A (incl. a RMB 0 transfer from Zhang to Wang) -> 2025 Series B
• Key assets: 1 Class II device registration (electronic blood-pressure monitor, exp. 2027); core in-development patent "Portable Blood Glucose Detection Method" names the departed CTO Wang XX as inventor, with no service-invention ownership agreement
• Debts: provided a RMB 20M joint guarantee for Hangzhou Zhilian Trading Co., Ltd. controlled by actual controller Zhang XX, undisclosed in financial statements
• Related-party transactions: 2025 raw-material purchases from Zhilian Trading = 35% of operating cost, without related-party approval procedures
• Financials: 2025 revenue ~RMB 120M, net profit ~RMB 8M, negative operating cash flow
• HR: ~150 employees (R&D 40%), ~30% of employees on minimum social-insurance base
• Litigation: 1 pending supplier payment dispute (~RMB 3M)

[DD requirements]
1. Scenario = M&A, depth = full (all 10 parts covered)
2. Review each part of the 10-part framework, tagging risk rating (Normal / Attention / [Red Flag]) + information source
3. Apply the 16-dimension risk matrix, tagging each dimension's risk type and red-flag quantification (amount / ratio / remediation cost)
4. Deep-dive each [Red Flag] and summarize in Part 1 of the report
5. Convert findings into investment-agreement annex suggestions (representations & warranties / closing conditions / indemnity clauses)
6. Include a disclaimer; verify cited statutes online or tag as [To verify]
7. Output format: a single self-contained HTML file (inline styles, no external dependencies, openable in any browser, printable, and exportable to PDF); render the 16-dimension risk matrix as an embedded HTML table, not as a separate Excel/Word file

cases.title: 中国宏观经济仪表盘
cases.subtitle: 一页看懂GDP·CPI·PMI·M2·社融
cases.subtitle_en: GDP, CPI, PMI, M2 & AFRE at a glance
cases.description:
想快速了解中国经济现在到底冷还是热，却要在国家统计局、人民银行、各类研报之间来回翻？数字散、口径乱、还容易拿到过时数据。

这个案例用 NeoData 金融搜索服务实时查询 GDP、CPI、制造业 PMI、M2、社融和经济事件日历，一键生成一张浅色专业风的单文件 HTML 宏观仪表盘：温度结论、核心指标卡片、近几期趋势图、事件日历一应俱全，红升绿降、荣枯线一眼看清，还能中英切换、离线打开。

适合：
- 需要定期盯宏观的投研/策略人员
- 想做经济简报的财经自媒体与分析师
- 关注货币与物价走势的企业决策者
- 学习宏观指标口径的学生与爱好者
- 想要可复现数据看板的效率工具用户
cases.description_en:
Want to quickly gauge whether China's economy is running hot or cold, but tired of jumping between the statistics bureau, the central bank and scattered research reports? Numbers are fragmented, definitions inconsistent, and it's easy to grab stale data.

This case uses NeoData Financial Search to query GDP, CPI, manufacturing PMI, M2, aggregate financing and the economic calendar in real time, then generates a clean, professional single-file HTML macro dashboard: a temperature verdict, core indicator cards, recent trend charts and an event calendar — red-up/green-down and the 50 boom-bust line at a glance, with EN/ZH toggle and offline support.

Good for:
- Research/strategy staff who track macro regularly
- Finance creators and analysts making economic briefs
- Corporate decision-makers watching money and prices
- Students learning macro indicator definitions
- Productivity users who want a reproducible data dashboard
cases.prompt:
用 NeoData 金融搜索服务，实时查询中国最新一期的 GDP（同比增速与当期值）、CPI（同比与环比）、制造业 PMI、M2 货币供应量同比、社会融资规模，以及近期重要经济事件日历（如美联储 FOMC 利率决议、CPI/GDP 发布的前值/预测/现值）。务必先通过 NeoData 官方查询取到最新真实数据，不要凭记忆作答，也不要混用其他数据源；若某项查询为空就更换措辞重试。

拿到数据后，生成一张「中国宏观经济仪表盘」，产物为单文件 HTML：包含一句话经济温度结论、核心指标卡片组（GDP/CPI/PMI/M2/社融，各含最新值、同比与简短解读）、指标近几期趋势图、经济事件日历表（事件/时间/前值/预测/现值）、复现查询清单，以及口径与风险提示。

样式方向：浅色专业金融风、信息密度高，指标变化用红升绿降（PMI 高于 50 荣枯线可强调），单文件 HTML、资源全部内联、可离线打开。
cases.prompt_en:
Use the NeoData Financial Search service to query China's latest GDP (YoY growth and level), CPI (YoY and MoM), manufacturing PMI, M2 money supply YoY, aggregate financing (AFRE), and the recent key economic calendar (e.g., Fed FOMC rate decisions and the previous/forecast/actual for CPI/GDP releases). Always fetch the latest real data via NeoData's official query first — do not answer from memory and do not mix in other data sources; if a query returns nothing, retry with alternate phrasing.

With the data in hand, generate a "China Macro-Economy Dashboard" as a single-file HTML: include a one-line economic-temperature verdict, a group of core indicator cards (GDP/CPI/PMI/M2/AFRE, each with the latest value, YoY change and a short read), recent trend charts, an economic calendar table (event/time/previous/forecast/actual), a reproduce-query checklist, and methodology & risk notes.

Style direction: clean professional finance look, high information density, red-up/green-down for changes (highlight PMI above the 50 boom-bust line), single-file HTML with all resources inlined and offline-capable.

cases.description_en:
This report comprehensively analyzes the pricing strategies of 5 mainstream SaaS project management tools: Notion, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, and Teambition.

The report covers detailed pricing tier comparisons, per-user monthly cost calculations, core differentiating feature analysis, user review summaries, and pricing trend observations over the past two years.

Based on the competitive analysis results, it provides targeted pricing strategy recommendations to help product teams develop a competitive pricing structure.

cases.prompt: 帮我做一份 SaaS 项目管理工具竞品定价分析报告。对比 5 款主流产品（Notion、Asana、Monday.com、ClickUp、Teambition）的定价策略，包含：各产品定价层级详细对比（免费版/专业版/企业版功能矩阵）、每用户月均成本计算、核心差异化功能分析、用户评价摘要（优缺点各 3 条）、定价趋势观察（近 2 年调价历史）、针对我们产品的定价策略建议。输出为结构化 Markdown 报告，含对比表格。
cases.prompt_en: Help me produce a competitor pricing analysis report for SaaS project-management tools. cases.subtitle: 按客户决策阶段匹配话术，附转化跟踪卡，把咨询变成可复用的转化工具
cases.subtitle_en: Match scripts to each client decision stage, with a conversion tracker to turn consultations into a reusable funnel tool
cases.description:
最怕客户问完问题扭头就走，白嫖一次咨询就没了下文。这个案例把婚姻家事律师的接待经验沉淀成一套「六段话术工作台」：从开场破冰、诊断提问、钩子留客、窗口期唤醒，到促成出口和异议收尾，每一段都附「为什么有效」和执业红线提示。

更关键的是内置了一张「转化跟踪卡」——记录客户决策阶段、关键事实、已用话术和下一步待办，数据只存在本机浏览器，帮助律师追踪每一位客户的转化进度，把一次性咨询变成可持续跟进的线索。

适合：婚姻家事律师、离婚业务律师、律所案源与咨询接待人员、准备做个人 IP 的执业律师。
cases.description_en:
Tired of clients asking a question and then disappearing after one free consultation? This case turns a family lawyer's reception experience into a six-stage script workbench: opening, diagnostic questioning, hook, urgency, closing, and objection handling — each with a "why it works" note and a professional red-line reminder.

More importantly, it includes a built-in conversion tracker that records each client's decision stage, key facts, scripts used, and next actions — all stored locally in the browser — helping lawyers follow up on every lead and turn one-off consultations into a lasting pipeline.

For: family & marriage lawyers, divorce practitioners, law firm intake and reception staff, and practicing lawyers building a personal brand.

artifacts.label: 六段话术工作台（含转化跟踪卡）

cases.prompt:
你是一位执业8年的婚姻家事律师，正在做个人 IP 与案源转化。请帮我生成一个「咨询转化六段话术工作台」，用于接待客户时按决策阶段快速调取话术并跟踪转化进度。

要求：
1. 分成六个阶段：开场破冰、诊断提问、钩子留客、窗口期唤醒、促成出口、异议收尾。每个阶段给出可背诵的话术原文，并附「为什么有效」的心理学/信任机制说明。
2. 话术要符合婚姻家事场景：开场先立身份、给安全感、强调「不一定都要请律师」；诊断阶段用领证时间/财产归属/孩子抚养三件事追问；钩子阶段给一半答案留一个待办；窗口期只讲客观的证据灭失与时间风险，不恐吓、不承诺结果。
3. 底部加一张「转化跟踪卡」，可填写客户脱敏称呼、咨询日期、当前决策阶段、关键事实（领证时间/财产/孩子）、已用话术、下一步待办、下次触达时间，并支持本地保存。
4. 页脚常驻执业安全红线：不承诺结果、不制造焦虑、正式交付须律师人工确认。

请以「单文件 HTML、资源全内联、可离线打开」的方式输出，视觉风格专业克制（深色标题 + 留白 + 单一强调色）。话术中的「你老公」「他」等表述保留，标注可按实际案情替换。
cases.prompt_en:
You are a family & marriage lawyer with 8 years of practice, building a personal brand and intake funnel. Generate a "Six-Stage Consultation Conversion Workbench" to quickly pull up scripts by decision stage and track conversion progress.

Requirements:
1. Six stages: opening, diagnostic questioning, hook, urgency, closing, and objection handling. Each stage provides a memorizable script plus a "why it works" explanation of the underlying trust mechanism.
2. Scripts must fit family-law scenarios: opening establishes identity and safety while stressing "you may not need a lawyer at all"; diagnostic stage probes three things (marriage registration date / property ownership / child custody); hook stage gives half an answer and leaves a follow-up task; urgency stage only states objective evidence-loss and time risks — no fear-mongering, no outcome promises.
3. Add a "conversion tracker" at the bottom for recording the client's anonymized name, consultation date, current stage, key facts (marriage date / property / children), scripts used, next actions, and next contact time, with local save support.
4. Keep a persistent professional red-line footer: no outcome promises, no fear-mongering, and formal deliverables require lawyer confirmation.

Output as a single-file HTML with all resources inlined and offline-capable, in a restrained professional style (dark headings + whitespace + a single accent color). Keep the original gendered expressions and note that they may be replaced per case.

cases.title: 数学教学工作台
cases.subtitle: 待办、课表、学情、成绩、座位、值日、家校沟通与健康打卡，一位数学老师的带班中枢
cases.subtitle_en: Todos, timetable, student tracking, scores, seating, duty roster, parent communication and health check-in — a homeroom hub for a math teacher
cases.description:
带两个班的数学老师，每天要在备课、批改、家长沟通和班级事务之间来回切换，信息散在微信群、备忘录和成绩单里。

这个工作台把日常收进一屏：首页是今日概览——今天要处理的待办（逾期的置顶标红）、今日课程、喝水打卡和教学进度；「数学教学」里课表、教学安排、题库、学情分析各归其位；「学情分析」按学生档案和成绩记录跟踪薄弱知识点，家校沟通单独留档；「班级管理」覆盖学生档案、座位安排（支持六列排座/四大组双列/小组合座三种布局自动排座）、值日表和常用网站；「身体健康」板块用喝水打卡联动首页。

数据层面 13 张表共用一套字段（模块区分），在线版数据落在资料库数据表、支持在线存储与双向同步；演示版内置 560 条示例数据。内置示例数据覆盖四年级 5 班/6 班的真实场景，打开即可对照使用。

适合：小学、初中带班老师，以及需要一套「教学—学情—班务」闭环管理的班主任。
cases.description_en:
A math teacher running two classes juggles lesson prep, grading, parent communication and class affairs — with information scattered across group chats, notes and grade sheets.

This workbench brings the day into one screen: a home overview with today's todos (overdue pinned in red), today's timetable, water check-in and teaching progress; a teaching hub with timetable, lesson plans, question bank and learning analytics; student tracking that follows each learner's weak points through score records, with parent communication archived separately; class management covering student profiles, seating (three layouts with auto-arrangement), duty roster and frequently-used sites; and a health section whose water check-in links back to the home screen.

Under the hood, 13 tables share one unified schema (a module field separates concerns); the online version stores data in Library database tables with two-way sync, while the demo build ships 560 built-in sample records covering real Grade-4 scenarios, ready to explore.

Best for: primary and middle school subject teachers, and homeroom teachers who want a closed loop across teaching, learning analytics and class affairs.

artifacts.label: 数学教学工作台（单文件演示版 HTML）

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/p7tnhDkbMoQGkisM3WhElR，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

做一个「数学教学工作台」，面向小学/初中带班数学老师，用 13 张数据表（共用一套字段，用「模块」字段区分业务：教学待办、课程表、学生跟踪、教学进度、学期设置、家校沟通、教学安排、题库、成绩记录、座位安排、值日安排、常用网站、健康打卡）管理班级日常。字段包括：模块（select）、事项名称、班级（select）、星期（number）、节次（number）、优先级（select）、状态（select）、关注程度（select）、课堂表现（select）、近期成绩（number）、薄弱知识点、家校沟通、计划课时（number）、完成课时（number）、截止日期（date）、备注、示例数据（checkbox）、单元、作业类型（select）、批改状态（select）、发送身份（select）、沟通要点等。

页面功能：首页今日概览（今日待办支持标记完成与顺延、逾期置顶标红、今日课程、喝水打卡与教学进度）；教学模块含课表视图、教学安排进度、题库与组卷、学生成绩录入（支持 CSV 解析预览导入）与班级成绩分析；学情分析含学生档案、重点关注与近期成绩趋势；班级管理含学生档案、座位安排（六列排座/四大组双列/小组合座三种布局、一键自动排座与清空）、值日表（按班级切换）与常用网站导航；身体健康含每日喝水打卡（目标杯数、撤销，与首页联动）与健康打卡记录。

视觉：浅色教育风、卡片化分区、左侧目录导航+顶部状态栏，状态用彩色徽章区分（优先级/批改状态/关注程度），PC 与移动端自适应。内置四年级 5 班/6 班示例数据，打开即可对照使用。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 13 张数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library capability to build a same-style copy of https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/p7tnhDkbMoQGkisM3WhElR with data stored online and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click same-style flow; if unavailable, build it as follows: Build a "Math Teaching Workbench" for primary/middle school math teachers, managing class routines with 13 data tables sharing one unified schema (a module field separates concerns: teaching todos, timetable, student tracking, teaching progress, term settings, parent communication, lesson plans, question bank, score records, seating, duty roster, favorite sites, health check-in). Fields include: module (select), item name, class (select), weekday (number), period (number), priority (select), status (select), attention level (select), class performance (select), recent score (number), weak points, parent communication, planned lessons (number), completed lessons (number), due date (date), notes, sample flag (checkbox), unit, homework type (select), grading status (select), sender identity (select), communication points, etc. Page features: a home overview (today's todos with complete/postpone actions, overdue pinned in red, today's timetable, water check-in and teaching progress); a teaching hub with timetable view, lesson-plan progress, question bank and paper assembly, score entry with CSV parse-preview import, and class score analysis; learning analytics with student profiles, key-attention list and recent score trends; class management with student profiles, seating (six-column / four-group paired / small-group layouts, one-click auto-arrange and clear), duty roster (switchable by class) and a site navigator; a health section with daily water check-in (goal cups, undo, linked to home) and check-in records. Visual: light education style, card-based sections, left navigation plus top status bar, colored badges for priority/grading/attention states, responsive for PC and mobile. Ships with Grade-4 Class 5/6 sample data ready to explore.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus 13 data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 自媒体运营工作台
cases.subtitle: 单文件 HTML 离线自媒体运营台，选题·脚本·发布·复盘一个台闭环
cases.subtitle_en: Single-file offline creator workbench — ideas, scripts, publishing & review in one place
cases.description:
做自媒体最累的不是写，是脑子里同时转着一堆事：这周写什么、开头怎么钩人、几点发、发完那条到底行不行——全散在备忘录和聊天记录里，越做越乱。

这个案例产出了一个完整的单文件 HTML 自媒体运营工作台，把博主每天/每周真正在重复的「招牌动作」串成一条飞轮：① 今日——灵感速记随手记（可一键转选题）+ 今天要做的智能提醒（逾期/待录数据）+ 连更里程碑徽章 + 每日激励；② 选题——每周选题会 4 步方法论 + 三类选题库（爆款/日常/系列）+ 一句话大纲 + 本周配比进度 + 爆款雷达（收集对标爆款自动聚合钩子/平台/赛道洞察）；③ 脚本——黄金 3 秒开头 6 公式 + 爆款结构模板（视频/图文切换）+ AI 拆解/写脚本指令生成器（把你的输入编排成专家级 prompt，复制到任意 AI 跑）+ 资产库；④ 发布——5 平台最佳时段 + 发布排期（逾期红标、可改期/删除）+ 发布后黄金 1 小时清单；⑤ 复盘——四率看板（完播/互动/关注/转化，图文视频自动切换指标）+ 曝光×涨粉双轴趋势 + 归因图（按选题库/钩子/时段/形态/平台切换）+ 自动判定爆了/达标/低于预期。视觉是小红书素人女生喜欢的珊瑚粉少女风，数据全存浏览器本地、零后端、完全离线，手机可加到桌面当 App。

适合：正在做号涨粉、希望把选题到复盘系统化沉淀下来的泛自媒体博主；图文和视频都发、需要一套能兼容两种数据口径的运营工具的创作者；想看一个「单文件 HTML + 原生 SVG 图表 + localStorage」完整运营台实现的前端开发者。
cases.description_en:
The exhausting part of being a creator isn't writing — it's juggling everything at once: what to post this week, how to hook the opening, when to publish, and whether that last post actually worked. It all ends up scattered across notes and chat logs, getting messier over time.

This case delivers a complete single-file HTML creator workbench that turns a blogger's real daily/weekly signature moves into one flywheel: (1) Today — quick idea capture (one-click convert to topic) + smart to-dos (overdue / data-to-log) + streak milestone badges + daily encouragement; (2) Topics — a 4-step weekly topic-meeting method + three topic libraries (viral / routine / series) + one-line outlines + weekly mix progress + a Viral Radar that collects benchmark hits and auto-aggregates hook / platform / niche insights; (3) Scripts — 6 golden-3-second opening formulas + viral structure templates (video / text toggle) + an AI prompt generator for teardown & scriptwriting (composes your input into an expert-level prompt to run in any AI) + an asset library; (4) Publish — best posting times for 5 platforms + a publishing schedule (overdue flags, editable / deletable) + a golden-first-hour checklist; (5) Review — a four-rate dashboard (completion / engagement / follow / conversion, auto-switching metrics for video vs. text) + a dual-axis reach×followers trend + an attribution chart (by library / hook / time slot / format / platform) + auto verdicts (viral / on-target / underperforming). The visual style is a soft coral "xiaohongshu girl" aesthetic; all data lives in the browser locally with zero backend, fully offline, and can be added to a phone home screen as an app.

Suitable for: general-interest creators growing an audience who want to systematize everything from topic selection to review; creators posting both text and video who need one tool compatible with both data models; frontend developers interested in a complete "single-file HTML + native SVG charts + localStorage" workbench implementation.

cases.title: 药品咨询
cases.subtitle: 家里的药弄明白：用途、用法用量、注意事项、靠谱购买渠道，一页讲清
cases.subtitle_en: Understand your medications in one page: uses, dosage, precautions, and trustworthy ways to get them
cases.description:
几乎每个家庭都有几盒常吃或刚配的药，但真正把它弄明白的人不多：治什么、怎么吃、要当心什么、吃完了去哪儿买——说明书字小又难懂，网上信息杂得不敢全信。药这件事，糊涂不得。

以抗凝药华法林为例：问微小医「这是什么药、怎么用、要注意什么、去哪买」，它会把用途、用法用量、出血的预警信号、食物药物的相互影响一条条讲清楚，还告诉你医院药房、实体药店、互联网医院三条靠谱的购买路径——生成一页用药指南，存图转给家人，吃药这件事就不再糊涂了。
cases.description_en:
Almost every household keeps a few boxes of medication, yet few people truly understand them — what they're for, how to take them, what to watch out for, where to get more. The leaflet is dense, the internet is messy, and medication is not something you can afford to be fuzzy about.

Take the anticoagulant warfarin as an example: ask Weixiaoyi, and it patiently walks you through the drug's purpose, dosage, bleeding warning signs and food-drug interactions, then shows you three trustworthy ways to get it — hospital pharmacy, retail pharmacy, or internet hospital — all in a one-page guide you can save and share, so taking medication never feels confusing again.

cases.prompt: 华法林是什么药？该如何使用？有什么注意事项？该如何购买？将结果生成html进行展示。html 功能：1. 如有跳转链接，要同时支持点击跳转及弹窗扫描二维码访问；2. 固定导航栏，根据页面尺寸显示在顶部或侧边，需高亮当前模块，点击切换定位页面至对应模块；3. 可将页面内容保存为本地图片，图片中的信息元素显隐、排版需根据分享场景做一下优化；4. 数据列表限制最多5条；5.头部信息标题、副标题文本需体现该页面为全面的健康服务，显示品牌名称“微小医”及logo（https://kano.guahao.com/zj8979871203），logo裁成圆形。html ui设计风格：1. "医疗蓝扁平卡片流"：纯白大圆角卡片，以 0.5px 细线代替阴影分隔，全部交互强调收敛到单一品牌蓝 #3f86ff 及其渐变/透明度变体，通过 PingFang SC 三档字重与四级灰阶建立信息层级，主次按钮（渐变实心 vs 浅蓝描边）形成清晰的操作引导优先级；2. 统一配内联的svg图标；3. 可交互按钮鼠标悬停时增加动效；4. 元素布局根据页面尺寸调整，以提高展示效果。5. 重点内容用流程图、指标卡片等特殊样式进行说明。
cases.prompt_en: What is warfarin? How should it be used? What precautions apply? How can it be purchased? Present the results as an HTML page. HTML features: 1. Any external link should support both direct click-through and a popup with a scannable QR code; 2. A fixed navigation bar that sits on top or on the side depending on page width, highlighting the current section and scrolling to the corresponding section on click; 3. The page content can be saved as a local image, with element visibility and layout optimized for sharing; 4. Data lists are limited to 5 items at most; 5. The header title and subtitle should convey that this page is a comprehensive health service, showing the brand name "Weixiaoyi" and its logo (https://kano.guahao.com/zj8979871203), with the logo cropped into a circle. HTML UI style: 1. "Medical-blue flat card flow": pure white cards with large border radius, 0.5px hairlines instead of shadows for separation, all interactive emphasis confined to a single brand blue #3f86ff and its gradient/opacity variants, information hierarchy built on three font weights of PingFang SC and four grayscale levels, with primary vs. secondary buttons (solid gradient vs. light-blue outline) forming a clear action priority; 2. Consistent inline SVG icons; 3. Hover animations on all interactive buttons; 4. Element layout adapts to page size for better presentation; 5. Key content should be explained with special styles such as flow charts and metric cards.

cases.description_en:
Just found out you're pregnant, and the scariest part is the medication you're already taking — metformin, blood pressure pills, sleep aids. Should you stop? Will it affect the baby?

This case shows how to hand your gestational age and current medications to the AI clinical assistant, which identifies your pregnancy or breastfeeding status and weighs the risks using drug labels and pregnancy safety categories — without giving a flat "safe" or a scare-you-into-stopping answer.

For: people trying to conceive, expectant mothers, breastfeeding mothers, family members of pregnant women, and anyone wanting plain-language medication safety guidance.

cases.description_en:
Newly diagnosed with hypertension, the doctor said "less salt, take pills, monitor" — but how exactly, and why not stop, stays vague. Online answers mix truth and myth.

This case shows handing "what should hypertension patients watch daily" to Tencent Medpedia Q&A: it truly queries the official Medpedia knowledge base and summarizes four points — take meds on time, low-salt low-fat diet, monitor BP, control weight and mood — with 6 real article links and reviewer attributions at the end, every point traceable.

Good for: chronic-disease self-management, community health education, post-checkup literacy, hospital patient education.

半夜孩子烧到 38.7℃，抱起来又活蹦乱跳，要不要现在冲急诊？家长最怕判断错。

cases.description_en:
Googling symptoms is scary — you never know what to trust. This case shows how to hand a health question to Tencent Medpedia Health Q&A: ask "how is diabetes treated", and it queries Medpedia's official health-science knowledge base, first stating the core conclusion "not curable, but controllable", then expanding into six steps (know your type, oral drugs + insulin, nutrition therapy, post-meal exercise, glucose monitoring, lifelong management) — every point cited to a source, with a reference list of article titles and links (up to 6). For: adult children managing parents' diabetes, everyday users who want authoritative health science, and developers who want traceable medical Q&A in their product.

cases.subtitle: 本地儿科库确定性计算，剂量可复现
cases.subtitle_en: Local pediatric DB deterministic calc — reproducible dosage
cases.description:
2 岁宝宝发烧，家里有美林，家长最怕「吃多了伤肾、吃少了不退」。网上剂量五花八门。

这个案例演示腾讯医典健康问答的「儿童用药剂量计算」分支：它基于 skill 内置、经医学核查的本地儿科药品库（pediatric-drugs.json，30 种药），对「2 岁 12 kg 美林」做确定性计算——单次 120 mg（20 mg/ml 规格合 6 ml），每 6–8 小时一次、日不超 4 次、6 月龄以下禁用，并跑安全检查。结果可复现，不靠记忆编。

适合：育儿家庭精准用药、母婴 App 用药计算、儿科用药安全教育、互联网医院剂量核对。
cases.description_en:
A 2-year-old has a fever and you have Motrin at home — parents fear "too much harms the kidneys, too little does not work". Online doses vary wildly.

This case shows the "pediatric dosage calculation" branch of Tencent Medpedia Q&A: based on the skill's built-in, medically-checked local pediatric drug DB (pediatric-drugs.json, 30 drugs), it deterministically computes "Motrin for a 2yo 12kg" — 120 mg single (6 ml at 20 mg/ml), every 6–8h, ≤4/day, contraindicated under 6 months, with safety checks. cases.prompt:
请根据我上传的 1–3 张商品图，为该商品生成一套可直接用于 Amazon、Temu、TikTok Shop 等电商平台的 Listing 商品套图。请先识别商品主体、材质、品类和主要卖点，再统一规划整套视觉风格；至少覆盖白底主图、核心卖点图、规格或细节图、使用场景图和生活方式图。保持商品外观、包装、颜色、Logo 与关键文字一致，不得改变产品结构；图内文案简洁、可读，默认使用英文，画面比例为 1:1。完成后直接交付整套高质量图片，并确保不同图片之间具有一致的品牌感和版式体系。

cases.prompt_en:
Based on 1–3 product photos I upload, generate a complete Listing image set suitable for Amazon, Temu, TikTok Shop and other ecommerce platforms. First identify the product, material, category and key selling points, then plan a unified visual style; cover at least white-background main image, core selling point image, spec/detail image, usage scenario image and lifestyle image. Keep product appearance, packaging, color, logo and key text consistent; do not alter the product structure. Use concise, readable copy in English by default, with 1:1 aspect ratio. Deliver the complete set of high-quality images with consistent branding and layout.

Output: After completing the visuals, organize all pages or images into a single self-contained HTML file named output.html. All images, styles and necessary scripts must be inlined; no separate image files, resource directories, or second output files. The page must open directly and be compatible with both desktop and mobile.

First prioritize information around the target role, highlighting quantifiable work achievements, representative projects, and core design capabilities; use a creative editorial style with warm white paper, black marker lines, and purple brush doodles, with clear modules for personal profile, work experience, skills, education, tools, and contact info. Layout Chinese and English content per the information I provide; do not fabricate experience, education, awards, or contact details; photos must preserve the person's identity and facial features. Balance personal expression, reading efficiency, and print readiness.

Output: After completing the visuals, organize all pages or images into a single self-contained HTML file named output.html. All images, styles and necessary scripts must be inlined; no separate image files, resource directories, or second output files. The page must open directly and be compatible with both desktop and mobile.

Ideal for laundry shops, lifestyle service brands, and knowledge content creators who need to quickly produce shareable explainer content.

cases.prompt:
请把我提供的洗衣避坑知识整理成一张适合社交媒体发布的 3:4 漫画科普图文。采用清新国风 Q 版插画，使用同一位古风少女作为贯穿角色；顶部用醒目标题概括主题，中间以编号分镜呈现 5 个常见误区，每格包含简短标题、对应生活场景和一句易懂提醒；底部补充正确洗护建议与可执行清单。整体使用蓝白与暖米色配色，分镜边界清晰、人物形象统一、文字层级明确，确保手机端也能阅读。不得添加无关品牌、二维码或水印；如果我提供参考图，请保留其核心人物和视觉语言，但根据新内容重新组织画面。

cases.prompt_en:
Organize the laundry care knowledge I provide into a 3:4 comic explainer image suitable for social media. Use a fresh Chinese-style chibi illustration with a consistent ancient-style girl as the recurring character; top with a prominent title summarizing the theme, middle section presents 5 common mistakes in numbered storyboards, each cell containing a short title, corresponding life scene, and an easy-to-understand reminder; bottom section supplements correct care advice and an actionable checklist. Use blue-white and warm beige tones, clear storyboard borders, consistent character design, and clear text hierarchy for mobile readability. Do not add unrelated brands, QR codes, or watermarks; if I provide a reference image, keep its core character and visual language but reorganize the layout for the new content.

Output: After completing the visuals, organize all pages or images into a single self-contained HTML file named output.html. All images, styles and necessary scripts must be inlined; no separate image files, resource directories, or second output files. The page must open directly and be compatible with both desktop and mobile.
