cases.subtitle: 把上午密集快讯去重后压成交易台可扫读情报板
cases.subtitle_en: Turn dense morning flashes into a trading-desk board that can be scanned in seconds
cases.description:
盘中最烦的不是消息少，而是消息太多。同一件事换个标题反复刷屏，真正该盯的信号反而容易被埋掉。

这个案例演示如何把 2026-07-27 09:30–13:30 HKT 的财经快讯做时间过滤、去重和信号拆解，再生成一份交易台式双语 HTML 情报板。它保留查询统计、核心 round-up、8 张关键信号卡和一套可直接口播的午盘总结。

适合：盘中盯盘同学、销售交易、投顾沟通、市场内容运营、需要快速把上午行情讲清楚的研究与公关团队。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part intraday is not a lack of headlines, but too many of them. The same event gets repeated under new titles, and the signals that actually matter end up buried.

This case shows how to take finance flashes for 2026-07-27 between 09:30 and 13:30 HKT, apply time filtering, deduplication and signal extraction, and turn them into a bilingual HTML board built like a trading desk. It keeps the query stats, the core round-ups, eight key signal cards and a ready-to-speak midday script.

Best for: intraday monitors, sales-trading teams, advisory communication, market-content operators, and research or PR teams that need to explain the morning move quickly.
cases.prompt: 请抓取 2026-07-27 09:30–13:30 HKT 的财经快讯，覆盖全市场、A股、港股和全球宏观四类查询，做时间过滤和去重后，输出一份单文件 HTML 午盘异动快讯板。报告需要包含：查询统计、核心快讯 round-up、拆解后的关键信号卡、上午市场主线、午盘口播总结，以及原文时间与链接。内容必须基于真实查询结果并注明时间与来源；HTML 资源全内联。
cases.prompt_en: Please pull finance flashes for 2026-07-27 between 09:30 and 13:30 HKT, covering four query buckets: broad market, A-shares, Hong Kong equities and global macro. After time filtering and deduplication, generate a single-file HTML midday moves board. The report should include query stats, the core flash round-ups, decomposed signal cards, the morning market lead, a spoken-style midday wrap, and original timestamps and links. The content must be based on real query results with timestamps and sources noted; all HTML assets must be inlined.

cases.prompt:
你是TradeBuddy出品的B2B贸易运营专家。请基于我的经营数据，生成一份可视化的月度经营分析看板。

【数据来源（三选一，按我的实际情况）】
- 我已绑定业务系统/ERP：直接读取{时间范围，如 2026年7月}的经营数据；
- 我上传了Excel/表格：请读取并映射到营收、成本、毛利、回款、客户、品类、账龄等标准口径；
- 我暂时没有数据：请说明需要哪些字段，并给出一份示例看板作参考。

【看板要求】
1. 顶部KPI卡片：当月营收、毛利额、毛利率、回款率，各附环比变化；
2. 图表：近6个月营收/毛利趋势、品类销售结构、Top5客户销售额、应收账龄分布；
3. 底部经营洞察：查询【行业信息资产库】里这个行业的经营口径，结合数据给出3条以内可执行建议（如价格战预警、集中度风险、超期账款跟进）；
4. 输出为一页深色主题的可视化看板，图表用ECharts，适合发给管理层。

若数据源未就绪或返回明显不足，请以通用经营分析方法论为主产出，并说明。请生成完整看板。

cases.title_en: Lightbox Collection · Film & TV Recommendation Workbench
cases.subtitle: 每天抽 5 部经典生成海报甄选，IMDb/烂番茄/豆瓣三评分对照，收藏、影评人与观影档案一面墙搞定
cases.subtitle_en: Five classic picks a day on a swipeable poster wall, with IMDb / Rotten Tomatoes / Douban scores, favorites, critic reviews and your viewing archive in one place
cases.description: 影迷的观影记录散落在各个平台：想看一部片，评分要跑 IMDb、烂番茄、豆瓣三个地方对；家人推荐过的片子看完就忘，谁推荐的、适合一个人看还是全家一起看，全都没处记。这个工作台把收藏和推荐做成一整面会滑动的海报墙：甄选页每天从推荐池随机抽 5 部经典，逐片展示三平台评分，一键加入收藏；馆藏页每部影片都能一键切换收藏/已观影/不喜欢、写一句话短评、记下推荐人和个人/家庭观影归属，检索浮层支持片名、推荐人、标签、备注实时过滤；批评家页 5 位风格各异的独立影评人各占一屏，自动汇总点评数、均分与近作；读数页把馆藏总数、收藏数、观影状态和豆瓣评分分布统计成图表。数据落在资料库数据表，支持在线存储与双向同步。适合：正在建立自己观影体系的影迷，想管理家庭片单、区分个人与家庭口味的家长，以及喜欢评分数据和观影档案的影视爱好者。
cases.description_en: A film lover's records live everywhere: checking one title means cross-referencing IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Douban; a family recommendation is forgotten right after watching — who recommended it, and whether it suits a solo night or a family evening, none of it gets kept. This workbench turns your collection into a full swipeable poster wall: the Picks page draws 5 classics from the recommendation pool each day with three-platform scores and one-tap add-to-library; the Library page lets you toggle Favorite / Watched / Not for me on any title, jot a one-line note, and record the recommender and Personal / Family audience, with a live search overlay filtering by title, recommender, tag or note; the Critics page gives 5 independent critics a screen each, auto-summarizing review counts, averages and latest reviews; the Stats page charts library size, favorites, viewing status and the Douban score distribution. All data is stored in Library database tables featuring online storage and two-way sync. Great for film lovers building their own viewing system, parents managing a family watchlist with personal and family tastes separated, and movie buffs who live on ratings and viewing archives.
cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/CqW9JOAkHg92OZDn3QO6ZC，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

做一个「光影收藏馆」全球影视收藏推荐工作台，数据落在资料库数据表，共两张表：① 影片收藏（片名、类型(电影/剧集)、年份、IMDb 评分、烂番茄(%)、豆瓣评分、推荐人、海报链接、观影归属(个人/家庭)、收藏/已观影/不喜欢三个勾选、备注短评、影评人评分五列：迷影客/胶片手/夜航船/放映室/第七艺术，均为 0-10 数字）——点右上角 ＋ 弹出入藏表单，保存即写入数据表；② 每日推荐池（片名、类型、年份、IMDb 评分、烂番茄(%)、豆瓣评分）——预置经典影视作为每日甄选的数据源。

四个整屏海报式模块，左右滑动切换，移动端适配：① 甄选——每次从推荐池随机抽取 5 部生成「今日甄选」海报流，逐片展示 IMDb/烂番茄/豆瓣三评分与一键加入收藏，加入后即时写入馆藏并在下次甄选中避开，菜单里可随时换一批；② 馆藏——全部收藏影片的海报滑片，每片可一键切换收藏/已观影/不喜欢并即时回显按钮态，展示推荐人与个人/家庭观影归属，检索浮层支持片名/推荐人/标签/备注关键词实时过滤，顶部胶囊在个人/家庭/全部之间切换；③ 批评家——5 位独立影评人各占一屏，自动汇总各自点评数、均分与最近点评影片，点评列表随打分实时更新；④ 读数——自动统计馆藏总数、收藏数、已看数、家庭观影数与豆瓣均分，配豆瓣评分分布柱状图与观影状态环形图，随数据变化即时刷新。

视觉走影院海报风：深色底、影院红单一强调色，海报底图按片名哈希自动配色程序化生成，无需外部图片；评分用 IMDb 金、烂番茄红、豆瓣绿三色区分。未入藏时用演示数据展示完整效果。

cases.title: 多城市天气对比看板
cases.subtitle: 六城天气一屏横向对比
cases.subtitle_en: Compare six cities' weather at a glance
cases.description:
想同时看几个城市的天气、决定去哪儿出差或旅行时，一个个网站切换查半天，看完前一个就忘了后一个，根本没法横着比。

这个案例让 QQ 浏览器自动化依次跑完六座城市的天气页，真实抓取今日天气、温度区间、风力和未来三天预报，再整理成一张清爽的对比看板：每城一张卡，温度条统一映射一眼看出谁热谁凉，顶部还自动算出最热城市、下雨城市数量。

适合：出差旅行选目的地、异地办公团队同步天气、需要多地气象横向对比的运营与调度。
cases.description_en:
When you want to check several cities' weather at once, switching between sites one by one is tedious and you forget the earlier one before finishing the next, making side-by-side comparison impossible.

This case has QQ Browser automation visit six cities' weather pages in sequence, truly scraping today's conditions, temperature range, wind, and the next three days' forecast, then assembles a clean comparison board: one card per city, a unified temperature bar showing hot vs. cool at a glance, plus an auto-computed summary of the hottest city and how many are rainy.

For: choosing a destination for business trips or travel, syncing weather across distributed teams, and operations that need multi-location weather comparison.

cases.prompt:
用 QQ 浏览器自动化 skill 依次真实查询北京、上海、广州、成都、哈尔滨、三亚这六座城市的天气：分别导航到中国天气网对应城市页，抓取今日天气现象、今日温度区间（最高/最低）、风力风向，以及未来两到三天的简要预报，并注明数据来源（中国天气网 www.weather.com.cn）和抓取时间。所有数据必须真实查询，禁止使用示意或模拟数据。

然后把六城真实数据整理成一个单文件 HTML 天气对比看板，保存为 output.html：便于横向比较、一眼看出哪座城市更热更凉即可，风格你来把握。所有资源内联、可离线打开，天气图标用内联 SVG 或 CSS 绘制。
cases.prompt_en:
Use the QQ Browser automation skill to truly query, one by one, the weather for six cities — Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chengdu, Harbin and Sanya: navigate to each city's page on China Weather, scrape today's condition, today's temperature range (high/low), wind, and a brief 2-3 day forecast, and note the data source (China Weather, www.weather.com.cn) and capture time. All data must be genuinely queried — no placeholder or simulated data.

Then organize the six cities' real data into a single-file HTML weather comparison board saved as output.html: it should make side-by-side comparison easy and show at a glance which city is hotter or cooler; the visual style is up to you. Inline all resources so it opens offline, and draw weather icons with inline SVG or CSS.

cases.description: 做自媒体最头疼的不是写，而是「今天发什么」：选题散落在聊天记录和备忘录，热点追不上，拍完不知道发哪，发了没数据复盘。这个工作台把一个人的内容工厂装进一页：选题中心管「今天发什么」——选题池待办、今日热点榜单可一键转选题；内容工厂四条产线（长图文/短图文/口播/微短剧）排队开工，任务自动推进到把关；IP 形象库管理人设，出演后自动锁定防撞车；草稿箱把关通过后进发布中心登记多平台发布；数据看板按天记录阅读/点赞/评论/转发，自动给出产线表现洞察和下周排期建议。首次打开自动播种演示数据（日期对齐当天），适合独立创作者、一人内容团队、想把内容生产跑成 SOP 的自媒体运营者。
cases.description_en: The hardest part of running your own media isn't writing — it's 'what do I post today?': topics scattered across chats and notes, trends you can't chase in time, finished videos with nowhere to go, and no data to review after publishing. This workbench fits a one-person content factory onto a single page: the Topic Center answers 'what to post today' with a topic backlog and a hot-trend list that converts to topics in one click; the Content Factory runs four production lines (long-form / short-post / voiceover / short-drama) as queued tasks that advance automatically to review; the IP Library manages personas and auto-locks them once cast to prevent conflicts; drafts pass review into the Publish Center for multi-platform logging; the Analytics board records daily reads/likes/comments/shares and generates per-line performance insights plus next-week scheduling advice. Demo data seeds itself on first open (dates aligned to today). Best for: solo creators, one-person content teams, and media operators who want their production to run like a SOP.

cases.title: 开完一场国际大会，把中国专家的真观点整理成一张热点雷达

cases.subtitle: 按话题聚合公开点评：谁在关注什么、观点分歧在哪
cases.subtitle_en: Public commentary clustered by topic: who cares about what, and where opinions diverge
cases.description: 每年 ASCO、ESMO、WCLC 开完，信息铺天盖地，同事带回一堆截图却说不清哪些结论真会影响明天的临床决策。这个案例演示了怎么把一个大会的公开学术内容按话题聚合，标注每位中国专家的关注点和观点之间的分歧，产出一页能内部分发、也能拿去跟医生对话的热点雷达。适合医学事务、产品经理做大会速递和内部赋能。
cases.description_en: After every ASCO, ESMO, or WCLC, the team comes back with a pile of screenshots and no clear answer about which conclusions will actually change clinical decisions tomorrow. This case shows how to cluster a congress's public academic content by topic, tag each Chinese expert's focus and where opinions diverge, and produce a one-page topic radar you can circulate internally or take straight into a conversation with a physician. Built for medical affairs and product managers running congress updates and internal enablement.
cases.prompt:
2025 ASCO 刚开完，团队带回一堆截图，但没人说得清哪些结论真会影响明天的临床决策。帮我做一张肺癌领域的「热点雷达」。

这是会上公开报道的内容，作为起点：
2025 ASCO 肺癌专场公开报道的研究要点：
陆舜教授牵头的 SACHI 研究（MET 扩增人群，奥希替尼联合赛沃替尼对比含铂双药化疗，ITT 人群中位 PFS 8.2 个月对 4.5 个月，ORR 58%，三代 TKI 经治亚组中位 PFS 6.9 个月）；
张力教授牵头的 OptiTROP-Lung03（芦康沙妥珠单抗对比多西他赛，ORR 45.1% 对 15.6%，中位 PFS 6.9 对 2.8 个月）；
韩宝惠教授牵头的 CAMPASS（贝莫苏拜单抗联合安罗替尼对比帕博利珠单抗，中位 PFS 11 对 7.1 个月）；
吴一龙教授公开质疑 NeoADAURA 把主要终点设为 MPR 而非 EFS；CheckMate 816 公布五年生存率 65.4%。

请联网核实这些研究的准确数据与会议原文，再补上会上其他有影响力的中国专家报告，按「治疗策略 / 耐药机制 / 检测技术 / 围术期」几个话题重新归类，标出每位专家的核心观点，以及观点之间的分歧在哪。产物给我一个单文件 HTML 雷达页，话题能点开看详情，附来源。

cases.description: 明天要去见一位领域大咖，可你连他最近两年在关心什么都答不上来，翻文献又根本来不及。这个案例演示了怎么把一位专家近两年的公开论文、学会任职和会议点评，梳理成一张手机上看得完的速读卡：他是谁、最近在关注什么、从哪个话题开口最自然、哪些说法一说就显得不专业。适合医药代表、区域市场和医学联络官在拜访、科室会邀约前做快速准备。
cases.description_en: You have a meeting tomorrow with a leading expert and can't answer the most basic question: what has this person actually cared about for the past two years? There is no time to read dozens of papers. This case shows how to distill a specialist's public papers, society positions, and conference commentary into a briefing card you can finish on your phone: who they are, what they are focused on right now, which topic opens the conversation most naturally, and which claims will make you look uninformed. Built for sales reps, regional marketing, and medical liaisons preparing for a call or a departmental meeting invitation.
cases.prompt:
下周要去拜访广东省人民医院的吴一龙教授，聊 EGFR 突变晚期 NSCLC 的一线治疗策略。我没时间翻几十篇文献，想要一张手机上能看完的拜访速读卡：他是谁、近两年在公开场合最关心哪几个学术问题、我从哪个话题开口最自然、哪些说法一说就显得不专业。

他 2025 年 ASCO 期间公开点评过陆舜教授牵头的 SACHI 研究，随笔里给出的数字是 PFS 9.8 个月对 6.4 个月、三代 TKI 经治亚组 6.9 对 3.0 个月，还公开吐槽过 NeoADAURA 把主要终点设成了 MPR 而不是 EFS——这些是公开信息，帮我顺着这条线把他的学术关注点理出来。联网检索他近两年的公开论文、学会任职和会议报告来补全，注明来源。

产物给我一个单文件 HTML，手机上能一屏一屏往下划，字别太小，最后附信息来源清单。
cases.prompt_en:
Next week I'm visiting Prof. Yilong Wu at Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital to discuss first-line strategy for advanced EGFR-mutated NSCLC. I don't have time to read dozens of papers. I want a briefing card I can finish on my phone: who he is, which academic questions he has cared most about publicly over the past two years, which topic opens the conversation most naturally, and which claims would make me look uninformed.

During ASCO 2025 he publicly commented on the SACHI study led by Prof. Shun Lu — in his own notes he cited PFS of 9.8 vs 6.4 months, and 6.9 vs 3.0 months in the third-generation TKI-pretreated subgroup — and he openly criticized NeoADAURA for setting MPR rather than EFS as the primary endpoint. That is all public. Follow that thread and map out his academic priorities. Search public sources to fill in his papers, society positions, and conference talks from the past two years, and cite them.

Give me a single self-contained HTML file that scrolls screen by screen on a phone, with text large enough to read, ending with a source list.

cases.prompt:
我们要在华东办一场 60 人的区域肺癌学术会，主题是「EGFR 突变晚期 NSCLC 的全程管理」，需要 5 位讲者。我不想靠拍脑袋定名单，想看到一份有依据的候选人对比。

陆舜 37.66 上海市胸科医院；张力 34.29 中山大学肿瘤防治中心；莫树锦 28.37 香港中文大学（中国香港）；
陈海泉 28.20 复旦大学附属肿瘤医院；何建行 26.07 广州医科大学附属第一医院；

cases.prompt:
周五要在胸科医院做一场 15 分钟的科室会，听众是 20 多位肿瘤科医生，主题是「EGFR 突变晚期 NSCLC 一线治疗后的耐药管理」。我需要一套能直接上讲台的东西：PPT 加逐页讲稿。

可用的真实素材如下，请联网核实它们的准确出处、最新状态和国内获批情况，必要时补充：
2025 ASCO 肺癌专场公开报道的研究要点：
陆舜教授牵头的 SACHI 研究（MET 扩增人群，奥希替尼联合赛沃替尼对比含铂双药化疗，ITT 人群中位 PFS 8.2 个月对 4.5 个月，ORR 58%，三代 TKI 经治亚组中位 PFS 6.9 个月）；
张力教授牵头的 OptiTROP-Lung03（芦康沙妥珠单抗对比多西他赛，ORR 45.1% 对 15.6%，中位 PFS 6.9 对 2.8 个月）；
韩宝惠教授牵头的 CAMPASS（贝莫苏拜单抗联合安罗替尼对比帕博利珠单抗，中位 PFS 11 对 7.1 个月）；
吴一龙教授公开质疑 NeoADAURA 把主要终点设为 MPR 而非 EFS；CheckMate 816 公布五年生存率 65.4%。

给我一份 12 页左右的 PPT，配一页一页的讲稿，讲稿写医生听得懂的话、别说教，每页标注数据出处。

cases.title: 一篇 3000 字专家访谈，压成一张能微信转发的一页学术卡
cases.title_en: Turn a 3,000-Word Expert Interview Into a One-Page Shareable Academic Card
cases.subtitle: 保留学术严谨度，去掉长文的阅读负担
cases.subtitle_en: Keep the academic rigor, drop the reading burden
cases.description: 公众号发了篇专家访谈，三千多字，阅读量惨淡——医生不是不关心，是没时间看长文。这个案例演示了怎么把一篇长访谈压成一张一屏看完、能直接微信发给医生的学术速递卡，同时保住指南依据和专家观点，不为了短而丢严谨度。适合数字营销、产品经理做学术内容的二次分发。
cases.description_en: You published a 3,000-word expert interview and the readership was dismal — not because physicians don't care, but because nobody reads long-form anymore. This case shows how to compress a long interview into an academic update card that fits one screen and can be sent straight to a physician over WeChat, while preserving the guideline basis and the expert's actual positions rather than trading rigor for brevity. Built for digital marketing and product managers redistributing academic content.
cases.prompt:
我们刚发了一篇肺癌领域的专家访谈，三千多字，阅读量惨淡——医生没时间看长文，可内容本身是有价值的。我想把它压成一张一屏就能看完、能直接微信发给医生的学术速递卡。

原文如下：
继表皮生长因子受体酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（EGFR-TKI）成为EGFR突变（Ex19del/L858R）晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的标准治疗后，EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略取得了重要突破，有望进一步延长EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者的生存[1]。在EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略发展的同时，针对其耐药机制及全程管理体系的探讨也在不断深入。特邀湖南省肿瘤医院邬麟教授，总结EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略的重要进展，并从EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略全程管理的角度发表独到见解。

邬麟 教授｜专家简介：二级主任医师、博士生导师、博士后合作导师；湖南省肿瘤医院（中南大学湘雅医学院附属肿瘤医院）内科教研室主任，GCP肿瘤专业负责人、胸内二科主任；湖南省肺癌临床医学研究中心主任；中国抗癌协会(CACA)老年肿瘤专委会副主委；CSWOG肺癌专业委员会候任主委；CSCO理事；CACA临床化疗专业委员会常委；湖南省抗癌协会肿瘤化疗专业委员会主任委员等。

肺癌的个体化精准诊疗是临床的热点和难点之一，能否请您谈谈如何为EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者制定精准治疗策略？既往局限于医疗技术的落后，肺癌患者在临床中往往接受同质化的诊疗。EGFR突变的发现和EGFR-TKI疗法的兴起使肺癌治疗从经验性的化疗转向精准分子靶向治疗，自此晚期NSCLC迈向了精准诊疗时代。精准检测是实施精准靶向治疗的前提。邬麟教授介绍道，精准治疗，检测先行，晚期NSCLC患者在初诊时需进行基因检测，精准的基因检测对于晚期NSCLC的一线治疗选择具有指导作用，这已在全球形成共识，并成为标准的临床实践[1-2]。此外，基因检测在患者的全程管理中也十分重要。随着治疗时间的延长，EGFR-TKI耐药和疾病进展的出现不可避免，基因检测可以明确EGFR-TKI耐药机制，为后续精准治疗提供依据。针对EGFR-TKI一线治疗后出现进展的人群，国内外权威指南均建议根据进展模式和耐药机制指导后续治疗策略的制定[1-2]。总而言之，基因检测不仅在一线治疗决策中具有关键作用，更是肺癌全程管理中动态调整治疗方案的重要工具。基因检测指导下的精准治疗是确保EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者获益的关键。需要强调的是，在肺癌的全程管理过程中，一线治疗方案的选择尤为重要。邬麟教授指出，一线治疗在EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者的整体治疗进程中扮演着至关重要的角色，一线获益对于提升全程获益和患者治疗信心具有积极影响，有助于优化全程管理和患者的治疗依从性。继三代EGFR-TKI成为EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者的一线标准治疗后，EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略的探索也已取得初步成功，进一步提高了患者获益。在选择一线用药方案时，亦需要把握全程管理的观念，从而优化整体治疗策略。

参考文献：[1] 中国临床肿瘤学会（CSCO）非小细胞肺癌诊疗指南. 2024版. [2] NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology (NCCN Guidelines). Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer. Version 3.2025.

帮我提炼出最值得医生记住的 3~5 个要点，保留原文里的指南依据和专家观点，别为了短而丢掉严谨度。产物给我一个单文件 HTML 竖版页面，手机上打开一屏看完，能直接转发，参考文献和专家信息放在最后。
cases.prompt_en:
We just published a 3,000-word expert interview in lung cancer and the readership was dismal. Physicians don't have time for long-form, but the content itself is worth reading. I want to compress it into a one-screen academic update card I can send straight to a physician over WeChat.

Source article:
Following the establishment of EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR-TKIs) as standard therapy for patients with advanced EGFR-mutated (Ex19del/L858R) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), EGFR-TKI combination strategies have achieved major breakthroughs and are expected to further extend survival [1]. In parallel, investigation into resistance mechanisms and whole-course management continues to deepen. This issue features Professor Lin Wu of Hunan Cancer Hospital, summarizing key advances in EGFR-TKI combination strategies and offering perspectives on whole-course management.

Professor Lin Wu — Profile: Grade-II Chief Physician, Doctoral Supervisor; Director of the Internal Medicine Teaching and Research Section, Hunan Cancer Hospital (The Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Xiangya School of Medicine, Central South University); Head of the Thoracic Internal Medicine Department II; Director of the Hunan Lung Cancer Clinical Medical Research Center; Vice Chair of the Geriatric Oncology Committee of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association (CACA); President-Elect of the CSWOG Lung Cancer Committee; Council Member of CSCO.

Individualized precision diagnosis and treatment of lung cancer remains a clinical hotspot and challenge. Historically, limited medical technology meant patients received largely homogeneous care. The discovery of EGFR mutations and the advent of EGFR-TKIs shifted lung cancer treatment from empirical chemotherapy to precision molecular targeted therapy. Precision testing is the prerequisite for precision targeted therapy. As Professor Wu notes, "precision treatment begins with testing" — genetic testing at initial diagnosis is now a global consensus and standard clinical practice for guiding first-line selection in advanced NSCLC [1-2]. Genetic testing is equally critical across the whole disease course: as treatment duration extends, EGFR-TKI resistance and disease progression become inevitable, and testing clarifies the resistance mechanism to inform subsequent precision therapy. For patients progressing after first-line EGFR-TKI, major Chinese and international guidelines recommend tailoring subsequent strategy to the pattern of progression and the resistance mechanism [1-2]. In short, genetic testing is both pivotal to first-line decision-making and an essential tool for dynamically adjusting therapy across the whole course. The choice of first-line regimen is especially consequential: first-line benefit positively influences overall benefit and patient confidence, optimizing whole-course management and adherence. Following third-generation EGFR-TKIs as first-line standard, exploration of EGFR-TKI combination strategies has achieved initial success, further improving patient benefit. First-line selection should likewise be guided by a whole-course management mindset.

References: [1] Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology (CSCO) Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, 2024 Edition. [2] NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Version 3.2025.

Pull out the 3–5 points most worth a physician's attention, preserving the guideline basis and the expert's stated positions from the original — don't trade rigor for brevity. Deliver a single self-contained vertical HTML page that fits one screen on a phone, ready to forward, with references and the expert's profile at the end.

cases.title: 医生当场抛来的学术质疑，帮我备一本能翻的应对手册
cases.title_en: A Pocket Handbook for Handling On-the-Spot Academic Objections
cases.subtitle: 把公开可查的争议观点整理成有出处的应答卡
cases.subtitle_en: Organize verifiable public controversies into sourced response cards
cases.description: 拜访时医生当场抛问题，一紧张就答得没底气，尤其现在医生会直接拿国际会议上中国专家的质疑来反问。这个案例演示了怎么把这些公开可查的争议观点整理成一本随身能翻的异议应对手册：每条质疑配事实依据、该怎么回应、以及哪些地方必须坦承数据还不成熟。适合医药代表、区域市场做拜访赋能。
cases.description_en: A physician throws a question at you mid-visit and your confidence evaporates — especially now that physicians quote Chinese experts' own criticisms from international congresses back at you. This case shows how to turn those publicly verifiable controversies into a pocket handbook: every objection paired with the factual basis, how to respond, and where you must concede that the data is not mature yet. Built for sales reps and regional marketing running call enablement.
cases.prompt:
拜访时医生经常当场抛问题，我一紧张就答得没底气。最近几次医生直接拿国际会议上中国专家的质疑来反问我，比如：「你们都说联合治疗好，可吴一龙教授在 2025 ASCO 上不也吐槽 NeoADAURA 把主要终点设成了 MPR 而不是 EFS 吗？」「HER3 ADC 的 HERTHENA-Lung02 不是也铩羽而归了吗，ADC 这条路到底行不行？」

帮我做一本能随身翻的异议应对手册：把我可能遇到的学术质疑列全，每一条给出公开可查的事实依据、该怎么回应、以及哪些地方必须坦承「数据还不成熟」。

背景素材，请联网核实并补充：

cases.description: 新人代表上岗最怕被医生问住，可打印成册的学术资料没人背。这个案例演示了怎么把专家访谈和指南要点拆成三四十张问答闪卡：正面是医生真会问的问题，背面是答案和数字出处，配一个能翻着练的网页，再导出一份能直接导入 Anki 的卡包。适合培训、区域市场做新人上岗赋能。
cases.description_en: New reps dread being stumped by a physician, yet nobody memorizes printed academic handbooks. This case shows how to break an expert interview and guideline highlights into 30–40 Q&A flashcards: a question a physician would actually ask on the front, the answer with its numeric source on the back, plus a web page for flipping through them and an export that imports straight into Anki. cases.prompt:
新人医药代表上岗，最怕被医生问住。我们有一篇肺癌领域的专家访谈和几份指南要点，但打印成册没人背。我想做成一摞能翻的闪卡，手机上碎片时间刷一刷就能记住。

素材如下：
继表皮生长因子受体酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（EGFR-TKI）成为EGFR突变（Ex19del/L858R）晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的标准治疗后，EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略取得了重要突破，有望进一步延长EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者的生存[1]。在EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略发展的同时，针对其耐药机制及全程管理体系的探讨也在不断深入。特邀湖南省肿瘤医院邬麟教授，总结EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略的重要进展，并从EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略全程管理的角度发表独到见解。

邬麟 教授｜专家简介：二级主任医师、博士生导师、博士后合作导师；湖南省肿瘤医院（中南大学湘雅医学院附属肿瘤医院）内科教研室主任，GCP肿瘤专业负责人、胸内二科主任；湖南省肺癌临床医学研究中心主任；中国抗癌协会(CACA)老年肿瘤专委会副主委；CSWOG肺癌专业委员会候任主委；CSCO理事；CACA临床化疗专业委员会常委；湖南省抗癌协会肿瘤化疗专业委员会主任委员等。

肺癌的个体化精准诊疗是临床的热点和难点之一，能否请您谈谈如何为EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者制定精准治疗策略？既往局限于医疗技术的落后，肺癌患者在临床中往往接受同质化的诊疗。EGFR突变的发现和EGFR-TKI疗法的兴起使肺癌治疗从经验性的化疗转向精准分子靶向治疗，自此晚期NSCLC迈向了精准诊疗时代。精准检测是实施精准靶向治疗的前提。邬麟教授介绍道，精准治疗，检测先行，晚期NSCLC患者在初诊时需进行基因检测，精准的基因检测对于晚期NSCLC的一线治疗选择具有指导作用，这已在全球形成共识，并成为标准的临床实践[1-2]。此外，基因检测在患者的全程管理中也十分重要。随着治疗时间的延长，EGFR-TKI耐药和疾病进展的出现不可避免，基因检测可以明确EGFR-TKI耐药机制，为后续精准治疗提供依据。针对EGFR-TKI一线治疗后出现进展的人群，国内外权威指南均建议根据进展模式和耐药机制指导后续治疗策略的制定[1-2]。总而言之，基因检测不仅在一线治疗决策中具有关键作用，更是肺癌全程管理中动态调整治疗方案的重要工具。基因检测指导下的精准治疗是确保EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者获益的关键。需要强调的是，在肺癌的全程管理过程中，一线治疗方案的选择尤为重要。邬麟教授指出，一线治疗在EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者的整体治疗进程中扮演着至关重要的角色，一线获益对于提升全程获益和患者治疗信心具有积极影响，有助于优化全程管理和患者的治疗依从性。继三代EGFR-TKI成为EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者的一线标准治疗后，EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略的探索也已取得初步成功，进一步提高了患者获益。在选择一线用药方案时，亦需要把握全程管理的观念，从而优化整体治疗策略。

参考文献：[1] 中国临床肿瘤学会（CSCO）非小细胞肺癌诊疗指南. 2024版. [2] NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology (NCCN Guidelines). Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer. Version 3.2025.

帮我把里面的核心知识点拆成 30~40 张问答卡片：正面是问题，背面是答案和数字出处。给我两样东西——一个能在网页上直接翻着练的单文件 HTML（卡面能翻转），再加一份能直接导入 Anki 的 CSV。别出「什么是肺癌」这种没用的题，要出医生真会问的。
cases.prompt_en:
New sales reps dread being stumped by a physician. We have a lung cancer expert interview and several guideline highlights, but nobody memorizes printed booklets. I want a stack of flip cards they can drill through on their phone in spare moments.

Source material:
Following the establishment of EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR-TKIs) as standard therapy for patients with advanced EGFR-mutated (Ex19del/L858R) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), EGFR-TKI combination strategies have achieved major breakthroughs and are expected to further extend survival [1]. In parallel, investigation into resistance mechanisms and whole-course management continues to deepen. This issue features Professor Lin Wu of Hunan Cancer Hospital, summarizing key advances in EGFR-TKI combination strategies and offering perspectives on whole-course management.

Professor Lin Wu — Profile: Grade-II Chief Physician, Doctoral Supervisor; Director of the Internal Medicine Teaching and Research Section, Hunan Cancer Hospital (The Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Xiangya School of Medicine, Central South University); Head of the Thoracic Internal Medicine Department II; Director of the Hunan Lung Cancer Clinical Medical Research Center; Vice Chair of the Geriatric Oncology Committee of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association (CACA); President-Elect of the CSWOG Lung Cancer Committee; Council Member of CSCO.

Individualized precision diagnosis and treatment of lung cancer remains a clinical hotspot and challenge. Historically, limited medical technology meant patients received largely homogeneous care. The discovery of EGFR mutations and the advent of EGFR-TKIs shifted lung cancer treatment from empirical chemotherapy to precision molecular targeted therapy. Precision testing is the prerequisite for precision targeted therapy. As Professor Wu notes, "precision treatment begins with testing" — genetic testing at initial diagnosis is now a global consensus and standard clinical practice for guiding first-line selection in advanced NSCLC [1-2]. Genetic testing is equally critical across the whole disease course: as treatment duration extends, EGFR-TKI resistance and disease progression become inevitable, and testing clarifies the resistance mechanism to inform subsequent precision therapy. For patients progressing after first-line EGFR-TKI, major Chinese and international guidelines recommend tailoring subsequent strategy to the pattern of progression and the resistance mechanism [1-2]. In short, genetic testing is both pivotal to first-line decision-making and an essential tool for dynamically adjusting therapy across the whole course. The choice of first-line regimen is especially consequential: first-line benefit positively influences overall benefit and patient confidence, optimizing whole-course management and adherence. Following third-generation EGFR-TKIs as first-line standard, exploration of EGFR-TKI combination strategies has achieved initial success, further improving patient benefit. First-line selection should likewise be guided by a whole-course management mindset.

References: [1] Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology (CSCO) Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, 2024 Edition. [2] NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Version 3.2025.

Break the core knowledge points into 30–40 Q&A cards: the question on the front, the answer with its numeric source on the back. Give me two things — a single self-contained HTML page where the cards flip on screen for practice, plus a CSV that imports straight into Anki. Skip useless questions like "what is lung cancer"; only ask what a physician would actually ask.

Built for digital marketing distributing academic content across formats.

原文如下：
继表皮生长因子受体酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（EGFR-TKI）成为EGFR突变（Ex19del/L858R）晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的标准治疗后，EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略取得了重要突破，有望进一步延长EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者的生存[1]。在EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略发展的同时，针对其耐药机制及全程管理体系的探讨也在不断深入。特邀湖南省肿瘤医院邬麟教授，总结EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略的重要进展，并从EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略全程管理的角度发表独到见解。

邬麟 教授｜专家简介：二级主任医师、博士生导师、博士后合作导师；湖南省肿瘤医院（中南大学湘雅医学院附属肿瘤医院）内科教研室主任，GCP肿瘤专业负责人、胸内二科主任；湖南省肺癌临床医学研究中心主任；中国抗癌协会(CACA)老年肿瘤专委会副主委；CSWOG肺癌专业委员会候任主委；CSCO理事；CACA临床化疗专业委员会常委；湖南省抗癌协会肿瘤化疗专业委员会主任委员等。

肺癌的个体化精准诊疗是临床的热点和难点之一，能否请您谈谈如何为EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者制定精准治疗策略？既往局限于医疗技术的落后，肺癌患者在临床中往往接受同质化的诊疗。EGFR突变的发现和EGFR-TKI疗法的兴起使肺癌治疗从经验性的化疗转向精准分子靶向治疗，自此晚期NSCLC迈向了精准诊疗时代。精准检测是实施精准靶向治疗的前提。邬麟教授介绍道，精准治疗，检测先行，晚期NSCLC患者在初诊时需进行基因检测，精准的基因检测对于晚期NSCLC的一线治疗选择具有指导作用，这已在全球形成共识，并成为标准的临床实践[1-2]。此外，基因检测在患者的全程管理中也十分重要。随着治疗时间的延长，EGFR-TKI耐药和疾病进展的出现不可避免，基因检测可以明确EGFR-TKI耐药机制，为后续精准治疗提供依据。针对EGFR-TKI一线治疗后出现进展的人群，国内外权威指南均建议根据进展模式和耐药机制指导后续治疗策略的制定[1-2]。总而言之，基因检测不仅在一线治疗决策中具有关键作用，更是肺癌全程管理中动态调整治疗方案的重要工具。基因检测指导下的精准治疗是确保EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者获益的关键。需要强调的是，在肺癌的全程管理过程中，一线治疗方案的选择尤为重要。邬麟教授指出，一线治疗在EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者的整体治疗进程中扮演着至关重要的角色，一线获益对于提升全程获益和患者治疗信心具有积极影响，有助于优化全程管理和患者的治疗依从性。继三代EGFR-TKI成为EGFR突变晚期NSCLC患者的一线标准治疗后，EGFR-TKI联合治疗策略的探索也已取得初步成功，进一步提高了患者获益。在选择一线用药方案时，亦需要把握全程管理的观念，从而优化整体治疗策略。

参考文献：[1] 中国临床肿瘤学会（CSCO）非小细胞肺癌诊疗指南. 2024版. [2] NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology (NCCN Guidelines). Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer. Version 3.2025.

cases.prompt_en:
We have a lung cancer expert interview that is solid but gets few opens. I want to turn it into an 8-minute audio piece a physician can listen to on the commute. The format should be a two-person conversation — one asks, one answers — not a single voice reading a script.

Source article:
Following the establishment of EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR-TKIs) as standard therapy for patients with advanced EGFR-mutated (Ex19del/L858R) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), EGFR-TKI combination strategies have achieved major breakthroughs and are expected to further extend survival [1]. In parallel, investigation into resistance mechanisms and whole-course management continues to deepen. This issue features Professor Lin Wu of Hunan Cancer Hospital, summarizing key advances in EGFR-TKI combination strategies and offering perspectives on whole-course management.

Professor Lin Wu — Profile: Grade-II Chief Physician, Doctoral Supervisor; Director of the Internal Medicine Teaching and Research Section, Hunan Cancer Hospital (The Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Xiangya School of Medicine, Central South University); Head of the Thoracic Internal Medicine Department II; Director of the Hunan Lung Cancer Clinical Medical Research Center; Vice Chair of the Geriatric Oncology Committee of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association (CACA); President-Elect of the CSWOG Lung Cancer Committee; Council Member of CSCO.

Individualized precision diagnosis and treatment of lung cancer remains a clinical hotspot and challenge. Historically, limited medical technology meant patients received largely homogeneous care. The discovery of EGFR mutations and the advent of EGFR-TKIs shifted lung cancer treatment from empirical chemotherapy to precision molecular targeted therapy. Precision testing is the prerequisite for precision targeted therapy. As Professor Wu notes, "precision treatment begins with testing" — genetic testing at initial diagnosis is now a global consensus and standard clinical practice for guiding first-line selection in advanced NSCLC [1-2]. Genetic testing is equally critical across the whole disease course: as treatment duration extends, EGFR-TKI resistance and disease progression become inevitable, and testing clarifies the resistance mechanism to inform subsequent precision therapy. For patients progressing after first-line EGFR-TKI, major Chinese and international guidelines recommend tailoring subsequent strategy to the pattern of progression and the resistance mechanism [1-2]. In short, genetic testing is both pivotal to first-line decision-making and an essential tool for dynamically adjusting therapy across the whole course. The choice of first-line regimen is especially consequential: first-line benefit positively influences overall benefit and patient confidence, optimizing whole-course management and adherence. Following third-generation EGFR-TKIs as first-line standard, exploration of EGFR-TKI combination strategies has achieved initial success, further improving patient benefit. First-line selection should likewise be guided by a whole-course management mindset.

References: [1] Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology (CSCO) Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, 2024 Edition. [2] NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Version 3.2025.

Write a conversational two-host script that puts the academic content into plain language without losing rigor, working the key numbers and guideline sources into the dialogue naturally. Then generate listenable audio from that script. Finally, condense the key conclusions into a one-page text version for people who don't have time to listen.

cases.description:
护理信息化项目多、口径杂、跨年周期长，靠表格和群聊追进度很容易失焦。

这个案例把一家医院护理信息专科（NIC）十余年的真实运转搬进资料库：六张在线数据表（任务台账 779 条、统计事务 95 条、年度总结 19 份、周报 18 期、到会统计与趋势）作为唯一数据源，页面直连读写、双向同步；数据治理内建——受控词表约束科室与状态口径，DAMA 六维数据质量评估直接看分；源表文件上传后离线解析、差异比对，合并结果自动写回在线表，全站指标实时重算。每一项分析都能点回原始记录。

适合：医院信息科/护理部管理信息化项目群、想参考「真存表 + 数据治理内建 + 分析可审计」工作台范式的数字化负责人。
cases.description_en:
Nursing informatics projects are numerous, inconsistently coded, and span years — tracking them in spreadsheets and group chats loses focus fast.

This case moves a hospital nursing informatics committee's (NIC) decade of real operations into the Library: six online database tables (a 779-row task ledger, 95 statistics log entries, 19 annual summaries, 18 weekly reports, plus attendance stats and trends) serve as the single source of truth, with the page reading and writing directly and syncing both ways; governance is built in — a controlled vocabulary enforcing department/status coding plus a DAMA six-dimension quality score; source files are parsed offline in-browser, diffed, and merged results auto-written back to the online tables with site-wide metrics recomputed live. Every analysis links back to raw records.

Best for: hospital IT / nursing departments running informatics project portfolios, and digital leads looking for a workbench pattern with real table storage, governance, and auditability built in.

Views: ① overview KPI cards and trend charts; ② project ledger with multi-dimensional filters (department/year/status/keyword) and expandable row details; ③ status kanban; ④ multi-dimensional analytics; ⑤ data governance: controlled-vocabulary management plus a DAMA six-dimension quality scorecard (completeness, uniqueness, consistency, timeliness, accuracy, validity); ⑥ annual summaries archived by year with full-text view; ⑦ attendance matrices and trend curves; ⑧ data import & sync: upload source files (xlsx/docx) parsed offline in-browser → diff (add/update/remove) → merge auto-written back to the online tables, with site-wide metrics recomputed. On load, page pulls all tables with cursor pagination (recursive startCursor beyond 200 rows) so every device sees the latest data. Visual: medical blue-and-white palette, dense table style, desktop-first with mobile compatibility.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus 14 data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 办公电脑采购验收风险
cases.subtitle: 围绕配置不符、设备故障、验收异议与暂缓付款的互动法律分析
cases.subtitle_en: Interactive legal analysis for configuration variance, device defects, acceptance objections, and payment withholding
cases.description: 痛点：办公电脑到货后发现配置不符、设备故障，而供应商要求先付全款再售后，采购、IT 与法务很难在验收期限和付款节点内统一行动。演示：本案例以可点击验收流程、付款情形判断、合同条款矩阵、责任路径、函件要点和证据清单，展示如何形成可执行的初步分析。适用人群：企业采购负责人、IT 资产管理人员、法务与内控团队，以及需要处理设备采购履约争议的业务管理者。
cases.description_en: Pain point: Office computers arrive with configuration discrepancies and device failures while the supplier demands full payment before after-sales support, leaving procurement, IT, and legal teams struggling to align within inspection and payment windows. Demonstration: This case uses a clickable acceptance workflow, payment scenarios, contract matrix, liability routes, notice essentials, and evidence checklist to demonstrate an actionable preliminary review. For: Corporate procurement leads, IT asset managers, legal and internal-control teams, and business managers handling equipment procurement performance disputes.
cases.prompt: 公司向供应商采购了一批办公电脑，合同约定指定品牌、型号及关键配置。货到验收时发现部分电脑配置不符，另有数台无法开机、频繁死机或存在硬件故障；供应商要求先支付全部货款再处理售后。请基于现行有效法律和合同约定，对以下事项形成一份可供管理层决策的初步法律分析报告：1）按合同付款节点、验收约定、未通过验收、部分瑕疵与重大违约分别判断公司能否暂缓付款及合理范围；2）设计从到货签收至异议通知的验收和证据留存流程；3）提出整改、维修、换货、退货、减价、赔偿、违约责任或解除的适用条件与行动顺序；4）列明应审查的合同条款、函件要点和待核实事实。报告须明确其基于假设事实，关键结论待合同原件、检测记录和送达证据核验。
cases.prompt_en: The company purchased a batch of office computers from a supplier under a contract specifying a designated brand, model, and key configurations. At delivery inspection, some computers have configurations inconsistent with the agreement, while several cannot boot, crash repeatedly, or have hardware defects; the supplier demands full payment before providing after-sales service. Based on currently effective law and the contract, prepare a preliminary legal analysis for management decision-making that: (1) separately assesses whether and to what reasonable extent payment may be withheld under the contract payment milestones, acceptance terms, failed acceptance, partial defects, and material breach; (2) designs an acceptance and evidence-preservation workflow from receipt through objection notice; (3) sets out the conditions and sequence for remediation, repair, replacement, return, price reduction, damages, breach liability, or termination; and (4) identifies contract clauses, notice essentials, and facts to verify. The report must state that it is based on assumed facts and that key conclusions await verification against the executed contract, testing records, and proof of delivery.

This case turns a 200-square-meter office lease brief into an editable Office Lease Agreement, with key cards for term, rent, deposit, use and breach liability.

Suitable for: administrative leads, startups, park leasing teams and commercial property managers.

cases.title: O了么·求职搭子工作台
cases.subtitle: 大一到大四的求职手账：进度、情报、行动、复盘、资产五个页签，15 张数据表接住全过程
cases.subtitle_en: A job-hunt journal from year 1 to year 4: progress, intel, action, review and assets across 15 database tables
cases.description: 大一大二不知道该准备什么、大三投递全凭感觉、大四手里几个 Offer 又算不清该选哪个——信息散在备忘录、群聊和十几个招聘网站里，没走两步就断线。这个工作台把求职拆成五本手账，用 15 张数据表接住全过程：进度页用「今天要处理」把逾期任务、快到期投递和今日三件事拢到一处，大一到大四时间轴一点就换阶段，任务打勾自动记一笔投入，打卡、月历和近 14 天投入图看得出节奏；情报页把校园招聘、事业单位和实习公告分成三个栏目，关键词命中的岗位自动置顶，一键生成投递包、随简历实时刷新润色建议；行动页是能拖拽的六列投递看板，配高频题库、STAR 故事库、人脉内推 CRM 和七项加权的 Offer 决策表；复盘页给出转化率与渠道效果，四栏便签复盘可一键转任务；我的页沉淀多版本简历、成就清单和材料包。演示数据是一份完整的大三实习求职实录：9 条任务、14 个真实在招岗位、7 张投递卡、6 道高频题、2 版简历和 1 份 Offer 对比表。适合不知道怎么规划的大一新生、正在攒实习的大二大三学生，以及手里有多个 Offer 要做选择的大四应届生。
cases.description_en: Year 1 and 2 pass without knowing what to prepare, year 3 applies on gut feeling, and by year 4 there are several offers but no clear way to choose — the information is scattered across notes, group chats and a dozen job sites, and the thread breaks after two steps. This workbench splits the job hunt into five journals backed by 15 database tables: the Progress tab gathers overdue tasks, imminent deadlines and today's top three into one "To handle today" strip, switches stages with a tap on the Year 1 → Year 4 timeline, logs time automatically when a task is ticked, and shows your rhythm through check-ins, a month calendar and a 14-day investment chart; the Intel tab splits campus recruitment, public-institution and internship notices into three sections, pins keyword matches to the top, builds a one-click application pack and refreshes resume polish tips as you edit; the Action tab is a draggable six-column application board with a frequently-asked question bank, a STAR story bank, a referral CRM and a seven-criteria weighted offer comparison; the Review tab reports conversion rates and channel performance, and the four-column sticky-note review converts into tasks in one tap; My Offer collects multiple resume versions, achievements and an asset pack. The demo data is a complete year-3 internship job hunt: 9 tasks, 14 live postings, 7 application cards, 6 frequently asked questions, 2 resume versions and 1 offer comparison. Best for first-years who don't know where to start, second- and third-years building internships, and final-years choosing between offers.
cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/fApg8dLRt3lp3TYwyLePRt，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

做一个「O了么 · 大学生的求职搭子」求职工作台，面向大一到大四在校生，把「规划 → 情报 → 行动 → 复盘 → 资产沉淀」串成一条主线。手账贴纸风：虚线卡片、和纸胶带、便签纸、手绘抖动圆角，五套治愈系配色（玫瑰粉灰 / 奶茶棕 / 鼠尾草绿 / 雾霾蓝 / 雾霾紫）可一键切换；PC 左侧导航、移动端底部标签栏，两栏自适应。

数据表（共 15 张，均落资料库数据表）：
- 求职任务：任务（文本）、年级（单选 大一/大二/大三/大四）、优先级（单选 普通/重要/紧急）、截止日期（日期）、已完成（复选框）、排序（数字）
- 每日打卡：日期（日期）、打卡习惯（文本，多个习惯 id 逗号连接）、投递分钟 / 简历分钟 / 笔试面试分钟 / 行业学习分钟（数字）、焦虑值 / 能量值（数字）
- 投入记录：事项（文本）、日期（日期）、分钟（数字）、分类（单选 投递/简历/笔试面试/行业学习/其他）
- 日程事件：日期（日期）、事项（文本）
- 岗位情报：公司、岗位、类型（单选 校园招聘/事业单位/实习）、城市、截止日期（日期）、来源、可信度、匹配度（数字）、竞争热度、所需附件、下一步、简介、更新批次（文本）、官网链接（链接）、已收藏（复选框）
- 匹配清单：公司、岗位、类型（单选）、求职要点、已投递（复选框）、岗位标识
- 投递看板：公司、岗位、渠道、阶段（单选 想投/已投/笔试/面试/Offer/归档）、截止日期（日期）、下一步、联系人
- 面试备战：题目或标题、类型（单选 高频题/STAR故事/模拟面试/模板）、要点、情境S、任务T、行动A、结果R、得分（数字）、模拟日期（日期）
- 人脉内推：姓名、身份、公司、内推码、跟进事项
- Offer决策：公司、月薪K（数字）、城市、户口分 / 成长分 / 加班分 / 稳定分 / 违约月（数字）、已选（复选框）
- 成就清单：名称、分类（单选 成绩记录/获奖记录/实习记录/学生工作/社团活动/社会活动）、量化成果、标签、情境S、任务T、行动A、结果R
- 材料包：名称、类型（单选 成绩单/证书/作品集/证件照/图片）、图片（图片）
- 简历版本：版本名、更新日期（日期）、当前使用（复选框）、姓名、学校、电话、邮箱、教育背景、实践经历、技能特长
- 复盘周报：周起始、保持、问题、尝试、下周预案
- 我的档案：姓名、专业、年级、城市、求职意向、目标行业、霍兰德、MBTI、职业锚、价值观、技能盘点、订阅关键词、周目标天（数字）、今日三件事（文本 JSON）、Offer权重（文本 JSON）、焦虑值 / 能量值（数字）、当前阶段

五个页签：
- offer进度：顶部「今天要处理」自动汇总逾期任务、3 天内截止的投递与今日三件事（逾期标红、未完成自动顺延）；大一→大四求职时间轴点击节点即可切换阶段；本阶段任务支持新增、勾选完成（自动记一条投入记录）、上下移、拖拽排序、删除；每日打卡含本周进度环、连续天数、习惯增删与补卡；今日三件事可勾选增删；月历按 DDL / 日程 / 打卡三种点标记，点某天弹出当天事项并可直接补记投入分钟；近 14 天按投递 / 简历 / 笔试面试 / 行业学习分目标堆叠柱状图；最近 10 条投入记录可改说明、可删；任务 DDL 可一键导出 ICS 日历。大一 / 大二阶段额外出现「搭子建议」卡，按内置建议库结合测评结果、订阅关键词与近 7 天投入自动调整，可一键加入任务。
- offer情报：订阅关键词命中岗位自动置顶；分「校园招聘 / 事业单位公告 / 实习公告」三个栏目展示岗位卡（类型、城市、截止倒计时、来源、可信度、匹配度、竞争热度、所需附件、下一步），卡片可收藏、可跳官网、可一键加入投递看板；「我的精准匹配清单」按简历与关键词关联显示待投岗位，支持标记投递、生成一键投递包（含简历版本与所需附件清单）、删除；「岗位简历润色建议」随当前简历内容实时生成待补关键词 / 量化 / 经历 / 证书提醒，可标 ✓ 完成或 ✗ 忽略并记住状态；底部推荐攻略视频每次随机 3 个、可换一批、可弹层预览或跳原站。
- offer行动：投递看板六列（想投 / 已投 / 笔试 / 面试 / Offer / 归档），卡片拖拽或点状态字切换，点卡片可改状态、截止、下一步、联系人并删除；面试备战含高频题库（增删、去重）、STAR 故事库、模拟面试与录音自评记录；人脉与内推 CRM 记姓名 / 身份 / 公司 / 内推码 / 跟进事项，可标记已跟进；Offer 决策表按薪资 / 城市 / 户口 / 成长 / 加班 / 稳定 / 违约成本七项加权评分，可加对比项、算最优；模板库存感谢信、跟进信、Argue 信、自我介绍等，可复制全文。
- offer复盘：情绪能量（焦虑值 / 能量值滑块，配微行动 / 拖延阻断 / 同辈压力脱敏提示条）；数据看板给出投递→笔试、投递→面试、投递→Offer 转化率、各渠道效果表、14 天投入堆叠柱状图与目标进度环；本周四栏复盘（保持 / 问题 / 尝试 / 下周预案）以便签形式填写，预案可一键转成本阶段任务；历史周自动归档，含失败归档与成功经验标签。
- 我的offer：个人基本信息（姓名 / 专业 / 年级 / 城市 / 求职意向 / 目标行业）；职业偏好测试（霍兰德 / MBTI / 职业锚 / 价值观 / 技能盘点）可编辑，改动后实时联动匹配分析与岗位匹配度；多版本简历可切换当前版本、在线编辑并生成完整简历文本；成就清单按 STAR 记录，可一键生成简历 bullet；材料包支持登记文件与上传图片（上传自动压缩到 800px 宽、最多 9 张，图片随数据一起云端存储）。

交付：资料库在线工作台，PC 与移动端自适应。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library capability to build a same-style copy of https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/fApg8dLRt3lp3TYwyLePRt with data stored online and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click same-style flow; if unavailable, build it as follows:

Build an "Oleme · A Job-Hunting Buddy for College Students" job-hunt workbench for students from year 1 to year 4, threading "plan → intel → act → review → asset building" into one storyline. Paper-journal sticker style: dashed cards, washi tape, sticky notes, hand-drawn wobbly rounded corners, five soothing colour themes (rose grey / milk-tea brown / sage green / haze blue / haze purple) switchable in one tap; left sidebar on desktop, bottom tab bar on mobile, responsive two-column layout.

Data tables (15 in total, all stored in Library database tables):
- Job tasks: task (text), year (select: Year 1/2/3/4), priority (select: Normal/Important/Urgent), due date (date), done (checkbox), order (number)
- Daily check-in: date (date), habits (text, habit ids joined by commas), apply minutes / resume minutes / test & interview minutes / industry-learning minutes (number), anxiety / energy (number)
- Time log: item (text), date (date), minutes (number), category (select: Apply/Resume/Tests & interviews/Industry learning/Other)
- Calendar events: date (date), item (text)
- Job intel: company, role, type (select: Campus recruitment/Public institution/Internship), city, deadline (date), source, credibility, match score (number), competition level, required files, next step, summary, update batch (text), official link (url), saved (checkbox)
- Shortlist: company, role, type (select), key points, applied (checkbox), role id
- Application board: company, role, channel, stage (select: To apply/Applied/Written test/Interview/Offer/Archived), deadline (date), next step, contact
- Interview prep: title, type (select: Frequently asked/STAR story/Mock interview/Template), key points, situation S, task T, action A, result R, score (number), mock date (date)
- Referral CRM: name, relation, company, referral code, follow-up
- Offer decision: company, salary k (number), city, hukou / growth / overtime / stability / penalty (number), chosen (checkbox)
- Achievements: name, category (select: Academic record/Award/Internship/Student leadership/Club activity/Community activity), metrics, tags, situation S, task T, action A, result R
- Asset pack: name, type (select: Transcript/Certificate/Portfolio/ID photo/Image), image (image)
- Resume versions: version name, updated (date), current (checkbox), name, school, phone, email, education, experience, skills
- Weekly review: week starting, keep, problem, try, next-week plan
- My profile: name, major, year, city, target role, target industries, Holland, MBTI, career anchor, values, skill inventory, subscribed keywords, weekly goal days (number), top three today (text JSON), offer weights (text JSON), anxiety / energy (number), current stage

Five tabs:
- Offer Progress: a "To handle today" strip at the top gathers overdue tasks, applications due within 3 days and today's top three (overdue in red, unfinished items roll over); the Year 1 → Year 4 timeline switches the active stage when you tap a node; stage tasks support adding, ticking off (which writes a time-log entry automatically), moving up/down, drag reordering and deleting; daily check-in shows a weekly progress ring, streak, habit add/remove and make-up check-ins; the top three can be ticked and removed; the month calendar marks deadlines, events and check-ins, and tapping a day opens that day's items with an inline shortcut to log minutes; a 14-day stacked bar chart splits minutes by apply / resume / tests & interviews / industry learning; the latest 10 time-log entries can be edited or deleted; task deadlines export to an ICS calendar. In year 1 and 2 an extra "buddy suggestions" card appears, tuned by a built-in suggestion library using test results, subscribed keywords and the last 7 days of invested time, with one-tap "add as task".
- Offer Intel: jobs matching subscribed keywords are pinned to the top; three sections (campus recruitment / public-institution notices / internship notices) show job cards (type, city, deadline countdown, source, credibility, match score, competition level, required files, next step) that can be saved, opened on the official site or added to the application board in one tap; "My shortlist" is matched from the resume and keywords and supports marking as applied, generating a one-click application pack (resume version plus required-file checklist) and deleting; "Resume polish tips for this role" is generated live from the current resume with missing keyword / metrics / experience / certificate reminders that can be marked ✓ done or ✗ ignored with the state remembered; recommended guide videos show 3 at random each time, can be shuffled, previewed in a modal or opened on the source site.
- Offer Action: a six-column application board (To apply / Applied / Written test / Interview / Offer / Archived) where cards can be dragged or moved by tapping a stage, and opening a card lets you edit its stage, deadline, next step and contact or delete it; interview prep holds a frequently-asked question bank (add, delete, dedupe), a STAR story bank, and mock-interview self-review records; the referral & network CRM stores name / relation / company / referral code / follow-up and can mark a contact as followed up; the offer decision table weights seven criteria (salary, city, hukou, growth, overtime, stability, penalty cost), accepts extra rows and picks the best; the template library ships thank-you notes, follow-up letters, an offer-negotiation letter and self-introductions with copy-full-text.
- Offer Review: mood & energy (anxiety / energy sliders with micro-action, procrastination-blocker and peer-pressure tips); the dashboard shows apply→test, apply→interview and apply→offer conversion rates, a channel performance table, a 14-day stacked bar chart and a goal progress ring; the four-column weekly review (keep / problem / try / next-week plan) is written on sticky notes and the plan converts into stage tasks in one tap; past weeks are archived automatically together with a failure log and success tags.
- My Offer: personal profile (name / major / year / city / target role / target industries); career preference tests (Holland / MBTI / career anchor / values / skill inventory) are editable and feed the match analysis and role scores live; multiple resume versions can be switched, edited online and rendered as full resume text; achievements are recorded as STAR stories and can generate resume bullets in one tap; the asset pack registers files and accepts uploaded images (auto-compressed to 800px wide, up to 9, stored in the cloud with the data).

Deliverable: a Library online workbench, responsive on desktop and mobile.

cases.title: 药物靶点外推证据评估
cases.subtitle: FGFR2 扩增胃癌用 FGFR 抑制剂？证据链逐环审查
cases.subtitle_en: FGFR inhibitor for FGFR2-amplified gastric cancer? A link-by-link evidence audit
cases.description: 测序发现一个可成药的扩增靶点，临床同事马上问：能不能用那个已经上市的抑制剂？「药能抑制靶点」和「药对这个病人有效」之间隔着一条外推链，链条断在哪一环往往没人说得清。这个案例审查一项真实常见的临床提议——「FGFR2 扩增（CNV=8）的胃癌患者 off-label 使用胆管癌获批的 FGFR 抑制剂 pemigatinib/futibatinib」：把提议拆成靶点检测、靶点-疾病、标志物对齐、药物-靶点、适应症外推五个环节，用 PubMed + KEGG DRUG 真实检索逐环核查（ToGA III 期作对照链），定位证据断裂点（癌种 + 变异类型双重跨线外推、无 RCT 支撑），输出分层用药路径建议与可检验假设。适合：精准医学方向研究者、肿瘤分子病理/临床基因组学人员、靶向治疗方案讨论参与者。
cases.description_en: Sequencing finds a druggable amplification, and the clinician immediately asks: can we use that already-approved inhibitor? Between "the drug inhibits the target" and "the drug helps this patient" lies an extrapolation chain — and no one can usually say which link breaks. This case audits a real-world clinical proposal: "off-label use of the cholangiocarcinoma-approved FGFR inhibitors pemigatinib/futibatinib in an FGFR2-amplified (CNV=8) gastric cancer patient." It decomposes the proposal into five links — target detection, target-disease, biomarker alignment, drug-target, and indication extrapolation — checks each against real PubMed and KEGG DRUG retrieval (with the ToGA phase-III trial as the comparison chain), locates the breaking point (dual cross-line extrapolation of both cancer type and variant class, with no RCT support), and outputs tiered treatment-path recommendations plus testable hypotheses. Suitable for: precision-medicine researchers, molecular pathology / clinical genomics staff, and anyone joining targeted-therapy plan discussions.

artifacts.label: 药物靶点外推证据评估报告（自包含 HTML）

cases.prompt:
我们的胃癌（GC）样本 WGS + 转录组联合分析发现 P13 携带 FGFR2 高水平扩增（CNV=8）且 mRNA 过表达，临床团队提议 off-label 使用 FGFR 抑制剂（pemigatinib / futibatinib，两者获批适应症均为 FGFR2 改变的胆管癌 CCA）。请帮我做靶点外推证据评估，产出单文件自包含 HTML 报告（图片 base64 内嵌、样式内联、无任何外部资源引用、内容默认可见、不使用 hash 锚点导航，可离线打开）。

输入（以下为演示用模拟数据，需在报告中明确标注；真实场景由用户提供）：
- 13 例 GC 样本，P13 的 FGFR2 CNV=8、log TPM+1=6.8（队列均值的 4.5 倍），其余 12 例 CNV 1-4
- 待评估外推链：FGFR2 扩增（GC）→ FGFR 抑制剂（CCA 获批）
- 对照链：ERBB2 扩增（GC）→ 曲妥珠单抗（ToGA III 期 RCT）

要求：
1. 把临床提议拆成显式外推链：① 靶点检测 → ② 靶点-疾病（FGFR2 扩增与 GC 预后）→ ③ 标志物对齐（扩增与 FGFR2b 过表达一致性）→ ④ 药物-靶点（FGFR2 抑制剂）→ ⑤ 适应症外推（CCA 获批药用于 GC），逐环节评估证据。
2. 用 PubMed（NCBI E-utilities）与 KEGG REST API（find/drug、get/hsa:2263 等）真实检索证据：FGFR2 扩增在 GC 的发生率与预后、FGFR2b 过表达与扩增对齐、bemarituzumab FIGHT II 期试验、futibatinib/pemigatinib 的获批适应症边界、ToGA III 期试验；检索命令与日期写入复现说明；禁止编造 PMID 或 KEGG ID——检索不到就如实写「未找到」。
3. 输出证据表（环节 | 支持/部分支持/矛盾/未找到 | 来源 PMID/KEGG ID | 强度）+ 已知结论 + 外推断裂点分析（明确指出哪一环证据不足及原因）+ 分层用药路径建议（临床试验入组 / 同情用药 / 标准化疗的优先级排序）+ 方法学风险（CNV calling 平台差异、扩增≠驱动、标志物人群不重合、个案发表偏倚）+ 重点关注 Top-3；报告须明确标注「不构成诊疗建议」。
4. 演示图（13 例样本 CNV 与表达联动、外推链各环节证据强度条形图、off-label 用药决策路径图）用 matplotlib 固定随机种子生成后 base64 内嵌。
5. 报告包含分析代码段与数据合规声明（演示数据与真实检索的边界写清楚）。
cases.prompt_en:
Our gastric cancer (GC) WGS + transcriptome joint analysis found that P13 carries a high-level FGFR2 amplification (CNV=8) with mRNA overexpression, and the clinical team proposes off-label use of FGFR inhibitors (pemigatinib / futibatinib, both approved for FGFR2-altered cholangiocarcinoma, CCA). Please run a target-extrapolation evidence review and produce a single self-contained HTML report (figures embedded as base64, styles inlined, no external resources, content visible by default, no hash-anchor navigation, openable offline).

Input (simulated demo data below — must be clearly labeled in the report; in real use these come from the user):
- 13 GC samples; P13 has FGFR2 CNV=8 and log TPM+1=6.8 (4.5x the cohort mean); the other 12 have CNV 1-4
- Extrapolation chain under review: FGFR2 amplification (GC) → FGFR inhibitors (CCA-approved)
- Comparison chain: ERBB2 amplification (GC) → trastuzumab (ToGA phase-III RCT)

Requirements:
1. Decompose the clinical proposal into an explicit extrapolation chain: (1) target detection → (2) target-disease (FGFR2 amplification and GC prognosis) → (3) biomarker alignment (amplification vs FGFR2b overexpression concordance) → (4) drug-target (FGFR2 inhibitors) → (5) indication extrapolation (CCA-approved drugs for GC), and assess the evidence link by link.
2. Retrieve real evidence via PubMed (NCBI E-utilities) and the KEGG REST API (find/drug, get/hsa:2263, etc.): FGFR2 amplification frequency and prognosis in GC, FGFR2b overexpression-amplification concordance, the bemarituzumab FIGHT phase-II trial, the approved-indication boundaries of futibatinib/pemigatinib, and the ToGA phase-III trial; record retrieval commands and date in the reproduction notes; never fabricate PMIDs or KEGG IDs — write "not found" when retrieval comes up empty.
3. Output an evidence table (link | supported/partially-supported/contradicted/not-found | source PMID/KEGG ID | strength) + verified conclusions + breaking-point analysis (state explicitly which link lacks evidence and why) + tiered treatment-path recommendations (priority order of clinical-trial enrollment / compassionate use / standard chemotherapy) + methodological risks (CNV-calling platform differences, amplification ≠ driver, non-overlapping biomarker populations, case-report publication bias) + Top-3 priorities; the report must clearly state that it "does not constitute medical advice".
4. Generate demo figures (CNV and expression across the 13 samples, evidence-strength bars per extrapolation link, off-label decision-path diagram) with matplotlib at a fixed random seed and embed them as base64.
5. Include analysis code blocks and a data-compliance statement clarifying the boundary between demo data and real retrieval.

cases.title: 生成 RNA-seq 分析流程代码
cases.subtitle: AI 写好流程脚本，先看架构再动手
cases.subtitle_en: AI-generated pipeline scripts — review the architecture before running
cases.description:
想跑 RNA-seq 流程，但不确定脚本怎么设计、担心直接跑出问题？这个案例演示了如何让 HPC 专家自动发现集群资源，生成数据模拟、QC 统计、TPM 定量、SLURM 投递四个脚本，并输出一份含 DAG 调用图、脚本清单卡与可折叠预览的「代码设计文档」HTML，让你在提交前先把架构看清楚。

适合：想先预览 RNA-seq 流程代码设计、不依赖任何外部生物信息工具（零依赖纯 Python3）、希望在 HPC 集群上自动化运维的生信用户。
cases.description_en:
Worried about script design before running an RNA-seq pipeline? This case shows how the HPC expert auto-discovers cluster resources and generates four scripts (data simulation, QC, TPM quantification, SLURM submission), then produces a professional 'Code Design Document' HTML with a DAG flow diagram, script inventory cards, and collapsible code previews — so you can review the architecture before submitting anything.

Suitable for: bioinformatics users who want to preview RNA-seq pipeline code design, avoid external tool dependencies (zero-dependency pure Python3), and automate operations on HPC clusters.

artifacts.label: RNA-seq 代码设计文档

cases.prompt:
请为我生成一套 RNA-seq 分析流程的代码（本步只写代码、不执行）。

先自动发现资源：列出所有运行中集群，选第一个 SLURM 集群，找到第一个可写的 CFS 挂载点作为工作目录。然后在工作目录生成 4 个脚本 + 1 个说明：

- gen_rnaseq_data.py：模拟 5 条转录本（1000–5000bp，丰度 40/25/20/10/5%）和 100 万条 SE reads（reads 名内嵌转录本 ID），并输出真值表 ground_truth.json
- run_pipeline.py：QC 统计（reads 数/长度/GC/N 占比）+ 按 reads 名的转录本 ID 归组计数 + 计算 TPM，结果写入 results.json
- make_report.py：读 results.json 生成自包含 HTML 报告（图表用内联 SVG，不依赖任何外部库）
- run_rnaseq.sh：SLURM 投递脚本（#SBATCH：compute 队列/1h/4G），依次串跑上面三个
- README.md：执行说明

硬性要求：所有脚本只用 Python3 标准库，不得依赖 hisat2/salmon/samtools 等需安装的工具。

最后生成一份「代码设计文档」HTML，风格专业美观、自包含内联 SVG：渐变紫色 Hero + 顶部 KPI 卡（脚本数/流程阶段数/外部依赖数=0/总代码行数）+ 脚本调用关系流程图（DAG）+ 每个脚本一张产物清单卡（文件名/用途/输入/输出/依赖/行数）+ 测试数据规格卡 + 可折叠脚本预览 + 执行准备清单。只写代码不跑分析。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a complete RNA-seq analysis pipeline code for me (this step only writes code, does not execute).

First auto-discover resources: list all running clusters, select the first SLURM cluster, find the first writable CFS mount point as the working directory. Then generate 4 scripts + 1 README in the working directory:

- gen_rnaseq_data.py: simulate 5 transcripts (1000–5000bp, abundance 40/25/20/10/5%) and 1 million SE reads (read names embed transcript IDs), output ground_truth.json
- run_pipeline.py: QC statistics (read count/length/GC/N ratio) + group count by transcript ID from read names + calculate TPM, write results to results.json
- make_report.py: read results.json and generate a self-contained HTML report (charts as inline SVG, no external libraries)
- run_rnaseq.sh: SLURM submission script (#SBATCH: compute queue/1h/4G), run the above three scripts sequentially
- README.md: execution instructions

Hard requirement: all scripts use only Python3 standard library, no external tools like hisat2/salmon/samtools.

Finally generate a 'Code Design Document' HTML, professional and self-contained with inline SVG: gradient purple Hero + top KPI cards (script count/pipeline stages/external dependencies=0/total code lines) + script call flow diagram (DAG) + one artifact card per script (filename/purpose/input/output/dependencies/lines) + test data spec card + collapsible script previews + execution checklist. Write code only, do not run analysis.

cases.title: 从头设计（De Novo Design）
cases.subtitle: 用 IgGM 生成式模型对 PD-L1 靶点进行抗体从头设计
cases.subtitle_en: Antibody de novo design against PD-L1 using IgGM generative model
cases.description: 痛点：抗体药物研发的核心难题是从零起点快速获得高质量候选序列——传统方法依赖实验筛选，耗时耗力，成本高。本案例演示如何用腾讯 IgGM 生成式大模型（ICLR 2025），针对肿瘤免疫热门靶点 PD-L1 执行一次完整的抗体从头设计流程：提交 IgGM-WDL 任务、跟踪运行直至完成，最终以单文件 HTML 报告交付候选抗体序列表（VH/VL + 可开发性评分）与代表性候选的 3D 交互视图（链着色、自动旋转、测距截图）。适合抗体研究员、计算生物学家、想快速生成多样化先导序列的研发团队。
cases.description_en: Pain point: Generating high-quality antibody candidates from scratch is a major bottleneck in drug discovery—traditional methods rely on costly experimental screening. This case demonstrates how to use Tencent's IgGM generative model (ICLR 2025) to perform a complete de novo antibody design workflow against PD-L1: submitting an IgGM-WDL job, tracking until completion, and delivering a single-file HTML report with candidate sequence table (VH/VL + developability scores) and interactive 3D structure view. Ideal for antibody researchers and computational biologists seeking diverse lead candidates.

artifacts.label: 抗体从头设计报告（含 3D 结构）

cases.prompt:
Prompt 1 ｜从头设计（De Novo Design）

我是做肿瘤免疫方向的抗体研究员，靶点为 PD-L1。请使用 IgGM(WDL) 公共应用，完全按默认参数（不改动抗原、模型与资源配置），执行一次抗体从头设计（De Novo Design），并完成分析：

1. 提交前给我任务确认单（设计模式｜靶点｜关键参数｜WDL 引擎｜预计时长），确认后提交；
2. 跟踪任务直至完成，失败则按错误知识库给根因与修复建议；
3. 完成后以单文件 HTML 报告交付（内嵌 3Dmol.js + PDB 坐标）：候选抗体序列表（排名｜VH/VL｜可开发性评分）；代表性候选的 3D 交互视图按「3D 交付标准」执行（链着色、默认自动旋转、拖拽/缩放、链显隐、表示切换、测距、截图）。

experts.name: IgGM抗体药物研发专家
experts.description: 展示如何用腾讯 IgGM 生成式模型对 PD-L1 靶点执行抗体从头设计（De Novo Design）——无需提供初始序列，模型直接生成完整 VH/VL 候选序列并附可开发性评分；任务完成后以单文件 HTML 交付候选序列表与 3D 交互视图，支持链着色、自动旋转、链显隐与测距截图。适合抗体研究员快速生成多样化候选序列，作为 Lead 发现的起点。

cases.title: CDR 区重设计
cases.subtitle: 保持框架区不变，用 IgGM 对先导抗体 CDR 区重设计并输出 3D 复合物视图
cases.subtitle_en: Keep the framework region intact, redesign the CDR region of a lead antibody with IgGM, and output an interactive 3D complex view
cases.description:
手里有一株先导抗体，框架区已人源化，但 CDR 区的结合特性还需要打磨？每次重设计都要手动整理残基对比和序列 logo，费时费力。

这个案例演示了如何用 IgGM 抗体药物研发专家对抗 PD-L1 先导抗体执行 CDR Redesign：专家先确认设计区域（默认 CDR-H3）与参数摘要，确认后提交并全程跟踪，完成后输出重设计前后 CDR 对比表（IMGT 编号｜原残基→新残基）、序列 logo 与突变概率柱状图，以及与抗原 5C3T_A 复合物的 3D 交互视图。

适合：持有先导抗体、希望定向优化 CDR 亲和力的研究者，抗体改造方向的生信工程师，以及需要可视化 CDR 重设计结果的药物发现团队。
cases.description_en:
Got a lead antibody with a humanized framework but CDR regions that still need work? Manually aligning residue comparisons and generating sequence logos after each redesign round is tedious.

This case demonstrates how to run CDR Redesign on an anti-PD-L1 lead antibody with the IgGM Antibody R&D Expert: the expert confirms the design region (default CDR-H3) and parameter summary, submits and tracks the job to completion, then outputs a before/after CDR comparison table (IMGT numbering | original → new residue), sequence logo and mutation probability histogram, and an interactive 3D view of the redesigned antibody in complex with antigen 5C3T_A.

Ideal for: researchers with a lead antibody seeking targeted CDR affinity optimization, bioinformatics engineers in antibody engineering, and drug discovery teams needing visual CDR redesign results.

artifacts.label: CDR 区重设计分析报告（含序列 logo、突变概率图与 3D 复合物视图）

cases.prompt:
Prompt 2 ｜CDR 区重设计

我有一株抗 PD-L1 的先导抗体，框架区已人源化且稳定，需保持框架区不变，对 CDR 区重设计以改善结合特性。请使用 IgGM(WDL) 公共应用按默认参数执行 CDR Redesign，并完成分析：

1. 提交前确认设计区域（默认 CDR-H3）与参数摘要，确认后提交；
2. 跟踪任务直至完成；
3. 结果以单文件 HTML 报告交付：重设计前后 CDR 对比表（IMGT 编号｜原残基→新残基）；运行 Merge_output 后处理生成序列 logo 与突变概率柱状图（设计组 vs 原始组）；重设计产物的 3D 交互视图按「3D 交付标准」执行（与抗原 5C3T_A 复合物视图，链着色、默认自动旋转、链显隐、抗原表面、测距、截图）。

experts.name: IgGM抗体药物研发专家
experts.description: 演示如何在保持框架区不变的前提下，用 IgGM 对先导抗体的 CDR 区进行重设计以改善结合特性：输出重设计前后 CDR 残基对比表（IMGT 编号）、序列 logo 与突变概率柱状图，并展示与 PD-L1 抗原复合物的 3D 交互视图。适合已有先导抗体、希望定向优化 CDR 亲和力的研究者。

cases.title: CDR-H3 条件设计
cases.subtitle: 以 PD-L1 抗原为约束条件，用 IgGM 条件生成 CDR-H3 区并输出候选序列汇总与 3D 视图
cases.subtitle_en: Use PD-L1 antigen as constraint for IgGM conditional CDR-H3 generation, and output a candidate sequence summary with interactive 3D view
cases.description:
想让 CDR-H3 的设计紧扣靶点结合需求，而不是漫无目的地随机生成？条件设计能约束生成方向，但结果分析和可视化还是让人头疼。

这个案例演示了如何以 PD-L1 抗原为约束，用 IgGM 抗体药物研发专家执行 CDR-H3 条件设计：先确认任务单（设计模式、设计区域、靶抗原、资源与预计时长），确认后提交并全程跟踪，最终输出候选 CDR-H3 序列汇总表（序列、出现频率、位点保守度）、序列 logo 与逐位点保守度柱状图，以及 Top 候选结构的 3D 交互视图。

适合：需要靶向约束 CDR-H3 设计的抗体研究者、想对比多个候选 CDR-H3 序列保守度的生信工程师、以及希望快速可视化条件生成结果的药物发现团队。
cases.description_en:
Want CDR-H3 design to stay tightly aligned with target binding requirements rather than generating randomly? Conditional design can steer generation, but analyzing and visualizing the results is still a chore.

This case demonstrates how to run CDR-H3 conditional design with PD-L1 antigen as the constraint using the IgGM Antibody R&D Expert: confirm a task sheet (design mode, design region, target antigen, resources, estimated duration), submit and track to completion, then output a candidate CDR-H3 sequence summary table (sequence, frequency, positional conservation), sequence logo and per-position conservation histogram, and an interactive 3D view of top candidates.

Ideal for: antibody researchers who need targeted CDR-H3 design constraints, bioinformatics engineers comparing positional conservation across multiple CDR-H3 candidates, and drug discovery teams seeking rapid visualization of conditional design results.

cases.description: 单细胞分析跑完了，代码、图、结论散落各处；写进报告的结论哪些有文献支撑、哪些只是猜想，自己也说不清，组会上被追问就只能现场翻文献。这个案例把一份结直肠癌 scRNA-seq 分析（QC、聚类注释、DEG、KEGG 富集）打包成单文件自包含报告：完整 scanpy 代码、关键结果表、4 张结果图全部内嵌；并用 PubMed + KEGG 对 LGR5、FAP、SPP1、CXCL8 等关键基因结论逐条核查，输出「支持/部分支持/矛盾/未找到」证据表、可放心写入讨论的已证实结论、以及值得追查的潜在新发现假设。适合：单细胞/组学方向研究生、生信分析师、论文补充材料准备者、组会汇报人。
cases.description_en: Your scRNA-seq analysis is done, but the code, figures and conclusions are scattered everywhere — and you can't say which claims are literature-backed and which are just hunches. This case packages a colorectal cancer scRNA-seq analysis (QC, clustering annotation, DEG, KEGG enrichment) into a single self-contained report: full scanpy code, key result tables, and 4 embedded figures. It then checks every key gene claim (LGR5, FAP, SPP1, CXCL8, etc.) against PubMed and KEGG, producing a supported/partially-supported/contradicted/not-found evidence table, verified conclusions safe for the discussion section, and novel hypotheses worth chasing. Suitable for: graduate students in single-cell/omics, bioinformatics analysts, supplementary-material writers, and lab-meeting presenters.

cases.prompt:
我刚刚做完一份结直肠癌（CRC）单细胞 RNA-seq 分析，结果如下。请帮我生成一份可直接交付的报告（单文件 HTML，自包含），所有图片必须以 base64 data URI 内嵌，不能是相对路径链接，所有样式内联、无任何外部资源引用，内容默认可见，不使用 hash 锚点导航。

分析背景：
- 物种/样本：人，肿瘤 vs 正常，3 v 3（模拟数据演示用）
- 流程：scanpy QC → 降维聚类 → 细胞注释 → Wilcoxon DEG → gseapy KEGG 富集
- 关键结论：6 大细胞群；肿瘤组 CAF 与单核/巨噬比例升高、NK 比例下降；1882 个 DEG；Wnt/ECM/黏着斑通路显著富集
- 关键基因：LGR5、FZD5、CTNNB1、DKK1、MYC、COL1A1、FAP、SPP1、MMP9、CXCL8

要求：
1. 文档结构：标题 + 摘要（结论先行）+ 数据设计 + 完整 scanpy 代码 + DEG / 富集结果表 + 4 张主要图（UMAP 聚类、DEG 火山图、KEGG 富集条形图、细胞比例堆叠图）+ 解读与待验证点 + 复现说明。
2. 图片使用 matplotlib 模拟生成，随机种子固定为 42，保证可复现；生成后以 base64 data URI 直接内嵌进 HTML，不引用外部 images/ 文件夹。
3. 用 PubMed + KEGG 对 LGR5、FZD5、COL1A1/FAP、SPP1/MMP9/CXCL8 等关键基因-疾病/通路关系做一轮证据化核查，输出「主张清单 + 证据表（支持/部分/矛盾/未找到）+ 潜在新发现假设 + 方法学风险」。
4. 删除元教程、规范说明、自查清单等对用户价值不大的章节，只保留实质交付内容。
5. 最终产物必须是单个自包含 .html 文件，可离线打开、拷贝、汇报。
cases.prompt_en:
I have just finished a colorectal cancer (CRC) single-cell RNA-seq analysis with the results below. Please generate a directly deliverable report (single self-contained HTML file): all images must be embedded as base64 data URIs (no relative-path links), all styles inlined, no external resource references, content visible by default, and no hash-anchor navigation.

Analysis background:
- Species/samples: human, tumor vs normal, 3 vs 3 (simulated data for demonstration)
- Pipeline: scanpy QC → dimensionality reduction and clustering → cell annotation → Wilcoxon DEG → gseapy KEGG enrichment
- Key findings: 6 major cell populations; elevated CAF and monocyte/macrophage proportions and reduced NK proportion in the tumor group; 1,882 DEGs; significant enrichment of Wnt/ECM/focal-adhesion pathways
- Key genes: LGR5, FZD5, CTNNB1, DKK1, MYC, COL1A1, FAP, SPP1, MMP9, CXCL8

Requirements:
1. Document structure: title + summary (conclusions first) + data design + full scanpy code + DEG/enrichment result tables + 4 main figures (UMAP clustering, DEG volcano plot, KEGG enrichment bar chart, cell-proportion stacked bar) + interpretation and points to verify + reproduction notes.
2. Generate figures with matplotlib in simulation mode, random seed fixed at 42 for reproducibility; embed them into the HTML as base64 data URIs without referencing an external images/ folder.
3. Run an evidence-based check of the gene-disease/pathway relationships for key genes (LGR5, FZD5, COL1A1/FAP, SPP1/MMP9/CXCL8) against PubMed and KEGG, outputting a claim list + evidence table (supported/partial/contradicted/not found) + potential novel hypotheses + methodological risks.
4. Remove meta-tutorials, specification notes, and self-check lists that add little user value; keep only substantive deliverable content.
5. The final artifact must be a single self-contained .html file that can be opened offline, copied, and presented.

cases.title: 空间转录组TME结果解读
cases.subtitle: Stereo-seq 边界生态位结论的 PubMed/KEGG 证据化核查
cases.subtitle_en: Evidence check of Stereo-seq boundary-niche conclusions against PubMed/KEGG
cases.description: 空间转录组分析跑完了，结论写得很漂亮——「边界区形成免疫排斥生态位」——但组会被问「这个说法有人发过吗」就卡壳：哪些是文献共识、哪些是自己数据的首次观察，说不清楚。这个案例把一份结直肠癌 Stereo-seq 分析（空间域识别、边界生态位、配受体通讯）做成证据化审阅报告：先拆成 5 条原子主张，再用 PubMed + KEGG 逐条检索真实证据（Nat Commun 2022 的 SPP1+ 巨噬-CAF 互作、HCC 免疫屏障旁证等），输出「支持/部分支持/未找到」证据表、可写入讨论的已知结论、值得追查的新发现假设（SPP1-CD44 维持巨噬-CAF 配对结构）与验证实验设计。适合：空间组学方向研究生、Stereo-seq 平台用户、写论文讨论段的作者、组会汇报人。
cases.description_en: Your spatial transcriptomics analysis produced a beautiful conclusion — "an immunosuppressive niche forms at the tumor boundary" — but when someone asks at lab meeting "has this been published before?" you freeze: you can't tell literature consensus from your own first observation. This case turns a colorectal cancer Stereo-seq analysis (spatial domain detection, boundary niche, ligand-receptor communication) into an evidence-based review: it first decomposes the claim into 5 atomic assertions, then retrieves real evidence from PubMed and KEGG for each (the SPP1+ macrophage-CAF interaction in Nat Commun 2022, the HCC immune-barrier analogy, etc.), producing a supported/partially-supported/not-found evidence table, verified conclusions safe for the discussion section, novel hypotheses worth chasing (SPP1-CD44 maintaining the macrophage-CAF pairing), and validation experiment designs. Suitable for: spatial-omics graduate students, Stereo-seq platform users, discussion-section writers, and lab-meeting presenters.

artifacts.label: 空间转录组 TME 证据化审阅报告（自包含 HTML）

cases.prompt:
我做完了一张结直肠癌（CRC）组织切片的 Stereo-seq 空间转录组分析，请对结果做证据化审阅，产出单文件自包含 HTML 报告（图片 base64 内嵌、样式内联、无任何外部资源引用、内容默认可见、不使用 hash 锚点导航，可离线打开）。

分析结果（以下为演示用模拟数据，需在报告中明确标注；真实场景中由用户提供）：
- bin50 聚合后识别 4 个空间域：肿瘤核心 D1 / 边界区 D2 / 间质边缘 D3 / 正常组织 D4
- 边界区 SPP1+ 巨噬细胞（26%）与 POSTN+ CAF（24%）显著共定位，T 细胞在边界带（±3 bin）密度下降约 75%
- 空间约束配受体分析：CXCL12–CXCR4（得分 3.4）与 SPP1–CD44（3.1）在边界区最高
- 核心结论主张：「SPP1+ 巨噬与 POSTN+ CAF 在肿瘤边界形成免疫排斥生态位/免疫屏障」

要求：
1. 把复合结论拆解为可独立检索的原子主张清单（基因-细胞-空间定位、细胞-功能、空间结构、通路、潜在新发现）。
2. 用 PubMed（NCBI E-utilities）与 KEGG REST API 真实检索每条主张的证据（如 SPP1+ 巨噬-CAF 互作、CXCL12 介导 T 细胞排斥、肿瘤边界免疫屏障），检索命令与日期写入报告复现说明；禁止编造 PMID——检索不到就如实写「未找到」。
3. 输出证据表（主张 | 支持/部分支持/矛盾/未找到 | 来源 PMID/通路 ID | 强度）+ 已知结论（为何可信）+ 潜在新发现假设（可证伪陈述 + 支持线索 + 证据缺口 + 建议验证实验）+ 方法学风险（边界定义循环论证、bin 混合、配受体库偏差、多重检验、单切片代表性）+ 重点关注 Top-3。
4. 演示图（空间域散点图、边界区放大与沿轴密度曲线、配受体热图、空间域组成堆叠图）用 matplotlib 固定随机种子生成后 base64 内嵌。
5. 报告包含分析代码段（squidpy / SpaGCN / CellPhoneDB 风格，API 真实）与数据合规声明（演示数据与真实检索的边界写清楚）。
cases.prompt_en:
I have finished a Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics analysis of a colorectal cancer (CRC) tissue section. Please perform an evidence-based review of the results and produce a single self-contained HTML report (figures embedded as base64, styles inlined, no external resources, content visible by default, no hash-anchor navigation, openable offline).

Analysis results (simulated demo data below — must be clearly labeled in the report; in real use these come from the user):
- 4 spatial domains identified on bin50 aggregation: tumor core D1 / interface D2 / stromal edge D3 / normal D4
- SPP1+ macrophages (26%) and POSTN+ CAFs (24%) co-localize in the interface; T-cell density drops ~75% within the boundary band (±3 bins)
- Spatially constrained ligand-receptor analysis: CXCL12–CXCR4 (score 3.4) and SPP1–CD44 (3.1) highest in the interface
- Core claim: "SPP1+ macrophages and POSTN+ CAFs form an immunosuppressive niche / immune barrier at the tumor boundary"

Requirements:
1. Decompose the composite conclusion into an atomic-claim checklist (gene-cell-spatial location, cell-function, spatial structure, pathway, potential novel finding).
2. Retrieve real evidence for each claim via PubMed (NCBI E-utilities) and the KEGG REST API (e.g., SPP1+ macrophage-CAF interaction, CXCL12-mediated T-cell exclusion, tumor-boundary immune barrier); record the retrieval commands and date in the reproduction notes; never fabricate PMIDs — write "not found" when retrieval comes up empty.
3. Output an evidence table (claim | supported/partially-supported/contradicted/not-found | source PMID/pathway ID | strength) + verified conclusions (why they are trustworthy) + novel-finding hypotheses (falsifiable statement + supporting clues + evidence gap + suggested validation experiments) + methodological risks (circular boundary definition, bin mixing, ligand-receptor database bias, multiple testing, single-section representativeness) + Top-3 priorities.
4. Generate demo figures (spatial-domain scatter, boundary zoom with along-axis density curves, ligand-receptor heatmap, domain-composition stacked bar) with matplotlib at a fixed random seed and embed them as base64.
5. Include analysis code blocks (squidpy / SpaGCN / CellPhoneDB style, real APIs) and a data-compliance statement clarifying the boundary between demo data and real retrieval.

cases.title_en: Antibody Structure Prediction → CDR Quality Assessment
cases.subtitle: tFold-Ab 预测 7ox3 Fv 结构，CDR-H3 构象高亮可视化
cases.subtitle_en: tFold-Ab predicts 7ox3 Fv structure with CDR-H3 conformation highlighted in 3D
cases.description:

cases.title: OPC 个人工作室
cases.subtitle: 从客户到项目再到回款，一个人也能把工作室经营得井井有条
cases.subtitle_en: Run clients, projects and cash flow like a studio — even when you work solo
cases.description:
一个人经营工作室，客户、报价、项目任务、工时和回款往往散在不同表格与聊天窗口里。最容易出问题的不是不会做，而是同一件事重复填写、老客户复购还得从头建单、项目做完却忘了追尾款。

这个案例演示了一套单文件 OPC 个人工作室：8 个菜单覆盖首页、可拖动看板、客户、订单、项目、收付款、数据复盘和模板设置。客户页能查看合作与回款并发起“再次合作”；订单和项目可以复制、存为模板或从模板创建；订单确认后生成项目，任务和工时独立跟踪，分期应收自动补齐剩余报价；收入、支出、复购率、来源占比和类型时薪集中复盘。全部数据本地自动保存，支持 V1 手动迁移、JSON 备份和五工作表 Excel 导出。

适合：一人公司与个人工作室经营者；同时管理多个客户和项目的自由职业者；需要把复购、模板和交付流程标准化的创意服务者；希望数据自己掌握、离线也能工作的独立顾问。
cases.description_en:
Running a one-person studio often means clients, quotes, project tasks, hours and payments are scattered across spreadsheets and chat threads. The biggest risk is not lacking skill — it is re-entering the same information, rebuilding repeat-client work from scratch, and finishing delivery without following up on the final payment.

This case demonstrates a self-contained OPC studio workbench with eight sections: home, a draggable board, clients, orders, projects, finance, insights, and templates/settings. Client records combine relationship and payment history with a “work together again” action. Orders and projects can be duplicated, saved as templates, or created from templates. Confirmed orders become projects; tasks and time entries are tracked independently; new installment rows automatically fill the unallocated quote balance. Income, expenses, repeat-client rate, source share and category hourly value are reviewed in one place. Everything autosaves locally, with optional V1 migration, JSON backup, and a genuine five-sheet Excel export.

Ideal for: one-person companies and solo studios; freelancers managing several clients and projects; creative service providers standardizing repeat work and delivery; and independent consultants who want offline operation and full ownership of their data.
cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款（https://workbuddy.link/p/I4YOLlBwyjpd3qvGrneFah），需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：
把一个简单的接单工具升级成适用于 OPC（一人公司）和个人工作室的多菜单工作台，仍然交付为一个可离线打开的。不要加入线索、合同、内容运营、自动化、客户门户或报税。

导航包括：首页、看板、客户、订单、项目、收付款、数据复盘、模板与设置。首页突出今日任务、逾期应收、待跟进客户和经营摘要；看板按洽谈、待开始、进行中、待验收、已完成展示，并支持拖动与状态选择；客户页显示联系资料、合作历史、累计实收、待收和“再次合作”；订单支持服务项、分期应收、复制、存为模板和转项目；项目支持任务、工时、交付清单、修改轮次、复制和模板；财务与复盘展示收付款、支出、月收入、来源占比、复购率和类型时薪。

在订单和项目页直接提供“从模板新建”。新增分期时，默认金额自动等于报价减去已填分期合计。数据自动保存到浏览器本地，支持 JSON 备份、真实五工作表 Excel 导出和手动 V1 数据迁移。视觉采用清新可爱但可信赖的奶油白、薄荷绿和浅蓝风格，手机和电脑都能完整使用，无网络依赖。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library skill to replicate this workspace (https://workbuddy.link/p/I4YOLlBwyjpd3qvGrneFah) with online data storage and bidirectional sync. Prioritize the one-click replication flow; if unavailable, build from scratch:
Upgrade a simple order tracker into a multi-section workbench for an OPC (one-person company) or solo studio, while still delivering it as one self-contained HTML file that works offline. Do not add lead management, contracts, content operations, automation, client portals, or tax filing. The navigation should include Home, Board, Clients, Orders, Projects, Finance, Insights, and Templates & Settings. Home highlights today’s tasks, overdue receivables, clients to follow up with, and operating metrics. The board shows Negotiating, To Start, In Progress, Awaiting Acceptance, and Completed, with both drag-and-drop and a status selector. Client records include contact details, work history, total cash received, outstanding balances, and a “work together again” action. Orders support service items, installment receivables, duplication, saving as templates, and conversion into projects. Projects support tasks, time entries, deliverables, revision counts, duplication, and templates. Finance and insights cover payments, expenses, monthly income, source share, repeat-client rate, and category hourly value. Put “Create from template” directly on the Orders and Projects pages. When adding an installment, default its amount to the quote minus the total of installments already entered. Autosave all data in browser storage, with JSON backup, a genuine five-sheet Excel export, and manual V1 data migration. Use a fresh, friendly but trustworthy cream, mint and pale-blue visual style. Desktop and mobile must both retain the full workflow, and no network dependency.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

【数据来源（按我的实际情况）】
- 我已绑定业务系统：用【找钢龙虾MCP】取商机/客户行为数据；
- 我上传了客户/询价记录表：请读取并映射到客户、需求、询价频次、互动等口径；
- 我暂时没有数据：说明需要哪些字段并给示例清单。

【要求】
1. 查询【行业信息资产库】里这个行业的商机意向评分口径，综合询价频次、是否索要材质单/比价、复购周期、互动信号等给每条线索打意向分；
