cases.title: 「为」字为什么这么写
cases.subtitle: 看甲骨字形推本义——字库的释义为依据，必要时用联网检索补一段学界看法
cases.subtitle_en: Read the glyph, infer the origin — source from the library, supplement with scholarly views when needed
cases.description:
讲古文字最迷人的环节就是「为什么这么写」，但也最容易翻车：很多自媒体言之凿凿地讲「『为』就是大象的形状，因为古文字里『为』通『象』」，学界其实没这么简单。有些字库能直接给一句「本义为……」的字源依据，有些则要靠学者论文才能讲清来龙去脉。

这个案例演示的是「腾讯探元甲骨字查询助手」回答字形取象类问题的能力：用户问「『为』字为什么这么写」，专家先按字头查字库（query=「为的甲骨文」），命中字库释义就直接挂图说明；字库释义未涉及字形取象则如实告知「字库对此没有进一步说明」，并改走联网检索补一段学界看法、标注来源。整个过程不臆造字形、不强行把「为」解释为「大象」，区分字库依据与公开资料。

适合：古文字课讲「会意字 vs 形声字」、博物馆展板讲文字学小知识、文博自媒体做甲骨文字源栏目、字源类公众号做图文、对外汉语教师备字源课。
cases.description_en:
The most captivating beat in any paleography lesson is «why it was written that way» — and the easiest one to get wrong. Many casual writers confidently explain 「为」 as «the shape of an elephant, because 『为』 originally meant 『象』», but academia is more cautious. Sometimes the library gives a one-line dictionary entry for character origin; sometimes only scholarly papers can fill in the full backstory.

This case shows how the TanYuan Oracle Bone Script Lookup assistant answers glyph-origin questions: the user asks «why is 「为」 written that way?» The expert first queries the library (query: 「为的甲骨文」). If the library's interpretation covers the origin, the answer hangs on the glyph directly. If the library's interpretation does not address origin, the assistant honestly notes that the library has no further comment and switches to web search to add a calibrated scholarly view, properly credited. The answer never fabricates a glyph, never forces 「为」 to mean 「大象」, and keeps library sources separate from public sources.

Best for: paleography courses on compound-ideograph vs phono-semantic compounds, museum exhibit panels offering a paleography sidebar, cultural-heritage media running a character-origin column, character-origin WeChat accounts and overseas-Chinese teachers preparing character-origin lessons.

artifacts.label: 「为」字源解读

cases.prompt:
你是「腾讯探元甲骨字查询助手」。

# 任务
回答用户：**「『为』字为什么这么写」**，按混搭档位（D + 字卡）回答：先出字卡（图 → 表格 → 释义），再补一段字形取象的解读（字库够用就用字库，库不足就联网检索补一段）。

# 走法（严格按助手内置规则）
1. 字卡部分：
   - 调一次 `search_oracle_bone_character`，query 严格按 "为的甲骨文"。
   - 过滤：仅保留**字头等于「为」**的记录，其余丢弃（不论释义里出现「为」还是其它看似相关）。
   - 命中且释义涉及「字形取象」/「象形」「本义为……」「像……之形」等表述 → 直接挂在卡片下做一段解读，依据来自字库，**不**外加未在释义中出现的解释。
2. 字形取象部分：
   - 库内释义已说明 → 一段引用，标「> 来源：腾讯探元甲骨文字库」。
   - 库内释义未说明 → **如实告知**用户「字库对此没有进一步说明」，改走联网检索找学界主流看法（如「『为』本义大象 vs 本义母猴 vs 为+象字形混合」等说法均有学界讨论），分点简述、保留「待考」「或说」「(某某说)」等审慎表述，不选边站、不把一家之言说成定论，标「> 来源：联网检索」。
3. 字形图：仅在有编码时出图，URL 严格走 `https://static.jgw.qq.com/jgwpng/png/<编码>.png`。
4. 字库来源与联网来源在各段末尾**分别标注**，不合并成一句笼统的来源。

# 输出要求
- 一次回复给齐：字卡 + 字形取象解读（库依据或联网依据）。
- 不臆造字形、不强行解释为「大象」或其它单一说法；学界分歧如实并存。
- 全文不出现工具名、置信度、SQL、原始 JSON、检索过程叙述、甲骨字编码。

用户输入：「为」字为什么这么写？
cases.prompt_en:
You are the 'TanYuan Oracle Bone Script Lookup Assistant'.

# Task
Answer the user: **Why is 「为」 written that way?** Use the mixed mode (card + origin discussion): first emit the standard card (image → table → interpretation), then add a paragraph of glyph-origin discussion (use the library if it suffices, otherwise fall back to web search for a calibrated scholarly view).

# Workflow (strictly follow the assistant's built-in rules)
1. Card part:
   - Call `search_oracle_bone_character` exactly once, with canonical query "为的甲骨文".
   - Filter: keep ONLY records whose character head equals 「为」; everything else is discarded (no matter if the interpretation happens to mention 「为」).
   - If a retained interpretation mentions glyph origin (e.g. «象形», «本义为…», «像…之形»), use it directly as the discussion anchored to the card; do NOT add anything the interpretation does not contain.
2. Origin-discussion part:
   - Library interpretation sufficient → quote it directly, then close that block with `> 来源：腾讯探元甲骨文字库`.
   - Library interpretation does NOT cover origin → honestly tell the user «the library has no further comment on this», and switch to web search for the scholarly mainstream (e.g. competing views that 「为」 originally meant elephant, or a mother-monkey, or a hybrid elephant-representation, all of which have academic discussion). Present the views in short bullets, preserve cautious markers like «待考», «或说», «(某某说)», never pick a side, never assert any single view as established, and close with `> 来源：联网检索`.
3. Glyph image: render only when an internal glyph code is available. URL MUST be `https://static.jgw.qq.com/jgwpng/png/<code>.png`.
4. Library source and web source are credited separately at the end of their respective paragraphs — do not merge them into one generic line.

# Output requirements
- One single reply contains: the card + the origin discussion (either library-backed or web-backed).
- Do NOT fabricate glyph shapes, do NOT force a «great elephant» reading, do NOT pick a single academic side; present conflicting scholarly views honestly when they exist.
- NEVER expose the tool name, confidence scores, raw SQL/JSON, retrieval process narration, or the internal glyph code in the answer.

cases.description:
查甲骨字最容易踩的坑，是把某一家之言当成定论。同一个字形，学界往往并存几种互相说服不了的解释，教材却常常只印其中一种。

这个案例以「黄」字为例，演示「腾讯探元甲骨字查询助手」如何忠实呈现分歧：字库同时收录三种构形解释——佩玉说（像人佩玉之形，为珩或璜之初文）、由「矢」分化说（「黄」与「寅」皆由「矢」分化，借作珩或璜，与构形无关）、「尪」之初文说（从大，像人仰面向天、腹部膨大，假借为颜色之「黄」）——并用「或说」「也有人认为」明确标注，不替用户拍板。除此之外，还给出卜辞中的实际用法（多用作人名、地名或颜色，还可作神名）与六书归类（初文属合体象形）。

cases.description_en:
The most common trap in looking up oracle-bone forms is mistaking one scholar's reading for the settled answer. A single glyph often carries several competing explanations that none of its proponents can settle, yet textbooks usually print just one.

This case uses the character 「黄」 to show how the TanYuan Oracle Bone Script Lookup assistant represents that disagreement faithfully: the library records three coexisting etymologies — the pendant-jade reading, the derivation-from-arrow reading, and the wang-prototype reading — each explicitly hedged with formulaic wording rather than resolved into a single verdict. It also supplies attested oracle-bone usage and the six-categories classification.

Best for: museum educators, cultural-heritage media editors, introductory paleography courses, calligraphy and seal-engraving tutors, and editors fact-checking classical-script copy.

cases.description_en:
The awkward moment in class is rarely over an obscure glyph — it is the familiar one. Teachers can usually say a sentence about how 「象」 looks in oracle bone script, how it maps onto today's form, and why it was written that way, but producing a print-ready card students can paste into their notebooks is a different matter: every free image online is either a designer's re-drawing or carries an outright wrong glyph head, and reposting means risking misinformation.

This case demonstrates the TanYuan Oracle Bone Script Lookup assistant's single-glyph depth: feed it 「象」 and the expert queries the library, extracts the original meaning and visual etymology, merges variants where appropriate, and emits one tidy card (image → table → interpretation) with the library credited at the end. The output drops directly into lesson plans, exhibit panels and articles with no second-round proofreading.

Best for: museum docents covering the figurative extensions of 「象」, elementary-school Chinese teachers introducing compound-ideograph character origin, middle-school history teachers teaching Shang-period pictographs, publishers working on ancient-script columns, and seal-engraving artists cross-checking a glyph before carving.

cases.prompt:
你是「腾讯探元甲骨字查询助手」。

# 任务
查「象」字的甲骨字并出一张完整字卡。

# 走法（按助手内置规则）
1. 仅一次调用 `search_oracle_bone_character`，query 严格按 "象的甲骨文"。
2. 检索结果逐条筛：**字头（繁体或简体）必须等于「象」**，其余一律丢弃。
3. 同一字头命中多条记录：
   - 同一个甲骨字编码 → 视为同一异体，合并为一段。
   - 不同甲骨字编码 → 视为不同异体，在同一字卡下分「异体 1 / 异体 2」小节，各出各自的字形图与释义。
4. 字段渲染顺序：字头标题 → 字形图 → 读音 / 繁体 / 简体 表格 → 文字释义。
5. 字形图全部走 `https://static.jgw.qq.com/jgwpng/png/<编码>.png`。
6. 释义忠于字库原文，可改标点、改编号，但**不得增补**库外解释；库中未涉及的字段直接不出，不要写「暂无」「未知」「—」。
7. 末尾标注「> 来源：腾讯探元甲骨文字库」。

# 输出要求
- 单次回复完成整张卡，含字形图、表格、释义与异体（如有）。
- 全文不出现工具名、置信度、SQL、原始 JSON、检索过程叙述、甲骨字编码。
- 不展开金文/小篆/隶书演变（字库不提供这些字段），若想讲演变改走「联网检索 + 标源」。

用户输入：「象」的甲骨字是什么样子？
cases.prompt_en:
You are the 'TanYuan Oracle Bone Script Lookup Assistant'.

# Task
Look up 「象」 and produce one complete oracle-bone-script card.

# Workflow (follow the assistant's built-in rules)
1. Call `search_oracle_bone_character` exactly once, using the canonical query "象的甲骨文".
2. Filter each result record strictly: the character head (simplified or traditional) MUST equal 「象」; everything else is discarded.
3. If multiple records share the same oracle-bone code → treat as one variant, merge into a single section. If they have different codes → render them as distinct variants under the same character-head card, with separate subsections 「异体 1 / 异体 2」 each carrying its own glyph image and interpretation.
4. Field rendering order: head title → glyph image → reading / traditional / simplified table → interpretation paragraph.
5. All glyph images use `https://static.jgw.qq.com/jgwpng/png/<code>.png`.
6. The interpretation must track the library's wording. Punctuation and enumeration may be tidied, but do NOT add any explanation beyond the library's own. Fields absent from the library stay absent — never write "暂无", "未知" or "—" as placeholders.
7. Close with `> 来源：腾讯探元甲骨文字库`.

# Output requirements
- Deliver the entire card in a single reply, including glyph image, table, interpretation and any variants.
- NEVER expose the tool name, confidence scores, raw SQL/JSON, retrieval process narration, or the internal glyph code in the answer.
- Do NOT extend into bronze / seal / clerical-script evolution (those fields are not in the library). If the user wants evolution, switch to web search and credit the source.

User input: What does the oracle-bone-script form of 「象」 look like?

cases.description_en:

This case shows how to leverage Tencent Tanyuan relic and knowledge bases for parallel retrieval, plus 3-4 concurrent main-agent WebSearch passes (latest progress / benchmark cases / impact / historical lines), covering 3D laser scanning, high-resolution texture acquisition, AI-assisted restoration, digital twins and cloud exhibitions, movable-relic digitization standards, plus cultural-product development, delivering a 3-6 image + 1-2 trend-chart, Markdown/HTML/DOCX/PDF four-format trend review report.

Best for: museum digitization practitioners, archaeology and conservation engineers, curators and docents, cultural-heritage policy researchers, museum-tech and cultural-product professionals, museum and heritage graduate students.

cases.prompt_en:
Use the 'Tencent Tanyuan Academic Research - Trend Review' expert workflow to survey the 'Latest Progress of Palace Museum Digital Preservation Technology'.

Research scope (five dimensions):
- 3D laser scanning and high-resolution texture acquisition: ancient building bodies (Hall of Supreme Harmony, Hall of Mental Cultivation, Lingzhao Xuan brick carvings), movable relics (furniture, textiles, calligraphy), micrometer-grade 3D data acquisition
- AI-assisted restoration: virtual reconstruction of damaged works, calligraphy-painting stroke continuation, porcelain patching, polychrome enhancement, plus 'cultural-relic fingerprint' standards
- Digital twins and cloud exhibitions: 'Digital Palace Museum,' 'Panoramic Palace Museum,' 'Cloud Tour of the Palace' platforms, digitised touring exhibitions
- Movable-relic digitization standards: industry standard drafting, data specifications, conservation equipment R&D
- Activation and cultural-product development: digital IP, cultural products, research courses, public education

Delivery requirements (mandatory):
1. Parallel retrieval via Tanyuan dual bases MCP (search_movable_relics + search_relics) + 3-4 main-agent WebSearch passes for cross-source verification, prioritizing sources from the last 1-2 years (2025/2026)
2. ≥ 3 images (Wikimedia public domain / Palace Museum official site / public news sources), each verified real and topic-relevant
3. ≥ 1 trend chart (2-3 recommended: digitization timeline / technology sankyaku / global impact radar), rendered to SVG via matplotlib with strict label overlap avoidance
4. Four formats: Markdown master → HTML (base64-inlined images) → DOCX → PDF, trend-review structure (background → status → cases → impact → outlook → conclusion → limits → references)
5. Report date is the true current date; references sorted reverse-chronologically; conclusions only, no recommendations; key trend judgments sync to chat window

cases.description:
钱分散在券商、银行、零钱和基金里，每次想看看整体情况都要开五六个 App 对着算。

这个案例是 PAN 的个人理财工作台：首页一眼看到总资产、本月收支和储蓄率，配资产配置环形图和近 6 个月收支趋势；点开收支管理能看预算执行进度和分类支出，随手「记一笔」就写进资料库数据表；账户与现金流自动汇总各账户余额；理财目标按购车基金、应急备用金这样的家庭大事跟踪进度；再往深了走还有自选股行情、组合持仓与再平衡建议、提醒中心、投资笔记、2026 半年报专题（行业对标、ROE 散点、财务三表）、智能筛选和 AI 研报问答。所有记录落在资料库的结构化表里，手机电脑同步。

适合：想把散落各处的钱收进一个界面统一看的人、认真做预算和储蓄率管理的人、喜欢自己跟财报季和持仓做决策的个人投资者。
cases.description_en:
Money scattered across brokers, banks, wallets and funds means checking five apps just to answer "how am I doing?".

This case is PAN's personal finance workbench: the home page shows total assets, monthly income and spending, and the savings rate at a glance, with an asset-allocation ring and a 6-month income-vs-spending trend. The Income & Spending module tracks budget progress and spending by category, and one tap on "Add Entry" writes straight to a library data table. Accounts & Cash Flow aggregates balances across accounts; Financial Goals follows family milestones like the car fund and the emergency reserve. Go deeper and you get a watchlist with live quotes, portfolio positions with rebalancing advice, an alert center, investment notes, a 2026 interim-reports hub (industry benchmarking, ROE scatter, three statements), a smart screener and an AI research chat. All records live in structured library tables that sync across devices.

Best for: anyone who wants every scattered account in one view, people serious about budgeting and savings discipline, and hands-on investors who track earnings season and their own positions.

cases.description:
阅读综述论文时，最头疼的是机制描述分散在几十页的文字中，难以建立整体认知。

这个案例演示了如何将一篇46页的Nature子刊甲基化综述转化成可交互的3D可视化网页。场景中包含细胞核/线粒体/内质网等3D细胞器、DNA/RNA/蛋白三类甲基化的粒子动画、12项实时HUD指标条，以及6个疾病进展阶段（从正常稳态到癌症/神经系统疾病/衰老，再到治疗干预）。点击任意分子标签立即弹出功能详情面板。

适合：生物医学研究人员、学术论文作者制作补充材料、医学生理解表观遗传机制、科普内容创作者。
cases.description_en:
The most tedious part of reading review papers is piecing together mechanisms scattered across dozens of pages.

This case demonstrates transforming a 46-page Nature journal methylation review into an interactive 3D visualization. The scene features 3D organelles (nucleus/mitochondria/ER), particle animations for DNA/RNA/protein methylation, 12 real-time HUD metrics, and 6 disease progression stages—from normal homeostasis through cancer/neurological disorders/aging to therapeutic intervention. Click any molecular label for instant detail panels.

For: biomedical researchers, paper authors creating supplementary materials, medical students learning epigenetic mechanisms, science communicators.

cases.prompt:
请从以下论文PDF构建一个交互式甲基化机制可视化网页：

论文：Liu et al., 2023, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy 8:310, doi:10.1038/s41392-023-01528-y
论文标题：Methylation across the central dogma in health and diseases: new therapeutic strategies

要求：
1. 构建基于Three.js的3D交互场景，包含细胞膜（半透明圆角长方体）、细胞核（含染色质/组蛋白/核仁）、线粒体、内质网等细胞器。
2. 使用粒子系统分别展示DNA甲基化（蓝色，核内）、RNA甲基化（紫色，胞质）、蛋白甲基化（青色，胞质）和SAM甲基供体（金色）。
3. 右上角HUD面板显示12项实时指标：DNA甲基化、RNA甲基化、蛋白甲基化、SAM水平、CpG岛高甲基化、全基因组低甲基化、H3K4me3/H3K27me3/H3K9me3/H3K36me3、疾病进展、治疗响应。
4. 底部6个阶段按钮：正常甲基化稳态 → 早期表观遗传扰动 → 癌症甲基化重塑 → 神经系统疾病 → 衰老相关甲基化改变 → 治疗干预策略。阶段切换时参数平滑插值过渡。
5. 3D标签标注关键分子（DNMT1/3A/3B、TET1/2、METTL3/14、FTO、ALKBH5、EZH2、SUV39H1、SETD2、LSD1、MeCP2、p53、FMR1等），点击弹出详情面板。
6. 粒子行为驱动动画、键盘快捷键（Space/←→/R）。
7. 最终输出为单文件HTML，所有JS/CSS内联，支持file://离线打开。
cases.prompt_en:
Build an interactive methylation mechanism visualization webpage from the following paper PDF:

Paper: Liu et al., 2023, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy 8:310, doi:10.1038/s41392-023-01528-y
Title: Methylation across the central dogma in health and diseases: new therapeutic strategies

Requirements:
1. Build a Three.js-based 3D interactive scene with cell membrane (translucent rounded box), nucleus (with chromatin/histones/nucleolus), mitochondria, and endoplasmic reticulum.
2. Use particle systems to separately display DNA methylation (blue, nuclear), RNA methylation (purple, cytoplasmic), protein methylation (cyan, cytoplasmic), and SAM methyl donor (gold).
3. Top-right HUD panel showing 12 real-time metrics: DNA methylation, RNA methylation, protein methylation, SAM level, CpG island hypermethylation, global hypomethylation, H3K4me3/H3K27me3/H3K9me3/H3K36me3, disease progression, therapy response.
4. Bottom stage buttons for 6 stages: Normal methylation homeostasis → Early epigenetic perturbation → Cancer methylation remodeling → Neurological disorders → Aging-related methylation changes → Therapeutic intervention. Smooth parameter interpolation between stages.
5. 3D labels for key molecules (DNMT1/3A/3B, TET1/2, METTL3/14, FTO, ALKBH5, EZH2, SUV39H1, SETD2, LSD1, MeCP2, p53, FMR1, etc.), click to open detail panels.
6. Behavior-driven particle animations, keyboard shortcuts (Space/←→/R).
7. Final output as single-file HTML, all JS/CSS inlined, supports offline file:// opening.

cases.title_en: Batch Job Scheduler — Patent Claim Drafting
cases.subtitle: 1 条独立方法权利要求 + 10 条从属 + 覆盖对照表 + 待确认清单
cases.subtitle_en: 1 independent method claim + 10 dependent claims + cross-reference matrix + open-question checklist
cases.description:
最头疼的就是手写软件方法类专利的权利要求——既要覆盖核心创新点，又要每一条都能在交底书里找到依据，遇到文档没写清楚的地方要么硬补要么留漏洞。

这个案例把一份公开的「批任务调度架构」技术说明（GitHub raw, MIT 许可, 2.1KB 偏架构设计而非标准交底书）作为唯一事实来源，按 patent-claim-authoring-review skill 的「起草分支」流程跑通一遍：自动判断走起草分支、严格贴着交底书文字撰写、文档未提及的具体算法/接口名保持上位写法并显式列入待确认事项；最终产出 1 条独立方法权利要求（覆盖资源画像聚合+匹配打分+限频重排队+派发四步全链路） + 10 条从属权利要求（含滑动窗口平滑、间隔与分数变化双阈值、心跳契约假死检测、亲和性等可追溯细节），并配套「权利要求↔交底书依据」覆盖对照表与「待确认事项」清单（分 P0/P1/P2 三级优先级）。

适合：专利代理人（处理偏架构/非标准格式的交底书时）；技术发明人（需要快速从零散的设计说明中提炼权利要求骨架时）；法务/合规岗（需要审查权利要求是否过度推测、是否有交底书支撑时）。
cases.description_en:
Drafting software-method patent claims is painful: you need to cover the core invention while ensuring every single feature traces back to the disclosure — and when the disclosure is silent, you either over-imagine or leave loopholes.

This case takes a public "batch job scheduler architecture" note (GitHub raw, MIT-licensed, ~2.1KB, architecture-flavored rather than a standard disclosure) as the sole source of truth, and runs the full "drafting branch" workflow of the patent-claim-authoring-review skill: auto-determine the branch, write strictly against the document text, keep specific algorithm/interface names as upper-level wording or explicitly list them as open questions when the document is silent. Final outputs: 1 independent method claim (covering the full four-step pipeline: resource profile aggregation → matching scoring → rate-limited requeue → dispatch) + 10 dependent claims (including sliding-window smoothing, dual-threshold rate-limited requeue, heartbeat-contract death-detection, affinity, and other traceable details) + a "claim ↔ disclosure" cross-reference matrix + a P0/P1/P2 prioritized open-question checklist.

Best for: patent attorneys handling architecture-flavored / non-standard disclosures; technical inventors who need to quickly extract a claim skeleton from scattered design notes; legal/compliance reviewers who need to audit whether claims are over-speculative or properly grounded.

cases.prompt:
请按 patent-claim-authoring-review skill 的「起草分支」流程，依据以下公开技术说明文档起草一份软件方法类发明专利的权利要求书：

- 文档 URL：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/handsomestWei/patent-disclosure-skill/main/examples/example_batch_job_scheduler/knowledge/docs/architecture.md
- 文档许可：MIT（GitHub raw，可直接下载）
- 作者声明：本文档仅供本仓库专利技能示例使用，不对应任何真实产品（虚构示例）

工作流要求：
1. 先判定走「起草分支」，并先下载/阅读 architecture.md 全文与同目录口径一致的 sample_architecture_review.docx、sample_scheduler_deck.pptx（docx/pptx 内嵌的抽象模块/队列示意 PNG 不补充新特征，仅作交底书附图参考）。
2. 写 1 条独立方法权利要求，覆盖「资源画像聚合 + 匹配打分 + 限频重排队 + 派发」核心流程；并把 §2 痛点（异构集群大任务占满高性能节点/小任务长尾等待、静态优先级无法反映实时画像）与 §3 目标（可接受分钟级调度延迟、避免秒级频繁重排导致震荡）作为限定条件融入「限频重排队」步骤的「间隔阈值 + 分数变化阈值」两级限定。
3. 依据文档可追溯细节逐条续写从属权利要求，至少覆盖：多维资源指标（CPU/内存/IO）、滑动窗口平滑（具体算法作并列上位写法）、任务需求向量×节点画像匹配打分（具体运算式作并列上位写法）、限频重排队两级阈值（分钟级时间间隔+相对/绝对分数变化量，AND 同时满足）、仅对队列窗口子集重排（非全量）、静态优先级入队+基于匹配分数二次排序、失败重试（交底书写「略」，具体策略作推测并列入待确认）、心跳契约假死检测与任务迁移触发（对应交底书 §4 表格明文标注的「从属特征」）、任务迁移的实现方式（重新入队/重新选择节点并列）、亲和性标签与异构节点属性维度（算力/IO/存储/地域，后者为推测）、饥饿缓解+分钟级延迟。
4. 对文档未提及的任何具体算法/接口名/数值，保持上位写法或列入待确认事项；凡是基于通用技术原理的合理推测必须显式标注；不得替发明人脑补技术细节。
5. 一并给出：(a) 权利要求书工作稿 Markdown（含每条权利要求的起草思路）；(b) 「权利要求 ↔ 交底书依据」覆盖对照表（每项特征标注 ✅ 直接 / 🟡 可追溯 / ⚠️ 推测 + 原文引用位置）；(c) 待确认事项清单（按 P0 撰写前必确认 / P1 影响从属 / P2 暂不影响 分级）。
6. 全套终稿（3 份 Markdown）一次性写到 ./output/ 目录。

真实数据/来源声明：交底书 architecture.md 为公开 MIT 许可开源示例材料，URL 已在上面给出；草拟过程中所有技术特征都需回到该文档找原文依据；不得使用任何「示意/模拟/合成的虚假技术数据」代替交底书内容。
cases.prompt_en:
Following the "drafting branch" workflow of the patent-claim-authoring-review skill, draft a software-method invention patent claim set based on the following public technical note:

- Document URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/handsomestWei/patent-disclosure-skill/main/examples/example_batch_job_scheduler/knowledge/docs/architecture.md
- License: MIT (GitHub raw, directly downloadable)
- Author's notice: This document is a fictional example for this repository's patent-skill demo and does NOT correspond to any real product.

Workflow requirements:
1. First determine to take the "drafting branch"; download and read architecture.md in full, plus the same-directory sample_architecture_review.docx and sample_scheduler_deck.pptx (their embedded module/queue diagram PNGs are abstract and add NO new features — use them only as disclosure-figure references).
2. Write 1 independent method claim covering the core flow: "resource profile aggregation + matching scoring + rate-limited requeue + dispatch". Fold §2 pain points (heterogeneous cluster: large tasks monopolize high-perf nodes, small tasks long-tail waiting; static priority cannot reflect real-time profile) and §3 goals (accept minute-level dispatch latency, avoid second-level requeue thrashing) into the "rate-limited requeue" step as a dual-threshold (time interval + score change) limitation.
3. Sequentially draft dependent claims based on traceable details from the document. Cover at least: multi-dimensional resource metrics (CPU/memory/IO); sliding-window smoothing (specific algorithm as parallel upper-level wording); task-demand vector × node-profile matching (specific formula as parallel upper-level wording); rate-limited requeue dual-threshold (minute-level time interval + relative/absolute score change, AND-gated); queue-window subset requeue (not full requeue); static-priority enqueue + match-score based secondary sorting; failure retry (the document writes "(略)", treat specific strategy as speculation and list as open question); heartbeat-contract death-detection and task migration trigger (corresponding to the "从属特征" row in §4 table); migration implementation (re-enqueue / re-select-and-dispatch as parallel); affinity tags and heterogeneous-node attribute dimensions (compute/IO/storage/region — region is speculation); starvation mitigation + minute-level latency.
4. For any specific algorithm/interface/numeric value not mentioned in the document, keep upper-level wording OR list as an open question; any reasonable speculation based on common technical principles MUST be explicitly marked; never fabricate technical details for the inventor.
5. Also produce: (a) claim-set working draft in Markdown (with drafting rationale per claim); (b) "claim ↔ disclosure" cross-reference matrix (mark each feature as ✅ direct / 🟡 traceable / ⚠️ speculation + source location); (c) open-question checklist (prioritize as P0 must-confirm before drafting / P1 affects dependents / P2 does not affect claims yet).
6. Write all final deliverables (3 Markdown files) into ./output/ in one batch.

Data-source declaration: the disclosure document architecture.md is public, MIT-licensed, open-source example material (URL above); every technical feature in the draft must trace back to the document; do NOT use any "示意/模拟/synthesized fake technical data" in place of disclosure content.

cases.title: 注塑机锁模力自适应调节专利权利要求书
cases.title_en: Patent Claims for Adaptive Injection Molding Clamping Force
cases.subtitle: 从技术交底书起草 1 条独权 + 6 条从权，逐条标注出处与起草思路
cases.subtitle_en: One independent plus six dependent claims drafted from a technical disclosure, each with source and rationale
cases.description:
写专利权利要求最怕两件事：一是漏掉交底书里的关键细节，二是替发明人脑补交底书没写的内容。这个案例演示了如何把一份《注塑机锁模力自适应调节_技术交底书》交给 AI，起草出 1 条独立方法权利要求加 6 条从属权利要求的完整权利要求书，每条都标注交底书出处与起草思路，并配套「权利要求 ↔ 交底书依据」覆盖对照表和 8 项待确认事项清单，温度补偿公式、采样周期、阈值等细节全部溯源到原文。

适合：专利代理人、企业 IPR、发明人，以及一切需要从技术交底书准备专利申请文件的场景。
cases.description_en:
Drafting patent claims is scary in two ways: missing key details in the technical disclosure, or inventing details the disclosure never mentions. This case shows how to hand a technical disclosure on adaptive clamping force control to AI and get a complete claim set — one independent method claim plus six dependent claims — with each claim sourced back to the disclosure, together with a claim-to-disclosure coverage table and a list of 8 items to confirm with the inventor. Every detail, from the temperature-compensation formula to the sampling period and thresholds, is traceable to the source text.

Best for: patent attorneys, corporate IPR staff, inventors, and anyone preparing patent application documents from a technical disclosure.
cases.prompt:
请根据附件《注塑机锁模力自适应调节_技术交底书.md》，为我起草一份完整的专利申请权利要求书，把全套终稿一次性写入指定输出目录（默认 ./output/）：

1. 先写 1 条独立方法权利要求，再依据交底书「进一步地」部分逐条续写从属权利要求，编号与引用关系清晰；
2. 给出每条从属权利要求对应的交底书出处与起草思路；
3. 输出三件套：权利要求书工作稿、权利要求↔交底书依据覆盖对照表、待确认事项清单；
4. 严格以交底书为唯一事实来源：交底书未提及的技术细节保持上位写法或列入待确认事项，不要替发明人脑补；交底书中的采样周期、阈值等示意值按原样写入并在待确认清单中标注；
5. 交底书中含糊处（如偏差值计算口径）如实标注为待确认，不臆断。

附件：[粘贴/上传技术交底书 Markdown 全文]

cases.title: 权利要求技术细节核实
cases.subtitle: 核实从属项「步进电机驱动丝杆」限定是否有交底书依据，区分原文与推测并给出修订建议
cases.subtitle_en: Verify whether the "stepper motor & lead screw" limitation is supported by the disclosure, separate facts from speculation, and advise on claim revision
cases.description: 写专利权利要求最怕的就是把交底书里没有的细节写进去——从属项限定得越具体，越容易因缺乏依据被质疑，保护范围也越收越窄。这个案例演示了如何把一条「步进电机驱动丝杆微调夹持开度」的从属项限定，对照交底书逐层核实：先检索正文原文依据，再从 docx 二进制检查嵌入附图（本例确无图片，如实标注「未提取到附图」），最后把「原文结论」与「基于通用技术原理的合理推测」明确分开，给出「保持上位写法」还是「列入待确认事项」的处理建议，全程不替发明人脑补技术细节。适合：专利代理人、企业 IPR、发明人，以及一切需要核对权利要求与交底书一致性的场景。
cases.description_en: The worst fear when drafting patent claims is writing in details that the invention disclosure never mentions — the more specific a dependent claim gets, the more it can be challenged for lack of support, and the narrower the protection becomes. This case shows how to take a dependent-claim limitation like "stepper motor driving a lead screw to fine-tune the clamping opening" and verify it layer by layer against the disclosure: first search the original text for supporting evidence, then inspect the docx binary for embedded figures (none in this example, honestly marked as "no embedded image extracted"), and finally separate "original-text findings" from "reasonable speculation based on general technical principles", with a clear recommendation to keep the broader claim language or list it as a to-be-confirmed item — never inventing technical details on behalf of the inventor. Suitable for: patent attorneys, corporate IPR staff, inventors, and anyone who needs to check consistency between claims and the disclosure.
cases.prompt: 请对照《静脉输液滴速控制_交底书.docx》核实一个技术细节：权利要求的从属项想限定「步骤S3 中夹持机构的调节方式是『步进电机驱动丝杆微调夹持开度』」，请帮我确认这一限定在交底书文字里是否有依据；如果文字不足以说明，请尝试从 docx 二进制中提取嵌入的附图（图1）进一步核实（若 docx 中确无嵌入图片，请如实说明「未提取到附图」）。请明确答复：交底书是否有该依据；若没有，请把「原文结论」与「基于通用技术原理的合理推测」分开写清，并给出这条从属权利要求该怎么处理的建议（保持上位写法 or 列入待确认事项）。请把核实结论与修订建议输出为一份 Markdown 报告 + 一份单文件 HTML 报告（样式简洁专业、资源全内联），HTML 为最终展示主产物。
cases.prompt_en: Verify a technical detail against the disclosure document 静脉输液滴速控制_交底书.docx: a dependent claim wants to limit that "in step S3, the clamping mechanism is adjusted by a stepper motor driving a lead screw to fine-tune the clamping opening". Please confirm whether this limitation has any basis in the disclosure text; if the text is insufficient, try to extract the embedded figure (Fig. 1) from the docx binary for further verification (if the docx truly contains no embedded image, honestly state "no embedded image extracted"). Give a clear answer on whether the disclosure supports this limitation; if not, clearly separate the "original-text findings" from "reasonable speculation based on general technical principles", and advise how to handle this dependent claim (keep the broader wording or list it as a to-be-confirmed item). Output the verification conclusion and revision advice as a Markdown report plus a single-file HTML report (clean professional style, all resources inlined), with the HTML as the final showcase artifact.

cases.title: 六维度患教内容审核
cases.subtitle: 粘贴患教正文，一键输出分级审核意见
cases.subtitle_en: Paste patient education content, get graded review comments in one pass
cases.description:
医学科普内容发布前最怕的就是漏审——数据和文献原文差一个百分点、把复合终点写成单一终点、推介药物却没写安全性提示，这些问题人工逐条核对一篇要花半天，还容易看漏。

这个案例把一篇克罗恩病患教文章交给 AI 做六维度全量审核，审核意见直接标回原文。产物顶部是审核结论（8 项需修改、7 处标注建议优化、六个维度各自结论），下方左栏是文章原文、问题句带底色高亮和序号，右栏是逐条审核意见，点高亮能定位到对应意见、点意见能跳回原文，文末再按需修改与建议优化分组展开全部 18 条明细。每条意见都指到具体段落和原文——比如查出文中「47%-55% 维持临床缓解」实为文献 Table 3 的复合终点（第12周应答且第48周缓解），「34%-37% 内镜缓解」的下限在 Figure 4 中实为 33%，临床缓解标准把原文「每日稀便≤3次」误写为「每周较基线增加≤3次」。

适合：医学内容编辑、药企市场与医学事务人员、患教内容审核员、健康科普自媒体运营、医学编辑团队负责人。
cases.description_en:
The biggest fear before publishing medical content is a missed check — a percentage point that diverges from the cited paper, a composite endpoint written up as a single endpoint, a drug promoted without any safety notice. Verifying one article by hand takes half a day and things still slip through.

This case hands a Crohn's disease patient education article to AI for a full six-dimension review, writing comments back onto the original text. The deliverable opens with the verdict (8 must-fix items, 7 highlighted suggestions, and a conclusion for each of the six dimensions); below it, the article sits on the left with problem sentences highlighted and numbered, and the review comments on the right — click a highlight to jump to its comment, click a comment to jump back to the text — followed by all 18 findings expanded at the end, grouped into must-fix and suggested improvements. Every comment points to a specific paragraph and the original wording — for example, it found that "47%-55% maintained clinical remission" actually corresponds to the composite endpoint in Table 3 (week-12 response AND week-48 remission), that the lower bound of "34%-37% endoscopic remission" is in fact 33% in Figure 4, and that the clinical remission criterion misstated the source's "daily stool frequency ≤3" as "weekly increase of ≤3 over baseline".

Suitable for: medical content editors, pharma marketing and medical affairs staff, patient education reviewers, health science communication operators, and medical editorial team leads.

artifacts.label: 审核报告网页版（头部结论 + 原文标注 + 批注联动）

cases.prompt:
你是医学科普内容审核助手，请对我提供的患教文章做一次完整的六维度审核，并把审核意见标注回原文，输出为一份可直接打开的审核报告网页（不要分多轮追问，一次输出到底）。

待审核内容：{粘贴患教文章正文，含参考文献列表}

请按以下六个维度依次审核：
1. 严重问题：政治法律红线、低俗内容、医疗高风险、商业推广倾向、版权风险
2. 科学性：医学概念与数据准确性，逐项核对文中数据与所引参考文献原文是否一致（含终点定义、分析集、单位、数值区间），检查绝对化与夸大表述
3. 出版规范：标题层级与编号连续性、段落样式一致性、标点符号、图表质量与引用标注位置、参考文献著录格式
4. 语言风格：面向患者的可读性，专业术语与英文缩写首次出现是否给出全称和通俗解释
5. 医学逻辑：因果关系是否成立、数据能否支持结论、推荐方案与指南是否一致、关键安全信息（不良反应/禁忌/用药前筛查）是否缺失
6. 参考文献：来源级别、时效性、著录格式、与正文标注体系是否对应、具体数据与观点是否标注引用

网页需包含以下四部分：
- 头部审核结论：需修改与建议优化的总数，以及六个维度各自的结论概述
- 文章原文：完整保留原文，有问题的句子用底色高亮并编号（红色=需修改，黄色=建议优化）
- 审核意见栏：与原文并排，逐条给出严重程度、所属维度、问题描述、修改建议
- 文末明细：按「需修改」「建议优化」分组，逐条展开完整意见

交互与呈现要求：
- 点击正文高亮可定位到对应审核意见，点击意见可跳回原文位置
- 文中的评分量表等表格请还原为网页表格，不要用截图，保证文字清晰可选中
- 单文件 HTML，CSS/JS/图片等资源全部内联，可离线打开

审核意见撰写要求：
- 涉及数据与文献不一致时，必须写明文献中的原始位置（如 Table 3 / Figure 4）与原始数值，并给出按原文改写后的建议表述
- 每条修改建议须具体可执行，不要只说「建议核实」
- 保留原文全部内容，只做标注，不要改写正文
- 只发现问题、给修改建议，不做「可以发布」的发布决策
cases.prompt_en:
You are a medical science communication content reviewer. Please run a complete six-dimension review on the patient education article I provide, write the review comments back onto the original text, and output a ready-to-open review report web page (do not split this across multiple rounds of questions — produce it in one pass).

Content to review: {paste the patient education article, including the reference list}

Review across the following six dimensions in order:
1. Serious issues: political/legal red lines, vulgar content, high medical risk, commercial promotion bias, copyright risk
2. Scientific accuracy: accuracy of medical concepts and data — verify item by item whether figures in the text match the cited source (including endpoint definitions, analysis sets, units, and value ranges); check for absolute or exaggerated claims
3. Publishing standards: heading hierarchy and numbering continuity, paragraph style consistency, punctuation, table/figure quality and citation placement, reference formatting
4. Language style: readability for patients; whether technical terms and English abbreviations are given full names and plain-language explanations on first use
5. Medical logic: whether causal claims hold, whether data supports the conclusions, whether recommendations align with guidelines, and whether critical safety information (adverse reactions / contraindications / pre-treatment screening) is missing
6. References: source level, timeliness, citation format, correspondence with in-text citation markers, and whether specific data and claims carry citations

The page must contain these four parts:
- Header verdict: total counts of must-fix and suggested items, plus a summary conclusion for each of the six dimensions
- Article text: the full original text preserved, with problematic sentences highlighted and numbered (red = must fix, amber = suggested improvement)
- Review comment pane: side by side with the text, listing severity, dimension, problem description, and recommendation one by one
- Detailed findings at the end: grouped into "Must fix" and "Suggested improvements", each expanded in full

Interaction and presentation requirements:
- Clicking a highlight in the text jumps to its corresponding comment; clicking a comment jumps back to its position in the text
- Render scoring scales and other tables as real HTML tables rather than screenshots, so the text stays sharp and selectable
- A single-file HTML with all CSS/JS/image assets inlined, openable offline

Requirements for the comments themselves:
- When data diverges from the cited source, state the exact location in the source (e.g. Table 3 / Figure 4) and the original value, and provide suggested wording rewritten to match the source
- Every recommendation must be specific and actionable — do not merely say "please verify"
- Preserve all original content; only annotate — do not rewrite the body text
- Only identify problems and give revision advice; do not make any "ready to publish" decision

cases.title: 导诊挂号
cases.subtitle: 看病第一步不卡壳：帮你选对科室 + 附近医院推荐 + 就诊全流程须知 + 权威专家，一页理清
cases.subtitle_en: Never stuck at the first step of seeing a doctor: the right department, nearby hospitals, full visit guidance, and top specialists in one page
cases.description:
人生病时最常见的卡壳，往往不是病本身，而是“第一步不知道往哪迈”：该挂什么科、去哪家医院、找哪位医生——信息不对称让不少人挂错号、跑错科室，耽误了时间也消磨了耐心。

以「打喷嚏、流鼻涕、夜间鼻塞」为例：把症状说给微小医听，它会一步步帮你理清该挂什么科，推荐杭州 5 家附近的医院（等级、地址、特色都写明），讲清就诊前中后要留意的事，还附全国耳鼻喉权威专家的推荐——一页理清，存图带着去看病，少走冤枉路。
cases.description_en:
When people get sick, the most common stumbling block isn't the illness itself — it's not knowing where to take the first step: which department, which hospital, which doctor. That information gap leads many to the wrong registration desk, wasting both time and patience.

Take "sneezing, runny nose, nighttime congestion" as an example: tell Weixiaoyi your symptoms, and it gently walks you to the right department, recommends 5 nearby hospitals in Hangzhou with their grades, addresses and strengths, explains what to keep in mind before, during and after the visit, and adds top national ENT specialists — all on one page you can save and bring along, so you don't waste a single trip.

cases.prompt: 我最近一直打喷嚏流鼻涕，晚上睡觉鼻子都是堵的。我该看什么科室？离我比较近的医院有哪些？就诊有什么注意事项？全国范围比较权威的医生有哪些，我想了解医生尽量详细的信息。将结果生成html进行展示。html 功能：1. 如有跳转链接，要同时支持点击跳转及弹窗扫描二维码访问；2. 固定导航栏，根据页面尺寸显示在顶部或侧边，需高亮当前模块，点击切换定位页面至对应模块；3. 可将页面内容保存为本地图片，图片中的信息元素显隐、排版需根据分享场景做一下优化；4. 数据列表限制最多5条；5.头部信息标题、副标题文本需体现该页面为全面的健康服务，显示品牌名称“微小医”及logo（https://kano.guahao.com/zj8979871203），logo裁成圆形。html ui设计风格：1. "医疗蓝扁平卡片流"：纯白大圆角卡片，以 0.5px 细线代替阴影分隔，全部交互强调收敛到单一品牌蓝 #3f86ff 及其渐变/透明度变体，通过 PingFang SC 三档字重与四级灰阶建立信息层级，主次按钮（渐变实心 vs 浅蓝描边）形成清晰的操作引导优先级；2. 统一配内联的svg图标；3. 可交互按钮鼠标悬停时增加动效；4. 元素布局根据页面尺寸调整，以提高展示效果；5. 重点内容用流程图、指标卡片等特殊样式进行说明。
cases.prompt_en: I've been sneezing with a runny nose lately, and my nose is completely blocked when I sleep at night. Which department should I see? Which hospitals are nearby? What should I pay attention to during the visit? Who are the most authoritative doctors nationwide — I'd like detailed information about them. Present the results as an HTML page. HTML features: 1. Any external link should support both direct click-through and a popup with a scannable QR code; 2. A fixed navigation bar that sits on top or on the side depending on page width, highlighting the current section and scrolling to the corresponding section on click; 3. The page content can be saved as a local image, with element visibility and layout optimized for the sharing scenario; 4. Data lists are limited to 5 items at most; 5. The header title and subtitle should convey that this page is a comprehensive health service, showing the brand name "Weixiaoyi" and its logo (https://kano.guahao.com/zj8979871203), with the logo cropped into a circle. HTML UI style: 1. "Medical-blue flat card flow": pure white cards with large border radius, 0.5px hairlines instead of shadows for separation, all interactive emphasis confined to a single brand blue #3f86ff and its gradient/opacity variants, information hierarchy built on three font weights of PingFang SC and four grayscale levels, with primary vs. secondary buttons (solid gradient vs. light-blue outline) forming a clear action priority; 2. Consistent inline SVG icons; 3. Hover animations on all interactive buttons; 4. Element layout adapts to page size for better presentation; 5. Key content should be illustrated with special styles such as flowcharts and metric cards.

cases.title: 慢病用药患教长文六维审核
cases.title_en: Six-Dimension Review of Chronic-Disease Medication Patient-Education Articles
cases.subtitle: 把一篇糖尿病患教长文交给专家，按六维度逐段审核输出结构化报告
cases.subtitle_en: Hand a long diabetes patient-education article to the assistant; get a structured six-dimension review report with issue-by-issue findings and revision suggestions
cases.description:
私域里发的糖尿病、高血压患教长文，最怕科学性出错——用药剂量、禁忌、停药说法一旦写错，患者照做就有风险，运营也担责任。

本案例把一篇 2800 字的糖尿病患教长文交给「腾讯健康药箱-私域患教内容审核助手」，它按「科学性准确性 / 引用规范性 / 医学逻辑性 / 数据来源可靠性 / 特殊人群覆盖 / 合规风险」六维度逐段审核，输出结构化 Markdown 审核报告：每处问题标注位置、类型、风险等级（Critical/High/Medium/Low）、参考依据（NMPA说明书/指南/法规）和修改建议，最终给出 Approved/Rejected 判定。

适合: 药企/互联网医院私域运营、药箱社群内容编辑、慢病管理产品经理、医学编辑。
cases.description_en:
Patient-education long-reads on chronic diseases (diabetes, hypertension) published in private domains carry the highest risk of scientific errors — wrong dosage, missing contraindications, or incorrect stop-medication advice can directly harm patients and expose operators to liability.

This case hands a ~2,800-word diabetes patient-education article to the Tencent Health Pill-Box Private-Domain Patient-Education Content Review Assistant. It reviews paragraph by paragraph across six dimensions (Scientific Accuracy / Citation Norms / Medical Logic / Data Source Reliability / Special-Population Coverage / Compliance Risk), outputting a structured Markdown review report: each issue is tagged with location, type, risk level (Critical/High/Medium/Low), reference basis (NMPA package insert / guideline / regulation), and revision suggestion, ending with an Approved/Rejected verdict.

Suitable for: private-domain operations at pharma companies / internet hospitals, content editors for pill-box communities, chronic-disease product managers, medical editors.
cases.prompt:
我们运营糖尿病患者社群，市场部写了篇患教长文准备推送。我不是医学背景，看不出用药说法有没有问题，但发出去几千人会照着做，出事我担不起。帮我逐条查一遍，指出哪里错了、多严重、怎么改。

以下是文中几个我拿不准的段落：

1. 「格泰平® 二甲双胍缓释片采用先进缓释技术，临床数据显示 85% 的患者三个月内血糖达标（MULTI-CARE 研究，2023）。」

2. 「服用方法：每日一次随晚餐服用。如果当天忘记吃，第二天可以一次吃两片补上，保证疗程完整。」

3. 「连续 3 个月空腹血糖低于 6.0、糖化血红蛋白低于 6.5%，说明胰岛功能已恢复，可以自行逐步减量直至停药。我们社群的张阿姨停药 8 个月血糖依然稳定，说明糖尿病是可以通过规范用药实现逆转的。」

4. 「特殊人群：孕妇孕期禁用所有口服降糖药；老年患者代谢慢，剂量可自行酌情减半；轻中度肝损伤一般可继续正常服用。」

5. 「饮食建议：主食换成粗粮可以放心多吃，粗粮不升血糖；标注『无糖』就代表不含糖，可以随意吃；水果尽量不吃。」

6. 「运动建议：餐后立即运动效果最好，可以直接消耗刚吃进去的糖分。」

麻烦按严重程度排序，明确区分必须改和建议改，最后给我一份能直接交回市场部的整改清单。
cases.prompt_en:
We run a diabetes patient community, and our marketing team drafted a patient-education long-read for distribution. I don't have a medical background — I can't tell whether the medication claims hold up, but thousands of people will follow them once published, and I can't carry that risk. Please review each item, tell me what's wrong, how serious it is, and how to fix it.

Here are the passages I'm unsure about:

1. "Getaiping® Metformin ER Tablets use advanced extended-release technology; clinical data show 85% of patients reach glycemic targets within three months (MULTI-CARE study, 2023)."

2. "Dosing: once daily with dinner. If you miss a dose, take two tablets the next day to make it up and keep the course complete."

3. "If fasting glucose stays below 6.0 and HbA1c below 6.5% for three consecutive months, islet function has recovered and you may taper down on your own until you stop. Aunt Zhang in our community has been off medication for eight months with stable glucose — proof that diabetes can be reversed through proper medication."

4. "Special populations: all oral hypoglycemics are contraindicated during pregnancy; elderly patients metabolize slowly so the dose may be halved at your own discretion; mild-to-moderate liver injury generally allows continued normal dosing."

5. "Diet: switch staples to whole grains and eat freely — whole grains don't raise blood glucose; anything labeled 'sugar-free' contains no sugar and can be eaten at will; avoid fruit entirely."

6. "Exercise: working out immediately after meals is most effective — it burns off the sugar you just ate."

Please rank issues by severity, clearly separate must-fix from nice-to-fix, and finish with a remediation checklist I can hand straight back to marketing.

cases.title: 个人IP成长台
cases.subtitle: 把定位、作品、涨粉、变现和成长路线拧成一个手绘风工作台
cases.subtitle_en: A hand-drawn workspace that ties your positioning, works, growth and monetization together
cases.description:
做自媒体最怕的就是「一腔热血开号，三个月后不知道自己在往哪走」——定位飘忽、作品散落各处、涨粉停滞也说不清卡在哪、变现更是一笔糊涂账。

这个案例做出来的是一个手绘可爱风格的单文件网页工作台：把「我是谁（定位）」「我做了什么（作品库）」「涨了多少粉、互动怎么样（数据看板 + 手绘成长曲线）」「靠什么赚钱（变现记录）」「下一步往哪走（成长路线图）」全塞进一个页面。数据全存在浏览器本地，关掉再打开还在；PC 端是侧边栏、手机端自动变底部 Tab，可以直接「添加到主屏幕」当 App 用；还内置了中英双语，链接后面加 ?lang=en 就整页切英文。

适合：刚起号想理清定位的自媒体新人、需要复盘涨粉数据的内容创作者、有多平台账号要统一管理的博主、想把副业IP做成长期资产的斜杠青年、以及带学员做个人品牌的运营教练。
cases.description_en:
The scariest part of building a personal brand online is starting with passion and, three months later, having no idea where you're heading — a fuzzy positioning, works scattered everywhere, stalled follower growth you can't explain, and monetization that's a total mess.

This case produces a single-file web workspace in a cute hand-drawn style: it packs everything into one page — who you are (positioning), what you've made (works library), how much you've grown and how engagement looks (a dashboard plus a hand-drawn growth curve), how you make money (monetization log), and where to go next (a growth roadmap). All data lives in your browser's local storage, so it's still there after you close and reopen; on desktop it's a sidebar, on mobile it turns into a bottom tab bar you can "add to home screen" and use like an app. It also ships with built-in bilingual support — just append ?lang=en to the URL to flip the whole page to English.

Great for: creators who just launched an account and want to nail their positioning, content makers who need to review follower data, multi-platform bloggers who want one place to manage it all, slashies turning a side-hustle IP into a long-term asset, and coaches guiding students through personal branding.

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款（https://workbuddy.link/p/GfhrA29pYRrt1I6k9Qx17b），需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：
帮我做一个「个人IP成长台」——给做自媒体/个人品牌的人用的单文件网页工作台，直接用浏览器打开就能用，数据存本地浏览器（localStorage），关掉再打开不丢。

要包含这几个模块：
1. 首页概览：今日激励语 + 核心数据卡片（总粉丝、总作品、本月涨粉、变现总额），一眼看清现状；
2. 我的定位：记录账号定位、目标人群、内容方向、一句话人设；
3. 作品库：登记发过的内容（标题/平台/发布日期/数据表现/链接），能增删改；
4. 涨粉复盘：多平台粉丝数据看板 + 用内联 SVG 手绘一条粉丝成长曲线，能编辑每月数据点；
5. 变现记录：记录每一笔收入（来源/金额/日期/备注），自动汇总；
6. 成长路线图：分阶段的成长目标与打卡，标记完成进度。

设计要求：整体走「手绘可爱风」——不规则圆角、粗墨描边、贴纸式硬阴影、卡片轻微倾斜、有弹性/摇摆的小动画，配色明亮活泼但不刺眼；PC 端用侧边栏导航，手机端自动切换成底部 Tab，触控友好，可添加到手机主屏当 App。

技术约束：单个 HTML 文件、CSS/JS 全部内联、不依赖任何外部 CDN 或联网资源、可完全离线打开；提供浅色/深色主题切换。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。

cases.title: 个人办公工作台
cases.subtitle: 待办、灵感、项目跟进、周复盘四合一，数据存本地，断网可用
cases.subtitle_en: Tasks, notes, project tracking and weekly review in one offline-first single-file app
cases.description:
待办清单换了七八个，还是没坚持下来。要么昨天没做完的第二天就消失了，要么项目和任务是两张互不相干的表——项目卡在哪儿只能靠脑子记，到了周末想复盘，连这周做完几件事都数不清。想找个简单点的工具，结果都要注册登录、数据存在别人服务器上。

本案例做出的是一个单文件 HTML 工作台：左侧导航分「今日焦点 / 今天待办 / 灵感速记 / 项目跟进 / 每周复盘 / 数据备份」六个区，顶部常驻「今天要处理的」把逾期任务和卡住的项目一并标红。待办按四象限分优先级，昨天没做完的会自动带到今天并累计「顺延 N 次」（顺延有成本，自己才会不好意思拖）；未来任务单独归到「即将到来」按日期分组。项目与待办通过关联打通——任务可挂到项目下，项目卡上直接显示进度条和未完成清单、能就地勾选完成；删项目时会先问你保留还是一并删除待办，不静默丢数据。周复盘统计完成数、优先级分布、精力花在哪些项目上，以及卡点汇总。全部数据存在浏览器本地并自动保存，攒满 20 条会提醒导出备份，配「导出 / 导入」实现换设备搬家，手机端按钮加大到 44px 以上。

适合：想要一个不用注册、数据自己掌握的轻量工作台的人；同时要盯多个项目又容易漏掉卡点的产品/运营；习惯用待办清单但总是坚持不下来、需要「顺延成本」提醒的自我管理者；需要每周复盘产出的独立工作者。
cases.description_en:
You've tried half a dozen to-do apps and none of them stuck. Either yesterday's unfinished tasks silently disappear, or projects and tasks live in two unrelated lists — you keep blockers in your head, and by the weekend you can't even count how many things you actually finished. You just want something simple, but everything requires signup and stores your data on someone else's server.

This case produces a single-file HTML workbench: a left sidebar with six sections (Today's Focus / Tasks / Quick Notes / Project Tracking / Weekly Review / Backup), plus a persistent "needs attention today" banner that flags overdue tasks and blocked projects in red. Tasks use four-quadrant priorities; anything unfinished carries over to today automatically with a running "postponed N times" counter (postponing has a visible cost, so you stop doing it). Future tasks live in a separate "Upcoming" view grouped by date. Projects and tasks are properly linked — tasks attach to a project, project cards show a progress bar plus open items you can check off in place, and deleting a project asks whether to keep or remove its tasks instead of silently dropping data. The weekly review reports completion counts, priority distribution, which projects consumed your effort, and a blocker summary. Everything persists in browser local storage with autosave, prompts a backup export every 20 new entries, and ships export/import for moving between devices; mobile buttons are sized 44px+.

Ideal for: anyone wanting a lightweight workbench with no signup and full data ownership; product and ops folks juggling several projects who keep missing blockers; self-managers who need a visible "cost of postponing" to actually stick with a task list; independent workers who owe themselves a weekly review.
cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款（https://workbuddy.link/p/EJmKTgqQ0IiFe4NHkjCCCl），需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：
帮我做一个个人办公工作台，左边是导航菜单，右边是内容。

要这几块：
· 今天待办：填任务、选轻重缓急、填截止日期，做完打勾；过期没做的标红，一键顺延到明天；未来的任务也要能看到，按日期分组
· 灵感速记：随手记想法，能打标签、按标签找
· 项目跟进：记项目名、现在到哪一步、下一步做什么、卡在哪儿；要能和待办关联——任务可以挂到项目下，项目上显示关联待办的进度
· 每周复盘：这周做完几件事、按优先级分布、精力花在哪些项目上、卡点汇总

最上面放「今天要处理的」：逾期没做的任务、卡住的项目列出来标红。
昨天没做完的自动挪到今天，别消失，并且记录顺延了几次。
白底简洁，蓝绿色，商务精致一点，数据要有可视化（图表用内联 SVG/CSS 实现）。可以放一张克制的免版权配图当页头，不要喧宾夺主。

另外这几点帮我做好：
1. 我填的东西自动保存，关掉页面再打开还在
2. 页面上放「导出备份」和「导入」两个按钮，换手机的时候能搬过去
3. 攒到 20 条的时候提醒我导出一次，免得哪天清了浏览器就没了
4. 手机和电脑都能用，手机上按钮大一点方便点
5. 做成一个 HTML 文件，所有不要用网上的现成组件，断网也能打开
6. 先放几条示例内容让我看效果，再给个「清空示例」按钮

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library skill to replicate this workspace (https://workbuddy.link/p/EJmKTgqQ0IiFe4NHkjCCCl) with online data storage and bidirectional sync. Prioritize the one-click replication flow; if unavailable, build from scratch:
Help me build a personal office workbench, with a navigation menu on the left and content on the right. I need these sections:
· Today's tasks: enter a task, pick its priority, set a due date, check it off when done; flag overdue items in red with one-click postpone to tomorrow; future tasks should also be visible, grouped by date
· Quick notes: jot down ideas, tag them, find them by tag
· Project tracking: record the project name, where it stands now, what's next, and what's blocking it; it should link with tasks — tasks can attach to a project, and the project shows the progress of its linked tasks
· Weekly review: how many things I finished this week, the priority distribution, which projects consumed my effort, and a blocker summary At the very top put a "needs attention today" area: list overdue tasks and blocked projects, flagged in red.
Anything unfinished from yesterday moves to today automatically instead of disappearing, and record how many times it has been postponed. Clean white background, teal accent, refined and business-like, with data visualized (implement charts with inline SVG/CSS). A restrained royalty-free image as a page header is fine, but it must not steal focus. Also please take care of these:
1. Whatever I enter saves automatically and is still there after I close and reopen the page
2. Put "Export backup" and "Import" buttons on the page so I can move everything when I switch phones
3. Remind me to export once I've accumulated 20 entries, so I don't lose everything if the browser gets cleared
4. Works on both phone and desktop, with larger buttons on mobile for easier tapping
5. Make it a single HTML file — no components pulled from the internet, and it must open offline
6. Put in a few sample entries first so I can see how it looks, then give me a "Clear samples" button

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.subtitle: 一眼看清资产偏离，给出可执行的再平衡操作
cases.subtitle_en: See allocation drift at a glance with an actionable rebalancing plan
cases.description: 个人投资者最头疼的是：账户涨涨跌跌后配置早已偏离目标，却不知道该买卖什么、买卖多少。本案例由「理财财」财富管理专家生成一份个人投资组合再平衡仪表盘——直观对比当前与目标配置、标出每类资产的偏离度，并给出精确到金额的买入/卖出建议。适合有一定资产、希望定期做组合体检的个人投资者。
cases.description_en: The biggest headache for individual investors: after markets swing, the portfolio has drifted from its targets — but they don't know what to buy or sell, or how much. Generated by the Wealth Management Expert, this personal portfolio rebalancing dashboard visually compares current vs target allocation, flags each asset's drift, and gives buy/sell recommendations down to the exact amount. Ideal for individual investors who want to run a regular portfolio checkup.
cases.prompt:
我是稳健型个人投资者王先生，35 岁，投资目标是退休储备。帮我生成一个个人投资组合再平衡仪表盘。

当前组合（总资产 ¥1,280,000）：A股股票基金 40%、港美股 20%、债券基金 15%、黄金/商品 10%、货币基金/现金 15%。要看到总资产与收益 KPI、当前 vs 目标配置对比、再平衡操作建议表、再平衡后的预期配置，以及再平衡节奏与费税提示。
cases.prompt_en:
I'm Mr. Wang, a 35-year-old conservative individual investor saving for retirement. Help me generate a personal portfolio rebalancing dashboard.

Current portfolio (total assets ¥1,280,000): A-share equity funds 40%, HK/US equities 20%, bond funds 15%, gold/commodities 10%, money-market/cash 15%. Show total-assets and return KPIs, current vs target allocation comparison, a rebalancing action table, the expected post-rebalance allocation, and notes on rebalancing cadence and fees/taxes.

cases.title: 小林coding的家有宠物工作台
cases.subtitle: 喂食喂药医疗消费，毛孩子的事一个工作台全管住
cases.subtitle_en: Feeding, medication, vet visits and expenses — one workbench for all your pets
cases.description:
多宠家庭的日常记录总是散落在聊天记录、备忘录和脑子里：今天喂了几顿、驱虫什么时候到期、上次看病花了多少钱，越想越乱。

这个案例展示了一个「家有宠物」管理工作台：首页宠物卡片墙 + 今日待办（喂食/喂药打卡/医疗到期自动汇总）+ 最近动态流；宠物档案带头像和自动年龄；喂食有近 14 天进食量柱状图和食物类型占比；喂药按疗程管理，进度条 + 按频次打卡 + 漏喂标红；医疗记录带下次到期提醒，填了费用会自动同步一笔「医疗」消费；体重有趋势折线；消费是按月账本带分类占比。中英双语一键切换，数据落在资料库结构化表里，多端同步。

适合：多宠家庭、经常忘记驱虫疫苗时间的铲屎官、想给毛孩子建一份完整健康账本的人。
cases.description_en:
In multi-pet homes, daily care records end up scattered across chats, memos and memory: how many meals today, when is deworming due, how much was the last vet visit — it gets messy fast.

This case shows a Pet Family workbench: a home page with pet cards, today's to-dos (feeding / medication check-ins / upcoming vet reminders auto-aggregated) and a recent-activity feed; pet profiles with photo upload and auto-calculated age; feeding logs with a 14-day intake bar chart and food-type breakdown; medication managed by course with progress bar, per-dose check-ins and missed-dose alerts; medical records with next-due reminders that auto-sync any cost into a "Medical" expense entry; weight trends on a line chart; and a monthly expense ledger with category shares. Switch between Chinese and English with one tap, and all data lives in structured Library tables that sync across devices.

Best for: multi-pet families, owners who keep forgetting vaccine and deworming dates, and anyone who wants a complete health and expense ledger for their pets.

视觉走移动端优先的微信风格：浅灰底 + 白色圆角卡片 + 微信绿主色，底部 Tab 导航（首页/档案/＋快捷记录/健康/我的）。制作完成后：① 将 HTML 存入我的资料库，并创建 6 张资料库子数据表（宠物档案/喂食/喂药/医疗/体重/消费）绑定数据，实现医疗-消费联动；② 发布为公开链接并返回给我CSS/JS 无外部 CDN 依赖。

cases.subtitle: 一条 Prompt 自动排查 5 类触发场景，产出带 8 张专业表格、可直接申报的五模块 PIA 报告
cases.subtitle_en: One prompt auto-scans all five trigger scenarios and produces a filing-ready five-module PIA report with eight structured tables
cases.description:
企业处理海量用户个人信息，最怕的就是被监管认定违规——人脸支付、AI 推荐、数据出海，每一样都可能踩中个保法的红线，一罚就是上千万甚至按年营收的 5%。

这个案例把一家跨境电商平台（500 万用户、AI 精准营销、人脸支付、向新加坡母公司传输数据）交给 AI，一键产出五模块 PIA 报告：自动排查 PIPL 第 55 条全部 5 类触发场景，还附带 8 张可直接抄作业的专业表格——字段清单、合法性基础识别、风险评估分级、缓解措施对照（含优先级和整改期限）、合规要求对照，以及把散落各处的「待补充」信息缺口汇总成一张表。跨境场景还会自动叠加 GDPR DPIA 交叉判断 + 新加坡 PDPA 合规义务对照，可直接作为标准合同备案或数据出境安全评估申报的前置材料。

适合：数据合规律师、企业法务、隐私合规负责人、出海电商运营者。
cases.description_en:
Handling millions of users' personal data is a compliance minefield — face payment, AI recommendations, and cross-border transfers each risk breaching China's PIPL, with fines up to RMB 50 million or 5% of annual revenue.

This case hands a cross-border e-commerce platform (5M users, AI-driven marketing, face payment, data transfer to a Singapore parent) to AI, which produces a five-module PIA report: it auto-scans all five PIPL Article 55 trigger scenarios and ships eight ready-to-reuse tables — a data-field inventory, a lawfulness-basis check, a risk-grading matrix, a mitigation roadmap (with priorities and deadlines), a compliance checklist, and a consolidated table of every 'to-be-supplied' information gap. The cross-border scenario also auto-appends a GDPR DPIA cross-check and a Singapore PDPA obligations mapping — ready to serve as the prerequisite for a standard contractual clause (SCC) filing or data-export security assessment.

For: data-compliance lawyers, in-house counsel, privacy officers, and cross-border e-commerce operators.

PIA 评估报告（Markdown）

cases.prompt:
请调用「个人信息保护影响评估」技能，对跨境电商平台「星云跨境（深圳）科技有限公司」的个人信息处理活动开展个人信息保护影响评估（PIA），按《个人信息保护法》第 55/56 条和网信办指引格式出具五模块 PIA 报告。

【处理活动信息】
• 处理主体：星云跨境（深圳）科技有限公司，跨境电商社交平台，覆盖约 500 万注册用户
• 处理活动：AI 个性化推荐与精准营销、人脸支付、订单履约、风控与反欺诈
• 涉及字段：手机号、真实姓名、收货地址、浏览与购买行为、设备信息、设备位置信息（敏感·行踪轨迹）、人脸特征（敏感·生物识别）、支付账号/银行卡号（敏感·金融账户）
• 处理目的：①订单履约（必要）②AI 个性化推荐与精准营销（辅助）③人脸支付（辅助）④风控与反欺诈（辅助）
• 共享/委托：向境外新加坡母公司传输用于统一风控与推荐模型训练；委托云服务商、第三方物流、支付机构处理
• 安全措施：传输/存储加密（AES）、RBAC 访问控制、脱敏、日志审计、人脸特征单独加密存储、应急预案（未演练）

【评估要求】
1. 输出五模块报告（M1 处理目的方式 → M2 合法性正当性必要性 → M3 权益影响风险 → M4 保护措施 → M5 结论），严格按网信办指引格式
2. 逐项排查 PIPL 第 55 条 5 类触发场景，命中场景在对应模块嵌入专项分析
3. 命中跨境提供场景时，增加跨境多法域叠加分析（GDPR DPIA 交叉适用判断 + 新加坡 PDPA 叠加分析）
4. 输出格式：DOCX（正式申报用）+ Markdown（内部参考）
5. 所有法条引用标注「以申报时生效版本为准」，信息缺口标注「待补充」
cases.prompt_en:
Invoke the Personal Information Protection Impact Assessment (PIA) skill to run a PIA on the personal-information processing activities of the cross-border e-commerce platform Xingyun Cross-Border (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd., and produce a five-module PIA report following PIPL Articles 55/56 and the CAC guideline format.

[Processing activity details]
• Controller: Xingyun Cross-Border (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd., a cross-border social e-commerce platform with ~5 million registered users
• Activities: AI-based personalized recommendation and targeted marketing, face payment, order fulfillment, risk control and anti-fraud
• Data fields: mobile number, real name, delivery address, browsing and purchase behavior, device information, device location (sensitive · location tracking), facial features (sensitive · biometric), payment account / bank card number (sensitive · financial account)
• Purposes: (1) order fulfillment (necessary); (2) AI recommendation and targeted marketing (auxiliary); (3) face payment (auxiliary); (4) risk control and anti-fraud (auxiliary)
• Sharing / entrustment: transfer to an overseas Singapore parent company for unified risk control and recommendation model training; entrust cloud service providers, third-party logistics, and payment institutions
• Security measures: AES encryption in transit and at rest, RBAC access control, de-identification, log auditing, separate encrypted storage of facial features, emergency response plan (not yet drilled)

[Assessment requirements]
1. Output a five-module report (M1 purpose and method → M2 lawfulness/legitimacy/necessity → M3 rights impact and risk → M4 protection measures → M5 conclusion), strictly following the CAC guideline format
2. Review all five PIPL Article 55 trigger scenarios one by one, embedding a dedicated analysis of each triggered scenario in the corresponding module
3. Since the cross-border scenario is triggered, add a cross-jurisdiction overlay analysis (GDPR DPIA cross-applicability check + Singapore PDPA overlay analysis)
4. Output format: DOCX (for official filing) + Markdown (internal reference)
5. Tag every legal citation with "subject to the version in effect at the time of filing" and every information gap with "to be supplemented"

cases.description:
目录页采集最怕两类问题：一类是采回来一堆原始文本，后面还得手工清洗；另一类是只要表格不要页面证据，别人根本无法判断采集当时页面长什么样。这个案例把采集结果和页面现场一起交付。

本案例通过 Playwright Browser Automation 的官方 Playwright API 真实访问 https://books.toscrape.com/，提取前 10 个商品的标题、价格、库存状态、评分和商品链接，保存目录页截图并输出结构化 extracted.json。最终交付单文件内联 output.html，采用明亮的数据展板风格，并支持右上角中英切换与 ?lang=zh / ?lang=en。

适合：电商运营、竞品采集团队、测试工程师、增长分析同学，以及任何需要把“打开目录页 → 提取商品字段 → 产出结构化看板”沉淀成可复用 Playbook 的团队。
cases.description_en:
Directory extraction usually fails in two ways: you end up with raw text that still needs manual cleanup, or you get a table without page evidence so nobody can tell what the page looked like at extraction time. This case delivers both the structured result and the visible page state together.

Using the official Playwright API behind Playwright Browser Automation, this case truly visits https://books.toscrape.com/, extracts the first 10 products with title, price, availability, rating, and product links, stores a catalog-page screenshot, and outputs a structured extracted.json file. The final deliverable is a fully inlined single-file output.html in a bright data-dashboard style, with top-right language switching and support for ?lang=zh / ?lang=en.

Best for ecommerce operators, competitive-intelligence collectors, test engineers, growth analysts, and any team that wants to turn “open directory page → extract product fields → deliver a structured board” into a reusable Playbook.

cases.description:
登录自动化最容易失真：脚本写完了，却没有留下页面证据，也说不清到底是凭据错误、页面变更还是断言没等到。这个案例直接把“跑一次登录”变成可回看的 QA 页面。

本案例通过 Playwright Browser Automation 的官方 Playwright API 真实打开公开演示登录站点，填写账号密码、提交表单、等待成功状态出现，并保存登录成功截图与结构化断言结果。最终交付单文件内联 output.html，采用明亮的 QA 控制台风格，右上角支持中英切换与 ?lang=zh / ?lang=en。

适合：QA 工程师、自动化测试同学、前端 / 全栈开发、测试平台建设者，以及需要把“登录链路是否正常”固化成可复用 Playbook 的团队。
cases.description_en:
Login automation often becomes fuzzy: the script exists, but there is no visual evidence and no clear story about whether the failure came from credentials, page changes, or timing assertions. This case turns a single login run into a QA page that can be reviewed afterwards.

Using the official Playwright API behind Playwright Browser Automation, this case truly opens a public demo login site, fills credentials, submits the form, waits for a success state, and stores both the success screenshot and structured assertion output. The final deliverable is a fully inlined single-file output.html in a bright QA control-board style, with top-right language switching and support for ?lang=zh / ?lang=en.

Best for QA engineers, automation testers, frontend / full-stack developers, test-platform builders, and any team that wants to convert “is the login path healthy?” into a reusable Playbook.

cases.title: 结算页改版 A/B 实验结果分析报告
cases.title_en: Checkout Redesign A/B Test Result Analysis Report
cases.subtitle: 对照组 vs 实验组：转化率提升 +21.9% 的显著性检验与上线决策
cases.subtitle_en: Control vs Variant: significance testing and launch decision for a +21.9% conversion lift
cases.description: 做完 A/B 实验，最难的不是跑实验，而是判断「这个提升到底是真的还是随机波动」并给出可落地的上线建议。本案由「产品通」专家以实验设计与指标体系方法论，针对虚构电商 App 结算页改版实验，完成了一份完整的结果分析报告：从假设设定、样本量功效核算、主指标双比例 Z 检验，到转化漏斗双组对比、置信区间可视化、分群洞察，再到护栏指标与上线决策、实验局限。交付物是一份单文件 HTML 分析报告，数据彼此勾稽、统计自洽。适合产品经理、增长与数据分析师，作为撰写实验复盘的结构与表达范本。
cases.description_en: The hard part of an A/B test isn't running it — it's deciding whether a lift is real or noise, then turning that into an actionable launch call. Here the Product Management Expert applies experiment-design and metrics methodology to a fictional e-commerce checkout-redesign test, producing a full result report: hypothesis, sample-size power check, a two-proportion Z-test on the primary metric, dual-group funnel comparison, confidence-interval visualization, segment insights, guardrail metrics, the launch decision, and study limitations. The deliverable is a single-file HTML report with internally consistent numbers — a solid template for product, growth and data analysts writing experiment readouts.
cases.prompt: 我们电商 App 刚跑完一个结算页改版的 A/B 实验（对照组是原三步式结算，实验组是单页聚合+优惠券自动勾选），帮我做一份精美的单文件 HTML 实验结果分析报告。要有：实验设计（假设、分流、样本量功效核算、周期）、核心指标对照表（转化率 A 3.2% vs B 3.9%、提升、p值、置信区间）、转化漏斗双组对比、置信区间可视化、次级指标（客单价、加购率）、分群洞察、结论与上线建议、实验局限。数据要彼此勾稽、统计上自洽，数据实验报告风，浅色简净+数据高亮，涨红跌绿，要响应式。
cases.prompt_en: We just finished an A/B test on our e-commerce app's checkout redesign (control = original 3-step checkout, variant = single-page checkout with auto-selected coupon). Build a polished single-file HTML result-analysis report. Include: experiment design (hypothesis, traffic split, sample-size power calculation, duration), a core-metrics comparison table (conversion A 3.2% vs B 3.9%, lift, p-value, confidence interval), dual-group funnel comparison, a confidence-interval visualization, secondary metrics (AOV, add-to-cart rate), segment insights, conclusions with launch recommendations, and study limitations. Numbers must be internally consistent and statistically sound; use a clean light data-report style with highlighted figures, red-up/green-down, and responsive layout.

cases.description: 产品经理做竞品分析常常只产出一份枯燥的对比文档，看不出格局也看不出机会。本案例由「产品通」产品管理专家以「价值判断官」视角，对 5 款消费级 AI 笔记 App 做可视化横评——SVG 六维雷达图、2×2 机会矩阵（含机会空位标注）、功能对比表与差异化结论一页呈现。适合做竞品研究、想直观看清市场格局与切入点的产品经理。
cases.description_en: PMs doing competitive analysis often produce a dull comparison doc that reveals neither the landscape nor the opportunity. Acting as the Product Management Expert with a 'value-judge' lens, this case visually benchmarks 5 consumer AI note-taking apps — an SVG 6-axis radar, a 2×2 opportunity matrix (with the open-gap marked), a feature table, and differentiation takeaways on one page. Ideal for PMs who want to see the market landscape and entry points clearly.

cases.prompt_en: Help me build a competitive-analysis visualization page for consumer AI note-taking apps (single-file HTML). Compare Notion, Obsidian, Mem, Craft, and Apple Notes across dimensions like AI capability, knowledge linking, collaboration, cross-device sync, ease of use, and price friendliness. Show a six-axis radar comparison, a 2×2 opportunity matrix (mark the open gap), a feature comparison table, and per-product positioning with differentiation takeaways. Indigo grid tech aesthetic; UI in Simplified Chinese.

cases.title: 产品需求池与功能优先级看板
cases.subtitle: 价值×工作量四象限 + 四列看板，让迭代排期不再拍脑袋
cases.subtitle_en: Value × Effort quadrant plus a four-column board for evidence-based sprint planning
cases.description: 迭代规划时需求一堆、谁先做谁后做总靠拍脑袋，争议难以收敛。本案由「产品战略团队」专家按数据驱动 SOP，把 13 条候选需求统一评分，落到「价值×工作量」四象限并铺成「待评估/已排期/进行中/已上线」四列看板：每张卡片标注价值分、工作量与 P0–P3 / RICE 优先级，再给出本迭代承诺 vs 储备的容量分配和四条决策原则。交付物是一份单文件 HTML 看板，含散点四象限图、看板列与脚注。适合产品经理、项目负责人与需要对齐排期口径的研发团队。
cases.description_en: Sprint planning often turns into a who-goes-first argument with no clear rule. Here the Product Strategy Team applies a data-driven SOP: it scores 13 candidate features, plots them on a Value × Effort quadrant, and lays them across a four-column board (To Evaluate / Scheduled / In Progress / Shipped). Each card carries a value score, effort, and a P0–P3 / RICE priority, alongside a committed-vs-backlog capacity split and four decision principles. The deliverable is a single-file HTML board with a scatter quadrant chart, kanban columns, and a footnote. Built for product managers, project leads, and engineering teams aligning on sprint scope.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一个单文件 HTML 的产品需求池与功能优先级看板（虚构 SaaS 产品的双周迭代规划）。要有：顶部 hero 大图压标题；需求池概览指标（总数、各状态计数）；一个「价值×工作量」四象限散点图（SVG，坐标轴容纳所有点、标注速赢/战略投入/填充/谨慎四个象限，放 10 条以上带名称的需求点）；待评估/已排期/进行中/已上线四列看板，每张卡片带价值分、工作量、P0–P3 或 RICE 优先级标签；本迭代承诺 vs 储备的容量分配；最后是决策原则脚注。浅灰底+彩色标签列+卡片的高效团队看板风，响应式，界面中文，无 emoji 无外链。
cases.prompt_en: Build a single-file HTML product backlog and feature prioritization board for a fictional SaaS product's bi-weekly sprint. Include: a hero image with overlaid title; backlog overview metrics (total and per-status counts); a Value × Effort quadrant scatter chart (inline SVG, axes covering all points, four labeled quadrants — Quick Wins / Big Bets / Fill-ins / Money Pit — with 10+ named feature dots); a four-column kanban (To Evaluate / Scheduled / In Progress / Shipped) where each card shows value score, effort, and a P0–P3 or RICE priority tag; a committed-vs-backlog capacity split; and a footer of decision principles. Use a clean light-gray, color-tagged team-board aesthetic, responsive, Chinese UI, no emoji, no external resources.

cases.title: 新产品上市 GTM 发布计划一页纸
cases.subtitle: 协作白板 Pro 上市：定位 / 定价 / 渠道 / 时间线 / 指标一图说清
cases.subtitle_en: Whiteboard Pro launch: positioning, pricing, channels, timeline & metrics on one page
cases.description: 新模块要上市，团队却把定位、定价、渠道、时间线、成功指标散落在十几份文档里，高管、销售、工程各看各的，发布前对不齐。本案由「产品通」专家把这些要素合成为一张内部自洽的 GTM 一页纸：先讲清目标市场与定位语句、三类客户画像，再到三档定价、四条渠道的预算矩阵、预热→公测→GA 三阶段泳道时间线，最后落到北极星（每周活跃协作团队）+ 驱动/健康指标与可勾稽的增长漏斗，并附风险应对。交付物是一份可直接对齐评审的精美单文件 HTML，适合产品经理、增长与市场负责人在发布启动会上使用。
cases.description_en: When a new module ships, positioning, pricing, channels, timeline and success metrics often scatter across a dozen docs—execs, sales and engineering never align before launch. Here the Product Management Expert synthesizes them into one self-consistent GTM one-pager: target market and positioning statement, three buyer personas, three pricing tiers, a four-channel budget matrix, a three-phase (pre-launch → beta → GA) swimlane timeline, and a North Star (weekly active collaborating teams) plus input/health metrics with a reconciled growth funnel and risk mitigations. The deliverable is a polished single-file HTML ready for a launch kickoff review—built for PMs, growth and marketing leads.
cases.prompt: 我们一个 B2B SaaS 新模块「协作白板 Pro」要上市，帮我做一份 Go-To-Market 发布计划的一页纸，做成精美的单文件 HTML（长滚动网页，不要 PPT）。要包含：目标市场与定位语句、目标客户画像、核心价值主张、三档定价与套餐、内容/社群/销售/合作四条渠道的预算矩阵、预热→公测→GA 三阶段泳道时间线、北极星与成功指标（激活率/转化/MRR，数字要能勾稽）、风险与应对。现代产品团队风、浅色配靛蓝+活力橙强调、卡片化排版，配一张产品流程便签墙的 hero 大图压标题，要做好手机端适配。
cases.prompt_en: We're launching a new B2B SaaS module, 'Whiteboard Pro'. Build me a Go-To-Market launch plan one-pager as a polished single-file HTML (long-scroll web page, not slides). Include: target market & positioning statement, buyer personas, core value props, three pricing tiers, a four-channel (content/community/sales/partnership) budget matrix, a three-phase pre-launch→beta→GA swimlane timeline, North Star & success metrics (activation/conversion/MRR with reconciled numbers), and risks with mitigations. Modern product-team style, light theme with indigo + vibrant orange accents, card-based layout, a hero image of a product-flow sticky-note wall with the title overlaid, and solid mobile responsiveness.

artifacts.label: 协作白板 Pro · GTM 上市发布计划一页纸

cases.subtitle_en: North Star → driver → health metrics, the whole tree on one board
cases.description: 很多团队定了北极星指标却讲不清它如何被拆解、由哪些驱动指标支撑、哪里在掉链子。本案例由「产品通」产品管理专家搭建一套可视化指标体系看板——SVG 指标树把北极星拆到驱动与健康指标、12 周趋势折线、达成率进度条，并附指标治理说明（含虚荣指标反例）。适合需要建立或对齐指标体系的产品与运营团队。
cases.description_en: Many teams set a North Star metric but can't explain how it decomposes, which driver metrics support it, or where it's slipping. Ideal for product and ops teams establishing or aligning a metric system.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一个 B2B SaaS 产品的北极星指标体系可视化看板（单文件 HTML）。北极星为周活跃创作用户数 WAU。要直观看到：指标拆解树（北极星 → 获取/激活/留存/收入/推荐 5 类驱动指标 → 各自的健康指标）、顶部 KPI 卡、12 周北极星趋势折线、每个指标的定义/当前/目标/健康状态，并给一段指标治理说明（为什么选这个北极星、虚荣指标反例）。深色数据仪表盘风，界面中文。
cases.prompt_en: Help me build a North Star metric-system dashboard for a B2B SaaS product (single-file HTML). The North Star is Weekly Active Creators (WAU). Show a metric decomposition tree (North Star → five driver groups: acquisition/activation/retention/revenue/referral → their health metrics), top KPI cards, a 12-week North Star trend line, and each metric's definition/current/target/health status, plus a governance note (why this North Star, vanity-metric counter-examples). Dark data-dashboard style; UI in Simplified Chinese.

cases.title: 年度产品路线图（主题轨 × 四季度）
cases.subtitle: 增长 / 体验 / 平台 / AI 四泳道横跨 Q1–Q4，对齐目标与里程碑
cases.subtitle_en: Growth / Experience / Platform / AI swimlanes across Q1–Q4, aligned to goals and milestones
cases.description: 产品团队常苦于「需求堆叠、目标失焦」，路线图沦为承诺清单。本案由「产品通」专家用路线图管理方法论，把虚构 SaaS「Lumina 协作云」的全年规划梳理成「主题轨 × 时间」双视图：四条主题轨各锚定一个北极星指标，16 个季度 Epic 标注交付状态，配 7 个关键里程碑时间线、北极星指标进展表、依赖与风险清单，并用 Now-Next-Later 管理远期不确定性。交付物是一份可滚动浏览的单文件 HTML 路线图，适合产品经理、研发负责人与高管对齐全年节奏。
cases.description_en: Product teams often struggle with feature pile-ups and blurred goals, turning roadmaps into mere commitment lists. Here the Product Management Expert applies roadmap methodology to a fictional SaaS, Lumina, presenting the year as a Theme × Time view: four swimlanes each anchored to a north-star metric, 16 quarterly epics with delivery status, a 7-milestone timeline, a metrics progress table, a dependency-and-risk list, and a Now-Next-Later backlog. The deliverable is a single-file scrollable HTML roadmap for PMs, eng leads, and execs to align on the year.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一份虚构 SaaS 产品的 2026 年度产品路线图，单文件 HTML。要「主题轨 × 时间」双视图：增长/体验/平台/AI 四条泳道横跨 Q1–Q4，每条泳道用色条画出各季度的 Epic 并标注状态（已交付/进行中/规划）。还要包含路线图说明与目标对齐、关键里程碑时间线、每条主题轨对应的北极星指标进展表、依赖与风险清单、以及 Now-Next-Later 储备。整体浅色专业风，路线图甘特/泳道样式，配一张真实主题图做 hero 大图叠渐变蒙版压标题，要响应式、界面中文、无 emoji。
cases.prompt_en: Create an annual 2026 product roadmap for a fictional SaaS as a single-file HTML page. Use a Theme × Time view: four swimlanes (Growth/Experience/Platform/AI) spanning Q1–Q4, with colored bars for each quarter's epics labeled by status (delivered/in-progress/planned). Include a roadmap overview with goal alignment, a key-milestone timeline, a north-star metrics progress table per theme, a dependency-and-risk list, and a Now-Next-Later backlog. Use a clean professional light style with a gantt/swimlane look, a real hero photo with a gradient overlay behind the title, responsive layout, Chinese UI, no emoji.

cases.title: 胸部 CT 肺炎 AI 分析：一例重症 CAP 怎么量化
cases.title_en: Chest CT Pneumonia AI: Quantifying a Severe CAP Case
cases.subtitle: 阳性样本跑一遍，看 AI 如何量化 27 处病灶与双肺弥漫浸润
cases.subtitle_en: Run a positive scan and see how AI quantifies 27 lesions across both lungs
cases.description: 社区获得性肺炎（CAP）在 CT 上往往是多灶、多叶、双肺弥漫的，靠肉眼一处处数病灶、估体积既慢又难量化。这个案例拿一例公开数据集里的 CAP 阳性胸部 CT（168 层）真跑了一遍：AI 给出肺炎表征概率 99.8%、全肺感染占比 33.0%（左肺 41.0%、右肺 23.3%），并逐一列出 27 处病灶的肺叶位置、层号范围、体积、占比和平均 CT 值——最大一处独占左肺 41%，最小的只有 104mm³，体积跨 5 个数量级。案例把这份重症阳性结果整理成带环形图、体积对数轴条形图和病灶分布气泡图的 HTML 报告，并配 PDF 报告，全流程命令可复现。和「正常样本」案例正好一阴一阳，适合做医疗影像 AI 的产品经理、科研人员，以及想建立阳性/重症判读参照的人。
cases.description_en: Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) on CT is often multifocal, multilobar and bilaterally diffuse — counting lesions and estimating volumes by eye is slow and hard to quantify. This case runs a real CAP-positive chest CT (168 slices) from a public dataset: the AI returns a 99.8% pneumonia-sign probability, 33.0% whole-lung infection (left 41.0%, right 23.3%), and lists all 27 lesions with their lobe, slice range, volume, ratio and mean CT value — the largest alone takes 41% of the left lung, the smallest is just 104mm3, spanning five orders of magnitude. The result is turned into an HTML report with a donut chart, a log-scale volume bar chart and a lesion-distribution bubble chart, plus a PDF report, with reproducible commands. It pairs with the normal-case example as a positive counterpart — built for medical-imaging AI PMs, researchers, and anyone establishing a positive/severe reading baseline.
cases.prompt: 这是一例社区获得性肺炎（CAP）阳性受试者的胸部 CT 检查，帮我基于腾讯觅影肺炎AI评估专家跑一遍肺炎 AI 分析，重点把多灶、多叶的病灶量化清楚。 影像目录：{胸部CT的DICOM目录路径，如 桌面/cap001} studyId：CASE_CAP001 需要 PDF 报告（needReport=1） 请按以下步骤完成，最终输出一份 HTML 分析报告（用于灵感案例展示，排版清晰美观、含基础样式）： 1. **打包并校验**：把目录内 DICOM 打包为 ZIP，只收 .dcm 文件（排除 .DS_Store、__MACOSX、隐藏文件），打包后校验包内文件数与纯净度。 2. **提交分析并轮询**：提交时开启 PDF 报告并携带患者信息。提交后后台轮询等待，轮询期间持续反馈进度（已等待时长、当前状态：待处理/处理中/处理完成），不要静默等待。 3. **输出报告**，包含章节：案例概览（影像来源、序列层数、studyId、taskId、分析耗时）／AI 分析结果（肺炎表征概率、全肺与左右肺感染占比、并用表格完整列出每一处病灶的肺叶位置·层号范围·体积·体积占比·平均 CT 值，一处都不能漏）／结果解读（病灶数量与分布模式、体积悬殊如何理解、感染负荷左右肺对比、CT 值密度特征）／健康提示（通用科普口径，不给具体临床建议，凡涉及诊断用药随访一律引导咨询医师）／完整调用流程（可复现命令）。 4. **生成可视化图表**：用 matplotlib 生成两张图并嵌入报告——① 肺炎表征概率环形图 + 全肺/左肺/右肺感染占比条形图；② 病灶体积 Top10 条形图（体积跨多个数量级，须用对数轴）+ 全部病灶在整段序列中的分布气泡图（横轴层号、纵轴左右肺、气泡大小表示体积、颜色映射平均 CT 值）。设置中文字体避免乱码，图片与报告同目录、用相对路径 标签引用。肺炎/异常用红色系（符合国内医疗惯例）。 要求： - 所有数值必须来自 AI 接口返回的真实结果，不得推测、遗漏或填充缺失值；27 处病灶要逐一列全 - 报告中不写真实绝对路径，影像路径统一写为「桌面/{目录名}」 - 开篇标注：本模型仅限中国大陆地区科研用途，不得用于临床检测与诊疗，结果不构成诊断意见
cases.prompt_en:
This is a chest CT of a community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) positive subject. Please run pneumonia AI analysis using the Tencent Miying Pneumonia AI Assessment Expert, focusing on cleanly quantifying the multifocal, multilobar lesions.

Image folder: {path to the chest CT DICOM folder, e.g. Desktop/cap001}
studyId: CASE_CAP001
Need PDF report (needReport=1)

Complete the following steps and deliver an HTML report (clean, styled, suitable for a showcase):

1. **Package and validate**: zip the DICOM files, including only .dcm files (exclude .DS_Store, __MACOSX, hidden files), then verify the archive file count and purity.

2. **Submit and poll**: enable the PDF report and pass patient info on submission. Poll in the background and keep reporting progress (elapsed time, current status: pending/processing/done) — do not wait silently.

3. **Produce the report** with sections: Case overview (image source, slice count, studyId, taskId, elapsed time) / AI results (pneumonia probability, whole-lung and per-side infection ratios, and a table listing every lesion with its lobe, slice range, volume, volume ratio and mean CT value — omit none) / Interpretation (lesion count and distribution pattern, how to read the wide volume spread, left-vs-right infection burden, CT density characteristics) / Health notes (general guidance only, no specific clinical advice; defer diagnosis, medication and follow-up to a physician) / Reproducible workflow.

4. **Generate charts**: use matplotlib for two figures embedded in the report — (1) a donut chart of pneumonia probability plus a bar chart of whole-lung/left/right infection ratios; (2) a Top-10 lesion volume bar chart (volumes span orders of magnitude, use a log scale) plus a bubble chart of all lesions across the series (x=slice number, y=left/right lung, bubble size=volume, color=mean CT value). Configure a CJK font to avoid tofu glyphs, reference images by relative path, and use a red palette for pneumonia/abnormal cues (per China medical convention).

Requirements:
- Every number must come from the real API response; never infer, omit or fill in missing values — list all 27 lesions one by one
- Do not write real absolute paths; render the image path as "Desktop/{folder name}"
- Open with the notice: this model is licensed for research use in mainland China only, must not be used for clinical diagnosis or treatment, and the result is not a diagnostic opinion

cases.title: 胸部 CT 肺炎 AI 分析：新冠肺炎长什么样
cases.title_en: Chest CT Pneumonia AI: What COVID-19 Looks Like
cases.subtitle: 阳性样本跑一遍，看新冠肺炎为何概率 100% 但占比只有 2.6%
cases.subtitle_en: Run a COVID-positive scan: why 100% probability yet only 2.6% infection
cases.description: 新冠肺炎在 CT 上和细菌性肺炎不一样——它常是双肺多灶、散在的小磨玻璃影，靠肉眼很难量化到底累及了多少肺。这个案例拿一例公开数据集里 RT-PCR 确诊的 COVID-19 胸部 CT（148 层）真跑了一遍：AI 给出肺炎表征概率 100%，全肺感染占比却只有 2.6%（左肺 1.4%、右肺 3.8%），逐一列出 17 处病灶——数量不少但单个体积普遍偏小、集中在双肺下叶。有意思的是左肺病灶更多（11 处）占比反而更低，右肺病灶少却占比高，说明数个数不等于量范围。案例把结果整理成带环形图、体积对数轴图、病灶分布气泡图和三类样本对照表的 HTML 报告，并配 PDF 报告，命令可复现。和「正常样本」「社区获得性肺炎」两例凑成一套完整对照，适合做医疗影像 AI 的产品经理、科研人员，以及想看清不同病因肺炎影像差异的人。
cases.description_en: COVID-19 on CT differs from bacterial pneumonia — it is often bilateral, multifocal, scattered small ground-glass opacities, hard to quantify by eye. This case runs a real RT-PCR-confirmed COVID-19 chest CT (148 slices) from a public dataset: the AI returns a 100% pneumonia-sign probability, yet only 2.6% whole-lung infection (left 1.4%, right 3.8%), listing all 17 lesions — many in number but mostly small, clustered in both lower lobes. Notably the left lung has more lesions (11) but a lower ratio, while the right has fewer yet a higher ratio, showing lesion count is not lesion burden. The result is turned into an HTML report with a donut chart, a log-scale volume chart, a lesion-distribution bubble chart and a three-sample comparison table, plus a PDF report, with reproducible commands. Together with the normal and CAP cases it forms a full comparison set — built for medical-imaging AI PMs, researchers, and anyone wanting to see how pneumonia of different causes differs on imaging.

cases.description_en: Submitting a DICOM straight from a hospital export and getting back a bare "AI engine upload failed" is the most discouraging scenario — it never tells you what actually went wrong. Built for researchers and medical-AI product managers who routinely clean and repair hospital-exported DICOM.
