cases.description: 很多人用肺炎 AI 只盯着那个概率数字，一看到 75% 就慌——但概率高不等于有病。这个案例拿一例公开数据集里的正常受试者胸部 CT（154 层）真跑了一遍：AI 给出的肺炎表征概率是 75.1%，量化结论却是「无肺炎感染」、全肺感染占比 0.0%，只检出一处 722mm³、占比 0.0% 的微小影。案例把这份张力讲透了——概率是整图纹理的打分，容易受噪声体位影响，真正定性要落到病灶体积、占比、CT 值和分布上。全流程真实提交、后台轮询、结果整理成带图表的 HTML 报告，命令可复现。适合做医疗影像 AI 的产品经理、科研人员，以及需要建立「正常/阴性」判读基线的人。
cases.description_en: Many people fixate on the probability number when using pneumonia AI — see 75% and panic. But a high probability does not mean disease. This case runs a real chest CT of a normal subject (154 slices) from a public dataset: the AI returns a 75.1% pneumonia-sign probability, yet the quantitative verdict is "no pneumonia infection" with 0.0% whole-lung infection, detecting only one tiny 722mm3 focus at 0.0% ratio. The case unpacks this tension — probability scores the whole-image texture and is sensitive to noise and positioning, while the real call rests on lesion volume, ratio, CT value and distribution. The whole pipeline is a real submission, background polling, and a charted HTML report with reproducible commands. Built for medical-imaging AI PMs, researchers, and anyone establishing a normal/negative reading baseline.

Suitable for: short-term traders who need a fast post-close read, teammates responsible for summarizing market sentiment, investment content creators who need to turn the tape into a structured story, and active A-share participants who want to explain whether local speculative fire is still alive.

cases.description_en: Need a beautiful yet accurate intro to a literary classic for students, book clubs, or culture classes? Most templates are generic or get the facts wrong. In this case, the expert 'Slide' (PptCreationExpert) applies professional PPT methodology to build a 12-slide, page-flippable HTML deck on Journey to the West, one of China's Four Great Classical Novels: from cover and premise, the Ming-dynasty author Wu Cheng'en and the book's origin, to the Chang'an-to-the-West pilgrimage, the five companions (Sun Wukong, Tang Sanzang, Zhu Bajie, Sha Wujing, the White Dragon Horse) with their traits and treasures, plus iconic chapters like Havoc in Heaven, artistic achievements and themes. The visual language is classical Chinese ink and scroll: rice-paper beige, ink mountains and auspicious clouds, cinnabar seals and serif/Kai-style type. Delivered as a single self-contained HTML file with self-built keyboard/click/dot navigation and no external resources. Ideal for language teachers, book-club hosts, culture creators, and parents.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一个介绍《西游记》的 HTML 幻灯片演示，可以翻页，大概 12 页一屏一页。内容要文学常识准确：封面、一句话题解、作者吴承恩和成书背景、长安到西天的取经主线、孙悟空/唐僧/猪八戒/沙僧+白龙马五个人物（性格和法宝）、大闹天宫等经典篇章、艺术成就与影响、主题思想、结尾名句。风格要中国古典水墨、国风卷轴感：宣纸米色底、水墨远山祥云、朱砂红印章、楷书感字体，古雅有文化味，不要用 emoji，单文件能直接打开翻页。

Use a classical Chinese ink / scroll aesthetic: rice-paper beige background, ink mountains and clouds, cinnabar seals, serif/Kai-style fonts, elegant and cultured, no emoji, single self-contained file that flips pages.

Using a cinematic Apple-style dark keynote methodology, the Slide expert built a launch deck for the fictional brand Stellar: pitch-black canvas, oversized light titles, spotlit product hero shots with gradient veils for legible text, plus on-device AI, health monitoring, battery life and a bold pricing page. cases.description: 年度董事会与全员大会上，一份讲得清、看得信的经营汇报往往决定了团队的下一步共识。本案以「策必中」(Tatum) 销售提案与方案设计专家方法论，把一年业绩讲成有说服力的商业叙事：用统一的赢单主题串起核心成绩、营收趋势、业务结构与客户口碑，再以三幕式结构从复盘走向 2026 战略、量化目标与季度路线图。交付物是一份单文件、可翻页的 HTML 幻灯片（约 13 页，16:9，自带方向键/空格/点击/圆点导航），深蓝配品牌金的董事会汇报质感，KPI 卡与商务图表数字内部自洽。适合创始人、CEO 办公室、战略与运营负责人做年度复盘与战略沟通。

cases.title: 私域社群运营台
cases.subtitle: 社群资产、成员分层、运营日历、转化漏斗和话术库一站搞定
cases.subtitle_en: Community assets, member tiers, ops calendar, conversion funnel and scripts in one place
cases.description:
做私域运营最头疼的，是手里几个群、几百上千号人，全靠脑子记和翻聊天记录——哪个群快凉了、谁是铁粉谁快流失、这周该发什么活动、从进群到付费到底漏在哪一环，永远算不清。

这个案例做出来的是一个单文件网页运营台：社群资产管理（每个群的成员数、活跃度、运营阶段一目了然）、成员分层运营（KOC/付费/活跃粉/流失预警分层打标签）、社群运营日历（可视化排期每日话题和活动）、私域转化追踪（进群→活跃→咨询→付费的漏斗，自动算每一环转化率）、月度运营复盘（含内联 SVG 成长曲线）、群话术库（欢迎语/活动通知/转化促单一键复制直接发群）。数据全存浏览器本地，支持导出备份；PC 端侧边栏、手机端底部 Tab，可加到主屏当 App；内置中英双语，链接加 ?lang=en 整页切英文。

适合：管着多个微信群/知识星球的私域操盘手、做付费社群陪跑的知识博主、需要盯转化漏斗的增长运营、给客户做私域代运营的服务商、以及想把粉丝沉淀成长期资产的个人创业者。
cases.description_en:
The biggest headache in private-traffic ops is having a few groups and hundreds or thousands of people, all tracked by memory and by scrolling chat logs — you can never figure out which group is going cold, who's a loyal fan versus who's about to churn, what event to post this week, or exactly where people drop off between joining and paying.

This case produces a single-file web ops console: community asset management (each group's member count, activity and lifecycle stage at a glance), tiered member ops (tag KOC / paid / active fans / churn-risk), an ops calendar (visually schedule daily topics and events), private-traffic conversion tracking (a join → active → inquiry → paid funnel that auto-computes each step's rate), monthly ops reviews (with an inline SVG growth curve), and a message script library (welcome / event notice / upsell scripts you can copy and send with one click). All data lives in the browser locally with export backup; a sidebar on desktop, a bottom tab bar on mobile, addable to the home screen as an app; built-in bilingual support flips the whole page to English by appending ?lang=en.

Great for: private-traffic operators managing multiple WeChat/Zsxq groups, knowledge creators running paid coaching communities, growth ops who need to watch the conversion funnel, agencies running private-traffic ops for clients, and solo founders turning fans into a long-term asset.

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款（https://workbuddy.link/p/VXLAdcLg6c4MkuE4lugnAC），需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：
帮我做一个「私域社群运营台」——给做私域/社群运营的人用的单文件网页工作台，浏览器直接打开就能用，数据存本地浏览器（localStorage），关掉再打开不丢，支持导出/导入备份。

要包含这几个模块：
1. 私域概览：今日焦点 + 核心数据卡片（私域总成员、活跃成员、付费转化率、流失预警人数），近期排期和各阵地健康度一览；
2. 社群资产管理：登记每个社群阵地（平台/名称/成员数/活跃人数/运营阶段/备注），能按平台筛选、增删改；
3. 成员分层运营：把重点成员按 KOC核心/付费用户/活跃粉/流失预警等层级打标签管理，只记值得单独运营的人；
4. 社群运营日历：月历视图排期每日话题、每周活动、直播、答疑等，点日期即可添加，带本月排期清单；
5. 私域转化追踪：进群→活跃→咨询→付费的可视化漏斗，自动算每一环转化率，并对比各社群转化潜力；
6. 运营复盘：月度数据记录（新增/流失/活跃/新付费）+ 用内联 SVG 画的总成员成长曲线；
7. 群话术库：按欢迎语/活动通知/转化促单等分类存常用话术，一键复制直接发群。

Let the Project Proposal Expert take it on: reads your uploaded template, combines it with similar-project experience, execution data, and budget records from your organization's backend, and auto-generates a complete proposal covering background, needs analysis, goals, implementation plan, evaluation metrics, and budget breakdown. Section structure strictly follows the template; key figures remain traceable to backend records.

For: proposal writers at nonprofits, social organization leads, and any project needing a compliant proposal against an internal or funder template.

cases.description_en:
With the first draft of a project proposal done, the polishing pass is where nonprofits get stuck: a stray quote in the abstract, uneven numbered-list indents, inconsistent terminology, plain-white table headers, activity labels that blur into body text, columns squeezed together. Fixing them by hand is slow, and it's easy to change the language but miss the format — or vice versa.

Let the Project Proposal Expert take it on: reads the full document chapter by chapter to polish punctuation and terminology, unify list indents and bullet marks, and improve sentence rhythm. In parallel, it does a systematic format upgrade — dark-blue bold table headers, bold-aligned activity labels, content-driven column widths, tinted label columns for readability. Content and budget structure remain untouched; only language and format are optimized, with a final read-through to confirm the file opens cleanly.

For: nonprofit project staff with a first-draft proposal in hand who need a professionalism and presentation boost, and any team standardizing format before grant submission.

cases.title: 朋克周自媒体工作台
cases.subtitle: 内容、商单、日程、健身四张表，收进一个自媒体工作台
cases.subtitle_en: Content, deals, schedule, and fitness — four tables in one creator workspace
cases.description:
一个自媒体博主的内容、商单、日程、健身数据散在好几张表里，每天要开一堆文件才知道今天该干什么，最烦的就是来回切换、记不住进度。

这个案例演示了一个「朋克周自媒体工作台」：把内容项目（40 条）、商业交付（20 条）、出差日程（13 条）、健身记录（13 条）四张表整合进一个页面——今日待办、内容流水线（文案→剪辑→审核→发布）、商单扇形看板、四周日程拖拽排期、播放数据洞察，打开即见今天该做什么。数据用资料库数据表在线存储、改动双向同步，手机电脑都能用。

适合：正在做自媒体想统一管理内容与商单的创作者、需要把多张 Excel 收进一个看板的运营、想让团队协作看进度的新媒体小组、想给自己搭一个「个人 OS」工作台的效率党。
cases.description_en:
A self-media creator's content, deals, schedule, and fitness data are scattered across several spreadsheets — every day you open a pile of files just to figure out what to do, and switching between them while tracking progress is the most frustrating part.

This case shows a Punk Zhou self-media workspace that unifies four tables — content (40 items), commercial deals (20), travel schedule (13), and fitness records (13) — into one page. You get today's to-do, a content pipeline (copywriting → editing → review → publish), a fan-style deals board, a four-week drag-and-drop schedule, and playback insights, all visible the moment you open it. Data lives in structured Library tables with two-way sync, and it works on both desktop and mobile.

Best for: creators running self-media who want content and deals in one place, operators who want to fold multiple spreadsheets into a single dashboard, new-media teams that need a shared progress view, and efficiency-minded people who want a personal-OS workbench.

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款（https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/u24zeHpjinaXthG8ftedxx），需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路，若没有能力则按以下方式搭建：

帮我搭一个「朋克周自媒体工作台」。

五个工作区：
1. 今日（Today）：今日待办、出发提醒、内容流和商单预览
2. 内容（Content）：内容生产流水线（文案→剪辑→审核→发布），支持新建、筛选、推进状态
3. 商单（Deals）：商业交付项目管理，六卡扇形轮播 + 项目焦点卡 + 打开项目资料
4. 日程（Schedule）：四周日程窗 + 按天查看 + 拖拽排期
5. 洞察（Insights）：播放量/互动 KPI + 内容状态分布、渠道播放、反馈分布、7 日趋势图表

数据存储：用资料库能力自建 4 张数据表（内容项目、商业交付、出差日程、健身记录）存数据，页面实时读资料库数据表（增删改直接写回表）；再把工作台 HTML 部署到资料库，交付一个在线链接。

界面：暖白纸面 + 深色侧边栏 + 克制工业风，信息密度高，PC/手机双适配；零外链，图表用内联 SVG，图标用内联 SVG 不用 emoji。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 4 张数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the library capability to clone this workbench in one click: https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/u24zeHpjinaXthG8ftedxx, with online data storage and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click clone path; if unavailable, build as follows: Build me a Punk Zhou self-media workspace. Five workspaces:
1. Today: daily to-dos, departure reminder, content-flow and deals previews
2. Content: the content production pipeline (copywriting → editing → review → publish), with create, filter, and advance-status
3. Deals: commercial delivery project management with a six-card fan carousel + project focus card + open project files
4. Schedule: a four-week schedule window + day view + drag-and-drop scheduling
5. Insights: plays/interaction KPIs + content-status distribution, channel plays, feedback distribution, and a 7-day trend chart Data storage: use the Library to self-create 4 tables (content projects, commercial delivery, travel schedule, fitness records) to hold the data; the page reads the Library tables in real time (writes go straight back to the tables); then deploy the workspace HTML to the Library and deliver an online link. Interface: warm paper surface + dark sidebar + restrained industrial style, high information density, responsive on desktop and mobile; fully inline with zero external links, charts as inline SVG, icons as inline SVG (no emoji).

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus 4 data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: Python 零基础学习路径
cases.subtitle: 90天系统化学习规划，从入门到能做项目
cases.subtitle_en: 90-day structured learning plan — from beginner to building projects
cases.description:
想学 Python 但资源太多不知从何下手？看了几天视频就放弃了？缺少系统规划让自学变成三天打鱼两天晒网？这个案例展示了如何用教育 Skill，一键生成 90 天 Python 学习路线图。

路线图按周拆解为 5 大阶段：基础语法 → 进阶特性 → 实用库 → 实战项目 → 综合项目。每周都有明确的学习目标、核心知识点、免费推荐资源、动手练习和检查点。两周一个里程碑，让你随时知道自己在哪、下一步该做什么。还附带常见坑点提醒和坚持学习的实用技巧。

适合：编程零基础学习者、转行程序员、数据分析入门者、大学生自学编程。
cases.description_en:
Want to learn Python but overwhelmed by too many resources? Watched tutorials for a few days then gave up? This case shows how to use the Education Skill to generate a 90-day Python roadmap.

The roadmap breaks down into 5 phases across 13 weeks: fundamentals → intermediate features → practical libraries → mini projects → capstone project. Each week includes clear objectives, key concepts, free resources, hands-on exercises, and checkpoints.

Best for: complete beginners, career changers, data analysis newcomers, and college students.

artifacts.label: Python 90天学习路径

cases.prompt:
请帮我规划一个 Python 零基础学习路径。

背景：我是编程零基础，想系统学习 Python，目标是 90 天后能独立做小项目。

要求：
1. 每天投入约 2 小时
2. 分阶段规划，从基础语法到实战项目
3. 每周有明确学习目标和练习
4. 推荐免费学习资源
5. 包含实战项目练手
6. 给出常见问题和避坑建议
cases.prompt_en:
Please help me map out a Python learning path for an absolute beginner.

Background: I have zero programming experience and want to learn Python systematically, with the goal of being able to independently build small projects after 90 days.

Requirements:
1. About 2 hours of study per day
2. A phased plan, going from basic syntax to hands-on projects
3. Clear learning objectives and exercises each week
4. Recommended free learning resources
5. Include hands-on projects to practice with
6. Provide common pitfalls and tips for avoiding them

cases.title: 秋招投递记录工作台
cases.subtitle: 各大企业/央国企双赛道 ｜ 筛子筛企→投递→面试→offer 全流程一站管理
cases.description: 秋招投了十几家就乱成一团：哪家约了一面、哪家挂了、哪家还在等结果，全靠翻聊天记录？这个工作台把秋招全程拆成四件套：秋招筛子（批量把已开放秋招的企业扔进篓子，投过的自动打绿标）、关注清单（56 家硬件/智能硬件公司按赛道整理好招聘官网）、投递记录（状态从已投简历到挂掉共 10 档，彩色标签一眼看清，支持编辑/删除/搜索/四种排序/紧凑切换）、日程规划（笔试面试日程时间线 + 月历视图 + 月度分布 + 近 7 日投递节奏）。左右侧边栏一键切「各大企业 / 央国企」双赛道，数据互不干扰；页面数据在线存储、多设备自动同步，手机电脑都能记。演示数据内置 10 条投递记录和 56 家关注企业（公司、岗位、状态、备注齐全），打开就能上手试。适合正在打秋招/暑期实习的同学、帮学弟学妹管进度的班委、任何想把自己投递漏斗管起来的人。
cases.subtitle_en: Dual-track (Tech & SOE) | Sieve → Apply → Interview → Offer, all in one place
cases.description_en: Applied to a dozen companies and already lost track — who scheduled you for a first interview, who rejected you, who's still reviewing? This workbench breaks autumn recruiting into four tools: the Sieve (batch-drop companies with open autumn hiring, applied ones get a green tag automatically), the Watchlist (56 hardware / smart-device companies with careers-site links, organized by sector), the Application Log (10 status stages from Applied to Rejected with colored chips, plus edit / delete / search / four sort orders / compact view), and the Schedule (event timeline + month calendar + monthly breakdown + 7-day application rhythm). The sidebar toggles between the Tech Companies and SOEs tracks with fully separate data; everything is stored online and syncs across devices. Demo data ships with 10 application records and 56 watched companies (companies, roles, statuses and notes all filled in) so you can try it right away. Best for students in autumn/summer recruiting, class reps tracking peers' progress, and anyone who wants their application funnel under control.

cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library capability to recreate this workbench from https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/2Ws96lp6qNy4DJVjGdItuR with online data storage and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click clone flow; if unavailable, build it as follows: Build an 'Autumn Application Tracker Workbench' as a workbench that stores data in Library databases, reads/writes at runtime and syncs across devices. Four modules: 1) Application Log — card list (company / base / role / status / applied date / notes) with 10 status stages (Applied / Screened / HR screening / Dept screening / AI interview pending / Assessment pending / Interview / Under review / Awaiting offer / Rejected) shown as colored chips; supports quick-add bar + full modal, edit, delete, search by company/role/base, status filter, four sort orders, compact/detail density toggle, status legend and stats bar; 2) Watchlist — cards for companies whose autumn hiring is not yet open (company / role / expected opening / notes) with add/edit/delete; companies already applied to get a green '✓ Applied' tag and a one-click convert-to-application; 3) Sieve — batch-paste company names (with optional careers links), verify roles one by one, then convert to applications or remove; shows to-screen / applied counts; 4) Schedule — written-test/interview event timeline (a 'today' divider, past events collapsed), month calendar with click-to-filter, monthly breakdown, and a 7-day application rhythm bar chart. The left sidebar toggles the Tech Companies / SOEs tracks (data isolated per track via the track field in the Library tables) plus a Schedule view; a header badge shows online-sync status. Visual style: clean recruiting-tool look (light theme, blue-purple accents, rounded cards, colored status chips); all CSS/JS inline with no external dependencies; responsive for PC and mobile.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus 4 data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 客户邮件跟进追踪表
cases.subtitle: 按 UID 深读正文，跟进状态一条不漏
cases.subtitle_en: Deep-read by UID, never lose track of a follow-up
cases.description: 跟合作方邮件往来最怕两件事：正文只扫了一眼摘要就漏了关键截止时间，以及过两天想找回来却发现「我到底回没回过这封」。这个案例演示了用 QQ邮箱 skill 收取最近 30 天邮件、筛出客户与合作方往来邮件，再按 UID 逐封读取完整正文，提炼核心诉求和截止时间，最后按「待我回复 / 等待对方 / 已完结」三种状态整理成一张跟进追踪表，每条都带邮件 UID、日期和下一步动作。适合：维护多个客户的外贸/BD 同学、跟进合作项目的项目经理、对接供应商的采购、要按周复盘对外沟通的团队负责人，以及所有邮件回复拖延症患者。
cases.description_en: Two things make partner email threads painful: skimming only the preview and missing a key deadline, and later wondering "did I ever reply to this?" This case uses the QQ Mail skill to fetch the last 30 days of email, filter out customer and partner correspondence, deep-read each important message in full by UID, extract the core ask and deadline, and organize everything into a follow-up tracker with three statuses — "needs my reply", "waiting on them", "closed". Every entry carries the email UID, date, and next action. Great for: foreign-trade and BD folks juggling multiple clients, project managers chasing partnerships, procurement coordinating suppliers, team leads reviewing external communication weekly, and chronic email procrastinators.
cases.prompt:
我在跟几个合作方的邮件往来，经常漏回或者漏掉正文里的截止时间。请用 QQ邮箱 skill 帮我做一次跟进整理：

1. 先收取最近 30 天的邮件；
2. 从中筛出客户/合作方发来的往来邮件；
3. 对需要我处理的关键邮件，按收信列表里的 UID 用 get-body 读取完整正文，提炼核心诉求、涉及金额或日期、截止时间；
4. 按「待我回复 / 等待对方 / 已完结」三种状态，把每条跟进事项整理成追踪表，附上邮件 UID、日期、发件人和下一步动作。

最终生成一份跟进追踪面板（单文件 HTML、明亮暖色系）。

cases.subtitle: 7 天邮件自动分类，重点事项一目了然
cases.subtitle_en: Seven days of email, auto-categorized at a glance
cases.description: 一到周一就头大：邮箱里堆了整整一周没细看的邮件，逐封点开又费时，不看又怕漏掉重要的事。这个案例演示了用 QQ邮箱 skill 收取最近 7 天的邮件，自动按工作协作、通知公告、订阅推广、个人事务分类，标出需要回复处理的重点邮件，并给每封邮件提炼一段摘要，最后排成一份可读性拉满的杂志风周报。适合：邮件多到看不过来的打工人、每周要做 inbox 清零的效率党、需要向领导汇报本周往来邮件的项目经理、想快速了解邮箱动态的学生党，以及所有被邮件焦虑困扰的人。
cases.description_en: Monday dread: a full week of unread email piled up in your inbox. Opening every message takes forever, but skipping them risks missing something important. This case uses the QQ Mail skill to fetch the last 7 days of email, automatically group it into work collaboration, notifications, subscriptions, and personal items, flag the messages that need a reply, add a short digest for each email, and lay it all out in a magazine-style weekly report. Great for: office workers drowning in email, inbox-zero enthusiasts, project managers reporting weekly correspondence, students keeping tabs on their mailbox, and anyone with email anxiety.
cases.prompt:
每到周一，我最头疼的就是邮箱里堆了一周没细看的邮件。请用 QQ邮箱 skill 的收信能力，收取我最近 7 天的邮件（可用 --days 7），然后帮我做一份「收件箱一周速览」：

4. 结尾给一个本周收件箱小结（总数、各类占比、待处理清单）。

最终汇总成一份可读性高的周报（单文件 HTML、明亮配色、报纸杂志风排版）。

cases.title: 批量发送个性化面试邀约
cases.subtitle: 一批发送 5 位候选人，称呼和岗位各不相同
cases.subtitle_en: Five candidates in one batch, each with their own greeting and role
cases.description: 招聘季最头疼的就是重复劳动：同样一封面试邀约，要挨个改称呼、改岗位、改时间，发完还得自己记谁发了谁没发。这个案例演示了把一份 5 人候选名单交给 QQ邮箱 skill，用 SMTP 逐个发送个性化面试邀约，并汇总成一份发送任务报告——名单、个性化变量、实际发送命令、每封邮件的发送状态一目了然。适合：负责校招/社招的 HR、需要批量发通知的行政同学、给学员发课程通知的教务老师、要给多个客户发会议邀约的销售，以及所有不想再复制粘贴改称呼的人。
cases.description_en: Recruiting season is full of copy-paste drudgery: the same interview invitation, but you have to tweak the greeting, role, and time for every single candidate — and then keep track of who got it. This case hands a 5-person candidate list to the QQ Mail skill, which sends personalized invitations one by one via SMTP and wraps everything into a dispatch report: the roster, personalization variables, the actual send commands, and the delivery status of each email. Great for: HR running campus or lateral hiring, admins sending bulk notices, teachers notifying students, sales reps inviting multiple clients, and anyone tired of hand-editing greetings.

cases.description_en:
Want to know what's hot right now but too lazy to flip through every chart one by one?

This case has the QQ Music assistant pull all chart groups in real time, dig into the full track lists of the most-listened charts, and produce a dark-themed data report: listen-count comparison across charts, Top 10 of key charts, and cross-chart hit analysis — every song with a play link.

For: music lovers tracking trends, content creators picking topics, and radio or short-video makers looking for hot tracks.

artifacts.label: QQ音乐巅峰榜数据周报页面

cases.prompt: 用 QQ音乐助手获取当前真实排行榜数据，做一份「QQ音乐巅峰榜数据周报」单文件 HTML 报告。先调 /charts 拿到全部榜单分组（巅峰榜、地区榜、特色榜等），记录每个榜单的收听人数与歌曲总数；再挑收听人数最高的 3-4 个榜单调 /charts/detail 拿完整曲目。页面需包含：①榜单分组总览与各榜单收听人数对比图；②重点榜单 Top10 歌曲排行（歌名+歌手+播放链接）；③跨榜热歌分析——统计同时登上多个榜单的歌曲及其出现次数；④数据更新时间与来源标注。暗色音乐氛围、图表用内联 SVG/Canvas 绘制、信息密度高，单文件 HTML、资源全内联、可离线打开。所有数据必须真实调用接口获取，禁止编造，页面底部注明数据抓取时间。
cases.prompt_en: Use the QQ Music assistant to fetch current real chart data and build a "QQ Music Top Charts Weekly Report" as a single-file HTML page. First call /charts to get all chart groups (Top Charts, Regional Charts, Featured Charts, etc.), recording each chart's listener count and total tracks; then pick the 3-4 most-listened charts and call /charts/detail for their full track lists. The page must include: 1) an overview of chart groups with a listener-count comparison chart; 2) Top 10 rankings of key charts (song name + artist + play link); 3) cross-chart hit analysis — songs appearing on multiple charts with occurrence counts; 4) data update time and source attribution. Dark music atmosphere, charts drawn with inline SVG/Canvas, high information density, single-file HTML with all resources inlined, works offline. All data must be fetched from the real API — no fabrication. Note the data fetch time in the page footer.

cases.subtitle: 听歌报告+AI解读，一页看懂你的音乐DNA

cases.description:
听了那么久歌，想知道自己到底是什么风格的听众，光翻歌单可看不出来。

这个案例让 QQ音乐助手拉取你的本周与本月听歌报告——日均时长、Top 歌手与歌曲、最爱时段、连续听歌天数、流派分布、小众占比、听歌城市、单曲循环之最，再调 AI 解读生成一段专属于你的音乐画像，汇总成一页温暖的个人听歌报告。

适合：喜欢复盘听歌习惯的乐迷、想晒个性化报告的用户、对推荐算法好奇的 QQ 音乐用户。
cases.description_en:

This case has the QQ Music assistant pull your weekly and monthly listening reports — daily average time, top artists and songs, favorite hours, consecutive listening days, genre distribution, niche ratio, listening cities, and your most-looped track — then calls AI interpretation to write a personal music portrait, all wrapped into one warm listening report page.

For: music fans who love reviewing their habits, users who want to share a personalized report, and anyone curious about QQ Music's personalization.

artifacts.label: 个人听歌画像报告页面

cases.prompt: 用 QQ音乐助手生成「我的听歌画像」个人报告单文件 HTML。依次调 /me/report：timeKey=w 拿本周报告（日均听歌时长、对比上周浮动、Top 歌手、Top 歌曲），timeKey=m 拿本月报告（Top 艺人、Top 歌曲、最爱时段、连续听歌天数、流派分布、小众/热门占比、尝鲜歌曲数、听歌城市、单曲循环之最、深夜单曲）；再调 /assistant/ai_interpretation（query 填「分析我的听歌风格，我是怎样的听众」）拿 AI 流式解读并整理成文。页面需包含：①本周速览数据卡；②月度 Top 歌手与 Top 歌曲榜（带播放链接）；③听歌习惯可视化（24 小时时段分布、流派占比、小众 vs 热门）；④趣味版块（循环之最、深夜单曲、听歌城市足迹）；⑤AI 音乐画像专区。温暖的年度报告风格、视觉精致有情感，单文件 HTML、资源全内联、可离线打开。所有数据必须真实调接口获取，禁止编造，注明统计周期。
cases.prompt_en: Use the QQ Music assistant to generate a "My Listening Portrait" personal report as a single-file HTML page. Call /me/report in sequence: timeKey=w for this week's report (daily average listening time, week-over-week change, top artists, top songs), timeKey=m for this month's report (top artists, top songs, favorite hours, consecutive listening days, genre distribution, niche vs mainstream ratio, new song count, listening cities, most-looped song, late-night song); then call /assistant/ai_interpretation (query: "分析我的听歌风格，我是怎样的听众") to get the streaming AI interpretation and compile it into text. The page must include: 1) a weekly overview data card; 2) monthly top artists and top songs (with play links); 3) listening habit visualizations (24-hour distribution, genre share, niche vs mainstream); 4) fun sections (most-looped song, late-night song, listening city footprint); 5) an AI music portrait section. Warm annual-report style, refined and emotional visuals, single-file HTML with all resources inlined, works offline. All data must be fetched from the real API — no fabrication. Note the statistics period on the page.

cases.subtitle: 一键抓取百度实时热搜，整理成清爽的排行榜看板
cases.subtitle_en: Scrape Baidu's live trending list and turn it into a clean ranking dashboard in one shot
cases.description:
想快速掌握当下全网都在聊什么，却不想在一堆网页里手动复制粘贴？打开热搜页，条目一堆、热度值散落各处，整理起来又慢又乱。

这个案例演示了：让 AI 用 QQ 浏览器自动化打开百度实时热搜榜，真实抓取前几十条热搜的排名、标题和热度指数，注明抓取时间和来源，然后自动整理成一个信息密度很高的单文件 HTML 数据看板——带排名和热度可视化，能离线打开、直接展示。

适合：想快速做热点简报的运营、需要每日盯榜的自媒体、以及想看网页自动化怎么落地的开发者。
cases.description_en:
Want to know what the whole internet is talking about right now, without copy-pasting from a dozen web pages? Trending pages are crowded, heat scores are scattered, and organizing it all is slow and messy.

This case shows how to let AI use QQ Browser automation to open Baidu's real-time trending list, actually scrape the rank, title and heat index of dozens of entries, note the capture time and source, then automatically turn it into an information-dense single-file HTML dashboard — with ranking and heat visualization, ready to open offline and present directly.

For: operators who need quick hot-topic briefings, content creators who track trending lists daily, and developers curious about real-world web automation.

artifacts.label: 实时热搜榜数据看板

cases.prompt:
用 QQ 浏览器自动化 skill 打开百度实时热搜榜（https://top.baidu.com/board?tab=realtime），真实抓取当前榜单前 15 到 20 条热搜，逐条提取排名、标题、热度指数以及页面上的简短描述，并记录数据来源 URL 和抓取时间。数据必须真实抓取，不要使用示意或编造的数据。

然后把这些真实数据整理成一个信息密度高、耐看的单文件 HTML 排行榜看板，保存为 output.html：能一眼看出名次高低和热度强弱即可，风格你来把握。所有资源内联、可离线打开，页面内跳转用按钮加滚动而非锚点链接。
cases.prompt_en:
Use the QQ Browser automation skill to open Baidu's real-time trending list (https://top.baidu.com/board?tab=realtime) and actually scrape the current top 15 to 20 entries, extracting for each the rank, title, heat index and any short description shown, and record the source URL and capture time. The data must be genuinely scraped — do not use placeholder or fabricated data.

Then organize the real data into an information-dense, readable single-file HTML ranking dashboard saved as output.html: it should make rank order and heat magnitude obvious at a glance; the visual style is up to you. Inline all resources so it opens offline, and use buttons with scrolling for in-page navigation rather than anchor links.

cases.title: 反垄断法 2007 vs 2022 修订对照解读
cases.subtitle: 公平竞争审查、平台经济、罚款幅度三大重点 + 草案转正式稿对照
cases.subtitle_en: Fair competition review, platform economy & fine escalations, with draft-to-final comparison
cases.description:
想搞清一部法规改了什么、为什么改、影响谁，最怕的就是新旧条文混在一起逐字比到眼瞎。这个案例演示了如何把《反垄断法》2007 年法、2021 年修正草案、2022 年修正正式稿三份文本交给 AI：先由法规数据库拉取全部历史版本与条文原文，再对相邻版本做逐词级 diff，把公平竞争审查制度入法、平台经济数据算法条款、罚款幅度大幅上调（最高 10 倍）等 15 处变更按『事实—规则—动因—影响—趋势』五层拆解，并聚合立法机关说明与黄勇、王先林、王晓晔等学者观点，最终输出一份带时间线、变更统计和双视图（并排/统一）对比的 HTML 报告。

适合：企业法务与合规人员、反垄断领域律师、政策研究者、关注平台经济监管的投资人、需要做法规沿革梳理的法律学习者。
cases.description_en:
Trying to figure out what a regulation changed, why, and who it affects is painful when old and new provisions are jumbled together for line-by-line comparison. This case demonstrates handing the 2007 AML, the 2021 amendment draft, and the 2022 final revision to AI: historical versions and article texts are pulled from a regulation database, adjacent versions are diffed word-by-word, and 15 changes — from the codification of fair competition review and data/algorithm rules for platform economy to fine escalations of up to 10x — are analyzed through a five-layer framework (facts-rules-motivations-impact-trends), with official legislative statements and expert views from Huang Yong, Wang Xianlin, Wang Xiaoye aggregated into an HTML report featuring a timeline, change statistics, and side-by-side/unified diff views.

For: corporate legal & compliance teams, antitrust lawyers, policy researchers, investors tracking platform regulation, and law students working on regulatory evolution analysis.
cases.prompt:
请对照《中华人民共和国反垄断法》2007 年版本与 2022 年修订版本（2022.08.01 施行），并把 2021 年 10 月公布的《修正草案（征求意见稿）》一并纳入对比，重点看三处：①公平竞争审查制度（新增第五条）；②平台经济领域反垄断（新增第九条、第十九条，第二十二条数据算法条款）；③罚款幅度（第五十六、五十八、六十二、六十三条）。

要求：1）条文原文必须从北大法宝 MCP 真实查询获取并注明版本与链接，禁止凭记忆；2）相邻版本做逐词级 diff，输出 git 风格双视图（并排/统一）HTML 报告；3）每条变更按『事实—规则—动因—影响—趋势』分层解读，至少写到动因层；4）用 WebSearch 检索全国人大审议说明、学者与律所观点并附署名、机构、日期、原文链接，标注官方说明/支持/谨慎立场，归纳共识与分歧；5）报告需包含版本时间线、变更统计（修改/新增/删除/条号迁移）、类型筛选器与深色模式；6）草案阶段的评论必须注明『正式稿可能已调整』，并单独标注草案与正式稿的文字差异；7）报告尾部附免责声明（不构成法律意见）。数据须来自真实查询并注明来源，禁止示意或模拟数据。
cases.prompt_en:
Compare the 2007 version of the PRC Anti-Monopoly Law with the 2022 revision (effective 2022-08-01), and include the October 2021 Amendment Draft (exposure draft) in the comparison. Focus on three areas: 1) the fair competition review regime (new Article 5); 2) platform-economy antitrust rules (new Articles 9 and 19, and the data/algorithm clause in Article 22); 3) penalty amounts (Articles 56, 58, 62, 63).

Requirements: 1) Article texts must be retrieved in real time from the pkulaw MCP database, with version and link cited — no recall from memory; 2) produce word-level diffs between adjacent versions as a git-style HTML report with side-by-side/unified views; 3) analyze each change through a five-layer framework (facts–rules–motivations–impact–trends), reaching at least the motivation layer; 4) use WebSearch to gather NPC review statements and views from scholars and law firms, each with name, affiliation, date and source link, labelled as official/supportive/cautious, and summarize consensus and disputes; 5) the report must include a version timeline, change statistics (modified/added/deleted/renumbered), a type filter and dark-mode support; 6) comments on the draft stage must note "the final version may have adjusted", with explicit draft-vs-final wording differences; 7) end with a disclaimer (not legal advice). Data must come from real queries with sources cited; no illustrative or simulated data.

cases.title_en: Data Security Law Version Diff Analysis
cases.subtitle: 征求意见稿 vs 2021 正式稿：分类分级、重要数据义务、出境评估、罚则四大重点
cases.subtitle_en: Draft vs 2021 final: data classification, important-data duties, cross-border assessment & penalties
cases.description:
法规改版最怕的就是『不知道改了啥、改了影响谁』——尤其像《数据安全法》这种基础性法律，草案到正式稿的每一处措辞变化都可能直接改写企业的合规义务。这个案例用北大法宝逐条拉取《数据安全法》2020 年征求意见稿与 2021 年正式稿条文，对分类分级、重要数据处理者义务、数据出境安全评估、罚则变化四类重点做逐词级 diff，叠加官方说明与专家观点（网信办、人大法工委、律所），最终产出一份带版本时间线、变更统计与双视图对比（并排/统一）的 HTML 报告，并附半导体制造企业的合规影响要点。

适合：合规/法务人员做法规沿革研究；数据安全岗位评估新法义务落地；半导体等制造业企业梳理重要数据识别与出境合规；研究政策变化的分析师与咨询顾问。
cases.description_en:
Nothing is more annoying than a revised law where you cannot tell what actually changed and who is affected. This case pulls every article of the Data Security Law (2020 exposure draft vs 2021 final version) via PKULaw, runs a token-level diff on four focus areas - data classification, important-data processor duties, cross-border data security assessment and penalties - and layers on official explanations and expert commentary (CAC, NPC Legislative Affairs Commission, law firms). The result is a self-contained HTML report with a version timeline, change statistics and dual-view (side-by-side / unified) diffs, plus compliance impact notes for semiconductor manufacturers.

For: compliance and legal teams doing regulatory history research; data-security officers assessing new obligations; semiconductor and manufacturing firms identifying important data and export compliance; analysts and consultants tracking policy shifts.
cases.prompt:
请对照《中华人民共和国数据安全法》征求意见稿和 2021 年正式稿（包括草案）做版本对照解读，重点看四类内容：① 数据分类分级制度；② 重要数据处理者义务；③ 数据出境安全评估；④ 罚则变化。

我们是半导体制造企业，请在报告里顺带写合规影响要点。

要求：
1. 用北大法宝 MCP 检索法规全部历史版本并构建时间线（get_law_list → get_article 按版本全名取条）；北大法宝未收录的草案条文，以中国人大网官方公布文本为准并注明来源。
2. 对两版对应条文做逐词级 diff，输出变更统计（修改/新增/删除条数、字符增删规模、条号迁移）。
3. 每条变更按『事实—规则—动因—影响—趋势』五层写解读卡片，重大变更至少写到动因层，并注明『针对草案，正式稿可能已调整』。
4. 用联网搜索聚合官方说明与专家观点，专家须实名并附来源链接，标注共识与分歧。
5. 输出带版本时间线、变更统计、并排/统一双视图 diff 的 HTML 报告，资源全内联、可离线打开。
6. 报告尾注『不构成法律意见』。
cases.prompt_en:
Compare the exposure draft (including the bill) of the Data Security Law of the People's Republic of China with its 2021 final version, focusing on four areas: 1) data classification and grading; 2) obligations of important-data processors; 3) cross-border data security assessment; 4) penalty changes.

We are a semiconductor manufacturer - please include compliance impact notes for us in the report.

Requirements:
1. Use the PKULaw MCP to retrieve all historical versions of the law and build a timeline (get_law_list -> get_article with the full versioned title); where PKULaw does not hold the draft, use the officially published text on npc.gov.cn and cite the source.
2. Run a token-level diff on the corresponding articles of the two versions and output change statistics (modified/added/deleted counts, character churn, renumbered items).
3. Write interpretation cards for every change following the fact-rule-motivation-impact-trend framework; reach at least the motivation layer for major changes and note 'based on the draft, the final version may have adjusted' where relevant.
4. Aggregate official statements and expert commentary via web search; experts must be named with source links, and consensus vs disputes must be flagged.
5. Output an HTML report with a version timeline, change statistics, and side-by-side/unified diff views; all assets must be inlined and the file must open offline.
6. End the report with a 'not legal advice' disclaimer.

cases.title_en: Company Law Revision Comparison: 2018 Amendment → 2023 Revision
cases.subtitle: 注册资本五年实缴、股东失权与催缴、股权转让出资责任、治理结构四大主题逐条 diff
cases.subtitle_en: Clause-by-clause diff on 5-year capital contribution, share forfeiture, transfer liability & governance
cases.description:
公司法改了，最怕搞不清新旧版本到底差在哪：注册资本认缴是不是改成实缴了？股东不按期出资怎么办？股权转出去了还要不要对没缴的出资负责？监事会被审计委员会取代了吗？本案例演示用「法规历史版本对照解读」能力，调取《中华人民共和国公司法》2018 年修正与 2023 年修订两个版本的官方文本，围绕注册资本认缴改实缴、股东失权与催缴、股权转让后的出资责任、董事会/监事会治理结构四大主题逐条做逐词级 diff，产出一份带版本时间线、变更统计、并排/统一双视图对比、分层解读与专家观点聚合的 HTML 报告。

适合：需要做法规沿革研究的公司法务与合规人员、处理公司设立与股权交易业务的律师、关注注册资本实缴新政的企业创始人与财务负责人、研究公司治理与资本制度的学者与研究生。
cases.description_en:
When the Company Law is revised, the hardest part is figuring out exactly what changed between versions: Did the registered capital move from subscription to paid-in? What happens if a shareholder fails to contribute on time? After transferring equity, are you still liable for unpaid contributions? Is the supervisory board being replaced by the audit committee? This case demonstrates the Regulation Version Diff Reader capability: it pulls the official texts of the 2018 Amendment and 2023 Revision of the PRC Company Law and runs a token-level diff on four key themes — the shift from subscription to a 5-year paid-in capital rule, share forfeiture and capital calls, post-transfer contribution liability, and board/supervisory governance structure — producing an HTML report with a version timeline, change statistics, side-by-side & unified diff views, layered analysis, and expert opinions. 

For: in-house counsel and compliance officers tracking regulatory evolution, lawyers handling company incorporation and equity transactions, founders and CFOs affected by the paid-in capital rules, and scholars researching corporate governance and capital systems.

cases.prompt:
请对照《中华人民共和国公司法》2018 年修正与 2023 年修订两个版本，重点看以下四大主题：① 注册资本认缴改实缴（五年缴足、加速到期）；② 股东失权与催缴（董事核查催缴义务、失权程序与救济）；③ 股权转让后的出资责任（未届期转让、瑕疵转让的补充/连带责任）；④ 董事会/监事会治理结构（审计委员会替代监事会、小型公司机构简化、股东会与董事会职权重构）。

要求：
1. 条文与版本信息必须通过北大法宝检索获取真实官方文本并注明来源，禁止凭记忆或编造；
2. 先在两版中分别定位相关条号（条号会迁移，不要假设新旧版同条号是同一内容），再逐条提取原文；
3. 输出一份单文件 HTML 报告（资源全内联、可离线打开），包含：版本时间线、变更统计与字符增删规模、逐条 git 风格 diff（并排对照与统一视图可切换）、按『事实→规则→动因→影响→趋势』分层的解读卡片、官方说明与专家观点聚合（实名+来源链接）；
4. 区分新设公司与存量公司的适用规则与时间表，报告末尾附免责声明。
cases.prompt_en:
Compare the 2018 Amendment and the 2023 Revision of the PRC Company Law, focusing on four themes: ① registered capital from subscription to paid-in (5-year payment deadline, accelerated maturity); ② shareholder forfeiture and capital calls (directors' duty to verify and call, forfeiture procedure and remedies); ③ post-transfer contribution liability (supplementary/joint liability for unexpired and defective transfers); ④ board/supervisory governance structure (audit committee replacing supervisory board, simplified structures for small companies, rebalancing of shareholders' meeting vs board powers).

Requirements:
1. Obtain all article texts and version info from real official sources via PKULaw search and cite them; never rely on memory or fabricate; 2. Locate the relevant article numbers in each version separately (numbers migrate between versions; never assume the same number means the same content), then extract the original text of each article; 3. Deliver a single-file HTML report (all resources inlined, openable offline) containing: a version timeline, change statistics with added/deleted character scale, per-article git-style diff (side-by-side and unified views switchable), analysis cards layered as Facts → Rules → Rationale → Impact → Trends, and aggregated official statements and expert opinions (with real names and source links); 4. Distinguish rules and timelines for newly established vs existing companies, and append a disclaimer at the end.

cases.description:
每次想把一件国宝讲清楚，最头疼的就是：文字一大堆、图没有重点、读者划两下就走。这个案例演示了如何用 tanyuan-relic-infographic-expert 把春秋时期镇国之宝「越王勾践剑」拆成一张可展陈、可传播的单文件 HTML 长图：从尺寸/铸造/铭文/暗格花纹/科学检测，到历史地位与流传，配探元知识库来源标注，开箱即展。

This case shows how the tanyuan-relic-infographic-expert turns the Spring and Autumn treasure 「Sword of Goujian」 into a single-file HTML infographic ready for exhibition and sharing: from dimensions / metallurgy / inscription / dark-pattern inlay / scientific tests to historical provenance, every fact attributed to the TanYuan knowledge base.

要求：

cases.description:
查一件大众名物，最怕两种结果：一是硬凑出一张全是「未知 / 暂无」的半张卡，二是查不到就直接把用户劝退。

这个案例演示的是 tanyuan-relic-lookup-expert 的第三条路：用户问「清明上河图」，结构化文物库确实没有独立条目——但知识库里有扎实的可核验记载。助手不硬凑卡片、也不生造字段：先以更短 query 重试结构化检索，确认未收录后转向知识库检索，把能确认的事实稳稳定定写出来——作者张择端（存世孤本）、年代北宋末年、绢本设色长卷（通行著录约 24.8 × 528.7 cm）、故宫博物院藏；再给出构图、内容、价值三条核心看点，以及卷首「插柳」民俗、明清仇英仿本等知识库佐证。

对无法从结构化字段确认的内容（精确尺寸、馆藏编号），案例在末尾明确标注「依据探元知识库文献与通行权威著录整理，若需精确到具体馆藏著录可进一步核查」——既交付可用信息，也讲清信息边界。

走法对应专家的降级路径：结构化库未收录 → 知识库佐证 + 权威著录。这条路径常被新手忽略，遇冷就直接劝退用户；资深用法是把它当作一次换路径的检索——用户更欣赏一个「能讲清讲了多少、讲不清也讲清为什么」的助手。

适合：博物馆社教老师讲案头查不到的大众名物、文物拍卖与媒体撰稿人快速核实、文博科普视频作者做脚本底稿、文博文创内容创作者。
cases.description_en:
Looking up a household-name artwork usually ends in one of two bad outcomes: a half-empty card padded with "unknown / N/A", or an outright dismissal when the first query misses.

This case demonstrates a third path. Asked about Along the River During the Qingming Festival, the structured relic database returns no standalone record — yet the knowledge base holds solid, verifiable material. The assistant neither pads the card nor invents fields: it retries the structured search with a shorter query, confirms the gap, then turns to the knowledge base and states what can be confirmed — Zhang Zeduan (sole surviving work), late Northern Song, handscroll in ink and colour on silk (canonically c. 24.8 x 528.7 cm), Palace Museum, Beijing — followed by three key observations on composition, content and value, plus knowledge-base evidence such as the willow-planting custom at the scroll's opening and the later Ming copies by Qiu Ying.

Where structured fields cannot confirm a value (exact dimensions, accession number), the case states so explicitly at the end: sourced from the knowledge base and canonical records, with further verification recommended for collection-specific data. It delivers usable information while being honest about its limits.

The workflow follows the expert's fallback path: structured miss, then knowledge-base evidence plus canonical records. Novices often abandon the lookup here; experienced users treat it as a route change.

Best for: museum educators handling famous objects absent from the catalogue, auction and media writers fact-checking quickly, heritage video authors drafting scripts, and cultural-creative content producers.

>
> <稳妥、准确的说明，可引用知识库检索片段>。
>
> 如果你能补充它的<年代 / 出土地 / 馆藏机构>等线索，我可以再帮你更准确地定位一次。
>
> 来源：腾讯探元知识库 + 公开资料

# 硬约束
- 不臆造：未在检索中确认的字段（具体尺寸、具体馆藏号、保护级别、入藏年份等）**不要编**。
- 不复述检索过程：禁用「检索为空」「接口未命中」「数据库没收录」等技术性失败措辞，改为「探元文物库中暂时没有收录到对应的藏品记录」这一统一表达。
- 不发散：清明上河图不是本专家速查范畴的典型对象，不要长篇展开历史背景，只给 2-4 句稳妥、可溯源的说明。
- 全程中文，统一以「腾讯探元知识库 + 公开资料」作为资料来源标识。

# 用户输入
清明上河图的基本信息
cases.prompt_en:
Use the tanyuan-relic-lookup-expert workflow to respond to the user's lookup request for 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival'.

# User question
Basic information about Along the River During the Qingming Festival

# Retrieval steps (execute in order)
1. Call `search_relics` once, query: "Basic information about Along the River During the Qingming Festival, please return relic name, era, holding museum, dimensions, cover". The hit rate may be empty.
2. If step 1 misses, do NOT show any error — retry with a shorter query: "Along the River During the Qingming Festival".
3. If still empty, call `search_movable_relics` once with query "Along the River During the Qingming Festival" to collect quotable fragments (e.g., 'painted by Zhang Zeduan in the Northern Song, now in the Palace Museum, Beijing', 'a Chinese treasure').
4. After multiple rounds still no structured fields, take **Level C** — see output rule below.

# Output Level C (not in TanYuan library → graceful answer, no forced card)
Template:
> About 「<user's question」, the TanYuan relic database has not yet recorded a matching entry. Based on public sources:
>
> <a steady, accurate description, possibly citing knowledge-base fragments>.
>
> If you can supplement <era / findspot / holding museum>, I can help you locate it more precisely.
>
> Source: Tencent TanYuan knowledge base + public sources

# Hard constraints
- No fabrication: fields unconfirmed in retrieval (specific dimensions, specific accession number, protection grade, accession year, etc.) MUST NOT be invented.
- No process narration: forbid technical failure phrases like 'retrieval empty', 'endpoint missed', 'database has no entry'; use only the unified expression 'the TanYuan relic database has not yet recorded a matching entry'.
- Stay in scope: Along the River During the Qingming Festival is not the typical object of this expert — do not deliver long historical background; only 2-4 steady, source-traceable sentences.
- Default Chinese; cite 'Tencent TanYuan knowledge base + public sources' as the source.

# User input
Basic information about Along the River During the Qingming Festival

cases.subtitle: 看不懂的报告有人陪你看：指标逐项解读 + 综合研判 + 下一步建议 + 对症医院医生推荐，一页讲清
cases.subtitle_en: Reports you can't read, walked through with you: item-by-item interpretation, overall assessment, next steps, and matching hospitals & doctors in one page
cases.description:
医疗报告是写给专业人士看的，可拿到它的却是普通人——满纸术语像一道门槛，把人挡在“自己身体状况”的门外。严不严重、怎么办、找谁看，这几个最朴素的问题，恰恰最难找到答案。

以一份乳腺病理报告为例：把报告交给微小医，它会陪你逐项读懂病理诊断、免疫组化指标和淋巴结情况，给出综合研判和下一步该怎么做的建议，还帮你推荐杭州真实的三甲医院和对症医生——生成一页图文解读，存图发给家人，一起商量着来。
cases.description_en:
Medical reports are written for professionals, yet they land in the hands of ordinary people — the wall of jargon becomes a barrier between you and your own health. The simplest questions — how serious is it, what do I do, whom do I see — are often the hardest to answer.

Take a breast pathology report as an example: hand it to Weixiaoyi, and it walks you through the diagnosis, immunohistochemistry markers and lymph node status one by one, gives an overall assessment with clear next steps, and recommends real top-tier hospitals and the right doctors in Hangzhou — all in a one-page interpretation you can save and share with family, so you can decide together.

"医疗蓝扁平卡片流"：纯白大圆角卡片，以 0.5px 细线代替阴影分隔，全部交互强调收敛到单一品牌蓝 #3f86ff 及其渐变/透明度变体，通过 PingFang SC 三档字重与四级灰阶建立信息层级，主次按钮（渐变实心 vs 浅蓝描边）形成清晰的操作引导优先级；2. 统一配内联的svg图标；3. 可交互按钮鼠标悬停时增加动效；4. 元素布局根据页面尺寸调整，以提高展示效果。
cases.prompt_en: Interpret this report for me, and based on the results, recommend suitable hospitals and doctors. Present the results as an HTML page. HTML features: 1. Any external link should support both direct click-through and a popup with a scannable QR code; 2. A fixed navigation bar that sits on top or on the side depending on page width, highlighting the current section and scrolling to the corresponding section on click; 3. The page content can be saved as a local image, with element visibility and layout optimized for sharing; 4. Data lists are limited to 5 items at most; 5. The header title and subtitle should convey that this page is a comprehensive health service, showing the brand name "Weixiaoyi" and its logo (https://kano.guahao.com/zj8979871203). HTML UI style: 1. Consistent inline SVG icons; 3. Hover animations on all interactive buttons; 4. Element layout adapts to page size for better presentation.

cases.description: AI 编程工具已成为开发者的主流基础设施，但它们究竟如何赚钱、竞争格局走向何方？本案由「风向标」趋势研究专家运用桌面研究与多源数据三角验证方法，系统拆解了 AI 代码助手赛道：从 85% 的开发者采用率、约 80 亿美元市场规模，到 GitHub Copilot、Cursor、Windsurf 三强的定位差异，再到订阅/席位/用量/模型差价的四层变现栈与单位经济挑战。交付一份风投 deck 风格的单文件 HTML 深度研究报告，含核心读数、市场增长曲线、竞争象限、变现拆解与趋势展望。适合产品经理、投资人、创业者与关注 AI 商业化的从业者。
cases.description_en: AI coding tools have become mainstream developer infrastructure, but how do they actually make money and where is competition heading? Using desk research and multi-source triangulation, the TrendResearcher expert dissects the AI code assistant market: from 85% developer adoption and an ~$8B market, to the positioning of GitHub Copilot, Cursor and Windsurf, and the four-layer monetization stack (subscription / seats / usage / model margin) and unit-economics challenges. Delivers a VC-deck-style single-file HTML deep-research report with key metrics, a market growth curve, a competitive quadrant, monetization breakdown and outlook. Ideal for product managers, investors, founders and anyone tracking AI commercialization.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一份关于 AI 编程工具赛道商业模式的深度研究报告，做成单文件 HTML，风投/产品分析 deck 风格（明亮现代 SaaS 商业风、靛蓝+翠绿强调、卡片化）。要覆盖：执行摘要核心结论、核心读数（开发者采用率、GitHub Copilot 用户与付费、Cursor 估值、市场规模）、市场增长曲线、竞争象限与玩家对比、变现模式拆解（订阅/企业席位/API用量/模型差价）、单位经济与挑战、SWOT 和趋势展望，关键数据要标注来源、页脚附完整来源清单，核心数据（采用率、Copilot/Cursor 用户与营收、市场规模等）须联网搜索真实公开来源并标注，仅在缺乏公开数据时对推算部分注明为估算。

Cover: an executive-summary conclusion, key metrics (developer adoption, GitHub Copilot users & paid, Cursor valuation, market size), a market growth curve, a competitive quadrant and player comparison, a monetization breakdown (subscription / enterprise seats / API usage / model margin), unit economics and challenges, SWOT and an outlook. cases.subtitle_en: A deep-research report on populations, threats, and transboundary conservation
cases.description: 全球最快的陆地动物正退出它曾经的疆域：野外仅存约 6,500 只、现存范围不足历史的 10%。本案由「深研研」专家以综合深度研究方法论，基于 IUCN 红色名录与 WWF（2024）真实数据，系统梳理猎豹的种群现状、历史下降趋势、三大威胁（人兽冲突/非法贸易/栖息地丧失）与跨境保护行动，交付一份图文并茂、来源可追溯的单文件 HTML 深度研究报告。适合野生动物保护研究者、科普内容创作者、环保 NGO 与关注生物多样性的读者。
cases.description_en: The fastest land animal is running out of range: only ~6,500 remain in the wild, across just 10% of its historical territory. Using a comprehensive deep-research methodology and real data from the IUCN Red List and WWF (2024), the expert 'Iris' synthesizes cheetah population status, the century-long decline, three major threats (human-wildlife conflict, illegal trade, habitat loss) and transboundary conservation action into a single-file, source-traceable HTML report. Ideal for wildlife researchers, science communicators, environmental NGOs, and biodiversity-minded readers.
cases.prompt: 我想要一份关于猎豹（Acinonyx jubatus）保护现状的深度研究报告，做成精美的单文件 HTML（CSS/JS 全内联，可离线打开）。请基于 IUCN 红色名录和 WWF 2024 的真实数据，包含：hero 大图标题、执行摘要、核心数据速览（野外约 6500 只 / IUCN 易危 / 仅存历史范围 10% / 亚洲亚种极危）、一张历史种群下降趋势的 SVG 折线图、三大威胁章节（人兽冲突、盗猎与非法贸易、栖息地丧失与碎片化）、历史 vs 现存范围对比、种群与繁育章节、保护行动与展望，以及页脚的完整来源清单。视觉走自然保护科考/野生动物纪录片风格，大地暖色调，关键数据正文标注来源。
cases.prompt_en: I want a deep-research report on the conservation status of the cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus), built as a polished single-file HTML (all CSS/JS inlined, works offline). Base it on real data from the IUCN Red List and WWF 2024, and include: a hero image with title, an executive summary, a key-stats overview (~6,500 in the wild / IUCN Vulnerable / only 10% of historical range / Asiatic subspecies Critically Endangered), an SVG line chart of the historical population decline, a three-threats section (human-wildlife conflict, poaching & illegal trade, habitat loss & fragmentation), a historical vs. current range comparison, a population & breeding section, conservation actions & outlook, and a full source list in the footer. Use a wildlife-documentary / field-research visual style with earthy warm tones, citing sources inline for key figures.

cases.description: 面对 GPT-5、Claude 4 Opus、Gemini 2.5 Pro 三大旗舰模型，团队该如何按场景选型？本案由「深研研」深度研究专家整合 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 官方数据与 AIbase 第三方评测，围绕编程、数学、多模态、长上下文与定价五大维度做事实交叉验证，产出一份暗色基准跑分台风格的单文件 HTML 深度研究报告：含执行摘要、关键发现卡、多基准分组柱状图、五维能力雷达、定价与长上下文对比及场景选型建议表，正文逐项标注来源、页脚附完整来源清单与研究局限。适合需要做模型选型决策的研发负责人、架构师与技术决策者。

cases.subtitle: 2024 回顾、2025/2030 展望与中欧美三大市场的结构性分化
cases.subtitle_en: 2024 Review, 2025/2030 Outlook, and the Structural Divergence of China, Europe and the US
cases.description: 全球电动化进程已跨过 20% 渗透率临界线，但增长并不均质——中国领跑、新兴市场起飞、美国掉队。本案由「风向标」专家运用趋势研究方法论，以 IEA《Global EV Outlook 2025》权威数据为底座，对 2024 年市场格局做了系统复盘，并对 2025/2030 进行情景展望，重点拆解中/欧/美三大市场的结构性分化、电池降价催生的平价拐点、新兴市场第二曲线、充电基建及石油替代效应。交付一份单文件 HTML 深度研究报告，含双轴趋势图、区域分组柱状对比图与完整来源清单。适合产品战略、投资研究、出海规划及行业分析人员参考。
cases.description_en: Global EV adoption has crossed the 20% penetration threshold, yet growth is far from uniform — China leads, emerging markets take off, and the US falls behind. Using the Trend Researcher methodology and grounded in the IEA Global EV Outlook 2025, this case systematically reviews the 2024 landscape and projects 2025/2030 scenarios, dissecting the structural divergence among China, Europe and the US, the price-parity tipping point driven by falling battery costs, the second growth curve in emerging markets, charging infrastructure, and oil-displacement effects. Delivers a single-file HTML deep-research report with a dual-axis trend chart, grouped regional bar comparison, and a full source list — ideal for product strategy, investment research and market-entry planning.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一份『全球电动汽车市场格局』的深度研究报告，单文件 HTML，清洁能源/绿色科技数据简报风格（明亮清新、电光青绿主色）。要基于 IEA Global EV Outlook 2025 的真实数据：2024 全球销量 1700 万辆+、占比首破 20%、同比 25%；中/欧/美三区域占比分化（中国近一半→2030 约 80%，欧洲 20%→58%，美国约 11%→20%）；新兴市场增长、电池降价与平价拐点、充电基建、2030 展望与每日替代 500 万桶石油。要有 executive summary、核心读数、全球销量与占比双轴趋势图（SVG，历史到 2030，标注里程碑）、中欧美三区域分组柱状对比图、风险分析和页脚完整来源清单。图表坐标轴要容纳最大值、刻度比例一致，无 emoji，界面中文。

Include an executive summary, headline readouts, a dual-axis trend chart of global sales and share (SVG, history through 2030 with milestone annotations), a grouped bar comparison of China/Europe/US, risk analysis, and a complete source list in the footer. Chart axes must accommodate maximums with consistent scales; no emoji; Chinese UI.

cases.description: 2025 年国际金价走出 1979 年以来最强年度行情，全年涨约 65%、年内逾 50 次刷新历史高位。本案由「严研行」行业研究专家运用行业全景与驱动因素拆解方法论，对这轮历史性牛市进行系统复盘：梳理台阶式价格走势、拆解降息/去美元化/避险三大驱动、剖析 5002 吨总需求的结构构成与央行连续三年超千吨购金，并给出 2026 年展望与下行风险边界。交付为单文件 HTML 深度研究报告，配真实数据引用与完整来源清单。适合需要快速建立金价逻辑框架的研究员、基金经理与财经内容创作者。
cases.description_en: In 2025 international gold prices delivered their strongest annual rally since 1979 — up about 65% with over 50 record highs. Using the Market Researcher methodology of sector landscape and driver decomposition, this case systematically reviews the historic bull run: the staircase price path, the three drivers (rate cuts, de-dollarization, safe-haven demand), the composition of 5,002 tonnes of total demand, three straight years of 1,000+ tonne central-bank buying, plus a 2026 outlook and downside-risk boundaries. Delivered as a single-file HTML deep-research report with cited real data and a full source list. For analysts, PMs, and finance content creators who need a fast, rigorous framework on gold.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一份关于 2025 年国际金价牛市的深度研究报告，要做成精美的单文件 HTML（CSS/JS 全部内联，可直接打开）。视觉走高端财经研报、黑金奢华质感。内容要包含：hero 大图标题、执行摘要、核心读数（全年涨约65%、盘中峰值约4549.96美元/盎司、全球需求5002吨、央行连续三年净购超千吨）、金价台阶式走势图（标注3月破3000、10月上4000、年底逼近4600这三个关键点位）、降息/去美元化/避险三大驱动因素章节、需求结构构成图（投资/央行/金饰/工业合计100%）、央行购金趋势对比柱状图、展望与风险，以及页脚完整数据来源清单（WGC、新华社、Bullionvault）。正文关键数据要标注来源。注意中国习惯涨红跌绿。
cases.prompt_en: Create a deep-research report on the 2025 international gold bull run as a polished single-file HTML (all CSS/JS inlined, opens directly in a browser). Use a high-end financial research, black-and-gold luxury aesthetic. Include: a hero image with title, an executive summary, core readings (about +65% for the year, intraday peak near $4,549.96/oz, global demand of 5,002 tonnes, central banks net-buying 1,000+ tonnes for three straight years), a staircase price chart marking the three key levels (breaking $3,000 in March, $4,000 in October, nearing $4,600 at year-end), a section on the three drivers (rate cuts / de-dollarization / safe-haven demand), a demand-composition chart (investment / central banks / jewelry / industrial summing to 100%), a central-bank purchase trend bar chart, an outlook and risks section, and a complete source list in the footer (WGC, Xinhua, Bullionvault). Cite sources next to key figures in the body. Follow the Chinese convention where up moves are shown in red.

cases.description:

Want a SaaS operations dashboard you can throw straight onto the big screen in a weekly review, but get stuck on "how do I build the charts, split the components, and fabricate self-consistent data"? This case has the EdgeOne Makers dev team build the whole thing for real.

In the demo, the team lead orchestrates a frontend specialist to build a full-screen dark-themed dashboard with Vite + React + Tailwind CSS: a top Hero showing the product name and data period; four KPI cards for DAU / MAU / paid conversion / MRR with MoM arrows; a 7-day active-user area chart, a traffic-channel donut chart, a 5-feature × 7-day usage heatmap, a day-1/3/7/30 retention funnel bar chart, and four operational insight cards with anomaly descriptions and suggested actions. Great for: frontend devs building dashboards/admin panels, indie hackers who need an ops dashboard for their product, engineers learning Recharts component breakdown, and product/growth folks preparing SaaS analytics demos.

cases.title: 三星堆面具与中原青铜器关联对比
cases.title_en: Sanxingdui Bronze Mask vs Central Plains Bronze Vessel Correlation
cases.subtitle: 同源异流:商代晚期古蜀与中原青铜器的工艺、造型与文化比较
cases.subtitle_en: Same Origin, Different Streams: A comparison of craft, form, and culture between late Shang Shu (Sanxingdui) and Central Plains bronzes
cases.description:
研究古蜀文明最头疼的,就是三星堆那些神性夸张的青铜面具跟前母戊鼎这种规整庄严的中原礼器到底有什么关系?研究文物又怕资料零散、工艺断章、文化关系缺乏交叉核验。

这个案例演示了如何借助腾讯探元文物库与知识库的并行检索,主代理亲自做三路 WebSearch 多源核验,覆盖工艺技法、造型特征、材质成分、文化内涵与历史交流脉络五个维度,最终交付包含配图与对比雷达图的 Markdown/HTML 双格式对比报告。

适合:商代考古与青铜器研究者、博物馆策展与社教人员、中华文明探源工程与三星堆研究爱好者、艺术史与古代工艺美术专业学生、文物爱好者与高端文旅讲解员。
cases.description_en: Researching the ancient Shu civilization usually stalls on one big question: how do the otherworldly Sanxingdui bronze masks actually relate to canonical Central Plains ritual bronzes like the Houmuwu Ding? Traditional digs into late Shang bronze work scatter sources, fragment craft notes, and rarely cross-check cultural-exchange evidence. This case demonstrates how to pair the Tencent Tanyuan relic and knowledge bases for parallel structured retrieval, then run three concurrent main-agent WebSearch passes for cross-verification across five dimensions—craftsmanship technique, form characteristics, material composition, cultural meaning, and historical-cultural exchange patterns—delivering a cross-checked comparison report with embedded images and a contrast radar chart in both Markdown and HTML.

artifacts.label: HTML 可视化报告(含对比雷达图)

cases.prompt:
请按「腾讯探元学术研究-关联研究」专家的工作流,关联对比「三星堆青铜面具」与「中原青铜礼器」在工艺、造型、文化层面的关系。

研究范围(覆盖五维):
- 工艺技法:陶范法/分铸-嵌铸/铸后补铸、合金配比(铜-锡-铅)、空心设计、装饰浮雕工艺
- 造型特征:人像vs兽面、纵目/凸眼柱/夔龙冠 vs 饕餮纹/夔龙纹/扉棱/云雷纹
- 材质成分:铜-锡-铅三元合金,有否添磷、空心铸件、四足热裂处理
- 文化内涵:神性夸张+祭祀崇拜(古蜀)vs 王权礼制+祖先沟通(商)
- 交流脉络:丝绸之路前的早期跨区域交流史,长江中下游文化间接影响

交付要求(强制):
1. 探元两库并行(知识库语义+文物数据库结构化) + 主代理 2-3 次 WebSearch 多源核验(对象 A/对象 B/文化背景)
2. 配图 ≥ 2 张,优先 Wikimedia / 官方博物馆公开图源;图表 ≥ 1 张(雷达图,SVG 渲染)
3. 报告:对比结构(对象 A 概述 → 对象 B 概述 → 逐维度对比 → 文化影响与交流 → 结论 → 证据与局限 → 参考来源 → 图片与图表来源)
4. 仅写「对比结论」,不含行动建议;参考文献只列网络公开来源;图表与图注嵌入对应章节;主要结论同步到对话窗口
cases.prompt_en:
Use the 'Tencent Tanyuan Academic Research - Correlation Research' expert workflow to comparatively research the relationship between 'Sanxingdui bronze masks' and 'Central Plains bronze ritual vessels' across craft, form, and culture.

Research scope (five dimensions):
- Craftsmanship: piece-mold casting, after-cast patching, alloy recipes (Cu-Sn-Pb), hollow casting, decorative relief
- Form: anthropomorphic vs zoomorphic faces, protruding eyes/peak-dragon crown vs taotie/kui dragon/flange/cloud-thunder patterns
- Material: Cu-Sn-Pb ternary alloy, optional phosphorus addition, hollow leg casting, four-foot thermal-crack mitigation
- Cultural meaning: spiritual-transcendent & sacrificial worship (Shu) vs royal-ritual & ancestral communication (Shang)
- Exchange: pre-Silk-Road trans-regional exchange, indirect Lower Yangtze influence

Delivery requirements (mandatory):
1. Parallel Tanyuan dual bases (knowledge base semantics + relic database structural) + 2-3 main-agent WebSearch passes (Object A / Object B / cultural context)
2. ≥ 2 images (Wikimedia / official museum public sources preferred); ≥ 1 chart (radar SVG)
3. Report structure: contrastive (Object A summary → Object B summary → per-dimension comparison → cultural exchange → conclusion → limits → references → image/chart sources)
4. Conclusions only, no recommendations; references limited to public web sources; charts/figures embedded in corresponding sections; key conclusions sync to chat window

cases.title: PBMC 免疫通讯图谱：LIANA 真实数据分析
cases.title_en: PBMC Immune Communication Atlas: LIANA Real-Data Analysis
cases.subtitle: pbmc68k_reduced · 10 类免疫细胞 · consensus 资源 · 抗原呈递主轴
cases.subtitle_en: pbmc68k_reduced · 10 immune cell types · consensus resource · antigen presentation axis
cases.description: 拿到一份 PBMC 10 类免疫细胞混合数据（10X v1，scanpy 内置 `pbmc68k_reduced`，FACS 排序真值），想知道这些细胞之间在「喊话」什么——谁是主要信号发送者，谁是接收者，抗原呈递轴怎么工作？本案例用 LIANA 框架（Python 版的 CellChat + NicheNet 综合体）在 omnipath consensus 资源上跑出 1288 个配体-受体互作：覆盖 6 阶段（数据加载 / 互作全景 / sender × receiver 热图 / 出度入度 / MHC-II 通路聚焦 / 配体表达点图）。最直观的发现是树突状细胞 HLA-DR → CD4 T 是这条数据集里最强的抗原呈递轴，出度 Dendritic 31、入度 CD4 Naive 16——这与 FACS 排序中 DC 富集、CD4 T 是其天然配对完全吻合。所有数字与图表来自真实 LIANA 执行，可复现。适合：做组织微环境通讯分析的研究者、想替代 CellChat 用 Python 单栈做 LR 配对分析、想理解「互作图谱怎么从单细胞里来」的初学者。
cases.description_en: You have a 10-class PBMC immune cell dataset (10X v1, bundled in scanpy as `pbmc68k_reduced`, with FACS-sorted ground truth) and want to know what these cells are saying to each other — who are the main signal senders, who receives, and how does the antigen presentation axis work? This case uses the LIANA framework (a Python combination of CellChat + NicheNet) on the omnipath consensus resource and produces 1288 ligand-receptor interactions across 6 stages: data load / global interaction landscape / sender × receiver heatmap / out-degree and in-degree / MHC-II pathway focus / ligand expression dotplot. The most striking finding: dendritic-cell HLA-DR → CD4 T is the strongest antigen presentation axis in this dataset, with Dendritic out-degree 31 and CD4 Naive in-degree 16 — matching the FACS-sorted cell type abundances. All numbers and figures from real LIANA execution. Suitable for tissue microenvironment communication analysis, switching from CellChat R to a Python single-stack LR analysis, and learners who want to understand how interaction maps emerge from single-cell data.

cases.prompt:
你是一位资深单细胞转录组分析专家，习惯在 Python（scanpy）与 R（Seurat）两栈之间无缝切换。请严格按下面指令一次性产出最终文档，不要询问补充问题。

# 任务
构建一份名为《scRNA-seq 9 阶段实战手册》的中文 HTML 文档，作为可复跑、可对照、可讲解的完整流水线演示。

# 输入（合成数据，可复现）
请用代码生成一份合成 PBMC 数据，模拟下面规格：
- 3,000 cells × ~10,000 expressed genes（用稀疏高斯过程模拟 8 个细胞类型的真实 marker 表达模式）
- 2 个技术批次（b1/b2，约 6:4 比例），批次 2 在 5 个基因上有 ~15% 的均值偏移
- 加入合理的线粒体基因比例分布（大多数细胞 <10%，少量到 30%）
- 加入细胞周期相关基因作为可选评分依据

# 输出
单文件 HTML：output.html，要求自包含（所有 CSS 内联、11 张结果图全部用 base64 data URI 内嵌、无任何外部资源引用、内容默认可见、不使用 hash 锚点导航），单文件可移植、可离线打开。

# 9 阶段结构（每节固定格式）
每节必须按以下五段式呈现，缺一不可：

## 阶段 N · <阶段名>
1. 简短引言（2-3 句，说明目标 + 关键决策点）
2. Python 代码（scanpy）：可直接运行的代码块，每步加行内注释；代码后给出关键维度变化（如过滤后 cell 数、cluster 数、HVG 数、PC 数等）
3. 等价 R 提示（Seurat/其他）：给出对应 R 版本的 1-3 行核心函数路径（如 Seurat::NormalizeData()），不要复写完整 R 代码，仅用注释标识等效步骤
4. 核心结果（数值表）：用表格写本阶段拿到的结果数值，包括关键维度变化（cells/genes/HVG/clusters）、选用参数（min_genes、n_top_genes、n_pcs、resolution 等）、关键阈值（线粒体比例 cutoff、doublet score 阈值等）
5. 结果图：用 matplotlib 生成 PNG，base64 内嵌到 HTML；下方写图注说明怎么读、主要发现

# 9 个阶段必须覆盖
1. 数据读入 —— 合成数据生成 + AnnData/Seurat 对象构造 + 关键检查
2. 质控 (QC) —— 计算 nFeature/nCount/pct.mt，过滤前后数值 + QC violin 图
3. 标准化 + HVG + PCA —— normalize、log1p、HVG 数 + PCA elbow 图
4. 聚类 + UMAP —— Leiden/Louvain、resolution 探索 + UMAP-cluster 着色
5. 自动 + 手工注释 —— 用 CellTypist 风格规则/已知 marker 列表分配 8 个 cell types + Marker 点图 + z-score 热图
6. 批次整合 —— Harmony 整合前后对比（计算一个混合度指标，如 kBET 或 iLISI）+ 整合前后 UMAP 对比
7. 差异分析 (DE) —— 选一个 cluster vs rest，输出 top markers + 火山图
8. 拟时序 —— Monocle3/PAGA 选根节点 + Pseudotime UMAP
9. 细胞通讯 —— CellChat 跑全部配体-受体对，统计每个 cell type 的入度/出度 + CellChat chord/network 图

# 必须嵌入的 11 张图
1. QC 指标分布 violin（nFeature, nCount, pct.mt 三联图）
2. PCA elbow（解释方差 vs PC 编号）
3. UMAP 按 cluster 着色
4. UMAP 按 cell type 注释着色
5. Marker dotplot（gene × cluster，size=pct, color=mean）
6. Marker heatmap（top 5 marker per cluster 的 z-score 热图）
7. 批次整合前后 UMAP 对比（左 raw，右 Harmony）
8. 差异基因火山图（log2FC vs -log10 p-value，关键基因高亮）
9. 拟时序 UMAP（按伪时间着色 + 根节点标记）
10. CellChat 出度/入度条形图
11. CellChat 网络图（点 + 边，或 chord diagram）

# 风格与排版
- 中文输出；每张代码块前写一句「这一步在做什么」的指引
- 表格里写真实能拿到的结果数字，而不是模板填空
- 每张图注 1-2 句，告诉读者怎么读、主要发现
- 末尾必须有「前置条件清单」：通讯需先有可靠注释、聚类分辨率探索、整合需 batch 列等

# 不要做的事
- 不留 TODO 或占位符；不输出多轮对话引导
- 不留任何外链引用，所有图必须 base64 内嵌
- 不使用 emoji 作为章节符号；不写「完整代码见附录」等偷懒话

# 完成判定
完成后回报：1) 文件路径 2) 文件大小 3) 嵌入图数量 4) 9 个阶段小节数。
cases.prompt_en:
You are a senior single-cell transcriptomics expert fluent in both Python (scanpy) and R (Seurat). Follow the instructions below to produce the final document in one pass, without asking follow-up questions.

# Task
Build a Chinese-language HTML document titled "scRNA-seq 9-Stage Practical Handbook" — a reproducible, cross-referenced, presentable full-pipeline demo.

# Input (synthetic data, reproducible)
Generate a synthetic PBMC dataset in code with these specs:
- 3,000 cells × ~10,000 expressed genes (sparse Gaussian process simulating realistic marker expression of 8 cell types)
- 2 technical batches (b1/b2, ~6:4 ratio); batch 2 has a ~15% mean shift on 5 genes
- A reasonable mitochondrial gene ratio distribution (most cells <10%, a few up to 30%)
- Cell-cycle genes included as optional scoring basis

# Output
Single-file HTML: output.html — self-contained (all CSS inlined, all 11 result figures embedded as base64 data URIs, no external resource references, content visible by default, no hash-anchor navigation), portable and openable offline.

# 9-stage structure (fixed per-section format, all five parts required)

## Stage N · <name>
1. Brief intro (2-3 sentences: goal + key decision points)
2. Python code (scanpy): runnable code blocks with inline comments; report key dimension changes after the code (post-filter cell count, cluster count, HVG count, PC count, etc.)
3. Equivalent R hints (Seurat/others): 1-3 lines of core function paths (e.g. Seurat::NormalizeData()); do not rewrite full R code, just annotate equivalent steps
4. Core results (numeric table): real numbers from this stage — key dimension changes (cells/genes/HVG/clusters), chosen parameters (min_genes, n_top_genes, n_pcs, resolution, etc.), key thresholds (mitochondrial ratio cutoff, doublet score threshold, etc.)
5. Result figure: matplotlib PNG embedded as base64; caption below explaining how to read it and the main finding

# The 9 stages must cover
1. Data loading — synthetic data generation + AnnData/Seurat object construction + key checks
2. QC — compute nFeature/nCount/pct.mt, pre/post-filter numbers + QC violin plot
3. Normalization + HVG + PCA — normalize, log1p, HVG count + PCA elbow plot
4. Clustering + UMAP — Leiden/Louvain, resolution exploration + UMAP colored by cluster
5. Auto + manual annotation — CellTypist-style rules/known marker lists to assign 8 cell types + marker dotplot + z-score heatmap
6. Batch integration — Harmony before/after comparison (compute a mixing metric such as kBET or iLISI) + before/after UMAP comparison
7. Differential analysis (DE) — one cluster vs rest, top markers + volcano plot
8. Pseudotime — Monocle3/PAGA root selection + pseudotime UMAP
9. Cell communication — CellChat over all ligand-receptor pairs, per-cell-type in/out degree + CellChat chord/network figure

# The 11 required figures
1. QC metric violins (nFeature, nCount, pct.mt triplet) 2. PCA elbow (variance explained vs PC number) 3. UMAP colored by cluster 4. UMAP colored by cell-type annotation 5. Marker dotplot (gene × cluster, size=pct, color=mean) 6. Marker heatmap (z-score of top 5 markers per cluster) 7. Before/after batch-integration UMAP (left raw, right Harmony) 8. DEG volcano plot (log2FC vs -log10 p-value, key genes highlighted) 9. Pseudotime UMAP (colored by pseudotime + root marked) 10. CellChat out/in degree bar chart 11. CellChat network figure (nodes + edges, or chord diagram)

# Style and layout
- Chinese output; one line of "what this step does" before each code block
- Tables must contain real obtainable result numbers, not template placeholders
- Each figure caption 1-2 sentences: how to read it, main finding
- The document must end with a "prerequisites checklist": communication requires reliable annotation, clustering resolution exploration, integration requires a batch column, etc.

# Do not
- Leave TODOs or placeholders; produce multi-turn dialogue prompts
- Leave any external link references; all figures must be base64-embedded
- Use emoji as section symbols; write lazy lines like "full code in appendix"

# Completion criteria
When done, report: 1) file path 2) file size 3) number of embedded figures 4) number of the 9 stage sections.

cases.description: 手头有一份真实的骨髓单细胞数据（Paul 等 2015 造血分化，scanpy 内置 `paul15`，2730 细胞 × 3451 基因，FACS 排序真值），想回答：分化顺序与分叉点是什么？每个谱系（Erythroid / Granulocyte / Monocyte / Megakaryocyte）的速率驱动基因？scVelo 速率方向与 PAGA/DPT 是否一致？本案例用 PAGA 粗粒度图谱揭示簇 7（MEP 区）作为中枢节点向 4-5 个分支辐射；用 DPT 扩散伪时间给每个细胞一个 0-1 的时间排序；用基于 DPT 合成的 spliced/unspliced（unspliced 沿 DPT 前移 0.05 dt）跑 scVelo stochastic 模型，速率流场从 UMAP 中心向外辐射——与 PAGA 拓扑完全吻合；按谱系 top 8 速率基因展示 Ccl5、Id2、S100A8/A9 等。**注意**：paul15 原始数据无 RNA 剪接计数，本案例为演示 velocity 流程基于 DPT 合成演示数据，真实分析应先用 velocyto/STARsolo 从 BAM 重建。6 张图全部内嵌。适合：做分化/发育轨迹的研究者、PAGA 与 DPT 想从入门到上手、学习 scVelo 速度分析的初学者。
cases.description_en: You have a real myeloid single-cell dataset (Paul et al. 2015, bundled in scanpy as `paul15`, 2730 cells × 3451 genes, FACS-sorted ground truth) and want to know: what's the differentiation order and branching point? What are the velocity-driven genes for each lineage (Erythroid / Granulocyte / Monocyte / Megakaryocyte)? Do scVelo velocity directions agree with PAGA/DPT? This case uses PAGA coarse-grained graphs to reveal cluster 7 (MEP region) as a central hub radiating to 4-5 branches, computes DPT diffusion pseudotime for every cell, runs scVelo stochastic on DPT-synthesized spliced/unspliced (unspliced shifted forward 0.05 dt) yielding a velocity stream that radiates from the UMAP center — perfectly matching the PAGA topology — and displays top-8 velocity genes per lineage (Ccl5, Id2, S100A8/A9, etc). **Note**: paul15 has no splice counts; this case synthesizes demo data based on DPT to demonstrate velocity flow — for real analysis, generate spliced/unspliced from velocyto/STARsolo first. All 6 figures embedded. Suitable for differentiation/development researchers, PAGA/DPT learners, scVelo beginners.

cases.prompt:
你是一位资深单细胞轨迹与 RNA 速率分析专家，熟练 PAGA / DPT / scVelo 全套工具链。请严格按下面指令一次性产出最终文档，不要询问补充问题。

# 任务
构建一份名为《paul15 骨髓分化轨迹与 RNA 速率实战》的中文 HTML 文档，作为可复跑、可对照的分化轨迹演示。

# 输入（真实数据，scanpy 内置，可一键加载）
使用 `sc.datasets.paul15()`：2730 细胞 × 3451 基因，原始 counts，带 19 个 FACS 排序真值 `paul15_clusters`（如 `1Ery`、`7MEP`、`9GMP`）。**不直接用这 19 个原簇**——重做 Leiden（resolution=1.0 → 12 个新簇），并把 19 个原簇按 lineage 缩写归为 5 大谱系大类 + Other（Erythroid / Granulocyte / Monocyte / Megakaryocyte / Dendritic 加上未匹配的 `Ba / CD4+/CD8+ T / NK / ILC / pDC` 等归入 Other）。

# 输出
单文件 HTML：output.html，自包含（6 张图全部 base64 data URI 内嵌、无外部资源、内容默认可见、不使用 hash 锚点）。

# 6 阶段结构（每节五段式：引言 + Python 代码 + R 等效 + 数值表 + 图注）

# 6 阶段必须覆盖
1. 加载 paul15 + 简化 lineage 标签（5 谱系 + Other） + 标准化 + HVG(1500) + PCA(50)
2. neighbors + UMAP + Leiden(1.0) + 谱系多数投票映射 + 双联图（leiden/lineage）
3. PAGA：`sc.tl.paga(groups='leiden')` + `sc.pl.paga(layout='fr', threshold=0.05)`，展示簇 7 作为中枢节点
4. diffmap(15) + 选 Erythroid 区根节点 + `sc.tl.dpt(n_dcs=10)` + DPT UMAP
5. 与 DPT 相关 top 24 基因（正负各 12）→ 50 个 DPT 分箱的 z-score 热图
6. **基于 DPT 合成 spliced/unspliced**：spliced = 沿 DPT 移动平均平滑 + 噪声；unspliced = spliced 沿 DPT 前移 0.05 dt + 噪声。`scv.pp.filter_and_normalize` → `sc.pp.neighbors` → `scv.pp.moments` → `scv.tl.velocity(stochastic)` → `scv.tl.velocity_graph` → `scv.pl.velocity_embedding_stream`
7. 按谱系 top 8 速率基因水平条形图（4 谱系 × 8 基因）

# 必须嵌入的 6 张图
1. UMAP 双联（leiden / lineage）
2. PAGA 粗粒度连通性图（force-directed layout）
3. DPT UMAP（紫到黄） + 红圈根节点
4. 24 基因 z-score 热图（含 r 值标注）
5. scVelo 速率流场 stream plot（按谱系着色）
6. 4 谱系 × top 8 速率基因水平条形图

# 关键说明（必须出现）
- paul15 原始数据无 RNA 剪接计数，本案例合成 spliced/unspliced 用于演示 velocity 流程
- 真实分析应先用 velocyto/STARsolo 从 BAM 重建剪接计数后从 .loom 导入
- 提供 PAGA vs Monocle3 vs Slingshot 对比表
cases.prompt_en:
You are a senior single-cell trajectory and RNA velocity analysis expert proficient in the PAGA / DPT / scVelo toolchain. Produce the final document in one pass without asking follow-up questions.

# Task
Build a Chinese HTML document titled 'paul15 Myeloid Differentiation Trajectory & RNA Velocity' as a reproducible, comparable differentiation trajectory demo.

# Input (real data, bundled in scanpy)
Use `sc.datasets.paul15()`: 2730 cells × 3451 genes, raw counts, with 19 FACS-sorted labels in `paul15_clusters` (e.g. `1Ery`, `7MEP`, `9GMP`). **Do not use the 19 original clusters directly** — re-run Leiden (resolution=1.0 → 12 new clusters) and map the 19 original clusters by lineage abbreviation to 6 broad categories (Erythroid / Granulocyte / Monocyte / Megakaryocyte / Dendritic / Lymphoid).

# Output
Single-file HTML: output.html, self-contained (6 figures embedded as base64 data URIs, no external resources, content visible by default, no hash anchors).

# 6-stage structure (fixed per-section 5-part format)

# Stages to cover
1. Load paul15 + simplified lineage labels + normalize + HVG(1500) + PCA(50)
2. neighbors + UMAP + Leiden(1.0) + lineage majority vote mapping + double-plot (leiden/lineage)
3. PAGA: `sc.tl.paga(groups='leiden')` + `sc.pl.paga(layout='fr', threshold=0.05)`, show cluster 7 as central hub
4. diffmap(15) + select Erythroid-region root cell + `sc.tl.dpt(n_dcs=10)` + DPT UMAP
5. Top 24 DPT-correlated genes (12 positive + 12 negative) → 50 DPT bins z-score heatmap
6. **Synthesize spliced/unspliced from DPT**: spliced = DPT moving-average smooth + noise; unspliced = spliced shifted forward 0.05 dt in DPT + noise. `scv.pp.filter_and_normalize` → `sc.pp.neighbors` → `scv.pp.moments` → `scv.tl.velocity(stochastic)` → `scv.tl.velocity_graph` → `scv.pl.velocity_embedding_stream`
7. Top 8 velocity genes per lineage horizontal bar chart (4 lineages × 8 genes)

# Required 6 figures
1. UMAP double-plot (leiden / lineage)
2. PAGA coarse-grained connectivity graph (force-directed layout)
3. DPT UMAP (purple to yellow) + red circle root cell
4. 24-gene z-score heatmap (with r values annotated)
5. scVelo velocity stream plot (colored by lineage)
6. 4 lineages × top 8 velocity gene horizontal bar chart

# Required key notes
- paul15 has no RNA splice counts; this case synthesizes spliced/unspliced for velocity demo only
- For real analysis, generate spliced/unspliced from velocyto/STARsolo first then import from .loom
- Include a PAGA vs Monocle3 vs Slingshot comparison table

cases.description_en:

Data lives in a Library structured table — every add, edit, or delete writes back in real time, so desktop and mobile always show the same thing.

Best for: creators who want to publish consistently, side-hustlers running an account alongside a PhD or a day job, operators managing multi-platform publishing cadences, and anyone who wants a lightweight personal CMS.

cases.subtitle_en: Input target keyword, AI delivers a complete report on search volume, competition, long-tail keywords and content strategy
cases.description:
做跨境电商独立站，想靠内容获取自然流量，可光是关键词调研就让人头大——搜索量在哪查、竞争度怎么判断、长尾词怎么挖、选题怎么定？手动整理一次至少半天，还不一定准。

这个案例演示了输入目标关键词「跨境电商独立站」，AI 一站式产出完整的 SEO 关键词调研报告：核心关键词搜索量估算与竞争度分析、20 个长尾关键词挖掘（含搜索意图分类）、关键词难度评级（高/中/低）、10 个基于关键词的文章标题建议、竞品排名前 5 页面分析摘要、关键词布局策略建议。报告 3000 字以上，结构化 Markdown 格式，直接指导后续内容生产。

适合：跨境电商运营、独立站站长、SEO 专员、内容营销团队、数字营销从业者。
cases.description_en:
Running a cross-border e-commerce DTC site and want organic traffic through content, but keyword research alone is overwhelming — where to check search volume, how to judge competition, how to mine long-tail keywords, how to pick topics? Manual research takes at least half a day and may still be inaccurate.

This case demonstrates inputting the target keyword 'cross-border e-commerce DTC site' and having AI produce a complete SEO keyword research report: core keyword search volume estimation and competition analysis, 20 long-tail keywords with search intent classification, keyword difficulty ratings (high/medium/low), 10 keyword-based article title suggestions, top-5 competitor page analysis summary, and keyword placement strategy recommendations. The report is 3000+ words in structured Markdown, directly guiding subsequent content production.

Ideal for: Cross-border e-commerce operators, DTC site owners, SEO specialists, content marketing teams, digital marketing professionals.

artifacts.label: SEO关键词调研报告

cases.prompt: 帮我做一份 SEO 关键词调研报告，目标关键词是「跨境电商独立站」。要求包含：核心关键词搜索量估算与竞争度分析、20 个长尾关键词挖掘（含搜索意图分类）、关键词难度评级（高/中/低）、内容选题建议（10 个基于关键词的文章标题）、竞品排名前 5 的页面分析摘要、关键词布局策略建议。输出为结构化 Markdown 报告，3000 字以上。
cases.prompt_en: Help me produce an SEO keyword research report, with the target keyword being "cross-border e-commerce independent stores (DTC sites)." Requirements: estimate the search volume and analyze the competitiveness of the core keyword, mine 20 long-tail keywords (with search-intent classification), rate keyword difficulty (high/medium/low), provide content topic suggestions (10 article titles based on keywords), a summary analysis of the top 5 ranking competitor pages, and keyword layout strategy recommendations. Output a structured Markdown report, 3,000+ words.

cases.title: 唐代金银器与拜占庭工艺关联研究
cases.title_en: Tang Gold-Silver Ware vs Byzantine Craftsmanship
cases.subtitle: 何家村窖藏 vs 东罗马鎏金银盘:锤鍱与鎏金在丝绸之路两端的两种命运
cases.subtitle_en: Hejiacun Hoard vs East Roman Gilt-Silver Plate: two destinies of hammering and gilding along the Silk Road
cases.description:
唐代那么繁盛的金银器跟地中海那边的拜占庭有什么关系?是不是简单照搬?研究丝路金银器又怕断章:粟特、波斯萨珊、拜占庭各有贡献,常被混淆。

这个案例演示了如何借助腾讯探元文物库与知识库的并行检索,主代理亲自做三路 WebSearch 多源核验(对象 A 唐代金银器、对象 B 拜占庭鎏金银盘、丝绸之路双向交流脉络),覆盖工艺技法、造型特征、材质成分、文化内涵与历史交流五个维度,最终交付包含配图与对比雷达图的 Markdown/HTML 双格式对比报告。

适合:丝绸之路与中外文化交流研究者、唐代金银器与博物馆学专业者、拜占庭艺术史研究者、中西物质文明交流史爱好者、文物爱好者与高端文旅讲解员、艺术史与考古专业学生。
cases.description_en: How does the glorious Tang gold-silver ware actually relate to Byzantine Mediterranean craft? Was it a simple copy or a complex dialogue? Studying Silk Road metalwork easily fragments sources, conflating Sogdian, Sasanian Persian, and Byzantine contributions into a single 'Western' stream. This case demonstrates how to pair Tencent Tanyuan relic and knowledge bases for parallel retrieval, plus three concurrent main-agent WebSearch passes (Object A Tang metalwork, Object B Byzantine gilt plate, bidirectional Silk Road exchange), covering five dimensions—craft, form, material, cultural meaning, and historical exchange—delivering a cross-checked comparison report with embedded images and a contrast radar chart in Markdown and HTML formats.

artifacts.label: HTML 可视化报告(含对比雷达图)

cases.prompt:
请按「腾讯探元学术研究-关联研究」专家的工作流,关联对比「唐代金银器(以何家村窖藏鎏金舞马衔杯纹银壶为代表)」与「拜占庭鎏金银器(以甘肃省博物馆藏东罗马鎏金银盘为代表)」在工艺与文化层面的关系。

研究范围(覆盖五维):
- 工艺技法:锤揲(捶揲)+錾刻+鎏金基础工艺组合;萨珊凸纹装饰 vs 拜占庭高浮雕传统;粟特带把杯、波斯萨珊立鸟纹/联珠纹、拜占庭高足杯对唐代影响
- 造型特征:扁圆皮囊壶/八棱带把杯/高足杯 vs 圆形高浮雕大盘/圈足/卷唇/斜弧壁
- 材质成分:薄胎银+局部鎏金 vs 高纯度银胎+整体鎏金;盘心高浮雕模压镶嵌
- 文化内涵:皇室祭祀/舞马祝寿/装饰奢华 vs 高等级收藏/外交礼品/贸易货币
- 交流脉络:丝绸之路北道要隘(靖远)、萨珊-粟特-拜占庭-唐的多向互动、双向输出(唐→日本正仓院)

交付要求(强制):
1. 探元两库并行 + 主代理 2-3 次 WebSearch 多源核验
2. 配图 ≥ 2 张(鎏金舞马衔杯纹银壶 + 东罗马鎏金银盘),公开图源(故宫敦煌特展/陕历博/陕西传媒网);图表 ≥ 1 张(雷达图 SVG)
3. 报告结构:对比结构(对象 A 概述 → 对象 B 概述 → 逐维度对比 → 丝路双向交流 → 结论 → 证据与局限 → 参考来源 → 图片与图表来源)
4. 仅写"对比结论",不含建议;参考文献只列网络公开来源;主要结论同步到对话窗口
cases.prompt_en:
Use the 'Tencent Tanyuan Academic Research - Correlation Research' expert workflow to comparatively research the relationship between 'Tang gold-silver ware (Hejiacun hoard gilded silver ewer with dancing horse as representative)' and 'Byzantine gilt-silver ware (East Roman gilt-silver plate at Gansu Provincial Museum as representative)' across craft and culture.

Research scope (five dimensions):
- Craft: hammering-repoussé + chasing + gilding; Sasanian relief vs Byzantine high-relief traditions; Sogdian handled cups, Sasanian standing-bird/pearl-roundel motifs, Byzantine stemmed cups and their impact on Tang metalwork
- Form: flat-round leather-bag ewer / eight-lobed handled cup / stemmed cup vs round high-relief plate / ring foot / rolled rim / slanted wall
- Material: thin silver body + partial gilding vs high-purity silver + overall gilding; center-disk repoussé inlay
- Cultural meaning: royal ritual / dancing-horse birthday banquet / decorative luxury vs high-grade collection / diplomatic gift / trade currency
- Exchange: Northern Silk Road corridor (Jingyuan ferry), Sasanian-Sogdian-Byzantine-Tang multi-directional interaction, two-way transmission (Tang→Shōsōin Japan)

Delivery requirements (mandatory):
1. Parallel Tanyuan dual bases + 2-3 main-agent WebSearch passes for cross-source verification
2. ≥ 2 images (gilded dancing-horse ewer + Byzantine gilt plate), public sources (Palace Museum Dunhuang Special Exhibition / Shaanxi History Museum / Shaanxi Media); ≥ 1 chart (radar SVG)
3. Report structure: contrastive (Object A summary → Object B summary → per-dimension → Silk Road exchange → conclusion → limits → references → image/chart sources)
4. Conclusions only, no recommendations; references limited to public web sources; key conclusions sync to chat window
