cases.title: AI Page 项目双周报 · PREP
cases.subtitle: 用 PREP 观点回环把双周报做成 5 屏给完结论的可交互 HTML
cases.subtitle_en: Turn a bi-weekly report into a 5-screen interactive HTML using PREP
cases.description:
写周报最难的不是写——是「怎么让 Leader 30 秒就读完」。

这个案例基于腾讯文档「智能页面」（Smart Page）技能，用 PREP 观点回环（Point-Reason-Example-Point）+ 腾讯蔚蓝皮肤，把一份 AI Page 项目双周报做成单文件可交互 HTML。首屏左右分栏：左 P 大字结论（本期评价 + 下期重点），右 R 三条原因卡片。中段 4 个关键数字滚动到视口自动从 0 累加，下面接 5 条核心成果时间线 + 3 条外部声音引述。再往下是下一步行动卡片，owner / ETA 一目了然。最后红/黄卡片明确标出 3 条风险（含 mitigation） + 3 条求助清单（含 urgency）。整体不超过 5 屏，PREP 的灵魂就是短。

适合：
- 每周/双周需要写周报、月报的产品经理 / 项目经理 / Tech Lead
- 跨部门协作汇报、轻量同步周会、月度复盘
- 受够 PPT 翻 5 页才看到结论、想要首屏给结论的同学
- 希望让汇报有可读性、有数据、有求助、有跟进项的人
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of writing a weekly report is not writing — it is getting your leader to read it in 30 seconds.

This case is built on Tencent Docs Smart Page. Using the PREP loop (Point-Reason-Example-Point) + Tencent Blue skin, an AI Page bi-weekly report is assembled into a single-file interactive HTML. The first fold splits left/right: a big-typography Point on the left (this period's verdict + next focus), three Reason cards on the right. Mid-section: 4 key metrics that count up from 0 on scroll, followed by a 5-item achievement timeline and 3 external voice quotes. Then a Next-Steps card grid showing owner & ETA. Finally red/amber cards explicitly marking 3 risks (with mitigations) and 3 asks (with urgency). The whole report stays under 5 screens — brevity is the soul of PREP.

Best for:
- PMs, project managers, and tech leads writing weekly / bi-weekly / monthly reports
- Cross-team sync, lightweight weekly stand-ups, monthly retrospectives
- People sick of flipping 5 PPT pages before seeing the conclusion
- Anyone who wants their reports to be readable, data-backed, with explicit asks and follow-ups

artifacts.label: AI Page 项目双周报（可交互 HTML）

cases.prompt:
请使用「腾讯文档智能页面 · Smart Page」技能，帮我生成一份项目双周报的可交互 HTML 汇报网页。

参数：
- 场景：sync（周期同步 / 双周报）
- 叙事范式：prep（PREP 观点回环：Point-Reason-Example-Point）
- 皮肤：tencent-blue（腾讯蔚蓝，司内汇报默认）
- 受众：直属 Leader + 协作团队

内容框架（5 屏 PREP 回环，每屏自成结论）：
1. P · 一句话结论：本期整体评价 + 下期重点
2. R · 1-3 条原因

cases.description: 做空间转录组分析最头疼的是流程割裂：上游投递在 DCS 平台、下游分析换 Stereopy、细胞分割又得学 Spateo，网上没有一份把 7 个场景串起来的中文手册。这个案例生成一份覆盖 SAW-ST-V8 上游主分析、Stereopy 标准下游、多样本整合（Harmony）、Spateo 细胞分割、连续切片 3D 重建、CCI 细胞通讯、SCC 结构数字化 7 大场景的完整手册：每个场景都有目标说明、可运行代码、产出文件清单、结果图和解读要点，11 张图全部内嵌，单文件自包含可直接当团队培训材料。适合：Stereo-seq 平台用户、空间组学方向研究生、搭建空间转录组 SOP 的团队、DCS 云平台任务投递者。
cases.description_en: Spatial transcriptomics workflows are painfully fragmented: upstream submission on the DCS platform, downstream analysis in Stereopy, cell segmentation in yet another tool (Spateo) — and no single Chinese handbook ties the seven scenarios together. This case generates a complete handbook covering SAW-ST-V8 upstream analysis, standard Stereopy downstream, multi-sample integration (Harmony), Spateo cell segmentation, serial-section 3D reconstruction, CCI cell communication, and SCC structural digitization. Every scenario includes goal, runnable code, output file list, a result figure, and interpretation points — 11 figures all embedded in one self-contained file ready for team training. Suitable for: Stereo-seq platform users, spatial-omics graduate students, teams building spatial transcriptomics SOPs, and DCS cloud task submitters.

cases.prompt:
你是 Stereo-seq 空间转录组分析专家。请生成一份以分析结果为核心的自包含 Playbook 手册：

要求：
1. 覆盖 7 个场景：SAW-ST-V8 上游主分析、Stereopy 标准下游（GEF → 聚类注释）、多样本整合（MSData + Harmony）、Spateo 细胞分割、连续切片 3D 重建、CCI 细胞通讯、SCC 结构数字化。
2. 每个场景必须包含：分析目标、完整可运行的 Python/dcs-cli 代码（带注释）、产出文件清单（含文件名和用途）、代表性结果图、关键解读要点。
3. 用 matplotlib 预先生成 11 张代表性结果图（QC 小提琴、空间聚类散点、UMAP、marker 热图、批次混色对比、时间序列空间演变、细胞分割三联图、3D 重建渲染、CCI 网络圆圈图、SCC 层梯度、SAW 流水线流程图）。
4. 将所有图片以 base64 data URI 内联嵌入，产出单文件自包含报告（无外链）。
5. 末尾附避坑清单和图表文件索引。

约束：
- 输出单文件 HTML（output.html）：所有 CSS 内联、图片 base64 内嵌、无任何外部资源引用、内容默认可见、不使用 hash 锚点导航；所有代码基于此前 9 个 skill 实测验证的真实 API 编写，不要虚构函数签名。
- 中文版，代码标识符保持英文生态惯例。
- 文档可直接作为团队培训手册使用。
cases.prompt_en:
You are a Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics analysis expert. Generate a result-oriented, self-contained playbook handbook:

Requirements:
1. Cover 7 scenarios: SAW-ST-V8 upstream analysis, standard Stereopy downstream (GEF → clustering and annotation), multi-sample integration (MSData + Harmony), Spateo cell segmentation, serial-section 3D reconstruction, CCI cell communication, and SCC structural digitization.
2. Each scenario must include: analysis goal, complete runnable Python/dcs-cli code (commented), output file list (filenames and purposes), a representative result figure, and key interpretation points.
3. Pre-generate 11 representative result figures with matplotlib (QC violin, spatial clustering scatter, UMAP, marker heatmap, batch mixing comparison, time-series spatial evolution, cell segmentation triplet, 3D reconstruction render, CCI network circle plot, SCC layer gradient, SAW pipeline diagram).
4. Inline all figures as base64 data URIs and produce a single-file self-contained report (no external links).
5. Append a pitfall checklist and a figure file index at the end.

Constraints:
- Output a single-file HTML (output.html): all CSS inlined, figures base64-embedded, no external resource references, content visible by default, no hash-anchor navigation; all code must be based on real APIs verified by the previous 9 skills — do not fabricate function signatures.
- Chinese language; code identifiers follow English ecosystem conventions.
- The document must be usable directly as team training material.

cases.description:
想看懂一只股票，往往要在行情软件、财报、研报、资金流之间反复切换，数据散、口径乱，还容易凭记忆记错数字。

cases.description_en:
Understanding a single stock usually means jumping between the quote app, filings, research notes and money flow — data is scattered, definitions vary, and it's easy to misremember numbers.

This case uses NeoData Financial Search to run real queries on Kweichow Moutai (600519.SH) — live quote, valuation percentiles, three-year financials, today's capital flow, analyst ratings and recent events — and compiles them into one high-density, professionally laid-out single-file HTML deep-dive card: verdict first, with quote/valuation/fundamentals/flow/analysts/events sections, red-up-green-down, built-in bilingual text, all resources inlined for offline use.

Good for: retail investors who want to grasp a stock fast; researchers/analysts producing single-stock snapshot cards; developers automating research workflows; finance content creators covering A-share leaders; learners studying financial data querying and visualization.
cases.prompt:
用 NeoData 金融搜索服务，帮我为贵州茅台(600519.SH)做一张个股基本面深挖卡片，产物是一个单文件 HTML。

请务必先通过 NeoData 官方脚本真实查询以下数据，全部取最新值，不要凭记忆或编造，也不要混用其他数据源：
1. 实时行情：最新价、涨跌幅、开盘/最高/最低、成交量与成交额、换手率、总市值；
2. 估值：PE、PB、股息率，以及历史分位；
3. 最新财报关键指标：营业收入、归母净利润及同比增速、毛利率、净利率、ROE、每股收益；
4. 今日主力资金流向与净流入；
5. 近期券商评级与盈利预测（目标价、买入/增持占比、未来几年 EPS 与增速预测）；
6. 近期重大事件：分红送配、股份回购、提价等。

把每条查询回包里的关键数字与结论提炼出来，标注数据时间，然后汇总成一张信息密度高、排版专业的深挖卡片。

结构建议：结论先行 → 行情快照 → 估值水位 → 基本面财报表 → 资金流向 → 机构观点/评级 → 事件追踪 → 复现查询清单 → 口径与风险提示。

每次做方向选择都想找人问问，但身边的人要么不懂要么只会说「分散投资」。这个案例演示了炒股搭子圆桌专家如何处理「AI vs 新能源」这道年度选择题：先查实时行情（AI板块 PE 66.7倍/3年分位89.8%，新能源 PE 48.8倍），再从产业趋势、估值定价、资金信号三个维度展开真实分歧——星仔认为 AI 景气度碾压是今年第一顺位，文仔算出储能 PEG 0.8 比 AI 性价比更高，洲仔则提示4月22日地缘窗口前任何方向都要打折扣。最终不给单一结论，而是三条操作路线图供你按自己偏好选择。

适合：在 AI 和新能源之间纠结选择的投资者、想听到真实分歧而非统一口径的股民、需要量化依据支撑方向判断的散户。
cases.description_en:
When it's time to pick a sector, you want real debate — not vague "diversify" advice. This case shows how the Stock Roundtable expert handles the classic AI vs. New Energy dilemma: starting with live data (AI sector PE 66.7x at 89.8% 3-year percentile; New Energy PE 48.8x), then surfacing genuine disagreements across three lenses. Xingzai sees AI momentum as the year's clear leader; Wenzai calculates that energy storage's PEG of 0.8 beats AI on value; Zhouzai flags the April 22 geopolitical window as the biggest variable overriding any sector call. The output isn't a single verdict — it's three decision paths mapped to your personal priorities.

Ideal for: investors torn between AI and New Energy, stock pickers who want genuine disagreement instead of consensus takes, and retail traders who need quantitative anchors before committing to a direction.

artifacts.label: AI vs 新能源圆桌讨论分析报告

cases.prompt:
我在 AI 和新能源之间做方向选择，请帮我组织一场圆桌讨论。

背景：投资期限约 6-12 个月；关注 A 股 AI 算力产业链 vs 新能源；纠结哪个方向风险回报比更好。

请按炒股搭子圆桌流程：
1. 先查今日实时行情（大盘 + 两个板块的 PE 与涨幅）
2. 查宏观背景，判断有无系统性风险
3. 安排星仔（趋势派）、文仔（估值派）、洲仔（信号派）并行分析后汇总
4. 明确点出成员间的核心分歧
5. 给出三条差异化操作路线图：激进看多 AI / 保守配置新能源 / 观望等待信号

要求：每个数字都要有实时数据出处，不要「综合来看」式的空泛结论；三条路线之间差异要足够大，让我感受到真实分歧。
cases.prompt_en:
I'm choosing a direction between AI and new energy — please help me organize a roundtable discussion.

Background: investment horizon about 6-12 months; sectors of interest are the A-share AI computing-power supply chain vs. new energy; I'm unsure which offers the better risk/reward.

Please follow the stock-buddy roundtable process:
1. First look up today's live market data (the broad index + PE and change for both sectors)
2. Check the macro backdrop and judge whether there's any systemic risk
3. Bring in Xingzai (trend school), Wenzai (valuation school), and Zhouzai (signal school) to analyze in parallel, then summarize
4. Clearly point out the core disagreements among members
5. Provide three differentiated action roadmaps: aggressively bullish on AI / conservative new-energy focus / wait-and-watch for signals

Requirements: every number must cite a live data source; no hand-wavy "all things considered" conclusions; the three roadmaps must differ enough that I can feel the real disagreement.

cases.subtitle_en: Fundamentals, valuation, and contrarian experts debate — from screening to position building
cases.description:
想用PE和ROE筛好公司，但筛出来不知道谁更值得买？腾讯PE 18倍看着不贵，但又怕高位站岗。这个案例演示了炒股搭子圆桌如何处理这类先筛再评的问题：先按PE<20+ROE>15%+市值>500亿筛出美的、福耀、格力等标的，再让钊仔逐个验证基本面（格力PE 6.4是低估还是陷阱？），文仔横向对比PEG（福耀0.65 vs 腾讯1.1谁更值？），坤仔给腾讯的支撑位分批建仓计划（514→476→414→359，每个价位都有K线依据）。最终三条路线图：重仓腾讯的/选性价比的/等趋势确认的。

适合：想用财务指标筛股但不会进一步评判的投资者、纠结腾讯该不该买的港股股民、需要分批建仓具体计划的人。
cases.description_en:
You can screen stocks with PE and ROE, but then what? Tencent looks cheap at 18x PE, but is it a trap? This case shows how the Stock Roundtable handles the classic screen-then-evaluate workflow: first filter for PE<20 + ROE>15% + market cap>CNY 50B to find Midea, Fuyao, Gree, etc., then have Zhaozai verify fundamentals (Gree at 6.4x PE — undervalued or value trap?), Wenzai compare PEG across picks (Fuyao 0.65 vs Tencent 1.1), and Kunzai lay out a support-driven scaling plan for Tencent (514→476→414→359 HKD, each level anchored to chart support). Three decision paths: go heavy on Tencent / pick best value / wait for trend confirmation.

Ideal for: investors who screen by financials but can't judge what to buy, Hong Kong stock pickers torn on Tencent, and anyone needing a concrete scaling plan with price levels.

artifacts.label: PE<20+ROE>15%选股与腾讯分析

cases.prompt:
帮我筛选 PE 低于 20、ROE 大于 15%、市值超 500 亿的股票（A股+港股），然后重点分析腾讯现在能不能买。

腾讯关注点：当前约 18 倍 PE、22% ROE，想知道是否偏贵、与筛出的其他公司性价比如何、若买怎么分批建仓。

请安排三位成员并行分析：
1. 钊仔（基本面派）：验证每家公司基本面，重点拆解腾讯财报、业务与管理层
2. 文仔（估值派）：横向对比 PEG / PE 分位，给出便宜到贵的排序与核心+卫星仓位建议
3. 坤仔（逆向派）：给腾讯一份支撑位驱动的分批建仓计划

要求：每个数字都要有实时数据出处，结论具体可执行。
cases.prompt_en:
Help me screen for stocks with PE below 20, ROE above 15%, and market cap over CNY 50 billion (A-shares + Hong Kong stocks), then focus on whether Tencent can be bought now.

Tencent focus: currently about 18x PE and 22% ROE; I want to know whether it's expensive, how its value-for-money compares to the other screened companies, and how to scale into a position if buying.

Please arrange three members to analyze in parallel:
1. Zhaozai (fundamentals school): verify each company's fundamentals, with a deep breakdown of Tencent's financials, business, and management
2. Wenzai (valuation school): compare PEG / PE percentiles, give a cheapest-to-most-expensive ranking, and recommend core + satellite position sizing
3. Kunzai (contrarian school): give Tencent a support-level-driven scaling-in plan

Requirement: every number must have a real-time data source, and conclusions must be specific and actionable.

五个模块：
1. 首页控制台：今天要处理、已收录方向、适合我的方向、正在尝试、本周任务和关联资料表；
2. 兼职雷达：机会情报卡与方向库同页展示，支持关键词、类型、收入、时间投入、远程程度等筛选，能把一条情报收录为自建方向，也能新增、删除、横向比较方向；

cases.description:
几乎每个人都有过这样的时刻：身体突然不舒服，说不上大病却又不踏实——要不要紧？扛一扛还是去趟医院？真要去，又不知从哪一科挂起。这个“拿不准”的空档，往往最熬人。

cases.description_en:
Almost everyone has had this moment: something feels off with your body — not quite an emergency, but not nothing either. Should you tough it out or see a doctor? And if you go, where do you even start? That stretch of uncertainty is often the hardest part.

Take a headache as an example: describe your symptom to Weixiaoyi, and it offers caring relief tips, likely-cause self-checks and red-flag warnings, tells you which department to register with, and recommends real hospitals and specialists — one page to read, and you can head to the doctor with peace of mind.

"Medical-blue flat card flow": pure white cards with large border radius, 0.5px hairlines instead of shadows for separation, all interactive emphasis confined to a single brand blue #3f86ff and its gradient/opacity variants, information hierarchy built on three font weights of PingFang SC and four grayscale levels, with primary vs. secondary buttons (solid gradient vs. light-blue outline) forming a clear action priority; 2. cases.title: 唐代与日本奈良佛像艺术风格对比
cases.title_en: Tang vs Nara Buddhist Sculpture Artistic Style Comparison
cases.subtitle: 盛唐彩塑与奈良干漆夹纻:跨海造像艺术的本真传承与本土再创造
cases.subtitle_en: High-Tang painted sculpture vs Nara dry-lacquer: authentic transmission and indigenous re-creation of Buddhist art across the East China Sea
cases.description:
讲起唐代佛像大家都能想象敦煌彩塑,但跟日本奈良佛像到底什么关系?是简单照搬还是有更深的本地化再创造?对比两座佛像又怕断章取义、漏掉干漆夹纻等关键工艺差异。

这个案例演示了如何借助腾讯探元文物库与知识库的并行检索,主代理亲自做三路 WebSearch 多源核验(对象 A 唐代造像、对象 B 奈良佛像、中日佛教艺术交流脉络),覆盖工艺技法、造型特征、材质成分、文化内涵与历史交流五个维度,最终交付包含配图与对比雷达图的 Markdown/HTML 双格式对比报告。

适合:佛教艺术史研究者、敦煌学与丝绸之路文化研究者、唐代社会与文化爱好者、奈良时代东亚文化交流研究者、博物馆策展与文博教育人员、艺术院校佛教美术专业学生。
cases.description_en: Talking about Tang Buddhist sculpture most people picture Dunhuang painted statues, but how do they actually relate to Nara-period Japanese works? Are Nara sculptures simple knockoffs or do they carry deeper indigenous re-creation? Comparing two iconic traditions often fragments sources, misses key craft differences like dry-lacquer (干漆夹纻) hollow-body technique, and overlooks the cross-cultural exchange network. This case shows how to use Tencent Tanyuan relic and knowledge bases for parallel retrieval, plus three concurrent main-agent WebSearch passes (Object A Tang sculpture, Object B Nara sculpture, Sino-Japanese Buddhist art exchange), covering five dimensions—craftsmanship, form, material, cultural meaning, and historical exchange—delivering a cross-checked comparison report with embedded images and a contrast radar chart in Markdown and HTML formats.

artifacts.label: HTML 可视化报告(含对比雷达图)

cases.prompt:
请按「腾讯探元学术研究-关联研究」专家的工作流,关联对比「唐代佛像(以敦煌莫高窟盛唐彩塑为代表)」与「日本奈良佛像(以唐招提寺鉴真和尚坐像为代表)」在艺术风格层面的关系。

研究范围(覆盖五维):
- 工艺技法:泥塑/木骨泥塑 vs 干漆夹纻(活脱干漆)/木雕,鎏金、敷彩、贴金箔等装饰工艺
- 造型特征:面相丰满/菩萨世俗化 vs 写实肖像/精神化塑造,衣纹处理、身躯比例
- 材质成分:木-苇草-泥-矿物颜料 vs 苎麻-生漆,以及两地原料来源
- 文化内涵:世俗化圆满/丰腴神性 vs 写实人格/肖像化精神,以及中日审美差异
- 交流脉络:遣唐使学问僧(最澄、空海)、鉴真东渡(公元754年)、中日文化输出的双向性

交付要求(强制):
1. 探元两库并行 + 主代理 2-3 次 WebSearch 多源核验
2. 配图 ≥ 2 张(敦煌莫高窟代表彩塑 + 唐招提寺鉴真像),优先 Wikimedia / 公开博物馆图源;图表 ≥ 1 张(雷达图 SVG)
3. 报告结构:对比结构(对象 A 概述 → 对象 B 概述 → 逐维度对比 → 中日交流脉络 → 结论 → 证据与局限 → 参考来源 → 图片与图表来源)
4. 仅写「对比结论」,不含建议;参考文献只列网络公开来源;主要结论同步到对话窗口
cases.prompt_en:
Use the 'Tencent Tanyuan Academic Research - Correlation Research' expert workflow to comparatively research the artistic-style relationship between 'Tang Buddhist sculpture (Dunhuang Mogao high-Tang painted sculpture as representative)' and 'Nara-period Japanese Buddhist sculpture (Tōshōdai-ji Jianzhen portrait as representative)'.

Research scope (five dimensions):
- Craft: clay sculpture / wood-boned clay vs dry-lacquer (活脱干漆) / wood carving; gilding, polychromy, gold-leaf application
- Form: full-faced / secularized bodhisattvas vs realistic portrait / spiritualized expression; drapery handling, body proportions
- Material: wood-reed-clay-mineral pigments vs ramie-raw lacquer, with raw material sources on both sides
- Cultural meaning: secularized fullness / corporeal divinity vs realistic persona / portrait spirituality, plus Sino-Japanese aesthetic divergence
- Exchange: Kentōshi monk-students (Saichō, Kūkai), Jianzhen's eastward voyage (754 CE), bidirectional nature of cultural transmission

Delivery requirements (mandatory):
1. Parallel Tanyuan dual bases + 2-3 main-agent WebSearch passes for cross-source verification
2. ≥ 2 images (Dunhuang Mogao + Tōshōdai-ji Jianzhen), Wikimedia / public museum sources preferred; ≥ 1 chart (radar SVG)
3. Report structure: contrastive (Object A summary → Object B summary → per-dimension → Sino-Japanese exchange → conclusion → limits → references → image/chart sources)
4. Conclusions only, no recommendations; references limited to public web sources; key conclusions sync to chat window

请基于我上传的文创品图，设计一张 A6 竖版印刷明信片，比例 111:154，风格为「当代文物研究档案 × 克制古画印刷 × 精品皮具编辑设计」。
主体必须完整保留上传包的真实身份特征：马鞍包轮廓、绿色马鞍形翻盖、翻盖上的立体马纹、浅黄皮革包身、棕色皮革包边与肩带、绿色褶皱前袋、金属扣环、车线、皮革纹理和原有比例。不要改造包的结构，不要替换材质，不要把它变成真实古董或普通时装广告。
构图采用“宽而圆的现代文创品研究式排版”：包作为前景主视觉，放在画面中下部，约占画面 50%–60%，保持完整清晰、真实皮革质感和综合色彩；上方、左右与底部留出充足呼吸空间。背景为暖米白手工纸，带非常细腻的纸纤维、轻微旧印刷颗粒和低对比灰褐线条。
从包本身提取研究性辅助图形，而非加入泛化国风背景：将翻盖上的马纹转化为左上角的细线描马匹图；将金属扣、车线、褶皱皮革口袋和马鞍弧线转化为右上局部圆形放大图、底部局部结构线稿、虚线缝线轨迹和弧形构造线。所有辅助图形必须来源于包的可见结构，像产品档案或设计研究稿，保持很浅的灰褐色，不抢主体。
色彩体系：暖米白纸色、低饱和灰褐线描、雾青绿与浅灰蓝的大面积半透明几何色块；保留包本身的绿色、浅黄、棕色与黄铜色。仅在角落加入一个很小的砖红色印章点睛，面积不超过画面 2%。整体安静、雅致、现代，不要高饱和。
排版只使用极少量英文信息：左侧小号高对比衬线体 “OBJECT STUDY” 与编号 “01”；若文字无法清晰呈现，宁可省略文字。不要加入中文标题、品牌名、年代、地点或任何未经提供的历史信息。
避免：山水、宫殿、古建筑、人物、市集、花卉、龙凤、祥云、灯笼、旅游纪念品风、金箔、厚重国潮、复杂边框、镜面产品摄影、3D 渲染感、过重噪点、水印、乱码。最终输出为清晰的 A6 竖版 PNG。

cases.title: 青铜器兽面纹的起源与精神象征
cases.title_en: Origin and Symbolism of the Bronze Beast-Face Motif
cases.subtitle: 从史前图像→二里头铜牌→商周礼器，追踪兽面纹（旧称「饕餮纹」）的演化线索与多重解释
cases.subtitle_en: Trace the 3000-year evolution from Liangzhu jades to Shang-Zhou ritual bronzes, and decode its 'theocracy-to-kingship' symbolism
cases.description:
博物馆里青铜鼎上的两只大眼睛常常让人发怵——很多人想知道那到底是什么、有没有具体含义。

关于名称：正文与封面所说的「饕餮纹」是沿用已久的旧称，「兽面纹」是现代考古与博物馆展陈中更常用的称呼，两者指的是同一类以中轴展开、突出双目的正面兽首纹样；案例正文已专门说明这一称谓差异。

这个案例演示了腾讯探元文博知识问答专家如何回答历史溯源问题——它从史前兽面图像、二里头镶嵌铜牌讲到商周青铜礼器，同时明确区分“可观察的图像联系”和“尚未证实的直接传承”。全文以镶嵌绿松石兽面纹铜牌饰、商代兽面纹铜斝两件真实文物配图，分层呈现动物综合、祭祀信仰与权力表达等解释，并用正文 [1][2][3][4] 对应文末来源。

适合：博物馆与考古专业学生；青铜器收藏与研究者；做博物馆深度讲解的志愿者；对纹饰学、纹样发展史感兴趣的设计与艺术史学习者；做'5·18 国际博物馆日'、'文化遗产日'主题推文的公众号编辑。
cases.description_en:
The two huge eyes on a Shang dynasty bronze ding can be unnerving — many visitors want to know what's behind the motif.

This case shows how the Tencent TanYuan cultural-heritage Q&A expert answers a 'historical origin' question — it traces the full evolutionary chain of the beast-face motif (formerly called 'taotie'): from Liangzhu jades (ca. 3300-2300 BCE), to Erlitou pottery of the Xia, to Shang dynasty bronze ritual vessels, to the Western Zhou. Each stage's visual features and symbolic meaning are spelled out, and the answer makes clear that the motif is an idealised composite of multiple animals (ox, tiger, dragon variants), and that its use shifted from natural-spirit worship to a symbol of kingship. Two real artefacts anchor the narrative: the inlaid turquoise beast-face bronze plaque from Erlitou (Yanshi), and the Shang dynasty 'beast-face li' at the Anhui Museum.

Best for: Museum studies and archaeology students; bronze collectors and researchers; volunteer docents who do in-depth tours; design and art-history students interested in ornamental patterns; WeChat editors preparing 'International Museum Day (18 May)' or 'Cultural Heritage Day' themed posts.

artifacts.label: 完整问答报告（起源链+实物对照+精神象征+来源）

cases.prompt:
请回答：青铜器上的兽面纹（旧称饕餮纹）到底是什么？它最早出现在什么时候？后来为什么会变成商周礼器的'主流纹饰'？

要求：
1. **结论先行**：一两句话讲清——兽面纹是商周青铜礼器的重要纹饰，可能综合多种动物特征；其含义存在多种解释，不能把“政治符号”或“良渚直接起源”写成唯一结论
2. **完整溯源链**：分四段展开并明确证据强弱：
   - **史前背景**：良渚等文化的兽面图像可作为参照，但与商周纹饰的直接传承仍有争议
   - **过渡期**：二里头文化镶嵌绿松石兽面纹铜牌饰显示兽面图像已与青铜、镶嵌工艺及礼仪场景发生联系
   - **鼎盛期**：商代兽面纹成为青铜礼器的重要主纹，并与地纹、器形共同组织
   - **转折期**：西周以后逐步简化、几何化，并转化为后世装饰母题
3. **两种主流学术观点**：明确写出'多源综合说（主流）'和'自然神崇拜说'两条解释路线，承认学界至今无完全定论
4. **精神象征三层**：早期=氏族图腾/自然神；商代=政教合一视觉统治工具；西周以后=秩序化、神秘感退场
5. **实物对照**：至少使用 2 个已核实的真实锚点，其中包括二里头镶嵌绿松石兽面纹铜牌饰和一件商代兽面纹青铜礼器
6. **名字溯源**：解释“饕餮纹”和“兽面纹”两种名称为何并见，避免写成学界已完全统一
7. **学界争议和待考**：明确点出图像来源、具体动物原型和精神象征均未形成唯一结论，不添加与主题无关的铸造争议
8. **图文与引用**：至少加入 2 张真实文物图；正文只用 [1][2][3] 标注事实或观点，不要反复写“来源于某知识库”；文末统一列明题名、机构、完整 URL 与图片出处
9. **数据要可溯源**：每个时间点都对应可核验的考古时间框架，不确定处明确写“尚有争议”

风格：能给一个对青铜器一无所知的人讲清楚 3000 年的演化路径；不要用过程叙述词；末尾给一条'下次类似问题'作为延伸钩子。
cases.prompt_en:
Please answer: What exactly is the beast-face motif (formerly 'taotie') on Chinese bronzes? When does it first appear? Why did it become the dominant motif on Shang-Zhou ritual vessels?

Requirements:
1. **Conclusion first**: Lead with the three verifications — it is an idealised composite of multiple animals (essentially a political symbol); it is not a real headless monster; its origins can be traced back to Liangzhu jades.
2. **Full origin chain**: Four clearly delineated stages, each anchored to widely accepted archaeological dates:
   - **Proto-motif phase**: Liangzhu jades (ca. 3300-2300 BCE) + Longshan-culture eggshell black pottery / stone moulds — technical rehearsal.
   - **Transition phase**: Xia-dynasty Erlitou (Taosi, ca. 1900 BCE) + the inlaid turquoise beast-face bronze plaque from Erlitou (Yanshi) — the earliest bronze instance.
   - **Apex phase**: Shang — from 'independent / connected beast-face' two types → mid-Shang two-tier patterns → late Yinxu three-tier patterns.
   - **Turning point**: Western Zhou onward — simpler, more ordered, less terrifying.
3. **Two mainstream scholarly views**: Spell out clearly 'multi-animal composite (mainstream)' and 'natural-spirit worship' — and acknowledge the lack of a complete consensus.
4. **Three symbolic layers**: Early = clan totem / natural-spirit worship; Shang = theocratic-political visual tool; Western Zhou onward = rationalised, mystery recedes.
5. **Real artefact anchors**: At least three — the inlaid turquoise beast-face bronze plaque from Erlitou (Yanshi); the Shang dynasty 'beast-face li' at the Anhui Museum (from the Funan Yueyahe discovery); the 'beast-face bronze yan' at the Anhui Huizhou History Museum.
6. **Name etymology**: Why the ancients called it 'taotie', why modern archaeology renamed it 'beast-face', and the horn-shape sub-types (outward-curled, inward-curled, zigzag-horned, double-dragon-horned, sheep-horned, ox-horned, variant).
7. **Open questions**: Make clear that 'whether the motif depicts any real animal' is still debated; for details without consensus (e.g. 'cast-in ear vs. one-piece casting'), explicitly say further research is needed.
8. **Sources**: 'Tencent TanYuan knowledge base' by topic + 'Public sources' with URLs; different views should be separately attributed.
9. **Traceable data**: Every date should match an archaeological consensus timeframe (e.g. 'Liangzhu culture, ca. 3300-2300 BCE').

Style: Make a 3000-year evolutionary path understandable to someone who knows nothing about bronzes. No process narration. End with one 'next time, try asking' hook.

cases.title: 金缮工艺到底是什么——与锔瓷有什么不同
cases.title_en: What Kintsugi Really Is — and How It Differs from Juci Riveting
cases.subtitle: 瓷器的'碎裂伤疤'怎么变成'金色艺术'——原理、工序、与锔瓷的本质区别
cases.subtitle_en: How a broken porcelain scar becomes gold-traced art — principles, process, and why kintsugi differs from 'juci' (riveting)
cases.description:
看到一件用金色线条'勾'出裂痕的瓷器，很多人只觉得漂亮，却说不出它的工序与美学。

本案例的主线是对比：封面取「金缮与锔瓷 · 有何不同」这一角度，正文也按此展开——先拆解金缮拼接、补缺、描线、饰金的完整流程，再与锔瓷（钻孔加金属锔钉的机械连接）逐项对照，并区分传统金缮与现代「金缮风格」修补。

这个案例演示了腾讯探元文博知识问答专家如何回答传统工艺问题——它会拆解拼接、补缺、描线、饰金的完整流程，再与锔瓷对比，并区分传统金缮和现代'金缮风格'修补。全文选用东京国立博物馆与 Cooper Hewitt 馆藏实物配图，用正文 [1][2][3] 对应文末来源。

适合：博物馆讲解员与非遗传承研究者；陶艺与漆艺爱好者；瓷器收藏家与工艺品买家；对'残缺美'感兴趣的设计师、文创从业者；想为自己破损的瓷器找修复方案的实用用户。
cases.description_en:
Many people see a porcelain bowl traced with gold along its crack and only register 'pretty', without knowing the technique behind it.

This case shows how the Tencent TanYuan cultural-heritage Q&A expert answers a 'traditional craft' question — first explaining the two key steps (lacquer bonding → gold application), then contrasting kintsugi with 'juci' (riveting-repair), and finally tracing the aesthetic back to the Japanese wabi-sabi philosophy. The full answer references a real artefact (a Southern Song 'black-body water dropper' at the Longquan Celadon Museum that has been kintsugi-repaired) and closes with a pragmatic checklist for anyone considering commissioning a kintsugi repair — to avoid being misled by cheap 'machine kintsugi'.

Best for: Museum docents and intangible-heritage researchers; ceramics and lacquerware enthusiasts; porcelain collectors and craft buyers; designers / cultural-product creators interested in 'the beauty of imperfection'; end-users looking for a trustworthy way to repair a broken heirloom piece.

artifacts.label: 完整问答报告（工序+对照+美学溯源+实用提醒+来源）

cases.prompt:
请回答：金缮工艺到底是什么？它与锔瓷工艺有什么本质区别？

要求：
1. **结论先行**：第一段一两句话讲清'金缮是用大漆粘合、贴金装饰的瓷器修补工艺'，并强调它的本质不是'修好瓷器'而是'让残缺可视化为美'
2. **两道关键工序**：把粘合（大漆常温固化）和装饰（描线+贴金）讲透，说明大漆固化的环境要求
3. **与锔瓷对比**：用表格或对照段落讲清两种工艺的核心差异（锔瓷=金属钉加固实用性、金缮=漆粘+贴金艺术性）。明确'现代修复中两者常常结合使用'
4. **美学溯源**：从日本侘寂（wabi-sabi）理念讲起——侘=朴素质朴、寂=时间痕迹——说明金缮为何重视残缺
5. **现代延伸**：讲清金缮已从'修复工艺'演变为'当代陶瓷创作语言'，举例说明
6. **真实文物对照**：使用权属清晰的博物馆馆藏金缮实物，不得编造馆藏或修复记录
7. **实用提醒**：天然漆固化条件、技艺门槛、修复材料与修复师甄别建议
8. **图文与引用**：至少加入 2 张真实实物图；正文只用 [1][2][3] 标注对应事实，不要反复写“来源于某知识库”；文末统一列明题名、机构、完整 URL 与图片授权
9. **面向人群**：文博爱好者、文创设计师、瓷器收藏者、收藏破损瓷器的家庭用户都能读懂

风格：不要用'我检索了两次''系统返回'这类过程语；专业术语第一次出现时用一句话解释（生漆、侘寂）；末尾给一条'下次类似问题'作为延伸钩子。
cases.prompt_en:
Please answer: What is kintsugi, and how does it fundamentally differ from 'juci' (riveting-repair)?

Requirements:
1. **Conclusion first**: Open with a one- or two-sentence verdict — kintsugi bonds the pieces back with urushi lacquer and traces the crack with gold; its essence is not 'fixing the porcelain' but 'making the imperfection visible as art'.
2. **The two key steps**: Explain bonding (urushi cures at room temperature; the curing chamber) and decoration (lacquer line tracing + gold application). Include the environmental requirements for urushi curing.
3. **Kintsugi vs juci**: Use a table or parallel paragraph to spell out the core difference — juci = metal-rivet reinforcement for utility; kintsugi = lacquer bond + gold trace for artistry. Make clear the two are often combined in modern repair.
4. **Aesthetic origin**: Trace back to Japanese wabi-sabi — wabi = quiet simplicity; sabi = the patina of time — and explain why kintsugi values imperfection.
5. **Modern extension**: Note that kintsugi has evolved from a 'repair technique' into a 'contemporary ceramic creative language', with an example.
6. **Real artefact reference**: Anchor on a real object — the Southern Song 'black-body water dropper' at the Longquan Celadon Museum, which was kintsugi-repaired.
7. **Pragmatic checklist**: Curing-environment requirements, skill thresholds, advice for choosing a real kintsugi artisan vs cheap 'machine kintsugi'.
8. **Sources**: Separately label 'Tencent TanYuan knowledge base' (topic only) and 'Public sources' (must carry clickable URLs).
9. **Audience**: Accessible to museum enthusiasts, cultural-product designers, porcelain collectors, and households with a broken heirloom piece.

Style: No process narration like 'I retrieved twice' or 'the system returned'. Explain every technical term the first time it appears (urushi, wabi-sabi). End with one 'next time, try asking' hook.

cases.description:
这个案例按既定设计规范制作成化斗彩鸡缸杯典藏明信片：外层双回纹边框与四角回纹角花，右侧竖排标题与年代小竖框，红色朱文印章、竖排英文名与竖排馆藏年代信息分列两侧，底部为馆藏实拍杯体。

关于命名：产物与封面统一为「典藏明信片 / COLLECTOR POSTCARD」，由腾讯探元典藏海报专家产出，与「典藏海报」同属一套典藏视觉，区别只在成品用途与尺寸。

执行要点：文物主体只用故宫博物院馆藏实拍，仅做背景分离与等比缩放，器形、斗彩纹饰与子母鸡雏均保持原貌；生图工具用于生成宣纸质感与团花、祥云底纹，不参与文物绘制；所有中文由字体排版并逐字核对，避免生成错字。

适合：故宫与瓷器主题社教文创、明清瓷器爱好者、典藏类自媒体、文博文创产品经理、设计系文化创意方向学生。
cases.description_en: A collectible postcard produced to the established design system: double fret border with corner ornaments, vertical title with a boxed reign mark, vermilion seals, vertical English name and collection details, and an unretouched museum photograph of the cup. Image generation is used only for the paper texture and medallion ground; all Chinese text is typeset and proofread.

artifacts.label: 成化斗彩鸡缸杯典藏明信片

cases.prompt:
你是「腾讯探元典藏海报专家」，按既定设计规范制作「成化斗彩鸡缸杯」竖版典藏明信片。

## 一、事实检索
并行检索探元文物库与知识库，核对名称、年代、馆藏、尺寸（高 3.4cm、口径 8.3cm、足径 3.7cm）、斗彩工艺与子母鸡雏纹饰。缺失或冲突的事实标注待确认，不补写。

## 二、文物主体
1. 只使用探元 cover 或博物馆馆藏实拍图，允许背景分离、等比缩放与版面定位。
2. 禁止把文物交给生图模型重绘、补绘、换纹饰或改器形；杯口、腹部、圈足与鸡雏纹饰必须与原图一致。
3. 无可靠实物图时停止制作并说明缺少图源。

## 三、必须调用生图工具
调用生图工具生成非文物层：暖米黄做旧宣纸质感，右上角淡团花，左侧淡祥云，中下部保持干净留白，画面内不得出现任何文字、印章、边框与器物。禁止用纯色或 CSS 渐变代替生图背景。

## 四、版式规范（固定结构）
- 外框：双线回纹边框 + 四角回纹角花。
- 右上：竖排馆藏与年代信息（故宫博物院藏 / 明成化年间 1465—1487）+ 朱文印章。
- 中部偏右：竖排大字标题「成化斗彩鸡缸杯」。
- 标题左侧：小竖框年代「明成化」、朱文印章「御窑」、竖排斜体英文名。
- 标题右侧：竖排「典藏明信片」+ 竖排英文 COLLECTIBLE POSTCARD。
- 下部：馆藏实拍杯体居中。
- 底部：尺寸信息与「文物主体为馆藏实拍，未作形态重绘」。

## 五、质检
逐项比对实物原图（器形、口沿、圈足、鸡雏与花石纹饰），逐字核对标题、印章、英文与落款；确认生图背景中无文字与器物。

## 六、交付
渲染为 1024×1536 PNG，嵌入单文件 output.html，提供下载与打印按钮，无外链、无 emoji、无锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Produce the Chenghua Doucai Chicken Cup collectible postcard to the fixed design system: double fret border with corner ornaments, vertical title, boxed reign mark, vermilion seals, vertical English name, vertical collection details, centered museum photograph, and a footer with dimensions plus the no-redraw notice. Verify all facts first. The artifact layer must be an unretouched museum photograph; you must invoke an image-generation tool for the paper texture and medallion ground only, and that generated layer must contain no text, seals, borders or objects. Typeset and proofread every Chinese character, render 1024×1536, and package a single offline output.html.

cases.title: 越王勾践剑典藏海报
cases.subtitle: 青铜千古、越地风华——一柄春秋名剑的水墨典藏视觉
cases.subtitle_en: Bronze through the ages, the splendor of Yue — an ink-wash collector visual for a Spring and Autumn masterpiece
cases.description:
想把一件国宝做成一张典藏海报，关键不只是放大文物，而是让文物特征、字体、意境和信息层级共同形成完整的视觉叙事。

本案例采用用户指定的「越王勾践剑」成品作为最终产物：以水墨山川、古建与江面为意境背景，突出剑身菱形暗格、青铜质感和馆藏信息，书法题字、诗句与篆印共同完成典藏海报表达。专家工作流已新增硬性要求：必须调用生图工具生成主视觉，不能用纯 HTML/CSS 拼一张海报；生图前先锁定真实文物特征，生成后逐项比对；若文物主体难以准确风格化，则转为特展海报、馆藏名片、展览预告等视觉类目，用展览主题、日期与馆藏信息丰富画面，而不是杜撰器物。

适合：博物馆文创与新媒体运营、展览宣传与海报设计者、文博科普内容编辑、历史与美育教师、文博爱好者。
cases.description_en: A collector poster that combines an AI-generated ink-wash hero visual with calligraphy, poetic copy, collection facts and a seal; the same visual can also be printed at postcard size. The workflow must invoke image generation for the main visual, constrain the artifact's verified features before generation, and validate them afterward. When close-up stylization cannot preserve the artifact, the expert should switch to an exhibition poster, collection card or event visual rather than inventing a relic.

artifacts.label: 越王勾践剑文物明信片（单文件 HTML）

cases.prompt:
请以「越王勾践剑」为主题，制作一张可下载、打印或分享的文物明信片/海报，输出单文件 HTML。

## 一、先锁定真实文物特征
并行调用探元文物库与知识库，至少核对：春秋晚期、湖北江陵望山一号墓出土、湖北省博物馆藏、通长约 55.6cm、短柄、剑首小型圆盘且内铸 11 道同心圆、剑茎两道凸箍、剑格正面蓝色琉璃/背面绿松石、剑身满饰黑色菱形暗格、八字鸟篆铭文仅位于剑身正面靠近剑格处。信息冲突或缺失时标注待确认，不得自行补写。

## 二、必须调用生图工具
1. 必须实际调用 ImageGen 或同等生图工具生成主视觉底图，禁止仅靠 HTML/CSS/SVG 拼接一张页面冒充生图结果。
2. 优先使用真实馆藏图作为参考图，设置高参考图保真度；如当前生图工具不支持参考图，不得声称实现了像素级还原，必须在成品说明中标注风格化示意。
3. 生成内容包含完整文物主体与水墨意境背景；HTML 只负责承载最终生图成品及必要文字，不得用网页元素拼造剑身、纹饰或背景。

## 三、生图提示词约束
竖版文博典藏视觉，暖白宣纸底，淡青灰水墨山川、江面、古建剪影与飞鸟，大面积留白。中央为完整越王勾践剑正面立姿。严格遵守以下结构：短柄，柄长只占全剑约 15%；剑首是比例克制的小型圆盘，不得画成权杖或大圆帽；剑茎仅两道凸箍；剑格小巧并带蓝色琉璃与青绿色镶嵌；剑身宽阔扁平、近格处较宽、向尖端缓慢收窄；全剑保持笔直；剑身连续分布黑色菱形暗格；鸟篆铭文只在靠近剑格的小区域，不得铺满剑身；青铜原色与青绿色包浆，不得变成金色、银色、黑色武侠剑，不增加剑穗、挂饰或幻想构件。风格化只作用于纸张、背景、光影与色调，不得改变器形、结构、比例、纹饰和铭文位置。生成底图中不要文字、印章、日期和 Logo。

## 四、生成后硬性核验
把生成图与真实文物图并排检查：短柄比例、剑首、两道凸箍、小型剑格、菱形暗格、铭文位置必须全部通过。任一项不一致立即重新生图，最多 3 次；3 次仍失败时，不得交付失真文物，改做「特展海报 / 馆藏名片 / 展览预告 / 研究成果视觉」：保留真实文物图，将生成能力用于环境背景，并增加展览主题、日期、地点、单元标题等信息丰富画面。

## 五、排版与交付
参考东方立轴和用户示例：书法主标题「越王勾践剑」，副题「青铜千古·越地风华」，诗句「吴戈越剑 湛卢遗风 / 千年不锈 寒光依旧」，落款「湖北省博物馆藏 / 春秋晚期青铜名剑」。文字使用可商用书法字体或字体转 SVG 路径，并内联到 HTML；逐字检查，不让图片模型生成中文。最终必须是完整的生图主视觉，不是网页临时拼贴；单文件 HTML 内联字体与图片，无外链、无 emoji、无锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Create a vertical Sword of Goujian heritage postcard. Verify all artifact facts first. You MUST invoke an image-generation tool for the hero visual; HTML may only package the finished visual and typography, not fabricate the artifact or background with page elements. Constrain the generated sword to the verified short hilt, small disc pommel with concentric circles, two hilt rings, compact inlaid guard, broad tapering blade, continuous dark rhombic pattern, and a small bird-script inscription area near the guard. Compare every generated result with a real collection image and retry up to three times. If accurate stylization fails, switch to an exhibition poster, collection card or event visual using the real artifact image and AI-generated environmental background, adding exhibition theme, date and venue instead of inventing the relic.

这个案例按既定设计规范制作后母戊鼎典藏海报：左上角「国宝重器」方框标签，顶部分隔式导语与回纹纹饰，中央烫金大字标题配双层副题，两侧竖排文物属性与馆藏信息，中央朱印，下部为馆藏实拍方鼎。

执行要点：文物主体只用中国国家博物馆馆藏实拍，仅做抠底与等比缩放，双耳、长方形深腹、四柱足与器身纹饰均保持原貌；生图工具用于生成暖白纸底与饕餮拓片底纹，不参与文物绘制；形制表述已修正为通耳高 133cm、双耳四足。

cases.description_en: A collector poster produced to the established design system: a boxed national-treasure tag, a segmented top lead line with fret ornament, a gilded title with two-tier subtitles, flanking vertical captions, a central seal, and an unretouched National Museum of China photograph of the ding. artifacts.label: 后母戊鼎典藏海报

cases.prompt:
你是「腾讯探元典藏海报专家」，按既定设计规范制作「后母戊鼎」竖版典藏海报。

## 一、事实检索
并行检索探元文物库与知识库，核对馆藏、出土信息、通耳高 133cm、口长 110cm、口宽 79cm、重 832.84kg、双耳、长方形深腹、四柱足与器身纹饰。形制为双耳四足，不得写成四耳；事实冲突时标注待确认。

## 二、文物主体
1. 只使用探元 cover 或中国国家博物馆馆藏实拍图，允许抠底、等比缩放与版面定位。
2. 禁止把鼎交给生图模型重绘、补绘、增删耳足、替换纹饰或再造铭文。
3. 内壁铭文在正面视角不可见时，不得画到器身外部。
4. 无可靠实物图时停止制作并说明缺少图源。

## 三、必须调用生图工具
调用生图工具生成非文物层：暖白到浅米色纸底，中部一枚极淡的商代饕餮/回纹圆形拓片印记，上下保持大面积留白，画面内不得出现任何文字、印章、边框与立体器物。禁止用纯色或 CSS 渐变代替生图背景。

## 四、版式规范（固定结构）
- 外框：双线回纹边框 + 四角回纹角花。
- 左上：方框标签「国宝重器」。
- 顶部：分隔式导语「中 / 国 / 青 / 铜 / 文 / 明 / 瑰 / 宝」+ 左右细线 + 中央回纹纹饰。
- 中央：烫金渐变大字标题「后母戊鼎」。
- 标题下：主副题「商代青铜重器」（两侧细线）与「青铜之巅，礼制之威」。
- 两侧：左竖排文物属性、右竖排文物级别与馆藏。
- 中央朱印一枚。
- 下部：馆藏实拍方鼎居中，不遮挡两侧竖排文字。
- 底部：尺寸重量信息与「文物主体为馆藏实拍，未作形态重绘」。

## 五、质检
逐项比对实物原图（双耳、深腹、四柱足、器身纹饰、比例），逐字核对标题、副题、标签、印章与落款；确认生图背景中无文字与器物，且文物未遮挡侧栏文字。

## 六、交付
渲染为 1024×1536 PNG，嵌入单文件 output.html，提供下载与打印按钮，无外链、无 emoji、无锚点。
cases.prompt_en: Produce the Houmuwu Ding collector poster to the fixed design system: fret border with corner ornaments, boxed national-treasure tag, segmented top lead line with fret ornament, gilded title, two-tier subtitles with hairlines, flanking vertical captions, central seal, centered museum photograph that must not overlap the side captions, and a footer with dimensions plus the no-redraw notice. Verify the facts first: 133 cm overall height, 110 × 79 cm mouth, 832.84 kg, two ears and four columnar legs. The artifact layer must be an unretouched museum photograph; invoke an image-generation tool only for the paper and faint taotie rubbing ground, which must contain no text, seals, borders or solid objects. Render 1024×1536 and package a single offline output.html.

cases.title: 唐三彩为什么不是瓷器
cases.title_en: Why Tang Sancai Is Not Porcelain
cases.subtitle: 从胎料、烧成温度、胎体状态三条门槛，把'是陶还是瓷'讲透
cases.subtitle_en: Walk through the three thresholds (clay, firing temperature, body state) to settle the 'pottery or porcelain?' question
cases.description:
一提到唐三彩很多人下意识就说'它是瓷器'，但博物馆的展签明明写的是'唐三彩'三个字。

这个案例演示了腾讯探元文博知识问答专家如何回答这类'X 为什么不是 Y'的概念辨析题——它会从胎料与配方、烧成温度、胎体状态三个相互关联的维度展开，最终明确归类到'低温铅釉陶'。全文以两件真实唐三彩实物配图说明釉色与露胎细节，并用正文 [1][2][3] 对应文末来源，避免来源名称打断阅读。

适合：博物馆讲解员与志愿者；博物馆爱好者、教师与科普编辑；做文博短视频/公众号需要一段准确科普脚本的创作者；文物拍卖与工艺品行业做内容鉴别的人员。
cases.description_en:
Most people instinctively call Tang sancai 'porcelain', but museum labels never say that.

This case shows how the Tencent TanYuan cultural-heritage Q&A expert answers a 'why is X not Y?' question — it first lays out the three objective thresholds for calling something 'porcelain' (clay, firing temperature, body state), then compares Tang sancai against each one, and finally places it cleanly as 'low-fire lead-glazed earthenware'. The full answer is backed by real retrieval data, real numbers (800°C vs 1200°C+), a real artefact (Tang sancai camel at the Nanjing Museum), and a clean-up of the misconception that 'three colours = three colours'.

Best for: Museum docents and volunteers; museum enthusiasts, teachers and popular-science editors; short-video / WeChat creators who need an accurate explainer script; auction and craft-industry content reviewers.

artifacts.label: 完整问答报告（结论+分节论证+常见误解+来源）

cases.prompt:
请回答：唐三彩为什么不是瓷器？

要求：
1. **结论先行**：第一段直接给出判断（是低温铅釉陶，不是瓷器），一两句话讲清
2. **立标准 + 逐条比对**：从胎料与配方、烧成温度、胎体状态三个相互关联的维度解释陶与瓷，再用唐三彩逐条比对；不要把材料、温度、吸水率写成彼此独立的绝对门槛
3. **引用真实数据**：必须基于检索到的资料给出具体数字（800℃ 左右的釉烧 vs 1200℃+ 的瓷器烧成），不要凭印象编造
4. **澄清常见误解**：点破'三彩不是只有三种颜色'、'三彩的彩与瓷器无关'两点
5. **区分事实与综合判断**：对学界有定论的（如'瓷器判定标准'）直接讲，对'唐三彩的釉烧温度区间'这类来自不同文献的不同说法标注'综合判断'
6. **图文与引用**：至少加入 2 张与正文紧密对应的真实文物图；正文只用 [1][2][3] 标注事实，不要反复写“来源于某知识库”；文末统一列明题名、机构、完整 URL 与图片出处
7. **温度数据要有锚点**：给出约 800℃ 的低温釉烧参照，但不要用未经来源支持的类比

风格：口语化、解释链条完整、对一个完全不懂陶瓷工艺的人也能讲懂；不出现'检索''知识库''查询'等过程叙述词；末尾给出 1 条'下次类似问题可以这样发问'作为延伸引导。
cases.prompt_en:
Please answer: Why is Tang sancai not considered porcelain?

Requirements:
1. **Conclusion first**: Open with a one- or two-sentence verdict — it is low-fire lead-glazed earthenware, not porcelain.
2. **Standards before comparison**: First lay out the three objective thresholds for 'porcelain' — (a) body uses porcelain stone / kaolin instead of ordinary clay; (b) firing temperature high enough to vitrify the body; (c) body is vitrified, dense, very low water absorption with a high-fire glaze firmly fused to it. Then check Tang sancai against each threshold: its body material, its firing temperature, whether the body vitrified, water absorption, and whether lead glaze is a high-fire or low-fire glaze.
3. **Real data only**: Cite concrete numbers backed by retrieved sources (around 800°C glaze-firing vs 1200°C+ for porcelain). Don't invent figures.
4. **Debunk common misconceptions**: Clarify that 'three colours' refers to the polychrome family (lead-glaze palette dominated by yellow / green / white), not literally three colours, and that the word 'cai' has nothing to do with porcelain.
5. **Distinguish established fact from synthesis**: Established consensus (e.g. the porcelain criteria) can be stated directly; for figures that differ across sources (e.g. the exact glaze-firing temperature range of Tang sancai) mark as 'synthesis'.
6. **Always end with sources**: Two buckets — 'Tencent TanYuan knowledge base' (named by topic only) and 'Public sources' (every citation must carry a clickable URL, otherwise don't claim it as public).
7. **Anchor unfamiliar numbers**: e.g. 'around 800°C, well below the melting point of steel' so a lay reader can follow.

Style: colloquial, full cause-and-effect chain, accessible to a reader with zero ceramics background. Never use process narration like 'searching', 'querying the knowledge base', 'retrieved twice'. End with one 'next time, try asking this related question' hook.

experts.name: 文博百科专家
experts.description: 依托腾讯探元文博知识库，从工艺原理与材质分析解答文博疑问，结论先行并标注权威资料来源。

cases.title: TAPD 缺陷质量分析报告
cases.subtitle: 按严重程度、模块、处理人聚合缺陷，一键出质量趋势报告
cases.subtitle_en: Aggregate bugs by severity, module and owner into a quality trend report
cases.description:
迭代快结束了，缺陷散落在 TAPD 里，谁也说不清这个版本质量到底稳不稳、哪个模块最坑、还有多少高危没闭环——每次做质量复盘都要手动导表格拉数据，费时又容易漏。

这个案例帮你把一个项目或迭代里的全部缺陷自动拉下来，按严重程度、模块、处理人、状态四个维度聚合，再算出缺陷密度、重开率、平均修复时长、遗留缺陷等关键指标，最后生成一份暗色科技感的单文件 HTML 报告：概览卡片、严重程度环形图、近 6 周新增/修复趋势、高发模块 TOP 排行、代表性缺陷明细、质量结论与风险提示一应俱全，双开即看。

适合测试负责人做版本质量评估、研发 Leader 定位高发模块、项目经理做迭代复盘汇报，也适合想给老板一份体面质量报告的你。
cases.description_en:
The sprint is wrapping up, bugs are scattered across TAPD, and nobody can say for sure whether this release is solid, which module is the biggest pain, or how many critical defects are still open. Every quality retro means manually exporting sheets and crunching numbers by hand.

This case pulls every bug from a project or iteration, aggregates them across four dimensions — severity, module, owner and status — then computes key metrics like defect density, reopen rate, average fix time and remaining defects. The output is a dark, tech-styled single-file HTML report: overview cards, a severity donut chart, a 6-week new-vs-fixed trend, a top hotspot-module ranking, a representative bug table, plus a quality conclusion and risk section — all viewable in one double-click.

Great for QA leads assessing release quality, dev leads pinpointing hotspot modules, PMs running sprint retros, and anyone who needs a presentable quality report for their boss.

cases.prompt: 请用 TAPD skill（tapd-openapi / tapd-cli）生成一份「缺陷质量分析报告」单文件 HTML。数据来源：优先用 TAPD 官方接口拉真实数据——调用 bug list / count / fields 拉取 workspaceid={{WORKSPACE_ID}} 下指定迭代内全部缺陷；若无权限或取不到，则用演示数据代替并明确标注「演示数据」。聚合分析：按严重程度、状态、模块、处理人分别聚合，统计近 6 周新增 vs 修复趋势，并计算缺陷密度、重开率、平均修复时长、遗留数、修复率等关键指标，各维度数字须自洽、加总一致。交付：输出单文件 HTML，资源全部内联、可离线双击打开。
cases.prompt_en: Use the TAPD skill (tapd-openapi / tapd-cli) to generate a single-file HTML "Bug Quality Analysis Report". Data source: prefer real data via TAPD official APIs — call bug list / count / fields to fetch all bugs under workspaceid={{WORKSPACE_ID}} within a specified iteration; if access is unavailable or data cannot be retrieved, use demo data instead and clearly label it as "demo data". Aggregation: aggregate by severity, status, module and assignee, compute the new-vs-fixed trend over the last 6 weeks, and calculate key metrics such as defect density, reopen rate, average fix time, open count and fix rate — all numbers must be internally consistent and add up. Delivery: output a single-file HTML with all resources inlined, openable offline by double-click.

cases.title: TAPD 迭代健康度看板
cases.subtitle: 一键汇总迭代进度、燃尽、需求健康度与成员负载
cases.subtitle_en: One board for iteration progress, burndown, story health and member load
cases.description:
迭代到了中后期，进度到底行不行？需求卡在哪、谁过载了、还有几个缺陷没清，光靠翻 TAPD 列表根本看不清，开站会全靠嘴对。

这个案例用 TAPD skill 拉取当前进行中的迭代及其下的需求、任务、缺陷，一次性汇总成「迭代健康度看板」：迭代概览、燃尽图（理想线 vs 实际）、需求状态分布、受阻需求风险、成员负载、缺陷压力、多迭代趋势对比，最后给一个综合健康度评级和行动建议。产物是暗色科技感的单文件 HTML，资源全内联、可离线打开。

适合项目经理、Scrum Master、研发 TL 在每日站会/迭代复盘时快速看清健康度、及早发现延期与阻塞风险。
cases.description_en:
Mid-to-late in a sprint, is progress actually on track? Which stories are stuck, who is overloaded, how many bugs are still open — scrolling through TAPD lists tells you none of it, and standups turn into guesswork.

This case uses the TAPD skill to pull the current in-progress iteration with its stories, tasks and bugs, and rolls them up into one Iteration Health Dashboard: iteration overview, burndown (ideal vs actual), story-status distribution, blocked-story risks, member load, defect pressure, multi-iteration trend comparison, plus an overall health rating with action items. The output is a dark tech-styled single-file HTML with all resources inlined, openable offline.

Great for PMs, Scrum Masters and dev leads to grasp sprint health at a glance during daily standups and retros, catching delays and blockers early.

Output a single-file HTML with all resources inlined, openable offline.

cases.title: TAPD 需求评审看板一键生成
cases.subtitle: 把一个迭代的需求与变更历史整理成可视化评审材料
cases.subtitle_en: Turn an iteration's stories and change history into a visual review board
cases.description:
开评审会前，产品经理经常要在 TAPD 里挨个点开需求，手动整理优先级、状态、验收标准和这段时间改了什么，一个迭代十几条需求折腾大半天还容易漏掉变更风险。

这个案例用 TAPD skill 拉取指定迭代下的全部需求（story list）和需求变更历史（story changes），自动整理成一份需求评审看板：顶部是需求总数和各状态概览，中间用环形图 / 条形图展示按优先级、状态、模块的分布，下面是完整需求明细表，还单独把近期发生优先级 / 范围变更的需求拎出来做「变更风险区」，最后附评审 checklist 和结论区。产物是单文件 HTML，暗色科技感，可离线打开。

适合产品经理、项目经理、迭代负责人在需求评审会前快速准备材料，也适合团队 leader 一眼掌握迭代内需求全貌。
cases.description_en:
Before a review meeting, product managers often have to open each story in TAPD one by one, manually collecting priorities, statuses, acceptance criteria and what changed recently. A dozen stories in an iteration can take half a day, and change risks are easily missed.

This case uses the TAPD skill to pull all stories (story list) and story change history under a given iteration, then automatically compiles a review board: an overview of total story count and status breakdown at the top, donut / bar charts showing distribution by priority, status and module, a full story detail table below, plus a dedicated "change risk" panel that surfaces stories with recent priority or scope changes, and finally a review checklist and conclusion section. The output is a single-file HTML with a dark tech aesthetic that opens offline.

Ideal for product managers, project managers and iteration owners preparing materials before a review meeting, and for team leads who want a full picture of the iteration's requirements at a glance.

cases.title: 投放复盘报告一键生成
cases.subtitle: 投完一波广告，把后台数据变成一份能下载打印的复盘文档
cases.subtitle_en: Turn raw campaign data into a downloadable, print-ready retrospective
cases.description:
广告投完了，钱花了、单出了，但「这波到底打得怎么样、下次该改哪里」往往说不清——数据散在后台，看得懂的人才看得懂，想给老板或客户交一份说明也无从下手。

这个案例把一整套投手的复盘方法装进一次对话：给出渠道、周期、花了多少钱、换来多少结果和当初的目标，就能得到一份完整报告。顶部先用大白话讲清「总账 / 做对了什么 / 还能更好 / 下次这样投」四段结论，往下接六节数据文档——表现总览与成交漏斗、逐日走势折线图（标出爬坡·高峰·衰退三段与成本拐点）、阶段对比与效率缺口测算、素材分析（结构·排行·建议）、五维星级评价、下一波建议与目标对照。术语全部翻成人话，好坏只跟自己的目标比，没有的数据如实标注不估算。

适合：投完一波想认真总结的广告主、需要给客户交复盘文档的代理商投手、刚接手投放要快速看懂账户表现的运营新人。
cases.description_en:
When a campaign wraps up, the money is spent and the orders are in — but "how did we actually do, and what should change next time?" usually goes unanswered. The data sits scattered in a dashboard that only specialists can read, and putting together an explanation for a boss or client feels like starting from scratch.

This case packs a full media buyer's retrospective method into a single conversation. Provide the channel, date range, spend, results, and your original target, and you get a complete report. It opens with four plain-language conclusions — the bottom line, what worked, what could be better, and how to run it next time — followed by six sections of data: a performance overview with conversion funnel, a daily trend line chart (marking the ramp-up, peak, and decline phases plus the cost inflection point), phase-by-phase comparison with efficiency gap analysis, creative analysis (structure, ranking, recommendations), a five-dimension star rating, and next-round recommendations with target benchmarks. Jargon is translated into everyday language, performance is judged only against your own goals, and missing data is labeled as such rather than estimated.

Good for: advertisers who want a real post-campaign review, agency buyers who owe clients a retrospective document, and marketers new to ad operations who need to understand account performance fast.

cases.title: 香薰新品朋友圈素材策略
cases.title_en: WeChat Moments Creative Strategy for a Scented Candle Launch
cases.subtitle: 8 万预算 30 天，把「我要推广」拆成可开工的素材清单
cases.subtitle_en: Turn an 80K budget over 30 days into a ready-to-execute creative checklist
cases.description:
第一次投广告最卡的不是钱，是不知道该做多少条素材、做哪几类、每条配什么文案。凭感觉做十几张图投出去，跑不动也不知道问题在哪。

这个案例把一句「我要推广香薰产品踏雪，预算 8 万投 30 天，希望获客成本 100 元以内」，直接算成一份可开工的素材策略：按日预算倒推出广告数与素材数，推荐适配的素材类型，逐条给出尺寸、文案和可直接出图的生图提示词，最后合成一份离线可看、可打印的单文件 HTML 手册。

适合：第一次投效果广告的广告主、一人公司/独立品牌主理人、需要快速出素材 brief 的运营与设计。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of a first ad campaign isn't the budget — it's not knowing how many creatives to make, which formats to use, or what copy goes with each one. Ship a dozen images on instinct and, when they underperform, you have no idea why.

This case turns a single sentence — "I want to promote my scented candle brand Taxue, 80,000 budget over 30 days, target CPA under 100" — into a ready-to-execute creative strategy. It back-calculates ad and creative counts from the daily budget, recommends the creative formats that fit, then specifies dimensions, copy, and ready-to-use image-generation prompts for every single item, delivered as a single-file offline HTML manual.

Good for: advertisers running performance ads for the first time, one-person companies and indie brand founders, and marketers or designers who need a creative brief fast.

cases.title: 桂枝汤方解思维导图
cases.title_en: Guizhi Decoction Formula Breakdown Mind Map
cases.subtitle: 一张图看懂桂枝汤的君臣佐使配伍与作用机理
cases.subtitle_en: Understand the sovereign-minister-assistant-courier compatibility and mechanism of Guizhi Decoction in one diagram
cases.description:
学方剂最头疼的就是面对一长串药名和君臣佐使的复杂关系，教材翻来翻去脑子还是一团浆糊。

这个案例以《伤寒论》经典方「桂枝汤」为例，输入方剂组成和配伍信息，一键生成层次清晰的方解思维导图——君药桂枝解肌发表、臣药芍药益阴敛营、佐药姜枣调和脾胃、使药炙甘草调和诸药，功效、主治、配伍特点、用法一图尽览。

适合：中医学学生复习备考、中医爱好者自学方剂、方剂研究者梳理配伍逻辑、中医教学工作者制作讲义。
cases.description_en:
The most frustrating part of learning herbal formulas is facing a long list of ingredients with complex sovereign-minister-assistant-courier relationships, flipping through textbooks without a clear mental picture.

This case takes the classic Shang Han Lun formula "Guizhi Decoction" as an example—input the composition and compatibility data, and generate a well-structured formula breakdown mind map in one click: sovereign herb Guizhi releases the exterior, minister herb Shaoyao nourishes yin and secures the defensive, assistants Jiangzao harmonize spleen and stomach, and courier Zhigancao mediates all herbs—covering functions, indications, compatibility features, and usage all in one view.

Ideal for: TCM students preparing for exams, TCM enthusiasts self-studying formulas, formula researchers analyzing compatibility logic, and TCM educators creating teaching materials.
cases.prompt: 请为「桂枝汤」做一张方解思维导图（SVG）。组成：桂枝 9g（君）、芍药 9g（臣）、生姜 9g（佐）、大枣 3 枚（佐）、炙甘草 6g（使）。功效：解肌发表、调和营卫。主治：外感风寒表虚证（恶风、发热、汗出、脉浮缓）。用法：水煎温服，服后啜热稀粥，温覆取微汗。来源：《伤寒论》。
cases.prompt_en: Please create a formula breakdown mind map (SVG) for "Guizhi Decoction". Composition: Guizhi (Cinnamon Twig) 9g (Sovereign), Shaoyao (White Peony Root) 9g (Minister), Shengjiang (Fresh Ginger) 9g (Assistant), Dazao (Jujube) 3 pieces (Assistant), Zhigancao (Honey-fried Licorice Root) 6g (Courier). Functions: Release the exterior and resolve the muscle layer, harmonize the defensive and nutritive qi. Indications: External wind-cold with exterior deficiency pattern (aversion to wind, fever, sweating, floating and moderate pulse). Usage: Decoct in water and take warm; after taking, sip hot thin congee, cover with blankets to induce slight sweating. Source: Shang Han Lun (Treatise on Cold Damage).

cases.title: 高校教师开学任务清零工作台
cases.subtitle: 五大板块 · 逾期预警 · 清零进度一屏统管，开学季冲刺在线同步
cases.subtitle_en: Five hubs, overdue alerts and clearing progress on one screen — sprint through semester start with live sync
cases.description: 高校老师一到开学就被备课、组会、课题、行政事务追着跑：事情散在群通知、邮箱和脑子里，谁快到期、谁已经逾期全靠记性。这个工作台把教学、科研、指导学生、事务、成长五大板块的任务放进同一张表，逾期标红、今天到期高亮、总体清零进度一屏看清。演示数据是一位高校旅游管理教授开学季的 20 项任务，从第一周课件、组会安排到课题申报、学者档案全覆盖。适合高校教师、研究生导师，以及任何想用一张表管住开学冲刺季的人。
cases.description_en: When a new semester starts, college professors get chased by course prep, group meetings, grant deadlines and admin paperwork — everything scattered across group chats and inboxes, with due dates living only in memory. This workbench puts all tasks from five hubs (teaching, research, student mentoring, affairs, growth) into one table: overdue items turn red, due-today items get highlighted, and the overall clearing progress is visible at a glance. The demo data covers 20 real-to-life tasks of a tourism-management professor during semester start, from Week 1 courseware to grant applications and scholar profiles. Great for college teachers, graduate advisors, and anyone wrangling a semester-start sprint with one table.
cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/SzymywKLxiqKbzNOk2Nmu1，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

做一个高校教师的开学任务清零工作台，浅色学术风、蓝紫渐变主色，面向高校教师与研究生导师，用一张「高校教师开学任务清零工作台」数据表管住开学季全部待办。表字段：事项名称、所属中枢（教学中枢/科研中枢/指导学生中枢/事务中枢/成长中枢）、所属模块（备课进度/作业批改/考核安排/文献管理/论文写作/课题申报/选题管理/组会管理/日程管理/材料整理/成果展示/学术影响力）、状态（未开始/进行中/已完成/已搁置）、进度、优先级（P0/P1/P2）、截止日期、关联对象、关键指标、下一步行动。页面包含：顶栏同步状态；欢迎卡（教授问候与场景日期）；清零总览（总体进度环形图、全部/进行中/已完成/已逾期四张可点击筛选的统计卡、「今天要处理」区按逾期天数排序、可折叠的添加任务表单，选中选题模块时显示脱敏提示）；五大板块完成情况环形卡片，点击跳转对应清单；事项清单（板块页签 + 模块筛选 + 按分组展示的任务卡，支持改状态、改进度、删除，进度满 100 自动完成）；侧栏板块导航与清空数据入口。内置 20 条开学季演示任务，所有增删改实时写回数据表。PC 与移动端自适应。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library capability to build a same-style copy of https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/SzymywKLxiqKbzNOk2Nmu1 with data stored online and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click same-style flow; if unavailable, build it as follows:/n/nBuild a semester-start task clearing workbench for college professors, in a light academic style with a blue-purple gradient, for college teachers and graduate advisors, managing every semester-start to-do with one "Semester-Start Task Clearing" table. Fields: task name, hub (Teaching / Research / Student Mentoring / Affairs / Growth), module (Course prep / Grading / Assessments / Literature / Paper writing / Grant proposals / Topic mgmt / Group meetings / Scheduling / Paperwork / Achievements / Academic presence), status (Not started / In progress / Done / On hold), progress, priority (P0/P1/P2), due date, related target, key metric, next action. The page includes: a header with sync status; a welcome card (professor greeting with scenario date); a clearing overview (overall progress ring, four clickable stat cards for all / in progress / done / overdue, a "to handle today" list sorted by overdue days, a collapsible add-task form with a privacy note when the topic module is selected); five hub ring cards that jump to the hub's list; a task list (hub tabs + module filter + grouped task cards supporting status change, progress edit and delete, auto-complete at 100% progress); a sidebar with hub navigation and clear-all entry. Ships with 20 semester-start demo tasks; every create, update and delete is written back to the table in real time. responsive on PC and mobile.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 教师工作台
cases.subtitle: 把课堂记录、成绩分析与班务安排集中到一个在线工作台
cases.subtitle_en: One online workspace for classroom records, grade analysis, and homeroom routines
cases.description:
老师在课堂上要快速记下学生表现、打卡和成绩，课后又要整理待办、补测、家校沟通和班务，信息常常分散在纸张、表格和聊天记录里。

这个案例演示了一个教师可直接使用的在线工作台：今天课程与待办、快速批量记录、完成率和成绩概览、学生名册，以及考勤、家校联系、沟通和班务都围绕同一套数据表展开。

cases.description_en:
Teachers need to capture participation, check-ins, and grades during class, then organize tasks, retests, family communication, and homeroom routines after class. Those details are often scattered across paper, spreadsheets, and messages.

This case demonstrates an online workspace teachers can use directly: today’s classes and tasks, rapid batch recording, completion and grade insights, a student roster, plus attendance, family contacts, communication, and class duties built around one connected set of data tables.

Suitable for: primary and secondary teachers managing daily records across multiple classes; homeroom teachers coordinating attendance, family communication, and duties; and teaching teams demonstrating a maintainable classroom-data workflow.

cases.prompt:

cases.title: 技术服务合同风险审查
cases.subtitle: 锁定知识产权归属、验收标准与延期赔付的关键漏洞
cases.subtitle_en: Identify key weaknesses in IP ownership, acceptance criteria, and delay compensation
cases.description:
技术服务合同的核心在于交付成果的定义与验收标准的量化。本案例演示专家如何从企业数字化转型咨询+系统开发服务合同中，精准定位知识产权归属不明确、服务需求明细待填写、分期付款未绑定里程碑节点、保密义务赔偿未量化等高风险点，确保甲方投入的安全性与乙方权益的平衡。

适合：CTO/CIO、技术采购负责人、SaaS产品经理、创业公司创始人。
cases.description_en:
The core of tech-service contracts lies in defining deliverables and quantifying acceptance criteria. This case demonstrates how the expert pinpoints high-risk issues in an enterprise digital-transformation + system-development agreement: undefined IP ownership, pending service details, milestone-unbound staged payments, unquantified confidentiality damages.

Suitable for: CTOs/CIOs, tech-procurement leads, SaaS PMs, startup founders.
cases.prompt: 请对我提供的《技术服务合同》进行深度风险审查。重点关注知识产权归属条款是否明确（源代码、文档、数据）、各阶段交付物与验收标准是否量化具体、四期付款是否绑定明确的里程碑节点（原型确认/上线验收/质保期满）、延期赔偿比例是否合理且设有上限、保密义务范围与违约赔偿金额是否量化。输出高/中/低分级风险清单。
cases.prompt_en: Please perform a deep risk review on my Technical Service Agreement. Focus on IP-ownership clarity (source code, docs, data), quantified deliverables & acceptance criteria per phase, whether 4-stage payments bind clear milestones, reasonableness of delay damages with caps, and whether confidentiality scope & breach damages are quantified. Output a tiered risk list.

cases.title: 腾讯校招面试准备
cases.subtitle: 围绕目标岗位生成面试准备计划和模拟追问清单
cases.subtitle_en: Create interview preparation plans and follow-up question lists for target roles.
cases.description:
痛点：同学常把面试准备做成题库背诵，忽略岗位 JD、项目表达和真实追问逻辑。
演示内容：本案例以算法-多模态方向官网 JD 为输入，结合腾讯校招面试辅导材料，输出 1v1 面试准备路径、项目深挖问题和 10 天计划。
适用人群：已进入笔试或面试前准备阶段，需要针对腾讯技术/算法方向进行系统复盘的候选人。
cases.description_en:
Pain point: Students often prepare by memorizing question banks while ignoring the JD, project storytelling, and realistic follow-up logic.
Demo: This case uses an official multimodal algorithm JD and Tencent campus interview coaching materials to generate a 1:1 interview plan, project deep-dive questions, and a 10-day schedule.
Audience: Candidates preparing for Tencent engineering or algorithm interviews after application or written tests.
cases.prompt:
我准备腾讯校招“算法-多模态方向”的 1v1 面试，请你作为腾讯校招求职教练，基于官网 JD 和面试辅导材料，帮我制定准备计划。

我的背景：硕士，做过图文检索/多模态理解项目，熟悉 Python、PyTorch、Transformer，论文和竞赛一般，但有完整项目落地经历；面试预计 10 天后。

请输出：
1. 先判断是否缺少关键信息，必要时用 2-4 个选项追问。
2. 基于官网 JD 拆解面试官通常会关注的能力。
3. 给出项目深挖准备框架。
4. 生成 12 个可能的追问问题，并说明每类问题考察什么。
5. 制定 10 天准备计划。

注意：不要承诺题目命中率，不要说“一定会问”；用“通常会关注”“建议准备”等柔性表达。不要编造通过率、录取率、HC、薪酬。
cases.prompt_en:
I'm preparing for a 1:1 interview for Tencent's campus recruitment "Algorithm - Multimodal direction." Please act as a Tencent campus recruitment job coach and, based on the official website JD and interview coaching materials, help me create a preparation plan.

My background: Master's degree, have worked on image-text retrieval / multimodal understanding projects, familiar with Python, PyTorch, and Transformer, average on papers and competitions, but with complete project-implementation experience; the interview is expected in about 10 days.

Please output:
1. First determine whether key information is missing, and if necessary follow up with 2-4 options.
2. Based on the official website JD, break down the competencies interviewers typically focus on.
3. Provide a framework for preparing to deep-dive into projects.
4. Generate 12 possible follow-up questions, and explain what each category of question is assessing.
5. Develop a 10-day preparation plan.

Note: Do not promise question hit rates, do not say "will definitely be asked"; use soft phrasing like "typically focuses on" and "recommend preparing." Do not fabricate pass rates, offer rates, headcount, or compensation.

cases.title: 腾讯校招岗位匹配
cases.subtitle: 基于官网岗位与 JD，生成岗位推荐和准备路径
cases.subtitle_en: Generate role recommendations and preparation steps from official Tencent campus JDs.
cases.description:
痛点：很多同学只知道想投腾讯，但不知道产品、技术、算法等方向哪个更匹配，也容易被非官方岗位信息干扰。
演示内容：本案例基于 join.qq.com 官网岗位数据，先澄清候选人背景，再推荐 3 个真实岗位，并拆解匹配理由、风险点和 7 天准备计划。
适用人群：准备投递腾讯校招或实习、需要快速选方向并制定行动计划的应届生。
cases.description_en:
Pain point: Many students want to apply to Tencent but are unsure which product, engineering, or algorithm roles fit them, and may be misled by unofficial job information.
Demo: This case uses official join.qq.com job data, clarifies the candidate profile, recommends three real roles, and breaks down fit, gaps, and a 7-day preparation plan.
Audience: Students preparing for Tencent campus recruitment or internships who need role selection and an actionable plan.
cases.prompt:
我正在准备腾讯校园招聘，请你作为腾讯校招求职教练，基于 join.qq.com 官网岗位/JD 数据帮我完成岗位匹配。

我的背景：计算机相关专业硕士，做过大模型应用、数据分析和后端服务项目；目标城市深圳/北京/上海；希望在产品经理（技术背景）、后台开发、算法/多模态之间选择；当前处于投递前准备阶段。

请按腾讯校园招聘 Skill 的规则执行：
1. 先判断信息是否足够；若缺少关键条件，用 2-4 个选项追问，不要猜。
2. 用官网岗位脚本查询真实岗位和 JD，不要编造岗位、HC、通过率、薪酬或 offer 档位。
3. 推荐 3-5 个真实岗位，输出岗位名称、工作地、招聘类型、投递链接、匹配理由和风险点。
4. 对最推荐岗位拆解硬性条件、软性素质、加分项、简历侧重和面试准备。
5. 最后给 7 天求职准备计划，并提醒个人流程信息以 join.qq.com 校招官网 offer 鹅为准。
cases.prompt_en:
I'm preparing for Tencent's campus recruitment. Please act as a Tencent campus-recruitment job coach and help me with job matching based on the position/JD data from the join.qq.com official site.

My background: a master's degree in a computer-related major, with project experience in LLM applications, data analysis, and backend services; target cities Shenzhen/Beijing/Shanghai; I want to choose among Product Manager (technical background), backend development, and algorithm/multimodal roles; I'm currently in the pre-application preparation stage.

Please follow the rules of the Tencent campus recruitment Skill:
1. First judge whether the information is sufficient; if key conditions are missing, ask follow-up questions with 2-4 options—don't guess.
2. Use the official-site job script to query real positions and JDs; don't fabricate positions, headcount, pass rates, compensation, or offer tiers.
3. Recommend 3-5 real positions, outputting the job title, work location, recruitment type, application link, match rationale, and risk points.
4. For the most recommended position, break down the hard requirements, soft qualities, bonus points, resume emphasis, and interview prep.
5. Finally provide a 7-day job-prep plan, and remind me that personal process information is authoritative on the join.qq.com campus recruitment official site's "Offer E" (offer goose).

cases.title_en: Target Assessment and Pipeline Research for PCSK9
cases.subtitle: 一键获取心血管靶点全景：遗传证据、作用机制、管线资产一览
cases.subtitle_en: Full-spectrum cardiovascular target view: genetics, mechanism, and pipeline assets in one report
cases.description: 靶点评估需要同时覆盖人类遗传学、成药性、临床试验进展三条维度，但手工逐一检索 PubMed、ClinVar、ClinicalTrials 极为耗时，且难以保证不遗漏。腾讯生命科学文献检索专家可联查多权威来源，自动去重并按维度分层呈现，附完整 PMID / DOI / NCT 溯源。本案例以 PCSK9 在动脉粥样硬化性心血管病中的靶点评估为示例，产出完整的靶点情报 HTML 报告，涵盖人类遗传、作用机制、成药性、在研及终止资产管线。适合药物研发团队、医学事务及靶点选择阶段的研究人员使用。
cases.description_en: Target assessment requires simultaneous coverage of human genetics, tractability, and clinical trial progress — yet manually searching PubMed, ClinVar, and ClinicalTrials is time-consuming and error-prone. The Tencent Life Sciences Literature Search Expert federates authoritative sources, deduplicates results, and presents findings in stratified layers with full PMID/DOI/NCT traceability. This case uses PCSK9 in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease as a demonstration, delivering a complete HTML target intelligence report covering human genetics, mechanism, tractability, and active/discontinued pipeline assets. Ideal for drug discovery teams, medical affairs, and researchers at the target selection stage.

cases.prompt: 请深度评估 PCSK9 在动脉粥样硬化性心血管病中的靶点价值，并梳理截至检索日公开来源中的在研与终止资产；分开呈现人类遗传、作用机制、成药性、试验阶段和申办方，附 PMID、DOI、NCT。
cases.prompt_en: Please deeply evaluate PCSK9 as a therapeutic target in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, and map all active and discontinued assets from public sources as of the retrieval date. cases.description:

这个案例展示了一个专属于自己的「腾讯会议工作台」：顶部四宫格总览（倒计时下一场、本周会议数、本月会议数、本月总时长），主体是带热力图和冲突标记的月历（时间冲突标红、前后间隔 ≤15 分钟标黄、密度从少到多），右侧今日会议表清晰区分已结束/进行中/未开始，附带录制回看与权限申请入口。中英双语（?lang=en 切换英文）。开箱即用，无需连接真实账号即可在内置演示数据下查看完整布局与交互。

适合：周会密集的团队负责人、需要快速回顾历史会议/纪要的人、想拥有一个可视化会议日历而不只是看通知的人、希望把会议冲突和间隔紧提前看见的人。
cases.description_en:
When "how many meetings this week, who overlapped, where is yesterday's recap" throws you off, the missing piece is a glanceable meeting map plus minutes that don't take ten clicks to fetch.

This case shows a personal Tencent Meeting Workbench: a top four-tile overview (next-meeting countdown, this-week count, this-month count, this-month total time), a main month calendar with a heatmap and conflict markers (red for time overlap, yellow for ≤15-minute tight gaps, density from light to heavy), and a right-side today list that clearly separates ended / live / upcoming with recording playback and access-request entry. Bilingual in Chinese and English (?lang=en switches to English). It works out of the box with built-in demo data, no live account required, so you can preview the full layout and interactions immediately.

Best for: team leads with packed weekly syncs, anyone needing quick access to past meetings and minutes, people who want a visual meeting calendar instead of just notifications, and those who want to spot meeting conflicts and tight gaps in advance.

cases.title: Tiffany 的学习工作台
cases.subtitle: 把预习、错题、资料与亲子激励收进一个学习空间
cases.subtitle_en: Bring preview notes, mistakes, materials, and family motivation into one study space
cases.description:
学习资料、错题复盘和每日计划散落在不同地方时，孩子很难看见自己的进步，家长也不容易给到及时、具体的鼓励。

这个案例展示了一个面向中学生的学习工作台：首页汇总今日任务、课表、考试倒计时和心情；预习区、错题本、专项突破和学科资料库分别沉淀学习过程；积分、奖励兑换与家长留言板把正反馈自然融入日常。数据落在资料库数据表，支持在线存储与双向同步。页面内置中英双语，追加 ?lang=en 即可切换英文。

适合：需要建立自主学习节奏的学生、想把学习陪伴做得更具体的家长，以及希望快速搭建一套可持续使用的家庭学习工作台的人。
cases.description_en:
When study materials, mistake reviews, and daily plans live in different places, students struggle to see their progress and parents struggle to give timely, specific encouragement.

This case demonstrates a study workbench for middle-school students: the dashboard brings together today's tasks, schedule, exam countdown, and mood; Preview Zone, Mistake Notebook, Breakthrough, and Subject Library capture the learning process; points, rewards, and a family message board make positive feedback part of everyday learning. Data lives in WorkBuddy Library tables with online storage and two-way sync. The page includes built-in Chinese and English UI; append ?lang=en to switch to English.

Best for: students building a self-directed study rhythm, parents who want more concrete ways to support learning, and anyone who wants to quickly create a sustainable family study workbench.

artifacts.label: Tiffany 的学习工作台（中英双语单文件 HTML）

cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/KSR5qI0MECB44ZjU6YhTf9，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

做一个「学习工作台」，面向中学生与家长，用结构化数据表管理学习过程与亲子激励。数据表：错题本（题目、学科、年级、单元、错因、正确解法、掌握状态、下次复习）、学科资料（标题、学科、类型、内容）、爸妈留言（作者、内容、时间、状态、类型）、积分流水（原因、变动额、时间）、预习区（学科、单元、笔记、疑问、状态）、专项突破（学科、薄弱点、目标、状态）、任务清单（文本、类型、日期、已完成、完成时间、学科）。

页面与交互：① 首页仪表盘——今日任务勾选完成即自动加积分、输入回车快速新增、可删除，显示完成进度；考试倒计时按日期排序、临近 7 天高亮、支持添加考试（名称+日期+科目）；每周课表按周一到周五逐节展示，点击格子可改科目；每日一句可换一句或自定义；今日心情打卡可附一句话。② 预习区——按学科新增预习（单元、笔记、疑问），可标记已复习、编辑删除。③ 错题本——录入错题（题目、错因、正确解法、掌握状态、下次复习日期），支持按学科分组和掌握状态看板两种视图、今日待复习筛选，标记已掌握记积分。④ 专项突破——为薄弱学科建立目标，进度在未开始/进行中/已达成间流转。⑤ 学科资料库——收集公式、笔记、试卷等内容，支持图片与外链。⑥ 家长留言板——积分明细全部留痕（任务/错题/预习/打卡自动加减分）；孩子用积分按价格申请兑换奖励，兑换自动扣分；爸妈可给孩子留言；设置里可改名字、各行为积分规则与奖励清单（名称+积分，一行一个）。PC 与移动端自适应。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 6 张数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library capability to build a same-style copy of https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/KSR5qI0MECB44ZjU6YhTf9 with data stored online and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click same-style flow; if unavailable, build it as follows: Build a "Study Workbench" for middle-school students and their parents, managing the learning process and family motivation in structured tables. Tables: Mistake Notebook (question, subject, grade, unit, mistake cause, correct solution, mastery status, next review), Subject Library (title, subject, type, content), Parent Messages (author, content, time, status, type), Points Log (reason, delta, time), Preview Zone (subject, unit, notes, questions, status), Breakthrough (subject, weak point, goal, status), Task List (text, type, date, done, completion time, subject). Pages and interactions: ① Dashboard — checking off a today-task auto-awards points, press Enter to add tasks quickly, deletable, with completion progress; exam countdown sorted by date with a 7-day approaching highlight, exams addable by name + date + subject; weekly timetable shown period by period, click a cell to change the subject; the daily quote can be shuffled or customized; today's mood check-in with an optional note. ② Preview Zone — add previews by subject (unit, notes, questions), mark reviewed, edit and delete. ③ Mistake Notebook — record mistakes (question, cause, correct solution, mastery status, next review date), browse by subject grouping or a mastery board, filter due-today, marking mastered awards points. ④ Breakthrough — set goals for weak subjects, progress flows through Not Started / In Progress / Achieved. ⑤ Subject Library — collect formulas, notes, and papers, with images and links. ⑥ Family Board — a full points log (tasks / mistakes / previews / check-ins auto add or subtract); the child redeems rewards at listed prices with points deducted automatically; parents leave messages; Settings edits the name, per-action point rules, and the reward list (name + price, one per line). responsive on PC and mobile.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus 6 data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.description_en:

cases.description: 企业法务、知识产权律师和商标代理人经常接到「修法了，快速给我一份新旧法对比」的需求，但手动翻阅条文、核对条号费时费力，还容易遗漏关键变化。本案例演示如何通过法律法规检索 Skill，分别调取现行有效的《商标法（2019 修正）》与尚未生效的《商标法（2026 修订）》原文，自动生成一份包含监管体制、诚实信用、恶意注册、商标代理、驰名商标、侵权赔偿、误导公众使用等重点主题的前后对比表和实务要点提示 HTML 报告。适合需要快速完成修法解读、客户汇报、合规培训或内部风控提示的法律从业者、企业知识产权负责人和商标代理机构。

It is designed for legal professionals, corporate IP managers, and trademark agencies who need to deliver amendment briefs, client updates, compliance training, or internal risk alerts quickly.

cases.prompt_en: Use the legal research Skill to retrieve the following topics from the Trademark Law of the People's Republic of China (2019 Amendment, currently effective) and the same law (2026 Amendment, not yet effective, scheduled to take effect on 2027-01-01): legislative purpose, supervision system, good-faith principle, bad-faith registration, trademark agency practice, well-known trademark protection, infringement damages, types of infringement acts, misleading public use, and penalties for bad-faith litigation. Compile the article numbers and text into a side-by-side comparison table, extract 8-10 practical tips, and output a single-file HTML with inline CSS, no external resources, and no hash anchors. Clearly label the 2026 Amendment as not yet effective at the top.

This case delivers a ready-to-use editorial package around “When Intelligence Becomes Cheap”: 12 headline options, three leads, a complete long-form essay, eight pull quotes, three follow-up issues, and a magazine-style reading page with a judgment compass and a data relationship graphic. The work draws on public sources from Microsoft, the World Economic Forum, Stanford HAI, and Anthropic, while clearly separating facts, analysis, and sample limitations.

Best for: brand content leads, knowledge creators, business-media editors, and corporate thought-leadership teams.

cases.description: 接手一个新项目要做视觉，最怕的就是没方向——脑子里只有「高级一点」「有质感一点」这种模糊词，落到配色、字体和圆角上还是无从下手。这套案例演示了把「晨间习惯打卡 App」这样一句话主题交给 UI 设计师，得到一本可翻阅的灵感手册：6 个差异明显的视觉方向（极简留白、编辑排版、暗色专注、温暖有机、新粗野主义、玻璃拟态），每个方向都给出配色板、字体搭配、形态参数，还有一块用该风格真实渲染的打卡界面示意，风格看得见摸得着；结尾附六方向气质定位图和选型建议，色板点击可复制色值。适合：正在给新产品定视觉方向的产品经理和设计师、需要快速产出多套风格提案的独立开发者、想学习设计系统参数化表达的前端工程师，以及接了设计需求但缺少灵感的创作者。
cases.description_en: Starting visual design on a new project with zero direction is painful—all you have are vague words like "make it premium" or "give it texture," and they collapse the moment you face concrete choices of color, type, and radius. This case shows what happens when you hand a one-line brief—"a morning habit check-in app"—to a UI designer: you get a browsable inspiration handbook with 6 distinctly different visual directions (quiet minimal, editorial, dark focus, warm organic, neo-brutalism, glassmorphism). Each direction includes a color palette, type pairing, form parameters, and a live check-in screen rendered in that style so the look is visible, not imagined. A positioning map and selection guide wrap it up, and every swatch is click-to-copy. Ideal for: PMs and designers setting the visual direction for a new product, indie developers who need multiple style proposals fast, front-end engineers learning parameterized design-system thinking, and creators who took on a design task but need inspiration.
cases.prompt:
我想为「晨间习惯打卡 App」做视觉设计，但现在完全没有方向。请你作为专业 UI 设计师，帮我生成一套设计灵感卡片（单文件 HTML，可直接离线打开）：

1. 给出 6 个差异明显的视觉方向（例如：极简留白、编辑排版、暗色专注、温暖有机、新粗野主义、玻璃拟态）
2. 每个方向做成一张完整的灵感卡片，包含：设计理念、配色板（含色值与用途标注）、字体搭配与字号比例、圆角/描边/阴影/留白等形态参数、情绪关键词、适用场景
3. 关键要求：每个方向配一块「组件微缩示意」——用该方向的视觉语言真实渲染一个打卡界面（习惯列表 + 主按钮），让风格看得见
4. 结尾给一张六方向气质定位图（冷静—温暖 × 克制—张扬两个维度）和简短的选择建议
5. 页面本身要有设计刊物级的排版质感，像一本可翻阅的灵感手册

把主题换成你自己的产品（如「手冲咖啡电商」「夜跑 App」）即可复用同样的方法。
cases.prompt_en:
I need to do the visual design for a "morning habit check-in app" but have no direction at all yet. Acting as a professional UI designer, generate a set of design inspiration cards for me (single-file HTML, openable offline):

cases.title: 超广角眼底照 AI 多病种筛查报告
cases.title_en: Ultra-Wide Fundus AI Multi-Disease Screening Report
cases.subtitle: 一张超广角眼底照，一次调用跑完 47 维体征 + 23 项疾病筛查，输出带病灶坐标的完整报告
cases.subtitle_en: One ultra-wide fundus photo, 47 sign dimensions and 23 diseases screened in a single call, with a full report including lesion coordinates
cases.description:
拿到医院拍的眼底照片，最难受的是看不懂——一张灰扑扑的圆形图，医生一句「有点问题，再观察」，回家只能自己瞎搜。想找个人认真解读，挂号又得等上两周。

这个案例把一张真实的左眼超广角眼底彩照交给腾讯觅影眼科 AI，实测约 54 秒返回结构化结果：23 项疾病推测诊断检出 3 项疑似（视网膜裂孔、玻璃体内硅油/气体填充物、增殖期糖网 PDR），47 维体征逐项判别得到 6 项阳性、30 项阴性、11 项不适用，还给出 4 个带坐标和置信度的病灶检测框（视网膜纤维膜 3 处，置信度 0.50/0.48/0.34）。报告没有停在罗列结果，而是把这些散点串成一条判读链——新生血管加纤维膜指向 PDR，光凝斑和硅油说明既往已治疗，纤维膜牵拉造成裂孔，而「视网膜脱离」为阴性意味着还在能用激光封孔预防脱离的时间窗内。同时如实标注了两个子模型结论冲突的低置信项（黄斑前膜 0.37 vs 分类阴性），建议以 OCT 复核。

适合：拿到眼底照片想读懂结果的患者及家属、需要快速初筛的基层与体检机构医生、糖尿病患者的眼底年度随访、眼科 AI 产品的能力验证、医学影像 AI 的落地评估。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part about getting a fundus photo from the hospital is that you cannot read it. You get a dim circular image, the doctor says "something looks off, let's watch it," and you go home to search blindly. Booking a specialist for a proper reading means waiting two more weeks.

This case hands a real left-eye ultra-wide fundus photo to the Tencent Miying ophthalmic AI and gets structured results back in about 54 seconds of measured wall-clock time: 3 of 23 diseases flagged as suspected (retinal hole, intravitreal silicone oil/gas tamponade, proliferative diabetic retinopathy), 47 sign dimensions resolved into 6 positive, 30 negative and 11 not-applicable, plus 4 lesion detection boxes with coordinates and confidence scores (three retinal fibrous membranes at 0.50, 0.48 and 0.34). The report does not stop at listing findings — it connects them into a reading chain: neovascularization plus fibrous membrane points to PDR, laser scars and silicone oil indicate prior treatment, membrane traction produced the retinal hole, and a negative retinal detachment means the case is still inside the window where laser can seal the hole and prevent detachment. It also honestly flags a low-confidence conflict between two sub-models (epiretinal membrane at 0.37 versus a negative classification) and recommends OCT confirmation.

Good for: patients and families trying to understand a fundus photo, primary-care and health-checkup physicians who need fast triage, annual retinal follow-up for diabetic patients, capability validation of ophthalmic AI products, and deployment evaluation of medical imaging AI.

artifacts.label: 超广角眼底 AI 分析报告（可视化网页版，含病灶位置示意图）
超广角眼底 AI 分析报告（Markdown 完整解读）
示例输入影像：超广角眼底彩照原图（左眼 OS，蔡司设备，4004×4008，5.15 MB）— 可直接用它复现本案例
觅影 AI 接口结构化返回结果

cases.prompt:
我朋友最近左眼不舒服，去医院做了一次超广角眼底检查，这里是她的超广角眼底照片（左眼 OS，蔡司 ZEISS 设备拍摄）。请帮我用腾讯眼科 AI 诊断专家分析这张图，并输出一份完整的分析报告。

要求：
1. 诊断结论必须来自眼底 AI 模型的真实接口返回，不要凭图像观感推断；如果调用失败请直接告诉我，不要编造结果。
2. 报告按「基本信息 → 青光眼评估 → 多病种筛查 → 病灶描述 → 综合诊断 → 建议」组织，明确标注眼别。只上传了左眼，**不要输出任何右眼结论，也不要把未上传写成正常或未见**。
3. 47 维体征要区分阳性 / 阴性 / 不适用三类，逐项标注接口索引以便核对，并说明「不适用」不等于正常；体征检测结果要给出病灶坐标和置信度。
4. 不要只罗列结果，请把阳性发现之间的临床关联串成判读逻辑链，并指出哪些结论置信度低、需要 OCT 或 FFA 复核。
5. 报告里属于你自己临床推断的部分（如风险分层、就诊建议）要与模型直接输出区分标注。
6. 若某项结果本次未返回（如体征分割掩膜），请如实写成「本次未输出」并给出可能原因，**不要断言该能力不存在，也不要为了拿到该结果而改用其他设备参数重跑**——那样会得到不可靠的结论。
7. 对专业术语（PDR、视网膜裂孔、光凝斑、杯盘比等）附通俗解释，最后给出就诊与复查建议，并声明 AI 结果不能替代医生诊断。

[上传超广角眼底彩照，注明眼别：左眼/右眼。本案例附带示例影像 `sample-input-ultra-wide-fundus-OS.jpg`（左眼 OS，蔡司设备），可直接使用它复现完整分析流程]
cases.prompt_en:
My friend has been having discomfort in her left eye and had an ultra-wide fundus examination at the hospital. Here is her ultra-wide fundus photo (left eye, OS, captured on a ZEISS device). Please analyze this image with the Tencent ophthalmic AI diagnosis expert and produce a complete analysis report.

Requirements:
1. Diagnostic conclusions must come from the real API response of the fundus AI model, not from visual impression of the image. If the call fails, tell me directly instead of fabricating results.
2. Organize the report as: basic information → glaucoma assessment → multi-disease screening → lesion description → integrated diagnosis → recommendations, with the eye side clearly labeled. Only the left eye was uploaded — **do not output any conclusion for the right eye, and never write "not uploaded" as normal or negative**.
3. For the 47 sign dimensions, separate positive / negative / not-applicable, label each with its API index for verification, and explain that "not applicable" does not mean normal. Detection results should include lesion coordinates and confidence scores.
4. Do not merely list findings — connect the positive findings into a clinical reasoning chain, and point out which conclusions have low confidence and need OCT or FFA confirmation.
5. Clearly mark which parts are your own clinical inference (risk stratification, follow-up advice) versus direct model output.
6. If some output is absent in this run (e.g. segmentation masks), state it honestly as "not returned in this run" with possible reasons — **do not claim the capability does not exist, and do not re-run with a different device parameter just to obtain that output**, as it would yield unreliable conclusions.
7. Add plain-language explanations for technical terms (PDR, retinal hole, laser scars, cup-to-disc ratio, etc.), close with follow-up recommendations, and state that AI results cannot replace a physician's diagnosis.

[Upload the ultra-wide fundus photo and specify the eye: left / right. This case ships a sample image `sample-input-ultra-wide-fundus-OS.jpg` (left eye OS, ZEISS device) that can be used directly to reproduce the full analysis]

cases.title: 大学 NPC 任务轴
cases.subtitle: 用任务地图串起报名、备考、打卡和考试节点

cases.description:
大学里的证书、考试和赛事常常错开报名、准考证、考试与查分日期，靠日历很难持续跟进。

这个案例演示了一个游戏化任务轴：把每项证书或赛事作为任务节点，自动按时间线排布并生成倒计时；已报名任务可拆成阶段计划，配合每日打卡、番茄专注、等级剧情和徽章反馈推进进度。

适合：同时准备多项证书或赛事的大学生、需要把学习节点集中管理的人，以及想用轻量游戏化机制保持学习节奏的人。
cases.description_en:
Registration, entry-slip, exam, and result dates for campus certificates and competitions often fall at different times, making it difficult to keep track with a calendar alone.

This case demonstrates a gamified questline: each certificate or competition becomes a timeline node with an automatic countdown. Registered quests can be broken into staged plans, supported by daily check-ins, Pomodoro focus sessions, level-based story progression, and milestone badges.

Suitable for university students preparing for several certificates or competitions, learners who want one place for their study milestones, and anyone who benefits from a lightweight gamified study rhythm.

请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://workbuddy.link/p/fpEkjaeWssZ9oAUGRWDeiu，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

做一个面向大学生的游戏化备考工作台，覆盖证书考试和专业赛事。核心有两张在线数据表：任务节点表记录名称、简称、类型、报名网站、报名地点、报名费用、报名起止、准考证起止、考试日期、查分日期、是否已报名和备考计划；打卡记录表记录节点、日期、科目、阶段和备注。

页面以任务时间轴为首页，按实际日期安排节点，临近报名、准考证、考试或查分自动高亮；已报名任务生成考试倒计时。提供任务新增、编辑、报名状态切换与删除，输入任务名称时从内置证书和赛事知识库匹配常规时间和阶段计划。

另设阶段任务打卡页，按月显示科目、重点、完成率与每日补卡；提供 25/5/15 分钟番茄钟、专注统计和学习标签；加入学习桌宠、经验等级、章节进度和连续打卡徽章。

视觉采用浅灰底、紫色渐变页头、白色卡片和金色奖励点缀；电脑端左侧导航加多栏主区，手机端折叠为流式布局。
