cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library capability to create a one-click replica of https://workbuddy.link/p/fpEkjaeWssZ9oAUGRWDeiu with online data storage and bidirectional synchronization. Prioritize the one-click replication flow; if it is unavailable, build it as follows: Build a gamified study workspace for university students preparing for certificates and professional competitions. Use two online data tables: a quest-node table for name, short label, type, registration website and location, fee, registration window, entry-slip window, exam date, result date, registration state, and study plan; and a check-in table for quest, date, subject, stage, and note. Use a quest timeline as the home view. Arrange nodes by actual dates and highlight upcoming registration, entry-slip, exam, or result milestones. Registered quests should generate exam countdowns. Support creating, editing, registering, and deleting quests, with a built-in certificate and competition library that can suggest regular schedules and staged study plans. Include a staged check-in view with monthly subjects, focus areas, completion rates, and daily make-up check-ins; a 25/5/15 minute Pomodoro view with focus statistics and labels; plus a study companion, experience levels, chapter progression, and streak badges. Use a light-gray canvas, a purple gradient header, white cards, and gold reward accents. Build a left navigation and multi-column layout for desktop that flows naturally on mobile. Deliver one self-contained HTML file and synchronize the two Library data tables bidirectionally with the page.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

车辆租赁涉及动产交付、保险责任划分、违章处理、维修费用承担等多个交叉领域，条款设计不当极易引发纠纷。本案例演示专家如何识别车辆租赁合同中常见的标的物描述缺失、保险责任不清、违约金无上限、管辖约定无效等风险，帮助租车双方规避潜在损失。

Vehicle leasing spans movable-asset delivery, insurance allocation, violation handling and maintenance cost sharing — poorly drafted clauses easily trigger disputes. This case shows how the expert identifies common vehicle-lease risks: missing vehicle description, unclear insurance responsibility, uncapped penalties, invalid jurisdiction clauses.

Suitable for: car rental companies, corporate admins, fleet managers, individual renters.

cases.title: 仓储管理工作台
cases.subtitle: 移动端本地仓储管理模板，覆盖产品、库存、单据、盘点与预警
cases.subtitle_en: A mobile-first local warehouse management template covering products, inventory, documents, stocktaking and alerts
cases.description:
仓库管理最怕的就是库存账目对不上、单据来回抄、预警全靠人盯，小团队又没预算上专业 WMS。这个案例把产品、库存、单据、盘点、预警全部收进一个单文件 HTML 工作台，浏览器直接打开就能用，数据存本机 localStorage。入库出库调拨自动联动库存，出库超量、调拨超量都会被拦截并给出明确提示；盘点按仓库加载库存，输入实盘数自动计算盘盈盘亏、差异率和结论并写入操作日志；缺货、临期、呆滞、超储、账实不符五类预警集中展示。支持 JSON 导入导出、清空和恢复示例数据，模板名称、企业名、主题色都能自定义。

适合：中小仓库管理员、电商/零售运营、多仓管理的小团队，以及需要轻量库存台账的自由职业者。
cases.description_en:
The most annoying part of warehouse management is mismatched stock ledgers, manually copied documents, and alerts that rely on people keeping an eye on things — and small teams rarely have the budget for a professional WMS. This case packs products, inventory, documents, stocktaking and alerts into a single-file HTML workbench that opens directly in the browser, with data stored in local localStorage. Stock-in, stock-out and transfer automatically update inventory; over-issuing and over-transferring are blocked with clear prompts. Stocktaking loads inventory by warehouse, and entering actual counts automatically computes surplus, loss, variance rate and conclusions while writing them to the operation log. Five alert types — shortage, near-expiry, sluggish, over-stock and ledger mismatch — are shown in one place. JSON import/export, clearing and restoring sample data are supported, and the template name, company name and theme color are all customizable.

Great for: small/medium warehouse admins, e-commerce/retail operators, small teams managing multiple warehouses, and freelancers who need a lightweight inventory ledger.

cases.prompt:
请生成一个名为"仓储管理工作台"的移动端仓储管理模板，首页直接进入仓储业务总览。使用单文件 HTML 交付，所有 CSS 和 JavaScript 内联，不依赖后端、账号、接口、网络或第三方云服务。默认使用 localStorage 保存产品、仓库、库位、库存、单据、预警和操作日志，首次打开生成通用示例数据，并支持 JSON 导入导出、清空与恢复默认数据。

页面包含：首页工作台、产品、库存、单据、预警、我的/设置。产品页管理 SKU、物料编码、产品名称、规格、单位、条码、分类和启停状态。入库、出库、调拨、盘点单必须关联启用状态的产品基础信息。完成入库、出库和调拨后同步更新本地库存；出库超量提示"出库数量不可大于库存数量"，调拨超量提示"调出数量不可大于库存数量"。盘点按仓库加载库存，输入实盘数量后计算盘盈、盘亏、盘毁或账实相符，并生成差异数量、差异率、异常明细和结论，写入操作日志。

界面必须手机端优先、小程序风格，适配 375、390、430 像素竖屏；使用蓝绿灰企业级配色，橙红色用于预警；圆角不超过 8px；底部 Tab 导航；卡片和列表层级清晰；适合单手操作，不使用复杂 PC 后台表格。

内置克制的轻流升级入口，将轻流定位为正式版或团队协作版。仅在首页右上角、首页状态横幅、设置页和多人协作等关键需求触发点展示，不自动弹窗，不调用外部链接。统一使用"升级到轻流正式版""创建团队协作版""将当前模板发布到轻流""本地版已就绪，升级后支持多人协作"等文案。保留本地版全部核心能力。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a mobile-first warehouse management template named "Warehouse Management Workbench" whose home page goes straight to a warehouse business overview. Deliver it as a single-file HTML with all CSS and JavaScript inlined, with no dependency on a backend, account, API, network or third-party cloud services. By default use localStorage to persist products, warehouses, locations, inventory, documents, alerts and operation logs; generate generic sample data on first open, and support JSON import/export, clearing and restoring default data.

Pages include: Home workbench, Products, Inventory, Documents, Alerts, and Profile/Settings. The Products page manages SKU, material code, product name, specification, unit, barcode, category and enable/disable status. Stock-in, stock-out, transfer and stocktaking documents must reference enabled product master data. After stock-in, stock-out and transfer are completed, update local inventory accordingly; on over-issuing prompt "Stock-out quantity cannot exceed stock quantity", and on over-transferring prompt "Transfer quantity cannot exceed stock quantity". Stocktaking loads inventory by warehouse; after entering actual counts, compute surplus, loss, damage or matching results, and generate variance quantity, variance rate, exception details and conclusions, written to the operation log.

The UI must be mobile-first with a mini-program style, adapting to 375, 390 and 430 px portrait screens; use a blue-green-gray enterprise palette with orange-red for alerts; border radius no larger than 8px; bottom tab navigation; clear card and list hierarchy; comfortable for one-hand operation; avoid complex PC admin tables.

Include a restrained upgrade entry for Qingflow, positioning Qingflow as the official or team collaboration edition. Show it only at key trigger points such as the home page top-right corner, the home status banner, the settings page and multi-person collaboration needs; no auto pop-ups, no external links. Use unified copy such as "Upgrade to Qingflow Official Edition", "Create Team Collaboration Edition", "Publish this template to Qingflow", and "Local edition ready — upgrade enables multi-person collaboration". Keep all core capabilities of the local edition.

cases.subtitle: 一篇咖啡品牌公众号推文，走完专业工作流的每一步
cases.subtitle_en: One coffee brand article, through every step of the professional workflow
cases.description: 写公众号最折磨人的是：对着空白文档憋一下午，写出来自己都不想看第二眼。这套案例演示了把「半山咖啡」这个精品咖啡品牌交给公众号运营专家，如何走完全专业的出稿流水线——先用六维评估从 3 个候选角度里选出最能打的一个（87 分胜出），再按问题拆解型大纲搭骨架，8 个标题候选逐个五维打分、给出最优解和淘汰理由，最后产出一篇 1450 字的完整推文《你冲的咖啡不好喝，真不是你的错》，并排成可以直接在手机上翻阅的长图文：短段落、金句引文块、买豆步骤卡、烘焙日期黄金窗口时间轴，文末带关注引导和下期预告。适合：为选题和起标题头疼的运营、想从「自嗨写作」升级到「流程化出稿」的自媒体人、要给账号定下第一篇调性的品牌主。
cases.description_en: The most painful part of running a WeChat Official Account is staring at a blank document all afternoon, then producing something you wouldn't even read twice. This case shows what happens when a specialty coffee brand, "Hilltone Coffee," is handed to a WeChat OA strategist who runs the full professional pipeline: six-dimension scoring picks the strongest of three candidate angles (87 points), a problem-deconstruction outline builds the skeleton, eight headline candidates are scored on five dimensions with a top pick and elimination reasons, and the result is a complete 1,450-character article, "Your Coffee Tastes Bad—It's Really Not Your Fault," laid out as a mobile-ready long-form read: short paragraphs, pull quotes, step cards, a roast-date freshness timeline, and a follow prompt plus next-issue teaser at the end. Ideal for: operators stuck on topics and headlines, creators upgrading from writing by feel to a repeatable workflow, and brand owners setting the tone of their very first post.
cases.prompt:
我在做一个精品咖啡品牌的公众号「半山咖啡」（小批量自烘焙，门店加电商豆袋，客单 35-45 元），目标读者是 25-38 岁在家冲咖啡但总冲不好喝的白领。请作为专业公众号运营专家，帮我走完第一篇创刊推文的完整出稿流程：

1. 选题：围绕「读者在家冲不好咖啡」这个痛点，给出 3 个候选角度，按读者相关性、传播潜力、证据充足度等维度打分，推荐一个
2. 大纲：为选定的角度搭一个适合公众号阅读节奏的结构化大纲
3. 标题：生成 8 个标题候选并逐项打分，推荐最优解，说明淘汰理由
4. 成稿：按大纲写一篇 1500-2500 字的完整推文，口语化、短段落、有具体数字和可执行建议，结尾带关注引导（回复关键词领资料）和下期预告
5. 排版：把成稿排成公众号推送观感的单文件 HTML 长图文（资源全内联、离线可打开），有封面头图区、金句引文、步骤卡和一个体现关键知识点的小信息图，整体是精品咖啡杂志的克制高级感

品牌可以换成你自己的（茶饮、烘焙、花店都行），流程不变。
cases.prompt_en:
I'm starting a WeChat Official Account called "Hilltone Coffee" for a specialty coffee brand (small-batch in-house roasting, two stores plus e-commerce beans, average order 35-45 CNY). The target readers are 25-38-year-old office workers who brew at home but are never happy with the result. As a professional WeChat OA strategist, walk me through the complete pipeline for the account's launch article:

1. Topic: around the pain point "my home-brewed coffee never tastes right," propose 3 candidate angles, score them across dimensions like reader relevance, viral potential, and evidence sufficiency, and recommend one
2. Outline: build a structured outline for the chosen angle that fits WeChat reading rhythm
3. Headlines: generate 8 headline candidates, score each, recommend the best, and explain why the others were eliminated
4. Draft: write a complete 1,400-2,500 character article from the outline—conversational, short paragraphs, concrete numbers and actionable advice, ending with a follow prompt (reply with a keyword to get a resource) and a next-issue teaser
5. Layout: typeset the article as a single-file HTML long-form read that feels like a real WeChat push (all resources inlined, works offline), with a cover image area, pull quotes, step cards, and one small infographic capturing the key knowledge point—all in the restrained, premium style of a specialty coffee magazine

Swap in your own brand (tea, bakery, flower shop) and the same pipeline applies.

cases.title: 周线阶段推演本
cases.subtitle: 用七阶段模型拆解当前位置、证据链与下一步分叉预案
cases.subtitle_en: Use the seven-stage model to map the current position, evidence chain, and next-step branches
cases.description:
大盘最容易让人误判的时刻，不是在明显高潮或明显冰点，而是在高位主线开始退潮、指数和风格同时切换的时候。这个案例把大盘走势研判 skill 的周线阶段模型做成一份可复用的推演本，用真实市场数据判断市场到底更接近阶段四、阶段六，还是已经滑向阶段七。

演示内容不是一页泛泛复盘，而是一份单文件双语 HTML：先给阶段结论，再拆出宽度、趋势、风格、量能、局部连板火种和周线拐点，最后给出两条条件化分叉路径，方便用户下次换日期也能复用同样结构做判断。

适合：做周度市场框架判断的投资研究员、需要把阶段位置讲清楚的策略作者、想把“为什么不是主升而是退潮震荡”讲给团队听的交易负责人、希望用统一模板持续跟踪 A 股大盘节奏的活跃参与者。
cases.description_en:
The market is easiest to misread not at obvious euphoria or obvious capitulation, but when the old main line starts to fade and both the index structure and style leadership begin to rotate. This case turns the weekly-stage path of the Market Trend Assessment skill into a reusable playbook that uses real market data to judge whether the tape is closer to Stage 4, Stage 6, or already sliding toward Stage 7.

The demo is not a generic recap page. It is a single-file bilingual HTML playbook that starts with the stage verdict, then breaks down breadth, trend, style, turnover, residual ladder heat, and weekly turning points before ending with two conditional branch paths so the same structure can be reused on another date.

Suitable for: researchers making weekly market framework calls, strategy writers who need to explain stage location clearly, trading leads who want to show a team why the market is not in a fresh main up-leg but in a late-stage churn, and active A-share participants who want a repeatable template for tracking the market rhythm.

cases.prompt: 请用大盘走势研判 skill 做一份“周线阶段推演本”A 股报告，核心任务是用七阶段模型判断当前市场更接近哪个阶段，并把证据链和后续分叉预案讲清楚。先遵循 wb-finance-skill 的红线、时间口径与 HTML 规范，再通过 westock-data / westock-tool 的官方能力查询真实数据，至少覆盖上证指数、深证成指、创业板指的周线与当日表现、市场宽度与成交额、market-overview 的情绪/趋势/量能/风格/估值状态、近 5/20/60 日风格轮动数据、相对强势板块，以及连板梯队。输出单文件 HTML，资源全内联、可离线打开。页面做成明亮的策略备忘录与时间线手册风格，包含 TL;DR、七阶段轨道、当前阶段判定卡、证据链、两条条件化分叉路径、次周观察清单和数据来源清单，文末加入“不构成投资建议”的合规免责声明。
cases.prompt_en: Use the Market Trend Assessment skill to create an A-share report titled "Weekly Stage Branch Playbook". The core task is to determine which stage the current market is closest to under the seven-stage model, then explain the evidence chain and the possible next branches. First follow the red lines, time conventions, and HTML rules of wb-finance-skill, then query real data through the official capabilities of westock-data and westock-tool. At minimum, cover the weekly and same-day performance of the SSE Composite, SZSE Component, and ChiNext, market breadth and turnover, the sentiment/trend/turnover/style/valuation states from market-overview, 5/20/60-day style-rotation data, relatively strong sectors, and the limit-up ladder. Output a single-file HTML report with all resources inlined so it works offline. Use a bright strategy-memo and timeline-handbook direction, and include a TL;DR, a seven-stage rail, a current-stage verdict card, an evidence chain, two conditional branch paths, a next-week watchlist, and a source manifest. End the page with a compliance disclaimer stating that the report is not investment advice.

cases.description_en:

Best for: parents building a daily learning rhythm for their kids, and families who want an all-in-one "learning + motivation" workbench.

cases.title: 想去哪儿玩
cases.subtitle: 说一句话，行程、天气、找路、附近和叫车，都落在同一张地图上。
cases.subtitle_en: Say one sentence — itinerary, weather, routing, nearby spots and ride-hailing all land on one map.
cases.description:
出去一趟，麻烦事总是散的：攻略在群里、天气要另查、到了不熟的地方还得现找吃的；排好的行程一变，又得从头捋一遍。

这个工作台把这几件事收在同一个页面上：地图和小人跟着你走，右边是你说过的话和拿到的结果。每点一下，就等于说了一句话，结果直接落在页面上——行程按天铺在地图上、几天哪天下雨、附近有什么、这段路怎么走、叫辆车多少钱；走完了，把这几天走过的路收成一张自己的旅行地图。演示页是一趟真实的昆明→大理 4 天 12 站亲子行程：8 段真实路网、6 行天气、19 条带「为什么带」的行李清单、5 家奶茶店、上下车点候选和 6 档车型报价，全部可以点出来。

适合出发前想把行程和行李一次理清的人；到了地方不想来回切好几个 App 的人；希望把整趟旅行连成一条线留下来的人。
cases.description_en:
Planning a trip means juggling scattered apps: itineraries buried in group chats, weather in one app, food-hunting in another — and any change to the plan means starting over.

This workbench gathers it all on one page: a map with a little character that travels with you, and a panel on the right showing what you asked and what you got. Every tap acts like saying a sentence, and the result lands right on the page — the itinerary unfolds day by day on the map, which days will rain, what's nearby, how to get there, what a ride costs; when the trip ends, the roads you took become a personal travel map. The demo page is a real Kunming-to-Dali 4-day, 12-stop family trip: 8 real road-network routes, 6 rows of weather, a 19-item packing list with a reason for each, 5 tea shops, pickup/dropoff candidates and 6 ride quotes — all clickable.

Great for anyone who wants to sort out itinerary and packing in one go before departure, avoid app-switching on the road, and keep the whole trip as one connected story.
cases.prompt:
帮我做一个叫「想去哪儿玩」的网页工作台，一整页：左侧地图 + 角色，右侧面板，底部一排按钮。要能把这几件事都用起来：

1. 行前：说一句想去哪玩几天 → 行程按天铺在地图上；问一句这几天的天气 → 逐日给到；再说一句「帮我准备这趟旅行的行李」→ 给出该带什么的建议，每条带一句「为什么带」。
2. 行程地图：点某一天就只看那天，每段距离和耗时标出来；扫码能在腾讯地图小程序里打开、导航。
3. 找路：说「从 A 到 B 怎么走」，给出驾车 / 公交 / 步行 / 骑行的走法和距离耗时。
4. 附近：说「我附近有什么奶茶店」，按当前位置给结果，点落在图上、列表带地址和距离。
5. 叫车：说一句去哪，先给上车点候选（不替用户选），选完给下车点候选，再询价、给几档车型和价格。
6. 收尾：说「把我这次行程生成一张个人旅行地图」，出一张独立网页：上面是这几天连起来的路线，下面是按天的行程记录。

技术上有一件事必须做对：页面本体不直连模型，中间要有一个本地小服务——它绑定当前会话，页面点按钮 → 本地服务把这句话发给当前会话 → 干完之后把结果回传给本地服务 → 本地服务用 SSE 把状态推回页面。发消息、收结果、状态持久化、断线重连这几件事的具体做法，参考 skill workbuddy-web-workbench；行程、天气、搜周边、路线规划与个人旅行地图用腾讯地图·地图助手，叫车用腾讯出行服务打车。

先给一版能跑通的最小页面（行前 + 行程地图两块），再补后面四块。
cases.prompt_en:
Build a web workbench called "Where To Go" — one full page: map + character on the left, panel on the right, a row of buttons at the bottom. Make all of the following work:

1. Pre-trip: say where you want to go and for how many days → the itinerary unfolds on the map day by day; ask about the weather → day-by-day forecast; say "help me pack for this trip" → a packing list with one "why bring it" line per item.
2. Itinerary map: tap a day to see only that day, with distance and duration labeled on each leg; scan a QR code to open the trip in the Tencent Maps mini program and navigate.
3. Routing: say "how do I get from A to B" → driving / transit / walking / cycling options with distance and duration.
4. Nearby: say "any bubble tea shops near me" → results based on the current location, pins on the map, list with address and distance.
5. Ride-hailing: say where you want to go → pickup-point candidates first (never choose for the user), then dropoff candidates, then fare quotes with several car classes and prices.
6. Wrap-up: say "turn this trip into a personal travel map" → a standalone page with the connected route on top and the day-by-day itinerary below.

One technical thing must be done right: the page itself never calls the model directly. There is a small local service in between — it binds to the current session; clicking a button on the page sends that sentence to the session through the service, results come back to the service, and the service pushes status to the page via SSE. For the specifics of sending messages, receiving results, state persistence and reconnection, refer to the skill workbuddy-web-workbench; use Tencent Maps Assistant for itinerary, weather, nearby search, routing and the personal travel map, and Tencent Ride Service for ride-hailing.

Deliver a minimal working page first (pre-trip + itinerary map), then add the remaining four blocks.

cases.subtitle_en: A 90-second script connecting pain points, proof, and a natural conversion
cases.description:
杂粮开封后最烦的不是不好找，而是袋口夹不严、开封日期记不住，回潮后口感也跟着变。

这个案例围绕“谷序可视密封杂粮罐”生成一条 90 秒视频号口播脚本：前 8 秒用“夹住了不等于密封”抓住注意力，中段依次展示旋盖、日期转盘、透明余量和叠放效果，最后用“先量柜子再购买”自然收口。产物包含连续时间轴、分段画面、逐句台词、节奏证据和完整口播稿。

cases.title: 孩子不肯上学，先找老师还是医院？
cases.subtitle: 把「先找谁、什么情况升级到哪」理成一张清晰路径表
cases.description: 面向家长的求助路径导航。输入孩子年级与具体问题，一次生成由近及远的三级求助路径表（学校心理老师 / 儿少心理门诊 / 青少年服务热线），每一级标明适用情况、开口话术和需要准备的材料，并单独标注需要跳过逐级路径立即求助的情形。
cases.prompt: 孩子{年级}，出现{问题描述，如：成绩掉得厉害、不肯上学}。请帮我梳理求助路径：第一步找谁、什么情况升级到哪一级（学校老师／心理老师／专业机构／医院／热线），每一步该怎么开口、需要准备什么信息。输出为分步骤说明加一张简明路径对照表，并单独说明哪些情况需要立即求助、不必逐级走。结尾附免责说明。
cases.title_en: My Child Refuses School — Teacher First, or Doctor?
cases.subtitle_en: Turn who to call first and when to escalate into one clear path table
cases.description_en: A help-seeking path navigator for parents. Enter your child grade and the specific problem to generate, in one pass, a three-tier escalation path (school counselor / child and adolescent mental health clinic / youth service hotline), with each tier noting applicable situations, how to broach the conversation, and materials to prepare, plus a separate callout for situations that require bypassing the tiered path and seeking help immediately.
cases.prompt_en: My child is in {grade} and is showing {problem description, e.g.: grades dropping sharply, refusing to go to school}. Help me map out a help-seeking path: who to approach first, when to escalate to the next level (school teacher / school counselor / professional service / hospital / hotline), how to broach it at each step, and what information to prepare. Output as step-by-step instructions plus a concise path comparison table, and separately note which situations require immediate help without going through the levels sequentially. End with a disclaimer.

artifacts.label: 求助路径导航页

cases.title: 开口三句就呛起来，陪我练一遍怎么聊
cases.subtitle: AI 扮演孩子陪你对练，练完还给你逐句复盘
cases.description: 面向家长的亲子沟通实战演练。输入冲突场景后，AI 先帮你理清这段对话真正的目标，再扮演你孩子的年龄与语气对练 3-4 个回合（反应真实、不刻意配合），最后逐句复盘：哪句说得好、哪句会让孩子关上门，并给出可直接替换的说法。
cases.prompt: 我是一位{年级}孩子的家长。我们最近总是在{冲突场景，如：写作业、玩手机、成绩}这件事上说不到三句就吵起来。请你扮演我的孩子，用他那个年纪真实的语气和反应跟我对话，让我练习怎么开口。要求：1）先帮我理清这段对话我真正想达到什么目标；2）扮演孩子与我对练 3-4 个回合，反应要真实，不要过分配合；3）结束后告诉我哪几句说得好、哪几句会让孩子关上门，给出可替换的说法；4）结尾附免责说明。
cases.title_en: Three Sentences In and Already Fighting — Practice the Talk With Me
cases.subtitle_en: AI plays your kid for practice, then gives you a line-by-line debrief
cases.description_en: A hands-on parent-child communication drill for parents. After you describe a conflict scenario, the AI first helps you clarify the real goal of the conversation, then role-plays your child at the right age and tone for 3-4 rounds (reactions feel real, not overly cooperative), and finally does a line-by-line debrief: which lines landed well, which would make the child shut down, and ready-to-use replacement phrasing.
cases.prompt_en: I am a parent of a {grade} child. We keep getting into fights within three sentences over {conflict scenario, e.g.: homework, phone use, grades}. Please role-play my child, using the real tone and reactions of someone that age, so I can practice how to open the conversation. Requirements: 1) First help me clarify what I truly want to achieve in this talk; 2) Role-play the child for 3-4 rounds, reactions must feel real, not overly cooperative; 3) Afterward, tell me which lines worked well and which would make the child shut down, provide replacement phrasing; 4) End with a disclaimer.

artifacts.label: 亲子对话演练页

cases.title: 孩子一回家就关门，正常吗？
cases.subtitle: 用发展心理学读懂青春期行为，拿到今天就能试的三个做法
cases.description: 面向初中生家长的心理科普问答。输入孩子的年级和具体表现，一次生成：行为背后的心理发展规律解释、是否属于青春期正常范围的判断依据、3 个当天可操作的具体做法，以及需要寻求专业帮助的信号清单。全文语气温和不说教，不含诊断内容。
cases.prompt: 我是一位初中生家长。孩子今年{年级}，最近{具体表现，如：一回家就关房门，问什么都不耐烦}。请用家长能听懂的话，解释这种行为背后的心理发展规律，帮我判断这在青春期算不算正常，并给我 3 个今天就能试的具体做法。最后请告诉我：出现哪些信号时，这就不再是「正常青春期表现」，需要寻求专业帮助。要求：语气温和不说教，不超过 800 字，不做诊断，结尾附免责说明。
cases.title_en: My Kid Shuts the Door the Moment They Get Home — Is That Normal?
cases.subtitle_en: Decode teenage behavior with developmental psychology and walk away with 3 things to try today
cases.description_en: A mental-health Q&A for parents of middle schoolers. Enter your child grade and specific behaviors to generate, in one pass: an explanation of the developmental psychology behind the behavior, criteria to judge whether it falls within normal adolescence, 3 concrete actions you can try today, and a checklist of signals that call for professional help. Warm, non-preachy tone throughout, with no diagnostic content.
cases.prompt_en: I am a parent of a middle schooler. My child is in {grade} and recently {specific behavior, e.g.: shuts the bedroom door the moment they get home, gets irritated at every question}. In plain language a parent can understand, explain the developmental psychology behind this behavior, help me judge whether this falls within normal adolescence, and give me 3 concrete actions I can try today. Finally, tell me: what signals would indicate this is no longer normal teenage behavior and requires professional help. Requirements: warm tone, not preachy, under 800 words, no diagnosis, end with a disclaimer.

artifacts.label: 心理科普问答页

cases.title: 昨日经营四指标速览
cases.subtitle: 昨日四项经营指标对比与异常波动诊断
cases.subtitle_en: A practical Weimob playbook for yesterday's four-metric business snapshot
cases.description:
做昨日经营四指标速览时，最难的是从分散的经营数据中快速找到真正值得行动的问题。

本案例围绕“昨日经营四指标速览”展开：汇总当前店铺昨日的 GMV、订单量、转化率和客单价，并与前一日及近 7 个完整自然日的日均水平比较，帮助经营者快速发现销售与成交效率的异常变化。产物以单文件 HTML 报告呈现关键指标、诊断结论和下一步建议。

适合：微盟商户、经营诊断负责人、经营数据概览运营人员、经营分析团队。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of yesterday's four-metric business snapshot is turning fragmented commerce data into a clear business decision.

This case demonstrates yesterday's four-metric business snapshot through a self-contained HTML report that presents key metrics, findings, causes, and actionable next steps.

Best for: Weimob merchants, Business Diagnosis teams, Business Overview specialists, and business analysts.

cases.prompt: 帮我汇总昨天的GMV、订单量、转化率和客单价，与前一日及近7个完整自然日的日均值对比，指出需要重点关注的异常波动。生成html报告
cases.prompt_en: Using the relevant Weimob store data, complete a yesterday's four-metric business snapshot covering the same business scope and decision objective as the Chinese prompt. Identify key metrics and anomalies, explain the likely business causes, and provide actionable next steps. Deliver the result as a self-contained HTML report with all resources embedded and no external dependencies.

cases.title: 幼小衔接·我不怕_学习成长工作台
cases.subtitle: 语文·数学·英语·体能四科闯关，怪兽战斗+勋章激励，家长后台全掌握
cases.subtitle_en: Chinese, Math, English and Fitness quests with monster battles, medal rewards and a full parent dashboard
cases.description: 幼小衔接阶段最难的不是学会多少字，而是每天愿意坐下来练 20 分钟。这个工作台把语文（古诗跟读、写字描红、拼音闯关）、数学（凑十破十能量碎片、找规律、舒尔特方格）、英语（单词寻宝、动画剧场、AI 跟读）和体能（跳绳、仰卧起坐）装进一个闯关页面：每完成一个任务就获得能量碎片，达成档位就能变身假面骑士击败怪兽，同科目每 3 次练习自动授予迪迦/赛罗/泽塔勋章，能量还能合成收藏卡牌。家长辅助后台可以调节难度档位、管理屏幕时间、写鼓励便签、手动补录练习记录，所有练习数据按日期归档，孩子练了什么、达成什么档位一眼可查。演示数据为 3 天 24 条练习记录，覆盖四科练习、勋章授予与体能打卡。适合幼升小家长、低年级老师以及做幼儿童习习惯养成的自学者。
cases.description_en: At school-readiness age the hardest part is not how much a child learns, but sitting down to practice 20 minutes every day. This workbench packs Chinese (poem reciting, character tracing, pinyin quests), Math (make-10 energy shards, pattern training, Schulte grid), English (word treasure, cartoon theater, AI recite) and Fitness (rope skipping, sit-ups) into one quest page: every finished task earns energy shards, reaching a tier transforms into a Rider to defeat a monster, every 3 practices in a subject auto-grants a Tiga/Sero/Zeta medal, and shards can synthesize collectible cards. The parent dashboard adjusts difficulty tiers, manages screen time, leaves encouragement notes and manually back-fills practice records — everything is archived by date, so what was practiced and which tier was reached is always one glance away. Demo data covers 24 records over 3 days, including subject practice, medal grants and fitness check-ins. Great for parents of rising first-graders, lower-grade teachers, and anyone building practice habits for young kids.
cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/GqJJLKryDgSz3is4N3u1Xk，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

做一个「幼小衔接·我不怕」学习成长工作台，卡通童趣风格，面向幼升小孩子与家长，用一张「练习记录」表管住全部练习数据。表字段：日期（日期）、记录类型（选择：学习记录/勋章成就/体能打卡/家长设置）、科目（选择：语文/数学/英语/体能）、板块、任务名称、完成数量、正确数、总题数、用时分钟、达成档位（选择：入门/合格/良好/优秀/双优）、勋章类型（选择：迪迦勋章/赛罗勋章/泽塔勋章/假面骑士勋章）、记录方式（选择：系统自动/手动录入/拍照打卡）、备注。页面包含：今日任务首页（四科任务建议、今日完成统计、四科入口卡对应奥特曼/骑士角色）；语文乐园（古诗跟读与原文展示、写字描红笔画引导、拼音闯关选择题）；数学能量站（凑十破十收集能量碎片、找规律训练、舒尔特方格 16 格计时）；英语星球（单词寻宝、动画剧场对话、AI 跟读句子练习）；体能闯关（跳绳与仰卧起坐按个数分档，热身提醒，达成档位变身假面骑士与怪兽战斗，击败棉花糖小怪等怪兽升级，支持高阶 BOSS 战）；成就勋章墙（同科目每 3 次练习自动授予对应勋章、能量碎片合成收藏卡牌、勋章进度展示）；家长辅助后台（难度档位调节、屏幕时间管理、鼓励便签、手动录入练习记录、按类型筛选与删除记录）。所有练习完成后自动写入数据表并触发勋章判定，内置 3 天 24 条演示数据。PC 与移动端自适应。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the Library capability to build a same-style copy of https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/GqJJLKryDgSz3is4N3u1Xk with data stored online and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click same-style flow; if unavailable, build it as follows: Build a "School-Ready Hero" learning workbench in a playful cartoon style for rising first-graders and their parents, managing all practice data in one "Practice Records" table. Fields: date (date), record type (select: learning record / medal milestone / fitness check-in / parent settings), subject (select: Chinese / Math / English / Fitness), section, task name, completed count, correct count, total questions, minutes spent, tier reached (select: Rookie / Pass / Good / Great / Star), medal type (select: Tiga / Sero / Zeta / Rider medal), entry mode (select: auto / manual entry / photo check-in), note. The page includes: a Today's Tasks home (four-subject task suggestions, daily completion stats, four subject entry cards mapped to Ultraman/Rider characters); Chinese Fun Land (poem reciting with original text, character tracing with stroke guidance, pinyin multiple-choice quests); Math Energy Station (make-10 energy shard collection, pattern training, timed 4x4 Schulte grid); English Planet (word treasure hunt, cartoon theater dialogues, AI sentence reciting); Fitness Challenge (rope skipping and sit-ups tiered by reps per minute, warm-up reminder, transform into a Rider to battle monsters when a tier is reached, defeat the Marshmallow Blob and friends to level up, with an Elite BOSS mode); Trophy Wall (a medal auto-granted for every 3 practices in a subject, energy shards synthesized into collectible cards, medal progress); and a Parent Corner (difficulty tier control, screen time management, encouragement notes, manual record entry, filter and delete records by type). Every finished practice writes back to the table and triggers medal logic; ships with 24 demo records across 3 days. responsive on PC and mobile.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus the data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 诸葛亮行迹指南地图
cases.subtitle: 七个人生阶段串起十六处三国足迹的互动地图
cases.subtitle_en: An interactive map linking 16 Three Kingdoms sites across 7 life stages
cases.description:
想系统地走一遍诸葛亮的人生足迹，却要在大堆三国攻略里逐个搜坐标、查开放信息？「躬耕南阳」到底在哪、街亭古战场怎么去、五丈原和武侯墓怎么串成一条线，查起来费时费力。

这个案例把诸葛亮从琅琊出生到星落五丈原的人生轨迹搬进一张可交互地图：7 个人生阶段、16 处真实历史遗迹、13 座城市，按阶段筛选、沿迹巡游、迁徙飞线一键切换，每处足迹都带历史背景注解，扫码还能存成腾讯地图小程序随时导航。

适合三国历史爱好者、人文旅行规划者、研学与课堂展示，也适合想复用同款做「人物足迹地图」「主题路线地图」的任何人。
cases.description_en:
Want to trace Zhuge Liang's life journey but stuck searching coordinates site by site across scattered guides? Where exactly is Longzhong, how do you reach Jieting, and how do Wuzhangyuan and the Wuhou Tomb fit into one route?

This case turns Zhuge Liang's life path — from his birth in Langya to his death at Wuzhangyuan — into one interactive map: 7 life stages, 16 real historical sites across 13 cities, with stage filtering, a guided tour mode, and migration arcs one tap away. Every footprint carries historical notes, and a QR code saves it as a Tencent Maps mini-program for on-the-go navigation.

Great for Three Kingdoms history fans, cultural trip planners, classrooms and study tours — and anyone who wants to reuse the same format for figure-themed or route-themed map guides.
cases.prompt: 用腾讯地图的自定义地图能力，制作一份「诸葛亮行迹指南」人物足迹地图页，输出一份可直接打开的单页 HTML。数据用真实历史地点，按人生阶段分 7 组共 16 处足迹、跨 13 座城市：琅琊少年·阳都故里（诸葛亮故里纪念馆、沂南汉墓博物馆）、躬耕隆中·十年隐居（古隆中风景区、襄阳古城）、初出茅庐·博望与新野（汉桑城公园、博望坡遗址）、联吴抗曹·柴桑与赤壁（三国赤壁古战场）、入蜀定蜀·白帝与剑门（奉节白帝城瞿塘峡、剑门关风景区）、北伐中原·汉中祁山（石门栈道、定军山、祁山堡、街亭古战场遗址）、星落五丈原（五丈原诸葛亮庙、武侯墓风景区、成都武侯祠博物馆），每处足迹含名称、坐标、历史背景注解与所属阶段。页面布局：左侧标题卡与阶段分组列表（序号徽标、阶段简介、足迹卡片，支持按阶段筛选、单阶段独占与查看全部），右侧全幅腾讯地图渲染点位与轨迹连线，点击列表或标记联动聚焦并弹出信息窗；工具条提供「全部阶段、沿迹巡游、迁徙飞线」三种模式，巡游按顺序自动飞行聚焦各足迹，飞线以弧线展示跨阶段迁徙示意，底部附图例与小程序指南二维码。交付：一份可直接双击打开的单页 HTML 地图指南。
cases.prompt_en: Use Tencent Maps' custom map capability to create a "Zhuge Liang Footprints Guide" interactive map page, delivered as a single HTML file that opens directly in a browser. Use real historical sites, organized into 7 life-stage groups totaling 16 footprints across 13 cities: Langya Youth – Yangdu Hometown (Zhuge Liang Hometown Memorial, Yinan Han Tomb Museum); Farming in Longzhong – Ten Years in Seclusion (Gulongzhong Scenic Area, Xiangyang Ancient City); First Campaign – Bowang and Xinye (Hansang City Park, Bowang Slope Historic Site); Alliance at Chibi – Chaisang and Red Cliffs (Three Kingdoms Chibi Ancient Battlefield); Entering Shu – Baidi City and Jianmen (Fengjie Baidi City Qutang Gorge, Jianmenguan Scenic Area); Northern Expeditions – Hanzhong and Qishan (Shimen Plank Road, Dingjun Mountain, Qishan Fortress, Jieting Ancient Battlefield); Fall at Wuzhangyuan (Wuzhangyuan Zhuge Liang Temple, Wuhou Tomb Scenic Area, Chengdu Wuhou Shrine Museum). Each footprint includes a name, coordinates, historical notes, and its life stage. Layout: a left panel with the title card and stage-grouped list (numbered badges, stage intro, footprint cards, with per-stage filtering, solo-stage mode, and show-all), and a full-bleed Tencent map on the right rendering all markers and route lines, with list-marker linked focus and info windows. The toolbar offers three modes — All Stages, Guided Tour (auto-flying through footprints in order), and Migration Arcs (arcs showing cross-stage movements), plus a legend and a mini-program guide QR code. Deliverable: a single-page HTML map guide that opens by double-click.

skills.description: 腾讯地图·地图助手 Skill，一句自然语言调用腾讯地图全套能力，开箱即用。提供 AI 旅游攻略、地点搜索（含评分/人均/营业时间）、关键词提示、路线规划（驾车/步行/公交/骑行）、地址解析与逆解析、行政区划、IP 定位、距离计算、天气查询，并可生成自定义地图（网页 / 小程序指南）。涉及找地点、规划路线、旅游行程、查天气、坐标转换等出行场景时使用。

cases.title: 打倒那个猪妖 · TDEE 减肥搭子
cases.title_en: Slay the Pig Demon · TDEE Weight-Loss Companion
cases.subtitle: 口述三餐打卡、晨起称重，引擎拿真实体重反向校准你的专属每日消耗，每瘦一公斤猪妖血条掉一截
cases.subtitle_en: Log meals by voice and weigh in each morning — the engine reverse-calibrates your true daily burn from real weigh-ins, and the pig demon loses HP with every kilo you shed
cases.description: 减肥有两道坎：一是不知道自己每天到底消耗多少——网上的公式套谁都是同一个数；二是坚持不下去，每年上亿国人尝试减肥，九成中途放弃。这个工作台的创建人曾是国家二级运动员，用 8 个月从 210 斤减到 140 斤，把亲测有效的打法做成了产品。它不是一张减脂记录表，而是一台会自我校准的秤：每天一句话口述三餐和运动、早上称个体重，引擎以 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式起步，每周拿真实掉秤数据对账反向校准（1kg 脂肪约等于 7700 千卡），约两周收敛出专属于你的每日消耗（TDEE），误差从 6.4% 压到 4% 以内，打卡越久越准。四个战场各司其职：打倒猪妖把目标体重变成猪妖血量，每瘦一公斤血条掉一截，11 态像素猪妖陪你作战；口述打卡一句话解析热量与营养素，近 7 日饮食健康雷达 6 维评分一眼看穿；我的数据提供身体档案、体重趋势与校准引擎收敛曲线；体质进化用数据回答你是猎豹还是树懒，坚持会升级，还能生成分享海报。10 套主题配色随机切换，数据落在资料库数据表，支持在线存储与双向同步。适合：想搞清自己真实代谢、告别「喝水都胖」困惑的减肥人，需要游戏化正反馈才能坚持的打卡党，以及喜欢用数据管理身材的健身爱好者。
cases.description_en: Losing weight has two hurdles: you never know how many calories you actually burn each day — generic formulas give everyone the same number — and sticking with it is hard, with over a hundred million people in China trying to lose weight each year and ninety percent giving up. This workbench was built by a former national second-tier athlete who shed 35 kg (210 to 140 jin) in 8 months, turning a personally proven method into a product. It is not a fat-loss log sheet but a scale that calibrates itself: each day, describe your meals and exercise in one sentence and log your morning weight; the engine starts from the Mifflin-St Jeor estimate, then reconciles recorded intake against actual weight change (1 kg of fat ≈ 7,700 kcal) every week to reverse-calibrate your personal TDEE, converging in about two weeks with error squeezed from 6.4% to under 4% — the longer you check in, the more accurate it gets. Four battlefields: Slay the Pig Demon turns your target weight into the demon's HP bar, dropping with every kilo lost, joined by an 11-state pixel demon; Voice Check-in parses calories and nutrients from one sentence, with a 7-day diet health radar scoring 6 dimensions; My Data offers body profile, weight trend and the calibration convergence curve; Body Evolution answers with data whether you are a cheetah or a sloth, leveling up as you persist, with a shareable poster. Ten switchable color themes, with all data stored in Library database tables featuring online storage and two-way sync. Great for anyone who wants to understand their real metabolism, check-in users who need gamified feedback to stay on track, and fitness lovers who manage their body with data.
cases.prompt:
请使用资料库的能力帮我一键做同款 https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/HBTff2KNrtAUpfLTLQv8XN，需要实现数据在线存储和双向同步。优先走一键做同款的链路；若没有能力，则按以下方式搭建：

做一个「打倒那个猪妖」TDEE 减肥搭子工作台，数据落在资料库数据表，共三张表：① 身体档案（昵称、性别、年龄、身高(cm)、当前体重(kg)、目标体重(kg)、初始BMR(kcal)、基础日TDEE(kcal)、主要运动、每周次数、单次时长(小时)）——首次使用弹出建档向导，一分钟填完生成专属档案；② 每日记录（日期、晨重(kg)、摄入热量(kcal)、运动消耗(kcal)、是否训练日、当日盈余(kcal)、数据来源、备注）——同日再次打卡走增量更新补全，当日已有晨重或口述时自动回填表单；③ 常吃食物（食物名、分类、单位、每单位热量(kcal)、常用份量参考）——作为口述解析的热量参照库。

核心机制：引擎以 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式估算每日总消耗（TDEE）起步，之后每天拿「记录的摄入热量 vs 实际体重变化（1kg 脂肪约 7700 千卡）」对账，每周反向校准专属于用户的个人 TDEE，误差持续收敛，打卡越久越准。四个模块：① 打倒猪妖——目标体重即猪妖血量（血量＝总目标进度），每瘦一公斤血条掉一截，实时展示已减重量、今日热量缺口与预计击败天数，击败后进入庆祝态；② 口述打卡——一句话描述三餐和运动，自动解析热量与营养素并写入当日记录，展示今日战况与近 7 日饮食健康雷达（6 维度评分）；③ 我的数据——身体档案、体重趋势、TDEE 校准收敛曲线（预估值逐步贴向真实值）；④ 体质进化——基于记录数据给出猎豹、候鸟、棕熊、树懒、仓鼠等代谢体质画像与升级路径，体质变化自动留痕，支持生成体质进化分享海报。视觉走像素游戏风（像素猪妖随进度切换状态、军事风像素指挥官头像），内置多套可随机切换的配色主题；未设定目标时用演示数据展示完整效果，建档后切换为真实记录。

交付：资料库在线工作台——在线 HTML 页面 + 7 张数据表部署到资料库空间，页面绑定数据表读写，数据在线存储、支持双向同步。
cases.prompt_en:
Use the Library capability to build me a same-style copy of https://www.workbuddy.cn/space/d/HBTff2KNrtAUpfLTLQv8XN with online data storage and two-way sync. Prefer the one-click same-style flow; if unavailable, build it as follows: Build a "Slay the Pig Demon" TDEE weight-loss companion workbench backed by Library database tables, with three tables: (1) Body Profile (nickname, gender, age, height(cm), current weight(kg), target weight(kg), baseline BMR(kcal), baseline daily TDEE(kcal), main sport, sessions per week, hours per session) — an onboarding wizard pops up on first use and creates a personal profile in one minute; (2) Daily Record (date, morning weight(kg), calorie intake(kcal), exercise burn(kcal), training day, daily surplus(kcal), data source, notes) — checking in again on the same day merges into the existing record incrementally, and the form auto-fills when today's weight or narration already exists; (3) Frequent Foods (food name, category, unit, calories per unit(kcal), portion reference) — the calorie reference library for narrated-meal parsing. Core mechanism: the engine starts from a Mifflin-St Jeor estimate of daily total energy expenditure (TDEE), then reconciles recorded calorie intake against actual weight change (1 kg of fat ≈ 7,700 kcal) each day and reverse-calibrates the user's personal TDEE weekly, with error converging over time — the longer the check-in streak, the more accurate it gets. Four modules: (1) Slay the Pig Demon — target weight is the demon's HP (HP = total goal progress), dropping with every kilo lost, live-tracking weight lost, today's calorie gap and projected days to victory, with a celebratory state upon defeat; (2) Voice Check-in — describe meals and exercise in one sentence, auto-parse calories and nutrients into the daily record, and show today's battle report plus a 7-day diet health radar (6-dimension scoring); (3) My Data — body profile, weight trend and the TDEE calibration convergence curve (the estimate gradually hugging the true value); (4) Body Evolution — data-driven metabolic body-type portraits (cheetah, migratory bird, brown bear, sloth, hamster, etc.) with leveling paths, automatic history of body-type changes, and a shareable body-evolution poster. Visuals follow a pixel-game style (the pixel pig demon changes state with progress, military-style pixel commander avatars) with multiple randomly switchable color themes; when no goal is set, demo data showcases the full experience and switches to real records after onboarding.

Deliverable: an online Library workbench — an online HTML page plus 7 data tables deployed to the Library space, with the page bound to the tables for online storage and two-way sync.

cases.title: 达格列净片用法用量查询
cases.subtitle: 一句话问出口，按肾功能分层的剂量一次说清
cases.subtitle_en: Ask once, get eGFR-stratified dosing in a single pass
cases.description:
降糖药里最不敢自己乱吃的，是剂量要跟着肾功能走的那一类。达格列净片能不能吃、吃多少，取决于肾功能检查结果落在哪一档，患者自己根本记不住，翻说明书又被一整张表格劝退。

这个案例把用法用量查询交给用药专家：用户只发一句「帮我查一下达格列净片的用法用量」，专家调官方药品库拉到安达唐®（10mg*30 片、阿斯利康）的电子说明书原文，一次就产出一张网页——先交代查到的是哪一盒药，再把用法用量拆成四条人能读的话：开始治疗前要查什么、推荐剂量按什么定、eGFR 低于 45 为什么不建议用来降糖、肝功能受损要不要调量。页面注明数据来源，附扫码进小程序看完整说明书的入口。不追问、不分多轮。

适合：2 型糖尿病长期服药人群、心衰或慢性肾病患者、替父母管药的家庭照护者、做患者教育的社区医生与药师。
cases.description_en:
The hardest glucose-lowering drugs to self-manage are the ones whose dose follows kidney function. Whether dapagliflozin is appropriate, and at what dose, depends on which band your kidney-function result falls into — impossible for a patient to remember, and the package insert presents it as a dense table most people give up on.

This case hands the lookup to the medication expert. The user sends one line — "help me look up the dosage for dapagliflozin" — and the expert queries the official drug database for the electronic package insert of Forxiga (10 mg x 30 tablets, AstraZeneca), then produces a single web page in one pass: which pack was found, followed by the dosage section broken into four readable points — what to check before starting, what the recommended dose depends on, why it is not recommended for glucose control below an eGFR of 45, and whether liver impairment changes the dose. The page states its data source and includes a scan-code entry to the full insert. No follow-up questions, no multi-turn back and forth.

Best for: people on long-term type 2 diabetes medication, patients with heart failure or chronic kidney disease, family caregivers managing medicines for parents, and community doctors and pharmacists doing patient education.

artifacts.label: 达格列净片用法用量说明页（按肾功能分层给剂量 + 小程序码入口）

cases.prompt:
你是腾讯健康药箱用药专家。用户用一句大白话问某个药怎么吃，你要在**这一轮内直接产出成品页面**，不追问、不拆成多轮对话。

用户输入：帮我查一下达格列净片的用法用量

请一次做完以下四步：
1. 用官方药品查询能力检索该药品，取匹配度最高的那一条，读取其电子说明书的「用法用量」章节原文。
2. 页面开头交代查到的是哪一盒药：商品名（通用名）、规格、生产企业。该药若存在多个厂家或规格版本，在页面内用一句话说明本页展示的是哪个版本即可，**不要反问用户**。
3. 把「用法用量」原文拆成几条人能读懂的话，每条一个小标题加一句说明：开始治疗前要评估什么、推荐剂量由什么决定、哪些情况不建议用于某个治疗目标、肝肾功能受损要不要调整剂量。其中「不建议使用」这类内容单独做成警示条目，视觉上和其他条目区分开。
4. 页面注明数据来源，结尾提示具体剂量请遵医嘱，并给出扫码进入腾讯健康药箱小程序查看完整说明书的入口。

数据要求：剂量、适应症、禁忌等一律以查到的说明书原文为准，不要凭印象补数字；查不到的内容如实说明并提示以药品实际标签为准。

输出要求：单文件 HTML，CSS 与图片资源全部内联、可离线打开；医疗蓝的清爽风格，适老化阅读（正文字号偏大、行距宽松）。只讲用法用量这一件事，不要把适应症、不良反应、成份等章节一股脑铺开。
cases.prompt_en:
You are the Tencent Health Medicine Chest medication expert. The user asks in plain everyday language how to take a drug, and you must **produce the finished page within this single turn** — no follow-up questions, no splitting into a multi-turn dialogue.

User input: help me look up the dosage for dapagliflozin

Complete all four steps in one pass:
1. Use your official drug lookup capability to search for the drug, take the best-matching result, and read the verbatim "dosage and administration" section of its electronic package insert.
2. Open the page by stating which pack was found: brand name (generic name), strength, manufacturer. If the drug has multiple manufacturers or strengths, simply note on the page which version is shown — **do not ask the user**.
3. Break the dosage text into a few readable points, each with a short heading and a one-line explanation: what to assess before starting treatment, what determines the recommended dose, situations where it is not recommended for a given treatment goal, and whether impaired kidney or liver function changes the dose. Render "not recommended" content as a separate warning item, visually distinct from the rest.
4. State the data source on the page, close with a note that the exact dose should follow the prescriber, and include a scan-code entry to the Tencent Health Medicine Chest mini-program for the full package insert.

Data requirements: dosage, indications, and contraindications must follow the retrieved insert text verbatim; never fill in numbers from memory. If something cannot be found, say so and defer to the physical drug label.

Output requirements: a single-file HTML page with all CSS and images inlined so it opens offline; a clean medical-blue style, readable for older users (larger body text, generous line spacing). Cover only the dosage question — do not dump the indications, adverse reactions, or ingredients sections.

cases.title: 基金下跌了，我该怎么办？
cases.title_en: My Fund Dropped — What Should I Do?
cases.subtitle: 小达养基笔记：下跌时的行为纠偏与应对框架
cases.subtitle_en: Xiaoda's Fund Notes: behavioral correction and a response framework for downturns
cases.description: 【痛点】基金账户一片绿、净值持续回撤时，很多投资者会被恐慌和"损失厌恶"劫持，要么冲动割肉、要么越跌越补，事后往往追悔。他们缺的不是代码，而是一套能让自己冷静下来的判断框架。【演示】本案例用易方达投教基地「小达养基笔记」技能，基于财富学堂投教知识库，以三段式结构输出一份自包含图文回答：先用真实行情图还原"近一月 A 股走出了怎样的行情"，再拆解"恐慌时大脑在干什么"（追涨杀跌、锚定、损失厌恶等认知偏误），最后给出"不同情况、不同选择"的情景化应对（按持基质量、仓位、资金来源分情形），全程不替用户做买卖决策。【适用人群】正经历基金回撤、情绪化操作倾向明显的基金/理财用户，以及需要投教级合规引导来稳定心态的投资者。
cases.description_en: Pain point: when a fund account turns red and net value keeps falling, many investors are hijacked by panic and loss aversion — either impulsively cutting losses or averaging down at every dip, and often regretting it afterward. What they lack is not a ticker code but a calm, structured decision framework. Demo: this case uses the E Fund investor-education assistant "Xiaoda's Fund Notes" to produce a self-contained illustrated answer grounded in the Fortune Academy knowledge base, in a three-part structure: first a real chart showing "how A-shares have moved over the past month", then "what your brain does when panicking" (cognitive biases like herding, anchoring, and loss aversion), and finally "different situations, different choices" — scenario-based responses by holding quality, position size, and funding source — never making the buy/sell decision for the user. Target audience: fund/wealth-management users currently suffering drawdowns or prone to emotional trading, and anyone needing a compliant, educational nudge to steady their mindset.

cases.title: 画像推荐：硕士应届的两条赛道对比
cases.title_en: Profile-Based Recommendation: Two Tracks for Master's Graduates
cases.subtitle: 同一份画像分别投进公务员和事业单位岗位库，看总量与结构差异
cases.subtitle_en: Run one profile against both civil-service and public-institution databases
cases.description:
很多硕士应届生同时在准备公务员和事业单位，但没人告诉他们两边到底有多少岗位能报、推荐出来的岗位长什么样。

本案例把「硕士研究生 + 2027 届 + 江苏」这组画像分别投进两个岗位库，拿到 6,988 与 8,817 两个总量，逐条列出推荐值最高的岗位，并统计推荐理由标签（薪资区间 / 加班强度 / 平台优势）的分布，最后如实说明推荐值不是录取概率、接口不返回专业与报名时间。

适合：同时备考多条赛道的硕士应届生、帮学生做选岗规划的老师。
cases.description_en:
Many master's students prepare for both civil-service and public-institution exams, yet nobody tells them how many posts each track actually offers.

This case runs one profile — master's degree, class of 2027, Jiangsu — against both databases, returning 6,988 and 8,817 eligible posts. It lists the highest-scoring recommendations, breaks down the reason tags (salary band, overtime intensity, platform advantage), and states plainly that the recommendation score is not an admission probability.

For: master's students weighing multiple tracks, and counsellors planning applications with them.

artifacts.label: 硕士应届画像的双赛道推荐对照

cases.prompt: 我是 2027 届硕士研究生，想在江苏考编。帮我做一次对照分析：1) 分别按「公务员」和「事业单位」两个考试类型，用同一组画像（硕士研究生 + 江苏 + 2027 年毕业）真实查询可推荐岗位，各给出总数和推荐值最高的 5 个岗位（岗位、单位、地区、招录人数、推荐值、推荐理由）；2) 统计两批结果的推荐理由标签分布，说明薪资区间、加班强度、平台优势各自代表什么；3) 明确说明推荐值不等于录取概率；4) 接口没有的信息（学历/专业/政治面貌要求、报录比、报名时间）如实说明需查公告原文，不要推测。

cases.title: 患教参考文献专项审核
cases.subtitle: 逐条评估文献来源级别、时效性与引用准确性
cases.subtitle_en: Grade each reference by source level, timeliness, and citation accuracy
cases.description:
患教文章里引用了 5 篇文献，编辑最怕两种坑：一是把不含数据的官方公告当成药代数据的出处，二是文献清单和正文上标对不上、具体数值无法溯源。

这个案例把一篇新型安眠药（DORA 类）患教文章交给 AI 做参考文献专项审核，逐条给出来源级别、时效性与引用准确性结论。产物顶部是专项审核结论（文献 5 篇、🔴 需修改 1、🟡 建议优化 3），下方是 5 张文献审核卡片：[1] 国家药监局批准公告被错误用于支撑半衰期（公告不含任何药代数据）；[2] 莱博雷生临床应用中国专家共识（P0，2026）；[3] 法赞雷生片说明书（P4，半衰期 2~4h 与原文一致）；[4] 达利雷生 FDA 说明书（P4，半衰期约 8h 与原文一致）；[5] 失眠症诊断和治疗指南 2025 版（P0）。每条都标出文中引用点、与原文核对结果和改写建议，文末按严重程度分组展开全部明细。

适合：医学内容编辑、患教内容审核员、药企医学事务与 Market Access 人员、健康科普作者、医学编辑团队负责人。
cases.description_en:
A patient education article cites 5 references — the two traps editors fear most are using an official approval notice (which carries no PK data) as the source for pharmacokinetic numbers, and a reference list that does not line up with in-text citations so figures cannot be traced.

This case hands a DORA-class hypnotic patient education article to AI for a dedicated reference audit, giving a source-level, timeliness, and citation-accuracy verdict for each reference. The deliverable opens with the audit conclusion (5 references, 1 must-fix, 3 suggested), followed by 5 reference cards: [1] the NMPA approval notice wrongly used to support half-life (the notice carries no PK data); [2] Chinese expert consensus on lemborexant (P0, 2026); [3] fazeren (fazanorexant) package insert (P4, half-life 2~4h matches); [4] daridorexant FDA label (P4, half-life ~8h matches); [5] Insomnia Diagnosis and Treatment Guideline 2025 (P0). Each card shows the in-text citation points, the check against the source, and a rewrite suggestion, with all findings grouped at the end.

Best for: medical content editors, patient-education reviewers, pharma medical-affairs and market-access teams, health science writers, and editorial team leads.

artifacts.label: 参考文献专项审核报告（逐条文献卡片 + 核对结论）

cases.prompt:
你是医学科普内容审核助手，请对我提供的患教文章做一次参考文献专项审核，逐条评估每篇文献的来源级别、时效性与引用准确性，并输出为一份可直接打开的审核报告网页（不要分多轮追问，一次输出到底）。

待审核内容：{粘贴患教文章正文，含参考文献列表}
参考文献原文：{上传该文章引用的全部参考文献 PDF（指南/共识/说明书/期刊论文原文），供逐条溯源核对}

请按以下方式逐条审核参考文献：
1. 来源级别：依据指南/共识(P0) > 系统评价/Meta(P1) > 大样本RCT(P2) > 权威期刊论著/队列(P3) > 政府或权威机构官方发布、可查证中文期刊(P4) > 专家意见/可查证报刊科普(P5) 的优先级，给出每篇的级别与判定理由
2. 时效性：标注发表/更新年份，判断是否在近5年内、是否存在更新版本可用
3. 引用准确性：列出文中每个标注该文献的句子，逐项核对文中所引数据/表述是否能在文献原文中溯源（写明原文位置与原文表述），指出引用错配、冗余标注或无法溯源之处
4. 著录格式：检查文献列表是否缺卷期页、中英文标点是否统一、是否给出通用名对照

网页需包含以下部分：
- 头部专项审核结论：文献总数、需修改与建议优化项数
- 逐条文献审核卡片：每篇含题录、来源级别徽章、时效性、文中引用点、与原文核对结果、修改建议
- 文末明细：按「需修改」「建议优化」分组展开

呈现要求：单文件 HTML，CSS/图片资源全部内联，可离线打开。
审核意见撰写要求：涉及数据与文献不一致时，必须写明文献中的原始位置（如 p9 半衰期）与原始数值，并给出按原文改写后的建议表述；每条修改建议须具体可执行。
只发现问题、给修改建议，不做「可以发布」的发布决策。
cases.prompt_en:
You are a medical science communication content reviewer. Run a dedicated reference audit on the patient education article I provide — grade each reference by source level, timeliness, and citation accuracy — and output a ready-to-open review report web page in one pass.

Content to review: {paste the patient education article, including the reference list}
Reference sources: {upload the full-text PDFs of every reference cited (guidelines/consensus/package inserts/journal articles) so each citation can be traced}

Audit each reference as follows:
1. Source level: assign a level per the priority guideline/consensus(P0) > systematic review/Meta(P1) > large RCT(P2) > authoritative journal article/cohort(P3) > government or authoritative official release, verifiable Chinese journal(P4) > expert opinion, verifiable newspaper/popular-science(P5), with the rationale.
2. Timeliness: state the publication/update year and whether it is within 5 years or a newer version exists.
3. Citation accuracy: list every in-text sentence citing that reference, verify item by item whether the cited data/statement can be traced to the source (give the original location and wording), and flag mismatches, redundant citations, or untraceable claims.
4. Bibliography format: check for missing volume/issue/page, punctuation consistency, and generic-name cross-reference.

The page must contain: a header audit verdict (total references, must-fix and suggested counts); per-reference cards (bibliographic entry, source-level badge, timeliness, in-text citation points, check against source, suggested fix); and an end detail section grouped by must-fix / suggested.
Single-file HTML, fully inlined, offline-openable. Find issues and give fixes only — no publish decision.

cases.title: 私域社群短文话术合规快审
cases.title_en: Quick Compliance Review for Private-Domain Social Copy
cases.subtitle: 10 条社群推送文案逐条过审，秒判通过/修改/驳回
cases.subtitle_en: 10 social media copy items reviewed one by one — instant Pass/Modify/Reject verdicts
cases.description:
药企私域社群每天要发很多条推送文案——打卡提醒、用药指导、活动推广混杂在一起。运营同学最头疼的是：这条能不能发？那句有没有违规？一条条人工看太慢，漏了一条被投诉就麻烦了。

本案例把 10 条微信社群推送文案（含商品名推荐、用户见证、直播送药、团购优惠等高风险场景）交给「腾讯健康药箱-私域患教内容审核助手」，它逐条快速审核，重点抓：处方药隐性广告（违反《广告法》第15条）、可识别隐私信息、个案当普遍化、疗效断言、诱导性促销、停药换药建议等。每条文案输出判定 + 问题列表 + 修改后版本。

适合: 药企私域运营、社群内容审核员、医药合规专员、互联网医院内容风控。
cases.description_en:
Pharma private-domain groups push dozens of copy items daily — medication reminders, usage tips, promotional offers all mixed together. Operations teams' biggest headache: Can this line be published? Is that sentence compliant? Manual review is too slow; missing one problematic line can lead to complaints.

This case hands 10 WeChat social copy items (including high-risk scenarios like branded drug recommendations, user testimonials, drug giveaways, group-buy discounts) to the Tencent Health Pill-Box Private-Domain Patient-Education Content Review Assistant. It reviews each item rapidly, focusing on: hidden prescription drug ads (violating Ad Law Art.15), identifiable privacy info, case-to-generalization, efficacy claims, induced promotions, discontinuation/switching advice. Each item gets a verdict + issue list + revised version.

Suitable for: pharma private-domain operations, community content reviewers, pharma compliance officers, internet-hospital content moderators.
cases.prompt:
我是药企私域运营，每周要往糖尿病社群发十几条推送。上次被合规抽查退回两条，说踩了红线，我到现在也没搞清楚边界在哪。这是本周排期的 5 条文案，帮我逐条判：能发、要改、还是必须撤？要改的直接给我写好替换版本。

**01 打卡提醒**
糖友们早上好！今天是您服用格泰平® 二甲双胍缓释片的第 23 天啦～连续打卡药效更稳定！还没打卡的赶紧的！群里张阿姨已连续打卡 60 天，血糖从 9.3 降到 6.1，效果太好了！

**02 直播活动**
本周五晚 8 点，北京协和医院内分泌科陈主任直播讲《糖尿病并发症早期信号》！福利：前 100 名送免费血糖仪；抽奖送格泰平® 一个月用量（价值 298 元）。仅限本群，名额有限，先到先得！

**03 患者见证**
刘姐去年 7 月确诊 2 型糖尿病，空腹血糖 11.8。服用格泰平® 配合饮食运动，3 个月后复查空腹 6.1、糖化 6.3%，医生说控制得非常好！附刘姐体检报告对比图（已获授权）。

**04 新品促销**
格泰平® 新包装上线！现在下单首发优惠：原价 298 元/盒，限时 198 元/盒！团购 3 盒起再打 8 折！点击购买（本内容仅用于用药管理辅助，不作为诊疗依据）

**05 用药知识**
长期吃一种药会耐药吗？二甲双胍不会产生传统耐药性。若原方案"不管用了"，可考虑：医生指导下加用第二种药；换用新型制剂（如格泰平® 缓释片血药浓度更平稳）；评估是否启动胰岛素。请咨询主治医生。

我特别想知道：提药品商品名到底能不能提、患者故事配数据算不算违规、直播送药风险多大。最后给我一张汇总表，我拿去跟合规同事对齐。
cases.prompt_en:
I handle private-domain operations at a pharma company, pushing a dozen-plus messages weekly to our diabetes community. Compliance spot-checked us last time and bounced two for crossing red lines — I still don't understand where the boundary sits. Here are 5 pieces scheduled this week. Judge each: ship, revise, or pull? For revisions, write me the replacement copy directly.

**01 Check-in reminder**
Morning! Today is day 23 on your Getaiping® Metformin ER Tablets — consistent check-ins keep the effect steadier! Haven't checked in? Hurry! Aunt Zhang has a 60-day streak and her glucose dropped from 9.3 to 6.1 — amazing results!

**02 Livestream event**
This Friday 8pm, Director Chen from Peking Union Medical College Hospital's endocrinology department presents "Early Warning Signs of Diabetic Complications"! Perks: free glucose meter for the first 100; lucky draw for a one-month supply of Getaiping® (worth ¥298). Group members only, limited slots, first come first served!

**03 Patient testimonial**
Sister Liu was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes last July, fasting glucose 11.8. On Getaiping® plus diet and exercise, three months later fasting was 6.1 and HbA1c 6.3% — her doctor said control was excellent! Attached: before/after lab report comparison (consent obtained).

**04 Product promotion**
Getaiping® new packaging is here! Launch offer: was ¥298/box, now ¥198/box for a limited time! Buy 3+ for another 20% off! Tap to buy. (This content supports medication management only and is not a basis for diagnosis or treatment.)

**05 Medication knowledge**
Does long-term single-drug use cause resistance? Metformin doesn't cause resistance in the traditional sense. If your regimen "stops working," consider: adding a second agent under physician guidance; switching to a newer formulation (e.g., Getaiping® ER offers steadier plasma levels); evaluating whether to start insulin. Consult your treating physician.

I especially want to know: can we name branded drug products at all, does a patient story with numbers count as a violation, and how risky is giving away medication in a livestream? Finish with a summary table I can take to align with the compliance team.

cases.title: 清明上河图深度考证
cases.title_en: Deep Verification of Along the River During the Qingming Festival
cases.subtitle: 北宋张择端风俗画的内容、技法、流变与馆藏全维度考证
cases.subtitle_en: Full-dimensional verification of content, technique, transmission and collection of Zhang Zeduan's Northern Song genre painting
cases.description:
一幅传世名画背后的版本流变、技法考据、馆藏流转常常众说纷纭。这个案例演示了如何借助腾讯探元文物库与知识库，并行检索历代《清明上河图》摹本与张择端相关馆藏，再由主代理亲自做 2-3 次多源 WebSearch 交叉核验，覆盖画作内容与历史背景、艺术技法与材料、版本流变与后世摹本、当前馆藏与保护四个维度，最终交付包含配图与图表的 Markdown/HTML/DOCX/PDF 四格式深度考证报告。

适合：书画研究者、博物馆策展与社教人员、宋代社会史与城市史爱好者、艺术史与绘画专业学生、文化遗产数字化保护从业者。
cases.description_en:
The provenance, technique, version transmission and museum custody of a传世 masterpiece are often debated. This case demonstrates how to leverage the Tencent Tanyuan relic and knowledge bases for parallel retrieval of historical copies of Along the River During the Qingming Festival and Zhang Zeduan-related collections, then run 2-3 multi-source WebSearch passes for cross-verification across four dimensions—painting content and historical context, artistic technique and materials, version transmission and later copies, current collection and conservation—delivering a cross-checked four-format (MD/HTML/DOCX/PDF) deep verification report with embedded images and charts.

Best for: painting and calligraphy researchers, curators and docents, Song dynasty social and urban history enthusiasts, art-history students, and cultural heritage digital conservation practitioners.

cases.prompt:
请按「腾讯探元学术研究-深度考证」专家的工作流，深度研究「清明上河图」。

研究范围（覆盖四维）：
- 内容与历史背景：北宋汴京城市生活、市井百态、虹桥漕运场景
- 艺术技法与材料：绢本设色、界画与白描结合、人物建筑比例、色彩与晕染技法
- 版本流变与摹本：宋本/明本/清院本对比、各代摹本传承谱系、仇英/沈源等后世摹本
- 馆藏与保护现状：故宫博物院藏北宋张择端本状态、数字化保护与展陈实践

交付要求（强制）：
1. 探元两库 MCP（search_movable_relics + search_relics）并行检索 + 主代理 2-3 次 WebSearch 多源核验
2. 配图 ≥ 2 张（建议 3-6 张），优先探元两库 cover；图表 ≥ 1 张（建议 2-3 张，如版本流变时间线/技法对比表/汴京城市结构图）
3. 四格式报告：Markdown 母版 → HTML → DOCX → PDF，10 章节固定结构
4. 仅结论不含建议；参考文献只列网络公开来源；主要结论同步输出到对话窗口
cases.prompt_en:
Use the 'Tencent Tanyuan Academic Research - Deep Verification' expert workflow to deeply research 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival'.

Research scope (four dimensions):
- Content and historical context: Northern Song Bianjing urban life, market scenes, Hongqiao canal transport
- Artistic technique and materials: silk-based painting with color, jiehua (ruled-line) + baimiao combination, figure/architecture proportion, coloring techniques
- Version transmission and copies: Song/Ming/Qing court-edition comparison, copy lineage, Qiu Ying/Shen Yuan later copies
- Collection and conservation status: Palace Museum Song-dynasty Zhang Zeduan original, digital conservation and display

Delivery requirements (mandatory):
1. Parallel retrieval via Tanyuan dual bases MCP (search_movable_relics + search_relics) + 2-3 multi-source WebSearch passes by main agent
2. ≥2 images (3-6 recommended), Tanyuan covers preferred; ≥1 chart (2-3 recommended: version timeline/technique comparison/Bianjing urban structure)
3. Four-format reports: Markdown master → HTML → DOCX → PDF, fixed 10-section structure
4. Conclusions only, no recommendations; references only list public web sources; main conclusions sync to chat window

cases.title: 香薰新品投放可行性评估
cases.title_en: Ad Feasibility Assessment for a Scented Candle Launch
cases.subtitle: 5-20 万首投腾讯广告前，先花 30 秒看个底
cases.subtitle_en: A 30-second read before your first Tencent Ads campaign with a 50K–200K budget
cases.description:
第一次投腾讯广告最悬的不是「钱够不够」，是「这钱到底能不能花」：品类适不适合投、预算够不够、可能要承担的成本、哪里会踩坑——问一圈人说法都不一样，自己又拿不准。

这个案例把「评估踏雪香薰投腾讯广告可不可行」这句话直接变成一份五维打分的可行性评估报告：总分与结论（能不能投）、建议怎么投、预算怎么花、主要风险和避坑建议，合成一份离线可看、可打印的单文件 HTML 报告。

适合：首次投放腾讯广告的广告主、预算有限想先看底的中小品牌主理人、需要快速判断投放可行性的市场负责人。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of a first Tencent Ads campaign isn't whether the budget is enough — it's whether the money is even worth spending: is the category even viable here, is the budget realistic, what's the cost you may need to absorb, and what pitfalls will you hit. Ask five people, get five different answers, and you're still not sure.

This case turns a single sentence — "Assess whether promoting our scented candle Taxue on Tencent Ads is viable" — into a five-dimension scored feasibility report. It covers the verdict (can we run it), a recommended approach, how the budget should be split, the main risks, and how to avoid them, delivered as a single-file offline HTML report.

Good for: advertisers running Tencent Ads for the first time, indie brand founders with limited budgets who want a baseline read, and marketing leads who need a quick go/no-go assessment.

cases.prompt:
帮我评估「踏雪香薰」投腾讯广告可不可行，出一份可行性分析报告。

- 产品/服务：踏雪香薰——东方美学与情绪疗愈香氛品牌。以"雪"为意象，主打静谧、清冽、祛除烦躁的嗅觉体验，为快节奏生活中的都市人打造一片"精神留白"与独处空间。

- 核心卖点：
  - 自然植萃与静音燃烧：天然手工大豆蜡与蜂蜡混合配方，搭配木质烛芯，燃烧时伴有轻微松木焚裂声，带来视觉、听觉与嗅觉的多重疗愈
  - 极简冷感东方美学 packaging：瓶身采用哑光磨砂冰川质感玻璃或微粗糙感素烧陶瓷，兼具空间摆件属性与收藏价值

- 产品线与售价：
  - 香薰蜡烛：168-288 元
  - 香薰配件（藤条/扩香石）：58-228 元
  - 随身香氛（车载/香囊）：58-288 元
  - 礼盒装：188-588 元

- 测试目标：验证情绪疗愈香氛在腾讯广告的兴趣电商链路，沉淀"夜晚独处 + 东方美学"心智占位
- 关注指标：ROI 达成（兴趣电商链路回本优先）+ 品牌声量（与小红书等种草心智协同）
- 成本预期：单条成交客单 CPL 50-150 元（兴趣电商低客单区间）
- 总预算：5-20 万
- 投放周期：1 个月
- 上线时间：2 周内

- 线上门面：微信小店（视频号小店同步）+ 腾讯官方落地页（用于积累企微私域）
- 开发资源：零开发基础（小团队主要做内容与品牌，无专职研发，需用平台自动归因能力）
- 文案风险点：「治愈」「祛除烦躁」类强效果承诺词需自检；东方美学意境表达避免过度玄化
- 投放历史：从没投过腾讯广告（首次投放，团队精力集中在线下买手店与电商平台）

请直接生成《投放可行性评估》网页报告（HTML），包含：总分与结论、能不能投、建议怎么投、预算怎么花、主要风险和避坑建议。
cases.prompt_en:
Assess whether promoting our scented candle brand "Taxue" on Tencent Ads is viable, and produce a feasibility analysis report.

- Product/Service: Taxue is an Eastern-aesthetic, emotional-healing fragrance brand. Centered on the imagery of "snow," it focuses on a quiet, crisp, and stress-relieving scent experience, creating a small space of mental "negative space" and solitude for urban dwellers living at a fast pace.

- Core selling points:
  - Natural plant extracts and silent burning: a handcrafted blend of soy wax and beeswax with a wooden wick; the gentle pine-crackling sound of the wick adds a multi-sensory healing touch (visual, auditory, olfactory)
  - Minimalist cool-toned Eastern aesthetic packaging: matte frosted glacier-textured glass or slightly coarse unglazed ceramic, doubling as a decorative object and a collectible

- Product line and pricing:
  - Scented candles: RMB 168–288
  - Accessories (rattan diffusers/aromatherapy stones): RMB 58–228
  - Carry-on fragrance (car clips/sachets): RMB 58–288
  - Gift sets: RMB 188–588

- Test goal: validate emotional-healing fragrance performance on Tencent Ads' interest-based e-commerce path, and anchor the "evening solitude + Eastern aesthetic" mind-share
- KPIs: ROI achievement (interest e-commerce path prioritized for break-even) + brand buzz (synergy with Xiaohongshu and other content-driven mental-share channels)
- Cost expectation: per-order CPL between RMB 50–150 (interest e-commerce low-AOV range)
- Total budget: RMB 50,000–200,000
- Campaign duration: 1 month
- Launch timeline: within 2 weeks

- Online storefronts: WeChat Mini Shop (synced with Video Account Mini Shop) + Tencent official landing page (to accumulate enterprise-WeChat private-domain contacts)
- Engineering resources: zero in-house development (small team focused on content and brand, no dedicated engineers; must rely on platform-native attribution)
- Copywriting risk notes: strong-effect claims such as "healing" and "stress relief" must be self-checked; Eastern-aesthetic expressions should avoid being overly abstract
- Tencent Ads history: never run Tencent Ads before (first-time advertiser; the team has been focused on offline concept stores and e-commerce platforms)

Please produce an "Ad Feasibility Assessment" web report (HTML) directly, covering: total score and verdict, whether to launch, recommended approach, how the budget should be split, main risks, and how to avoid them.

cases.title: 基金进阶知识
cases.subtitle: 小达养基笔记：核心-卫星、决策框架与再平衡
cases.subtitle_en: Xiaoda's Fund Notes: core-satellite, decision framework and rebalancing
cases.description: 【痛点】很多投资者不是缺"买什么"的点子，而是缺一套能长期复用、能管住情绪的方法论——结果行情一来就乱、一跌就慌。【演示】本案例用易方达投教基地「小达养基笔记」技能，基于财富学堂投教知识库，输出一份系统化的基金投资方法图文：先讲"核心-卫星"如何搭好仓位结构，再点出投资前要管住大脑的四个陷阱（认知偏误），给出可落地的"五步投资决策框架"，并拆解资产配置的再平衡怎么做、核心仓如何用股债搭配搭建，最后总结配置的典型误区，全程不替用户做买卖决策。【适用人群】有一定基金认知、想从"零散操作"升级到"方法体系"的投资者，以及需要投教级合规方法论梳理的用户。
cases.description_en: Pain point: many investors don't lack ideas of "what to buy" — they lack a reusable, emotion-proof methodology, so they scramble when markets move and panic when prices fall. Demo: this case uses the E Fund investor-education assistant "Xiaoda's Fund Notes" to produce a systematic, illustrated guide to fund-investing methods grounded in the Fortune Academy knowledge base: first how to structure positions with a "core-satellite" approach, then the four mental traps to guard against before investing (cognitive biases), a practical five-step investment decision framework, how to rebalance asset allocation, how to build the core sleeve with stock-bond pairing, and finally the typical allocation pitfalls — never making the buy/sell decision for the user. Target audience: investors with some fund knowledge who want to upgrade from ad-hoc trades to a method system, and anyone needing a compliant, educational methodology overview.

cases.title: 玛仕度肽注射液药品查询
cases.subtitle: 全球首个 GCG/GLP-1 双靶新药，一次搞懂是什么药
cases.subtitle_en: The first GCG/GLP-1 dual agonist, understood in one pass
cases.description:
新机制、新名字的代谢病用药越来越多，用户拿到一个陌生药名时最朴素的诉求只有两个：这到底是个什么药、它能治什么。可说明书一上来就是十几个章节，剂量还要按周数一档档加，普通人根本读不完，更记不住哪一周该打多少。

这个案例把「是什么药」型查询交给用药专家：用户问一句「帮我查一下玛仕度肽注射液，这是什么药」，一次就拿到完整速读页——先锁定是哪一盒（信尔美®、信达生物、三个规格），再讲清双靶机制（GLP-1 受体管降糖减重、GCG 受体管能量消耗与肝脂代谢），然后把两项已获批适应症分开列（长期体重控制、2 型糖尿病血糖控制），并把最容易记错的剂量滴定表（2mg 起始→4mg→维持 4 或 6mg）和漏打处理规则做成对照表。禁忌、警示语、特殊人群、贮藏条件在侧栏一并给全，文末注明数据来源并留扫码入口。

适合：正在用或准备用 GLP-1 类药物的患者、关注减重与控糖新药的人群、替家人查药的家庭照护者，以及需要对新药做快速核对的社区医生与药师。
cases.description_en:
New-mechanism metabolic drugs keep arriving, and when users meet an unfamiliar name they really only ask two things: what kind of drug is this, and what does it treat. The package insert answers neither quickly — it opens with a dozen dense sections, and the dose has to be escalated week by week, which is exactly what people forget.

This case hands the "what is this drug" question to the medication expert. A user asks "help me look up mazdutide injection, what is this drug" and gets one complete primer page: it pins down the product (Xinermei, Innovent Bio, three strengths), explains the dual-target mechanism (the GLP-1 receptor arm for glucose and weight, the GCG receptor arm for energy expenditure and hepatic fat metabolism), then lists both approved indications separately (long-term weight management, and glycaemic control in adult type 2 diabetes). The easily-misremembered titration schedule (start at 2mg, step to 4mg, maintain at 4 or 6mg) and the missed-dose rules are laid out as comparison tables. Contraindications, the boxed warning, special populations, and storage conditions sit in the sidebar, and the page closes with the data source and a scan-code entry.

Best for: patients on or starting GLP-1 class drugs, anyone tracking new weight-loss and glucose-lowering agents, family caregivers looking up medicines for relatives, and community doctors and pharmacists who need a fast, accurate check on a new drug.

artifacts.label: 玛仕度肽注射液速读页（是什么 / 能治什么 / 剂量滴定 / 漏打处理 + 小程序码入口）

cases.prompt:
你是腾讯健康药箱用药专家，帮用户认识一个陌生药品。用户会拿一个没听过的药名来问「这是什么药」，你要**一次性**输出一个读完就懂的完整速读页面，不追问、不分多轮。

用户输入：{用户想了解的药品，例如「帮我查一下玛仕度肽注射液，这是什么药」}

请一次完成以下全部内容：

1. **确认是哪一盒药**：商品名（通用名）、上市许可持有人、剂型、是否处方药，并列出全部规格；规格有多档时说明每档的用途差异。
2. **这是什么药**：讲清它属于哪一类、作用在什么靶点或机制上。若是多靶点药物，把每个靶点各自负责什么疗效分开讲。再补一段制剂与给药特点（给药途径、用药频次、可否自行注射或服用、禁止的给药方式、给药时间是否受进餐影响）。
3. **能治什么**：把**全部已获批适应症**逐项分开列出，不要只写其中一项。每项适应症下的细分场景（如单药治疗与联合治疗、或不同 BMI 与合并症门槛）必须分条写清，不合并成一句话。
4. **剂量怎么用**：如该药需要剂量滴定或分档给药，做成按阶段（周数或分层指标）对照的表格，写清每档剂量、该档的目的、进入下一档的前置条件与最大维持剂量。
5. **漏用怎么办**：如说明书有漏用处理规则，按距上次给药的时间区间做成对照表。
6. **特殊人群**：肝肾功能不全、老年、儿童青少年、孕妇与哺乳期分别说明是否需要调整剂量或禁用，并区分「无需调整」「数据有限」「禁用」三类结论。
7. **安全信息**：禁忌人群、说明书警示语、常见不良反应、贮藏条件（含温度与特殊保存期限）。
8. **数据来源与入口**：注明数据来源，并在结尾给出扫码进入腾讯健康药箱小程序查看完整说明书的入口。

数据要求：必须真实查询该药品的官方电子说明书或权威药品数据库，机制、适应症、规格、剂量、禁忌一律以查到的说明书原文为准。查不到的项目如实说明并提示以药品实际标签为准，**不要凭印象补内容、不要写「示意」或「模拟」数据**。涉及具体剂量处应提示遵医嘱。

输出形式：单文件 HTML 页面，所有 CSS 与图片资源内联、可离线打开，不引用任何外部链接或 CDN。整体走克制的蓝色医疗风，采用主栏 + 侧栏的卡片式布局，把核心结论（用法、剂量）前置到首屏，安全信息收在侧栏；信息密度要高但层级清晰，不使用 emoji 作图标。页面顶部以用药专家形象作为标识。文末附免责声明，说明内容仅供用药参考、不构成诊疗建议。
cases.prompt_en:
You are the Tencent Health Medicine Box medication expert, helping users understand an unfamiliar drug. Users bring a name they have never heard and ask "what is this drug"; you must produce a complete primer page in **one shot** — no follow-up questions, no multi-turn dialogue.

User input: {the drug the user asks about, e.g. "help me look up mazdutide injection, what is this drug"}

Complete all of the following in a single pass:

1. **Confirm which product it is**: brand name (generic name), marketing authorisation holder, dosage form, prescription status, and every available strength; when several strengths exist, explain how their roles differ.
2. **What this drug is**: state its class and the target or mechanism it acts on. For multi-target agents, describe what each target contributes separately. Then add the formulation and administration facts (route, dosing frequency, whether self-administration is allowed, prohibited routes, and whether timing depends on meals).
3. **What it treats**: list **every approved indication** as a separate item — do not cover only one of them. Sub-scenarios under each indication (monotherapy vs combination, or differing BMI and comorbidity thresholds) must be itemised rather than collapsed into one sentence.
4. **How it is dosed**: if the drug requires titration or tiered dosing, build a stage-by-stage table (by week or by a stratifying metric) stating each dose level, its purpose, the precondition for stepping up, and the maximum maintenance dose.
5. **Missed doses**: if the label defines missed-dose handling, present it as a table keyed by the interval since the last dose.
6. **Special populations**: address hepatic and renal impairment, elderly, children and adolescents, pregnancy and lactation, stating whether dose adjustment or contraindication applies, and distinguishing "no adjustment needed", "limited data", and "contraindicated".
7. **Safety information**: contraindicated populations, the labelled warning, common adverse reactions, and storage conditions (including temperature and any special holding period).
8. **Source and entry point**: state the data source, and close with a scan-code entry to the Tencent Health Medicine Box mini-program for the full package insert.

Data requirements: you must perform a real lookup of the drug's official electronic package insert or an authoritative drug database. Mechanism, indications, strengths, doses, and contraindications must follow the retrieved label text. Where something cannot be found, say so and defer to the physical drug label — **do not fill in content from memory and do not present "illustrative" or "simulated" figures**. Wherever specific doses appear, remind the reader to follow medical advice.

Output form: a single-file HTML page with all CSS and images inlined so it opens offline, referencing no external links or CDNs. Use a restrained blue medical style with a main-column plus sidebar card layout, promoting the core conclusions (administration and dose) to the first screen and keeping safety information in the sidebar. Information density should be high but clearly tiered; do not use emoji as icons. Place the medication-expert character at the top of the page as its identity mark. Close with a disclaimer stating the content is for medication reference only and does not constitute medical advice.

cases.title: 患教科学性与医学逻辑审核
cases.subtitle: 逐项核查数据来源、机制描述与因果关系表述
cases.subtitle_en: Verify data sourcing, mechanism description, and causal claims item by item
cases.description:
中医科普最容易踩的两个雷：一是把文献里的方子改写后和原方对不上，二是食疗推荐漏了关键人群禁忌。

这个案例把一篇「秋包伏」中药饮片调理患教文章交给 AI 做科学性与医学逻辑专项审核，逐项核查数据来源、机制描述与因果关系。产物顶部是专项审核结论（🔴 需修改 2、🟡 建议优化 4，覆盖科学性与医学逻辑两个维度），下方是 6 张问题卡片：🔴 文中「罗汉果粥」配方与文献[3]原方不符——原方六味含罗汉果 1/3 个、小黄粟米 50g，文中的「基础方」把这两味丢了且全无剂量，方名叫「罗汉果粥」却不含罗汉果；🔴 祛湿组推荐薏苡仁却未提示文献[1]明确「孕期不要服用薏米」这一关键禁忌；🟡 文献[3]为小儿秋季咳嗽经验却直接套用成人、多篇文献合并标注扩大化、培土生金术语与原文献不一致、糖尿病患者等特殊人群未提示。每条都指到具体段落并给出可执行修改建议，文末按严重程度分组展开明细。

适合：中医科普编辑、患教内容审核员、中医院公众号运营、健康科普自媒体、医学编辑团队负责人。
cases.description_en:
TCM popular-science articles hit two classic traps: rewriting a sourced formula so it no longer matches the original, and recommending food therapy while omitting a key population contraindication.

This case hands an article on autumn 'dryness' (qiubao fu) herbal-regimen patient education to AI for a dedicated scientific-accuracy and medical-logic audit, verifying data sourcing, mechanism description, and causal claims item by item. The deliverable opens with the verdict (2 must-fix, 4 suggested, across the scientific and medical-logic dimensions), followed by 6 issue cards: 🔴 the 'luohanguo congee' formula does not match reference [3] — the six-herb original uses 1/3 luohanguo and 50 g millet — both dropped in the text, with no dosages given, so a congee named after luohanguo contains none; 🔴 the dampness-removing group recommends coix seed without flagging reference [1]'s explicit 'do not take coix during pregnancy'; plus 4 suggested items (pediatric experience applied to adults, over-broad multi-reference citation, terminology mismatch, missing special-population notes). Each points to a specific paragraph with an actionable fix; all findings grouped at the end.

Best for: TCM science-communication editors, patient-education reviewers, hospital WeChat-account operators, health content creators, and editorial team leads.

artifacts.label: 科学性与医学逻辑专项审核报告（逐条问题卡片 + 核对结论）

cases.prompt:
你是医学科普内容审核助手，请对我提供的患教文章做一次科学性与医学逻辑专项审核，逐项核查数据来源、机制描述与因果关系表述，并输出为一份可直接打开的审核报告网页（不要分多轮追问，一次输出到底）。

待审核内容：{粘贴患教文章正文，含参考文献列表}
参考文献原文：{上传该文章引用的全部参考文献 PDF（指南/共识/说明书/期刊论文原文），供逐条溯源核对}

请重点审核以下两类问题：
一、科学性
1. 数据 / 配方溯源：文中引用的方药、剂量、食疗方是否与所引文献原文一致，指出与原方不符、剂量缺失或张冠李戴之处
2. 机制描述：中医病机 / 治则表述是否准确，术语与所引文献是否一致
3. 引用标注：每个标注的文献是否真正支撑该表述，是否存在标注扩大化
二、医学逻辑
1. 因果关系：相关性能否被表述为因果，机制推论是否成立
2. 证据外推：文献人群（如小儿）与文章受众（如成人）是否匹配，外推是否说明
3. 关键安全信息：食疗 / 用药推荐是否遗漏特殊人群禁忌（如孕妇、糖尿病、脾胃虚寒），缺失是否致害

网页需包含以下部分：
- 头部专项审核结论：需修改与建议优化项数，以及科学性与医学逻辑两个维度的各自结论
- 逐条问题卡片：每条含严重程度（🔴/🟡）、所属维度、位置（段落）、问题描述、修改建议
- 文末明细：按「需修改」「建议优化」分组展开

呈现要求：单文件 HTML，CSS/图片资源全部内联，可离线打开。
审核意见撰写要求：涉及与文献不符时，必须回到文献原文，逐味/逐句写明原始配方与剂量、或原句表述，并与文中写法做「文中：X ／ 原文：Y」的对照，再给出按原文改写后的建议表述；每条修改建议须具体可执行。
只发现问题、给修改建议，不做「可以发布」的发布决策。
cases.prompt_en:
You are a medical science communication content reviewer. Run a dedicated scientific-accuracy and medical-logic audit on the patient education article I provide — verify data sourcing, mechanism description, and causal claims item by item — and output a ready-to-open review report web page in one pass.

Content to review: {paste the patient education article, including the reference list}
Reference sources: {upload the full-text PDFs of every reference cited (guidelines/consensus/package inserts/journal articles) so each citation can be traced}

Focus on two classes of issues:
A. Scientific accuracy: (1) formula/data sourcing — do cited formulas, dosages, food therapies match the referenced source, flag mismatches, missing dosages, or misattribution; (2) mechanism description — are TCM pathogenesis/principle statements accurate and terminology consistent with sources; (3) citation — does each cited reference actually support the claim, or is citation over-broad.
B. Medical logic: (1) causality — is correlation presented as causation, do mechanism inferences hold; (2) extrapolation — does the source population (e.g., children) match the article audience (e.g., adults), is extrapolation noted; (3) critical safety — do therapy/drug recommendations omit special-population contraindications (pregnancy, diabetes, cold-spleen), and would omission cause harm.

The page must contain: a header verdict (must-fix and suggested counts, plus a conclusion for each of the scientific and medical-logic dimensions); per-issue cards (severity 🔴/🟡, dimension, location/paragraph, problem, suggested fix); and an end detail section grouped by must-fix / suggested.
Single-file HTML, fully inlined, offline-openable. When flagging a mismatch, go back to the source text, state the original formula with dosages (or the original sentence) herb by herb, present it as "text: X / source: Y", then give a rewrite; fixes must be actionable. Find issues and give fixes only — no publish decision.

cases.title: 患教参考文献 P0-P5 分级专项核验
cases.title_en: P0-P5 Graded Reference Audit for Patient-Education Articles
cases.subtitle: 引用的文献逐条验真伪、查数据、评级别，输出核验清单
cases.subtitle_en: Verify every cited reference for authenticity, data accuracy, and authority — output a graded audit checklist
cases.description:
患教文章里引用的文献是科学性的基石，但运营同学不是医学研究员，很难判断一篇引用到底靠不靠谱：这篇 SCI 论文是真的吗？正文里的数据和原文一致吗？这篇指南是最新的吗？引用一个过时的结论会不会误导患者？

本案例把一篇引用了 7 篇文献的高血压患教文章交给「腾讯健康药箱-私域患教内容审核助手」，它对每篇参考文献做 P0-P5 分级逐条核验：文献真实性（DOI/期刊/标题可查）、权威性评估（SCI 分区/影响因子/是否国家级指南）、时效性（近 5 年）、正文数据一致性（引用的数据与原文是否吻合）、引用适当性。输出《参考文献核验清单》表格 + 每篇详细核验报告。

适合: 药企医学部、患教内容质控员、医学编辑、循证医学专员。这是唯一以「审计形态」呈现的患教审核案例，与六维审核和社群快审形成差异化互补。
cases.description_en:
Cited references are the scientific foundation of patient-education articles — but operations staff aren't medical researchers. How can they tell if a citation is reliable: Is this SCI paper real? Does the data in the article match the original? Is this guideline up-to-date? Could citing outdated conclusions mislead patients?

This case hands a hypertension patient-education article citing 7 references to the Tencent Health Pill-Box Private-Domain Patient-Education Content Review Assistant. It performs a P0-P5 graded audit on each reference: authenticity (DOI/journal/title verifiable), authority assessment (SCI IF / national guideline or not), timeliness (within 5 years?), data consistency (does quoted data match original?), citation appropriateness. Outputs a Reference Audit Checklist table + detailed per-reference report.

Suitable for: pharma medical affairs, patient-education QC, medical editors, EBM specialists. This is the only "audit-style" patient-education review case, complementing the six-dimension review and social-copy quick-review cases.
cases.prompt:
我是医学编辑，这篇高血压患教文章挂了 5 篇参考文献，看着挺唬人。但我怀疑有几篇是作者随手编的——期刊名对不上、年份可疑，正文数字也跟我印象中的原文对不上。帮我一篇一篇查：真的存在吗？够权威吗？太老了吗？正文引用跟原文对得上吗？哪几篇必须换掉？

**正文引用（节选）**
- 我国成人高血压患病率 27.5%，患者约 2.45 亿，控制率仅 16.8%【1】
- 覆盖 31 省、45 万人的调查显示 18 岁以上居民患病率 23.2%【2】
- ALLHAT 研究纳入超 4 万人，噻嗪类利尿剂预防心血管事件不劣于钙拮抗剂与 ACEI【3】
- SPRINT 研究收缩压目标 120 mmHg，主要终点风险降低 25%，全因死亡降 27%【4】
- DASH 饮食使收缩压平均下降 11.4 mmHg，效果接近单药治疗【5】

**参考文献**
1. 《中国高血压防治指南（2024 年版）》，中国高血压联盟
2. Wang Z, et al. China Hypertension Survey 2012–2015. *Circulation*. 2018
3. ALLHAT Officers. Major outcomes in high-risk hypertensive patients. *JAMA*. 2002
4. SPRINT Research Group. Intensive versus Standard Blood-Pressure Control. *NEJM*. 2015
5. Appel LJ, et al. Effects of Dietary Patterns on Blood Pressure. *NEJM*. 2001

麻烦给每篇打个可用性等级（能直接用／可用但要留意／必须换掉），单列一节说清"正文数字 vs 原文数字"哪里不一致。最后给我替换检索建议——不能用的那些，我该去找什么文献补上。
cases.prompt_en:
I'm a medical editor. This hypertension patient-education article cites 5 references, and they look impressive. But I suspect some were fabricated — journal names don't match, years look off, and the body figures don't line up with what I recall. Verify each: does it exist? Authoritative enough? Too dated? Do the cited figures match the source? Which must be replaced?

**Body citations (excerpt)**
- Adult hypertension prevalence in China is 27.5%, about 245 million patients, with only 16.8% controlled [1]
- A survey across 31 provinces and 450,000 people found prevalence among adults 18+ at 23.2% [2]
- ALLHAT enrolled over 40,000 patients; thiazide diuretics were non-inferior to calcium channel blockers and ACE inhibitors [3]
- SPRINT targeted 120 mmHg systolic, reporting 25% primary-endpoint risk reduction and 27% lower all-cause mortality [4]
- The DASH diet lowers systolic pressure by 11.4 mmHg on average, approaching monotherapy [5]

**References**
1. Chinese Guidelines for the Prevention and Treatment of Hypertension (2024 edition), Chinese Hypertension League
2. Wang Z, et al. China Hypertension Survey 2012–2015. *Circulation*. 2018
3. ALLHAT Officers. Major outcomes in high-risk hypertensive patients. *JAMA*. 2002
4. SPRINT Research Group. Intensive versus Standard Blood-Pressure Control. *NEJM*. 2015
5. Appel LJ, et al. Effects of Dietary Patterns on Blood Pressure. *NEJM*. 2001

Assign each reference a usability grade (use as-is / usable with caveats / must replace), and add a dedicated section on where "body figure vs. source figure" diverges. Finish with replacement search guidance — for the ones I can't use, what literature should I find instead?
