cases.title: 一眼看出是 AI 写的，养成个人专属风格
cases.title_en: Everyone Can Tell It's AI-Written — Build a Voice That's Yours
cases.subtitle: 没写过东西也能定风格，五个问题聊出来再逐项挑掉 AI 味
cases.subtitle_en: Five questions to define your voice even with nothing written yet, then strip the AI tells one by one
cases.description: 用 AI 编程做产品的人，做内容也习惯让 AI 生成，结果发出来一眼假——而个人产品恰恰靠人味建立信任。这个案例针对「还没写过内容、没有样本可提取」的情况，用五问访谈直接聊出初始风格档案（语气人称、开场习惯、论证方式、可信度来源、风格禁区），然后逐项指出你那段内容的 AI 味具体在哪个词哪个句式、为什么显得假、怎么改，给出前后对照改写。特别处理开发者的语气平衡问题：技术味不能全删，全删会连可信度一起删掉，给出该去该留的判断标准。缺真实细节的地方明确指出，不代为编造。
cases.description_en: People who build products with AI coding tools tend to let AI write their content too — and it reads fake on arrival, which is fatal when a personal product runs on trust. Built for the case where you have written nothing and have no samples to mine, this case runs a five-question interview to produce an initial voice profile (tone and person, opening habits, how you argue, where credibility comes from, and your hard no-go zones), then points at the exact words and sentence patterns that make your draft read like AI, why each one reads fake, and how to fix it, with a before-and-after rewrite. It handles the developer's tone-balance problem specifically: technical voice must not be stripped entirely, because stripping it takes your credibility with it — so you get clear criteria for what to cut and what to keep. Where real detail is missing it says so instead of inventing it.

artifacts.label: 个人风格档案与去 AI 味改写

cases.prompt:
你是内容风格教练。我是一人公司（独立开发者），做了自己的产品在做内容推广。我发的内容一看就是 AI 写的，想改成自己说话的样子。

我的情况：
- 我的产品：{产品一句话介绍}
- 我之前写过内容吗：{写过几篇，可以贴 1-2 篇 / 没写过，都是 AI 生成的}
- 我不想变成哪种账号：{你反感的表达方式或账号类型}
- 需要改的这段内容：{把你觉得 AI 味重的那段贴进来}

请帮我做三件事：

1. 先问我五个问题定风格：如果我没有作品可参考，用访谈的方式问我五个问题（一次问完，不要来回聊），从我的回答里提炼出初始风格档案：语气人称、开场习惯、论证方式、可信度来源、以及我不能说的话
2. 逐项指出这段的 AI 味在哪：不要笼统说「太生硬」，要指到具体的词和句式，说明为什么这样写会显得假，怎么改
3. 按我的风格重写一版：给出前后对照，并说明每处为什么这么改

三条硬要求：

- 技术味不要全删。我是开发者，保留一部分技术表达反而可信；请明确告诉我哪些该去、哪些该留
- 改写必须用我自己的真实经历补细节。如果我提供的信息不够，直接告诉我缺什么，不要自己编具体数字和场景
- 最后给我一份可以复用的风格档案，下次我说「按我的风格写」就能直接用

输出为 HTML 卡片，单文件、CSS 内联，可直接双击打开。
cases.prompt_en:
You are a content style coach. I run a one-person company (indie developer) and I'm doing content to promote my own product. What I post obviously reads as AI-written and I want it to sound like me.

My situation:
- My product: {one-line product description}
- Have I written content before: {written a few pieces, can paste 1-2 / never written any, all AI-generated}
- The kind of account I don't want to become: {styles or account types you dislike}
- The piece that needs fixing: {paste the passage that reads most like AI}

Please do three things:

1. Ask me five questions first to define my voice: if I have no writing to reference, interview me with five questions (all at once — no back and forth) and distill an initial voice profile from my answers: tone and person, opening habits, how I argue, where my credibility comes from, and the things I must never say
2. Point out exactly where this piece reads like AI: don't just say "too stiff" — point at the specific words and sentence patterns, explain why they read fake, and how to fix them
3. Rewrite it in my voice: show it before and after, and explain why each change was made

Three hard requirements:

- Don't strip out all the technical voice. I'm a developer — keeping some technical language actually makes me credible; tell me explicitly what to cut and what to keep
- The rewrite must fill in detail from my real experience. If what I gave you isn't enough, tell me what's missing — don't invent specific numbers or scenes
- End with a reusable voice profile, so next time I can just say "write it in my voice" and use it directly

Output as an HTML card: single file, inlined CSS, openable with a double click.

experts.name: 赵写·营销通内容风格教练
experts.description: 把你自己怎么说话变成可复用的风格档案，写出来像本人不像 AI。

cases.title: 早餐杯定价与促销决策
cases.title_en: Breakfast Cup Pricing and Promotion Decision
cases.subtitle: 从成本地板到促销保本增量的确定性测算
cases.subtitle_en: Deterministic modeling from price floor to promotion break-even lift
cases.description:
新品定价不能只看竞品，也不能只把成本乘一个毛利率；平台费、退货损耗、支付意愿和促销让利会同时改变答案。

这个案例以七杯装燕麦谷物早餐杯为匿名商品，通过商品定价与促销组合 Skill 的确定性脚本测算贡献毛利保本价、完全成本保本价、目标毛利价、支付意愿区间、建议价格点和三种促销机制的保本增量与风险，最终生成可离线打开的 HTML 决策报告。

适合：新品负责人、电商运营、商品经理、经营分析和需要在活动前核算毛利底线的团队。
cases.description_en:
New-product pricing cannot rely only on competitors or cost-plus margins. Platform fees, return losses, willingness to pay, and promotional discounts all change the answer.

Using an anonymized seven-cup oat breakfast product, this case applies the Product Pricing and Promotion Strategy Skill's deterministic engine to calculate contribution and full-cost break-even prices, target-margin price, willingness-to-pay range, recommended price points, and the break-even lift and risk of three promotion mechanisms. The final deliverable is a self-contained offline HTML decision report.

Ideal for: new-product owners, e-commerce operators, merchandise managers, business analysts, and teams checking margin floors before campaigns.

artifacts.label: 定价与促销决策报告

cases.prompt: 请为七杯装燕麦谷物早餐杯制定平台电商新品定价与促销组合。已确认输入：单位变动成本 31.60 元，其中货品 22 元、包装 2.60 元、快递 7 元；平台佣金 5%、支付手续费 0.6%；退货率约 4%，货值回收率 80%，逆向物流 6 元；月固定投入 3 万元、月销量预期 2000 件。当前测试价 79 元，竞品价格为 69 元和 89 元，市场价格带按 49—109 元参考，目标贡献毛利率不低于 40%。单点支付意愿依次为太便宜 49 元、划算 59 元、有点贵 79 元、太贵 99 元；Gabor-Granger 的五个案例运营估计为 59/69/79/89/99 元对应购买意愿 68%/55%/40%/25%/14%，月度潜在可触达客群按 15000 人、陈述意愿折减系数按 55%，均标 C 级并需真实调研校准。经济价值估计为便利性增益 8 元、品牌认知弱势 3 元、价值捕获率 40%，同样为 C 级。没有历史销量序列，弹性只能用 C 级基准 -1.8。对比三种促销：满 159 减 20 按活动客单 176 元测算；赠送成本 6 元、感知标价 29 元的摇摇杯，预计销量增量 18%（已确认的运营估计）；新客满 69 减 10 券按测算客单 79 元、预计核销率 25% 计算。活动客单、感知标价和核销率均为 B/C 级运营估计，执行前需用真实数据复核。所有金额与 ROI 必须由官方脚本测算，并保留证据等级、假设与价格合规提示。
cases.prompt_en: Create an e-commerce new-product pricing and promotion strategy for a seven-cup oat breakfast product. Confirmed inputs: unit variable cost RMB 31.60, comprising RMB 22 product cost, RMB 2.60 packaging, and RMB 7 shipping; 5% platform commission and 0.6% payment fee; approximately 4% returns, 80% product-cost recovery, and RMB 6 reverse logistics; RMB 30,000 monthly fixed investment and 2,000 expected monthly units. The current test price is RMB 79, competitors are RMB 69 and RMB 89, the reference market band is RMB 49–109, and the target contribution margin is at least 40%. A single-point willingness-to-pay estimate is RMB 49 too cheap, RMB 59 good value, RMB 79 expensive but considered, and RMB 99 too expensive. Case planning estimates for Gabor-Granger are prices RMB 59/69/79/89/99 with purchase intent of 68%/55%/40%/25%/14%, a monthly reachable audience of 15,000, and a stated-intent discount factor of 55%; grade all of these C and require calibration with real research. The economic-value assumptions are RMB 8 convenience uplift, RMB 3 brand-awareness disadvantage, and a 40% capture ratio, also grade C. There is no historical sales series, so elasticity must remain a grade-C benchmark of -1.8. Compare three promotions: RMB 20 off RMB 159 modeled with an RMB 176 promotional basket; a shaker gift costing RMB 6 with RMB 29 perceived value and an operator-confirmed estimated unit lift of 18%; and a RMB 10 new-customer coupon with an RMB 69 threshold, RMB 79 modeled basket, and 25% estimated redemption. Treat the promotional basket, perceived value, and redemption rate as grade-B/C operating estimates that require real-data validation before execution. All financial figures and ROI must be calculated by the official script, with evidence grades, assumptions, and pricing-compliance warnings retained.

cases.title: 品牌 Messaging 手册
cases.subtitle: 从品牌审计到分受众话术治理的一体化品牌手册
cases.subtitle_en: An integrated brand playbook from messaging audit to audience-specific talk tracks
cases.description:
很多成长型 B2B 品牌并不是没有内容，而是官网、公众号、销售话术、PR 表达各说各话——亮点很多，却没有被组织成一套一致、可复用、可被销售和传播放大的品牌语言。本案例演示营销战役团队如何为典型成长型 B2B 科技 / 企业服务品牌完成一次品牌 Messaging 重塑：从竞品与标杆扫描、品牌问题诊断、Message House 搭建、Proof Points 体系、分受众话术库，到官网 / 公众号 / 销售 / 媒体 / 路演模板，最终形成 Markdown 完整手册 + HTML 品牌展示版。

适合：品牌负责人、市场负责人、创始人、内容团队、销售 enablement 团队、B2B 增长团队
cases.description_en:
Many growing B2B brands do not suffer from a lack of content, but from fragmented language across the website, social channels, sales decks, and PR: too many good points, with no single system organizing them into reusable brand messaging. This case shows how the Marketing Campaign Team rebuilds a Messaging v2.0 system for a typical growth-stage B2B technology or enterprise-service brand: from competitor and benchmark scans, messaging diagnosis, Message House design, and proof-point architecture, to audience-specific talk tracks and templates for the website, official content, sales, media, and investor narratives. Outputs both a full Markdown handbook and an HTML brand-manual version.

Best for: Brand Leads, Marketing Leads, Founders, Content Teams, Sales Enablement Teams, B2B Growth Teams

artifacts.label: 品牌手册 HTML 展示版
品牌手册 Markdown 完整版

cases.prompt:
请完成一次品牌审核与 Messaging 体系重塑，适用于典型成长型 B2B 科技 / 企业服务品牌：
1. 扫描 2-3 个竞品 / 标杆品牌的定位与 messaging 结构
2. 审计官网 / 公众号 / 销售话术中的 messaging 一致性问题
3. 提出新的 Messaging 框架（定位句、三大支柱、痛点映射、Proof Points）
4. 分受众输出话术库（C 端 / B 端 / 投资人 / 媒体）
5. 补充官网 Hero、About、公众号文末、销售开场、媒体采访、投资人路演等标准文案模板

输出《品牌 Messaging 体系 v2.0》Markdown 完整手册 + HTML 品牌手册版本。
cases.prompt_en:
Please complete a brand audit and messaging system rebuild, applicable to a typical growth-stage B2B technology / enterprise-service brand:
1. Scan the positioning and messaging structure of 2-3 competitors / benchmark brands
2. Audit messaging consistency issues across the website / official content channels / sales talk tracks
3. Propose a new messaging framework (positioning statement, three pillars, pain-point mapping, proof points)
4. Output audience-specific talk tracks (consumer / business / investor / media)
5. Add standard copy templates for the website hero, About, end-of-article on official content channels, sales openers, media interviews, investor pitches, etc.

Output a complete "Brand Messaging System v2.0" Markdown handbook + an HTML brand-handbook version.

experts.description_en: A team of 4 marketing specialists led by a Marketing Director: Content Creator (blog posts/email/social media/brand voice), Campaign Planner (campaign strategy/audience/channels/budget), SEO Expert (technical audit/content optimization/performance analytics), and Brand Analyst (competitive positioning/brand review). Covers the full marketing lifecycle.

cases.title: 用营销通自己当案例：洞察报告长什么样
cases.title_en: Eating Our Own Dog Food: A User Insight Report for Marketing Connect Itself
cases.subtitle: 以营销通（思研 + 金手指双平台）自身为演示对象——微信聊天、社群、评论、思研访谈四源语料，交叉验证产出洞察报告，看看自己的用户洞察闭环长什么样
cases.subtitle_en: Using Marketing Connect itself as the demo product — four sources of corpus cross-validated into an insight report, showing the full insight loop on our own platform
cases.description:
营销通有两个平台：思研做调研、金手指做投放。那用营销通自己当产品，跑一遍「用户洞察报告」会得到什么？这个案例给出了答案：以营销通为演示对象，虚构了一套早期用户的反馈语料（微信聊天、一人公司社群、应用商店评论、思研 AI 访谈四源 12 条），演示技能如何交叉验证出「起点缺失」「小预算诉求」「报告后断档」三个多源结论，并产出人群线索、话题钩子和可直接引用的用户原话。给想搞懂营销通定位的内部同学，也给想看洞察报告实际效果的用户——你自己的产品，照着 prompt 里的语料格式替换即可。

**关于演示语料**：Prompt 里内嵌的营销通用户反馈为虚构演示语料（4 个来源 12 条），分析框架与交叉验证逻辑是真实的；照着格式替换成你产品的真实反馈即可。
cases.description_en:
Marketing Connect has two platforms: SiYan for research and JinShouZhi for ad delivery. What happens if we run the User Insight Report skill on Marketing Connect itself? This case shows exactly that: a fictitious corpus of early-user feedback (WeChat chats, one-person-company communities, app-store reviews, and SiYan AI interviews — 12 items across 4 sources), cross-validated into three multi-source conclusions — missing starting point, small-budget demand, and the post-report gap — plus audience leads, topic hooks, and quotable user voices.

**About demo corpus**: The embedded feedback is fictitious; the analysis framework and cross-validation logic are real. Replace with your own product's real feedback in the same format.

artifacts.label: 营销通用户洞察报告（自身演示）

cases.prompt:
请把下面散落各处的用户反馈整合成一份完整的用户洞察报告（单文件 HTML，一次输出，不要反问我）。

【我的产品】
营销通 —— 面向小商家、一人公司与独立开发者的一站式营销平台，包含思研（AI 调研平台：发一个访谈链接即可回收真实用户反馈）和金手指（AI 广告投放系统：素材策略与投放咨询）。
（替换为你的产品：{产品名 + 一句话介绍}）

【语料一：微信聊天】（示例语料，替换为你的真实记录）
对话 A（朋友，一人公司，卖 Notion 模板）：
「上个月模板卖了两万三，全是靠社群自发。我试了下金手指，给的素材策略挺全，但我连广告账户都没有，卡在开户那一步就放弃了」「最想要的是你直接告诉我第一周花多少钱、投什么词」
对话 B（朋友，淘宝手作店主）：
「我不懂什么人群包定向，我就想知道每天 50 块能不能投，投了有没有人来问我」

【语料二：社群/朋友圈反馈】（示例语料，替换为你的）
「试了思研，发了 20 个链接回来 14 份，比我自己一个个约人聊快多了。问题是报告出来我不知道下一步干嘛」
「金手指的素材策略 PDF 很专业，但对我这种连图都不会修的人，能不能直接把图也生成好」
「从验证需求到投广告整个链路是通的，就是入口藏得有点深，我找金手指找了半天」

【语料三：应用商店/评论区】（示例语料，替换为你的）
评论 1（5 星）：「思研访谈是真省事，发到两个群里当天就回收了十几份，免费版额度够用。」
评论 2（3 星）：「素材策略给了十几页，看不完。我只想知道先投哪一条。」
评论 3：「什么时候出手机版？在外面想看投放数据只能等回家。」

【语料四：思研 AI 访谈】（示例语料，替换为你的；暂无可整段删除）
受访者 1（vibe coding 开发者，做了个 AI 记账工具）：
「我用思研访谈了 10 个用户，发现根本没人需要自动记账，大家要的是月底能给我看花了多少。这一轮帮我省了三个月白做功能」「广告我肯定投，但我预算一个月就 500，怕全打水漂」
受访者 2（一人公司，做知识付费）：
「内容我自己能写，就是不知道发什么平台、什么时间发。要是能根据洞察直接排个内容日历我就付费」

【分析要求】
1. 严格区分「用户原话」与「推测」——原话单独列出并标注来源；推测必须标注为待验证
2. 多源交叉验证——同一问题至少两个来源重复出现才标高频；单源问题标注「仅单一来源」；口头付费意愿标注「口头报价」；矛盾点（如"策略要专业完整" vs "我只要先投哪条"）单独列出并指出需要产品决策
3. 报告包含六节：核心结论（≤3 条，标来源数）· 洞察明细（表格，含状态标签）· 用户原话（按主题分组，可直接引用，标来源）· 人群线索（人群×特征×话题钩子×卖点角度——这是给内容与广告的创意输入）· 当前未知 · 下一步建议（编号，按顺序做）
4. 输出单文件 HTML：无外部资源引用，原话与推测要有视觉区分（不同底色/标签）
5. 如果我的语料太少不足以分析，直接在报告「当前未知」节说明，并给我 3-5 个建议用思研（营销通专区的 AI 调研平台，发访谈链接即可回收反馈）补采的具体问题

cases.description: 面对突然被公司辞退的困境，不知道自己的权益如何保障？本案例演示如何运用系统化法律推理，从管辖权、事实认定、法律争点、适用法律、风险评估到行动建议六个维度，全面分析劳动合同解除的法律风险。适合职场人士、HR从业者、法律专业学生及需要了解劳动法维权路径的人群。
cases.description_en: Facing sudden dismissal and unsure about your rights? This case demonstrates systematic legal reasoning across six dimensions — jurisdiction, facts, issues, applicable law, risk assessment, and action recommendations — to comprehensively analyze legal risks in labor contract termination. Suitable for professionals, HR practitioners, law students, and anyone needing to understand labor law protection paths.

artifacts.label: 法律分析报告

cases.prompt:
你是一位资深劳动法律师。公司以「不胜任工作」为由解除劳动合同，员工认为考核不合理。请从管辖权、事实认定、法律争点、适用法律、风险评估、行动建议六个维度进行系统分析。

背景：员工在北京某互联网公司工作3年，最近一次绩效考核为C（不合格），公司依据内部规章制度解除劳动合同，未支付经济补偿金。

输出要求：以 Markdown 格式输出完整法律分析报告，包含表格对比、风险矩阵和分点行动建议，不少于 2000 字。
cases.prompt_en:
You are a senior labor law attorney. A company terminated an employment contract on the grounds of "inability to perform the job," and the employee believes the performance evaluation was unreasonable. Please conduct a systematic analysis across six dimensions: jurisdiction, fact-finding, legal points of dispute, applicable law, risk assessment, and recommended actions.

Background: The employee worked at an internet company in Beijing for 3 years, and the most recent performance evaluation was a C (unsatisfactory). The company terminated the employment contract based on internal rules and regulations, without paying severance.

Output requirements: Output a complete legal analysis report in Markdown format, including comparison tables, a risk matrix, and itemized action recommendations, no fewer than 2,000 words.

cases.title: 微信小店 30 天冷启动计划
cases.subtitle: 私域破零、推客分发与素材测试的执行界面
cases.subtitle_en: An execution interface for private-domain launch, affiliates, and creative testing
cases.description:
微信小店新店最常见的问题不是“没有流量技巧”，而是没有先跑通关联账号、支付履约、私域破零和首批成交数据。

这个案例为一个早餐食品新店设计 30 天冷启动方案，通过微信小店运营 Skill 的测算、违禁词扫描和 HTML 渲染链路，交付包含目标倒推、三条增长路径、四周甘特图、逐周动作、责任人、完成标准、风险项和开店自检的交互式页面。

适合：微信小店新商家、视频号电商运营、私域团队和需要把冷启动任务拆到周与责任人的小型团队。
cases.description_en:
The most common new-store problem on WeChat is not a lack of traffic tricks, but failure to establish linked accounts, payment and fulfillment, private-domain first orders, and initial transaction signals.

This case creates a 30-day launch plan for a breakfast-food store. Using the WeChat Store Ops Skill's calculator, compliance scanner, and HTML renderer, it delivers an interactive interface covering target decomposition, three growth paths, a four-week Gantt, weekly actions, owners, completion criteria, risk flags, and a store-launch checklist.

Ideal for: new WeChat Store merchants, WeChat Channels commerce operators, private-domain teams, and small teams assigning launch work by week and owner.

artifacts.label: 30 天冷启动交互方案

cases.prompt: 请为主营七杯装燕麦谷物早餐杯的微信小店制定 30 天冷启动方案。店铺处于新店未破零阶段，客单价约 79 元；现有触点包括约 8000 名公众号粉丝、5 个社群共约 900 人、企微好友约 1500 人，尚未开通视频号。30 天目标支付 GMV 为 5 万元，可投预算 1 万元，团队包括老板、运营、客服和仓储各一名。GMV 倒推采用案例规划假设 UV=8000、转化率=2.5%、客单价=79 元；69 元测试到手价的毛利测算采用货品及履约成本 31.60 元、技术服务费 3%、推客佣金 10%、退货损耗 2 元、运费已含在 31.60 元成本中。以上均不是历史实绩，真实执行前必须以后台费率、实际佣金和履约成本重跑官方脚本。方案必须先跑通关联视频号、运费与退货模板、有效电话、商户号和 1 元测试单，再依次安排私域预售破零、推客素材包、首场直播和小额素材投放。所有 GMV 倒推和毛利数字使用官方脚本；每个时间轴动作必须有责任人、完成标准和必要风险提示；最终交付自包含 HTML。
cases.prompt_en: Create a 30-day launch plan for a new WeChat Store selling a seven-cup oat breakfast product. The store has not yet made its first sale, with an average order value of about RMB 79. Existing touchpoints include roughly 8,000 Official Account followers, five communities totaling about 900 people, and around 1,500 WeCom contacts; there is no WeChat Channels account yet. The 30-day paid-GMV target is RMB 50,000 with a RMB 10,000 test budget. The team consists of one owner, one operator, one customer-service person, and one warehouse person. Use case-planning assumptions of 8,000 UV, a 2.5% conversion rate, and RMB 79 AOV for GMV decomposition. For the RMB 69 delivered-price margin model, use RMB 31.60 product-and-fulfillment cost, a 3% technical service fee, 10% affiliate commission, RMB 2 return loss, and treat shipping as already included in the RMB 31.60 cost. These are planning assumptions, not historical performance; rerun the official script with actual backend rates, commissions, and fulfillment cost before execution. The plan must first establish the linked Channels account, shipping and return templates, valid contact numbers, merchant account, and a RMB 1 test order, then sequence private-domain presale for first orders, an affiliate asset pack, the first livestream, and small-budget creative testing. Use the official scripts for all GMV decomposition and margin figures. Every timeline action must include an owner, completion criterion, and necessary risk warning. Deliver a self-contained HTML report.

cases.title: Agent 竞品网站变更监控
cases.subtitle: 多 Agent 协作监控竞品定价、功能与内容变更并生成可视化仪表盘
cases.subtitle_en: Multi-Agent Workflow for Monitoring Competitor Pricing, Features & Content Changes with Visual Dashboard
cases.description:
竞品悄悄调整了定价策略、上线了新功能、或在博客中暗示了产品方向——等你从行业群聊中偶然得知，竞争窗口期可能已经过去了。手动定期检查竞品网站不仅耗时，而且很容易遗漏细微但关键的变化。

这个案例演示了一个多 Agent 竞品监控工作流：采集 Agent 模拟抓取 Notion、Coda、Craft 三个竞品的定价页面、功能页面和博客更新日志；对比 Agent 将本次抓取结果与历史数据对比，识别价格调整、新增功能、下线功能和文案变化；分析 Agent 评估每项变更的影响等级（高/中/低）并生成竞品动态摘要；报告 Agent 生成包含变更时间线、详情卡片、影响标签和应对建议的可视化仪表盘。

适合：产品经理、竞品分析师、市场研究员、战略规划团队、SaaS 创业公司的业务负责人。
cases.description_en:
Competitors quietly adjust pricing, launch new features, or hint at product direction in blog posts — by the time you hear about it casually, the competitive window may have passed. Manually checking competitor websites is time-consuming and easy to miss subtle but critical changes.

This case demonstrates a multi-agent competitor monitoring workflow: a Collection Agent simulates scraping Notion, Coda, and Craft's pricing pages, feature pages, and changelogs; a Comparison Agent identifies changes against historical data; an Analysis Agent evaluates impact levels; a Report Agent generates a visual dashboard with change timelines, detail cards, impact badges, and recommended actions.

Ideal for: product managers, competitive analysts, market researchers, strategy teams, and SaaS startup leads.
cases.prompt: 我需要一个 Agent 工作流来监控 3 个竞品的网站变更。竞品：Notion、Coda、Craft。请设计流程：1) 采集 Agent 模拟抓取三个竞品的定价页面、功能页面和博客/更新日志；2) 对比 Agent 将本次抓取结果与上次（模拟的历史数据）对比，识别变更项（价格调整/新功能/下线功能/文案变化）；3) 分析 Agent 评估变更的影响等级（高/中/低）并生成竞品动态摘要；4) 报告 Agent 生成可视化的竞品监控仪表盘。产出一个 HTML 仪表盘，包含三个竞品的变更时间线、变更详情卡片、影响等级标签和应对建议。
cases.prompt_en: I need an Agent workflow to monitor changes on the websites of 3 competitors. Competitors: Notion, Coda, Craft. Please design the workflow: 1) A Collection Agent simulates scraping each competitor's pricing page, features page, and blog/changelog; 2) A Comparison Agent compares the latest scrape with the previous one (simulated historical data) and identifies changes (price adjustments / new features / discontinued features / copy changes); 3) An Analysis Agent assesses the impact level of each change (high/medium/low) and generates a competitor activity summary; 4) A Reporting Agent generates a visual competitor monitoring dashboard. Produce an HTML dashboard containing a change timeline for the three competitors, change detail cards, impact-level tags, and recommended responses.

cases.title: B2B 官网 SEO 审计
cases.subtitle: 技术诊断到 90 天优化路线图的一体化审计案例
cases.subtitle_en: An end-to-end SEO audit from technical diagnosis to a 90-day optimization roadmap
cases.description:
很多 B2B 官网的问题不是“没做 SEO”，而是技术底座、栏目结构、关键词覆盖和转化路径彼此脱节——首页讲品牌、博客讲知识、产品页讲功能，但搜索流量进来之后并没有被有效导向商机页面。本案例演示营销战役团队如何为典型 B2B 官网 xxx.com 做完整 SEO 审计：梳理技术 SEO 风险、内容 SEO 短板、竞品内容差距、关键词机会地图、TOP 20 内容优化优先级，以及 90 天执行计划与 KPI 汇报机制。最终输出 Markdown 审计完整版 + HTML 可视化报告。

适合：市场负责人、增长负责人、SEO 经理、内容负责人、B2B 官网运营、企业服务创始人
cases.description_en:
The real problem with many B2B websites is not a lack of SEO effort, but disconnected foundations: technical setup, site architecture, keyword coverage, and conversion paths all operate in silos. The homepage talks brand, the blog talks education, the product pages list features—yet incoming search traffic is not effectively guided toward pipeline-generating pages. This case shows how the Marketing Campaign Team conducts a full SEO audit for a typical B2B website, xxx.com: covering technical SEO risks, content SEO gaps, competitor content benchmarking, a keyword opportunity map, a prioritized top-20 content optimization list, and a 90-day execution plan with KPI reporting cadence. Outputs both a full Markdown audit and an HTML visualization-ready report.

Best for: Marketing Leads, Growth Leads, SEO Managers, Content Leads, B2B Website Operators, B2B SaaS Founders

artifacts.label: SEO 审计 HTML 可视化版
SEO 审计 Markdown 完整版

cases.prompt:
我们有一个 B2B 官网（xxx.com），流量 6 个月没增长。请做完整 SEO 审计：
- 技术 SEO（爬取/索引/速度/结构化数据）
- 内容 SEO（现有内容表现、关键词覆盖、竞品对比）
- 外链现状
- 关键词机会地图
- 现有 TOP 20 文章优化建议
- 90 天 SEO 行动计划

输出《官网 SEO 全面审计报告》Markdown + HTML 可视化（关键词机会热力图、内容差距矩阵）。
cases.prompt_en:
We have a B2B corporate website (xxx.com), and traffic hasn't grown in 6 months. Please do a complete SEO audit:
- Technical SEO (crawling/indexing/speed/structured data)
- Content SEO (performance of existing content, keyword coverage, competitor comparison)
- Backlink status
- A keyword opportunity map
- Optimization recommendations for the current TOP 20 articles
- A 90-day SEO action plan

Output a "Comprehensive Website SEO Audit Report" in Markdown + an HTML visualization (a keyword opportunity heatmap and a content gap matrix).

Covers the full marketing lifecycle.

cases.title: Agent 自动汇总 Git 周报
cases.subtitle: 多 Agent 协作采集、分类、统计 Git 数据并生成可视化周报
cases.subtitle_en: Multi-Agent Git Data Collection, Classification, Statistics & Visual Dashboard
cases.description:
每周五下午花两小时手动汇总团队周报？从 Git log 里数 commit、从 GitHub 上查 PR、从 Issue 列表里统计进度——重复劳动不说，还容易遗漏和出错？monorepo 项目模块多、人员多，手工整理根本理不清楚。

本案例展示了一套多 Agent 协作的 Git 周报自动化工作流：采集 Agent 拉取本周所有 commit log、PR 合并记录和 Issue 关闭情况，分类 Agent 将变更按模块分类（组件库/业务页面/基础设施/文档）并标注 PR 类型（feature/fix/refactor/chore），统计 Agent 计算每人代码量、PR 数、Review 数和平均 PR 合并时间，呈现 Agent 生成包含数据可视化的 HTML 周报仪表盘。从原始 Git 数据到专业周报页面，全程自动完成。

适合：前端/全栈团队 Leader、项目经理、Scrum Master、需要定期产出团队产出报告的技术管理者。
cases.description_en:
Spending hours every Friday manually compiling team weekly reports? Counting commits from git log, checking PRs on GitHub, tallying issue progress — tedious, error-prone, and never complete?

This case demonstrates a multi-Agent automated Git weekly report workflow: Collection Agent pulls commit logs, merged PRs, and closed issues, Classification Agent categorizes changes by module and PR type, Statistics Agent calculates per-developer metrics, Presentation Agent generates an HTML dashboard with data visualization.

Ideal for: frontend/full-stack team leads, project managers, Scrum Masters, and tech managers needing regular team output reports.
cases.prompt:
请设计一个 Agent 工作流自动生成团队 Git 周报，产出一个 HTML 周报仪表盘（单文件 HTML，内联无外部依赖），界面文字用简体中文（PR/Commit 等术语可保留英文）。

场景：5 人前端团队 monorepo。流程：
1. 采集 Agent：拉取本周 commit、PR 合并、Issue 关闭（模拟数据）
2. 分类 Agent：按模块（组件库/业务页面/基础设施/文档）分类，标注 PR 类型（feature/fix/refactor/chore）
3. 统计 Agent：每人代码量、PR 数、Review 数、平均 PR 合并时间
4. 呈现 Agent：生成可视化周报
cases.prompt_en:
Design an Agent workflow that automatically generates a team Git weekly report, producing an HTML weekly dashboard (single-file HTML, inlined with no external dependencies). The interface text should be in Simplified Chinese (terms like PR/Commit may remain in English).

Scenario: a 5-person frontend team monorepo. Workflow:
1. Collection Agent: pull this week's commits, merged PRs, and closed issues (mock data)
2. Classification Agent: categorize by module (component library / business pages / infrastructure / docs) and label PR type (feature/fix/refactor/chore)
3. Statistics Agent: per-person lines of code, PR count, review count, and average PR merge time
4. Presentation Agent: generate the visual weekly report

cases.title: Agent 自动化测试报告生成
cases.subtitle: 多 Agent 协作完成测试执行、覆盖率分析与报告生成
cases.subtitle_en: Multi-Agent Collaboration for Test Execution, Coverage Analysis & Report Generation
cases.description:
测试写了不少，但覆盖率报告只是一堆数字？失败用例需要手动排查根因？每次发版前花半天时间整理测试报告？Node.js 电商项目功能越来越多，测试套件越来越庞大，团队急需一套自动化方案来系统化管理测试质量。

本案例展示了一套完整的多 Agent 协作测试工作流：分析 Agent 扫描项目结构识别测试文件与覆盖率目标，执行 Agent 运行 Jest 测试套件收集通过/失败/跳过的用例详情，覆盖率 Agent 分析各模块覆盖率并标注低覆盖率热点，报告 Agent 生成结构化测试报告——包含覆盖率矩阵、失败用例根因分析和具体修复建议。最终产出完整的 TypeScript 测试代码和 JSON 格式测试报告。

适合：全栈开发工程师、QA 工程师、技术团队 Leader、希望提升测试自动化水平的 Node.js 团队。
cases.description_en:
Tests written but coverage reports are just meaningless numbers? Failed cases need manual root cause analysis? Spending half a day preparing test reports before every release?

This case demonstrates a complete multi-Agent collaborative testing workflow: Analysis Agent scans project structure and identifies test targets, Execution Agent runs Jest test suites and collects pass/fail/skip details, Coverage Agent analyzes per-module coverage and flags low-coverage hotspots, Report Agent generates structured test reports with coverage matrices, failure root cause analysis, and fix recommendations.

Ideal for: full-stack developers, QA engineers, tech leads, and Node.js teams seeking better test automation.
cases.prompt: 我需要一个 Agent 工作流来自动执行测试并生成报告。场景：一个 Node.js 电商项目。流程：1) 分析 Agent 扫描项目结构，识别测试文件和覆盖率目标；2) 执行 Agent 运行 Jest 测试套件，收集通过/失败/跳过的用例；3) 覆盖率 Agent 分析各模块覆盖率，标注低覆盖率热点；4) 报告 Agent 生成结构化测试报告（含覆盖率矩阵、失败用例根因分析、修复建议）。输出一个完整的 TypeScript 测试文件 + JSON 格式测试报告。
cases.prompt_en: I need an Agent workflow that automatically runs tests and generates a report. Scenario: a Node.js e-commerce project. Workflow: 1) An Analysis Agent scans the project structure, identifying test files and coverage targets; 2) An Execution Agent runs the Jest test suite, collecting passed/failed/skipped cases; 3) A Coverage Agent analyzes per-module coverage and flags low-coverage hotspots; 4) A Report Agent generates a structured test report (including a coverage matrix, root-cause analysis of failed cases, and fix recommendations). Output one complete TypeScript test file plus a test report in JSON format.

cases.title: 涨停情绪驾驶舱
cases.subtitle: 用高密度卡片和信号面板呈现封板强度、情绪温度与高标接力。
cases.subtitle_en: A high-density signal board for sealing strength, sentiment temperature, and ladder continuation.
cases.description:
盘后看涨跌停，最怕只有清单没有判断：到底是普涨修复、局部抱团，还是高标接力重新启动？这个案例把封板率、涨跌比、连板高度、封单榜和热点扩散整合成一个情绪驾驶舱，适合快速判断市场温度。

你能直接看到一份高密度双语 HTML 看板：大盘温度、指数脉冲、连板塔、热点簇和封单集中区都在一屏到两屏内说清楚，便于交易团队盘后复盘或盘前快速预热。

适合：短线交易员、情绪周期研究者、盘后复盘作者、需要快速抓强弱切换的人。
cases.description_en:
When reviewing limit-ups after the close, a raw list is never enough: was the market broadening, crowding into one pocket, or reigniting ladder continuation? This case packages seal rate, breadth ratio, ladder height, seal leaders, and hotspot diffusion into a sentiment cockpit built for fast judgment.

The output is a dense bilingual HTML dashboard where market temperature, index pulse, ladder structure, hotspot clusters, and seal concentration are all visible within one or two screens, making it useful for post-close debriefs or pre-open preparation.

Best for: short-term traders, sentiment-cycle researchers, recap writers, and anyone tracking strength rotation.
cases.prompt: 请基于最新一个有完整收盘数据的 A 股交易日，生成一份“涨停情绪驾驶舱”HTML，看清当日市场温度。用真实查询得到的涨停家数、封板未遂、涨跌比、连板高度、封单榜、热点板块与代表个股，突出强修复、分歧还是退潮的判断。页面需要高信息密度但保持明亮易读，风格偏轻科技、信号墙和斜切操作面板，适合交易团队盘后复盘或盘前快速查看；单文件 HTML、资源全内联、可离线打开。请保留数据日期、来源说明与风险声明。
cases.prompt_en: Using the latest A-share trading day with complete closing data, generate a “Limit-Up Sentiment Cockpit” HTML page that reveals the day’s market temperature. Query real data for total limit-ups, failed seals, the up/down ratio, ladder height, seal leaders, hotspot sectors, and representative names, then judge whether the session reflected broad repair, divergence, or fading momentum. Keep the page bright but high-density, with a light-tech signal-wall feel and angular operation panels, suitable for a trading team’s post-close debrief or pre-open check. Deliver a single self-contained HTML file that works offline, and include the data date, source notes, and risk disclaimer.

cases.title: A股短线博弈台
cases.subtitle: 先定周期，再看高低位与空仓检验
cases.subtitle_en: Define the cycle first, then read high-vs-low setup and the empty-hand test
cases.description:
短线复盘最容易掉进一个坑：只看涨停数量，却看不清到底是谁在定高度、谁只是跟风补涨、谁又会成为第二天最先掉队的中位风险区。很多所谓“龙头战法”，问题都出在节奏而不是名字。

这个案例演示了如何用 A 股收盘后的真实连板、封单、资金流和龙虎榜数据，做一份短线博弈复盘：先定周期，再区分绝对高位和低位试错，接着看换手、人气和空仓检验，最后输出次日纪律清单。

适合：做短线题材与连板观察的人、关注龙头与低位试错节奏的交易者、需要把“今天到底能不能打板”讲清楚的复盘场景。
cases.description_en:
Shortline reviews often fall into the same trap: people count limit-ups without seeing who actually sets the ceiling, who is merely a sympathy follower, and which mid-ladder names are most likely to fail first the next day. In many so-called leader strategies, the real problem is timing rather than the chosen ticker.

This case shows how to turn real A-share ladder, seal-volume, flow and Dragon-Tiger data into a shortline game review: define the cycle first, separate absolute highs from low-base probes, then study turnover, popularity and the empty-hand test before ending with a disciplined next-session checklist.

Ideal for traders tracking shortline themes and ladder names, anyone focused on timing high-level leaders versus low-base probes, and post-close review scenarios that need a precise answer to whether the day was truly playable.

cases.prompt_en: Create a single-file HTML A-share shortline game review for a specified trade date. First confirm whether the day is a trading session; if the market is closed, say so directly. If data exists, focus on the sentiment cycle, absolute highs, low-base probes, seal strength, main-force flow, popularity anchors and the empty-hand test, and output a cycle judgment, representative ladder names, Dragon-Tiger observations, next-session discipline and risk notes. Fully self-contained for offline use, and based on real public market data with the statistics date shown clearly.

cases.title: 创始人不在场的执行系统
cases.title_en: An Execution System That Runs Without the Founder
cases.subtitle: 把反复拍板变成团队可复用的判断
cases.subtitle_en: Turn Repeated Approvals into Reusable Team Judgement
cases.description:
一家 15 人内容服务创业公司里，创始人外出两天，项目排期、客户承诺和优先级便全部卡住。团队并非不愿意推进，而是在等待创始人逐项解释什么更重要、什么可以承诺、什么才算做对。

本案例不把问题误诊为执行力不足，也不建议用更多例会和逐项审批加码。它回到更前面的判断：系统是否已经把确认过的判断、对错标准与上报边界固定进团队共同可见的环境。

通过三项自检，创始人可以检查判断是否固定、成功标准是否清楚、升级边界是否明确，并把“我不在就停摆”的信号转化为建设可重复执行环境的起点。
cases.description_en:
At a 15-person content-services startup, the founder leaves for two days and project schedules, client commitments, and priorities all stall. The team is not unwilling to proceed; it is waiting for the founder to explain, item by item, what matters most, what can be promised, and what counts as doing it right.

This case does not misdiagnose the issue as weak execution, nor does it prescribe more meetings and item-by-item approvals. It returns to the earlier judgement: has the system fixed confirmed judgement, standards for right and wrong, and escalation boundaries in an environment visible to the whole team?

Through three self-checks, founders can test whether judgement is fixed, success standards are clear, and escalation boundaries are explicit—then turn the signal of “everything stops when I am away” into a starting point for building a repeatable operating environment.
cases.prompt: 你是一家 15 人内容服务创业公司的创始人。你外出两天后，项目排期、客户承诺和优先级全部卡住，团队说“老板不拍板就不知道怎么做”。你原本想增加每日例会和逐项审批。请不要把问题简单归为团队执行力不足，也不要给出空泛的管理技巧。请先诊断真正卡住的是什么：哪些已确认的判断仍只留在创始人脑中，团队缺少哪些共同的对错标准，以及什么情况下应该自行判断、什么情况下必须上报。然后围绕“创始人不在场时，事情是否还能以认可方式继续发生”设计一个最小的执行系统自检框架，包含判断是否固定、成功标准是否清楚、升级边界是否明确三项。最后把“盯人”的反应替换成“建系统”的动作，并用 1–2 个具体反问收尾，帮助创始人回到自己的位置重新看问题。不得虚构企业数据。
cases.prompt_en: You are the founder of a 15-person content-services startup. After you leave for two days, project schedules, client commitments, and priorities all stall. The team says, “Without the boss deciding, we do not know what to do.” Your first instinct is to add daily meetings and item-by-item approvals. Do not reduce this to a simple lack of team execution, and do not offer generic management tips. First diagnose what is actually stuck: which confirmed judgements still exist only in the founder’s mind, which shared standards for right and wrong the team lacks, and which situations should be decided independently versus escalated. Then design a minimal execution-system self-check around this question: when the founder is absent, can work still proceed in a way the founder recognizes? Include three checks: whether judgement is fixed, whether success standards are clear, and whether escalation boundaries are explicit. Finally, replace the instinct to watch people with actions that build a system, and close with one or two concrete questions that bring the founder back to their own position. Do not invent company data.

cases.description:

报告会结合真实公开资料，拆出玻璃原片、激光成孔、金属化填铜、检测与封装验证等关键节点，再把这些瓶颈映射到 A 股公司，并说明哪些仍停留在验证阶段。

适合：想理解先进封装新方向的人；需要从技术升级反推产业受益链的投研人员；要评估 TGV 公司映射真实性的产业分析师。
cases.description_en:
As advanced packaging keeps moving toward higher density and bandwidth, glass substrate / TGV is mentioned repeatedly, but the real value is not the phrase “new material” — it is who can actually stabilize via formation, copper filling, RDL, and yield. This case shows how to trace the glass-substrate TGV chain backward from technology iteration to process and equipment chokepoints.

Using real public materials, the report breaks the chain into glass sheet, laser via formation, metallization copper filling, inspection, and packaging-validation nodes, then maps those bottlenecks to A-share companies while explaining which names still sit at the verification stage.

Best for: users trying to understand new advanced-packaging directions; researchers tracing beneficiaries from technology upgrades; industry analysts assessing whether TGV mappings are real.

cases.title_en: Track Chronic Disease Indicators Across Rechecks
cases.subtitle: 多次复查报告一起看，指标是变好还是变差一目了然
cases.subtitle_en: Compare multiple recheck reports at once — see instantly whether indicators improved or worsened
cases.description:
高血压、糖尿病、脂肪肝这类慢病，最关键的不是单次数值，而是趋势。可现实是几次复查单夹在不同文件夹里，上次血糖多少、药调整后有没有效果，全靠回忆，医生问起来也说不清。

这个案例演示把同一个人多次（3 次以上）的复查报告一起交给 AI：先逐份提取指标建立统一口径的对照表，再按时间轴计算每个关键指标的变化方向和幅度，标出「持续改善 / 基本稳定 / 持续恶化 / 波动明显」，指出哪些指标已回到参考范围内、哪些仍在恶化需要重点干预，并整理出一份可以直接带去门诊、方便医生快速判断的随访摘要。

适合：高血压/糖尿病/脂肪肝等慢病长期管理者、术后与用药后复查人群、家庭健康档案整理、基层医疗与慢病随访管理团队、体检中心的持续健康管理服务。
cases.description_en:
For chronic conditions like hypertension, diabetes, or fatty liver, what matters is the trend, not a single reading. In practice, recheck reports sit in different folders — what was last time's glucose? Did the medication adjustment work? — and it all comes down to memory, which fails when the doctor asks.

This case shows how to hand AI several (3+) recheck reports from the same person: it extracts indicators from each report into one consistent comparison table, computes the direction and magnitude of change for each key indicator along a timeline, labels them as steadily improving / broadly stable / steadily worsening / notably fluctuating, points out which indicators have returned to the reference range and which still need intervention, and compiles a follow-up summary you can bring straight to the clinic for quick physician review.

Good for: people managing hypertension / diabetes / fatty liver long term, post-op and post-medication recheck patients, family health record keeping, primary-care and chronic disease follow-up teams, and ongoing health management services at checkup centers.
cases.prompt: 我有 2 型糖尿病，在吃二甲双胍。四次复查的糖化血红蛋白依次是 8.6%、7.9%、7.1%、6.5%（参考 4.0–6.0），同期高密度脂蛋白是 0.88、0.91、0.89、0.92 mmol/L（参考 >1.04）。这两年到底控制得怎么样，下次门诊该重点跟医生聊什么？
cases.prompt_en: I have type 2 diabetes and take metformin. My HbA1c across four follow-ups was 8.6%, 7.9%, 7.1%, 6.5% (ref 4.0–6.0), while HDL-C over the same period was 0.88, 0.91, 0.89, 0.92 mmol/L (ref >1.04). How well have I actually been controlling this, and what should I focus on with my doctor at the next visit?

cases.subtitle: 把散落资料折叠成新人能直接走通的知识地图

cases.description:
项目资料散落在网页收藏、会议纪要、碎片笔记和已有云文档里时，新同学接手最难的不是“资料不够”，而是不知道先看什么、哪些是最新版本、哪些内容要继续维护。

这个案例展示如何用金山文档的知识库、导入云文档、创建条目和智能文档整理能力，把分散材料收拢成一个交接入口：先建知识视图，再按项目背景、决策记录、交付资产、运行手册和 FAQ 五层结构归档，同时补出 30 分钟上手路径、交接清单和常见问题。

适合：项目经理、产品运营、研发负责人、交付经理，以及任何需要把历史资料沉淀成团队入口、降低新人接手成本的人。
cases.description_en:
When project materials are scattered across web saves, meeting notes, loose notes, and existing cloud docs, the hardest part for a newcomer is not a lack of material—it is not knowing where to start, which version is current, and what should keep evolving.

This case shows how to use Kdocs knowledge views, cloud-doc import, item creation, and smart-document organization to turn scattered materials into one handoff entry. It creates a knowledge view first, then arranges content into five layers—project context, decision records, delivery assets, runbooks, and FAQ—while adding a 30-minute onboarding path, a handoff checklist, and common questions.

Best for: project managers, product operators, engineering leads, delivery managers, and anyone who wants to turn historical materials into a durable team entry and reduce onboarding friction.

First locate or create the knowledge base, then build a structure for project context, decision records, delivery assets, runbooks, and FAQ; save web content into the knowledge base, import existing cloud docs directly, and turn loose text into smart documents. Finally, provide the home structure, a 30-minute onboarding path, a handoff checklist, and FAQ.

cases.title: 给知识库做一次全面体检
cases.title_en: Run a Full Health Check on Your Knowledge Base
cases.subtitle: 云知批量遍历所有页面，逐篇诊断过时/缺结构，输出可视化体检报告
cases.subtitle_en: Traverse every page with Tencent Yunzhi, diagnose stale & unstructured docs, and get a visual health report
cases.description:
知识库越攒越大，文档越堆越多，可没人说得清哪些内容早就过时了、哪些是当年随手记的没结构流水账，真要用的时候翻起来一团糟，找半天还不敢信。

这个案例让腾讯云知批量遍历你知识库下的所有页面，逐篇诊断内容是否过时、是否缺乏结构、是否重复，给每篇打一个健康分，最后汇总成一份带总体健康分和整改优先级清单的可视化体检报告（暗色科技感单文件 HTML），每条结论都附真实页面链接可回溯。

适合：知识库管理员、知识运营、团队负责人、文档 owner，以及任何想定期给知识库做治理的人。
cases.description_en:
Your knowledge base keeps growing, but nobody can tell which docs went stale long ago or which ones are just unstructured brain-dumps. When you actually need something, it's a mess to dig through and you can't even trust what you find.

This case lets Tencent Yunzhi batch-traverse every page under your knowledge base, diagnosing each doc for staleness, missing structure, and duplication, scoring each one on health, then rolling it all up into a visual health report with an overall score and a prioritized fix-list (a dark, techy single-file HTML). Every finding links back to the real page.

Good for: knowledge base admins, knowledge ops, team leads, doc owners, and anyone who wants to govern their KB regularly.

artifacts.label: 知识库健康度体检报告

cases.prompt:
用腾讯云知帮我给知识库做一次全面体检。请批量遍历我这个知识库 [知识库链接或ID] 下的所有页面，逐篇诊断内容是否过时、是否缺乏结构、是否重复，给每篇打一个健康分，最后汇总成一份带总体健康分和整改优先级清单的可视化体检报告。

要求：
1. 遍历和读取全部走云知（乐享）的真实能力——用 entry_list_children 拿到父节点下所有页面，逐篇读取内容后再诊断，禁止编造任何页面名、评分或结论。
2. 每篇给出：诊断结论（健康 / 内容过时 / 缺乏结构）、结构分、具体问题清单、以及需要整改的给出整改建议。
3. 每条诊断都要附上该页面的真实链接，方便我点进去核对。
4. 汇总总览：总页面数、健康数、过时数、缺结构数、总体健康分，再给一份按优先级排序的整改清单。
5. 产物做成一份暗色科技感、带仪表盘感的单文件 HTML 体检报告；健康用绿、过时用橙、缺结构用红。样式你自己把握，重点是数据真实、可回溯。
cases.prompt_en:
Use Tencent Yunzhi to run a full health check on my knowledge base. Batch-traverse every page under my KB [KB link or ID], diagnose each doc for staleness, missing structure, and duplication, give each a health score, then roll it up into a visual health report with an overall score and a prioritized fix-list.

Requirements:
1. All traversal and reading must use Yunzhi's real capabilities — use entry_list_children to get every page under the parent node, read each one before diagnosing, and never fabricate page names, scores, or conclusions.
2. For each page, give: a diagnosis (Healthy / Outdated / Unstructured), a structure score, a concrete issue list, and a fix suggestion where needed.
3. Attach the real page link to every finding so I can click through and verify.
4. Summary overview: total pages, healthy count, outdated count, unstructured count, overall health score, plus a fix-list sorted by priority.
5. Deliver a dark, techy, dashboard-style single-file HTML health report; green for healthy, orange for outdated, red for unstructured. Style is up to you — what matters is the data being real and traceable.

cases.description_en:
After a product launch, many marketing teams end up with plenty of campaign data but no retrospective that actually guides the next round of spend and optimization. Metrics are scattered, channel performance is hard to compare, and content issues rarely connect cleanly with business outcomes. This case packages a draft retrospective for the 'Tax Small Genius' launch campaign, already covering the funnel, ROI/CAC/LTV, channel comparison, budget reallocation, and 30/60/90-day optimization actions, while clearly preserving placeholder sections for qualitative sample review and reporting structure. It is useful for leadership preview, structural review, and later completion.

Best for: Marketing Leads, Growth Leads, Performance Managers, Content Leads, B2B SaaS Founders, retrospective report writers

患者长期服用华法林，正打算自行加用鱼油、银杏叶、三七粉——这个组合安不安全、有没有禁忌、该怎么监测？

这个案例演示了把「拟加用的保健品清单」交给 AI 临床助手，它逐项评估鱼油、银杏叶、三七粉的抗凝 / 抗血小板活性与华法林的叠加出血风险，判定哪些组合需避免、哪些需谨慎，并给出 INR 监测方案与患者宣教要点。

cases.description_en:
A patient on long-term warfarin is about to self-add fish oil, ginkgo leaf and panax powder — is this combination safe, are any of them contraindicated, and how should it be monitored?

This case shows how to hand a planned supplement list to the AI clinical assistant, which itemizes the anticoagulant / antiplatelet activity of fish oil, ginkgo and panax against warfarin's bleeding risk, judges which combinations to avoid and which to use cautiously, and lays out an INR monitoring plan plus patient counseling points.

For: patients on warfarin and other anticoagulants, seniors planning to self-add supplements, anyone needing interaction and medication-safety guidance, and clinical pharmacists for teaching.

cases.subtitle_en: Job lifecycle and cluster ops status — everything on one dashboard
cases.description:
提交了作业不知道跑到哪了，集群资源用得怎样也不清楚？这个案例演示了如何全程跟踪作业从 PENDING 到 COMPLETED 的每个阶段，同时巡检集群节点健康、存储用量与弹性伸缩事件，输出一张含作业甘特图、节点弹性伸缩曲线、资源环形仪表与扩缩容事件日志的「运维监控大盘」HTML，作业与集群状态一图尽览。

适合：需要同时掌握作业进度与集群运维全局状态的 HPC 运维人员、生信工程师，以及想了解 SLURM 弹性伸缩机制的用户。
cases.description_en:
Submitted a job but have no idea how it's going, or what the cluster resource usage looks like? This case demonstrates how to track a job through every stage from PENDING to COMPLETED, while simultaneously inspecting cluster node health, storage usage, and elastic scaling events, producing an 'Ops Monitoring Dashboard' HTML with a job Gantt chart, node elastic scaling curve, resource ring gauges, and a scaling event log — full visibility in one view.

Suitable for: HPC ops engineers and bioinformatics engineers who need simultaneous visibility into job progress and cluster-wide status, and users who want to understand SLURM elastic scaling mechanics.

artifacts.label: 集群运维监控大盘

cases.prompt:
请生成一份任务跟踪 + 集群运维监控大盘。

先列出所有运行中集群，选第一个 SLURM 集群，用 squeue/sacct 定位最近提交的作业作为跟踪目标。跟踪该作业全生命周期（每 30 秒轮询 PENDING→RUNNING→COMPLETED 各阶段时间戳，观察 sinfo 弹性扩容与缩容释放，作业完成后用 sacct 取最终状态/退出码/耗时/内存/节点）。同时巡检集群运维状态：节点健康（sinfo）、存储用量（df -h）、内存水位（free -h）、扩缩容事件、最近 24h 失败作业与 OOM。

最终输出一份「运维监控大盘」HTML，风格专业美观、运维深色青主题、自包含内联 SVG，包含：顶部运维 KPI 卡（作业最终状态/峰值活跃节点/集群可用率/峰值 CPU/告警数）+ 作业生命周期甘特图（PENDING/RUNNING/COMPLETED 分段耗时）+ 作业状态看板 + 节点弹性伸缩曲线（时间-节点数，叠加作业阶段背景带与扩容/缩容触发点）+ 集群资源环形仪表（CPU/内存/存储）+ 集群与队列健康列表 + 扩缩容事件日志表 + 运维事件时间线。只读巡检，无需确认。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a job tracking + cluster operations monitoring dashboard.

First list all running clusters, select the first SLURM cluster, use squeue/sacct to locate the most recently submitted job as the tracking target. Track the job's full lifecycle (poll every 30 seconds for PENDING→RUNNING→COMPLETED stage timestamps, observe sinfo elastic scale-out and scale-in releases, use sacct after completion to get final status/exit code/duration/memory/nodes). Simultaneously inspect cluster ops status: node health (sinfo), storage usage (df -h), memory level (free -h), scaling events, failed jobs and OOM in the last 24h.

Finally output an 'Ops Monitoring Dashboard' HTML, professional and self-contained with dark teal ops theme and inline SVG, including: top ops KPI cards (final job status/peak active nodes/cluster availability/peak CPU/alert count) + job lifecycle Gantt chart (PENDING/RUNNING/COMPLETED segment timing) + job status board + node elastic scaling curve (time vs node count, with job stage background bands and scale-out/in trigger points) + cluster resource ring gauges (CPU/memory/storage) + cluster and queue health list + scaling event log table + ops event timeline. Read-only inspection, no confirmation needed.

cases.title: 热稳定性评估（Thermostability）· 设计验证
cases.subtitle: ORI 预测蛋白 Tm 值，60℃ 耐温门槛判定 + HTML 验证报告一键生成
cases.subtitle_en: ORI predicts protein Tm values with 60°C threshold judgment and one-click HTML validation report
cases.description:
发酵工艺验证最怕到最后才发现蛋白不耐温，白白浪费整条设计流程。

这个案例演示了通过 ORI 专家的 Thermostability 子应用，对示例序列执行热稳定性评估，输出每条序列的预测 Tm（℃）与 60℃ 门槛判定，渲染为达标/不达标一目了然的 HTML 验证报告（含差值标注）。**进阶用法：可衔接 omics-ori-expert-case-2，直接验证从头设计最优候选序列的耐温性。**

适合：发酵工艺工程师、蛋白热稳定性优化研究员、工业生物技术从业者。
cases.description_en:
The worst outcome in fermentation process validation is discovering a protein's thermal tolerance falls short only at the very end, wasting the entire design pipeline.

This case demonstrates how to use the ORI expert's Thermostability sub-application to assess a sequence set, output predicted Tm (°C) and 60°C threshold judgments, and render a clear pass/fail HTML validation report with margin annotations. **Advanced usage: pair with omics-ori-expert-case-2 to directly validate the top de novo designed candidate's thermal tolerance.**

Ideal for: fermentation process engineers, protein thermostability optimization researchers, and industrial biotechnology practitioners.

artifacts.label: 热稳定性评估 HTML 验证报告

cases.prompt:
Prompt 3 ｜ 热稳定性评估（Thermostability）· 设计验证

我是发酵工艺方向的工程师，需要确认蛋白耐温性是否满足 60℃ 工艺要求。请使用 ORI 公共应用的 thermostability 子流程，完全按默认参数（默认示例输入、模型与资源配置），执行一次热稳定性评估，并完成分析：

1. 提交前给我任务确认单（子流程｜输入摘要｜关键参数｜预计时长），确认后提交；
2. 跟踪任务直至完成，失败则按错误知识库给出根因与修复建议；
3. 完成后输出：预测 Tm 结果表（序列｜预测 Tm(℃)｜60℃ 门槛判定），并渲染为 HTML 验证报告（达标/不达标 + 差值标注）；进阶用法：紧接 Prompt 2 时，改用其最优候选序列作输入（模型与资源仍默认），验证"耐 60℃"设计目标是否达成。

cases.title: 端到端全流程（Stage1 → Stage2）
cases.subtitle: 一次运行完整演示 scPROTEIN 两阶段，交付完整可视化报告
cases.subtitle_en: One run, full scPROTEIN two-stage demo with a complete visual report
cases.description:
想一次性跑完 scPROTEIN 全流程，从原始数据到细胞分群结果？这个案例演示了从默认公共数据集出发，依次跑 Stage1 不确定性定量和 Stage2 细胞嵌入，Stage1 完成校验后自动衔接，最终交付一份融合概览卡片、t-SNE 分群图、不确定性分布、Top20 复核表与热图的 ECharts 交互式完整报告。

适合：想完整体验 scPROTEIN 端到端分析流程、快速获得全量可视化结果的蛋白质组学研究人员与平台评测用户。
cases.description_en:
Want to run the full scPROTEIN pipeline in one go — from raw data to cell clustering results? This case demonstrates starting from the default public dataset, running Stage1 uncertainty quantification and Stage2 cell embedding sequentially (Stage2 auto-starts after Stage1 validation), and delivering a complete ECharts interactive report combining overview cards, t-SNE cluster plots, uncertainty distribution, Top20 review table, and heatmap.

Suitable for: proteomics researchers and platform evaluators who want to experience the full scPROTEIN end-to-end analysis and quickly obtain comprehensive visual results.

artifacts.label: scPROTEIN 端到端完整分析报告

cases.prompt:
我需完整演示 scPROTEIN 端到端能力：从默认公共数据集出发，依次执行 Stage1（不确定性定量）与 Stage2（细胞嵌入），交付可视化报告。两阶段均用默认参数。

1. 提交前确认两个子应用与参数摘要，我确认后提交；
2. Stage1 完成并校验输出后，再衔接提交 Stage2，任一失败给根因诊断；
3. 结果固化为一份可复用的 ECharts 交互式 HTML 报告文件（如 scprotein_visual_report.html），在内置浏览器打开预览，须包含：概览卡片（肽段数/细胞数/嵌入维度/最优 k/silhouette/低置信占比）、t-SNE 细胞分群散点图（KMeans 着色 + Silhouette vs k 曲线）、不确定性分布直方图（P90 阈值线）、Top20 复核表、高方差肽段热图。

cases.title: 蛋白多层分类
cases.subtitle: FASTA 序列输入，三层分类层级揭示蛋白扰动特性
cases.subtitle_en: FASTA sequence input — three-level classification hierarchy reveals protein perturbation characteristics
cases.description:
拿到蛋白序列，想知道它们在扰动表征空间里属于哪个类别、与哪些扰动最相似？这个案例演示了如何用 UniPert genes 子应用将蛋白 FASTA 序列编码为统一表征，完成扰动模态层 → 表征邻域层 → 激活特征层三层多级分类，输出含三层分类层级图、表征指纹热图、邻域相似度对比图与分类依据汇总的 ECharts 交互报告。

适合：需要对蛋白质进行功能分类、理解蛋白质在扰动表征空间中定位的计算生物学与药物靶点研究人员。
cases.description_en:
Got protein sequences and want to know which category they belong to in the perturbation representation space and which perturbations they most resemble? This case demonstrates how to use the UniPert genes sub-application to encode protein FASTA sequences into unified representations, complete three-level multi-tier classification (perturbation modality layer → representation neighborhood layer → activation feature layer), and produce an ECharts interactive report with a three-level classification hierarchy diagram, representation fingerprint heatmap, neighborhood similarity comparison, and classification basis summary.

Suitable for: computational biology and drug target researchers who need to functionally classify proteins and understand their positioning in the perturbation representation space.

artifacts.label: 蛋白多层分类分析报告

cases.prompt:
我需要基于 UniPert 统一表征完成蛋白多层分类。请使用 UniPert-WDL 合集的 genes 子应用，按默认输入模板（protein.fasta，无需我提供数据）执行蛋白表征编码。

1. 提交前确认子应用、同名检查结果与参数摘要，我确认后提交；
2. 跟踪任务至完成，失败给根因诊断（debug 取证 + 错误知识库匹配 + 修复建议）；
3. 结果固化为一份可复用的 ECharts 交互式 HTML 报告（如 unipert_protein_report.html），在内置浏览器打开预览，须包含：概览卡片（蛋白数 / 表征维度 / 激活维度数 / 最近邻扰动 / 邻域相似度 / 层级判定结果）、三层分类层级图（扰动模态层 → 表征邻域层 → 激活特征层，附各层依据）、表征指纹热图（峰值维度标注）、邻域相似度对比图、分类依据汇总与局限说明。

cases.title: 彩陶鼎文创 · 易拉宝
cases.title_en: Painted Pottery Ding Cultural Product · Roll-Up Banner
cases.subtitle: 基于大汶口文化彩陶鼎文创品的宣传易拉宝
cases.subtitle_en: A monument-like Oriental cultural roll-up banner
cases.description:
展会要一张 80×200 的易拉宝，主体、标题、说明、收卷安全区全要排明白，做起来最头疼。

案例以大汶口文化彩陶鼎文创摆件为唯一主体，2:5 超长竖构图、对称纪念碑式排版：象牙米白宣纸背景，顶部小标签、黑色主标题「大汶口文化彩陶鼎」、主题词「古器新生」、朱红小印、放大浅底暗纹、产品说明与底部山形收束，底部预留收卷安全区，输出克制清雅的当代东方博物馆展陈易拉宝。

适合：文创展陈策划、平面/展览设计师、博物馆市场团队、文化活动主办方
cases.description_en:
This case makes a Dawenkou painted-pottery Ding creative object the sole subject in a 2:5 ultra-tall symmetric monument layout: ivory rice-paper backdrop, a top label, black main title, the theme phrase, a cinnabar seal, an enlarged faint watermark motif, product notes and a mountain-shaped base, with a safe roll-up zone reserved — a restrained, elegant contemporary museum banner.

Good for: Exhibition planners, Graphic & exhibition designers, Museum marketing teams, Cultural event organizers
cases.prompt:
请根据用户上传的文创品图片，生成一张80×200cm、2:5超长竖构图的东方文化展陈易拉宝平面设计。产品是画面唯一核心主体，必须严格保持其原有品类、正面朝向、整体轮廓、长宽比例、色彩、木质质感、旋涡纹样、部件数量和三足结构，不得重新设计、替换、拉伸、压扁或增加细节。

画面采用稳定、对称、具有纪念碑感的纵向中心构图。背景为温暖柔和的象牙米白色宣纸，带有轻微纸张纤维、自然颗粒与克制的旧印刷质感。顶部居中放置小号深青绿色文字“文创摆件 / CULTURAL OBJECT”，中文使用精致宋体，英文使用增加字距的纤细衬线字体，下方设置一条短而细的青绿色分隔线。

画面上部居中排布黑色主标题“大汶口文化彩陶鼎”，使用高对比现代宋体，字号醒目、字距紧凑；标题下方排布主题词“古器新生”，字号略小，使用低饱和深青绿色。主题词下方居中点缀一枚小型朱红色抽象印记，只作为色彩锚点，不使用真实机构印章或复杂文字。

提取产品表面的旋涡纹样，将其大幅放大并以约5%–10%的透明度铺陈在标题与产品之间，形成左右延伸、局部越出画面的浅米灰色背景暗纹，不得抢夺主体。文创品完整置于画面中下部并严格水平居中，约占画面高度的38%–45%、宽度的60%–72%，保留清晰自然的木质纹理，底部加入边缘柔和的接地阴影，不添加基座、道具或复杂场景。

产品下方居中排布两行说明文字：“取意于大汶口文化彩陶鼎，将史前彩陶的旋涡纹样与三足器形，转译为温润木质摆件。”使用深灰黑色小号宋体，行距疏朗，文本宽度不超过画面的70%；文字下方设置一条细短的低饱和青绿色横线。

画面最底部使用2–3层低饱和灰青绿色山峦与河流状抽象平面色块横向延展，边缘自然、层次柔和并带轻微版画颗粒，用于稳定画面重心。底部8%–12%区域不放置任何重要文字、Logo或二维码，作为易拉宝收卷安全区。

整体色彩限定为象牙米白、炭黑、深青绿、陶土红棕和少量朱红，呈现克制、温润、清雅的当代东方博物馆编辑设计审美。确保“顶部小标签—主标题—古器新生—产品—说明文字—山形收束”形成明确的纵向阅读顺序。输出干净的易拉宝平面设计稿，不展示支架、展厅、墙面透视或样机场景；不复制产品，不添加未经提供的Logo，不虚构尺寸、编号、馆藏信息或历史结论，避免厚重边框、祥云堆叠、金色装饰、泛滥书法、错误文字和水印。

cases.subtitle: 用岩石、木火与干花呈现琥珀香水的沉静气味
cases.subtitle_en: Rock, firewood, and dried flowers express the calm scent of an amber fragrance
cases.description:
单张产品图很难直接变成有层次的商业短片，产品外观还容易在生成中走样。

案例围绕一只黑盖琥珀香水瓶，用湿润森林、黑色岩石、木材火星和干花四组环境建立气味联想，最后回到干净的品牌定帧。

适合：香水、护肤、酒饮、家居香氛和需要竖屏种草素材的消费品牌。
cases.description_en:
A single product image rarely becomes a layered commercial on its own, and the product can deform during generation.

An amber fragrance bottle is placed among a damp forest, black rock, wood sparks, smoke, and dried flowers before returning to a clean brand lockup.

Best for fragrance, skincare, beverages, home scent, and consumer brands that need vertical social ads.

artifacts.label: 成片视频

cases.prompt: 请由「商业广告创作」专家调用 Flova 的「商品宣传短片」Skill，根据我上传的黑盖琥珀色香水瓶产品图，制作一支约 17 秒、9:16 的商业短片《琥珀香水的森林余烬》。必须保持瓶身比例、棕色玻璃、黑色瓶盖与标签排版不变。镜头顺序为：湿润森林中的瓶身轮廓；香水瓶立于黑色岩石、侧面暖光扫过；木材火星和烟雾掠过瓶身；干花与琥珀液体的微距；最后在纯黑背景中定格产品与品牌名。先确认规格和故事板，再依次确认产品环境图、氛围/功能镜头和音频方案；每阶段批准后再进入下一步。运镜以缓慢推进、微距滑动和一次利落转场为主，配低频环境音乐、火星与玻璃轻响，不新增未经提供的功效宣称。
cases.prompt_en: Ask the “Flova Commercial Director” expert to invoke Flova’s “Product Promo Short” Skill and use my uploaded product image of an amber fragrance bottle with a black cap to create a 9:16 commercial titled Forest Embers for an Amber Fragrance, about 17 seconds long. Preserve the bottle proportions, brown glass, black cap, and label layout exactly. Use this shot order: the bottle silhouette in a damp forest; the bottle standing on black rock as warm side light sweeps across it; wood sparks and smoke passing the bottle; macro views of dried flowers and amber liquid; and a final product-and-brand lockup on pure black. Confirm the specification and storyboard first, then obtain approval for the product-in-environment images, atmospheric or functional shots, and audio plan in sequence. Use slow push-ins, macro slides, and one crisp transition, with low-frequency ambient music, sparks, and delicate glass sounds. Do not add product claims that I did not provide.

cases.subtitle: 玛瑙入釉的天青孤品 vs 紫口铁足的皇家御窑：釉色/工艺/存世量三维对峙
cases.subtitle_en: Ru ware's agate-glazed sky-blue singletons vs Guan ware's imperial 'purple rim, iron foot' — glaze, craft, and survival compared
cases.description:
「汝官哥钧定」里汝窑排名第一、官窑紧随其后，但每次讲起两者的区别，要么停留在「都很美、都是青色」，要么直接被「汝窑只有 67 件」的传说堵住。这个案例演示了如何用腾讯探元文博知识库对两个窑口**分窑口粒度**分别检索，用粒度对齐的方式补齐「**釉色、工艺、存世量**」三个用户点名维度的硬数据，并扩展到胎体、装烧、器型、开片四个证据维度，最后给到一份能拿到博物院里就能直接上手辨识的对比清单。

适合：宋代青瓷爱好者、博物馆观众（尤其是台北故宫 / 上博 / 国博常客）、文博自媒体编辑、文物拍卖入门者、艺术院校陶瓷史方向师生。
cases.description_en: When fans talk about the 'Wu Da Ming Yao' (five great Song kilns), Ru ranks first and Guan second, but most comparisons either stop at 'both are blue and beautiful' or get blocked by the half-legend that 'only 67 Ru pieces survive.' This case shows how the TanYuan knowledge base uses **kilo-level granularity** to query each kiln separately, hardens the three user-named dimensions (glaze, craft, surviving quantity) with published evidence, and extends to body, firing setup, vessel shape, and crackle — finishing with a hands-on comparison list you can take straight into a museum gallery. Best for: Song celadon enthusiasts, museum visitors (especially NPM/Shanghai Museum/National Museum regulars), cultural-heritage editors, newcomers to relic auctions, and ceramics-history students.

artifacts.label: Markdown 对比报告（一句话结论 + 对比表 + 快速辨识要点 + 代表器物 + 来源）

cases.prompt:
请按「腾讯探元文物对比分析师」专家的工作流，对比分析**汝窑**与**官窑**在**釉色、工艺、存世量**三个用户指定维度，以及胎体、装烧方式、器型用途、开片纹饰、特征性标识等由证据决定的补充维度上的差异。

研究范围：
- 对象 A：汝窑（北宋晚期，约 1086—1106 年；河南宝丰清凉寺村）
- 对象 B：官窑（含北宋官窑汴京 / 南宋官窑杭州修内司与郊坛下）

用户**必答维度**（必须排在前三行且必须出现）：釉色、工艺、存世量
补充维度候选（资料撑住才上，不全部列）：
- 年代与产地
- 胎体与材质
- 装烧方式（芝麻钉 / 垫饼支钉）
- 器型与用途
- 开片纹饰（蟹爪纹 vs 金丝铁线）
- 特征性标识（紫口铁足 / 奉华款等后刻）

交付要求（强制）：
1. 粒度识别为「窑口 / 品类」，**严格只走探元知识库（mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_movable_relics）分别查两窑口**，分别 query: "汝窑"、"官窑"、"南宋官窑"；维度不足时分别补精简子 query 如 "汝窑 釉色"、"官窑 开片"、"汝窑 玛瑙"、"官窑 紫口铁足"
2. **绝不能用一次 query 问「汝窑和官窑的区别」**——必须分两次检索
3. **存世量、口径必须走联网核对**，区分台北故宫 21 件、故宫博物院、上海博物馆、大维德基金会等不同机构统计，保留不同口径而非编造伪精确数字
4. 输出严格遵循专家骨架：**一句话结论 → 对比表（用户点名维度最前）→ 快速辨识要点（3—5 条可操作动作）→ 代表器物（每方 2—4 件附馆藏）→ 来源（探元知识库 + 联网补充出处）**
5. 空白格写「公开资料未见明确记录」，**不留空、不编造**
6. **不向用户暴露内部运行信息**——禁止出现 query、检索、工具名、requestId、条数机制词
cases.prompt_en:
Use the 'TanYuan Cultural Relic Comparison Analyst' expert workflow to comparatively analyse the differences between **Ru ware** and **Guan ware** along three user-named dimensions (glaze, craftsmanship, surviving quantity) and any evidence-supported supplementary dimensions (body material, firing setup, vessel shape & use, crackle pattern, signature marks like 'purple-rim/iron-foot').

Scope:
- Object A: Ru ware (Northern Song late period, ~1086–1106 CE; Qingliangsi kiln site, Baofeng, Henan)
- Object B: Guan ware (includes Northern Song Guan at Bianjing / Southern Song Guan at Xiuneisi & Jiaotanxia in Hangzhou)

Mandatory user-named dimensions (must occupy the first three rows of the table): glaze, craftsmanship, surviving quantity.

Evidence-driven supplementary dimensions (only if the retrieved material actually supports them — never pad): date and provenance, body and material, firing setup (sesame-spur supports / pad-and-spur), vessel shape and use, crackle pattern (crab-claw vs gold-and-iron-wire), signature marks (purple-rim/iron-foot, post-cut 'Fenghua' inscriptions).

Delivery requirements (mandatory):
1. Granularity is 'kiln / category' — query the TanYuan knowledge base **only** via `mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_movable_relics`, once each for 'Ru ware', 'Guan ware', 'Southern Song Guan ware'. Supplement missing dimensions with focused sub-queries like 'Ru ware glaze', 'Guan ware crackle', 'Ru ware agate', 'Guan ware purple-rim iron-foot'.
2. **Never** combine objects in a single query ('difference between Ru and Guan'). Always query separately.
3. **Surviving quantity and canonical figures must come from public web verification** — distinguish between NPM Taipei 21 pieces, Palace Museum Beijing, Shanghai Museum, David Foundation etc., keep multiple calibres, never fabricate pseudo-exact numbers.
4. Output must follow the expert skeleton strictly: **one-line conclusion → comparison table (user-named dimensions first) → 3–5 actionable quick-identification tips → 2–4 representative pieces per side with current custodian → sources (TanYuan knowledge base + web-verified supplements)**.
5. Empty cells write 'no public record found', **never leave blanks, never fabricate**.
6. **Never expose internal mechanics** — no queries, no search log, no tool names, no requestId, no result-count mechanism words.

cases.description:
讲一件汉代灯具，「环保设计」四个字往往一笔带过；但凡想让观众真的「看见」烟怎么走、水怎么容、光怎么调，没有结构图基本是空谈。这个案例用 tanyuan-relic-infographic-expert 调出「典藏版」模板（暗金主题，适合深色展陈背景），把长信宫灯拆成头部、躯壳、左袖、右臂（烟道）、灯盘灯罩、底盘六大分件，附 HERO 封面、三栏拼版、烟道走向 SVG 标注、五节点时间轴——一张可直接挂展厅或公众号头条的单文件 HTML。

适合：博物馆汉代专题展常设讲解屏、文物环保设计课引入案例、青铜灯具研究课论文配图、青少儿博物馆手册栏目、科技与文物跨学科课件。
cases.description_en:
Explaining a Han dynasty lamp with the four characters「eco design」rarely lands — to actually show visitors how the smoke travels, how water absorbs soot, and how light is adjusted, you need structural diagrams, not words. This case uses tanyuan-relic-infographic-expert's「premium edition」template (dark-gold theme, suited to deep exhibition backdrops) to break down the Changxin Palace Lantern into six major parts: head, torso, left sleeve, right arm (the smoke duct), shade-and-tray, and base — with a HERO cover, three-column split layout, SVG smoke-flow annotations, and a five-node timeline — a single HTML ready to hang in the gallery or top a public-account post.

Suitable for: permanent interpretation screens at Han-era special exhibitions, opening cases for museum eco-design lessons, illustrations for bronze-lamp research papers, junior-museum handbook columns, and STEAM courseware bridging craft and conservation.
cases.prompt:
请调用 tanyuan-relic-infographic-expert 专家，使用「典藏版（进阶）」模板，为「西汉长信宫灯」生成一张含「结构拆解」的单文件 HTML 科普图解长图。

要求：
1. 数据真实：使用 tanyuan-wb-mcp-server 的 search_relics（查询「长信宫灯」）与 search_movable_relics（查询「长信宫灯」）真实检索——本次会话已确认 MCP 可用。检索返回的真实字段包括：通高 48cm / 宫女高 44.5cm / 重量 15.85kg / 材质青铜 / 铭文「长信尚浴」「阳信家」9 处共 65 字 / 现藏河北省博物院 / 制作年代约公元前 151 年（西汉景帝至武帝时期）/ 出土背景（1968.8 河北满城窦绾墓，灯盘内残留碳化动物油脂）/ 流转链（阳信侯刘揭 → 吴楚七国之乱朝廷没收 → 长信宫窦太后御用 → 赐予窦绾随葬）/ 工艺（分铸套接 + 鎏金 + 头身右臂灯座灯盘灯罩六分件可拆装 + 右臂虹管导烟 + 体内中空容水）/ 学术价值（铭文为汉代宫廷制度第一手资料 + 写实主义艺术代表 + 环保设计理念在世界科技史具重要意义）。
2. 文物本体图：探元检索已返回 2 张授权图（miniapp-static.tanyuan.qq.com 域名，已授权直接用）—— 一张正面照（1222×1406）+ 一张抠图版（540×643，适合中部展示）；下载 base64 内联；aspect-ratio 等于真实图片比例。
3. 视觉：用典藏版模板（cyan / gold / red 三主题之一），HERO 封面采用「左文字 + 右真实照片」横向布局，避免我之前画的火柴人 SVG——按专家 SKILL.md「文物本体绝不让 AI 自由重画」铁律执行。
4. 结构：HERO 封面（文字 + 探元真实照片）→ 三栏拼版（左=基础信息 8 字段 + 造型叙事；中=探元抠图版授权图 + 特征要点 5 条；右=环保巧思 4 项 + 铭文流转链）→ 烟道走向 SVG 教学辅助图（标注 ① 灯盘点燃 ② 烟雾上行 ③ 烟尘溶水，虚线箭头）→ 六大分件拆解 SVG（头部/中空躯壳/左臂持盘/右臂烟道虹管/灯盘+灯罩/底盘，每件编号+SVG+名称）→ 五节点时间轴（前 151 制作 / 前 154 后没收归长信宫 / 前 113 入葬 / 1968 出土 / 现藏河北省博）→ 页脚诗 + 免责声明。
5. 硬约束：单文件 HTML、CSS/图片/SVG 全部内联、不得 https:// 外链、不得 href="#" 空锚点、不得 emoji；中部为探元抠图版授权图，非我自画 SVG；拆解 SVG 与烟道 SVG 明确标注「教学辅助示意图，非真实文物照片或拆解模型」。
cases.prompt_en:
Use the tanyuan-relic-infographic-expert's「premium edition」 template to produce a single-file HTML infographic for the「Changxin Palace Lantern」 with explicit structural breakdown.

Requirements:
1. Real data: query via tanyuan-wb-mcp-server (search_relics「长信宫灯」 + search_movable_relics「长信宫灯」) — MCP confirmed reachable this session. Real fields returned include: total height 48cm / maid height 44.5cm / weight 15.85kg / material bronze / inscription「Changxin Shangyu」「Yangxin Jia」9 places totaling 65 characters / current keeper Hebei Museum / made around 151 BCE (Western Han, reigns of Jingdi to Wudi) / excavation context (1968.8 Mancheng Douwan tomb, lamp tray contained carbonized animal-fat residue) / circulation chain (Yangxin Marquis Liu Jie → imperial confiscation after Seven States Rebellion → Changxin Palace Empress Dou → bestowed on Douwan for burial) / craft (separate casting + gilding + six-part modular head-body-right arm-base-tray-shade + right-arm smoke duct + hollow torso water reservoir) / academic value (inscriptions as first-hand evidence for Han palace institutions + realism art representative + environmental design significant in world history of technology).
2. Relic photo: TanYuan returns 2 authorized images (miniapp-static.tanyuan.qq.com domain, free to use) — a front view (1222×1406) + a cut-out version (540×643, suited for central display); download + base64 inline; aspect-ratio equals actual image.
3. Visual: «premium edition» template (one of cyan / gold / red themes); HERO uses「left text + right real photo」 horizontal layout — DO NOT hand-draw stick-figure SVGs of the maid; strictly follow expert SKILL.md「the relic body must never be re-drawn by AI」 rule.
4. Structure: HERO cover (text + TanYuan real photo) → three-column layout (left: 8-field basic info + form narrative; center: TanYuan cut-out authorized image + 5-item feature highlights; right: 4 eco-design points + inscription circulation chain) → smoke-flow SVG teaching-auxiliary diagram (steps ① lamp tray ignition ② smoke rising ③ soot dissolving in water, dashed arrows) → six-part exploded-view SVG (head / hollow torso / left arm holding tray / right-arm-as-smoke-duct / shade+tray / base — each with number + SVG + name) → five-node timeline (151 BCE making / post-154 BCE confiscation to Changxin Palace / 113 BCE burial / 1968 excavation / current keeper Hebei Museum) → footer poem + disclaimer.
5. Hard constraints: single HTML, all CSS/images/SVG inlined, no external https://, no href="#" anchors, no emoji; the central image is the TanYuan cut-out authorized image (NOT a self-drawn SVG); the exploded-cell SVG and the smoke-flow SVG must be explicitly marked as「teaching-auxiliary schematic, not a real artifact photo or disassembly model」.

cases.subtitle_en: Standard downstream from GEF to clustering & annotation — copy-paste-ready runnable pipeline
cases.description: 拿到 SAW 跑出来的 .tissue.gef 或 .cellbin.gef 之后怎么往下走？文档散落在 readthedocs 各篇教程，GEF 读写、bin_type 区别、raw_checkpoint 什么时候打、Seurat 怎么转、SingleR 注释要不要 GPU——全靠自己拼。这个案例把立体Seq专家内置的 stereopy-docs 官方文档浓缩成一份「拿到 GEF 就能跑」的单样本 SOP：覆盖环境准备（Python 3.8 + pip/conda）、GEF 读写速查（square bin / cell bin 对比 + IO 速查表）、标准流水线（read → cal_qc → filter → raw_checkpoint → normalize → HVG → PCA → neighbors → UMAP → Leiden → find_marker_genes）、QC 过滤前后分布、空间散点 + UMAP 必看原则、marker 基因解读 + SingleR 注释、Scanpy/Seurat 互转、结果保存。6 张代表性示意图全部内嵌，单文件自包含可直接当团队 SOP。适合：空间组学方向研究生、需要把 SAW 产出矩阵接上下游分析的算法团队、刚上手 Stereopy 想跳过踩坑的工程师。
cases.description_en: What's next after SAW gives you a .tissue.gef or .cellbin.gef? The docs are scattered across readthedocs tutorials — GEF I/O, bin_type differences, when to call raw_checkpoint, how to convert to Seurat, whether SingleR needs GPU — all of it is a stitching job. This case distills the `stereopy-docs` skill into a 'pick up a GEF and just run' single-sample SOP covering environment setup (Python 3.8 + pip/conda), GEF I/O cheatsheet (square vs cell bin comparison + I/O table), the standard pipeline (read → cal_qc → filter → raw_checkpoint → normalize → HVG → PCA → neighbors → UMAP → Leiden → find_marker_genes), pre/post-filter QC distributions, the space-scatter + UMAP viewing principle, marker gene interpretation + SingleR annotation, Scanpy/Seurat interop, and result saving. 6 representative figures all embedded in a self-contained file. Suitable for: spatial-omics graduate students, algorithm teams bridging SAW outputs to downstream, and engineers new to Stereopy who want to skip the pitfalls.

artifacts.label: Stereopy 单样本空间聚类 SOP（自包含 HTML）

cases.prompt:
你是 Stereo-seq 空间转录组分析专家。请基于立体Seq专家内置的 `stereopy-docs` 官方 skill 文档与教程，生成一份 Stereopy 单样本空间聚类 SOP。

要求：
1. 覆盖九个章节：环境准备（conda Python 3.8 + pip install stereopy + 验证 import）、GEF 数据读入（square bin / cell bin 概念对比 + IO 速查表 + 完整 read 代码）、标准分析流水线（read → cal_qc → filter → raw_checkpoint → normalize → HVG → PCA → neighbors → UMAP → Leiden → find_marker_genes 完整可运行代码）、QC 过滤前后分布、聚类结果可视化（空间散点 + UMAP 双视图原则）、marker 基因解读（find_marker_genes 输出表 + SingleR 注释完整代码）、格式转换与互操作（Scanpy / Seurat 风味 AnnData 互转表）、结果保存（write_h5ad / write_mid_gef / update_gef）、避坑清单（9 条 raw_checkpoint / filter / bin_size 等典型坑）。
2. 每章必须包含：目标说明、可运行 Python 代码（带注释）、API 速查、产出文件清单。
3. 用 matplotlib 预先生成 6 张代表性结果图（square vs cell bin 概念对比、分析流水线管线图、QC 过滤前后小提琴图、空间聚类散点、UMAP 嵌入、marker × cluster 热图）。
4. 将所有图片以 base64 data URI 内联嵌入，产出单文件自包含 HTML（无外链）。
5. 末尾附图表索引与数据来源声明。

约束：
- 输出单文件 HTML（output.html）：所有 CSS 内联、图片 base64 内嵌、Noto Sans SC 子集按文档字符内联嵌入、无任何外部资源引用、内容默认可见、不使用 hash 锚点导航。
- 所有 API、参数、典型流程均直接来自 stereopy-docs 官方文档原文（SquareBin_Clustering.ipynb、CellBin_Clustering.ipynb、SingleR.ipynb、basic-workflow.md、annotation.md），不要虚构函数签名。
- 中文版，代码标识符保持英文生态惯例。
- 文档可直接作为团队培训 SOP 使用。
cases.prompt_en:
You are a Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics analysis expert. Using the `stereopy-docs` official skill documents and tutorials built into the stereo-seq expert, generate a Stereopy single-sample spatial clustering SOP.

Requirements:
1. Cover nine chapters: environment setup (conda Python 3.8 + pip install stereopy + import verification), GEF data loading (square vs cell bin concept comparison + I/O cheatsheet + complete read code), the standard analysis pipeline (read → cal_qc → filter → raw_checkpoint → normalize → HVG → PCA → neighbors → UMAP → Leiden → find_marker_genes with runnable code), pre/post-filter QC distributions, clustering result visualization (spatial scatter + UMAP dual-view principle), marker gene interpretation (find_marker_genes output table + SingleR annotation complete code), format conversion & interop (Scanpy / Seurat flavor AnnData table), result saving (write_h5ad / write_mid_gef / update_gef), and a 9-item pitfall checklist (raw_checkpoint / filter / bin_size typical issues).
2. Each chapter must include: goal, runnable Python code (commented), API cheatsheet, output file list.
3. Pre-generate 6 representative figures with matplotlib (square vs cell bin concept comparison, analysis pipeline diagram, pre/post-filter QC violin plot, spatial clustering scatter, UMAP embedding, marker × cluster heatmap).
4. Inline all figures as base64 data URIs and produce a single-file self-contained report (no external links).
5. Append a figure index and a data-source disclosure.

Constraints:
- Output a single-file HTML (output.html): all CSS inlined, figures base64-embedded, Noto Sans SC subset inlined by document-character filtering, no external resource references, content visible by default, no hash-anchor navigation.
- All APIs, parameters, and typical flows come directly from the official stereopy-docs (SquareBin_Clustering.ipynb, CellBin_Clustering.ipynb, SingleR.ipynb, basic-workflow.md, annotation.md) — do not fabricate function signatures.

cases.title: 商代青铜器 vs 周代青铜器
cases.title_en: Shang Bronze vs Zhou Bronze: From Divine Kingship to Ritual Order
cases.subtitle: 饕餮神权之器 vs 列鼎礼制之器：纹饰·礼制·铭文三轴跨越 800 年
cases.subtitle_en: From Taotie-fuelled Shang ritual vessels of divine authority to ranked-ding Western Zhou vessels of Confucian order — three axes: pattern, ritual system, inscription
cases.description:
把一件青铜器摆你面前，如何一眼判断它是商代的、周代的、还是中间过渡的？这是博物馆讲解员、青铜器收藏者、艺术史学生最常被问到、也最容易被答错的问题。这个案例演示了如何用腾讯探元文博知识库按**年代体系粒度**分别检索两个时代的青铜主题，让对比的维度（纹饰主线、礼制用途、铸造工艺、铭文风格、器型与足型、出土分布）自然浮现，给出一份「**不用查文献就能上展柜讲解**」的三轴对照清单。

适合：青铜器爱好者与收藏者、博物馆讲解员与策展人、中国古代史与先秦史研究者、艺术史与美术专业师生、考古与文化遗产保护从业者。
cases.description_en: Put a bronze vessel in front of you — can you tell whether it's Shang, Zhou, or transitional? This is the question museum docents, bronze collectors, and art-history students get asked most often and answer wrong most often. This case shows how the TanYuan knowledge base uses **chronological-system granularity** to query each era's bronze topic independently so the comparison dimensions (pattern keyline, ritual use, casting technique, inscription style, vessel and foot shapes, excavation distribution) emerge naturally — producing a three-axis checklist you can use at a museum vitrine without consulting references. Best for: bronze collectors & enthusiasts, museum docents & curators, ancient Chinese and pre-Qin historians, art-history students, archaeology and heritage practitioners.

artifacts.label: Markdown 对比报告（一句话结论 + 对比表 + 快速辨识要点 + 代表器物 + 来源）

cases.prompt:
请按「腾讯探元文物对比分析师」专家的工作流，对比分析**商代青铜器**与**周代青铜器**在纹饰主题、铸造工艺、礼制用途（列鼎制度）、器型与器类、胎体与铭文、器型风格、出土分布上的差异。

研究范围：
- 对象 A：商代青铜器（约公元前 16 世纪—前 11 世纪，含商前期与商晚期）
- 对象 B：周代青铜器（公元前 11 世纪—前 256 年，含西周早/中/晚期、春秋、战国）

用户未点名维度，按本次实际能检到的资料决定补充维度（建议但不强制）：
- 纹饰主题（饕餮纹 / 夔龙纹 / 鸟纹 vs 窃曲纹 / 波曲纹 / 重环纹 / 瓦楞纹 / 鸟纹）
- 铸造工艺（范铸法 vs 失蜡法的出现时机）
- 礼制用途（重酒礼器 vs 列鼎制度、九鼎八簋）
- 器型风格（庄严神秘 vs 质朴规整；柱足 / 锥足 / 扁足 vs 蹄足）
- 铭文风格（族徽日名 vs 长篇册命、玉箸体）
- 出土分布（安阳殷墟 / 郑州商城 vs 宝鸡周原 / 琉璃河 / 曲村）

交付要求（强制）：
1. 粒度识别为「年代体系」，**只用探元知识库（mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_movable_relics）分别检索两个时代主题**，query: "商代青铜器"、"西周青铜器"、"列鼎制度"、"饕餮纹"、"窃曲纹"。**代表器物（后母戊鼎、四羊方尊、子龙鼎、毛公鼎、散氏盘、大盂鼎、利簋、何尊）必须走联网核对**
2. **绝不能用一次 query 问「商周青铜器的区别」**，必须分次检索
3. **search_relics 仅在举例证时使用**，不得用其返回的「地方馆藏品」充当「代表作清单」
4. 输出严格遵循专家骨架：**一句话结论 → 对比表（每行同一件事）→ 快速辨识要点（3—5 条可操作动作）→ 代表器物（每方 3—6 件附馆藏与时代）→ 来源（探元知识库 + 中国国家博物馆 chnmuseum.cn + 联网补充）**
5. 空白格写「公开资料未见明确记录」，**不留空、不编造**
6. **不向用户暴露内部运行信息**——禁止出现 query、检索、工具名、requestId、条数机制词
cases.prompt_en:
Use the 'TanYuan Cultural Relic Comparison Analyst' expert workflow to comparatively analyse the differences between **Shang bronzes** and **Zhou bronzes** across pattern keyline, casting technique, ritual use (the tripod ranking system), vessel shape and category, body and inscription style, style and aesthetic, and excavation distribution.

Scope:
- Object A: Shang bronzes (~16th–11th c. BCE)
- Object B: Zhou bronzes (11th c.–256 BCE, covering Western Zhou early/middle/late, Spring & Autumn, Warring States)

The user has not named dimensions — let evidence decide (recommended but not required):
- Pattern keyline (Taotie / Kui-dragon / bird vs 窃曲 qūqū / 波曲 bōqū / double-ring / tile-ridge / long-tailed bird)
- Casting (piece-mould vs emergence of lost-wax)
- Ritual use (wine-vessel emphasis vs tripod-ranking system, nine ding + eight gui)
- Vessel shape (solemn and mysterious vs austere and orderly; post-foot columnar/conical/hoof)
- Inscription (clan emblem + day-name vs long commissioning inscriptions, yùzhù body)
- Excavation distribution (Yinxu Anyang / Zhengzhou Shang vs Zhouyuan Baoji / Liulihe / Qucun)

Delivery requirements (mandatory):
1. Granularity is 'chronological system' — query the TanYuan knowledge base **only** via `mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_movable_relics`, once each for 'Shang bronze', 'Western Zhou bronze', 'tripod ranking system', 'Taotie pattern', 'qūqū pattern'. **Representative pieces (Houmuwu Ding, Four-Goat Square Zun, Zilong Ding, Maogong Ding, Sanzhong Pan, Dayu Ding, Li Gui, He Zun) MUST be cross-verified via public web**.
2. **Never** combine eras in a single query ('difference between Shang and Zhou bronzes'). Query separately.
3. **search_relics only when pointing to a specific piece**; never use its regional-catalog hits as a 'representative list'.
4. Output follows the expert skeleton strictly: **one-line conclusion → comparison table (every row one topic) → 3–5 actionable quick-identification tips → 3–6 representative pieces per side with custodian and date → sources (TanYuan + chnmuseum.cn + web supplements)**.
5. Empty cells write 'no public record found', **never leave blanks, never fabricate**.
6. **Never expose internal mechanics** — no queries, no search log, no tool names, no requestId, no result-count mechanism words.

2. 投递明细（约 30 条）：公司、职位、城市、薪资范围、渠道、投递日期、当前状态、面试轮次、下一步等；状态分布要真实，含 3 个 offer

Please generate a job-search progress tracking Excel (output.xlsx) for a front-end engineer with 3 years of experience preparing to switch jobs.

cases.title: 唐三彩 vs 宋青白瓷
cases.title_en: Tang Sancai vs Song Qingbai: Tomb Ware vs Daily-use Porcelain
cases.subtitle: 低温铅釉多彩陶器 vs 高温单色青白瓷器：陶与瓷、墓与桌、明器与日用之别
cases.subtitle_en: Low-fire lead-glazed polychrome pottery vs high-fire monochrome Qingbai porcelain — earthenware vs porcelain, tomb ware vs tableware
cases.description:
唐三彩是陶器、宋青白瓷是瓷器——这一基本分野很多爱好者都模糊。可一旦上手触摸、对光照射、侧耳倾听，二者差异其实一秒钟就能感知。这个案例演示了如何用腾讯探元文博知识库按「**品类粒度**」分别检索多彩低温釉陶与单色高温青白瓷，让「**工艺类别、釉色、胎体、用途、成型装饰、窑口**」六维对比自然浮现，并把最能上手的「颜色数量 + 敲声 + 照光」三招放在辨识要点首位。

适合：陶瓷史爱好者、博物馆观众（陕西历史博物馆 / 河南博物院 / 景德镇陶瓷馆常客）、文博自媒体编辑、文物拍卖入门者、艺术与考古专业师生。
cases.description_en: Tang Sancai is pottery, Song Qingbai is porcelain — even enthusiasts blur this basic distinction. Yet the moment you touch them, hold them to the light, and tap them, the gap shows in a second. This case shows how the TanYuan knowledge base uses **category granularity** to query polychrome low-fire earthenware and monochrome high-fire porcelain independently, surfacing a six-axis comparison (process category, glaze, body, use, shaping/ornament, kiln) — and places the three most hands-on cues (count the colours + listen to the ring + hold to the light) at the top of the quick-identification list. Best for: ceramics-history enthusiasts, museum visitors (Shaanxi History Museum / Henan Museum / Jingdezhen Ceramics Museum regulars), cultural-heritage editors, newcomers to relic auctions, and art/archaeology students.

artifacts.label: Markdown 对比报告（一句话结论 + 对比表 + 快速辨识要点 + 代表器物 + 来源）

cases.prompt:
请按「腾讯探元文物对比分析师」专家的工作流，对比分析**唐三彩**与**宋青白瓷**（又称影青）在工艺类别、釉色、胎体、用途、成型与装饰、代表窑口六维上的差异。

研究范围：
- 对象 A：唐三彩（唐代低温铅釉多彩陶器；以河南巩县窑、陕西铜川窑为代表）
- 对象 B：宋青白瓷 / 影青（宋代高温单色青白瓷器；以江西景德镇湖田窑为代表）

用户未点名维度，按本次实际能检到的资料决定补充维度（建议但不强制）：
- 工艺类别（陶器 vs 瓷器；低温铅釉 750—800 °C vs 高温还原焰 1200+ °C）
- 釉色（黄/绿/白/蓝多彩 vs 青白单色 / 影青）
- 胎体（白色粘土松脆陶胎 vs 高硅致密瓷胎）
- 主要用途（随葬明器 vs 日用器与陈设器）
- 成型与装饰（模制/雕塑/贴花 vs 轮制/刻花/印花）
- 代表窑口与釉色机理（多金属氧化物呈色 vs 少量铁还原青色调）

交付要求（强制）：
1. 粒度识别为「品类 / 工艺体系」，**只用探元知识库（mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_movable_relics）分别检索两个品类主题**，query: "唐三彩"、"青白瓷"、"景德镇窑"、"巩县窑"。**代表器物（唐三彩骆驼载乐俑、唐三彩女立俑、唐三彩天王俑、宋景德镇窑青白釉刻花梅瓶、宋景德镇窑青白釉注子注碗、宋湖田窑青白釉印花碗）必须走联网核对**
2. **绝不能用一次 query 问「唐三彩和青白瓷的区别」**，必须分次检索
3. 输出严格遵循专家骨架：**一句话结论 → 对比表（六维或更多实质维度，每行同一件事）→ 快速辨识要点（3—5 条可操作动作，按「看颜色/听声音/照光」的优先级排序）→ 代表器物（每方 3—5 件附馆藏）→ 来源（探元知识库 + 陕西历史博物馆 + 故宫博物院 + 景德镇陶瓷馆 + 联网补充）**
4. 空白格写「公开资料未见明确记录」，**不留空、不编造**
5. **不向用户暴露内部运行信息**——禁止出现 query、检索、工具名、requestId、条数机制词
cases.prompt_en:
Use the 'TanYuan Cultural Relic Comparison Analyst' expert workflow to comparatively analyse the differences between **Tang Sancai** and **Song Qingbai** (aka Yingqing) along six axes: process category, glaze, body, primary use, shaping and ornament, representative kiln site.

Scope:
- Object A: Tang Sancai (Tang low-fire lead-glazed polychrome pottery; Gongxian kiln Henan, Tongchuan kiln Shaanxi as leading producers)
- Object B: Song Qingbai / Yingqing (Song high-fire monochrome Qingbai porcelain; Jingdezhen Hutian kiln Jiangxi as the representative producer)

The user has not named dimensions — let evidence decide (recommended but not required):
- Process category (earthenware vs porcelain; low-fire lead glaze 750–800 °C vs high-fire reduction 1200+ °C)
- Glaze (yellow/green/white/blue polychrome vs Qingbai monochrome / Yingqing)
- Body (white clay porous vs high-silica vitrified porcelain)
- Primary use (tomb mingqi vs tableware and display ware)
- Shaping and ornament (moulding / sculptural / appliqué vs wheel-throwing / incised / impressed)
- Representative kilns and colouring mechanism (poly-metal-oxide coloration vs iron-reduction cyan tonality)

Delivery requirements (mandatory):
1. Granularity is 'category / craft system' — query the TanYuan knowledge base **only** via `mcp__tanyuan-wb-mcp-server__search_movable_relics`, once each for 'Tang Sancai', 'Qingbai porcelain', 'Jingdezhen kiln', 'Gongxian kiln'. **Representative pieces (Tang Sancai camel-musicians, Tang Sancai standing lady, Tang Sancai heavenly king, Song Jingdezhen Qingbai carved-meiping, Song Jingdezhen Qingbai ewer-and-bowl, Song Hutian Qingbai impressed bowl) MUST be cross-verified via public web**.
2. **Never** combine categories in a single query ('difference between Tang Sancai and Qingbai'). Query separately.
3. Output follows the expert skeleton strictly: **one-line conclusion → comparison table (every row one topic) → 3–5 actionable quick-identification tips ordered by 'count colours / listen to the ring / hold to the light' priority → 3–5 representative pieces per side with current custodian → sources (TanYuan + Shaanxi History Museum + Palace Museum + Jingdezhen Ceramics Museum + web supplements)**.
4. Empty cells write 'no public record found', **never leave blanks, never fabricate**.
5. **Never expose internal mechanics** — no queries, no search log, no tool names, no requestId, no result-count mechanism words.
