cases.title: 税务小智发布战役方案
cases.subtitle: 3个月冲刺5000家付费企业的完整新品发布打法
cases.subtitle_en: A full launch playbook to win 5,000 paying companies in 3 months
cases.description:
新品发布最怕的是目标很大、渠道很多、团队很忙，但没有一份真正能落地的整合营销方案——策略、品牌定位、SEO、内容节奏、效果复盘各做各的，最后无法形成合力。本案例演示营销战役团队如何为面向中小企业的 AI 财税 SaaS“税务小智”设计一套完整新品发布战役：从目标/KPI、受众画像、差异化 messaging、预算与时间线，到 SEO 关键词策略、12 周内容日历、16 篇首批核心内容，再到汇报节奏与 ROI 管理，一次性产出 Markdown 完整版 + HTML 内网展示版。

适合：市场负责人、增长负责人、品牌经理、内容团队、B2B SaaS 创始人、渠道运营
cases.description_en:
Launching a new product usually breaks down when the goal is big, channels are many, and teams are busy—but there is no single integrated plan tying strategy, positioning, SEO, content cadence, and reporting together. This case shows how the Marketing Campaign Team builds a complete launch campaign for 'Tax Small Genius', an AI tax SaaS for SMBs: from goals/KPIs, personas, differentiated messaging, budget and timeline, to SEO keyword strategy, a 12-week content calendar, 16 launch-ready content assets, and a reporting rhythm with ROI management. Outputs both a full Markdown plan and an HTML intranet-ready version.

Best for: Marketing Leads, Growth Leads, Brand Managers, Content Teams, B2B SaaS Founders, Channel Operators

cases.title: 年会策划方案
cases.subtitle: 500人年度盛典全案，从主题到执行一键生成 Word 文档
cases.subtitle_en: Complete Word document for a 500-person annual gala — theme to execution
cases.description:
年会策划千头万绪，预算怎么分、节目怎么排、场地怎么选，每年都是一场噩梦。这个案例展示了如何用 Word 文档生成技能一键输出一份500人年会完整策划案，包含主题设计、预算分配、时间线、节目单、场地布置、供应商清单、应急预案，直接生成可打印签批的正式 Word 文档。

从「共创·共赢·2026」主题出发，方案覆盖30万预算的精细化拆分、T-30天倒计时推进表、3小时活动流程编排、5个工作组的职责矩阵、3家候选酒店对比、6类应急预案。每个板块都给出了可直接落地的表格、清单和执行标准，生成 Word 格式拿来就能用。

适合：HR、行政主管、企业文化负责人、活动策划公司。
cases.description_en:
Planning an annual conference is overwhelming — how to allocate the budget, arrange performances, choose a venue — it's a nightmare every year. This case demonstrates using the Word Document Generation skill to produce a complete plan for a 500-person annual gala as a formal Word document, covering theme design, budget allocation, timeline, program schedule, venue setup, vendor list, and contingency plans.

Starting from the theme "Co-Create · Win Together · 2026", the plan covers detailed breakdown of a 300K CNY budget, a T-30 day countdown schedule, a 3-hour event flow, responsibility matrix for 5 working groups, comparison of 3 candidate hotels, and 6 types of contingency plans. Every section provides ready-to-use tables, checklists, and execution standards in a printable Word format.

Best for: HR managers, administrative supervisors, corporate culture leads, and event planning agencies.

Please generate a Word document (output.docx) with a corporate annual-gala planning proposal for a 500-person event.

Requirements:
1. Gala theme: "Co-create · Win Together · 2026", including a description of the key visual, a color scheme, and a slogan

8. Contingency plans for 6 common emergencies
9. Document formatting requirements: include a cover page, table of contents, headers/footers, multi-level heading numbering, and a consistent table style
10. Output as a formal Word document, ready to print and use directly

This case demonstrates a 3D-style data visualization dashboard: CSS 3D transforms create pseudo-isometric projection effects, featuring 3D bar charts, rotating ring indicators, network topology connections, and real-time data flow animations — delivering enterprise exhibition-grade visual impact.

Ideal for: data analysts preparing annual reports, marketing teams building brand data showcases, and tech teams designing architecture monitoring dashboards.

cases.prompt_en:

cases.description:

This case demonstrates a production-grade multi-step form wizard: step navigation with a progress bar, conditional branching between fields (selecting A reveals group B), real-time validation per step, and a data summary confirmation before final submission. Ideal for: frontend engineers learning form best practices, product designers prototyping back-office systems, and enterprise internal system development teams.

cases.title: CI/CD 流水线架构图
cases.subtitle: 一图看懂从代码提交到生产部署的全流程
cases.subtitle_en: Visualize the full journey from code commit to production deployment
cases.description:
每次跟新同事解释 CI/CD 流程，光靠嘴说总是讲不清楚——代码提交后到底经过哪些阶段、哪里会卡住、哪里需要人工审批？

这个案例用 Excalidraw 画了一张完整的 CI/CD 流水线架构图，覆盖代码提交、自动化测试、构建打包、镜像推送、Staging 部署、人工审批、生产发布 7 个关键阶段，每个节点标注了真实的工具和命令。

适合：DevOps 工程师、技术团队 Leader、需要做技术分享的开发者、正在搭建 CI/CD 体系的团队
cases.description_en:
Tired of explaining CI/CD pipelines verbally to new team members? It's hard to convey which stages code passes through, where bottlenecks occur, and where manual approvals are needed.

This case uses Excalidraw to create a complete CI/CD pipeline architecture diagram covering 7 key stages: code commit, automated testing, build & package, image push, staging deployment, manual approval, and production release — each node annotated with real tools and commands.

Ideal for: DevOps engineers, tech team leads, developers preparing tech talks, and teams building CI/CD systems
cases.prompt:
请用 Excalidraw 画一张 CI/CD 流水线架构图。

要求：
1. 从左到右的横向流程布局
2. 包含 7 个阶段，用不同语义色区分：代码提交、自动化测试、构建打包、镜像推送、Staging 部署、人工审批（菱形）、生产发布
3. 每个节点下方用小字标注真实工具名
4. 「人工审批」节点加分支：通过走生产发布，拒绝回退到代码提交
5. 加一个深色背景的证据块，展示关键的 GitHub Actions workflow YAML 片段
6. 顶部加标题 "CI/CD Pipeline Architecture"
7. 风格干净专业，使用 Excalidraw 标准配色
cases.prompt_en:
Please use Excalidraw to draw a CI/CD pipeline architecture diagram.

Requirements:
1. Left-to-right horizontal flow layout
2. Include 7 stages, distinguished by semantic colors: code commit, automated testing, build & package, image push, staging deployment, manual approval (diamond), production release
3. Label the real tool name in small text under each node
4. At the "Manual Approval" node, add a branch: if approved, proceed to production release; if rejected, fall back to code commit
5. Add a dark-background evidence block showing a key GitHub Actions workflow YAML snippet
6. Add the title "CI/CD Pipeline Architecture" at the top
7. Clean, professional style using the standard Excalidraw palette

cases.title: 个人年度目标看板
cases.subtitle: 交互式年度目标追踪面板，进度可视化 + 暗色主题切换
cases.subtitle_en: Interactive annual goal tracker with visual progress, milestones, and dark/light theme toggle
cases.description:
年初立的 flag 到年底还记得几个？健身卡办了没去几次，读书计划停在第三本，存款目标年中就放弃了。问题不是缺乏意志力，而是缺少一个随时可见的进度看板——看不到进展，就感受不到动力，最终不了了之。

这个案例生成一个精美的交互式年度目标看板 HTML 页面：4 大目标类别（健康、职业、学习、财务），每类 3 个具体目标，配有动态进度条、里程碑检查点、连续打卡计数器。页面顶部是整体完成度环形图和月度趋势折线图，底部轮播激励名言。支持暗色/亮色主题一键切换，纯前端实现无需后端。

适合：希望量化管理个人成长的职场人、年度规划爱好者、OKR 实践者、想要一个酷炫个人仪表盘的效率达人。
cases.description_en:
How many New Year's resolutions survive until December? Gym membership barely used, reading plan stalled at book three, savings goal abandoned by June. The problem isn't willpower — it's the lack of a visible progress dashboard. When you can't see progress, you can't feel momentum, and goals fade away.

This case generates a beautiful interactive annual goals dashboard HTML page: 4 goal categories (health, career, learning, finance), each with 3 specific goals featuring animated progress bars, milestone checkpoints, and streak counters. Top section shows an overall completion ring chart and monthly trend line graph, bottom rotates motivational quotes. Supports dark/light theme toggle, pure frontend with no backend required.

Best for: Professionals who want to quantify personal growth, annual planning enthusiasts, OKR practitioners, productivity fans who want a sleek personal dashboard.
cases.prompt:
请生成一个个人年度目标看板页面（单文件 HTML，内联无外部依赖），现代精美、支持明暗主题切换。

展示整体完成度（综合百分比 + 月度趋势）和各类目标的进度与里程碑，让人一眼看到全年达成情况。每个目标显示进度、里程碑节点和状态（进行中 / 已完成 / 落后），不同类别用不同颜色区分。

我的年度目标（粘贴你的目标，按类别组织）：
...
cases.prompt_en:
Generate a personal annual goals dashboard page (single-file HTML, inlined with no external dependencies), modern and polished, with light/dark theme switching.

Show the overall completion rate (composite percentage + monthly trend) and the progress and milestones of each goal category, so the full-year status is visible at a glance. Each goal should show its progress, milestone checkpoints, and status (in progress / completed / behind); distinguish categories with different colors.

My annual goals (paste your goals, organized by category):
...

cases.title: 广告投放效果分析表
cases.subtitle: 多渠道广告投放数据追踪与 ROI 优化分析
cases.subtitle_en: Multi-channel advertising data tracking and ROI optimization analysis
cases.description:
广告预算花出去了，效果却说不清——这是很多市场团队的痛点。不同渠道的数据口径不一、对比困难，预算分配靠「感觉」而非数据驱动，导致投放效率低下、ROI 难以优化。

本案例演示一份覆盖微信朋友圈、抖音信息流、百度 SEM、知乎效果广告、小红书薯条、B站花火六大主流渠道的 Q2 广告投放效果分析表。每个渠道按月拆解预算/花费/曝光/点击/转化等核心指标，并附带汇总对比 Sheet，包含渠道排名、预算分配优化建议和环比趋势分析，帮助团队用数据驱动下一期投放策略。

适合数字营销经理、增长团队负责人、CMO 及代理商投放优化师。无论是季度复盘还是预算申请汇报，这份表格都能直接作为决策依据。
cases.description_en: Advertising budgets are hard to optimize without unified cross-channel analytics. This case creates a Q2 ad performance analysis covering 6 major Chinese advertising channels with monthly breakdowns, ROI comparisons, and budget optimization recommendations.
cases.prompt: 请制作一份 2026 年 Q2 多渠道广告投放效果分析表。渠道覆盖：微信朋友圈广告、抖音信息流、百度 SEM、知乎效果广告、小红书薯条推广、B站花火。每个渠道包含：月度预算、实际花费、曝光量、点击量、CTR、CPC、转化数、CVR、CPA、ROI。另附汇总对比Sheet（渠道排名、预算分配优化建议、环比趋势）。数据要真实合理，反映不同渠道的典型表现差异。
cases.prompt_en: Please create a multi-channel ad campaign performance analysis spreadsheet for Q2 2026. Channels covered: WeChat Moments ads, Douyin in-feed ads, Baidu SEM, Zhihu performance ads, Xiaohongshu (RED) "French Fries" promotion, and Bilibili Sparkle (Huahuo). For each channel, include: monthly budget, actual spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, CVR, CPA, and ROI. Also add a summary comparison Sheet (channel ranking, budget allocation optimization recommendations, and month-over-month trends). The data should be realistic and reasonable, reflecting the typical performance differences across the various channels.

cases.title: 涨停热点数据地图
cases.subtitle: 把连板梯队、主线板块与封单热区整理成一张叙事感更强的数据地图。
cases.subtitle_en: A narrative data atlas that maps ladders, hotspot sectors, and seal clusters into one story.
cases.description:
做涨跌停复盘时，经常会遇到一个问题：数据很多，但难以把板块、连板、封单和市场宽度放进同一条叙事链。这个案例把涨停数据整理成一张热点数据地图，用更强的故事结构去讲清楚当天资金最认哪条线。

产物是一份双语交付级 HTML，包含主题节点、连板路径、热点板块、封单热区和全量清单，既能作为复盘材料，也能拿来做团队内分享或案例展示。

适合：题材研究、市场主线跟踪、内容型投研输出、需要把数据讲成故事的人。
cases.description_en:
A common pain point in limit-up reviews is that the data exists, yet sectors, ladders, seal clusters, and market breadth rarely form one coherent story. This case turns the dataset into a sector atlas so you can explain which themes the market truly paid for.

The output is a bilingual delivery-grade HTML page with theme nodes, ladder routes, hotspot boards, seal clusters, and the full list, making it suitable for both recap work and polished internal sharing.

Best for: theme researchers, market leadership trackers, content-style research output, and anyone who needs data to tell a story.
cases.prompt: 请基于最新一个有完整收盘数据的 A 股交易日，生成一份“涨停热点数据地图”HTML，把连板梯队、主线板块、封单热区和市场宽度组织成一条清晰的复盘叙事。使用真实查询得到的涨跌停、板块排行、代表个股与全量涨停列表，突出当天最强的主题扩散和高标结构。页面风格要求明亮、像展板式的数据地图与章节化故事页，信息丰富且适合展示；单文件 HTML、资源全内联、可离线打开。请在页脚注明数据日期、来源口径和投资建议免责声明。
cases.prompt_en: Using the latest A-share trading day with complete closing data, generate a “Limit-Up Sector Atlas” HTML page that organizes ladders, leading sectors, seal clusters, and market breadth into a clear recap narrative. Query real data for limit-ups and limit-downs, sector rankings, representative names, and the full limit-up list, with emphasis on theme diffusion and the structure of leadership. Keep the page bright, exhibition-like, and story-led, more like a chaptered data map than a generic dashboard; deliver a single self-contained HTML file that works offline. State the data date, source notes, and the investment disclaimer in the footer.

cases.prompt: 根据这个文创品生成的毛绒公仔化产品摄影，全身以柔软短绒布料呈现，可见织物纹理、细微缝线与刺绣走线，填充饱满、有肉感，带哑光绒面质感；这只鸭子有一段纤细的 S 形弯颈，头回转搭在肩背上，圆形黑豆眼、扁平圆喙，双翼收拢、原本雕刻的羽毛层次以凸起绣线还原，尾部上翘尖起，前方是一只张开的蹼足，整体端坐在一体成型的波浪形底座上；鸭身为温暖的沙琥珀色、米褐与琥珀米色并带柔和棕色羽纹阴影，底座则保留青花瓷质感，深靛蓝笔触水波纹叠印在米白底色之上，所有颜色都严格对齐原文物；画面为单体居中、四分之三侧视，纯白无缝背景，柔和均匀的漫射棚光配以淡淡接触阴影，对焦锐利、细节丰富，整体是高品质毛绒周边与收藏玩具的渲染风格，可爱、治愈且富有商业质感。

cases.title: 抗凝药出血风险与用药过量排查
cases.subtitle: 华法林 + 阿司匹林双抗凝，牙龈出血、皮下瘀斑是否用药过量？
cases.subtitle_en: Warfarin plus aspirin — do bleeding gums and bruising mean the anticoagulation is too strong?
cases.description:
72 岁老人，长期吃华法林、阿司匹林等慢病药，最近反复牙龈出血、皮下出现瘀斑——到底是药物叠加的出血风险，还是用药过量了？

这个案例演示了把「老年患者 + 完整用药清单 + 新发出血症状」交给 AI 临床助手，它逐药归因华法林（抗凝）与阿司匹林（抗血小板）的叠加出血风险，判断牙龈出血、皮下瘀斑是否提示抗凝强度 / INR 超标（用药过量可能），并区分需立即就医的危险信号与可观察的轻微症状。

适合：慢病老人及其家属、长期抗凝 / 抗血小板治疗患者、需要出血风险与用药过量科普的用户、社区健康管理员。
cases.description_en:
A 72-year-old on long-term warfarin and aspirin has recently developed recurrent gum bleeding and subcutaneous bruising — is it an additive bleeding risk from the drug combination, or is the anticoagulation too strong?

This case shows how to hand an elderly patient plus a full medication list plus new bleeding symptoms to the AI clinical assistant, which attributes bleeding risk to the warfarin (anticoagulant) + aspirin (antiplatelet) combination, judges whether gum bleeding and bruising signal excessive anticoagulation / an elevated INR (possible overdose), and separates urgent danger signs from mild watchable symptoms.

For: seniors and their families, patients on long-term anticoagulant / antiplatelet therapy, anyone needing plain-language guidance on bleeding risk and overdose, and community health workers.

artifacts.label: 抗凝药出血风险与用药过量排查演示（HTML，含中英双语）

cases.prompt:
请以「腾讯健康-AI临床助手-用药安全」的能力，评估一位老年患者的药物相关出血风险与用药过量可能：

72 岁男性，合并高血压、房颤及糖尿病，长期服用华法林、美托洛尔、二甲双胍和阿司匹林，近期反复牙龈出血并出现皮下瘀斑。请评估：
1. 是否存在药物相关出血风险（重点：华法林「抗凝」与阿司匹林「抗血小板」叠加，共同升高出血风险）；
2. 是否存在用药过量可能（重点：牙龈出血 + 皮下瘀斑是否提示抗凝强度 / INR 超标，需查凝血功能判断，而非简单判定「药吃多了」）；
3. 哪些是需立即就医的危险信号（黑便、呕血、血尿、持续出血、头痛意识改变、胸痛），哪些是可观察的轻微症状；
4. 下一步建议（尽快就医查 PT/INR、就诊带完整用药清单），并说明为什么不能擅自停用抗凝 / 抗血小板药（房颤停药有卒中 / 血栓风险）。

请客观说明出血机制与过量判断依据，不擅自建议停用或调整抗凝 / 抗血小板、降糖等慢病维持用药；不给出具体剂量调整数值；出血相关风险应主动强调；末尾建议尽快就医查凝血功能。

cases.title: 多宫格生视频
cases.subtitle: 一张多镜头拼版控制四段奢华香氛影像
cases.subtitle_en: One multi-cut sheet controls four luxury fragrance movements
cases.description:
多镜头商品视频常在产品角度、材质和剪辑顺序上失去一致，逐镜返工成本很高。

案例把黑金香水瓶、瓶盖、丝绸烟雾与喷雾粒子组织成带编号的多镜头拼版，再据此生成连续的棚拍商业片。

适合：香水、珠宝、美妆、酒饮等需要高质感多镜头展示的产品内容。
cases.description_en:
Multi-shot product films often lose consistency in angle, material, and edit order, making per-shot rework expensive.

This case organizes a black-and-gold bottle, cap, silk, smoke, and spray particles into numbered multi-cut sheets before generating a continuous studio commercial.

Best for fragrance, jewelry, beauty, and beverage products that need premium multi-shot presentation.

artifacts.label: 成片视频

cases.prompt: 请由「商业广告创作」专家调用 Flova 的「多宫格生视频」Skill，使用我上传的黑色瓶身、金色瓶盖香水产品图，制作一支约 15 秒、16:9 的棚拍商业短片《黑金香氛四重奏》。四段内容按明确编号推进：1）黑丝绸从瓶身后方掠过，勾出金色边缘；2）瓶盖悬停旋转并与瓶身对齐；3）喷雾在逆光中形成细密金色粒子；4）产品落在黑色镜面台上完成英雄定帧。请先确认全局规格与故事板，并绑定产品资产；随后为每个镜头生成包含内部节拍编号的多镜头拼版，逐批展示让我确认，确认后再从拼版生成视频、设计低沉电子 BGM 与喷雾/金属轻响并完成组装。产品轮廓、Logo、材质和金色调必须始终一致。
cases.prompt_en: Ask the “Flova Commercial Director” expert to invoke Flova’s “Multi-Grid Video” Skill and use my uploaded image of a black fragrance bottle with a gold cap to create a 16:9 studio commercial of about 15 seconds titled Black-and-Gold Fragrance Quartet. Progress through four explicitly numbered movements: 1) black silk passes behind the bottle and reveals its gold edge; 2) the cap hovers, rotates, and aligns with the bottle; 3) backlit spray forms fine golden particles; 4) the product lands on a black mirrored plinth for the hero frame. Confirm the global specification and storyboard and bind the product asset first. Then generate a numbered multi-cut sheet for the internal beats of every shot and show each batch for approval. Once approved, generate video from the sheets, design a deep electronic score with spray and light metallic sounds, and assemble the film. Keep product silhouette, logo, materials, and gold tone consistent throughout.

cases.title: 通知中心消息列表
cases.subtitle: 输入消息数据，生成精美的通知中心 UI 页面
cases.subtitle_en: Input message data, generate an elegant notification center UI page

cases.title_en: Outpatient Note from Verbal Dictation with Safety Check
cases.subtitle: 口述症状自动解析，术语规范化 + 过敏-用药冲突 P0 红线
cases.subtitle_en: Parse verbal symptoms, normalize terms, block allergy-drug conflicts
cases.description:
患者口述「肚子疼两天，有点发烧，拉肚子」，青霉素过敏史却开了阿莫西林——门诊医生每天面对的口述转病历场景，错录一条就可能致命。

这个案例演示了把患者口述交给 AI 临床助手，它自动判别门诊场景、规范化术语（肚子疼→腹痛、发烧→发热、拉肚子→腹泻）、提取主诉与既往史，并在处方环节触发 P0 安全红线：青霉素过敏史与阿莫西林直接冲突，必须人工确认才能放行，绝不静默通过。

适合：门诊医师、急诊预检、基层全科、电子病历录入员、关注用药安全的临床管理者。
cases.description_en:
A patient says "stomach pain for two days, a bit feverish, diarrhea", yet amoxicillin is on the script despite a penicillin allergy — every day in outpatient clinics, a single misrecorded verbal dictation can be fatal.

This case shows how to hand the patient's verbal account to the AI clinical assistant. It identifies the outpatient scenario, normalizes lay terms (stomach pain → abdominal pain, feverish → fever, diarrhea → loose stools), extracts chief complaint and past history, then triggers a P0 safety redline at prescribing: a penicillin allergy directly conflicts with amoxicillin and requires explicit human confirmation — never silently passes.

For: outpatient physicians, emergency triage, primary care providers, EMR data entry staff, and clinical managers focused on medication safety.
cases.prompt:
帮我写一份门诊病历，从我的口述内容里提取结构化字段并做术语规范化。

口述内容：患者女性，35 岁，肚子疼两天，有点发烧，拉肚子；既往有青霉素过敏史；本次开具阿莫西林、蒙脱石散。

要求：
1. 判别场景为「门诊病历」；
2. 解析口述，提取主诉、现病史、既往史、用药等信息，口语转标准医学术语（如肚子疼→腹痛、发烧→发热、拉肚子→腹泻）；
3. 录入处方药品名与用法用量；
4. 校验 P0 安全红线：检测到「青霉素过敏史」与处方「阿莫西林」冲突时，必须拦截并提示人工确认，不得静默通过；
5. 对缺失关键字段（如体温数值、腹痛部位）进行渐进式追问，每批不超过 5 个、支持跳过，未作答字段如实标注缺失；
6. 不做诊断推理、不做治疗建议，不编造临床数据；
7. 末尾附安全声明，说明本记录仅供医生复核。
cases.prompt_en:
Draft an outpatient note from my dictation, extracting structured fields and normalizing terminology.

Dictation: Patient is female, 35, stomach pain for two days, a bit feverish, diarrhea; known penicillin allergy; prescribed amoxicillin and montmorillonite powder.

Requirements:
1. Identify the scenario as "outpatient note".
2. Parse the dictation to extract chief complaint, history of present illness, past history and medications; convert lay terms to standard medical terms (stomach pain → abdominal pain, feverish → fever, diarrhea → loose stools).
3. Record drug names and dosage/administration for the prescription.
4. Check the P0 safety redline: when a "penicillin allergy" conflicts with prescribed "amoxicillin", block it and require human confirmation — never pass silently.
5. Prompt progressively for missing key fields (e.g. temperature value, abdominal pain site), no more than 5 per batch, skippable; honestly mark unanswered fields as missing.
6. Make no diagnostic inference and no treatment recommendation; never fabricate clinical data.
7. End with a safety statement noting the record is for clinician review only.

cases.subtitle_en: Supply constraints + technology iteration + company mapping to separate real bottlenecks from concept followers.
cases.description:
固态电池讲了很多年，真正决定产业节奏的往往不是整车叙事，而是硫化锂前驱体、电解质粉体、设备能力和验证良率能不能跑顺。这个案例围绕硫化物电解质链，拆解上游原料、粉体制备、设备与客户验证的关键约束。

报告会基于真实公开资料，区分哪些公司已经有中试线、工艺积累和客户验证，哪些仍停留在主题映射或远期想象阶段，并补上需要持续跟踪的时间点与风险条件。

cases.description_en:
Solid-state batteries have been discussed for years, but the real pacing factors are often not the vehicle narrative — they are whether lithium-sulfide precursors, electrolyte powder, equipment capability, and validation yield can actually run smoothly. This case breaks down the sulfide-electrolyte chain into raw materials, powder preparation, equipment, and customer-validation constraints.

Grounded in real public materials, the report separates companies that already have pilot lines, process accumulation, and customer validation from names still living in theme exposure or distant optionality, then adds the key dates and risks worth tracking.

Best for: users following solid-state battery industrialization; researchers identifying bottlenecks in the electrolyte chain; industry analysts building a validation framework for equipment and materials.

cases.title: Spateo 细胞分割与 3D 重建实战
cases.subtitle: 从染色图像到三维器官模型——分割、对齐、点云/表面/体素全流程
cases.subtitle_en: From stain images to 3D organ models — segmentation, alignment, point-cloud/surface/voxel pipeline
cases.description: 细胞分割要么 SAW 出 cellbin.gef 直接用，要么只能从 ssDNA / DAPI / HE 自己切——后者网上代码片段散落，wavelet + watershed 调参就够折腾一天，切完还要切片对齐做 3D 重建。这个案例把立体Seq专家内置的 spateo skill 浓缩成一份「拿到 BGI counts + 染色图就能跑」的全流程指南：覆盖环境准备（spateo-release + [3d] extras + h5py/anndata pin）、染色图像细胞分割 9 步（read_bgi_agg → refine_alignment → mask_nuclei → peaks → watershed → stardist → augment → expand → read_bgi）、分割质量检查与互补策略、多切片 Morpho 对齐（group_pca + morpho_align）、TDR 3D 重建（construct_pc → construct_surface → construct_cells → voxelize → save_model）、4 种 VTK 模型（点云/表面/细胞/体素）用途速查、刚体 vs 非刚体选择。4 张代表性示意图全部内嵌，单文件自包含可直接当团队 SOP。适合：要做细胞分割或多切片 3D 重建的算法团队、做组织发育形态学的研究组、需要把染色与 RNA 配准的研究生。
cases.description_en: Cell segmentation either uses SA W's cellbin.gef directly, or you cut cells from ssDNA/DAPI/HE yourself — the latter has scattered code online, wavelet + watershed tuning is a day's fight, and after segmentation you still need slice alignment for 3D reconstruction. This case distills the `spateo` skill into a 'pick up BGI counts + stain image and just run' full-pipeline guide covering environment setup (spateo-release + [3d] extras + h5py/anndata pin), the 9-step stain image cell segmentation (read_bgi_agg → refine_alignment → mask_nuclei → peaks → watershed → stardist → augment → expand → read_bgi), segmentation QC and complementary strategies, multi-slice Morpho alignment (group_pca + morpho_align), TDR 3D reconstruction (construct_pc → construct_surface → construct_cells → voxelize → save_model), the 4 VTK model types (point cloud / surface / cells / voxel) cheatsheet, and rigid vs non-rigid selection. 4 representative figures all embedded in a self-contained file. Suitable for: algorithm teams doing cell segmentation or multi-slice 3D reconstruction, developmental tissue morphology labs, and graduate students needing to register stain with RNA.

artifacts.label: Spateo 细胞分割与 3D 重建实战（自包含 HTML）

cases.prompt:
你是 Stereo-seq 空间转录组分析专家。请基于立体Seq专家内置的 `spateo` skill 文档（含 01_stain_segmentation.md / 03_alignment_basic_2d.md / 04_tdr_3d_reconstruction.md），生成一份 Spateo 细胞分割与 3D 重建实战指南。

要求：
1. 覆盖八个章节：环境准备（pip install spateo-release + [3d] extras + h5py==3.7.0 anndata==0.8.0 pin + MPI 可选）、数据准备（BGI counts + 染色 + 配准前提）、染色图像细胞分割 9 步（read_bgi_agg → refine_alignment → mask_nuclei_from_stain → find_peaks_from_mask → watershed → stardist → augment_labels → expand_labels → read_bgi 完整可运行代码 + 各层可视化代码）、分割质量检查与互补策略表（7 类常见问题）、多切片 Morpho 对齐（group_pca + morpho_align 完整代码 + 刚体 vs 非刚体选择决策表）、TDR 3D 重建（construct_pc → construct_surface → construct_cells → voxelize → save_model 完整代码 + 4 类 VTK 模型用途速查）、完整最小可运行脚本（四阶段串联）、避坑清单（12 条染色配准 / equalize / group_pca 联合 / 刚体优先 3D 等关键坑）。
2. 每章必须包含：目标说明、可运行 Python 代码（带注释）、API 速查、产出文件清单。
3. 用 matplotlib 预先生成 4 张代表性结果图（细胞分割 9 步流程图、分割三联图模拟、Morpho 对齐前后 2D 叠加、TDR 3D 重建点云+表面双面板）。
4. 将所有图片以 base64 data URI 内联嵌入，产出单文件自包含 HTML（无外链）。
5. 末尾附图表索引与数据来源声明。

约束：
- 输出单文件 HTML（output.html）：所有 CSS 内联、图片 base64 内嵌、Noto Sans SC 子集按文档字符内联嵌入、无任何外部资源引用、内容默认可见、不使用 hash 锚点导航。
- 所有 API、参数、典型流程均直接来自 spateo skill 文档原文（01_stain_segmentation.md、03_alignment_basic_2d.md、04_tdr_3d_reconstruction.md），不要虚构 morpho_align / construct_surface 等函数签名。
- 中文版，代码标识符保持英文生态惯例。
- 文档可直接作为团队培训 SOP 使用。
cases.prompt_en:
You are a Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics analysis expert. Using the `spateo` skill documents built into the stereo-seq expert (including 01_stain_segmentation.md / 03_alignment_basic_2d.md / 04_tdr_3d_reconstruction.md), generate a Spateo cell segmentation & 3D reconstruction playbook.

Requirements:
1. Cover eight chapters: environment setup (pip install spateo-release + [3d] extras + h5py==3.7.0 anndata==0.8.0 pin + optional MPI), data preparation (BGI counts + stain + registration prerequisite), the 9-step stain image cell segmentation (read_bgi_agg → refine_alignment → mask_nuclei_from_stain → find_peaks_from_mask → watershed → stardist → augment_labels → expand_labels → read_bgi with runnable code + per-layer visualization), segmentation QC and complementary strategies table (7 common issues), multi-slice Morpho alignment (group_pca + morpho_align complete code + rigid vs non-rigid decision table), TDR 3D reconstruction (construct_pc → construct_surface → construct_cells → voxelize → save_model complete code + 4 VTK model-type cheatsheet), complete minimum-runnable script (four-stage pipeline), and a 12-item pitfall checklist (stain registration / equalize / group_pca joint / rigid-first 3D etc.).
2. Each chapter must include: goal, runnable Python code (commented), API cheatsheet, output file list.
3. Pre-generate 4 representative figures with matplotlib (9-step segmentation pipeline diagram, segmentation triplet mock, Morpho before/after 2D overlay, TDR 3D point-cloud + surface dual panel).
4. Inline all figures as base64 data URIs and produce a single-file self-contained report (no external links).
5. Append a figure index and a data-source disclosure.

Constraints:
- Output a single-file HTML (output.html): all CSS inlined, figures base64-embedded, Noto Sans SC subset inlined by document-character filtering, no external resource references, content visible by default, no hash-anchor navigation.
- All APIs, parameters, and typical flows come directly from the spateo skill (01_stain_segmentation.md, 03_alignment_basic_2d.md, 04_tdr_3d_reconstruction.md) — do not fabricate morpho_align / construct_surface signatures.
- Chinese language; code identifiers follow English ecosystem conventions.
- The document must be usable directly as team training SOP.

cases.title_en: Cutoff-Score Filter: Cross-Analysis of the 115-135 Band

cases.description:
估完分想找「够得着」的岗位，可只按分数筛出来的岗位，竞争强度天差地别。

本案例按进面分 115–135 筛出 7,331 个国考岗位，本页 30 条全部同时带往年进面分和报录比。按分数升序逐条列出，做分数分段统计，并用真实数据验证「报录比高≠分数线高」，最后给出一套先估分、再看比、再看招录人数的挑岗顺序。

cases.title: Agent 驱动的代码重构助手
cases.subtitle: 多 Agent 协作完成代码审计、方案规划、逐步重构与质量验证
cases.subtitle_en: Multi-Agent Code Audit, Refactoring Planning, Step-by-Step Execution & Quality Validation
cases.description:
遗留代码越来越难维护？单个路由文件膨胀到 500 行，巨型函数、重复逻辑、硬编码配置、缺少错误处理、类型不安全——每次改需求都如履薄冰，新人接手更是无从下手。重构势在必行，但手动重构容易引入回归 Bug，缺乏系统化方法论。

本案例展示了一套多 Agent 协作的代码重构工作流：审计 Agent 全面扫描代码识别所有 code smell 并评估严重程度，规划 Agent 制定重构方案（提取函数、引入类型、配置外部化、统一错误处理中间件），重构 Agent 逐步执行重构并保持每步功能等价，验证 Agent 对比重构前后的代码质量指标。产出生产级别的重构代码，附带关键重构决策说明。

适合：后端开发工程师、全栈工程师、技术 Leader、负责遗留系统维护和代码质量提升的开发团队。
cases.description_en:
Legacy code becoming unmaintainable? Route files bloated to 500+ lines with god functions, duplicated logic, hardcoded configs, missing error handling, and unsafe types?

This case demonstrates a multi-Agent code refactoring workflow: Audit Agent scans for code smells and severity assessment, Planning Agent designs refactoring strategy, Refactoring Agent executes step-by-step with functional equivalence, Validation Agent compares before/after quality metrics. Outputs production-quality refactored code with documented decisions.

Ideal for: backend engineers, full-stack developers, tech leads, and teams maintaining legacy systems.
cases.prompt:
请设计一个 Agent 工作流来分析和重构一段 TypeScript 代码。输入是一个 500 行的 Express.js 路由文件，存在以下问题：巨型函数（单个函数超过100行）、重复代码、硬编码配置、缺少错误处理、类型不安全。流程：1) 审计 Agent 扫描代码，识别所有 code smell 并评估严重程度；2) 规划 Agent 制定重构方案（提取函数、引入类型、配置外部化、统一错误处理中间件）；3) 重构 Agent 逐步执行重构，每步保持功能等价；4) 验证 Agent 对比重构前后的代码质量指标。输出重构后的代码文件。

代码注释和用户可见字符串用简体中文，标识符（变量/函数/类型名）保留英文。
cases.prompt_en:
Design an Agent workflow to analyze and refactor a piece of TypeScript code. The input is a 500-line Express.js route file with the following problems: god functions (single functions exceeding 100 lines), duplicated code, hardcoded configuration, missing error handling, and unsafe types. Workflow: 1) Audit Agent scans the code, identifies all code smells, and assesses their severity; 2) Planning Agent designs the refactoring plan (extract functions, introduce types, externalize configuration, unify error handling via middleware); 3) Refactoring Agent executes the refactoring step by step, keeping functional equivalence at every step; 4) Validation Agent compares code quality metrics before and after refactoring. Output the refactored code file.

Code comments and user-visible strings should be in Simplified Chinese; keep identifiers (variable/function/type names) in English.

cases.description_en:
Everyone knows provincial exams are less competitive than the national one — but by how much, and how much variation sits inside a single city?

This case filters Jiangsu posts by a 120–135 cutoff, hitting 1,217. All 30 shown fall in Suzhou under one announcement. Each carries a ratio, cutoff and salary band; the median is compared against the national-exam band, then broken down by district and recruiting unit.

For: candidates sitting both exams, and those committed to one city.

artifacts.label: 江苏省考 120-135 分段岗位分析

cases.prompt: 帮我查江苏省考里往年进面最低分在 120–135 分之间的岗位。要求：1) 真实筛选并给出总数；2) 取 30 条，按报录比升序列出岗位、单位、地级市、招录人数、报录比、进面最低分、薪资区间；3) 统计这 30 条的地区分布（到区一级）和招录单位集中度；4) 算出本批报录比的中位数（偶数条数取中间两位的均值），与国考查询结果的中位数做量级参照，并说明两次查询的分数区间并不相同；5) 列出分数最高和最低的各三个岗位，分析分数线差异的成因，不要归结为岗位好坏。
cases.prompt_en: Find Jiangsu provincial-exam posts with a historical cutoff score between 120 and 135. Requirements: 1) run the filter and give the total; 2) take 30, listed by ascending competition ratio, with post, unit, city, headcount, ratio, cutoff score and salary band; 3) break down the 30 by district and by recruiting unit concentration; 4) compute the median ratio and compare it with the national exam's median for the same band; 5) list the three highest- and three lowest-scoring posts and analyse what drives the difference — not whether the post is 'good'.

cases.title: 营销活动 ROI 分析表

cases.description:
做营销最怕什么？钱花出去了，但不知道花在哪个渠道最值。微信、抖音、小红书、SEM、信息流、邮件、KOL、线下活动——八个渠道同时投放，每个渠道的 CPM、CPC、CPA 各不相同，月底汇报时 Excel 拼了十几个表还是算不清楚哪个渠道的 ROI 最高、预算该往哪里倾斜。

这个案例用 AI 一键生成一套完整的营销活动 ROI 分析 Excel：覆盖 8 大主流渠道、6 个月投放数据，自动计算 CPM/CPC/CPA/ROAS 四大核心指标，内置渠道 ROI 横向对比、预算分配优化建议、从曝光到转化的全链路漏斗分析。打开就能看到哪个渠道花钱最值、哪个渠道在浪费预算、下个月的预算该怎么调。

适合：市场营销经理、增长黑客、CMO、投放优化师、数字营销团队、任何需要用数据驱动营销决策的人。

artifacts.label: 营销活动 ROI 分析表

cases.prompt:
帮我生成一份专业的营销活动 ROI 分析 Excel 报表。

**业务背景**：我们是一家消费品牌，在 8 个主流渠道投放营销广告，需要分析各渠道投入产出比、优化预算分配。请生成 2025 年下半年 6 个月的合理模拟数据。

**报告结构（多 Sheet）**：
- Sheet 1 渠道总览：各渠道 KPI 汇总，代表性字段如渠道、投放金额、曝光、点击、转化、收入、CPM、CPC、CPA、ROAS，并给出合计行。
- Sheet 2 月度明细：6 个月 × 8 渠道逐月数据，体现投放节奏。
- Sheet 3 ROI 对比：各渠道 ROAS 排名与成本效率对比。
- Sheet 4 预算分配：当前 vs 建议预算，高 ROAS 增投、低 ROAS 缩减。
- Sheet 5 转化漏斗：从曝光到成交的全链路漏斗与分环节流失。

格式：专业商务风格，关键指标用条件格式分级，金额带 ¥，首行冻结并加自动筛选。输出为 .xlsx 文件。
cases.prompt_en:
Help me generate a professional marketing campaign ROI analysis Excel report.

**Business context**: We're a consumer brand running ads across 8 major channels, and we need to analyze each channel's input-output ratio and optimize budget allocation. Please generate reasonable simulated data for 6 months in H2 2025.

**Report structure (multiple sheets)**:
- Sheet 1 Channel Overview: a KPI summary per channel, with representative fields like channel, spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, revenue, CPM, CPC, CPA, ROAS, plus a total row.
- Sheet 2 Monthly Detail: month-by-month data for 6 months × 8 channels, reflecting spend rhythms.
- Sheet 3 ROI Comparison: ROAS ranking and cost-efficiency comparison per channel.
- Sheet 4 Budget Allocation: current vs. recommended budget — increase high-ROAS channels, cut low-ROAS ones.
- Sheet 5 Conversion Funnel: a full funnel from impression to conversion with per-stage drop-off.

Formatting: professional business style; use conditional-format tiers for key metrics; amounts with ¥; freeze the top row and add auto-filter. Output as an .xlsx file.

cases.title: AI 口语陪练竞品深度分析
cases.title_en: Deep Competitive Analysis for AI Oral English Coach
cases.subtitle: 8 款竞品对标 + Battle Card + 定价策略 + 市场数据
cases.subtitle_en: 8-competitor benchmarking with Battle Cards, pricing strategy, and market data
cases.description:
推 AI 口语陪练产品却不知道市场格局？这个案例对标了斑马AI、洪恩、多邻国、ChatGPT口语、有道Hi Echo、流利说、VIPKID、伴鱼绘本 8 款竞品，输出完整竞品画像、学习路径对比、口碑优劣分析、差异化机会和销售用 Battle Card，同时提供市场规模数据、定价策略建议和 6 个月增长预测。交付物含 Markdown 报告和 HTML 可视化版（竞品雷达图、功能对比表、定价阶梯图）。

适合：教育产品经理、在线教育创业者、需要做竞品分析的产品团队。
cases.description_en:
Launching an AI oral English product but unclear about the market? This case benchmarks 8 competitors (Zebra, HongEn, Duolingo, ChatGPT, Hi Echo, Liulishuo, VIPKID, BanYu), delivering full competitive profiles, learning path comparisons, reputation analysis, differentiation opportunities, and Battle Cards for sales. Includes market sizing, pricing strategy, and 6-month growth forecast. Deliverables include Markdown report and HTML visualization with radar chart, feature matrix, and pricing ladder.

Suitable for: EdTech product managers, online education entrepreneurs, product teams needing competitive analysis.

artifacts.label: 竞品分析报告(Markdown)
可视化报告(HTML雷达图+对比表)

cases.prompt:
为一家一线城市儿童教育机构的「AI 口语陪练」在线产品做完整竞品分析。对标斑马AI、洪恩、多邻国、ChatGPT口语、有道Hi Echo、流利说、VIPKID、伴鱼绘本 8 款竞品。

要求：
1. 每个竞品的定位/目标用户/定价/核心功能/商业模式/技术路线
2. 学习路径和内容体系对比
3. 各自用户口碑优劣
4. 差异化机会分析（结合线下机构优势）
5. Battle Card 给销售/运营使用
6. 市场规模数据、定价策略建议、增长预测

输出 Markdown 报告 + HTML 可视化版（竞品雷达图、功能对比表、定价阶梯图）。
cases.prompt_en:
Conduct a complete competitive analysis for the online "AI Oral English Coach" product of a children's education institution in a tier-1 city. Benchmark against 8 competitors: Zebra AI, HongEn, Duolingo, ChatGPT Voice, Youdao Hi Echo, LiuLiShuo, VIPKID, and BanYu Picture Books.

Requirements:
1. Each competitor's positioning / target users / pricing / core features / business model / technical approach
2. Comparison of learning paths and content systems
3. Each one's user-reputation strengths and weaknesses
4. Differentiation opportunity analysis (leveraging the offline institution's advantages)
5. Battle Cards for sales/operations use
6. Market size data, pricing strategy recommendations, and growth forecast

Output a Markdown report + an HTML visualization version (competitor radar chart, feature comparison table, pricing ladder chart).

Covers the full product lifecycle from ideation to launch.

cases.title: 季度 Pipeline 评审报告
cases.subtitle: 从健康度打分到预测区间，再到两周推进动作的一体化评审
cases.subtitle_en: An integrated review from pipeline health scoring to forecast ranges and next-two-week actions
cases.description:
季度 Pipeline 评审最容易掉进两个坑：要么只看总量，不看结构；要么只报预测，不给动作。这个案例演示了销售作战团队如何围绕 8,000 万 Pipeline 与 3,000 万目标回款做完整评审：先对覆盖率、转化率、停滞率和漏斗形状打分，再拆出风险交易、推动交易、管理层介入机会和保守/基准/乐观预测区间，最后补上未来两周的推进动作与风险矩阵。最终输出 Markdown 报告 + HTML 仪表盘。

适合：销售 VP、CRO、销售总监、销售运营、区域管理者
cases.description_en:
Quarterly pipeline reviews often fail in two ways: they either focus on total volume without looking at structure, or they report forecasts without attaching actions. This case shows how the Sales Battle Team reviews an 80M pipeline against a 30M quarter target: scoring coverage, conversion, stagnation, and funnel shape; identifying risk deals, push deals, and management escalation opportunities; modeling conservative/base/upside forecast ranges; and attaching a concrete two-week action plan plus a risk matrix. The final output includes a Markdown report and an HTML dashboard.

Best for: Sales VPs, CROs, Sales Directors, Sales Operations, Regional Leaders

artifacts.label: 季度 Pipeline 评审仪表盘
季度 Pipeline 评审报告

cases.prompt:
请对我团队当前季度的 Pipeline 做全面评审（总 Pipeline 金额 8000 万，目标回款 3000 万）：
1. 整体健康度打分（覆盖率、转化率、停滞率、漏斗形状）
2. 风险交易清单（卡住/倒退/预期外）
3. 推动交易清单（临门一脚）
4. 需要管理层介入的高价值交易
5. 最终预测区间（保守/基准/乐观）与达成概率
6. 未来两周行动建议

输出《季度 Pipeline 评审报告》Markdown + HTML 仪表盘（漏斗图 + 风险矩阵）。
cases.prompt_en:
Please conduct a comprehensive review of my team's pipeline for the current quarter (total pipeline value 80M, target collections 30M):
1. Overall health scoring (coverage, conversion rate, stagnation rate, funnel shape)
2. Risk deal list (stuck / regressed / unexpected)
3. Push deal list (near the finish line)
4. High-value deals requiring management intervention
5. Final forecast ranges (conservative / base / upside) and achievement probability
6. Action recommendations for the next two weeks

Output a "Quarterly Pipeline Review Report" in Markdown + an HTML dashboard (funnel chart + risk matrix).

cases.title: App 版本更新日志
cases.subtitle: 从变更记录自动生成用户友好的 Word 版 Changelog
cases.subtitle_en: Auto-generate user-friendly Word changelog from change records
cases.description:
每次发版都要手写更新日志，开发写的太技术化用户看不懂，产品写的又漏掉关键变更？这个案例展示了如何用 Word 文档生成技能，输入版本变更列表，自动按 Keep a Changelog 规范分类整理，同时生成面向用户的友好版本说明，输出为正式 Word 文档格式。

以移动 App v3.2.0 为例，演示了将深色模式上线、首页加载优化 40%、支付崩溃修复等变更记录自动整理为 Added/Changed/Fixed/Security 四大分类，并附带面向普通用户的版本说明，格式规范可直接归档。

适合产品经理、发布工程师、技术写作者。
cases.description_en:
Writing release notes manually every sprint — dev notes are too technical, PM notes miss key changes? This case shows how to use the Word Document Generation skill to input change records and auto-generate categorized changelogs following Keep a Changelog format, plus user-friendly release notes, all in a formal Word document.

Using mobile App v3.2.0 as an example, it demonstrates organizing changes like dark mode launch, 40% homepage speed improvement, and payment crash fixes into Added/Changed/Fixed/Security categories with plain-language user notes.

Perfect for PMs, release engineers, and tech writers.

artifacts.label: App版本更新日志（Word）

cases.prompt:
帮我为一个移动 App 生成一份版本更新日志 Word 文档（output.docx），版本号 v3.2.0。假设最近两周有以下变更：新增深色模式、优化首页加载速度 40%、修复支付流程偶发崩溃、新增 3 种消息通知模板、升级隐私策略合规、API 接口向后兼容调整。

文档要求：
1. 按 Keep a Changelog 格式输出，分为 Added/Changed/Fixed/Security 四类
2. 同时生成面向用户的友好版本更新说明
3. 包含封面页、版本信息摘要表、详细变更列表
4. 文档格式规范：多级标题、统一表格样式、页眉页脚
5. 输出为正式 Word 文档（output.docx）
cases.prompt_en:
Help me generate a release changelog Word document (output.docx) for a mobile app, version v3.2.0. Assume the following changes happened over the past two weeks: added dark mode, improved home page load speed by 40%, fixed occasional crashes in the payment flow, added 3 new message notification templates, upgraded privacy policy compliance, and made backward-compatible API adjustments.

Document requirements:
1. Output in the Keep a Changelog format, divided into the four categories Added/Changed/Fixed/Security
2. Also generate a user-friendly version of the release notes
3. Include a cover page, a version-info summary table, and a detailed list of changes
4. Follow document formatting standards: multi-level headings, a consistent table style, and headers/footers
5. Output as a formal Word document (output.docx)

cases.title: 品牌 Logo 创意应用
cases.subtitle: 让黑色圆角标识在六个真实世界场景中自然出现
cases.subtitle_en: A rounded black mark appears naturally in six real-world scenes
cases.description:
品牌 Logo 动效经常只是平面缩放，难以展示标识在不同材质、尺度和环境中的适应力。

案例把一个黑色圆角符号分别放进纹身、海运集装箱、冰淇淋粉面、复古车头、城市环岛和自动售货机，再将六张超写实应用图做成短动态合集。

适合：品牌发布、Logo 提案、社交媒体包装、设计公司案例和视觉识别系统展示。
cases.description_en:
Logo motion often amounts to flat scaling and fails to show how a mark behaves across materials, scales, and environments.

A rounded black symbol appears as a tattoo, shipping-container mark, cocoa imprint, vintage-car badge, traffic island, and vending-machine panel before the six scenes become a motion compilation.

Best for brand launches, logo proposals, social packaging, design-studio cases, and identity-system presentations.

artifacts.label: 成片视频

cases.prompt: 请由「商业广告创作」专家调用 Flova 的「品牌 Logo 创意应用」Skill，使用我上传的黑色圆角几何 Logo，制作默认 9:16 的六场景动态展示《一个 Logo 的六次出现》。先分析 Logo 的轮廓、负形、颜色和文字，确认全局规格后，提出六个彼此差异明显的超写实方案：纹身师正在把符号纹到手臂；海上货轮的白色集装箱；冰淇淋表面的可可粉压印；复古黑色跑车的金属车头章；俯拍城市圆形交通岛；夜间自动售货机的发光面板。先展示六个创意与动态逻辑让我确认，再逐张生成 2K 场景图并再次确认，最后每张生成 3–5 秒视频并可选拼接。每个场景都必须保持 Logo 几何比例与识别度，不生成额外品牌文字。
cases.prompt_en: Ask the “Flova Commercial Director” expert to invoke Flova’s “Brand Logo Creative Application” Skill and use my uploaded rounded black geometric logo to create a default 9:16 six-scene motion showcase titled Six Appearances of One Logo. Analyze the logo’s silhouette, negative space, colors, and lettering first. After confirming the global specification, propose six clearly differentiated photorealistic applications: a tattoo artist placing the mark on an arm; a white shipping container on a cargo vessel; a cocoa-powder imprint on ice cream; a metal hood badge on a vintage black sports car; an overhead view of a circular urban traffic island; and an illuminated panel on a nighttime vending machine. Show all six concepts and motion ideas for approval, then generate the six 2K scene images and obtain approval again. Finally turn each image into a 3–5 second video and optionally assemble them. Preserve the exact logo geometry and recognizability in every scene, and generate no additional brand wording.

cases.title: 文创品建模 · 硅胶材质
cases.subtitle: 把文创品变成软胶质感的可交互 3D 模型
cases.subtitle_en: Turn a creative product into a soft-silicone interactive 3D model
cases.description:
硅胶周边打样贵、周期长，前期很难预览成品的软胶质感与形态。

案例识别文创品的品类、轮廓、比例与纹样，转译为软胶（硅胶）材质的可交互 3D 模型：柔光半透质感、圆润手感，网页可 360° 旋转缩放，单文件离线可开。

适合：文创衍生开发、潮玩/礼品设计师、博物馆文创团队、IP 授权方
cases.description_en:
This case reads the product's category, silhouette, proportion and motif, translating it into a soft-silicone interactive 3D model with soft-light translucency and rounded feel — rotate and zoom in the browser, single-file and offline-ready.

Good for: Merch developers, Toy & gift designers, Museum creative teams, IP licensors
cases.prompt:
根据用户上传的文创品图片，准确识别主体的品类、外形轮廓、长宽比例、造型结构、朝向、主色、纹样、配件及关键识别特征，并将其作为画面中的唯一主体。完整保留原产品设计，不重新设计、不增删结构、不改变比例、不替换品类、不擅自卡通化；仅将主体表面材质转换为一体成型的软质哑光硅胶材质。

构图：主体居中完整呈现，采用四分之三前侧视角（3/4 front-side view）；原图中属于产品本体的底座、支撑或配件应一并保留。使用纯净白色无缝背景和产品级静物棚拍，无文字、无水印、无装饰道具、无人物、无第二主体。

材质：呈现细腻、柔软、略带弹性的模压硅胶质感，表面均匀顺滑，带有极细微的磨砂颗粒与柔和触感；整体低反射，以柔和漫反射和宽缓高光表现材质，不出现坚硬锐利的镜面反光。边缘仅可产生符合硅胶工艺的轻微软化效果，不得改变原有轮廓和结构。忠实保留原产品的主色、色彩关系及纹样位置，只通过表面光泽、触感和细微明暗变化体现硅胶材质。

光影与画质：采用柔和均匀的棚拍光线，保留轻微自然的接触阴影，主体轮廓清晰、细节完整、画面干净，适合作为3D建模与材质重建参考。避免塑料感、蜡质感、油腻反光、玻璃透明感、金属质感、毛绒纤维、过度圆润变形、结构缺失、模糊、强烈阴影遮挡及背景杂物。

experts.name: 文创品3D建模专家
experts.description: 将文创品转译为可交互的 3D 模型效果，支持毛绒、硅胶、金属珐琅、亚克力等材质渲染

cases.title: NPS 用户满意度调研问卷
cases.subtitle: 专业 NPS 问卷页面，动态追问 + 满意度矩阵
cases.subtitle_en: Professional NPS survey with dynamic follow-ups and satisfaction matrix
cases.description:
每次做用户满意度调研，从零搭建一份专业 NPS 问卷既耗时又容易遗漏关键指标——评分逻辑、动态追问、满意度矩阵、移动端适配，每项都要反复调试。

这个案例展示了如何用一句话描述产品和调研目标，AI 即可生成一份完整的交互式 NPS 调研页面：0-10 分彩色评分条带动画反馈，根据分数自动切换追问题（贬损者多选痛点、被动者填写改进建议、推荐者勾选喜爱功能），五维满意度矩阵评分，以及可选的用户信息收集模块，全响应式设计，纯前端无外部依赖。

适合：产品经理、用研团队、运营同学、客户成功经理，以及任何需要快速上线专业 NPS 调研的团队。
cases.description_en:
Building a professional NPS survey from scratch is time-consuming — scoring logic, dynamic follow-ups, satisfaction matrices, and mobile responsiveness all need careful tuning.

This case demonstrates generating a complete interactive NPS survey page from a single prompt: a color-coded 0-10 rating bar with animations, dynamic follow-up questions based on score (detractor pain points, passive improvement suggestions, promoter favorite features), a five-dimension satisfaction matrix, and optional user demographics — fully responsive, pure frontend, no external dependencies.

Best for: Product managers, UX researchers, operations teams, customer success managers, and anyone who needs to quickly launch a professional NPS survey.

artifacts.label: NPS 调研问卷页面

cases.prompt:
请设计一个专业的 NPS 用户满意度调研问卷页面（单文件 HTML，内联无外部依赖），现代简洁、单页滚动式、响应式、NPS 评分条有交互动画，提交后显示感谢页（无需真实提交）。

产品「TaskFlow」，调研 v3.0 版本满意度。
1. 品牌化头部 + 调研说明
2. NPS 核心题「您有多大可能向同事推荐？」0-10 评分条，0-6 贬损者/7-8 被动者/9-10 推荐者按色区分
3. 动态追问（按分数显示不同问题）：0-6 多选体验问题、7-8 文本框、9-10 多选喜欢的功能
4. 满意度矩阵：易用性/功能完整性/性能稳定性/客服支持/性价比 各 5 档
5. 开放反馈框
6. 可选用户信息：使用时长/团队规模/行业
7. 提交按钮 + 感谢页
cases.prompt_en:
Please design a professional NPS customer satisfaction survey page (single-file HTML, fully inline with no external dependencies), in a modern, clean, single-page scrolling, responsive style, with an interactive animation on the NPS rating bar, and a thank-you page shown after submission (no real submission needed).

The product is "TaskFlow," surveying satisfaction with version v3.0.
1. A branded header + survey description
2. The core NPS question "How likely are you to recommend us to a colleague?" with a 0-10 rating bar, color-coded as 0-6 detractors / 7-8 passives / 9-10 promoters
3. Dynamic follow-up questions (different questions shown by score): a multiple-choice experience question for 0-6, a text box for 7-8, a multiple-choice "features you like" question for 9-10
4. A satisfaction matrix: ease of use / feature completeness / performance stability / customer support / value for money, each on a 5-point scale
5. An open-ended feedback box
6. Optional user info: length of use / team size / industry
7. A submit button + a thank-you page

cases.title: 竞争比查询：国考低竞争段真实比值
cases.title_en: Competition Ratios: Real Low-Ratio National Exam Posts
cases.subtitle: 先把 300:1 的卷王岗筛出去，同样的分数才有胜算
cases.subtitle_en: Screen out 300:1 battlegrounds first — the same score goes further
cases.description:
同样 130 分，报在 300:1 的岗是炮灰，报在 30:1 的岗有胜算。报岗第一步不是挑喜欢的，是排除卷不动的。

本案例按「国考 + 竞争比≤30:1」实时筛出 7528 个岗位，逐行展示真实竞争比（低至 5:1、8:1），有往年进面分的标出实值，没有的如实标注「无历史数据」，并解释低竞争的常见成因——专业门槛替你筛掉了对手。

适合：分数中游想避开激烈竞争的考生、研究报考策略的老师。
cases.description_en:
With the same 130 points, applying to a 300:1 post makes you cannon fodder; a 30:1 post gives you a real shot. Step one isn't picking favourites — it's excluding the unwinnable.

This case live-filters 7,528 national-exam positions with ratios ≤30:1, showing real per-post ratios (as low as 5:1 and 8:1), marking actual historical cutoffs where they exist and honestly labelling "no historical data" where they don't, and explains why low competition happens — eligibility bars filter out rivals for you.

For: mid-scoring candidates avoiding fierce competition and strategy-minded advisors.

artifacts.label: 国考竞争比≤30:1 岗位清单（真实比值）

cases.prompt: 帮我在国考岗位里找竞争比不超过 30:1 的。要求：1) 实时查询并给出总数；2) 逐条列岗位、单位、真实竞争比、往年进面分（没有就如实标注无历史数据，不许用别的岗替代）、招录人数，重复条目去重后展示；3) 分析这批岗位竞争低的原因；4) 提醒「低竞争不等于低门槛」要核对什么。
cases.prompt_en: Find national-exam positions with competition ratios no higher than 30:1. cases.title: 住院全流程三阶段病历衔接
cases.title_en: Inpatient Record: Admission to Discharge Chained
cases.subtitle: 入院 → 病程 → 出院自动衔接，病案首页一键汇总
cases.subtitle_en: Admission → progress → discharge chained, auto front-sheet summary
cases.description:
65 岁慢心衰患者入院，3 天加呋塞米、5 天 BNP 下降、7 天出院带三种药——住院病历要写入院记录、病程记录、出院小结，还要出病案首页，纯靠医生手敲耗时一两个小时。

这个案例演示了把分阶段口述内容连续交给 AI 临床助手，它自动判别住院场景，先写入院记录；阶段完成后主动询问「是否继续病程阶段」，得到确认才推进，绝不自动跳转；病程独立撰写而非复制入院记录；出院小结汇总住院天数、带药、随访；最后自动汇总病案首页，并对时间逻辑、剂量等做三级校验（P0/P1/P2）。

适合：住院医师、主治医师、病案室编码员、医务科管理者、关注病历质量与合规的临床科室。
cases.description_en:
A 65-year-old chronic HF patient is admitted, gets furosemide on day 3, BNP drops on day 5, and is discharged on day 7 with three medications. Writing the admission note, progress notes, discharge summary, plus the front sheet — by hand, this eats one to two hours of the doctor's day.

This case shows how to feed staged dictation into the AI assistant. It identifies the inpatient scenario, drafts the admission record first, then asks "continue to progress notes?" and only advances after explicit confirmation — never auto-jumps. Progress notes are written independently instead of being copy-pasted from the admission record. The discharge summary aggregates LOS, take-home meds and follow-up, and finally auto-rolls up the front sheet with a three-tier (P0/P1/P2) sanity check on timeline and dosage.

For: residents, attendings, medical records coders, medical affairs managers, and any clinical department focused on record quality and compliance.
cases.prompt:
帮我写一份住院病历，分阶段完成入院记录、病程记录、出院小结，并自动汇总病案首页。

入院信息：患者男性，65 岁，反复胸闷气促 3 年、加重 1 周入院；高血压病史 10 年、糖尿病 5 年；入院查体血压 160/95、双下肢轻度水肿；诊断慢性心力衰竭急性加重。

要求：
1. 判别场景为「住院病历」，先写入院记录（主诉、现病史、既往史、查体、诊断）；
2. 入院完成后询问是否继续病程阶段，病程完成后询问是否继续出院阶段——阶段间必须确认后再继续，不自动跳转；
3. 病程记录独立撰写，不直接复制入院记录，同一临床事实用不同表达方式；
4. 出院小结汇总住院天数、出院诊断、出院带药、随访建议；
5. 全部阶段完成后自动生成病案首页；
6. 对时间逻辑、剂量等做三级校验（P0/P1/P2），P0 问题必须人工确认；
7. 不做诊断推理、不新增诊断，不编造临床数据，末尾附安全声明。
cases.prompt_en:
Draft an inpatient record in stages — admission note, progress notes, discharge summary — and auto-roll up the front sheet.

Admission info: Patient is male, 65, recurrent chest tightness and dyspnea for 3 years, worse over 1 week; hypertension 10 years, diabetes 5 years; BP 160/95 on admission, mild edema of both lower limbs; diagnosis acute exacerbation of chronic heart failure.

Requirements:
1. Identify the scenario as "inpatient record" and write the admission note first (chief complaint, HPI, past history, physical exam, diagnosis).
2. After the admission note, ask whether to continue to progress notes; after progress notes, ask whether to continue to discharge — advance only after explicit confirmation, never auto-jump.
3. Write progress notes independently, never copying the admission record; use different wording for the same clinical facts.
4. The discharge summary aggregates length of stay, discharge diagnosis, discharge meds and follow-up.
5. Auto-generate the front sheet after all stages are done.
6. Apply a three-tier check (P0/P1/P2) on timeline and dosage; P0 issues require human confirmation.
7. Make no diagnostic inference, add no new diagnosis, never fabricate clinical data; end with a safety statement.

cases.subtitle_en: Skip the thousand-to-one posts and the coldest ones — 4,247 sit in between
cases.description:
挑岗时人们要么冲热门，要么专捡最冷门，很少有人认真看中间那一档。

本案例筛出报录比 50–100:1 的国考岗位共 4,247 个，本页 30 条按比值升序排列，统计招录单位分布，指出这一档为什么长期被部委的专业方向岗占据，并如实说明报录比与进面分是两套数据、覆盖范围不重合。

适合：想找性价比岗位的考生、专业方向较窄的报考者。
cases.description_en:
People either chase the hottest posts or hunt the coldest — few look carefully at the middle.

This case filters national-exam posts with ratios of 50–100:1, finding 4,247. The 30 shown are sorted by ascending ratio with a breakdown of recruiting units, explaining why ministry-level specialist posts dominate this band, and noting that ratio and cutoff data cover different sets of posts.

For: candidates seeking value-for-effort posts, especially those with narrow specialisms.

cases.title: 竞争比筛选：国考冷热岗位对照榜
cases.title_en: Ratio Filter: The Hottest and Coldest National-Exam Posts
cases.subtitle: 最热 5117:1、最冷 1:1，同一年同一场考试
cases.subtitle_en: 5117:1 at one end, 1:1 at the other — same exam, same year
cases.description:
「国考很卷」是句正确的废话——真正有用的是知道卷在哪、冷在哪，以及两端各自的坑。

本案例做两次极值查询：1000:1 以上的岗位有 132 个，10:1 以下的有 2,017 个。两张榜并排看，能直接读出热榜岗位 15 条里 12 条只招 1 人，冷榜岗位则集中在语言类翻译和公安特殊岗位——冷不等于容易。

适合：第一次报考的考生、想理解竞争分布形状的人。
cases.description_en:
"The national exam is brutal" is true but useless — what helps is knowing where the crowding is, where it isn't, and the trap at each extreme.

This case runs two extreme queries: 132 posts above 1000:1, and 2,017 below 10:1. Side by side, the hot list turns out to be almost entirely single-opening posts with no major restriction, while the cold list clusters in language translation and specialist police roles — cold does not mean easy.

For: first-time candidates and anyone wanting to understand the shape of the competition curve.

artifacts.label: 国考冷热岗位对照榜

cases.prompt: 帮我做一次国考岗位的冷热对照。要求：1) 分两次真实查询——一次筛报录比 1000:1 以上的岗位，一次筛 10:1 以下的，各给出总数；2) 两榜各列 8 条，包含岗位、招录单位、地区、招录人数、报录比、薪资区间（冷榜若有进面分也一并列出）；3) 分别总结热榜岗位和冷榜岗位各自的共同特征（招录人数、专业限制等），用数据说话；4) 指出冷热两端各自的陷阱，说明为什么报录比低不等于容易上岸；5) 给出一个更实际的竞争比筛选区间建议。
cases.prompt_en: Run a hot-versus-cold comparison of national-exam posts. Requirements: 1) two real queries — one for ratios above 1000:1, one for below 10:1 — with totals for each; 2) list 8 from each with post, unit, region, headcount, ratio and salary band (plus cutoff score for the cold list where available); 3) summarise what the posts on each list have in common (headcount, major restrictions) using the data; 4) identify the trap at each extreme and explain why a low ratio doesn't mean an easy admission; 5) suggest a more practical ratio range to filter on.

cases.title: 微服务架构拓扑图
cases.subtitle: 清晰展示服务间依赖、数据流向与故障隔离边界
cases.subtitle_en: Clearly map service dependencies, data flows, and fault isolation boundaries
cases.description:
微服务拆得越多，系统全貌就越难看清——哪个服务依赖哪个？数据从哪里流到哪里？一个服务挂了会影响多大范围？新人入职第一天就被这些问题搞懵了。

这个案例用 Excalidraw 画了一张典型电商系统的微服务拓扑图，分为网关层、业务服务层、基础设施层三个区域，标注了真实的 API 路径、消息队列主题、数据库连接，并用颜色区分同步调用和异步事件。

适合：后端架构师、微服务团队负责人、需要做系统设计文档的开发者、准备技术方案评审的工程师
cases.description_en:
The more microservices you split, the harder it is to see the full picture — which service depends on what? Where does data flow? How far does a single service failure cascade? New hires get confused on day one.

This case uses Excalidraw to create a microservice topology diagram for a typical e-commerce system, divided into Gateway, Business Services, and Infrastructure layers, annotated with real API paths, message queue topics, and database connections, using colors to distinguish sync calls from async events.

Ideal for: Backend architects, microservice team leads, developers writing system design docs, and engineers preparing technical reviews
cases.prompt:
请用 Excalidraw 画一张微服务架构拓扑图，以典型电商系统为例。

要求：
1. 上下分层布局，分三个区域（用浅色背景框出）：网关层、业务服务层（用户、订单、商品、支付、通知等服务）、基础设施层（PostgreSQL、Redis、RabbitMQ、Elasticsearch）
2. 实线箭头表示同步 HTTP/gRPC 调用，虚线箭头表示异步消息
3. 在关键箭头旁标注真实 API 路径与消息队列 Topic
4. 每个服务节点标注技术栈
5. 加一个深色背景的证据块，展示一段网关路由配置片段
6. 用颜色语义区分网关、业务服务、数据库、消息队列几类节点
7. 顶部加标题 "E-Commerce Microservice Topology"
cases.prompt_en:
Please use Excalidraw to draw a microservice architecture topology diagram, using a typical e-commerce system as an example.

Requirements:
1. Top-to-bottom layered layout, three zones (outlined with light backgrounds): Gateway, Business Services (user, order, product, payment, notification services), Infrastructure (PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch)
2. Solid arrows for synchronous HTTP/gRPC calls, dashed arrows for asynchronous messages
3. Annotate real API paths and message-queue topics next to key arrows
4. Label the tech stack inside each service node
5. Add a dark-background evidence block showing a gateway routing config snippet
6. Use color semantics to distinguish gateway, business services, databases, and message queues
7. Add the title "E-Commerce Microservice Topology" at the top

cases.title: 用户旅程流程图
cases.subtitle: 电商购物全链路可视化，一键生成专业用户旅程图
cases.subtitle_en: Visualize the full e-commerce shopping journey, generate professional user journey maps in one click
cases.description:
分析用户旅程时还在用 PPT 手动画流程图？节点对不齐、样式不统一、改一个阶段要拖半天——效率低下且难以复用。

这个案例用 Mermaid Journey 图完整呈现了电商购物的全链路用户旅程：从「发现商品」到「复购推荐」共 9 个核心阶段，每个阶段标注满意度评分（1-5 分）和关键触点行为。可视化效果清晰专业，支持快速迭代修改，只需编辑文本即可调整流程节点。

适合：产品经理梳理用户体验地图、UX 设计师做旅程分析、运营团队复盘转化漏斗
cases.description_en:
Still manually drawing user journey flowcharts in PowerPoint? Misaligned nodes, inconsistent styles, and hours spent dragging one stage around — inefficient and hard to reuse.

This case uses a Mermaid Journey diagram to present the complete e-commerce shopping user journey: from 'Discover Products' to 'Repurchase Recommendation' across 9 core stages, each annotated with satisfaction scores (1-5) and key touchpoint actions. The visualization is clean and professional, supports rapid iteration, and can be modified simply by editing text.

Ideal for: Product managers mapping user experience journeys, UX designers conducting journey analysis, operations teams reviewing conversion funnels
cases.prompt:
请生成一个电商用户旅程图页面（单文件 HTML，用内联 SVG 绘制 journey 图，无外部依赖），含标题区、专业清爽排版。

9 个阶段（含满意度评分 1-5 和关键触点）：
1. 发现商品（3）：搜索引擎、社媒种草、好友推荐
2. 浏览详情（4）：看图、读描述、看评价
3. 加入购物车（4）：选规格、对比、收藏
4. 下单结算（3）：确认地址、选配送、用券
5. 在线支付（4）：选支付方式、验证、确认
6. 物流配送（3）：看轨迹、预约时间、签收
7. 确认收货（4）：检查质量、确认、售后
8. 评价晒单（3）：写评价、传图、分享
9. 复购推荐（5）：个性化推荐、领券、再下单
cases.prompt_en:
Generate an e-commerce user journey diagram page (single-file HTML, drawing the journey diagram with inline SVG, no external dependencies), including a title area and professional, clean typography.

9 stages (with satisfaction scores 1-5 and key touchpoints):
1. Discover Products (3): search engines, social media seeding, friend recommendations
2. Browse Details (4): view images, read descriptions, check reviews
3. Add to Cart (4): select specs, compare, save to favorites
4. Checkout (3): confirm address, choose delivery, apply coupons
5. Online Payment (4): choose payment method, verify, confirm
6. Logistics & Delivery (3): track shipment, schedule time, sign for delivery
7. Confirm Receipt (4): inspect quality, confirm, after-sales
8. Review & Share (3): write review, upload images, share
9. Repurchase Recommendation (5): personalized recommendations, claim coupons, reorder

cases.title: LLM Agent 研究综述 2023-2026
cases.subtitle: 60 篇顶会论文 × 5 大方向 × 标准 BibTeX，一份能直接投稿 Related Work 的学术综述
cases.subtitle_en: 60 top-venue papers × 5 directions × standard BibTeX — a Related-Work-ready academic survey
cases.description:
做 Agent 方向的研究最难的不是写实验，而是把三年来 ReAct、Reflexion、MemGPT、AutoGen、Toolformer、AgentBench、WebArena、SWE-bench…… 几十篇论文按脉络串起来——既要讲清谁继承了谁、谁反对了谁，又要给出准确的 arXiv ID 和作者署名，任谁都头疼。

这个案例演示了深度研究团队如何 6 分钟内产出一份《2023-2026 大模型 Agent 研究进展综述》：Chief Editor 统筹，按 5 大方向（经典范式 / 记忆机制 / 多智能体 / 工具使用 / 评测基准）+ 未来预判共 6 章分头调研，每章 5-11 篇代表性工作（含作者、arXiv ID、发表场所、核心贡献），章末附 ASCII 研究脉络图（继承/反对/改进关系），最后交付 60 条标准 BibTeX 清单，可直接粘到 LaTeX 模板里。

适合：AI 博士生开题 / 投稿前做 Related Work / Foundation Model 研究团队内部培训 / Applied Scientist 跟进前沿 / 技术 VP 了解 Agent 技术图谱。
cases.description_en:

cases.description:

案例以彩绘漆木鸠为主体，保留真实轮廓、比例与纹样，转译为金属胎珐琅质感的可交互 3D 模型：釉彩光泽与金属描边清晰，网页可自由旋转查看，单文件离线可开。

cases.prompt:
根据这张图文创品图片，以图中彩绘漆木鸠为唯一主体，完整保留其真实轮廓、比例、造型结构、材质厚薄、主色、纹样、做旧或磨损痕迹与关键结构锚点，不重新设计、不改变品类身份、不替换为其他物件或真实动物；仅将其重塑为一件金属景泰蓝珐琅质感的立体收藏摆件（3D 手办／公仔）。
构图：画面中仅一个主体，居中，采用四分之三前侧视角（3/4 front-side view），完整展现整体造型（若原物含底座／支撑则一并保留）；纯净白色背景，柔和均匀的棚拍布光，产品级静物摄影；主体完整不裁切，无多余道具、无文字水印、无多视角拼图、无第二主体。
材质表现：玻璃质釉面带光泽，各色釉块之间以细凸起金丝（掐丝）勾边，喙／眼圈／足／底边为抛光鎏金铜，色彩宝石感、饱满干净；忠实保留实拍产品的主色与材质色，仅做轻微暖化与饱和度收敛，不改变识别色。
画质：清晰锐利、细节丰富、主体轮廓干净完整，适合直接作为 3D 建模重建的参考图；避免噪点、模糊、强烈阴影遮挡和背景杂物。

cases.title_en: Prescription-Only Entry with Smart Field Prompt and Skip
cases.subtitle: 头孢克洛 + 奥美拉唑，剂量 / 疗程缺失分级追问，支持跳过
cases.subtitle_en: Cefaclor + omeprazole, tiered prompts for dose and duration, skip to ship
cases.description:
「开头孢克洛缓释片，一天两次，再开个奥美拉唑」——单次剂量、疗程、给药途径全缺，临床最怕的是把残缺处方直接录进去，出了问题说不清是谁的锅。

这个案例演示了把口头处方交给 AI 临床助手，它只问处方必需的剂量 / 疗程 / 给药途径，不过度追问病史；追问分级进行、每批不超过 5 个；回复「跳过」或「直接生成」后基于已有信息输出，缺失项如实标注 [信息缺失]，不编造剂量或疗程数据。

适合：门诊药房、诊所医师、电子处方录入员、关注处方完整性的药师与医务管理者。
cases.description_en:
"Cefaclor sustained-release, twice a day, plus omeprazole." Single dose, duration, route — all missing. The worst thing a clinic can do is ship a partial prescription and then argue about whose fault it is when something goes wrong.

This case shows how to hand the verbal prescription to the AI clinical assistant. It only asks the prescription-essential fields — dose, duration, route — and won't over-ask about unrelated history. Prompts are tiered (no more than five per round), and replying "skip" or "just generate" makes it produce what it has while honestly tagging missing items as [信息缺失] — never invents a dose or duration.

For: outpatient pharmacies, clinic physicians, e-prescription entry staff, and pharmacists and medical affairs managers focused on prescription completeness.
cases.prompt:
帮我录一个处方，从口头描述里提取药品信息，缺失的必需字段要追问，支持跳过。

口头处方：开头孢克洛缓释片，一天两次，再开个奥美拉唑。

要求：
1. 判别场景为「纯处方录入」；
2. 提取药品名、频次等信息；
3. 检测单次剂量、疗程、给药途径等必需字段缺失时，进行渐进式追问，每批不超过 5 个、不过度追问非处方相关信息；
4. 我回复「跳过」或「直接生成」后，基于已有信息输出，缺失项标注 [信息缺失]，不编造剂量或疗程数据；
5. 生成校验报告，如实反映缺失项和潜在问题；
6. 不做用药咨询、不解释药物作用，末尾附安全声明。
cases.prompt_en:
Enter a prescription from my verbal description, extracting drug info and prompting for missing required fields, with skip support.

Verbal prescription: cefaclor sustained-release, twice a day, plus omeprazole.

Requirements:
1. Identify the scenario as "prescription-only entry".
2. Extract drug names and frequency.
3. When required fields (single dose, duration, route) are missing, prompt progressively — no more than 5 per batch, and never over-ask about non-prescription info.
4. After I reply "skip" or "just generate", produce output from what is available, tagging missing items as [信息缺失] — never invent dose or duration data.
5. Generate a check report honestly reflecting missing items and potential issues.
6. Give no medication counseling and do not explain drug effects; end with a safety statement.

cases.description:
昨晚港股财报暴雷、今天盘前跌 8%，原计划的买入操作瞬间乱了套 — 追还是不追、现在价位安全吗、一次买满还是分批进，半小时内根本想不清楚。

cases.description_en:

This case shows the TradingAgent expert team running in "rapid decision mode" on a real emergency: Meituan-W (3690.HK) Q3 core local commerce swung to a 14.1B RMB operating loss and net profit flipped to -18.6B. The team divides work across earnings deep-dive + news/rating sweep (MS→95, Citi→133) + technical breakdown analysis after losing 118 with key supports at 110/95/85-88 + fund flow read (12.45B main outflow, southbound vs institutional divergence) + bull-bear debate. The final verdict: 2/5 star chase willingness, initial position capped at 20-30%, a 3-tier left-side scaling plan at 100-105 / 95 / 85-88, hard stop on a close below 82. ~4,500 characters, every number traceable.

Target audience: HK investors forced into same-day decisions by earnings/black swan events, retail traders learning "structured thinking in 30 pre-market minutes", long-term traders looking for a left-side scaling template, and finance content creators producing rapid single-stock commentary.

Ideal for: B2B SaaS marketing teams, growth hackers, product managers, CRO specialists — anyone looking to boost lead capture form conversion rates.

cases.title: 月度费用报销汇总表
cases.subtitle: 个人报销明细到部门汇总，费用管控一键生成
cases.description:
每到月底，财务桌上堆满了报销单：差旅费、餐饮费、办公用品……金额对不上、审批卡在谁那儿不知道、超标报销混在正常单据里——靠人工逐条核对，既慢又容易出错。

这个案例用 AI 一键生成一份完整的月度费用报销汇总 Excel：80 条真实场景报销记录，覆盖 4 个部门 20 名员工，涵盖差旅、餐饮、办公用品、交通、培训、招待六大费用类别。内置报销明细表、部门费用汇总、类别占比分析、审批状态追踪、同比趋势对比，还有超标合规标记——打开就能看清每一分钱花在了哪里、卡在了哪个环节。

cases.prompt:
帮我生成一份专业的月度费用报销汇总 Excel 报表（.xlsx）。

**业务背景**：中型互联网公司，4 个部门各约 5 人，需汇总报销数据做费用管控。

Help me generate a professional monthly expense reimbursement summary Excel report (.xlsx).

**Business context**: A mid-sized internet company, 4 departments with about 5 people each, needing to summarize reimbursement data for expense control.

**Simulated data**: Generate about 80 reimbursement records for March 2026, covering six categories (travel, meals, office supplies, transportation, training, entertainment).

**Report structure (multiple Sheets)**:
- Sheet 1 Expense Detail: fields such as reimbursement number, date, employee, department, expense category, amount, approval status
- Sheet 2 Dept Summary: cross-tabulated by department × expense category
- Sheet 3 Category Analysis

cases.title: 文创品建模 · 亚克力材质
cases.subtitle: 把文创品变成通透亚克力质感的可交互 3D 模型
cases.subtitle_en: Turn a creative product into a clear-acrylic interactive 3D model
cases.description:
通透亚克力的光感和体积最难靠平面图表达，客户总要求看立体效果。

案例以唐三彩马为主体，保留三维体积、造型与主色，转译为通透亚克力材质的可交互 3D 模型：透光折射质感真实，网页可 360° 旋转缩放，单文件离线可开（模型已内联，约 62MB）。

适合：文创衍生开发、展陈/礼品设计师、博物馆文创团队、IP 授权方
cases.description_en:
Using the Tang Sancai horse as subject, this case keeps its 3D volume, form and main colors, rendering a clear-acrylic interactive 3D model with realistic light refraction — rotate and zoom in the browser, single-file offline-ready (model inlined, ~62MB).

Good for: Merch developers, Exhibition & gift designers, Museum creative teams, IP licensors
cases.prompt:
根据用户上传的文创品图片，准确识别主体的品类、外形轮廓、长宽比例、三维体积、造型结构、朝向、主色、纹样、配件及关键识别特征，并将其作为画面中的唯一主体。完整保留原产品设计，不重新设计、不增删结构、不改变比例、不替换品类、不擅自卡通化；仅将主体材质转换为高品质亚克力材质。

构图：主体居中完整呈现，采用四分之三前侧视角（3/4 front-side view）；原图中属于产品本体的底座、支撑或配件应一并保留。使用纯净白色无缝背景和产品级静物棚拍，无文字、无水印、无装饰道具、无人物、无第二主体。
材质：主体呈现高透或半透明浇铸亚克力质感，表面光洁平整，边缘经过精细抛光，具有清晰而克制的高光、透光、折射及内部色彩叠加效果。产品原有的三维体积、厚度和结构必须保持不变，不得擅自改成平面立牌、薄片挂牌或其他造型。忠实保留原产品的主色、色彩关系和纹样位置，可根据原图效果使用透明彩色亚克力、半透明亚克力、局部不透明色层、UV印刷或内嵌图案层表现，但不得改变图案形态、比例与颜色关系；透明度保持适中，不因过度透光而削弱产品识别度。
光影：采用柔和均匀的棚拍光线，通过侧前方柔光表现亚克力的透明边缘、内部折射、材质厚度与精致高光；主体底部保留轻微自然的接触阴影，使产品稳定落地，避免悬浮感。

画质：画面清晰锐利，主体轮廓准确，边缘干净，细节完整，适合作为3D建模与材质重建参考。避免玻璃器皿感、水晶雕塑感、果冻感、廉价透明塑料感、过曝高光、严重色散、内部气泡、裂纹、擅自增加拼接件、结构变形、模糊、强烈阴影遮挡及背景杂物。

cases.title: 诊断复核与误诊漏诊排查
cases.subtitle: 已有确诊结果？AI 帮你找鉴别诊断、漏诊、误诊风险等级
cases.subtitle_en: Already have a diagnosis? Let AI scan for differentials, missed and mis-diagnosis risks
cases.description:
门诊已下「社区获得性肺炎」诊断，但三天抗生素下去没见好转。到底是真的 CAP，还是被表象盖住了别的病——是肺栓塞？是血管炎？还是漏掉了某个共病？

这个案例演示了把患者的「主诉 / 现病史 / 既往史 / 查体 / 辅助检查 / 当前诊断」一并交给「腾讯健康 · AI 临床助手·辅助诊断」。它会在报告开头醒目标出可能的危急征象，然后按常见病优先顺序列出不少于 3 个需鉴别的疾病，覆盖感染性、血栓性、免疫性 / 血管炎性、肿瘤性等不同病因机制，逐条给出鉴别要点与排除依据；再对当前诊断「可能误诊为什么」「可能漏诊哪些共病」给出风险等级评估。

行为边界：只做诊断推理，不延伸至治疗方案；鉴别诊断不少于 3 个且覆盖不同病因机制；误诊 / 漏诊风险逐条标注等级；危急征象醒目标注于报告开头；末尾附安全声明，明确最终以临床医生判断为准。

适合：住院 / 门诊医师、规培医生、临床药师、医学研究生、想训练鉴别诊断思维的临床用户。
cases.description_en:
The clinic has labeled it "community-acquired pneumonia," but three days of antibiotics haven't helped. Is it really CAP, or is something else hiding behind the label — pulmonary embolism, vasculitis, a missed comorbidity?

This case shows how to hand the AI clinical assistant the full record: chief complaint, history of present illness, past history, physical exam, workup and current diagnosis. It opens the report with prominent warning signs, then lists at least three conditions to rule out — covering infectious, thromboembolic, immune-mediated / vasculitic, neoplastic and other mechanisms — in common-disease-first order, with exclusion rationale for each, and rates the misdiagnosis / missed-comorbidity risks of the current label.

Boundaries: diagnosis reasoning only, no treatment plans; ≥3 differentials across distinct mechanisms; risk levels labeled on every missed or mis-diagnosis; warning signs up top; safety statement at the end reminding that final judgment rests with the clinician.

For: inpatient / outpatient physicians, residents, clinical pharmacists, medical students, and anyone using AI clinical assistants to sharpen differential-diagnosis thinking.

artifacts.label: 诊断复核与误诊漏诊排查报告（HTML）

cases.prompt:
请基于以下患者病历做一次诊断复核，评估当前诊断是否有误诊或漏诊可能。

【患者病历】
[粘贴患者病情描述：主诉、现病史、既往史、查体、辅助检查、当前诊断]

【示例场景】
这个患者门诊诊断为社区获得性肺炎，用了三天抗生素没好转，请帮我做一下诊断分析，看看有没有漏诊或误诊（附件病情描述）。

【输出要求】
1. 危急征象识别：报告开头醒目标注
2. 病历文本解析：提取主诉、现病史、既往史、查体、辅助检查、当前诊断
3. 鉴别诊断：列出需与「当前诊断」鉴别的疾病（不少于 3 个，按常见病优先排序），每条附鉴别要点与排除依据
4. 误诊 / 漏诊风险评估：当前诊断可能误诊为什么、可能漏诊什么共病，逐条标注风险等级（高 / 中 / 低）
5. 安全声明附在报告末尾

【行为边界】
- 只做诊断推理，不延伸至治疗方案
- 鉴别诊断应覆盖不同病因机制（感染性 / 血栓性 / 免疫性 / 血管炎性 / 肿瘤性 / 心源性等）
- 误诊 / 漏诊风险逐条标注风险等级
- 危急征象在报告开头醒目标注
- 诊断依据 100% 溯源至输入信息，不引用输入中不存在的指标

【不应出现】
- 具体的用药调整建议或治疗方案
- 诊断依据引用输入中不存在的信息
- 鉴别诊断少于 3 个
- 省略安全声明
cases.prompt_en:
Please perform a diagnostic review of the following patient record and assess whether the current diagnosis carries any risk of misdiagnosis or missed comorbidity.

【Patient record】
[Paste the patient's case: chief complaint, history of present illness, past history, physical exam, workup, current diagnosis]

【Example scenario】
This patient was diagnosed with community-acquired pneumonia in clinic but did not improve after three days of antibiotics. Please analyze the case and check for any misdiagnosis or missed diagnosis (see attached description).

【Output requirements】
1. Warning-sign recognition: prominently flagged at the top of the report
2. Record parsing: extract chief complaint, history of present illness, past history, physical exam, workup, current diagnosis
3. Differential diagnosis: list conditions to rule out against the current diagnosis (≥ 3, in common-disease-first order), each with differentiation points and exclusion rationale
4. Misdiagnosis / missed-diagnosis risk assessment: state what the current diagnosis may be confused with and what comorbidities may be missed, with risk levels (high / medium / low) labeled for each item
5. Safety statement appended at the end

【Boundaries】
- Diagnosis reasoning only; do not extend into treatment plans
- Differentials must span distinct etiologic mechanisms (infectious / thromboembolic / immune / vasculitic / neoplastic / cardiac, etc.)
- Each misdiagnosis / missed-diagnosis item must be labeled with a risk level
- Warning signs must be flagged at the top of the report
- Diagnostic clues must be 100% traceable to the input — never invent indicators not in the record

【Must not appear】
- Specific medication adjustments or treatment plans
- Diagnostic clues referencing information not present in the input
- Fewer than 3 differential diagnoses
- A missing safety statement

cases.prompt_en: Ask the “Flova Commercial Director” expert to invoke Flova’s “Fashion Showcase Short” Skill and use my uploaded design for a cream dress to create one 30-second 16:9 Lifestyle fashion film titled The Embroidered Dress in the Rose Garden. First generate a three-view technical garment sheet without a model and pause for approval. Then create a wardrobe card for a long-haired brunette model and confirm the fabric and silhouette. Present three location options; after I choose an English rose garden, generate and approve an empty golden-hour garden image. The storyboard must include walking along the flower path, sitting for afternoon tea, macro details of cuffs and embroidery, a skirt turn, and a sunset glance back. Generate a six-panel cinematic storyboard for approval, then produce the complete video in one pass and add gentle music. cases.title: 专业目录：一个会计学 8 种归类
cases.title_en: Major Directories: One Major, Eight Categories
cases.subtitle: 查清专业在各省目录里算哪类，避免资格复审被刷
cases.subtitle_en: Know your major's category in every directory before review rejects you
cases.description:
公考最冤的失败是笔试面试都过了、资格复审被刷——理由是专业大类对不上。各省专业目录归类根本不统一。

适合：跨省报考的考生、专业名易混淆的考生、做资格审查的工作人员。
cases.description_en:
The cruellest failure: passing written and interview stages, then losing at qualification review because the major category doesn't match. Provincial directories simply disagree.

This case queries "bachelor's + Accounting" and pulls its classification across 10 official directories at once: three codes in the MoE directory, three simultaneous categories in the national exam directory, an extra Economics listing in Jiangsu — eight different category labels across nine directories.

For: cross-province applicants, easily-confused major names, and qualification reviewers.

本案例查询计算机科学与技术在 10 份目录（教育部 + 国考 + 各省考）中的归类，命中 24 条条目、11 种大类叫法。逐份列出所属大类、专业小类与专业代码，并特别指出江苏目录把同一专业挂在 4 个不同大类之下。

cases.description_en:
The post table says "computer science category" and your degree says "computer science and technology" — does that qualify? Change province and the answer may change too.

This case looks up computer science and technology across 10 catalogues (Ministry of Education, national exam, and provincial exams), returning 25 entries under 8 different category labels. Each catalogue's category, sub-category and major code is listed, highlighting that Jiangsu files the same major under four separate categories.

For: candidates applying across provinces where major wording differs.

cases.title: Agent 自动采集生成数据报表
cases.subtitle: 多 Agent 协作自动采集、清洗、分析并生成结构化运营数据报表
cases.subtitle_en: Multi-Agent Workflow for Automated Data Collection, Cleaning, Analysis & Report Generation
cases.description:
每周手动从多个系统导出数据、粘贴到 Excel、计算环比同比、标注异常……运营数据报表的制作流程重复、耗时，且容易出错。一旦指标口径不一致或数据源缺失，整份报表的可信度就大打折扣。

这个案例演示了一个完整的多 Agent 数据报表生成工作流：数据采集 Agent 从多个模拟数据源抓取用户增长、收入、活跃度和留存率等核心指标；数据清洗 Agent 自动识别异常值和缺失数据并标注原因；分析 Agent 计算环比/同比变化、发现显著趋势并生成数据洞察；报表 Agent 最终将所有分析结果整理为包含「数据概览」「趋势分析」「异常标注」「运营建议」四个模块的结构化报表。

适合：运营经理、数据分析师、业务决策者、BI 团队、需要定期产出数据报告的任何团队。
cases.description_en:
Manually exporting data from multiple systems every week, pasting into Excel, calculating WoW/YoY changes, flagging anomalies — the weekly operations report workflow is repetitive, time-consuming, and error-prone.

This case demonstrates a complete multi-agent data report generation workflow: a Data Collection Agent fetches key metrics from simulated sources; a Data Cleaning Agent identifies anomalies and missing values; an Analysis Agent computes trends and generates insights; a Report Agent assembles everything into a structured report with four sections: Data Overview, Trend Analysis, Anomaly Flags, and Operational Recommendations.

Ideal for: operations managers, data analysts, business decision-makers, BI teams, and anyone producing regular data reports.
cases.prompt: 我需要一个 Agent 工作流来自动化生成周度运营数据报表。流程：1) 数据采集 Agent 从模拟的多个数据源（用户增长、收入、活跃度、留存率）抓取关键指标；2) 数据清洗 Agent 检查数据异常和缺失值，标注异常原因；3) 分析 Agent 计算环比/同比变化、识别显著趋势、生成洞察；4) 报表 Agent 将分析结果整理为结构化的 Excel 格式报表。最终产出一份包含「数据概览」「趋势分析」「异常标注」「运营建议」四个Sheet的报表。请用 Agent Team 技能执行整个流程。
cases.prompt_en: I need an Agent workflow to automate the generation of a weekly operations data report. Workflow: 1) A Data Collection Agent pulls key metrics from several simulated data sources (user growth, revenue, activity, retention rate); 2) A Data Cleaning Agent checks for anomalies and missing values, annotating the cause of each anomaly; 3) An Analysis Agent computes month-over-month/year-over-year changes, identifies significant trends, and produces insights; 4) A Reporting Agent organizes the analysis results into a structured Excel-format report. The final deliverable is a report with four sheets: "Data Overview", "Trend Analysis", "Anomaly Annotations", and "Operations Recommendations". Please use the Agent Team skill to execute the entire workflow.

cases.description:
手动编写 GitHub Actions 工作流配置繁琐且容易遗漏安全扫描、缓存优化等关键环节，维护多环境部署流程更是耗时费力。

本案例演示如何通过 github 技能一次性生成覆盖 lint、测试、构建、Docker 镜像推送、Staging 自动部署及 Production 手动审批部署的完整工作流，并内置矩阵测试、依赖缓存、安全扫描等最佳实践。

适合：全栈开发者、DevOps 工程师及希望快速搭建标准化 CI/CD 管线的技术团队。
cases.description_en:
Manually writing GitHub Actions workflow configs is tedious and often misses critical steps like security scanning and cache optimization.

This case demonstrates how to use the github skill to generate a complete workflow covering lint, testing, build, Docker image push, automatic Staging deployment, and manual Production approval deployment, with built-in matrix testing, dependency caching, and security scanning best practices.

Ideal for full-stack developers, DevOps engineers, and teams looking to quickly set up a standardized CI/CD pipeline.

cases.title: 财务月报/损益表
cases.subtitle: SaaS 初创公司标准损益表，收入成本一目了然
cases.subtitle_en: Standard P&L statement for SaaS startups with clear revenue and cost breakdown
cases.description:
每月财务结账后，CFO 需要一份既能给管理层看又能给投资人看的损益表：收入要按业务线拆分、成本要细分到科目、毛利率净利率要标清楚、同比环比要对齐——手动从财务系统导数据再排版格式，光调对齐和公式就能折腾一下午。

这个案例为一家 A 轮后的 SaaS 初创公司（团队 45 人、月活客户 320 家、ARR 约 1200 万）生成完整的 2026 年 3 月损益表 Excel：标准 P&L 格式包含收入明细（SaaS 订阅 98.5 万 / 定制开发 12.3 万 / 技术支持 5.8 万）、营业成本（云资源 / API / 客户成功团队）、毛利 89.3 万（76.6%）、六项运营费用明细、净利润 7.3 万；每项均含同比环比对比列，配有收入构成饼图和费用结构条形图，以及独立的经营分析 Summary sheet（11 项关键指标 + 6 条分析要点）。

适合：CFO、财务团队、创业公司 CEO、投资人对接、董事会汇报、任何需要制作月度财务报告的人。
cases.description_en:
After monthly financial closing, the CFO needs a P&L that works for both management and investors: revenue split by business line, costs broken down by category, gross and net margins clearly marked, YoY and MoM comparisons aligned — manually exporting from accounting systems and formatting can eat up an entire afternoon.

This case generates a complete March 2026 P&L Excel for a Series A SaaS startup (45 employees, 320 active customers, ~12M ARR): standard P&L format with revenue breakdown (SaaS subscriptions 985K / custom development 123K / tech support 58K), cost of revenue (cloud/API/customer success), gross profit 893K (76.6%), six operating expense line items, net profit 73K; each with YoY and MoM comparison columns, revenue composition pie chart, expense structure bar chart, and a standalone Summary sheet (11 key metrics + 6 analysis points).

Ideal for: CFOs, finance teams, startup CEOs, investor relations, board reporting, anyone producing monthly financial reports.
