cases.title: 症状与报告的疑似诊断倾向
cases.subtitle: 还没下诊断？AI 帮你锁定高可能性疾病方向
cases.subtitle_en: No diagnosis yet? Let AI point to the most likely conditions
cases.description:
患者还没下诊断，但症状体征和化验报告已经摆在面前：心悸、多汗、体重下降、甲状腺 II 度肿大、双手震颤阳性，FT3 / FT4 显著升高、TSH 明显降低、TRAb 升高……这种甲功五项表现，到底最可能是什么病？

这个案例演示了把「主诉 / 现病史 / 查体 / 辅助检查」交给「腾讯健康 · AI 临床助手·辅助诊断」，确认无当前诊断后，它基于甲功异常 + 临床表现推导最可能的诊断，按常见病优先排序，仅输出高可能性的疑似诊断条目（不输出中 / 低可能性条目），每条附可溯源至输入信息的诊断依据，并给出建议进一步检查的项目（如甲状腺超声、摄碘率等）。

行为边界：只输出高可能性疑似诊断，不输出中 / 低可能性条目；诊断依据 100% 可溯源至输入信息，绝不引用输入中不存在的指标；不延伸至具体抗甲状腺药物方案或剂量建议；末尾附安全声明，明确最终诊断以专科医生为准。

适合：内分泌科初诊医生、全科医生、规培医生、医学研究生、需要了解 AI 疑似诊断推理思路的患者及家属。
cases.description_en:
No diagnosis yet, but the symptoms and labs are on the table — palpitations, sweating, weight loss, a grade-II goiter, fine tremor, FT3 / FT4 clearly elevated, TSH suppressed, TRAb elevated… With a thyroid panel like this, what's most likely?

This case shows how to hand the AI clinical assistant the patient's chief complaint, history, physical exam and labs. After confirming there is no current diagnosis, it reasons from thyroid abnormalities plus clinical features, lists only high-probability suspected diagnoses (no medium / low entries) in common-disease-first order, with every diagnostic clue traceable back to the input and a list of suggested follow-up tests (thyroid ultrasound, radioiodine uptake, etc.).

Boundaries: high-probability diagnoses only; clues 100% traceable to the input — never invents indicators not in the record; no specific anti-thyroid drug or dosing recommendations; safety statement at the end reminding that final diagnosis rests with the specialist.

For: endocrinology first-visit physicians, GPs, residents, medical students, and patients / families wanting to understand AI diagnostic reasoning.

artifacts.label: 症状与报告疑似诊断报告（HTML）

cases.prompt:
请基于以下患者信息（尚未下诊断）做疑似诊断推理，列出最可能的疾病方向。

【患者信息】
[粘贴：主诉、现病史、既往史、查体、辅助检查结果]

【示例场景】
这个患者还没下诊断，请根据病历信息帮忙分析一下最可能是什么病。
患者：女，45岁
主诉：心悸、多汗、体重下降 2 月
现病史：2 月前无明显诱因出现心悸，活动后加重。伴怕热多汗，食欲增加但体重下降 4 kg。无胸闷胸痛，无发热。月经周期紊乱 2 个周期。
既往史：无特殊。无甲状腺疾病家族史。
查体：T 37.1℃，P 108 次/分，BP 125/70 mmHg；甲状腺 II 度肿大，未闻及血管杂音，无触痛；双手细震颤阳性；无突眼。
辅助检查：
  FT3 12.5 pmol/L ↑（参考值 3.1-6.8）
  FT4 38.2 pmol/L ↑（参考值 12-22）
  TSH 0.05 mIU/L ↓（参考值 0.27-4.2）
  TPOAb 156 IU/mL ↑（参考值 <34）
  TRAb 3.8 IU/L ↑（参考值 <1.75）
  血常规、肝肾功能正常

【输出要求】
1. 病历文本解析：提取主诉、现病史、查体、辅助检查，确认无当前诊断
2. 疑似诊断推理：基于化验异常 + 临床表现推导最可能的诊断
3. 常见病优先排序：高流行病学概率的诊断排在首位
4. 仅输出高可能性疑似诊断，每条附诊断依据 + 建议进一步检查
5. 安全声明附在报告末尾

【行为边界】
- 只输出高可能性的疑似诊断条目，不输出中 / 低可能性条目
- 诊断依据 100% 可溯源至输入信息
- 不延伸至治疗方案（不给抗甲状腺药物方案或剂量建议）

【不应出现】
- 中 / 低可能性的疑似诊断条目
- 诊断依据引用输入中不存在的信息
- 具体的抗甲状腺药物方案或剂量建议
- 省略安全声明
cases.prompt_en:
Based on the following patient information (no diagnosis yet), reason about the most likely suspected diagnosis and point to the leading condition.

【Patient information】
[Paste: chief complaint, history of present illness, past history, physical exam, workup results]

【Example scenario】
This patient has not been diagnosed yet. Based on the record below, please help analyze what the most likely condition is.
Patient: female, 45 y/o
Chief complaint: palpitations, sweating, weight loss for 2 months
History of present illness: palpitations appeared 2 months ago without obvious trigger, worsening with activity, accompanied by heat intolerance and sweating, increased appetite with 4 kg weight loss, no chest pain, no fever, menstrual cycle irregular for 2 cycles.
Past history: unremarkable; no family history of thyroid disease.
Physical exam: T 37.1℃, P 108 bpm, BP 125/70 mmHg; grade-II goiter without bruit or tenderness; fine tremor of both hands positive; no exophthalmos.
Workup: FT3 12.5 pmol/L ↑ (ref 3.1-6.8); FT4 38.2 pmol/L ↑ (ref 12-22); TSH 0.05 mIU/L ↓ (ref 0.27-4.2); TPOAb 156 IU/mL ↑ (ref <34); TRAb 3.8 IU/L ↑ (ref <1.75); CBC and liver / kidney function normal.

【Output requirements】
1. Record parsing: extract chief complaint, history, physical exam, workup; confirm no current diagnosis
2. Suspected-diagnosis reasoning: derive the most likely diagnosis from lab abnormalities plus clinical features
3. Common-disease-first ranking: high epidemiological probability ranked first
4. Output high-probability suspected diagnoses only, each with diagnostic clues + suggested follow-up tests
5. Safety statement appended at the end

【Boundaries】
- High-probability diagnoses only; no medium / low entries
- Clues 100% traceable to the input
- No treatment plans (no anti-thyroid drug regimen or dosing)

【Must not appear】
- Medium / low-probability suspected-diagnosis entries
- Diagnostic clues referencing information not present in the input
- Specific anti-thyroid drug regimens or dosing
- A missing safety statement

cases.title: 工业产品商业宣传片
cases.subtitle: 从外观、端口到内部电路完整讲清一台专业设备
cases.subtitle_en: A professional device explained from chassis and ports to internal circuitry
cases.description:
工业产品信息密集，单纯旋转展示无法同时讲清结构、接口和核心功能。

案例以黑色机架式音频/网络设备为主角，通过轮廓光、RGB 接口、爆炸结构、电路板和手部调节展示产品设计与信号能力。

适合：专业硬件、制造设备、汽车零部件、消费电子和发布会产品片。
cases.description_en:
Information-dense industrial products cannot explain form, ports, and core functions through a simple rotating beauty shot.

A black rack-mounted audio and network device is presented through rim light, color-coded ports, exploded construction, circuitry, and hands-on control shots.

Best for professional hardware, manufacturing equipment, automotive components, consumer electronics, and launch films.

artifacts.label: 成片视频

cases.prompt: 请由「商业广告创作」专家调用 Flova 的「工业产品商业宣传片」Skill，依据我上传的黑色 1U 机架式音频网络接口产品图和参数表，制作一支 30 秒、16:9、冷峻工业风、1080p 的商业宣传片《机架音频接口科技片》，使用沉稳中文男声与对应字幕。核心信息只使用参数表中的真实内容：前面板旋钮与状态屏、背部彩色网络/音频端口、低延迟信号路由和模块化内部电路。请先一次确认时长、画幅、风格、画质、旁白与字幕，再锁定全局规格并分析产品覆盖度；建立并确认产品资产后，依次生成黑场轮廓、端口亮起、爆炸结构、电路信号流、手部调节和英雄定帧。最后生成旁白、低沉电子工业 BGM、字幕并组装；产品端口数量、标签、比例和颜色必须以上传素材为准。
cases.prompt_en: Ask the “Flova Commercial Director” expert to invoke Flova’s “Industrial Product Commercial” Skill and use my uploaded images and specification sheet for a black 1U rack-mounted audio network interface to create a 30-second 16:9 commercial titled Technology Film for a Rack Audio Interface. Use a cold industrial look, 1080p delivery, a calm Chinese male narrator, and matching subtitles. Use only verified details from the specification sheet: front-panel controls and status display, color-coded network and audio ports on the rear, low-latency signal routing, and modular internal circuitry. Confirm duration, aspect ratio, visual style, quality, narration, and subtitles together first, then lock the global specification and assess product coverage. After the product assets are approved, generate the dark silhouette, illuminated ports, exploded structure, circuit signal flow, hand adjustment, and hero frame in sequence. Finish with narration, deep electronic industrial music, subtitles, and assembly. Port count, labels, proportions, and colors must follow the uploaded materials exactly.

cases.title: 报考答疑：三方社保与应届身份
cases.title_en: Application Q&A: Contracts, Social Security & Status
cases.subtitle: 知识库检索原文作答，一条社保记录就能改变应届身份
cases.subtitle_en: Answered from the knowledge base — one social-security record can change your status
cases.description:
「我还算应届生吗」是报考咨询里被问得最多、也最不能答错的问题——答错直接影响能报哪些岗。

本案例围绕「三方协议、劳动合同、社保对应届身份的影响」检索高顿公考知识库，命中 4 条原文问答（匹配度 0.87–0.90）：三方协议不影响应届身份、签劳动合同并缴社保即失去应届身份、择业期认定等，并把 4 条串成一条判断线。知识库内部库名已脱敏。

适合：毕业前后状态变动过的考生、拿不准基层年限起算的考生。
cases.description_en:
"Am I still a fresh graduate?" is the most-asked and least-forgiving question in application counselling — getting it wrong changes which posts you can apply for.

This case searches Gaodun's civil-exam knowledge base on how tripartite agreements, labour contracts and social security affect fresh-graduate status, hitting four verbatim Q&As (match 0.87–0.90): a tripartite agreement alone does not end the status; a signed labour contract plus social-security payment does; the two-year job-hunting window rule — then threads them into one decision line. Internal knowledge-base names are masked.

For: candidates whose status changed around graduation and anyone unsure when grassroots tenure starts.

artifacts.label: 应届身份知识库问答

cases.title: 产品技术架构图
cases.subtitle: 用 Mermaid 一键生成专业级 SaaS 微服务架构图
cases.subtitle_en: Generate a professional SaaS microservice architecture diagram with Mermaid in one click
cases.description:
当团队需要梳理系统架构时，总会遇到这些问题：手动画图耗时且难以维护，Visio/Draw.io 导出的图片模糊不清，架构变更后文档永远跟不上代码，新人入职看不懂系统全貌。一张清晰、可维护的架构图是技术团队的刚需。

这个案例用 mermaid-diagram 技能为一个典型的 SaaS 产品生成了完整的微服务架构图：从客户端（Web/Mobile）到 API 网关（Nginx/Kong），核心业务服务（认证、用户、订单、商品、支付、通知）横向展开，底层基础设施（Kafka 消息队列、Redis 缓存、PostgreSQL 数据库）纵深排列，右侧监控体系（Prometheus + Grafana + ELK）全覆盖，最底层 Docker/Kubernetes 容器编排一目了然。用文字描述架构，Mermaid 自动渲染，版本可控，随时更新。

适合：后端工程师、架构师、技术负责人、DevOps 工程师、需要在技术评审或方案汇报中展示系统架构的任何人
cases.description_en:
When teams need to map out system architecture, they always face the same problems: manually drawing diagrams is time-consuming and hard to maintain, exported images from Visio/Draw.io are blurry, documentation never keeps up with code changes after architecture updates, and new hires can't grasp the full system picture. A clear, maintainable architecture diagram is a must-have for any technical team.

This case uses the mermaid-diagram skill to generate a complete microservice architecture diagram for a typical SaaS product: from client layer (Web/Mobile) through API Gateway (Nginx/Kong), core business services (Auth, User, Order, Product, Payment, Notification) spread horizontally, infrastructure layer (Kafka message queue, Redis cache, PostgreSQL databases) in depth, monitoring stack (Prometheus + Grafana + ELK) on the side, and Docker/Kubernetes orchestration at the bottom. Describe architecture in text, Mermaid renders automatically — version-controlled and always up to date.

Ideal for: backend engineers, architects, tech leads, DevOps engineers, anyone who needs to present system architecture in technical reviews or proposals

1. 客户端层：Web App、移动端、桌面端、Open API

3. 核心服务层：用户、订单、支付、商品、通知、搜索六大微服务，通过 Event Bus 异步通信
4. 基础设施层：PostgreSQL、Redis、Elasticsearch、RabbitMQ、MinIO

附等效 Mermaid 源码供复用。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a SaaS product microservice architecture diagram: single-file HTML, with the diagram as inline SVG, no external dependencies, pure-CSS interactions (zero JS), UI text in Simplified Chinese, dark modern style, six layers displayed top to bottom, with protocols labeled on the connections between layers.

1. Client layer: Web App, Mobile, Desktop, Open API
2. Gateway layer: API Gateway, load balancer, rate limiter, auth gateway
3. Core services layer: six microservices—User, Order, Payment, Product, Notification, Search—communicating asynchronously via an Event Bus
4. Infrastructure layer: PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, MinIO
5. Monitoring layer: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Sentry, Jaeger
6. Deployment layer: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD, CDN

cases.title: 报考答疑：应届生身份的四类边界
cases.title_en: Application Q&A: Four Edge Cases for New-Graduate Status
cases.subtitle: 签了合同、当过兵、做过基层项目、留学回国，分别还算不算应届生
cases.subtitle_en: Signed a contract, served in the military, joined a grassroots programme, studied abroad — still eligible?
cases.description:
「限应届生」是最常见的岗位限制，真正卡人的从来不是常规情形，而是那些看起来不该算、实际却算（或反过来）的边界情况。

本案例做三次定向检索——常规就业、服兵役与基层项目、留学回国，逐条列出知识库原文与匹配度，整理成一张覆盖七种情形的判定表，并指出「未缴社保」与「择业期」两条口径之间的张力该怎么区分。

适合：退役士兵、基层项目服务期满人员、留学回国求职者，以及所有不确定自己是否还算应届生的人。
cases.description_en:
"New graduates only" is the most common restriction, and what trips people up is never the ordinary case — it's the edges that look disqualifying but aren't, or the reverse.

This case runs three targeted searches — ordinary employment, military service and grassroots programmes, and returning from study abroad — quoting each knowledge-base answer verbatim with its match score, organising them into a seven-scenario decision table, and flagging the tension between the "no social insurance" and "job-seeking window" rulings.

For: veterans, people finishing grassroots service, returning overseas graduates, and anyone unsure whether they still qualify.

artifacts.label: 应届生身份四类边界情形问答与判定表
artifacts.label_en: New-graduate status edge cases and decision table

cases.prompt: 帮我查清楚公考里的「应届毕业生身份」在几类特殊情形下怎么界定。要求：1) 分三次真实检索报考知识库——常规就业与择业期、服兵役退役士兵、留学回国人员，各给出命中条数；2) 按情形分组，逐条列出问答原文和匹配度分值，不要改写；3) 把三组口径整理成一张判定表，逐行给出「是否可报限应届岗位」与依据；4) 如果不同条目之间的口径存在张力（如未缴社保 vs 择业期），明确指出并说明区分点；5) 说明哪些返回条目与主题无关、未被采用，并提醒各省口径可能有差异、以当年公告为准。
cases.prompt_en: Clarify how "new graduate" status is defined for civil-service applications in several edge cases. Requirements: 1) run three targeted knowledge-base searches — ordinary employment and the job-seeking window, military veterans, and returning overseas graduates — reporting the hit count for each; 2) group the results by scenario and quote each Q&A verbatim with its match score, without rewriting; 3) organise all three groups into one decision table giving the verdict and basis per row; 4) if answers conflict (e.g. no social insurance versus the job-seeking window), say so and explain the distinguishing factor; 5) state which returned entries were off-topic and excluded, and note that provincial rules vary and the year's announcement governs.

cases.subtitle: 10 家竞品 × 5 维度 × 完整 SWOT，含 SVG 雷达图与 5 条差异化切入机会

cases.description:
要进协同办公赛道，最怕的不是没点子，而是开战略会时被问：'飞书和 Teams 到底谁的 AI 更强？Notion 为什么卡在 SMB？我们到底从哪切？'——没有一份横贯全量玩家的完整竞品调研，这些问题根本没法拍板。

这个案例演示了深度研究团队怎么在十几分钟内交付一份战略决策级竞品调研：Markdown 主报告 ~16,000 中文字、10 家竞品（飞书/钉钉/企业微信/Teams/Slack/Notion/Google Workspace/ClickUp/Asana/Monday）×5 维度（功能/定价/规模/增长策略/优劣势）全覆盖、10 张结构化对比表、完整 SWOT 矩阵、5 条差异化机会点（含客群/防御难度/落地路径/定价建议）；配套 HTML 可视化版含三类纯 CSS/SVG 可视化——10×8 功能对比矩阵、内联 SVG 五维雷达图（无任何 CDN/JS）、10 张 SWOT 2×2 四宫格卡片。

适合：准备进入 SaaS 赛道的产品 VP / 战投经理 / 创业者；做年度战略规划的 CEO / CMO / COO；行业研究员；做客户画像或竞争情报的商分团队。
cases.description_en:
Entering the collaboration SaaS market? The scariest question in a strategy meeting isn't 'do we have ideas' — it's 'so between Lark and Teams, whose AI is stronger? Why does Notion plateau in SMB? Where exactly do we cut in?' Without a full-stack competitor scan, these questions can't be answered.

This case shows the Deep Research Team delivering a boardroom-grade competitor analysis in minutes: a 16k-character Markdown report covering 10 competitors (Lark, DingTalk, WeCom, Teams, Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, ClickUp, Asana, Monday) across 5 dimensions (functionality, pricing, scale, growth strategy, S/W), 10 structured comparison tables, full SWOT matrix, and 5 specific differentiation opportunities (each with target segment, defense difficulty, GTM path, pricing). A companion HTML report includes three pure-CSS/SVG visualizations — a 10×8 feature matrix, an inline SVG 5-dimension radar chart (no CDN, no JS), and 10 SWOT 2×2 cards.

Fit for: SaaS product VPs evaluating new segments, strategy investors, founders, annual-plan CEOs/CMOs/COOs, industry analysts, and competitive intelligence teams.

cases.title: 检查无异常？AI 帮你定位缺失信息
cases.title_en: Workup Normal? Find What's Still Missing
cases.subtitle: 反复不适 + 检查没异常？AI 反推还需补充的关键检查
cases.subtitle_en: Recurrent symptoms but normal tests? Let AI reverse-engineer the missing workup
cases.description:
反复腹痛查了一堆化验和影像都没异常，到底是检查没做对，还是真的没病？医生和患者都卡在「下一步该查什么」上——继续重复原来的检查，还是换一个方向？

这个案例演示了把「主诉 / 现病史 / 已做的辅助检查」交给「腾讯健康 · AI 临床助手·辅助诊断」，确认无当前诊断且信息不足以做出高置信度判断后，它从鉴别诊断出发，反向推导还需补充的关键检查（如妇科查体、盆腔超声、肠镜、泌尿系影像等），每条缺失信息都明确标注「缺失类型 + 内容 + 理由 + 症状 / 体征 → 疑似疾病 → 确诊需补充的检查」完整依据路径，并按优先级排序下一步建议。它不强行输出诊断结论，方向提示一律标注「非诊断结论，需补充信息后重新评估」，末尾附安全声明。

行为边界：不强行输出疑似诊断，因信息不足以支撑高置信度判断；方向提示必须明确标注「非诊断结论」；缺失信息清单逐条列出缺失类型 / 内容 / 理由 / 依据路径；下一步建议按优先级排序；不给出具体治疗方案；末尾附安全声明。

适合：全科医生、消化科、妇科、急诊科、基层医疗机构、慢病管理医生、需要梳理下一步检查策略的患者。
cases.description_en:
Recurrent abdominal pain with a slew of normal labs and imaging — wrong workup, or truly nothing wrong? Both clinician and patient are stuck at "what next?" Repeat the same tests, or pivot?

This case shows how to hand the AI clinical assistant the chief complaint, history, and the workup already done. After confirming there is no current diagnosis and evidence is insufficient for a high-confidence call, it reverse-engineers from plausible differentials to identify the missing information (e.g., pelvic exam, pelvic ultrasound, colonoscopy, urinary tract imaging, etc.), with every missing item labeled type / content / rationale / complete reasoning chain (symptom + sign → suspected condition → confirmatory test needed), and prioritizes next-step workup. It never forces a diagnostic conclusion — every directional hint is labeled "Not a diagnostic conclusion — re-evaluate after supplementation," and a safety statement closes the report.

Boundaries: no forced suspected diagnosis when evidence is insufficient; directional hints explicitly labeled "Not a diagnostic conclusion"; missing-info list with type / content / rationale / chain per item; next steps prioritized; no specific treatment plans; safety statement at the end.

For: GPs, gastroenterologists, gynecologists, ER physicians, primary-care clinicians, chronic-care managers, and patients who want a clear missing-test strategy.

artifacts.label: 缺失信息定位与下一步检查建议报告（HTML）

cases.prompt:
请基于以下患者信息（反复不适 + 已做检查无异常）做缺失信息识别，反向推导还需补充的关键检查。

【患者信息】
[粘贴：主诉、现病史、既往史、查体、已做的辅助检查结果]

【示例场景】
这个患者反复腹痛，查了几项检查都没异常，想看看能不能帮忙分析一下到底是什么问题。

【输出要求】
1. 病历文本解析：提取主诉、现病史、辅助检查，确认无当前诊断
2. 缺失信息识别：明确缺什么信息、为什么需要、推理链路是什么
3. 从诊断假设反向推导还需补充的检查（如妇科查体、盆腔超声、肠镜等）
4. 每条缺失项包含完整依据路径（症状 + 体征 → 疑似疾病 → 确诊需补充的检查）
5. 可附初步方向提示，但必须标注「非诊断结论，需补充信息后重新评估」
6. 下一步建议按优先级排序
7. 安全声明附在报告末尾

【行为边界】
- 不得强行输出疑似诊断，因信息不足以支撑高置信度判断
- 方向提示必须明确标注「非诊断结论」
- 缺失信息清单需逐条列出缺失类型、内容、理由、依据路径
- 建议下一步按优先级排序

【不应出现】
- 强行输出疑似诊断报告
- 缺少依据路径的缺失信息项
- 省略「非诊断结论」警告标注
- 具体的治疗方案建议
- 省略安全声明
cases.prompt_en:
Based on the following patient information (recurrent symptoms + normal workup so far), identify the missing information and reverse-engineer the key tests still needed.

【Patient information】
[Paste: chief complaint, history of present illness, past history, physical exam, workup already done]

【Example scenario】
This patient has recurrent abdominal pain and several normal tests. Please help analyze what might be going on.

【Output requirements】
1. Record parsing: extract chief complaint, history, workup; confirm no current diagnosis
2. Missing-information identification: state what is missing, why, and the reasoning chain
3. Reverse-engineer from diagnostic hypotheses to the tests still needed (e.g., pelvic exam, pelvic ultrasound, colonoscopy, etc.)
4. Each missing item must carry a complete reasoning chain (symptom + sign → suspected condition → confirmatory test needed)
5. A directional hint may be attached but must be labeled "Not a diagnostic conclusion — re-evaluate after supplementation"
6. Next-step workup prioritized
7. Safety statement appended at the end

【Boundaries】
- Do not force a suspected diagnosis when evidence is insufficient
- Directional hints must be explicitly labeled "Not a diagnostic conclusion"
- Missing-info list per item: type / content / rationale / reasoning chain
- Next steps prioritized

【Must not appear】
- A forced suspected-diagnosis report
- Missing-info items without a reasoning chain
- Omission of the "Not a diagnostic conclusion" warning label
- Specific treatment plans
- A missing safety statement

cases.title: 音乐MV
cases.subtitle: 让动漫摇滚演出与霓虹雨夜剧情逐拍交错
cases.subtitle_en: An anime rock performance intercut beat by beat with a neon rain narrative
cases.description:
音乐 MV 如果只按歌词配图，演奏、剧情与节奏往往彼此脱节，演唱口型也难以稳定。

案例围绕一支动漫摇滚乐队：蒙眼银蓝发主唱在舞台演唱，吉他、鼓点与雨夜城市奔跑线交替，副歌在霓虹现场汇合。

适合：原创歌曲 MV、虚拟乐队、动漫音乐宣传、角色演出和节奏型视觉内容。
cases.description_en:
Music videos built as lyric illustrations often disconnect performance, narrative, and rhythm, while singing lip sync becomes unstable.

An anime rock band alternates a blindfolded silver-blue-haired singer’s live performance with a neon rain-night running story, converging during the chorus.

Best for original-song videos, virtual bands, anime music promotion, character performances, and rhythm-led visuals.

artifacts.label: 成片视频

cases.prompt: 请由「音乐 MV 创作」专家调用 Flova 的「音乐MV（需上传音乐）」Skill，根据我上传的约 50 秒原创摇滚歌曲，制作一支 16:9 动漫乐队 MV《雨夜失速乐队》。主唱为银蓝短发、黑色眼罩、深色舞台服的女性；固定吉他手、贝斯手和鼓手造型。主歌表现她独自在雨夜霓虹街道奔跑，副歌切入小型现场演出，鼓点、拨弦特写、观众手臂和主唱近景按音乐强拍交错，最后在停雨后的空街收尾。请先分析歌曲 BPM、段落、精确时间戳和歌词，再确认规格与故事板；绑定音频和角色资产，依次确认元素图与每镜关键帧。只有主唱嘴部清晰可见的演唱近景使用音频驱动口型，其余镜头按节奏生成，最终严格对齐原始音乐完成剪辑。
cases.prompt_en: Ask the “Flova Music Video Director” expert to invoke Flova’s “Music Video (Music Upload Required)” Skill and use my uploaded original rock song of about 50 seconds to create a 16:9 anime-band music video titled Runaway Band in the Rain. The female lead singer has short silver-blue hair, a black blindfold, and dark stagewear; lock the guitarist, bassist, and drummer designs as well. During the verse she runs alone through neon streets in the rain. The chorus cuts to an intimate live performance, interweaving drums, string-plucking close-ups, audience arms, and lead-singer close-ups on strong beats. End on an empty street after the rain stops. Analyze the song’s BPM, sections, exact timestamps, and lyrics first, then confirm the specification and storyboard. Bind the audio and character assets and obtain approval for element images and per-shot keyframes. Use audio-driven lip sync only for singing close-ups where the singer’s mouth is clearly visible; generate all other shots to rhythm, and edit everything precisely to the original music.

cases.subtitle: 按到岗天数和课表匹配度筛选正在开放的实习
cases.subtitle_en: Filter open internships by on-site days and class-schedule fit
cases.description:
在校生找实习最现实的约束不是薪资，是一周能去几天——招聘平台偏偏不让按这个筛。

本案例按「上海 + 本科 + 财务」实时检索到 147 个在招岗位，取前 8 条整理成对照表，把埋在标签里的关键信息拉到台面：3 天/周还是 5 天/周、接不接受大一大二、有没有一对一导师，并识别出混在结果里的应届全职岗。

适合：学期中只能兼职到岗的在校生、想提前攒履历的大一大二学生。
cases.description_en:
The real constraint on a student internship hunt isn't pay — it's days per week on site, which job boards won't let you filter by.

This case live-searches "Shanghai + bachelor's + finance", finds 147 open postings, and turns the top 8 into a comparison table surfacing what's buried in tags: 3 or 5 days a week, whether first- and second-years are accepted, whether a mentor is provided — and flags the full-time graduate role mixed into the results.

For: students who can only work part-time during term and early-years building a CV.

Requirements: 1) search live and give the total; 2) turn the top 8 into a table: role, company, size, pay, district, days per week, first/second-year acceptance, mentor availability; 3) use the platform's own pay figures and tags; 4) flag any non-internship entries separately; 5) rank by fit with my class schedule.

出差订票总是踩点，打开12306又卡又慢，还得一列一列比耗时和余票，效率极低。

Booking train tickets is always a last-minute scramble — 12306 is slow to load and you have to compare each train's duration and availability one by one.

Best for: Business travelers, frequent rail commuters, corporate travel assistants, and anyone who needs quick booking decisions.

cases.subtitle: 14 个岗位里，一半藏在采购、财务、HR 部门

cases.description:
想找数据分析实习，搜「数据分析」四个字只能出来寥寥几个岗，很容易以为机会很少。

本案例不限城市检索数据分析方向实习，命中 14 个岗位。结果揭示了一个关键事实：岗位名里带「数据分析」的多数属于采购、财务、HR、市场等业务部门，而非数据部门。案例给出日薪区间、城市分布、出勤要求与公司规模统计，并给出一套换关键词挖岗的方法。

适合：想入行数据分析的在校生、找第一份分析类实习的人。
cases.description_en:
Searching "data analysis" for internships returns only a handful of posts, making the field look closed.

This case searches nationwide for data-analysis internships, finding 14. The results reveal something useful: most posts with "data analysis" in the title sit inside procurement, finance, HR or marketing teams rather than data departments. Daily pay, city spread, attendance requirements and company sizes are tabulated, along with a method for finding more via alternative keywords.

For: students breaking into analytics and anyone seeking a first analysis internship.

cases.prompt: 帮我找数据分析方向的实习岗位，不限城市。要求：1) 真实检索并给出命中总数；2) 按日薪上限降序列出岗位、公司、城市、日薪、公司规模、标签；3) 统计城市分布、有明确日薪与面议各几个、日薪区间是多少；4) 观察岗位名称的构成，指出有多少岗位其实属于业务部门（采购、财务、HR、市场）而非数据部门，并说明这对求职者意味着什么；5) 给出挑选数据分析实习的具体建议（关键词、出勤天数、转正标签等）。
cases.prompt_en: Find data-analysis internships anywhere in the country. Requirements: 1) run the search and give the total; 2) list posts by descending daily pay with company, city, pay, company size and tags; 3) report the city distribution, how many list explicit pay versus negotiable, and the pay range; 4) examine the job titles and report how many actually sit in business functions (procurement, finance, HR, marketing) rather than data teams, and what that means for applicants; 5) give concrete advice on choosing among them (keywords, weekly attendance, conversion-to-full-time tags).

cases.title: 项目时间线可视化
cases.subtitle: 甘特图式项目排期，里程碑进度一目了然
cases.subtitle_en: Gantt-style project timeline with milestone tracking at a glance
cases.description:
项目排期散落在 Excel 和各种文档里，依赖关系看不清、进度更新靠口头同步，一旦某个环节延期，整条线都得手动调。

这个案例用 Mermaid 甘特图为一个虚拟的移动端产品「SuperApp v2.0」生成了完整的时间线：跨越 6 个月的 4 大阶段（规划设计、开发、测试、上线），每个阶段包含多项子任务，配备里程碑标记和依赖关系。

适合：项目经理、技术负责人、PMO、初创公司 CTO——任何需要把复杂排期变成可视化的人。
cases.description_en:
Project schedules buried in spreadsheets and scattered docs make it nearly impossible to see dependencies, track progress, or react when a task slips.

This case uses Mermaid Gantt chart to generate a full timeline for a fictional mobile product 'SuperApp v2.0': 4 major phases spanning 6 months with sub-tasks, milestone markers, and dependency relationships.

Ideal for: project managers, tech leads, PMO, startup CTOs — anyone who needs to turn complex schedules into visualizations.
cases.prompt:
请生成一个项目甘特图页面（单文件 HTML，用 Mermaid gantt 渲染，含任务依赖和里程碑标记），展示虚拟移动应用「SuperApp v2.0」的开发排期（2026 年 1-6 月）。

4 个阶段：
1）规划设计（1/5-2/15）：需求调研、UX 研究、原型设计、UI 设计、设计评审
2）开发（2/10-4/30）：前端、后端、API 联调、数据库迁移
3）测试（4/1-5/31）：单元、集成、UAT、性能
4）上线（5/15-6/30）：Beta 发布、Bug 修复、营销准备、正式发布

里程碑：设计冻结 2/15、Alpha 4/1、Beta 5/15、正式上线 6/15。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a project Gantt chart page (single-file HTML, rendered with Mermaid gantt, including task dependencies and milestone markers) that shows the development schedule of a fictional mobile app "SuperApp v2.0" (January-June 2026).

4 phases:
1) Planning & Design (1/5-2/15): requirements research, UX research, prototyping, UI design, design review
2) Development (2/10-4/30): front-end, back-end, API integration, database migration
3) Testing (4/1-5/31): unit, integration, UAT, performance
4) Launch (5/15-6/30): Beta release, bug fixes, marketing prep, official release

Milestones: Design Freeze 2/15, Alpha 4/1, Beta 5/15, Official Launch 6/15.

cases.title: GraphQL API 设计与实现
cases.subtitle: 在线书店完整 API，从 Schema 到 Resolver
cases.subtitle_en: Complete online bookstore API, from Schema to Resolver
cases.description:
设计一个功能完整的 GraphQL API 需要考虑类型系统、查询优化、权限控制、实时订阅等多个层面，对开发者的架构能力要求较高。新手容易陷入 N+1 查询、过度获取等常见陷阱。

本案例演示了如何利用 AI 为在线书店设计一套完整的 GraphQL API。涵盖 Schema 定义（Book/Author/User/Order/Review 含关系）、完整的 Query/Mutation/Subscription 设计、DataLoader N+1 优化、认证权限中间件、自定义标量类型等生产级特性。

适合后端开发者、API 架构师、全栈工程师，以及正在从 REST 迁移到 GraphQL 的团队使用。
cases.description_en:
Designing a complete GraphQL API requires consideration of type systems, query optimization, access control, and real-time subscriptions.

This case demonstrates using AI to design a comprehensive GraphQL API for an online bookstore, covering schema definitions, queries, mutations, subscriptions, DataLoader optimization, auth middleware, and custom scalars.

Ideal for backend developers, API architects, and teams migrating from REST to GraphQL.
cases.prompt:
请为一个在线书店设计完整的 GraphQL API（TypeScript + Apollo Server）。要求：1) Schema 定义（Book/Author/User/Order/Review 类型，含关系）；2) Query（书籍搜索/分类浏览/作者详情/用户订单历史/评论列表，支持分页和排序）；3) Mutation（注册登录/购物车/下单/评论/更新用户信息）；4) Subscription（新书上架/订单状态变更）；5) 中间件（认证/权限/限流/日志）；6) DataLoader 解决 N+1；7) 自定义 Scalar（DateTime/ISBN/Money）。

代码注释和用户可见字符串用简体中文，标识符保留英文。
cases.prompt_en:
Please design a complete GraphQL API (TypeScript + Apollo Server) for an online bookstore. Requirements: 1) Schema definitions (Book/Author/User/Order/Review types, with relationships); 2) Queries (book search / browse by category / author details / user order history / review list, with pagination and sorting support); 3) Mutations (register & login / shopping cart / place order / review / update user info); 4) Subscriptions (new book releases / order status changes); 5) Middleware (authentication / authorization / rate limiting / logging); 6) DataLoader to solve N+1; 7) Custom Scalars (DateTime/ISBN/Money).

Code comments and user-visible strings should be in Simplified Chinese, while identifiers remain in English.

运营是实习岗里体量最大的方向，也是最容易「同名不同活」的方向——同样叫运营实习生，有人只做内容排期，有人一个人包全流程。

本案例检索深圳运营方向实习，命中 31 个，本页 20 条中南山区占一半以上。案例列出日薪、公司规模与标签，指出同一家大厂就有三个不同的运营实习岗，并整理出一张「对新手友好」的筛选信号表（接受大一大二、零基础、远程、一对一导师）。

适合：找第一份实习的低年级学生、想进互联网做运营的人。
cases.description_en:
Operations is the largest internship category and the most inconsistently defined — two roles with the same title can mean scheduling content or running an entire funnel alone.

This case searches Shenzhen operations internships, finding 31, with over half of the 20 shown in Nanshan district. It lists daily pay, company size and tags, notes that a single large company posts three distinct operations roles, and builds a table of beginner-friendly signals (open to first- and second-years, no experience required, remote, one-on-one mentoring).

For: junior students seeking a first internship and anyone entering internet operations.

artifacts.label_en: Shenzhen operations internships and beginner signals

cases.subtitle: 多维漏斗分析图，直观展示转化瓶颈
cases.subtitle_en: Multi-dimensional funnel analysis chart to visualize conversion bottlenecks

cases.prompt: 请由「音乐 MV 创作」专家调用 Flova 的「汉斯季默风格史诗MV」Skill，根据文字想法制作一支约 25 秒、16:9、1080p、24fps 的慢节奏沉浸式科幻 MV《穿越土星的归途》。无旁白、无对口型、无字幕。叙事围绕一名年长宇航员：眼睛映出土星环，飞船从巨大行星边缘掠过；他在失重舱里握住女儿小时候的照片，随后穿越扭曲星门；地球农场中的成年女儿在谷仓打开一段延迟多年的讯息，画面回到宇航员释然的眼神。请先把文字想法拆成情绪曲线和段落表，并确认“慢节奏沉浸式”；锁定规格后生成并展示完整分镜，批准后逐镜生成。音乐采用低频脉冲、渐强弦乐和管风琴质感，但必须为原创，不复制任何现有作品旋律，最后按情绪峰值完成合成。
cases.prompt_en: Ask the “Flova Music Video Director” expert to invoke Flova’s “Hans Zimmer–Style Epic MV” Skill and create a slow, immersive 16:9 science-fiction music video titled The Way Home Beyond Saturn, about 25 seconds long at 1080p and 24 fps, based on the following text idea. Use no narration, lip sync, or subtitles. An older astronaut’s eye reflects Saturn’s rings as his spacecraft skims the edge of the giant planet. In zero gravity he holds a childhood photograph of his daughter, then crosses a distorted star gate. On an Earth farm, his now-adult daughter opens a message delayed for years, and the film returns to the astronaut’s relieved gaze. First transform the idea into an emotional curve and section table and confirm the “slow immersive” rhythm. Lock the specification, generate and present the full storyboard, and produce shots only after approval. Use original music with low-frequency pulses, swelling strings, and an organ-like texture, without copying any existing composition, and assemble the film around the emotional peak.

cases.subtitle: 45 个银行校招实时清单 + 提前批到春招的节奏表
cases.subtitle_en: 45 live bank programmes plus the early-batch-to-spring timeline
cases.description:
校招的残酷在于节奏：提前批 8 月就启动，网申错过没有补录，而多数人 10 月才开始看。

本案例按关键词「银行」实时检索校招库，命中 45 个在架项目（含杭州银行「摘星计划」暑期实习暨提前批），按更新时间倒序列出，并附「提前批 → 秋招 → 春招」的备考节奏建议——银行笔试与公考行测题型高度重合，两条线可以并行。

适合：2027 届毕业生、公考银行双线备考的考生、做就业指导的老师。
cases.description_en:
Campus recruiting is brutal about timing: early batches open in August with no make-ups, while most students start looking in October.

This case live-searches the campus database for "bank", hitting 45 listed programmes (including Hangzhou Bank's summer-internship-plus-early-batch), sorted by update time, with a preparation timeline from early batch through autumn to spring — and notes that bank aptitude tests overlap heavily with civil-service exams, so the two tracks can run in parallel.

For: class-of-2027 graduates, dual-track candidates, and careers staff.

artifacts.label: 银行校招项目清单

cases.prompt: 帮我看看现在有哪些银行校招在架。要求：1) 按关键词「银行」实时检索校招库并给出总数；2) 列出项目名称与工作地点，按更新时间倒序；3) 结合校招一般节奏给出「提前批/秋招/春招」的时间安排建议，并注明这是规律性建议、具体以各行公告为准；4) 说明公考备考生转投银行校招的优势。
cases.prompt_en: Show me which bank campus programmes are currently listed. Requirements: 1) live-search the campus database for "bank" and give the total; 2) list programme names and locations, newest first; 3) add a preparation timeline across early batch, autumn and spring hiring, noting it's general guidance with each bank's announcement authoritative; 4) explain why civil-service candidates convert well to bank hiring.

cases.subtitle: 109 场科技校招，已经有企业在招 2027 届
cases.subtitle_en: 109 tech campus drives — some already recruiting the class of 2027
cases.description:
科技公司的校招节奏普遍比传统行业早一整年，等到大四秋天才开始找，最好的岗位往往已经在提前批发完了。

本案例按关键词检索科技类校招，命中 109 场。把标题里的届别与工作城市拉出来看，可以直接读出各家的节奏差异和放岗形态——本页已有面向 2027 届的校招。案例同时说明校招信息与职位库的区别。

适合：想提前规划校招节奏的大二大三学生、目标科技行业的应届生。
cases.description_en:
Tech companies run campus recruitment a full year ahead of traditional industries — start looking in your final autumn and the best roles have often gone in the early rounds.

This case searches tech campus drives by keyword, finding 109. Pulling the graduation year and work city out of each title reveals how far apart companies are on timing and which post across multiple sites — several already target the class of 2027. It also explains how campus listings differ from post databases.

For: second- and third-year students planning ahead and graduates targeting tech.

artifacts.label: 科技类企业校招清单

cases.prompt: 帮我查科技类企业的校园招聘信息。要求：1) 真实检索并给出命中总数；2) 列出最新的 14 条，包含校招标题、面向哪一届、工作城市；3) 统计这一页里面向 2027 届和 2026 届各几条，说明科技类企业的校招节奏特点；4) 统计多地放岗与单城市招聘各几条，分析城市选择与行业方向的关系；5) 说明这个接口返回的是校招活动信息而不是具体岗位，字段有哪些限制，想看薪资和学历要求应该怎么办。

Requirements: 1) run the search and give the total; 2) list the 14 most recent with title, target graduating class and work city; 3) count how many target the classes of 2027 and 2026, and characterise tech recruitment timing; 4) count multi-site versus single-city drives and relate city choice to industry direction; 5) explain that this interface returns recruitment events rather than individual posts, which fields are limited, and where to look for salary and education requirements.

cases.title: 校招推荐：央国企专场
cases.subtitle: 174 场校招，一家企业能同时开春招、秋招和全球招
cases.subtitle_en: 174 drives — one company can run spring, autumn and global rounds at once
cases.description:
央国企校招批次多、周期长，同一家企业同一届会分好几次发布，只盯着一个入口很容易以为「已经招完了」。

本案例检索央国企校招，命中 174 场。本页同时出现了同一家企业的春季招聘和全球招聘两条——案例据此讲清批次密集、多地放岗、研究院所单列、补招是机会这四个特点，并给出一套按企业建清单的跟进方法。

适合：目标央国企的应届生、错过第一批想找补招的人。
cases.description_en:
State-owned enterprises run many recruitment rounds over long cycles, and the same company posts the same graduating class several times — watch one entry point and you'll assume it's closed.

This case searches SOE campus drives, finding 174. The page shows one company's spring and global rounds side by side, illustrating four traits: dense rounds, multi-site postings, institutes posting separately, and supplementary rounds as genuine second chances — with a company-by-company tracking method.

For: graduates targeting SOEs and anyone who missed the first round.

artifacts.label: 央国企校招清单与批次分析
artifacts.label_en: SOE campus recruitment list and round analysis

cases.prompt: 帮我查央国企的校园招聘信息。要求：1) 真实检索并给出命中总数；2) 列出最新的 14 条，包含校招标题、属于哪个批次（春招/秋招/全球招聘等）、工作城市；3) 指出有没有同一家企业同时出现多条不同批次的情况，说明这对求职者意味着什么；4) 统计多地放岗的条数，总结央国企校招的几个特点（批次密集、多地放岗、下属院所单列、补招等）；5) 给出一套跟进央国企校招的具体方法。
cases.prompt_en: Search campus recruitment at state-owned enterprises. Requirements: 1) run the search and give the total; 2) list the 14 most recent with title, round (spring, autumn, global) and work city; 3) note whether the same company appears across multiple rounds and what that means for applicants; 4) count multi-site postings and summarise the characteristics of SOE recruitment (dense rounds, multi-site, institutes posting separately, supplementary rounds); 5) give a concrete method for tracking SOE recruitment.

cases.title: 用户行为漏斗分析报告
cases.subtitle: 电商 App 转化漏斗全链路追踪，精准定位流失瓶颈
cases.subtitle_en: E-commerce app full-funnel tracking with precise bottleneck identification
cases.description:
做增长的人都知道「漏斗分析」是必修课，但现实是：从埋点数据里拉出各环节数字后，要手动算转化率、拼对比图、写分析结论，一套完整的漏斗看板做下来半天就没了——更别提还要按渠道拆分找异常、跟上月数据做环比。

这个案例为一款电商 App 构建了完整的用户注册转化漏斗分析看板：58 万月访问用户、6 个转化环节（首页浏览 -> 商品详情 -> 加购 -> 结算 -> 下单 -> 支付）、4 条渠道拆分对比，发现信息流广告的购物车到结算环节流失率异常高达 68%。交互式深色主题 HTML 看板包含：漏斗图、渠道转化率对比折线图、环比趋势柱状图、关键发现与优化建议卡片。

适合：增长团队、产品经理、数据分析师、电商运营、市场投放团队。
cases.description_en:
Every growth professional knows funnel analysis is essential, but the reality is painful: after pulling numbers from event tracking, you still need to manually calculate conversion rates, build comparison charts, and write analysis conclusions.

This case builds a comprehensive user conversion funnel dashboard for an e-commerce app: 580K monthly visitors, 6 conversion stages, 4 channel breakdowns, revealing an abnormally high 68% cart-to-checkout drop-off rate for feed ad traffic. The interactive dark-themed HTML dashboard includes: funnel chart, channel comparison line chart, trend bar chart, key insights and optimization recommendation cards.

Ideal for: Growth teams, product managers, data analysts, e-commerce operators, marketing teams.
cases.prompt:
请为一款电商 App 构建用户注册转化漏斗分析看板（单文件 HTML，内联无外部依赖），深色主题、交互式。

数据场景：2026 年 3 月，App 总访问 58 万用户，6 个转化环节，按 4 个渠道拆分。
包含：漏斗图、渠道对比柱状图、关键发现和优化建议卡片、环比趋势折线图。
cases.prompt_en:
Please build a user-registration conversion-funnel analysis dashboard for an e-commerce app (single-file HTML, inlined with no external dependencies), with a dark theme and interactive.

Data scenario: March 2026, the app has 580,000 total visiting users, 6 conversion steps, broken down by 4 channels.
Include: a funnel chart, a channel-comparison bar chart, key-findings and optimization-suggestion cards, and a month-over-month trend line chart.

This case demonstrates using AI to generate a complete blog template based on Next.js 14 App Router + TypeScript with all essential features including pagination, MDX rendering, tag filtering, dark mode, and SEO optimization.

Ideal for developers wanting to quickly set up a personal tech blog.

cases.title: 产品选型对比矩阵
cases.subtitle: 输入候选产品和评估维度，生成加权评分对比矩阵表格
cases.subtitle_en: Input candidate products and evaluation criteria, generate weighted scoring comparison matrix
cases.description:
技术选型最难的不是调研，是决策——三个数据库、四个云服务商、五个前端框架，每个都有优缺点，每个同事都有偏好，最后拍脑袋决定。缺一个客观、可量化的对比方法。

这个案例演示了输入候选后端框架和评估维度，AI 自动生成一份完整的产品选型对比矩阵 Excel 表格：评估维度与权重定义（8 个维度，加权百分比）、候选产品多维度打分（1-10 分制）、加权总分自动计算排名、每项评分附带简要依据、最终推荐结论与各产品优劣势分析。公式自动加权汇总，一目了然。

适合：技术架构师做框架选型、采购部门比选供应商、产品经理评估竞品、团队方案评审决策。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of technology selection isn't research — it's the decision. Three databases, four cloud providers, five frontend frameworks, each with pros and cons, each colleague with their own preference, and the final call comes down to gut feeling. What's missing is an objective, quantifiable comparison method.

This case demonstrates inputting candidate backend frameworks and evaluation criteria, with AI generating a complete product comparison decision matrix Excel spreadsheet: evaluation dimensions with weighted percentages (8 dimensions), multi-dimensional scoring for each candidate (1-10 scale), auto-calculated weighted total rankings, brief justification for each score, and a final recommendation with pros/cons analysis. Formulas auto-calculate weighted summaries at a glance.

Best for: Tech architects selecting frameworks, procurement teams comparing vendors, product managers evaluating competitors, team decision-making on proposals.
cases.prompt:
请为后端框架技术选型生成一份加权评分对比矩阵 Excel 表格。

选型背景：15 人后端团队，高并发微服务架构，现技术栈 Python Flask 准备迁移；候选框架 Go Gin、Rust Axum、Node.js Express、Java Spring Boot。（可替换为你的候选产品与背景）

请生成以下工作表：
1. 评估维度定义：约 8 个维度及权重，每维含评分标准说明
2. 评分矩阵：候选产品 × 维度打分（1-10），每分附一句依据，加权得分自动计算
3. 推荐报告：最终排名、各产品优劣势、推荐结论与迁移建议

表格要求：加权得分用公式计算，按加权总分降序，分数高低用条件格式区分。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a weighted-scoring comparison matrix as an Excel spreadsheet for a back-end framework technology selection.

Selection background: a 15-person back-end team, high-concurrency microservice architecture, current stack Python Flask (preparing to migrate); candidate frameworks Go Gin, Rust Axum, Node.js Express, Java Spring Boot. (Replace with your own candidates and background.)

Please generate the following worksheets:
1. Evaluation Dimension Definitions: about 8 dimensions and weights, each with scoring-criteria notes
2. Scoring Matrix: candidate products × dimensions scored 1-10, each score with a one-sentence rationale, weighted scores auto-calculated
3. Recommendation Report: final ranking, each product's pros/cons, recommendation and migration advice

Spreadsheet requirements: weighted scores computed by formula, sort descending by weighted total, and use conditional formatting to distinguish high vs. low scores.

cases.title: 被迫离职补偿咨询
cases.subtitle: 5 角色法律团队：案情采集、法条判例分析与风险评估，一次产出可直接行动的劳动纠纷报告
cases.subtitle_en: 5-role legal team: case intake, statute and precedent analysis, risk assessment, and an actionable labor-dispute report in one run
cases.description:
被公司突然从总监降到助理、工资直接砍掉 60%，最难受的不是面子，而是根本不知道该不该立刻走、怎么走才拿得到补偿、晚一天会不会就被认定默认接受。劳动纠纷里最怕的就是又气又急，结果错过了异议和仲裁时点。

这个案例演示了中文法律咨询团如何完整处理一类高频劳动争议：先由信息采集团队拆清时间线、合同条款和证据缺口，再由法条研究与判例分析并行给出《劳动合同法》第35条、第38条、第46条、第47条的适用路径、北京地区相关裁判趋势、经济补偿和工资差额的测算逻辑，最后汇总成一份可直接执行的《法律咨询报告》，附 12 项证据清单、5 步行动计划和被迫解除操作重点。

适合：遭遇违法调岗降薪、被迫离职、拖欠工资等问题的劳动者；做人力资源合规与劳动争议预判的 HR/法务；需要快速形成劳动仲裁前置方案的律师助理与咨询顾问。
cases.description_en:
When a company suddenly cuts you from director to assistant and slashes pay by 60%, the hardest part is not only the humiliation — it's not knowing whether to leave now, how to leave while preserving compensation rights, and whether one more day of silence will be treated as acceptance. In labor disputes, the biggest trap is acting in anger and missing the key objection and arbitration window.

This case shows how the ChatLaw Team handles a common labor-dispute scenario end to end: the intake role first structures the timeline, contract terms, and evidence gaps; statute and precedent researchers then work in parallel on Labor Contract Law Articles 35, 38, 46, and 47, Beijing-area judicial trends, and the calculation logic for wage arrears and economic compensation; finally the team assembles everything into a practical legal consultation report with a 12-item evidence checklist, a 5-step action plan, and key reminders for a forced-resignation strategy.

Target audience: employees facing unlawful demotion, pay cuts, forced resignation, or wage arrears; HR and legal teams doing labor-risk pre-assessment; legal assistants and consultants preparing pre-arbitration strategies for labor disputes.

cases.prompt:
我在某互联网公司工作 5 年 3 个月，上个月公司单方面把我岗位从“产品总监”调到“产品助理”，月薪从 3 万降到 1.2 万。我不同意，现在公司天天给我安排与岗位不匹配的琐碎工作。我考虑申请被迫离职并要求经济补偿。

材料原文：

---

# 格泰平® 二甲双胍缓释片｜区域学术拜访资料 & 卫星会提纲

## 第一章 产品定位

格泰平®，**彻底终结血糖烦恼**的新一代缓释制剂。独家缓释技术实现 **100% 平稳控糖**，让您的患者**彻底告别并发症困扰**。

## 第二章 临床数据

- MULTI-CARE 真实世界研究（n=2,847）：**三个月血糖达标率 85.3%**
- 与普通片剂头对头比较：**格泰平® 有效率 91.2%，显著优于竞品 A（76.4%）**
- 胃肠道不良反应发生率仅 3.1%，**安全性有保障**

## 第三章 患者故事

**李阿姨，58 岁，病程 12 年**
"以前吃别的药胃里翻江倒海，换成格泰平® 之后一点感觉都没有，血糖也稳了。现在我天天跟老姐妹们推荐这个药！"

—— 建议代表拜访时播放李阿姨的视频证言，增强医生信心。

## 第四章 拓展适应症机会点

除已获批的 2 型糖尿病，以下场景可作为**学术沟通切入点**：
- 糖尿病前期人群的早期干预
- 多囊卵巢综合征患者的代谢管理
- 配合减重需求患者的体重管理

（以上适应症尚在研究阶段，可作为学术探讨方向引导处方）

## 第五章 竞品对话话术

医生若提到竞品 B，可回应："竞品 B 的缓释技术是上一代的，血药浓度波动大，格泰平® 才是真正的平稳释放。"

## 第六章 数字化推广规划

为扩大品牌声量，Q4 启动以下动作：
1. 抖音、小红书品牌官方账号开设"控糖知识"专栏，自然植入格泰平® 产品露出
2. 邀请 20 位健康类博主进行产品"种草"，突出"平稳控糖不伤胃"卖点
3. 搜索引擎投放"二甲双胍 哪个牌子好""格泰平 效果"等关键词
4. 直播间引导观众线上问诊后购药，打通转化闭环

## 第七章 代表行为指引

- 拜访目标医生每月不少于 4 次
- 可根据科室处方量安排学术会议赞助
- 建立重点医生微信群，定期推送产品资料

---

我最担心第六章那套数字化推广和第四章的适应症拓展。麻烦按风险高低排序，标清楚哪些是碰了就要吃罚单的、哪些改改文字还能救，改法直接写出来。另外告诉我这份材料现在能不能发。
cases.prompt_en:
I work in pharma marketing. This academic detail aid for our antidiabetic drug goes to the rep team next week, and it also lays out a short-video platform push. My boss is pressing to launch, but I'm uneasy — can prescription drugs really be promoted this way? Please tell me which parts will get us in trouble, how heavy the penalties are, and how to fix each one.

Material:

---

# Getaiping® Metformin ER Tablets｜Regional Academic Detail Aid & Satellite Symposium Outline

## Chapter 1 Product Positioning

Getaiping® — the next-generation extended-release formulation that **puts an end to blood sugar worries once and for all**. Proprietary ER technology delivers **100% steady glycemic control**, letting your patients **completely leave complications behind**.

## Chapter 2 Clinical Data

- MULTI-CARE real-world study (n=2,847): **85.3% reached glycemic target in three months**
- Head-to-head vs. standard tablets: **Getaiping® efficacy 91.2%, significantly superior to Competitor A (76.4%)**
- GI adverse event rate only 3.1% — **safety assured**

## Chapter 3 Patient Story

**Aunt Li, 58, 12-year disease duration**
"Other drugs turned my stomach upside down. After switching to Getaiping® I feel nothing at all, and my glucose is steady. Now I recommend this drug to all my friends every day!"

—— Recommend reps play Aunt Li's video testimonial during visits to build physician confidence.

## Chapter 4 Indication Expansion Opportunities

Beyond the approved type 2 diabetes indication, the following can serve as **academic engagement entry points**:
- Early intervention in prediabetes
- Metabolic management in PCOS patients
- Weight management for patients seeking weight loss

(These indications remain investigational and may be framed as academic discussion topics to guide prescribing.)

## Chapter 5 Competitor Talk Track

If a physician raises Competitor B, respond: "Competitor B's ER technology is last-generation with large plasma fluctuations. Getaiping® delivers truly steady release."

## Chapter 6 Digital Promotion Plan

To amplify brand voice, launch the following in Q4:
1. Open a "glycemic knowledge" column on official Douyin and Xiaohongshu accounts with organic Getaiping® product placement
2. Engage 20 health influencers for product seeding, emphasizing "steady control, gentle on the stomach"
3. Buy search keywords such as "which metformin brand is best" and "Getaiping results"
4. Guide livestream viewers to online consultation then purchase, closing the conversion loop

## Chapter 7 Rep Conduct Guidance

- Minimum 4 visits per month to target physicians
- Arrange academic meeting sponsorship based on departmental prescription volume
- Build WeChat groups for key physicians and push product materials regularly

---

Chapter 6's digital plan and Chapter 4's indication expansion worry me most. Rank issues by severity, flag which ones draw fines on contact versus which can be salvaged with wording changes, and write the fixes out directly. Also tell me whether this material can ship as-is.

cases.description:
2024 年欧盟反补贴税落地、美国 100% 关税溢出、印尼巴西同步加码，中国车企出海从「甩货模式」被迫切换到「深耕模式」。到底哪个市场还能进？关税怎么算？比亚迪/奇瑞/上汽/吉利/蔚来各自的出海打法差在哪儿？——没有一份把政策、基建、竞品、税率、车企策略全串起来的专题报告，高管开董事会根本没法拍板。

这个案例演示了深度研究团队 8 分钟内交付的《中国新能源汽车出海 2026 专题研究》：Markdown 主报告约 1.3 万字，覆盖全球格局 → 三大目标市场（欧洲 / 东南亚 / 拉美）现状 → 5 家代表车企出海策略（BYD / Chery / MG / Geely / NIO）→ 4+2 大挑战（关税 / 本地化 / 品牌 / 售后 / 金融 / 地缘）→ 2026-2030 趋势预测 → 分市场 × 分车企战略建议，含 10+ 张对比表与 55 条权威引用链接。配套 HTML 可视化版含三类纯 CSS/SVG 可视化：16 国 NEV 渗透率横向条形图（三色按大洲区分）、五档彩色关税矩阵（出口 vs 本地化两情形）、5 家车企 × 4 年出海关键里程碑时间线。

适合：车企战投 / 海外事业部 / 券商研究所汽车组 / 行业咨询 / 做 ESG 与 CVC 投资组合的海外基金 / 媒体主理人做年度专题。
cases.description_en:
The 2024 EU countervailing duties, the US 100% tariff spillover, and fresh Indonesian/Brazilian restrictions have forced Chinese NEV OEMs to pivot from clearance mode to deep-local mode. Which markets remain open? How do the tariffs actually stack? How differently are BYD / Chery / MG / Geely / NIO playing it? Without a single report that stitches policy, infrastructure, competition, tariff math, and company-level playbooks, no board meeting can land a decision.

This case shows the Deep Research Team delivering the full China NEV Global Expansion 2026 report in 8 minutes: ~13k-character Markdown main report covering global landscape, current state of 3 target markets (Europe / SEA / LatAm), 5 OEM go-global strategies (BYD / Chery / MG / Geely / NIO), 4+2 core challenges (tariffs / localization / branding / after-sales / finance / geopolitics), 2026-2030 forecasts, and a market-by-OEM strategy matrix. 10+ comparison tables and 55 hyperlinked sources. Companion HTML with three pure-CSS/SVG visualizations: a 16-country NEV penetration bar chart (color-coded by continent), a 5-tier tariff matrix (export vs localized), and a 5-OEM x 4-year go-global timeline.

Fit for: OEM corporate strategy, overseas BUs, sell-side auto analysts, consulting firms, overseas funds running ESG/CVC portfolios, and industry media editors running year-end themes.

报告结构：
1. 全球市场格局与中国车企份额（2023–2026）
2. 三大目标市场现状（政策 / 基建 / 消费力 / 竞品）
3. 代表性中国车企出海策略（比亚迪 / 奇瑞 / 上汽 MG / 吉利 / 蔚来）
4. 核心挑战（关税壁垒 / 本地化 / 品牌 / 售后）
5. 趋势预测（2026–2030）
6. 战略建议（分市场 × 分车企）

cases.subtitle: Node.js + Express + TypeScript 实现 OAuth2 授权码模式

cases.description:
需要为项目添加 OAuth2 认证但从零实现太复杂？授权码模式、PKCE 扩展、Token 轮换、安全存储……每一步都有坑。

本案例演示了 fullstack-dev 全栈开发技能如何基于 Node.js + Express + TypeScript 实现完整的 OAuth2 授权码模式认证系统：支持 PKCE 扩展的授权端点、授权码兑换与 Refresh Token 轮换的令牌端点、基于 RS256 的 JWT Access Token 签发与验证中间件、加密存储和自动过期的安全 Refresh Token 管理、客户端注册与管理接口、以及 CORS/CSP 安全头配置。

适合：全栈开发者、后端工程师、安全工程师。
cases.description_en:
Need OAuth2 authentication but implementing from scratch is complex? Authorization code flow, PKCE extension, token rotation, secure storage — every step has pitfalls.

This case demonstrates how fullstack-dev implements a complete OAuth2 Authorization Code Flow system with Node.js + Express + TypeScript: authorization endpoint with PKCE, token endpoint with code exchange and refresh token rotation, RS256 JWT middleware, secure refresh token management, client registration, and CORS/CSP security headers.

Perfect for fullstack developers, backend engineers, and security engineers.

artifacts.label: OAuth2 完整实现代码

cases.prompt: 请实现完整的 OAuth2 授权码模式（Authorization Code Flow）认证系统，基于 Node.js + Express + TypeScript。要求：1) 授权端点（/authorize）支持 PKCE 扩展；2) Token 端点（/token）支持授权码兑换和 Refresh Token 轮换；3) JWT Access Token 签发与验证中间件；4) 安全的 Refresh Token 存储（加密 + 过期策略）；5) 客户端注册与管理接口；6) CORS 和 CSP 安全头配置；7) 完整的 TypeScript 类型定义。请用全栈开发技能输出包含完整实现代码的 Markdown 文档。
cases.prompt_en: Please implement a complete OAuth2 Authorization Code Flow authentication system based on Node.js + Express + TypeScript. Requirements: 1) An authorization endpoint (/authorize) that supports the PKCE extension; 2) A token endpoint (/token) that supports authorization code exchange and Refresh Token rotation; 3) JWT Access Token issuance and a verification middleware; 4) Secure Refresh Token storage (encryption + expiration policy); 5) Client registration and management interfaces; 6) CORS and CSP security header configuration; 7) Complete TypeScript type definitions. Please use the full-stack development skill to output a Markdown document containing the complete implementation code.

我们是家医美机构，运营刚交了一批小红书和抖音的文案，明天就要发。上个月同行因为发术前术后对比图被罚了，我现在看什么都心慌。帮我把这几条文案审一遍，哪句话会被罚、罚多少、换成什么说法能既合规又还能卖。

待发文案：

---

## 臻颜医美 · 双十一投放物料

### 小红书笔记标题（5 选 1）
1. 30 岁还素颜出门？难怪你被叫姐姐
2. 同龄人已经悄悄做了这个项目，你还在敷面膜
3. 法令纹让你老 10 岁！一次搞定，效果终身保持
4. 姐妹们！我终于告别丑脸了
5. 男朋友说我像他妈？做完这个他跪着道歉

### 正文（种草款）
姐妹们，我上周做了热玛吉，**效果我先说结论：绝对值！**

来看我的对比图 👇
【左：术前松垮下垂脸｜右：术后紧致小 V 脸】
（附术前术后正面、侧面对比照各 2 张）

我们院长 **王主任是做了 20 年的专家**，他跟我说这个项目**零风险、无恢复期、100% 有效**，我做完确实一点没耽误上班。

**保证一次见效，无效全额退款！** 我闺蜜们看了我的效果都排队来做了。

### 促销区
🔥 双十一秒杀：热玛吉原价 19800，**限时 6800**！
🔥 前 50 名再送水光针 1 次
🔥 **今晚 12 点前下单再减 500，仅限今天！**
🔥 支持医美分期，0 首付、0 利息

### 抖音口播脚本（30 秒）
"你是不是也觉得自己脸垮了？（停顿）别人 30 岁像 20，你 30 岁像 40，差距就在这里。（举手机展示对比图）这是我们客户小美做完的效果，**术后完全看不出动过**。现在下单立减 13000，**这个价格全网找不到第二家**。地址就在评论区，来了就找王主任，他做过 5000 例，**从没出过事故**。"

### 门店挂牌信息
臻颜生活美容会所 · 主营项目：热玛吉、水光针、瘦脸针、埋线提升

---

我知道对比图可能有问题，但拿掉之后完全没说服力，有别的合法办法吗？另外那句"无效全额退款"和"零风险"是运营硬要加的，你帮我评估下风险有多大，我拿你的结论去跟他们吵。最后给我一版能直接发的改写文案。
cases.prompt_en:
We're a medical aesthetics clinic. Our marketing team just handed over a batch of Xiaohongshu and Douyin copy set to publish tomorrow. Last month a peer clinic got fined for posting before/after photos, and now everything makes me nervous. Please review this copy: which lines will draw penalties, how large, and what wording would keep us compliant while still selling.

Copy queued for publication:

---

## Zhenyan Aesthetics · Double 11 Campaign Assets

### Xiaohongshu Note Headlines (pick 1 of 5)
1. Still going out bare-faced at 30? No wonder they call you "ma'am"
2. Your peers already had this treatment quietly — you're still doing sheet masks
3. Nasolabial folds age you 10 years! One session, results last a lifetime
4. Girls! I finally said goodbye to my ugly face
5. My boyfriend said I looked like his mom — after this he apologized on his knees

### Body Copy (seeding version)
Girls, I had Thermage last week. **Verdict first: absolutely worth it!**

Look at my before/after 👇
【Left: saggy drooping pre-op face｜Right: tight V-line post-op】
(2 frontal and 2 profile before/after photos attached)

Our clinic director **Dr. Wang is a 20-year expert**. He told me this treatment is **zero risk, no downtime, 100% effective** — and indeed I didn't miss a single workday.

**Guaranteed results in one session, full refund if ineffective!** All my friends saw my results and lined up to book.

### Promotion Block
🔥 Double 11 flash sale: Thermage was ¥19,800, **now ¥6,800** for a limited time!
🔥 First 50 bookings get a free hydro-injection session
🔥 **Order before midnight tonight for another ¥500 off — today only!**
🔥 Aesthetic financing available: zero down payment, zero interest

### Douyin Voiceover Script (30 seconds)
"Do you feel your face has fallen too? (pause) Others look 20 at 30 — you look 40 at 30. That's the gap. (holds up phone showing before/after) This is our client Xiaomei's result — **you absolutely can't tell she had anything done**. Order now and save ¥13,000 — **you won't find this price anywhere else**. Address is in the comments; ask for Dr. Wang, he's done 5,000 cases and **never had a single incident**."

### Storefront Signage
Zhenyan Life Beauty Salon · Services: Thermage, hydro-injection, botulinum toxin for face slimming, thread lifting

---

I know the before/after photos are probably a problem, but without them the copy has no persuasive power — is there a lawful alternative? Also, "full refund if ineffective" and "zero risk" were forced in by the marketing team; assess how serious that exposure is so I can take your conclusion into the argument with them. Finish with a rewritten version I can publish as-is.

很多人拿到 MBTI 结果后最想问的是：这四个字母到底在测什么？光看一个类型的描述，很难有实感。

本案例用同一套 44 题跑出 ESTJ，与 ENFP 那份并排看：共享 E，但在 S/N、T/F、J/P 三对上完全相反。案例展示逐维度分布、题库原文的优势与短板，并解释为什么两者的职业清单几乎没有重叠。

适合：想理解 MBTI 维度含义的学生、给团队做性格差异科普的人。
cases.description_en:
The question people most want answered after an MBTI result is: what are these four letters actually measuring? Reading one type's description rarely settles it.

This case runs the same 44 questions to an ESTJ result and sets it beside the ENFP: they share E but sit opposite on S/N, T/F and J/P. It shows the dimension splits, the strengths and blind spots from the item bank, and explains why the two career lists barely overlap.

For: students wanting to understand what each dimension means, and anyone explaining personality differences to a team.

artifacts.label: MBTI ESTJ 型测评结果报告

cases.prompt: 帮我做一次 MBTI 职业性格测评。我作答时倾向于：愿意主动社交、相信具体事实和经验多过直觉、决策时以规则和效率为准、喜欢提前计划并按计划执行。要求：1) 用 44 题题库真实跑一遍评分脚本，给出人格类型和类型清晰度分数；2) 逐个维度对展示作答分布与判定结果；3) 完整给出题库中该类型的优势与需要留意的倾向，不要改写；4) 列出匹配职业方向；5) 把这个结果与 ENFP 做对比，说明两者在哪几个维度上相反、这如何解释职业清单的差异。
cases.prompt_en: Run an MBTI career-personality assessment. My answers lean toward active socialising, trusting concrete facts and experience over intuition, deciding by rules and efficiency, and planning ahead. Requirements: 1) run the official 44-question scoring script and give the type and clarity score; 2) show the answer split and verdict for each dimension pair; 3) reproduce the strengths and blind spots from the item bank verbatim; 4) list the matched career directions; 5) compare this result with ENFP, identifying which dimensions are opposite and how that explains the difference in career lists.

cases.title: 离婚财产抚养咨询
cases.subtitle: 5 角色法律团队：房产分割、父母出资认定与子女抚养权一体分析，输出可执行离婚方案
cases.subtitle_en: 5-role legal team: integrated analysis of property division, parental down-payment contribution, and child custody with an actionable divorce strategy
cases.description:
离婚最难谈的，往往不是要不要离，而是房子到底归谁、父母出的首付款算不算个人贡献、孩子跟谁生活才更稳。尤其是婚后买房只写一方名字、孩子又长期由另一方照料时，很多人一边怕房子拿不住，一边又担心抚养权完全没机会。

这个案例演示了中文法律咨询团如何完整处理一类高频婚姻家事问题：先把婚龄、房屋资金链、父母出资、车辆理财、孩子当前照料状态等事实拆清，再结合《民法典》婚姻家庭编、2025 年婚姻家庭编解释（二）以及北京和最高法的公开裁判趋势，分析哪些属于夫妻共同财产、哪些只能作为分割时倾斜因素、房屋归一方时补偿如何估算、以及 6 岁子女抚养权在实务上最看重什么。最终交付一份完整《法律咨询报告》，附结果区间、证据清单和 7 步行动建议。

适合：准备离婚、正卡在房屋分割和孩子抚养安排上的夫妻；婚姻家事律师助理、家事调解员、企业法务；需要快速形成谈判底稿和诉前方案的人群。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of divorce is often not whether to separate, but who keeps the home, whether a parental down payment counts as personal contribution, and which living arrangement is truly better for the child. This becomes even harder when the marital home was purchased during marriage but registered under only one spouse, while the child has long been cared for mainly by the other spouse.

This case shows how the ChatLaw Team handles a common family-law scenario end to end: first structuring the marriage timeline, housing payment chain, parental contribution, car and investment assets, and the child's current caregiving pattern; then applying the Civil Code marriage-and-family rules, the 2025 judicial interpretation (II), and public Beijing / Supreme People's Court case trends to analyze what counts as marital property, what may only influence allocation rather than ownership, how compensation works when the home is awarded to one side, and what courts practically care about most in custody disputes involving a 6-year-old child. The final output is a full legal consultation report with outcome ranges, evidence checklist, and a 7-step action plan.

Target audience: people preparing for divorce and stuck on property and custody issues; family-law legal assistants, mediators, and in-house legal teams; anyone needing a fast negotiation brief and pre-litigation strategy.

cases.prompt:
我和妻子结婚 8 年，有 6 岁孩子。婚后共同买了一套房（房产证登记在我一人名下，首付 60 万是我父母出的，贷款双方共同还）、一辆车（登记在妻子名下）、还有些理财。现准备离婚，想要房子和孩子抚养权，愿意合理补偿。

请使用中文法律咨询团完整流程处理：
1. 先做信息采集，必要信息缺失时向我追问；
2. 输出完整《法律咨询报告》Markdown，必须包含：案情摘要、适用法条、类似判例、法律定性、财产分割结果区间（协议离婚 vs 诉讼离婚）、孩子抚养权归属影响因素、推荐路径（协商→调解→诉讼）、风险提示与证据清单；
3. 明确哪些属于夫妻共同财产、哪些可能视为个人财产或个人贡献；
4. 说明若房屋归我，大致补偿思路如何测算；
5. 给出下一步行动建议。

cases.title: 活动策划执行方案
cases.subtitle: 描述活动需求，自动生成含时间线、预算和应急预案的 Word 方案

cases.description:
策划一场 200 人的公司庆典有多崩溃？场地、餐饮、节目、预算、人员分工、物料清单、应急预案……每一项都是大工程，传统方式靠 Excel + Word 来回切换，改一个预算数字就得连改五张表。

这个案例演示了输入「公司五周年庆典」的核心需求（200 人、15 万预算、线下+直播），AI 自动生成一份完整的活动策划执行方案 Word 文档：包含精确到分钟的活动时间线、14 万+ 的详细预算明细表、RACI 人员分工矩阵、三轮抽奖方案、颁奖流程设计、物料采购清单、5 套应急预案、筹备倒推时间表，以及活动后复盘框架。生成正式 Word 格式，拿来就能用。

适合：行政部门、HR 团队、市场部活动策划、项目经理、需要组织年会/庆典/团建的任何人。
cases.description_en:
How stressful is planning a 200-person company celebration? Venue, catering, entertainment, budget, staff assignments, materials list, contingency plans — each is a major project. The traditional approach of switching between Excel and Word means changing one budget number requires updating five spreadsheets.

This case demonstrates inputting core requirements for a "Company 5th Anniversary Gala" (200 people, 150K budget, offline + livestream), and AI auto-generates a complete event planning proposal as a Word document: minute-by-minute timeline, detailed budget breakdown, RACI staffing matrix, raffle plan, award ceremony design, materials checklist, 5 contingency plans, and post-event review framework.

Ideal for: Admin departments, HR teams, marketing event planners, project managers, anyone organizing annual galas or team-building events.

artifacts.label: 活动策划执行方案（Word）

cases.prompt:
策划公司成立五周年庆典活动，生成一份完整的活动策划方案 Word 文档（output.docx）。

公司是一家 200 人的互联网科技公司，总部在深圳。活动要求：
1）形式：线下为主 + 线上直播（照顾异地同事）
2）预算：15 万元以内
3）时间：2026 年 6 月 14 日（周六）下午 14:00-21:00
4）场地：公司附近可容纳 250 人的活动场地
5）核心环节包括：开场 CEO 致辞与回顾视频、优秀员工/团队颁奖、各部门创意节目表演、抽奖互动环节（至少 3 轮）、自助晚宴 + 自由交流

需要生成完整的活动策划方案，包含时间线、预算明细表、人员分工表、物料清单、应急预案。

文档格式要求：包含封面页、目录、页眉页脚、多级标题编号、统一表格样式
输出为正式 Word 文档（output.docx）
cases.prompt_en:
Plan a 5th-anniversary celebration event for the company, and generate a complete event proposal as a Word document (output.docx).

The company is a 200-person internet tech company headquartered in Shenzhen. Event requirements:
1) Format: primarily in-person + live streaming (to accommodate colleagues in other locations)
2) Budget: within RMB 150,000
3) Time: Saturday, June 14, 2026, afternoon 14:00-21:00
4) Venue: an event space near the company that can hold 250 people
5) Core segments include: an opening CEO address and retrospective video, awards for outstanding employees/teams, creative performances from each department, lucky-draw interaction rounds (at least 3 rounds), and a buffet dinner + free mingling

I need a complete event proposal that includes a timeline, a detailed budget table, a staffing assignment table, a materials checklist, and a contingency plan.

Document formatting requirements: include a cover page, table of contents, headers and footers, multi-level heading numbering, and consistent table styling
Output as a formal Word document (output.docx)

cases.title: 人形机器人产业链深度研究 2026
cases.title_en: Humanoid Robot Industry Chain Deep Research 2026
cases.subtitle: 6 大环节 95+ 家代表公司 × 投资机会三层分级 × 产业链地图与融资趋势 SVG
cases.subtitle_en: 6 segments 95+ companies x 3-tier investment playbook, with industry map and funding trend SVG
cases.description:
2024 年 Figure 02 量产、NVIDIA GR00T 发布、Tesla Optimus V3 亮相，人形机器人赛道从「科研展示」真正跃迁为「千亿美金产业」。但一级二级投资人面对这个赛道最头疼的是：本体厂就有 18 家，零部件再按关节/传感器/控制/AI 大脑拆开，满屏都是代码，到底哪家值得买？哪家是假故事？

这个案例演示了深度研究团队 13 分钟内交付的《人形机器人产业链深度研究报告 2026》：Markdown 主报告约 1.6 万字，按「本体 - 关节/执行器 - 感知 - 控制 - AI 大脑 - 应用场景」6 大环节全产业链拆解，每环节列出 8-18 家代表公司（A 股代码/港股/美股/非上市融资轮次全标注），合计覆盖 95+ 家公司；给出 2026-2030 五年产业链成熟度甘特图、投资机会三层分级（短期 8 家/中期 8 家/长期 8 家共 24 只推荐 + 买入逻辑）、4 类风险识别 13 条具体点。配套 HTML 可视化版含产业链地图（CSS Grid 6 环节×10 公司四色编码：国内上市红实/国内非上市红虚/海外上市蓝实/海外非上市蓝虚）、6 块代表公司矩阵卡（60 张 micro 卡片）、2020-2026 融资热度双轴 SVG 图（柱形事件数+折线总额，标注 2024 爆发拐点）。

适合：VC / PE 投委会、公募基金新兴产业组、卖方分析师、FA、产业 CVC、做年度策略的买方研究总监。
cases.description_en:
With Figure 02 mass production, NVIDIA GR00T launch, and Tesla Optimus V3 unveil in 2024, humanoid robotics leapt from research demos to a hundred-billion-dollar industry. Yet investors face a brutal screening problem: 18 OEMs alone, then components split across joints/sensors/control/AI brains, who actually deserves capital and who is just a story?

This case shows the Deep Research Team delivering a complete Humanoid Robot Industry Chain Deep Research 2026 report in 13 minutes: a ~16k-character Markdown main report dissecting the full chain across 6 segments (OEM, joints/actuators, sensing, control, AI brain, applications) with 8-18 representative companies per segment (A-share/HK/US tickers, private-round history fully tagged), covering 95+ companies in total; a 2026-2030 five-year maturity Gantt chart; a 3-tier investment playbook (short 8 + mid 8 + long 8 = 24 picks with buy logic); and 13 concrete risk points across 4 categories. Companion HTML includes an industry map (CSS Grid, 6 segments x 10 companies, four-color coded: CN-listed solid red, CN-private dashed red, overseas-listed solid blue, overseas-private dashed blue), 6 matrix-card sections (60 micro cards), and a 2020-2026 funding trend SVG dual-axis chart (bars = deal count, line = total dollars, with 2024 inflection annotated).

Fit for: VC/PE investment committees, mutual-fund emerging-sector desks, sell-side analysts, FAs, corporate venture capital, and buy-side research heads running annual strategy.

artifacts.label: Markdown 主报告（1.6 万字 · 95+ 家公司）
HTML 可视化版（产业链地图+融资趋势+矩阵卡）

cases.prompt:
请面向一级/二级投资人产出一份《人形机器人产业链深度研究报告 2026》，使用「深度研究团队」5 阶段完整模式。

产业链按 6 大环节拆解（本体、关节/执行器、感知、控制、AI 大脑、应用场景），每环节独立一章并列出代表公司（上市标注代码与市值，非上市标注融资轮次与估值，附核心技术与量产进度）。

报告结构：引言、产业链全景与市场规模、六大环节、成熟度时间表、投资机会分级（短/中/长期，每层附买入逻辑）、风险识别、结论、参考文献。总字数 1.5-2 万字，2025-2026 数据标注「需核对」。

另出 HTML 可视化版（单页内联、无外部依赖）：产业链地图、代表公司矩阵、融资热度趋势图。
cases.prompt_en:
Produce a "Humanoid Robot Industry Chain Deep Research Report 2026" for primary/secondary-market investors, using the Deep Research Team's full 5-phase mode.

Break the value chain into 6 segments (body/whole machine, joints/actuators, perception, control, AI brain, application scenarios). Give each its own chapter and list representative companies (listed ones with ticker and market cap; private ones with funding round and valuation; all with core tech and mass-production progress).

Report structure: introduction, industry-chain landscape & market size, the six segments, a maturity timeline, tiered investment opportunities (short/mid/long term, each with buy thesis), risk identification, conclusion, references. Total 15,000–20,000 characters; mark 2025–2026 data as "to be verified".

Also produce an HTML visual version (single-page, inline, no external dependencies): industry-chain map, representative-company matrix, funding-heat trend chart.

cases.description:

帮我生成一份专业的销售漏斗追踪 Excel 报表。

**业务背景**：我们是一家 B2B SaaS 公司，销售团队 6 名销售代表，需要追踪从线索到成交的全链路漏斗。请生成 2026 年上半年的合理模拟数据。

**报告结构（多 Sheet）**：
- Sheet 1 漏斗总览：各阶段商机数量、金额、转化率（公式计算），及加权管线价值、平均销售周期、整体赢单率。
- Sheet 2 线索库：约 50 条线索，代表性字段如线索ID、公司、来源渠道、状态、负责人。
- Sheet 3 商机跟踪：约 30 条商机，代表性字段如商机ID、预计金额、成交概率、当前阶段、负责销售。
- Sheet 4 收入预测：按月展示目标、已成交、加权预测及完成率，并按销售代表展示个人达成。
- Sheet 5 客户分层：成交客户按 ABC 分层，统计各层数量、收入、续费率等。

# 糖尿病患者到底该怎么吃主食？

很多糖友一确诊就把米饭馒头全戒了，结果饿得头晕、血糖反而更乱。其实主食不是敌人，关键在选什么、吃多少。

## 一、为什么不能完全不吃主食

碳水是大脑主要能量来源。长期极低碳水饮食可能导致低血糖、酮症、肌肉流失。中国居民膳食指南建议，糖尿病患者碳水供能比控制在 45%–60% 之间为宜。

## 二、看懂 GI 和 GL

- **GI（升糖指数）**：反映食物升高血糖的速度。白米饭 GI 约 83，属高 GI；燕麦约 55，属中低 GI。
- **GL（血糖负荷）**：同时考虑速度和分量，比 GI 更实用。

## 三、主食替换的三个原则

1. **粗细搭配**：白米里掺三分之一杂豆、糙米
2. **控制总量**：每餐主食生重 50–75 克为参考
3. **调整顺序**：先吃蔬菜和蛋白，最后吃主食，餐后血糖更平稳

## 四、常见误区

- ❌ "无糖食品可以随便吃" —— 无糖只是不加蔗糖，淀粉照样升糖
- ❌ "喝粥养胃对糖友好" —— 粥糊化程度高，升糖比干饭快
- ❌ "水果一律不能吃" —— 低 GI 水果两餐之间少量可以吃

## 五、说点实在的

道理都懂，可真到做饭的时候还是难。我们医院营养科很多医生都推荐一款**「稳糖膳」控糖主食面**——低 GI、高膳食纤维，煮起来跟普通面条一样方便。

我自己吃了两个月，**吃着吃着血糖就稳了**，比天天吃药舒服多了。很多糖友反映餐后血糖比吃白米饭低不少。

**现在下单还有优惠，糖友专属价 79 元 3 包，点下方链接就能买**：
👉 【立即购买 稳糖膳控糖主食面】

买过的糖友都说好，回购率超高。放心买，我们只推荐自己吃过的。

---

我想清楚三件事：一是"我们医院营养科医生推荐"这种说法能不能写；二是食品说"血糖就稳了""比吃药舒服"是不是踩线；三是如果我在文章开头标个"广告"，后半段是不是就合法了。最后给我一张"哪些留、哪些删、哪些改"的对照清单，我照着动刀。

# How Should Diabetes Patients Actually Eat Staples?

Many patients cut out rice and steamed buns entirely upon diagnosis, only to end up dizzy from hunger with even more erratic glucose. Staples aren't the enemy — what matters is which ones and how much.

## 1. Why You Shouldn't Cut Staples Entirely

Carbohydrates are the brain's primary energy source. Prolonged very-low-carb eating can cause hypoglycemia, ketosis, and muscle loss. Chinese dietary guidelines suggest diabetes patients keep carbohydrate energy contribution between 45% and 60%.

## 2. Understanding GI and GL

- **GI (glycemic index)**: how fast a food raises blood glucose. White rice is around 83 (high GI); oats around 55 (medium-low).
- **GL (glycemic load)**: accounts for both speed and portion — more practical than GI alone.

## 3. Three Principles for Swapping Staples

1. **Mix refined with whole**: add one-third mixed beans or brown rice to white rice
2. **Control total volume**: 50–75 g dry weight of staples per meal as a reference
3. **Change the order**: vegetables and protein first, staples last — steadier post-meal glucose

## 4. Common Misconceptions

- ❌ "Sugar-free foods can be eaten freely" — sugar-free only means no added sucrose; starch still raises glucose
- ❌ "Congee is gentle on the stomach and good for diabetics" — congee is highly gelatinized and raises glucose faster than steamed rice
- ❌ "No fruit at all" — small portions of low-GI fruit between meals are fine

## 5. Let's Get Practical

Knowing the theory is one thing; actually cooking is another. Many doctors in our hospital's nutrition department recommend a product called **"Wentang Shan" glucose-friendly staple noodles** — low GI, high dietary fiber, and as easy to cook as ordinary noodles.

I've eaten them for two months and **my blood sugar just steadied out as I went**, far more comfortable than taking pills every day. Many patients report notably lower post-meal glucose than with white rice.

**There's a discount right now — a diabetes-community price of ¥79 for 3 packs, just tap the link below**:
👉 【Buy Now: Wentang Shan Glucose-Friendly Staple Noodles】

Everyone who's bought them says they're great, with a very high repurchase rate. Buy with confidence — we only recommend what we eat ourselves.

---

I want clarity on three things: first, whether "doctors in our hospital's nutrition department recommend it" is permissible; second, whether a food claiming "blood sugar just steadied" and "more comfortable than pills" crosses the line; third, if I label the article "Advertisement" at the top, does that make the second half lawful? Finish with a keep/delete/revise comparison checklist I can cut against.

This case shows how the Word Document Generation skill generates a complete agenda Word document for a v3.5 requirements review meeting with 6 agenda items, each with clear time allocation, owners, discussion points, expected outputs, and pre-meeting preparation materials.

cases.title: 糖尿病基层诊疗规范
cases.subtitle: 8 章完整规范·跨章审计闭环·基层临床送审初稿
cases.subtitle_en: An 8-chapter primary-care guideline with cross-chapter audit closure and review-ready delivery
cases.description:
基层临床长文档最怕的不是篇幅长，而是关键口径前后打架：诊断阈值一章一个版本、SGLT-2i 的 eGFR 下限写乱、低血糖分级把 2 级和 3 级混在一起、老年 HbA1c 目标前后漂移。对于 2 型糖尿病这种横跨诊断、药物、随访、并发症筛查、特殊人群和转诊的规范文件，只要一处口径失真，就可能直接变成医疗安全风险。

这个案例基于 openspec-doc-team 专家团的真实协作产物，围绕《2 型糖尿病基层诊疗规范》完成 8 章长文档交付，并保留了项目参数卡与跨章审核报告。完整稿整合了国家基层糖尿病防治管理指南（2025）、CDS 2024、医保目录 2024、基药目录 2018 与基本公卫第三版的核心口径，覆盖疾病定义、诊断标准、药物治疗路径、非药物干预、随访与并发症筛查、特殊人群管理、双向转诊、附录工具与医嘱模板；同时通过跨章审计修正了 SGLT-2i eGFR 阈值、老年 HbA1c 分层、低血糖三级分类、CKD 用药矩阵和 16.7 mmol/L 紧急阈值等高风险问题。

适合：社区医院和乡镇卫生院的全科医师、家庭医生团队、基层慢病管理负责人、医疗内容产品经理、临床规范编辑，以及想把 AI 用作“规范初稿 + 审核闭环”助手的医疗机构。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of writing long clinical documents is not the length — it is keeping every high-risk threshold consistent. One chapter uses one diagnostic cutoff, another drifts on SGLT-2 inhibitor eGFR thresholds, hypoglycemia levels get mixed up, and elderly HbA1c targets start contradicting each other. In a T2DM guideline that spans diagnosis, drugs, follow-up, complications, special populations, and referrals, a single drift can become a patient-safety issue.

This case packages a real multi-agent delivery produced by the openspec-doc-team around a full Primary Care T2DM Guideline, with the final 8-chapter document, the project card, and the cross-chapter audit record preserved together. The deliverable consolidates the 2025 National Primary Diabetes Prevention and Management Guideline, CDS 2024, the 2024 NRDL, the 2018 Essential Medicines List, and the National Basic Public Health Service Specification. It covers disease definition, diagnosis, drug pathways, non-drug interventions, follow-up and complication screening, special populations, referral rules, and appendix tools/templates, while explicitly fixing high-risk inconsistencies around SGLT-2i eGFR thresholds, elderly HbA1c stratification, hypoglycemia classification, CKD drug adjustments, and the 16.7 mmol/L emergency threshold.

Best for community hospitals, township clinics, primary-care physicians, family doctor teams, chronic disease program leads, medical content product managers, and clinical guideline editors who want AI to function as a draft-plus-audit-loop assistant rather than a free-form text generator.

Perfect for TypeScript developers, frontend engineers, and fullstack devs.

cases.prompt: 请为以下 TypeScript 购物车模块生成完整的 Jest 单元测试。源代码包含：CartService 类（addItem、removeItem、updateQuantity、getTotal、applyCoupon、checkout 方法），CartItem 接口，CouponType 枚举。要求：1) 覆盖所有公共方法的正常和边界情况；2) 使用 describe/it 组织测试结构；3) 包含 mock 外部依赖（支付网关、库存服务）；4) 测试异常场景（库存不足、优惠券过期、支付失败）；5) 使用 beforeEach 管理测试状态；6) 覆盖率目标 > 90%。请用全栈开发技能输出包含完整测试代码的 Markdown 文档。
cases.prompt_en: Please generate complete Jest unit tests for the following TypeScript shopping cart module. The source code includes: a CartService class (addItem, removeItem, updateQuantity, getTotal, applyCoupon, checkout methods), a CartItem interface, and a CouponType enum. Requirements: 1) cover the normal and edge cases of all public methods; 2) use describe/it to organize the test structure; 3) include mocking of external dependencies (payment gateway, inventory service); 4) test exception scenarios (insufficient inventory, expired coupon, payment failure); 5) use beforeEach to manage test state; 6) coverage target > 90%. cases.description:
朋友一起旅行最尴尬的时刻就是算账——谁垫付了酒店、谁请了那顿饭、有人提前走了两天该怎么算？微信群里丢一堆截图和数字，越算越乱，最后要么有人吃亏要么伤感情。

这个案例生成完整的旅行 AA 分账 Excel：费用明细表（每笔消费的付款人/参与人/金额）、个人汇总表（每人应付总额/已付总额/差额）、最优转账方案（最少转账次数完成清算）。公式自动计算分摊，支持部分人参与的费用按实际人头平摊。

适合：朋友出游、公司团建、合租室友分摊、同事聚餐。
cases.description_en:
The most awkward moment of a group trip is splitting the bill — who fronted the hotel, who paid for that dinner, how to calculate when someone left two days early? Screenshots and numbers flying around in group chats just make it worse, and someone always ends up short-changed or resentful.

This case generates a complete travel expense splitting Excel: expense detail sheet (payer/participants/amount per transaction), personal summary (total owed/total paid/balance per person), and optimal settlement plan (minimum transfers to clear all debts). Formulas auto-calculate splits, supporting partial participation expenses divided by actual headcount.

Best for: Friend trips, company team-building, roommate expense sharing, colleague dinner splits.
cases.prompt:
请为一次 5 人成都旅行生成一份完整的 AA 分账 Excel 表格。

旅行信息：成员小明、小红、阿杰、Lisa、大伟；目的地成都；2026 年 5 月 1–4 日（4 天 3 晚）；大伟 5 月 3 日下午提前离开，不参与最后一天费用。

请生成以下工作表：
1. 费用明细表：代表性字段如日期、项目、金额、付款人、参与人、人均分摊、备注；包含 20+ 笔消费，部分消费非全员参与（按实际人头平摊）。
2. 个人汇总表：用公式汇总每人应付总额、已垫付总额、差额。
3. 清算方案：用最少转账次数完成所有人之间的清算，含转账人、收款人、金额。

格式：金额保留两位小数，差额用条件格式标色。输出为 .xlsx 文件。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a complete AA (split-the-bill) expense Excel sheet for a 5-person trip to Chengdu.

Trip info: members Xiao Ming, Xiao Hong, A Jie, Lisa, Da Wei; destination Chengdu; May 1-4, 2026 (4 days, 3 nights); Da Wei leaves early on the afternoon of May 3 and does not share the last day's expenses.

Please generate the following worksheets:
1. Expense Detail Sheet: representative fields like date, item, amount, payer, participants, per-person share, notes; include 20+ expenses, with some not involving everyone (split by actual headcount).
2. Personal Summary Sheet: use formulas to summarize each person's total owed, total fronted, and balance.
3. Settlement Plan: clear all debts with the minimum number of transfers, including payer, payee, and amount.

Formatting: amounts to 2 decimal places; use conditional formatting to color the balance. Output as an .xlsx file.

cases.title_en: Holland Codes: RIA — Hands-On, Investigative and Creative
cases.subtitle: 60 题分三部分问「感兴趣 / 擅长 / 喜欢这个职业」，六维分别计分
cases.subtitle_en: Sixty items across three sections, scored on six dimensions
cases.description:
兴趣测评最容易被当成算命——真正有用的读法是看六个维度的分布形状，尤其是得分为 0 的那几个。

本案例用 60 题版跑出 RIA 型，兴趣显著度 46 分。六维分布极度两极化：R/I/A 拿下 10/9/8 分，而 E（企业型）和 C（常规型）双双为 0。案例给出题库原文的维度特征与典型职业，并强调兴趣不等于适合。

适合：不确定自己喜欢什么类型工作的学生、做专业与职业匹配的人。
cases.description_en:
Interest inventories are easily mistaken for fortune-telling — the useful reading is the shape of the six-dimension distribution, especially the zeros.

This case runs the 60-item version to an RIA result with 46% interest salience. The distribution is sharply polarised: R/I/A take 10/9/8 while enterprising and conventional both score zero. It reproduces the item bank's dimension characteristics and typical occupations, and stresses that interest is not the same as fit.

For: students unsure what kind of work appeals, and anyone matching major to career.

artifacts.label: 霍兰德 RIA 型测评结果报告

cases.prompt: 帮我做一次霍兰德职业兴趣测评。我作答时对动手操作类、研究探索类、创意表达类的活动都答「是」，对销售管理类和事务性工作基本答「否」。要求：1) 用 60 题题库真实跑一遍评分脚本，给出霍兰德代码和总分；2) 展示六个维度的得分分布；3) 完整给出代码对应三个维度的共同特征和典型职业（题库原文，不要改写）；4) 指出得分最低的几个维度是什么，说明低分维度同样重要的原因；5) 解释总分是怎么算出来的、它代表兴趣的广度还是集中度，以及为什么兴趣不等于适合。

cases.description:

cases.description_en:
The core divide in Holland's hexagon is working with things versus working with people — but a single result doesn't show you where that line falls.

This case runs the same 60 items to an SEA result and sets it beside RIA: the two sit almost diagonally opposite on the hexagon, sharing only A. It explains why adjacent-triangle codes are more stable than codes spanning the hexagon, with each dimension's definition from the item bank.

For: students drawn to people-facing work and anyone learning the model's structure.

cases.subtitle: 电商产品用户评价情感分析与洞察报告
cases.subtitle_en: E-commerce Product User Review Sentiment Analysis & Insights Report
cases.description:
电商运营最大的盲区之一，就是只看评分不看评价内容。4.5 分的产品可能隐藏着严重的售后问题，3.8 分的产品也许只是物流拖了后腿。手动翻几百条评价效率太低，关键信息容易遗漏，更别提跨产品维度的系统性分析了。

这个案例基于 500 条真实用户评价数据，自动完成从情感分类到深度洞察的全链路分析：整体情感分布统计、五大产品维度（外观、性能、价格、售后、物流）的情感热力图、高频关键词词云与情感关联、负面评价 Top 10 问题归类、按月情感趋势变化追踪、竞品情感得分横向对比，最终输出改进建议优先级矩阵，帮你把用户的声音转化为可执行的产品决策。

适合：电商运营、产品经理、品牌管理、用户研究员、市场分析师。无论是日常评价监控还是季度产品复盘，这份报告都能帮你从海量评价中快速提取核心洞察。
cases.description_en:
One of the biggest blind spots in e-commerce operations is looking only at ratings while ignoring review content. A 4.5-star product might be hiding serious after-sales issues, while a 3.8-star product might just be dragged down by logistics. Manually reading hundreds of reviews is inefficient, key insights get missed, and systematic cross-dimension analysis is nearly impossible.

This case analyzes 500 real user reviews through a complete pipeline from sentiment classification to deep insights: overall sentiment distribution, sentiment heatmap across five product dimensions (appearance, performance, price, after-sales, logistics), high-frequency keyword word cloud with sentiment correlation, Top 10 negative issue categorization, monthly sentiment trend tracking, competitor sentiment score benchmarking, and a final improvement priority matrix that turns user voices into actionable product decisions.

Best for: E-commerce operators, product managers, brand managers, user researchers, and market analysts. Whether for daily review monitoring or quarterly product retrospectives, this report helps you extract core insights from massive review volumes quickly.

The data contains 500 user reviews, and I need to analyze: 1) the overall sentiment distribution (positive/neutral/negative proportions); 2) a sentiment heatmap by product dimension (appearance, performance, price, after-sales, logistics); 3) a word cloud of high-frequency keywords and their sentiment associations; 4) a Top 10 categorization of issues in negative reviews; 5) sentiment trend changes (by month); 6) a competitor comparison of sentiment scores; 7) a priority matrix for improvement recommendations. Output as a structured Markdown analysis report.
