cases.description:
每月发薪日前最怕什么？HR 手动核算五十号人的基本工资、绩效奖金、五险一金、个税……一个公式拉错，要么多发要么少发，员工投诉不断、财务对账头大。更别说遇到社保基数调整、个税累计预扣法变化，Excel 里一堆嵌套公式改到怀疑人生。

这个案例演示如何用 AI 一键生成一套完整的薪酬核算 Excel：覆盖 5 个部门 50 名员工，从基本工资、岗位津贴、绩效奖金出发，自动计算养老保险、医疗保险、失业保险、工伤保险、生育保险和住房公积金（五险一金），再按最新累进税率表计算个人所得税，最终得出每人实发工资。同时生成部门薪酬汇总分析，一眼看清各部门人力成本结构。

适合：HR 专员、薪酬主管、财务会计、中小企业老板、任何需要批量处理薪酬核算的人。
cases.description_en:
What's the biggest dread before payday? HR manually calculating base salary, performance bonuses, social insurance, and income tax for dozens of employees — one wrong formula means overpayment or underpayment, triggering employee complaints and accounting nightmares. It gets worse when social insurance bases adjust or tax withholding rules change, leaving you drowning in nested Excel formulas.

This case demonstrates how AI can generate a complete payroll calculation Excel in one click: covering 50 employees across 5 departments, starting from base salary, position allowances, and performance bonuses, automatically computing pension, medical, unemployment, work injury, and maternity insurance plus housing fund (five insurances and one fund), then calculating individual income tax using the latest progressive tax brackets, and finally arriving at each employee's take-home pay. Ideal for: HR specialists, compensation managers, accountants, SMB owners, and anyone who needs to process batch payroll calculations.

cases.description:

This case completes the 85-item assessment (innate aptitudes plus general professional abilities): perfect scores in language, interpersonal and coordination form the strength band; logic and others at 75 form the potential band; spatial and aesthetic sit at 25. The report gives a full bar panorama, verbatim Top-5 readings, and the advice that for desk-role tracks you maximise strengths rather than patch irrelevant gaps.

For: students hunting résumé highlights and candidates prepping self-awareness questions.

cases.subtitle: 85 题覆盖 17 个维度，这份结果的形状非常「尖」

cases.description:

本案例用 85 题版跑出一份尖峰型画像：数学能力、逻辑思维、研究分析、细节洞察四项并列 90 分，而动觉、审美、人际交往、商业思维并列垫底 35 分，总分 62。案例给出 17 维分布、题库原文的高分描述，并说明尖峰型画像的优势与迁移风险。

This case runs the 85-item version to a sharply peaked profile: mathematical ability, logical thinking, research analysis and attention to detail all tie at 90, while kinaesthetic, aesthetic, interpersonal and commercial thinking tie at 35, for a total of 62. It shows all seventeen dimensions with the item bank's high-score descriptions, and discusses the strengths and transfer risk of a spiked profile.

For: students targeting technical roles and anyone deciding between specialising and generalising.

cases.title: 商业计划书 (BP)
cases.subtitle: 从执行摘要到财务预测的完整融资 BP

cases.description:
写 BP 是创业者最头疼的事之一——投资人要看市场规模、竞品分析、财务模型、团队背景，每个板块都有讲究，结构稍乱就丢印象分。很多创始人花两周写出来的 BP，投资人 30 秒就翻完了，因为重点不突出、数据没说服力。

本案例以一家 AI 智能客服 SaaS 创业公司的 Pre-A 轮融资为场景，演示了 AI 如何生成一份完整的商业计划书：涵盖执行摘要、公司概况与里程碑、TAM/SAM/SOM 市场分析、产品架构与技术壁垒、竞品矩阵对比、SaaS 商业模式与单位经济模型、核心团队介绍、三年财务预测（含盈亏平衡分析）、融资计划与资金用途、以及风险评估矩阵。

适合：创业者、融资顾问、投资经理、商业分析师。
cases.description_en:
Writing a business plan is one of the most daunting tasks for founders — investors want to see market sizing, competitive analysis, financial models, and team backgrounds. Each section has its own standards, and a poorly structured BP loses credibility in seconds. Many founders spend two weeks crafting a BP that investors skim in 30 seconds because key points aren't prominent and the data isn't compelling.

This case uses an AI-powered customer service SaaS startup's Pre-A fundraising round as the scenario, demonstrating how AI generates a complete business plan: covering executive summary, company overview with milestones, TAM/SAM/SOM market analysis, product architecture and technical moats, competitor matrix comparison, SaaS business model with unit economics, core team profiles, three-year financial projections with break-even analysis, fundraising plan and use of funds, and risk assessment matrix.

Best for: Founders, fundraising advisors, investment managers, business analysts.

Company snapshot (replace with your own): ~1.5 years old, team of nearly 20, dozens of paying customers, MRR in the hundreds of thousands with steady monthly growth; product is an LLM-based multi-turn customer-service chatbot; this round raises several million to ~ten million RMB.

Produce a complete BP including: executive summary, market analysis (TAM/SAM/SOM), product, business model, competitive analysis, team, three-year financial projection, and fundraising plan & use of funds.

cases.title: 能力测评：总分 77 却九项并列的均衡型画像
cases.title_en: Aptitude Assessment: A Balanced Profile Scoring 77 With Nine Dimensions Tied
cases.subtitle: 总分更高，但没有一项拔尖——这样的结果该怎么用
cases.subtitle_en: A higher total with no standout — how to read that
cases.description:
有人测完发现「哪项都还行，但哪项都不突出」，第一反应是「我是不是没有特长」——这其实是对自评量表的误读。

本案例跑出一份均衡型画像：总分 77（高于尖峰型的 62），但前五名全部并列 80 分，另有 4 个维度同样 80 分，实际是九项并列。案例解释这种分布的真实含义，并建议改用职业锚和霍兰德来定位方向。

适合：测评结果没有明显优势项的人、纠结于「我到底擅长什么」的学生。
cases.description_en:
People whose results come back "decent everywhere, outstanding nowhere" tend to conclude they have no strengths — which misreads what a self-report instrument does.

This case produces a balanced profile: a total of 77 (above the spiked profile's 62), but the top five all tie at 80, with four more dimensions also at 80 — nine tied in all. It explains what that distribution actually means and recommends using career anchors and Holland codes to find direction instead.

For: anyone whose results show no clear peak, and students stuck on "what am I actually good at".

artifacts.label: 职业能力倾向均衡型结果报告

cases.prompt: 帮我做一次职业能力倾向测评。我作答时大部分题都选「比较符合」，少数几题选「完全符合」，整体比较平均，没有明显偏向。要求：1) 用 85 题题库真实跑一遍评分脚本，给出总分和 17 个维度的得分；2) 展示得分最高的 10 个维度；3) 完整给出前五名维度的题库高分描述；4) 指出有多少个维度并列同分，说明并列意味着什么、脚本是按什么规则排序的；5) 分析均衡型画像该怎么用，如果它无法帮我定方向，还应该做哪些测评。

cases.title: 婚礼预算规划表
cases.subtitle: 输入婚礼需求，生成详细的预算规划与费用追踪表格
cases.subtitle_en: Input wedding requirements, generate detailed budget planning and expense tracking spreadsheet
cases.description:
筹备婚礼最崩溃的不是选婚纱、不是定酒店，而是预算——婚庆公司报价水分多大？酒席到底按什么标准算？零零碎碎加起来到底花了多少？等到婚礼结束一算账，发现比预期超支了 30% 以上的新人不在少数。

这个案例演示了输入婚礼基本信息（宾客人数、预算上限、婚礼风格），AI 自动生成一份完整的婚礼预算规划 Excel 表格：总览仪表盘（总预算/已确认/已支付/待付款）、分类明细表（场地、餐饮、婚纱摄影、婚庆布置、喜糖回礼、交通住宿等 8 大类）、供应商对比表、付款时间线、宾客礼金预估。每项都有预算金额、实际金额、差异、备注，公式自动汇总。

适合：准新人、婚礼策划师、父母帮忙筹备婚礼的家庭。
cases.description_en:
The most stressful part of wedding planning isn't choosing the dress or the venue — it's the budget. Vendor quotes are inflated, banquet costs are confusing, and miscellaneous expenses add up invisibly. Many couples end up 30%+ over budget by the end.

This case demonstrates inputting basic wedding info (guest count, budget cap, wedding style), with AI generating a complete wedding budget planning Excel spreadsheet: overview dashboard (total budget/confirmed/paid/pending), categorized expense breakdown (venue, catering, photography, decorations, gifts, transportation, etc. across 8 categories), vendor comparison sheet, payment timeline, and gift money estimation. Each item includes budgeted amount, actual amount, variance, and notes, with automatic formula summation.

Best for: Engaged couples, wedding planners, families helping with wedding preparation.
cases.prompt:
请为一对准新人生成一份完整的婚礼预算规划 Excel（output.xlsx）。

基本信息：婚礼日期 2026 年 10 月 3 日，宾客约 200 人（20 桌），总预算上限 25 万元，户外草坪 + 室内晚宴，城市杭州。

请生成以下工作表：
1. 总览仪表盘：总预算、已确认、已支付、待付款，各分类占比与使用进度
2. 费用明细：约 8 大分类（场地、餐饮、婚纱摄影、布置、服饰造型、喜糖回礼、交通住宿等），每项含预算金额、实际金额、差异、供应商、状态、备注
3. 供应商对比：对比几家婚庆公司与酒店的报价和服务
4. 付款时间线：各笔大额支出的定金 / 尾款节点，按月排列现金流
5. 宾客礼金预估：按关系分类预估礼金及总收入

要求：用公式自动汇总各类小计与总计，超预算标红、节省标绿，状态列用下拉，金额规范显示。输出为 .xlsx 文件。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a complete wedding budget planning Excel (output.xlsx) for a soon-to-be-married couple.

Basic info: wedding date October 3, 2026, about 200 guests (20 tables), total budget cap ¥250,000, outdoor lawn ceremony + indoor evening banquet, in Hangzhou.

Please generate these worksheets:
1. Overview Dashboard: total budget, confirmed, paid, pending, each category's share and usage progress
2. Expense Detail: about 8 categories (venue, catering, photography, decoration, attire & styling, candy & gifts, transport & accommodation, etc.), each item with budgeted amount, actual amount, variance, supplier, status, notes
3. Supplier Comparison: compare quotes and services of several wedding companies and hotels
4. Payment Timeline: deposit / final-payment milestones for large expenses, cash flow by month
5. Guest Gift Money Estimate: estimate gift money by relationship and total income

Requirements: auto-sum subtotals and totals with formulas, mark over-budget in red and savings in green, dropdown for the status column, properly formatted amounts. Output as an .xlsx file.

cases.title: SOP 标准操作流程文档
cases.subtitle: 描述业务流程，自动生成可落地的 Word 标准操作手册
cases.subtitle_en: Describe a business process, auto-generate an actionable SOP as Word document
cases.description:
团队规模一大，最怕的就是「每个人做同一件事的方式都不一样」。客户投诉处理，有人先道歉再查原因，有人先查原因让客户等半天；新人入职，不同 mentor 教的流程五花八门。没有标准化的 SOP，团队效率就是一笔糊涂账。

这个案例演示了描述一个「客户投诉处理」业务流程，AI 自动生成一份完整的 SOP Word 文档：包含目的与范围、角色与职责矩阵（RACI）、分步操作流程、判断分支与升级路径、异常情况处理预案、质量检查清单、以及 KPI 度量指标。生成正式 Word 格式，开箱即用，打印出来就能培训新人。

适合：运营经理、客服主管、质量管理人员、创业公司搭建标准化流程、任何需要把经验变成文档的团队。
cases.description_en:
When teams grow, the biggest problem is "everyone does the same thing differently." Without standardized SOPs, team efficiency is a mess. But writing SOPs is tedious — mapping the full process, detailing every step and exception, then iterating.

This case demonstrates describing a "Customer Complaint Handling" process and having AI auto-generate a complete SOP as a Word document: purpose and scope, RACI responsibility matrix, step-by-step procedures, decision branches and escalation paths, exception handling, quality checklists, and KPI metrics. Generated as a formal Word document, print-ready for training.

Best for: Operations managers, customer service leads, quality managers, startups building standardized processes.

请为「客户投诉处理」业务流程生成一份完整的 SOP 标准操作文档（output.docx）。

请按以下结构输出完整 SOP：
1. 文档信息（编号、版本、生效日期、审批人、修订记录）

cases.title: 跨境电商商业计划书
cases.subtitle: 东南亚出海全案，从市场分析到财务预测
cases.subtitle_en: Southeast Asia expansion — from market analysis to financial projections
cases.description:
想做跨境电商但不知道目标市场怎么选、物流怎么搭、合规怎么做，写商业计划书更是无从下手——东南亚六国市场差异大，Shopee/Lazada/TikTok Shop 各有生态，物流有直发、海外仓、本地仓三种模式，税务清关政策各国不同，一份靠谱的 BP 需要覆盖太多维度。

本案例演示了如何用 FBS-BookWriter 长文写作能力生成一份完整的东南亚跨境电商 BP，覆盖市场分析（六国电商市场规模与增长率对比）、目标市场选择（印尼+泰国 PEST 分析）、竞争格局（三大平台差异化定位）、商业模式（B2C 自营+平台混合+供应链架构）、运营策略（选品/定价/TikTok 达人+Facebook 广告+本地 KOL）、物流方案（三种模式成本测算）、合规与风险（税务/清关/知识产权/支付）、财务预测（三年 P&L + Unit Economics + BEP 分析）、团队与里程碑（核心四人团队+12 个月时间线）共 9 大模块。

适合：跨境电商创业者、出海业务负责人、投资人、供应链企业。
cases.description_en:
Want to launch a cross-border e-commerce business but unsure how to choose target markets, set up logistics, handle compliance, or even write a business plan? Southeast Asia's six major markets differ widely — Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop each have their own ecosystems, logistics options range from direct shipping to overseas warehouses to local warehouses, and tax and customs policies vary by country. A solid BP needs to cover an overwhelming number of dimensions.

This case demonstrates how to use FBS-BookWriter's long-form writing capability to generate a comprehensive Southeast Asia cross-border e-commerce BP covering: market analysis (six-country e-commerce market size and growth rate comparison), target market selection (Indonesia + Thailand PEST analysis), competitive landscape (differentiated positioning across three major platforms), business model (B2C direct + platform hybrid + supply chain architecture), operations strategy (product selection, pricing, TikTok influencers + Facebook ads + local KOLs), logistics solutions (cost analysis for three models), compliance and risk (tax, customs, IP, payments), financial projections (three-year P&L + Unit Economics + BEP analysis), and team & milestones (four-person core team + 12-month timeline) — nine major modules in total.

Best for: Cross-border e-commerce entrepreneurs, overseas expansion leads, investors, supply chain companies.

artifacts.label: 跨境电商商业计划书

cases.prompt: 为一家计划进军东南亚市场的跨境电商创业公司撰写完整的商业计划书。公司定位：家居日用品垂直品类跨境电商，首批目标市场为印尼和泰国。商业模式：B2C自营+Shopee/Lazada/TikTok Shop平台店铺混合模式，供应链架构为国内仓→海外仓→Last mile。营销策略：以TikTok达人带货+Facebook广告+本地KOL为主要获客渠道。融资需求：500万元人民币用于首批市场拓展。要求生成完整BP，覆盖执行摘要、东南亚六国市场分析（规模/增长率/互联网渗透率对比）、目标市场PEST分析、竞争格局分析、商业模式与供应链、运营策略、物流方案对比、合规与风险、三年财务预测（含Unit Economics和BEP分析）、核心团队与12个月里程碑。请用 FBS-BookWriter 的长文写作能力输出一份详尽的商业计划书。
cases.prompt_en: Write a complete business plan for a cross-border e-commerce startup planning to enter the Southeast Asian market. Company positioning: a cross-border e-commerce business in the home & daily-goods vertical, with Indonesia and Thailand as the first batch of target markets. Business model: a hybrid of B2C self-operation and Shopee/Lazada/TikTok Shop platform stores; the supply chain architecture is domestic warehouse → overseas warehouse → last mile. Marketing strategy: customer acquisition primarily through TikTok influencer livestream selling + Facebook ads + local KOLs. Funding needs: RMB 5 million for the first wave of market expansion. The requirement is to produce a complete BP covering the executive summary, market analysis of six Southeast Asian countries (comparing size / growth rate / internet penetration), a PEST analysis of the target markets, competitive landscape analysis, business model and supply chain, operations strategy, logistics options comparison, compliance and risk, a three-year financial forecast (including Unit Economics and BEP analysis), the core team, and a 12-month milestone plan. Please use FBS-BookWriter's long-form writing capability to output a detailed business plan.

cases.title: 简历诊断：46 分是怎么算出来的
cases.title_en: Resume Diagnosis: How a 46 Is Computed
cases.subtitle: 复刻后端流水线逐字段扫描，三类诊断 + 六维评分
cases.subtitle_en: A field-by-field pipeline scan: three diagnosis types, six scoring dimensions
cases.description:
「简历帮我看看」得到的往往是几句感觉式点评。诊断应该像体检：逐项扫、给依据、能复查。

本案例把一份虚构的会计学学生简历（李慕华）跑过 1:1 复刻高顿后端的诊断流水线：52 个字段逐一判定，产出 21 项空白提醒（NO_FILL）、1 个缺失模块（NO_DATA）、3 条描述改进建议，六维评分合成总分 46、打败 50% 求职者，并给出修改优先级。

适合：投递前想过一遍机检的学生、批量看简历的就业老师。
cases.description_en:
"Take a look at my resume" usually earns a few impressionistic comments. Diagnosis should work like a physical: scan every item, cite evidence, be repeatable.

This case runs a fictional accounting student's resume (Li Muhua) through a pipeline that replicates Gaodun's backend 1:1: all 52 fields judged one by one, producing 21 blank-field alerts (NO_FILL), 1 missing module (NO_DATA), 3 description suggestions, six-dimension scores totalling 46 — beating 50% of applicants — plus a fix-priority list.

For: students pre-screening before applying and careers staff reviewing at volume.

artifacts.label: 简历诊断 46 分报告

cases.prompt: 帮我诊断这份简历（上传 PDF/DOCX）。要求：1) 按诊断流水线逐字段解析，产出 NO_DATA/NO_FILL/DESCRIPTION_SUGGEST 三类结果；2) 六维评分（完整度/经历描述/学习能力/专业能力/创新领导力/职场能力）用脚本真实计算，经历描述按量化规则分档；3) 报告含总分、打败百分比、逐模块诊断明细；4) 给出修改优先级：先补什么最回分。
cases.prompt_en: Diagnose this resume (PDF/DOCX upload). Requirements: 1) parse field by field through the diagnosis pipeline, producing NO_DATA / NO_FILL / DESCRIPTION_SUGGEST results; 2) compute the six dimension scores (completeness, experience description, learning, professional, innovation-leadership, workplace) with the real script, banding descriptions by the quantification rule; 3) report the total, beat percentage, and per-module details; 4) end with fix priorities — what recovers the most points first.

cases.title: 技术外包服务合同
cases.subtitle: 输入合同要素，AI 自动生成结构完整的 Word 合同模板
cases.subtitle_en: Enter contract elements, AI auto-generates a well-structured Word contract template
cases.description:
找律师起草一份技术外包合同动辄大几千，小公司和创业团队根本承受不起。自己写又担心条款不严谨——付款节点怎么设？验收标准写多细？知识产权归属有没有坑？违约金比例定多少合理？

这个案例演示了输入一份技术外包合同的核心要素（甲乙方信息、项目内容、金额 38 万三期付款、4 个月开发周期、验收标准、质保条款等），AI 自动生成一份结构完整的正式合同 Word 文档：包含项目概况与技术要求、分期付款方案、里程碑交付计划、验收标准、12 个月质保条款、知识产权归属、保密条款、违约责任、争议解决等十二章完整条款。可直接作为谈判底稿使用。

适合：创业公司签外包合同、技术负责人管理供应商、采购经理起草服务合同、自由职业者签项目协议。
cases.description_en:
Hiring a lawyer to draft a tech outsourcing contract costs thousands — unaffordable for small companies and startups. Writing it yourself risks incomplete clauses: How should payment milestones be structured? How detailed should acceptance criteria be?

This case demonstrates entering core contract elements (party information, project scope, 380K in three payment installments, 4-month development timeline, acceptance criteria, warranty terms) and having AI auto-generate a complete formal contract as a Word document: covering project overview, staged payments, milestone delivery, acceptance standards, 12-month warranty, IP ownership, confidentiality, breach penalties, dispute resolution — twelve complete chapters ready as a negotiation draft.

Best for: Startups signing outsourcing contracts, tech leads managing vendors, procurement managers drafting service agreements, freelancers signing project agreements.

artifacts.label: 技术外包服务合同（Word）

cases.prompt:
生成一份技术外包服务合同 Word 文档（output.docx）。甲方为一家互联网公司（深圳市创新科技有限公司），乙方为一家软件开发外包商（广州极客软件有限公司）。

项目概况：甲方委托乙方开发一套内部 OA 审批系统（请假、报销、采购三个模块），需对接企业微信和飞书。

合同要素：
1）总金额 ¥38 万元，分三期付款（签约 30%、中期验收 40%、终验 30%）
2）开发周期 4 个月（2026.05.01 - 2026.08.31）
3）验收标准：功能测试通过率 ≥ 98%，500 并发响应时间 ≤ 2s
4）质保期 12 个月，期间 bug 免费修复
5）知识产权归甲方所有
6）保密条款：合同期及终止后 3 年内有效
7）违约责任：延期交付每日按合同金额 0.5% 计违约金，上限 10%

格式：含封面页、目录、页眉页脚、多级标题编号、甲乙方信息区与签字盖章区，条款结构严谨可直接打印签署。输出为正式 Word 文档（output.docx）。
cases.prompt_en:
Generate a technology outsourcing service contract Word document (output.docx). Party A is an internet company (Shenzhen Innovation Technology Co., Ltd.), Party B is a software outsourcing vendor (Guangzhou Geek Software Co., Ltd.).

Project overview: Party A commissions Party B to develop an internal OA approval system (leave, reimbursement, procurement modules), integrating with WeCom and Feishu.

Contract elements:
1) Total amount ¥380,000, paid in three installments (30% on signing, 40% on mid-term acceptance, 30% on final acceptance)
2) Development period 4 months (2026.05.01 - 2026.08.31)
3) Acceptance criteria: functional test pass rate >= 98%, response time <= 2s under 500 concurrent users
4) Warranty period 12 months, with free bug fixes during it
5) Intellectual property belongs to Party A
6) Confidentiality: effective during the contract term and for 3 years after termination
7) Breach liability: liquidated damages of 0.5% of the contract amount per day of late delivery, capped at 10%

Format: cover page, table of contents, headers/footers, multi-level heading numbering, Party A/B information section and signature/seal section, rigorous clause structure ready to print and sign. Output as a formal Word document (output.docx).

cases.description:
很多人以为简历写满就没问题了，可 HR 看的从来不是字段完整度，而是每一段经历有没有说清楚「做了什么、达成了什么」。

本案例跑通完整诊断流水线：一份填了 66/72 字段的应届简历拿到 74 分、超过 80% 的求职者，但实习经历以外的模块仍触发 6 条建议。案例展示五个确定性维度得分、各模块经历描述评分、NO_FILL 判定与逐条描述建议原文。

适合：简历已经写得不错但想再提一档的应届生、做简历辅导的老师。
cases.description_en:
People assume a full resume is a good resume, but recruiters don't read field completeness — they read whether each experience says what you did and what came of it.

This case runs the full diagnosis pipeline: a graduate resume with 66 of 72 fields filled scores 74, beating 80% of applicants — yet modules outside the internships still trigger six suggestions. It shows the five deterministic dimension scores, per-module description ratings, NO_FILL findings and every suggestion verbatim.

For: graduates polishing an already-solid resume, and resume coaches.

artifacts.label: 74 分简历诊断报告

cases.prompt: 帮我诊断这份应届生简历（内容见附件/粘贴）：市场营销本科，两段实习分别做用户运营和市场推广，有校内活动、比赛、项目、培训、职业规划和自我评价。要求：1) 走完整诊断流程，给出六维总分和超过多少求职者；2) 分别列出五个确定性维度的得分，说明它们是怎么算出来的；3) 给出各经历模块的描述评分，并说明评分的分档规则；4) 列出所有未填字段（NO_FILL）和逐条描述建议原文；5) 分析这份简历的问题集中在哪类模块，为什么实习经历没有触发建议。
cases.prompt_en: Diagnose this graduate resume (attached/pasted): marketing bachelor's, two internships in user operations and marketing, plus campus activities, a competition, a project, training, career planning and a self-evaluation. Requirements: 1) run the full diagnosis and give the six-dimension total and the percentile beaten; 2) list the five deterministic dimension scores and explain how each is computed; 3) give the per-module description ratings and the banding rules behind them; 4) list every unfilled field (NO_FILL) and reproduce each suggestion verbatim; 5) analyse which modules the problems cluster in and why the internships triggered no suggestions.

cases.title: 3000 行 Go 订单 PR 综合审查
cases.title_en: Comprehensive Review of a 3000-Line Go Order PR
cases.subtitle: 工程保障团队四维度深度审查，附架构影响与测试充分性评估
cases.subtitle_en: Engineering assurance team's 4-dimension deep review with architecture and test coverage assessment
cases.description:
**痛点**：大版本 PR（3000+ 行）一次性合入风险巨大，但常规 review 只能覆盖代码层，看不到架构影响和测试盲区，上线后频发资金精度/幂等/超卖事故。

**演示内容**：工程保障团队三位专家（代码审查师科迪 + 系统架构师阿奇 + 测试专家泰莎）并行独立产出，由主理人甄宇航汇编出完整《PR 审查报告》：67 条具体意见（含安全 / 性能 / 正确性 / 可维护性 / 架构影响 / 测试覆盖六大维度），每条含严重度（Blocker/Major/Minor/Suggestion）、具体位置、Go 代码 Bad/Good 对照、修复建议。同时产出可直接贴到 PR 评论区的精简版（Top 10 Blocker + 合入路径）。

**适用人群**：后端技术 Leader、架构师、TL、CTO，尤其是负责交易/支付/订单系统的团队。
cases.description_en:
**Pain point**: Large PRs (3000+ lines) carry massive merge risk, yet routine reviews only cover the code surface—missing architectural impact and test blind spots. The result: production incidents around money precision, idempotency, and oversell.

**What this case shows**: Three specialists from the engineering assurance team work in parallel—Cody (code reviewer), Archi (system architect), and Tessa (test expert)—and the lead Zhen Yuhang consolidates a full PR Review Report. Output: 67 concrete findings across 6 dimensions (security / performance / correctness / maintainability / architecture / test coverage), each with severity (Blocker/Major/Minor/Suggestion), precise location, Go Bad/Good code samples, and fix guidance. A slim version for the PR comment box is included (Top-10 Blockers + merge path).

**Who it's for**: Backend tech leads, architects, TLs, and CTOs—especially those owning trading, payments, or order systems.
cases.prompt:
我有一个 3000+ 行变更的 PR（后端 Go 服务，订单模块核心逻辑 + 小规模数据库 schema 调整），请做全面代码审查。

要求：
- 从安全、性能、正确性、可维护性四个维度；
- 评估对现有架构的影响；
- 评估测试覆盖和用例充分性；
- 按严重度排序（Blocker / Major / Minor / Suggestion）；
- 每条意见给出具体位置、问题描述、修复建议。

输出完整《PR 审查报告》Markdown 文档 + 可直接贴到 PR 评论区的精简版。

cases.title: 转行简历诊断 62 分：有两年经历，为什么分数上不去
cases.title_en: Career-Change Resume at 62: Two Years of Experience, Still Stuck
cases.subtitle: 同一个人的两段项目经历，一段扎实一段空洞，把模块分拉了下来
cases.subtitle_en: Two projects by the same person — one solid, one hollow — dragging the module down
cases.description:
转行的人最容易犯的错是「用练手项目凑数量」——以为多写一条总没坏处，实际上一条没有指标的项目会把整个模块的评分拉下来。

本案例诊断一份机械转数据分析的简历：两年工作经历带来职场能力 4 分（高于应届样本），但经历描述维度只拿到 23/50，总分 62。案例逐条对比两段项目经历的描述特征与所属评分档位，并总结转行简历的三个结构性问题：岗位语言未翻译、自我评价全是形容词、培训经历只写「学过」。

适合：准备转行的求职者、简历有工作经历但投递效果差的人。
cases.description_en:
The classic career-changer mistake is padding with practice projects — assuming one more entry can't hurt, when a project without metrics drags the whole module's score down.

This case diagnoses a mechanical-engineering-to-data-analysis resume: two years of work earn a workplace-ability score of 4 (above the graduate sample), but the experience-description dimension scores just 23 of 50, totalling 62. It compares the two projects' descriptions and scoring bands side by side and identifies three structural problems: untranslated job vocabulary, an adjective-only self-evaluation, and training reduced to "I studied it".

For: career changers and anyone whose resume has experience but gets no responses.

artifacts.label: 62 分转行简历诊断报告

cases.prompt: 帮我诊断这份转行简历（内容见附件/粘贴）：机械专业本科，两年设备工程师经历，目标岗位是数据分析师，有两段项目经历、培训经历和自我评价。要求：1) 走完整诊断流程，给出六维总分和超过多少求职者；2) 列出五个确定性维度得分和各经历模块的描述评分；3) 逐条对比两段项目经历的描述特征，按官方评分 Rules 判断各自应落在哪个档位、为什么，并说明这对项目经历这个模块得分的影响（注意脚本只输出模块级分数，不出单条分数）；4) 列出所有未填字段和描述建议原文；5) 总结转行简历特有的结构性问题。
cases.prompt_en: Diagnose this career-change resume (attached/pasted): mechanical engineering bachelor's, two years as an equipment engineer, targeting a data-analyst role, with two projects, training and a self-evaluation. Requirements: 1) run the full diagnosis and give the six-dimension total and percentile beaten; 2) list the five deterministic dimension scores and the per-module description ratings; 3) compare the two projects, identifying which scoring band each falls in and why, and how that affects the module score; 4) list every unfilled field and reproduce each suggestion verbatim; 5) summarise the structural problems specific to career-change resumes.

cases.title: 年终述职报告生成
cases.subtitle: 输入年度工作要点，多 Agent 协作输出结构化述职报告
cases.description:
每到年底，写述职报告就成了所有人的噩梦——一年做了那么多事，不知道从哪写起；写出来要么像流水账，要么重点不突出，老板看完毫无印象。更怕的是交上去一份明显 AI 味的述职报告，那印象分直接归零。

这个案例演示了如何用「内容工厂」Skill 的多 Agent 协作模式来生成述职报告：Writer Agent 负责把零散要点组织成结构化长文，Editor Agent 做润色和去 AI 味，确保用词干净、数据突出、语气得体。两轮 Agent 接力，产出的报告既有逻辑又不空洞。

适合：所有需要写年终总结/述职报告的职场人，不限岗位和行业。

artifacts.label: 年终述职报告（多 Agent 协作生成）

cases.prompt:
帮我写一份年终述职报告。请用内容工厂的 Writer + Editor 双 Agent 模式：先由 Writer 生成结构化初稿，再由 Editor 润色并去 AI 味。

我的基本信息与年度工作（粘贴姓名、岗位、汇报对象，以及全年主要工作要点和明年计划）：
...

要求：
1. 按标准述职结构：年度总结 → 重点项目 → 数据成果 → 个人成长 → 明年规划
2. 数据要突出，用对比和百分比让成果可感知
3. 语气自信但不浮夸，去掉 AI 常见的空洞修饰
4. 控制在 1500 字左右
cases.prompt_en:
Help me write a year-end performance review. Please use the Content Factory's Writer + Editor dual-agent mode: first the Writer drafts a structured first version, then the Editor polishes it and removes the AI flavor.

My basic info and annual work (paste your name, role, who you report to, plus your main work highlights for the year and plans for next year):
...

Requirements:
1. Follow the standard review structure: Annual Summary → Key Projects → Data Results → Personal Growth → Next Year's Plan
2. Make the data stand out, using comparisons and percentages to make achievements tangible
3. Confident but not boastful tone, removing the empty modifiers AI commonly uses
4. Keep it to around 1,500 characters

cases.description_en:
Every year-end, writing the performance review becomes everyone's nightmare — a whole year of work and you don't know where to start; the result reads like a laundry list or buries key achievements so the boss has no impression. Even worse is submitting an obviously AI-written review — that's an instant zero on the impression score.

This case shows how the Content Factory Skill's multi-agent mode generates a performance review: the Writer Agent drafts structured content, the Editor Agent refines the narrative, and the Humanizer Agent removes AI traces — delivering a report that's structured, data-driven, and naturally written.

Best for: All professionals, managers, anyone who writes annual performance reviews.

cases.title: 商务英语写作润色
cases.subtitle: 去AI味的商务英语写作能力提升系统课程
cases.subtitle_en: AI-polished Business English Writing Skills Enhancement Course
cases.description:
在跨国公司工作，英语写作是绕不开的硬技能——写邮件怕语气不对、写报告不知道怎么组织、开完会纪要写得像流水账，更别提那些「中式英语」让老外一头雾水。

这个案例用去AI味技能生成了一份系统的商务英语写作课程大纲与核心教材，覆盖商务邮件（5 种场景 10 个模板）、会议纪要与备忘录规范、商务报告与提案框架（Executive Summary + SCQA 模型）、跨文化沟通要点、200 个高频商务词汇短语、20 个中式英语典型问题纠正，以及写作自检清单与评分标准。内容经过去AI味处理，语言自然流畅、不生硬。

适合：在跨国公司工作的中国职场人士、外贸从业者、需要提升英文写作能力的管理者、英语培训师。
cases.description_en:
Working in a multinational company, English writing is an essential hard skill — worrying about email tone, struggling to structure reports, and those 'Chinglish' expressions that confuse native speakers.

This case uses the humanizer skill to generate a comprehensive Business English writing course with natural, human-sounding language: covering business emails (5 scenarios with 10 templates), meeting minutes standards, business report frameworks (SCQA model), cross-cultural communication, 200 high-frequency phrases, 20 Chinglish corrections, and a self-check rubric.

Ideal for: Chinese professionals in multinationals, foreign trade practitioners, managers, and English trainers.

artifacts.label: 商务英语写作系统课程

cases.prompt: 帮我编写一份商务英语写作系统课程大纲与核心教材。面向需要在跨国公司工作的中国职场人士。需要包含：1）商务邮件写作（请求、回复、跟进、投诉、道歉 5 种场景各 2 个模板）；2）会议纪要与备忘录写作规范；3）商务报告与提案写作框架（Executive Summary、SCQA 模型）；4）跨文化沟通要点（直接 vs 间接表达、礼貌程度把控）；5）高频商务词汇与短语 200 个（按场景分类）；6）常见语法错误纠正（中式英语典型问题 20 个）；7）写作自检清单与评分标准。请用去AI味技能确保内容自然流畅，输出结构化 Markdown 课程文档。
cases.prompt_en: Help me write a comprehensive Business English writing course outline and core teaching materials. It targets Chinese professionals who need to work in multinational companies. It should include: 1) Business email writing (request, reply, follow-up, complaint, apology — 2 templates each for these 5 scenarios); 2) Standards for writing meeting minutes and memos; 3) Frameworks for business reports and proposals (Executive Summary, SCQA model); 4) Cross-cultural communication essentials (direct vs. indirect expression, calibrating levels of politeness); 5) 200 high-frequency business words and phrases (categorized by scenario); 6) Correction of common grammar mistakes (20 typical Chinglish problems); 7) A writing self-check list and scoring rubric. Please use the Humanizer skill to ensure the content reads naturally and fluently, and output a structured Markdown course document.

cases.title: 用户增长实验方案
cases.subtitle: 数据驱动的 AB 测试增长实验全流程方案
cases.subtitle_en: Data-driven AB testing growth experiment playbook
cases.description:
用户增长不是靠「拍脑袋」——没有系统化的实验框架，增长团队容易陷入盲目尝试、无法复现成功的困境。实验设计不严谨导致结论不可信，缺乏优先级排序让团队资源被低价值实验消耗。

本案例为一款日活 50 万的在线教育 App 制定完整的增长实验方案。从当前增长漏斗瓶颈分析出发，设计 5 个覆盖注册→激活→留存→付费→推荐全链路的增长实验，每个实验包含假设、方案、AB 测试设计、核心指标、ICE 评分。附带实验排期甘特图、数据埋点方案和决策框架，形成一套可落地执行的增长实验 SOP。

适合增长产品经理、用户运营负责人、数据分析师，以及任何希望用科学方法驱动用户增长的互联网团队。
cases.description_en: User growth requires systematic experimentation, not guesswork. This case creates a complete growth experiment plan for an education app with 500K DAU, covering funnel analysis, 5 structured AB test designs with ICE scoring, experiment timelines, event tracking specs, and decision frameworks.
cases.prompt: 请为一款日活 50 万的在线教育 App 制定一份用户增长实验方案。包含：1) 当前增长漏斗分析（注册→激活→留存→付费→推荐各环节转化率和瓶颈）；2) 5 个增长实验设计（每个包含假设、实验方案、AB测试设计、核心指标、预期提升、优先级评分ICE）；3) 实验排期甘特图（文字版）；4) 数据埋点方案（关键事件和属性定义）；5) 成功标准和决策框架。5个实验覆盖：新用户引导优化、分享裂变机制、Push通知策略、付费转化页改版、老用户召回。
cases.prompt_en: Please create a user-growth experiment plan for an online education App with 500,000 daily active users. It should include: 1) An analysis of the current growth funnel (the conversion rates and bottlenecks at each stage: registration→activation→retention→payment→referral); 2) 5 growth experiment designs (each containing a hypothesis, the experiment plan, A/B test design, core metrics, expected lift, and an ICE priority score); 3) An experiment schedule Gantt chart (text version); 4) A data tracking plan (definitions of key events and properties); 5) Success criteria and a decision framework. The 5 experiments should cover: new-user onboarding optimization, a share/viral mechanism, Push notification strategy, a redesign of the payment conversion page, and reactivation of lapsed users.

cases.title: 站内AI助手完整评审
cases.subtitle: 产品+安全+QA+设计四线协同 Go/No-Go 评估
cases.subtitle_en: A four-track Go/No-Go review across product, security, QA, and design
cases.description:
很多 SaaS 团队在做站内 AI 助手时，最容易踩的坑不是“模型不够聪明”，而是需求边界不清、安全默认松、上线门禁不完整——结果功能看起来很先进，实际一上线就面临越权查数、引用不可信、回滚无抓手等问题。

本案例演示 GStack 工程团队如何围绕一个“用户自然语言提问、AI 查询内部数据并给出答案”的 SaaS 新功能，拆成 CEO/设计/工程/DX 四份产品评审、OWASP + STRIDE 双视角安全审计、QA 测试与 Canary 方案、设计系统与交互评审，最终汇总成一份可直接用于立项和上线门禁讨论的完整 Markdown 报告。

适合：SaaS 产品经理、技术负责人、安全负责人、QA Lead、设计负责人，以及任何正在规划 AI Copilot / AI 助手功能的团队。
cases.description_en:
When SaaS teams build an in-app AI assistant, the real trap is usually not 'the model is not smart enough'—it is unclear scope, weak default security, and missing launch gates. The result is a feature that looks advanced in demos but quickly runs into data overreach, unverifiable citations, and poor rollback readiness in production.

This case shows how the GStack engineering team reviews a SaaS feature where users ask natural-language questions and AI queries internal data to answer them. The workflow combines four product reviews (CEO / Design / Engineering / DX), dual-track security analysis (OWASP + STRIDE), a QA and Canary release plan, and a design-system-level interaction review, then consolidates everything into one Markdown report ready for planning and launch discussions.

Best for SaaS product managers, engineering leads, security owners, QA leads, design leads, and teams planning an AI copilot or in-app AI assistant capability.

artifacts.label: 站内 AI 助手完整评审报告

cases.prompt:
要做一个新功能"站内 AI 助手"（SaaS 产品内，用户自然语言提问、AI 查询内部数据并给出答案）。PRD 草稿已有，请做一次完整评审：
- 产品评审：CEO（商业价值）、设计（体验）、工程（复杂度）、DX（开发者体验）四份独立评审；
- 安全审计：OWASP + STRIDE 双视角评估（Prompt 注入、数据泄露、权限越界等）；
- QA 策略：测试计划、自动化覆盖建议、Canary 发布方案；
- 设计评审：视觉稿和交互是否符合设计系统、有无可改进变体。

输出《站内 AI 助手功能完整评审报告》Markdown，按不同评审员分段署名，每段给出明确可改进项与 Go/No-Go 建议。

cases.title: 家庭装修预算清单
cases.subtitle: 100㎡ 住宅装修全流程预算管控，实时追踪每笔开支
cases.subtitle_en: Full renovation budget tracking for a 100sqm apartment with real-time expense monitoring
cases.description:
装修是大多数家庭最大的非房产支出，却也是最容易超预算的项目。拆改多花了、水电走多了、瓷砖补货了、定制柜加钱了……每一个环节都可能冒出预算外的开销。没有一份清晰的预算表，装修到一半才发现钱不够用，是无数业主的噩梦。

这个案例生成一份专业级的装修预算管控 Excel：涵盖拆改、水电、地面、墙面、厨房、卫浴、家具、家电、软装、应急预备金共 10 大类，每类下设具体明细项（材料+人工），标注预算金额、实际花费、差异、供应商、施工状态。自动计算各类小计和总预算偏差，配有汇总看板快速掌握整体进度。

适合：即将装修或正在装修的业主、室内设计师、装修项目经理、需要控制家装预算的家庭。
cases.description_en:
Renovation is the biggest non-property expense for most families, and also the easiest to overshoot. Demolition costs more, electrical runs longer, tiles need reordering, custom cabinets get marked up — every phase can spawn unexpected expenses. Without a clear budget tracker, running out of money mid-renovation is every homeowner's nightmare.

This case generates a professional-grade renovation budget Excel: covering 10 major categories (demolition, water/electric, flooring, walls, kitchen, bathroom, furniture, appliances, soft furnishing, contingency), each with detailed line items (materials + labor), tracking estimated cost, actual cost, variance, vendor, and status. Auto-calculates subtotals and total budget deviation, with a summary dashboard for at-a-glance progress.

Best for: Homeowners preparing for or in the middle of renovation, interior designers, renovation project managers, families needing to control home improvement budgets.
cases.prompt:
请为一套 100㎡ 住宅装修项目生成一份完整的预算管控 Excel 表格。

装修信息：100㎡（实用约 78㎡），现代简约，中等偏上档次，一线城市行情。（可替换为你的房屋信息）

Sheet 1 预算明细：分 10 大类——拆改、水电、地面、墙面、厨房、卫浴、家具、家电、软装、应急预备金；每类含具体明细项，列出项目名称、规格、数量、单价、预算金额、实际金额、差异、供应商、状态等字段。

Sheet 2 汇总看板：各大类预算 vs 实际对比、总预算/已支出/剩余/超支、各类完成进度、按状态统计。

表格要求：超支/节余用条件格式区分，状态列下拉选择，自动汇总公式，金额填入合理参考价格。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a complete budget-control Excel spreadsheet for the renovation of a 100㎡ residence.

Renovation info: 100㎡ (usable area ~78㎡), modern minimalist, mid-to-high tier, tier-1 city pricing. (Replace with your own home info.)

Sheet 1 Budget Details: 10 major categories — demolition, plumbing & electrical, flooring, walls, kitchen, bathroom, furniture, appliances, soft furnishings, contingency reserve; each with specific line items, listing fields such as item name, specification, quantity, unit price, budgeted amount, actual amount, variance, vendor, status.

Sheet 2 Summary Dashboard: budget vs. actual per category, total budget/spent/remaining/over-budget, completion progress per category, counts by status.

Spreadsheet requirements: use conditional formatting for over-budget/savings, a dropdown for the status column, auto-summing formulas, and fill in reasonable reference prices.

skills.name: Excel 文件处理
skills.description: Excel 文件处理（.xlsx, .csv, .tsv）

cases.title: 每周膳食规划表
cases.subtitle: 一键生成全家一周三餐计划，含食材清单与营养摘要
cases.subtitle_en: Generate a full family weekly meal plan with grocery list and nutritional summary
cases.description:
每周想吃什么？这个问题困扰着无数家庭。工作日下班后站在菜市场发呆，周末打开冰箱不知道买什么，临时凑合导致营养不均衡、花销超预算。更头疼的是三口之家众口难调，荤素搭配、营养均衡全靠脑子记，经常顾此失彼。

这个案例生成一份完整的家庭周餐规划表：7天×3餐的详细菜单（菜名、食材、热量、准备时间），覆盖中式家常菜的丰富搭配。自动汇总每日营养摘要（热量、蛋白质、碳水、脂肪），并按蔬菜、肉蛋、乳制品、主食、调味品分类生成采购清单，标注预估用量和价格。一表在手，全周不愁。

适合：家庭主妇/主夫、注重健康饮食的上班族、需要控制饮食的健身人群、想省时省钱的小家庭。
cases.description_en:
What to eat this week? This question plagues countless families. Standing blankly at the market after work, opening the fridge on weekends with no plan, improvising meals that end up nutritionally imbalanced and over budget. It's even harder for a family of three with different preferences — balancing meat and vegetables, ensuring nutrition, all from memory.

This case generates a complete family weekly meal plan: 7 days × 3 meals with detailed menus (dish name, ingredients, calories, prep time), covering rich combinations of Chinese home cooking. Auto-summarizes daily nutrition (calories, protein, carbs, fat) and generates a categorized grocery shopping list (vegetables, protein, dairy, staples, condiments) with estimated quantities and prices. One spreadsheet, zero stress for the whole week.

Best for: Homemakers, health-conscious office workers, fitness enthusiasts managing diets, small families looking to save time and money.
cases.prompt:
请为一个三口之家（两位成人 + 一位 8 岁儿童）设计一份完整的一周膳食规划 Excel。

要求：
1. Sheet 1 周餐计划：周一到周日共 7 天、每天早 / 午 / 晚 3 餐；以中式家常菜为主、荤素搭配合理；每餐含菜名、主要食材、估算热量（kcal/人均）、准备时间；每天底部汇总人均热量、蛋白质、碳水、脂肪
2. Sheet 2 采购清单：按蔬菜 / 肉蛋 / 乳制品 / 主食 / 调味品分类汇总全周食材，含预估用量、参考单价、小计，底部汇总全周总预算
3. Sheet 3 营养摘要：7 天每日热量与三大营养素汇总、周均值，并与中国居民膳食指南推荐量对比

不同颜色区分早 / 午 / 晚餐，热量超标 / 达标分别标色。输出为 Excel 文件。
cases.prompt_en:
Please design a complete one-week meal plan Excel for a family of three (two adults + one 8-year-old child).

Requirements:
1. Sheet 1 Weekly Meal Plan: Monday through Sunday (7 days), 3 meals each (breakfast/lunch/dinner); mainly Chinese home cooking with a reasonable meat-and-veg balance; each meal includes dish name, main ingredients, estimated calories (kcal per person), and prep time; at the bottom of each day, summarize per-person calories, protein, carbs, and fat
2. Sheet 2 Shopping List: summarize the whole week's ingredients by category (vegetables / meat & eggs / dairy / staples / seasonings), with estimated quantity, reference unit price, and subtotal; total weekly budget at the bottom
3. Sheet 3 Nutrition Summary: a daily summary of calories and the three macronutrients across 7 days, weekly averages, and a comparison with the Dietary Guidelines for Chinese Residents

Use different colors to distinguish breakfast / lunch / dinner, and color-code calories over vs. within target. Output as an Excel file.

cases.title: NestJS 单元测试实战模板
cases.subtitle: Service + Controller 的 Jest 测试全覆盖方案
cases.subtitle_en: Full Jest test coverage for Service + Controller layers
cases.description:
NestJS 项目测试覆盖率低，mock 写法五花八门，新人不知道怎么测 Guard 和 Pipe？用全栈开发技能生成用户模块的完整 Jest 测试模板，覆盖 Service CRUD、密码加密、Controller 路由、权限守卫、DTO 校验，附带 mock 策略和命名规范。

本案例演示了 fullstack-dev 如何为 NestJS 用户模块生成一套完整的测试方案：包含 UserService 的 CRUD 操作测试（含边界情况）、密码加密验证、UserController 的路由测试、AuthGuard 权限守卫测试、ValidationPipe DTO 校验测试，以及 Repository 和外部服务的 mock 策略。

适合：NestJS 开发者、后端工程师、技术 Lead。
cases.description_en:
NestJS project has low test coverage with inconsistent mock patterns? Use the fullstack-dev skill to generate complete Jest test templates for a user module covering Service CRUD, password hashing, Controller routes, Guards, and DTO validation.

This case demonstrates how fullstack-dev generates a comprehensive test suite for a NestJS user module: including CRUD operation tests with edge cases, password hashing verification, route tests, AuthGuard tests, ValidationPipe tests, and mock strategies for repositories and external services.

Perfect for NestJS devs and tech leads.

artifacts.label: NestJS单元测试模板

cases.prompt: 帮我为一个 NestJS 项目的用户模块编写完整的 Jest 单元测试。覆盖 UserService（CRUD + 密码加密 + 邮箱验证）和 UserController（路由 + 权限守卫 + DTO 校验）。包含：mock 策略（Repository/外部服务）、测试工厂函数、边界情况覆盖、覆盖率配置、测试命名规范。请用全栈开发技能输出包含完整代码的 Markdown 文档。
cases.prompt_en: Help me write complete Jest unit tests for the user module of a NestJS project. Cover UserService (CRUD + password encryption + email verification) and UserController (routes + auth guards + DTO validation). Include: a mocking strategy (Repository / external services), test factory functions, edge-case coverage, coverage configuration, and test-naming conventions. Please use full-stack development skills to output a Markdown document containing complete code.

skills.name: 全栈开发
skills.description: 全栈应用架构与开发指南

cases.title: 简历优化：46 分改到能过筛
cases.subtitle: 接住诊断建议，用 STAR 和量化逐段改写对照
cases.subtitle_en: Take the diagnosis and rewrite section by section with STAR and metrics
cases.description:
诊断告诉你哪里不行，优化要给出「改成什么样」。两步接起来才是完整闭环。

本案例接住简历诊断的 3 条改进建议，逐段给出优化前后对照：实习经历补上量化结果（评分从 41–70 档升 71–90 档的分界线）、实践经历写清具体环节、自我评价用事实替换形容词，并附银行网申的三条通用规则。所有示例数字标注为占位，不替虚构人物编造经历。

适合：简历写了但总过不了筛的学生、指导改简历的老师。
cases.description_en:
Diagnosis says what's wrong; polishing must show what "fixed" looks like. Only together do they close the loop.

This case picks up the three diagnosis suggestions and shows before/after rewrites: internship experience gains quantified results (the very boundary between the 41–70 and 71–90 scoring bands), campus practice states concrete duties, self-evaluation swaps adjectives for facts — plus three universal rules for bank applications. Every example figure is marked as a placeholder; nothing is fabricated for the fictional persona.

For: students whose resumes keep failing screens and the teachers coaching them.

artifacts.label: STAR 改写前后对照

cases.prompt: 基于刚才的诊断结果帮我优化简历（如果没有前置诊断，直接上传简历或粘贴要优化的段落也可以）。要求：1) 针对每条 DESCRIPTION_SUGGEST 建议给出优化前后对照；2) 用 STAR 法则改写经历段，量化结果用占位数字并提醒我替换成真实数据，不许编造经历；3) 自我评价改成「特质+事实支撑」结构；4) 附目标行业网申的通用规则。
cases.prompt_en: Polish my resume based on the diagnosis just produced (if there is no prior diagnosis, uploading the resume or pasting the paragraphs to improve works too). Requirements: 1) give a before/after rewrite for every DESCRIPTION_SUGGEST item; 2) restructure experience sections with STAR, using placeholder metrics and reminding me to substitute real figures — never fabricate experience; 3) rewrite the self-evaluation as trait-plus-evidence; 4) append universal rules for my target industry's online applications.

skills.description: 两阶段追问与优化交互，整份优化生成 HTML

cases.title: 简历改写：面向目标岗位的定向重写
cases.title_en: Resume Rewriting: Targeted at a Specific Role
cases.subtitle: 先反问三个问题补齐数字，再按目标岗位的语言重组结构
cases.subtitle_en: Three questions to fill in the numbers, then a rebuild in the target role's language
cases.description:
改简历最常见的失败是「越改越空」——把动词换成更漂亮的动词，但该有的数字还是没有，岗位相关性也没提升。

本案例完整跑通两阶段改写流程：先按目标岗位反问三个填空式问题把量化结果补齐，再用第二段 Prompt 把同一批事实按「关键词：具体描述 + 结果数值」重组。案例展示改写前后对照，并明确指出五处数字全部来自考生自己的回答，没有新增任何事实。

适合：投递特定岗位前想做定向优化的求职者、经历写不出数字的人。
cases.description_en:
The usual way resume editing fails is that it gets emptier — verbs get prettier while the numbers stay missing and relevance doesn't improve.

This case runs the full two-stage rewrite: three fill-in-the-blank questions framed by the target role surface the missing quantities, then a second prompt rebuilds the same facts as "keyword: specific description plus result". It shows a before-and-after comparison and states plainly that all five figures come from the candidate's own answers — nothing was invented.

For: applicants tailoring a resume to a specific role, and anyone struggling to put numbers on their experience.

artifacts.label: 两阶段定向简历改写全过程

cases.prompt: 帮我把这段工作经历改写成适合投「数据分析师（制造业方向）」的版本。原文是：「负责车间设备的日常点检、故障排除和维护保养，参与设备技术改造项目，配合生产部门保障产线正常运行，编写设备台账和维修记录，协助部门经理完成月度设备管理报表。」公司是安徽晟远精密制造有限公司，部门设备保障部，岗位设备工程师。要求：1) 先按目标岗位向我提出 3 个填空式的追问，把缺失的量化结果问出来；2) 我回答后，按目标岗位的语言重组这段经历，结构为分条职责 + 一句工作收获；3) 同时给出目标岗位的核心职责说明和具体的优化建议；4) 改写只能使用我提供的事实和回答，不得编造任何新经历或数字。
cases.prompt_en: Rewrite this work experience for a "data analyst (manufacturing)" application. Original: "Responsible for daily equipment inspection, fault clearance and maintenance in the workshop; participated in equipment upgrade projects; supported production in keeping lines running; maintained equipment ledgers and repair records; assisted the department manager with monthly equipment management reports." Company: Anhui Shengyuan Precision Manufacturing; department: Equipment Assurance; role: equipment engineer. Requirements: 1) first ask me three fill-in-the-blank questions, framed by the target role, to surface the missing quantitative results; 2) once I answer, rebuild the experience in the target role's language as itemised responsibilities plus a closing takeaway; 3) also give the target role's core responsibilities and specific improvement advice; 4) use only the facts and answers I provide — invent no new experience or figures.

skills.name: 简历 AI 帮你写
skills.description: 两阶段追问与优化交互，按目标岗位定向改写简历内容

cases.title: 开源项目选型调研报告
cases.subtitle: 多维度对比分析，助力技术选型决策
cases.subtitle_en: Multi-dimensional comparison analysis for technology selection decisions
cases.description:
技术选型是每个开发团队都会面临的关键决策，错误的选择可能导致后期大量的重构成本和技术债务。面对生态中层出不穷的开源方案，如何系统性地评估和比较成为一大痛点。

本案例演示了如何利用 AI 快速生成一份专业的前端状态管理库选型调研报告，覆盖 Redux Toolkit、Zustand、Jotai、Valtio、MobX 五大主流方案。报告从基本信息、技术架构、性能表现、开发体验、社区生态五个维度进行深度对比，并给出量化评分矩阵和推荐结论。

适合前端技术负责人、架构师、技术经理以及需要做技术选型决策的开发团队使用。同样的方法论可迁移到任何开源项目选型场景（数据库、框架、工具链等）。
cases.description_en:
Technology selection is a critical decision every development team faces. Wrong choices can lead to costly refactoring and technical debt.

This case demonstrates using AI to quickly generate a professional evaluation report comparing five major frontend state management libraries: Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Jotai, Valtio, and MobX across multiple dimensions.

Ideal for frontend tech leads, architects, and development teams making technology selection decisions.
cases.prompt: 请为我的团队做一份前端状态管理库选型调研报告。候选方案：Redux Toolkit、Zustand、Jotai、Valtio、MobX。评估维度：1) 基本信息（GitHub stars/npm 周下载/最新版本/维护活跃度）；2) 技术架构（设计理念/数据流模型/TypeScript 支持）；3) 性能对比（Bundle size/渲染优化策略/大数据量表现）；4) 开发体验（学习曲线/模板代码量/DevTools 支持/中间件生态）；5) 社区生态（文档质量/教程资源/Stack Overflow 问答数/企业采用案例）；6) 适用场景推荐。最终给出评分矩阵和推荐结论。
cases.prompt_en: Please produce a technology-selection research report for frontend state-management libraries for my team. Candidates: Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Jotai, Valtio, MobX. Evaluation dimensions: 1) basic info (GitHub stars / weekly npm downloads / latest version / maintenance activity); 2) technical architecture (design philosophy / data-flow model / TypeScript support); 3) performance comparison (bundle size / render-optimization strategy / performance with large data volumes); 4) developer experience (learning curve / amount of boilerplate / DevTools support / middleware ecosystem); 5) community ecosystem (documentation quality / tutorial resources / number of Stack Overflow Q&As / enterprise adoption cases); 6) recommended use-case scenarios. Finally, provide a scoring matrix and a recommended conclusion.

artifacts.label: 选型调研报告

cases.title: 商业综合体施工图设计说明
cases.subtitle: 6.8 万 ㎡ 商业综合体·合规施工图文档一键生成
cases.subtitle_en: One-click generation of a 68,000 sqm commercial complex construction drawing specification
cases.description:
建筑施工图设计说明写起来规范多、条款引用繁、动辄上百页，项目组常为「GB50016 到底是哪一版」「防火分区面积怎么写」「节能参数引用哪一条」反复返工，手写 2-3 周是常态。

本案例由 openspec-doc-team 专家团（总编辑·章成文 + 检索·苏寻源 + 撰写·支笔生 + 审核·严审之）协作产出一份 7.3 万字、8 章完整、附录齐全的《XX 市城东新区商业综合体项目施工图设计说明》，覆盖工程概况、设计依据、建筑/结构/机电设计、消防疏散、节能绿建、施工注意事项，每一条规范引用都标注了条款层级与生效日期。

适合甲方项目经理、施工图设计院、建筑设计师、项目总包把 AI 作为「合规初稿 + 条款自查」助手使用——AI 出初稿，专业人员复核签字，把 2 周的枯燥工作压缩到 1 天。
cases.description_en:
Writing construction drawing specifications is painful: endless code citations, hundreds of pages, and the same questions asked again and again ("Which GB50016 edition?" "How to format fire zoning?" "Which energy clause to cite?"). Manual drafting typically takes 2-3 weeks.

This case uses the openspec-doc-team expert team (Editor-in-Chief + Researcher + Generator + Auditor, 4 roles working in SOP) to produce a 73K-character, 8-chapter specification for a commercial complex project. It covers project overview, design basis, architectural/structural/MEP design, fire safety, energy/green building, and construction notes, with every code citation labeled with clause level and effective date.

Ideal for project managers, design institutes, and general contractors who want AI to act as a compliance-draft assistant: AI writes the first pass, professionals review and sign off, compressing two weeks of tedium into a single day.

artifacts.label: 施工图设计说明

cases.prompt:
请生成《XX 市城东新区商业综合体项目施工图设计说明》，面向甲方和施工单位，符合国家现行建筑设计规范（GB50016、GB50009、GB50011 等）。

项目信息：5 层商业综合体、地下 2 层、总建筑面积 6.8 万平方米、抗震设防烈度 7 度、年降水量 1200mm。

交付完整 Markdown 长文档，章节至少包含：
1. 工程概况  2. 设计依据（标注具体规范条款和生效日期）  3. 建筑设计（平面、立面、剖面、防火分区）  4. 结构设计  5. 给排水/电气/暖通主要设计要点  6. 消防与疏散  7. 节能与绿建  8. 施工注意事项

每条引用的规范都要标明出处、层级和生效日期。
cases.prompt_en:

cases.subtitle_en: 68,000 sqm complex · Live GB code retrieval + 6-dim audit loop + 2024 updated codes
cases.description:
建筑施工图设计说明最大的坑是「AI 编造规范条款」——模型凭印象写 GB 50016 某条，但条文编号、年版、强制/推荐属性全错，施工图审查一眼打回。传统 AI 生成长文档在这个场景完全失效。

本案例用 openspec-doc-team 4 成员专家团（章成文总编辑 + 苏寻源文献检索员 + 支笔生内容生成员 + 严审之质量审核员）走完 6 阶段严格工作流：Phase 1 需求分析 → Phase 2 联网检索（WebSearch 真实拿到 40 部 GB/JGJ 条款 + 住建部公告 URL）→ Phase 3 结构化撰写 → Phase 4 6 维审核（逻辑/规范/参数/完整/格式/跨章一致性）→ Phase 5 整合汇编 → Phase 6 交付。前 3 章（工程概况/设计依据/建筑设计）每章经至少 1 轮审核修订闭环，审核员独立发现 5 项硬伤（GB 5.7.2 条号错位、GB 50067 第 4.1.13 条误引、JGJ 48-2014 强条漏标、跨章门禁 3 部规范遗漏、注 2 论证跳跃），全部修复后 PASS。

最值得学习的 3 个亮点：
1. **2024 新版规范自动发现**——检索员联网查到 GB 50010/50011/50034/50378 四部规范 2024 年已升级为 GB/T 并改名「标准」，附住建部公告 2024 年第 62 号；传统 AI 仍用 2015/2016 老版
2. **防火分区双分支写法**——建筑高度 [待填写]（横跨 24m 分界线），采用「若 h≤24m... / 若 h>24m...」双分支让甲方实测后锁定，而非武断取值
3. **前向补丁清单（PENDING_CH02_SUPPLEMENTS.md）**——后章节发现第 2 章规范清单缺项时不立即回修（避免定稿反复污染），登记到清单待 Phase 5 一次性回补

适合设计院、建筑事务所、合规文档经理、AI 工程文档产品负责人学习「AI 生成规范合规文档」的真实工程级做法。
cases.description_en:
The biggest pitfall for AI-generated construction specs: the model 'hallucinates' code clauses. It writes 'GB 50016 clause X' from vague memory, but the clause number, year version, mandatory/recommended status are all wrong — instant rejection at drawing review.

This case uses openspec-doc-team (4 roles: Editor-in-Chief + Literature Researcher + Content Writer + Quality Auditor) running a 6-phase rigorous workflow: Phase 1 requirement analysis → Phase 2 live retrieval (WebSearch fetched 40 real GB/JGJ clauses + MOHURD announcement URLs) → Phase 3 structured writing → Phase 4 6-dim audit (logic / code / params / completeness / format / cross-chapter) → Phase 5 integration → Phase 6 delivery. First 3 chapters each went through 1+ audit-revise loops, auditor independently caught 5 hard errors (GB 5.7.2 clause mis-reference, GB 50067 Art 4.1.13 wrong citation, JGJ 48-2014 mandatory clause un-flagged, cross-chapter gate 3 missing codes, note 2 logical gap), all fixed before PASS.

3 most valuable takeaways:
1. **Auto-discovery of 2024 updated codes** — researcher retrieved that GB 50010/50011/50034/50378 were all upgraded to GB/T and renamed 'Standard' in 2024 with MOHURD Announcement No.62; traditional AI still cites 2015/2016 versions
2. **Fire-zone dual-branch writing** — building height [TBD] straddles 24m boundary, so use 'if h≤24m... / if h>24m...' dual-branch letting owner lock after measurement, not arbitrary choice
3. **Forward patch registry (PENDING_CH02_SUPPLEMENTS.md)** — when later chapters find Chapter 2 spec list missing items, don't immediately rework (avoid repeated contamination), register and batch-fix in Phase 5

Ideal for design institutes, architectural firms, compliance document managers, and AI engineering document product leads learning real engineering-grade AI spec generation.

背景：CloudDesk 是企业协作办公 SaaS，提供基础版（免费）、专业版（¥99/月/席位）、企业版（¥299/月/席位）；当前付费客户约 2400 家，Q1 流失率从 6.5% 升至 8.2%，净流失 MRR 达 ¥380K，管理层高度关注。

1. 流失概览：月度趋势、各版本流失率对比
2. 流失用户画像：按企业规模、行业、获客渠道
3. 行为特征：登录频率、功能使用深度、工单提交等
4. 流失原因归因：各类因素占比
5. 预警模型：流失风险评分卡
6. 挽回策略：按风险等级分层执行方案
7. 预计 ROI：挽回投入产出比测算

要求：使用具体数据和表格，给出可直接执行的策略建议。
cases.prompt_en:
Please help me do a comprehensive data analysis of customer churn for the SaaS product CloudDesk.

Background: CloudDesk is an enterprise collaboration SaaS offering Basic (free), Pro (¥99/month/seat), and Enterprise (¥299/month/seat); it currently has ~2,400 paying customers, and the Q1 churn rate rose from 6.5% to 8.2%, with net churned MRR reaching ¥380K, which management is very concerned about.

Please analyze along these dimensions:
1. Churn overview: monthly trends, churn-rate comparison across tiers
2. Churned-user profile: by company size, industry, and acquisition channel
3. Behavioral signals: login frequency, depth of feature usage, ticket submissions, etc.
4. Churn-cause attribution: the share of each factor
5. Early-warning model: a churn-risk scorecard
6. Win-back strategies: a tiered execution plan by risk level
7. Projected ROI: an estimate of the input-to-output ratio for win-back

Requirements: use concrete data and tables; provide directly actionable strategy recommendations.

收藏了上千篇文章、记了几百条笔记，真正要用的时候翻遍全网也找不到？你缺的不是更好的工具，而是一套体系化的知识管理方法。

cases.description:
面试评分全凭感觉？面试官各问各的，评分标准不统一，面完了才发现没法横向比较候选人——这是大多数团队招聘中的真实痛点。

这个案例演示了如何用 AI 一键生成一份高级前端工程师（P6/P7）结构化面试评估表 Excel。覆盖技术能力、系统设计、编码能力、沟通协作、学习成长、文化匹配 6 大维度共 20+ 评估子项，每项配有详细评分标准（1-5分）和自动加权计算，底部自动汇总综合得分并输出录用建议。

适合：HR、招聘负责人、技术面试官、团队 Leader、任何需要组织标准化面试的人。
cases.description_en:
Hiring decisions fall apart when interviewers rely on gut feelings: everyone asks different questions, scoring is inconsistent, and comparing candidates afterward is nearly impossible — leading to missed talent or bad hires.

This case shows how AI generates a complete structured interview evaluation Excel for a Senior Frontend Engineer (P6/P7) position. It covers 6 dimensions (Technical Skills, System Design, Coding Ability, Communication, Learning Growth, Culture Fit) with 20+ evaluation items, each with detailed scoring rubrics (1-5 scale) and auto-weighted calculations, plus a summary section with automatic hiring recommendations.

Best for: HR professionals, hiring managers, technical interviewers, team leads, anyone running standardized interviews.

cases.prompt:
请帮我创建一份专业的面试评估表 Excel。

场景：招聘高级前端工程师（P6/P7），需要一份标准化面试评估表供面试官打分。

要求：
1. Sheet 1「面试评估表」：顶部候选人基本信息区（姓名、岗位、面试日期、轮次、面试官）；6 个评估维度（技术能力、系统设计、编码能力、沟通协作、学习成长、文化匹配），每维度含子项、1-5 评分、权重、加权得分、评语；底部综合评分（自动加权）+ 录用建议 + 面试官签名

Please help me create a professional interview evaluation Excel file.

Sheet 1 "Interview Evaluation Sheet": a top candidate info area (name, position, interview date, round, interviewer); 6 evaluation dimensions (technical skills, system design, coding ability, communication, learning & growth, culture fit), each with sub-items, a 1-5 score, weight, weighted score, and comments; at the bottom a composite score (auto-weighted) + hiring recommendation + interviewer signature

This case demonstrates how to use the market-researcher skill to produce a comprehensive patent landscape analysis report for the large language model domain: covering 2020-2025 global filing trends, Top 10 applicant rankings, patent distribution across six core technical fields, 10 high-citation patent summaries, regional distribution comparison, white space identification, and enterprise patent strategy recommendations.

cases.description:
**痛点**：线上出了 P0 事故，所有人要答案：什么级别？影响多少用户/GMV？为什么出事？谁负责？后续怎么防？复盘报告写得好不好直接决定「这事过不过得去」。

**演示内容**：工程保障团队交付一份可直接发给 CTO 和合作方的完整事故复盘包，含：SEV-1 评级依据、影响面 6 项量化（12.5 万用户 / 8.2 万失败单 / ¥520 万 GMV 损失）、带责任人的 21 节点完整时间线、5 Why 根因分析（直接根因 + 系统性 + 组织）、受影响用户 SQL 统计模板、对外沟通双模板（C 端 + 合作方）、11 项行动项（P0/P1/P2 分级 + Owner + DDL + 验收标准）、长期防御措施四大类。额外附给领导汇报用的 HTML 精简版。

**适用人群**：SRE、业务 TL、架构师、CTO，以及所有可能面对 P0 的团队。
cases.description_en:
**Pain point**: When a P0 incident hits, everyone wants answers fast: what severity? How many users and how much GMV impacted? Root cause? Who owns the fix? A good postmortem often decides whether the team 'survives' the incident politically.

**What this case shows**: The engineering assurance team delivers a CTO-ready postmortem package: SEV-1 grading rationale, 6 quantified impact metrics (125K users / 82K failed transactions / ¥5.2M GMV loss), 21-node timeline with owners, 5-Why analysis (immediate + systemic + organizational), SQL templates for user/transaction counting, external communication templates (C-end + partners), 11 action items across P0/P1/P2 with Owner + DDL + acceptance criteria, plus an HTML exec-summary for leadership.

**Who it's for**: SREs, business TLs, architects, CTOs—anyone who may face a P0.
cases.prompt:

1. SEV 评级与影响面量化
2. 完整时间线（告警触发、定位、处置、恢复每个关键节点）

6. 行动项清单（Owner + DDL + 验收标准）

2. A complete timeline (each key node: alert triggering, diagnosis, remediation, recovery)
3. 5 Whys root cause analysis
4. Methodology for counting affected users / transactions / amounts
5. External communication templates (one each for customers and partners)
6. Action item list (Owner + DDL + acceptance criteria)
7. Long-term defensive measure recommendations

银行面试里那些「你希望什么福利」「怎么对待批评」的问题，看起来像闲聊，答起来最容易翻车——因为考官在用低压力的题面反复测同一组底层特质。

本案例按「银行 / 客户经理」真实抽 3 题，三题都同时考核言语表达和价值观念/个性特征，只有第三个维度不同。案例给出每题全文、完整评分标准，并逐题拆解真正的考点在哪。

适合：准备银行秋招面试的应届生、觉得行为面试题「没什么可答」的人。
cases.description_en:
Bank interview questions like "what benefits matter to you" and "how do you handle criticism" sound like small talk and are the easiest to fail — because the panel is using low-pressure prompts to test the same underlying traits repeatedly.

This case draws three real questions for "bank / relationship manager". All three assess verbal expression and values/disposition, differing only in the third dimension. It gives each question in full with its complete rubric and unpacks what is really being tested.

For: graduates preparing for bank recruitment and anyone who finds behavioural questions hard to answer substantively.

cases.title: PRD 引导式生成教练
cases.subtitle: 从一句话想法到评审级 PRD，AI 帮你诊断盲区、补全需求
cases.subtitle_en: From a one-line idea to a review-ready PRD, AI diagnoses blind spots and fills gaps
cases.description:
写 PRD 最怕的不是格式不对，而是一开始就漏了关键问题——用户角色没想清楚、异常流没覆盖、业务目标模糊。等评审时才被挑出来，改起来比重写还痛苦。

这个案例以「团队内部知识共享平台」为想法起点，演示了内容工厂如何像一位资深产品教练那样工作：先做诊断扫描（哪些已知、哪些未知、哪些假设有风险），然后逐步引导补全信息，最后才输出完整 PRD——包含问题定义、用户角色、核心场景、功能需求、信息架构、边界场景、数据依赖和风险清单。

适合：产品经理（尤其是独立负责模块的）、创业团队、产品实习生、任何需要把模糊想法变成可评审文档的人。
cases.description_en:
The scariest part of writing a PRD isn't formatting — it's missing critical issues from the start: user roles not thought through, edge cases not covered, business objectives unclear. When reviewers catch them, reworking is worse than rewriting.

Using "Internal Team Knowledge Sharing Platform" as the starting idea, this case shows how content-factory works like a senior product coach: first running a diagnostic scan (what's known, unknown, and risky), then systematically guiding requirement refinement until delivering a review-grade PRD.

Best for: Product managers, aspiring PMs, anyone who wants structured thinking in requirements.

artifacts.label: 知识共享平台 PRD（引导式生成）

cases.prompt:
我想做一个团队内部的知识共享平台。

背景：我们是一个 200 人的互联网公司，技术团队 80 人。知识散落在飞书文档、Confluence、个人笔记、微信群里，新人找资料要问好几个人，老员工离职经验断档。老板让我出 PRD。

我目前想到的点：Markdown 写文章、搜索、分类和标签、评论、移动端可看。但我知道肯定漏了很多，帮我用引导式的方式把 PRD 补完整。

要求：
1. 先做诊断：哪些信息已知、哪些缺失、哪些假设有风险
2. 对缺失信息给出你的假设（标注「假设」），不要直接跳过
3. 输出完整 PRD，包含：背景与目标、用户角色、核心场景、Scope In/Out、功能需求清单（P0/P1/P2）、信息架构、边界场景与异常流、数据依赖与技术约束、风险清单与开放问题
4. 最后给出评审门禁：上评审前必须确认的 5 个问题

请用内容工厂的多 Agent 内容生产能力输出 Markdown 格式的完整 PRD。
cases.prompt_en:
I want to build an internal knowledge-sharing platform for our team.

Background: we're a 200-person internet company with an 80-person tech team. Knowledge is scattered across Feishu docs, Confluence, personal notes, and WeChat group chats; new hires have to ask several people to find materials, and veterans' experience is lost when they leave. The boss has asked me to produce a PRD.

Points I've thought of so far: writing articles in Markdown, search, categories and tags, comments, mobile viewing. But I know I'm surely missing a lot — help me complete the PRD in a guided way.

Requirements:
1. First do a diagnosis: what's known, what's missing, and which assumptions are risky
2. For missing info, provide your assumptions (labeled "Assumption"); don't just skip over it
3. Output a complete PRD, including: background and goals, user roles, core scenarios, Scope In/Out, a feature list (P0/P1/P2), information architecture, edge cases and exception flows, data dependencies and technical constraints, and a list of risks and open questions
4. Finally, give a review gate: the 5 questions that must be confirmed before review

Please use the content factory's multi-Agent content production to output the complete PRD as Markdown.

cases.title: 提示词工程指南
cases.subtitle: 从入门到精通的 AI 提示词工程实战手册
cases.subtitle_en: Beginner-to-Expert AI Prompt Engineering Practical Handbook
cases.description:
提示词写得好不好，直接决定了 AI 输出质量的天花板。很多人用 AI 停留在「随便问一句」的阶段，得到的回答泛泛而谈、不够精准、格式混乱，然后就下结论说「AI 不行」。实际上，提示词工程是一门有方法论、有技巧体系、有评估标准的实战学科。

这份手册从 LLM 工作原理出发，系统讲解 Token、Temperature、Top-P 等核心概念，再到六大核心技巧（角色设定、Few-shot、Chain-of-Thought、Self-consistency、ReAct、Tree-of-Thought），每种技巧配 3 个实战案例。提供 5 大场景的结构化提示词模板库（代码生成、文案撰写、数据分析、翻译润色、知识问答），深入讲解提示词链、多轮对话管理、输出格式控制、幻觉检测等高级技巧，并给出 A/B 测试框架和自动化评估方法论。最后附 10 个行业最佳实践案例和 15 个常见陷阱与调试技巧。

适合：想要系统掌握 AI 提示词技术的开发者、产品经理、运营人员、内容创作者、以及所有日常使用 AI 工具的知识工作者。
cases.description_en:
The quality of your prompts directly determines the ceiling of AI output quality. Many people use AI at the 'just ask casually' stage — getting vague, imprecise, poorly formatted responses — then conclude 'AI isn't good enough.' In reality, prompt engineering is a practical discipline with methodologies, technique systems, and evaluation standards.

This handbook starts from LLM working principles, systematically explaining core concepts like Token, Temperature, and Top-P, then covers six core techniques (Role Setting, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, Self-consistency, ReAct, Tree-of-Thought), each with 3 practical examples. It provides structured prompt template libraries for 5 major scenarios (code generation, copywriting, data analysis, translation, knowledge Q&A), deep-dives into advanced techniques like prompt chaining, multi-turn dialogue management, output format control, and hallucination detection, plus A/B testing frameworks and automated evaluation methodologies. Concludes with 10 industry best practice cases and 15 common pitfalls with debugging tips.

Ideal for: Developers, product managers, operations staff, content creators, and all knowledge workers who use AI tools daily and want to systematically master prompt engineering.

artifacts.label: 提示词工程实战手册（全文）

cases.prompt: 帮我编写一份完整的提示词工程实战手册。面向想要系统掌握 AI 提示词技术的开发者和产品经理。需要包含：1）提示词基础原理（LLM 工作机制、Token 概念、Temperature/Top-P 参数解析）；2）六大核心技巧（角色设定、Few-shot、Chain-of-Thought、Self-consistency、ReAct、Tree-of-Thought）并各附 3 个实战案例；3）结构化提示词模板库（代码生成、文案撰写、数据分析、翻译润色、知识问答 5 个场景）；4）高级技巧（提示词链、多轮对话管理、输出格式控制、幻觉检测与规避）；5）评估方法论（A/B 测试框架、评分标准、自动化评估脚本思路）；6）行业最佳实践案例 10 个（客服、营销、教育、编程、数据分析等）；7）常见陷阱与调试技巧 15 个。输出为结构化 Markdown 手册文档。
cases.prompt_en: Help me write a complete, hands-on prompt-engineering handbook. Aimed at developers and product managers who want to systematically master AI prompting techniques. It needs to include: 1) prompt fundamentals (how LLMs work, the concept of tokens, an explanation of the Temperature/Top-P parameters); 2) six core techniques (role setting, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, Self-consistency, ReAct, Tree-of-Thought), each with 3 hands-on examples; 3) a library of structured prompt templates (for 5 scenarios: code generation, copywriting, data analysis, translation/polishing, knowledge Q&A); 4) advanced techniques (prompt chaining, multi-turn conversation management, output-format control, hallucination detection and avoidance); 5) evaluation methodology (an A/B testing framework, scoring criteria, ideas for automated evaluation scripts); 6) 10 industry best-practice cases (customer service, marketing, education, programming, data analysis, etc.); 7) 15 common pitfalls and debugging tips. Output as a structured Markdown handbook document.

cases.description:
面试官最怕两件事：临时抱佛脚想不出好问题，以及凭感觉打分导致团队内评估标准不统一。尤其是技术岗位，面试官水平参差不齐，有人只会问八股文，有人又跳过基础直接问架构。

cases.description_en:

This case demonstrates inputting the target role "Senior Frontend Engineer" and having AI generate a complete interview evaluation package: 20 tiered questions (6 fundamental + 8 advanced + 4 system design + 2 soft skills), each with reference answers, scoring rubrics (1-5 scale), follow-up prompts, plus interview flow recommendations and a comprehensive scoring sheet.

Best for: Technical interviewers, HR professionals, team leads, startup managers building interview processes from scratch.

cases.title: 发布前 Go/No-Go 决策评估
cases.subtitle: 部署清单 + 风险矩阵 + 回滚预案 + 放大屏作战板
cases.subtitle_en: Deployment checklist + risk matrix + rollback plan + a dashboard war room
cases.description:
**痛点**：重要版本发布前，技术总监每次都要灵魂发问——这次能发吗？风险在哪？发了出事谁兜底？回滚要多久？答不上来就压力山大。

**演示内容**：工程保障团队针对「新支付方式 + 风控模型升级 + DB 主从切换」三合一发布，交付一份完整《Go/No-Go 评估报告》+ 一屏放大屏作战板：20 条 Before/During/After 部署清单（含 Owner/DDL/验收）、代码安全审查摘要、测试覆盖与 CI 9 个 Stage 状态、压测与混沌测试结果、8 条风险矩阵、三项变更各自的回滚预案、最终 CONDITIONAL GO 建议与签名位。HTML 作战板含实时健康指标、灰度进度、On-Call 值班表、决策条形，深色大屏直出。

**适用人群**：SRE、发布经理、架构师、CTO/技术副总裁、大型变更发布团队。
cases.description_en:
**Pain point**: Before a major release, your CTO always asks: Can we ship? Where are the risks? Who owns the rollback if it breaks? If you can't answer clearly, the pressure is immense.

**What this case shows**: The engineering assurance team delivers a full Go/No-Go evaluation report for a 3-in-1 release (new payment method + risk model upgrade + DB master failover), plus a big-screen war room dashboard: 20 Before/During/After checklist items with Owner/DDL/acceptance criteria, code security review summary, test coverage and CI 9-stage status, load and chaos test results, 8-row risk matrix, rollback plans for each of the three changes, and a CONDITIONAL GO recommendation with sign-off slots. The HTML war room features real-time health metrics, gray-release progress, on-call roster, and a decision bar—ready for large-screen display.

**Who it's for**: SREs, release managers, architects, CTOs, and teams operating large-scale releases.
cases.prompt:
下周五要发布重要版本（新支付方式接入 + 风控模型升级 + 一次数据库主从切换）。请生成《发布前 Go/No-Go 评估报告》：
- 定制化部署检查清单（before / during / after 分段）
- 发布代码安全审查摘要
- 测试覆盖与 CI 状态确认

- 最终 Go / No-Go 决策建议并说明理由

cases.prompt_en:

- A final Go / No-Go decision recommendation with the reasoning

A Markdown decision report + an HTML release war-room board for display on a large screen.

cases.description:
每次要写一份跨国内外、覆盖十几个厂商、还必须带引用链接的行业研究，真能把人写秃。从搜资料、拉定价、对比功能，到排章节、填表格、写 HTML 精华版，一个人至少要花两三周。

这个案例演示了深度研究团队（7 角色 5 阶段）是怎么把《2026 AI Coding 工具市场深度研究报告》跑出来的：Scout 多源搜索聚合、Planner 搭章节大纲、Reviewer/Reviser 审稿循环、Writer 统稿、Publisher 发布，最终交付 1.8 万字的 Markdown 主报告（6 大章 + 3 张硬性对比表 + 5 个图表描述 + 142 条引用超链接 + 55 条 APA 参考文献），并追加一份可直接转发的单页内联样式 HTML 精华版。

适合：战略规划岗、行业分析师、产品 VP / CTO、投资人、行业媒体主理人、准备做 PMF 调研的创业者。
cases.description_en:
Writing a cross-border industry report that covers a dozen vendors, six dimensions, and hundreds of source citations can literally take weeks — between googling, pricing lookups, feature matrices, outline drafting, table formatting, and the inevitable HTML polish.

This case shows how the Deep Research Team (7 roles × 5 phases) produced the 2026 AI Coding Tools Market report end-to-end: Scout aggregates multi-source findings, Planner structures the outline, Reviewer/Reviser iterate via a review loop, Writer stitches everything, and Publisher ships. The deliverable is an 18k-word Markdown report (6 chapters + 3 hard-required comparison tables + 5 chart descriptions + 142 hyperlinked citations + 55 APA references) and a shareable single-page HTML highlights version with inline styles.

Fit for: strategy leads, industry analysts, product VPs / CTOs, investors, industry media editors, and founders running PMF research.

artifacts.label: 主研究报告（Markdown 1.8万字）
单页 HTML 精华版（可直接转发）

cases.prompt:
请按【深度研究团队 5 阶段完整模式】完成一份《2026 AI Coding 工具市场深度研究报告》。

覆盖范围：海外（Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Windsurf、Cody、Tabnine 等）与国内（豆包 MarsCode、腾讯 CodeBuddy、通义灵码、文心 Comate、CodeGeeX 等）共 10+ 款主流工具。

六大分析维度：产品能力、商业模式、定价、用户规模、技术路线、生态建设。

报告结构：引言 / 行业总览 / 产品横评 / 商业模式与定价 / 技术路线 / 生态建设 / 2026–2028 趋势预测 / 结论 / 参考文献。

质量要求：每个数据点带 Markdown 超链接引用并标注时间；至少 3 张结构化对比表（功能矩阵 / 定价 / 用户规模）；至少 5 个关键图表文字描述；总字数 1–2 万字。

额外交付：一份单页内联样式 HTML 精华版（核心发现 + 关键对比表 + 结论趋势，纯 CSS 图表，无外部 CDN）。

输出：主报告 <主报告.md>，精华版 <精华版.html>。
cases.prompt_en:
Please complete a "2026 AI Coding Tools Market In-Depth Research Report" following the [Deep Research Team 5-Stage Complete Mode].

Scope: 10+ mainstream tools across overseas (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cody, Tabnine, etc.) and domestic China (Doubao MarsCode, Tencent CodeBuddy, Tongyi Lingma, Wenxin Comate, CodeGeeX, etc.).

Six analysis dimensions: product capabilities, business model, pricing, user scale, technical approach, ecosystem building.

Report structure: Introduction / Industry Overview / Product Comparison / Business Models & Pricing / Technical Approach / Ecosystem Building / 2026-2028 Trend Predictions / Conclusion / References.

Quality requirements: every data point carries a Markdown hyperlink citation with a date; at least 3 structured comparison tables (feature matrix / pricing / user scale); at least 5 textual descriptions of key charts; 10,000-20,000 words total.

Additional deliverable: a single-page inline-styled HTML highlights version (key findings + key comparison tables + conclusions and trends, pure-CSS charts, no external CDN).

Output: main report <report.md>, highlights <highlights.html>.

This case targets CS graduate students and provides a systematic breakdown of the full academic paper writing and submission workflow. From writing tips across seven core sections, to literature review methods, experiment design standards, academic English techniques, top-venue submission strategies, rebuttal writing, and tool recommendations.

Ideal for: CS master's and PhD students, junior faculty, research newcomers, and academics targeting top venues.

It needs to include: 1) A full breakdown of paper structure (writing points and common mistakes for each part: Title, Abstract, Introduction, Related Work, Method, Experiment, Conclusion); 2) A systematic method for literature reviews; 3) Standards for experimental design and presenting results; 4) Academic English writing techniques; 5) Strategies for submitting to top-tier conferences; 6) Rebuttal writing and revision strategies; 7) Recommended writing tools. Output a structured Markdown guide document.

This case uses a project management tool for SMBs as the scenario, demonstrating how finance-ops generates a complete SaaS financial model with cohort-based MRR/ARR projections, core SaaS metrics, cost structure analysis, cash flow and runway calculations, and three-scenario simulations.

cases.title: 选岗策略：汉语言文学上岸方案

cases.subtitle: 资格盘 × 低竞争段 × 分数可达段，三表叠出报考策略
cases.subtitle_en: Eligibility, low-competition and reachable-score tables stacked into strategy
cases.description:
选岗不是一次查询，是三个口径的叠加：能报什么、哪些竞争温和、哪些分数够得着。

本案例为汉语言文学 2027 届考生做三次独立实查：资格内报名中岗位 100 个、国考竞争比≤50:1 岗位 10949 个（中央对外联络部低至 5:1）、进面分≤125 岗位 7382 个，叠出「找限中文类专业的岗、用专业门槛筛掉对手」的策略，并如实说明库中为单年进面分、不虚构三年趋势。

适合：备考 2027 国考的文科生、做择岗咨询的老师。
cases.description_en:
Position selection isn't one query — it's three lenses stacked: what you can apply for, where competition is mild, and what your score can reach.

This case runs three independent live queries for a 2027 Chinese-literature candidate: 100 eligible open positions, 10,949 national-exam posts with ratios ≤50:1 (as low as 5:1 at the International Liaison Department), and 7,382 with cutoffs ≤125 — stacking into the strategy of targeting Chinese-major-restricted posts so the eligibility bar filters rivals for you. It also states honestly that the database holds single-year cutoffs, refusing to fabricate three-year trends.

For: humanities students aiming at the 2027 national exam and selection counsellors.

artifacts.label: 三表叠加选岗策略报告

cases.prompt: 我是汉语言文学专业 2027 届毕业生，帮我做一份国考选岗策略分析。要求：1) 三次独立实查：我资格内报名中的岗位、国考竞争比≤50:1 的岗位、往年进面分≤125 的岗位，各给总数与明细表；2) 竞争比和进面分必须是接口原值；3) 数据库只有单年进面分就如实说明，不许虚构趋势；4) 叠加三表给出报考策略与如实的局限说明。
cases.prompt_en: I'm a Chinese-literature major graduating in 2027 — build a national-exam selection strategy. Requirements: 1) three independent live queries: my eligible open positions, national-exam posts with ratios ≤50:1, and posts with historical cutoffs ≤125, each with totals and detail tables; 2) ratios and cutoffs must be the interface's original values; 3) if the database holds only single-year cutoffs, say so honestly — never fabricate trends; 4) stack the three tables into a strategy with candid limitations.

cases.description:
**痛点**：新上秒杀活动，老板一句话要求支持 50 万 QPS、5000 SKU、15 分钟活动窗口，架构师一脸懵——从哪下手？库存强一致怎么做？怎么扛住流量？超卖怎么防？上线前压测怎么组织？

**演示内容**：工程保障团队（阿奇主笔架构、甄宇航汇编、泰莎测试策略、梅伦技术债视角）产出一份可直接交付评审的《秒杀系统架构设计方案》，8 大章节覆盖：需求 SLO 量化、整体架构图与组件选型、下单/扣库存/支付回调三条核心时序图、库存预热/令牌桶限流/异步削峰/幂等/防刷五大关键方案（含 Redis Lua 脚本）、监控告警/降级预案/容量规划、测试金字塔 + 6 大压测场景 + 准入门禁、文档结构建议、8 大风险 + 5 个关键权衡。

**适用人群**：架构师、后端 Leader、技术总监、做大促/秒杀/抢购类活动的产品技术团队。
cases.description_en:
**Pain point**: You're asked to build a flash-sale system that takes 500K QPS for 5000 SKUs over a 15-minute window. Where to start? How to guarantee strong-consistent stock? How to prevent oversell? How to stress-test?

**What this case shows**: The engineering assurance team (Archi leading architecture, Zhen Yuhang consolidating, Tessa on testing, Meilun on tech debt) delivers a review-ready design doc covering 8 sections: SLO quantification, high-level architecture with component choices, 3 core sequence diagrams (order / stock deduction / payment callback), 5 key tech patterns (stock prewarming / token-bucket rate limiting / async offloading / idempotency / anti-fraud) with Redis Lua scripts, observability + degradation playbook + capacity planning, test pyramid + 6 load-test scenarios, doc structure recommendations, and 8 risks with 5 key tradeoffs.

**Who it's for**: Architects, backend leads, CTOs, and teams running high-traffic campaigns.
cases.prompt:
要做一个新的"秒杀活动系统"，预期峰值 QPS 50 万、SKU 数 5000、活动持续 15 分钟。请完整设计：

交付《秒杀系统架构设计方案》Markdown：
1. 需求与非功能性指标（TPS、RT、可用性、数据一致性）
2. 整体架构图与关键组件说明
3. 核心流程时序图（下单、扣库存、支付回调）
4. 关键技术方案（库存预热、令牌桶限流、异步削峰、幂等、防刷）
5. 可运维性评估（监控、告警、降级预案）
6. 测试策略与压测方案
7. 设计文档结构建议
8. 风险与权衡
cases.prompt_en:
We need to build a new "flash sale system" with an expected peak of 500K QPS, 5000 SKUs, and a 15-minute event duration. Please provide a complete design:

Deliver a "Flash Sale System Architecture Design" in Markdown:
1. Requirements and non-functional metrics (TPS, RT, availability, data consistency)
2. Overall architecture diagram and key component descriptions
3. Core flow sequence diagrams (order placement, stock deduction, payment callback)
4. Key technical solutions (stock pre-warming, token-bucket rate limiting, async load shedding, idempotency, anti-fraud)
5. Operability assessment (monitoring, alerting, degradation plans)
6. Testing strategy and load-testing plan
7. Design document structure recommendations
8. Risks and tradeoffs

cases.subtitle_en: Six domain experts weigh in with signed opinions, disagreements preserved, delivering aggressive / conservative / cut-loss playbooks
cases.description:
持仓深套 30%、天天盯着亏损数字又不敢割肉——这几乎是每个 A 股散户都经历过的折磨。单看 K 线想抄底，怕继续阴跌；想止损，又怕割在黎明前；问身边朋友，要么都说"拿住"，要么都说"别碰"，没人告诉你不同视角下的完整分析。

这个案例用用户真实场景（两年前 25 元买入比亚迪 002594.SZ 1 万股、现浮亏 30%），让 stock-partner-team 六位不同风格的股票专家上桌圆桌讨论：产业策略师讲新能源车进入成熟期后龙头的估值切换逻辑、信号派首席用"四层信号"判断当前既非买点也非卖点、估值分析师给出历史 PE Bands 与 DCF 保守测算、逆向投资人拿出按支撑位分三批抄底（170-175 / 155-160 / 130-140）的具体执行表、基本面研究员拆解海外建厂+储能+智驾三条增长线、短线冲浪手直说"深套票不适合做 T"。每一位的观点明确署名，分歧**不强行达成共识**，最后给出三种风格完整方案——激进补仓 / 保守持有 / 止损换仓——每种都附带价位、仓位、触发条件和止损线。

交付 Markdown 圆桌纪要（22KB / 363 行，分歧并列呈现）+ 单文件 HTML"多视角决策地图"（27KB，含立场矩阵、关键价位图、三方案对比卡片、深色专业风），可直接打开对照执行。

适合：A 股深套用户、想系统化决策而不是拍脑袋的个人投资者、不想盲从单一观点的人、希望把"多专家交叉验证"流程落到自己持仓上的散户、帮家人梳理套牢账户的理财顾问、金融科普博主/投教讲师需要"分歧保留"型决策案例素材。
cases.description_en:
Getting buried 30% in a stock you can't bring yourself to cut is a uniquely painful form of A-share torture. Charts whisper "bottom fishing," fears whisper "cut losses," friends either say "hold" or "dump it," and nobody walks you through the full spectrum of perspectives.

This case runs a real user scenario — bought BYD (002594.SZ) at ¥25 two years ago, 10,000 shares, now down 30% — through the stock-partner-team's six-expert roundtable. The industry strategist explains how NEV leader valuation is rotating from growth-stage to mature-stage multiples. The signal chief uses a 4-layer signal framework to argue it's neither a buy nor a sell, just "wait." The valuation analyst gives historical PE bands and a conservative DCF. The contrarian investor hands you a three-batch entry table (¥170-175 / ¥155-160 / ¥130-140). The fundamentals researcher breaks down three growth pillars: overseas plants, energy storage, and intelligent driving. The short-term surfer flatly declares, "deep-underwater tickets aren't for swing trading." Every opinion is signed, disagreements are NOT forced into consensus, and three complete action plans close the deck — aggressive add, conservative hold, cut-loss rotate — each with entry prices, position sizes, triggers, and stop-losses.

Delivers a Markdown roundtable memo (22KB / 363 lines, conflicting views side-by-side) plus a single-file HTML "multi-perspective decision map" (27KB, stance matrix, price chart, three-plan cards, dark professional theme) — open-and-execute ready.

Audience: A-share investors stuck on losing positions, anyone tired of bet-the-house single-opinion takes, wealth advisors helping family unwind trapped accounts, and finance educators who need a "disagreement-preserving" decision framework.
