cases.title: 朋友推荐说「没被发现」：6 专家圆桌辨扬杰科技真伪
cases.title_en: "Hidden Gem" Claim Under Scrutiny: 6-Expert Roundtable on Yangjie Electronics
cases.subtitle: 买 0 / 看一看 4 / 不碰 2 · 朋友那句「还没被发现」在数据面前成立吗
cases.subtitle_en: 0 Buy / 4 Wait / 2 Pass · Does "undiscovered gem" survive the numbers?
cases.description:
身边朋友、荐股群、雪球大 V 经常拿「有大逻辑但还没被发现」的冷门小票吸引你——听起来很性感，但真要上仓位又心里没底：业务真的好？财务有没有雷？机构为什么不买？到底是被低估还是便宜有理由？

这个案例用 stock-partner-team 六位风格互补的专家圆桌，辨证一只真实的「听起来像冷门但数据不支持」的创业板小票——扬杰科技（300373.SZ，功率半导体 + 碳化硅题材）。基本面研究员最看好（品质二线龙头 + SiC 真兑现 + 管理层稳健）；逆向派+估值派最反对（一年翻倍 + 近一季度 52 家机构调研 + PE 5 年分位 60%，「被低估」命题不成立）；信号派看资金层摇摆未统一所以只能「看一看」；短线派看周线 70-93 箱体中继非主升形态所以不跟。

**核心分歧保留**：6 人对 82.85 元的定价性质裂成两派——产业/基本面派认为「合理非最优买点」，估值/逆向派认为「已透支需等回调」。**共识**是功率半导体+SiC 产业逻辑是真的、扬杰是兑现型而非故事型公司。案例末尾附「最终表态矩阵」（每人 买/看一看/不碰 + 一句话理由）和一段「辨冷门真伪」一句话结论（谁最看好/谁最反对/共识/分歧）。

⚠️ **本案例为演示案例**，不构成对扬杰科技的投资建议。案例的复用价值是「冷门小票 6 维辨伪框架」：业务构成 → 产业链位置 → 估值 → 资金 → 信号 → 最终表态。

交付 Markdown 纪要（12KB / 201 行），6 专家署名、分歧保留、最终矩阵齐全。

适合：被朋友/荐股群推荐冷门股的散户、想学「如何看一只陌生股」的投资新手、FA/投顾被客户问「这只行不行」时的快速框架、金融科普博主做「拆解冷门股神话」类内容、投研社团训练新人。
cases.description_en:
Friends, stock-picking chat groups, and social-media whales love dangling "hidden-gem, undiscovered story" small caps — the narrative is seductive, but actually opening a position feels reckless: Is the business real? Are the financials clean? Why aren't institutions buying? Is this truly undervalued, or just cheap for a reason?

This case runs the stock-partner-team's six complementary experts through a real "sounds like a hidden gem but the data doesn't back it" ChiNext small cap — Yangjie Electronics (300373.SZ, power semiconductors + silicon carbide). The fundamentals researcher likes it most (quality mid-cap leader + SiC actually shipping + steady management). The contrarian + valuation analyst reject it most firmly (already doubled in a year + 52 institutional research visits last quarter + PE at 60th percentile over five years — the "undervalued" thesis collapses). The signal chief sees capital-flow signals un-aligned and goes "wait." The short-term surfer reads the weekly chart as a 70-93 range mid-consolidation, not an impulse leg, so he passes.

**Core disagreement preserved**: the six experts split on what ¥82.85 means — industry/fundamentals bulls call it "fair but not the best entry," while valuation/contrarian bears call it "already extended, wait for pullback." **Consensus**: power semiconductors + SiC is a real story, and Yangjie is a delivery-type (not story-type) company. The case closes with a final stance matrix (each expert's Buy/Wait/Pass + one-line rationale) and a summary line of "who's most bullish, who's most bearish, consensus, and key disagreement."

⚠️ This is a **demo case** and does not constitute investment advice on Yangjie Electronics. The reusable value is the "six-dimension hidden-gem authenticity framework": business mix → supply-chain position → valuation → capital → signals → final stance.

Delivers a Markdown memo (12KB / 201 lines), signed by all six experts, disagreements preserved, final matrix complete.

Audience: retail traders targeted by friend/group/whale recommendations, rookies learning "how to read an unfamiliar stock," advisors needing a rapid diligence framework when clients ask "should I buy this," finance educators debunking "hidden-gem" narratives, investment-club trainers.

cases.title_en: CSI 300 Bounces to 4200: 6-Expert Roundtable + Market Thermometer Dashboard
cases.subtitle: 4 看多 / 2 中性 / 0 看空 · 温度读数 63 分（中性偏热） · 加仓清单 vs 降仓清单一键对照
cases.subtitle_en: 4 bulls / 2 neutral / 0 bear · thermometer 63 (moderately warm) · add-positions vs. trim-positions side-by-side
cases.description:
指数一口气反弹几百点，最难受的不是满仓也不是空仓，而是「半仓观望」——加仓怕追高、减仓怕踏空、换仓又没方向。网上的观点要么「牛市起点」要么「反弹到头」，没人帮你把估值、资金、情绪、政策、趋势、外围 6 个维度的温度逐项点清楚。

这个案例把沪深 300 在 4200 点的位置判断交给 stock-partner-team 六位风格互补的专家圆桌：估值分析师给出 PE/PB 近 10 年分位与 DCF 合理区间下沿；产业策略师对比企业盈利增速、PMI、社融数据；信号派首席用周线趋势强度、量能变化、风格轮动特征三维信号判断；基本面研究员等一季报兑现；逆向投资人抓住「两融流入但 ETF 净赎回扩大」的散户抢跑/机构撤退信号主张等回调；短线冲浪手标记主题赛道的动能强弱。

分歧保留：最大的分裂在**「是否立即加仓」**——估值派+产业派认为击球区到了，逆向派坚持「等回调更有性价比」，基本面派要求季报兑现。共识是**「阶段底确认的反弹中段，不是大底重启」**，上方 4500-4700 需重新评估。末尾附两张清单：**加仓首选**（AI 算力 / 创新药出海 / 家电+电网出海）vs **降仓先砍**（高位无基本面主题股 / 一季报打脸的消费二线）。

交付 Markdown 纪要（14KB / 230 行）+ 单文件 HTML「市场温度计仪表盘」（16KB，ECharts gauge 大温度计 + 6 分维度子刻度 + 加仓/减仓对比卡 + 6 专家投票条 + 深色背景）。

适合：半仓观望纠结党、机构中观研究员做日常温度跟踪、FA/投顾给客户讲清「现在是不是该加仓」、金融科普博主需要「多维度市场读数」可视化素材、投教讲师给新手演示「看市场不是只看点位」的系统性框架。
cases.description_en:
When an index rips a few hundred points in weeks, the most painful position isn't full or empty — it's half-invested and paralyzed. Online takes are either "bull market start" or "rally exhausted," with nobody walking you through the six dimensions (valuation / sentiment / capital / trend / policy / external) one by one.

This case hands the CSI 300 at 4200 reading to the stock-partner-team's six-expert roundtable. The valuation analyst gives PE/PB 10-year percentiles and DCF fair-value corridor. The industry strategist cross-references earnings growth, PMI, and social financing. The signal chief reads weekly trend strength, volume changes, and style rotation. The fundamentals researcher waits for Q1 earnings confirmation. The contrarian catches the retail-front-running-while-institutions-exit divergence (margin inflows up, ETF redemptions widening) and argues for a pullback entry. The short-term surfer tags thematic momentum strength.

Disagreements preserved — the cleanest split is on **add-position timing**: valuation + industry bulls call it a buy zone; the contrarian insists on a pullback; the fundamentals researcher waits for earnings proof. Consensus lands on **"confirmed-bottom mid-bounce, not a major-bottom restart,"** with 4500-4700 requiring reassessment. Closes with two lists: **Add-now priorities** (AI infra / innovative-drug going global / appliances + power-grid exports) vs **Trim-first victims** (high-riding themes without fundamentals / Q1-miss consumer mid-caps).

Delivers a Markdown memo (14KB / 230 lines) plus a single-file HTML "Market Thermometer Dashboard" (16KB, ECharts gauge + 6 dimension mini-scales + add/trim comparison cards + 6-expert vote bar, dark theme).

Audience: half-invested hesitation sufferers, buy-side desk analysts running weekly temperature checks, advisors explaining "is now the time to add" to clients, finance educators needing a multi-dimension market reading visualization, investment-club instructors teaching rookies that "reading the market ≠ reading price alone."

cases.title: 50 万 A 股核心+卫星组合：6 专家圆桌 + 视觉化仪表板
cases.title_en: ¥500K A-Share Core-Satellite Portfolio: 6-Expert Roundtable + Visual Dashboard
cases.subtitle: 8 只最终标的 · 估值派+基本面派主导核心 65% · 5 位专家联手否决寒武纪 · 三档换仓触发表
cases.subtitle_en: 8 final holdings · value + fundamentals bulls anchor 65% core · Cambricon vetoed by 5 experts · three-tier rebalance triggers
cases.description:
散户做组合最常犯的错：要么把 50 万全砸进 1-2 只最热的票，赢了爽一把输了要命；要么跟着朋友圈的模糊建议乱买十几只，年底一看没一只能讲清楚为什么买。没人给你一份**带权重、带止损、带换仓触发条件、带反对意见**的完整组合文档。

这个案例用 stock-partner-team 六位风格互补的专家圆桌，为「50 万本金 / 持仓 5-10 只 / 期限 3-5 年 / 能接受 20-25% 回撤」的典型投资者定制核心+卫星组合：**核心 65%（32.5 万）**由估值派+基本面派主导，配茅台 12% / 宁德 10% / 招行 8% / 工行 8% / 美的 8% / 长江电力 8%，骨架是「高股息+品质龙头+安全边际」；**卫星 25%（12.5 万）**取逆向派迈瑞 7% + 产业趋势北方华创 4%；**现金 10%（5 万）**做弹药。

**分歧保留，且集中披露**：（1）宁德仓位争议——估值派嫌贵；（2）北方华创——逆向派反对追涨；（3）**寒武纪被 5 位专家一致否决**（估值、信号、基本面、逆向、短线）不入最终组合。

**纪律先于收益**：硬止损线 -25%、组合回撤 -20% 即停手重平衡、红利股股息率破 4% 减半、短线仓位 -8% 硬止损、三档换仓触发条件（单股减仓 / 单股加仓 / 全面调仓）清晰落表。

交付 Markdown 建议书（12KB / 182 行）+ 单文件 HTML 仪表板（13KB / 302 行，内含 ECharts 权重饼图 + 六维风格雷达 + 换仓触发表 + 6 专家推荐标的卡片墙 + 深色专业背景）。

⚠️ **演示建议，非投资建议**。案例的复用价值在于「核心+卫星 6 专家协同构建流程」，而非具体标的推荐。

适合：第一次做 A 股组合的中产家庭、想摆脱「听消息买股票」的散户、理财顾问给客户做资产配置模板、FA 做新客户入门教育、投研社团训练新人做组合构建作业、金融科普博主需要「核心+卫星结构化配置」案例素材。
cases.description_en:
Retail investors' two classic portfolio mistakes: dump all ¥500K into one or two hottest names (win big once, lose big forever) or buy 15 random stocks on mixed advice and, by year-end, can't articulate why any of them are there. Nobody hands you a complete portfolio document with weights, stop-losses, rebalance triggers, AND preserved disagreements.

This case runs the stock-partner-team's six complementary experts as a portfolio construction committee for a typical investor profile (¥500K principal / 5-10 holdings / 3-5 year horizon / 20-25% drawdown tolerance), producing a core-satellite portfolio: **Core 65% (¥325K)** anchored by the value + fundamentals bulls — Moutai 12% / CATL 10% / CMB 8% / ICBC 8% / Midea 8% / Yangtze Power 8%, a "high-dividend + quality leader + margin of safety" skeleton. **Satellite 25% (¥125K)** from the contrarian (Mindray 7%) plus industry trend (Naura 4%). **Cash 10% (¥50K)** as dry powder.

**Disagreements preserved and explicitly called out**: (1) CATL position disputed by the valuation analyst; (2) Naura opposed by the contrarian as chasing; (3) **Cambricon vetoed by 5 of 6 experts** (valuation, signal, fundamentals, contrarian, short-term) — excluded from final portfolio.

**Discipline before returns**: hard stop-loss at -25%, portfolio drawdown -20% triggers rebalance halt, dividend stocks halve on yield breaking below 4%, short-term tickets -8% hard stop, three-tier rebalance triggers (single-name trim / single-name add / portfolio-wide overhaul) laid out in a table.

Delivers a Markdown portfolio brief (12KB / 182 lines) plus a single-file HTML dashboard (13KB / 302 lines, ECharts weight pie + six-dimension style radar + rebalance triggers table + 6-expert recommendation card wall + dark professional theme).

⚠️ This is a **demo recommendation**, not investment advice. Reusable value is the "core-satellite 6-expert collaborative construction workflow," not the specific tickers.

Audience: middle-class families building their first A-share portfolio, retail investors tired of tip-driven trading, wealth advisors templating client allocations, FAs onboarding new clients, investment-club instructors assigning portfolio construction, finance educators needing a structured core-satellite case.

cases.description:

The output is a fully functional SKILL.md that, once installed, lets users describe data structures in natural language and auto-generates spec-compliant JSON Schema.

cases.title: 一周涨 25% 还能追吗：6 专家圆桌拆解中际旭创 AI 算力主线
cases.title_en: AI Hype Stock Up 25% in a Week — Chase or Skip? A 6-Expert Roundtable on Zhongji Innolight
cases.subtitle: 产业真伪 × 估值透支 × 主线强度 × 资金结构 四象限拆解，一张 HTML"跟与不跟"决策卡直接可用
cases.subtitle_en: Industry truth × valuation exhaust × theme strength × capital structure — a four-quadrant breakdown plus a ready-to-use go/no-go decision card
cases.description:
A 股最折磨人的时刻不是深套，而是「看着热门主线涨但不敢上车」——中际旭创（300308.SZ）一周 +25%、AI 算力概念刷屏、朋友圈都在晒盈利，你又怕错过又怕接盘。网上的分析不是无脑吹「1.6T 是印钞机」就是无脑空「一定崩盘」，没人帮你系统性拆清楚。

这个案例用 stock-partner-team 六位风格互补的专家上圆桌，把「追涨判断」拆到可执行颗粒度：产业策略师确认光模块-1.6T-英伟达 GB200 订单链条真实可查（证券日报 2026-04-17）、基本面研究员给出 2026Q1 单季净利 57 亿超 2024 全年的硬数据、估值分析师拆穿 PEG 0.26 的陷阱（分母用一次性高增速失真、按可持续增速回到 0.8-1.2）、信号派首席指出万亿市值 + 周涨 25% + 情绪化新闻的组合是典型情绪顶信号、逆向投资人拒绝上车并给出回踩到 700 以下的买点、短线冲浪手提示分时出现放量滞涨需要警惕。

分歧保留：产业派/基本面派 vs 信号派/短线派/逆向派在「现在追不追」上明确分裂，案例**不强行达成共识**，而是把两派条件落成两张对比卡——如果你选「跟」，首批/二批/三批价位是多少、止损设在哪里；如果你选「不跟」，下次介入的触发条件和替代标的是什么。

交付 Markdown 圆桌纪要（16KB / 213 行）+ 单文件 HTML「跟与不跟决策卡」（19KB，两张对比大卡 + 产业真伪四象限 + 6 专家迷你表态条 + 深色专业风）。

适合：追涨纠结症患者、热门题材股投资者、想在情绪市里保持纪律的散户、做投研教育的博主/讲师需要「产业真但位置贵」典型决策素材、FA/投顾给客户解释「为什么好公司不等于好买点」。
cases.description_en:
The true torture of A-share trading isn't getting stuck in a loss — it's watching a hot theme rocket up while you hesitate. Zhongji Innolight (300308.SZ) surged 25% in a week on the AI optical module theme, your WeChat feed is flooded with P&L screenshots, and you're torn between FOMO and bag-holder fears. Online analysis is either unhinged bullish ("1.6T = money printer") or unhinged bearish ("crash incoming") — nobody breaks it down systematically.

This case runs the stock-partner-team's six complementary experts through the chase decision at executable granularity. The industry strategist confirms the optical module → 1.6T → NVIDIA GB200 order chain is verifiable (Securities Daily, 2026-04-17). The fundamentals researcher surfaces hard data: Q1 2026 single-quarter net profit of 5.7B exceeds all of 2024. The valuation analyst exposes the PEG 0.26 trap (distorted by one-off growth; normalized PEG returns to 0.8-1.2). The signal chief flags the combo of trillion-yuan market cap + 25% weekly gain + emotional news flow as a classic sentiment-top signature. The contrarian refuses to board and names the ¥700 pullback as the entry. The short-term surfer warns about intraday volume-without-price stalling.

Disagreements are preserved — industry/fundamentals bulls versus signal/short-term/contrarian bears split cleanly on "chase now or not," and the case refuses to force consensus. Instead it compresses both sides into two comparison cards: if you chase — here are the three entry tranches, position sizes, and stop-loss; if you skip — here are the pullback triggers and alternative tickers.

Delivers a Markdown roundtable memo (16KB / 213 lines) plus a single-file HTML go/no-go decision card (19KB, two side-by-side plan cards, industry-truth four-quadrant, mini 6-expert stance bar, dark professional theme).

Audience: FOMO-paralyzed investors, hot-theme chasers, disciplined retail traders fighting emotional markets, finance educators who need a "great company ≠ great entry" teaching case, advisors explaining valuation exhaust to clients.

cases.description:

cases.description_en:

This case shows how the TradingAgent expert team (lead orchestrator + technical/fundamentals/news/sentiment analysts + bull & bear researchers + aggressive/conservative/neutral risk assessors + trader) — 11 roles in total — runs a full systematic investment analysis on Kweichow Moutai (600519.SH): from candlestick patterns, MACD/RSI/KDJ, moving averages, support & resistance, to ROE/gross margin/cash flow/valuation percentiles, to 3-month filings + baijiu policy + consumption data, to northbound flow + institutional holdings + margin trading + dragon-tiger list, then a structured bull-bear debate, an entry/target/stop-loss/position plan, and a three-way risk-adjusted HOLD recommendation with confidence level and holding period.

Target audience: A-share long-term value investors, retail traders seeking institutional-grade analysis, watch-list users comparing with sell-side research, financial advisors (FA), and finance content creators producing single-stock deep dives.

cases.subtitle: 四维分析法 + 多空辩论 + 新手操作方案，一篇带你从零学会系统性看股票
cases.subtitle_en: Four-dimensional analysis + bull-bear debate + beginner-friendly action plan, a one-stop tutorial from zero to systematic stock analysis
cases.description:
刚开户的新手最常见的三个错：只看 K 线追涨杀跌、只看 ROE 就觉得是好公司、只听大 V 消息跟风操作——结果往往被市场反复教育，甚至连「该怎么系统性分析一只股票」这件事都没人讲清楚。

这个案例演示了 TradingAgent 专家团（主理人 + 技术/基本面/新闻/情绪 4 位分析师 + 多空 2 位辩手 + 激进/保守/中性 3 位风险评估师 + 交易决策官）11 个角色，把一整套"四维分析 + 多空辩论 + 决策"的专业方法论，拆成手把手教学：用「四条腿的凳子」比喻讲清技术/基本面/新闻/情绪四个维度各自在回答什么问题，再用比亚迪（002594.SZ）真实数据逐章演示——技术面讲 K 线/MA/MACD/RSI 并演示 99 元筑底形态、基本面讲 ROE/毛利率/PE 分位并对比宁德时代/特斯拉、新闻面讲政策/公司/行业三类催化剂并梳理 2025-2026 海外建厂+固态电池节点、情绪面讲北向/龙虎榜/机构一致预期；最后 BULL/BEAR 两派交叉辩论，给出新手友好的 HOLD 偏积极结论和「三笔分批建仓法」（首仓 2% / 二次 3% / 三次 5%），附止损止盈纪律和 5 大血泪误区清单。

交付 Markdown 教学稿（21KB / 482 行）+ 交互 HTML 教学版（35KB，含 sticky 侧边目录、20+ 指标卡片、4 张 ECharts 图表、移动端适配）；每个章节都遵循"方法论 → 基础概念表 → 三步走口诀 → 比亚迪真实数据演示 → 新手小结"三段式结构，并在文末提供「新手工具箱」（免费数据源、推荐阅读、风险提示）。

适合：刚开户的 A 股投资新手、想系统学习「如何分析一只股票」但不知从何下手的人；家长/朋友帮孩子入门投资教育；金融科普博主需要结构化教学素材；高校投资社团做内训讲义；FA/理财顾问给新客户做入门教育材料；想看 AI Agent 如何把专业投研方法论"翻译"成新手能懂语言的金融科技从业者。
cases.description_en:
Three classic rookie mistakes: chasing candlesticks, fixating on ROE alone, and blindly following KOL tips — beginners get burned repeatedly, and nobody ever explains how to actually analyze a stock systematically from scratch.

This case shows how the TradingAgent expert team (lead orchestrator + 4 technical/fundamentals/news/sentiment analysts + 2 bull & bear researchers + aggressive/conservative/neutral risk assessors + trader) — 11 roles in total — translates a professional four-dimensional analysis + bull-bear debate framework into a step-by-step beginner tutorial. Starts with the "four-legged stool" metaphor explaining what each dimension answers, then walks through BYD (002594.SZ) with real data: technicals (K-line / MA / MACD / RSI plus BYD's 99-yuan bottoming pattern), fundamentals (ROE / gross margin / PE percentile vs. CATL & Tesla), news (policy / company / industry catalysts across 2025-2026 overseas plants and solid-state battery milestones), sentiment (northbound flows / dragon-tiger list / consensus estimates), followed by bull-vs-bear cross-debate, ending with a beginner-friendly HOLD (modestly bullish) conclusion and a "three-slice averaging" entry plan (2% first / 3% second / 5% third) with stop-loss discipline and a 5-mistake blood-lesson checklist.

Delivers a Markdown teaching manuscript (21KB / 482 lines) and an interactive HTML teaching version (35KB, sticky sidebar TOC, 20+ metric cards, 4 ECharts visualizations, mobile-responsive); every chapter follows a "methodology → concept cheat sheet → three-step drill → BYD live demo → beginner takeaways" three-part structure, plus a "Beginner Toolbox" appendix with free data sources, recommended reading, and risk disclosures.

Target audience: A-share rookies who just opened accounts; people seeking a systematic framework to analyze any stock but don't know where to start; parents teaching kids investing; finance popularization creators needing structured teaching material; university investment clubs; FAs/advisors preparing onboarding content for new clients; fintech practitioners curious about how AI agents translate professional investment methodology into beginner-accessible language.

cases.subtitle: 11 角色团队协作：6 只标的四维分析 + 多空辩论 + 组合层对冲 + 再平衡/压测
cases.subtitle_en: 11-role team collaboration: four-dimensional analysis on 6 holdings, bull-bear debate, portfolio-level hedging, rebalancing & stress testing
cases.description:
50 万资金想做港美股中长期组合，目标年化 15-20%、最大回撤 ≤ 20%——光选股就够折腾，还要兼顾跨市场对冲、仓位分配、再平衡规则、压测回溯，一个人根本做不完整。

这个案例演示了 TradingAgent 专家团（主理人 + 技术/基本面/新闻/情绪分析师 + 多空辩手 + 激进/保守/中性风险评估 + 交易决策官）11 个角色，围绕「港美股 50 万对冲组合」做一次系统性组合构建：港股池（腾讯 0700 / 美团 3690 / 友邦 1299）和美股池（NVDA / COST / LLY）各 3 只标的全部跑完四维分析 → 每只标的多空辩论给出 BUY/HOLD 建议 → 组合层面给出权重分配（港 45% / 美 55%）、行业对冲逻辑（科技 36% × 防御 33% × 医药 19% × 消费 12%）、再平衡规则（±5pp 或季度末）、2022 熊市压测（回撤 -18.5%）、2020 年极端抛售压测（-22% 临界）→ 输出 Markdown 报告 + HTML 可视化（双层权重饼图、历史回测曲线、风险收益散点、压测柱状图、KPI 卡片）。

适合：有 30-100 万可投资金、想同时布局港美股的中长期组合投资者；希望系统化做跨市场资产配置而不只是单股择时的进阶散户；做组合管理展业、需要给客户出专业组合方案的 FA / 投顾；金融自媒体创作组合配置类深度内容；想看 AI Agent 如何从单股研究走到组合层决策的金融科技从业者。
cases.description_en:
With 500K RMB, you want to build a mid-to-long-term HK-US portfolio targeting 15-20% annualized returns and max drawdown ≤ 20% — just stock picking is overwhelming, plus you need cross-market hedging, position sizing, rebalancing rules, and stress testing. No single analyst can deliver all of this.

This case shows how the TradingAgent expert team (lead orchestrator + technical/fundamentals/news/sentiment analysts + bull & bear researchers + aggressive/conservative/neutral risk assessors + trader) — 11 roles in total — builds a systematic HK-US hedge portfolio on 500K capital: runs full four-dimensional analysis on all 6 holdings (HK: Tencent 0700 / Meituan 3690 / AIA 1299; US: NVDA / COST / LLY), conducts bull-bear debate per holding with BUY/HOLD verdicts, then assembles the portfolio layer — weight allocation (HK 45% / US 55%), industry hedging logic (Tech 36% × Defensive 33% × Pharma 19% × Consumer 12%), rebalancing rules (±5pp bands or quarterly), 2022 bear-market stress test (-18.5% drawdown), 2020 extreme crash stress test (-22% borderline) — delivered as Markdown report + HTML with ECharts interactive visualizations (double-ring weight pie, historical backtest curve, risk-return scatter, stress bars, KPI cards).

Target audience: mid-long-term investors with 30-100K USD equivalent simultaneously allocating HK and US; retail investors graduating from single-stock timing to systematic cross-market allocation; FA/advisors producing professional portfolio proposals for clients; finance content creators covering portfolio construction; fintech practitioners evaluating how AI agents scale from single-stock research to portfolio-level decisions.

cases.title: 美股科技龙头浮盈止盈决策：英伟达（NVDA）
cases.title_en: US Tech Giant Profit-Taking Decision: NVIDIA (NVDA)
cases.subtitle: 11 角色团队协作：四维分析 + 多空辩论 + 三方风险评估，给出减仓 30% 明确方案
cases.subtitle_en: 11-role team collaboration: four-dimensional analysis, bull-bear debate, three-way risk assessment, with a clear 30% trim recommendation
cases.description:
持有美股科技股浮盈 60% 已经很久，每次到历史高位就纠结「到底是继续拿、砍一半、还是全部止盈」——看好 AI 基建逻辑舍不得下车，又怕一次回调把浮盈全吐回去，一个人根本决策不了。

这个案例演示了 TradingAgent 专家团（主理人 + 技术/基本面/新闻/情绪 4 位分析师 + 多空 2 位辩手 + 激进/保守/中性 3 位风险评估师 + 交易决策官）11 个角色，对英伟达（NASDAQ: NVDA）在 $208 当前价位做系统化诊断：从 RSI 83 严重超买、MACD 金叉动能放缓，到 Q4 FY2026 营收 $68.1B、Blackwell/Rubin 产品节奏，到 Google TPU v7/Meta 2027 转 ASIC 的自研拐点叙事，到北向资金/机构持仓/期权 IV，多空两位辩手交叉论证后，激进派（继续拿）、保守派（全部止盈）、中性派（部分减仓）三方辩论，最终锁定「减仓 30% 落袋 18% 绝对收益 + 保留 70% 博 Rubin 放量」的可执行方案，附止盈 $220–$230 / 止损 $170 / 跟踪财报+GPU 出货+监管动态的完整路线图。

适合：美股科技股长线持仓、有明显浮盈需要考虑止盈的中长线投资者；跨境资产配置的家庭/私人银行客户；做美股投顾展业的 FA；想系统化处理「既不想割肉、又怕回吐」心理博弈的个人投资者。
cases.description_en:
You've been holding a US tech stock at 60% profit for a long time, and every time it hits an all-time high, you agonize: 'keep it, cut half, or take everything off the table?' You like the AI infra story and don't want to get off the train, yet you're terrified that one drawdown erases all the paper gains — this is not a decision you can make alone.

This case shows how the TradingAgent expert team (lead orchestrator + 4 technical/fundamentals/news/sentiment analysts + 2 bull & bear researchers + aggressive/conservative/neutral risk assessors + trader) — 11 roles total — runs a systematic diagnosis on NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) at its current $208 level: from RSI 83 overbought and MACD momentum fading, to Q4 FY2026 revenue of $68.1B and the Blackwell/Rubin product roadmap, to the bearish self-designed-ASIC narrative (Google TPU v7, Meta migrating to TPU by 2027), to northbound flows/institutional holdings/options IV, with two debaters cross-examining, then aggressive/conservative/neutral risk assessors debating before landing on an actionable plan: trim 30% to lock in 18% absolute return, keep 70% to capture Rubin ramp-up, with a full roadmap — take-profit $220–$230, stop-loss $170, and tracking milestones on earnings, GPU shipments, and regulatory dynamics.

Target audience: US tech long-holders with significant paper gains weighing profit-taking; cross-border asset allocators and private banking clients; financial advisors doing US equity consulting; individual investors looking to systematically handle the 'don't want to sell yet don't want to round-trip' psychological tension.

cases.title: 三步翻译法：信达雅翻译
cases.subtitle: 直译 → 反思 → 意译，三步出地道英文
cases.subtitle_en: Literal → Reflect → Paraphrase, three steps to natural English
cases.description:
AI 翻译最大的问题不是翻不出来，而是翻出来的东西一股机翻味：语序生硬、用词重复、该拆的长句没拆、该合的短句没合。直接用 Google Translate 或通用 AI 翻译，放到英文论文或技术文档里一眼就能看出是翻译的。

这个案例演示了「三步翻译法」：第一步直译（保留原意的逐句翻译），第二步反思（标注直译中的问题：生硬表达、文化差异、术语不准、句式单调），第三步意译（基于反思结果重写为地道英文）。用一段中文技术文档作为输入，完整展示三步过程和最终结果的对比，让你看到每一步的改进。

适合：科研人员写英文论文、技术文档国际化、开发者写英文 README、任何需要高质量中译英的场景。
cases.description_en:
The biggest problem with AI translation isn't that it can't translate — it's that the output screams "machine translated": stiff word order, repetitive vocabulary, long sentences that should be split. Google Translate output in an academic paper is spotted immediately.

This case demonstrates the "Three-Step Translation Method": Step 1 literal translation (sentence-by-sentence preserving meaning), Step 2 reflection (annotating issues: stiff expressions, cultural differences, terminology errors, monotonous sentence patterns), Step 3 paraphrase (rewriting into natural English based on reflections). Using a Chinese technical document as input, it shows the complete three-step process with before/after comparisons.

Best for: Researchers writing English papers, technical documentation internationalization, developers writing English READMEs, any high-quality CN-to-EN translation needs.
cases.prompt:
请用「三步翻译法」（直译 → 反思 → 意译）把以下中文技术文档翻译成地道英文。

待翻译原文（粘贴你的中文文档）：
...

要求：
1. **直译**：逐段翻译，保留原文句式
2. **反思**：逐段标注直译中的问题
3. **意译**：基于反思重写为地道英文，符合英文技术写作风格，术语一致、句式长短搭配

最终输出三个完整版本 + 每步之间的改进说明。
cases.prompt_en:
Please use the "Three-Step Translation Method" (literal → reflect → paraphrase) to translate the following Chinese technical document into natural, idiomatic English.

Source text to translate (paste your Chinese document):
...

Requirements:
1. **Literal**: translate paragraph by paragraph, preserving the original sentence structure
2. **Reflect**: annotate the issues in the literal version paragraph by paragraph
3. **Paraphrase**: rewrite into natural, idiomatic English based on the reflections — English technical-writing style, consistent terminology, varied sentence lengths

Output all three complete versions + an explanation of the improvements between each step.

This case draws a real 2021 Guangxi question live (government sites "reporting only good news") and demonstrates a full round: a model answer unfolds through position-analysis-solutions, then scores on logical clarity, solution feasibility and fluency (17/15/16) with per-dimension advice. The model answer and scores are labelled as demonstration.

For: candidates in the final sprint who need high-frequency feedback.

cases.title: 用户画像生成器
cases.subtitle: 输入产品描述，自动生成 3 个立体用户画像
cases.subtitle_en: Input product description, auto-generate 3 detailed user personas
cases.description:
做产品最怕「我觉得用户需要」。用户画像是产品设计的起点，但传统做法要花几周做访谈、发问卷、整理数据，小团队根本没这个资源。直接拍脑袋画个画像又容易变成「25 岁互联网从业者月入 2 万」的万能模板，对决策毫无指导意义。

这个案例演示了输入一款「团队知识库 SaaS 产品」的简要描述，AI 自动生成 3 个差异化用户画像：每个画像包含人口统计信息、职业背景、一天时间线、核心痛点与需求、使用场景、付费意愿与决策链路、以及产品功能优先级排序。三个画像分别代表核心用户、增长用户和边缘用户，帮你全面理解目标市场。

适合：产品经理、创业者做用户研究、UX 设计师、市场营销人员制定投放策略、投资人评估市场。
cases.description_en:
The biggest product mistake is "I think users need this." User personas are the starting point of product design, but traditional approaches take weeks of interviews, surveys, and data analysis — resources small teams don't have. Guessing a persona usually produces a useless template.

This case demonstrates inputting a brief description of a "Team Knowledge Base SaaS" product, with AI auto-generating 3 differentiated user personas: each with demographics, career background, daily timeline, core pain points, usage scenarios, willingness to pay and decision chain, and feature priority ranking. The three personas represent core, growth, and edge users for comprehensive market understanding.

Best for: Product managers, entrepreneurs doing user research, UX designers, marketers planning targeting strategies, investors evaluating markets.
cases.prompt:
请为以下产品生成 3 个详细的用户画像。

产品描述（粘贴你的产品简介，含定位、核心功能与定价）：
...

请生成 3 个差异化画像，分别代表核心用户、增长用户、边缘用户。

每个画像需立体、可指导决策，涵盖基本信息、职业背景、核心痛点、功能需求优先级、使用场景、付费决策、流失风险与挽留策略。

最后附：三画像对比总结表 + 基于画像的产品策略建议（3-5 条）。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate 3 detailed user personas for the following product.

Product description (paste your product brief, including its positioning, core features, and pricing):
...

Generate 3 differentiated personas representing a core user, a growth user, and a fringe user.

Each persona should be vivid and decision-actionable, covering basic information, professional background, core pain points, feature need priority, usage scenarios, purchase decision, and churn risk with retention strategy.

Finally, add: a comparison summary table of the three personas + product strategy recommendations (3-5 items).

cases.title: SEO 长文内容创作
cases.subtitle: 输入关键词和选题，AI 产出 3000+ 字结构化 SEO 深度长文
cases.subtitle_en: Input keywords and topic, AI produces 3000+ word structured SEO long-form article
cases.description:
写一篇能抢搜索排名的深度长文有多难？关键词调研、竞品分析、大纲规划、正文撰写、FAQ 优化、meta 标签……光是列清单就够让人头大，更别说要保证每篇都 3000 字以上、结构清晰、还得有对比表格和内外链布局。

这个案例演示了输入目标关键词「2026 远程办公工具推荐」，AI 一站式产出一篇完整的 SEO 深度长文：包含 H2/H3 层级标题结构、10 款工具的功能-价格-适用团队对比表格、每款工具的优缺点分析和真实使用场景、5 个以上 FAQ 常见问题、内链/外链建议位置标注，以及 meta description 和 title tag 优化建议。复制即可发布。

适合：内容营销团队、SEO 运营人员、企业博客编辑、独立站站长、需要批量产出高质量 SEO 内容的任何人。
cases.description_en:
How hard is it to write a ranking-worthy long-form SEO article? Keyword research, competitor analysis, outline planning, body writing, FAQ optimization, meta tags — just listing the steps is overwhelming, let alone ensuring every piece is 3000+ words with clear structure, comparison tables, and internal/external link placement.

This case demonstrates inputting target keywords like "2026 remote work tools" and having AI produce a complete SEO long-form article: H2/H3 heading hierarchy, a comparison table of 10 tools covering features, pricing, and team size fit, pros/cons analysis with real usage scenarios for each tool, 5+ FAQ questions, internal/external link placement suggestions, plus meta description and title tag optimization. Copy and publish.

Ideal for: Content marketing teams, SEO specialists, corporate blog editors, independent site owners, anyone needing to produce high-quality SEO content at scale.

artifacts.label: SEO深度长文

cases.prompt: 为一家企业协同办公 SaaS 公司的官方博客撰写一篇 SEO 深度长文。目标关键词：「2026 远程办公工具推荐」「远程协作软件对比」「居家办公效率提升」。文章标题建议：《2026 年远程办公工具终极指南：10 款热门协作软件横评对比》。要求：1）3000-4000 字，结构清晰（含 H2/H3 标题层级）；2）包含工具对比表格（至少对比 6 款工具的核心功能、价格、适用团队规模）；3）每个工具段落包含优缺点分析和真实使用场景；4）包含 FAQ 章节（至少 5 个常见问题）；5）内链/外链建议位置标注；6）meta description 和 title tag 建议。
cases.prompt_en: Write an in-depth SEO long-form article for the official blog of an enterprise collaboration & office SaaS company. Target keywords: "2026 remote work tool recommendations," "remote collaboration software comparison," "boosting work-from-home productivity." Suggested article title: "The Ultimate 2026 Remote Work Tools Guide: A Head-to-Head Review of 10 Popular Collaboration Software." Requirements: 1) 3,000-4,000 words, clearly structured (with H2/H3 heading levels); 2) include a tool comparison table (comparing at least 6 tools on core features, price, and suitable team size); 3) each tool section includes a pros-and-cons analysis and real usage scenarios; 4) include a FAQ section (at least 5 common questions); 5) mark suggested positions for internal/external links; 6) suggestions for the meta description and title tag.

cases.description:
出发前最怕航班因天气延误，但看天气 App 根本看不出机场实际飞行条件。

这个案例演示了如何查询两个机场的实时 METAR 航空气象报文：温度、风速风向、能见度、云层高度，并把专业报文解读成普通人能看懂的飞行条件评估——是晴天可飞（VFR）还是低能见度（IFR），要不要提前关注延误风险。

适合：出行前想确认天气的乘客、关注航班延误风险的商务旅客、学习航空气象的爱好者
cases.description_en:
Worried about weather delays? Consumer weather apps don't tell you the actual flying conditions at the airport.

This case shows how to query real-time METAR reports for two airports: temperature, wind speed/direction, visibility, and cloud ceiling — then translates the technical jargon into plain language flight condition assessments (VFR vs IFR), so you know whether to worry about delays before you leave home.

Best for: Travelers wanting pre-flight weather checks, business passengers monitoring delay risks, aviation weather enthusiasts

Please look up the METAR reports for Beijing Capital Airport (PEK) and Shanghai Hongqiao Airport (SHA) separately, interpret the temperature, wind speed and direction, visibility, and cloud ceiling, determine whether conditions are Visual Flight Rules (VFR) or Instrument Flight Rules (IFR), and tell me whether there's a risk of delays.

这个案例演示了如何用一句话生成完整的亲子旅行方案：5天昆明-大理-丽江路线，每天精细到景点顺序、交通方式、用餐建议，自动按2大1小家庭结构推荐亲子友好景点，附带预算分配表和打包清单。省去翻攻略、拼信息的时间。

cases.description_en:
Planning a family trip to Yunnan — which attractions are kid-friendly, how to structure 5 days across 3 cities, how to split a 15,000 RMB budget — researching all this takes days.

This case shows how one prompt generates a complete family itinerary: 5 days Kunming-Dali-Lijiang, with each day's attractions sequenced, transport specified, and meals suggested, tailored for 2 adults + 1 child. Includes budget breakdown and packing checklist.

Best for: Parents planning domestic family trips, Yunnan self-guided travelers, busy families who need a ready-to-use itinerary fast

cases.prompt_en: Help me plan a 5-day family trip to Yunnan with kids, on the route Kunming → Dali → Lijiang, for a family of 2 adults and 1 child, with a budget of ¥15,000. For each day, arrange attractions suitable for children, including transportation and dining suggestions, and attach a budget allocation table and a packing checklist.

cases.title: 五一厦门旅行一站式规划

cases.description:
五一出行计划，机票、酒店、景点门票要分别去不同平台查，信息散乱还容易出现价格不一致的情况。

这个案例演示了如何用飞猪 MCP 一站式搜索厦门五一出行方案：上海→厦门直飞价格对比、厦门特色酒店推荐（含价格和区域）、鼓浪屿等主要景点门票，再附上4晚5天的简要行程框架，所有数据来自飞猪实时接口。

适合：五一出行计划者、喜欢一站式搜索的旅行者、需要快速出厦门方案的用户
cases.description_en:
Planning a May Day trip means bouncing between platforms for flights, hotels and tickets — information is scattered and prices vary.

This case shows how to use Fliggy MCP to get a complete Xiamen trip package in one shot: Shanghai-Xiamen flight price comparison, curated hotel recommendations with pricing, attraction tickets for Gulangyu and more, plus a 4-night itinerary framework. All data from Fliggy's live API.

Best for: May Day trip planners, one-stop-search travelers, anyone who needs a ready-to-use Xiamen plan fast

artifacts.label: 厦门出行方案

cases.prompt_en: Help me plan a 4-night, 5-day May Day trip to Xiamen: departing from Shanghai, search for direct-flight price comparisons, recommended distinctive Xiamen hotels (with prices and districts), and tickets for major attractions such as Gulangyu, with a brief itinerary framework. All data should come from Fliggy.

cases.title: 东京出行全攻略
cases.subtitle: 签证、汇率、机场、活动，出发前一次查清楚
cases.subtitle_en: Visa, exchange rates, airport info and events — everything before your Tokyo trip
cases.description:
出国旅游信息散落各处：签证要在官网查、汇率要在银行看、机场交通要单独搜、当地活动要找攻略——光是出发前的准备就要开十几个标签页。

这个案例演示了如何一次性获取东京出行的全套准备信息：中国公民签证要求、实时人民币兑日元汇率和换汇建议、成田机场交通攻略、以及出行月份的特色活动日历。一个 Prompt，覆盖出发前所有关键准备。

适合：第一次出国的旅行者、计划日本自由行的用户、需要快速梳理出境信息的人
cases.description_en:
Pre-trip research for international travel means opening a dozen tabs: visa requirements on the embassy site, exchange rates from the bank, airport transport on a travel blog, local events on yet another site.

This case shows how to get a complete Tokyo trip prep kit in one shot: Chinese citizen visa requirements, real-time CNY/JPY exchange rate with conversion tips, Narita airport transport guide, and a June activity calendar. One prompt, all the essentials covered.

Best for: First-time international travelers, Japan independent travelers, anyone who needs a quick pre-departure briefing

artifacts.label: 东京出行准备指南

cases.prompt_en: I'm planning a trip to Tokyo in June. Help me figure out everything at once: visa requirements for Chinese citizens traveling to Japan, the real-time CNY-to-JPY exchange rate and currency exchange advice, transportation tips for getting from Narita Airport to the city, and a calendar of special events in Tokyo in June.

cases.title: 头顶上空实时航班

有没有好奇过头顶的天空有多繁忙？每隔几分钟就有飞机经过，但你不知道它们来自哪里、飞向哪里、有多高多快。

这个案例演示了如何实时查询某个城市上空的所有航班：呼号、来源国、飞行高度、速度、航向，数据直接来自 OpenSky Network 全球 ADS-B 接收网络，完全免费、实时更新。还可以横向对比北京和上海的空中交通繁忙程度。

Ever wondered how busy the sky above you is? Planes pass overhead every few minutes, but where are they from, where are they going, how high and fast?

This case shows how to query all aircraft flying over a city in real time: callsign, origin country, altitude, speed, and heading — data straight from the OpenSky Network global ADS-B receiver network, completely free and updated in real time. Includes a comparison of air traffic density between Beijing and Shanghai.

Best for: Aviation enthusiasts, curious sky-watchers, developers exploring real-time flight data

cases.prompt_en: Help me check all the flights currently flying over Beijing, showing the callsign, country of origin, flight altitude, speed, and heading, and compare the air traffic congestion levels of Beijing and Shanghai.

cases.title: 国内机票三平台比价

cases.description:
买国内机票时，同一个航班在携程、去哪儿、飞猪上价格不一定相同，但一个一个搜又太费时间。

这个案例演示了如何一次性对比三大平台的北京→三亚机票价格：同日期、同航线，列出各平台最低价、对应航班信息和价差分析，帮你快速判断在哪个平台下单最划算。附带三亚各住宿区域的特点对比，一并解决住哪里的选择困难。

适合：国内出行的精打细算旅客、五一/黄金周出行计划者、想省钱买机票的用户
cases.description_en:
The same domestic flight can have different prices on Ctrip, Qunar, and Fliggy — but checking each platform one by one wastes time.

This case shows how to compare Beijing-Sanya flight prices across all three major platforms in one query: same date, same route, with the lowest fare from each platform, airline details, and price gap analysis so you know exactly where to book. Includes a Sanya accommodation zone comparison as a bonus.

Best for: Budget-conscious domestic travelers, Golden Week trip planners, anyone who wants to buy the cheapest ticket without the hassle

cases.prompt_en: Help me compare the airfare for Beijing to Sanya on May 1st across the three major platforms Ctrip, Qunar, and Fliggy. List each platform's lowest price, the corresponding flight information, and a price-difference analysis, and append a comparison of the characteristics of Sanya's various lodging areas.

cases.title: 简历精修：学生会经历改银行网申
cases.title_en: Resume Refit: Student-Union Story for Bank Applications
cases.subtitle: STAR 法则 300 字改写＋六个能力词植入
cases.subtitle_en: A 300-character STAR rewrite with six competency keywords
cases.description:
「组织过一次大型活动，办得很成功」——这句话机筛抓不到关键词，人筛记不住任何点。

本案例演示把一段普通学生会经历用 STAR 法则改写成银行网申段落：情境任务给规模与预算、行动拆三条执行线、结果给三个可核数字，并植入组织协调、项目管理等六个能力词。示例数字标注为占位，附「网申夸大属背调一票否决项」的诚信提醒。

适合：经历普通但想写出亮点的学生、批量辅导网申的老师。
cases.description_en:
"Organised a large event, it went very well" — machine screens catch no keywords and human screens remember nothing.

This case rewrites an ordinary student-union story into a bank-application paragraph via STAR: situation and task carry scale and budget, action splits into three execution lines, result lands three checkable numbers — with six competency keywords embedded. Example figures are marked as placeholders, alongside the integrity warning that exaggeration fails background checks outright.

For: students with ordinary experiences seeking real highlights, and teachers coaching applications at volume.

artifacts.label: STAR 300 字改写示范

cases.prompt: 我有一段在学生会组织大型活动的经历，请用 STAR 法则帮我改写成适合银行网申的 300 字项目描述。要求：1) 给出改写前后对照并诊断原句问题；2) STAR 四要素齐全，量化数字用占位并提醒我按真实经历替换，不许编造；3) 标注植入的关键能力词；4) 附银行网申的适配要点与诚信红线。
cases.prompt_en: I organised a large student-union event — rewrite it with the STAR method into a 300-character project description for bank applications. Requirements: 1) show before/after and diagnose the original; 2) cover all four STAR elements, using placeholder metrics with a reminder to substitute real ones — never fabricate; 3) mark the embedded competency keywords; 4) append bank-application fit points and the integrity red line.

cases.title: 个人知识体系梳理
cases.subtitle: 输入学习目标和背景，生成交互式学习路线图
cases.subtitle_en: Input learning goals and background to generate an interactive learning roadmap
cases.description:
想转型学习新技术栈，但面对海量资源不知从何下手——该先学什么、每个阶段要花多长时间、有哪些优质资源？自己梳理一份学习计划往往要花几天，而且很难做到系统化和可视化。

这个案例演示了为一位 3 年经验的后端工程师生成从零学习大模型（LLM）技术的学习路线图：4 个学习阶段（基础补课 -> ML入门 -> 深度学习 -> LLM实战），每阶段包含知识节点清单、推荐课程/书籍/实战项目、预估学时和难度标签。

适合：技术转型者、自学编程者、培训机构课程设计、团队技术培训规划。
cases.description_en:
Wanting to learn a new tech stack but overwhelmed by resources — what to learn first, how long each phase takes, which resources are best? Creating a systematic study plan manually takes days and rarely ends up visual or trackable.

This case demonstrates generating an LLM learning roadmap for a backend engineer with 3 years of experience: 4 learning phases (Foundation -> ML Basics -> Deep Learning -> LLM Practice), each with knowledge node checklists, recommended courses/books/projects, estimated hours and difficulty tags.

Best for: Career transitioners, self-learners, training curriculum designers, team tech training planners.

artifacts.label: LLM学习路线图

cases.prompt: 为一位想从零学习大模型（LLM）技术的后端开发工程师生成一个学习路线图。学习者背景：3 年 Java/Python 后端开发经验，熟悉数据库和分布式系统，数学基础一般。学习路线分 4 个阶段：Phase 1 - 基础补课（4 周）、Phase 2 - 机器学习入门（6 周）、Phase 3 - 深度学习核心（8 周）、Phase 4 - 大模型实战（6 周）。每阶段包含知识节点清单、推荐资源、预估学时和难度标签。
cases.prompt_en: Generate a learning roadmap for a backend developer who wants to learn large language model (LLM) technology from scratch. Learner background: 3 years of Java/Python backend development experience, familiar with databases and distributed systems, average math foundation. The learning path is divided into 4 phases: Phase 1 - Foundation Catch-up (4 weeks), Phase 2 - Machine Learning Basics (6 weeks), Phase 3 - Deep Learning Core (8 weeks), Phase 4 - LLM Hands-on Practice (6 weeks). Each phase includes a knowledge node checklist, recommended resources, estimated study hours, and difficulty tags.

cases.subtitle_en: Input content strategy, generate multi-platform content publishing schedule and tracking spreadsheet
cases.description:
做内容运营最怕的是排期混乱——公众号周三发还是周四发？抖音这周的选题定了吗？小红书的图文谁在写？上周的数据复盘做了没？信息散落在聊天记录、备忘录、脑子里，一忙起来就漏发、撞车、忘复盘。

这个案例演示了输入内容策略信息（运营平台、发布频率、内容主题），AI 自动生成一份完整的内容排期 Excel 表格：月度内容日历（按周排列的发布计划）、选题库（标题/平台/类型/状态/负责人）、数据追踪表（阅读量/点赞/评论/转发/转化）、平台规范速查表。自带条件格式和数据验证，团队协作即开即用。

适合：新媒体运营、内容团队、品牌市场部、自媒体创作者。
cases.description_en:
Content operations' biggest nightmare is schedule chaos — is the WeChat article going out Wednesday or Thursday? Is this week's Douyin topic finalized? Who's writing the Xiaohongshu post? Did we do last week's data review? Information scattered across chats, notes, and memory leads to missed posts, overlapping content, and forgotten reviews.

This case demonstrates inputting content strategy info (platforms, publishing frequency, content themes), with AI generating a complete content calendar Excel spreadsheet: monthly content calendar (weekly publishing plan), topic bank (title/platform/type/status/owner), data tracking sheet (views/likes/comments/shares/conversions), and platform specs reference sheet. Built-in conditional formatting and data validation for team collaboration.

Best for: Social media managers, content teams, brand marketing departments, independent creators.
cases.prompt:
请为一个科技品牌的新媒体团队生成一份内容发布排期 Excel（output.xlsx）。

品牌信息：消费科技品牌 TechPulse，运营微信公众号、小红书、抖音、B站四个平台，各平台有固定发布频率，内容涵盖产品评测、科技新闻、使用技巧、行业趋势等方向。

请生成以下工作表：
1. 月度内容日历（按周排列）：日期、星期、平台、内容标题、类型、负责人、状态等，填满 4 周
2. 选题库：约 20 个选题，含标题、平台、类型、优先级、状态、负责人、截止日期
3. 数据追踪表：约 15 条示例数据，含阅读 / 播放量、点赞、评论、转发、新增关注、转化
4. 平台规范速查：各平台内容格式、最佳发布时间、字数与规格建议

要求：状态列用数据验证下拉，优先级用条件格式区分，数据追踪表带汇总行。输出为 .xlsx 文件。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a content publishing schedule Excel (output.xlsx) for a tech brand's new-media team.

Brand info: consumer-tech brand TechPulse, operating WeChat Official Account, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Bilibili, each with a fixed publishing cadence, content covering product reviews, tech news, tips, industry trends, and more.

Please generate these worksheets:
1. Monthly content calendar (by week): date, day, platform, title, type, owner, status, etc., filling a full 4 weeks
2. Topic library: about 20 topics with title, platform, type, priority, status, owner, due date
3. Performance tracking: about 15 sample records with reads/views, likes, comments, shares, new followers, conversions
4. Platform guidelines: each platform's content format, best posting time, length and spec recommendations

Requirements: data-validation dropdown for the status column, conditional formatting for priority, a summary row on the tracking sheet. Output as an .xlsx file.

cases.title: 课程教学计划表
cases.subtitle: 输入课程信息，生成完整的教学计划与进度追踪表格
cases.subtitle_en: Input course info, generate complete teaching plan and progress tracking spreadsheet
cases.description:
老师每学期要做教学计划、备课进度、学时分配、考核方案——但这些信息散在不同文档里，期末汇总时手忙脚乱。培训机构更头疼，多个班级、多位讲师的排课协调经常出错。

这个案例演示了输入一门大学课程的基本信息（课程名称、学时、教学目标），AI 自动生成一份完整的课程教学计划 Excel 表格：学期总览（课程基本信息、学时分配、教学目标）、16 周教学计划（每周主题/知识点/教学方式/作业/资源）、考核方案（出勤/作业/实验/期中/期末项目的占比与评分标准）、学生成绩追踪表（15 名学生的各项成绩与加权总评）。公式自动计算总评和等级。

适合：高校教师、培训讲师、教务管理人员、在线教育课程设计者。
cases.description_en:
Teachers need teaching plans, lesson progress, hour allocation, and assessment schemes every semester — but this information is scattered across different documents, causing chaos at semester-end summaries. Training institutions face even bigger headaches coordinating schedules across multiple classes and instructors.

This case demonstrates inputting a college course's basic info (course name, hours, teaching objectives), with AI generating a complete course teaching plan Excel spreadsheet: semester overview (course info, hour breakdown, objectives), 16-week teaching plan (weekly topics/knowledge points/teaching methods/assignments/resources), assessment scheme (attendance/homework/labs/midterm/final project weightings and rubrics), and student grade tracking sheet (15 students with weighted scores and grade formulas).

Best for: University professors, training instructors, academic administrators, online course designers.
cases.prompt:
请为一门大学课程生成一份完整的课程教学计划 Excel 表格。

课程信息：Python 数据分析（CS3042），3 学分 / 48 学时，计算机专业大三，2026 秋。教学目标：掌握 NumPy/Pandas/Matplotlib 等核心库，具备数据清洗、分析与建模能力。（可替换为你自己的课程信息）

请生成以下工作表：
1. 学期总览：课程基本信息、学时分配、教学目标、教材参考
2. 周教学计划（16 周）：周次、主题、知识点、教学方式、作业/实验等
3. 考核方案：各项考核占比与评分标准
4. 学生成绩追踪表：约 15 名学生，含各项分数、加权总评公式、等级

表格要求：总评用加权公式自动计算，等级按分数段判定，条件格式区分高分/不及格。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a complete course teaching plan as an Excel spreadsheet for a university course.

Course info: Python Data Analysis (CS3042), 3 credits / 48 hours, third-year CS students, fall 2026. Objectives: master core libraries such as NumPy/Pandas/Matplotlib, develop data cleaning, analysis, and modeling skills. (Replace with your own course info.)

Please generate the following worksheets:
1. Semester Overview: basic course info, hour allocation, objectives, textbooks/references
2. Weekly Teaching Plan (16 weeks): week, topic, knowledge points, teaching format, homework/lab, etc.
3. Assessment Scheme: weightings and grading criteria for each component
4. Student Grade Tracking Sheet: about 15 students, with per-item scores, a weighted-total formula, and letter grades

Spreadsheet requirements: compute the overall grade automatically with a weighted formula, assign letter grades by score band, and use conditional formatting to distinguish high scores / failing grades.

cases.title: 健身训练记录表
cases.subtitle: 输入训练目标，生成系统化的健身计划与训练追踪表格
cases.subtitle_en: Input fitness goals, generate systematic workout plan and training tracking spreadsheet
cases.description:
健身最怕三天打鱼两天晒网——去了健身房不知道练什么，练完不记录下次忘了用多重，练了三个月看不到进步因为没有数据对比。健身 App 要么太复杂要么不够灵活，其实一张 Excel 表就能搞定。

这个案例生成完整的健身训练记录 Excel：周训练计划（每天的训练部位和动作安排）、训练日志（每组的重量/次数/组数记录）、身体数据追踪（体重/体脂/围度月度变化）、个人最佳记录（PR）表。公式自动计算训练容量、汇总每周总量，条件格式高亮 PR 突破。

适合：健身爱好者、私教客户、减脂增肌计划执行者。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of fitness isn't the workout — it's consistency and tracking. Going to the gym without a plan, forgetting last session's weights, training for months without data to compare progress. Fitness apps are either too complex or too rigid. A well-structured Excel spreadsheet is all you need.

This case generates a complete fitness training log Excel: weekly training plan (daily muscle group and exercise arrangement), training journal (weight/reps/sets per exercise), body measurement tracking (monthly weight/body fat/circumference changes), and personal records (PR) table. Formulas auto-calculate training volume and weekly totals, conditional formatting highlights PR breakthroughs.

Best for: Fitness enthusiasts, personal training clients, anyone executing a muscle-building or fat-loss program.
cases.prompt:
请为一位中级健身爱好者生成一份完整的健身训练记录 Excel 表格。

个人信息：陈浩，男，28 岁，75kg，训练 2 年，目标增肌，每周 6 练（PPL 六天分化）。（可替换为你的个人信息与目标）

请生成以下工作表：
1. 周训练计划：每天训练主题、动作及组数 × 次数、预计时长
2. 训练日志（约 4 周）：日期、主题、动作、每组重量/次数、训练容量、感受评分等，体现渐进超负荷
3. 身体数据追踪：每月一次，体重、体脂、各围度及变化趋势
4. 个人最佳记录（PR）：主要复合动作 1RM、达成日期、下一目标

表格要求：训练容量用公式自动计算，PR 突破与低感受评分用条件格式标记。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a complete fitness training log Excel spreadsheet for an intermediate fitness enthusiast.

Personal info: Chen Hao, male, 28, 75kg, 2 years of training, goal muscle gain, 6 sessions/week (PPL six-day split). (Replace with your own info and goals.)

Please generate the following worksheets:
1. Weekly Training Plan: each day's theme, exercises with sets × reps, estimated duration
2. Training Log (~4 weeks): date, theme, exercise, weight/reps per set, training volume, feel rating, etc., reflecting progressive overload
3. Body Metrics Tracking: monthly — weight, body fat, circumferences, and trends
4. Personal Records (PRs): 1RM for main compound lifts, date achieved, next goal

Spreadsheet requirements: auto-calculate training volume with formulas, and use conditional formatting to mark PR breakthroughs and low feel ratings.

cases.title: 活动签到管理表
cases.subtitle: 输入活动信息，生成参会人员登记、签到追踪与数据统计表格
cases.subtitle_en: Input event info, generate attendee registration, check-in tracking and statistics spreadsheet
cases.description:
办活动最怕现场签到混乱——报名 200 人到场 150 人，谁来了谁没来？VIP 嘉宾有没有专人接待？餐食数量够不够？T 恤尺码准备对了吗？用纸质签到表不方便统计，用专业系统又大材小用。

这个案例生成完整的活动签到管理 Excel：参会人员名单（姓名/公司/职位/联系方式/票种/餐食/T恤尺码）、签到追踪表（签到时间/签到方式）、数据统计仪表盘（到场率/票种分布/公司分布）、物资清单。每张表都有条件格式和数据验证，现场打印或投屏即用。

适合：会议活动、技术沙龙、公司年会、培训班、行业峰会。
cases.description_en:
The biggest fear when running events is check-in chaos — 200 registered but only 150 show up. Who came? Who didn't? Did VIP guests get greeted? Is there enough food? Are the T-shirt sizes right? Paper sign-in sheets are hard to analyze, and dedicated event systems are overkill for most events.

This case generates a complete event attendee management Excel: attendee roster (name/company/role/contact/ticket type/meal/T-shirt size), check-in tracking sheet (check-in time/method), data statistics dashboard (attendance rate/ticket distribution/company breakdown), and supplies checklist. Each sheet includes conditional formatting and data validation, ready for on-site printing or screen display.

Best for: Conferences, tech meetups, company annual events, training sessions, industry summits.
cases.prompt:
请为一场技术峰会生成一份活动签到管理 Excel（output.xlsx）。

活动：TechVision 2026 全球开发者峰会，2026 年 5 月 20 日 · 深圳，约 200 人，票种含 VIP/标准/学生/赞助商。请生成一份合理的代表性模拟数据。

包含工作表：参会名单、签到追踪表、数据统计（到场率/票种分布/公司分布/餐食/T恤尺码）、物资清单。代表性字段如姓名、公司、票种、签到状态、签到时间等。

要求：票种/餐食列用数据验证下拉，签到状态用条件格式，物资差额为负标红，统计表用公式汇总。
cases.prompt_en:
Generate an event check-in management Excel (output.xlsx) for a tech summit.

Event: TechVision 2026 Global Developer Summit, May 20 2026 · Shenzhen, ~200 attendees, ticket types VIP/Standard/Student/Sponsor. Generate a reasonable representative set of mock data.

Include sheets: attendee list, check-in tracker, statistics (attendance rate / ticket distribution / company distribution / meal / T-shirt size), and a supplies list. Representative fields such as name, company, ticket type, check-in status, check-in time.

Requirements: data-validation dropdowns for ticket type/meal, conditional formatting for check-in status, negative supply gaps in red, formula-based summaries in the stats sheet.

cases.title: 读书清单追踪表
cases.subtitle: 输入阅读目标，生成年度读书计划与阅读记录追踪表格
cases.subtitle_en: Input reading goals, generate annual reading plan and progress tracking spreadsheet
cases.description:
年初立 flag「今年读 50 本书」，年底发现只读了 8 本——不是不想读，是缺少系统化的追踪和激励。读完一本书，精华笔记记在哪里？推荐给朋友的时候又找不到了。

这个案例演示了输入年度阅读目标和偏好，AI 自动生成一份完整的读书追踪 Excel 表格：年度目标仪表盘（目标/已读/进行中/完成率）、书单明细（书名/作者/分类/页数/开始日期/完成日期/评分/状态）、月度阅读统计（每月读了几本/多少页）、读书笔记索引（每本书的核心收获/金句/推荐指数）。公式自动计算完成率和日均页数，条件格式高亮评分和状态。

适合：阅读爱好者、读书会组织者、个人成长计划执行者、想养成阅读习惯的人。
cases.description_en:
Set a New Year's resolution to read 50 books, only to find you've finished 8 by December — it's not lack of desire, but lack of systematic tracking and motivation. Where do you keep notes from finished books? When recommending to friends, you can never find them again.

This case demonstrates inputting annual reading goals and preferences, with AI generating a complete book reading tracker Excel spreadsheet: annual goal dashboard (target/read/in-progress/completion rate), book list detail (title/author/genre/pages/start date/end date/rating/status), monthly reading statistics (books and pages per month), and reading notes index (key takeaways/quotes/recommendation level per book). Formulas auto-calculate completion rates and daily page averages, with conditional formatting for ratings and status.

Best for: Book lovers, book club organizers, personal growth plan practitioners, anyone building a reading habit.
cases.prompt:
请为一位阅读爱好者生成一份年度读书追踪 Excel（output.xlsx）。

基本信息：2026 年度目标 36 本，截至 4 月中旬已读 14 本、在读 3 本，偏好商业/技术/文学/心理/历史/科普。请生成一份合理的代表性模拟数据。

包含工作表：年度总览、书单明细、月度阅读统计、读书笔记索引。代表性字段如书名、作者、分类、页数、起止日期、评分、状态等。

要求：评分列用条件格式，状态列用数据验证下拉，完成率用公式自动计算，月度统计有汇总行。
cases.prompt_en:
Generate an annual reading tracker Excel (output.xlsx) for a book lover.

Basics: 2026 goal of 36 books; as of mid-April, 14 read and 3 in progress; prefers business/tech/literature/psychology/history/popular-science. Generate a reasonable representative set of mock data.

Include sheets: annual overview, book list detail, monthly reading stats, reading-notes index. Representative fields such as title, author, category, page count, start/end date, rating, status.

Requirements: conditional formatting on the rating column, data-validation dropdown on status, formula-based completion rate, summary row in the monthly stats.

cases.title: A/B 测试结果分析表
cases.subtitle: 输入实验数据，生成完整的 A/B 测试分析与决策报告表格
cases.subtitle_en: Input experiment data, generate complete A/B test analysis and decision report spreadsheet
cases.description:
跑 A/B 测试最怕的是分析环节——实验跑完了，p 值怎么算？置信区间多少？样本量够不够？提升幅度有统计显著性吗？很多产品经理只看个转化率高低就下结论，结果上线后效果完全不符预期。

这个案例生成完整的 A/B 测试分析 Excel：实验概览（实验名/假设/指标/时间/样本量）、原始数据汇总（对照组/实验组的各项指标）、统计分析表（转化率差异/置信区间/p值/统计功效/MDE）、决策建议。自带统计公式和判断逻辑，产品经理直接填数据就能得到专业的分析结论。

适合：产品经理、增长团队、数据分析师、需要做实验决策的技术团队。
cases.description_en:
The scariest part of A/B testing isn't running the experiment — it's the analysis. How do you calculate p-values? What's the confidence interval? Is the sample size sufficient? Is the lift statistically significant? Many product managers just compare conversion rates and call it a day, only to find post-launch results don't match expectations.

This case generates a complete A/B test analysis Excel: experiment overview (name/hypothesis/metrics/duration/sample size), raw data summary (control vs treatment group metrics), statistical analysis table (conversion rate difference/confidence interval/p-value/statistical power/MDE), and decision recommendations. Built-in statistical formulas and decision logic — PMs just input data and get professional analysis conclusions.

Best for: Product managers, growth teams, data analysts, technical teams making experiment-driven decisions.
cases.prompt:
请为一次 A/B 测试生成完整的分析报告 Excel（output.xlsx）。

实验信息（填入你的实验）：
- 名称、假设、主/次要指标、实验时长、流量分配、最小可检测效应（MDE）
- 对照组与实验组的访客数、转化数、转化率等核心数据

工作表骨架：
1. 实验概览：基本信息与一句话结论
2. 数据汇总：两组核心指标对比与每日明细
3. 统计分析：提升幅度、置信区间、p 值与显著性等统计计算
4. 决策建议：上线建议、收入影响与后续实验

要求：用 Excel 公式完成统计计算，显著性与涨跌用条件格式区分。
用「Excel 文件处理」技能输出。
cases.prompt_en:
Please generate a complete analysis report Excel (output.xlsx) for an A/B test.

Experiment info (fill in your own):
- Name, hypothesis, primary/secondary metrics, duration, traffic split, minimum detectable effect (MDE)
- Core data for control vs treatment groups: visitors, conversions, conversion rate, etc.

Worksheet skeleton:
1. Experiment Overview: basic info and a one-sentence conclusion
2. Data Summary: core-metric comparison of both groups plus daily breakdown
3. Statistical Analysis: lift, confidence interval, p-value and significance, and related statistics
4. Decision Recommendations: launch advice, revenue impact, and follow-up experiments

Requirements: use Excel formulas for the statistical calculations, and use conditional formatting to distinguish significance and up/down changes.
Use the "Excel File Processing" skill to output it.

cases.title: 团队 OKR 对齐 PPT
cases.subtitle: 输入团队 OKR，生成 All-Hands 对齐演示文稿
cases.description:
每个季度的 OKR 对齐会，最让人头疼的不是目标本身，而是怎么把目标讲清楚、让所有人达成共识。这个案例以「产品团队 2026 Q2 OKR 对齐」为主题，展示了 AI 如何快速生成一份 8 页的专业 OKR 对齐演示文稿。

生成的 PPT 包含：封面页（紫色渐变 + Q2 OKR 标签）、公司战略与 Q2 聚焦、三个核心 Objective 及对应 Key Results（含量化指标）、跨团队依赖地图、Q2 里程碑时间轴、以及收尾页。每个 KR 都有当前值和目标值的对比，一目了然。

你可以替换为自己团队的 OKR 内容，直接用在 All-Hands、团队周会或季度 Review 中。

适合：团队负责人、产品经理、项目管理、技术 Leader。

artifacts.label: 团队 OKR 对齐 PPT（8 页）

cases.prompt:
请帮我生成一份团队 OKR 对齐 PPT。

团队：产品技术中心 - 产品团队；时间：2026 Q2。

要求：
1. PPT 结构（约 8 页）：封面页 / 公司战略页（愿景 → 使命 → Q2 聚焦）/ Objective 1 提升产品核心体验（3 个 KR）/ Objective 2 扩大用户增长（3 个 KR）/ Objective 3 建设技术壁垒（3 个 KR）/ 跨团队依赖地图 / Q2 里程碑时间轴 / 收尾页
2. 风格：现代紫色渐变 + 白色文字
3. 每个 KR 都要有「当前值」与「目标值」对比

Please help me generate a team OKR alignment PPT.

1. PPT structure (about 8 slides): cover slide / company strategy slide (vision → mission → Q2 focus) / Objective 1 Improve core product experience (3 KRs) / Objective 2 Drive user growth (3 KRs) / Objective 3 Build technical moats (3 KRs) / cross-team dependency map / Q2 milestone timeline / closing slide

This case uses video generation to auto-produce a 20-second vertical short from this week's 5 key AI stories: timeline-linked, animated title entrances, highlighted keywords, with intro and outro. Ideal for AI-news accounts, weekly-recap videos, and short social content.

cases.title_en: Global GDP Bar Chart Race Video
cases.subtitle: 用 Remotion 把 2000→2024 各国 GDP 做成 45 秒动态条形赛跑
cases.subtitle_en: A 45s animated bar chart race of national GDP, 2000 to 2024, built with Remotion
cases.description: 数据榜单的变化用静态图表很难讲出张力，而手动剪辑动态视频又门槛高。本案例用 Remotion（代码渲染视频）把全球前十大经济体 2000–2024 年的 GDP 做成一条 45 秒、1080p、30fps 的动态条形赛跑：逐年平滑换位、数值滚动、超大年份水印、实时 Top10 合计，深色数据大屏风格。数据来源、动效参数、配色文案全部集中在代码顶部常量区，改一处即可换主题（如换成营收、用户量、城市人口排名）。适合做数据科普、年度复盘、社媒传播的运营与分析者。
cases.description_en: Static charts struggle to convey how rankings shift over time, and hand-editing a motion video has a high barrier. This case uses Remotion (code-rendered video) to turn the GDP of the world's top 10 economies from 2000 to 2024 into a 45-second, 1080p, 30fps animated bar chart race: smooth yearly re-ordering, rolling values, a giant year watermark, and a live Top-10 combined total, in a dark data-dashboard style. Data, motion parameters, colors and copy all live in a constants block at the top of the code, so swapping the topic (revenue, user counts, city population) is a one-edit change. Ideal for data storytelling, annual recaps, and social content.

artifacts.label: 全球 GDP 榜单赛跑视频

cases.prompt:
用 Remotion 帮我做一条「全球主要经济体 GDP 排名变化」的动态条形赛跑视频，横屏 1920×1080、30fps、约 45 秒。

内容：全球前十大经济体的名义 GDP（万亿美元）从 2000 到 2024 逐年动态排序赛跑，条形带国旗与中英国名、数值滚动、相邻年份平滑插值换位、超大半透明年份水印、左下角实时 Top10 合计 GDP、片头标题卡、片尾 2024 终局定格。数据请联网搜索 IMF/世界银行等真实公开 GDP 数据，趋势需符合史实（美国全程第一、中国约 2010 超日本升至第二、印度后段快速上升）。

风格：现代深色数据大屏，每国独立配色，bar 圆角 + 辉光，spring/缓动让换位平滑。所有文案/颜色/节奏/数据放在代码顶部常量区便于一键改主题。最后渲染导出 MP4。

配一段动感、有推进节奏的背景音乐，随赛跑节奏烘托紧张感。
cases.prompt_en:
Use Remotion to make an animated bar chart race video of "the changing ranking of major economies by GDP", landscape 1920×1080, 30fps, ~45 seconds.

Content: the nominal GDP (USD trillions) of the world's top 10 economies racing year by year from 2000 to 2024, bars with flags and country names, rolling values, smooth interpolated re-ordering between adjacent years, a giant semi-transparent year watermark, a live Top-10 combined GDP in the lower-left, an intro title card, and a 2024 final freeze at the end. Use public-magnitude data labeled "real (web-searched)", with history-accurate trends (US first throughout, China overtaking Japan around 2010 to reach #2, India rising fast later). 

Style: modern dark data dashboard, a distinct color per country, rounded glowing bars, spring/easing for smooth swaps. Keep all copy, colors, pacing and data in a constants block at the top of the code for one-edit topic swaps. Finally render and export the MP4.

Add an energetic, driving background music track that builds tension along with the race.

cases.subtitle: 用 Remotion 做一条 Apple 风暗色发布会短片

cases.description: 新品要在官网、社媒、发布会现场放一条有质感的宣传短片，外包制作既贵又改不动。本案例用 Remotion（代码渲染视频）+ AI 生图，把一款虚构旗舰 AI 降噪耳机「Aura Buds Pro」做成一条 30 秒、1080p、Apple 风暗色 keynote 短片：悬念片头、产品主视觉登场、核心亮点逐个标注、规格面板、价格与预购 CTA。产品图由 AI 生成，文案/配色/节奏全在代码顶部常量区，换产品改几行即可。适合品牌市场、电商、硬件团队快速产出发布素材。
cases.description_en: A new product needs a polished promo clip for the website, social feeds, and the launch stage, but outsourcing is expensive and hard to revise. This case uses Remotion (code-rendered video) plus AI image generation to turn a fictional flagship ANC earbud "Aura Buds Pro" into a 30-second, 1080p, Apple-style dark keynote clip: a teaser intro, a product hero reveal, annotated key features, a spec panel, and a price/pre-order CTA. The product imagery is AI-generated, and all copy, colors, and pacing live in a constants block at the top of the code, so swapping products is a few-line edit. Ideal for brand/marketing, e-commerce, and hardware teams.

artifacts.label: 新品发布会宣传视频

cases.prompt:
用 Remotion 帮我做一条新品发布会宣传短片，横屏 1920×1080、30fps、约 30 秒。主题是虚构旗舰新品「Aura Buds Pro」AI 降噪耳机。

先用 AI 生图做出产品主视觉（深色影棚里的高级无线耳机充电盒+耳机，电光蓝点缀）和细节图，再用 Remotion 编排：悬念片头标题 → 产品主视觉大图 spring 登场 → 3-4 个核心亮点逐个卡片（图标+短文案动效，如主动降噪/自适应 AI 引擎/续航/防水）→ 规格面板（驱动单元/降噪 dB/续航/防水等级）→ 价格与预购 CTA。

风格 Apple 风暗色影院级 keynote：纯黑底、超大轻量标题、大量负空间、电光蓝高光、产品图叠暗色渐变，无 emoji（图标用 SVG）。文案/颜色/节奏常量集中在代码顶部，最后渲染导出 MP4。

配一段科技感的背景音乐：低沉脉冲 + 空灵合成音 + 结尾上升，呼应发布会氛围。
cases.prompt_en:
Use Remotion to make a product-launch promo clip, landscape 1920×1080, 30fps, ~30 seconds, for a fictional flagship "Aura Buds Pro" ANC earbud.

First generate the product hero image with AI (a premium wireless earbud charging case and buds in a dark studio with electric-blue accents) plus detail shots, then compose with Remotion: a teaser title intro -> the product hero springing in -> 3-4 key-feature cards (icon + short copy animation, e.g. active noise cancellation / adaptive AI engine / battery / water resistance) -> a spec panel (driver / noise reduction dB / battery / IP rating) -> a price and pre-order CTA.

Style: Apple-like dark cinematic keynote: pure black background, oversized light-weight titles, generous negative space, electric-blue highlights, product image over a dark gradient, no emoji (icons as SVG). Keep copy, colors, and pacing as constants at the top of the code, and finally render the MP4.

Add a tech-style background music track: deep pulse + ethereal synth pads + a rising finale to match the launch mood.

cases.title: 旅行路线动态地图视频
cases.subtitle: 用 Remotion 做一条竖版「云南 7 日环线」路线地图短片
cases.subtitle_en: A vertical animated route-map short of a 7-day Yunnan loop, built with Remotion
cases.description: 旅行攻略发社媒，纯文字和静态地图很难一眼讲清路线和节奏。本案例用 Remotion（代码渲染视频）+ AI 生图，把「云南 7 日环线」做成一条 30 秒竖版（1080×1920）路线动态地图短片：手绘风路线在水彩地形底图上逐段延伸，每到一城——图钉弹入、目的地大图卡滑入、天数与一句话亮点动效，片尾汇总总里程与天数。4 张目的地图与地形底图均由 AI 生成，城市/坐标/天数/文案全在代码顶部常量区，换路线改数据即可。适合文旅、本地生活、旅行博主做社媒短视频。
cases.description_en: Travel itineraries shared on social media are hard to grasp from text and a static map alone. This case uses Remotion (code-rendered video) plus AI image generation to turn a "7-day Yunnan loop" into a 30-second vertical (1080×1920) animated route-map short: a hand-drawn route extends segment by segment over a watercolor terrain base, and at each city a pin springs in, a destination photo card slides in, and the day count and a one-line highlight animate, ending with a total-distance and days summary. The four destination images and the terrain base are AI-generated, and cities, coordinates, days, and copy all live in a constants block, so swapping routes is a data edit. Ideal for tourism, local-life, and travel creators making social shorts.

artifacts.label: 云南 7 日环线路线地图视频

cases.prompt:
用 Remotion 帮我做一条旅行路线动态地图短片，竖版 1080×1920、30fps、约 30 秒，社媒风。主题「云南 7 日环线之旅」：昆明 → 大理 → 丽江 → 香格里拉。

先用 AI 生图做出 4 张目的地竖图（昆明翠湖/大理洱海苍山/丽江古城玉龙雪山/香格里拉草甸雪山）和一张柔和水彩地形底图，再用 Remotion 编排：片头大标题 → 一条手绘风路线在地形底图上用 SVG path 逐段延伸（strokeDashoffset 按帧 reveal，线头带行进光点）→ 每到一城：图钉 spring 弹入 + 该城大图卡从右滑入（DAY 徽章 + 中英城市名 + 一句话亮点）→ 4 城串完 → 片尾汇总（总天数/城市数/总里程）+ slogan。

风格明亮清新旅行风（珊瑚橙路线 + 青绿点缀 + 米白纸感），底图缓慢 ken-burns 漂移，注意竖版社媒安全区。城市/坐标/天数/文案/节奏常量集中在代码顶部，最后渲染导出 MP4。

配一段温暖轻快的旅行背景音乐（明亮五声旋律）。
cases.prompt_en:
Use Remotion to make an animated travel route-map short, vertical 1080×1920, 30fps, ~30 seconds, social-media style. Theme: a 7-day Yunnan loop, Kunming -> Dali -> Lijiang -> Shangri-La.

First generate four vertical destination images with AI (Kunming's Cuihu, Dali's Erhai and Cangshan, Lijiang old town and Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, Shangri-La meadows and snow peaks) and a soft watercolor terrain base, then compose with Remotion: a title intro -> a hand-drawn route extending segment by segment over the terrain base via an SVG path (strokeDashoffset reveal per frame, with a moving light head) -> at each city a pin springs in and the destination photo card slides in from the right (DAY badge + city name in Chinese/English + one-line highlight) -> after all four cities, a summary (total days / cities / distance) + slogan.

Style: bright, fresh travel look (coral route + teal accents + warm paper tone), slow ken-burns drift on the base, mind the vertical social-media safe areas. Keep cities, coordinates, days, copy, and pacing as constants at the top of the code, and finally render the MP4.

Add a warm, upbeat travel background music track (bright pentatonic melody).

cases.description: 线下大会、发布会、年会开场前，大屏需要一条有节奏的片头来聚焦全场，但很多开场动画偏暗、信息看不清。本案例用 Remotion（代码渲染视频）做一条 22 秒、1080p、明亮清爽路线的开场片头：浅色呼吸渐变背景 + 几何动效入场 → 大会名称逐字弹入 → 日期/地点/标语逐条滑入 → 关键词快闪 → logo 定格与 CTA。全程深色文字压浅底，高对比、信息清晰可读，无外部图片依赖。文案/配色/节奏常量集中在代码顶部，换大会名改几行即可。适合会展、市场、运营团队快速产出上大屏的开场素材。
cases.description_en: Before an offline conference, launch, or annual kickoff, the main screen needs a rhythmic opener to focus the room, but many opening animations are dark and hard to read. This case uses Remotion (code-rendered video) to build a 22-second, 1080p, bright and clean opening title: a soft breathing-gradient background with geometric entrances, the conference name springing in character by character, date/location/tagline sliding in line by line, a keyword burst, and a logo freeze with CTA. Dark text on light throughout means high contrast and clear readability, with no external image dependencies. All copy, colors, and pacing live in a constants block, so swapping the event name is a few-line edit. Ideal for events, marketing, and ops teams.

artifacts.label: 活动开场片头视频

cases.prompt:
用 Remotion 帮我做一条科技大会开场片头视频，横屏 1920×1080、30fps、约 20-25 秒。主题虚构「2026 创新者峰会 / INNOVATORS SUMMIT 2026」。

关键要求：画面要明亮清爽、信息清晰可读，不要暗黑压抑。浅色呼吸渐变背景（奶白→薄荷→浅蓝）+ 低饱和漂浮色块 + 浅点阵；深色高对比文字。

分镜：几何元素入场（旋转圆环+粒子）→ 大会名称 kinetic typography 逐字 spring 弹入（超大标题 + 珊瑚色年份 + 渐变下划线 + 英文展开）→ 副信息三行（日期/地点/标语，带内联 SVG 图标逐条滑入）→ 关键词快闪（AI·未来·共创·突破，中英对照，斜色条扫过）→ 片尾 logo 字标定格 + 日期 + CTA。节奏明快，无 emoji，图标用内联 SVG，纯 CSS/SVG motion graphics。文案/配色/节奏常量集中在代码顶部，最后渲染导出 MP4。

配一段激昂明亮的开场背景音乐：铺垫渐入、节拍推进、结尾定音，烘托大会开场气势。
cases.prompt_en:
Use Remotion to make a tech-conference opening title video, landscape 1920×1080, 30fps, ~20-25 seconds, for a fictional "INNOVATORS SUMMIT 2026".

Key requirement: the visuals must be bright, clean, and clearly readable, not dark or heavy. A soft breathing-gradient background (cream to mint to light blue) with low-saturation floating shapes and a faint dot grid; dark, high-contrast text.

Storyboard: geometric entrance (rotating rings + particles) -> the conference name as kinetic typography springing in character by character (oversized title + coral year + gradient underline + English reveal) -> three sub-info lines (date/location/tagline with inline SVG icons sliding in) -> a keyword burst (AI, Future, Co-create, Breakthrough, bilingual, with diagonal color sweeps) -> an end card with the logo wordmark, date, and CTA. Punchy pacing, no emoji, inline SVG icons, pure CSS/SVG motion graphics. Keep copy, colors, and pacing as constants at the top of the code, and finally render the MP4.

Add an uplifting, bright opening background music track: a gentle build, a driving beat, and a resolving chord to amplify the conference-opening energy.

cases.title: 向风而行：城市马拉松赛事官网
cases.title_en: Run the City: A Marathon Event Official Website
cases.subtitle: 高能撞色斜切版式，点燃热血与速度的赛事首页
cases.subtitle_en: High-energy clashing colors and diagonal layouts that ignite passion and speed
cases.description: 赛事官网最难的不是堆信息，而是一眼点燃情绪——但多数页面要么死板罗列报名细节，要么撞色花哨到读不下去。本案用设计创意模式驾驭高能运动视觉：午夜蓝深底衬托活力橙与高饱和黄，对角线斜切色块制造奔跑动势，压缩体巨字在 Hero 爆发冲击力，AI 生图产出有速度感的奔跑与完赛画面。从悬浮导航、报名倒计时、撞色项目卡（全马/半马/欢乐跑），到赛道路线、赛程时间轴、往届回顾与报名 CTA，8 屏信息完整且撞而不乱。产物为 Ardot 高保真设计稿。适合赛事运营、体育品牌与活动策划做同款官网视觉。
cases.description_en: The hardest part of an event website isn't packing in information — it's igniting emotion at first glance. This case uses the design-creative mode to command high-energy sports visuals: a midnight-blue base sets off vibrant orange and saturated yellow, diagonal slanted color blocks create running momentum, and compressed display type explodes in the Hero. AI-generated imagery delivers a real sense of speed in running and finish-line scenes. Across 8 screens — floating nav, registration countdown, clashing race cards (full/half/fun run), course map, schedule timeline, past-edition recap and registration CTA — the information stays complete yet legible. The deliverable is a high-fidelity Ardot design. Ideal for event operators, sports brands and activity planners building similar official-site visuals.
cases.prompt: 帮我设计一个虚构城市马拉松赛事的官网首页，中文为主（赛事名/标语/数据英文点缀），高能动感、热血、有速度感与张力。赛事名自拟一个有气势的，如「2026 城市马拉松·向风而行 RUN THE CITY」。风格：高能动感+大字冲击+撞色斜切版式，参考国际城市马拉松与 Nike 跑步那种热血视觉，大字号压缩体粗标题、对角线斜切分割、动势构图。配色：深色主底午夜蓝 #0F172A、卡片底 #192134、主强调活力橙 #EA580C、点睛高饱和黄 #FACC15、辅助配速绿 #059669、正文浅灰 #94A3B8、白 #FFFFFF，高饱和撞色制造速度张力。结构控制在 5-8 屏：悬浮透明导航+立即报名；Hero 满幅奔跑大图+斜切压暗+巨字赛事名+报名倒计时+CTA；亮点数据撞色条；全马/半马/欢乐跑三色项目卡；赛道介绍+路线示意；赛程时间轴；往届回顾；报名 CTA；Footer。马拉松标准距离须准确（全马 42.195km、半马 21.0975km），赛事数据合理虚构。AI 生图 2 张：高能奔跑者城市大图、完赛庆祝氛围图（dynamic motion blur, energetic marathon runners, golden hour, no text）；其余用 SVG 图标/斜切几何/路线图/时间轴节点。首屏务必惊艳，撞色斜切但信息清晰可读。
cases.prompt_en: Design the homepage of a fictional city-marathon event website, primarily Chinese (with English accents for event name/slogan/data), high-energy, passionate, with a strong sense of speed and tension. Invent a powerful event name, e.g. "2026 City Marathon · Run the City". Style: high-energy + bold-type impact + clashing diagonal layout, referencing international city marathons and Nike Running — large compressed bold headlines, diagonal slanted splits, dynamic composition. Palette: midnight-blue base #0F172A, card base #192134, primary vibrant orange #EA580C, accent saturated yellow #FACC15, supporting pace-green #059669, body grey #94A3B8, white #FFFFFF — saturated clashing colors for speed and tension. Keep to 5-8 screens: floating transparent nav + register CTA; Hero with full-bleed runner photo, slanted darkening overlay, giant event name, registration countdown and CTA; highlight data bar; three-color race cards (full/half/fun run); course intro + route map; schedule timeline; past-edition recap; registration CTA; footer. Marathon distances must be accurate (full 42.195km, half 21.0975km); event data plausibly fictional. Two AI images: a high-energy urban runner shot and a finish-line celebration (dynamic motion blur, energetic marathon runners, golden hour, no text); everything else as SVG icons, slanted geometry, route map and timeline nodes. The first screen must be stunning, clashing and slanted yet clearly legible.

cases.title: 让财富自有主张：金融科技 App 落地页
cases.title_en: Wealth With Conviction: A FinTech App Landing Page
cases.subtitle: 深蓝玻璃拟态与数据可视化，建立值得托付的信任感
cases.subtitle_en: Deep-blue glassmorphism and data viz that build trust worth entrusting
cases.description: 金融科技产品页最怕两件事：要么花哨像营销 banner 失了专业感，要么干瘪罗列功能建立不起信任。本案用设计创意模式驾驭高信任感金融页面：深午夜蓝渐变拉开纵深，半透明磨砂玻璃卡叠出高级层次，纯 frame 色块拼出专业级资产配置占比条与月度收益柱状图（遵循中国市场涨红跌绿），克制高光营造「值得托付」的安全感。从 Hero 悬浮资产看板、数据信任条、四大功能卡，到数据可视化区、安全合规、用户背书与开户 CTA，8 屏完整呈现，并附合规风险提示。产物为 Ardot 高保真设计稿。适合金融科技、财富管理、银行数字化团队做同款产品落地页。
cases.description_en: FinTech product pages risk two failures: looking like a flashy marketing banner that loses professionalism, or listing features so dryly that no trust forms. This case uses the design-creative mode to command a high-trust financial page: a deep midnight-blue gradient creates depth, frosted semi-transparent glass cards build premium layering, and pure frame color blocks assemble professional asset-allocation bars and monthly-return columns (following the China-market convention of red-up / green-down), with restrained highlights conveying safety worth entrusting. Across 8 screens — a floating Hero asset dashboard, a data trust bar, four feature cards, a data-viz section, security & compliance, user endorsements and an account-opening CTA — it stays complete and includes compliance risk disclosures. The deliverable is a high-fidelity Ardot design. Ideal for fintech, wealth-management and bank digitalization teams building similar landing pages.
cases.prompt: 帮我设计一个智能财富管理 App 的产品落地页，中文界面（产品名/术语英文点缀），专业、安全、高端、值得信赖的科技金融质感。风格：深蓝沉稳+玻璃拟态+数据可视化，参考 Stripe、Revolut 那种深色高级、克制有信任感的调性，午夜蓝渐变背景叠半透明磨砂玻璃卡。配色：背景 #0A1530 向 #0F1E45 渐变、玻璃卡填充 #FFFFFF14+高光描边 #FFFFFF26、主强调科技蓝 #3B82F6、青蓝 #38BDF8、蓝紫 #6366F1、主文白 #F8FAFC、次文 #94A3B8、涨红 #F43F5E、跌绿 #10B981（中国惯例务必涨红跌绿）。结构 6-8 屏：Hero（右侧悬浮玻璃资产看板+主张大字「让财富，自有主张」+开户 CTA+信任标识）、数据信任条、四大功能玻璃卡、数据可视化区（配置占比条+月度收益柱状，涨红跌绿）、安全合规、用户评价+媒体背书、下载/开户 CTA、Footer。图表用 frame 色块拼接（不要 SVG 画饼图/长弧），SVG 仅作简单线性图标、颜色直接写 #；货币用 ¥。真实数据：全球 AI 智能投顾 2025 约 82.4 亿美元/渗透率 18.9%、中国约 598.7 亿元/注册 1.32 亿，年化等敏感数据必附风险提示。AI 生图至多 1 张深蓝抽象科技背景。首屏务必惊艳。
cases.prompt_en: Design a product landing page for a smart wealth-management App, Chinese UI (English accents for product name/data labels/terms), professional, secure, premium, trustworthy fintech feel. Style: deep-blue, glassmorphism + data visualization, referencing Stripe, Revolut and Ant Fortune — dark, premium, restrained and trust-inspiring, with a midnight-blue gradient background and frosted semi-transparent glass cards. Palette: background midnight-blue #0A1530 to #0F1E45 gradient, glass card fill #FFFFFF14 + light highlight stroke #FFFFFF26, primary tech-blue #3B82F6, cyan-blue #38BDF8, supporting indigo #6366F1, main text #F8FAFC, secondary #94A3B8, up-red #F43F5E, down-green #10B981 (China-market convention: red up, green down). Structure 6-8 screens: Hero (blue gradient + floating glass asset dashboard: total assets / today's gain / allocation bar + headline "Let wealth speak for itself" + open-account CTA + trust badges); data trust bar; four feature glass cards; data-viz section (allocation bar + monthly-return columns, red-up green-down); security & compliance; testimonials + media endorsements; download / open-account CTA; footer. Important: build charts from frame color blocks (allocation bar = horizontal container + fixed-width rounded segments; columns = baseline-aligned equal-width bars), do NOT draw pie charts / long arcs in SVG; use SVG only for simple line icons, colors written directly as #. Currency symbol ¥. Real data: global AI robo-advisory ~US$8.24B in 2025 / 18.9% penetration, China ~RMB 59.87B / 132M registered users; sensitive figures like annualized returns must carry "past performance does not guarantee future results; markets carry risk, invest prudently". At most one AI image: a dark-blue abstract tech background. The first screen must be stunning, with professional glass texture and charts.

cases.title: 一座山的风土：精品咖啡庄园品牌站
cases.title_en: Terroir of a Mountain: A Specialty Coffee Estate Brand Site
cases.subtitle: 大地色暖调与摄影叙事，讲一杯咖啡的慢生活匠心
cases.subtitle_en: Earthy warm tones and photographic storytelling for a slow-living craft
cases.description: 品牌站最容易踩的坑：大地色做不好就显「土气」，信息一堆就失了呼吸感。本案用设计创意模式驾驭情感化品牌叙事：奶咖米白打底、焦糖棕做主强调，衬线英文与黑体中文混排出手作人文气质，靠氛围摄影、留白和真实产地故事打动人，而非数据轰炸。从 Hero 庄园风土大图+极简 slogan、品牌理念数据徽章，到精选庄园豆单（耶加雪菲/慧兰/翡翠瑰夏，附真实 SCA 分数）、风土溯源四步、订阅 CTA 与 Footer，6 屏克制高级、多留白。产物为 Ardot 高保真设计稿。适合精品消费、餐饮食品与生活方式品牌做同款品牌官网。
cases.description_en: Brand sites stumble in two ways: earthy palettes look cheap if done poorly, and piling on information kills the breathing room. This case uses the design-creative mode to command emotional brand storytelling: a milk-coffee off-white base with caramel-brown as the primary accent, serif English mixed with sans-serif Chinese for a handcrafted, humanistic feel — moving people through atmospheric photography, white space and real origin stories rather than data overload. Across 6 restrained, airy screens — a Hero estate-terroir photo with minimal slogan, brand-philosophy data badges, a curated single-origin bean list (Yirgacheffe / Huila / Esmeralda Geisha with real SCA scores), a four-step terroir-traceability flow, a subscription CTA and footer. The deliverable is a high-fidelity Ardot design. Ideal for premium consumer, food & beverage and lifestyle brands building similar brand sites.
cases.prompt: 帮我设计一个精品咖啡庄园的品牌官网首页，中文界面（庄园名/产区/SCA 分数英文点缀），温润、有匠心质感、慢生活气息。风格：大地色暖调+摄影叙事+手作衬线美学，参考 Aesop、Blue Bottle 那种克制高级、有呼吸感的调性，靠留白、质感和真实产地氛围打动人，不要花哨渐变。配色：奶咖米白 #F4EDE4 打底、深可可 #2B211A、主强调焦糖棕 #A6633C、辅助陶土橙 #C8794B 与橄榄绿 #6B6B47、浅卡片 #FBF7F1，低饱和暖灰像晒过的牛皮纸。字体：标题衬线（思源宋体/Cormorant），正文黑体，英文衬线点缀。结构 3-6 屏：Hero 庄园风土大图+极简文案（品牌名+slogan「每一杯，都是一座山的风土」）；品牌理念左文右图+数据徽章（海拔/SCA 均分/直接贸易农户）；精选豆单 3 张产品卡（庄园名/产区/处理法/风味标签/SCA 分数/价格）；风土溯源四步；订阅/页脚。内容真实：SCA≥80 为精品、87-89 微批次、>90 纳米批次，瑰夏品种、厌氧/日晒处理为行业核心。AI 生图 2 张：晨雾高海拔咖啡梯田、咖啡农手捧红色咖啡果（电影感浅景深，纪实，no text），其余 SVG。首屏务必惊艳，克制高级多留白。
cases.prompt_en: Design the homepage of a specialty-coffee estate brand site, Chinese UI (English accents for estate name/origin/SCA score), warm, crafted, slow-living in feel. Style: earthy warm tones + photographic storytelling + handcrafted serif aesthetics, referencing Aesop, Blue Bottle and Saturnbird — restrained, premium, with breathing room; no flashy gradients, moving people through white space, texture and authentic origin atmosphere. Palette: background milk-coffee off-white #F4EDE4, deep cocoa #2B211A (main text / dark blocks / footer), primary caramel-brown #A6633C, supporting terracotta #C8794B and olive-green #6B6B47, light card #FBF7F1 — overall low-saturation warm grey, like sun-bleached kraft paper. Type: serif headings (Source Han Serif / Cormorant, slightly wide tracking), sans-serif body, serif English accents for key terms. Keep to 3-6 screens: Hero estate-terroir photo + minimal copy (brand name + slogan "Every cup is the terroir of a mountain" + understated button); brand philosophy left-text right-image + data badges (altitude / SCA average / direct-trade farmers); curated bean list with 3 product cards (estate / origin / process / flavor tags / SCA score / price, premium soft shadow restrained radius); four-step terroir traceability; subscription / footer. Authentic content: SCA cupping ≥80 is specialty, 87-89 micro-lot, >90 nano-lot; Geisha variety, anaerobic / natural processing, direct trade and single-estate traceability are industry pillars. Two AI images: a misty high-altitude coffee terrace in warm golden dawn light, and a close-up of a farmer's hands cupping ripe red cherries (cinematic shallow DOF, documentary, no text); everything else as SVG. The first screen must be stunning — restrained, premium, with ample white space.

cases.title: 灰烬王冠：独立游戏发售页
cases.title_en: Ashen Crown: An Indie Game Launch Page
cases.subtitle: 暗黑奇幻油画质感与鎏金描边，打开即入戏的史诗发售页
cases.subtitle_en: Dark-fantasy oil-painting texture and gilded strokes for an epic launch page
cases.description: 游戏发售页要「打开即入戏」——但暗色系做不好就沉闷发脏，大图堆满又显廉价。本案用设计创意模式驾驭沉浸式氛围叙事：深炭黑底色打底、鎏金描边贯穿图标与分割线、余烬橙少量点缀，靠一张电影感油画主视觉定调，AI 生图克制在 4 张、其余一律 SVG。Cinzel 史诗衬线巨字与黑体中文混排出厚重张力。从 Hero 巨字游戏名+双 CTA，到世界观叙事、四大玩法特色、画面展廊、媒体赞誉评分、三档版本购买（豪华版鎏金高亮+最受欢迎角标）与 18+ 分级 Footer，7 屏信息完整、史诗感拉满。产物为 Ardot 高保真设计稿。适合游戏发行、娱乐 IP 与众筹项目做同款发售页。
cases.description_en: A game launch page must immerse you instantly — but dark palettes look dull and muddy if mishandled, and wall-to-wall imagery feels cheap.
