This case uses the design-creative mode to command immersive atmospheric storytelling: a deep charcoal-black base, gilded strokes running through icons and dividers, ember-orange as sparing accents, with one cinematic oil-painting key visual setting the tone — AI imagery restrained to four pieces, everything else SVG. Cinzel epic serif display type mixed with sans-serif Chinese creates weighty tension. Across 7 screens — Hero giant game title + dual CTA, lore narrative, four gameplay pillars, screenshot gallery, media-acclaim scores, three purchase tiers (deluxe gilded-highlighted with a "most popular" badge) and an 18+ rated footer — the page stays complete and epic. The deliverable is a high-fidelity Ardot design. Ideal for game publishers, entertainment IP and crowdfunding projects building similar launch pages.
cases.prompt: 帮我设计一个虚构独立游戏的官方发售页，中文界面（游戏名/标签英文点缀），暗黑奇幻+油画质感+鎏金描边，史诗、神秘、沉浸，参考《艾尔登法环》《黑暗之魂》那种厚重史诗调性，不要霓虹故障、不要明亮卡通。请构思一个暗黑奇幻世界观并取个酷的游戏名（如《Ashen Crown 灰烬王冠》：火之纪元熄灭、玩家作为「灰之徒」重燃或归于黑暗）。风格：深炭黑底+鎏金描边贯穿图标分割线+余烬橙点缀，一张电影感油画主视觉定调。配色：主底 #0E0B08、暗褐 #120D08、卡片 #16100A、鎏金 #C9A24B、余烬橙 #C8642A、羊皮米白 #E8DCC4、正文灰 #A89E8E。字体：英文标题用衬线 Cinzel，中文黑体混排。结构 5-7 屏：透明导航+愿望单；Hero 全屏油画大图+渐变压暗+游戏名巨字+中文副名+slogan+发售日期/平台+购买/预告双 CTA；世界观左文右图；四大特色卡（开放世界/魂系战斗/碎片叙事/联机，配 SVG）；画面展廊；媒体赞誉（评分大数字+五星）；三档版本购买（豪华版鎏金高亮+最受欢迎角标）；页脚（开发商/社交/18+ 分级）。AI 生图 3-4 张，prompt 英文强调 dark fantasy, oil painting texture, cinematic lighting, gold rim light, no text，其余 SVG。首屏务必惊艳。
cases.prompt_en: Design an official launch page for a fictional indie game, Chinese UI (English accents for game name / tags / chapter names), dark-fantasy + oil-painting texture + gilded-stroke style; epic, mysterious, immersive, intense, referencing Elden Ring and Dark Souls — weighty and epic; no neon glitch art, no bright cartoon. Invent a compelling dark-fantasy lore and a cool game name (e.g. "Ashen Crown": the Age of Fire dies out, the throne turns to ash, and the player as an "Ashen One" rekindles it or lets it fall to darkness), keeping the whole site self-consistent. Style: deep charcoal-black base, gilded strokes running through all icons and dividers, ember-orange as sparing accents, one cinematic oil-painting key visual setting the tone, SVG for functional graphics. Palette: base charcoal #0E0B08, dark-brown block #120D08, card #16100A, primary gilded #C9A24B, secondary ember #C8642A, heading parchment #E8DCC4, body grey #A89E8E. Type: Cinzel epic serif for English headings / game name / data (large, slightly wide tracking), sans-serif Chinese (mixed). Structure 5-7 screens: transparent nav + wishlist; Hero full-screen fantasy oil-painting + darkening gradient + giant game name + Chinese subtitle + epic slogan + release date + platforms + buy/trailer dual CTA; lore left-text right-image + gilded divider + quote; four feature cards (open world / souls combat / fragmented lore / co-op, each with SVG icon); screenshot gallery (chapter names overlaid on darkened images); media acclaim (big score numbers + five stars + quotes); three purchase tiers (deluxe gilded-highlighted + "most popular" badge); footer (studio / socials / three link columns / 18+ rating). Keep AI imagery to 3-4 pieces (Hero key visual, lore, gallery), English prompts emphasizing dark fantasy, oil painting texture, dramatic cinematic lighting, gold rim light, no text; everything else SVG. The first screen must be stunning, dark and unified with gilded accents, maximally epic.

cases.title: 于静谧之中：高端医美预约站
cases.title_en: In Serenity: A High-End Medical Aesthetics Booking Site
cases.subtitle: 极简留白与莫兰迪暖灰，营造洁净安心的高级感
cases.subtitle_en: Minimal white space and Morandi warm-grey for a clean, reassuring premium feel
cases.description: 医美预约站最难拿捏「安静的高级感」——色不对就灰扑扑，内容塞满就冰冷不可信。本案用设计创意模式驾驭极简留白：暖米白打底、莫兰迪卡其做唯一强调，section 之间大间距「呼吸」，衬线英文与黑体中文混排出洁净气质，AI 生图极致克制仅 2 张、其余全部线性 SVG。从 Hero 左留白大字+右氛围图，到品牌理念信任徽章、四大核心项目卡、诊疗流程、客户评价、医师团队、留资预约表单与备案 Footer，8 个 section 安静却惊艳，靠克制文案与信任徽章建立专业感而不冰冷。产物为 Ardot 高保真设计稿。适合医美、口腔、私人诊所与高端服务业做同款预约官网。
cases.description_en: Aesthetic-clinic booking sites struggle to nail "quiet luxury" — wrong tones look drab, and cramming content feels cold and untrustworthy. This case uses the design-creative mode to command minimalist white space: a warm off-white base with Morandi khaki as the sole accent, generous breathing room between sections, and serif English mixed with sans-serif Chinese for a clean feel — AI imagery kept to just two pieces, everything else line-style SVG. Across 8 sections — a Hero with left white-space headline + right atmosphere image, brand-philosophy trust badges, four core-treatment cards, a treatment journey, client testimonials, the medical team, a lead-capture booking form and a licensed footer — it stays quiet yet stunning, building professionalism through restrained copy and trust badges without feeling cold. The deliverable is a high-fidelity Ardot design. Ideal for medical aesthetics, dental, private clinics and premium service businesses building similar booking sites.
cases.prompt: 帮我设计一个高端医美/抗衰美学私人诊所的官网首页，中文界面（品牌名/项目名英文点缀），洁净、信赖、舒缓、专业、安心。风格：极简留白+莫兰迪低饱和暖灰+优雅无衬线，参考 Aesop、高端 spa 那种安静克制高级的调性，靠呼吸感留白、优雅排版和一张氛围图打动人，绝不大图轰炸或高饱和色。配色：暖米白 #F5F2ED 打底、卡片 #FBFAF7/#FFFFFF、主文字墨灰褐 #3A352F、正文暖灰 #7A736B、主强调莫兰迪卡其 #A89A86、图标描边 #8C7E6A、分割线 #E4DED4。字体：英文标题/品牌名用衬线 Cormorant，中文黑体混排。结构 5-8 屏：透明导航+在线预约；Hero 左大留白主张超大字+slogan+预约 CTA，右侧诊所氛围图；品牌理念左文右人像+3 数据徽章；四大项目卡（光电抗衰/肤质管理/轮廓塑形/注射美学，配线性 SVG）；诊疗流程四步（深色反白）；客户评价 3 卡；医师团队卡；预约 CTA 留资表单；Footer（地址/营业/资质备案）。视觉严格克制：AI 生图仅 1-2 张（莫兰迪诊所空间、柔光人像侧影，prompt 强调 minimal, clean, soft natural light, muted morandi tones, serene spa, no text，避免医疗操作画面），其余极简线性 SVG，颜色写 # 不要 %23。首屏惊艳在极致留白+优雅排版。
cases.prompt_en: Design the homepage of a high-end medical-aesthetics / anti-aging private clinic, Chinese UI (English accents for brand / treatment names / tags), clean, trustworthy, soothing, professional, reassuring. Style: minimalist white space + Morandi low-saturation warm grey + elegant sans-serif, referencing Aesop and luxury spas — quiet, restrained, premium; moved by generous breathing room, elegant typography and one premium atmosphere image; never image bombardment or saturated colors; large gaps between sections, never crammed. Palette: background warm off-white #F5F2ED, secondary / card #FBFAF7 and #FFFFFF, main text ink-grey-brown #3A352F, body warm grey #7A736B, primary Morandi khaki #A89A86 (instead of gold), icon stroke #8C7E6A, dividers #E4DED4 / #ECE7DD. Type: Cormorant elegant serif for English headings / numbers / brand, sans-serif Chinese headings (mixed), Montserrat for body and small all-caps labels with +3 tracking. Structure 5-8 screens: minimal transparent nav + book-online; Hero with large left white space holding an oversized headline + soothing slogan + booking CTA, plus a premium clinic atmosphere image on the right; brand philosophy left-text right-portrait + 3 data badges (clinical years / cases / certifications); four core-treatment cards (photoelectric anti-aging / skin management / contour shaping / injectables, with elegant line SVG); four-step treatment journey (dark block, reversed text); 3 testimonial cards; 2-3 doctor cards; booking CTA with lead-capture form (dark accent block); footer (address / hours / license / socials). Strictly restrained visuals: only 1-2 AI images (minimal Morandi clinic interior, soft-light portrait profile, prompts emphasizing minimal, clean, soft natural light, muted morandi tones, serene spa aesthetic, no text, avoiding any exposed / medical-procedure imagery); everything else minimal line SVG (fine strokes, Morandi colors), colors written directly as # not %23-encoded. The stunning first screen comes from extreme white space + elegant typography + one premium atmosphere image.

cases.title: raw 而有态度：设计师个人作品集
cases.title_en: Raw With Attitude: A Designer's Personal Portfolio
cases.subtitle: 新粗野主义与荧光绿撞黑，张扬视觉胆识的作品集
cases.subtitle_en: Neo-Brutalism and lime-on-black flaunting bold visual nerve
cases.description: 作品集是设计师的门面，本身就要会设计——它考验的不是信息密度，而是视觉胆识。本案用设计创意模式驾驭实验性个性表达：极黑底色、唯一的荧光绿点睛、0 圆角 2px 硬边框、无阴影无渐变，超大字号配紧字距制造冲击，作品网格用 masonry 错落+纯色块缩略图做出编辑感，「raw（生）」而非「polished（精致打磨）」。从 Hero 超大名字巨字+荧光绿 CTA，到精选作品错落网格、荧光绿满铺的关于/能力区、合作客户跑马灯、超大字联系 CTA 与荧光绿顶边框 Footer，6 屏张力十足、个人态度鲜明。AI 生图仅 1 张抽象创意视觉，其余全靠色块与超大字。产物为 Ardot 高保真设计稿。适合设计师、创意工作室与个人品牌做同款作品集。
cases.description_en: A portfolio is a designer's calling card and must itself be well designed — testing not information density but visual nerve. This case uses the design-creative mode to command experimental personal expression: a pure-black base, a single lime-green accent, zero radius, 2px hard borders, no shadows or gradients, oversized type with tight tracking for impact, and a masonry work grid with solid-color thumbnails for an editorial feel — raw rather than polished. Across 6 high-tension, attitude-forward screens — a Hero with a giant name + lime CTA, a staggered selected-works grid, a lime-flooded about/skills section, a clients marquee, an oversized-type contact CTA and a lime-top-bordered footer. Only one AI image (an abstract creative visual); everything else relies on color blocks and oversized type. The deliverable is a high-fidelity Ardot design. Ideal for designers, creative studios and personal brands building similar portfolios.
cases.prompt: 帮我设计一个独立视觉设计师的个人作品集网站，中文为主（英文点缀），大胆、实验、有态度——新粗野主义（Neo-Brutalism）混合编辑排版。参考 Kinetic Brutalism、独立工作室作品集那种 raw、高对比、超大字、硬边框的视觉，规则贯穿全站：0 圆角、2px 硬边框、绝不用阴影渐变、大量留白与超大字对比。配色：极黑 #0A0A0A 打底、卡片 #0C130E、主强调荧光绿 #C7F23D（唯一高饱和色，点睛）、撞色橙 #FF5A3D、米白 #EDEDE3、次文灰 #8A8A82、边框 #1F1F1F/#3A3A34。字体：全站 Space Grotesk Bold/Black（中文回退黑体），巨字标题 88-96px 紧字距。结构 6 屏：Hero 透明导航（logo+菜单+荧光绿下载简历）+超大名字巨字+角色行+宣言+双 CTA+右侧方形 AI 创意视觉图（荧光绿 2px 边框）；精选作品（两列 masonry 错落 4 卡，纯色块缩略图+编号+项目名巨字）；关于/能力（左荧光绿满铺+黑色大标题+数据，右黑色能力清单卡）；合作客户（客户名+荧光绿跑马灯条）；联系 CTA（黑底+超大双行标题，第二行荧光绿+邮箱按钮）；Footer（荧光绿 2px 顶边框+社交）。AI 生图仅 1 张 Hero 抽象创意视觉（荧光绿+黑+米白，色块+几何+网格+risograph 颗粒，no text），其余纯色块+超大字+2px 边框。首屏务必惊艳。
cases.prompt_en: Design a personal portfolio website for an independent visual designer, primarily Chinese (with English accents), bold, experimental, attitude-forward — Neo-Brutalism mixed with editorial layout. Style: referencing Kinetic Brutalism and indie design-studio portfolios — raw, high-contrast, oversized type, hard borders; rules run site-wide: zero radius, 2px hard borders, never shadows or gradients, abundant white space and oversized-type contrast. Palette: background pure-black #0A0A0A, dark card #0C130E, primary lime-green #C7F23D (the only saturated color, for accents), clashing orange #FF5A3D (work-card accents), text off-white #EDEDE3, secondary grey #8A8A82, borders #1F1F1F / #3A3A34. Type: Space Grotesk Bold/Black site-wide (Chinese auto-falls back to sans-serif, clean mix), giant headings 88-96px tight tracking -1, subhead 22px, body 17-18px, labels 12-13px all-caps + tracking. Structure 6 screens: Hero transparent nav (logo + WORK/ABOUT/CONTACT + lime download-resume button) + left oversized name + lime role line + manifesto + lime view-works CTA + outlined secondary CTA + right square AI creative visual (2px lime border); selected works (title + lime/outlined filter tags + two-column staggered masonry of 4 cards, solid-color thumbnails + numbers + giant project names); about/skills (left lime-flooded + black big heading + intro + stats, right black skills-list card: skills + percentages + tool tags); clients (a row of client names + a lime marquee text bar); contact CTA (black + oversized two-line headline "Got a good idea? / Let's make it real." second line lime + lime email button); footer (lime 2px top border + logo copyright + socials). Only one AI image: a Hero abstract creative visual (lime + black + off-white, organic blobs + geometry + grid + risograph grain, experimental composition, no text); everything else relies on solid color blocks + oversized type + 2px borders, no image piling. The first screen must be stunning — raw, high-contrast, with the designer's personal attitude.

cases.title: AI Coding 开发者大会主题演讲
cases.subtitle: 深色科技终端风 keynote，真实数据 + 代码流光氛围，极客又可信
cases.subtitle_en: Dark tech-terminal keynote with real data and code-glow ambience — geeky yet credible
cases.description:
做一场前沿科技主题的开发者大会演讲，既要有极客科技的氛围感，又要靠真实详实的行业数据建立可信度——这是很多技术分享、产品发布的共同难题：要么数据干瘪没设计，要么炫酷却空洞。

本案例演示如何用设计创意模式一次产出 8 页深色科技终端风 keynote：联网检索 AI 编程市场规模、采用率、效率提升等真实数据并标注来源，用 frame 色块拼专业柱状图与占比条，用 AI 生图做代码流光氛围背景与深色画布无缝融合，每页叠加光晕、辉光徽章、SVG 线性图标做到视觉丰富惊艳。

适合开发者大会、技术发布会、科技产品路演等需要「数据 + 科技氛围」双在线的演示场景。
cases.description_en:
Delivering a cutting-edge developer-conference keynote that is both geeky and credible is a shared challenge: data-heavy decks look dull, while flashy ones feel hollow.

This case shows how the design-creative mode produces an 8-page dark tech-terminal keynote in one go: it researches real data on the AI-coding market size, adoption, and efficiency gains with cited sources, builds professional bar charts and ratio bars from frame blocks, generates a code-glow ambient background that fuses seamlessly with the dark canvas, and layers glows, glowing badges, and linear SVG icons on every page for a rich, stunning look.

Ideal for developer conferences, tech launches, and product pitches that need both solid data and a tech atmosphere.
cases.prompt: 帮我设计一套「AI Coding 开发者大会」主题演讲，8 页 16:9，深色科技终端风，极客前沿且视觉丰富惊艳，中文为主英文点缀。配色：冷黑底 #0A0E0F、卡片 #0F1416、电光青 #22D3EE、代码绿 #4ADE80、主文 #F0FDFA、次文 #9DB0AD。中文用 Sarasa Gothic SC Bold，英文数字用 Inter Bold。8 页结构：封面（代码流光铺底 + 超大字「代码，正在重写本身」）→ 痛点（三张数据卡）→ 解决方案（从辅助到自主进阶时间线）→ 市场规模（超大数字 + frame 柱状图，配「五年增长 +430%」辉光徽章）→ 效率数据（2×2 KPI 卡）→ 核心能力（三栏卡片 + 青绿 SVG 线性图标）→ 采用趋势（巨大 84% + frame 占比条）→ 结尾金句。请联网检索 AI 编程的市场规模/采用率/效率真实数据并标注来源。视觉策略：AI 生图 1 张代码流光抽象图（prompt 含 deep black background）作封面主视觉并复用为各页纹理底（opacity 0.08-0.12）；数据图表全用 frame 色块拼，SVG 仅做线性图标；每页加光晕、辉光徽章、装饰线增惊艳度。
cases.prompt_en: Design an "AI Coding Developer Conference" keynote, 8 pages 16:9, dark tech-terminal style, geeky and visually rich, Chinese-led with English accents. Colors: cold-black bg #0A0E0F, card #0F1416, electric cyan #22D3EE, code-green #4ADE80, main text #F0FDFA, secondary #9DB0AD. Chinese in Sarasa Gothic SC Bold, English/numbers in Inter Bold. 8-page flow: cover (code-glow backdrop + huge title "Code is rewriting itself") -> pain points (three data cards) -> solution (assist-to-autonomous timeline) -> market size (huge number + frame bar chart with a "+430% in 5 years" glowing badge) -> efficiency data (2x2 KPI cards) -> core capabilities (three cards + cyan-green linear SVG icons) -> adoption trend (giant 84% + frame ratio bars) -> closing line. Research real data on AI-coding market size/adoption/efficiency and cite sources. Visual strategy: one AI-generated abstract code-glow image (prompt with deep black background) as cover hero, reused as page texture (opacity 0.08-0.12); build all charts from frame blocks, use SVG only for linear icons; add glows, glowing badges, and decorative lines on every page for impact.

cases.title: 旗舰手机产品发布会主题演讲
cases.subtitle: 乔布斯式极简深色 keynote，一页一信息，纯黑底 + 一抹冷光
cases.subtitle_en: Jobs-style minimalist dark keynote — one message per page, pure black with a touch of cool light
cases.description:
做科技产品发布会演示，难点不在信息密度，而在「克制」：如何用极致留白、超大字号的字重对比、纯黑基调上的一抹冷调高光，建立「高级、聚焦、值得期待」的发布会气场，而不是堆满信息和装饰。

本案例演示用设计创意模式产出 8 页乔布斯式 keynote：纯黑基底用 #0A0A0B 而非死黑，靠径向微光晕和提亮一档的卡片拉出层次；遵循封面→金句→产品亮相→单点特性→三栏总览→规格→上市→收尾的「一页一信息」叙事；规格页用 130px 超大数字替代图表；AI 产品图用纯黑背景 prompt 与画布无缝融合，无需抠图。

适合手机/数码/科技硬件发布会、新品预热、产品路演等追求高级克制气质的演示场景。
cases.description_en:
For a tech-product launch, the hard part is not information density but restraint: using extreme white space, bold weight contrast in huge type, and a single touch of cool highlight on a pure-black base to build a premium, focused, anticipated atmosphere — rather than cramming in data and decoration.

This case shows the design-creative mode producing an 8-page Jobs-style keynote: the pure-black base uses #0A0A0B (not dead black), with radial glows and one-shade-lighter cards adding depth; it follows a one-message-per-page narrative (cover, vision line, product reveal, single feature, three-column overview, specs, availability, closing); the spec page uses 130px giant numbers instead of charts; and AI product images use a pure-black-background prompt to fuse seamlessly with the canvas, no cutout needed.

Ideal for phone/gadget/hardware launches, teasers, and product pitches that demand a premium, restrained feel.
cases.prompt: 帮我设计一套旗舰智能手机产品发布会主题演讲（keynote），8 页 16:9，乔布斯式「一页一信息」，极简深色、超大字、极致留白、高级聚焦，中文为主英文点缀。配色：纯黑底 #0A0A0B（不用死黑）、卡片提亮一档 #0D0D0E、主文白霜 #FAFAFA、次文灰蓝 #94A3B8、冷光高光银蓝 #C7D2FE（小标签/分隔线/收尾品牌名/微光晕）。中文用 Sarasa Gothic SC，英文与大数字用 Inter Bold。8 页结构：封面（右上冷蓝径向微光晕 + 超大主张）→ 愿景金句（居中独白）→ 产品亮相（右半产品全貌 AI 图 + 左侧产品名大字）→ 影像特性（左半摄像头特写 AI 图 + 右侧超大数字）→ 三大特性（三栏卡片 + 冷蓝线性 SVG 图标）→ 规格数据（2×2 KPI 大数字卡）→ 上市信息（超大价格 + 三个配色圆点）→ 结尾（与封面首尾呼应）。产品为虚构旗舰机，规格用合理拟真数据，无需标注外部来源。视觉策略：AI 生图仅 2 张（产品全貌 + 摄像头特写，prompt 必须含 pure black background 实现与纯黑画布无缝融合）；SVG 做特性图标和配色圆点；不堆装饰，靠超大字 + 极致留白 + 一抹冷光建立高级感。
cases.prompt_en: Design a flagship-smartphone launch keynote, 8 pages 16:9, Jobs-style one-message-per-page, minimalist dark, huge type, extreme white space, premium and focused, Chinese-led with English accents. Colors: pure-black bg #0A0A0B (not dead black), card one shade lighter #0D0D0E, main text frost-white #FAFAFA, secondary blue-gray #94A3B8, cool highlight silver-blue #C7D2FE (small labels/dividers/closing brand/glow). Chinese in Sarasa Gothic SC, English and big numbers in Inter Bold. 8-page flow: cover (top-right cool-blue radial glow + huge tagline) -> vision line (centered monologue) -> product reveal (right-half full-product AI image + left product name in huge type) -> camera feature (left-half camera close-up AI image + right huge number) -> three features (three cards + cool-blue linear SVG icons) -> specs (2x2 KPI giant-number cards) -> availability (huge price + three color dots) -> closing (echoing the cover). The phone is fictional with plausible specs, no external sources needed. Visual strategy: only 2 AI images (full product + camera close-up, prompt must include pure black background for seamless fusion with the black canvas); SVG for feature icons and color dots; no decoration pile-up — build premium feel from huge type, extreme white space, and one touch of cool light.

cases.title: 仿人机器人融资路演 BP
cases.subtitle: 面向投资人的科技路演 BP，硬核数据 + 未来科技氛围
cases.subtitle_en: Investor-facing deep-tech pitch deck — hard data plus a future-tech atmosphere
cases.description:
仿人机器人是当下最热的硬科技赛道，但给投资人讲清楚一个机器人项目并不容易：既要展现技术壁垒与产品力，又要用真实的市场规模、商业模式、融资计划说服理性的投资人，还得在视觉上传递「未来感与专业度」。

本案例演示用设计创意模式产出一套投资人路演 BP（pitch deck）：深色科技基调搭配电光蓝/科技银强调色，按封面→赛道痛点→市场规模→产品与技术壁垒→应用场景→商业模式→团队→融资计划与里程碑→愿景的经典融资叙事组织，用 frame 拼市场规模柱状图与 KPI 大数字卡，用 AI 生图做仿人机器人产品主视觉，每页保持统一的母版基因与科技氛围。

适合硬科技创业融资、机器人/具身智能项目路演、技术产品对外汇报等场景。
cases.description_en:
Humanoid robots are today's hottest deep-tech track, but pitching a robotics project to investors is hard: you must show the technical moat and product strength, persuade rational investors with real market size, business model, and funding plan, and convey both a future feel and professionalism visually.

This case shows the design-creative mode producing an investor pitch deck: a dark tech base with electric-blue/tech-silver accents, organized in a classic fundraising narrative (cover, market pain points, market size, product and tech moat, use cases, business model, team, funding plan and milestones, vision), with frame-built market bar charts and KPI giant-number cards, an AI-generated humanoid-robot hero visual, and a consistent master template and tech atmosphere on every page.

Ideal for deep-tech startup fundraising, robotics/embodied-AI roadshows, and tech-product briefings.
cases.prompt:
设计一套仿人机器人公司 A 轮融资路演 BP，16:9（1920×1080）共 8 页，风格「暗黑工业科技 × 单点橙强调」，高级克制、留白充足，像顶级 VC Pitch Deck。中文正文，专有名词保留英文，不需要公司名。

视觉系统严格统一：全局深炭黑底 #14161A；强调色活力橙 #FA730E 仅用于眼眉标签/关键词/巨型数字/焦点卡描边（占比<10%，唯一彩色）；文字三级灰阶（近白 #F5F5F4 / 中灰 #A8A29E / 弱灰 #57534E）；卡片底 #1C1E24 配橙 18% 细描边，每页可选 1 张橙暖底焦点卡 #29190A 制造重心；角落放一个超大橙色径向光晕营造氛围，禁其他装饰。字体：中文思源黑体靠字重拉层级，英文/数字 Inter，眼眉标签 Inter SemiBold 全大写加宽，巨型数字 100~110px 橙色 Bold 做视觉锤。

八幕叙事：① 封面（一句话愿景 slogan + 右侧满高机器人主视觉）② WHY NOW 三股力量推动拐点 ③ THE NEED 三个巨数字讲刚需 ④ MARKET SIZE TAM 巨数字 + 增长柱状图 + CAGR ⑤ USE CASES 场景卡 + 等距插画 ⑥ BUSINESS MODEL 编号清单 + 单台经济模型数据卡 ⑦ WHY US 核心壁垒 ⑧ THE ASK 融资额 + 估值条款 + 资金用途百分比。

两张配图（封面机器人、场景等距图）用 AI 生成，暗调工业科技 + 橙色高光，与配色呼应；图表用橙渐变柱状（末根高亮），图标用线性 SVG。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a humanoid-robot company's Series-A pitch deck, 16:9 (1920×1080), 8 pages, in a "dark industrial tech × single-orange-accent" style, premium, restrained, with ample whitespace like a top VC pitch deck. Body in Chinese, keep proper nouns in English, no company name needed.

Strict visual system: a global deep-charcoal base #14161A; accent orange #FA730E only for eyebrow labels/keywords/giant numbers/focus-card borders (<10%, the only color); three-level gray text (near-white #F5F5F4 / mid #A8A29E / faint #57534E); cards #1C1E24 with an 18% orange hairline, one optional orange warm-tone focus card #29190A per page for weight; a single oversized orange radial glow in a corner for ambient light, no other decoration. Fonts: Chinese in Sarasa Gothic SC using weight for hierarchy, English/numbers in Inter, eyebrow labels in Inter SemiBold uppercase tracked, giant numbers 100-110px orange Bold as visual hammers.

Eight-act narrative: (1) cover (one-line vision slogan + full-height robot key visual on the right) (2) WHY NOW three forces driving the inflection (3) THE NEED three giant numbers for the pain/demand (4) MARKET SIZE TAM giant number + growth bar chart + CAGR (5) USE CASES scenario cards + isometric illustration (6) BUSINESS MODEL numbered list + per-unit economics data card (7) WHY US core moat (8) THE ASK raise + valuation terms + use-of-funds percentages.

Two images (cover robot, scene isometric) are AI-generated in dark industrial tech with orange highlights matching the palette; charts use orange-gradient bars (last one highlighted), icons as line SVG.

cases.title: 神经网络经典算法学术报告
cases.title_en: Classic Neural Network Algorithms Academic Report
cases.subtitle: 深蓝学术风 8 页讲义，SVG 架构图 + 公式条，从 RNN 到 Transformer
cases.subtitle_en: Deep-blue academic 8-page deck with SVG architecture diagrams and formula bars, RNN to Transformer
cases.description:
做学术报告或技术讲义最难的，是把抽象的算法原理讲得既专业又好懂：RNN 的隐状态递归、LSTM 的三门一记忆、CNN 的金字塔结构、Transformer 的 Encoder-Decoder，每一个都需要清晰的架构图、核心公式和要点提炼，而不是干巴巴的文字堆砌。

本案例演示用设计创意模式产出 8 页深蓝学术风讲义：统一的渐变顶栏、深蓝主色配强调橙、Noto Serif SC 标题 + Crimson Pro 公式字体；内容页采用「左架构图 + 右核心要点 + 底部公式条」的固定版式，四个经典模型的架构全部用 SVG 矢量绘制（正交直角连线），封面用 AI 生图做抽象神经网络插画，结尾配对比表与致谢页。

适合高校课堂、技术分享、论文答辩、算法科普等需要专业讲义的学术演示场景。
cases.description_en:
The hardest part of an academic report or technical lecture is making abstract algorithms both rigorous and accessible: RNN hidden-state recursion, LSTM's three gates and memory cell, CNN's pyramid structure, Transformer's encoder-decoder — each needs a clear architecture diagram, core formula, and distilled key points, not a wall of text.

This case shows the design-creative mode producing an 8-page deep-blue academic deck: a consistent gradient top bar, deep-blue primary with accent orange, Noto Serif SC titles plus Crimson Pro formula type; content pages use a fixed layout of left architecture diagram + right key points + bottom formula bar, with all four classic models' architectures drawn as SVG vectors (orthogonal connectors), an AI-generated abstract neural-network cover illustration, and a comparison table plus thank-you page at the end.

Ideal for university lectures, tech talks, thesis defenses, and algorithm explainers that need a professional academic deck.
cases.prompt: 帮我设计一套「神经网络经典算法」学术报告讲义，8 页 16:9，深蓝学术风，专业严谨又清晰易读，中文为主英文/公式点缀。配色：主色深蓝 #15296D→#2563EB（渐变，用于封面/结尾背景）、辅助蓝 #1E40AF/#3B82F6、强调橙 #F59E0B/#EA580C、内容页背景灰 #F5F7FC、主字 #1E293B、正文 #64748B。字体：中文标题 Noto Serif SC、中文正文 Sarasa Gothic SC、英文与公式 Crimson Pro。每页顶部 12px 蓝→橙渐变顶栏。8 页结构：封面（左文右图，深蓝渐变 + AI 生成抽象神经网络插画 + 主标题「神经网络经典算法」+ RNN/LSTM/CNN/Transformer 标签）→ 概览（四卡片演进时间线 1986/1997/1998/2017）→ RNN→LSTM→CNN→Transformer 四个详解页（统一版式：左架构图卡 + 右核心要点面板 + 底部蓝渐变公式条）→ 对比总结（深蓝背景 + 四模型对比表）→ 结尾致谢页。视觉策略：四个模型架构图全部用 SVG 矢量绘制（隐状态递归/三门一记忆/卷积金字塔/Encoder-Decoder，正交直角连线避免斜线交叉）；封面 AI 生图 1 张（抽象神经网络，深蓝橙配色，发光节点拓扑，深色背景）；公式用 Crimson Pro 配 Unicode 数学符号。
cases.prompt_en: Design a "Classic Neural Network Algorithms" academic-report deck, 8 pages 16:9, deep-blue academic style, rigorous yet clear and readable, Chinese-led with English/formula accents. Colors: primary deep-blue #15296D->#2563EB (gradient for cover/closing backgrounds), secondary blue #1E40AF/#3B82F6, accent orange #F59E0B/#EA580C, content-page bg gray #F5F7FC, main text #1E293B, body #64748B. Fonts: Chinese titles Noto Serif SC, Chinese body Sarasa Gothic SC, English/formulas Crimson Pro. Each page has a 12px blue-to-orange gradient top bar. 8-page flow: cover (left text right image, deep-blue gradient + AI-generated abstract neural-network illustration + title + RNN/LSTM/CNN/Transformer tags) -> overview (four-card evolution timeline 1986/1997/1998/2017) -> four detail pages for RNN/LSTM/CNN/Transformer (unified layout: left architecture-diagram card + right key-points panel + bottom blue-gradient formula bar) -> comparison summary (deep-blue bg + four-model comparison table) -> thank-you page. Visual strategy: draw all four model architectures as SVG vectors (hidden-state recursion / three gates + memory cell / convolution pyramid / encoder-decoder, orthogonal connectors avoiding crossing diagonals); one AI cover image (abstract neural network, deep-blue and orange, glowing-node topology, dark background); formulas in Crimson Pro with Unicode math symbols.

cases.title: 中式武侠开放世界游戏世界观发布
cases.title_en: Chinese Wuxia Open-World Game Worldview Reveal
cases.subtitle: 国风武侠游戏发布会幻灯片，水墨意境 + 沉浸式世界观叙事
cases.subtitle_en: Guofeng wuxia game-reveal slides — ink-wash mood and immersive worldview storytelling
cases.description:
游戏发布会的世界观幻灯片，最难的是「氛围与叙事并重」：既要用浓烈的视觉调性把观众瞬间拉进武侠世界，又要清晰交代世界观设定、核心玩法、角色门派与场景，让玩家既心动又看得懂。

本案例演示用设计创意模式产出一组中式武侠开放世界探索游戏的发布会幻灯片：以水墨国风为底，墨黑/宣纸色配朱砂红或鎏金强调，用 AI 生图做大幅武侠场景主视觉（山水、江湖、门派），按发布会叙事组织——封面定调→世界观背景→开放世界地图→核心玩法（轻功探索/江湖事件/武学系统）→门派与角色→视觉与美术风格→公测信息收尾，每页保持统一的国风母版基因与留白意境。

适合游戏发布会、世界观 PV 配套幻灯、产品立项汇报、国风主题演示等场景。
cases.description_en:
For a game-reveal worldview deck, the hard part is balancing atmosphere and narrative: you must pull the audience into the wuxia world instantly with strong visual tone, while clearly conveying the world setting, core gameplay, factions/characters, and scenes so players are both moved and informed.

This case shows the design-creative mode producing a set of reveal slides for a Chinese wuxia open-world exploration game: an ink-wash guofeng base with ink-black/rice-paper tones and cinnabar-red or gilt accents, AI-generated large wuxia scene hero visuals (landscapes, jianghu, sects), organized as a launch narrative — cover tone-setting, worldview background, open-world map, core gameplay (qinggong exploration / jianghu events / martial-arts system), factions and characters, visual/art style, and a closing beta-info page — with a consistent guofeng master template and negative-space mood on every page.

Ideal for game launches, worldview-PV companion slides, project pitches, and guofeng-themed presentations.
cases.prompt: 帮我生成一组中式武侠开放世界探索游戏的发布会幻灯片设计稿，8 页左右 16:9，水墨国风、沉浸有意境，中文为主英文点缀。整体风格：水墨意境 + 留白，墨黑/宣纸米色为底，朱砂红或鎏金做点睛强调，营造江湖侠气与东方氛围；中文标题用书法感衬线或思源宋体，正文用更纱黑体，避免现代科技感。按发布会世界观叙事组织：封面（大幅武侠山水场景 + 游戏名 + 一句话世界观定调）→ 世界观背景（江湖设定与时代纷争）→ 开放世界地图（场景区域概览）→ 核心玩法（轻功探索/江湖事件/武学修行，三栏卡片 + 线性 SVG 国风图标）→ 门派与角色（角色立绘或剪影）→ 美术与视觉风格→ 公测/预约信息收尾。视觉策略：用 AI 生图做多张大幅武侠场景主视觉（水墨山水/江湖城镇/门派楼阁，统一画风），叠半透明水墨纹理与留白做氛围层次；强调色克制只点睛；每页保持统一国风母版基因（小标签→书法感大标题→意境配图/卡片→留白）。
cases.prompt_en: Generate a set of reveal-slide designs for a Chinese wuxia open-world exploration game, about 8 pages 16:9, ink-wash guofeng style, immersive and atmospheric, Chinese-led with English accents. Overall style: ink-wash mood + negative space, ink-black/rice-paper-beige base, cinnabar-red or gilt accents for highlights, evoking jianghu chivalry and an Eastern atmosphere; Chinese titles in a calligraphic serif or Source Han Serif, body in Sarasa Gothic, avoiding a modern tech feel. Organize as a launch worldview narrative: cover (large wuxia landscape scene + game name + one-line worldview tone) -> worldview background (jianghu setting and era strife) -> open-world map (region overview) -> core gameplay (qinggong exploration / jianghu events / martial-arts cultivation, three cards + linear guofeng SVG icons) -> factions and characters (character art or silhouettes) -> art and visual style -> beta/pre-registration closing. Visual strategy: use AI generation for several large wuxia scene hero visuals (ink-wash landscapes / jianghu towns / sect pavilions, unified art style), overlay semi-transparent ink textures and white space for atmospheric depth; keep accent colors restrained as highlights only; maintain a consistent guofeng master template on every page (small label -> calligraphic big title -> mood image/card -> negative space).

cases.title: 智慧城市与 AI 工业解决方案
cases.subtitle: 明亮商务青政企方案 PPT，2.5D 等距插画 + 仪表盘 KPI
cases.subtitle_en: Bright business-teal gov-enterprise deck — 2.5D isometric illustrations and dashboard KPIs
cases.description:
面向政府、园区、制造企业决策者的政企方案 PPT，要的是「清爽专业、可信理性」的亮厅级气质，而不是深色发布会的炫酷——既要把四层架构、多场景能力讲清楚，又要用真实的市场规模与成效数据建立说服力。

本案例演示用设计创意模式产出 8 页明亮商务青风格方案 PPT：浅灰白底配深墨蓝主字、商务青强调与高亮卡，统一的「英文小标签→大字标题→主体→数据来源」母版基因；视觉主角是等距 2.5D 插画（智慧城市全景、智能工厂）与 frame 拼的超大 KPI 数字卡，按封面→时代挑战→四层架构→智慧城市四场景→AI 工业→万亿市场与成效→标杆案例→愿景结尾组织，市场数据联网检索并标注口径来源。

适合政企方案汇报、B 端解决方案路演、行业峰会演讲等需要清爽专业气质的演示场景。
cases.description_en:
A gov-enterprise solution deck for government, park, and manufacturing decision-makers needs a clean, professional, trustworthy, well-lit feel — not a flashy dark launch. It must clearly explain the four-layer architecture and multi-scenario capabilities while building persuasion with real market-size and impact data.

This case shows the design-creative mode producing an 8-page bright business-teal solution deck: a light gray-white base with deep-ink-blue primary text, business-teal accents and highlight cards, and a consistent master template (English small label -> big title -> body -> data source); the visual leads are isometric 2.5D illustrations (smart-city panorama, smart factory) and frame-built giant KPI number cards, organized as cover, era challenges, four-layer architecture, four smart-city scenarios, AI industry, trillion-scale market and impact, benchmark cases, and a vision closing, with market data researched online and sources cited.

Ideal for gov-enterprise briefings, B2B solution roadshows, and industry-summit talks that need a clean, professional feel.
cases.prompt: 帮我做一套「智慧城市 + AI 赋能工业」综合解决方案 PPT，8 页 16:9，面向政府/园区/制造企业决策者，明亮商务青风格（清爽专业可信，区别于深色发布会），中文为主英文点缀。配色：基底浅灰白 #F0F4F5、卡片纯白 + 商务青 #0E9488 细描边圆角、主字深墨蓝 #0F2E33、强调青 #0E9488/青亮 #14B8A6、高亮卡满铺青底白字、次文墨灰 #5A7378。中文用 Sarasa Gothic SC，英文/数字用 Inter。母版基因（每页）：英文小标签→大字标题（深墨蓝 60–104px Bold）→主体→数据来源，配径向青微光晕 + 左缘青光竖线 + 四角取景框。叙事：封面（智慧城市等距插画 +「让城市与工厂学会思考」）→时代挑战（数据孤岛/响应滞后/能耗高企三卡）→四层架构（应用层/AI 中枢高亮/数据层/感知层）→智慧城市四场景（交通/环保/安全/民生 2×2）→AI 工业（智能工厂等距插画 +「从自动化走向自治」）→万亿市场与成效（2×2 大数字 KPI 卡）→标杆案例（三卡大数字）→愿景结尾。视觉策略：大量用等距 2.5D 插画（智慧城市/智能工厂，青绿调）+ frame 拼超大 KPI 数字卡；数据请联网检索市场规模与成效并标注口径来源。
cases.prompt_en: Build a "Smart City + AI-empowered Industry" solution deck, 8 pages 16:9, for government/park/manufacturing decision-makers, bright business-teal style (clean, professional, trustworthy, well-lit — distinct from a dark launch), Chinese-led with English accents. Colors: base light gray-white #F0F4F5, white cards + business-teal #0E9488 thin border and rounded corners, main text deep-ink-blue #0F2E33, accent business-teal #0E9488 / bright-teal #14B8A6, highlight card full teal with white text + light-teal description #C8EDE8, secondary ink-gray #5A7378. Chinese in Sarasa Gothic SC, English/numbers in Inter. Master template (each page): English small label (teal, letter-spacing 6) -> big title (deep-ink-blue 60-104px Bold) -> body -> data source, with a radial teal glow + left-edge teal axis line + corner framing marks at the end. Narrative: cover (smart-city isometric illustration + "Let cities and factories learn to think") -> era challenges (data silos / slow response / high energy use, three cards) -> one platform four-layer architecture (application / AI hub highlighted / data / sensing) -> four smart-city scenarios (traffic/environment/safety/public services, 2x2 grid) -> AI industry (smart-factory isometric illustration + "From automation to autonomy") -> trillion-scale market and impact (2x2 giant-number KPI cards) -> benchmark cases (three big-number cards) -> vision closing. Visual strategy: heavily use isometric 2.5D illustrations (smart-city panorama, smart factory, teal-green) + frame-built giant KPI number cards; research smart-city and industrial-internet market size and impact and cite the caliber/sources.

cases.title: 节气国风 · 寒露海报
cases.title_en: Solar Term Guofeng Poster · Cold Dew
cases.subtitle: 现代新中式插画 + 题款式留白，一张清雅明亮的寒露节气海报
cases.subtitle_en: Modern Chinese illustration with calligraphic negative space — an elegant, luminous Cold Dew poster
cases.description:
节气海报最容易翻车的地方，是「为了国风而发暗发俗」——水墨老卷轴堆满画面，反而失了意境。

这个案例换了思路：用一张当代新中式扁平插画做主视觉——鎏金黄宣纸大留白、青金石蓝山峦勾金线、暖橙秋林、白色祥云与一只南飞鸿雁，明亮通透绝不浑浊。版式走「题款式留白」：竖排超大节气名「寒露」偏右、竖排诗句如题款、朱砂闲章钤印、三候物候落底，飞雁在左与文字右呼应，骨架与常规海报完全不同。文字配色取自画面（石青蓝标题 + 朱砂点睛），与插画同源更显高级。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版设计稿。

适合做节气/国风营销海报、文创视觉、品牌节气日签的设计师与运营，照着 prompt 改主题即可复刻同款。
cases.description_en:
Solar-term posters often fail by going dark and tacky in the name of "guofeng" — old ink scrolls crammed edge to edge that lose all atmosphere.

This case flips the approach: a contemporary flat Chinese illustration as the hero — vast golden rice-paper negative space, azurite-blue mountains with gold-leaf outlines, warm orange autumn trees, white auspicious clouds and a single southbound wild goose, luminous and never muddy. The layout follows a calligraphic inscription style: an oversized vertical term name "Cold Dew" set right, a vertical poem like an inscription, a vermilion seal, and the three pentads along the bottom — the goose on the left answering the text on the right. Text colors are drawn from the artwork itself. Delivered as an Ardot 1080×1620 portrait design.

Great for designers and marketers making solar-term/guofeng posters, cultural-creative visuals, and brand day-cards.
cases.prompt:
帮我做一张二十四节气「寒露」海报，竖版 1080×1620，现代新中式扁平插画风，清雅明亮有意境，不要发暗发俗。

主视觉用一张 AI 插画：明亮鎏金黄宣纸底占上方大片留白，下方青金石蓝/靛蓝写意山峦带金线勾边，暖橙金赭秋树成簇，白色祥云，左上一只优雅南飞鸿雁，明亮通透绝不浑浊。

配色取自画面三色：鎏金黄宣纸 #ECE4D2（留白）、石青蓝 #1B4B6B、朱砂绛红 #C4502E（点睛）。

版式走题款式留白（不满铺不居中，飞雁在左文字在右）：左上节气序「其十七」；右侧竖排超大节气名「寒/露」；其左竖排诗句；下方朱砂闲章；底部三候物候淡色托底。

要求：中文宋黑对比；单一主视觉；留白意境足；飞鸟与大字不重叠；节气文化真实。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a Chinese solar-term poster for "Cold Dew" (Hanlu), portrait 1080×1620, in a modern Chinese flat-illustration style — elegant, luminous, atmospheric, never dark or tacky.

Style anchor: contemporary flat Chinese illustration with a calligraphic-inscription layout (not full-bleed, not center-axis). Hero is one AI illustration: a bright golden rice-paper ground filling the upper area as vast negative space; below, stylized mountains in azurite/indigo blue with gold-leaf outlines; clusters of warm orange and golden-ochre autumn trees; soft white auspicious clouds; a single elegant wild goose flying south in the upper left; subtle gold accents; luminous and airy, never muddy.

Colors (three-tone): golden rice-paper #ECE4D2 (negative space) / azurite blue #1B4B6B (the character "Han" and the term index) / vermilion #C4502E (the character "Lu" and the seal).

Layout (goose left, text right): upper-left term index; a vertical oversized term name on the right; a vertical poem to its left; a vermilion seal lower-right; the three pentads along the bottom on a soft band.

Constraints: serif/sans contrast (Source Han Serif for name/poem, Source Han Sans for index/pentads); single hero; generous negative space; bird and large type never overlap; culturally accurate.

cases.title: 古典乐季音乐会海报
cases.subtitle: 电影级暗金大剧院氛围图为王 + 极简文字叠层，撑起古典乐季的庄重戏剧感
cases.subtitle_en: A cinematic dark-gold concert-hall hero plus minimal text overlay — drama and gravitas for a classical season
cases.description:
做古典音乐会海报，最大的坑是用系统中文字硬撑超大标题——思源宋体放到 100px 以上必然空心难看，气场全无。

这个案例给出正解：把质感全部交给一张电影级 AI 氛围图——深墨绿暗金的巴洛克音乐厅、一位大提琴手剪影沐浴在头顶单束暖金聚光里，体积光、漂浮金尘、油画肌理、强烈明暗对比；系统字只做极简信息叠层。大标题用 Montserrat 西文「AUTUMN NOCTURNE」拉气场，中文「秋夜乐章」退居小字副标，中西配合规避字体短板。暗金三色（深墨绿底 + 暖金光 + 米白字）克制统一，顶/底黑到透明渐变遮罩保证文字可读。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版设计稿。

适合做音乐会、演出、艺术节等高端文化活动海报的设计师与运营。
cases.description_en:
The biggest trap in classical-concert posters is forcing oversized titles in a system CJK font — Source Han Serif above ~100px looks hollow and loses all presence.

This case shows the right move: hand all the texture to one cinematic AI hero — a baroque concert hall in deep blackish-green and dark gold, a solo cellist silhouette bathed in a single warm golden spotlight from above, volumetric light, floating gold dust, oil-painting texture, strong chiaroscuro; system type does only minimal information overlay. The large title uses Montserrat Latin "AUTUMN NOCTURNE" for presence, with the Chinese title reduced to a small subtitle — a Latin/Chinese pairing that sidesteps the font weakness. A restrained dark-gold three-tone palette, with top/bottom black-to-transparent gradient masks keeping text readable. Delivered as an Ardot 1080×1620 portrait design.

Great for designers and marketers making concert, performance, and arts-festival posters.
cases.prompt:
帮我做一张古典音乐会海报，竖版 1080×1620，主题「秋夜乐章 AUTUMN NOCTURNE」古典乐季。

风格：电影级暗金大剧院氛围、油画质感、庄重戏剧感。主视觉用一张 AI 氛围图占满全幅——深墨绿/暗金的巴洛克音乐厅，一位大提琴手剪影沐浴在头顶单束暖金聚光里，体积光、漂浮金尘、油画肌理、强烈明暗对比，上下各留一块暗部放文字。

配色暗金三色：深墨绿黑 #0D1210（背景）、暖金 #D9B66A（光束/主标第二行/烫金线）、米白 #F3ECDD（文字）。

字体：大标题用 Montserrat 西文拉气场，中文小字用思源宋体，绝不用思源宋体撑超大中文标题。

版面：顶部乐季标记+烫金短线；中部氛围图；底部主标 AUTUMN（米白）/NOCTURNE（暖金）+ 中文副标「秋夜乐章」+ 日期场馆条；顶/底渐变遮罩保可读。所有文字 ≥28px，信息真实。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a classical concert poster, portrait 1080×1620, themed "AUTUMN NOCTURNE" for a classical season.

Style anchor: a cinematic dark-gold concert-hall atmosphere with oil-painting texture and dramatic gravitas, full-bleed texture layout. Hero is one AI atmospheric image filling the frame — a baroque concert hall in deep blackish-green and dark gold, a solo cellist silhouette bathed in a single warm golden spotlight from above, volumetric light rays, floating gold dust, oil-painting texture, strong chiaroscuro, with a quiet dark zone at top and bottom for text.

Colors (dark-gold three-tone): blackish-green #0D1210 (ground) / warm gold #D9B66A (beam, second title line, hairline) / cream #F3ECDD (text).

Fonts: large title in Montserrat (Latin, for presence); small Chinese in a serif. Never force an oversized Chinese title in a CJK serif.

Layout: top season tag + gold hairline; center the hero; bottom title AUTUMN (cream) / NOCTURNE (gold) on two lines + a small Chinese subtitle + a date/venue info bar. Add black-to-transparent gradient masks top and bottom for readability.

Constraints: all text ≥28px; at most 2 fonts; dark-gold three-tone; single hero; real info.

cases.title: 山系户外露营节海报
cases.subtitle: 水彩手绘插画主视觉，凸显手作质感的治愈系户外海报
cases.subtitle_en: A watercolor hand-painted hero with artisanal texture — a healing, expansive outdoor poster
cases.description:
想要「手作质感」的户外海报，光靠系统图形和滤镜堆不出来——真正的水彩笔触、纸张颗粒、湿画法晕染才是成败关键。

这个案例把质感全交给一张 AI 水彩插画做主视觉：层叠雾气山峦（松石青绿+靛青矿物色）、前景山谷里一顶暖色帐篷与篝火、山后暖赭橙落日余晖、松林剪影与飘动雾气，明显的水彩笔触、纸张纹理与颜料颗粒感，辽阔治愈。版式走「主视觉为王」，文字谦逊退让。因这张图天空区为浅米色，标题反其道用深色字（松绿/赭橙）压浅底，更显手作清新；底部信息用融入式渐变底卡托住，不显贴纸感。主标双色（WILD 松绿 + CAMP 赭橙）取自画面山色与落日，字与画同源。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版设计稿。

适合做露营节、户外品牌、文艺旅行活动海报的设计师与运营。
cases.description_en:
An outdoor poster that wants real "handmade texture" can't be faked with system shapes and filters — genuine watercolor strokes, paper grain, and wet-on-wet bleeding are what make or break it.

This case hands all texture to one AI watercolor illustration as the hero: layered misty mountains in mineral sage-green and teal, a cozy campfire tent in the foreground valley, warm ochre sunset glow behind the peaks, pine silhouettes and drifting fog, with visible watercolor strokes, paper grain and granulating pigment — expansive and calming. The layout lets the hero rule and the text recede. Because the sky area is pale, the title uses dark type (sage/ochre) over the light ground for a fresh artisanal feel; bottom info sits on a blended gradient card with no sticker effect. The two-tone title (WILD sage + CAMP ochre) is drawn from the artwork. Delivered as an Ardot 1080×1620 portrait design.

Great for designers and marketers making camping-festival, outdoor-brand, and travel-event posters.
cases.prompt:
帮我做一张山系户外露营节海报，竖版 1080×1620，水彩手绘风，治愈辽阔，凸显手作质感。

主视觉用一张 AI 水彩插画占满全幅——层叠雾气山峦（松石青绿+靛青矿物色），前景山谷一顶暖色帐篷与篝火，山后暖赭橙落日，松林剪影、飘动雾气，明显的水彩笔触、纸张纹理、湿画法晕染与颜料颗粒感，上方天空大片浅色留白放标题。

配色矿物三色：雾霭米白 #EDE6D6（背景）、松石青绿 #2E4A3A（深色标题/顶标）、赭橙落日 #D98A4E（点睛）。

字体：主标 Montserrat 西文，中文思源宋体。

版面：顶部活动标记；上部主标 WILD（松绿）/CAMP（赭橙）+ 中文「山野露营季」（左右赭橙细线夹）；中部水彩插画；底部日期地点+活动项目（米白字，加融入式渐变底卡保可读）。所有文字 ≥28px，大字不溢出，信息真实。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a mountain camping-festival poster, portrait 1080×1620, in a hand-painted watercolor style that foregrounds artisanal texture.

Style anchor: hand-painted watercolor illustration with a healing, expansive feel, hero-led layout. Hero is one AI watercolor illustration filling the frame — layered misty mountains in mineral sage-green and teal, a cozy campfire tent in the foreground valley, warm ochre sunset glow behind the peaks, pine silhouettes, drifting fog, visible watercolor strokes and paper grain, wet-on-wet bleeding edges, granulating pigment, serene and expansive, with a generous pale sky area at top for the title.

Colors (mineral three-tone): misty cream #EDE6D6 (ground) / deep sage #2E4A3A (dark title, top tag) / ochre sunset #D98A4E (second title line accent).

Fonts: title in Montserrat (Latin); Chinese in a serif.

Layout: top centered event tag (deep sage); upper title WILD (sage) / CAMP (ochre) + a Chinese event name flanked by ochre hairlines; center the watercolor hero; bottom date/place + activities in cream on a blended gradient card for readability.

Constraints: all text ≥28px; at most 2 fonts; mineral three-tone; single hero; titles don't overflow; real info.

cases.title: 独立电影展海报
cases.subtitle: 照片级 AI 氛围图主视觉 + 双色调电影质感，文艺片调性的影展海报
cases.subtitle_en: A photoreal AI hero with duotone cinematic texture — an arthouse film-festival poster
cases.description:
文艺片影展海报要的是「神秘忧郁的电影感」，这种情绪很难用图形堆出来，全靠主视觉的氛围与质感。

这个案例用一张文艺片 key art 氛围图做绝对主视觉：雨夜空荡城市街道、一个孤独人物背影、头顶路灯逆光长投影、湿沥青上的霓虹倒影、雾气与胶片颗粒，冷青与暖橙双色调（teal-blue + rust orange）——这是文艺片海报的经典视觉语言，让画面统一不杂。延续「大字不用系统中文撑大」的铁律，片名用 Montserrat 西文「AFTER THE RAIN」拉气场，中文片名「雨落之后」退居锈橙小字呼应画面霓虹。锈橙强调色在中文片名、影展标记、底部细线三处重复构成系统，顶/底渐变遮罩保证文字可读。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版设计稿。

适合做电影节、影展、艺术放映等文艺活动海报的设计师与运营。
cases.description_en:
An arthouse film-festival poster needs a "mysterious, melancholic cinematic" mood — hard to fake with shapes, it lives entirely in the hero's atmosphere and texture.

This case uses one arthouse key-art hero as the absolute focal point: a rain-soaked empty city street at night, a lone figure seen from behind, dramatic backlight and long shadow, neon reflections on wet asphalt, fog and film grain, in a teal-blue and rust-orange duotone — the classic visual language of arthouse posters that keeps the image unified. Sticking to the rule of not forcing oversized CJK titles, the film title uses Montserrat Latin "AFTER THE RAIN" for presence, with the Chinese title reduced to small rust-orange type echoing the neon. The rust accent repeats across the Chinese title, festival tag and bottom hairline to form a system, with top/bottom gradient masks for readability. Delivered as an Ardot 1080×1620 portrait design.

Great for designers and marketers making film-festival, screening, and arthouse-event posters.
cases.prompt:
帮我做一张独立电影展海报，竖版 1080×1620，文艺片调性。

风格：电影级双色调（teal-blue + rust orange），神秘忧郁感。主视觉用一张 AI 氛围图占满全幅——雨后深夜空荡城市街道，一个孤独人物背影站在街心，头顶路灯逆光长投影，湿沥青上霓虹倒影，雾气、胶片颗粒，远处霓虹电影院招牌，上方天空大片暗部留白放片名。

配色暗调三色：深炭蓝黑 #0E1014（背景）、冷青 #9FB6BE（西文影展名/次级信息）、锈橙 #E8743B（中文片名/影展标记/细线）。

字体：片名用 Montserrat 西文，中文思源宋体小字。

版面：顶部中外文影展名；上中部片名 AFTER/THE RAIN（米白）+ 中文「雨落之后」（锈橙小字）；中部氛围图；底部锈橙细线+展映期+影院+入选单元；顶/底渐变遮罩保可读。所有文字 ≥28px，大字不溢出截断，信息真实。
cases.prompt_en:
Design an indie film-festival poster, portrait 1080×1620, with an arthouse tone.

Style anchor: a cinematic teal-blue / rust-orange duotone with a mysterious, melancholic mood, full-bleed texture layout. Hero is one AI atmospheric image filling the frame — a rain-soaked empty city street at night, a lone figure standing center seen from behind, dramatic backlight and long shadow, neon reflections on wet asphalt, fog, film grain, a distant neon cinema sign, teal-blue and rust-orange duotone, with a dark sky area at top for the title.

Colors (dark three-tone): charcoal blue-black #0E1014 (ground) / cool teal #9FB6BE (Latin festival name, secondary info) / rust orange #E8743B (Chinese title, festival tag, hairline).

Fonts: film title in Montserrat (Latin); small Chinese in a serif.

Layout: top centered Chinese + Latin festival names; upper title AFTER / THE RAIN on two lines (cream) + a small rust-orange Chinese title; center the hero; bottom rust hairline + dates + cinema + selected sections. Add top/bottom gradient masks for readability.

Constraints: all text ≥28px; at most 2 fonts; dark three-tone; single hero; large type doesn't get clipped; real info.

cases.title: 手作咖啡市集海报
cases.subtitle: 厚涂油画插画 + 上下硬分栏编辑式版式，烟火气十足的市集海报
cases.subtitle_en: An impasto oil-painting illustration with a split-block editorial layout — a warm, bustling market poster
cases.description:
市集海报容易陷入「上方标题 + 满铺图 + 底部居中信息」的套路，千篇一律。

这个案例刻意换骨架：用 P03 上下硬分栏——上半 43% 奶油色块放左对齐编辑式大字、下半 57% 厚涂油画咖啡市集插画，上下交界线上压一条砖红横幅承载日期地点，打破中轴对称。主视觉是一张 AI 厚涂油画：户外咖啡市集、咖啡师在木质小推车前拉花、蒸汽升腾、头顶串灯、纸杯糕点摆台、人群在黄金时刻聚集，明显的厚涂笔触与调色刀肌理，暖褐砖红色调，手作温暖感。左对齐顶天立地的大字（COFFEE 深褐 / MARKET 砖红）做出杂志编辑感，砖红三处呼应（顶标签/MARKET/横幅）构成识别系统。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版设计稿。

适合做市集、咖啡店、手作活动海报的设计师与运营。
cases.description_en:
Market posters easily fall into the same rut — title on top, full-bleed image, centered info at the bottom.

This case deliberately changes the skeleton: a split-block layout where the upper 43% is a cream block holding left-aligned editorial type, the lower 57% is an impasto oil-painting coffee-market illustration, and a brick-red ribbon sits on the seam carrying date and place — breaking the center-axis cliché. The hero is one AI impasto oil painting: an outdoor coffee market, a barista pouring latte art at a rustic wooden cart, rising steam, hanging string lights, paper cups and pastries on the counter, people gathering at golden hour, visible thick brushstrokes and palette-knife texture, warm brown and brick-red tones. Floor-to-top left-aligned titles (COFFEE in deep brown / MARKET in brick red) give a magazine-editorial feel, with brick red repeating across the top tag, MARKET and ribbon to form a system. Delivered as an Ardot 1080×1620 portrait design.

Great for designers and marketers making market, café, and handcraft-event posters.
cases.prompt:
帮我做一张手作咖啡市集海报，竖版 1080×1620，厚涂油画插画风，烟火气，凸显手作质感。

版式用上下硬分栏（不满铺不居中，编辑式左对齐）：上半 43% 奶油色块放左对齐大标题与标签；下半 57% 厚涂油画咖啡市集插画；上下交界压一条砖红横幅放日期地点。

插画用一张 AI 厚涂油画——户外咖啡市集，咖啡师在木质小推车前拉花，蒸汽升腾，头顶串灯，纸杯糕点摆台，人群在黄金时刻聚集，明显厚涂笔触与调色刀肌理，暖褐砖红色调。

配色暖褐三色：奶油纸 #F0E6D2（上半）、深烘焙褐 #4A3528（标题/主体）、砖红 #C25A3C（标签/MARKET/横幅）。字体：大标题 Montserrat 西文左对齐，中文思源宋体。

版面全部左对齐：咖啡杯线稿图标+标签；大标题 COFFEE（深褐）/MARKET（砖红）；中文「手作咖啡市集」；交界横幅放日期地点；插画底部摊位信息小字（加暗托底渐变）。所有文字 ≥28px，大字不溢出，信息真实。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a handcraft coffee-market poster, portrait 1080×1620, in an impasto oil-painting illustration style — warm and bustling, foregrounding handmade texture.

Layout: use a split-block layout (not full-bleed, not center-axis) — editorial left alignment. Upper 43% a solid cream block holding a left-aligned title and tag; lower 57% an impasto oil-painting coffee-market illustration; a brick-red ribbon on the seam carrying date and place.

Hero: one AI impasto oil painting — an outdoor coffee market, a barista pouring latte art at a rustic wooden cart, rising steam, hanging string lights, paper cups and pastries on the counter, people gathering at golden hour, visible thick brushstrokes and palette-knife texture, warm brown and brick-red tones.

Colors (warm-brown three-tone): cream paper #F0E6D2 (upper block) / deep roast brown #4A3528 (title/subject) / brick red #C25A3C (tag, MARKET, ribbon).

Fonts: large title in Montserrat (Latin, left-aligned, floor-to-top); Chinese in a serif.

Layout (all left-aligned): upper-left line-art coffee cup icon + tag; title COFFEE (brown) / MARKET (brick); Chinese market name; the brick ribbon with date/place; small stall info at the bottom of the illustration on a dark gradient base.

Constraints: all text ≥28px; at most 2 fonts; warm-brown three-tone; single hero; left-aligned grid; titles don't overflow; real info.

cases.title: 精品咖啡点单 App
cases.subtitle: 暖大地色 + 手作插画的精品咖啡点单流程，从首页到会员中心一条真实动线
cases.subtitle_en: Warm earth tones and handcraft illustration for a specialty-coffee order flow — a real journey from home to membership
cases.description:
做点单类 App 设计稿，最容易堆屏数却走不通流程，或者满屏占位文字毫无质感。

这个案例演示设计创意模式在「移动 App 完整用户流程」上的能力：从启动→核心点单→结算→个人中心一条真实可用的动线（首页/商品详情/确认订单/会员中心，4 屏 375×812）。视觉走暖大地色 + 手作温度的精品咖啡调性——深咖棕主色、焦糖辅色、暖奶白背景，全程克制，只在首页 Hero 用 1 张照片级 AI 氛围图（手作咖啡 flat-lay）定调品牌质感，其余靠线性 SVG 图标系统与色块。核心交互（杯型/温度/浓度/糖度四组 chip 选择 + 实时计价、选中实底白字 vs 未选白底描边）想得很透，产地处理法风味价格都用真实精品咖啡惯例。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。

适合做餐饮/消费类 App、点单小程序、品牌会员体系的设计师与产品。
cases.description_en:
Ordering-app mockups often stack screens without a working flow, or fill every screen with placeholder text and no texture.

This case shows the design-creative mode on a complete mobile-app user journey: a real, usable flow from launch → core ordering → checkout → profile (home / product detail / order confirm / membership, four 375×812 screens). The visuals use warm earth tones and a handcraft specialty-coffee tone — deep coffee-brown primary, caramel secondary, warm cream background — restrained throughout, with just one photoreal AI hero on the home screen (a handcraft coffee flat-lay) to set brand texture, everything else carried by a linear SVG icon system and color blocks. The core interaction (cup/temperature/shot/sugar chip selection plus live pricing; selected = solid fill white text vs unselected = white outline) is fully thought through, with origins, processing, flavor and prices following real specialty-coffee conventions. Delivered as an Ardot design.

Great for designers and PMs building F&B/consumer apps, ordering mini-programs, and brand membership systems.
cases.prompt:
帮我设计一套「精品咖啡点单」移动 App 高保真设计稿，4 屏横向排列（每屏 375×812）：首页、商品详情、确认订单、会员中心。

风格：暖大地色 + 手作温度的精品咖啡调性，圆润亲和松弛温暖，不要冷峻科技感。配色——主色深咖棕 #92400E、辅色焦糖 #B45309、背景暖奶白 #FEF3C7、前景 #78350F、卡片白、边框 #FDE68A、次文字 #A87C5C。字体：标题 Varela Round，正文/价格 Nunito Sans（价格用 Black）。

逐屏：①首页 edge-to-edge Hero 氛围头图（底部深咖渐变遮罩+门店/头像/大标题）+ 搜索栏+4 圆形分类图标+今日精选商品卡+pill Tab Bar；②商品详情：商品大图+杯型/温度/浓度/糖度四组 chip（选中深咖实底白字、未选白底描边）+ 实时合计+加入购物车 CTA；③确认订单：取餐方式+门店卡+商品明细（规格+数量步进器）+优惠券+费用明细+去支付；④会员中心：深咖渐变头部+数据卡（咖啡豆/积分/优惠券）+功能宫格+积分商城横幅。

内容真实：门店、产地（耶加雪菲/哥伦比亚拼配）、处理法、烘焙度、风味、价格 ¥28-36 符合精品咖啡惯例，不要占位文字。仅首页 Hero 用 1 张 AI 生图（俯拍手作咖啡 flat-lay 陶土暖色实拍），其余图形一律线性 SVG 矢量。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a high-fidelity "specialty coffee ordering" mobile app, four screens laid out horizontally (each 375×812): home, product detail (order customization), order confirm, and membership.

Style anchor: warm earth tones with a handcraft specialty-coffee tone — rounded, friendly, relaxed and warm, not cold-tech.

Colors: primary deep coffee-brown #92400E / secondary caramel #B45309 / background warm cream #FEF3C7 / foreground dark cocoa #78350F / card white / border #FDE68A / secondary text #A87C5C. Fonts: titles in Varela Round (rounded), body/numbers/labels in Nunito Sans (prices in Black).

Screens: (1) Home: edge-to-edge hero (photoreal coffee image + bottom dark-brown gradient mask + store/avatar/big title) → search bar + 4 round SVG category icons + featured product cards → pill tab bar; (2) Detail: product image + info + cup/temperature/shot/sugar chip groups (selected = solid brown white text, unselected = white outline) + bottom live total + add-to-cart CTA; (3) Confirm: pickup toggle + store card + item detail (full spec + quantity stepper) + coupon + fee breakdown + pay bar; (4) Membership: brown-gradient header + stats card (beans/points/coupons) + function grid + points-mall banner + tab bar.

Content realism: store names, origins (Yirgacheffe / Colombia blend), processing, roast, flavor and prices (¥28-36) follow real specialty-coffee conventions, no placeholder text. Imaging & SVG: only the home hero uses one AI image (top-down handcraft coffee flat-lay, warm terracotta photoreal texture); all other graphics are linear SVG vectors, data/prices as text.

cases.title: 植物养护 App
cases.subtitle: 自然绿厚涂插画 + 神经拟物软 UI，治愈陪伴系的植物养护应用
cases.subtitle_en: Natural-green gouache illustration with neumorphic soft UI — a healing, companionable plant-care app
cases.description:
植物养护类 App 想要「治愈陪伴」的气质，光靠绿色配色远远不够，关键在主视觉的厚涂插画质感与软 UI 的细腻处理。

这个案例用 Organic Biophilic 风格落地：自然绿 + 厚涂插画 + 神经拟物软卡（浅绿填充、无硬边框）。AI 生插画克制使用——首页 1 张窗边群植厚涂插画定调、详情页 1 张单株龟背竹厚涂插画，其余功能全靠 SVG 矢量图标撑场。4 屏动线从「我的植物首页→植物详情→AI 识别→养护任务」（375×812）：今日浇水任务卡用绿渐变、植物 2 列网格带健康状态点、养护参数 2×2 神经拟物软卡、本周进度环、任务勾选态（实心绿勾 vs 空圈描边）、中间凸起识别 FAB 的底部导航。标题用 Varela Round 圆润亲和，正文用 Nunito Sans。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。

适合做生活/园艺/工具类 App、养成陪伴产品的设计师与产品。
cases.description_en:
A plant-care app that wants a "healing, companionable" feel needs far more than green colors — it lives in the gouache texture of the hero and the finesse of the soft UI.

This case lands an Organic Biophilic style: natural green + gouache illustration + neumorphic soft cards (pale-green fill, no hard borders). AI illustration is used sparingly — one window-side group-plant gouache hero on home, one single monstera gouache on detail — with everything else carried by SVG vector icons. The four-screen flow runs from My Plants → Plant Detail → AI Identify → Care Tasks (375×812): a green-gradient watering task card, a two-column plant grid with health dots, a 2×2 neumorphic care-parameter grid, a weekly progress ring, task check states (solid green tick vs hollow outline), and a bottom nav with a raised central identify FAB. Titles in Varela Round (rounded and friendly), body in Nunito Sans. Delivered as an Ardot design.

Great for designers and PMs building lifestyle/gardening/utility apps and companion products.
cases.prompt:
帮我设计一套「植物养护 App」移动端高保真界面，4 屏，每屏 375×812。

调性：居家植物养护/园艺，治愈、陪伴、温柔；视觉=自然绿 + 厚涂插画 + 神经拟物软 UI（Organic Biophilic）。AI 生图做厚涂插画主视觉但克制——首屏 1 张群植插画、详情页 1 张单株插画，其余用 SVG 矢量图标。

配色：主色森林绿 #15803D、辅色翡翠绿 #059669、强调金橙 #D97706、背景极浅绿白 #F0FDF4、卡片白、软卡填充 #F0F7F3、次文字 #64748B、边框 #E2EFE7。大圆角 16/32/48。字体：标题 Varela Round，正文/数据 Nunito Sans。

4 屏动线：①我的植物首页：厚涂群植插画 hero+问候+今日浇水任务卡（绿渐变）+植物 2 列网格（带健康状态点）+底部 Tab Bar（中间识别 FAB 凸起）；②植物详情：单株厚涂插画大图+名称/学名+健康徽章+养护参数 2×2 软卡（光照/浇水/温度/湿度）+下次浇水提醒+生长日记缩略；③AI 识别：暗绿相机取景+植物轮廓+四角扫描框+识别结果面板（置信度+结果卡）+拍摄控制；④养护任务：本周进度环卡+今日任务清单（勾选态/待办态）+成就统计。整体治愈温柔，厚涂插画质感要足。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a high-fidelity "plant care" mobile app, four screens, each 375×812.

Theme & tone: industry = home plant care / gardening, mood = healing, companionable, gentle; visuals = natural green + gouache illustration + neumorphic soft UI (Organic Biophilic). Use AI illustration for the gouache hero but sparingly — one group-plant illustration on home, one single-plant on detail, everything else carried by SVG vector icons.

Colors (natural-green system): primary forest green #15803D / secondary emerald #059669 / accent amber #D97706 / background pale green-white #F0FDF4 / card white / neumorphic soft-card fill #F0F7F3 / secondary text #64748B / border #E2EFE7 / danger/wilt #DC2626. Radii 16/32/48 (large organic corners). Fonts: titles Varela Round, body/data Nunito Sans.

Four-screen flow: (1) My Plants home: gouache group-plant hero + greeting + today's watering task card (green gradient) + two-column plant grid (health dots) + bottom tab bar with raised central identify FAB; (2) Plant Detail: single-plant gouache hero + name/binomial + health badge + 2×2 care-parameter grid (light/water/temp/humidity, neumorphic) + next-watering reminder bar + growth-diary thumbnails; (3) AI Identify: dark-green camera viewfinder + central plant outline + corner scan frame + result panel (confidence + result card) + capture controls; (4) Care Tasks: weekly progress-ring card (green gradient) + today's task list (checked/pending) + achievement stats (streak / health rate).

Each first view should be striking, with rich gouache texture and an overall healing, gentle feel.

cases.title: 城市跑步轨迹 App
cases.subtitle: 高对比撞色 + 大字冲击 + SVG 数据可视化，硬朗运动风的跑步追踪应用
cases.subtitle_en: High-contrast colors, bold typography and SVG data viz — a rugged running-tracker app
cases.description:
运动类 App 的设计稿，难点不在好看，而在「数据可视化能不能用纯界面元素拼出来」——很多人一遇到图表就想塞图片或图表引擎，质感全失。

这个案例展示设计创意模式在数据可视化 + 硬朗运动风上的能力：跑步轨迹用 SVG path 折线 + 起终点、配速分段用 frame 色块柱状图、心率区间用 frame 占比条、目标进度用 SVG 环，全部用界面元素绘制。视觉走 Kinetic Brutalism 街头运动风——0 圆角、2px 实边框、无阴影无渐变；大字冲击用 Barlow Condensed 压缩字体撑超大数字；撞色系统是近黑底 + 荧光绿主色（呼应跑鞋）+ 橙色强调。AI 生图克制，仅首屏 1 张跑者氛围实拍图定调能量。4 屏动线：首页概览→跑步进行中→运动详情→训练计划（375×812）。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。

适合做运动健康类 App、数据看板、训练计划产品的设计师与产品。
cases.description_en:
The hard part of a sports-app mockup isn't looks — it's whether the data viz can be built from pure UI elements. Many people reach for images or a chart engine the moment a chart appears, losing all texture.

This case shows the design-creative mode on data viz plus a rugged sports style: the run route as an SVG path polyline with start/end points, pace splits as a frame color-block bar chart, heart-rate zones as a frame proportion bar, and goal progress as an SVG ring — all drawn from UI elements. The visuals follow Kinetic Brutalism street-sport style — 0 radius, 2px solid borders, no shadows or gradients; bold impact via Barlow Condensed condensed type for oversized numbers; a clashing system of near-black ground + lime-green primary (echoing running shoes) + orange accent. AI imaging is sparing — just one runner hero on the home screen to set energy. Four-screen flow: overview → running → activity detail → training plan (375×812). Delivered as an Ardot design.

Great for designers and PMs building sports/health apps, dashboards, and training-plan products.
cases.prompt:
帮我设计一套「城市跑步轨迹」移动 App 高保真设计稿，4 屏横向排列（每屏 375×812）：首页概览、跑步进行中、运动详情、训练计划。

风格：高对比撞色 + 大字冲击 + Kinetic Brutalism 街头运动风，硬朗数据感，0 圆角、2px 硬边框、无阴影无渐变。配色——背景近黑 #0A0A0C、卡片 #16161A、主色荧光绿 #A3E635、强调橙 #F97316、警示红 #DC2626、前景白、次文字 #A1A1AA。字体：超大数字/标题 Barlow Condensed Bold（压缩冲击），正文 Barlow。

逐屏：①首页概览：跑者晨跑氛围图（底部近黑渐变压暗）+荧光绿周标签+超大本周累计公里+3 数据指标块+最近路线卡（SVG 轨迹缩略）+开始跑步大按钮+Tab Bar；②跑步进行中：上半地图（街区网格 SVG+荧光绿轨迹折线+当前位置光点）+下半数据面板（超大距离+配速/用时/心率+停止/暂停控制）；③运动详情：轨迹地图头+概要数据条+每公里配速柱状图（8 根 frame 色块柱底对齐，最快荧光绿高亮）+心率区间条（5 色 frame 占比 Z1-Z5）；④训练计划：本周目标卡（SVG 进度环+km）+本周日历（7 天圆点）+今日训练卡（间歇跑 8×400m）+开始训练按钮。

内容真实：GPS 轨迹/实时配速/每公里分段/心率区间/间歇跑参考真实跑步 App。仅首屏 1 张 AI 生图（城市晨跑跑者，动感低角度，荧光绿跑鞋），其余全部 SVG/frame 绘制。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a high-fidelity "city running tracker" mobile app, four screens laid out horizontally (each 375×812): overview, running-in-progress, activity detail, and training plan.

Style anchor: high-contrast clashing colors + bold typography + Kinetic Brutalism street-sport style, a rugged data feel. 0 radius, 2px hard borders, no shadows or gradients.

Colors: near-black background #0A0A0C / card #16161A / lime-green primary #A3E635 / orange accent #F97316 / red alert #DC2626 / white foreground / secondary text #A1A1AA / 10% white border (2px). Fonts: oversized numbers/titles in Barlow Condensed Bold (condensed impact); body/labels in Barlow.

Screens: (1) Overview: edge-to-edge runner hero (bottom near-black gradient) + lime week tag + oversized weekly total km (Barlow Condensed 88px) + 3 metric blocks (2px borders) + recent-route card (SVG route thumbnail) + lime start-run button + tab bar; (2) Running: upper map route (dark street-grid SVG + lime SVG route polyline + start point + current-position glow) + lower data panel (oversized distance 96px + pace/time/HR + red stop / lime pause controls); (3) Detail: map header + title/date + 4-column summary bar + per-km pace bar chart (8 frame bars, fastest lime-highlighted, bottom-aligned) + HR-zone bar (5-color frame proportion Z1-Z5); (4) Plan: weekly goal lime card (SVG progress ring + km) + weekly calendar (7 day dots) + today's training card (intervals 8×400m) + start button.

Content realism: features (GPS route / live pace / per-km splits / HR zones / training plan / intervals) follow real running apps; pace, HR zones and interval setups follow real runner conventions. Imaging & SVG: only one AI image on home (dynamic low-angle city runner, lime shoes); everything else SVG/frame (route polyline, street grid, pace bars, HR proportion bar, progress ring).

cases.title: 冥想睡眠 App
cases.subtitle: 深空暗色 + 极光流体渐变 + 玻璃拟态，静谧治愈的冥想睡眠应用
cases.subtitle_en: Deep-space dark, aurora gradients and glassmorphism — a serene, healing meditation-sleep app
cases.description:
冥想睡眠类 App 要的是「静谧沉浸」的氛围，这种情绪很难靠堆控件做出来，关键在暗色氛围、玻璃拟态质感与那颗发光呼吸球的精细程度。

这个案例展示设计创意模式在暗色沉浸式氛围上的能力：一张极光夜空 AI 生图作全屏背景定调（复用首页 + 播放页），配深色渐变压暗保证文字可读。玻璃拟态卡片（半透明白底 + 白描边 + 背景模糊）浮在极光上；核心的发光呼吸球用外层径向光晕 + 多圈柔光环 + 中心渐变实心球 + 紫色辉光投影 + 球内高光层层叠出，远比纯描边圆环精美；睡眠阶段柱状图用 frame 色块按比例拼。暗色不用纯黑（深空蓝黑 #0F172A），标题用 Lora 衬线撑静谧优雅。4 屏动线：今夜首页→呼吸引导播放→混音实验室→睡眠报告（375×812）。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。

适合做身心健康、助眠白噪音、正念冥想类 App 的设计师与产品。
cases.description_en:
A meditation-sleep app needs a "serene, immersive" mood that's hard to fake with stacked controls — it lives in the dark atmosphere, the glassmorphism texture, and the finesse of that glowing breathing orb.

This case shows the design-creative mode on dark immersive atmosphere: one aurora night-sky AI image as a full-screen background to set the tone (reused on home and player), with a dark gradient mask keeping text readable. Glassmorphism cards (translucent white fill + white stroke + background blur) float over the aurora; the core glowing breathing orb is built in layers — an outer radial glow + multiple soft light rings + a center gradient orb + a purple glow shadow + an inner highlight — far finer than a plain outline ring; sleep-stage bars are assembled from proportional frame blocks. The dark isn't pure black (deep-space blue-black #0F172A), with Lora serif titles for a serene, elegant feel. Four-screen flow: Tonight home → breathing guide player → mixing lab → sleep report (375×812). Delivered as an Ardot design.

Great for designers and PMs building wellness, sleep white-noise, and mindfulness apps.
cases.prompt:
帮我设计一套「冥想睡眠」移动 App 高保真设计稿，4 屏横向排列（每屏 375×812）：今夜首页、呼吸引导播放、混音实验室、睡眠报告。

风格：深空暗色 + 极光流体 + 玻璃拟态，静谧治愈沉浸，绝不用纯黑用深蓝紫。配色——主色靛蓝 #4338CA、辅色 #6366F1、强调梦境紫 #7C3AED·#A78BFA、背景深空蓝黑 #0F172A、卡片 #192134、前景白、次文字 #94A3B8、玻璃白 8% 填充+白 12% 描边。字体：标题 Lora 衬线，正文/数据 Raleway。

逐屏：①今夜首页：极光夜空 AI 图全屏背景（底部深色渐变压暗）+问候 Lora 大字+今夜睡眠计划玻璃卡（背景模糊）+推荐 3 张卡+玻璃 pill Tab Bar；②呼吸播放：全屏极光压暗+中央发光呼吸球（外径向光晕+2 柔光环+中心紫色渐变实心球带辉光投影+球内高光+圆心吸气文字）+引导文案+进度+播放控制；③混音实验室：4 张音轨卡（雨声/海浪/森林/营火，渐变圆图标+frame 色块滑块+百分比，激活紫描边）+保存音景按钮；④睡眠报告：评分玻璃卡（评分环 SVG+分数）+睡眠阶段柱状图（frame 色块：深睡/浅睡/REM/清醒底对齐）+数据指标卡（时长/入睡用时/觉醒次数）。

内容真实：呼吸引导/白噪音混音/睡眠阶段/睡眠评分参考真实冥想 App。仅 1 张 AI 生图（极光夜空，复用首页+播放页背景），其余全部 SVG 矢量+frame 色块绘制。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a high-fidelity "meditation & sleep" mobile app, four screens laid out horizontally (each 375×812): Tonight home, breathing-guide player, mixing lab, and sleep report.

Style anchor: deep-space dark + flowing aurora + glassmorphism, serene and healing, immersive. Never pure black — use deep blue-purple.

Colors: indigo primary #4338CA / secondary #6366F1 / dream-purple accent #7C3AED·#A78BFA / deep-space blue-black background #0F172A / card #192134 / white foreground / secondary text #94A3B8 / glass 8% white fill + 12% white stroke. Fonts: titles Lora (serif, serene and elegant); body/data Raleway.

Screens: (1) Tonight home: aurora night-sky AI image as full-screen background (bottom dark gradient) + Lora big greeting + tonight's sleep-plan glass card (background blur) + 3 recommendation cards (gradient round icon + duration + play) + bottom glass pill tab bar; (2) Breathing player: full-screen darkened aurora + central glowing breathing orb (outer radial glow + 2 soft rings + center purple gradient orb with glow shadow + inner highlight + center "inhale" text) + guide subtext + progress + bottom playback controls; (3) Mixing lab: big title + 4 track cards (rain/waves/forest/campfire, gradient round icon + frame slider + percentage, active = purple stroke / off = gray) + save-soundscape button; (4) Sleep report: score glass card (SVG score ring + number) + sleep-stage bars (frame blocks: deep/light/REM/awake, bottom-aligned + legend) + metric card (duration / fall-asleep time / awakenings, 3 columns with dividers).

Content realism: features (breathing guide / white-noise mixing / sleep-stage tracking / sleep score) follow real meditation apps; stage ratios, scores and noise types follow real conventions. Imaging & SVG: only one AI image (aurora night sky, reused on home + player); everything else SVG vectors (orb, track icons, playback, tab, score ring) + frame blocks (bars, sliders).

cases.title: 数字银行卡 App
cases.subtitle: 暗色 + 液态玻璃卡面 + 单点青荧光，高端精密的金融科技应用
cases.subtitle_en: Dark UI, liquid-glass card face and single-point cyan glow — a premium fintech app
cases.description:
金融科技 App 想要「高端精密」的质感很难拿捏：太花就廉价、太素就平淡，关键在液态玻璃卡面的奢华感与数据图表的克制处理。

这个案例展示设计创意模式在金融数据可视化 + 液态玻璃精密感上的能力：一张 AI 生图（黑曜石 + 青紫流体光泽）填入银行卡卡面，叠卡号品牌金色芯片，质感奢华（复用首页卡 + 卡片管理大卡）。消费占比条、分类明细圆点、近 6 月趋势柱状图全用 frame 色块拼，绝不用图表引擎；iOS 风格开关也用 frame。单点荧光克制——暗底 #070A0F + 仅电光青 #22D3EE 作单点强调，高端不喧闹；金融惯例收入用绿 #10B981、货币 ¥；数字标题用 Inter Bold 体现精确专业。4 屏动线：首页→卡片管理→转账支付（含数字键盘）→消费分析（375×812）。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。

适合做金融/钱包/记账类 App、数据看板的设计师与产品。
cases.description_en:
Fintech apps walk a fine line for a "premium, precise" feel — too busy looks cheap, too plain looks flat — and it lives in the luxury of the liquid-glass card face and the restraint of the data charts.

This case shows the design-creative mode on financial data viz plus liquid-glass precision: one AI image (obsidian black with cyan-violet fluid sheen) fills the bank-card face, layered with card number, brand and a gold chip for a luxurious texture (reused on home card and card-management hero). The spending-proportion bar, category dots, and 6-month trend bars are all assembled from frame color blocks — never a chart engine; the iOS-style switches are frame too. The single-point glow is restrained — a dark ground #070A0F with only electric cyan #22D3EE as the accent, premium and quiet; following finance conventions, income is green #10B981 and currency is ¥; number titles use Inter Bold for precise professionalism. Four-screen flow: home → card management → transfer (with number pad) → spending analysis (375×812). Delivered as an Ardot design.

Great for designers and PMs building finance/wallet/budgeting apps and dashboards.
cases.prompt:
帮我设计一套「数字银行卡」移动 App 高保真设计稿，4 屏横向排列（每屏 375×812）：首页、卡片管理、转账支付、消费分析。

风格：暗色 + 液态玻璃 + 单点青荧光，高端精密克制奢华。配色——背景近黑 #070A0F、卡片 #0F1620、主色电光青 #22D3EE（单点荧光）、辅 #0891B2、收益绿 #10B981、前景白、次文字 #64748B、分类色青·紫 #8C5CF6·绿·灰。字体：全部 Inter（数字/标题 Bold、正文 Medium、标签 SemiBold）。

逐屏：①首页：问候+总资产大字「¥128,540.60」+液态玻璃银行卡（青紫流体卡面 AI 图+品牌+金色芯片+卡号/持卡人/有效期）+快捷操作 4 宫格（青色 SVG+玻璃方块）+近期交易列表（带分类图标，收入绿）+Tab Bar；②卡片管理：大液态玻璃银行卡+额度行（可用青/总额度）+卡片设置开关列表（冻结/线上/海外，iOS 风格开关）；③转账支付：收款人卡+转账金额大字「¥2,000」+可用余额（青）+数字键盘+确认转账按钮（青色渐变发光）；④消费分析：本月支出卡（¥8,642.50+多色占比条）+分类明细（餐饮/购物/交通/其他，彩色圆点+占比+金额）+近 6 月趋势柱状图（frame 色块，当月青高亮）。

内容真实：余额/转账/卡管理/虚拟卡设置/消费分类/趋势参考真实数字银行，收入绿、货币 ¥。仅 1 张 AI 生图（液态玻璃卡面，黑曜石+青紫流体，复用首页卡+卡片管理大卡），其余全 SVG/frame 绘制。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a high-fidelity "digital bank card" mobile app, four screens laid out horizontally (each 375×812): home, card management, transfer, and spending analysis.

Style anchor: dark UI + liquid glass + single-point cyan glow, premium and precise, restrained luxury.

Colors: near-black background #070A0F / card #0F1620 / electric cyan primary #22D3EE (single-point glow) / secondary #0891B2 / income green #10B981 / white foreground / secondary text #64748B / 6-8% white borders / category colors cyan·violet #8C5CF6·green·gray. Fonts: all Inter (numbers/titles Bold, body Regular/Medium, labels SemiBold).

Screens: (1) Home: greeting + total-assets big number "¥128,540.60" + liquid-glass bank card (cyan-violet fluid AI face + brand + gold chip + number/holder/expiry) + 4 quick-action tiles (cyan SVG + glass blocks) + recent transactions (category icons, income green) + bottom tab bar; (2) Card management: large liquid-glass card + limit row (available cyan / total) + card-setting switch list (freeze / online / overseas, iOS-style switches); (3) Transfer: payee card + transfer amount big number "¥2,000" + available balance (cyan) + number pad (1-9 / . / 0 / delete) + confirm button (cyan gradient glow); (4) Spending analysis: this-month spend card (¥8,642.50 + multi-color proportion bar) + category detail (dining/shopping/transport/other, color dots + share + amount) + last-6-months trend bars (frame blocks, current month cyan-highlighted).

Content realism: features (balance / transfer / card management / virtual-card settings / spending-category analysis / trend) follow real digital banks; finance conventions of green income and ¥ currency. Imaging & SVG: only one AI image (liquid-glass card face, obsidian + cyan-violet fluid, reused on home card + card-management hero); everything else SVG/frame (quick/transaction/tab icons, proportion bar, category dots, trend bars, iOS switches).

cases.title: 二十四节气新中式插画
cases.subtitle: 宣纸亮底 + 金线远山的物候插画系列
cases.subtitle_en: A poetic phenology series on luminous rice-paper white
cases.description: 传统节气插画一画就成发黄卷轴、毛笔字老气挂历，缺乏现代感与系列一致性。本案精选立春、清明、夏至、白露、霜降、大雪六个物候记忆点，组成一条嫩绿→烟青→碧荷→月白→丹红→雪白的四季弧线。统一用「现代新中式扁平」骨架：宣纸暖白底 #FAF6EC、金线勾边远山 #C9A227、大留白天空、近景物候主体、一两笔飞鸟点活，只换季节主色与主体，保证连看成一套。产物为 Ardot 2×3 网格设计稿，含封面诗、六张插画卡与四季色板。适用于节气营销插画、文创海报、品牌物候视觉系列。
cases.description_en: Traditional solar-term art easily turns into aged-yellow scrolls and dated calligraphy that lack a modern, cohesive feel. This case picks six phenology highlights—Beginning of Spring, Qingming, Summer Solstice, White Dew, Frost Descent, Major Snow—into a four-season color arc. A unified 'modern new-Chinese flat' skeleton keeps them as one set: luminous rice-paper white #FAF6EC, gold-lined distant mountains #C9A227, big sky negative space, foreground seasonal flora and a couple of birds, swapping only color and motif. The artifact is an Ardot 2×3 grid with a cover poem, six illustration cards and a four-season palette. Fits seasonal marketing, cultural posters and brand phenology series.
cases.prompt: 做一套「二十四节气」新中式扁平插画系列，6 张自成体系，2×3 网格横版。精选立春、清明、夏至、白露、霜降、大雪六个物候记忆点，色彩走嫩绿→烟青→碧荷→月白→丹红→雪白一圈四季轮回。风格定调：现代新中式扁平，宣纸暖白底 #FAF6EC、金线勾边远山 #C9A227、主墨色 #2A2522、四季主色嫩绿#A8C66C/碧荷#3F8E7E/丹红#C0563E。坚决不做仿古水墨卷轴、不要毛笔字与发黄背景。每张统一骨架：远山金线 + 大留白亮天 + 近景物候主体（柳芽/杏花/红荷/白鹭/红柿/寒梅）+ 一两笔飞鸟点活，只换季节主色与主体，保证连看成一套。中文标题用思源宋体 Heavy，诗句清雅。封面区放系列标与节气总诗，页脚放六色四季色板。AI 生图意图：minimalist flat、luminous airy、poetic oriental、editorial illustration，绝不暗沉浑浊。
cases.prompt_en: Create a '24 Solar Terms' new-Chinese FLAT illustration series, 6 cohesive pieces in a 2×3 landscape grid. Pick six phenology highlights—Beginning of Spring, Qingming, Summer Solstice, White Dew, Frost Descent, Major Snow—running a full seasonal color cycle from tender-green to misty-teal to lotus-green to moon-white to crimson to snow-white. Style: modern new-Chinese flat, luminous warm rice-paper white background #FAF6EC, thin elegant gold-lined distant mountains #C9A227, ink title color #2A2522, seasonal accents tender-green #A8C66C / lotus-green #3F8E7E / crimson #C0563E. Absolutely NO ink-wash scroll, NO brush calligraphy, NO aged-yellow background. Every piece shares one skeleton: gold-lined mountains + big bright sky negative space + foreground seasonal flora (willow buds / apricot blossom / red lotus / egret / persimmon / winter plum) + a couple of birds; swap only color and motif so they read as one set. Use a heavy serif for Chinese titles and elegant poetry lines. Cover holds the series mark and a solar-term poem; footer shows a six-color seasonal palette. AI-gen intent: minimalist flat, luminous and airy, poetic oriental, editorial illustration—never dark or muddy.

cases.title: 复古游戏机像素图标系统
cases.subtitle: 8-bit 像素网格的成套 SVG 图标系统
cases.subtitle_en: A cohesive 8-bit pixel-grid SVG icon set
cases.description: 图标系统最难的是「网格规范」与「整套一致性」，零散绘制的图标尺寸混乱、风格漂移。本案以红白机/街机像素美学为锚点，做一套 24 枚 8-bit 像素图标系统：游戏硬件、操作按键、街机经典、界面元素、装备道具、系统状态六类各 4 枚。全部统一 16×16 像素网格、5 色调色板（深蓝底 #0F172A + 红 #DC2626 / 蓝 #2563EB / 绿 #22C55E / 金 #FACC15 / 白 #E2E8F0），仅用实心 rect 方块拼接、整数对齐、直角无描边，渲染零毛刺。产物为一张深色像素展示页（封面 + 六分类网格 + 网格规范区 + 色板页脚）。适用于游戏 UI 图标、像素风产品标识、图标系统教学样本。
cases.description_en: The hardest parts of an icon system are grid discipline and whole-set consistency; ad-hoc icons drift in size and style. Anchored to NES/arcade pixel aesthetics, this case builds a 24-icon 8-bit system: game hardware, controls, arcade classics, HUD elements, items and system states—four icons each. All share a 16×16 pixel grid and a 5-color palette (navy base #0F172A plus red #DC2626 / blue #2563EB / green #22C55E / gold #FACC15 / white #E2E8F0), built only from solid integer-aligned rects, right angles and no strokes for crisp rendering. The artifact is a dark pixel showcase page (cover + six-category grid + grid-spec block + palette footer). Fits game UI icons, pixel-style product marks and icon-system teaching samples.
cases.prompt: 帮我设计一套「复古游戏机 / 8-bit 像素风」成套图标系统展示页，画布宽 1440。风格锚点：红白机/街机厅像素美学，blocky 方块感、有限调色板、直角无圆角、硬边无描边，整体是一张点亮的深色街机屏幕。配色（5 色板）：背景深海军蓝 #0F172A、卡片底 #192134、主红 #DC2626、主蓝 #2563EB、得分绿 #22C55E、金币黄 #FACC15、像素白 #E2E8F0。字体：标题 Press Start 2P、标签正文 VT323、中文思源黑体。结构：封面区（三色像素块 + RETRO PIXEL / ICON SYSTEM 大标 + 副标）；图标网格区六分类每类一行 4 枚（游戏硬件 gamepad/joystick/cartridge/handheld、操作按键、街机经典 pac-man/ghost/invader、界面元素 life/score/coin、装备道具 sword/shield/potion/key、系统状态 sound/save/pause/trophy），每枚配 VT323 标签；网格规范区放放大图标 + 16×16 绿色网格边框 + 规则标签；页脚放 5 色调色板。关键实现：所有图标 SVG viewBox="0 0 16 16"，仅用整数坐标 rect 实心方块拼接，5 色板取色，禁止 path 曲线、描边与反锐齿。图标标签用真实游戏术语英文。
cases.prompt_en: Design a 'retro game console / 8-bit pixel' icon-system showcase page, canvas width 1440. Style anchor: NES/arcade pixel aesthetics—blocky feel, limited palette, hard right-angle edges, no rounding, no strokes; the whole page reads like a lit-up dark arcade screen. Palette (5 colors): navy background #0F172A, card base #192134, red #DC2626, blue #2563EB, score-green #22C55E, coin-gold #FACC15, pixel-white #E2E8F0. Fonts: Press Start 2P for titles, VT323 for labels/body, a CJK sans for Chinese. Structure: cover (tri-color pixel blocks + RETRO PIXEL / ICON SYSTEM headline + subtitle); icon grid of six categories, four icons per row (game hardware gamepad/joystick/cartridge/handheld, controls, arcade classics pac-man/ghost/invader, HUD life/score/coin, items sword/shield/potion/key, system states sound/save/pause/trophy), each with a VT323 label; a grid-spec block with an enlarged icon + 16×16 green grid border + rule tags; a footer 5-color palette. Key implementation: every icon is SVG viewBox="0 0 16 16", built only from integer-aligned solid rects taking colors from the 5-color palette—no path curves, no strokes, no anti-aliasing. Use real game-term English for icon labels.

cases.title: 太空探索扁平科普插画
cases.subtitle: 深空黑蓝底 + 青橙点睛的科普插画系列
cases.subtitle_en: A science series on deep-space navy with cyan-orange accents
cases.description: 科普插画既要理性准确又要成系列、视觉统一，零散绘制容易风格不一、露白边破坏沉浸感。本案做一套「太空探索」扁平科普插画 6 张，从近到远、从已知到未知：太阳系、火箭发射、空间站、月球探测、火星探测、深空黑洞。统一视觉语言保证「一套」：深空黑蓝底 #0B1437 满幅出血无白边、青 #22D3EE 与暖橙 #F59E0B 点睛、中文思源黑体 + 西文大写标注。每张 AI 生图都加 FULL BLEED / NO border 约束，避免填入卡片后露浅色竖条。产物为 Ardot 横版 2×3 网格设计稿（header + 六卡片 + 色板页脚）。适用于科普读物配图、航天主题展板、教育课件插画。
cases.description_en: Science illustrations must be both rational and a unified set; ad-hoc drawing causes style drift and white borders that break immersion. This case builds a 6-piece 'Space Exploration' flat infographic series, near-to-far and known-to-unknown: solar system, rocket launch, space station, Moon mission, Mars rover, deep-space black hole. A unified visual language keeps them as one set: deep-space navy #0B1437 full-bleed with no white edge, cyan #22D3EE and warm orange #F59E0B accents, a CJK sans plus uppercase Latin labels. Every AI-gen prompt adds FULL BLEED / NO border to avoid pale strips after placing into cards. The artifact is a landscape Ardot 2×3 grid (header + six cards + palette footer). Fits popular-science figures, aerospace exhibition boards and educational courseware.
cases.prompt: 做一套「太空探索」扁平科普插画系列，6 张自成体系，横版 2×3 网格 + 页脚色板。六图从近到远、从已知到未知：太阳系（同心轨道八大行星+橙日）、火箭发射（多级火箭+橙焰+入轨虚线）、空间站（桁架+青色帆板+地球弧）、月球探测（着陆器+月球车+环形山）、火星探测（六轮火星车+红色地表+卫星）、深空黑洞（吸积盘+引力透镜+星系旋臂）。统一视觉语言保证一套：底色深空黑蓝 #0B1437 满幅出血、卡片底 #192134、强调青 #22D3EE + 暖橙 #F59E0B、中间调靛蓝紫罗兰；中文思源黑体（标题 Bold/正文 Regular）+ 西文大写标注。AI 生图模板务必加约束：flat vector science infographic、FULL BLEED edge-to-edge、NO border NO frame NO margin，深空底铺满四边、minimal clean flat shapes、no gradient noise no texture，正方满幅。顶部 header 含「SPACE EXPLORATION · 太空探索」标签 + 主标 + 副标，页脚放 6 色圆点色板。
cases.prompt_en: Create a 'Space Exploration' flat infographic illustration series, 6 cohesive pieces in a landscape 2×3 grid with a palette footer. Six scenes, near-to-far and known-to-unknown: solar system (concentric orbits, eight planets + orange sun), rocket launch (multi-stage rocket + orange flame + dotted ascent arc), space station (truss + cyan solar arrays + Earth's curved horizon), Moon mission (lander + rover + craters), Mars rover (six-wheeled rover + red terrain + satellite), deep-space black hole (accretion disk + gravitational lensing + spiral galaxy). A unified visual language keeps them one set: deep-space navy #0B1437 full-bleed background, card base #192134, cyan #22D3EE + warm orange #F59E0B accents, indigo/violet mid-tones; a CJK sans (Bold titles / Regular body) plus uppercase Latin labels. AI-gen template must include: flat vector science infographic, FULL BLEED edge-to-edge, NO border NO frame NO margin, navy fills all four edges, minimal clean flat shapes, no gradient noise, no texture, square full bleed. Top header holds a 'SPACE EXPLORATION' tag + headline + subtitle; footer shows a six-dot color palette.

cases.title: 餐饮美食双色面性图标系统
cases.subtitle: 暖橙食欲基调的双色面性 SVG 图标系统
cases.subtitle_en: An appetite-warm two-tone SVG icon system
cases.description: 单色线性图标层次单薄、不够现代，而双色面性图标小尺寸下又容易元素过多糊成一团。本案做一套「餐饮美食」双色面性 SVG 图标系统 12 枚（饮品/主食/餐具/场景四类各 3），用三层语言保证成一套：浅橙 #FFEDD5 圆角背板托底、暖橙 #F97316 实面构形、番茄红 #EF4444 点睛细节，辅助金黄 #FBBF24 与深褐 #7C2D12。每枚 viewBox 64×64，纯几何 path/rect/circle 拼接，元素控制在 4 个以内、抓最强识别特征（如寿司极简为米团+鱼料+海苔三件套）。产物为 Ardot 设计稿（封面「好胃口」+ 3×4 网格 + 双色规范区 + 色板页脚）。适用于外卖餐饮 App 图标、菜单视觉、美食品牌图标库。
cases.description_en: Single-color line icons feel flat and dated, while two-tone icons can clutter at small sizes. This case builds a 12-icon 'Food & Beverage' duotone SVG system (drinks / staples / tableware / scenes—three each), using three layers to stay cohesive: a pale-orange #FFEDD5 rounded backplate, a warm-orange #F97316 solid body, and tomato-red #EF4444 accent detail, with gold #FBBF24 and deep-brown #7C2D12 support. Each icon is viewBox 64×64, built from plain geometric path/rect/circle, capped at four elements to grab the strongest recognition feature (e.g. sushi reduced to rice ball + topping + nori). The artifact is an Ardot design (cover '好胃口' + 3×4 grid + duotone spec block + palette footer). Fits food-delivery app icons, menu visuals and culinary brand icon libraries.
