cases.prompt: 做一套「餐饮美食」双色面性（two-tone / duotone flat）SVG 图标系统，12 枚 3×4 网格，作为图标&插画类的图标方法论案例。风格：以实心色块面构形再用第二色点睛，比单色线性更有层次、更现代（大厂彩色图标质感）。配色暖食欲基调：主色暖橙 #F97316 + 强调番茄红 #EF4444 + 浅橙背板 #FFEDD5 + 奶白底 #FFF7ED，辅助金黄 #FBBF24 / 深褐 #7C2D12。三层语言保证成一套：浅橙圆角背板托底（统一视觉面积）、暖橙实面承载识别轮廓、番茄红点睛细节拉层次。12 枚：饮品（咖啡/奶茶/酒杯）、主食（汉堡/披萨/拉面）、餐具（寿司/刀叉/餐盘）、场景（外卖盒/主厨帽/甜筒），各配中文标题（思源黑体 Bold）+ 英文标注（Medium）。每枚 viewBox 64×64 居中放入 120×120 浅橙圆角背板（圆角28）、白卡片（圆角20），纯几何 path/rect/circle 拼接。封面大标「好胃口」（思源黑体 Bold #7B2D10），底部双色规范区 + 四色板页脚。关键：小尺寸图标元素≤4个，抓最强识别特征。
cases.prompt_en: Create a 'Food & Beverage' two-tone (duotone flat) SVG icon system, 12 icons in a 3×4 grid, as an icon-methodology case for the Icon & Illustration category. Style: form with solid color planes, then accent with a second color—more layered and modern than single-color line icons. Appetite-warm palette: warm-orange #F97316 primary + tomato-red #EF4444 accent + pale-orange backplate #FFEDD5 + cream base #FFF7ED, with gold #FBBF24 / deep-brown #7C2D12 support. Three layers keep it cohesive: a pale-orange rounded backplate (uniform visual mass), a warm-orange solid body (recognizable outline), and tomato-red accent detail (depth). The 12: drinks (coffee/milk tea/wine), staples (burger/pizza/noodles), tableware (sushi/cutlery/plate), scenes (takeout box/chef hat/ice cream), each with a CJK-sans Bold title + Medium Latin label. Each icon viewBox 64×64, centered in a 120×120 pale-orange rounded backplate (radius 28) on a white card (radius 20), built from plain geometric path/rect/circle. Cover headline '好胃口' (CJK-sans Bold #7B2D10); bottom duotone spec block + four-color palette footer. Key: cap each small icon at ≤4 elements, grabbing the strongest recognition feature.

cases.title: 情绪心理水粉叙事插画
cases.subtitle: 厚涂水粉 + 单色调统领的情绪叙事插画
cases.subtitle_en: Gouache narrative illustration ruled by a single mood color
cases.description: 情绪类插画容易陷入两种极端：太抽象辨识度弱，或太写实失去艺术性与系统感。本案做一套「情绪心理」水粉叙事插画 6 张，是整组里最感性的压轴篇。六图组成情绪光谱：平静、喜悦、焦虑、疗愈、孤独、希望，每张由一种情绪色主导（青绿/暖黄/群青/草绿/冷蓝/天蓝），厚涂水粉纸纹质感、大面积纯色块 + 强烈光影、保留一个极小具象人物点睛、大量留白讲故事。统一视觉语言：暖米白底 #FAF6EF、群青蓝 #3B6CB7 点睛、竖版插画配竖版图框（约 2:3）、中文思源宋体（书卷气）。产物为 Ardot 横版 2×3 网格设计稿（header + 六竖版卡片 + 色板页脚）。适用于心理疗愈品牌、情绪类内容配图、艺术编辑插画。
cases.description_en: Emotion illustration tends to two extremes: too abstract to read, or too literal to feel artful and systematic. This case builds a 6-piece 'Emotion & Psychology' gouache narrative series—the most expressive finale of the set. Six pieces form a mood spectrum: calm, joy, anxiety, healing, loneliness, hope, each ruled by one emotion color (teal / warm yellow / indigo / fresh green / cool blue / sky blue), with thick gouache paper texture, large flat color blocks, strong light and shadow, a single tiny figurative accent, and generous negative space telling a story. Unified visual language: warm off-white base #FAF6EF, indigo-blue #3B6CB7 accent, portrait illustrations in portrait frames (~2:3), CJK serif for a literary feel. The artifact is a landscape Ardot 2×3 grid (header + six portrait cards + palette footer). Fits psychological-wellness brands, emotion-themed content figures and artistic editorial illustration.
cases.prompt: 做一套「情绪心理」水粉叙事插画系列，6 张自成体系，横版 2×3 网格，插画为竖版构图、图框用竖版比例（约 2:3）。风格定调：厚涂水粉/水彩纸质感（可见粗纹纸张颗粒+笔刷扫痕+颜料堆叠的哑光手绘感，非数字平涂）；极简叙事语言（大面积纯色块 + 强烈光影 + 保留一个极小具象人物点睛 + 大量留白）；每张由一种情绪色主导整张画面，克制高级。六图情绪光谱：平静（湖畔栈道独坐，青绿 #4E8C7D）、喜悦（阳光原野张臂奔跑，暖黄 #E8A23D）、焦虑（高墙夹缝渺小人影，群青 #3B4A7A）、疗愈（光束下俯身护新芽，草绿 #5DA271）、孤独（空房独立窗前，冷蓝 #7A8AA8）、希望（破晓仰望纸飞机上扬，天蓝 #3B8FB7）。统一视觉：画布暖米白 #FAF6EF、卡片纯白、群青蓝 #3B6CB7 点睛、中文标题思源宋体 Bold。AI 生图模板：minimalist narrative gouache on rough watercolor paper、visible paper grain and brush strokes、single dominant color、a tiny lone figure、generous negative space、no text、portrait full bleed。顶部 header + 底部 6 色圆点色板。
cases.prompt_en: Create an 'Emotion & Psychology' gouache narrative illustration series, 6 cohesive pieces in a landscape 2×3 grid, with portrait-format illustrations in portrait frames (~2:3). Style: thick gouache / watercolor-paper texture (visible rough grain, brush strokes and paint buildup, matte hand-painted finish, not digital flat fill); minimalist narrative language (large flat color blocks + strong light/shadow + a single tiny figurative accent + generous negative space); each piece ruled by one dominant emotion color, restrained and refined. Mood spectrum: calm (lone figure on a lakeside dock, teal #4E8C7D), joy (arms open running in a sunlit field, warm yellow #E8A23D), anxiety (a tiny figure dwarfed by towering walls, indigo #3B4A7A), healing (kneeling to tend a sprout in a light beam, fresh green #5DA271), loneliness (alone by a window in an empty room, cool blue #7A8AA8), hope (looking up at a rising paper plane at dawn, sky blue #3B8FB7). Unified visual: warm off-white canvas #FAF6EF, white cards, indigo-blue #3B6CB7 accent, CJK-serif Bold titles. AI-gen template: minimalist narrative gouache on rough watercolor paper, visible paper grain and brush strokes, single dominant color, a tiny lone figure, generous negative space, no text, portrait full bleed. Top header + bottom six-dot color palette.

cases.title: 观山茶品牌设计
cases.subtitle: 新中式留白 + 焦金点睛的精品茶品牌系统板
cases.subtitle_en: A premium tea brand board in new-Chinese negative space
cases.description: 精品茶品牌常陷入仿古俗套或元素堆砌，难有静雅气质与系统一致性。本案为「观山」精品茶做一张横版品牌系统板，综合展示极致排版留白 + SVG 矢量徽标 + AI 实拍样机能力。新中式留白：超大思源宋体 Heavy 主标 + 70% 负空间，焦金 #A16207 点睛；圆形印章山峦徽标用 SVG（渐变天 + 双层落日 + 四层山峦剪影）做出体量，可独立成标；标志系统卡演示徽标大中小三级缩放规范。配色白霜 #FAFAF9 / 墨褐 #1C1917 / 焚金，左深墨褐 Hero + 右白底 Bento 网格（标志/字体/色板/AI 茶罐样机+名片）。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。适用于茶饮品牌 VI、东方美学包装、高端消费品牌板。
cases.description_en: Premium tea branding often falls into faux-antique cliché or element clutter, lacking a serene, systematic feel. This case builds a landscape brand system board for 'Guan Shan' premium tea, showcasing extreme typographic negative space + SVG vector logo + AI product mockup. New-Chinese negative space: an oversized heavy CJK-serif headline with 70% white space and burnt-gold #A16207 accents; a circular seal mountain logo built in SVG (gradient sky + layered sunset + four-layer mountain silhouette) with real mass that stands alone; a logo-system card demonstrating large/medium/small scaling. Palette: frost-white #FAFAF9 / ink-brown #1C1917 / burnt-gold, with a dark ink-brown Hero on the left and a white Bento grid on the right (logo / type / palette / AI tea-tin mockup + business card). The artifact is an Ardot design. Fits tea brand VI, Oriental-aesthetic packaging and premium consumer brand boards.
cases.prompt: 做一张 1600×1000 横版「精品茶品牌系统板」，新中式留白 + 焦金点睛，气质极简静雅（Dieter Rams / 留白美学）。配色：白霜底 #FAFAF9、墨褐 #1C1917、暑木 #44403C、焚金 #A16207。字体：中文主标用思源宋体 Heavy、中文信息用思源黑体、西文用 Montserrat。版面：左栏深墨褐 Hero（580 宽，大留白）——顶部「TEA ATELIER / 精品茶」标签 + EST.2024；中部圆形印章山峦徽标（SVG：渐变天 rect + 双层 circle 落日 + 4 层 fill path 山峦剪影由远到近）+ 思源宋体 Heavy 148px「观山」+ 焦金「GUAN SHAN」+ 分隔线；底部 slogan「一叶知秋 一山含靠」+ 副文。右栏白霜底 Bento 网格：标志系统卡（徽标大/中/小三级缩放，展示 VI 手册标准页式的缩放规范）/ 字体规范卡（思源宋体大字示范 + 字体说明）/ 四色色板（各配色名与 HEX）/ 应用样机（AI 茶罐 + 墨褐名片，名片含圆徽缩略与联系信息）。整体内容真实、克制留白，主徽标改动后所有应用点须同步同一标志语言，保证 VI 一致性。AI 茶罐样机生图：minimalist premium tea tin packaging mockup、matte dark charcoal brown cylinder tin、thin gold mountain-line logo、warm off-white paper background、soft natural side light、high-end product photography、oriental zen、negative space、muted earthy tones。
cases.prompt_en: Create a 1600×1000 landscape 'premium tea brand system board' with new-Chinese negative space and burnt-gold accents, minimal and serene (Dieter Rams / white-space aesthetics). Palette: frost-white #FAFAF9, ink-brown #1C1917, shu-wood #44403C, burnt-gold #A16207. Fonts: heavy CJK serif for the headline, CJK sans for info, Montserrat for Latin. Layout: left dark ink-brown Hero (580 wide, lots of white space)—a 'TEA ATELIER / 精品茶' tag + EST.2024 at top; a circular seal mountain logo (SVG: gradient-sky rect + double-circle sunset + four fill-path mountain silhouettes near-to-far) + a 148px heavy-serif '观山' + burnt-gold 'GUAN SHAN' + a divider in the middle; a slogan and subtext at the bottom. Right white Bento grid: logo-system card (large/medium/small scaling) / type-spec card / four-color palette / application mockups. Real content, restrained white space. AI tea-tin mockup prompt: minimalist premium tea tin packaging mockup, matte dark charcoal brown cylinder tin, thin gold mountain-line logo, warm off-white paper background, soft natural side light, high-end product photography, oriental zen, negative space, muted earthy tones.

cases.title: Pétale 法式香氛品牌设计
cases.subtitle: 杂志编辑式版面 + 繁花博物画的法式香氛系统板
cases.subtitle_en: A French perfume board with editorial layout and botanical art
cases.description: 一组品牌案例若都用同一套「左深色 Hero + 右白底网格」结构会显得同质，且香氛是系列产品、用单一瓶子实拍会锁死延展性。本案为「Pétale」法式香氛改用杂志编辑式版面：左 2/3 编辑区（奶油底大留白，Playfair Display 150px 超大衬线主标 + 中文副标 + 法式 manifesto），右 1/3 全幅繁花博物画 AI 主视觉（粉兰花、藤蔓、覆盆子从四角向中心生长、中央留白压金色字标），自成可独立用的 Key Visual。配色奶油 #F7F1EA / 裸粉 #E8D5CE / 玫瑰金 #B08D6A / 深可可 #3A2D28，气质柔暖慵懒优雅。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。适用于香氛美妆品牌、法式高级视觉、博物画风 Key Visual。
cases.description_en: If a set of brand cases all use the same 'dark Hero left + white grid right' structure they look samey, and perfume is a product line—locking the visual to one bottle limits extensibility. This case gives 'Pétale' French perfume an editorial magazine layout: a left 2/3 editorial zone (cream base, lots of white space, a 150px Playfair Display serif headline + Chinese subtitle + a French manifesto), and a right 1/3 full-bleed botanical AI key visual (pink orchids, vines, raspberries growing from the corners toward a calm center holding a gold wordmark), a key visual that stands alone. Palette: cream #F7F1EA / nude-pink #E8D5CE / rose-gold #B08D6A / deep-cocoa #3A2D28, soft, warm, languid and elegant. The artifact is an Ardot design. Fits perfume/beauty brands, French luxury visuals and botanical-art key visuals.
cases.prompt: 做一张 1600×1000 横版「法式香氛品牌系统板」，杂志编辑式版面，气质参考 Gucci 植物学博物画 + 法式裸粉慵懒优雅。配色：奶油底 #F7F1EA、裸粉 #E8D5CE、玫瑰金 #B08D6A、深可可 #3A2D28（文字）。字体：英文主标用 Playfair Display（高对比衬线）、中文用思源宋体、标签用 Montserrat。版面：左 2/3 编辑区（奶油底大留白）——顶部品牌行（纤细花瓣线描小徽标 + PÉTALE 字标 + 右侧 PARIS · EST.2024）；中部超大衬线主标「Pétale」150px + 中文副标「花瓣里的法式温柔」+ 一段法式 manifesto 文案；底部细分隔线之上页脚信息条，左右分列调色盘（4 个圆色点 + HEX）与字体规范。右 1/3 全幅繁花博物画 AI 主视觉，中央留白处叠金色「Pétale / MAISON DE PARFUM」字标，使整张右图自成可独立使用的 Key Visual。整体呼吸感强、不对称、信息散落、克制优雅，避免与网格 Bento 结构同质。AI 博物画生图：highly detailed vintage botanical illustration、lush pink phalaenopsis orchids、trailing vines、sage green leaves、scattered raspberries、growing from edges toward center、soft blush-pink cream background、fine hand-drawn engraving、elegant feminine romantic、calm empty negative space in center、watercolor and ink botanical art。
cases.prompt_en: Create a 1600×1000 landscape 'French perfume brand system board' with an editorial magazine layout, channeling Gucci botanical illustration + French nude-pink languid elegance. Palette: cream #F7F1EA, nude-pink #E8D5CE, rose-gold #B08D6A, deep-cocoa #3A2D28 (text). Fonts: Playfair Display (high-contrast serif) for the English headline, CJK serif for Chinese, Montserrat for labels. Layout: left 2/3 editorial zone (cream base, lots of white space)—a brand row at top (slim petal line logo + PÉTALE wordmark + PARIS · EST.2024 on the right); an oversized serif headline 'Pétale' 150px + Chinese subtitle + a French manifesto in the middle; a footer info bar above a thin divider at the bottom, with a palette (4 color dots + HEX) and type spec split left/right. Right 1/3 full-bleed botanical AI illustration with a gold 'Pétale / MAISON DE PARFUM' wordmark centered. Airy, asymmetric, restrained and elegant. AI botanical prompt: highly detailed vintage botanical illustration, lush pink phalaenopsis orchids, trailing vines, sage green leaves, scattered raspberries, growing from edges toward center, soft blush-pink cream background, fine hand-drawn engraving, elegant feminine romantic, calm empty negative space in center, watercolor and ink botanical art.

cases.title: 野山猫精酿啤酒品牌设计
cases.title_en: Wild Lynx Craft Beer Brand Design
cases.subtitle: 复古木刻版画 + 高饱和撞色的街头厂牌系统板
cases.subtitle_en: A street-brewery board with woodcut art and high-saturation clash
cases.description: 精酿啤酒厂牌需要野性街头气质与强记忆点，写实或矢量都难出那股「燃」劲，且一组案例要避免版面同质。本案为「野山猫」精酿做品牌系统板，用 AI 生成复古木刻版画山猫肖像（铁锈橙 + 墨绿限色、木刻肌理、自带装饰圆环厂牌徽框）扛主视觉，一张图即一个完整啤酒徽章。版面采用第三种结构：左 720 满幅深墨绿版画主视觉 + 右米黄信息区。撞色铁锈橙 #D65A1F 撞墨绿 #1F3D2E，思源宋体 Heavy 撑「桀骜不驯」撞击式大标。SVG 山猫圆徽用于标识、AI 版画用于主视觉双层分工。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。适用于精酿啤酒厂牌、街头潮牌、版画风品牌视觉。
cases.description_en: A craft-beer brewery needs a wild street vibe and a strong memory hook—realistic or vector styles struggle to deliver that fire, and a set of cases should avoid samey layouts. This case builds a brand board for 'Wild Lynx' craft beer, using an AI-generated vintage woodcut lynx portrait (rust-orange + forest-green limited palette, linocut texture, a built-in ornamental badge ring) as the hero—one image is a complete beer badge. It uses a third layout type: a left 720 full-bleed dark-green woodcut hero + a right oatmeal info zone. Clashing rust-orange #D65A1F against forest-green #1F3D2E, with a heavy CJK serif powering an impactful '桀骜不驯' headline. An SVG lynx round mark serves as the logo while the AI woodcut serves as the hero—two layers, clear roles. The artifact is an Ardot design. Fits craft-beer breweries, street streetwear and woodcut-style brand visuals.
cases.prompt: 做一张 1600×1000 横版「精酿啤酒厂牌品牌系统板」，复古版画 + 高饱和撞色 + 街头野性风格。配色：米黄底 #EFE3C8、墨绿 #1F3D2E、铁锈橙 #D65A1F、炭黑 #211C18。字体：中文主标用思源宋体 Heavy（撞击感）、西文 Montserrat Bold、正文思源黑体。版面（第三种结构）：左 720 宽满幅深墨绿底，居中放一张 AI 生成复古木刻版画山猫头像；右侧米黄信息区竖向 SPACE_BETWEEN——顶部厂牌行（SVG 山猫圆徽 +「野山猫」+ 右 EST.2024）；中部「WILD LYNX BREWING CO.」小标 + 思源宋体 Heavy 110px「桀骜\n不驯」墨绿大标 + 文案；底部细分隔线 + 信息行（左色彩 4 方色块 + HEX、右字体规范）。版面采用左满幅版画主视觉 + 右信息区的第三种结构，避免与网格 Bento、左信息右图同质。街头、野性、燃，撞色强烈，内容真实，SVG 山猫圆徽用于标识、AI 木刻版画用于主视觉双层各司其职。AI 山猫版画生图：vintage woodcut engraving style illustration of a fierce wild lynx head facing forward with intense piercing eyes、retro craft beer label art、bold linocut texture、limited palette of rust orange and deep forest green on cream paper、high contrast、rugged street poster aesthetic、ornamental vintage badge feel、hand-printed ink texture、untamed and bold mood。
cases.prompt_en: Create a 1600×1000 landscape 'craft beer brewery brand system board' with vintage woodcut + high-saturation clash + wild street style. Palette: oatmeal base #EFE3C8, forest-green #1F3D2E, rust-orange #D65A1F, charcoal #211C18. Fonts: heavy CJK serif (impactful) for the headline, Montserrat Bold for Latin, CJK sans for body. Layout (third structure type): left 720-wide full-bleed dark forest-green field with an AI-generated vintage woodcut lynx head centered; right oatmeal info zone, vertical SPACE_BETWEEN—a brewery row at top (SVG lynx round mark + '野山猫' + EST.2024 on the right); a 'WILD LYNX BREWING CO.' small head + a heavy-serif 110px '桀骜\n不驯' green headline + copy in the middle; a thin divider + info row at the bottom (left: color 4 swatches + HEX; right: type spec). Street, wild and fiery, strong clashing colors, real content. AI lynx woodcut prompt: vintage woodcut engraving style illustration of a fierce wild lynx head facing forward with intense piercing eyes, retro craft beer label art, bold linocut texture, limited palette of rust orange and deep forest green on cream paper, high contrast, rugged street poster aesthetic, ornamental vintage badge feel, hand-printed ink texture, untamed and bold mood.

cases.title: 栖野户外露营品牌设计
cases.title_en: Qi Ye Outdoor Camping Brand Design
cases.subtitle: AI 等距插画 + 上下分层版面的户外生活方式系统板
cases.subtitle_en: An outdoor lifestyle board with isometric art and layered layout
cases.description: 户外露营品牌要传达松弛辽阔的生活方式感，纯色平涂缺乏自然粗粝质地，且一组案例需彻底去版面同质。本案为「栖野」户外做品牌系统板，用 AI 生成几何化等距露营场景（帐篷/松林/远山/湖面倒影、扁平矢量 + 大地色 + 渐变天光）扛主视觉。采用第四种版面结构——上下三层：顶部深墨绿品牌条 + 中部全幅等距插画主视觉（左下半透明燕麦标签牌承托大字）+ 底部燕麦信息带三栏。配色燕麦米 #E4DAC4 / 苔绿 #5C6B4A / 陶土橙 #C2703D / 深林墨 #2C3327，等距 SVG 徽标（山峦三面明暗 + 帐篷 + 月亮）。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。适用于户外露营品牌、生活方式 VI、等距插画风视觉。
cases.description_en: An outdoor camping brand must convey a relaxed, expansive lifestyle feel; flat fills lack rugged natural texture, and a set of cases needs to fully de-duplicate layouts. This case builds a brand board for 'Qi Ye' outdoors, using an AI-generated geometric isometric camping scene (tent / pines / distant mountains / lake reflection, flat vector + earthy colors + gradient sky) as the hero. It uses a fourth layout type—three stacked layers: a top dark forest-green brand bar + a center full-bleed isometric hero (a semi-transparent oatmeal label plate carrying the headline at lower-left) + a bottom oatmeal info band in three columns. Palette: oatmeal #E4DAC4 / moss-green #5C6B4A / terracotta #C2703D / forest-ink #2C3327, with an isometric SVG logo (three-faced mountain shading + tent + moon). The artifact is an Ardot design. Fits outdoor camping brands, lifestyle VI and isometric-illustration visuals.
cases.prompt: 做一张 1600×1000 横版「户外露营生活方式品牌系统板」，上下分层版面，等距插画 + 自然大地色 + 松弛辽阔。配色：燕麦米 #E4DAC4、苔绿 #5C6B4A、陶土橙 #C2703D、深林墨 #2C3327。字体：中文主标思源宋体 Heavy、西文 Montserrat、正文思源黑体。版面三层：①顶部深墨绿品牌条（左等距山 + 帐篷 SVG 徽标 +「栖野」浅色 / 右「户外生活方式 · SINCE 2024」橙标签）；②中部全幅等距露营插画 AI 生图（帐篷/松林/远山/湖面，扁平矢量 + 大地色 + 渐变天光），左下半透明燕麦标签牌承托「在野外，安放一个家」墨绿大字 + 英文副标；③底部燕麦信息带三栏：标志系统（徽标深底/浅底两态）/ 色彩（4 个大色块 + HEX）/ 字体规范。松弛、辽阔、自然，内容真实。AI 等距插画生图：isometric illustration of a serene camping scene、cozy triangular tent beside tall pine trees、small campfire、rolling hills and distant mountain、lake reflection、flat vector art with subtle grain texture、warm earthy palette of oatmeal beige sage green terracotta orange deep forest green、soft gradient sky from cream to pale sage、calm spacious relaxed mood、lots of open space。
cases.prompt_en: Create a 1600×1000 landscape 'outdoor camping lifestyle brand system board' with a layered top-to-bottom layout, isometric illustration + natural earthy colors + relaxed expansiveness. Palette: oatmeal #E4DAC4, moss-green #5C6B4A, terracotta #C2703D, forest-ink #2C3327. Fonts: heavy CJK serif for the headline, Montserrat for Latin, CJK sans for body. Three layers: (1) a top dark forest-green brand bar (left: isometric mountain + tent SVG logo + '栖野' in light color / right: '户外生活方式 · SINCE 2024' orange tag); (2) a center full-bleed isometric camping AI illustration (tent / pines / distant mountains / lake, flat vector + earthy colors + gradient sky), with a semi-transparent oatmeal label plate at lower-left carrying a green '在野外，安放一个家' headline + English subtitle; (3) a bottom oatmeal info band in three columns: logo system (dark/light two states) / color (4 large swatches + HEX) / type spec. Relaxed, expansive, natural, real content. AI isometric prompt: isometric illustration of a serene camping scene, cozy triangular tent beside tall pine trees, small campfire, rolling hills and distant mountain, lake reflection, flat vector art with subtle grain texture, warm earthy palette of oatmeal beige sage green terracotta orange deep forest green, soft gradient sky from cream to pale sage, calm spacious relaxed mood, lots of open space.

cases.title: NOVA 玻璃科技品牌设计
cases.subtitle: 全幅沉浸式 KV + 玻璃液态质感的科技品牌系统板
cases.subtitle_en: A tech brand board with immersive KV and liquid-glass texture
cases.description: 顶级科技品牌发布会主视觉讲究冷峻通透与极简呼吸感，分栏或网格结构难以营造沉浸感。本案为「NOVA」玻璃科技品牌做全幅沉浸式 Key Visual——整张即一张发布会主视觉：满幅 AI 玻璃液态背景（通透玻璃曲面 + 金色光晕折射 + 深蓝近黑底，中央留暗部）+ 居中极简白字标（Montserrat Light 120px「NOVA」超大字距 + 中文副标）+ 底部克制信息条三栏。配色深蓝 #0A1018 / 玻璃银蓝 #8FA8C8 / 暖金 #C9A86A / 纯白，星芒徽标（NOVA 即新星）。图上压字加径向暗化遮罩保证白字可读。这是区别于分栏/网格的第五种版面结构。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。适用于科技品牌发布会、AI 产品 KV、高端沉浸式视觉。
cases.description_en: Top-tier tech launch key visuals demand cold, translucent clarity and minimal breathing room—column or grid structures struggle to feel immersive. This case builds a full-bleed immersive key visual for the 'NOVA' glass-tech brand—the whole board is a launch KV: a full-bleed AI liquid-glass background (translucent glass surfaces + golden light refraction + deep navy near-black base with a dark center) + a centered minimal white wordmark (Montserrat Light 120px 'NOVA' with wide tracking + Chinese subtitle) + a restrained bottom info bar in three columns. Palette: deep navy #0A1018 / glass silver-blue #8FA8C8 / warm gold #C9A86A / pure white, with a starburst logo (NOVA = new star). A radial darkening mask over the image keeps the white text readable. This is a fifth layout type, distinct from columns/grids. The artifact is an Ardot design. Fits tech launch events, AI product KVs and premium immersive visuals.
cases.prompt: 做一张 1600×1000 横版「科技品牌全幅 Key Visual 系统板」，玻璃液态科技风，参考顶级科技品牌发布会主视觉：深蓝近黑 + 通透玻璃曲面 + 金色光晕折射 + 极简白字标。配色：深蓝 #0A1018、午夜蓝 #141E2E、玻璃银蓝 #8FA8C8、暖金 #C9A86A、纯白 #FFFFFF。字体：西文 Montserrat Light（大字距）、中文思源黑体。版面（第五种结构，根容器 layout:none 自由定位）：满幅 AI 玻璃液态主视觉铺底（流动玻璃曲面 + 金色光晕折射 + 深蓝底，中央留暗部空间）；中央叠极简字标——金色「LIQUID INTELLIGENCE」小标 + Montserrat Light 120px「NOVA」白字（字距很开）+ 中文副标「拟生智能 · 让智能如光流动」；底部深色半透明信息条三栏：星芒徽标 + NOVA / 四色色板 / 字体规范。中央加径向暗化遮罩保证白字可读。冷峻、通透、克制、未来。AI 玻璃主视觉生图：abstract premium tech key visual、flowing translucent liquid glass surfaces and curved transparent ribbons with crystal clarity、golden light refraction and caustics glowing through the glass、deep navy almost black background、midnight blue tones、cinematic studio lighting、futuristic high-end product launch aesthetic、wide horizontal composition with dark negative space in the center for text、ultra clean、photorealistic 3D render。
cases.prompt_en: Create a 1600×1000 landscape 'tech brand full-bleed Key Visual system board' in a liquid-glass tech style, channeling a top-tier tech launch key visual: deep navy near-black + translucent glass surfaces + golden light refraction + a minimal white wordmark. Palette: deep navy #0A1018, midnight blue #141E2E, glass silver-blue #8FA8C8, warm gold #C9A86A, pure white #FFFFFF. Fonts: Montserrat Light (wide tracking) for Latin, CJK sans for Chinese. Layout (fifth structure type, root container layout:none free positioning): a full-bleed AI liquid-glass hero fills the base (flowing glass surfaces + golden light refraction + navy base, dark space in the center); a minimal wordmark centered—a gold 'LIQUID INTELLIGENCE' small head + Montserrat Light 120px 'NOVA' in white (wide tracking) + a Chinese subtitle; a dark semi-transparent bottom info bar in three columns: starburst logo + NOVA / four-color palette / type spec. A radial darkening mask in the center keeps the white text readable. Cold, translucent, restrained, futuristic. AI glass hero prompt: abstract premium tech key visual, flowing translucent liquid glass surfaces and curved transparent ribbons with crystal clarity, golden light refraction and caustics glowing through the glass, deep navy almost black background, midnight blue tones, cinematic studio lighting, futuristic high-end product launch aesthetic, wide horizontal composition with dark negative space in the center for text, ultra clean, photorealistic 3D render.

cases.title: ColorHarbor 配色收藏库
cases.subtitle: 暗色画廊风的配色发现与收藏单页
cases.subtitle_en: A dark-gallery palette discovery and collection page
cases.description: 设计师在找配色灵感时常被零散的截图和书签淹没，缺一个能像画廊一样陈列、还能即点即取色值的工具。本案用前端开发工程师，按「暗色画廊」审美做了一个纯前端配色收藏库 ColorHarbor：近黑背景把每组色彩当艺术品框起来展示，霓虹青做交互反馈。首屏是分类过滤标签行加随机发现按钮、Masonry 色块网格，hover 放大并带柔光外发光；点击色块进入放大详情，显示 hex、一键复制、五色色值列表与 UI 预览。产物为单文件 output.html，可直接打开。适用于做配色工具、灵感库、设计系统取色页等同款开发。
cases.description_en: Designers hunting for color inspiration often drown in scattered screenshots; they lack a tool that displays palettes like a gallery while letting them grab hex values instantly. Built with a Frontend Developer agent in a dark-gallery aesthetic, ColorHarbor is a pure front-end palette library: a near-black background frames each palette like art, with neon-cyan interaction cues. The home view has category filters, a random-discover button and a Masonry color grid that scales up with a soft glow on hover; clicking a swatch opens an enlarged detail with hex, one-click copy, a five-value list and a UI preview. The deliverable is a single output.html. Great for building color tools, inspiration libraries or design-system swatch pages.

artifacts.label: ColorHarbor 配色收藏库

cases.prompt: 请用纯前端 HTML/CSS/JS 单文件，做一个名为 ColorHarbor 的配色收藏库网站，走「暗色画廊」审美：近黑背景 #0D0D0D 把每组色彩像艺术品一样框起来，卡片用半透明深灰 #1A1A1A，强调色霓虹青 #64FFDA 做交互反馈，色块极细白边，字体主色近白 #F5F5F5；色值用 Geist Mono 等宽，标题用 Inter。首屏：顶部一行分类过滤标签（极简/渐变/复古/霓虹/自然）加随机发现按钮，下方 Masonry 色块网格，每块随机高度，hover 放大并带柔光外发光，右下角收藏爱心，右侧 Favorites 抽屉入口。点击色块进入详情态：左侧放大展示该色、hex 与复制按钮、五色色值列表，右侧 UI 预览（按钮/卡片/输入框/评分）。整体交互流畅，可收藏、可一键复制色值。
cases.prompt_en: Build a pure front-end single-file HTML/CSS/JS website named ColorHarbor, a palette collection library in a 'dark gallery' aesthetic: a near-black background #0D0D0D frames each palette like gallery art, cards/panels use translucent dark grey #1A1A1A, the accent is neon cyan #64FFDA for interaction feedback, swatches have hairline white borders rgba(255,255,255,0.06), and primary text is near-white #F5F5F5. Fonts: hex values in Geist Mono (monospace, small), category and page titles in Inter (title font-light). Home/default state: a top row of category filter tags (minimal/gradient/retro/neon/natural) plus a random-discover button, then a Masonry color grid where each block has a random height and scales to ~110% with a soft glow on hover, each with a favorite (heart) button, and a Favorites drawer entry on the right. Clicking a swatch enters a transition state: left side enlarges the color, shows its hex with a copy button and a five-value list; right side shows a UI preview (button/card/input/rating). Make interactions smooth, with favoriting and hex copying.

cases.title: 糖果屋个人主页 · 新粗野主义
cases.subtitle: 纯单文件实现的新粗野主义中文作品集
cases.subtitle_en: A single-file Neo-Brutalism personal portfolio
cases.description: 做个人作品集时既想要强烈的视觉记忆点，又不想引第三方框架、还要保证可访问性，这往往很难兼顾。本案用前端开发工程师，按「新粗野主义」风格做了一个名为「糖果屋」的中文作品集单页，纯 HTML/CSS/JS 单文件实现。饱和糖果色配纯黑实线边框与零模糊硬阴影，SVG 噪点、条纹、圆点矩阵做质感，星形圆形等装饰全用内联 SVG。页面含导航、Hero、技能、项目（Bento 网格）、经历时间线、关于、联系 CTA、Footer 八个区域，hover 位移、按钮按压、IntersectionObserver 滚动揭示一应俱全，并完整尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。产物为单文件 output.html。适用于做个人主页、作品集等同款开发。
cases.description_en: Building a portfolio that is visually memorable yet framework-free and accessible is a tough balance. Built with a Frontend Developer agent, this single-file HTML/CSS/JS Chinese portfolio named 'Candy House' adopts a Neo-Brutalism style: saturated candy colors with solid black borders and zero-blur hard shadows, texture from SVG noise, stripes and dot matrices, and all decorations (stars, circles) as inline SVG. It covers eight sections: nav, hero, skills, projects (bento grid), an experience timeline, about, a contact CTA and footer, with hover offsets, button-press feedback and IntersectionObserver scroll reveals, fully honoring prefers-reduced-motion. The deliverable is a single output.html. Ideal for building personal homepages and portfolios in the same vein.

artifacts.label: 糖果屋个人主页

cases.prompt: 请构建一个 Neo-Brutalism（新粗野主义）风格的个人作品集单页，中文内容，纯 HTML/CSS/JS 单文件，网站名叫「糖果屋」。色彩用饱和糖果色（热粉 #FF1493、电光黄 #FFE135、天蓝 #00BFFF、青柠绿、橙、紫）各配淡色底，文字近黑 #0A0A0A、边框纯黑、页面底 #F5F5F0、黑底 Footer。所有组件必须有 2-4px 纯黑实线边框与零模糊纯黑硬阴影（如 5px 5px 0 #000），禁用模糊阴影/渐变/毛玻璃。字体从 Google Fonts 加载：标题 Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold、正文 Inter、标签 JetBrains Mono；质感用 SVG 噪点、斜条纹、圆点矩阵，装饰全用内联 SVG。含八个区：Sticky 导航、Hero、技能卡进度条、项目 Bento 网格、经历时间线、关于卡片、黄底联系 CTA、黑底 Footer。交互：卡片 hover 位移加阴影扩大、按钮 active 物理按压、IntersectionObserver 滚动揭示与进度条动画，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，语义化标签、键盘可达、零框架依赖。
cases.prompt_en: Build a Neo-Brutalism personal portfolio single-page website in Chinese, implemented as a single HTML/CSS/JS file, named 'Candy House'. Colors: saturated candy hues (hot pink #FF1493, electric yellow #FFE135, sky blue #00BFFF, lime #32CD32, orange #FF6B35, purple #A855F7), each paired with a pale background; outline/text in near-black #0A0A0A, borders pure black #000, page base #F5F5F0, black footer #0A0A0A. Every component must have a 2-4px solid black border and zero-blur pure-black hard shadows (e.g. box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #000); no blurred shadows, gradients or frosted glass. Load fonts from Google Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold for headings, Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for mono labels. Texture via SVG noise, -45deg stripes and dot matrices; all decorations as inline SVG. Eight sections: sticky nav, hero (online status / highlighted name / role tags / stat cards), skill cards with progress bars, a projects bento grid, an experience timeline, about cards, a yellow contact CTA and a black footer. Interactions: card hover offset with shadow growth, button active physical press, IntersectionObserver scroll reveals and progress-bar animation, fully honoring prefers-reduced-motion, with semantic tags, keyboard accessibility and zero external framework dependencies.

cases.title: 未来玻璃产品落地页
cases.subtitle: 毛玻璃质感的 Apple 气质产品发布页
cases.subtitle_en: An Apple-keynote-style frosted-glass landing page
cases.description: 产品发布落地页既要有发布会的高级氛围，又要避免千篇一律的「AI 味」模板，还得不依赖框架。本案用 guo-taste-design 设计风格库 skill，按「未来玻璃」风格做了一个单 HTML 文件、原生 CSS/JS 的产品发布落地页：深靛蓝宇宙背景上漂浮毛玻璃卡片，紫罗兰到霓虹粉渐变做 CTA 与标题，透出 Apple 发布会气质。页面含固定毛玻璃导航与亮暗切换、带 3D 透视 mockup 的 Hero、3×3 特性网格、可拖拽评价轮播、FAQ 折叠、底部订阅。图标全为硬编码 Lucide 风格 SVG，动画只动 transform/opacity 且用 IntersectionObserver 入场，并遵守零 em-dash、单一主题锁等审美硬规则。产物为单文件 output.html。适用于做产品发布、SaaS 落地页等同款开发。
cases.description_en: A product launch landing page needs keynote-grade atmosphere yet must avoid generic 'AI-slop' templates and framework dependencies. Built with the guo-taste-design style-library skill in a 'future glass' style, this single-file landing page (vanilla CSS/JS) floats frosted-glass cards over a deep-indigo cosmic background, using a violet-to-neon-pink gradient for CTAs and headings to evoke an Apple keynote. It includes a fixed frosted nav with light/dark toggle, a hero with a 3D-perspective mockup, a 3x3 feature grid, a draggable testimonial carousel, FAQ accordions and a footer subscribe. Icons are hardcoded Lucide-style SVG, animations only touch transform/opacity with IntersectionObserver entrances, and it follows hard aesthetic rules like zero em-dashes and a single locked theme. The deliverable is a single output.html. Ideal for product launches and SaaS landing pages.

artifacts.label: 未来玻璃产品落地页

cases.prompt: 做一个产品发布落地页，单 HTML 文件、原生 CSS/JS、无框架依赖，风格走「未来玻璃」：深靛蓝宇宙背景 #0A0B1A 配径向渐变，毛玻璃卡片漂浮（bg-white/5 加 backdrop-blur 加 hairline 边框），紫罗兰到霓虹粉渐变 #7C3AED→#EC4899 做 CTA 与标题、第三色 #06B6D4，文字 #F8FAFC，Apple 发布会气质，字体 Inter 配 JetBrains Mono。骨架：固定毛玻璃导航加亮暗切换；Hero（小标签 + 渐变大标题 + 2 CTA + CSS 3D 透视 mockup）；特性网格 3×3，图标循环紫/粉/青、hover 上浮 stagger 入场；评价轮播（头像/引文/星星、自动播加拖拽）；FAQ 折叠；底部订阅含 loading 与 toast。约束：图标硬编码 Lucide 风格 SVG 不用 CDN/Emoji，动画只动 transform/opacity、入场用 IntersectionObserver，暗色默认亮色可切、prefers-reduced-motion 塌缩为静态；审美硬规则：零 em-dash、单一主题锁、颜色圆角一致、图片用 AI 生图不用假截图。
cases.prompt_en: Build a product launch landing page as a single HTML file with vanilla CSS/JS and no framework, in a 'future glass' style: frosted-glass cards floating over a deep-indigo cosmic background, with a violet-to-neon-pink gradient for CTAs and an Apple-keynote vibe. Background #0A0B1A with a radial gradient #1E1B4B to base, text #F8FAFC; glass uses bg-white/5 plus backdrop-blur plus a white/10 hairline border; gradient accents #7C3AED to #EC4899 (CTAs, headings, focus lines), third color #06B6D4; fonts Inter plus JetBrains Mono (uppercase wide-tracked small labels). Page skeleton: 1) fixed frosted nav with logo, anchor links and a light/dark toggle (SVG moon/sun); 2) hero: twinkling-star tag + gradient headline + 2 CTAs + a CSS 3D-perspective mockup (rotateY sway, float); 3) a 3x3 feature grid, icons cycling purple/pink/cyan, hover lift, staggered entrance; 4) a testimonial carousel with circular avatars, name/company, italic quotes, stars, autoplay + drag + dots; 5) FAQ accordions with rotating arrows and max-height transitions; 6) a footer subscribe with an envelope-icon input, submit loading and toast. Constraints: hardcode Lucide-style SVG icon paths (no CDN/emoji), animate only transform/opacity, entrances via IntersectionObserver; dark by default with switchable light, collapsing to static under prefers-reduced-motion. Hard aesthetic rules: zero em-dashes, single locked theme, consistent colors and radii throughout, AI-generated imagery instead of fake div screenshots.

cases.title: Aether 天气网站
cases.subtitle: 插画手绘氛围感的单文件天气站
cases.subtitle_en: A hand-illustrated, ambient single-file weather site
cases.description: 想做一个有氛围、有动态、又不接真实 API 的天气展示站，难点在于把每种天气都做成独立的可交互场景而不显廉价。本案用 Impeccable 前端设计工具集 skill，做了一个名为 Aether 的单文件静态天气网站：插画手绘感加梦幻氛围，中英双语界面，清透天空感渐变背景从浅蓝过渡到奶油色。响应式城市卡片网格展示温度、天气、湿度风速，hover 上浮、点击有水波纹反馈。核心是七种天气各自的专属动态场景：晴朗光芒、多云飘云、雨雪、雷阵雨闪电、薄雾、晴夜星空，云朵分区错相漂移避免堆叠。内置约 25-30 城市库，支持实时搜索联想、添加/移除与 toast 提示，render 函数数据驱动重绘。产物为单文件 output.html。适用于做天气、仪表盘等氛围型展示站同款开发。
cases.description_en: Building an ambient, animated weather site without a real API is tricky: each weather type must become its own interactive scene without looking cheap. Built with the Impeccable front-end toolkit skill, Aether is a single-file static weather site with a hand-illustrated dreamy feel, a bilingual UI and an airy sky gradient from light blue to cream. A responsive city-card grid shows temperature, condition, humidity and wind, cards lift on hover and ripple on click. The core is seven bespoke animated scenes per weather type: clear-sky rays, drifting clouds, rain and snow, storm lightning, fog and starry night, with clouds spread across zones and phase-offset to avoid clustering. A built-in library of ~25-30 cities supports live search suggestions, add/remove and toasts, with a data-driven render function. The deliverable is a single output.html. Ideal for weather sites, dashboards and other ambient display sites.

artifacts.label: Aether 天气网站

cases.prompt: 请用纯前端 HTML/CSS/JS 做一个单文件静态天气网站，风格插画手绘感加梦幻氛围、动态丰富，不接真实 API。结构：顶部居中标题（主标题 Aether、副标题 Skies & Weather），主体是响应式城市卡片网格（auto-fill，每卡最小 280px），默认 6 张城市卡，底部小字页脚。字体（Google Fonts）：标题 Fraunces 衬线斜体、正文 Quicksand、温度 Baloo 2、中文 ZCOOL KuaiLe；背景用清透天空感渐变，从顶部浅蓝 #eaf4ff 过渡到底部奶油 #fdf3ec，正文色 #34435e。卡片显示城市名、温度、天气状况、最高最低温、湿度风速，hover 上浮加删除按钮、点击水波纹、入场淡入上移。核心：用 CSS+JS 给七种天气各做一套独立动态场景与天空底色——晴朗、多云、小雨、飘雪、雷阵雨（闪电）、薄雾、晴夜（月亮加星空），云朵分区错相漂移避免堆叠。功能：内置约 25-30 城市库，搜索框实时下拉联想（已展示的不再出现，最多 6 条），点击或回车加入、✕ 移除、操作后 toast，render() 数据驱动重绘，移动端单列自适应。
cases.prompt_en: Build a single-file static weather website with pure front-end HTML/CSS/JS, in a hand-illustrated dreamy style, polished and richly animated, with no real weather API. Structure: a centered top title area (main title Aether, subtitle Skies & Weather in uppercase wide tracking), a responsive city-card grid as the body (auto-fill, min 280px per card) defaulting to Beijing/Shanghai/Tokyo/New York/London/Paris, and a small footer line. Fonts (via Google Fonts): Fraunces italic serif for titles, Quicksand for body, Baloo 2 for temperatures, ZCOOL KuaiLe for Chinese. Background uses an airy sky gradient: a warm-orange glow top-right plus a light-blue glow top-left, overall from light blue #eaf4ff at top to cream #fdf3ec at bottom, background-attachment:fixed, body color #34435e. Each card shows the city's name, current temperature (with C), condition, high/low, humidity and wind, with a darkening sheen at the bottom for white-text legibility; cards lift and scale on hover with a circular delete button, ripple white on click, and fade-in-up on entrance. Core: use CSS animation plus JS to give each of seven weather types its own scene and sky color, clear (radiating rays plus pulsing sun), cloudy, rain, snow, storm (lightning), fog and clear-night (moon plus stars); spread clouds across zones inside the card with negative delays to avoid clustering. Features: a built-in library of ~25-30 cities (mixed Chinese and foreign), a search box with live suggestions (excluding those already shown, max 6), click or Enter to add a card, an X to remove, with bottom toasts; a render() function redraws data-driven from the current city array. Mobile single-column responsive.

cases.title: 项目管理工具 · 仿 Linear
cases.subtitle: 工程感冷峻克制的单页项目管理 Web 应用
cases.subtitle_en: An engineering-minded single-page project management app
cases.description: 团队想要一个像 Linear 那样简洁、冷峻、有工程感的项目管理工具原型，又不想拉一堆框架与后端依赖。本案用前端开发工程师，做了一个参考 Linear.app 风格的单页 Web 应用，纯 HTML 单文件加 Tailwind CDN 辅助，CSS 变量驱动深浅色换肤。左侧 240px 固定侧边栏加自适应内容区，四页功能：仪表盘（统计卡片、进度条、动态时间线）、任务看板（四列 Kanban，HTML5 拖拽流转状态并联动日志与 Toast）、团队管理、项目设置。支持深浅主题切换、⌘1-4/⌘N/Esc 键盘快捷键、新建任务弹窗，所有操作有 Toast 反馈。配色走纯白底加 Zinc 灰阶加 Indigo 单点强调，数据全部内联。产物为单文件 output.html。适用于做后台、看板、SaaS 工具等同款开发。
cases.description_en: A team wants a Linear-style project management prototype, clean, cold and engineering-minded, without pulling in heavy frameworks or a backend. Built with a Frontend Developer agent, this single-page web app references Linear.app, implemented as a single HTML file with Tailwind CDN assistance and CSS variables driving light/dark theming. A 240px fixed left sidebar pairs with a fluid content area across four pages: dashboard (stat cards, progress bar, activity timeline), task board (four-column Kanban with HTML5 drag-and-drop status flow plus activity log and toast), team management and project settings. It supports light/dark toggle, cmd+1-4 / cmd+N / Esc shortcuts and a new-task modal, with toasts on every action. Colors use a pure-white base, Zinc grays and a single Indigo accent, with all data inlined. The deliverable is a single output.html. Ideal for building admin panels, boards and SaaS tools in the same vein.

artifacts.label: 项目管理工具(仿Linear)

cases.prompt: 设计一个项目管理工具的单页 Web 应用，风格参考 Linear.app，简洁、工程感、冷峻克制。架构：左侧 240px 固定侧边栏（logo 与名称「项目中心」、导航菜单仪表盘/任务看板/团队/项目设置、主题切换 toggle、底部用户头像）加右侧自适应内容区，纯 HTML 单文件，CSS 变量驱动深浅色换肤。四页：仪表盘（4 张统计卡片加进度条加最近动态时间线）；任务看板（4 列 Kanban 待办→进行中→审阅中→已完成，卡片支持 HTML5 拖拽流转状态，显示标题/优先级/负责人/截止日期）；团队管理（成员卡片网格）；项目设置（信息表单、通知开关组、危险区删除）。交互：拖入目标列即时更新状态并联动活动日志与 Toast，主题切换带日月图标，键盘快捷键 ⌘1-4 切页/⌘N 新建/Esc 关弹窗，新建任务弹窗，所有操作有 Toast。规范：配色纯白底加 Zinc 灰阶加 Indigo #4F46E5 单点强调，字体 Inter 加 JetBrains Mono 等宽数字，圆角 6-10px、hover 阴影上浮 spring 过渡、进度条 0.6s 动画，响应式 1024px 统计双列、768px 看板竖排。约束：零框架依赖，Tailwind CDN 辅助，数据全部内联不依赖后端。
cases.prompt_en: Design a single-page project management web app in the style of Linear.app: clean, engineering-minded and coolly restrained. Architecture: a 240px fixed left sidebar plus a fluid right content area; the sidebar holds the project logo and name 'Project Center', a nav menu (Dashboard / Task Board / Team / Project Settings), a compact theme toggle and a bottom user avatar; single HTML file with CSS variables driving global light/dark theming. Four pages: Dashboard (4 stat cards, total/in-progress/done/members, plus a project progress bar and a recent-activity timeline); Task Board (4-column Kanban: Todo to In Progress to Review to Done, cards support HTML5 drag-and-drop status flow showing title, priority tag, assignee avatar and due date); Team (member card grid with gradient avatars, name, role, email, task stats); Project Settings (info form, notification-preference toggles, a danger-zone delete button). Interactions: dropping a card into a column instantly updates status and updates the activity log and a toast; a theme toggle with sun/moon icons; keyboard shortcuts cmd+1-4 to switch pages, cmd+N for new task, Esc to close modals; a new-task modal with title/description/priority (one of three)/assignee dropdown/target column; toasts on all actions. Design spec: pure-white base #FFF / light grey #FAFAFA plus Zinc grays plus a single Indigo #4F46E5 accent; Inter body plus JetBrains Mono for numerals; 6-10px radii, hover shadow lift and spring transitions; monospaced stat numbers and a 0.6s progress-bar animation; responsive 1024px two-column stats and 768px stacked board. Constraints: zero framework dependency, pure HTML+CSS+vanilla JS with Tailwind CSS CDN assistance, all data inlined (11 tasks, 3 members, 5 activities) and no backend.

cases.title: 当代现代室内设计研究
cases.subtitle: 空间、美学与生活方式演变的设计研究型 PPT
cases.subtitle_en: A design-research deck on space, aesthetics and lifestyle evolution
cases.description:
想做一份有深度、有审美的室内设计研究 PPT，最头疼的是既要梳理风格脉络、又要让画面有杂志级质感，稍不注意就变成堆资料的流水账。

这个案例演示了如何用一句话 Prompt 生成一份 10–12 页的当代现代室内设计研究 PPT：从现代主义、国际主义、Mid-century Modern 一路讲到当代极简与高端住宅，结合 John Pawson、Norm Architects、Vincent Van Duysen、Studio KO、Neri&Hu 等事务所案例，用空间案例图、材质板、风格演进图、平面/剖面分析讲清空间比例、材质、光线与动线，并延伸到 Quiet Luxury、Warm Minimalism、Japandi 等新趋势。产物为 Ardot 设计稿，可直接打开改。

适合：室内设计师、软装/家居品牌运营、设计研究从业者、需要做行业趋势汇报的设计团队。
cases.description_en:
Building a research deck on interior design that has both depth and magazine-grade aesthetics is hard — you either end up with a flat timeline of references or you lose the visual polish.

This case shows how a single-sentence prompt generates a 10–12 page deck on contemporary modern interior design: tracing the lineage from Modernism, International Style and Mid-century Modern to contemporary minimalism and high-end residential design, weaving in case studies by John Pawson, Norm Architects, Vincent Van Duysen, Studio KO and Neri&Hu, and using case imagery, material boards, style-evolution diagrams and plan/section analysis to explain how proportion, material, light and circulation shape modern living — extending into Quiet Luxury, Warm Minimalism and Japandi. The artifact is an Ardot design you can open and edit.

Great for interior designers, home/lifestyle brand operators, design researchers, and design teams running industry-trend reports.
cases.prompt: 请围绕「当代现代室内设计：空间、美学与生活方式的演变」制作一份专业的设计研究型 PPT，主动搜索并整理最新公开资料、经典案例与代表性设计事务所，重点分析当代现代室内设计的核心特征，包括极简主义、自然材料、开放空间、柔和中性色、模块化家具、智能家居、可持续设计、生物亲和设计以及艺术与功能的融合；梳理从现代主义、国际主义、Mid-century Modern 到当代极简与高端住宅设计的发展脉络，并结合 John Pawson、Norm Architects、Vincent Van Duysen、Studio KO、Neri&Hu 等代表性设计师或事务所案例，分析空间比例、材质、光线、家具、色彩和动线如何共同塑造现代生活体验。同时关注当代住宅、酒店、零售与办公空间中的新趋势，如"Quiet Luxury""Warm Minimalism""Japandi""Soft Modernism"等，讨论这些趋势背后的消费审美与生活方式变化。整体控制在 10–12 页，以空间案例图、材质板、风格演进图、平面/剖面分析和设计原则总结为主，减少大段文字，最终形成一份「视觉高级、案例丰富、设计逻辑清晰」的当代现代室内设计研究 PPT。使用ai生成风格类似配图
cases.prompt_en: Create a professional design-research deck on "Contemporary Modern Interior Design: the evolution of space, aesthetics and lifestyle". Actively search and curate the latest public material, classic cases and representative studios; analyze the core characteristics of contemporary modern interior design (minimalism, natural materials, open space, soft neutrals, modular furniture, smart home, sustainable design, biophilic design, and the fusion of art and function); trace the lineage from Modernism, the International Style and Mid-century Modern to contemporary minimalism and high-end residential design; and weave in case studies by John Pawson, Norm Architects, Vincent Van Duysen, Studio KO and Neri&Hu to analyze how proportion, material, light, furniture, color and circulation together shape modern living. Also cover new trends in contemporary residential, hotel, retail and office spaces — "Quiet Luxury", "Warm Minimalism", "Japandi", "Soft Modernism" — and the consumer aesthetics and lifestyle shifts behind them. Keep it to 10–12 pages, leaning on spatial case images, material boards, style-evolution diagrams, plan/section analysis and design-principle summaries, with less long-form copy, and produce a "visually premium, case-rich, design-logic-clear" research deck. Use AI to generate style-matched cover and supporting images.

cases.title: Nova 智能扫地机器人发布会
cases.subtitle: 高端科技品牌气质的旗舰产品发布 PPT
cases.subtitle_en: A flagship launch deck with premium tech-brand polish
cases.description:
给硬件新品做发布会 PPT，最难的是把「参数」讲出「One More Thing」的叙事张力——画面一平庸就变成了说明书。

这个案例演示了如何为「Nova 智能扫地机器人」生成一份高端科技品牌气质的产品发布 PPT：从「家庭清洁为什么要被重新定义」切入，逐页拆解产品理念、外观、核心硬件、AI 感知系统、清洁路径算法与真实家庭场景，用大图产品视觉、功能拆解、导航路径图、传感器结构图、清洁前后对比做叙事，视觉对标 Apple、Dyson、Nothing、Roborock 的极简未来感与精密工业设计，节奏感与「One More Thing」式产品叙事对齐。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。

适合：硬件产品经理、品牌发布会策划、消费电子市场团队、需要做新品发布方案的创业者。
cases.description_en:
Turning specs into "One More Thing" narrative tension is the hardest part of a hardware launch deck — flatten the visuals and it reads like a manual.

This case shows how to generate a premium tech-brand launch deck for the "Nova" robot vacuum: opening from "why home cleaning needs to be redefined", then walking through product concept, industrial design, core hardware, AI perception, cleaning-path algorithms and real home scenes — told through hero product visuals, feature teardowns, navigation-path diagrams, sensor structure diagrams and before/after comparisons, styled after Apple, Dyson, Nothing and Roborock's minimal, futuristic, precise industrial design, with the rhythm of a "One More Thing" product narrative. The artifact is an Ardot design.

Great for hardware PMs, launch-event planners, consumer-electronics marketing teams, and founders preparing a new-product launch.
cases.prompt: 请围绕「Nova 智能扫地机器人新品发布会」制作一份具有高端科技品牌气质的产品发布型 PPT，将 Nova 塑造成一款面向现代家庭的旗舰级自动扫地机器人，重点突出 自主导航、AI 环境识别、智能避障、自动建图、强力吸尘、拖地清洁、边角覆盖、自动回充、自清洁基站、宠物家庭适配与 App 智能控制 等核心能力；内容从"为什么家庭清洁需要重新被定义"切入，逐步展示 Nova 的产品理念、外观设计、核心硬件、AI 感知系统、清洁路径算法、真实家庭场景、与传统扫地机器人的体验差异，以及它如何从"清洁工具"升级为"自主运行的家庭清洁智能体"。整体控制在 10–12 页，以大图产品视觉、功能拆解、导航路径图、传感器结构图、清洁前后对比、场景化演示和参数亮点为主，减少大段文字，视觉参考 Apple、Dyson、Nothing、Roborock 等高端科技品牌发布会风格，强调极简、未来感、精密感与高级工业设计，最终形成一份具有「One More Thing」式节奏感和产品叙事张力的智能扫地机器人发布会 PPT。需要使用AI生成配图
cases.prompt_en: Create a premium tech-brand product-launch deck for the "Nova" smart robot vacuum launch. Cast Nova as a flagship home-floor-cleaning robot for modern families, highlighting autonomous navigation, AI environment recognition, intelligent obstacle avoidance, automatic mapping, strong suction, mopping, edge coverage, auto-recharge, the self-cleaning dock, pet-home adaptation and App smart control. Open from "why home cleaning needs to be redefined", then walk through Nova's product philosophy, industrial design, core hardware, AI perception system, cleaning-path algorithm, real home scenes, the experience gap vs traditional robot vacuums, and how it upgrades from a "cleaning tool" to an "autonomously running home-cleaning intelligent agent". Keep it to 10–12 pages, leaning on hero product visuals, feature teardowns, navigation-path diagrams, sensor structure diagrams, before/after cleaning comparisons, scenario demos and spec highlights, with less long-form copy. Visual reference: Apple, Dyson, Nothing and Roborock launch decks — minimal, futuristic, precise, premium industrial design — and end with a "One More Thing" rhythm and product-narrative tension. Use AI to generate cover and supporting images.

cases.title: 西班牙旅行研究
cases.subtitle: 建筑、艺术、美食与地中海生活方式的目的地研究 PPT
cases.subtitle_en: A destination deck on architecture, art, cuisine and Mediterranean lifestyle
cases.description:
做一份旅行攻略 PPT，最怕变成「景点罗列清单」，既没杂志感也没信息密度，读起来像旅行社宣传单。

这个案例演示了如何生成一份旅行杂志感的西班牙目的地研究 PPT：覆盖马德里、巴塞罗那、塞维利亚、格拉纳达、瓦伦西亚、马略卡岛，从建筑、艺术、美食、历史与城市生活切入，串联圣家堂、阿尔罕布拉宫、普拉多博物馆、高迪建筑等地标与 Tapas、海鲜饭、火腿、葡萄酒等饮食文化，设计一条 7–10 天路线，用路线地图、城市摄影、建筑案例、美食视觉、行程时间轴呈现，视觉对标 Monocle、Kinfolk、Condé Nast Traveler。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。

适合：旅行内容创作者、旅行社与定制游策划、生活方式自媒体、需要提前做旅行功课的自由行爱好者。
cases.description_en:
Travel decks too often become a bullet list of attractions — no magazine feel, no information density, reading like a tour-agency flyer.

This case shows how to generate a travel-magazine-grade Spain destination deck: covering Madrid, Barcelona, Seville, Granada, Valencia and Mallorca from architecture, art, cuisine, history and city life, linking landmarks like the Sagrada Família, the Alhambra, the Prado and Gaudí's works with tapas, paella, jamón and wine culture, and laying out a 7–10 day route through route maps, city photography, architecture case studies, food visuals and an itinerary timeline — styled after Monocle, Kinfolk and Condé Nast Traveler. The artifact is an Ardot design.

Great for travel content creators, tour and bespoke-trip planners, lifestyle media, and free-and-easy travelers doing advance trip research.
cases.prompt: 请围绕「西班牙旅行：建筑、艺术、美食与地中海生活方式」制作一份具有旅行杂志感的目的地研究型 PPT，主动搜索并整理最新旅行资料、城市信息与经典目的地，重点介绍 马德里、巴塞罗那、塞维利亚、格拉纳达、瓦伦西亚、马略卡岛等代表性地区，从建筑、艺术、美食、历史文化、城市生活与自然景观等角度展示西班牙旅行的独特魅力；结合圣家堂、阿尔罕布拉宫、普拉多博物馆、塞维利亚王宫、高迪建筑等代表性地标，以及 Tapas、海鲜饭、火腿、葡萄酒等饮食文化，设计一条适合 7–10 天旅行的路线，并分析不同城市的特色、最佳体验、交通方式与旅行节奏。整体控制在 10–12 页，以旅行路线地图、城市摄影、建筑案例、美食视觉、行程时间轴和目的地对比为主，减少大段文字，整体视觉参考 Monocle、Kinfolk、Condé Nast Traveler 等高端旅行杂志，最终形成一份兼具「旅行攻略、文化体验与视觉叙事」的西班牙旅行 PPT。需要使用AI生成配图
cases.prompt_en: Create a travel-magazine-grade destination-research deck on "Spain Travel: Architecture, Art, Cuisine and Mediterranean Lifestyle". Actively search and curate the latest travel material, city information and classic destinations, focusing on Madrid, Barcelona, Seville, Granada, Valencia and Mallorca — showing Spain's unique appeal through architecture, art, cuisine, history and culture, city life and natural scenery. Weave in landmarks like the Sagrada Família, the Alhambra, the Prado, the Royal Alcázar of Seville and Gaudí's works, plus Tapas, paella, jamón and wine culture, and design a 7–10 day itinerary that compares each city's character, best experiences, transport and pace. Keep it to 10–12 pages, leaning on route maps, city photography, architecture case studies, food visuals, itinerary timelines and destination comparisons, with less long-form copy. Visual reference: Monocle, Kinfolk and Condé Nast Traveler — and produce a deck that combines "travel guide, cultural experience and visual narrative". Use AI to generate cover and supporting images.

cases.title: 银发经济市场分析
cases.subtitle: 数据驱动的咨询风格市场研究 PPT
cases.subtitle_en: A data-driven, consulting-style market research deck
cases.description:
做行业市场分析 PPT，最怕数据陈旧、来源不可信、逻辑散成一盘——汇报时被追问「数字哪来的」就露怯。

这个案例演示了如何生成一份咨询风格的银发经济市场研究 PPT：主动检索并引用国家统计局、国务院、WHO、World Bank、QuestMobile、艾瑞、麦肯锡、BCG、德勤等可信数据来源，覆盖人口老龄化趋势、市场规模与增速、消费者画像、细分赛道（医疗健康、养老服务、智能科技、旅游、营养保健、金融保险、文化娱乐）、竞争格局与未来 5–10 年趋势，每页围绕一个核心结论展开，用市场规模图、趋势图、消费者画像、产业地图、机会矩阵可视化呈现，注明数据来源与年份。产物为 Ardot 设计稿。

适合：咨询与研究分析师、投资机构、大健康与养老产业从业者、需要写行业报告的战略与市场团队。
cases.description_en:
Market-research decks fall apart when the data is stale, the sources are shaky, or the logic doesn't hold — the "where did that number come from" question exposes it instantly.

This case shows how to generate a consulting-style silver-economy market research deck: actively retrieving and citing credible sources (National Bureau of Statistics, State Council, WHO, World Bank, QuestMobile, iResearch, McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte), covering population-ageing trends, market size and growth, consumer personas, sub-segments (healthcare, elderly services, smart tech, travel, nutrition, insurance, culture & entertainment), competitive landscape and the next 5–10 years, with a clear conclusion per page, visualized through market-size charts, trend lines, consumer profiles, industry maps and opportunity matrices — and sources/dates cited. The artifact is an Ardot design.

Great for consultants and research analysts, investment firms, healthcare/elderly-care professionals, and strategy/marketing teams writing industry reports.
cases.prompt: 请围绕「银发经济市场分析」制作一份专业的市场研究型PPT，主动搜索并整理最新公开资料与权威数据，重点分析中国人口老龄化趋势、银发经济市场规模与增长速度、银发消费者画像与消费特征、主要消费场景、产业链与细分赛道（如医疗健康、养老服务、智能科技、旅游、营养保健、金融保险、文化娱乐等）、代表性企业与市场竞争格局、当前用户痛点、未来5–10年发展趋势以及潜在商业机会。优先引用国家统计局、国务院、WHO、World Bank、QuestMobile、艾瑞、麦肯锡、BCG、德勤等可信来源，并在PPT中注明数据来源和年份。整体控制在10–12页，每页围绕一个核心结论展开，尽量使用市场规模图、趋势图、消费者画像、产业地图、机会矩阵等可视化方式，减少大段文字，最终形成一份逻辑清晰、数据驱动、具有咨询公司市场分析报告风格的PPT。保证ai 生图，和数据图表的可视化
cases.prompt_en: Create a professional market-research deck on "Silver Economy Market Analysis". Actively search and curate the latest public material and authoritative data, focusing on China's population-ageing trends, the silver economy's market size and growth, silver consumer personas and spending behavior, main consumption scenarios, the value chain and sub-segments (healthcare, elderly services, smart tech, travel, nutrition, insurance, culture & entertainment), representative players and competitive landscape, current user pain points, and the next 5–10 years of trends and commercial opportunities. Prioritize credible sources (National Bureau of Statistics, State Council, WHO, World Bank, QuestMobile, iResearch, McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte), and cite the data source and year inside the deck. Keep it to 10–12 pages, each centered on one core conclusion, visualized through market-size charts, trend lines, consumer personas, industry maps and opportunity matrices, with less long-form copy — producing a logically clear, data-driven, consulting-firm-style market report deck. Ensure AI-generated images and data-chart visualizations.

cases.title: 筑居生活 · 家居展览海报
cases.subtitle: 东京手帖式手绘日常，一眼温柔的家与生活气息
cases.subtitle_en: Tokyo-style hand-drawn everyday warmth — a lifestyle exhibition poster that feels lived-in
cases.description:
生活方式类展览海报最怕"设计感太重"——摆拍感、秀场感、高冷留白，反而离生活越来越远。

这个案例用「东京手帖」手绘风做主视觉：轻松日常的家居人物、柔和墨线与低饱和色块，像从生活手帐里撕下来的一页。文案走中文+日期+地点+时间的杂志式排版，"筑居有道 · 处处用心"作为辅助点睛，主标题"生活家居"压稳画面，骨架与一般商业海报完全不同。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版设计稿。

适合做家居/生活/文创类展览主视觉、品牌生活方式日签、文旅市集物料的设计师与运营，照着 prompt 改主题即可复刻同款。
cases.description_en:
Lifestyle exhibition posters often fail by over-designing — staged photography, runway vibes, cold negative space that pushes the warmth out of daily life.

This case flips it with a Tokyo-style hand-drawn approach: relaxed everyday home characters, soft ink lines and low-saturation color blocks, like a torn-out page from a life journal. The copy follows a magazine layout (Chinese title + date + venue + time), with a supporting line "build a home, mind every detail" and a steady main title "Home Living" anchoring the composition. Delivered as an Ardot 1080×1620 portrait design.

Great for designers and marketers making home/lifestyle/cultural-creative exhibition hero visuals, brand lifestyle cards, and tourism market collateral — swap the theme to recreate the same feel.
cases.prompt:
生成一张东京手帖风格海报。

活动主题：[以轻松日常的手绘人物表现家居生活与生活方式展览]

文案信息：
辅助文案：[筑居有道 · 处处用心]
主标题：[生活家居]
日期：[08.09 SAT]
地点：[江南家居会展]
时间：[10:00–19:00]
cases.prompt_en:
Generate a Tokyo hand-journal (东京手帖) style poster.

Event theme: [a relaxed everyday hand-drawn character composition expressing home living and lifestyle exhibition].

Copy:

cases.title: 组织变革课海报 · 数字蝶变
cases.subtitle: 深蓝紫渐变底 + AI FUTURE 品牌标，组织变革主题的高端商务感
cases.subtitle_en: Deep blue-purple gradient + AI FUTURE brand mark, high-end business feel for organizational-change themes
cases.description:
组织变革 / 数字化转型这类主题的海报最怕做成「喊口号 PPT」——大段红字加粗 + CEO 头像 + 箭头循环图，让一线管理者直接划走。

这个案例用深蓝紫渐变 + 极简几何光带做底，营造高端商学院的氛围。主标题「数字蝶变」系统字大号居中压轴，「组织变革课」紧贴作副标，左上「AI FUTURE」作为品牌标识小标点缀，底部双讲师半身照左右对称排列「周斌｜算法负责人」「王兮｜产品后台总监」，活动信息三行结构压底。整张图气质沉稳克制、不喊口号，2:3 竖版适合企业内训、行业峰会、EMBA 校友群分发。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版设计稿。

适合做组织变革、数字化转型、领导力培训、企业内训海报的设计师与运营。
cases.description_en:
Posters on organizational change or digital transformation most often fall into "slogan PPT" — large red bold text + CEO headshot + arrow-loop diagrams — that make frontline managers scroll right past.

This case uses deep blue-purple gradients + minimal geometric light bands for the base, creating the atmosphere of a high-end business school. The main title "Digital Metamorphosis" is centered large in the system font, with "Organizational Change Course" tucked as a subtitle, "AI FUTURE" as a small brand mark at the top-left, and the bottom featuring two speakers' half-body photos arranged symmetrically — "Zhou Bin | Algorithm Lead" and "Wang Xi | Product Backend Director" — with event info in three lines at the very bottom. The overall feel is composed and restrained, never slogan-y, with the 2:3 portrait format suited for corporate training, industry summits, and EMBA alumni groups. Delivered as an Ardot 1080×1620 portrait design.

Great for designers and marketers making organizational change, digital transformation, leadership training, or corporate training posters.

cases.title: Web3 课程海报 · 虚实共生
cases.title_en: Web3 Course Poster · Real & Virtual Coexistence
cases.subtitle: 霓虹紫蓝渐变 + 网格透视，Web3 / 空间计算主题的未来感
cases.subtitle_en: Neon purple-blue gradient + grid perspective, futuristic feel for Web3 / spatial computing themes
cases.description:
Web3 / 空间计算这类前沿主题海报最难的是「既显得前沿又不说人话」——全用 crypto 术语会把受众锁死在极客圈，全用通俗表达又显不出技术含金量。

这个案例用霓虹紫蓝渐变 + 网格透视 + 微光晕做底，营造 Web3 沉浸感。主标题「虚实共生，Web3 前沿」系统字大号压左上，副标「从数字孪生到空间计算，开启沉浸式体验新纪元」紧贴，左上「AI FUTURE」品牌标点缀，底部双讲师半身照分列左右「周斌｜产品战略总监」「王磊｜AI 算法专家」，活动时间地点三行结构收尾。整张图未来感强但不堆砌术语，受众面拉到技术与商业中间层。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版设计稿。

适合做 Web3、区块链、数字孪生、空间计算、元宇宙主题课程 / 大会海报的设计师与运营。
cases.description_en:
Posters on cutting-edge themes like Web3 and spatial computing struggle with "looking forward-looking without being incomprehensible" — pure crypto jargon locks the audience into the geek circle, while plain language fails to convey the technical weight.

This case uses neon purple-blue gradients + grid perspective + subtle glow for the base, building a Web3 immersion feel. The main title "Real & Virtual Coexistence, Web3 Frontier" is set large in the system font at the top-left, with the subtitle "From digital twins to spatial computing, opening a new era of immersive experience" tucked under it, "AI FUTURE" as a small brand mark at the top-left, and the bottom featuring two speakers' half-body photos side-by-side — "Zhou Bin | Product Strategy Director" and "Wang Lei | AI Algorithm Expert" — with three lines of event time/venue info closing the layout. The overall feel is futuristic without jargon-overload, expanding the audience into the tech-business middle layer. Delivered as an Ardot 1080×1620 portrait design.

Great for designers and marketers making Web3, blockchain, digital twin, spatial computing, or metaverse course / conference posters.

cases.title: AI 教育课海报 · 赛道经验
cases.subtitle: AI 渐变冷色 + 多 Agent 视觉元素，教育赛道的专业未来感
cases.subtitle_en: AI gradient cool palette + multi-Agent visual elements, professional futurism for the education track
cases.description:
AI 教育类海报最大的尴尬是「既要让老师觉得专业，又要让家长觉得不是噱头」——堆满 circuit / 神经网络图会让家长警惕，全用卡通又会被同行质疑深度。

这个案例走克制路线：冷蓝紫渐变 + 几何线条 + 抽象多 agent 节点图标做底，主标题「AI 教育，赛道经验分享」系统字大号压左上，副标「多 agent 智能体在 AI 教育领域的现状与未来趋势」紧贴，讲师半身照居中偏右 + 几何装饰做视觉锚点，底部三行信息条压讲师 / 时间 / 地点 + 「立即预约」行动文案。整张图专业感强但不说教，家长与同行都能读懂。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版设计稿。

适合做 AI 教育、AI 培训、智能学习产品发布会、行业闭门会海报的设计师与运营。
cases.description_en:
AI education posters often face the embarrassment of "appearing professional to teachers without looking gimmicky to parents" — circuits and neural-network diagrams make parents wary, while pure cartoons make peers doubt the depth.

This case takes a restrained route: cool blue-purple gradients + geometric lines + abstract multi-agent node icons for the base, main title "AI Education, Track Experience Sharing" set large in the system font at the top-left, subtitle "The present and future of multi-agent systems in AI education" tucked under it. The speaker's half-body photo sits slightly right of center anchored by geometric decoration, while three info bars at the bottom hold speaker / time / venue + "Reserve Now" call-to-action copy. The overall feel is professional without lecturing, readable by both parents and peers. Delivered as an Ardot 1080×1620 portrait design.

Great for designers and marketers making AI education, AI training, intelligent learning product launch, or industry closed-door event posters.

这个案例用暖橙 + 米白双色块做底，主标题「体验至上，产品驱动」系统字大号压左上，副标「以用户为中心的创新方法，重塑商业竞争力」紧贴，讲师半身照居中偏右 + 几何大色块做视觉锚点，底部三行信息条压讲师「赵铭远｜产品策略专家」/ 时间 / 地点。整张图气质介于商业与互联网之间，既有方法论的硬朗又不丢亲和力。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版设计稿。
