cases.title: 儿童竹纤维 A+ 内容图集
cases.title_en: Kids' Bamboo Fiber A+ Content Set
cases.subtitle: 亚马逊 A+ 模块化排版 + 童趣插画，母婴品类转化利器
cases.subtitle_en: Amazon A+ modular layout + playful illustration, a conversion booster for the kids category
cases.description:
做亚马逊母婴服装 A+ 内容，最容易踩的坑是「详情页当海报做」——单图好看，但买家滚动看下来抓不到卖点，转化反而更差。

这个案例把 A+ 当产品说明书来做：竖版模块化排版，左侧统一放置主图文与尺寸表，右侧用同一套童趣插画语言（柔和马卡龙色、圆润小动物、棉花/竹叶纹理）串起「天然竹纤维·透气不闷汗 / 安全 A 类母婴标准 / 7 套尺码对照表」三块卖点，每张图单独成立、连续阅读也成立，品牌调性一致但信息密度比海报高一个量级。产物为 Ardot 亚马逊 A+ 内容图集（竖版）。

适合做母婴服装、家居日用、轻小百货等亚马逊 A+ 详情页的运营与设计师，照模板换主图与卖点即可复用。
cases.description_en:
The most common pitfall when designing Amazon A+ content for kidswear is "treating detail pages like posters" — each image looks great on its own, but as shoppers scroll, they cannot grab the selling points and conversion actually drops.

This case treats A+ as a product spec sheet: portrait modular layout with hero artwork and size tables unified on the left; on the right, a consistent playful illustration language (soft macaron palette, rounded cute animals, cotton/bamboo-leaf textures) ties together three selling blocks — "Natural bamboo fiber, breathable & sweat-free" / "Safe Class A baby standard" / "7-size comparison table". Each image stands alone and also works in sequence, keeping brand tone unified while lifting information density far above a poster. Delivered as an Ardot A+ content set (portrait).

Great for e-commerce operators and designers building Amazon A+ detail pages for kidswear, home goods, or small daily-use categories. Swap hero images and selling points to reuse the template.
cases.prompt:
为该儿童竹纤维服装品牌创建一套亚马逊 A+ 内容图片集，需突出天然竹纤维面料、A 类母婴安全标准、7 套尺码对照表三大卖点。

主视觉：统一童趣插画语言，柔和马卡龙色（薄荷绿/奶油黄/浅粉），圆润可爱的小动物（兔子、小熊、小鹿）与竹叶、棉花、云朵纹理，传递天然柔软与安全。

版式：竖版模块化排版，左侧统一放置主图文与尺码表，右侧用同一套插画语言串起「天然竹纤维·透气不闷汗 / 安全 A 类母婴标准 / 7 套尺码对照表」三块内容，每张图独立成立、连续阅读也成立。

要求：品牌调性一致；信息密度高于普通海报；模块可复用；支持竖版手机端浏览。
cases.prompt_en:
Design an Amazon A+ content set for a kids' bamboo-fiber clothing brand. Highlight three selling points: natural bamboo-fiber fabric, Class A baby-safety standard, and a 7-size comparison table.

Hero language: unified playful illustration — soft macaron palette (mint green / cream yellow / light pink), rounded cute animals (rabbit, bear, fawn) plus bamboo-leaf, cotton and cloud textures, communicating softness and safety.

Layout: portrait modular structure with hero artwork and size table unified on the left; on the right, the same illustration language ties together three blocks — "Natural bamboo fiber, breathable & sweat-free" / "Safe Class A baby standard" / "7-size comparison table". Each image stands alone and also works in sequence.

Constraints: consistent brand tone; information density above a normal poster; reusable modules; portrait orientation for mobile.

cases.title: 马年迷幻交通灯海报
cases.subtitle: C4D 写实渲染 + LED 灯阵马字 + 高饱和街头视觉
cases.subtitle_en: C4D photoreal render + LED-array "horse" character + high-saturation street visuals
cases.description:
马年海报最容易俗气的地方，是「红金福字一通堆」——生肖元素堆满画面，反而丢了当代感。

这个案例把生肖「马」字藏进 LED 灯阵：用三盏竖向交通灯堆叠，红黄绿三面各显示 LED 点阵组成的「马」字，银灰色金属壳、低角度特写、玫瑰粉背景，整体走 C4D Octane 物理全局光照的写实渲染。超大英文「GENERAL RULES」横压交通灯做底，竖排中文「通行准则」与黄底「2026」点缀，中英粗体无衬线 + 哑光印刷颗粒，质感与街头冲击力同在。产物为 Ardot 1080×1620 竖版海报。

适合做马年/生肖主题、潮酷街头品牌 Campaign、年轻人向营销海报的设计师与运营。
cases.description_en:
The easiest way for a Year-of-the-Horse poster to fall flat is stacking red-and-gold auspicious elements everywhere — the zodiac motif fills the canvas and the contemporary feel disappears.

This case hides the "horse" character inside an LED matrix: three vertical traffic lights stacked, red/yellow/green each showing an LED-dot-matrix "马". Brushed silver-grey metal housing, low-angle close-up, rose-pink background, all in C4D Octane physically-based global lighting. Oversized "GENERAL RULES" in white behind the lights, vertical Chinese "通行准则" and a yellow "2026" block, bold sans-serif in Chinese and English over matte print grain — texture and street impact coexist. Delivered as an Ardot 1080×1620 portrait poster.

Great for designers and marketers working on Year-of-the-Horse / zodiac campaigns, edgy street brands, and youth-targeted posters.
cases.prompt:
竖版海报，迷幻街头酷炫设计，超写实 3D 渲染风格，C4D Octane 渲染，物理全局光照，8K 超高清。

核心视觉：三盏竖向交通信号灯堆叠于画面中心，低角度特写镜头。银灰色金属哑光外壳，质感细腻逼真，环境反射自然。自上而下依次为：红灯、黄灯、绿灯。每个圆形灯面均由密集的 LED 点阵灯组成，排列成网格状，构成汉字「马」。LED 灯珠发出强烈的自发光，带有柔和的光晕，色彩鲜艳饱和，照明自然逼真。

背景：高饱和度亮玫瑰粉/洋红色纯色背景。高对比度的红黄绿色彩碰撞。金属哑光质感。整体细腻的哑光印刷颗粒纹理叠加。街头时尚视觉冲击力强。

排版布局（自上而下）：顶部居中粗体黑色无衬线中文「通行准则」+ 黑色大写英文「RULES GENERAL」+ 黄色色块（含黑色数字「2026」）；交通灯后方超大白色粗体做旧英文「GENERAL RULES」横跨整图，视觉冲击力极强且不遮挡交通灯主体；左侧竖条白色英文「RED LIGHT CHARGE FULLY CHARGE BUFF」；右侧竖条白色英文「THE GREEN LIGHT IS ON LET’S GO」；底部白色条与顶部布局对称——黑色中文、英文和黄色数字标识。

技术参数：杰作，最佳品质，8K 超高清，极致细节，C4D Octane 渲染，物理全局光照，低角度特写透视，色彩饱和度高且无溢出，无杂乱元素。
cases.prompt_en:
Portrait poster, psychedelic street-style design, hyper-realistic 3D render, C4D Octane rendering, physically-based global illumination, 8K ultra-HD.

Core visual: three vertical traffic lights stacked at the center, low-angle close-up. Silver-grey brushed metal housing, fine photoreal texture with natural environmental reflections. From top to bottom: red, yellow, green. Each circular lamp face is made of a dense LED dot matrix arranged in a grid, forming the Chinese character "马" (horse). LEDs emit strong self-illumination, soft halos, saturated and natural light.

Background: high-saturation bright rose pink / magenta flat color. High-contrast red-yellow-green color collision. Brushed metal matte finish with an overall fine matte print-grain texture. Strong street-fashion visual impact.

Layout (top to bottom): center top — bold black sans-serif Chinese "通行准则" + black uppercase English "RULES GENERAL" + yellow block with black "2026"; behind the traffic lights — oversized bold distressed white "GENERAL RULES" stretching across the whole image, strong impact without occluding the lights; left vertical strip — white uppercase "RED LIGHT CHARGE FULLY CHARGE BUFF"; right vertical strip — white uppercase "THE GREEN LIGHT IS ON LET’S GO"; bottom white bar mirrors the top — black Chinese, English, and yellow numeric markers.

Technical: masterpiece, best quality, 8K ultra-HD, extreme detail, C4D Octane, physical GI, low-angle close-up perspective, saturated colors without clipping, no clutter.

cases.title: 皮克斯风三国武将赵云
cases.title_en: Pixar-Style Three Kingdoms Warrior Zhao Yun
cases.subtitle: 3D 皮克斯电影级特写 + 龙纹绿甲 + 暖光酒馆氛围
cases.subtitle_en: Pixar 3D cinematic close-up + dragon-etched green armor + warm tavern ambience
cases.description:
皮克斯风中国武将最容易画崩的地方，是「塞进一堆中国元素就不像皮克斯了」——堆龙鳞、堆祥云、堆红灯笼，结果出来像游戏立绘而非角色。

这个案例只保留两件中国元素：龙纹绿甲与暖光酒馆，剩下的全部走皮克斯公式——粘土渲染质感、微妙胶片颗粒、柔和温暖的立体光影、浅景深、面积极端细致的面部特征。演员选了三国赵云作为主角，戏剧性电影级人像光影，8K Octane 渲染质量。产物为 Ardot 电影级特写人物海报。

适合做国风动画立项参考、国创 IP 角色设计、游戏宣发人物海报的美术与运营。
cases.description_en:
The easiest way for a Pixar-style Chinese warrior to fall apart is stuffing in every Chinese motif until it stops looking Pixar — piling on dragon scales, auspicious clouds and red lanterns until the result feels like a game portrait, not a Pixar character.

This case keeps only two Chinese elements: dragon-etched green armor and a warm tavern interior. Everything else follows the Pixar formula — clay-render surface, subtle film grain, soft warm dimensional lighting, shallow depth of field, extremely refined facial features. The lead is Zhao Yun from the Three Kingdoms, with dramatic cinematic portrait lighting at 8K Octane quality. Delivered as an Ardot cinematic character poster.

Great for art directors working on Chinese-animation pitches, original IP character design, or game-launch character posters.
cases.prompt: 皮克斯 3D 动画风格，以电影级特写镜头呈现三国时期年轻英俊的中国武将赵云，他头戴饰有精美龙纹的绿色龙形盔甲，身着带有金属光泽的层叠鳞甲，眼神锐利而坚定，神情庄重高贵，侧面投射出柔和温暖的立体光影，细腻的织物与抛光金属质感，具有微妙表面细节的粘土渲染质感，叠加了微妙的胶片颗粒感，浅景深，充满温暖感的古代中国酒馆室内背景，配有木梁和灯笼的柔和光晕，色彩鲜艳饱满，角色设计达到迪士尼·皮克斯动画的水准，面部特征极其细致，采用 8K Octane 渲染质量，具有戏剧性的电影级人像光影效果。
cases.prompt_en: Pixar 3D animation style, cinematic close-up of young, handsome Chinese Three Kingdoms warrior Zhao Yun, wearing a green dragon-shaped helmet with refined dragon carvings and layered scale armor with metallic sheen, sharp and determined eyes, dignified and noble expression, soft warm dimensional lighting from the side, fine fabric and polished metal textures, clay-render surface with subtle micro-detail, subtle film grain overlay, shallow depth of field, warm ancient Chinese tavern interior background with soft halo from wooden beams and lanterns, vivid and saturated colors, character design at Disney/Pixar level, extremely refined facial features, 8K Octane rendering quality, dramatic cinematic portrait lighting.

cases.title: 复古未来主义中国仙女
cases.subtitle: 超写实厚涂肌理 + 低角度俯冲 + 暗黑电影海报质感
cases.subtitle_en: Hyper-real impasto + low-angle dive + dark cinematic poster quality
cases.description:
国风仙女图最容易翻车的，是「美则美矣没气场」——飘飘欲仙但撑不起一张海报。

这个案例把「仙气」和「冲击力」同时拉满：复古未来主义插画风，金属质感与有机美感交织，超写实厚涂肌理、不对称构图、低角度仰拍仙女从空中俯冲面朝下。冷冽白皙肌肤、眉间美人痣、空灵眼神，繁复刺绣袖、深色编织纹理层层叠叠，裙摆被风吹起形成流动线条，闪耀金属饰品在风中熠熠生辉。背景融入中国传统纹样、经典色彩和抽象云纹，魅惑之美与神秘力量并存。整体暗黑、唯美、电影质感。产物为 Ardot 全镜 3D 海报。

适合做国风游戏宣发、东方奇幻 IP、暗黑风国潮海报的美术与设计师。
cases.description_en:
The most common failure for Chinese-fairy illustration is "beautiful but no presence" — flowing and ethereal, but unable to carry a poster.

This case maximizes both "fairy air" and visual impact: retro-futurism illustration style, metallic texture interwoven with organic beauty, hyper-real impasto, asymmetric composition, low-angle shot of the fairy diving face-down from the sky. Cool porcelain skin, beauty mark between brows, ethereal gaze, intricate embroidered sleeves, deep woven textures in layers, skirt blown by the wind into flowing lines, glittering metallic ornaments. Background blends Chinese traditional patterns, classic colors and abstract clouds — alluring beauty and mysterious power coexist. Dark, exquisite, cinematic. Delivered as an Ardot full-body 3D poster.

Great for art directors and designers working on Chinese-fantasy game launches, Eastern fantasy IPs, and dark Chinese-style posters.
cases.prompt:
复古未来主义插画风格，金属质感与有机美感交织，超写实的厚涂肌理，极致的细节刻画，不对称的构图，动感十足的画面。哑光质感与强烈的光影效果相得益彰，营造出震撼的视觉冲击力，极高的艺术张力和立体感，呈现出暗黑、唯美、电影般的海报风格。

画面中的人物是一位古代中国仙女：冷冽的白皙肌肤，盘起的发髻，眉间点缀一颗美人痣，五官精致，鼻梁高挺，妆容干净无瑕，散发着空灵的气息。每一根发丝都清晰可见，细节刻画得淋漓尽致。

低角度仰拍，仙女从空中飞翔俯冲，面朝下，双臂自然舒展，展现出强烈的动感和夸张的空间深度。她身着极其繁复华丽的服饰：宽大的柔软刺绣袖子，深色的编织纹理，层层叠叠的褶皱随风飘扬，裙摆被风吹起形成流畅的线条，飘逸的丝带，闪耀的金属饰品在风中熠熠生辉。全身镜头，3D 效果强烈，细节丰富震撼。

整体色调以橙色为主，服装采用高对比度色彩，增强视觉冲击力。背景融合了丰富的中国传统纹样、经典色彩和抽象云纹，营造出一种魅惑之美和神秘力量。画面完美无瑕，品质卓越，超逼真，艺术风格强烈，冲击力十足，极具电影质感。
cases.prompt_en:
Retro-futurism illustration style, metallic texture interwoven with organic beauty, hyper-real impasto, extreme detail, asymmetric composition, dynamic composition. Matte texture with strong light and shadow interplay, shocking visual impact, high artistic tension and three-dimensionality, presenting a dark, exquisite, cinematic poster style.

Subject: an ancient Chinese fairy — cool porcelain skin, coiled hair bun, a beauty mark between the brows, refined features with a high nose bridge, clean flawless makeup, ethereal presence. Every strand of hair is clearly visible, with thorough detail.

Low-angle upward shot, the fairy diving face-down from the sky with arms naturally outstretched, showing strong motion and exaggerated spatial depth. She wears an extremely elaborate and gorgeous outfit: wide soft embroidered sleeves, deep woven textures, layered pleats flowing in the wind, skirt blown up into flowing lines, drifting ribbons, glittering metallic ornaments shining in the wind. Full-body shot, strong 3D effect, rich and stunning detail.

Overall palette led by orange, with high-contrast costume colors to enhance visual impact. Background blends rich Chinese traditional patterns, classic colors and abstract clouds, creating an alluring beauty and mysterious power. The picture is flawless, outstanding quality, hyper-real, strong artistic style, powerful impact, with strong cinematic quality.

cases.title: 连衣裙 UGC 带货短视频
cases.subtitle: 竖屏 UGC + 自然光公寓 + 拆箱试穿真实肤质
cases.subtitle_en: Vertical UGC + natural-light apartment + unboxing try-on with realistic skin
cases.description:
女装带货短视频最容易翻车的，是「拍成 TVC 广告」——灯光过曝、模特皮肤磨到失真、动作像走秀，买家看了反而觉得「不像真人在穿」。

这个案例走真正的 UGC 路线：明亮的极简风格公寓，自然光线，轻松随性的网红风格，真实的肤质（无 AI 美化/过度打光），竖屏构图，手机全程不可见，实拍写实风格。镜头跟着拆箱取出连衣裙并试穿展示，全过程像闺蜜在家随手拍，有生活气息才有人下单。产物为 Ardot 15 秒竖屏 UGC 短视频。

适合做女装/服饰/家居小百货的短视频投放与种草内容。
cases.description_en:
The most common failure for women's apparel short-video ads is "shooting it like a TVC" — overexposed lighting, AI-smoothed skin that feels fake, runway-style motion. Buyers watch and think "no real person actually wears it like this."

This case goes full UGC: bright minimalist apartment, natural light, relaxed influencer vibe, realistic skin (no AI beautification / over-lighting), vertical composition, phone never visible, photoreal unpolished style. The camera follows the unboxing of a dress and a natural try-on showcase — feels like a friend casually filming at home, and that lived-in feel is what drives the buy. Delivered as an Ardot 15-second vertical UGC short video.

Great for short-video ad delivery and seeding campaigns for women's apparel, fashion, and home goods.
cases.prompt:
竖屏 UGC 广告短视频，明亮的极简风格公寓，自然光线，轻松随性的网红风格，真实的肤质（无 AI 美化/过度打光）。竖屏构图，手机全程不可见，实拍写实风格。

镜头跟着模特拆箱取出连衣裙并试穿展示：开箱→取出→抖开→贴身穿→转身→镜头特写面料与版型→正面展示整体效果。过程自然不刻意，动作真实有生活感。最后镜头落在连衣裙正面/侧面全身，便于买家判断上身效果。
cases.prompt_en:
Vertical UGC ad short video, bright minimalist apartment, natural lighting, easy-going influencer vibe, realistic skin texture (no AI beautification / over-lighting). Vertical composition, phone never visible, photoreal and candid style.

Camera follows the model unboxing the dress and trying it on: unbox → pull out → shake open → wear → turn → close-up of fabric and silhouette → full-front presentation of the overall look. Natural and unstaged, with real-life motion. Final shot lands on a front/side full-body view so buyers can judge the fit.

cases.title: 冻结时间：高原响指短片
cases.subtitle: 两步串行生图+生视频 + 冻屏穿行 + 雨珠凝视
cases.subtitle_en: Two-step serial image+video pipeline + frozen walkthrough + raindrop gaze
cases.description:
短视频里最炫的「冻结时间」特效，单独调一次可以，但「文生图直接串图生视频」往往人物会漂移——五官、发型、身材走样，整段片废掉。

这个案例用两步串行流水线锁住一致性：Step 1 先用胶片质感的精确提示词生成人物参考图（年轻亚裔女性、深棕黑长低马尾、黑色挂脖针织衫，浅景深 35mm 半身中景，全脸清晰无遮挡），Step 2 把这张参考图丢进视频生成工具，全程声明人物外貌与参考图严格一致，视频里主角在细雨高原草原起舞→响指冻结→穿行悬浮雨帘→凝视雨珠→再响指恢复时间。声效设计是核心：冻结前后是绵密雨声/草浪/风声/远雷，冻结期间彻底无声，恢复瞬间爆发回归。产物为 Ardot 约 15 秒电影质感短片。

适合需要「人物跨模态一致」的剧情短片、广告片、视觉特效 demo 的创作者与团队。
cases.description_en:
The flashiest "freeze time" effect in short video can be generated standalone — but piping text-to-image directly into image-to-video often drifts the character: face, hair and proportions warp, and the whole clip goes to waste.

This case locks consistency with a two-step serial pipeline: Step 1 generates a character reference image with a precise film-grade prompt (young Asian woman, dark-brown-black low ponytail, black halter knit top, 35mm shallow-DOF half-body, full face clearly visible), Step 2 feeds that reference into the video tool with an explicit declaration that the character's appearance stays strictly identical. The video has her dancing in light rain on a plateau grassland → snap to freeze → walk through suspended raindrops → gaze at a hovering drop → snap to restore. Sound design is the core: pre-freeze is dense rain / grass wave / wind / distant thunder, frozen frame is total silence, the restore moment explodes the soundscape back. Delivered as an Ardot ~15-second cinematic short.

Great for creators and teams who need cross-modal character consistency for narrative shorts, ads, or visual-effect demos.
cases.prompt:
完成一个两步生成流水线：人物参考图 → 视频。严格按顺序串行执行，Step 2 必须等 Step 1 完成，其输入依赖 Step 1 的输出。

Step 1｜文生图：人物参考图
调用图像生成工具，使用以下提示词生成人物参考图：
照片级写实人像，胶片拍摄质感，35mm 镜头，浅景深，半身中景，正面略偏 15 度。

【人物】年轻亚裔女性，二十七八岁，自然的深棕黑色长发，发质柔顺不蓬松，随性的低马尾配八字刘海，干净的鹅蛋脸，眉形清晰，双眼皮，眼神冷静有掌控感，淡妆，唇色为自然的哑光豆沙色，皮肤质感真实、可见细微毛孔与自然的面部油光，身材匀称偏瘦，肩线清晰。

【服装】黑色无袖挂脖针织上衣，领口简洁，深色修身牛仔裤，无任何品牌标识与图案。

【环境】辽阔的高原草原上，背景为虚化的灰绿色草浪与压得极低的平线，天空为厚重的深灰层积云并有一道云隙漏光，湿冷的冷青与灰绿色调，自然柔和的阴天散射光，人面部受光均匀无硬阴影，发梢被风轻轻带起。

【要求】人物全脸清晰可辨，五官无遮挡，双手自然下垂于身侧且完整可见，细节丰富的织物纹理，高动态范围，画面无文字无水印。

反向约束（务必加上）：不要假发感的头发，不要荧光或霓虹粉色头发，不要塑料质感皮肤，不要过度磨皮，不要夸张的大眼睛，不要畸形的手。

Step 2｜图生视频
将 Step 1 生成的人物参考图作为输入。视频中主角的外貌、发型、面部特征、服装与身体比例完全由该参考图定义。主角在细雨中的开阔高原草原上起舞，一个响指冻结时间——漫天雨滴与翻涌的草浪瞬间凝固，世界归于绝对寂静；她平静地穿过悬浮的雨帘，在一颗悬停的雨珠前驻足凝视、轻触，随后再打一个响指，时间恢复，风雨声轰然回归。

风格：实拍电影质感，胶片感、35mm 镜头、浅景深；冷青与灰绿色调，云隙漏下金色光作为点缀；约 15 秒。
声音设计是核心：冻结前后是绵密雨声、草浪声、风声与远雷，冻结期间彻底无声，恢复瞬间所有声音爆发式回归。人物外貌全程与参考图严格一致。

执行要求
1. 严格串行：Step 2 依赖 Step 1 的输出图。
2. 反向约束不可省略：Step 1 的提示词中必须附带完整的反向约束。
3. 人物一致性：视频中的人物必须与参考图为同一人，五官、发型、肤色、身材比例不得漂移。
cases.prompt_en:
Complete a two-step generation pipeline: character reference image → video. Execute strictly in sequence; Step 2 must wait for Step 1 and depend on its output.

Step 1 | Text-to-image: character reference
Call the image generation tool with the following prompt to generate a character reference:
Photoreal portrait, film-photography feel, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, half-body mid-shot, facing the camera turned ~15 degrees off-axis.

[Character] Young Asian woman, 27–28 years old, natural dark-brown-black hair, smooth and not puffy, a casual low ponytail with wispy bangs, clean oval face, defined brows, double eyelids, calm and commanding gaze, light makeup, natural matte dusty-rose lip color, realistic skin texture with visible fine pores and natural facial oil, slim and even build, defined shoulders.

[Outfit] Black sleeveless halter-neck knit top, clean neckline, dark skinny jeans, no brand marks or patterns.

[Environment] Open plateau grassland, blurred grey-green grass waves and a very low horizon, heavy dark-grey stratocumulus sky with a single beam of light through a cloud gap, cool cyan and grey-green tones, soft overcast diffuse light, even illumination on the face with no hard shadows, hair tips gently lifted by wind.

[Requirements] Full face clearly visible with no occlusions, both arms naturally at the sides and fully in frame, rich fabric texture, high dynamic range, no text or watermarks in the image.

Negative constraints (must include): no wig-feel hair, no fluorescent or neon-pink hair, no plastic skin, no over-smoothing, no exaggerated big eyes, no deformed hands.

Step 2 | Image-to-video
Use the Step 1 reference image as input. The protagonist's appearance, hair, facial features, outfit and body proportions are fully defined by this reference. She dances in light rain on an open plateau grassland, snaps her fingers to freeze time — suspended raindrops and surging grass waves instantly solidify, the world goes absolutely silent; she calmly walks through the suspended rain curtain, pauses in front of a hovering raindrop, gazes at it and lightly brushes it, snaps her fingers again, time restores, the wind and rain return with a roar.

Style: live-action cinematic, film feel, 35mm lens, shallow DOF; cool cyan and grey-green tones, a gold beam through the cloud gap as accent; ~15 seconds. Sound design is the core: pre-freeze dense rain, grass waves, wind and distant thunder; during freeze, total silence; the restore moment explosively returns all sounds. The protagonist's appearance stays strictly identical to the reference throughout.

Execution requirements
1. Strictly serial: Step 2 depends on the Step 1 output image.
2. Negative constraints cannot be omitted: Step 1's prompt must include the complete negative list.
3. Character consistency: the video protagonist must be the same person as the reference — face, hair, skin tone, body proportions must not drift.

cases.title: 机械腕表悬浮拆解短片
cases.subtitle: 三段式分镜 + 模板可换产品 + 72 小时动力
cases.subtitle_en: Three-shot storyboard + swappable product template + 72H power reserve
cases.description:
产品宣传片最容易翻车的，是「看起来炫但说不清卖点」——镜头花哨、节奏很快，但用户看完不知道这产品到底哪里好。

这个案例用三段式结构把卖点拆干净：Shot 1 极简深灰摄影棚微距特写——哑光深灰岩石台面、不锈钢表壳、深蓝太阳纹表盘、剑形指针指向十点十分、机芯滴答走时 + 表冠旋出咬合声；Shot 2 悬浮拆解视角——表镜浮离、表盘展开、机芯拆解、摆轮摆动、齿轮咬合、「72H / Automatic Movement」白色文字浮现；Shot 3 机芯归位回收、表壳高光扫过、表带折叠扣合拢。整个 12 秒结构化、可复用，换成键盘/相机/耳机只要把产品描述替换即可，节奏与声效规格不动。产物为 Ardot 12 秒 16:9 产品宣传短片。

适合需要「结构化产品宣传短片」的电商运营、硬件品牌、独立设计师产品发布。
cases.description_en:
The most common failure for a product video is "looks flashy but the selling points are unclear" — flashy camera moves and fast pace, but viewers walk away not knowing what actually makes the product good.

This case unpacks the selling points with a strict three-part structure: Shot 1 — minimalist dark-grey studio macro close-up: matte dark-grey rock platform, stainless steel case, deep-blue sunray dial, sword hands at 10:10, mechanism ticking plus crown unscrewing with ratchet clicks; Shot 2 — suspended disassembly POV: crystal floats up, dial unfolds, mechanism disassembles, balance wheel oscillates, gears mesh, white text "72H / Automatic Movement" emerges; Shot 3 — mechanism reassembles, case highlight sweeps, strap deployant clasp closes. The 12-second structure is fully reusable — swap watch for a keyboard / camera / earphones by replacing the product description; pacing and sound design stay identical. Delivered as an Ardot 12-second 16:9 product promo short.

Great for e-commerce operators, hardware brands, and indie designers who need structured product launch videos.
cases.prompt:
拍一条 12 秒的产品宣传片（默认机械腕表，可换机械键盘/胶片相机/无线耳机）。
模式：文生视频，时长 12 秒，画面比例 16:9。
提示词里不出现真实品牌与标识。

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] 实拍高端商业广告质感，深色极简摄影棚，哑光深灰岩石台面，背景为渐入黑色的无缝深灰墙面，一道细窄的定向侧光从画面右上方切入，配合左侧一片极弱的补光勾出轮廓。微距特写镜头框住一只圆形不锈钢表壳的机械腕表，静置于台面中央，抛光的表壳边缘反射出一道锐利的高光，深蓝色太阳纹表盘随角度泛起放射状的光泽，蓝宝石表镜通透无反光涂层眩光，细长的剑形指针指向十点十分，六点位有一枚下沉式小秒盘，棕色小牛皮表带自然弯曲垂落，表面无任何品牌标识与文字。相机以小幅度慢速向前推进，小秒盘的秒针以每秒八次的高频均匀跳动，表冠被一股无形的力量缓缓旋出并转动，带出一连串细密清脆的棘轮咬合声。

[Shot 2] 在 00:04.000，镜头切至悬浮拆解视角，相机以慢速环绕，腕表在半空中垂直升起并逐层分离：蓝宝石表镜向上浮离，深蓝表盘与指针随后升起并水平展开，露出下方完整的机械机芯——擦亮的摆轮以恒定频率持续左右摆动，齿轮组彼此咬合转动，发条盒缓慢释放，游丝呼吸般收放，各部件之间以极细的白色引线相连并各自缓慢自转。展开的结构体旁浮现出一行清晰的白色数字文字 "72H"，随后是一行小字 "Automatic Movement"。

[Shot 3] 在 00:08.500，镜头切至摆轮的极浅景深特写，相机保持静止，拆解的各层向内快速回收，机芯、表盘、表镜依次归位并合拢为完整腕表，抛光表壳的高光随之扫过一遍。腕表在半空中轻轻旋转半圈后落回岩石台面，棕色表带自动弯曲贴合并合上金属折叠扣，发出一声干脆利落的金属扣合声，小秒盘的秒针继续均匀跳动，画面缓缓淡入黑屏。

overall_soundscape: 全程为极干净的摄影棚静默底噪，几乎不含环境残响，安静得能听见机械运转的每一个细节。开场是机械机芯清晰而规律的高频滴答走时声，表冠旋转时是一连串细密清脆的棘轮咬合声。拆解升起时伴随极轻微的气流声与部件分离的细小金属摩擦声，机芯展开后摆轮的摆动声、齿轮咬合的细碎咬合声与发条缓慢释放的低频张力声层层叠加，蓝宝石表镜浮离时有一声通透的玻璃轻鸣。结构回收是一连串紧密的机械归位声，结尾是表带折叠扣干脆的金属扣合声，随后只剩下持续的滴答走时声渐远。

non_diegetic_music: 稀疏的低频合成器长音以缓慢速度铺底，配合几点冷调的金属质感点音，在机芯展开段落逐层增加声部密度并将节奏对齐到滴答走时的频率上，在表带扣合的瞬间收拢为一记干净的低频落点后迅速淡出。
cases.prompt_en:
Shoot a 12-second product promo (default mechanical watch; swappable to mechanical keyboard / film camera / wireless earphones). Mode: text-to-video, 12 seconds, 16:9. No real brands or marks appear.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Live-action high-end commercial quality, dark minimalist studio, matte dark-grey rock platform, background fading to black on seamless dark-grey wall, a narrow directional side light enters from the upper right with a faint fill on the left to outline the form. Macro close-up frames a round stainless-steel mechanical watch resting at the platform center; the polished case edge reflects a sharp highlight, the deep-blue sunray dial catches radial light at angles, the sapphire crystal is clean without anti-reflective coating glare, slim sword hands at 10:10, a recessed sub-seconds dial at 6 o'clock, brown calfskin strap curving naturally, no brand marks or text. The camera slowly pushes in with a small amplitude; the sub-seconds hand ticks at a high and even 8 Hz; the crown is slowly unscrewed and rotated by an invisible force, producing a crisp chain of ratchet clicks.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, cut to a suspended-disassembly POV, the camera orbits slowly while the watch rises and separates in layers: the sapphire crystal floats up, the deep-blue dial and hands then rise and unfold horizontally, revealing the full movement — polished balance wheel oscillating steadily, gear train meshing and rotating, mainspring barrel releasing slowly, hairspring breathing in and out, components linked by faint white threads and gently rotating. Beside the unfolded structure, clean white numeric text "72H" appears, followed by smaller text "Automatic Movement".

[Shot 3] At 00:08.500, cut to an extremely shallow-DOF close-up of the balance wheel, camera holds still; the separated layers rapidly reassemble, movement, dial and crystal snap back into a complete watch, and the polished case highlight sweeps once. The watch rotates half a turn in mid-air and lands back on the rock platform, the brown strap automatically curves and closes with a metallic deployant click, the sub-seconds hand keeps ticking evenly, and the frame slowly fades to black.

overall_soundscape: Throughout, an extremely clean studio silence floor with almost no room ambience — quiet enough to hear every mechanical detail. Open with the mechanism's high-frequency regular ticking; the crown rotation produces a crisp chain of ratchet clicks. During disassembly, faint airflow and small metallic friction sounds; once the movement is unfolded, layered balance-wheel oscillation, gear-mesh clicks and a low-frequency tension of the releasing mainspring; the crystal floating up produces one transparent glass note. Reassembly is a tight chain of mechanical returns; the closing strap deployant produces one clean metallic click; after that, only the continuing ticking fades into the distance.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse low-frequency synth pads slowly underpinning the bed, with a few cold metallic point sounds; during the movement unfolding, voice density gradually increases and aligns to the ticking frequency; on the strap-close moment, it converges into one clean low-end hit and quickly fades out.

cases.title: 餐桌对话短剧：早知与未说
cases.title_en: Dinner Drama: Already Known, Never Spoken
cases.subtitle: 文生图剧照 + 参考图生视频 + 中文台词唇形对齐
cases.subtitle_en: Text-to-image still + image-to-video with Chinese dialogue lip-sync
cases.description:
AI 短剧最容易翻车的，是「人物不一致 + 中文台词对不上嘴形」——同一个角色从开场到结尾脸都变了，口型还明显对不上，沉浸感瞬间崩塌。

这个案例用两步流水线锁住一致性与唇形：Step 1 用胶片日式怀旧风的精确提示词生成双人餐桌剧照（中年男性 + 年轻女性，各自端杯相碰，深灰西装 + 浅灰针织上衣，浅景深 16:9 横版），Step 2 把这张剧照丢进参考生成模式 + 中文台词唇形标签（<d>[Chinese]...</d>），三段对话分明——"这件事，我其实早就知道了" / "那你为什么一直不说？" / "因为我在等你自己开口。" 酒杯相碰瞬间淡出。声效包含餐厅包间底噪、餐具声、酒液晃动、终幕酒杯脆响；钢琴单音 + 低音大提琴在第三段铺满。产物为 Ardot 14 秒 16:9 短剧片段。

适合需要「中文唇形 + 人物跨镜头一致」的剧情短片、广告短剧、视觉小说的创作者。
cases.description_en:
The most common failure for AI short dramas is "inconsistent characters + Chinese dialogue not matching lip movement" — the same role looks different from start to finish, and the mouth movements obviously don't match, breaking immersion.

This case uses a two-step pipeline that locks consistency and lip sync: Step 1 generates a film-grade Japanese nostalgic-style two-person dinner-table still with a precise prompt (middle-aged man + young woman, each holding up a wine glass clinking, dark-grey suit + light-grey knit, shallow DOF 16:9); Step 2 feeds that still with reference-image mode + Chinese dialogue lip-sync tags (<d>[Chinese]...</d>). Three distinct dialogue beats — "这件事，我其实早就知道了" / "那你为什么一直不说？" / "因为我在等你自己开口" — culminate in the wine-glass clink fading out. Sound design layers restaurant-room ambience, tableware clinks, wine swirling, and the closing crystal-glass chime; piano single notes plus low cello build through the final segment. Delivered as an Ardot 14-second 16:9 drama clip.

Great for creators who need "Chinese lip-sync + cross-shot character consistency" for narrative shorts, branded dramas, or visual novels.
cases.prompt:
按以下 2 个步骤完成一条 14 秒餐桌对话短剧视频，步骤之间有依赖关系，请全程自动执行，不要跳步。

【步骤 1｜文生图：餐桌场景剧照】
调用文生图工具，严格使用以下提示词生成一张 16:9 的双人餐桌剧照。

提示词：
照片级写实电影剧照，Arri Alexa Mini 质感，35mm 胶片电影感，日式怀旧电影、低对比度，低饱和度、暖黄偏绿调色、柔焦晕光，浅景深，横版 16:9，横跨餐桌的双人中景。
【构图】相机位于餐桌一侧、略高于桌面，水平取景，画面左侧为一名中年男性、右侧为一名年轻女性，各自端起一只酒杯在桌面中央上方轻轻相碰，两只杯壁贴合，杯中红酒微微倾斜晃动，两人的手部完整可见。
【人物左】中年亚裔男性，四十五岁上下，短发略有花白，面容沉稳，鼻梁清晰，眼角有细纹，深灰色羊毛西装外套内搭深色衬衫，未系领带。
【人物右】年轻亚裔女性，二十七八岁，自然的深棕黑色长发，随性的低马尾配八字刘海，眼眶微微泛起水光但未落泪，浅灰色针织上衣。

【步骤 2｜参考图生视频 + 对话音频：生成 12 秒视频】
调用视频生成工具，使用参考生成视频模式，参考图使用第一步的图片，时长 14 秒，画面比例 16:9。

重要：
1. 以下提示词必须一字不改地完整传给视频生成工具，不要改写、不要总结、不要翻译；
2. 提示词中的 <d>[Chinese]台词</d> 是台词与语言标签的专用格式，必须原样保留，不要翻译、不要删改，这样才能保证中文唇形对齐。

提示词：
[Shot 1] 实拍电影质感，暖调的室内餐厅包间，一盏低垂的黄铜吊灯在餐桌上方投下集中的光锥，背景是虚焦的木质格栅与几点温暖的壁灯，浅景深。过肩中景镜头框住餐桌两侧相对而坐的两人，桌面上上摆着两杯红酒与几道已经动过的菜肴。相机以小幅度慢速向前推进。坐在左侧、嗓音低沉平稳、语速偏慢的中年男性 (S1) 放下手中的餐具，抬眼看向对面，说道：<d>[Chinese] 这件事，我其实早就知道了。</d> 他说完闭上嘴唇，将餐巾缓慢地折了一下放在桌沿。
[Shot 2] 在 00:04.500，镜头切至坐在右侧的年轻女性的中近景，相机保持静止。她握着酒杯的手指微微收紧，肩膀绷起，视线短暂地垂下又抬起。声音清亮但此刻压得很低、带着一丝迟疑的年轻女性 (S2) 说道：<d>[Chinese] 那你为什么一直不说？</d> 她说完抿住嘴唇，喉部轻微起伏。
[Shot 3] 在 00:08.000，镜头切至横跨餐桌的双人中景，相机以极小幅度缓慢向后拉开。左侧的中年男性 (S1) 端起酒杯，语气转为平缓而略带释然，说道：<d>[Chinese] 因为我在等你自己开口。</d> 他将酒杯向前递出半寸。右侧的年轻女性听完后先是一僵，随即眼眶泛起水光，缓慢地抬起自己的酒杯与他相碰，两只杯壁在灯光下贴合。相机在最后两秒停止移动，两人的坐姿、手部位置、酒杯的相碰角度、吊灯的光锥落点与整体构图逐步收窄差异，最终在第 12 秒精确落定于 <Picture 1> 建立的画面。

overall_soundscape: 餐厅包间的低沉房间底噪与远处隐约的人声嗡鸣全程持续。餐具轻放在瓷盘上的清脆碰响、餐巾布料折叠的摩擦声、酒液在杯中晃动的细微水声，以及结尾两只酒杯相碰时清亮悠长的一声脆响，构成主要的动作音；两人之间有几段明显的呼吸声与短暂的静默。

non_diegetic_music: 稀疏的钢琴单音以缓慢速度进入，中段叠入一层持续的低音大提琴，在第三段对话开始时音量逐渐增强，在酒杯相碰的瞬间达到最强后自然收束为一段单音余响。
cases.prompt_en:
Complete a 14-second dinner-table dialogue short drama in 2 dependent steps; execute the full flow automatically, no skipping.

[Step 1 | Text-to-image: dinner-table scene still]
Call the text-to-image tool and strictly use the following prompt to generate a 16:9 two-person dinner-table still.

Prompt:
Photoreal cinematic still, Arri Alexa Mini texture, 35mm film feel, Japanese nostalgic cinema, low contrast, low saturation, warm yellow-green grading, soft-focus halation, shallow DOF, horizontal 16:9, two-person mid-shot across the dinner table.
[Composition] Camera on one side of the table, slightly above tabletop, level framing; left side is a middle-aged man, right side a young woman, each raising a wine glass and gently clinking them above the center of the table, glasses touching, red wine tilting and sloshing slightly, both pairs of hands fully visible.
[Person left] Middle-aged Asian man, ~45, slightly greying short hair, composed face, defined nose bridge, fine lines at the eye corners, dark-grey wool suit over a dark shirt, no tie.
[Person right] Young Asian woman, 27–28, natural dark-brown-black hair, casual low ponytail with wispy bangs, eyes slightly glistening but no tears, light-grey knit top.

[Step 2 | Reference-image-to-video + dialogue audio: 12-second video]
Call the video tool with reference-image-to-video mode, using Step 1's image as the reference, duration 14 seconds, aspect 16:9.

Important:
1. The following prompt must be passed to the video tool verbatim — no rewriting, summarizing or translating;
2. <d>[Chinese]line</d> in the prompt is the dedicated dialogue-and-language tag — preserve exactly; do not translate or edit, to keep Chinese lip sync aligned.

Prompt:
[Shot 1] Live-action cinematic feel, warm-toned private dining room, a low brass chandelier casts a focused light cone over the table, blurred wooden lattice and a few warm wall lamps in the background, shallow DOF. Over-the-shoulder mid-shot framing the two facing each other across the table, two glasses of red wine and several dishes already started sit on the table. The camera slowly pushes in with small amplitude. On the left, the low, steady, slow-speaking middle-aged man (S1) puts down his cutlery, looks across, and says: <d>[Chinese] 这件事，我其实早就知道了。</d> He closes his lips and slowly folds the napkin once onto the table edge.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, cut to a medium close-up of the young woman on the right, camera holds. Her fingers tighten slightly around the glass, shoulders tense, gaze drops briefly then lifts. Bright but now very low, slightly hesitant young woman (S2) says: <d>[Chinese] 那你为什么一直不说？</d> She presses her lips, throat subtly moving.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, cut to a two-person mid-shot spanning the table, camera pulls back with very small amplitude. The middle-aged man (S1) on the left picks up his glass, tone turning calm and faintly relieved, says: <d>[Chinese] 因为我在等你自己开口。</d> He extends the glass forward half an inch. The young woman on the right freezes for a beat, eyes glistening, slowly lifts her glass to meet his, the two glasses touch under the light. In the final two seconds the camera stops moving, and the two postures, hand positions, glass angles, chandelier cone and overall composition gradually narrow their drift, finally locking exactly onto the frame established by <Picture 1> at second 12.

overall_soundscape: Low private-room hum and distant muffled chatter persist throughout. Cutlery clinking gently onto porcelain, the soft friction of a folded napkin, the subtle water sound of wine sloshing in a glass, and the closing clean long chime of two glasses touching form the main action sounds; clear breathing and brief silences between the two.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse piano single notes enter slowly; in the middle a sustained low cello is layered in; volume swells as the third dialogue begins, peaks on the glass-clink moment, then naturally resolves into a single-note after-ring.

cases.title: Lumé 护肤品牌 VI 全案
cases.subtitle: 天然成分定位 + 完整 VI 系统 + 高级感视觉
cases.subtitle_en: Natural-positioning full VI system + refined visual identity
cases.description:
新消费护肤品牌做 VI 最常踩的坑，是「先定调性再做系统」——花大量精力选主色调与字体，结果到落地物料才发现 Logo、瓶身、包装、宣传卡彼此对不上。

这个案例走「先定位、再体系、后延展」的顺序：定位天然成分护肤品牌 Lumé，整套视觉走高级感低饱和路线——瓶身/外盒/礼盒/标签/购物袋/小卡一气贯通，统一字体与配色（建议莫兰迪中性色 + 一抹草本绿做点缀），每一件物料单独拿得出手、摆在一起也成系列。产物为 Ardot 品牌全案设计稿（多件物料拼贴展示）。

适合做新锐护肤、香氛、家居洗护品牌的 VI 全案与首发物料设计的品牌主理人与设计师。
cases.description_en:
The most common pitfall when a new skincare brand builds its VI is "set the tone first, then the system" — heavy focus on picking primary colors and type, only to discover at production that the logo, bottles, packaging and cards don't actually cohere.

This case follows the sequence "position first, system second, extension third": positioning Lumé as a natural-ingredient skincare brand, the full visual identity follows a refined, low-saturation direction — bottles, outer cartons, gift boxes, labels, shopping bags and small cards all aligned, unified type and palette (a Morandi neutral base with a single herbal-green accent). Each piece stands alone and also reads as a series when placed together. Delivered as an Ardot full VI design (multi-asset composite).

Great for indie brand owners and designers building the launch VI and first-round assets for emerging skincare, fragrance, or home-care brands.
cases.prompt:
为以天然成分为特色的护肤品牌 Lumé 打造一套完整的视觉识别（VI）系统。

品牌定位：天然成分护肤，强调温和、有效、低负担；目标用户为 25–35 岁注重生活品质的都市女性。

视觉方向：高级感、低饱和路线，主色调建议莫兰迪中性色（米白/燕麦/灰粉/浅卡其），点缀一抹草本绿或淡金；字体建议中英文搭配——中文宋体或衬线体传达天然与高级，英文衬线/小标无衬线混排。

延展物料：Logo 主视觉、瓶身/外盒/礼盒/标签/购物袋/小卡/招贴，每一件单独成立、摆在一起成系列；统一字体与配色，Logo 在不同尺寸下保持识别度。

要求：视觉调性统一；高级感强；可生产落地；适合电商详情页与线下物料双场景。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a complete visual identity (VI) system for Lumé, a natural-ingredient skincare brand.

Brand positioning: natural-ingredient skincare, gentle, effective, low load; target users 25–35 urban women who care about quality of life.

Visual direction: refined, low-saturation route, primary palette suggested as Morandi neutrals (cream / oat / grey-pink / light khaki), with a single herbal-green or pale-gold accent; type pairing — Chinese serif to convey natural and refined, English serif / small sans-serif mix.

Extended assets: hero logo, bottle / outer carton / gift box / label / shopping bag / small card / poster, each piece stands alone and reads as a series when placed together; unified type and palette, logo remains recognizable at different sizes.

Requirements: unified visual tone; strong refinement; production-ready; works for both e-commerce detail pages and offline assets.

cases.title: Miora 宠物烘焙品牌视觉
cases.subtitle: 拟人化西高地白梗 IP + 手绘潮酷 + 包装延展
cases.subtitle_en: Anthropomorphic Westie IP + hand-drawn chic + packaging extensions
cases.description:
宠物品牌做视觉最容易踩的坑，是「可爱过头丢专业感」——堆满猫狗照片与粉嫩色调，物料摆出来像儿童零食，不像一个正经品牌。

这个案例用一个拟人化的西高地白梗（Westie）IP 贯穿所有物料——超大号手提袋、面包袋、贴纸页、餐垫、杯盖、密封贴纸、餐具套/包装，蓝绿撞红粉的潮酷配色 + 手绘草图风线条 + 随性手写体英文，所有物品平铺展示在纯净白底之上，现代而清新，专业品牌形象，水准对得起品牌设计作品集。产物为 Ardot 16:9 品牌识别系统海报。

适合做宠物烘焙、宠物鲜食、宠物生活方式品牌的视觉系统与首发延展。
cases.description_en:
The most common pitfall for pet-brand visuals is "too cute, loses professionalism" — stacked with cat/dog photos and pink palettes, the assets read like kids' snacks rather than a serious brand.

This case threads a single anthropomorphic Westie IP through every asset — oversized shopping bag, bread bag, sticker sheet, placemat, cup lid, sealing sticker, cutlery/packaging set, blue-green with red-pink chic color collision + hand-drawn sketch line quality + casual handwritten English type. All items laid flat on a pure white ground — modern and fresh, with portfolio-grade brand design. Delivered as an Ardot 16:9 brand identity poster.

Great for pet bakery, fresh pet food, and pet-lifestyle brands building their visual system and launch extensions.
cases.prompt:
为名为「Miora」的宠物烘焙品牌设计的一款专业品牌识别系统海报，融合前卫的手绘插画风格与现代美学元素，采用上下分隔的版式构图，背景为纯净的白色。

上半部分：核心包装材料以错落有致的布局巧妙陈列，包括一个超大号手提袋、面包袋和贴纸页。所有商品均统一印有可爱的西高地白梗（Westie）卡通插画，品牌名称「Miora」醒目地印在上面。蓝绿色与红粉色的撞色搭配，传达出「有机、纯天然」的品牌理念。西高地白梗角色被拟人化了——可爱、活泼，部分款式中还戴着小小的面包师帽或系着围裙。所有设计均采用手绘草图般的线条风格。

下半部分：展示了扩展的品牌宣传物料——餐垫、杯盖、密封贴纸、餐具套/包装。所有物品均延续了同样可爱的西高地白梗犬插画风格和品牌文案，强化了视觉品牌形象的一致性。物品采用平铺式布局呈现。

主色调：以绿色、蓝色和白色为主色，红色和粉色作为点缀色。字体采用随性的手写体英文字体风格——充满趣味、不拘一格，且富有自然质感。拟人化的西高地白梗犬作为核心视觉符号贯穿于所有宣传物料中。

整体美学风格：前卫、吸睛、时尚的宠物烘焙品牌视觉氛围。产品摄影风格简洁，略带杂志版式设计质感。纯净的白色背景，柔和均匀的摄影棚灯光，物品投射出微妙的阴影。专业品牌形象呈现，现代而清新，吸引年轻的宠物主人。具备高端品牌设计作品集的水准，每件物品的材质渲染都极其精细，8K 级清晰度。
cases.prompt_en:
Design a professional brand identity poster for a pet bakery brand "Miora", blending avant-garde hand-drawn illustration with modern aesthetics, using a top-bottom split layout on a pure white ground.

Top: core packaging materials artfully arranged — oversized shopping bag, bread bag, sticker sheet. Every item printed with the cute Westie (West Highland White Terrier) cartoon illustration and the bold "Miora" brand name. Blue-green with red-pink color collision conveys "organic, all-natural" brand philosophy. The Westie character is anthropomorphized — cute and lively, in some variants wearing a tiny baker's hat or apron. All designs use a hand-drawn sketch line style.

Bottom: extended brand communication materials — placemat, cup lid, sealing sticker, cutlery/packaging set. All items continue the same Westie illustration style and brand copy, reinforcing visual brand consistency. Items laid flat.

Primary palette: green, blue, white, with red and pink as accents. Type is a casual handwritten English style — fun, unconventional, with natural texture. The anthropomorphic Westie runs through all communication as the core visual motif.

Overall aesthetic: avant-garde, eye-catching, fashionable pet-bakery brand atmosphere. Product photography style is clean with a magazine-layout feel. Pure white background, soft even studio lighting, subtle shadows. Professional brand presentation — modern and fresh, appealing to young pet owners. Portfolio-grade brand design, every material rendered with extreme refinement, 8K clarity.

cases.title: SPORT5 潮鞋社媒运营模板
cases.subtitle: 故事模板 3 款 + 视频封面 2 款 + 街头潮牌几何 5 字标
cases.subtitle_en: 3 story templates + 2 video cover templates + street brand geometric "5" mark
cases.description:
潮鞋品牌做社媒模板最容易踩的坑，是「每张图都是单独的设计」——风格忽冷忽热、字体忽大忽小，粉丝刷到看不出是同一个品牌。

这个案例把所有模板锁在同一套品牌语言里：左侧栏 3 款手机框架内的故事模板——「NEW DROP」喷漆柠檬黄新品发布、「运动员专题」电光紫速度线、「选择哪款配色？」柠檬黄投票条；右侧栏 2 张视频封面卡片——「打破第五面墙」黑底几何 5 标、「正在加载...」白底紫水印 55% 进度条。统一品牌标识：带斜线的几何「5」字标贯穿；超粗无衬线字体；黑底电光紫与荧光柠檬黄色块；模板/喷漆纹理点缀；所有文本与 UI 元素均为英文。产物为 Ardot 社媒运营模板组合（左侧 3 款手机 + 右侧 2 张卡片）。

适合做潮鞋/街头服饰/潮流集合店的 Instagram/小红书/TikTok 模板与日常发布。
cases.description_en:
The most common pitfall for sneaker-brand social templates is "every image is its own design" — styles swing hot and cold, type jumps in size, and fans scrolling can't tell it's the same brand.

This case locks all templates into one brand language: left column — 3 phone-frame story templates: "NEW DROP" spray-paint lemon yellow launch, "Athlete Feature" electric-purple speed lines, "Pick the colorway?" lemon-yellow vote bar; right column — 2 video cover cards: "Break the Fifth Wall" black-ground geometric "5" mark, "Loading..." white-ground purple watermark with 55% progress bar. Unified brand identity: the diagonal-stroke geometric "5" mark runs throughout; ultra-bold sans-serif type; black-ground electric purple plus fluorescent lemon yellow blocks; stencil/spray-paint texture accents; all text and UI elements in English. Delivered as an Ardot social media template set (3 phones on the left, 2 cards on the right).

Great for sneaker / streetwear / streetwear-resale stores building Instagram / Xiaohongshu / TikTok templates and daily posts.
cases.prompt:
为街头潮鞋品牌「SPORT5」设计的社交媒体运营模板。所有模板必须统一使用参考图片中的品牌标识（带有斜线的几何「5」字）。
背景为简洁的白色背景。

左侧栏——故事模板（3 款手机模型，均置于逼真的智能手机框架内，包含屏幕边框、状态栏和主屏幕指示器）：每款手机模型均以 9:16 的比例在框架内显示全屏故事。请展示三种不同的故事屏幕设计：
1. 新品发布公告：深黑色背景，醒目的荧光柠檬色「NEW DROP」字样，带有喷漆纹理，运动鞋轮廓居中，角落处有紫色「5」字标识，以及倒计时元素。
2. 运动员专题报道：亮紫色背景，醒目的白色运动员动作文字，几何速度线，底部有「SPORT5」字样，以及模板叠加纹理。
3. 互动投票：黑色/紫色背景呈对角线分割（与标识的斜线相呼应），标题为「选择哪款配色？」」互动问题，两款运动鞋选项，柠檬黄投票条指示器。

右侧栏——视频封面模板（2 张卡片，以扁平化设计卡片形式展示，无手机边框）：
1. 醒目的「打破第五面墙」标语，黑色背景中央带有几何「5」标记，柠檬黄斜线边框；
2. 极简白色布局，带有大型紫色「5」水印，「正在加载...」状态文字，柠檬黄进度条显示 55%。

风格：原始街头服饰平面设计，超粗无衬线字体，黑色背景上的电光紫和荧光柠檬黄色块，以及模板/喷漆纹理点缀。展现青年街头文化美学。所有文本标签和 UI 元素均为英文。
cases.prompt_en:
Design social media templates for the street-sneaker brand "SPORT5". All templates must consistently use the reference logo (geometric "5" with a diagonal stroke). Clean white background.

Left column — story templates (3 phone mockups, placed in realistic smartphone frames with screen borders, status bars and home indicators): each phone shows a fullscreen story at 9:16. Show three distinct story screens:
1. New drop announcement: deep black background, bold fluorescent lemon-yellow "NEW DROP" with spray-paint texture, sneaker silhouette centered, purple "5" mark in a corner, countdown elements.
2. Athlete feature: bright purple background, bold white athlete-action type, geometric speed lines, "SPORT5" wordmark at bottom, stencil overlay texture.
3. Interactive poll: black/purple diagonal-split background (echoing the diagonal stroke of the mark), headline "Pick the colorway?", two sneaker options, lemon-yellow vote bar indicator.

Right column — video cover templates (2 flat-design cards, no phone frame):
1. Bold headline "Break the Fifth Wall", geometric "5" mark centered on black, lemon-yellow diagonal border.
2. Minimal white ground, large purple "5" watermark, "Loading..." status text, lemon-yellow progress bar at 55%.

Style: raw streetwear graphic design, ultra-bold sans-serif, electric purple and fluorescent lemon-yellow blocks on black, with stencil/spray-paint texture accents. Expresses youth street culture. All text labels and UI elements in English.

cases.title: Q 版 3D IP · SMALL DUMBO 小象
cases.subtitle: 软胶毛绒治愈系 + 多表情合集 + 周边延展展板
cases.subtitle_en: Soft plush healing system + multi-expression sheet + merch extension board
cases.description:
IP 设计最容易踩的坑，是「主形象好看但延展性差」——单独看很萌，一落到工牌/徽章/和纸胶带/包装上就变形。

这个案例把 IP 当产品系统来做：浅蓝小象「SMALL DUMBO」头戴米色小帽子，软胶 + 毛绒可爱、圆润，浅蓝主色 + 白色 + 米色等马卡龙浅色系，治愈感强。主形象下方附多表情合集（开心、惊讶、生气、羞涩）展示 IP 的情绪承载能力；下部展板展示周边应用库——工牌、徽章、和纸胶带、cosplay 包装、卡片，所有物料统一小象 IP 元素。风格统一、细节精致，柔和的色调强烈，色彩简洁，商业 IP 展示展板，干净整洁，高清 3D 渲染。产物为 Ardot Q 版 3D IP 设计展板。

适合做新锐 IP、潮玩、萌系周边、治愈系品牌主理人的 IP 立项与首发延展。
cases.description_en:
The most common pitfall in IP design is "the hero looks great but the extensions break" — charming on its own, but distorted the moment it lands on a badge / washi tape / packaging.

This case treats the IP as a product system: light-blue elephant "SMALL DUMBO" wearing a beige small hat, soft vinyl + plush cute, rounded, light-blue as the primary color with white, beige and other macaron pastels — strongly healing. A multi-expression sheet under the hero (happy, surprised, angry, shy) demonstrates the IP's emotional range; the lower panel shows the merch library — name badge, pin, washi tape, cosplay packaging, card — every asset unified with the elephant motif. Consistent style, refined detail, soft strong palette, simple colors, commercial IP presentation board, clean and crisp, HD 3D render. Delivered as an Ardot chibi 3D IP design board.

Great for indie IP, designer toys, kawaii merch, and healing-brand owners building IP pitches and launch extensions.
cases.prompt:
Q 版萌系 3D IP 设计，主体是浅蓝小象 IP 形象「SMALL DUMBO」，头戴米色小帽子，软胶 + 毛绒可爱，圆润。整体以浅蓝为主，搭配白色、米色等马卡龙浅色系，治愈。

多表情合集（开心、惊讶、生气、羞涩）；下部：系列周边应用库存展示，包括工牌、徽章、和纸胶带、cosplay 包装、牌等，所有码头统一小象 IP 元素。

风格统一、细节精致，柔和的色调强烈，色彩简洁，商业 IP 展示展板，干净整洁，高清，3D 渲染，C4D，Octane 渲染。
cases.prompt_en:
Chibi kawaii 3D IP design, hero is the light-blue elephant IP "SMALL DUMBO" wearing a beige small hat, soft vinyl + plush cute, rounded. Overall light-blue primary, paired with white, beige and other macaron pastels, healing.

Multi-expression sheet (happy, surprised, angry, shy); lower section: series merch library — name badge, pin, washi tape, cosplay packaging, card, every item unified with the elephant motif.

Consistent style, refined detail, strong soft palette, simple colors, commercial IP presentation board, clean and crisp, HD, 3D render, C4D, Octane rendering.

cases.title: AI 红发魔女的工作台
cases.subtitle: 3D 沉浸式创作者小屋：7 房间 × 角色内容 × 跨设备存档
cases.subtitle_en: A 3D immersive cottage — 7 rooms, character-driven content, cross-device save
cases.description:
创作者的灵感、计划、内容进度、数据复盘散落在十几个工具里，每次切换都丢失状态；用普通 To-Do 表格又干巴无趣，缺少陪伴感。

这个案例把创作者日常全部收进一座可自由穿梭的 3D 温馨村屋：7 个原生 .dialog 小屋房间——卧室（每日计划）、客厅（选题灵感）、办公室（内容进度）、花园（健身计划）、厨房（数据复盘）、旅行码头（环游世界）、资产库（创作资产）。主理人是「红发魔女」女巫，可换装换昵称，不同角色在每个小屋看到的内容不同；资料库 4 张表驱动数据（房间定义 / 角色×房间内容 / 创作资产 / 用户存档），存档跨设备同步；点开房间就是原生 .dialog 面板，底部挂增删改查入口。3D 场景用 three.js 加载 cottage / witch / 猫狗羊驼等 glb 模型，花草、蘑菇、围栏、石灯笼装点；无资料库环境可降级到内置样本照常运行。最终发布为 WorkBuddy 在线 Page，分享出 workbuddy.link 链接。

适合博主 / UP 主 / 独立创作者、内容运营、想养成系工作流的个人。
cases.description_en:
Creator work — inspiration, plans, content progress, data reviews — fragments across a dozen tools, and switching between them always loses state. Plain to-do tables feel sterile and lack companionship.

This case folds the whole creator routine into a freely navigable 3D cozy cottage: 7 native .dialog rooms — Bedroom (daily plan), Living Room (idea inbox), Office (content pipeline), Garden (fitness plan), Kitchen (data review), Travel Dock (world travel), and Asset Library (creator assets). The default host is a red-haired witch who can change outfits and nicknames; different characters see different content in each room. A 4-table workspace (room definitions / character×room content / creator assets / user saves) drives data and syncs across devices. Each room opens to a native .dialog panel with a built-in CRUD entry on its footer. The 3D scene uses three.js to load cottage / witch / cat / dog / alpaca glb models, with flowers, mushrooms, fences and lanterns scattered around; it falls back to built-in samples when no workspace SDK is available. Final delivery is a WorkBuddy online page shared via a workbuddy.link URL.

Best for bloggers, uploaders and independent creators, content operators, and individuals who want a gamified growing workflow.
